title: Principal Analyst - Global Power Market
description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.
  
  
For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.
  
  
Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.
  
  
By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.
  
  
This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.
  
  
Wood Mackenzie
  
  
Intelligence Connected
  
  
**WoodMac.com**
**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**
**Wood Mackenzie Values**

* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action

**The Role**
We are seeking a
**Principal Analyst**
to lead our South Asia Power & Renewables research practice in Gurugram, India. This is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping the regional research agenda, managing and mentoring a team of analysts, overseeing power market modelling and research outputs, and serving as a trusted advisor to clients across the energy sector.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in South Asian power markets and be responsible for driving high-quality research, market analysis, policy and regulatory insights, and long-term market outlooks. They will play a central role in ensuring our research remains at the forefront of industry developments, helping clients navigate the evolving power sector landscape and supporting strategic decision-making across generation, renewables, storage, transmission, and power markets.
  
  
As a Principal Analyst, you will lead research and analysis across five core areas:
  
  

* Defining and executing the South Asia power market research agenda, identifying key themes, emerging trends, and strategic market developments.
* Leading market research and analysis to track supply, demand, investment, technology, and commercial trends across South Asian power markets.
* Overseeing policy and regulatory analysis, assessing the impact of market reforms, capacity mechanisms, ancillary markets, renewable integration policies, transmission developments, and decarbonization initiatives.
* Guiding the development and application of regional power market models to produce robust price, generation, emissions, storage, and technology outlooks.
* Translating market intelligence and model outputs into compelling insights, thought leadership, and client-facing research that informs strategic investment and commercial decisions.

The role requires significant interaction with clients and industry stakeholders. You will lead client briefings, respond to complex market questions, present research findings, and support commercial activities through thought leadership and relationship management. You will also work closely with our global research, modelling, and consulting teams to ensure consistency and excellence across our analytical offerings.
  
  
This position offers the opportunity to influence industry dialogue, develop junior talent, and establish yourself as a leading voice in South Asia's rapidly evolving power and renewable energy landscape.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Research Leadership & Thought Leadership**

* Lead the South Asia power market research agenda and identify strategic research priorities.
* Develop market views and analytical frameworks covering power, renewables, storage, flexibility, transmission, and decarbonization.
* Produce and oversee high-impact research publications, market outlooks, thematic reports, and thought leadership pieces.
* Ensure research outputs remain relevant, commercially valuable, and aligned with evolving client needs.
* Represent the company externally through industry conferences, webinars, workshops, and media engagements.

**Market Analysis & Modelling**

* Oversee power market modelling activities and ensure analytical robustness across market forecasts and scenarios.
* Guide analysis of power demand, generation, renewable deployment, storage economics, transmission, and market prices.
* Evaluate the implications of regulatory changes, policy developments, and market reforms on future market outcomes.
* Drive continuous improvement in modelling methodologies, assumptions, and analytical processes.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Manage, mentor, and develop a team of analysts and senior analysts.
* Provide technical guidance, quality assurance, and professional development support.
* Foster a collaborative and high-performance team culture.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, training, and capability-building initiatives.

**Client Engagement & Commercial Support**

* Act as a senior point of contact for client questions and market inquiries.
* Lead client briefings, presentations, workshops, and strategic discussions.
* Translate complex market developments into clear and actionable insights for clients.
* Support business development activities, including proposals, client meetings, and commercial discussions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, industry participants, regulators, and policymakers.

**Quality Assurance & Research Excellence**

* Review and approve research outputs, ensuring consistency, accuracy, and analytical rigor.
* Maintain high editorial standards across regional publications.
* Identify opportunities to enhance research products, modelling capabilities, and client offerings.
* Ensure research processes and methodologies remain industry-leading.

**Requirements**
**Intellectual Curiosity & Leadership**

* Strong intellectual curiosity and passion for energy markets.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex research programs and develop market insights.
* Collaborative leadership style with a track record of mentoring and developing teams.
* Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Client-focused mindset with a strong commitment to delivering impactful insights and exceptional service.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Economics, Energy Studies, Finance, Public Policy, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience within a utility, power developer, consultancy, research provider, market intelligence company, university, think tank, investment firm, or other energy-focused organization.
* Deep expertise in Indian power markets and strong knowledge of broader South Asian electricity markets.
* Proven experience leading research projects, market analysis, forecasting, or consulting engagements.
* Demonstrated experience managing and mentoring analysts or research teams.
* Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities, including power market modelling, commercial analysis, or market forecasting.
* Experience with optimization and dispatch models such as Plexos, Aurora, SDDP, or equivalent tools is highly desirable.
* Strong experience working with large datasets, databases, APIs, and analytical tools including Python, SQL, and Power BI/Power Query.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Deep understanding of power market fundamentals and renewable energy market dynamics.
* Strong knowledge of electricity market design, generation economics, transmission systems, storage technologies, and market reforms.
* Expertise in policy and regulatory frameworks across India and South Asia.
* Strong understanding of capacity markets, ancillary services, power purchase agreements, renewable support mechanisms, grid integration challenges, and energy transition pathways.
* Familiarity with investment decision-making, market risk assessment, and commercial strategy within power markets.
* Ability to connect technical analysis with commercial and strategic implications for clients.

**Communication & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Proven ability to write, review, and edit high-quality research reports and client-facing publications.
* Strong presentation skills and confidence engaging with senior stakeholders and executive audiences.
* Experience leading client briefings, workshops, webinars, and conference presentations.
* Ability to explain complex modelling outputs and market developments clearly and concisely.
* Fluency in additional South Asian languages is an advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A recognized thought leader in South Asian power markets.
* Delivery of industry-leading research and market insights.
* Strong client satisfaction and engagement across the research portfolio.
* A high-performing, motivated, and well-developed analyst team.
* Continued growth and enhancement of the South Asia research offering and market presence.

**Equal Opportunities**
We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov

title: Senior Associate - Rewards
description:
The Opportunity

As a Senior Associate, you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build meaningful client connections, and guide junior team members while developing a deeper understanding of the business context within our Workforce Consulting practice. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will interpret market and organizational data, translate workforce insights into practical recommendations, contribute to client proposals and thought leadership, and help advance rewards solutions that align with client strategy, culture, and performance goals.

* Analyzing compensation, benefits, and incentive data to support client workforce strategies

* Assessing compensation practices against policy, culture, and regulatory requirements
* Preparing reports, presentations, and financial materials that summarize findings and recommendations

What You Must Have
  
  

* Relevant experience of 4 to 7 years in Total Rewards

What Sets You Apart

* Demonstrate strong collaboration, independent ownership, and a commitment to innovation, while fostering efficient ways of working and continuously enhancing expertise through Rewards-focused certifications.

* Benchmarking market compensation data and interpreting workforce trends

* Translating client leadership insights into actionable rewards recommendations
* Using financial planning, reporting, and equity valuation tools
* Leading complex rewards analyses across multiple client workstreams
* Mentoring junior team members while navigating ambiguous client needs

title: Revenue Operations Analyst Intern
description:
**Location:**
Kolkata, India
  
  
**Shift:**
3:00 PM – 12:00 AM IST (US Shift)
  
  
**Experience:**
Fresher / Final-year student; relevant projects or internship experience is a plus
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time Internship
  
  
**Work Mode:**
Work From Office (WFO)
  
  
**Company Overview**
NetCom Learning, a part of the
**Sarder Ecosystem**
, is a global leader in IT and business skills training, empowering individuals and organizations through world-class learning solutions. We are committed to fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning while helping organizations build future-ready workforces.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented
**Revenue Operations Analyst Intern**
to work closely with our Marketing and Revenue Operations teams. The role involves tracking marketing leads through the funnel — from Lead to Meeting, Proposal, and Revenue — to identify conversion trends, data discrepancies, and opportunities for improvement.
  
  
The ideal candidate enjoys working with numbers, is proficient in Excel, and can translate data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Track marketing leads across the funnel: Lead → Meeting → Proposal → Revenue.
* Calculate and monitor conversion rates at each stage.
* Identify lead drop-offs, conversion trends, and performance changes across weeks, months, and quarters.
* Analyze lead sources, segments, and campaigns to understand their contribution to pipeline and revenue.
* Prepare and maintain weekly and monthly reports and basic dashboards.
* Clean and audit CRM data for duplicates, missing fields, incorrect stages, and unassigned leads.
* Ensure lead lifecycle stages and dates are recorded accurately.
* Investigate unusual changes in conversion rates and highlight potential causes.
* Share insights and recommend practical improvements to Marketing and RevOps teams.

**Qualifications**

* Recent graduate or final-year student in Commerce, Business, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong Excel skills, including SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, IF, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, filters, and basic charts.
* Comfortable working with numbers, percentages, conversion rates, and month-on-month comparisons.
* Basic understanding of marketing funnels, lead generation, and lead conversion.
* Ability to identify trends, patterns, and inconsistencies in data.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to learn CRM and marketing automation tools.

**Preferred Skills**

* Basic SQL knowledge, including SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, and simple JOINs.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
* Exposure to CRM or marketing automation platforms such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Marketo.
* Understanding of marketing analytics concepts such as MQL, SQL, pipeline, win rate, and attribution.
* Experience with reporting, dashboards, academic projects, or data analysis internships.

**Tools / Platforms**

* Microsoft Excel: Daily reporting, data cleaning, and analysis.
* CRM & Marketing Automation: Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Marketo.
* Power BI: Dashboard creation and reporting.
* SQL: Basic data extraction and analysis.
* Microsoft 365: Teams, Outlook, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.

**What You'll Learn**

* How a B2B sales funnel works, from the first lead to a signed deal.
* How Marketing, Sales, and RevOps collaborate and manage lead handoffs.
* How CRM data is structured, maintained, and audited.
* How to build effective reports and dashboards.
* How to translate data analysis into actionable recommendations.
* Practical exposure to Power BI and SQL, with training provided where needed.

**Why Join NetCom Learning?**

* Opportunity to work with a globally recognized learning organization and be part of the Sarder Ecosystem.
* Hands-on exposure to marketing analytics, revenue operations, and business analysis.
* Opportunity to work with real-world CRM data, reports, and dashboards.
* Collaborative work environment with opportunities to learn from Marketing and RevOps teams.
* Practical training in reporting, data analysis, Power BI, SQL, and CRM platforms.
* Opportunity to contribute to business decisions by identifying conversion gaps and revenue opportunities.

If you're passionate about
**data analysis, business insights, and understanding how marketing contributes to revenue**
, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**Apply today and become a part of the NetCom Learning team!**

title: Performance Marketer
description:
**Company Description**
Marcadors helps ambitious businesses transform disconnected or unclear marketing into focused, effective growth systems. The company specializes in brand clarity, aligning positioning across websites, pitches, and social channels so organizations communicate their value quickly and convincingly.

Marcadors supports clients by becoming an extension of their marketing team, managing execution and content production while leaders focus on scaling their business. With experience across multiple industries, Marcadors brings tested strategies that improve lead generation, visibility, and conversions, reducing guesswork and wasted spend. The team is committed to delivering measurable results through structured, data-informed marketing solutions.

**Role Description**

This is a full-time, remote then hybrid Performance Marketer role based in Kolkata. The Performance Marketer will plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across channels such as search, social, and display to drive leads, conversions, and revenue for clients.

Day-to-day responsibilities include setting up and managing ad campaigns, tracking performance metrics, running A/B tests, and improving targeting, creatives, and landing pages based on data.

The role involves collaborating with brand, content, and design teams to ensure messaging alignment and consistent execution, as well as preparing regular performance reports and insights for internal stakeholders and clients.

The Performance Marketer will also identify new growth opportunities, refine marketing funnels, and maintain best practices for budget management and attribution.

**Qualifications**

* Strong performance marketing skills, including experience with paid search, paid social, and display advertising, with the ability to optimize campaigns for ROI and conversions.
* Data and analytics skills, such as comfort with tracking tools, dashboards, and A/B testing, and the ability to interpret metrics and translate them into actionable strategies.
* Foundational marketing knowledge, including understanding of marketing funnels, audience segmentation, positioning, and conversion rate optimization.
* Collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work closely with content, design, and strategy teams and present performance insights clearly to stakeholders.
* Proficiency with common ad platforms and analytics tools (for example, Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics or similar), and familiarity with landing page or marketing automation tools.
* Relevant academic background such as a degree or certification in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ability to work on-site in Kolkata, manage multiple campaigns concurrently, and adapt quickly in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment.
* Experience in agency or multi-client environments and exposure to different industries is a plus.

title: Staff Applied Scientist
description:
**Take your career to new heights with Loopio! 🚀✨**
We’re hiring a
**Staff Applied Scientist**
to help build the knowledge and AI foundation behind Loopio’s products.
  
  
This role is for someone who has built knowledge graphs and AI agents in production and wants to own the science behind them. As a Staff-level scientist, you’ll also set technical direction, mentor senior talent, and shape how applied ML is done across the team.
  
  
This role requires close collaboration with teams across Canada, the UK, and India. To accommodate the time zone differences, you will be expected to work from 11 am - 7:30 pm IST.
  
  
This is a remote-first role where you can work from anywhere in India.
  
  
**💻 What You’ll Be Doing**
**Applied Science**

* Design and build knowledge graphs that turn unstructured content into structured, reliable knowledge.
* Build agents and agentic retrieval systems that find, check, and use that knowledge.
* Use feedback from real users to keep knowledge accurate and improve results over time.
* Define how we measure quality, and use those measures to decide what ships.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Set technical direction and make build vs. buy calls on tools and approaches.
* Work with Product, Engineering, and other AI teams to turn research into features customers use.
* Mentor engineers and data scientists, and set the standards for how the team runs experiments and ships models.

**✨ What You’ll Bring To The Team**
**ML, NLP & Evaluation**

* 8+ years applying ML in production.
* Strong background in NLP and LLMs. Experience with RAG is expected.
* Experience with finetuning LLM and classical ML is expected.
* Track record of designing evaluations and using them to decide what ships.

**Knowledge Graphs & Agents**

* 3+ years building knowledge graphs in production, including ontology design, information extraction, and entity resolution.
* Experience with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j) and query languages like Cypher.
* 3+ years building LLM-based agents in production, including planning, tool use, and orchestration.
* Experience making agents reliable through evaluation, guardrails, and human review.

**Engineering & Leadership**

* Strong Python and software engineering skills, with experience shipping ML services to production.
* Experience setting technical direction and mentoring senior engineers and data scientists.
* Ability to explain technical trade-offs in terms of customer value.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with graph neural networks or knowledge graph embeddings.
* Published work or open-source contributions in knowledge graphs, information extraction, or agents.

**Where You’ll Work 📍**

* This is a remote-first opportunity with the advantages of working flexibly across India.
* We are HQ’d in Canada, with established hub regions around the world where we hire from. Our employees (or Loopers, as we call ourselves!) live and work in 🇨🇦 Canada (British Columbia and Ontario), 🇺🇲 US, 🇮🇳 India (specifically in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Bengaluru), and 🇬🇧 London.
* Our India/UK hub employees work according to the business hours stated in the job description above. This is intentionally designed to enable our global teams to have overlapping hours for collaboration.
* You’ll collaborate with your teams virtually across the UK, India, and North America (we’re just a Zoom call and Slack message away!) with core sync hours and focus time for headsdown work 🙇🏾 during the workday
* We encourage asynchronous collaboration to effectively work as a global #OneTeam!

**Why You’ll ❤️ Working at Loopio**

* Your manager supports your development by providing ongoing feedback and regular 1-on-1s, we leverage Lattice for our 1:1s and performance conversations
* You will have the opportunity to elevate 🪄 your craft and the opportunity to explore your creativity, with a dedicated professional mastery allowance for more learning support! We encourage experimentation and innovative thinking to drive business impact.
* We’ll set you up to work remotely with a MacBook laptop 🍏, a monthly phone and internet subsidy, and a work-from-home budget to help get your home office all set up.
* We’ll give you a Claude account to experiment with, automate your routine tasks, and build tools so you can work smarter every day.
* You’ll be joining a supportive culture that has thoughtfully built out opportunities for connections in a remote first environment.
* Participate in 🎤 townhalls, AMA (Ask-Me-Anything), and company celebrations to celebrate the big wins and milestones as #oneteam!
* Our four Employee Resource Groups offer opportunities for employees to learn and connect year-round.
* You’ll be a part of an award-winning workplace 🏆with an opportunity to make a big impact on the business.

**Questioning your qualifications? Read this**
‼️ Hi there, we recognize that all too often, potential candidates don’t apply for a position simply because they don’t hit every single criteria included in the job description—particularly members of underrepresented groups.
  
  
Whether or not your experience ✅ checks off all the boxes on a job posting, we still encourage you to apply to ensure that your application receives a review from our team. We understand that a resume can only showcase so much during the applicant stage, so we've created prompts in the application for you to share more about yourself. If you've made a career transition (or a few!), you’re self taught in a new role, or you have skills/experience you’d like to highlight, we want to hear more about what you could bring to the table.
  
  
**AI in Recruitment 👩🏻‍💻**
At Loopio, we leverage artificial intelligence (AI) technology to enhance our recruitment process. These tools assist with tasks such as resume screening, drafting preliminary job descriptions, generating initial interview questions, transcription and occasionally sourcing prospective candidates. However, AI is never used to make final hiring decisions; our use of AI serves to support repetitive and administrative tasks in order to streamline our hiring and recruitment workflows. We are committed to the responsible use of AI in our hiring practices, prioritizing both an improved candidate experience and operational efficiency. Our standardized hiring practices remain focused on reducing biases, with all key hiring decisions solely made by our team. We continuously review and refine our hiring practices to align with industry best practices and evolving legal guidelines
  
  
**AI Usage in Interviews**
🤖 The Loopio interview process is designed to help us better understand your professional experiences, as well as your unique perspective and approach to delivery and collaboration. To ensure a fair and accurate assessment, we expect candidates to refrain from using AI-generated content to produce responses to our interview questions during the live interview, as our goal is to evaluate your own knowledge and problem-solving abilities - not those of an AI assistant. If AI-generated responses are identified during the interview, Loopio reserves the right to disqualify candidates from the interview process.
  
  
For specific roles that include a take-home assignment, our AI Interviewee Policy allows the use of AI for initial support; however, the final submission must be a true reflection of your personal insights, skills and decision-making.
  
  
*Loopio is an equal opportunity employer that is deeply committed to building equitable workplaces that are diverse and inclusive. We actively encourage candidates from
**all**
backgrounds and lifestyles to consider us as a future employer. Please contact a member of our Talent Experience team (*
*work@loopio.com*
*) should you require accommodations at any point during our virtual interview processes.*

title: Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses
description:
**Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses**

**Brainware University seeks an analytical and resourceful professional to lead a team of bright young AI researchers to work on problems relating to admissions, placements, HR, cost control, programme performance and institutional growth.**

**The role**

You will translate management concerns into clearly formulated problems, identify the questions that matter, investigate available evidence and recommend practical solutions.

The work will rely primarily on secondary research, supplemented by available university data discussions with relevant colleagues and market research.

Information will sometimes be incomplete. You must be able to make reasonable assumptions, explain their basis and assess how they affect your conclusions.

**Key responsibilities**

* Structure problems into specific questions, research tasks and measurable outcomes.
* Research comparable institutions, industry practices, market trends and relevant benchmarks.
* Develop realistic estimates and financial or operational models using clearly stated assumptions.
* Assess alternative solutions in terms of cost, feasibility, likely benefit and implementation requirements.
* Present concise recommendations explaining what should be done, why, by whom and how results should be measured.
* Refine recommendations as new evidence becomes available.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity and practical judgement.
* Ability to distinguish reliable evidence from unsupported claims.
* Confidence working with numbers, spreadsheets and incomplete information.
* Clear, concise writing and the ability to explain complex findings simply.
* Ability to work independently and question assumptions constructively.
* Responsible use of AI research tools, including verification of sources and calculations.

**Candidates may come from consulting, business analysis, economics, finance, operations, market research or related backgrounds. Experience in higher education would be preferred. Demonstrated problem-solving ability will carry more weight than a particular degree or designation.**

The expected output is a workable recommendation supported by evidence, transparent assumptions and an implementation plan.

**Selection process**

Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief practical case exercise and discuss their reasoning, assumptions and recommendations.

**Locations : Both Salt Lake and Barasat**

Team Size : 10 -15

Remuneration: Commensurate with capability and experience.

**To apply:**
Send your CV and a brief example of a problem you have analysed, explaining your approach, recommendation and outcome, to tulika.hr@brainwareuniversity.ac.in.

title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.

**Job Description**
Opensity Solutions provides strategic technology managed services to clients in the legal industry and adjacent sectors. This role within Procurement Operations will oversee strategic sourcing, buying and contract review for the Technology Enabled Services (TES) business unit. As the company integrates, there will be opportunity to support our Enterprise Business Solutions (EBS) business unit. This role is responsible for process improvement, savings on third party contracts, and client satisfaction. Role will require collaboration with Partner Management, Deals Desk, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Engineering, Project Management Office, Architecture, Service Delivery Management and Client Engagement to ensure 100% referenceable clients.
  
  
  
  
This position plays a critical role in ensuring client orders are processed accurately, efficiently, and on time. Success in this role requires exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational skills, professional communication, and the ability to consistently execute repeatable processes with a high degree of accuracy. The role will work closely with Procurement Operations, Deals Desk, Partner Management, Finance, Accounting, Service Delivery, and vendor partners to support a best-in-class client experience.
  
  
We are seeking a highly detail-oriented procurement professional who thrives in a process-driven environment and takes pride in accuracy and completeness.
  
  
The ideal candidate enjoys executing operational tasks, following established procedures, identifying discrepancies before they become issues, and communicating professionally with both internal stakeholders and external vendors. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, ownership of assigned work, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining quality and accuracy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Obtain quotes from vendor and distributor portals based on internal requests and client requirements.
* Request pricing, availability, and supporting documentation from vendors and partners.
* Review quotes, Statements of Work (SOWs), contracts, and supporting documentation to ensure information is complete and accurate.
* Create purchase orders that accurately match approved quotes, contracts, and SOWs.
* Process orders through vendor portals, distributor systems, and direct manufacturer channels.
* Track orders through completion and proactively follow up on outstanding items.
* Monitor order status and communicate updates to internal stakeholders in a timely and professional manner.
* Resolve routine order discrepancies, pricing variances, invoicing issues, shipping concerns, and vendor fulfillment challenges.
* Escalate complex issues, client risks, and vendor concerns appropriately while providing clear documentation and status updates.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C -AU - Senior
description:

**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Actively look for automation and AI enhancement opportunities

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Be able to build models from scratch
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, ResQ or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 or Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx, etc., will be a plus
* AI proficiency, automation mindset
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (US, UK, AU market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
  
  
Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The Opportunity

* Comfortable working with numbers, percentages, conversion rates, and month-on-month comparisons.

* Ability to identify trends, patterns, and inconsistencies in data.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to learn CRM and marketing automation tools.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.

* How Marketing, Sales, and RevOps collaborate and manage lead handoffs.
* How CRM data is structured, maintained, and audited.
* How to build effective reports and dashboards.

E-commerce Merchandiser — BulBul

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-site)
**Type:**
Full-time
**Brand:**
BulBul — Mass-Premium Indian Ethnic Wear

About BulBul

BulBul is a mass-premium Indian ethnic wear brand with 10+ years of in-house manufacturing expertise. We design and produce salwar suits, kurta sets, co-ord sets, and fusion wear — selling across Myntra, Nykaa Fashion, AJIO, Amazon India, and our own D2C website (bulbulfashions.com). We're scaling aggressively across marketplaces, D2C, and offline retail.

The Role

We're looking for an E-commerce Merchandiser who owns the entire product listing lifecycle — from catalog creation to conversion optimization — across all our marketplace and D2C channels. This is not a "upload and forget" role. You'll be directly responsible for how our products show up, get discovered, and convert.

Roles & Responsibilities

**Catalog & Listing Management**

* Create, publish, and maintain product listings across Myntra, Nykaa Fashion, AJIO, Amazon India, and bulbulfashions.com (Shopify)
* Write compelling, keyword-rich product titles, descriptions, and attribute tags — no copy-paste templates
* Ensure 100% accuracy in pricing, size charts, inventory sync, and product categorization across all channels
* Coordinate with the photography/creative team to ensure listing images meet each platform's specs and quality standards

**Marketplace Operations**

* Manage day-to-day seller panel operations: inventory uploads, order processing flags, return/exchange coordination with ops team
* Track and fix listing errors, suppressed SKUs, and content quality flags across platforms
* Stay on top of each marketplace's policies, algorithm changes, and catalog requirements

**Search & Discovery Optimization**

* Optimize listings for marketplace search (SEO within Myntra, AJIO, Amazon, Nykaa) — keywords, backend search terms, category mapping
* Monitor search ranking for key styles and categories; identify and act on drops
* Manage and optimize Myntra PLA (Product Listing Ads) and Amazon Sponsored Ads — budget allocation, keyword targeting, bid management, ROAS tracking

**Performance Analytics**

* Track SKU-level performance: views, CTR, conversion rate, sell-through, return rate
* Build and maintain weekly/monthly reports with actionable insights — not vanity dashboards
* Identify underperforming SKUs and recommend actions: price correction, image refresh, delisting, promotion push
* Analyze competitor listings, pricing strategies, and bestseller trends on each platform

**D2C Website (Shopify)**

* Manage product merchandising on bulbulfashions.com — collections, homepage curation, product sequencing
* Coordinate with the marketing team on sale events, landing pages, and promotional banners
* Ensure site navigation, filters, and product discovery are optimized for conversion

**Cross-functional Coordination**

* Work closely with the design and production teams on upcoming launches — ensure listings go live on time with complete assets
* Coordinate with the warehouse/inventory team on stock availability, low-stock alerts, and restock timing
* Flag market trends, size-level demand signals, and category gaps to the founder for production planning

You Should Have

* 1–3 years of hands-on experience in e-commerce merchandising or catalog management (fashion/apparel strongly preferred)
* Working knowledge of at least 2 of: Myntra Partner Panel, AJIO Seller Hub, Nykaa Fashion Seller Portal, Amazon Seller Central
* Experience with Shopify or any D2C platform
* Strong written English — you'll be writing product copy, not just filling forms
* Comfort with Excel/Google Sheets for data analysis and reporting
* Basic understanding of marketplace PLA/sponsored ads and performance metrics (ROAS, CTR, CVR)

Bonus Points

* Experience with marketplace advertising tools (Myntra PLA, Amazon PPC)
* Exposure to fashion trend research and competitive benchmarking
* Familiarity with inventory planning or demand forecasting at a SKU level

Why BulBul

* You're joining at a growth inflection — marketplace scaling, D2C push, offline expansion all happening simultaneously
* Direct access to the founder — zero bureaucracy, fast decisions
* In-house manufacturing means you'll see the full loop: design → production → listing → sale → data → next collection
* Real ownership of outcomes, not just task execution

**Apply with your resume and a short note on what you'd do differently if you looked at our current Myntra or Amazon listings today.**

title: Senior Capture Specialist
description:
Senior Capture Specialist / Capture Specialist II
  
  
**Role**
We are not looking for someone who simply downloads RFPs from procurement portals and forwards them to the team. We want someone who is naturally curious, persistent and commercially minded - part researcher, part investigator and part operator. When you see an opportunity, your instinct should be to understand who owns the problem, who has the work today, when the contract expires, what the agency is trying to accomplish, who is likely to compete and whether Dash has a real reason to believe it can win. The right person enjoys connecting dots that other people miss.
  
  
Opportunity Identification
  
  

* Continuously monitor U.S. State, Local and Education procurement sources for relevant opportunities.
* Maintain visibility across state procurement portals, agency sites and major bid platforms such as BidNet, DemandStar and Bonfire.
* Monitor SAM.gov and federal sources when relevant to the broader government strategy.
* Identify upcoming renewals, expiring contracts, pre-solicitation activity, RFIs and opportunities before formal RFP release whenever possible.

Opportunity Qualification
  
  

* Build concise opportunity briefs covering agency, problem statement, scope, estimated value, dates, incumbent, procurement method, vehicle, competition, requirements, past-performance fit and key risks.
* Support formal Bid/No-Bid analysis and separate genuinely strategic opportunities from keyword matches.
* Maintain accurate opportunity status and next actions in CRM and pursuit trackers.

Capture Intelligence
  
  

* Research agency budgets, technology priorities, incumbents, prior awards, procurement history and decision-making environment.
* Develop competitor and incumbent intelligence.
* Identify teaming partners, subcontractors, OEMs and contract-vehicle partners that could improve Dash's position.
* Maintain state-by-state procurement intelligence including registrations, vehicles, portals, renewal calendars and important procurement cycles.

Capture Planning & Proposal Transition
  
  

* Develop lightweight capture plans for priority opportunities and track customer, competitor, partner, solution, past-performance and contract-vehicle gaps.
* Coordinate actions required before the RFP is released.
* Conduct structured handoff from capture to proposal so proposal teams receive the intelligence collected during capture rather than starting from zero.
* Support proposal teams with competitor, customer and partner research throughout the pursuit.

Team Contribution
  
  

* Help coach the junior Capture Analyst already on the team.
* Build reusable research methodologies, templates and source lists.
* Proactively identify improvements in how Dash searches, qualifies and prioritizes opportunities.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 3-5 years of experience supporting U.S. government contracting, capture, proposals, market research or opportunity qualification.
* Direct exposure to U.S. State/Local/Education opportunities strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with public-sector procurement portals and RFP/RFQ/RFI documentation.
* Strong research and analytical capability and ability to turn large volumes of information into short decision-oriented summaries.
* Strong written and spoken English, excellent follow-through and attention to deadlines.
* Comfort with CRM, spreadsheets and structured opportunity tracking.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* Experience using GovWin or similar public-sector intelligence tools.
* Experience researching incumbent contracts and government spending.
* Exposure to IT services, staffing, cloud, data, AI or digital-transformation opportunities.
* Experience researching contract vehicles and teaming partners.

The Personality We Are Looking For
  
  

* Does not stop at the first search result.
* Keeps asking questions until the situation makes sense.
* Is comfortable saying, "I do not know yet, but I know how to find out."
* Follows through without needing reminders.
* Notices inconsistencies and investigates them.
* Treats every opportunity as a business decision, not an administrative task.
* Has the confidence to recommend that Dash walk away from a weak opportunity.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within the first 90 days, the capture function should have a reliable opportunity feed, standardized qualification briefs, state/vehicle intelligence, documented incumbent and competitor research, and a clean handoff process into active proposals.

**Junior SEO Executive**
who is eager to build a career in Search Engine Optimization (SEO) and emerging AI Search technologies.

You will work alongside our SEO, content, and development teams to improve website visibility, organic traffic, and search performance across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms.

This role is ideal for junior professionals who understand the basics of SEO and want hands-on experience working on real client websites across multiple industries, including international markets.

Roles & Responsibilities1. On-Page SEO

* Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and image alt text.
* Conduct keyword research and map relevant keywords to website pages.
* Assist with content optimization based on search intent and SEO best practices.
* Improve internal linking and identify opportunities to enhance website structure.
* Check pages for missing metadata, duplicate content, and basic on-page issues.

2. Keyword Research & Competitor Analysis

* Research primary keywords, secondary keywords, long-tail keywords, and relevant search queries.
* Analyze competitor websites to identify keyword and content opportunities.
* Identify content gaps and recommend topics that align with user search intent.
* Assist in preparing keyword mapping sheets and SEO content briefs.

3. Technical SEO

* Assist with website SEO audits and routine technical checks.
* Monitor indexing and website performance using Google Search Console.
* Check XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, broken links, and crawlability.
* Identify basic technical SEO issues and coordinate with the development team for fixes.
* Assist with structured data and schema markup implementation.

4. Off-Page SEO & Link Building

* Research relevant websites for ethical backlink opportunities.
* Assist with link-building, outreach, and backlink monitoring.
* Analyze competitor backlink profiles using available SEO tools.
* Maintain backlink tracking sheets and document outreach activities.

5. SEO Reporting & Performance Tracking

* Monitor organic clicks, impressions, keyword rankings, traffic, and indexing status.
* Use Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 to track SEO performance.
* Prepare weekly or monthly SEO reports using spreadsheets and reporting tools.
* Identify unusual performance changes and communicate findings to the team.

Education

**Experience**

* 5–7 years of experience in procurement or sourcing functions.
* Mandatory experience supporting importer-focused companies (India-based or global) operating in import-driven business models.
* Proven experience working within an international procurement environment.
* Experience supporting foreign-based importer companies is preferred.
* Hands-on experience working with suppliers across South Asia and other global sourcing regions.
* Practical experience in RFQ preparation, issuance, and quotation analysis.

* Proven experience working in environments involving international trade and import cost structures, including:
* Customs duties and tariffs

**Systems, Analytics & Costing**

* Experience with ERP systems and procurement tools.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel for data analysis and modeling.
* Proven ability to prepare and analyze landed cost structures with accuracy and attention to detail.
* Strong analytical mindset with focus on data accuracy and structured evaluation.

**Role Scope**

* Primary focus on execution, analysis, RFQ support, and supplier onboarding.
* Supports pricing and cost analysis, but does not own supplier negotiations or final commercial decisions.
* Works closely with the Procurement Manager to enable data-driven procurement outcomes.

* Strong analytical and detail-oriented mindset.
* High level of ownership and execution focus.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
**About MAXVAL:**

MaxVal started as an IP services company in 2004, with a keen focus on efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and continuous improvement through metrics-based processes. Our focus on these core values led to the tech-enablement of our offerings even before this buzzword became an industry standard. Over the years, MaxVal developed many internal applications to increase our quality and efficiency, and customer satisfaction. As these systems grew and became more sophisticated, we have productized them and offered them to our clients. Today, MaxVal serves over 600 clients across the full IP life cycle with the industry’s leading products and services. Our 700 plus employees represent the most IP and tech-savvy individuals in the industry." At MaxVal, we do the right things and innovate ceaselessly as a winning team to achieve customer success and employee success.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a Salesforce Administrator to serve as the primary system administrator for our Salesforce.com environment. In this role, you will be responsible for handling administrative functions, system audits, data integrations, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to define and document requirements. You will play a key role in ensuring the smooth operation of Salesforce, supporting development and change management activities, and assisting in user training to foster skill growth across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary system administrator for the Salesforce.com environment.
* Handle basic administrative functions including user account maintenance, reports, dashboards, workflows, and other routine tasks.
* Complete regular internal system audits and prepare for Salesforce upgrades.
* Manage Salesforce.com data feeds and integrations with other systems.
* Coordinate the evaluation, scope, and completion of new development requests.
* Collaborate with the institutional management team to establish processes supporting administrative, development, and change management activities.
* Assist in training new users and help grow the Salesforce skill set within the team/organization.
* Act as a liaison between users, vendors, and application development teams.
* Work independently with team members to define and document development requirements.

**Skills Required:**

* Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, handle and prioritize simultaneous requests, and manage tasks across different levels of the organization.
* Creative and analytical thinker with strong problem-solving skills.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels.
* Ability to assess the impact of new requirements on Salesforce.com and upstream/downstream applications, systems, and processes.

**Experience Required:**

* Minimum of 2 years of experience as a Salesforce.com administrator.
* Salesforce.com Admin (ADM201 and ADM211) certified (preferred).
* Salesforce certifications in Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and Developer (preferred).
* Proven ability to design and implement new processes and facilitate user adoption.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce platform capabilities, including building custom apps, objects, formula fields, workflows, custom views, and other content of intermediate complexity.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce best practices and functionality.
* Strong data management abilities.
* A documented history of successfully driving projects to completion.
* Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate complex requirements.
* Previous experience working in a SCRUM or agile environment (preferred).

**Additional Information:**

* Shift timings: 11:30 AM - 8:30 PM or 8:30 PM - 5:30 AM.

**Website Link:**
https://www.maxval.com/

**-**

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As an Aera Techno-Functional Senior, you will support the design, configuration, testing, and deployment of Decision Intelligence solutions. You will work with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate decision requirements into data, logic, user experience, and action-oriented solution components.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Gather and document business processes, decision points, KPIs, pain points, data needs, and expected outcomes.
* Convert functional requirements into solution designs covering data preparation, curated data views, rules, recommendations, workflows, user screens, and actions.
* Use SQL to profile, reconcile, transform, and validate data across source and curated datasets.
* Configure and test Aera solution components under the guidance of solution leads and architects.
* Prepare test scenarios, execute unit and functional testing, support user acceptance testing, and resolve defects.
* Create clear functional and technical documentation, including mappings, logic, assumptions, test evidence, and operating guidance.
* Collaborate with client teams, data engineers, developers, and project managers to manage dependencies and delivery risks.
* Support production deployment, hypercare, issue triage, and continuous improvement of deployed solutions.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute reusable delivery assets and best practices.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business analytics, supply chain, operations, finance, or a related field.
* Master’s degree or MBA from Tier 1 institute will be preferred.
* 5+ years of overall experience in technology consulting, analytics, enterprise applications, data solutions, or business process transformation.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, data quality checks, and performance-aware query design.
* Ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation in a techno-functional role.
* Experience with requirements gathering solution design, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Understanding of data models, integrations, business rules, workflows, and enterprise application delivery.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Prior hands-on Aera experience is a strong plus.
* Experience in Decision Intelligence, supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial, or finance use cases.
* Exposure to cloud data platforms, APIs, ETL/ELT, reporting, Python, or advanced analytics.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models and distributed global teams.

**What We Look For**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery-focused mindset.
* Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C -AU - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Actively look for automation and AI enhancement opportunities

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Be able to build models from scratch
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, ResQ or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 or Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx, etc., will be a plus
* AI proficiency, automation mindset
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (US, UK, AU market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
  
  
Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

* Value Chain Analysis Skills: Exposure to value chain analysis to identify areas for improvement and drive business results.

description:

Master's Degree

title: Research Analyst
description:

* Master’s Degree (M.Sc. / M.Tech / M.Phil) in Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Life Sciences, or a related discipline. (Ph.D. holders or candidates with relevant industry certifications are preferred).

* 1–3 years of experience in wet lab operations, academic teaching, or corporate training.
* Medical Coding: Certified Professional Coder (CPC / AAPC or AHIMA) or proven domain training experience is highly desirable.

* Technical Proficiency: Strong grasp of wet lab protocols alongside computational techniques and coding standards.
* Communication & Presentation: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to deliver engaging sessions to large audiences.
* Classroom & Group Management: Ability to engage college students, faculty members, and corporate professionals effectively.

* Positive participant feedback and pass rates from training programs (colleges and corporate segments).

* Successful delivery of client projects and workshop objectives.

Pay: Up to ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
