title: Biostatistician II - TA (India)
description:
**Who We Are**
We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.
  
  
We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.
  
  
Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.
  
  
**Why Worldwide**
We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!
  
  
**Make an Impact as a Biostatistician II at Worldwide**
As a Biostatistician II, you'll play a critical role in advancing clinical development programs by transforming complex clinical trial data into meaningful insights. Your expertise will help drive study design, statistical analysis, regulatory submissions, and data-driven decision-making that support the successful delivery of clinical research.
  
  
Working as part of the Clinical Development Operations Biostatistics team, you'll collaborate with project teams and external partners to ensure high-quality statistical analysis and reporting. You'll serve as a key statistical resource across studies, contributing technical expertise, scientific rigor, and strategic guidance throughout the clinical trial lifecycle.
  
  
This is an opportunity to take ownership of statistical deliverables, influence study outcomes, and support the development of therapies through thoughtful analysis, collaboration, and problem-solving.
  
  
**Where You'll Work**
This is a hybrid role open to candidates based in India. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones. Candidates are expected to work from the office at least once per quarter to support team collaboration, meetings, and business activities.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Partner with project teams and vendors to deliver statistical analysis and reporting activities on time and to quality standards.
* Provide statistical guidance on study design, endpoints, sample size requirements, and analytical methodology.
* Develop sample size calculations, randomization schemes, and supporting documentation in accordance with established procedures.
* Author statistical analysis plans and study specifications that support clinical trial objectives.
* Serve as the primary statistical contact for assigned studies and provide expertise to cross-functional project teams.
* Program and/or review statistical tables, listings, figures, and analysis datasets for clinical trials.
* Support regulatory submissions through the preparation and review of statistical deliverables and documentation.
* Conduct exploratory statistical analyses and apply scientific literature and regulatory guidance to support clinical development, publications, and presentations.
* Contribute to departmental initiatives and provide subject matter expertise to Biostatistics and Programming teams.

**What You'll Bring**

* Master's degree or higher in Biostatistics or a related field.
* Minimum 2 years of relevant biostatistics experience; pharmaceutical research or CRO experience preferred.
* Knowledge of clinical trial study design and clinical research methodologies.
* Experience developing statistical analysis plans, sample size calculations, randomization strategies, and study specifications.
* Proficiency with statistical software packages and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong interpersonal abilities, and experience collaborating with stakeholders across organizational levels.
* Proficiency in English.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.
  
  
To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit www.Worldwide.com or connect with us on LinkedIn.

title: Senior Associate - Resource Management
description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
  
  
The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling & Staffing Support**

* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.

**Capacity, Utilization & Workforce Analytics**

* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.
* Monitor schedule changes and ensure updates are reflected in timely reporting systems.
* Identify trends in staffing, utilization, and resource availability and communicate insights to support decision-making.
* Support data validation efforts to improve reporting accuracy, workforce visibility, and data integrity.
* Assist in workforce planning activities by monitoring forecasted workload, resource demand, and skill requirements.
* Provide scheduling, utilization, and capacity-related information as requested by management.

**Coordination & Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as a resource for routine scheduling inquiries from team members, managers, and engagement teams.
* Coordinate with U.S. and India Tax teams to gather staffing information, scheduling updates, and resource needs.
* Build effective working relationships with U.S. and India leadership teams to support resource deployment decisions.
* Facilitate communication regarding staffing conflicts, priorities, workload balancing, and schedule changes.
* Escalate staffing concerns, scheduling issues, or capacity risks to the Manager, Talent Optimization when appropriate.

**Process & Administrative Support**

* Follow established scheduling procedures, guidelines, and best practices.
* Assist with maintaining scheduling documentation, process materials, and training resources.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance scheduling efficiency, reporting quality, and data accuracy.
* Participate in team meetings, scheduling calls, capacity review exercises, and workforce planning discussions.
* Assist with onboarding and training activities related to scheduling tools, reporting processes, and resource management procedures.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, or related fields.
* 2-4 years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, professional services operations, project coordination, or related discipline.
* Experience in a CPA firm, tax practice, public accounting, or professional services environment preferred.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills, including pivot tables, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and shift business needs in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, summarize findings, and support practical solutions.

**Core Competencies**
Resource Coordination
  
  
Relationship Management
  
  
Schedule Management
  
  
Problem Solving
  
  
Capacity Planning & Tracking
  
  
Business Acumen
  
  
Workforce Analytics
  
  
Time Management
  
  
Operational Support
  
  
Attention to Detail
  
  
Data Accuracy & Reporting
  
  
Adaptability
  
  
**Success Measures**

* Accuracy and integrity of staffing, scheduling, and workforce planning data.
* Timely and effective processing of staffing requests and schedule updates.
* Quality, reliability, and usefulness of capacity, utilization, and availability reporting.
* Proactive identification and communication of capacity constraints, staffing risks, and workload imbalances.
* Responsiveness to scheduling inquiries and ability to support timely decision-making.
* Effective support of workload balancing, resource deployment, and staffing processes across U.S. and India teams.
* Positive stakeholder feedback from leadership, managers, and engagement teams.
* Contribution to improved scheduling efficiency, utilization of visibility, and resource management processes.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C -AU - Senior
description:

**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Actively look for automation and AI enhancement opportunities

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Be able to build models from scratch
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, ResQ or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 or Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx, etc., will be a plus
* AI proficiency, automation mindset
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (US, UK, AU market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
  
  
Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

title: Threat Hunter
description:
**Role Description**
Role Summary We are looking for a Threat Hunter to join our Cyber Security team and proactively identify, analyze, and mitigate advanced threats targeting the bank's IT and digital banking infrastructure. The candidate will use FortiRecon for external attack surface and digital risk monitoring, and interpret threat hunting reports and vulnerability advisories to drive proactive hunts using Splunk and Microsoft Sentinel, in line with RBI cybersecurity guidelines and industry best practices. Key Responsibilities Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunting across endpoints, network, cloud, and core banking-adjacent systems using Splunk and Microsoft Sentinel. Monitor and act on intelligence from FortiRecon (external attack surface management, brand/phishing protection, digital risk monitoring) to identify exposure relevant to a financial services target profile. Interpret threat intelligence reports, vulnerability advisories (CVE bulletins, OEM/vendor advisories), and sector-specific s (CERT-In, RBI/IDRBT, FS-ISAC) to build hunting hypotheses and prioritize action. Develop hunting playbooks, KQL/SPL queries, and use cases mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, with emphasis on threats relevant to banking (phishing, credential theft, fraud-linked malware, ATM/payment switch threats, insider risk). Correlate findings across EDR, network, cloud, and identity logs to validate threats and hand off confirmed incidents to the Incident Response team. Support timely reporting/escalation in line with CERT-In incident reporting timelines and internal regulatory obligations. Collaborate with Vulnerability Management, SOC, and IT teams to close detection and patching gaps surfaced during hunts. Maintain documentation of hunting methodology, findings, and detection coverage improvements for internal and regulatory audits (RBI IS Audit, VAPT reviews). Stay current on threat actor campaigns and TTPs targeting Indian financial institutions. Required Skills & Experience 3–6 years in a Threat Intelligence/Threat Hunting role, ideally within BFSI or a regulated industry. Hands-on experience with FortiRecon or a similar EASM/Digital Risk Protection platform. Strong proficiency in Splunk (SPL) and Microsoft Sentinel (KQL, analytics rules, workbooks). Ability to read and act on vulnerability advisories (CVSS scoring, exploitability, patch prioritization) and threat intel reports. **Qualifications**
Required Skills & Competencies

* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms AWS and Azure, including Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
* Proficient in scripting with Python and Bash for automation and deployment purposes.
* Deep understanding and practical experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.
* Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root cause analysis capabilities.
* Experience working effectively in Agile software development environments.

* Be at the forefront of DevOps transformation within large-scale automation programs driving innovation in the mining industry.
* Contribute to the faster and more reliable delivery of autonomous mining systems impacting global operations.
* Work cross-functionally with diverse global teams to influence the architecture of next-generation software delivery platforms.
* Lead, inspire, and grow talented teams committed to building robust DevOps methodologies and sustainable solutions.
* Engage in cutting-edge projects that promote smart and sustainable mining through scalable, brand-agnostic automation technologies.
* Opportunity to collaborate with international experts, enhancing your professional skills and amplifying your impact.
* Access to continuous learning opportunities and a supportive environment encouraging innovation and excellence.

**Desired Behaviors**

* Exemplify ownership and accountability towards platform reliability and consistent software delivery.
* Proactively seek opportunities to automate manual processes and optimize workflows.
* Deliver secure, stable, and scalable CI/CD solutions while maintaining a keen focus on quality.
* Efficiently diagnose and resolve complex system issues, driving root cause analysis and preventive improvements.
* Collaborate openly with developers, testers, and infrastructure teams to foster a seamless delivery pipeline.
* Advocate and implement DevSecOps and cloud-native best practices diligently.
* Continuously strive to enhance deployment speed, operational efficiency, and product quality.
* Maintain high availability systems by applying comprehensive monitoring and preventive maintenance strategies.
* Adapt quickly to evolving technologies and dynamic business environments.
* Communicate clearly and contribute to cultivating a culture centered on automation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

We encourage applications from all talented individuals. Epiroc is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion, ensuring a welcoming environment for all team members to thrive and contribute to the future of sustainable mining technologies.

The world needs metals and minerals for the energy transition and our cities and infrastructure must be developed to serve a growing population. description:
Position Description
  
  
Founded in 1976, CGI is among the world's largest independent IT and business consulting services firms. Job Title: Azure DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
  
  
Experience: 5–8 Years
  
  
Job Location: Bangalore
  
  
Position ID: J0926-0309
  
  
Work Type: Hybrid
  
  
Employment Type: Full Time / Permanent
  
  
Qualification: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Senior Azure DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer to architect, build, and maintain enterprise grade Azure cloud environments from the ground up. In this role, you will be the primary technical authority responsible for greenfield cloud infrastructure deployments, robust networking topologies, automated CI/CD pipelines, high availability clustering, and business continuity systems.
  
  
You will design resilient systems that incorporate multi region fault tolerance, advanced Layer 4 and Layer 7 load balancing, automated container management via AKS, and strict backup/restore controls—ensuring our cloud platform is secure, scalable, and highly available.
  
  

* Technical Stack Summary
* Cloud Platform: Microsoft Azure (Management Groups, Subscriptions, Landing Zones)
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Azure Bicep, ARM Templates
* Networking & Load Balancing: VNet Peering, ExpressRoute, VPN, Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway (WAF), Azure Front Door, Traffic Manager, Azure Firewall, Private Endpoints
* Containers & Orchestration: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Docker, Helm, NGINX / AGIC Ingress, ArgoCD / Flux
* CI/CD & Automation: Azure DevOps Pipelines (YAML), GitHub Actions, Ansible, PowerShell, Bash, Python
* Backup & Disaster Recovery: Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery (ASR), Velero
* Observability & Security: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Azure Policy
* Key Responsibilities
* Greenfield Cloud Infrastructure & IaC
* Landing Zone Architecture: Architect and provision production ready enterprise Azure Landing Zones based on Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) best practices.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Standardize all infrastructure deployments using modular Terraform or Bicep templates with state management and security scanning.
* Automated Provisioning: Build end to end automated environment creation workflows (Dev, Staging, QA, Prod) with integrated parameterization and validation gates.
* Advanced Networking & Traffic Load Balancing
* Network Topology & Isolation: Design secure Hub and Spoke network topologies, Virtual WAN (vWAN), cross region VNet peering, and strict subnet segmentation.
* Load Balancing & Ingress: Deploy and tune Layer 4 and Layer 7 traffic routing using Azure Load Balancer, Azure Application Gateway (WAF), Azure Front Door, and Traffic Manager.
* SSL & Traffic Policy: Configure SSL/TLS offloading, path based routing, health probe rules, custom WAF rules, and global latency based routing.
* Hybrid Connectivity & Perimeter Security: Implement secure ExpressRoute/VPN connections, Azure Firewall, User Defined Routes (UDRs), BGP routing, Private Link / Private Endpoints, and Azure Private DNS zones.
* Containerization & High Availability Clustering
* AKS Cluster Deployment: Build, scale, and maintain enterprise Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) multi tenant clusters with dedicated node pools, availability zones, and auto scaling (HPA & Cluster Autoscaler).
* Cluster Networking & Service Mesh: Manage advanced CNI plugins (Azure CNI / Overlay), ingress controllers (AGIC, NGINX), and service mesh architectures for microservice routing.
* Compute & Database HA: Configure Virtual Machine Scale Sets (VMSS) and collaborate with DBAs to manage high availability clusters for Azure SQL Managed Instance, Cosmos DB, and Redis Enterprise.
* CI/CD Pipelines & DevOps Automation
* Pipeline Engineering: Design, implement, and optimize robust CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps Pipelines or GitHub Actions for application and infrastructure code.
* GitOps & Release Automation: Establish GitOps workflows to eliminate manual environment updates and ensure configuration drift is automatically detected and reconciled.
* Secret & Artifact Management: Secure pipeline credentials using Azure Key Vault, Service Connections, and Workload Identity Federation.
* Backup, Restore & Business Continuity (DR)
* Automated Backup Operations: Design and enforce centralized backup policies with Azure Backup across virtual machines, databases, stateful persistent volumes (AKS), and storage accounts.
* Disaster Recovery (DR) Orchestration: Formulate, configure, and manage multi region Disaster Recovery plans leveraging Azure Site Recovery (ASR) to meet stringent RTO and RPO objectives.
* Restore Drills & Disaster Testing: Schedule and perform routine backup restore drills, cross region failovers, and failback validation procedures to ensure zero data loss during critical failures.

title: Principal Platform Engineer
description:
**Description**
About the role
  
  
At Trintech, the Principal Platform Engineer is a senior, hands-on technical leader who provides architecture and technical oversight for major platform initiatives. You will define scalable Azure platform patterns, implement and operate critical AKS and cloud capabilities, and resolve complex problems that cross infrastructure, application, security and delivery domains.
  
  
You will influence multiple teams through practical engineering, clear standards, technical guidance and mentoring, while remaining closely connected to implementation and production operations.
  
  
Your impact
  
  

* Shape the architecture, engineering patterns and operational readiness of major Azure, AKS and automation initiatives used by multiple teams.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership for complex implementation and production challenges that span infrastructure, application, security and delivery domains.
* Raise engineering quality through reusable standards, deep technical reviews, mentoring and clear guidance that teams can apply independently.

What you will do
  
  

* Provide architecture and technical oversight for major Azure environments and platform initiatives supporting Kubernetes and web application deployment.
* Design, implement and maintain Azure platform capabilities such as AKS, Container Registry, Key Vault, managed identities, service principals, app registrations and appropriate PaaS services.
* Act as a principal hands-on engineer for complex implementation, configuration, automation, lifecycle and operational work across Azure cloud services.
* Define and evolve Kubernetes and AKS patterns for cluster deployment, workload configuration, maintenance, scaling, resilience, recovery and operational readiness.
* Establish reusable Terraform patterns and modules that create secure, repeatable and supportable cloud environments.
* Shape CI/CD, GitOps and release-management patterns using Azure DevOps and related automation, including testing, evidence, approval and rollback controls.
* Set technical standards for container images, runtime configuration, platform lifecycle and application-hosting integration across multiple teams.
* Lead design discussions with cloud, application, security, networking and infrastructure teams and turn competing concerns into clear technical direction.
* Resolve complex issues spanning cloud resources, Kubernetes, networking, DNS, identity, secrets, pipelines, storage and application deployment.
* Evaluate Azure PaaS and platform-service options and recommend choices that improve scalability, reliability, maintainability and operational efficiency.
* Define observability, alerting, operational reporting, runbook and production-readiness expectations for major platform capabilities.
* Ensure consequential production changes are tested, documented and aligned with security, compliance, change and recovery requirements.
* Anticipate technical risk, remove complex implementation blockers and escalate unresolved business or enterprise-architecture decisions in time to protect delivery and stability.
* Mentor engineers and raise the engineering bar through architecture guidance, deep reviews, troubleshooting leadership and durable documentation.

What you will bring
  
  

* Broad, progressive experience in platform engineering, cloud operations, infrastructure, DevOps, systems engineering or a related field, gained through employment or equivalent practical work.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and public-cloud operating models.
* Strong AKS and Kubernetes depth across architecture, deployment, workload operation, maintenance, scaling, resilience and troubleshooting.
* Advanced container-platform knowledge, including image management, runtime configuration, lifecycle activity and production support.
* Strong Terraform and infrastructure-as-code capability, including reusable patterns, secure lifecycle management and governance through code.
* Experience designing and improving CI/CD practices in Azure DevOps or comparable platforms, including automated deployment and release orchestration.
* Hands-on knowledge of cloud identity and secrets patterns, container registries and relevant Azure platform services.
* Strong fundamentals across networking, DNS, directory and identity services, compute, storage, firewalls and load balancing.
* Advanced cross-domain troubleshooting skills and the ability to remain effective during high-impact production or delivery problems.
* Ability to produce clear standards, runbooks, diagrams and implementation guidance and to communicate architecture, status, risk and recommendations to varied audiences.
* A demonstrated ability to work independently, lead complex technical initiatives, mentor engineers and influence direction across teams.

Nice to have
  
  

* Typically 8-12 years of relevant experience in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps or systems engineering.
* Experience supporting customer-facing SaaS, hosted or other business-critical production applications.
* Depth in monitoring, metrics, observability, alerting and operational-health reporting for cloud platforms.
* Experience with cloud security, governance, policy, cost management, reliability engineering or disaster recovery.
* Experience coordinating technical work and influencing decisions across organisational boundaries.

How you will work and lead
  
  

* Provide technical direction and architecture guidance across multiple teams and lead the most difficult implementation and operational decisions.
* Mentor senior and developing engineers, create reusable guidance and strengthen design and troubleshooting practices across the group.
* Influence application, security and infrastructure partners through evidence, technical credibility and clear communication.
* Set design decisions, technical patterns and implementation guardrails for major platform initiatives within agreed enterprise direction.
* Exercise independent judgement across several technical domains and approve justified implementation exceptions within the initiative or platform area.
* Make recommendations that materially influence team roadmaps, production readiness and technical investment, supported by evidence and explicit trade-offs.
* Bring organisation-wide architecture, major programme priorities and enterprise-risk decisions to the appropriate governance and leadership forums.

What success looks like
  
  

* Major platform initiatives are technically coherent, secure, operable and ready for production use.
* Azure and AKS patterns are reusable across teams and produce more consistent delivery, reliability and support outcomes.
* Complex cross-domain problems are resolved with durable fixes and clearer ownership or standards.
* Technical risk is identified early enough to change a design or delivery approach before customer impact.
* Engineers and partner teams make better decisions because architecture guidance and platform documentation are clear and credible.
* The role remains visibly hands-on while its influence extends beyond any single service or team.

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*

title: Cloud Engineer - 5+yrs - SRE, Cloud Operations, DevOps / Platform Engineering
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
The Webex Contact Center team builds and operates a global, cloud-native customer-experience platform that helps organizations connect with their customers across voice and digital channels. Our services support business-critical customer interactions across multiple regions.
  
  
Within Webex Contact Center, our Cloud Operations and Site Reliability Engineering team is responsible for the availability, performance, and operational health of shared AWS and Kubernetes platforms. We work closely with application engineering, infrastructure, security, and architecture teams to operate production services, improve observability, automate operational work, and make deployments safer.
  
  
We are a collaborative team that learns from incidents and supports one another during operational challenges. If you enjoy troubleshooting production systems and turning recurring problems into automation, we would be excited to hear from you!
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a Cloud Engineer and Site Reliability Engineer, you will help us operate and improve the AWS- and Kubernetes-based platforms supporting Webex Contact Center. Together, we will monitor service health, investigate application and infrastructure failures, restore service during incidents, and implement improvements that prevent recurrence.
  
  
You will participate in a shared on-call rotation and use PagerDuty, logs, metrics, traces, Kubernetes events, and infrastructure signals to understand customer and service impact. You will contribute to incident coordination, root-cause analysis, blameless post-incident reviews, and corrective actions that reduce recovery time and alert noise.
  
  
You will use Python and Terraform to automate infrastructure provisioning, deployment validation, Kubernetes lifecycle activities, recovery procedures, and repetitive operational work. You will also help improve release safety through automated health checks, progressive delivery, rollback, and tested recovery procedures.
  
  
Working with application and platform teams, you will improve logging, monitoring, and alerting using technologies such as Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, Splunk, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, and CloudWatch. You will help define meaningful service-level indicators and objectives, improve capacity and performance, and create dashboards, runbooks, and troubleshooting procedures that make our services easier to operate.
  
  
Success in this role means our services consistently meet their reliability objectives, incidents are detected and resolved faster, deployments become safer, and recurring operational problems are addressed through engineering and automation.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, plus 5 years of relevant experience; a master’s degree plus 3 years of relevant experience; or equivalent practical experience.

* Experience operating and troubleshooting production Kubernetes environments, preferably Amazon EKS, including Linux, containers, networking, storage, configuration, secrets, health probes, and resource management.
* Experience diagnosing application and infrastructure failures using logs, metrics, traces, Kubernetes events, network behavior, dependency information, and deployment history.
* Experience with AWS infrastructure and services such as VPC networking, IAM, load balancing, S3, and CloudWatch, along with Python and Terraform automation.
* Experience using Git and supporting CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, production deployments, health validation, and rollback.
* Experience participating in an on-call rotation and responding to production incidents, including triage, service restoration, communication, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.

* Experience creating actionable dashboards, alerts, service-level indicators, service-level objectives, and error-budget practices for customer-facing services.
* Experience with observability technologies such as Grafana, VictoriaMetrics, Splunk, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, or CloudWatch.
* Experience troubleshooting Istio-based service communication and Kafka-based distributed services.

description:
**Company Description**
Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
  
  
At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
  
  
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who You’ll Work With**
SRE's at Arista combine strong software and systems engineering with a passion for operating production systems at scale. As an SRE you’ll be part of the team responsible for our global service fleet.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
CloudVision is deployed on Kubernetes across global regions using Spinnaker for our CI/CD pipeline. Our tech stack runs on GKE, using HBase/Hadoop as main distributed database and storage layer, ElasticSearch for powering search data, ClickHouse for fast real time queries of flow data, our own Kafka-based distributed real time stream processing layer for analytics, and TensorFlow for ML analysis. Our monitoring system is built on top of Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and other OSS tools.
  
  
As a Senior SRE, you’ll be responsible for our global CloudVision service fleet. This includes:
  
  

* Build, deploy safely and incrementally and operate critical production systems with focus on scalability, reliability, observability, performance and security.
* Monitor, support and enhance product deployment experience across services.
* Build automation to remove toil and efficiently operate production systems.
* Proactively monitor, respond to, and enhance alerts and set up automated alert handling
* Create and maintain the incident response runbooks.
* Build and deploy new systems with scalability, reliability, and observability as primary requirements
* Triage platform/infrastructural issues and help Arista software engineers in their triages. Engage with 3rd party vendor support.
* Deploy new systems in a staged manner
* Write postmortem documents and build solutions to avoid incidents from repeating.
* Plan and communicate maintenance windows on production systems.
* Work with Arista’s product development teams to identify infrastructural issues that are causing bottlenecks and limitations in their workflows. Design and implement solutions to resolve them.
* Survey and adopt best practices around infrastructure/platform to maintain secure, scalable and fault-tolerant systems.
* Implement solutions to scale the systems
* Implement fault-tolerance and performance to improve availability of the systems
* Study the design and sufficient implementation details of OSS systems for better triage and fix resolution.

**Qualifications**

* At least Bachelors in Computer Science or Engineering + 5 years’ experience, MS Computer Science or Engineering + 5 years’ experience, or equivalent work experience.
* Knowledge of one or more of Go, Python, bash shell scripting to be able to implement medium complexity automation workflows.
* Knowledge of Linux (or UNIX) from administration and debugging perspective
* Hands-on experience in operating software systems (infrastructure, complex applications etc) at scale
* Experience in server provisioning (esp from storage and networking perspective).
* Strong problem solving and software troubleshooting skills
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code.
* Desirable to have one/more of the following skills
* Experience managing databases - eg: PostgreSQL or equivalent RDBMS etc
* Experience with docker and virtualization technologies
* Experience managing monitoring stack - Prometheus, Grafana etc
* Experience managing Artifactory, docker registry etc
* Experience managing CI/CD systems like GitLab tools, Spinnaker etc
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code frameworks like Terraform
* Experience with container orchestration via Kubernetes

**Additional Information**
Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
  
  
We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
  
  
Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

title: R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:**
R&D Senior Member of Technical Staff
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Regular, full-time, hybrid work arrangement
  
  
**The job**
Experienced DevOps and Infrastructure Engineer responsible for designing, automating, and supporting scalable cloud and on-premises platforms that enable reliable software delivery. Collaborates with development, product, and architecture teams to build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure, monitoring, and operational processes. Drives automation, environment management, incident resolution, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance system reliability, performance, and developer productivity. Leverages expertise in Azure/AWS, Infrastructure-as-Code, containers, scripting, and DevOps best practices while supporting enterprise-scale applications and services
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with development, product management, and architecture teams to enhance developer platforms and support delivery of critical business applications and services.
* Design, implement, and maintain solutions that improve the availability, performance, reliability, and scalability of systems and applications.
* Participate in the design, deployment, administration, and support of cloud and on-premises infrastructure.
* Develop, maintain, and document DevOps processes, standards, and operational procedures to promote engineering best practices.
* Manage and automate the lifecycle of Development, QA, Staging, and Production environments across cloud and on-premises platforms.
* Build and maintain infrastructure required for multiple development and testing environments, ensuring consistency, stability, and release readiness.
* Implement, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to enable efficient and reliable software delivery.
* Troubleshoot and resolve build, deployment, release, and environment-related issues to minimize delivery disruptions.
* Evaluate and integrate new tools, technologies, and automation capabilities to improve developer productivity and operational efficiency.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools for cloud infrastructure, application deployment, and operational management.
* Create monitoring, logging, tracing, deployment, and self-healing solutions to improve system reliability and reduce manual operational effort.
* Support incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance platform stability and service availability.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to the adoption of DevOps best practices across the engineering organization.

**Essential Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Operations, Infrastructure Engineering, or a related role.
* Strong understanding of software development, systems administration, and operational support practices.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with developers, architects, product managers, and cross-functional teams.
* Proven experience driving automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency and developer productivity.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Sound judgment, ownership mindset, and ability to prioritize and escalate issues when appropriate.
* Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments supporting enterprise-scale applications and services.

**Desired Skills And Competencies**

* Strong experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, Git, and software version control systems.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar languages.
* Experience designing, implementing, and supporting CI/CD pipelines and release automation.
* Hands-on experience with Azure and/or AWS cloud platforms, including infrastructure deployment and management.
* Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (ARM Templates, Bicep, Terraform, or CloudFormation).
* Knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience deploying and supporting Microsoft technologies such as .NET applications, SQL Server, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure Automation.
* Familiarity with configuration management and desired state technologies such as PowerShell DSC or equivalent.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of cloud-based applications and infrastructure.
* Understanding of security, identity management, and access control using Azure AD, AWS IAM, Active Directory, and related technologies.
* Experience with test automation frameworks and scripting validation tools is a plus.
* Experience in Azure Service Fabric is an added advantage.

**R&D at AVEVA**
Our global team of 2000+ developers work on an incredibly diverse portfolio of over 75 industrial automation and engineering products, which cover everything from data management to 3D design. AI and cloud are at the centre of our strategy, and we have over 150 patents to our name.
  
  
Our track record of innovation is no fluke – it’s the result of a structured and deliberate focus on learning, collaboration and inclusivity. If you want to build applications that solve big problems, join us.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/r-and-d-careers/
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process
  
  
**About AVEVA**
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. title: Software Engineer, Delivery : Release
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

The Software Delivery Section, part of the Infrastructure Platforms Department, is dedicated to enhancing the safety, reliability, and overall customer experience of GitLab’s complete software delivery process. We aim to provide seamless and efficient delivery of GitLab products across all platforms, including SaaS multi-tenant, self-managed, and SaaS single-tenant environments. Our primary goals are to accelerate delivery cycles, minimize incidents, and ensure high-quality releases that consistently meet and exceed customer expectations. By focusing on these objectives, we aim to improve GitLab’s end-to-end software delivery process, making it more reliable, efficient, and aligned with the needs of our users.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Backend Engineers with the Software Delivery:Release bring not only a strong background in backend development but also a solid understanding of, or keen interest in, infrastructure and operations. In this role, you will work alongside Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) to enhance release management tooling, infrastructure, and processes. While SREs approach these responsibilities from an operational standpoint, Backend Engineers provide a software development perspective, collaborating closely to deliver efficient and safe solutions for streamlined code delivery across various supported environments. This role is ideal for individuals with a strong coding background who are also comfortable working on infrastructure, automation and operations-related topics or are motivated to develop expertise in these areas.
  
  

* Guarantee the GitLab Release Process
* Create new tools and frameworks to automate the release process
* Build new GitLab release features to replace existing custom tooling by contributing to new work for our Release Framework
* Work with individual teams on defining and implementing solutions that will help them release quicker
* Create frameworks that allow engineers to write code that scales with demand
* Help teams instrument their code and helps recognize parts of code that could benefit from increased observability
* Work closely with peer Infrastructure Platforms groups to control the impact of application code running in user facing products
* Help communicate the release schedule clearly with others
* Develop monitoring and alerting to measure release process velocity
* Identify process bottlenecks and introduce optimizations
* Participate in Release Manager rotation

**Requirements**
As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* Strong coding background. Mandatory Ruby or Go (willing to learn Ruby is a must). Proficiency with Ruby is a strong plus. Ruby on Rails knowledge is not mandatory
* Experience working on large-scale systems
* Experience optimizing Continuous Delivery and Continuous Deployment pipelines as well as the tooling and processes that go with them
* Interest in cloud platforms, containerization, and Infrastructure as Code tools
* Application and systems observability background
* Collaboration mindset, boundless curiosity and a demonstrable ability to learn
* A product development mindset when developing new components

You share our values, and work in accordance with those values.
  
  
**Performance indicators**
**The Delivery Team Has The Following Performance Indicators**

* Mean Time to Production

**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
  
  
**Privacy Policy:**
Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
  
  
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

title: Software Engineer
description:

At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!
  
  
**Your opportunity**

**What You’ll Do**

* Golang Proficiency: Proficiency in Go, specifically for infrastructure automation and systems programming.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Senior Platform Engineer - GCP
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.
  
  
Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for a strong Senior Platform Engineer to design, build, and evolve the enterprise platform that serves as the foundation for engineering teams across the company.
  
  
Leveraging GCP, Kubernetes/GKE, Terraform, GitOps, and automation, you will build scalable, secure, reliable, and reusable platform capabilities that accelerate software delivery, simplify operations, and provide a consistent developer experience.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on platform engineer who can take ownership from design through production, solve complex technical problems, establish engineering standards, and work across teams to improve the overall platform.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design, build, and operate scalable, secure, highly available, and reliable GCP platform capabilities.
* Build and evolve production Kubernetes/GKE platforms supporting business-critical workloads.
* Develop reusable platform capabilities, standards, and patterns that enable engineering teams to deploy and operate workloads consistently.
* Build and manage infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code, with a focus on repeatability and maintainability.
* Implement and improve GitOps and CI/CD practices, using tools such as ArgoCD and other CI/CD platforms.
* Develop automation using Python, Shell, or similar technologies to reduce manual operational work.
* Design and implement GCP networking, IAM, compute, storage, load balancing, and security patterns that support application and platform workloads.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across GCP, Kubernetes, networking, infrastructure, and platform services.
* Improve platform reliability, scalability, performance, security, and operational efficiency.
* Build platform standards and self-service capabilities that improve the developer experience and reduce operational dependencies.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews and provide technical guidance on platform engineering decisions.
* Partner closely with Application, SRE, DevOps, Security, and Architecture teams to understand requirements and deliver platform capabilities.
* Lead or participate in major incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to engineering standards, technical practices, and knowledge sharing.

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, SRE, or a similar engineering role.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and operating GCP production environments.
* Strong production experience with Kubernetes/GKE.
* Strong experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD and GitOps-based deployment practices.
* Strong understanding of GCP and cloud fundamentals, including:
* Networking
* IAM and access control
* Compute
* Storage
* Load balancing
* Security
* Experience building and operating highly available and scalable platforms.
* Strong production troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across cloud and Kubernetes environments.
* Experience developing automation using Python, Shell, or similar scripting languages.
* Experience taking ownership of platform capabilities from design and implementation through production operations.
* Strong understanding of platform reliability, security, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence technical decisions across teams.
* Demonstrated technical leadership and ability to mentor engineers.

GCP & Kubernetes
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform in production.
* Strong experience operating Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) in production.
* Good understanding of GCP services and concepts relevant to platform engineering, including:
* VPC and networking
* IAM
* Compute Engine
* Cloud Storage
* Load Balancing
* Cloud DNS
* Secret Manager
* Cloud Monitoring
* Experience with Kubernetes concepts including workload management, networking, ingress, resource management, scaling, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
* Ability to understand and troubleshoot issues across the GCP → GKE → workload stack.

Infrastructure as Code & Automation
  
  

* Strong experience using Terraform to provision and manage cloud infrastructure.
* Experience managing infrastructure through version-controlled repositories and automated workflows.
* Understanding of Terraform modules, state management, dependencies, and lifecycle management.
* Ability to develop reusable infrastructure patterns and automation.
* Strong focus on eliminating manual operational processes through automation.

Platform Engineering & Developer Experience
  
  

* Experience building reusable platform capabilities that can be consumed by multiple engineering teams.
* Ability to establish standardized patterns and guardrails without unnecessarily restricting development teams.
* Understanding of developer experience and the challenges application teams face when consuming cloud platforms.
* Experience improving deployment workflows, platform usability, and operational consistency.
* Exposure to self-service platform capabilities is highly valuable.
* Ability to reduce operational dependencies and enable engineering teams to become more self-sufficient.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Experience operating enterprise-scale or multi-team GCP environments.
* Experience developing reusable Terraform modules, platform frameworks, or shared infrastructure capabilities.
* Advanced GKE/Kubernetes platform engineering experience.
* Experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar CI/CD platforms.
* Experience with ArgoCD, FluxCD, or other GitOps technologies.
* Experience implementing platform security, governance, and compliance controls.
* Experience with GCP services such as Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, BigQuery, Memorystore, Artifact Registry, KMS, or similar services.
* Experience with cloud migration or application modernization initiatives.
* Experience working with distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native architectures.
* Experience working in financial services or other regulated environments.

What We Value
  
  

* Platform ownership — take responsibility for capabilities from design through production.
* Engineering mindset — build scalable and maintainable solutions rather than one-off fixes.
* Automation-first thinking — reduce manual work and operational toil.
* Strong focus on reliability, security, scalability, and simplicity.
* Ability to solve complex production problems and drive issues through to resolution.
* Ability to design standards and reusable capabilities that work across multiple engineering teams.
* Strong collaboration and ability to influence without direct authority.
* Focus on improving the developer experience and making the platform easier to consume.
* Willingness to mentor engineers and raise the technical maturity of the team.
* Curiosity and continuous learning, particularly as GCP and cloud-native technologies evolve.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**

Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

description:

Synechron is seeking a
**AWS Platform Engineer**
with 8+ years of experience in AWS cloud engineering, infrastructure automation, DevOps, and AI platform enablement. The role will design, migrate, secure, and operate scalable AWS platforms.

**Required**

title: Senior Solutions Automation Engineer
description:
**Description**
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with a Heart.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Nutanix Validated Designs (NVDs) certify Nutanix Solutions cross-product interoperability at scale. Solutions Automation Engineers build the software behind that certification: the programmatic environment builds and validation workflows that Solutions Architects and Quality Engineering rely on.
  
  
We are changing how that work gets done. Standing up infrastructure is already a solved problem for us, because our Python infrastructure-as-code tooling builds the same environment the same way every time. Judgment is the harder part, and it covers reading a validated design, catching the contradictions buried in it, and justifying every design decision before anything gets built. That is the work we are handing to agents.
  
  
In this role you will write the deterministic Python that has to be correct on every run, and you will build the agentic workflows around it: the prompts, the skills, the guardrails, and the evaluations that decide when an agent can act on its own and when control belongs to a pipeline or to a person.
  
  
You will work on hard problems at scale, with the freedom to deliver, alongside engineers who care about getting it right.
  
  
Your Role
  
  

* Design, build, and maintain Python software that deploys, configures, and validates Nutanix private and hybrid cloud environments.
* Build agentic workflows around that software, including prompt engineering, agent skill and tool development, and the evaluation harnesses that show a workflow works before we rely on it.
* Decide what belongs in deterministic code and what belongs to an agent, and be able to defend that decision. Most of what you deliver should be deterministic and repeatable, with agents used where the problem involves ambiguity, synthesis, or design judgment.
* Use agentic coding tools in your daily work, and help raise the team's practice as the tooling changes.
* Build and operate cloud native, automated pipelines, covering containerized workloads, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code, so that builds and validations run without manual intervention.
* Automate validation as part of building the feature, and catch regressions before a release reaches a customer.
* Analyze failures, determine root cause, and drive fixes to closure.
* Demo your work to Solutions Architects, product teams, and customers, and write documentation that other people can actually use.
* Engage with customers and support when needed to solve production issues.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* 6+ years building production software, with real depth in at least one role.
* Python is required. We are looking for production-grade depth and the ability to own a Python codebase that other people depend on.
* Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic tooling: prompt engineering, agent skills or tool definitions, and testing and evaluating non-deterministic systems.
* Good judgment about where automation should be deterministic and where an agent adds value, and the discipline to keep the trusted path in code.
* Strong fundamentals in Object-Oriented Programming, algorithms, data structures, and problem solving.
* Cloud native delivery experience: containerized applications (Docker, Kubernetes) and automated CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience working against REST APIs and building infrastructure as code.
* Experience with a "systems" product such as storage, virtualization, networking, databases, or operating systems.
* Skill in debugging complex distributed applications.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the confidence to present technical work to customers and senior stakeholders.
* A self-starter who can work independently, juggle competing priorities, respect differences, and maintain professionalism under pressure.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Additional languages beyond Python: Golang, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React, Angular, etc.
* Experience with Terraform, Ansible, or comparable infrastructure as code tooling.
* Background as a platform engineer, SRE, or solutions architect who writes production code.
* Experience with Jira, GitHub, Artifactory, and modern CI systems.
* Public evidence of your work: GitHub projects, open source contributions, or published technical writing.

description:

BHN helps businesses grow revenue, increase loyalty, motivate and reward their teams, disburse funds and engage consumers. You'll split your time between engineering solutions and operating our production platforms—maintaining the health of BHN's production services while building the automation, observability, and AI-driven capabilities that make incidents less frequent, easier to diagnose, and faster to resolve.

As part of the OCC, you'll play an active role in Major Incident Management, partnering with engineering teams to diagnose and restore production services during critical incidents. This role provides exceptional exposure to large-scale distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, observability platforms, automation, AI-assisted software development, and production engineering.
