title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Implementation Engineering)
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

**Forward Deployed Engineer (Implementation Engineering)**

*Embedded, hands-on engineering with enterprise customers building AI-native software delivery*

Harness builds the AI Software Delivery Platform used by engineering organizations to automate testing, deployments, application security, reliability, and cost optimization across the software delivery lifecycle. The company is led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal, founder of AppDynamics, and is backed by leading investors. Harness customers use the platform to ship software faster while maintaining strong security and governance, and the company's AI Agents are extending that automation across the entire delivery lifecycle.

We are looking for exceptional engineers to join our fast-growing global team and help build the future of AI-native software delivery.

**Position Summary**
====================

Forward Deployed Engineers work embedded inside enterprise engineering teams to design and build AI-native automation on the Harness platform. This is a hands-on, code-first role. You will write production code and scripts, build production pipelines, and connect Harness AI Agents into a customer's existing systems, staying engaged until the capability is live in production. You will work directly alongside customer engineers, turning business objectives into working software rather than documentation or advice.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Embed inside a customer's engineering organization for the length of a build engagement to design and build agent-driven automation across the software delivery lifecycle.
* Write production code connecting Harness AI Agents to a customer's pipelines, repositories, ITSM tooling, security systems, and infrastructure.
* Partner directly with customer engineering stakeholders and the broader Harness delivery team to translate an approved plan into working software.
* Prototype quickly, ship incrementally, and iterate directly with customer engineers rather than handing off a static design document.
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and share them with the broader Harness delivery organization.
* Bring direct feedback to Harness product and engineering teams based on what you learn building in real customer environments.
* Support the transition from custom build to steady-state operation so the customer can independently operate and extend what you built.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* A working, production agent integration lives in the customer's environment by the end of the engagement.
* A reusable pattern or template captured in the Solutions Factory as a direct result of the build.
* Customer engineering stakeholders are able to operate and extend the integration without an ongoing Forward Deployed Engineer presence.
* Healthy, ongoing customer adoption of the Harness platform and AI Agents beyond the specific build, achieved by working closely with the customer throughout the engagement rather than handing off at go-live.
  

**About You**
=============

* A platform engineering or software engineering background, with hands-on coding, scripting, and integration ability, not configuration-only experience. You are comfortable working directly in a customer's codebase, infrastructure workflows, and CI/CD frameworks.
* Experience building integrations against APIs, event-driven systems, or LLM and agent orchestration frameworks.
* Prior experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering, architecture, or embedded consulting capacity where success was measured by working software, not documentation or advisory output.
* Strong grounding in CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code, plus depth in at least one adjacent domain, such as security, observability, or cost management, sufficient to reason about where an agent should plug into a customer's software delivery lifecycle.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity: able to work from a business objective and an agent's capability boundary to a working integration without a pre-written specification.
* Excellent stakeholder communication, able to work day to day with customer engineers while keeping internal stakeholders aligned on progress.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites for the duration of an active build.

### **Harness in the news:**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

title: Senior Principal - SRE Principal, Automation & Toil Reduction
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The SRE Principal, Automation & Toil Reduction leads the engineering of automation that removes repetitive operational work and improves the reliability, resilience and efficiency of GSK platforms. The role acts as a hands-on principal SRE, shaping reusable automation patterns, enabling safe autonomous operations and embedding measurable toil reduction across platform domains.

The role sits in Reliability Engineering & Operations and works across platform domains through a hub-and-spoke model. It owns the enterprise approach for identifying, baselining and prioritising toil, and converts high-value candidates into production-grade automation for diagnostics, remediation, recovery, fulfilment and compliance workflows. Platform build direction remains with Principal Engineers and Engineering Directors, major incident command remains with the Major Incident Manager, and the central reliability and automation standard is set by the Reliability Engineering Senior Director. Automation outcomes and priorities are agreed jointly with Platform Managers and Product Owners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and evolve the enterprise SRE automation and toil-reduction strategy, roadmap, reference patterns and engineering standards.
* Establish a consistent toil taxonomy and measurement approach using operational data, service-management evidence, task frequency, effort, risk and business impact.
* Prioritise automation candidates by hours avoided, repeatability, reliability risk, human-error exposure, control value, delivery complexity and reuse potential.
* Design and build secure, reusable automation for provisioning, diagnostics, incident triage, remediation, recovery, capacity, patching, service requests and compliance evidence.
* Create APIs, event-driven integrations, workflows, infrastructure-as-code modules, runbook automation and self-service capabilities rather than isolated scripts.
* Engineer closed-loop and AI-assisted operations with strong telemetry, policy controls, confidence thresholds, auditability and human approval for higher-risk actions.
* Establish production guardrails covering identity, least privilege, secrets, testing, change integration, release, rollback, failure containment and support ownership.
* Instrument automation to measure success, failure, latency, coverage, adoption, exceptions, cost and reliability impact end to end.
* Integrate automation with observability, ITSM, CI/CD, configuration, orchestration and knowledge platforms to reduce hand-offs and context switching.
* Use incident, problem and post-incident evidence to identify recurring failure modes and convert them into permanent engineering fixes or automated prevention.
* Partner with service and platform owners to define SLOs for automation-enabled services and use error-budget and risk evidence to prioritise reliability work.
* Lead technical design reviews for high-impact automation and prevent unsafe, brittle or low-value automation from becoming operational debt.
* Coach engineers, publish reusable patterns and grow an automation community of practice across internal and supplier teams.
* Provide technical oversight of supplier-delivered automation and ensure GSK retains maintainable code, documentation, telemetry, security evidence and knowledge.
* Track outcomes including toil ratio, capacity returned, automation adoption, cycle time, repeat incidents, MTTR, human-error reduction and control effectiveness.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience, such as Computer Science or Software Engineering.
* Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE, security, IT service management or automation certifications are desirable.

**Area of Specialisation**

* Site reliability engineering, toil management and operations automation at enterprise scale.
* Software engineering for production operations, including APIs, event-driven integration, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, testing and observability.
* AIOps and safe autonomous operations, including anomaly detection, decision support and governed remediation.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical engineering experience.
* Typically 8 or more years of experience in software, platform, infrastructure or reliability engineering, with substantial hands-on ownership of production services and automation.
* Demonstrated experience converting recurring operational work into reliable, reusable automation with measurable adoption and benefits.
* Advanced programming and automation engineering using Python or an equivalent language, including
* APIs, testing, packaging, error handling and secure coding.
* Deep coding or scripting capability, plus practical experience with APIs, source control, automated testing and CI/CD.
* Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code, configuration management or enterprise orchestration.
* Experience instrumenting distributed systems and automation workflows using metrics, logs, traces and events.
* Experience applying SRE practices including SLOs, error budgets, incident management, postmortems, resilience and toil reduction.
* Experience designing safe production automation controls for access, secrets, approvals, change, rollback, audit and ongoing support.
* Experience leading technical design across multiple teams, mentoring experienced engineers and influencing without formal authority.
* Platform engineering depth in at least one domain such as cloud, hosting, networks, containers, databases or digital workplace.

**Desirable requirements:**

* Relevant cloud, Kubernetes, DevOps, SRE, security, IT service management or automation certifications.
* Experience with AIOps, generative AI or agentic operations, including evaluation, confidence thresholds, guardrails and human-in-the-loop approval.
* Experience creating self-service platforms, service catalogues, golden paths or reusable automation products.
* Experience with chaos engineering, game days, automated recovery testing, progressive delivery and pre-change or post-change validation.
* Experience integrating observability, ITSM, CMDB, CI/CD and orchestration platforms to reduce operational hand-offs.
* Experience operating in a global, multi-supplier environment and assuring supplier-delivered code, documentation, telemetry and knowledge transfer.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare or another regulated industry, including GxP or validated systems.
* Experience measuring capacity returned, repeat-incident reduction, automation execution success, exception rates, control effectiveness and reuse.

**Skills/Background**

* Principal-level judgement to distinguish genuine toil from valuable engineering work and to know when simplification is better than automation.
* Ability to influence platform, product, operations, security, quality and supplier teams without formal authority.
* Product mindset for automation, including users, SLOs, ownership, documentation, lifecycle, support and decommissioning.
* Composure during live incidents and discipline to convert restored service into permanent prevention.
* Ability to explain complex technical decisions to engineers and senior stakeholders in outcome-oriented language.
* Commitment to automate work away rather than becoming indispensable to recurring manual activity.
* Learning mindset toward evolving AIOps, agentic automation and platform engineering practices, without adopting technology ahead of control maturity.

**Skills**

Automation, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Configuration Management (CM), Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM), Disaster Recovery (DR), Financial Operations, Identity Access Management (IAM), Incident Management, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Operating Systems (OS), Performance Tuning, Python (Programming Language), Scripting, Software Engineering, SRE Observability, System Monitors, Vulnerability Management

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

In partnership with product teams, application owners, HR, security, architecture, operations and audit stakeholders, you will then apply these capabilities to engineer and release secure IAM lifecycle solutions while improving automation, governance and identity-data quality.

**About the team**:

IAM Lifecycle Management owns the identity and account lifecycle end to end. The team ensures that people and non-human identities receive appropriate access when created, joining, moving, changing status or returning, and that access is suspended or removed promptly when no longer required across on-premises, cloud and SaaS systems.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Implement and enhance Azure DevOps pipeline engineering for IAM solutions, including reusable YAML templates, build and release automation, artifact management, automated testing, code-quality and security gates, secrets handling, environment promotion, deployment approvals, release evidence, end-to-end traceability and tested rollback controls.
* Deliver assigned lifecycle engineering work to agreed scope, quality, security and timelines, identifying delivery risks and dependencies early.
* Collaborate with product owners, architects and engineering stakeholders to translate business, security, regulatory and architectural requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable technical solutions.
* Engineer end-to-end identity and account lifecycle capabilities, including creation, provisioning, modification, suspension, recertification and deprovisioning across on-premises, cloud and SaaS systems.
* Implement and enhance joiner, mover, leaver, rehire, contractor and non-human identity workflows, including trigger events, approval paths, account states, exception handling and recovery controls.
* Integrate authoritative HR and identity sources with directories, governance platforms and target applications using connectors, APIs and event-driven services, while improving source-data quality and reconciliation.
* Create functional and technical test scenarios, maintain requirements traceability and implementation evidence, and support remediation of defects, audit findings and control gaps.
* Develop, enhance and support secure IAM applications using Next.js microfrontends, Express.js and NestJS services, GraphQL APIs and .NET components, applying reusable architecture patterns across the full solution stack.
* Design and deliver accessible, responsive Next.js user interfaces and secure Express.js, NestJS or ASP.NET APIs for IAM lifecycle applications, with reusable components, API versioning, validation, authentication, authorisation, error handling, observability and performance optimisation.
* Support colleagues through technical guidance, peer review, troubleshooting, reusable documentation and knowledge sharing.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and operating Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, including reusable YAML templates, pipeline-as-code practices, artifact and package management, automated unit and integration tests, code-quality and security gates, secrets handling, deployment approvals, environment promotion, release traceability and rollback controls.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in identity and access management, including implementation and support of identity and account lifecycle capabilities.
* Strong understanding of joiner, mover, leaver, rehire, employee, contractor and non-human identity lifecycle patterns and their associated governance controls.
* Experience designing and configuring provisioning and deprovisioning workflows, approval processes, birthright and role-based access, account-state transitions and exception handling.
* Experience integrating IAM platforms with HR systems, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP, databases, SaaS applications and custom applications.
* Knowledge of identity data models, account correlation, reconciliation, access reviews, certification, policy enforcement, orphan-account prevention and auditability.
* Strong hands-on development experience with Next.js, Express.js and NestJS, including microfrontend architecture, TypeScript, reusable user-interface components, secure backend services, authentication and authorisation integration, automated testing and performance optimisation.
* Experience delivering end-to-end UI and API solutions across Next.js microfrontends and Express.js, NestJS, GraphQL or .NET services, including responsive design, secure API development, input validation, automated testing, documentation and production troubleshooting.
* Hands-on engineering experience with .NET and ASP.NET Web APIs, including secure service design, authentication and authorisation, integration with IAM platforms, automated testing, performance optimisation and production support.
* Understanding of least privilege, segregation of duties, account ownership, privileged-access dependencies and application-security practices.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver work independently to a high standard, with strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation and stakeholder-communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Advanced experience architecting enterprise-scale Azure DevOps delivery platforms for Next.js, Express.js, NestJS, GraphQL and .NET solutions, including governed reusable YAML templates, artifact lifecycle management, multi-stage CI/CD, automated quality and security controls, deployment approvals, release traceability, resilience and rollback strategies.
* Advanced hands-on experience with SailPoint, Saviynt or a comparable IGA platform, including workflow, connector and policy configuration.

* Relevant certification such as CISSP, SailPoint, Saviynt, CIMP, Microsoft Azure or another IAM, cloud or security certification.

* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Typical tools and technologies: Azure DevOps Pipelines and Artifacts; YAML, Git, CI/CD automation, quality and security gates, deployment approvals, release traceability and rollback controls; Next.js, React, TypeScript, microfrontend frameworks and UI component libraries; Express.js; .NET and ASP.NET Web APIs; REST and SOAP APIs, Microsoft Graph, JSON and SQL; SailPoint, Saviynt, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP and Azure integration services.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

title: Application Support Engineering Associate Director
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The Enterprise Application Support (EAS) team is responsible for providing technical application support for ITP and ECS lines of business. Within EAS, the Associate Director Application Support Engineering / SRE Lead (Site Reliability Engineer Lead) is a senior technical role responsible for driving the overall reliability, scalability, and performance of critical systems by implementing standard methodologies, participating in incident response, automating processes, and collaborating with development teams to ensure system stability and uptime across the organization, often acting as a technical partner in promoting a strong SRE culture within the company; key responsibilities include designing monitoring systems, capacity planning, and actively identifying and mitigating potential issues before they impact users.
  
  
The SRE team works closely with development teams, infrastructure and network partners, security partners, Scrum Masters, and internal / external clients to improve observability, operational supportability, resiliency, and mean time to restore service through driving improvements to support capabilities.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Scrum Participation: Join all project collaborators planning and design sessions, sprint zero and stand-ups for all new delivery, to champion SRE requirements reflective of a strong observability and resiliency traits.
* System Reliability Architecture: Drive Design and help implement reliable, resilient, and scalable systems, considering redundancy, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery strategies. Make design recommendations that will allow the application to recover without cleanup activities or create a recovery runbook for application support team to follow for improved application recovery times.
* Monitoring and Alerting: Develop comprehensive monitoring systems to identify potential issues proactively, define actionable alerts, and establish SLIs (Service Level Indicators) and SLOs (Service Level Objectives).
* Incident Management: Lead incident response during critical system outages, facilitating timely problem diagnosis and resolution, conducting post-mortem analysis to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences.
* Automation and Tooling: Develop and maintain automation scripts to streamline operational tasks, including self-healing, application deployments, scaling, and infrastructure management.
* Collaboration with Development Teams: Work closely with development teams to integrate SRE practices into the software development lifecycle, promoting code quality, reliability, and observability.
* Security Integration: Collaborate with security teams to ensure system resilience against cyber threats, implementing security best practices and supervising for vulnerabilities.
* Technical Expertise: Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends related to cloud computing, distributed systems, and reliability engineering.
* Operational Readiness: Attend and present operational readiness with application support (EAS L2) at each project management meeting - raise any operational risks and concerns. Test SRE requirements in UAT environments to validate effectiveness and completeness of operational capabilities.
* Risk Management: Partner with IT Embedded Risk Managers to identify strategic solutions for risk incidents.
* Metrics and Reporting: Demonstrate operational improvements through defined KPIs.
* Capacity Planning: Proactively assess system capacity needs, plan for future growth, and implement scaling strategies to ensure optimal performance under high load.
* Performance Optimization: Analyze system performance metrics to identify bottlenecks and implement optimization strategies to improve system responsiveness and efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 8 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

**Talents Needed For Success**

* Strong Programming Skills: Proficiency in one or more programming languages like Python, Java, Go, etc. including the use of AI technology (Amazon Q, Kiro), for automation and development of monitoring and SRE compliance validation tools.
* System Administration: Expertise in Linux/Unix operating systems, network administration, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Mainframe experience is a plus.
* Monitoring and Observability: Deep understanding of monitoring tools (Splunk, Grafana, Dynatrace, ITSI, etc.) and experience in designing robust monitoring systems.
* Incident Management: Proven track record to participate in incident response teams under pressure, effectively solving complex issues.
* Experience in the financial services industry is good to have

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
**Role Summary**
The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable.
  
  
The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix — Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions — ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks.
  
  
The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation
  
  

* Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments.
* Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology.

**Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build**

* Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained.
* Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership.

**Integration and Data Engineering**

* Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

**DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management**

* Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management.
* Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control.
* Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles.

**Vendor and Managed Service Delivery**

* Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance.
* Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Alignment**

* Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability.
* Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums.

**Organisational Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8–10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources.
* Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality.

**Compliance, Risk and Governance**

* Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements.
* Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management.

**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application.
* Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies.
* Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline.
* Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management.
* Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred.
* Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness
* Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context.
* Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon).
* Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions.
* Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes.
* Recognised cloud or architecture certification.

**Physical/Mental Requirements**
Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work.
  
  
**Non-standard Work Schedule, Travel Or Environment Requirements**
Occasional travel up to 20%
  
  
Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare.
  
  
**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**
Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead.
  
  
Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation.
  
  
External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners.
  
  
**RESOURCES MANAGED
  
  
Financial Accountability**
Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation
  
  
**Supervision**
Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects,integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleague's leadership.
  
  
Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER
  
  
**Location: Chennai | Type: Fulltime**
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.
  
  
From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.
  
  
We are proud to be a Great Place to Work certified company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people s lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in.
  
  
You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end-to-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself.
  
  
This is a builder-first individual-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You Ll Do**
**Problem / Opportunity Discovery**

* Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable.
* Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week.
* Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships.
* Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques.

**Build (fast) with AI**

* When the brief is clear, head down and produce.
* Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain-driven design.
* Create fullstack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, FastAPI, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono.
* Architect and ship production-grade agentic applications using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer.
* Integrate frontier and self-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors.
* Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with ElasticSearch or Solr, and BM25 + similarity search.
* Work across relational, document, key-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event-driven patterns where they fit, not by default.
* Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub-agents with discipline and review.
* Fine-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it.

**Test, Deploy, Productionize**

* Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users.
* Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless chosen for fit, not preference.
* Treat evals as a first-class discipline: hands-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks. Build with a clear-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short.
* Apply engineering practices that hold up in production: TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Own what you build end-to-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running.
* Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices.

**What You Bring**

* Minimum 7+years of Experience and 3+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches fullstack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models. You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and innovative approaches.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You've built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* End-to-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses.
* Cloud-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave and where they break and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost.
* Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them.
* A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Healthcare or life sciences domain exposure.
* AWS Professional certification or other relevant industry certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we re building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer:
  
  

* A people-first culture - Supportive peers, open communication and a strong sense of belonging
* Smart, purposeful collaboration - Work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges
* Balance that lasts - We respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life
* Room to grow - Opportunities for learning, leadership and career development, shaped around you
* Meaningful rewards - Competitive compensation that recognises both contribution and potential

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
VNDLY, a Workday company, is a next-generation vendor management SaaS platform designed for procurement executives, talent acquisition teams, suppliers, and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to optimize contingent workforce management. We develop cloud software that simplifies talent sourcing and acquisition across various channels, including staffing agencies, job boards, and freelance management systems. Our aim is to create intuitive software that enables customers to efficiently acquire top talent (contractors or full-time employees) through data-driven insights and transparent dashboards.
  
  
As part of Workday, we are committed to becoming the most customer-centric enterprise software company in the world. We prioritize enabling our customers to connect to the talent they need to excel, achieved by fostering an exceptional engineering team committed to code quality and innovative design.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Development Engineer, you will be joining a team in Chennai responsible for maintaining and building our pay-related features. This is a hands-on-keyboard role where you will not only build features but also own the design, scalability, and resilience of critical services.
  
  
You will tackle complex challenges related to how contingent workers are onboarded, managed, and paid, working on key features like Jobs, Worker Provisioning, Contracts, and Integrations. You will be a key voice in our architectural decisions and will guide the team in building robust solutions using our stack: Python (backend), React (frontend), and AWS.
  
  
**About You**
This role is for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex software problems. The ideal candidate will join an established office of 15 VNDLY colleagues and will be at the forefront of building our engineering presence as part of Workday's larger investment in Chennai!
  
  
Beyond a desire for solving complex and writing high-quality, efficient code, this person must be an exceptional communicator, acting as a key technical connection between our established U.S. teams and the new Chennai office. The ability to work independently, while also working effectively within a large, distributed team, is essential.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 4+ years shown experience in software development, including experience in designing, building, and maintaining RESTful web services and working with SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Deep proficiency in Python and experience with at least one Python web framework (e.g., Django, Flask).
* Strong experience with JavaScript frameworks, specifically React.js.

**Other Qualifications**

* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools (e.g., Git).
* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda).
* Knowledge of SaaS applications, multi-tenant architectures, and DevOps/CI/CD practices.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.

Workday is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.
  
  
Further, pursuant to applicable local ordinances, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
You may view the Workday's Pay Transparency Policy, and Equal Employment Opportunity is the Law notice, by clicking on their corresponding links.
  
  
Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans during our application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, contact us at accommodations@workday.com.

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

title: Senior Engineer I - QA
description:
**What is Contentstack?**
Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.
  
  
While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.
  
  
Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.
  
  
Learn more at www.contentstack.com.
  
  
**Who Are We?**
At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let's go!
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Own the test strategy for Platform (Web and API): decide what runs on every PR, nightly and at release
* Perform frontend and backend testing (Platform - Web, REST APIs, analytics and data pipelines)
* Perform regression and sanity testing across environments and cloud regions (AWS, GCP, Azure) and give a clear go/no-go for releases
* Design, build and maintain the UI and API automation frameworks (Playwright/Selenium), including shared page objects, fixtures, test data and stable selectors
* Add automated quality gates to CI/CD pipelines, and track and fix flaky tests
* Plan and run performance and load tests for APIs and data pipelines
* Validate data correctness for analytics and metering pipelines (completeness, duplicates, reconciliation)
* Build internal scripts and tools to automate QA processes and test data creation Generate testing reports, status reports and QA metrics (pass rate, defect escape rate) Create and maintain the test case repository
* Provide feedback to the developers, review test code and pull requests
* Mentor junior QA engineers and help developers write better tests
* Complete tasks in a timely manner
* Update internal product documentation

**Mandatory Skills**

* 3 to 5 years of QA experience, with at least 2 years in test automation
* Strong experience with JavaScript/TypeScript based E2E frameworks like Playwright or Cypress.io Experience designing an automation framework from scratch (page objects, fixtures, reporting)
* Strong knowledge of JSON and REST, and API test automation (Postman/Newman, REST Assured, Playwright API or similar)
* Experience in Load Testing with tools like JMeter, k6 or Locust
* Knowledge of Continuous Integration and hands-on experience with Jenkins, GoCD or GitHub Actions
* Experience in using Github and Git, including code reviews
* Experience in any bug reporting and test management tool such as JIRA
* Strong knowledge of the system development life cycle and the testing life cycle
* Experience in Agile/Scrum
* Good SQL and data validation skills; experience testing data or analytics pipelines is preferred
* Experience with logs and monitoring tools (Observe, Datadog or similar) for root cause analysis is preferred
* Basic knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure) is preferred Self-Directed - Ability to detect and solve problems

**What Do We Offer?**
**Interesting Work |**
We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the "challenge yourself" role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you're doing it.
  
  
**Tribe Vibe**
| We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict "no a\*\*hole policy" and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.
  
  
**Bragging Rights**
| We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!
  
  
**One Team One Dream**
| This is one of our values, and it shows. We don't believe in artificial hierarchies. If you're part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it's a great time to be joining…

description:
**Job Summary**
Serve as a technical lead for hybrid delivery of cloud native web applications using AWS React TypeScript Node JS and Java Springboot ensuring high quality engineering practices for a day shift role with no travel. Collaborate across teams to design secure scalable solutions and contribute domain insight in auto claims and property and casualty insurance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement end to end cloud native applications on AWS using services that support scalable resilient and secure enterprise solutions for business critical functions in insurance
* Develop rich responsive user interfaces with React and TypeScript that provide accessible intuitive and high performing user experiences for internal and external stakeholders
* Engineer robust backend services with Node JS that expose well structured APIs and support reliable integrations with internal platforms and external partners in the insurance ecosystem
* Build and maintain Java Springboot microservices that enable modular deployment clear service boundaries and efficient data processing for transactional and analytical workloads
* Optimize application performance by profiling services tuning queries refining front end rendering strategies and addressing bottlenecks that affect latency throughput and user responsiveness
* Apply secure coding practices across the stack by validating input protecting sensitive data managing secrets through AWS services and aligning with internal compliance guidelines
* Collaborate with product managers business analysts and quality engineers to refine user stories define acceptance criteria and deliver increments that clearly align with customer outcomes
* Guide the selection and configuration of AWS infrastructure components such as compute storage networking and managed services to balance cost reliability and performance objectives
* Implement automated testing strategies covering unit integration and end to end scenarios to improve regression detection and support confident frequent releases to production environments
* Contribute to continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines by configuring build jobs test execution quality gates and deployment workflows that enhance delivery speed and stability
* Document solution designs technical decisions and operational runbooks in a clear organized manner so that support teams and future engineers can maintain and extend the platform efficiently
* Engage with stakeholders in auto claims and property and casualty insurance to translate domain requirements into technical designs that improve claims handling underwriting and policy servicing
* Provide mentoring and code review support to peers by sharing best practices in React TypeScript Node JS Java Springboot and AWS while fostering an inclusive and collaborative engineering culture

**Qualifications**

* Possess six to ten years of professional software engineering experience with a strong focus on building and scaling distributed web applications for complex business domains
* Demonstrate advanced proficiency in React and TypeScript including state management patterns reusable component design and integration with backend APIs for dynamic data driven interfaces
* Exhibit strong hands on experience in Node JS and Java Springboot for building RESTful services integrating with databases and implementing domain logic with attention to maintainability and testability
* Show proven capability with AWS core services for compute storage networking monitoring and security along with practical exposure to infrastructure as code and cloud cost awareness
* Bring practical understanding of auto claims and property and casualty insurance processes as a desirable asset enabling more effective collaboration with domain experts and product stakeholders
* Communicate clearly in hybrid work settings by using collaboration tools structured updates and inclusive discussions to keep distributed team members aligned and productive in day shift operations
* Display a continuous learning mindset by staying current with updates in AWS React TypeScript Node JS and Java Springboot and by applying new techniques that improve quality reliability and user value

**Certifications Required**
AWS Certified Developer Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate preferred

title: Production Support Analyst
description:
**About The Role**
Citi's Securities Services division is seeking a Senior Production Support Analyst to join the Data & Client Platforms (DCP) Production Support team — a globally distributed, 24×6 function supporting business-critical and client-facing data and reporting platforms across Investor & Issuer Services.
  
  
This is a senior operational role that sits at the intersection of data platform operations, client service delivery, and technology transformation. The DCP PS team supports an expanding portfolio of platforms serving some of the world's largest institutional investors, across multiple geographies and business lines within Investor & Issuer Services.
  
  
The team is actively investing in engineering capability, automation, and AI-assisted operations — making this an opportunity for candidates who want to grow beyond traditional incident management into a forward-looking, engineering-oriented production support function.
  
  
**What You Will Be Working On**
The DCP platform underpins Citi's data distribution, client reporting, and operational data services across Securities Services. You will be supporting a portfolio of proprietary and industry-standard platforms spanning:
  
  

* Client data and reporting platforms — real-time and end-of-day data delivery, client reporting, and operational oversight tools
* Data lake and cloud-native platforms — next-generation cloud data infrastructure built on modern technologies including Snowflake, Apache Kafka, Couchbase, Amazon S3, and DataBricks
* Client-facing digital experience — platforms delivering data, reporting, and instructions to institutional clients via Citi's digital channels
* Entitlements and data access management — infrastructure governing client and user access to data services

The platform is undergoing significant transformation — including migration of applications to modernised digital platforms, consolidation of data services across business lines, and adoption of cloud-native data lake architectures. You will be directly involved in supporting this evolution.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Production Operations**

* Provide L2 production support across the DCP application portfolio — incident triage, investigation, escalation, and resolution — operating within a global follow-the-sun support model
* Perform start-of-day checks, continuous platform monitoring, and structured regional handovers to ensure seamless 24×6 coverage
* Manage and resolve user and client-reported incidents via ServiceNow, maintaining SLA adherence and clear communication throughout the incident lifecycle

**Client Service & Communication**

* Act as the internal operational point of contact for client-impacting incidents — providing timely, accurate, and professional communication to client-facing teams including Client Services, Technology Relationship Managers, and Operations
* Proactively identify and escalate data quality and service availability issues — contributing to a detect-first operating model that reduces client-reported incidents
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of a centralised service level inventory — ensuring Citi's commitments to institutional clients are tracked, governed, and met

**Platform Stability & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and drive resolution of recurring incident patterns through structured problem management — reducing manual toil and preventing reoccurrence
* Develop and maintain technical runbooks, support documentation, and operational procedures across the platform portfolio
* Contribute to automation and observability initiatives — using tools including Grafana, ITRS, and GCO — to reduce manual effort and improve platform monitoring coverage
* Participate in change management activities including release preparation, deployment support, post-implementation review, and production risk assessments

**Engineering & AI Enablement**

* Actively engage with and adopt AI-assisted tooling for incident troubleshooting, automated investigation, and resiliency gap detection — aligned to Citi's firm-wide AI-driven production management strategy
* Contribute to operational readiness for new platform migrations and onboarding — ensuring production support capability keeps pace with technology evolution
* Partner with development and platform engineering teams to influence upstream design decisions that improve production operability and resilience

**Transformation & Programme Delivery**

* Participate in continuous improvement workstream items spanning automation efficiency, monitoring uplift, resiliency, and application onboarding
* Support DCP's expansion as the central data services hub across Investor & Issuer Services
* Contribute to business continuity planning, contingency testing, and resiliency exercises across the platform portfolio

**Team & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as subject matter expert (SME) for one or more platforms — owning operational knowledge and serving as escalation point for junior team members
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with Development, Platform Engineering, Risk & Compliance, Audit, Infrastructure, and Vendor/Partner teams
* Contributing to the team's reputation as a value-adding, engineering-oriented function

**Experience**
**What We Are Looking For**

* 4 to 8 years in an application support, production management, or platform operations role — preferably within financial services or data-intensive environments
* Hands-on experience supporting data pipelines, reporting platforms, or client-facing financial applications
* Experience working within a global, follow-the-sun support model across multiple time zones
* Familiarity with ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management processes

**Technical Skills**

* Strong working knowledge of SQL and data querying — ability to investigate data quality issues across relational and cloud databases

title: SENIOR CONSULTANT
description:
