**About Atos Group**
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role summary**
Migrate existing Lambda/Dagster/dbt pipelines onto a Glue‑based, Redshift‑centric medallion architecture (S3 Bronze → Redshift Silver → Gold canonical model), embed data quality, lineage, security and CI/CD controls into every pipeline, and mentor engineers through domain‑by‑domain migration waves
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Inventory and baseline current Lambda functions, Dagster pipelines, dbt models, MySQL ODS flows and Kafka feeds, document lineage, schedules, SLAs and failure paths.
* Design and build Glue‑based ingestion, transformation, and cataloguing patterns (Glue jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) with Lambda/Step Functions/Event Bridge orchestration.
* Implement S3 Bronze landing with lifecycle/archive policies, Redshift Silver conformance and Gold canonical data products (Customer, Loan, Collections, Risk).
* Build automated data‑quality gates, reconciliation checks, and source‑to‑report lineage; support the enterprise data dictionary and certification of business‑critical reports
* Implement IAM, AWS‑native encryption, Secrets Manager and Gold‑layer RBAC/least‑privilege access.
* Establish Dev/Test environments, Git‑based CI/CD, schema version control (Liquibase) and controlled release promotion; monitoring and recovery via CloudWatch.
* Migrate and reconcile workloads wave by wave against baselines; decommission ODS dependencies and replace reverse flows with governed interfaces.
* Optimise Redshift performance and cost (WLM, sort/Dist keys, materialised views).
* Mentor engineers, own technical quality assurance of deliverables, and work with Data Owners/Champions and Atos architects in an Agile setup.

**Mandatory Skills**

* 10+ years in data engineering, 5+ Experience in AWS data platforms.
* Amazon Redshift (deep) data modelling, performance tuning, WLM, RBAC, external schemas/Spectrum.
* AWS Glue (jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) and hands‑on medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) implementation on S3 + Redshift.
* AWS Lambda, Step Functions, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager.
* Advanced SQL, dimensional/canonical data modelling, ETL/ELT frameworks.
* Python (primary) — PySpark for Glue jobs.
* MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
* DBT— must be able to read, reverse‑engineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
* Data‑quality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
* Git, CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
* Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

**Nice to have**

* Dagster orchestration — for AS‑IS discovery and migration.
* Kafka / event‑driven streaming ingestion.
* Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR
* Tableau, Metabase serving‑layer knowledge.
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
* Data‑governance tooling (Glue Data Quality, Data Zone, Lake Formation).
* UK financial‑services experience IFRS 9, BCBS 239, FCA/PRA reporting, UK GDPR.
* Preparing governed datasets for AI/ML use cases.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

In this hands-on role, you will manage GCP infrastructure, GitLab pipelines, edge security and observability for the Anaqua/RightHub stack. This is an infrastructure and automation role — Java development is not part of the position.
  
  
**You'll Love This Job If You Like To**

* Own GCP infrastructure with the team — GKE clusters, multi-region setup, global load balancing, autoscaling, VPC networking, DNS, firewall rules and IAM.
* Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines and shared CI templates consumed across every service team.
* Help shape company-wide standards for how services get deployed, secured, monitored and rolled back.
* Operate and harden the cluster — node pool upgrades, namespace/RBAC/resource-quota design, rolling updates, health probes, and supply-chain security.
* Run the platform security stack — gateway policies, secret rotation, dependency scanning, workload identity, and IAM least-privilege.
* Own observability and incident response on GCP — structured logging, metrics, dashboards, alerting, post-mortems and on-call runbooks.
* Build internal developer tooling — CLIs, self-service workflows and golden-path automation.
* Treat AI tooling as a daily collaborator, building platform tooling, runbooks and structured logs that both humans and AI agents can work against.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful**

* Strong production ownership on GCP — operating real workloads, not just standing up demos.
* Kubernetes in production (GKE) — deployments, Helm, RBAC, resource quotas, rolling updates, multi-region setups and rollbacks.
* Terraform as a daily tool, with clean management of IAM, networking, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL and secrets.
* CI/CD pipeline depth — GitLab CI at scale, with security and dependency scans built into the pipeline.
* Cloud networking depth — VPC design, load balancing, DNS, firewall rules and network security groups.
* Production observability and reliability on GCP — structured logs, metrics, SLIs/SLOs/error budgets, on-call rotations, and post-mortems.
* Operational PostgreSQL and asynchronous messaging on GCP Pub/Sub, plus scripting in Bash and Python or Go.
* Excellent written and spoken English, comfortable working across time zones; GCP certification, gRPC/Envoy experience, FinOps practice, or a background in IP/legal-tech/regulated B2B SaaS all an advantage.

Anaqua, Inc. is a premium provider of integrated intellectual property (IP) management technology solutions and services. Anaqua’s AQX platform combines best practice workflows with big data analytics and tech-enabled services to create an intelligent environment designed to inform IP strategy, enable IP decision-making, and streamline IP operations. Today, nearly half of the top 100 U.S. patent filers and global brands, as well as a growing number of law firms worldwide use Anaqua’s solutions. Over one million IP executives, attorneys, paralegals, administrators, and innovators in large and medium-sized companies use the platform for their IP management needs. The company’s global operations are headquartered in Boston, with offices across the U.S., Europe, Asia, and Australia. For additional information, please visit anaqua.com, or on LinkedIn.

title: AIOps Platform Engineer Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior AIOps Engineer to design, build, and operate the autonomous agents that turn observability data into safe, closed-loop operational action. You will sit at the intersection of service observability and agentic AI: connecting agents to metrics, logs, traces, events, change data, and service topology so they can detect, diagnose, and remediate production issues with minimal human intervention. You will define how agents reason over telemetry, which tools and runbooks they can call, the guardrails and approval gates that keep their actions safe, and the feedback loops that make them smarter after every incident. This role moves us from dashboards people have to watch to a self-healing production estate where AI observes, decides, and acts — and humans stay in control.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design and build autonomous AIOps agents (LLM-based and multi-agent) that run the full operational loop — observe, correlate, diagnose, decide, act, and verify — across incident triage, root-cause analysis, and auto-remediation
* Connect agents to the observability estate (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Tempo/Jaeger, APM, CMDB, change and deployment events) through well-defined tools/APIs and MCP servers, giving agents real-time, topology-aware context to reason over
* Turn observability signals into autonomous action: build event-driven triggers on SLO burn-rate, anomaly, and correlated alert patterns that launch agent workflows such as rollback, restart, scale-out, failover, traffic shift, config fix, or ticket enrichment
* Build the agent action layer: convert runbooks into machine-executable, idempotent actions (runbook-as-code), with pre-checks, blast-radius limits, dry-run modes, automatic rollback, and post-action health verification against SLIs
* Implement guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls: risk-tiered autonomy levels, policy-as-code, approval gates for high-risk changes, full audit trails, and explainable reasoning for every decision an agent makes
* Apply AI to observability data: anomaly detection, forecasting, alert noise reduction, event correlation, and retrieval-augmented reasoning over past incidents, runbooks, and post-mortems to speed up RCA and cut MTTD/MTTR
* Build evaluation and observability for the agents themselves: trace agent reasoning and tool calls, measure accuracy, action success rate, false-action rate, latency, and cost; run replay/simulation and chaos tests before increasing autonomy in production
* Partner with SRE, platform, and application teams to onboard services to autonomous operations, set standards and reusable patterns, and coach engineers on using AI + observability to automate their own operational workflows

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:
  
  

* 10+ years overall experience with 5+ years in SRE, AIOps, observability, or platform engineering.
* Proven hands-on development of autonomous agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent; strong grasp of tool/function calling, MCP, planning, memory, and multi-agent orchestration
* Deep service observability expertise: OpenTelemetry, , Grafana, , Jaeger/Tempo, or enterprise APM (Splunk, AppDynamics); strong PromQL/LogQL/SQL and SLO/SLI/error-budget design
* Track record of delivering closed-loop auto-remediation in production that measurably reduced MTTR, alert noise, or manual toil, with clear safety controls and rollback
* Strong Python (Go a plus) with experience building event-driven services and integrations across Kubernetes, CI/CD, ITSM (ServiceNow), and automation tools.
* Practical knowledge of applied ML and LLM techniques for operations: anomaly detection, time-series forecasting, event correlation, RAG, prompt engineering, and evaluation of LLM outputs
* Understanding of responsible and secure AI in regulated environments: least-privilege agent access, PII redaction, auditability, model risk management, and change-control compliance
* Demonstrated technical leadership, with experience mentoring and leading engineers, setting engineering direction, reviewing designs, and developing team capability while influencing risk partners and senior stakeholders

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

title: Engineer II - Cloud Support Engineer
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
  
  
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.
  
  
Cloud Support engineers at LPL run the cloud — they're the first humans on every ticket from an application team and the people who turn 'this happened again' into 'we automated it.' As Engineer 2, Cloud Support Engineer, you'll triage tickets, execute runbooks, fulfill account / IAM / access requests, support change windows, and respond to production cloud incidents inside the Support team, with senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support close at hand. If you want to learn AWS at a Tier 1 financial firm by running it for real with a globally distributed team across the US and India, this is your seat.
  
  
**Job Overview**
As the Engineer 2, Cloud Support Engineer, you are a hands-on mid-level cloud operations engineer in the Support team in LPL's Cloud Center of Excellence (CCOE). You support LPL's 24x7 Tier 1 / Tier 2 production support for the AWS landing zone — the run-the-cloud function inside CCOE — alongside senior engineers, AVPs, and the VP, Support. Day-to-day you triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow, fulfill account / IAM / access requests, execute and improve runbooks, support change windows, and respond to production cloud incidents. You partner closely with the Monitoring pod within Foundations on alert routing into ServiceNow and runbook execution, and you escalate cleanly into the Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, and Delivery when the issue is beyond the Support team's remit. LPL is an AWS-first CCOE: a multi-account landing zone with 100+ private reusable Terraform modules that enable 60+ AWS services, all delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions. You spend the majority of your time hands-on in tickets, runbooks, Terraform, and incident response across LPL's US offices and India Global Capability Center (GCC) — and you continuously turn repeatable requests into automated, self-service paths.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Triage inbound tickets from application teams across Jira and ServiceNow against clear SLAs: own the ticket end-to-end if it's Tier 1 / Tier 2 scope, and escalate cleanly into the Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring), Platforms, Containers, and Delivery when it's not
* Fulfill account / IAM / access requests for the landing zone and actively turn the repeatable ones into self-service paths through the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) and the private Terraform module library
* Execute and improve runbooks for known incident classes; pair with the Monitoring pod within Foundations to feed incident lessons back into durable monitoring and runbook improvements
* Support change-management execution: change-window participation, ServiceNow change-record discipline, and verification of changes against the affected accounts and workloads
* Embed agentic AI capabilities into the team's engineering practice (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Bedrock, MCP servers, agentic IaC and review workflows) and into the platform's self-service experience for internal customers
* Use agentic AI capabilities in your day-to-day support work: AI-assisted ticket triage and routing, conversational self-service for common account / IAM / access requests via MCP, runbook generation and lookup, and on-call copilots that summarize recent telemetry and chat during incidents
* Operate as a hands-on mid-level cloud engineer in the pod: spend the majority of your time in Terraform code, AWS console / CLI, design documents, peer code review, and incident response — execution and growth are the primary leverage points
* Personally participate in 24x7 on-call rotations as a primary responder for production incidents within the pod's scope; grow into senior responder framing over time with support from AVPs and VPs
* Consume the private Terraform module library and reference patterns to ship application-aligned infrastructure; raise small, well-scoped pull requests against shared modules and the Account Factory for Terraform (AFT) foundational base layer to improve what you use
* Partner with peer engineers, AVPs, and VPs across the Cloud Center of Excellence — the five CCOE teams (Foundations, Platforms, Containers, Support, Delivery) and the five Foundations pods (Security & Governance, FinOps, Functional Design Engineering & Strategy, Network Engineering, Monitoring) — to deliver pod outcomes; ask for help early and pass what you learn on to peers
* Apply the AWS Well-Architected Framework in the work you touch and drive continuous improvement against operational, security, reliability, performance, cost, and sustainability outcomes
* Participate fully in Agile / Scrum ceremonies (sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives) with the pod's embedded Scrum Master and partner with the enterprise EPMO / RTE on delivery commitments and dependencies
* Pursue and maintain the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix — AWS Certified Developer – Associate, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA), and Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) — progressing toward Senior Engineer over time

What are we looking for?
  
  
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 3+ years of progressive technical experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or software engineering; Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent work experience)
* 1+ years of hands-on production AWS in a multi-account environment with hands-on production Terraform delivered through Terraform Cloud and GitHub Actions; comfort consuming a private Terraform module library and raising well-scoped pull requests against shared modules
* Demonstrated track record of owning meaningful, well-scoped engineering work end-to-end under senior guidance — design, implementation, code review participation, and follow-through
* Experience participating in 24x7 production on-call rotations as a primary responder in a fast-paced, security-conscious environment (financial services preferred)
* Hands-on experience working a production cloud operations or cloud support queue (Jira, ServiceNow, or comparable ITSM): ticket triage SLAs, runbook execution, account / IAM / access-request fulfillment, change-window participation, and primary on-call response

**Core Competencies**

* Strong growth mindset — actively pursues the Engineer 2 certifications in the CCOE certification matrix and uses each incident, code review, and design discussion as a learning loop
* Bias toward shipping high-quality, well-tested, code-reviewed work; leaves the codebase a little better than they found it
* Asks for help early when stuck and writes down what they learn for the next engineer
* Calm primary responder during incidents; pages an AVP or VP early rather than struggling alone
* Continuous learner in cloud-native, IaC, and applied AI
* Builds high-trust relationships with peer engineers across the US and India / GCC
* Excellent written and verbal communication; can articulate what they changed and why in a clear pull request description

**Preferences**

* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: AWS Certified Developer – Associate
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate (004)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Kubernetes and Cloud Native Associate (KCNA)
* On the Engineer 2 certification path per the CCOE certification matrix: Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Experience using agentic AI / GenAI tooling (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Bedrock, MCP) in day-to-day engineering work
* Strong scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell
* Experience working with globally distributed teams across the US and India / GCC
* AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (CCP) as a stepping stone toward Developer – Associate

**Position Overview**
The Manager, Cloud Infrastructure is a hands-on leader responsible for the reliability, resilience, performance, operational discipline, cost management, and continuous improvement of Nationwide’s cloud infrastructure and AI platform capabilities in India. * Promote secure-by-default, resilient-by-design, and repeatable cloud engineering patterns.
* Coordinate dependencies across Cloud, Core Infrastructure, Security, Network, Data, Applications, and enterprise architecture to deliver integrated outcomes.
* Develop trusted relationships with internal partners, cloud providers, vendors, and service providers.
* Translate business needs into clear technical priorities, delivery plans, risks, and decisions for senior leadership.
* Ensure cloud processes and technical solutions support Nationwide’s risk-management, governance, and audit expectations.

**People leadership expectations**

* Create a positive, inclusive, and accountable team environment.
* Coach individuals through regular feedback, career conversations, mentoring, and meaningful development opportunities.
* Build a strong bench of cloud and platform talent through delegation, stretch assignments, knowledge sharing, and succession planning.
* Recognize contributions and reinforce behaviors that improve customer outcomes, teamwork, and reliability.
* Lead through change with transparency, empathy, consistency, and a bias toward constructive problem solving.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

* Demonstrated experience designing, operating, or modernizing cloud infrastructure and platform services at enterprise scale.
* Experience leading critical incidents, operational reviews, service improvements, migrations, and cross-functional delivery.
* Strong understanding of cloud reliability, security, resilience, capacity, performance, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to coach and develop technical professionals and first-line leaders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical issues to senior and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with distributed teams, external partners, and global operating models.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a regulated, highly available, or financial-services environment.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, containers, platform engineering, observability, DevSecOps, and modern operational practices.
* Experience with cloud landing zones, identity and access management, network architecture, resiliency patterns, and disaster recovery.
* Experience managing budgets, vendor relationships, cloud-provider relationships, service providers, and technology road maps.
* Experience establishing or improving FinOps, IT service management, or reliability engineering practices.

**Leadership profile**
We are seeking a leader who is technically credible, calm under pressure, optimistic, collaborative, and committed to making the people and the platform better every day. The right candidate brings energy to difficult problems, stays close enough to the work to understand reality, and creates an environment where people can do their best work.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technological solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!
  
  
The Technology Engineering Manager manages a team of infrastructure engineers who analyse, design, develop and implement hardware/software. You’ll determine hardware/software systems requirements; lead systems hardware/software design; plan projects; and establish priorities. You’ll also coordinate with other managers to integrate projects with other systems hardware/software. As a people leader, you have responsibility for project deployment, career development, performance management and pay determination. You also may have the opportunity to mentor associates on other teams.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manages a team that delivers on build and operational components for the product(s) aligned to a technology area, such as but not limited to, consulting, managing and development of new products, upgrade/patching efforts, annual budgeting, efficiency efforts, etc. and the function responsible for driving a competitive unit cost through efficient product lifecycle.
* Responsible for applying secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities.
* Leads a team accountable for product delivery and the first line of defense for risk and security management.
* Assigns and allocates roles, in partnership with the Technology Product Executive, based on capacity and demand (finance, marketing, etc.).
* Responsible for the design, development, modification and implementation of products and processes to aid in the overall product lifecycle and operational metrics.
* Manages a team who is accountable for product management across platforms (on-premises, off-premises and across premises) by providing engineering support for products/processes to improve productivity and reduce cost.
* Demonstrates user empathy by partnering with user advocates to understand and incorporate user sentiment.
* Understands and manages team skill maturity in context of effective product management.
* Oversee vendor management/relationships and sourcing, in collaboration with Technology Product Manager.
* Drives release cadence and business feature alignment leveraging automation to drive speed and actively drives continuous process improvement activities including Lean, process/product innovation, quality, cost reduction and other initiatives.
* Leads people through guidance and support on the execution of work; management of associates including but not limited to performance management, salary planning, training, development, workforce planning, hiring, and disciplinary actions; and attracts, hires, engages and develops the team through impactful recruitment, coaching and feedback.
* Participates in strategic initiatives/planning for core products including products that cross Technologies.
* Develops and manages project budgets and deployment, including training and development of personnel.

**Qualifications & Experience**
May perform other responsibilities as assigned.
  
  
**Education**
Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, mathematics, or related field is strongly preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
Eight years knowledge of operational management concepts and techniques. Experience leading multiple teams and assets across various technology platforms. Three years of management experience is preferred. Experience with concepts and solutions: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and package solutions.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Business Acumen
* Business Strategies
* Computer Science
* Financial Management
* IT Infrastructure
* Technical Acumen
* Vendor Management
* Technology Strategies

**Soft Skills & Attributes**

* Strong communication skills
* Ability to influence, negotiate, and set priorities
* Mentoring and coaching abilities to guide associates
* Identifying and removing blockers to progress
* Ability to work in agile and global environments
* Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus

Template.net is an AI-native creation platform used by more than 4 million people worldwide every month.

We are building the next generation of AI-powered creation tools, where users simply describe what they need, and AI turns their ideas into finished, editable designs, videos, and documents—all in one place, from prompt to ready-to-use content in minutes.

This is not a management-only role. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys coding, solving complex technical challenges, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building high-performing engineering teams.

You'll work closely with Product to build, launch, and scale AI-powered applications used by millions of people worldwide.

**What You'll Do**

* Stay hands-on with coding: Actively write, review, debug, and ship production code while guiding the engineering team.
* Design scalable systems: Build reliable, high-performance applications using modern backend architectures, databases, APIs, caching, queues, and asynchronous processing.
* Build AI-powered products: Integrate LLMs, generative AI models, APIs, and image, video, and audio generation workflows.
* Optimize AI infrastructure: Improve inference latency, processing performance, model integration reliability, and API costs.
* Own production reliability: Drive CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, security, performance optimization, and incident resolution.

* Build and mentor the team: Hire, develop, and lead engineers while establishing strong engineering standards and a culture of ownership.
* Ship products quickly: Collaborate closely with Product to turn ideas into working software, launch features rapidly, and continuously improve them.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, with proven hands-on coding skills and technical leadership.
* Engineer first, leader second: Someone who enjoys writing code, solving complex technical problems, and leading by example—not just managing people.

* Strong ownership and product thinking: Able to make pragmatic technical decisions, move quickly, avoid unnecessary complexity, and deliver reliable products that create real customer value.

**Why Join Template.net?**

* Build cutting-edge AI products used by millions of people worldwide.
* Work on challenging engineering problems across generative AI, image, video, documents, and design.
* Take real ownership of technical architecture, engineering decisions, and product delivery.
* Build and lead a talented engineering team while continuing to write production code.
* Work in a fast-moving, product-focused environment where your contributions have a direct impact.

* We're looking for a builder who leads by example—someone who can take a problem, design the solution, write the code, ship it to production

title: AI Infrastructure Engineer – Generative AI Model Serving (Go / Rust / GPU)
description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
Power the Platform Behind Enterprise Generative AI
  
  
At Teradata, we’re not just managing data; we’re unleashing its full potential. Our ClearScape Analytics™ platform and Enterprise Vector Store help the world’s largest enterprises derive value from their most complex data. Generative AI and agentic systems are the next frontier, and they run on infrastructure that has to be fast, efficient, and dependable at scale.
  
  
As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, you will build the serving layer that runs large language models and other generative models inside the Teradata Vantage ecosystem. You will work on GPU-accelerated inference, high-performance Go and Rust services, and the cloud-native platform that lets teams ship models to production with confidence. You will own systems end to end, from a CUDA kernel profile to a Kubernetes rollout.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Design, build, and operate scalable, low-latency model-serving platforms for LLMs and generative models, covering batching, streaming, routing, autoscaling, and multi-tenant isolation.
* Develop high-performance control-plane and data-plane services in Go and performance-critical components (tokenizers, schedulers, runtimes, gRPC/HTTP gateways, native extensions) in Rust.
* Optimize GPU inference for throughput, latency, and cost using continuous batching, KV-cache management, quantization (INT8/FP8/AWQ/GPTQ), speculative decoding, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and efficient memory use.
* Integrate and extend inference engines such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Triton Inference Server, Ray Serve, KServe, SGLang, llama. cpp, and ONNX Runtime; contribute fixes upstream where it makes sense.
* Build and manage GPU cluster infrastructure on Kubernetes (NVIDIA GPU Operator, device plugins, MIG/time-slicing, node pools, scheduling and bin-packing) across cloud and on-prem environments.
* Own the full delivery path: CI/CD pipelines, model packaging and registries, canary and blue/green rollouts, infrastructure as code, and automated performance regression testing.
* Build AI observability into everything: metrics, logs, and traces for token throughput, time-to-first-token, GPU utilization, queue depth, error and hallucination signals, using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Provide clean APIs, SDKs, and developer tooling (OpenAI-compatible endpoints, internal services, and lightweight UIs or dashboards) so AI engineers and agent builders can deploy and monitor models self-serve.
* Support agentic and RAG workloads by serving embedding, reranking, and generation models alongside the Enterprise Vector Store, with predictable latency and graceful degradation.
* Drive reliability, security, and cost efficiency: SLOs, load and chaos testing, capacity planning, GPU cost attribution, and secure model and tenant isolation.

Who You’ll Work With
  
  
You will collaborate daily with AI researchers, ML engineers, data scientists, and platform and SRE teams who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You’ll be part of a cohesive team delivering high-quality, highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Vantage platform. You will report to the Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions.
  
  
What Makes You a Qualified Candidate
  
  

* 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend systems, distributed systems, or AI/ML infrastructure.
* Strong, production-level proficiency in Go (concurrency, gRPC, profiling, service design) and working proficiency, or a demonstrated passion for learning, Rust (ownership, async runtimes such as Tokio, FFI, performance tuning).
* Hands-on experience with GPU computing for ML: CUDA fundamentals, GPU profiling (Nsight, nvidia-smi/DCGM), memory and bandwidth tradeoffs, and multi-GPU or multi-node inference.
* Experience serving LLMs or generative models in production, with practical knowledge of inference optimization techniques and the serving frameworks listed above.
* Solid understanding of transformer architectures and the LLM inference lifecycle (prefill vs. decode, attention, KV cache, sampling), plus familiarity with PyTorch and Hugging Face tooling.
* Strong system design skills and a deep understanding of distributed systems, networking, concurrency, and failure modes.
* Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm) and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or similar), plus infrastructure as code (Terraform).
* Full-stack engineering experience: comfortable building REST/gRPC APIs and a pragmatic front end (React or similar) for dashboards, playgrounds, or admin tools; Python for glue, tooling, and ML integration.
* Experience with observability practices and tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, tracing) applied to ML or LLM workloads.
* You are obsessive about reliability, debuggability, and ensuring AI systems behave predictably and deterministically when needed.
* You code daily, own systems end to end, and are knowledgeable about open-source tools and know how to leverage and extend them.

What You Bring
  
  

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Genuine excitement for AI, LLMs, and the systems that make them efficient and affordable to run at scale.
* Strong communication skills and a bias toward measuring, benchmarking, and iterating.
* Familiarity with modern data platforms such as Teradata, Snowflake, or Databricks is a plus.

Bonus Points
  
  

* Experience writing or tuning CUDA / Triton (OpenAI) / CUTLASS kernels, or contributing to inference engines.
* Experience with on-device or edge ML inference (ONNX, TFLite, llama. cpp, quantized small language models), embedded or mobile deployment.
* Knowledge of RAG pipelines, vector databases, embeddings, and agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, ReAct-style agents).
* Experience with model monitoring, drift detection, evaluation harnesses, and responsible AI practices.
* Open-source contributions, technical writing, or public projects in ML systems, Go, or Rust.
* Experience with service meshes, RDMA/InfiniBand/NCCL, Slurm, or Ray clusters.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.
  
  
Additional information
  
  
**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
* Snacks & Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
* CSR Days: Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.

The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

title: Senior Manager/ AVP – IT Infrastructure & Trading Technology
description:
Abans Financial Services Ltd. is a listed, diversified financial services company offering a comprehensive suite of solutions across broking, commodity trading, asset management, financing, and investment advisory. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company operates with a strong presence in both Indian and global markets, serving institutional, corporate, and retail clients. As part of the larger Abans Group, the company continues to expand its footprint by delivering integrated financial services and building robust technology platforms to support its growing client base.
  
  
**Profile : Senior Manager/ AVP – IT Infrastructure & Trading Technology**
**Location: Nariman Point, Mumbai**

We are looking for an experienced IT Manager with expertise in IT infrastructure, trading technology, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance within the stockbroking industry. * Ensure system availability, performance monitoring, capacity planning, and timely issue resolution.
* Manage backups, Disaster Recovery (DR), Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and periodic DR drills.

* Ensure compliance with applicable SEBI, exchange, and other regulatory requirements relating to IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and trading systems.

* Maintain IT policies, SOPs, infrastructure documentation, access records, and compliance reports.
* Oversee DR/BCP compliance, technology risk management, and required regulatory reporting.
* Vendor & Team Management
* Manage CTCL, RMS, back-office, network, cloud, and cybersecurity vendors.

* Lead the IT team, allocate responsibilities, and ensure timely resolution of critical issues.

* Experience working with SOC operations, SIEM platforms, security monitoring, incident response, and threat management.
* Strong understanding of Cybersecurity frameworks, Zero Trust Architecture, Vulnerability Management, Patch Management, and Security Best Practices.
* Familiarity with RMS, back-office systems, market data feeds, and trading application integration.
* Knowledge of firewalls, endpoint security, SOC operations, vulnerability management, and cybersecurity controls.
* Understanding of SEBI and exchange IT, cybersecurity, DR, and BCP requirements.
* Experience in exchange audits, IT compliance documentation, vendor management, and incident resolution.
* Minimum 5+ years of team management/leadership experience.
* Prior experience in Trading, Broking, Capital Markets, Financial Services, or BFSI organisations is highly preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* Hands-on involvement in CTCL implementations, exchange mock tests, system upgrades, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with trading operations, RMS, clearing, depository, and back-office technology.

title: Senior Associate Cloud SRE - Azure & AWS
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title: Senior Associate Cloud SRE – Azure & AWS**
**Education: Any Graduate**
**Experience: 7+years**
**Location: Mumbai**
**Role Summary**
As a Site Reliability Engineer supporting multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS and Azure), you will manage complex operational challenges and escalations while implementing reliability best practices across production systems. You will work collaboratively with customer teams and senior engineers to ensure system stability, automate operational workflows, and maintain comprehensive observability. This is a delivery-focused role requiring both advanced technical execution and operational ownership across cloud platforms.

* Containers: AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service) & Docker.
* Operating Systems: Windows Server, Linux Server

**Primary Responsibilities**
**Tier 2 Multi-Cloud Operations & Managed Services**
**Azure Operations**

* Provide tier two support for Azure cloud environments
* Manage and update Azure Virtual Machine images
* Create and configure Azure Virtual Machines and Azure SQL databases
* Manage Azure Active Directory (AAD) identities, roles, and role-based access control (RBAC)
* Configure Azure Storage account policies and access controls
* Manage Virtual Networks, Network Security Groups (NSGs), and route tables
* Restore VM snapshots and database backups to lower environments
* Manage disk resizing and Azure Managed Disks optimization
* Implement Azure resource tagging and cost management
* Manage log archiving using Azure Monitor and Log Analytics
* PIM (Privileged Identity Management)

**AWS Operations**

* Provide 24x7x365 tier two support and escalation handling for AWS environments
* Patch and manage Amazon Machine Images (AMIs)
* Create and configure EC2 instances and RDS databases
* Manage IAM roles, users, and policies
* Configure S3 bucket policies and Access Control Lists (ACLs)
* Open and manage network routes (VPC, subnets, security groups)
* Restore snapshots and database backups to lower environments
* Increase disk sizes (EBS volumes) and manage storage optimization
* Implement proper tagging for environment identification and cost allocation
* Manage log archiving using CloudWatch Logs and S3

**Cross-Cloud Responsibilities**

* Handle escalations from tier one support with deep technical analysis across both platforms
* Provide root cause analysis for complex incidents in multi-cloud environments
* Implement consistent operational standards across AWS and Azure
* Support hybrid cloud connectivity and integration scenarios

**Reliability & Incident Management**

* Implement and maintain SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs across AWS and Azure in collaboration with senior engineers and customer stakeholders
* Lead tier two incident response and incident triage, performing advanced troubleshooting and resolution on both cloud platforms (ServiceNow, OpsGenie)

* Reduce reactive work by improving runbooks, alert configurations, and standard operating procedures for both clouds
* Apply reliability engineering best practices with oversight and review

**Automation & Infrastructure as Code**

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployments on AWS and Azure

* Create scripts and tooling to eliminate manual toil and improve operational efficiency
* Implement Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates or Bicep for Azure-specific automation
* Follow established patterns and contribute continuous improvements
* Document automation processes for knowledge sharing across cloud platforms

**Containerization & Deployment**

* Deploy and operate containerized workloads using Docker on AWS services (ECS, EKS) and Azure services (AKS, Azure Container Instances)
* Support container reliability through health checks, autoscaling configurations, and resource management on both platforms
* Implement safe deployment patterns (canary, blue/green) across AWS and Azure
* Troubleshoot complex containerization and orchestration issues in multi-cloud Kubernetes environments
* Follow and enhance established containerization standards across both cloud providers

**Observability & Performance**

* Configure and maintain comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting across AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, New Relic, and Splunk
* Leverage observability data to identify issues and lead root cause analysis in multi-cloud environments
* Contribute to performance tuning and cost optimization initiatives across both platforms
* Ensure proper instrumentation and telemetry across AWS and Azure environments
* Identify patterns and trends to prevent future incidents
* Build custom dashboards and reports using CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Datadog, and Grafana

**Collaboration & Customer Engagement**

* Work closely with customer development and operations teams to improve system operability
* Participate in design reviews and reliability assessments for multi-cloud architectures
* Communicate technical concepts, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders
* Provide regular operational updates and service reports covering both AWS and Azure
* Act as technical liaison between customers and internal engineering teams

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 7+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, or production operations roles
* Proven experience operating production systems in AWS OR Azure (deep expertise in one required)

* VMware virtualization experience
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux server administration
* Basic database administration/troubleshooting skills
* Demonstrated experience managing containerized applications in production

**For Azure-Primary Candidates**

* Azure Certifications (for Azure-primary): Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)

**Additional Preferred Experience**

* Hands-on experience with both AWS and Azure (even if limited in one)
* Experience with Kubernetes in production environments
* Prior consulting or managed services provider experience
* Experience with hybrid cloud or cloud migration projects

description:

In 2025, Sealed Air generated $5.4 billion in sales and has approximately 16,100 employees who serve customers in 119 countries/territories. To learn more, visit www.sealedair.com.
  
  
Senior Platform Engineer
  
  
Sealed Air is seeking a highly skilled and self-motivated Senior Cloud Platform Migration Engineer to assume ownership of critical cloud infrastructure supporting customer-facing digital services and connected manufacturing capabilities.
  
  
The successful candidate will stabilize, operate, document, and modernize an existing AWS-based platform ecosystem while helping drive the long-term strategic transition to Microsoft Azure. The role requires practical experience with AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, automation, infrastructure-as-code, Linux, security, and cloud platform operations.
  
  
This is not primarily an application development role. The candidate must understand enough about application hosting patterns to support infrastructure decisions, troubleshoot platform-level issues, and partner effectively with application teams, but application code ownership and long-term application modernization.
  
  
What are we looking for in you?
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cloud Platform Ownership
  
  

* Own the operational health, reliability, security, and lifecycle management of assigned cloud-hosted infrastructure platforms.
* Administer current-state AWS platform components including IAM, networking, compute, storage, platform services, encryption, and security controls.
* Support and maintain Cloud Foundry and BOSH platform infrastructure, including stemcells, releases, manifests, routing dependencies, certificates, and operational procedures.
* Manage platform patching, operating system lifecycle activities, certificate renewals, vulnerability remediation, and related production maintenance activities.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, technical diagrams, and support procedures for inherited and future-state environments.

Azure Migration and Modernization
  
  

* Help lead infrastructure planning and execution for migration from AWS-hosted platform services to Azure-based target-state architecture.
* Assess current AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, Linux, networking, IAM, and platform service dependencies to define migration approach, risks, sequencing, and operational impacts.
* Design repeatable Azure infrastructure patterns aligned to enterprise standards, including identity, network, security, monitoring, backup, and operational support models.
* Partner with Jayaram's application team to ensure application workloads are migrated or modernized with a clear separation between application ownership and infrastructure platform ownership.
* Develop migration automation and validation patterns to reduce risk and improve repeatability across future transitions.

Why do we need you?
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, automation, or related infrastructure operations experience.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience, including operational support of production cloud infrastructure.
* Practical Azure knowledge and demonstrated ability to design or support cloud migration and modernization activities.
* Hands-on scripting and automation experience with Python and Shell/Bash.
* Experience with GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, Linux administration, infrastructure automation, and cloud security practices.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
* Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, documentation, and operational problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate independently in a partially documented inherited environment and convert ambiguity into structured technical action plans.
* Cloud Foundry administration experience, especially with self-managed or legacy platform environments.
* BOSH administration experience, including directors, stemcells, releases, manifests, and platform lifecycle management.
* Experience migrating workloads or platform services between public cloud providers, especially AWS to Azure.
* Experience with Azure landing zones, Azure networking, Azure identity, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure-native platform services.

title: Lead Golang Engineer
description:
Lead Golang Platform Engineer

**Domain:**
Fintech / Trading & Capital Markets

**Experience:**
6–8+ Years

**Work Mode:**
To be confirmed

About the Role

We are looking for a
**Lead Golang Platform Engineer**
to own the stability, performance, and reliability of mission-critical backend platforms supporting real-time market data, transactions, portfolio systems, and enterprise integrations.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role focused on distributed systems, production incident management, performance optimization, and platform ownership rather than feature development alone.

Key Responsibilities

* Own production stability and act as the L3/L4 escalation point for backend and middleware systems.
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents, latency spikes, Kafka lag, database contention, and memory issues.
* Drive non-functional requirements (NFRs), including performance, throughput, high availability, fault tolerance, and resource efficiency.
* Design and optimize distributed systems and event-driven microservices using
  **Golang, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and Redis**
  .
* Ensure reliable event processing through idempotency, offset management, retries, dead-letter queues, event replay, and backpressure handling.
* Optimize PostgreSQL queries, indexing, partitioning, connection pooling, and Redis caching for high-performance workloads.
* Build configurable, rule-driven workflows and high-performance backend services.
* Improve observability through logging, tracing, metrics, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Lead vendor knowledge transfer, take ownership of legacy codebases, and establish backend engineering standards.
* Mentor engineers on production debugging, distributed systems, and code quality.

Required Skills & Experience

* 6–8+ years of backend engineering experience, preferably in fintech, trading, or transaction-heavy systems.
* Strong hands-on expertise in
  **Golang**
  , including concurrency, context propagation, runtime behavior, and memory profiling.
* Strong production experience with
  **Apache Kafka**
  , including consumer groups, rebalancing, offset management, and lag diagnostics.
* Proven expertise in
  **PostgreSQL performance tuning**
  and database optimization.
* Experience troubleshooting live production incidents and driving permanent corrective actions.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, fault tolerance, and high-throughput APIs.
* Demonstrated ownership of non-functional requirements (NFRs), performance benchmarks, and production reliability.

Good to Have

* Experience with low-latency trading platforms, exchanges, or regulated financial systems.
* Production exposure to Kubernetes and Redis performance optimization.
* Experience with WebSockets, streaming systems, ClickHouse, and Grafana.
* Familiarity with CockroachDB or other distributed databases.
* Experience taking over vendor-built or legacy platforms.

Ideal Candidate

Someone who can remain calm during critical production incidents, diagnose complex distributed-system issues, optimize runtime performance, and take end-to-end ownership of platform reliability while providing technical guidance to the backend team.

title: CONSULTANT
description:

With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. * Evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and patterns to improve data infrastructure and engineering capabilities.

* Strong proficiency with data pipeline development in Python, Java, or Scala.
* Experience with modern data frameworks (Spark, Kafka, Flink, dbt, or equivalent).

* Ability to optimize SQL, pipelines and storage for performance and cost.
* Experience building batch and/or streaming data solutions.
* Experience using Microsoft Fabric Notebooks to develop, debug, and operationalize data engineering workflows.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with observability and monitoring tools (Datadog preferred).
* Ability to work in collaborative, iterative, product‑centric team environments.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with cloud data services (Azure, AWS).
* Hands‑on experience with Microsoft Fabric components, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, and Semantic Models.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, etc.).

Here at Atos, diversity and inclusion are embedded in our DNA. Read more about our commitment to a fair work environment for all.
  
  
Atos is a recognized leader in its industry across Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria. Find out more on our CSR commitment.
  
  
**Choose your future. Choose Atos.**

title: TPRM Java - Technical Lead
description:

With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Position Purpose
  
  
Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable Java-based backend services and middle business layer components within enterprise full-stack applications. Own backend architecture decisions, API design, data access patterns, and integration with upstream and downstream systems. Work competently across the existing frontend layer using Angular/TypeScript/React
**.**
Bring the depth of an experienced backend engineer with the breadth to contribute across the full stack. Leverage AI-assisted development tools as a standard part of day-to-day engineering practice.
  
  
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Design and Develop scalable full-stack solutions using Java, Spring Boot, and modern frontend frameworks (React/Angular).
* Design and optimize high-performance APIs with security, caching, and fault tolerance.
* Design and Develop robust backend services with efficient database interactions.
* Build responsive UI with seamless backend integration.
* Automate CI/CD pipelines for rapid, reliable software delivery.
* Lead cloud-native deployments with containerization, auto-scaling, and cost optimization.
* Enforce Quality-first engineering: Unit, integration, and ensure high code quality with SonarQube.
* Mentor junior developers, conduct code reviews, and drive technical excellence across the team.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business needs into robust, compliant technical solutions.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Contribute to technical design discussions and architecture decisions, particularly around API design, data layer, and system integration
* Participate in code reviews and enforce clean code and quality gate standards
* Support knowledge transfer and capability building within the India Solutions team
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (frontend, QA, infrastructure) on integration and delivery
* Improving DevSecOps maturity and SDLC practices within the team

Technical & Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to work autonomously and take end-to-end ownership of backend components
* Industry Expertise: Experience in large-scale regulated enterprise environments (banking/financial services preferred)
* Collaboration & Communication: Strong collaborative and communication skills to work in a global team

**Specific Qualifications**
**Experience Level: 8+ years**

* 7+ years with Java backend development at enterprise scale
* 5+ years with Spring Boot/Spring MVC in production environments
* Demonstrated good experience across the listed Technical skills.
* Familiarity with frontend integration using Angular/TypeScript/React
* Experience with legacy system refactoring to target architecture
* Active use of AI coding assistants in daily workflow

**Domain Experience**

* Banking, financial services, or similarly regulated enterprise environments preferred
* Experience in GCC or offshore delivery models advantageous
* Exposure to high-volume, high-availability backend systems

Technical Skills
  
  
**Required**
**Skill Group**
**Details**
**Core Java & JDK 21+**

* Modern language features – records, sealed classes, pattern‑matching, text blocks, and functional APIs (streams, Optional).
* Concurrency & Parallelism – virtual threads (Project Loom), Completable Future, Executor Service, Fork/Join, and basic lock/atomic primitives.
* JVM & GC tuning – G1/ZGC behaviour, heap‑dump analysis, JFR profiling, and module‑system (JPMS) usage.
* Logging / Instrumentation / Error Handling
* Build & Unit‑test foundation – Maven/Gradle multi‑module builds, JUnit 5 + AssertJ, static code checks (SpotBugs), and basic GraalVM native‑image awareness.

**Spring Ecosystem**

* Spring Boot 3.x – create micro‑service skeletons, auto‑configuration, actuator health‑checks, and simple security (JWT/OAuth2).,
* Spring Data (JPA/R2DBC) – entity mapping, query‑hint optimisation, reactive repositories, and transaction demarcation.
* Spring Cloud basics – service discovery (Eureka), API‑gateway pattern, externalized config (Config Server), and circuit‑breaker (Resilience4j).
* Either Spring Batch OR Spring MVC OR Spring Integration
* Spring Security– CSRF protection, OAuth2 resource‑server setup, basic role‑based access control, and token validation, zero trust, MTLS.

**Database & Data Access Engineering**

* SQL & query optimisation – complex CTEs, window functions, indexing strategies, and execution‑plan analysis (PostgreSQL/Oracle/MySQL).
* Database optimisation - (indexing, query plans). Understanding of partitioning
* ORM performance – JPA/Hibernate mapping, N+1 detection, second‑level cache, batch inserts/updates, and @QueryHints.
* NoSQL & caching – when to use MongoDB, GraphDB, Redis (session/Cache‑aside), basic data‑modeling, and TTL/eviction policies.
* Migrations & transactions – Flyway/Liquibase versioning, multi‑DB transaction handling (JTA), and isolation‑level choices.

**Design & Architecture**

* Clean / Hexagonal architecture – ports‑and‑adapters, dependency‑inversion, and keeping frameworks at the outer ring.
* Domain‑Driven Design basics – bounded contexts, aggregates, domain events, and idempotent processing.
* API‑first & contract – OpenAPI/Swagger spec authoring, versioning strategy, and consumer‑driven contract testing (Pact).
* Event‑driven patterns – Kafka or RabbitMQ producers/consumers, out‑box pattern, and basic saga (choreography) implementation.
* Security: Public Keys / Hash Concepts. Design around Access Control, Role Based security.
* Microservices design Pattern ex: SAGA Design pattern

Concepts like -Circuit breaker, load balancer, Reverse Proxy
  
  

* Integration Patterns, Enterprise Patterns, Application scalability (stateful & stateless), Microservices Patterns, Distributed Transactions
* Caching Strategies (Redis, CDN)

**DevOps**

* Containerisation & K8s – Docker multi‑stage builds, Helm chart basics, pod liveness/readiness probes.
* CI/CD pipeline – Jenkins/Argo CD job that runs unit, integration, and static‑analysis steps; artefact publishing. Pipeline-as-code (Jenkinsfile/YAML)
* Observability starter – expose Prometheus metrics, configure a basic Grafana dashboard, and ship structured logs to ELK.
* Runtime security, secret‑management (CyberArk / Hashicorp / equivalent)
* Canary/blue‑green release patterns

**Testing & Quality Engineering**

* Test‑pyramid implementation – unit (JUnit 5/Mockito), integration (Testcontainers), contract (Pact).
* Performance & load testing – JMeter script creation, baseline latency/SLO definition, simple analysis of results.
* Static analysis & coverage – SonarQube quality gate, JaCoCo coverage threshold, SpotBugs rule set.

**Frontend**
Proficient working within existing Angular/TypeScript/NodeJS/NPM frameworks.
  
  
**AI Tools**
Daily use of AI DevAssistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate implementation across all skill areas
  
  
Understanding of MCP and Agentic concepts and able to develop and design.
  
  
Experience with Prompt Engineering, codebase context and constraints of AI assistants
  
  
**Behavioral Skills**

* Sets technical direction for multiple squads and aligns it with business objectives
* Cross-functional collaboration across frontend, QA, DecvSecOps and infrastructure teams
* Balances speed, quality, and regulatory constraints in a fast-moving environment and is results oriented
* Ensures that security, data‑privacy, and regulatory requirements are baked in.
* Structured communication of technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders
* Adaptability to legacy and greenfield environments delivering modern, cloud‑native solutions.
* Leverages generative AI to boost productivity and foster a culture of experimentation

**Education Level:**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience
