title: Sr. Application Architect
description:
**Description**
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team.
  
  
You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built.
  
  
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions

description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data management, data analytics, Cloud AI, networking, migrations, security.
* Experience managing the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, or penetration testing).

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business issues. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
  
  
You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration testing within existing ones as a technical generalist. You will blend sales prowess, market knowledge and direct technical engagement.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting specific sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture to show the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots, and in-depth workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration, or implementation phases.

title: DevOps Engineer – AWS & Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for a technically strong and hands-on DevOps Engineer to manage, secure, automate, and scale the cloud infrastructure supporting Bondsmart, our digital debt investment platform.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for managing our AWS infrastructure, application deployments, CI/CD pipelines, server configurations, networking, monitoring, backups, and infrastructure security.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with AWS, Linux, deployment automation, networking, and production troubleshooting. They should be capable of independently managing the existing infrastructure while continuously improving its reliability, security, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  
  
As a growing fintech startup, we require someone who can establish robust DevOps practices, reduce manual operational dependencies, improve deployment reliability, and prepare the platform for future growth without unnecessary infrastructure complexity or cost.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**AWS Infrastructure Management**

* Manage and maintain AWS infrastructure, including EC2, VPC, subnets, security groups, route tables, Internet Gateways, NAT Gateways, Elastic IPs, IAM, and related services.
* Manage development, QA, and production environments with appropriate resource separation and access controls.
* Configure and maintain EC2 instances running Node.js applications, Nginx, and PM2.
* Manage Amazon RDS PostgreSQL infrastructure, including connectivity, backups, monitoring, storage, and availability.
* Manage S3 buckets and CloudFront distributions for frontend hosting, content delivery, and application routing.
* Configure and maintain Route 53 DNS records, domain mappings, ACM SSL/TLS certificates, and HTTPS redirects.
* Maintain infrastructure documentation, environment configurations, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure, networking, connectivity, and server-level issues independently.

**CI/CD & Deployment Automation**

* Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools.
* Automate application build, testing, deployment, and release processes across development, QA, and production environments.
* Implement secure deployment workflows for React frontend applications and Node.js / Express.js / NestJS backend services.
* Automate S3 deployments, CloudFront cache invalidation, backend deployments, and application restarts where applicable.
* Establish controlled release workflows, environment-specific configurations, rollback procedures, and deployment verification.
* Implement secure GitHub deployment practices, branch protection, environment approvals, and deployment permissions.
* Reduce manual server access and repetitive operational tasks through scripting and automation.
* Support zero-downtime or low-downtime deployment strategies wherever feasible.

**Linux & Application Server Management**

* Manage Linux-based servers and troubleshoot operating system, disk, memory, CPU, networking, and process-related issues.
* Configure and maintain Nginx reverse proxies, virtual hosts, SSL/TLS settings, request routing, and application-level security headers.
* Manage Node.js application processes using PM2, including startup configuration, process monitoring, log management, and restart policies.
* Configure application environment variables, runtime versions, service dependencies, and server permissions.
* Investigate application availability issues, port conflicts, failed deployments, memory leaks, and resource exhaustion.
* Establish standardised server configuration and maintenance procedures across environments.

**Networking & Infrastructure Reliability**

* Design, configure, and troubleshoot AWS networking, including VPCs, public and private subnets, routing, security groups, and network access.
* Ensure databases and internal services remain private and are accessible only through authorised network paths.
* Configure NAT Gateways and Elastic IPs where required for stable outbound connectivity and third-party vendor IP whitelisting.
* Manage connectivity requirements for external financial integrations, including payment gateways, KYC providers, and exchange-related services.
* Plan and implement load balancing, health checks, and Auto Scaling for application workloads as the platform’s traffic grows.
* Identify infrastructure bottlenecks and recommend improvements for availability, resilience, and performance.
* Support future infrastructure evolution towards containerised deployments and managed orchestration services when justified by business requirements.

**Monitoring, Logging & Production Support**

* Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and logging using Amazon CloudWatch and relevant application monitoring tools.
* Maintain centralised application and server logs for backend services, Nginx, and operational processes.
* Configure actionable alerts for CPU, memory, disk utilisation, application availability, error rates, and infrastructure health.
* Work with developers to improve error tracking, request correlation, and production incident investigation using tools such as Sentry and CloudWatch.
* Troubleshoot production incidents, identify root causes, and implement preventive measures.
* Establish incident response procedures, escalation mechanisms, and operational runbooks.
* Monitor application and infrastructure health during releases and critical business operations.

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement AWS IAM best practices, least-privilege access, role-based permissions, and secure service-to-service access.
* Use IAM roles for EC2 workloads instead of storing long-lived AWS access keys on servers.
* Manage application secrets and configuration securely using AWS Secrets Manager and Systems Manager Parameter Store.
* Ensure RDS databases remain private and protected through appropriate network controls, encryption, and access restrictions.
* Configure security groups, SSH access restrictions, HTTPS, security headers, and secure administrative access.
* Manage CloudTrail audit logs and relevant AWS security monitoring services.
* Support vulnerability remediation, security assessments, VAPT findings, and infrastructure hardening.
* Maintain appropriate backup, retention, access-control, and auditability practices for a fintech environment.
* Support security and infrastructure documentation required for internal reviews and external audits.

**Backup, Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity**

* Implement and maintain automated database backups, snapshots, retention policies, and recovery procedures.
* Establish and periodically test disaster recovery and restoration processes.
* Configure appropriate RDS backup, encryption, and deletion-protection settings.
* Define recovery objectives and identify infrastructure components that could become single points of failure.
* Develop practical recovery and rollback procedures for application releases and infrastructure failures.
* Ensure critical application services and transaction-related infrastructure can be restored reliably.

**Infrastructure Scaling & Cost Optimization**

* Monitor AWS resource utilisation and identify opportunities to optimise infrastructure costs.
* Recommend appropriate EC2 instance types, storage configurations, networking options, and managed services based on actual workload requirements.
* Plan for increased API traffic, concurrent users, and growth in investment activity.
* Implement infrastructure changes incrementally, balancing cost, availability, security, and scalability.
* Evaluate and implement Docker, infrastructure as code, Auto Scaling, and container-based deployments where appropriate.
* Help establish a scalable architecture that can evolve towards services such as ECS / Fargate without unnecessary premature complexity.
* Track AWS resource usage and implement cost alerts, tagging, and resource lifecycle management.

**Collaboration & Engineering Enablement**

* Work closely with backend, frontend, QA, and product teams to understand deployment and infrastructure requirements.
* Support developers in debugging environment-specific issues and improving application reliability.
* Establish standardised development, QA, and production deployment practices.
* Maintain clear documentation for CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure architecture, incident handling, and server operations.
* Participate in release planning, infrastructure reviews, incident reviews, and technical discussions.
* Take end-to-end ownership of DevOps activities and continuously improve the team’s operational efficiency.

**Skills And Knowledge**
**Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with AWS services, particularly EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, RDS, CloudWatch, and ACM.
* Good understanding of AWS networking, including public/private subnets, route tables, security groups, NAT Gateways, Elastic IPs, and network troubleshooting.
* Strong proficiency in Linux server administration, preferably Ubuntu.
* Experience managing Nginx, reverse proxies, SSL/TLS certificates, DNS, and HTTPS configurations.
* Experience deploying and maintaining Node.js applications using PM2 or equivalent process managers.
* Hands-on experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools.
* Strong understanding of Git, GitHub workflows, branching strategies, pull requests, and deployment controls.
* Experience with PostgreSQL / Amazon RDS administration, backups, monitoring, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Experience with application logging, monitoring, alerting, and production incident management.
* Knowledge of IAM roles, least-privilege access, secrets management, encryption, and infrastructure security.
* Ability to write shell scripts and automate routine infrastructure operations.
* Understanding of load balancing, health checks, high availability, and Auto Scaling concepts.
* Experience with AWS cost optimisation and infrastructure capacity planning.
* Good troubleshooting, analytical, and root-cause investigation skills.

**Preferred Technical Skills**

* Experience with Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or other Infrastructure as Code tools.
* Experience with Docker and container-based application deployment.
* Familiarity with Amazon ECS / Fargate and container orchestration.
* Experience with AWS Systems Manager, Session Manager, and secure remote server administration.
* Familiarity with CloudTrail, GuardDuty, AWS Config, and other AWS security services.
* Experience with performance testing, load testing, and capacity planning.
* Familiarity with Sentry, CloudWatch dashboards, and centralised log management.
* Understanding of backup strategies, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
* Experience supporting fintech, banking, payment systems, or other security-sensitive applications.

**Behavioural & Professional Competencies**

* Strong ownership and accountability for infrastructure reliability.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve complex production issues.
* Security-first mindset, particularly when handling financial applications and sensitive data.
* Proactive approach to automation, monitoring, and incident prevention.
* Ability to balance scalability, reliability, security, and infrastructure cost.
* Strong documentation and operational discipline.
* Good communication and collaboration skills with developers and business stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving technical requirements.
* Willingness to take responsibility for both day-to-day infrastructure operations and long-term improvements.
* Key Expectations from the Role
* Own AWS Infrastructure – Take end-to-end responsibility for the stability, security, availability, and maintainability of Bondsmart’s cloud infrastructure.
* Automate Deployments – Build reliable CI/CD pipelines and reduce manual deployment and server management activities.
* Strengthen Security – Implement secure access controls, private networking, secrets management, audit logging, and infrastructure hardening.
* Improve Monitoring & Reliability – Establish effective logging, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis practices.
* Prepare for Growth – Improve infrastructure readiness for increased traffic through appropriate capacity planning, load balancing, and Auto Scaling.
* Control Infrastructure Costs – Optimise AWS spending while maintaining appropriate reliability, security, and performance.
* Ensure Backup & Recovery Readiness – Establish and test reliable backup, restoration, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Support Financial Integrations – Maintain reliable network connectivity and stable outbound IP requirements for external financial service providers.
* Build Maintainable Infrastructure – Document infrastructure, automate repeatable tasks, and establish standardised operational procedures.
* Be Hands-on – Actively work on AWS, Linux, networking, deployment pipelines, debugging, and production incidents rather than functioning only as an infrastructure coordinator.

Experience Background
  
  

* AWS cloud infrastructure management, configuration, and optimization.
* Management of EC2 instances, VPCs, subnets, security groups, route tables, and IAM.
* Deployment and maintenance of Node.js / Express.js / NestJS backend applications.
* Management of Nginx, PM2, Linux servers, and application runtime environments.
* Frontend deployment using Amazon S3, CloudFront, Route 53, and SSL/TLS certificates.
* CI/CD pipeline development and automation using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools.
* Database infrastructure management using Amazon RDS and PostgreSQL.
* Infrastructure monitoring, logging, alerting, and production troubleshooting.
* Cloud security, access management, network security, and secrets management.
* Backup management, disaster recovery, high availability, and infrastructure reliability.
* Infrastructure cost optimization, capacity planning, and performance monitoring.
* Experience working with development teams to improve deployment processes and operational reliability
* Experience in fintech, banking, financial services, or other security-sensitive environments is preferred

Educational Qualification
  
  
B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech / MCA / BCA in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Relevant practical experience and industry certifications will be an advantage.

title: Senior Devops Engineer
description:
Manages infrastructure operations for application teams including hardware, networking, virtual infrastructure, server and VM configurations and storage. * Days (8 Casual and 18 Privilege), following local guidelines and practices.

* Access to hundreds of professional e-learning courses, specifically created for Comscore

* The ability to become a truly global engineer, with exposure to markets across the world. With more than 30 offices around the world, many Comscore teams work together across locations.

**About Comscore**
At Comscore, we’re pioneering the future of cross-platform media measurement, arming organizations with the insights they need to make decisions with confidence. Central to this aim are our people who work together to simplify the complex on behalf of our clients & partners. Though our roles and skills are varied, we’re united by our commitment to five underlying values: Integrity, Velocity, Accountability, Teamwork, and Servant Leadership. If you’re motivated by big challenges and interested in helping some of the largest and most important media properties and brands navigate the future of media, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Comscore (NASDAQ: SCOR) is a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms. With a data footprint that combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence with advanced audience insights, Comscore allows media buyers and sellers to quantify their multiscreen behavior and make business decisions with confidence. A proven leader in measuring digital and set-top box audiences and advertising at scale, Comscore is the industry’s emerging, third-party source for reliable and comprehensive cross-platform measurement. To learn more about Comscore, please visit Comscore.com.
  
  
Comscore is committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity.

title: Devops Engineer II-2
description:
**Overview**
At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges.
  
  
Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.
  
  
You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.
  
  
Come make an impact every day at Zebra.
  
  
**What We're Looking For**
DevOps Engineer (2–4 years of experience) to join our Cloud Engineering team. In this role, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership to manage, maintain, and automate our day-to-day cloud operations and deployment pipelines across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  
  
The ideal candidate has strong foundational skills in Linux, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), containerization, and CI/CD automation, along with a strong drive to troubleshoot issues, maintain system reliability, and streamline developer workflows.
  
  

* Day-to-Day Cloud & Infrastructure Maintenance
* Support and maintain multi-cloud environments across AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring high availability, security compliance, and performance.
* Manage cloud resource provisioning, tagging, cost hygiene, and routine hygiene tasks (cleaning up orphaned disks, unused IPs, obsolete snapshots).
* Assist in user access management, role provisioning (IAM/RBAC), and adherence to least-privilege security policies.
* CI/CD & Release Support
* Maintain and optimize existing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
* Assist development teams with daily builds, staging rollouts, production deployments, and rollback procedures.
* Troubleshoot build failures, deployment pipeline bottlenecks, and environment drift issues.
* Containerization & Orchestration
* Support containerized workloads running on Docker and managed Kubernetes services (EKS, AKS, GKE).
* Assist in rolling out Helm chart updates, ingress configurations, secrets management, and pod scaling policies.
* Monitoring, Observability & Incident Response
* Monitor platform health, logs, and alerts using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, or ELK/OpenSearch.
* Participate in on-call rotations and first-response triage for operational incidents, identifying root causes and escalating when necessary.
* Assist in running routine backup, restore, and disaster recovery verification checks.
* Automation & Scripting
* Write and maintain modular Terraform configurations for infrastructure automation.
* Create and maintain utility scripts in Bash or Python to automate repetitive operational tasks.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Experience: 2–4 years of dedicated hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Systems Engineering roles.
* Cloud Platforms: Hands-on operational experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and foundational familiarity with the others.
* Operating Systems & Networking: Strong proficiency in Linux administration (Ubuntu, RHEL/CentOS), shell scripting (Bash), and core networking concepts (VPC, Subnets, DNS, VPN, NAT, Routing, Firewalls).
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Working experience with Terraform (creating modules, managing state files, and basic refactoring).
* Containers & Orchestration: Solid experience with Docker and basic Kubernetes administration (kubectl, Helm, pod lifecycle management).
* CI/CD: Experience maintaining automated deployment pipelines in tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins.
* Scripting: Proficiency in Python or Bash for task automation and API integrations.

Soft Skills & Working Style
  
  

* Strong problem-solving aptitude and curiosity to learn across diverse cloud ecosystems.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and incident updates.
* Ability to prioritize operational tickets and communicate blockers promptly.

Nice-to-Have
  
  

* Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate, Azure Administrator AZ-104, or GCP Associate Cloud Engineer).
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Application Developer (CKAD).

**Benefits**
We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.
  
  
**Job Posting Statement**
To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.
  
  
**AI Technology Statement**
Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

description:

Professional Experience

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset with the ability to solve complex, distributed system problems.

title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Job Purpose**
To lead the reliability, availability, performance, and continuous improvement of Air Arabia's mission-critical Java-based applications and airline reservation systems by implementing Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) best practices. Responsible for driving operational excellence through proactive monitoring, automation, incident management, scalability improvements, and collaboration with cross-functional teams, while ensuring compliance with organizational policies, industry standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  
  
Key Result Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) initiatives for Java-based microservices and monolithic applications supporting mission-critical airline operations and Passenger Service Systems (PSS).
* Establish, monitor, and continuously improve system reliability by defining and managing Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and error budgets.
* Lead and facilitate root cause analysis (RCA) for complex production incidents, ensuring timely resolution and implementation of preventive measures to minimize recurrence.
* Drive architectural enhancements to improve system performance, scalability, resilience, availability, and operational efficiency through optimization techniques such as caching and distributed system design.
* Mentor and provide technical guidance to team members by promoting best practices in incident management, production support, troubleshooting, and operational excellence.

Key Result Responsibilities-Continued
  
  

* Collaborate closely with software engineering, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams to enhance application design, improve system reliability, and ensure production readiness.
* Own and define CI/CD pipeline standards, GitOps practices, and infrastructure automation strategy, setting the framework that engineers across the team execute against.
* Set the containerization and orchestration strategy (Docker, Kubernetes) for the team, defining standards for scalability, resilience, and high availability that other engineers implement.
* Own the on-call escalation framework, ensuring adequate coverage and clear escalation paths, and lead post-incident reviews.
* Evaluate new tools and technologies to strengthen reliability and represent SRE in capacity planning and release readiness reviews.
* Own reliability reporting to management, translating SLA/SLO performance and incident trends into clear business updates.

**Qualifications (Academic, Training, Languages)**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Engineering/ Computer Science/ Information Technology.
* Fluent in English Language.
* Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, and troubleshooting complex production issues within enterprise environments.
* Airline, aviation, or travel industry experience, particularly with Passenger Service Systems (PSS), is preferred.
* Proficiency in MS Office.
* Strong knowledge of SQL with experience in database design, optimization, and performance tuning; experience with Oracle Database is an advantage.
* Solid understanding of distributed systems, system architecture, scalability, high availability, and resilient application design.
* Proficiency in monitoring, logging, and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, or Datadog, used to drive proactive incident detection and reliability strategy.
* Exposure to Node.js and Next.js is an advantage

Work Experience
  
  

* With 6-8 years of experience in Software Engineering, SRE, or Production Support (Java Applications).
* Hands-on experience designing, developing, and supporting both microservices and monolithic application architectures.
* Strong hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes for containerization, orchestration, and production deployment (mandatory).
* Experience with JBoss Application Server or similar enterprise Java application servers is an added advantage.
* Proven experience designing and governing CI/CD pipeline standards, GitOps practices, and Git-based workflows across multiple teams.
* Hands-on experience with caching technologies (e.g., Redis) and messaging platforms to improve application performance and reliability.

description:
**Your Future Evolves Here**
Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.
  
  
Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.
  
  
Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**
**Department:**
Platform Engineering & Operations (PEO)Function / Team Platform Architecture
  
  
**Reports To:**
Director, Platform Architecture
  
  
**Location / Work Arrangement:**
Remote / Work at Home
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Date / Version:**
2026-09 / v1 (standard template)
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As a Platform Architect in Evolent's Platform Engineering & Operations (PEO) organization, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the cloud and infrastructure platforms that Evolent's applications run on. This role involves strategic thinking to solve high impactful organizational issues with expertise in major cloud platforms, specifically Microsoft Azure.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
Evolent is transforming how it builds and operates infrastructure under a refreshed Platform Engineering & Operations operating model, grounded in four principles: Architecture First, Automation by Default, Reliability is a Shared Responsibility and Golden Paths Over Custom Solutions. You will turn approved designs into provisioned, automated, and documented platforms, and you will do it transparently, through formal handoffs, Office Hours reviews, and documentation your peers can actually rely on.
  
  
**Agentic AI**
: Platform Engineering is moving toward agentic AI as a standard part of how the organization works. As agentic AI transforms the way we work, we expect our engineers to be at the forefront of that change, designing and building intelligent solutions rather than simply consuming them. This builder mentality is a core attribute we assess from the first conversation.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Provision and change infrastructure exclusively as code, so that every environment is reproducible, reviewable, and free of manual drift.
* Reverse engineer the applications and infrastructure you inherit: trace dependencies, integrations, and data flows end to end until you can explain how a system actually works.
* Design and build agentic AI solutions for platform, delivery, and operations work: identify the toil worth automating, then build, evaluate, and harden the agent that removes it.
* Build security and compliance into the delivery path: least-privilege access, secrets handling, policy-as-code guardrails, and audit evidence produced by design rather than assembled under deadline.

*Scope note: This role works inside one PEO function and partners across the others. Platform Architecture defines and approves standards, DevOps provisions and delivers, Site Reliability Engineering operates production, Platform Enablement & Automation builds golden paths and guardrails, Database Administration owns data platforms, and Cloud Network Services owns the foundational cloud fabric and network. Hiring manager: add any boundary specific to your team here.*
What You'll Need to Be Successful
  
  

* Demonstrates humility, openness to feedback, and a team-first mindset.
* Comfortable with a high level of transparency, surfacing risks and mistakes early.
* Ability to create high-quality technical diagrams and documentation.
* Deep knowledge of agentic AI concepts: agents and tool use, orchestration, context and retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, and the limits of each. This is one of the most important requirements for the role, because every person in Platform Engineering & Operations is expected to become a builder of agentic AI solutions rather than only a user of them.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to reverse engineer application architecture: take an unfamiliar application and the infrastructure under it, trace its components, dependencies, and data flows.
* Working fluency in Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code. Terraform and Ansible are Evolent's standard tooling.

Domain Expertise — Platform Architecture
  
  

* Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and resilient workloads on the Azure platform
* Maintain overall cloud organization and standards such as the Azure Landing Zone architecture, the Azure Well Architected Framework, and Enterprise Policy Governance.
* Implement cloud security measures and controls set by Senior and Principal team members from regulatory compliance frameworks such as HITRUST & CIS.
* Proficiency with tools such as Azure Portal/CLI, Azure Advisor, Azure Policy, Azure Resource Graph, and VS Code.
* Analyze existing cloud architectures and recommend optimizations for cost efficiency, scalability, resiliency, and performance.

**Nice To Have (Preferred)**

* Experience applying agentic AI concepts, whether through professional experience, personal projects, academic work, or other relevant initiatives: what it does, the choices you made, what failed, and what you would change.
* Proficiency in a scripting or programming language used for automation and tooling, such as Python, Go, PowerShell, C#, or Bash.
* Experience in a regulated environment, for example healthcare and HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Relevant Azure certifications preferred, for example AZ-104 or AZ-305, AI-500 or AB-100
* ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity

Academic Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

title: AIOps Platform Engineer Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Senior Associate Director, Software Engineering
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior AIOps Engineer to design, build, and operate the autonomous agents that turn observability data into safe, closed-loop operational action. You will sit at the intersection of service observability and agentic AI: connecting agents to metrics, logs, traces, events, change data, and service topology so they can detect, diagnose, and remediate production issues with minimal human intervention. You will define how agents reason over telemetry, which tools and runbooks they can call, the guardrails and approval gates that keep their actions safe, and the feedback loops that make them smarter after every incident. This role moves us from dashboards people have to watch to a self-healing production estate where AI observes, decides, and acts — and humans stay in control.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Design and build autonomous AIOps agents (LLM-based and multi-agent) that run the full operational loop — observe, correlate, diagnose, decide, act, and verify — across incident triage, root-cause analysis, and auto-remediation
* Connect agents to the observability estate (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Tempo/Jaeger, APM, CMDB, change and deployment events) through well-defined tools/APIs and MCP servers, giving agents real-time, topology-aware context to reason over
* Turn observability signals into autonomous action: build event-driven triggers on SLO burn-rate, anomaly, and correlated alert patterns that launch agent workflows such as rollback, restart, scale-out, failover, traffic shift, config fix, or ticket enrichment
* Build the agent action layer: convert runbooks into machine-executable, idempotent actions (runbook-as-code), with pre-checks, blast-radius limits, dry-run modes, automatic rollback, and post-action health verification against SLIs
* Implement guardrails and human-in-the-loop controls: risk-tiered autonomy levels, policy-as-code, approval gates for high-risk changes, full audit trails, and explainable reasoning for every decision an agent makes
* Apply AI to observability data: anomaly detection, forecasting, alert noise reduction, event correlation, and retrieval-augmented reasoning over past incidents, runbooks, and post-mortems to speed up RCA and cut MTTD/MTTR
* Build evaluation and observability for the agents themselves: trace agent reasoning and tool calls, measure accuracy, action success rate, false-action rate, latency, and cost; run replay/simulation and chaos tests before increasing autonomy in production
* Partner with SRE, platform, and application teams to onboard services to autonomous operations, set standards and reusable patterns, and coach engineers on using AI + observability to automate their own operational workflows

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:
  
  

* 10+ years overall experience with 5+ years in SRE, AIOps, observability, or platform engineering.
* Proven hands-on development of autonomous agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent; strong grasp of tool/function calling, MCP, planning, memory, and multi-agent orchestration
* Deep service observability expertise: OpenTelemetry, , Grafana, , Jaeger/Tempo, or enterprise APM (Splunk, AppDynamics); strong PromQL/LogQL/SQL and SLO/SLI/error-budget design
* Track record of delivering closed-loop auto-remediation in production that measurably reduced MTTR, alert noise, or manual toil, with clear safety controls and rollback
* Strong Python (Go a plus) with experience building event-driven services and integrations across Kubernetes, CI/CD, ITSM (ServiceNow), and automation tools.
* Practical knowledge of applied ML and LLM techniques for operations: anomaly detection, time-series forecasting, event correlation, RAG, prompt engineering, and evaluation of LLM outputs
* Understanding of responsible and secure AI in regulated environments: least-privilege agent access, PII redaction, auditability, model risk management, and change-control compliance
* Demonstrated technical leadership, with experience mentoring and leading engineers, setting engineering direction, reviewing designs, and developing team capability while influencing risk partners and senior stakeholders

title: Lead AI Platform Engineer (Hybrid Work Model)
description:
**Lead AI Platform Engineer**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Model of Work: Hybrid**
**About Quorum Software**
Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1,800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. For more information, visit quorumsoftware.com
  
  
**Be a part of our legacy**
Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.
  
  
**Who We Are Looking For**
Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We're hiring a Lead AI Platform Engineer: a lead, hands-on engineer who will champion our AI Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) across engineering teams and design and build core parts of our AI platform, working day to day with our Pune and US AI platform team.
  
  
The team owns the Agentic AI Platform and drives AI adoption, including AIDLC, across the engineering departments. We don't hand work off after release: the team builds it, ships it, monitors it, and supports it in production.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role, not a team lead or people-management position. You lead through technical depth: owning hard problems, setting a high bar for quality, and helping the engineers around you do their best work.
  
  
**What You Will Own**
You will own technical design and delivery for your areas of the AI platform, and help drive AIDLC adoption across engineering.
  
  

* The Agentic AI Platform: the agentic runtime and LLM gateway.
* Shared platform services: a growing set of services, such as a knowledge base built on a vector database.
* AIDLC and AI adoption: helping engineering teams across departments implement AIDLC, AI coding tools, and engineering automation.

**Responsibilities**
**AIDLC and AI adoption**

* Make AI-assisted engineering the norm by championing AIDLC, AI coding tools, and engineering automation.
* Help engineering teams across departments implement AIDLC in their own workflows and codebases.

**Technical design**

* Take on the most complex platform work across the AI platform, Databricks, and shared services.
* Make design and trade-off decisions for your areas.
* Contribute to technical planning with the Pune and US teams.

**Hands-on engineering**

* Spend time writing, testing, and shipping code across Python, TypeScript, C#, and Elixir codebases.

**Engineering quality**

* Set a high bar for testing, code review, design documentation, and observability through your own work and reviews.
* Work closely with QA and DevOps so quality is built in, not inspected in.

**Production ownership**

* Make sure what you ship is deployed safely, monitored, and supported in production.
* Help lead the response when something breaks.

**Cross-site collaboration**

* Collaborate closely with the OPTI US team by sharing designs, aligning priorities, and keeping work moving across time zones.
* And other duties as assigned.

**Requirements**
We care about lead-level capability, not a title. Manager experience is not required if you've been the person others go to for technical direction.
  
  

* Lead-level software engineering experience building and running production systems, typically 10+ years.
* Production experience in at least two of Python, TypeScript, Elixir, and C#, and the comfort to pick up the rest.
* A strong testing mindset: you design for testability and treat automated tests as part of the work.
* Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and engineering automation, and a view on how they change the way teams build software.
* Experience working with AIDLC or a similar structured approach to AI-assisted delivery.
* Experience owning services in production, including deployments, monitoring, and incident response.
* Experience supporting other engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussions.
* Clear written and spoken English, and confidence working with distributed teams across India and the US.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience building with LLMs, such as agents, tool use, orchestration, or an LLM gateway.
* Exposure to Databricks, Spark, or large-scale data pipelines.
* Azure knowledge, including CI/CD.
* Experience onboarding new team members.
* Background in enterprise software.

**Our Stack**

* Languages: Python, TypeScript, Elixir, and C#
* Cloud and data: Azure and Azure Databricks
* AI platform: an in-house agentic runtime and LLM gateway
* Engineering: AI coding tools throughout the development lifecycle

**Additional Details**

* Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position.

At Quorum, we are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of belonging. We want to be the place where a diverse pool of talented people join us, stay with us and do their best work. With a diverse team of employees, we grow and learn better together. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression, and talent that our employees invest in their work represents not only part of our culture, but our reputation and our achievements. We are fully focused on equity and equality and believe deeply in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ethnicity, national origin, ability, neurodiversity and all the other characteristics that make us unique.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law.*

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer (Security)

**Location:**
Pune (Hybrid)

**Experience:**
5+ years (about 70% software development, 30% security)

About the role

This is a development-first security role. About 70% of the work is engineering: you will fix vulnerabilities in application code, upgrade vulnerable components, and build the tooling and automation that keep issues from coming back. The other 30% is security testing across our web apps and APIs. You own each fix end to end, from the finding to a merged, tested change.

What you will do

Development and remediation

* Fix vulnerabilities directly in application code, in whatever language or framework the application uses, and add tests that prove the fix.
* Fix root causes, not single instances: build shared validation, output encoding, parameterized queries, and authorization checks that remove whole classes of vulnerabilities.
* Upgrade vulnerable libraries, frameworks, and third-party components, resolve breaking changes, and keep builds and tests passing.
* Build internal security tooling and automation: scanner integrations, triage and reporting scripts, and checks that catch issues before release.
* Integrate SAST, DAST, and SCA tooling such as Aikido into CI/CD pipelines, and tune the rules to cut noise.
* Fix infrastructure and configuration issues: web server and TLS settings, cloud IAM and network rules, container and Kubernetes configuration, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipeline hardening.
* Where code or infrastructure is owned by another team, raise the change yourself as a pull request and drive it to merge.

Security testing

* Test web applications and APIs for exploitable vulnerabilities.
* Review code and design for flaws in authentication, authorization, session handling, data flows, and secrets management.
* Run and tune vulnerability scans across applications, hosts, or cloud accounts, and prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact alongside CVSS.
* Retest fixes and close findings only when the vulnerability is confirmed resolved.

Reporting and communication

* Write clear findings and fix notes with reproduction steps, evidence, risk rating, and the change made.
* Agree on realistic remediation timelines with engineers, and share secure coding patterns so the same issues stop recurring.

What you bring

Experience

* 5+ years total: approx. 3.5 years building and shipping production software as a developer, and approx. 1.5+ years of hands-on security work such as VAPT, application security, or secure code review.
* A track record of fixing security issues in code.

Development expertise

* Production-level depth in at least two of: Java, C#/.NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, Go, Swift, or Kotlin. Comfortable reading and changing code in languages you know less well.
* Able to land a correct, tested fix in an unfamiliar codebase without breaking existing behavior.
* Web and API development: REST and GraphQL services; authentication with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT; session management; databases and ORMs.
* Unit and integration testing, Git-based workflows, pull requests, and code review.
* CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Working knowledge of Nginx, Apache, IIS, and TLS configuration.
* Scripting in Python, Bash, or PowerShell to automate testing and remediation.

Communication

* Clear written findings and the ability to explain risk and trade-offs to engineers and business stakeholders.

Nice to have

* Web and API: manual testing with Burp Suite Professional; OWASP Top 10 and ASVS; injection, authentication and session flaws, access control (IDOR/BOLA), SSRF, and OAuth and JWT weaknesses.
* Secure code review: spotting vulnerable patterns in code and using SAST and SCA results to find and fix real issues.
* Built security tools, Burp extensions, or custom SAST rules (for example, Semgrep or CodeQL).
* Threat modeling and secure design review experience.
* Familiarity with compliance evidence requirements (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS) as they relate to vulnerability remediation.

What success looks like

* Vulnerabilities reach merged, tested fixes within agreed timelines.
* Recurring vulnerability classes decline because fixes address root causes.
* The tooling and automation you build catch issues before release and cut manual triage.
* Development teams see you as a fellow engineer who ships fixes alongside them.
* Cloud misconfiguration and patch exposure windows stay short.

title: Remote Pod Lead - Material Science
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Materials Science expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review materials science tasks for technical accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic computational materials research workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging scientific tasks.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of materials science tasks.
* Review scientific tasks end to end, including problem statements, crystal structures, interatomic potentials, thermodynamic databases, simulation inputs, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving density functional theory (DFT), molecular dynamics, computational thermodynamics, phase diagrams, crystallography, materials characterization, mechanical properties, semiconductors, and energy materials.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic materials research workflows and require meaningful multi-step scientific reasoning rather than simple database lookups or library calls.
* Verify scientific correctness across units, crystal symmetry, convergence criteria, electronic structure calculations, thermodynamic consistency, and simulation parameters.
* Validate computational environments, scientific software, pseudopotentials, interatomic potentials, and dependencies to ensure reproducible results.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful scientific outputs such as lattice parameters, formation energies, band gaps, elastic constants, phonon properties, phase fractions, diffusion coefficients, and microstructure metrics.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect numerical tolerances, and opportunities to bypass scientific calculations or simulations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Materials Science, Metallurgy, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, Fortran, or Julia, with proficiency in Linux and terminal-based environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: atomistic simulation, computational thermodynamics, mesoscale modeling, electronic structure calculations, or materials characterization data analysis.
* Strong understanding of materials science fundamentals, numerical methods, computational modeling, and scientific validation.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, scientific code, computational simulations, manuscripts, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate scientific assumptions, numerical accuracy, simulation convergence, and the reliability of computational results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed scientific assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical or research teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with computational materials science tools such as Quantum ESPRESSO, VASP, GPAW, ABINIT, LAMMPS, pymatgen, ASE, spglib, phonopy, pycalphad, MOOSE, FiPy, OVITO, or DREAM3D.
* Experience with machine-learned interatomic potentials, high-throughput materials simulations, or materials databases such as Materials Project.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and high-performance computing (HPC) environments.
* Experience developing scientific benchmarks, programming challenges, simulation-based evaluations, or automated grading systems.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated scientific solutions.
* Industry experience in semiconductors, batteries, alloys, advanced materials, or manufacturing.
* Publications, research contributions, or open-source development experience in computational materials science.
* Prior experience in AI training, scientific quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: Senior Devops Engineer
company: Bennett Coleman & Co. Ltd. (The Times of India)
description:
**Role Details**

We are looking for an experienced Senior DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer, with more than 8-12 years of relevant experience, to design, build, and maintain our CI/CD pipelines and containerized and On-Prem Infrastructure. You will own the automation that lets our development teams ship reliably and at scale. The work spans AI, DevOps, virtualization, and container orchestration platforms.

You'll make a difference through your expertise in:

* DevOps (Jenkins, Github, Pipelines, Repos, Artifacts)
* CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance
* Docker containerization and Kubernetes orchestration
* Hyper-V virtualization
* Infrastructure management (networking, storage, compute)
* Scripting and automation (PowerShell, Bash)
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, or similar)
* Git source control
* AWS Cloud

**Role Overview**

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role. You will shape how software moves from commit to production and how the underlying infrastructure is built, changed, and supported. You will work closely with development teams, infrastructure colleagues, and security specialists.

You are accountable for the reliability and maintainability of the delivery platform. You are not expected to own every application or act as the sole authority on security or networking. Senior judgment matters as much as technical depth. That means choosing proportionate solutions, documenting decisions, and helping others adopt sound practices.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Pipelines and Release Engineering**

You will design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines. Pipelines will be defined as code in YAML and Shell scripts, using reusable templates, consistent stage gates, and clear approval paths. You will manage repositories and branching strategies Repos and Git, and support pull request workflows and code review standards.

You will run Artifactory as the central artifact and container registry. This includes:

* Repository structure, retention policies, and access controls
* Promotion of build outputs between environments
* Integration with Artifacts where appropriate

You will select deployment approaches, such as rolling or blue-green releases, according to each service's needs, with practical rollback mechanisms.

**Containers and Orchestration**

You will standardize Docker image builds with minimal base images, versioned tags, and automated vulnerability scanning. You will operate Kubernetes clusters, covering but not limited to:

* Namespaces, resource limits, and role-based access control
* Ingress configuration and secrets handling
* Deployment patterns for services

You will also work with application teams on containerization and production readiness.

**Virtualization and Infrastructure**

You will manage Hyper-V hosts and virtual machines, including clustering, capacity, live migration, and patching. You will maintain the supporting networking, storage, and compute infrastructure with infrastructure colleagues. You will monitor performance, forecast capacity, and plan hardware and software lifecycle. You will also confirm that backups and restore procedures meet agreed recovery objectives.

**Automation and Infrastructure as Code**

You will provision and change infrastructure through Terraform and manage configuration through Ansible or similar tools. Changes go through peer review, automated validation, and drift detection. You will write and maintain PowerShell and Bash automation for provisioning, maintenance, and operational tasks, with testing and documentation that let others maintain the code with confidence.

**Security and Operational Practice**

You will build security controls into delivery workflows, including:

* Dependency and image scanning
* Secrets management
* Least-privilege service accounts
* Certificate renewal

You will triage findings by risk, working with the security team, which sets policy and provides independent assurance. You will take part in incident response, root cause analysis, and blameless reviews. You will also improve monitoring and alerting so that every alert prompts a clear action.

**Required Qualifications**

Candidates should be able to demonstrate:

* More than 8-12 years of relevant experience across DevOps, infrastructure engineering, and systems administration
* Substantial hands-on experience designing and maintaining AWS,DevOps pipelines, repositories, and artifact feeds
* Practical experience operating Docker and Kubernetes in production
* Experience administering Hyper-V virtualization, including clustering and capacity management
* Solid grounding in networking, storage, and compute infrastructure
* Strong scripting ability in PowerShell and Bash
* Working experience with Terraform, Ansible, or comparable infrastructure-as-code tools
* Fluent use of Git, including branching strategies and code review
* Demonstrated experience administering Artifactory
* Experience troubleshooting production issues and communicating clearly during incidents

A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience is accepted.

**Preferred Qualifications**

The following would be valuable but are not required:

* Experience migrating pipelines between CI platforms.
* Familiarity with Helm or GitOps tooling
* Experience with Windows Server and Linux in mixed environments
* Exposure to software supply chain controls such as artifact signing or software bills of materials

AWS Certifications, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate are welcome. They complement demonstrated experience rather than replace it.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description: Job DescriptionLeads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.ResponsibilitiesKey ResponsibilitiesSystem Design & Architecture - System Scalability:–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.–Design performance and load testing.System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.Compliance & Security:–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.Automation & Change Management:–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.Core ResponsibilitiesPlanning & Execution:–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.Collaboration & Partnership:–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.Problem Solving:–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.Continuous Learning:–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.Continuous Improvement:–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.Performance and Development:–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.About UsOnly Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.
