title: Lead AI Ops Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead AI Ops Engineer
  
  
AI Ops
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard's Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As AI agents move from POC to production, their behavior keeps changing in real time: the context they retrieve, the skills they select, how they resolve exceptions. These agents are never really “finished.” They keep learning from production outcomes, so their reliability, safety, and trustworthiness need to be actively operated, not just monitored. That is the job of AI Ops: making sure each agent’s reasoning stays correct, its context stays current, and its behavior stays governed as it learns.
  
  
**Role**

* Own end to end production monitoring for one or more AI agents, tracking key metrics, KPIs, accuracy, latency, SLA breaches, guardrail triggers, and out of scope rates through dedicated observability dashboards
* Serve as L1/L2 production support, providing first response monitoring, triage, and escalation to tech teams as new agentic services go live
* Identify and diagnose issues by monitoring eval scores and drift alerts, inspecting failing traces and patterns, and classifying root causes such as intent, tool, parameter, or hallucination errors
* Evaluate whether the agent’s reasoning remains correct in production, checking whether context retrieval stays current, whether resolutions match ground truth, and whether the learning loop is drifting
* Monitor and manage post production reliability, including API and authentication failures and issues originating from external AI endpoints, to protect revenue generating, client facing agents
* Partner with AI Engineering to prioritize fixes, run experiments on prompts, context, and routing in Dev, and validate improvements via evals before handing off proven changes for deployment
* Embed governance within the agent’s learning loop so that approval workflows and audit logging travel with every production change, rather than being added after the fact

**All About You**

* Experience monitoring or operating production AI/ML or agentic systems, including observability, evaluation, and drift detection practices
* Strong analytical skills to diagnose root causes across intent classification, tool selection, parameter errors, and hallucination patterns
* Understanding of AI/LLM observability concepts such as tracing, telemetry, guardrails, and evaluation engineering including benchmarks, automated evals, human review, and regression testing
* Familiarity with governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices such as PII detection, access control, audit logging, and policy enforcement is a plus
* Ability to work independently alongside existing Tech teams while owning a dedicated agent’s post launch health
* Excellent communication skills to translate production signals into clear, prioritized asks for AI Product and AI Engineering teams
* Comfort working in a fast evolving environment where the process itself, not just the throughput, is what is being continuously operated on and improved

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:

Job Category
  
  
Sales
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Senior Product Security Engineer
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Description:**
As Product Security Engineer - Senior, you will:
  
  

* Implement and continuously improve Sprinklr's cloud security controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments.
* Perform security assessments of cloud infrastructure, IAM configurations, network architectures, Kubernetes environments, and cloud services to identify risks and recommend practical remediation.
* Develop, automate, and operationalize security baselines, guardrails, and security standards for cloud-native services, infrastructure, platforms, and product deployments.
* Assess Infrastructure as Code and Embed security controls enabling secure design, development, deployment, and operations of Cloud Infrastructure.
* Extend support for triaging Network PenTest findings and revalidating the fixes
* Support initiatives focused on cloud hardening, vulnerability management, identity security, attack surface reduction, infrastructure security, cloud governance, and DDoS resilience.
* Communicate technical risks, security findings, and remediation recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Partner closely with Engineering teams to remediate security findings, improve secure engineering practices, and integrate security into day-to-day development workflows.

Additionally, you will:
  
  

* Develop security tooling, AI automation frameworks and integrations that improve visibility, reduce manual effort, and scale security across engineering teams.
* Evaluate emerging cloud services, security technologies, and AI-driven capabilities, prototype solutions, and recommend improvements to strengthen Sprinklr's security posture.
* Support the execution of Sprinklr's cloud security and product security roadmap by partnering with Engineering, DevOps, Platform, and Product teams.
* Contribute to defining and tracking security metrics, operational dashboards, and engineering KPIs to measure security coverage, automation adoption, remediation effectiveness, and overall program maturity.
* Support in security incident response, root cause analysis, and post-incident improvements to strengthen cloud and product security.

**Required Skills:**
**Must have**

* Knowledge about storage, compute, DNS and network services in AWS, Azure and/or GCP
* Knowledge about securing cloud services - (VPC/VNET, S3 or similar, Cloud Network Security, IAM, Logging and Auditing in Cloud, DNS, SMTP and Datastores)
* Knowledge about cloud agnostic & cloud specific security services offerings
* Knowledge about CIS benchmarks and security controls for Cloud service providers, Operating systems, Kubernetes, Docker and Server software technologies
* Knowledge about Disaster Recovery, High Availability and Encryption in Cloud
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, AWS Cloud Formation
* Basic knowledge of Kubernetes administration and security
* Docker concepts
* Operating Systems: Linux
* Any of these Scripting Languages: Python / shell / SQL / JavaScript
* Excellent communication skills
* Experience in understanding vulnerabilities, triaging them and providing remediation guidance to development

**Good to have**

* Experience with CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, DSPM, KSPM, IaC Scanning and Vulnerability Management solutions
* Application Security: OWASP, Secure coding practices, vulnerability scanning, penetration testing
* Collaboration and Communication: Agile, Scrum, Jira, Confluence
* Experience working with Version Control Tools: Gitlab / Github
* Experience working with any of these Continuous Integration Tools: Jenkins / Airflow
* Experience working with any of these Continuous Deployment Tools: Chef / Ansible / Helm
* Experience building AI Assisted or Agentic workflows
* Data Lakes: Snowflake or BigQuery
* API Tools: Postman

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

Acting as the single point of accountability for SAP Cloud ALM adoption across all global regions and workstreams, the ideal candidate will establish cross-functional governance, build end-to-end lifecycle traceability, integrate enterprise toolchains, and drive quality engineering across all phases of the SAP Activate framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Core Governance**
  
  

* Cloud ALM Strategy & Governance

* Governance Framework: Establish and enforce ALM governance standards across requirements gathering, business process hierarchy modeling, testing execution, defect management, deployment controls, and operations.
* Single Accountability: Serve as the central point of contact and accountability for Cloud ALM adoption across global regions, system integrators, and project workstreams.

* End-to-End Lineage: Maintain complete vertical and horizontal traceability across the lifecycle: Business Scope → Process Design → Requirements/User Stories → Development Units → Test Cases → Defects → Transports/Deployments.
* Integration Engineering: Design and implement robust integration and real-time data synchronization between SAP Cloud ALM and enterprise solutions, including:

+ Process Modeling: Signavio
+ Architecture & Capability Mapping: LeanIX
+ Work Management & ITSM: Jira / ServiceNow
+ Test Management: Tricentis, HP ALM, or equivalent
+ Documentation Systems: Confluence, SharePoint

+ Business process hierarchy structure and solution documentation
+ Requirement, scope, and user story management
+ Test planning, script execution, and defect tracking
+ Task management and deployment tracking

+ Integration & Exception Monitoring

* Operational Transition: Lead the transition of ALM artifacts from the project phase to Hypercare and steady-state operations (Run phase).

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:

title: Advisory Solutions Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. * Deep Expertise Development: Cultivate an in-depth understanding of Confluent’s technologies and the intricacies of building streaming applications.
* Technical Discovery and POC/Pilot Solutions: Collaborate with Confluent solutions engineers to gather requirements, identify use cases, and facilitate the development of Proof of Concept (POC)/Pilot solutions. Aid customers in overcoming technical challenges during initial blueprinting and use case deployment.
* Prospect Demos and Evangelization: Collaborate seamlessly with Confluent's Account Executives (AEs) and Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to bring our offerings to new prospects. Craft and deliver tailored demos that go beyond the standard, showcasing the unique value proposition Confluent has to offer.
* Customer Engagement: Offer technical assistance in driving customer consumption through monthly customer health reports, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Quarterly Technical Reviews.
* Knowledge Sharing, Workshops, and Training: Support cross-functional teams, including Field Marketing, Partner Solutions by conducting training sessions and workshops/webinars for customers, partners, prospects, and internal teams to educate them on Confluent's platform/cloud, features, and best practices.
* RFP/Vendor risk assessment Support: Contribute to vendor risk assessments to ensure a comprehensive understanding of potential risks and opportunities associated with proposed solutions. Assist in answering Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Quotations (RFQs).
* Technical Artifact Creation and Maintenance: Architect, build, and maintain reusable artifacts, including tools, prototypes, demos, workshops, and architecture blueprints.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Solutions Engineering or similar work experience in a technical pre-sales capacity.
* Process & Efficiency, a “scale” mindset. An ability to quickly leverage standardized demo environments, template proposals, and documented Proof of Concept (PoC) scopes to minimize preparation time.

Experience with Event-Driven architecture, Data Integration & Processing Techniques, Database & Data Warehouse technologies.
  
  

* First-Hand exposure to Cloud Architecture, Migrations, Deployment & Application Development.
* Experience with Automation, GitOps and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency in Java, Python or SQL.
* Development or implementation experience in a cloud-based environment, along with Technical certifications (e.g., Cloud Developer/Architect, Data Engineering & Integration).
* Clear, consistent demonstration of self-starter behavior, a desire to learn new things and tackle hard technical problems.
* Managing multiple evaluation processes across various industry verticals and use cases, ability to be nimble and organized is a must
* Exceptional presentation and communications capabilities to all levels across an organization.
* Ability to explain complex concepts in plain, non-technical language that resonates with mid-level managers and business owners.
* Fluency in English is a requisite.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Previous experience building solutions with Apache Kafka.
* Understanding of systems operations concepts (disk, network, operating systems, etc).
* Experience with software development tools, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD tooling (Terraform, Ansible) is a plus
* Experience building and operating large scale systems.
* Experience in technical pre-sales or consultative roles.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver technical solutions and drive continuous service improvements.
* Mentor network engineers through technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and professional support.

description:

Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) Lead – Enterprise Integrations & Digital Transformation**
**Experience:**
7–10 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Kochi / Bangalore / Hyderabad (Hybrid)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Reports To:**
Service Delivery Manager – Enterprise Applications / Integration Services
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and technically strong
**Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) Lead**
to lead enterprise integration initiatives across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid application landscapes.
  
  
This role is responsible for defining integration strategy, designing scalable integration architectures, establishing governance standards, and leading teams responsible for implementing secure and high-performing integrations using
**Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)**
and related enterprise integration technologies.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Oracle Integration Cloud, API-led integration, enterprise application connectivity, process automation, and integration architecture. You will work closely with Architects, Business Analysts, Salesforce Teams, ERP Teams, HR Technology Teams, and Business Stakeholders to deliver seamless connectivity between Oracle Cloud Applications, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Microsoft platforms, and other enterprise systems.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for professionals who enjoy solving complex integration challenges while supporting large-scale enterprise modernization and digital transformation programs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Integration Leadership & Architecture**

* Lead enterprise integration initiatives using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
* Define integration architecture, governance frameworks, standards, and best practices.
* Design scalable, secure, and resilient integration solutions supporting cloud-to-cloud, cloud-to-on-premises, and hybrid ecosystems.
* Partner with enterprise architects to align integration strategies with organizational technology roadmaps.
* Conduct architecture reviews, design workshops, and technical assessments.
* Define integration roadmaps supporting business transformation and modernization initiatives.
* Establish API governance, security policies, monitoring standards, and operational frameworks.

**Oracle Integration Cloud Solution Delivery**

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of integration solutions using:

+ Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
+ Application Integrations
+ Process Automation
+ Visual Builder Integrations
+ File-Based Integrations
+ Event-Driven Integrations
+ REST and SOAP Services

* Develop reusable integration frameworks and enterprise integration patterns.
* Configure and manage Oracle and third-party adapters and connectors.
* Ensure delivery of scalable, maintainable, and reusable integration solutions.

**Enterprise Application Integrations**

* Lead integrations involving:

+ Oracle ERP Cloud
+ Oracle HCM Cloud
+ Oracle EPM
+ Salesforce
+ ServiceNow
+ Workday
+ SAP
+ Microsoft Platforms
+ Third-Party SaaS Applications

* Ensure seamless data synchronization, workflow orchestration, and process automation across enterprise systems.
* Support enterprise-wide business processes spanning finance, HR, service management, customer operations, and shared services.

**API Management & Security**

* Design and manage APIs using Oracle Integration Cloud capabilities.
* Implement API governance, lifecycle management, and security standards.
* Support authentication and security frameworks including:

+ OAuth 2.0
+ JWT
+ SSL/TLS
+ API Security Policies
+ Identity and Access Management Controls

* Ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

**Operational Excellence & Delivery Governance**

* Monitor and optimize integration performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex integration issues.
* Establish proactive monitoring, alerting, and support mechanisms.
* Support release management, production deployments, upgrades, and platform maintenance activities.
* Manage integration risks, dependencies, and operational challenges.
* Ensure timely and high-quality delivery across integration workstreams.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Lead and mentor Integration Developers and technical teams.
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance assessments.
* Support technical capability development, certification initiatives, and knowledge sharing.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the primary escalation point for integration-related technical issues.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7–10 years of overall IT experience.
* Minimum 5+ years of enterprise integration experience.
* Minimum 3+ years of hands-on Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) experience.
* Experience leading enterprise integration projects and technical teams.
* Proven track record delivering large-scale integration solutions in complex enterprise environments.

title: Senior Engineer - M365 & Cloud Platforms
description:
**Overview**
**Connecting clients to markets – and talent to opportunity.**
With 5,400+ employees and over 80,000 institutional, commercial, and payments clients, we operate from more than 80 offices spread across six continents. As a Fortune 100, Nasdaq-listed provider, we connect clients to the global markets – focusing on innovation, human connection, and providing world-class products and services to all types of investors.
  
  
Whether you want to forge a career connecting our retail clients to potential trading opportunities, or ingrain yourself in the world of institutional investing, StoneX Group is made up of four business segments that offer endless potential for progression and growth.
  
  
**Business Segment Overview**
**Corporate:**
Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
We are seeking a Senior Staff Engineer to lead the engineering delivery and long-term evolution of our Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and Azure AI environments across a global enterprise. This is an engineering and delivery leadership role, not a day-to-day administration role: the successful candidate will plan and execute complex, long-running projects — including large-scale migrations and platform modernizations — from design through delivery, while also building and governing AI-enabled solutions using Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform, and Azure AI Foundry. The role works within architectural standards set by our Architecture team and partners closely with security, compliance, and business stakeholders to modernize how the organization collaborates and works.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary duties will include:**

* Engineering & Delivery — Build, configure, and deliver solutions across M365 workloads (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive), Power Platform, and Azure AI services, working within designs and standards set by the Architecture team.
* Project & Migration Leadership — Plan and execute long-running, multi-phase projects end-to-end, including tenant and platform migrations, integrations, and modernization initiatives. Own project scope, sequencing, risk, and stakeholder communication from kickoff to close.
* AI Enablement — Design, build, and deliver AI-enabled solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem using Copilot, Power Platform, and Azure AI Foundry; stay current with new Microsoft AI capabilities and evaluate them for enterprise adoption.
* Power Platform & Azure AI Foundry Management — Administer and govern Power Platform environments (Power Apps, Power Automate), including environment strategy, DLP policies, and application lifecycle management. Manage Azure AI Foundry projects, model deployments, and usage governance.
* Security & Compliance Implementation — Implement and maintain controls aligned to Conditional Access, MFA, DLP, and Microsoft Purview compliance requirements; partner with security teams on risk mitigation.
* Documentation & Knowledge Management — Produce runbooks, standard operating procedures, and knowledge base content for engineering and support teams.
* Stakeholder Leadership — Act as the delivery lead and point of escalation for engineering execution across M365, Power Platform, and Azure AI initiatives, and drive adoption of new capabilities across the organization.

**Qualifications**
**T o land this role you will need**
:
  
  

* 5+ years of proven track record planning and executing complex, long-running migration or platform modernization projects in an enterprise environment
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot, Power Platform (Power Apps/Power Automate), and Azure AI Foundry or comparable Azure AI/OpenAI services
* Strong PowerShell scripting and automation experience, including Microsoft Graph API
* Solid working knowledge of Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint Online, including mail flow (SMTP, connectors) and identity fundamentals
* Experience governing Power Platform environments (DLP, ALM, Center of Excellence practices)
* Demonstrated program/project management skills with the ability to work autonomously across long project timelines
* Experience leading migration projects tied to M&A, tenant consolidation, or similar large-scale initiatives

**What makes you stand out:**

* Experience with security tooling (Entra ID, Defender, Sentinel, Intune)
* Experience with financial compliance tools (Global Relay, Purview, Proofpoint)
* Exposure to hybrid Exchange environments
* Experience with Azure OpenAI Service or Azure Cognitive Services
* Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM tools

**Education / Certification Requirements:**

* Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert (MS-102)
* Power Platform certification (PL-400 or PL-600)
* Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or equivalent Azure AI certification
* Security certification (SC-200 / SC-300 / SC-400) strongly preferred

**Working environment:**

* 4 days' work from office

title: Lead Platform Engineer
description:

**Job Title:**
Lead Platform Engineer
  
  
**Overview:**
Our solutions hosted on our Iris Smart Manufacturing platform combine equipment and process domain expertise in Mining & Metals, Oil & Gas, Chemicals & Petrochemicals with the state-of-the-art in data sciences, machine learning, and process optimization. The IRIS platform can work in hybrid mode and is built using microservices architecture. The applications are containerised and run on Azure Kubernetes service and use Azure blob storage, Data Lake, IoT Hub, Event Hub, Event Grid, and Queues.
  
  
The development team embraces DevOps culture and delivers products using Continuous Delivery principles. You will be key in managing multiple installations of the platform across Cloud and on-premise environments, fixing security vulnerabilities on a monthly basis, conducting audits, and contributing to automation of installations. You will have a great opportunity to work with a world-class team and latest technologies and be able to learn and contribute.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Contribute to the IRIS Platform operations roadmap and execute planned research and development
* Deploy and manage cloud infrastructure on Azure and AWS using best practices and governance standards
* Lead production operations, including incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis
* Automate so that IRIS Platform is deployable easily across multiple Cloud providers such as Azure and AWS, and on-premise such as K3s and RKE2
* Work with customers and Services team to support multiple installations of the IRIS platform
* Conduct monthly audits including vulnerabilities, DAST tests, and review of backups, cost and access reviews
* Develop CICD pipelines for projects built microservices that would be deployable across multiple environments
* Implement security best practices in cloud and on-premise environments to address vulnerabilities and compliance requirements
* Develop and maintain Helm charts for packaging and deploying Kubernetes applications
* Manage operations of the databases and messaging systems Postgres, Elastic, Redis, and Kafka including configuration, scalability, and backups
* Implement auto-scaling of various platform services within the Kubernetes environment
* Automate infrastructure provisioning with Terraform, Ansible, or similar IaC tools
* Operate Kubernetes clusters, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting to maintain SLAs and availability targets
* Apply security best practices and enforce compliance standards across cloud and deployment pipelines
* Be the operations contact point for multiple product teams

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure
* 3+ years of experience working with Linux systems
* 4+ years of commercial experience with Kubernetes
* 2+ years of experience working with Docker
* 4+ years of experience setting up CICD pipelines (AzureDevOps or similar)
* 2+ years of experience with automation tools such as Terraform and Ansible
* 2+ years of experience with Cloud such as Azure, AWS or GCP
* Good knowledge of best security practices, vulnerability management, and testing tools such as Acunetix, Snyk, CheckMarx or Trivy
* Troubleshooting problems in Production and comfortable doing root cause analysis
* Able to work in an Agile environment

* Opportunities for professional growth and development

title: Sr Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - S&T
description:
**Description**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
  
  
You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web & mobile applications with data store technologies.
  
  
AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.
  
  
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
  
  
Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
  
  
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.
  
  
As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.
  
  
**About The Team**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. title: Application Platform Architect
description:
As an Application Platform Architect at Zeta Global, you will be a visionary leader responsible for designing the foundational architecture that supports all of our applications and services. You will focus on building a scalable, reliable, and secure platform that empowers engineering teams to build and deploy applications with speed and efficiency. This role involves defining standards, selecting technologies, and guiding the development of core platform components such as microservices frameworks, APIs, and shared libraries—including those that enable AI agents and agentic workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Platform Strategy:**
  Define the technical vision and roadmap for the Zeta application platform, ensuring it meets the long-term needs of the business and engineering teams.
* **Architectural Design:**
  Design and lead the implementation of core platform services, including reusable microservices, APIs, and shared components that serve all applications.
* **AI Platform Integration:**
  Architect and build the underlying platform services and APIs that enable the seamless integration of
  **AI agents, large language models (LLMs)**
  , and
  **agentic workflows**
  . Design a robust and scalable infrastructure to support these advanced capabilities.
* **Scalability & Reliability:**
  Ensure the platform's architecture can handle increasing scale and complexity, with a focus on high availability, performance, and fault tolerance.
* **Developer Enablement:**
  Create tools, frameworks, and best practices that improve the developer experience, accelerate development velocity, and ensure consistency across all applications.
* **Technology Evaluation:**
  Research, evaluate, and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and architectural patterns to keep the platform at the forefront of innovation.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner with engineering, DevOps, and security teams to embed security, monitoring, and operational best practices into the platform's design and development lifecycle.
* **Documentation & Governance:**
  Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, guidelines, and governance standards for the platform's architecture and usage.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a lead architect or principal engineer role.
* Extensive experience designing and building large-scale, distributed application platforms.
* Deep expertise in microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and event-driven systems.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as
  **Java, Scala, or Python**
  .
* Strong experience with cloud platforms (
  **AWS**
  preferred) and cloud-native services.
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (
  **Docker, Kubernetes**
  ).
* Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code (
  **Terraform, Ansible**
  ).
* Excellent communication, presentation, and leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI/ML frameworks like
  **LangChain**
  , LlamaIndex, or similar, and a proven track record of architecting platforms to support them.
* Experience with service meshes (
  **Istio, Linkerd**
  ) and API gateways.
* Familiarity with identity and access management (
  **IAM**
  ) systems.
* Experience with security architecture, including threat modeling and secure-by-design principles.
* A track record of contributing to open-source projects or speaking at industry conferences.

**Company Profile:**

Zeta Global is a data-powered marketing technology company with a heritage of innovation and industry leadership. Founded in 2007 by entrepreneur David A. Steinberg and John Sculley, former CEO of Apple Inc and Pepsi-Cola, the Company combines the industry’s 3rd largest proprietary data set (2.4B+ identities) with Artificial Intelligence to unlock consumer intent, personalize experiences and help our clients drive business growth.

Zeta Global is a leading AI-powered marketing technology company that enables enterprise brands to acquire, grow, and retain customers through intelligent, data-driven engagement. At the center of its innovation is the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), which unifies customer data, identity, and advanced analytics to transform billions of data signals into actionable marketing intelligence and measurable business outcomes.

Publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: ZETA), Zeta is redefining modern marketing with Athena by Zeta™, a superintelligent, conversational agent embedded in ZMP that personalizes the marketer’s workspace, surfaces platform generated insights through natural dialogue and recommends next-best actions to help brands accelerate and optimize their marketing outcomes.

title: Principal Platform Engineer
description:
**Description**
About the role
  
  
At Trintech, the Principal Platform Engineer is a senior, hands-on technical leader who provides architecture and technical oversight for major platform initiatives. You will define scalable Azure platform patterns, implement and operate critical AKS and cloud capabilities, and resolve complex problems that cross infrastructure, application, security and delivery domains.
  
  
You will influence multiple teams through practical engineering, clear standards, technical guidance and mentoring, while remaining closely connected to implementation and production operations.
  
  
Your impact
  
  

* Shape the architecture, engineering patterns and operational readiness of major Azure, AKS and automation initiatives used by multiple teams.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership for complex implementation and production challenges that span infrastructure, application, security and delivery domains.
* Raise engineering quality through reusable standards, deep technical reviews, mentoring and clear guidance that teams can apply independently.

What you will do
  
  

* Provide architecture and technical oversight for major Azure environments and platform initiatives supporting Kubernetes and web application deployment.
* Design, implement and maintain Azure platform capabilities such as AKS, Container Registry, Key Vault, managed identities, service principals, app registrations and appropriate PaaS services.
* Act as a principal hands-on engineer for complex implementation, configuration, automation, lifecycle and operational work across Azure cloud services.
* Define and evolve Kubernetes and AKS patterns for cluster deployment, workload configuration, maintenance, scaling, resilience, recovery and operational readiness.
* Establish reusable Terraform patterns and modules that create secure, repeatable and supportable cloud environments.
* Shape CI/CD, GitOps and release-management patterns using Azure DevOps and related automation, including testing, evidence, approval and rollback controls.
* Set technical standards for container images, runtime configuration, platform lifecycle and application-hosting integration across multiple teams.
* Lead design discussions with cloud, application, security, networking and infrastructure teams and turn competing concerns into clear technical direction.
* Resolve complex issues spanning cloud resources, Kubernetes, networking, DNS, identity, secrets, pipelines, storage and application deployment.
* Evaluate Azure PaaS and platform-service options and recommend choices that improve scalability, reliability, maintainability and operational efficiency.
* Define observability, alerting, operational reporting, runbook and production-readiness expectations for major platform capabilities.
* Ensure consequential production changes are tested, documented and aligned with security, compliance, change and recovery requirements.
* Anticipate technical risk, remove complex implementation blockers and escalate unresolved business or enterprise-architecture decisions in time to protect delivery and stability.
* Mentor engineers and raise the engineering bar through architecture guidance, deep reviews, troubleshooting leadership and durable documentation.

What you will bring
  
  

* Broad, progressive experience in platform engineering, cloud operations, infrastructure, DevOps, systems engineering or a related field, gained through employment or equivalent practical work.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services and public-cloud operating models.
* Strong AKS and Kubernetes depth across architecture, deployment, workload operation, maintenance, scaling, resilience and troubleshooting.
* Advanced container-platform knowledge, including image management, runtime configuration, lifecycle activity and production support.
* Strong Terraform and infrastructure-as-code capability, including reusable patterns, secure lifecycle management and governance through code.
* Experience designing and improving CI/CD practices in Azure DevOps or comparable platforms, including automated deployment and release orchestration.
* Hands-on knowledge of cloud identity and secrets patterns, container registries and relevant Azure platform services.
* Strong fundamentals across networking, DNS, directory and identity services, compute, storage, firewalls and load balancing.
* Advanced cross-domain troubleshooting skills and the ability to remain effective during high-impact production or delivery problems.
* Ability to produce clear standards, runbooks, diagrams and implementation guidance and to communicate architecture, status, risk and recommendations to varied audiences.
* A demonstrated ability to work independently, lead complex technical initiatives, mentor engineers and influence direction across teams.

Nice to have
  
  

* Typically 8-12 years of relevant experience in platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, DevOps or systems engineering.
* Experience supporting customer-facing SaaS, hosted or other business-critical production applications.
* Depth in monitoring, metrics, observability, alerting and operational-health reporting for cloud platforms.
* Experience with cloud security, governance, policy, cost management, reliability engineering or disaster recovery.
* Experience coordinating technical work and influencing decisions across organisational boundaries.

How you will work and lead
  
  

* Provide technical direction and architecture guidance across multiple teams and lead the most difficult implementation and operational decisions.
* Mentor senior and developing engineers, create reusable guidance and strengthen design and troubleshooting practices across the group.
* Influence application, security and infrastructure partners through evidence, technical credibility and clear communication.
* Set design decisions, technical patterns and implementation guardrails for major platform initiatives within agreed enterprise direction.
* Exercise independent judgement across several technical domains and approve justified implementation exceptions within the initiative or platform area.
* Make recommendations that materially influence team roadmaps, production readiness and technical investment, supported by evidence and explicit trade-offs.
* Bring organisation-wide architecture, major programme priorities and enterprise-risk decisions to the appropriate governance and leadership forums.

What success looks like
  
  

* Major platform initiatives are technically coherent, secure, operable and ready for production use.
* Azure and AKS patterns are reusable across teams and produce more consistent delivery, reliability and support outcomes.
* Complex cross-domain problems are resolved with durable fixes and clearer ownership or standards.
* Technical risk is identified early enough to change a design or delivery approach before customer impact.
* Engineers and partner teams make better decisions because architecture guidance and platform documentation are clear and credible.
* The role remains visibly hands-on while its influence extends beyond any single service or team.

*At our core, Trintechers stand committed to fostering a culture rooted in our core values – Humble, Empowered, Reliable, and Open. Together, these values guide our actions, define our identity, and inspire us to continuously strive for excellence in everything we do.*
*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or disability.*
