We are looking for a Principal Architect for our Core Platform who combines deep technical architecture skill with a strong grasp of LeadSquared’s technology, product, and business landscape. This is a senior individual-contributor role reporting directly to the CTO built around technical ownership and influence .
  
  
You will own the target-state architecture of the core platform: defining where it needs to go to support the future direction of our products and business, and charting a credible, phased path to get there. Just as importantly, you will be a magnet and mentor for our most talented senior engineers raising the technical bar across the organisation and giving high-potential IC talent a compelling reason to grow and stay at LeadSquared.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Platform & Technical Strategy
  
  

* Build and maintain a deep working understanding of LeadSquared’s technology stack, product portfolio, and the business/customer landscape across BFSI, Education, Healthcare, and Marketplaces.
* Define and drive the target-state architecture for the core platform covering scalability, multi-tenancy, extensibility, performance, security, Infra Cost and data architecture.
* Translate the future direction of product and business including emerging AI-native and agentic capabilities into a coherent, sequenced architecture roadmap.
* Establish architectural principles, standards, and guardrails across services, APIs, data, and integration layers, and ensure they are consistently applied.
* Evaluate new technologies, platforms, and patterns (cloud-native, data, AI/agentic where relevant) that keep the platform future-ready and competitively differentiated.
* Make and own architectural trade-off calls that balance paying down technical debt against the pace of new capability delivery.

Cross-Functional & Business Alignment
  
  

* Partner closely with the CTO, Engineering and Product leadership, and business stakeholders to keep platform architecture aligned with product strategy and market direction.
* Represent core platform architecture in leadership forums, bringing a technical lens to business and product decisions.
* Assess build-vs-buy, platform consolidation, and modernisation choices through a business-outcomes lens, not just a technical one.
* Engage with customers and internal stakeholders as needed to validate that architectural direction holds up against real-world use cases.

Talent Development & Mentorship
  
  

* Inspire and mentor senior engineers, tech leads, and architects across the organisation raising the overall quality of technical thinking and decision-making.
* Build structured mechanisms for coaching and knowledge-sharing d esign reviews, architecture forums/guilds, RFC and ADR processes that scale good architectural practice beyond any one team.
* Act as a magnet for senior IC talent: create a visible, credible technical growth path that improves engagement and retention of high-potential engineers.
* Champion engineering best practices design reviews, architecture decision records, documentation, and code quality as habits, not one-off exercises.

Hands-On Technical Leadership
  
  

* Stay hands-on: prototype, review designs and code, and work directly alongside teams on the platform’s hardest problems.
* Lead resolution of the most complex, cross-cutting architectural challenges such as scale, reliability, data consistency, and security.
* Set up lightweight governance (architecture review forums, a technology radar) that keeps the platform coherent as teams and services multiply.

**Required Skills & Experience**
Technical Background
  
  

* 14–20 years of overall software engineering experience, with a significant and recent track record in architecture and technical leadership roles on large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms.
* Proven experience owning target-state or reference architecture for a platform of meaningful scale and complexity.
* Strong, credible hands-on background across modern technology stacks (e.g., Java/.NET, cloud-native services, microservices, distributed systems) deep enough to earn the respect of senior engineers.
* Solid understanding of database technologies (SQL & NoSQL) and system design trade-offs at scale.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cloud-native architecture practices.
* Familiarity with AI/ML and agentic architecture patterns (e.g., RAG, LLM orchestration, vector search) is a strong plus, given LeadSquared’s growing AI-native roadmap.

Leadership & Influence
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to mentor and elevate senior engineers and architects without formal reporting authority — leading through influence and credibility.
* Excellent communication skills; able to explain architectural rationale clearly to the CTO, business leaders, and, where needed, customers.
* Strong stakeholder management, able to balance the sometimes-competing needs of product, business, and engineering.
* Genuine interest in coaching and teaching, with a track record of building technical culture that improves the quality and retention of senior talent.

Why LeadSquared?
  
  

* Shape the target-state architecture of a global SaaS platform used by thousands of enterprises.
* A high-ownership, high-visibility role reporting directly to the CTO, with the freedom to set technical direction.
* The opportunity to build a lasting technical legacy both in the platform’s architecture and in the engineers you mentor.
* Competitive compensation and the chance to work at the intersection of core platform, product, and emerging AI capabilities.

title: Chief Architect - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

  
About JumpCloud®
  

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

  
  
**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

**About the Role**
  

We are seeking a visionary, disruptive, and highly agile
**Chief Architect**
to define and drive the next generation of our platform’s architecture. Reporting directly to the Head of Engineering, you will be our primary AI evangelist, challenging the status quo and seamlessly embedding evolving AI capabilities into our core systems.

  

Operating in the dynamic Identity, Access Management, and Device Management space you will architect high-scale solutions, conduct deep competitive analysis, and provide strategic technical guidance to leadership. As a deeply experienced technologist and a natural mentor, you will inspire our engineering teams, ensuring we remain nimble, innovative, and ahead of the curve in a rapidly changing technological landscape.

**Key Responsibilities:**
  

  
* **Architectural Disruption & Design:**
  Continuously evaluate our existing platform architecture and suggest/implement transformative design changes to leverage the latest advancements in AI.
  
* **AI Evangelism & Strategy:**
  Act as the internal and external champion for AI. Challenge legacy mindsets, drive a culture of disruptive innovation, and articulate a clear AI vision that aligns with our business goals in the Identity space.
  
* **Technical Leadership & Guidance:**
  Serve as the trusted advisor and strategic partner to the Head of Engineering and executive leadership, translating complex AI developments into actionable product and engineering strategies.
  
* **Scale & Performance:**
  Architect robust, scalable, and secure AI-driven systems capable of handling massive data volumes and high-traffic identity workflows globally.
  
* **Mentorship & Team Building:**
  Be a force multiplier for our technical teams. Provide hands-on mentorship, foster a culture of continuous learning, and elevate the technical capabilities of individual contributors and engineering managers.
  
* **Competitive Analysis & Market Positioning:**
  Keep a pulse on the rapidly evolving AI and Identity/Directory-as-a-Service markets. Conduct deep technical competitive analyses to ensure our architecture and AI features outpace industry rivals.
  
* **Agile Adaptation:**
  Maintain a nimble approach to architecture. Pivot and adapt technical strategies quickly as new AI models, frameworks, and security requirements emerge.
  
  

  
**Required Qualifications:**
  

  
* **Deep AI Expertise:**
  15+ years of software engineering/architecture experience with at least 4+ years dedicated to deep AI integrations.
  
* **Domain Expertise in Identity Space:**
  Proven experience in the Identity and Access Management (IAM), Directory-as-a-Service (DaaS), Zero Trust, or endpoint management domains (comparable to JumpCloud, Okta, Ping Identity, etc.).
  
* **Massive Scale Experience:**
  A strong track record of designing, building, and maintaining distributed cloud architectures and data pipelines that operate reliably at massive scale.
  
* **Disruptive & Nimble Mindset:**
  Demonstrated ability to be an "agent of change." You are highly adaptable, agile, and comfortable pivoting architectures to adopt cutting-edge technologies.
  
* **Exceptional Mentorship & Leadership:**
  Proven experience elevating the teams around you. You are known as a technical leader who leads by influence, coaches individual engineers, and upskills entire organizations.
  
* **Executive Communication:**
  The ability to distill highly complex technical concepts into clear, strategic guidance for the Head of Engineering and C-suite leadership.
  
* **Analytical Prowess:**
  Strong capability to dissect competitors' products, anticipate industry trends, and translate those insights into architectural advantages.
  
  

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**
  

  
* **Public Thought Leadership:**
  Experience speaking at industry conferences, publishing technical papers, or maintaining a strong presence as an AI/Tech evangelist in the open-source community.
  
* **Security & Privacy Background:**
  Deep understanding of data privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA), AI ethics, and data security—critical for integrating AI into identity systems.
  
* **Hands-on Coding Proficiency:**
  While this is an architectural role, the ability to jump into the code (Python, Go, Rust, or similar) to build rapid proof-of-concepts (PoCs) is highly desirable.
  
* **Cloud Native Mastery:**
  Advanced certifications or deep expertise in AWS, GCP, or Azure AI ecosystems and cloud-native orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker).
  
* **Experience in High-Growth Startups:**
  A background of successfully navigating the ambiguity and rapid growth phases of a hyper-growth tech company.

  



**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

  

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.**

  
  

Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

  
  

**Language:**

  

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

  
  

**Why JumpCloud?**

 

  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  

 

  

One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  

 

  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

  

 

  

JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

  
  

**Scam Notice:**

  

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

  
  

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" 

  

 

  

#BI-Remote

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: Consulting Architect - Platform
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
You are the person a customer calls when their Elasticsearch platform is the problem, or when they need one designed properly the first time.
  
  
That means you decide the shape of a cluster and then defend that decision — node topology, shard strategy, data tiers, lifecycle and retention — with the sizing arithmetic to back it up. It also means you can follow a performance problem beyond Elastic itself. We need someone whose instinct is to look down the stack and sideways to whatever else shares the infrastructure, rather than stopping at the cluster API.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Design and build Elasticsearch platforms for customers across self-managed, orchestrated and managed deployments, including air-gapped and regulated environments
* Own sizing and capacity planning as a derivation from workload characteristics — ingest rate, document shape, retention, query concurrency, growth — validated by benchmark rather than estimated from a form
* Run health checks and remediation on production estates, and redesign sharding, mapping and index strategies where the original design no longer holds
* Lead major-version upgrades, snapshot and disaster recovery strategy, and multi-cluster architectures
* Diagnose performance problems across the full stack — Elastic, the JVM, the operating system, storage and network — and across adjacent systems in the data path
* Work directly with customer architects, platform owners and engineering leadership; run discovery, present designs, and own the technical outcome of an engagement end to end
* Build reusable tooling, automation and IP that makes the next engagement faster, including AI-assisted tooling for diagnosis, configuration and reporting
* Mentor other consultants and contribute to the GCC's technical practice

**What You Bring:**
**Elastic depth — non-negotiable**
We
**are not looking**
for someone who will learn Elastic on the job.
  
  

* 8+ years hands-on with the Elastic Stack, substantially on cluster and platform work rather than dashboarding or pipeline authoring
* Shard strategy you can derive, not recite — how you arrived at a shard count and size for a given workload, what you traded off, and what you got wrong the first time
* Index and mapping design, and why those choices drive cluster performance
* Lifecycle and retention across data tiers, including the cost and latency implications of each
* Snapshot, restore and disaster recovery designed and executed, not just configured
* Major-version upgrades in production — the sequencing, the breaking changes, the rollback position
* More than one deployment model: self-managed plus at least one managed or orchestrated option
* Cluster stability and performance troubleshooting — heap and garbage collection, circuit breakers, thread pool rejections, shard allocation, expensive queries
* Elastic Certified Engineer, or the demonstrable knowledge to obtain it within your first quarter
* Strong Linux and operating system fundamentals, with solid grounding in storage and networking
* A working understanding of how infrastructure conditions translate into Elastic symptoms, and how infrastructure choices constrain what a deployment can do
* Experience troubleshooting on shared infrastructure, where the cause of your problem is another workload's behaviour and resolving it means engaging the team that owns it

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
* Embracing parenthood with a minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave

Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law, ordinance or regulation.

title: AI Solutions Architect
description:
**About The Job**
As a specialist in electronics and software for the past 20 years, in-tech is a dynamic, fast-growing engineering company headquartered in Munich, Germany, employing around 2,350 employees globally across 20 project locations in 8 countries. in-tech develops innovative engineering solutions for the automotive, rail, aerospace, defence, and industrial sectors.
  
  
We are committed to a flexible, modern work culture and work-life balance. Our colour orange stands for liveliness, warmth, and dynamism. We value a strong team spirit, fresh ideas, and a positive work culture. We call it the “Orange Spirit”!
  
  
Since 2024, in-tech has been a subsidiary of Infosys Ltd. This strategic partnership enables us to offer our customers even more comprehensive development and digitalisation services, along with greater offshore capability.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced
**AI-Enabled Solutions Architect / AI Architect**
to join our team. In this role, you will lead the architecture, design, and delivery of scalable software products, cloud platforms, enterprise AI systems, and AI-enabled modernization programs. You will work with enterprise customers and internal stakeholders to identify business transformation opportunities and translate them into secure, scalable, and value-driven solutions using Generative AI, Agentic AI, Predictive AI, and intelligent automation. If you are passionate about enterprise architecture, emerging AI technologies, cloud-native engineering, and creating measurable business impact in a growing organization with a positive culture and strong team spirit, we would love to connect with you!
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Architect and lead the design of software products, SaaS platforms, cloud-native solutions, distributed systems, and enterprise AI ecosystems.
  
  
Identify business transformation opportunities using Generative AI, Agentic AI, Predictive AI, and intelligent automation, and translate them into scalable solution architectures.
  
  
Design and develop end-to-end AI and GenAI solutions using LLMs, RAG, Agentic RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and enterprise knowledge management platforms.
  
  
Architect AI agents, multi-agent systems, agent workflows, and orchestration solutions using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar technologies.
  
  
Define and implement enterprise AI orchestration patterns, including MCP, A2A communication, agent supervision, human-in-the-loop controls, and governance mechanisms.
  
  
Design modern application architectures using Java, Python, APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
  
  
Lead the architecture and technical execution of AI-enabled modernization programs, including legacy application assessment, code transformation, refactoring, migration, and platform modernization.
  
  
Apply AI across the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, development, testing, DevSecOps, operations, monitoring, and support.
  
  
Architect and implement cloud-based AI and software platforms on AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, Databricks, and Kubernetes-based environments.
  
  
Define platform engineering, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, containerization, observability, and operational readiness practices.
  
  
Integrate AI solutions with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and custom business applications.
  
  
Establish responsible and secure AI architectures covering privacy, security, compliance, risk management, model governance, data protection, and enterprise AI guardrails.
  
  
Define AI business cases, value realization frameworks, KPIs, adoption strategies, and ROI models for enterprise AI initiatives.
  
  
Lead AI initiatives from opportunity assessment and proof of concept through production deployment, scaling, adoption, and business value realization.
  
  
Develop reusable AI accelerators, reference architectures, frameworks, engineering standards, and best practices.
  
  
Collaborate with enterprise architects, product managers, engineering teams, security teams, data specialists, and C-level stakeholders to define AI roadmaps and solution strategies.
  
  
Facilitate architecture workshops, design-thinking sessions, technical assessments, executive discussions, and customer presentations.
  
  
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, frameworks, and agentic tools, and assess their suitability for enterprise adoption.
  
  
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to architects, developers, data scientists, and engineering teams.
  
  
Drive measurable improvements in productivity, software quality, customer experience, operational efficiency, and business performance through AI-enabled solutions.
  
  
**Requirements**
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Informatics, or a comparable technical field.
  
  
10+ years of experience in software architecture, product architecture, enterprise architecture, cloud architecture, or technology consulting.
  
  
Proven experience architecting and delivering software products, SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, distributed systems, and cloud-native solutions.
  
  
Strong hands-on expertise in Java, Python, modern full-stack technologies, APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and enterprise integration patterns.
  
  
Proven experience designing and implementing Generative AI, LLM, RAG, Agentic RAG, or intelligent automation solutions for enterprise environments.
  
  
Strong knowledge of LLM concepts, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, model selection, fine-tuning approaches, evaluation methods, and enterprise knowledge management.
  
  
Hands-on experience designing AI agents, multi-agent systems, and orchestration workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar frameworks.
  
  
Strong understanding of MCP, A2A, agent governance, human-in-the-loop workflows, agent supervision, AI orchestration, and enterprise AI operating models.
  
  
Experience applying AI across the SDLC, including requirements engineering, code generation, architecture analysis, testing, DevSecOps, operations, and application support.
  
  
Proven experience leading legacy modernization initiatives, including application assessment, code transformation, refactoring, re-platforming, migration, and modernization strategy.
  
  
Strong expertise in one or more major cloud platforms, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  
  
Experience with Databricks, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, DevSecOps, Infrastructure-as-Code, platform engineering, observability, and cloud security.
  
  
Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model deployment, model monitoring, AI evaluation, and production operationalization of AI systems.
  
  
Practical experience integrating AI and software solutions with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, or custom business applications.
  
  
Strong understanding of Responsible AI, AI security, data privacy, compliance, risk management, model governance, and enterprise AI guardrails.
  
  
Experience defining AI business cases, KPIs, ROI models, value realization frameworks, and enterprise adoption strategies.
  
  
Proven ability to take AI initiatives from opportunity assessment and PoC through production deployment, scaling, and measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Experience creating reusable AI accelerators, reference architectures, frameworks, technical standards, and engineering best practices.
  
  
Strong consulting, stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  
  
Familiarity with architecture frameworks and agile delivery methods such as Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar approaches.
  
  
Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and presentation skills.
  
  
**Apply with us**
If you have experience and team spirit and are looking for a great place to work, then start your job with us.
  
  
As part of our dedication to the diversity of our workforce, in-tech is committed to equal employment opportunity without regard for age, race, colour, national origin, ethnicity, gender, protected veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or religion
  
  
We develop technologies that make the future possible: As an engineering and digitalization partner, we support our customers in developing intelligent, connected, and software-based systems. Through engineering excellence, innovative technologies, and global collaboration, we create sustainable value and accelerate innovation. At the same time, we foster an environment where people take pride in helping to shape the technologies of tomorrow.

title: Operations Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Operations Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Support the operations and/or manage delivery for production systems and services based on operational requirements and service agreement.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
AWS Administration
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
A Principal Engineer — Cloud leads the hands-on design, build, and operation of large-scale cloud infrastructure across AWS and GCP. The role is accountable for engineering secure, resilient, and cost-optimized cloud platforms — building real infrastructure, writing real code, and owning outcomes end to end alongside product, security, and application engineering teams.
  
  
This individual operates as a recognized cloud engineering authority — setting platform standards, driving infrastructure automation, and solving complex distributed cloud Infrastructure challenges including having good understanding of the insurance industry. In a financial services context, engineering decisions must satisfy stringent regulatory requirements including PCI DSS, SOX, and DORA, alongside enterprise-grade reliability and availability commitments.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
Cloud Platform Engineering
  
  
– Design, build, and operate large-scale, cloud-native infrastructure across AWS and GCP — owning platform reliability, security posture, and cost efficiency
  
  
– Implement and maintain infrastructure-as-code across both cloud platforms using Terraform and native tooling — enforcing standards, modularity, and drift detection
  
  
– Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, GitOps workflows, and deployment automation for cloud infrastructure and platform services
  
  
– Engineer landing zones, account vending, and governance guardrails on AWS (Control Tower, SCPs) and GCP (Resource Manager, Org Policies)
  
  
AI Orchestration: High Level understanding of LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI — agentic workflow design, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, human-in-the-loop workflows
  
  
– Design and implement cloud networking — AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect and GCP VPC, Shared VPC, Cloud Interconnect — for hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity
  
  
– Implement security controls across IAM, network policy, encryption, secrets management, and audit logging on both platforms
  
  
– Drive platform observability — metrics, logging, distributed tracing, and alerting using CloudWatch, GCP Operations Suite, and third-party tooling
  
  
– Perform capacity planning, cost analysis, and right-sizing to maintain efficient cloud spend across AWS and GCP estates
  
  
LLM & AI Tooling: High Level Understanding of OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini — prompt engineering, RAG architecture, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB), LLMOps
  
  
Application & Container Platform Engineering
  
  
– Engineer and operate Kubernetes-based container platforms — EKS on AWS and GKE on GCP — including cluster lifecycle, node management, networking, and security hardening
  
  
– Define and enforce standards for microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, and data platform integrations across cloud environments
  
  
– Collaborate with application engineering teams on cloud-native design patterns — serverless, service mesh, and distributed data stores – Build and maintain developer platform tooling — internal developer portals, self-service infrastructure, and platform APIs — to accelerate engineering delivery
  
  
– Drive observability and reliability engineering practices — SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, and chaos engineering — across cloud-hosted services
  
  
– Support secure software delivery — SAST, DAST, container image scanning, and supply chain security in CI/CD pipelines
  
  
Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence
  
  
– Set cloud engineering standards, patterns, and reference architectures — codified in reusable Terraform modules, runbooks, and design guides
  
  
– Lead proof-of-concept and spike work for emerging cloud technologies — making build-vs-buy recommendations grounded in engineering evidence
  
  
– Conduct technical design reviews and production readiness assessments for cloud-hosted services
  
  
– Mentor senior and mid-level engineers — providing hands-on guidance on IaC, cloud-native patterns, and production operations
  
  
– Drive continuous improvement of the cloud platform — reducing toil through automation, improving reliability, and eliminating technical debt
  
  
– Contribute engineering patterns and reusable modules back to internal platform teams and cloud centre of excellence
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  
Must-Have Technical Skills
  
  
Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (advanced) — modular design, remote state, workspace strategy, and policy-as-code (Sentinel/OPA) across AWS and GCP
  
  
Containers & Kubernetes: EKS and GKE — cluster lifecycle, CNI, RBAC, admission controllers, network policies, and production-grade operations

title: Senior Principal - Platform Architect Segmentation
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Platform Architect owns the technical design of GSK's network segmentation and security platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations.
  
  
The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Platform architecture in the relevant domain, covering reference architecture, patterns, standards and design assurance.
* Security and resilience by design, including AI reference patterns and GxP considerations where applicable.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 yearsTypically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace.
* Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard.
* Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context.
* Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet.
* Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations.
* Extensive experience designing enterprise network security and segmentation services.
* Deep knowledge of identity based access, firewalls, microsegmentation and secure zones across information and operational technology.
* Evidence of defining segmentation architectures that improved control coverage, risk reduction or secure access.

**Skills/Background**

* Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented.
* Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard.
* Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them.
* Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome.
* Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright.
* Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform.

description:

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled AI Engineer to join our team and drive innovation in the fast-evolving landscape of Generative AI. The ideal candidate will have deep hands-on expertise in RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and working familiarity with Frontier Models (e.g., GPT-4, Claude, LLaMA, etc.). Lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of enterprise data platforms and AI/LLM-powered products from conceptualization to production.
  
  
Drive product discovery and requirements with business stakeholders, translating workflows and pain points into scalable data and AI solutions.
  
  
Ensure all data and AI products strictly adhere to US Healthcare standards and regulations (HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC2, PHI/PII handling).
  
  

* AI Engineering & Solution Architecture

Architect and oversee the implementation of Generative AI applications, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, and autonomous agentic workflows.
  
  
Design robust orchestration systems using modern frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph.
  
  
Evaluate and integrate state-of-the-art foundation models (including Anthropic Claude, Azure OpenAI models, and open-source alternatives).
  
  
Implement robust AI Guardrails (content safety, hallucination detection, prompt injection defense) to guarantee compliance, safety, and deterministic behavior in clinical or operational workflows.
  
  

* Data Platform & Infrastructure

Lead data architecture efforts leveraging Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) and the Microsoft Azure tech stack.
  
  
Oversee scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, and data integrations involving healthcare data standards (FHIR, HL7, EHR data).
  
  
Collaborate with data engineering teams to optimize lakehouse performance, query speed, and storage efficiency.
  
  

* Data & AI Governance, Security, and AIOps

Establish enterprise-wide Data & AI Governance practices, including data lineage, cataloging, access controls, and model explainability.
  
  
Build and scale AIOps & MLOps operational frameworks to ensure continuous monitoring, prompt logging, drift detection, model evaluation, and cost optimization.
  
  
Work closely with Information Security and Regulatory teams to ensure compliance across all data pipelines and AI deployments.
  
  
**AI & LLM Engineering**
Demonstrated hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph).
  
  
Direct experience working with advanced foundation models (e.g., Anthropic Claude, GPT-4) via APIs or cloud deployments.
  
  
Deep understanding of guardrailing tools and techniques (NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, Llama Guard, Guardrails AI, or custom validation pipelines).
  
  
AIOps & MLOps: Proven track record in operationalizing AI systems—including monitoring, evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, TruLens), observability, and prompt versioning.
  
  
Leadership & Communication: Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to articulate complex technical and AI concepts to non-technical business leaders.
  
  
**Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills**
Experience with healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7).
  
  
Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Azure AI Search, Databricks Vector Search).
  
  
Certifications: Azure Solutions Architect, Databricks Certified Data Engineer / Machine Learning Professional, or Scrum Product Owner.

title: Lead Solutions Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**The Team:**
Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers’ data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.
  
  
**The Role:**
In this role you will work across diverse enterprise source systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and cloud databases, with a strong focus on the Oracle technology ecosystem. You will drive data extraction from Oracle environments (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Database and Autonomous Database) and build integrations with Oracle’s AI and automation infrastructure.
  
  
You will own complex, highly customized integration projects end to end, anticipate blockers before they surface, and shape the best long-term solution together with the customer and Celonis internal teams. You are a trusted technical advisor to customer IT, data, and security leaders, and a go-to partner for colleagues across Services, Product & Engineering, and Go-to-Market.
  
  
Beyond day-to-day delivery, you invest part of your time in growing the SA practice: building reusable assets, and driving small initiatives that advance team strategy, including our Oracle integration playbooks.
  
  
**The work you’ll do:**
**Lead complex data integration and ingestion**

* Own Oracle data extraction. Architect and deliver ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, and Oracle Database / Autonomous Database, including JDBC and PL/SQL-based approaches, while understanding the underlying business processes in these systems.
* Build real-time and CDC integrations. Design change data capture and event-driven architectures using Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, and REST/SOAP APIs, and use them to power Celonis Action Flows.
* Deliver Oracle ERP and other enterprise connections. Lead Oracle ERP connections or cloud based equivalents (e.g. via Oracle BICC). Deliver customized JDBC setups, including Dockerized and real-time configurations.
* Build and own custom API connectors. Design advanced connectors, including complex authentication, pagination, and delta loads, and advise on API design topics such as synchronous versus asynchronous APIs and OData.
* Architect push-based and lakehouse pipelines. Lead Python-based pipelines with Celonis data ingestion API with data engineering and SDLC best practices, and design Landing Zone and lakehouse solutions (for example Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric), including zero copy solutions.
* Solve hard infrastructure problems. Work with customer IT on DMZs, network bridges, WAFs, proxies, certificates, on-premise agent deployments, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) networking.
* Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, optimize database and pipeline performance (for example on Oracle DB and Exadata), and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

**Actions, automation, and AI connectivity**

* Deliver advanced writebacks and automation. Configure Action Flows with customized agent settings and direct API-based integrations, including writebacks into Oracle systems, and advise on bot integrations, permissioning, and security.
* Connect Celonis to enterprise AI. Design AI integration patterns that connect Celonis Orchestration and Action Flows with OCI Generative AI Agents, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), or Oracle Digital Assistant, and guide customers in connecting Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP, covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

**Identity, security, and governance**

* Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as OCI IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.
* Lead security conversations. Coordinate with the Celonis security team on customer questionnaires, answer questions confidently on live calls, and explain architecture and data flows to customer security and compliance stakeholders.

**Customer and team impact**

* Act as a trusted advisor. Recommend solutions that set the customer up for long-term success, knowing when to build the ideal setup and when to compromise, drawing on best practices in data management, ETL, streaming, and project management.
* Be a recognized expert. Build deep expertise in Oracle integrations and other product areas, give structured feedback to Product & Engineering on Oracle connectors and AI agent capabilities, and become a source of trust for product managers and engineers.
* Advance team strategy. Set up and run initiatives such as knowledge bases and best-practice libraries (for example Oracle integration templates): define goals and success criteria, document the plan, and hold yourself and others accountable.

**The qualifications you need:**

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, technical consulting, or solutions architecture in a customer-facing role, including leading customer implementations.
* Oracle data engineering experience: hands-on experience extracting data from and understanding business processes in Oracle systems (Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, Oracle Database / Autonomous Database), with PL/SQL and Oracle SQL skills.
* Oracle Cloud: experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and its integration and data services such as Oracle Integration Cloud, alongside familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
* Python and SQL skills, and ETL pipeline creation for large volumes of enterprise data, including migration scripting and custom transformations.
* Hands-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, and API design concepts (synchronous and asynchronous APIs, OData).
* Network and security fluency at the level needed to engage customer enterprise IT (DMZ, WAF, proxies, certificates, VPNs), plus comfort with Linux environments.
* Excellent communication and storytelling across written, verbal, and slide formats, tailored to technical and executive audiences, and fluency in English.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Oracle Exadata, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), Oracle Digital Assistant, or Oracle Analytics.
* Familiarity with SAP (ECC/S/4HANA, PI/PO, SNC, RISE, CPI, BTP) or other enterprise ERPs.
* Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and with iPaaS or low-code tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Power Automate).
* Experience with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.
* Docker and Linux server administration experience.
* Relevant certifications (Celonis, Oracle/OCI, cloud, or SAP).

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
  
  
**Your Privacy:**
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
  
  
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
  
  
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
  
  
Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

title: Principal Software Development Engineer
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Exposure Management & Security Operations department. In this role, you will architect, build, and scale critical security operations and exposure management infrastructure. You will drive end-to-end technical execution, mentor engineering talent, and lead the delivery of high-performance microservices and cloud-native solutions.
  
  
**What You’ll Do (Role Expectations)**

* Designing and developing high-quality, scalable, and secure software systems, including microservices and REST/gRPC APIs
* Leading the design and implementation of distributed systems using Messaging, Search stores, and cloud storage solutions
* Collaborating with front-end engineers to deliver APIs that enable user-focused, high-performance interfaces
* Mentoring junior engineers and fostering team growth through knowledge sharing and guidance
* Monitoring system health, troubleshooting issues, and optimizing services with a DevOps mindset

**Who You Are (Success Profile)**

* You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
* You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
* You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
* You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
* You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

**What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualifications)**

* Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
* 13+ years of hands-on software application development experience with distributed systems and cloud storage solutions
* Proficiency with Java, Spring frameworks (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Security), and containerization with Docker or Kubernetes
* Deep understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP and experience with observability tools like DataDog, Grafana, or Prometheus
* Expertise across the full Software Development Life Cycle, including version control with Git, design, deployment, and system optimization

**What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)**

* Experience integrating AI/ML model inference, AI security controls, or automated threat intelligence into high-throughput microservices
* Expertise in designing for SLAs, high availability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization
* Background in test-driven development (TDD), Agile workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and relational or NoSQL databases

At Zscaler, we are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and the customers we work with. We foster an inclusive environment that values all backgrounds and perspectives, emphasizing collaboration and belonging. Join us in our mission to make doing business seamless and secure.

description:
**Job Description: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer**

***Position Overview***

We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with at least 7 years of experience in full-stack software development, web crawling, network protocol analysis, and enterprise data telemetry. In this role, you will bridge the gap between application architecture, web scraper engineering, network traffic analysis, and data analytics.

Using Node.js as your primary backend environment, you will design automated crawling engines, analyze client-side rendering mechanics, monitor live application traffic in New Relic, and join web-level findings with data warehouse records to produce high-impact analytical reports.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Full-Stack Engineering & Web Crawling

Full-Stack Development: Architect, develop, and maintain robust services and analytics applications using Node.js (TypeScript/JavaScript) on the backend along with modern frontend frameworks.

Scalable Web Crawling: Design and scale high-throughput crawling suites using Node.js automation libraries (Playwright, Puppeteer) to inspect complex DOM structures, handle dynamic client-side rendering, and extract structured metadata.

DOM & Rendering Analysis: Evaluate the browser rendering lifecycle—including HTML/CSS parsing, JavaScript execution, DOM tree construction, layout, and visual paint—to detect client-side performance bottlenecks or script execution failures.

**2. HTTP Protocol & Network Traffic Analysis**

Network & Payload Inspection: Perform deep-dive analysis on inbound and outbound HTTP/HTTPS traffic, inspecting request/response headers, status codes, cookies, session tokens, payloads, and API endpoints.

APM & Traffic Patterns: Monitor real-time traffic volumes, request distribution, latency metrics, and error rates using New Relic (or equivalent APM systems) to detect operational anomalies and traffic spikes.

Full-Trace Mapping: Correlate client-side event triggers and tracking calls with server logs, microservice calls, and backend API responses.

**3. Data Warehouse Integration & Reporting**

Data Warehouse Querying: Write complex, optimized SQL queries and manage data pipelines to extract and aggregate large-scale records from platforms like Snowflake, BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift.

**Data Synthesis:** Merge web crawling datasets, HTTP payload logs, and APM telemetry with warehouse transaction history to perform root-cause analysis and pattern identification.

Technical Reporting: Build and deliver comprehensive technical reports, automated executive dashboards, and actionable recommendations for product, platform, and data teams.

**Required Qualifications**

Professional Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack software engineering, with a strong focus on backend systems, web scraping, and data-driven web analytics.

Node.js Expertise: 7+ years of deep technical proficiency in Node.js (TypeScript/JavaScript), microservices architecture, and asynchronous runtime performance tuning.

Frontend Mechanics: Master-level understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript runtime engines, browser rendering paths, DOM structures, and DevTools.

Browser Automation: Demonstrated track record building resilient, production-grade scrapers using Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium within a Node.js ecosystem.

Networking & Protocols: Expert knowledge of network protocols (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTPS), RESTful APIs, GraphQL, CORS, cookies, and HTTP request/response lifecycle mechanics.

Telemetry & APM: Hands-on expertise with New Relic or similar enterprise monitoring suites to analyze system performance, network payloads, and user traffic behavior.

**Preferred Qualifications**

5+ years in a senior or lead technical capacity guiding web architecture, data engineering pipelines, or scraping infrastructure.

Data Warehouse & SQL: Advanced SQL skills and extensive experience extracting, transforming, and loading data across cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

Familiarity with bypassing advanced anti-bot protections, IP rotation systems, and browser fingerprinting challenges.

Practical experience deploying serverless microservices (AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Workers) for distributed web crawling tasks.

title: Data Modelling Lead —[Procurement / Planning & Logistics /Manufacturing] Data
description:
Job Description:

**THE ROLE IN CONTEXT**

We are establishing a dedicated Data Modelling team inside GSC Data & Analytics to give our enterprise data a designed, governed structure — and to remove the single biggest constraint on our AI ambitions: data that is disconnected, inconsistently mastered and misaligned across systems.

This team is the connective tissue of the **Data Backbone**. In our strategy the Data Backbone is the **bridge** between today’s federated landscape and the clean, converged foundation that T.U.K (Titan · Unify · KunPeng) will deliver over the coming years. The bridge is what lets us run AI and autonomous planning *now* — by joining, organising and streamlining data across systems as they exist today, rather than waiting for convergence to finish.

That landscape is heterogeneous — SAP & Oracle ERPs, alongside best-of-breed platforms such as **Kinaxis** (planning) and **Manhattan** (logistics execution), procurement systems such as **Prism and Coupa**, and external data sources such as **Z2**. Bridging these — not just ERP-to-ERP — is the substance of the role.

The team is led by a Director, with three Data Modelling Leads owning distinct domain clusters. **This role is one of those three Leads, accountable for the [****Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing****] domain.**

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS (AND IS NOT)**

You own how **[****Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing****] data connects across systems**. You understand how data in one system relates to data in another — despite non-standard master data, coverage gaps and structural differences — and you design the models and mappings that make it connectable, trustworthy and reusable. That mapping is held as an **enterprise asset**.

**The boundary that defines this team:** This team designs and owns the map — the logical and canonical models, the source-to-target mappings and the definitions — while GSC Data Engineering builds the pipelines and physical structures from those designs. You stay deep in the modelling craft, hands-on with real source data, rather than spread thin across pipeline build.

**Where your work sits**

* **You own, hands-on:** conceptual and logical data models, canonical entity and KPI definitions, source-to-target mapping specifications, business-rule and quality-rule definitions, lineage and metadata documentation.
* **You hand off and stay close:** well-specified designs go to Data Engineering (including its Technical Data Architects) to build — and you review the build back against the model, staying involved in how it is realised.

These are designed as genuine partnerships, not tickets into a void: Data Engineering builds to your designs and reviews with you, and the GSC Data Office owns fixing the source-data issues you surface. Your ownership of the map carries real influence over what gets built and what gets cleaned.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Enterprise Mapping & Canonical Modelling (the core of the role)**

* Design conceptual and logical data models for the [**Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing**] domain that reflect how the business actually operates.
* Produce source-to-target mappings across ERPs, best-of-breed platforms (e.g. Kinaxis, Manhattan, procurement systems) and external data sources (e.g. Z2), explicitly accounting for non-standard master data, coverage gaps and structural inconsistencies.
* Define canonical entities, business rules & KPI definitions so the same concept means the same thing across squads.

**Own the [****Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing****] Map as an Enterprise Asset**

* Maintain the mapping and models as a governed, versioned, reusable asset — not a one-off deliverable.
* Keep documentation, lineage and decision rationale transparent and traceable, so the map is trusted and auditable.

**Delivering to Demand, Within Projects**

* Extend the enterprise map incrementally — object by object, area by area — predominantly in response to demand (AI use cases and business projects), rather than as a single big-bang build.
* Deliver your modelling within project constructs and squads to time-bound commitments, managing dependencies and priorities so modelling keeps pace with delivery.
* Balance this demand-driven delivery with the proactive, foundational modelling that no single project triggers — the work that stands up the backbone itself.

**Business Requirements, Backbone Coverage & Data Quality (with the GSC Data Office)**

* Translate [**Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing**] business requirements into the data needed to meet them — the essential link between what the business asks for and what the backbone must hold.
* Determine whether that data already exists in the Data Backbone; where it does not, partner with the GSC Data Office to determine the authoritative data source and set it up. *(The Data Office owns authoritative-source identification; this role connects it to the business need.)*
* Surface and diagnose join-level data-quality issues — where and why data fails to connect across systems — so the Data Office and domains can remediate the underlying transactional source issues.

**Design–Build Handoff with Data Engineering (clear RACI)**

* Translate your models into build-ready specifications and hand them to Data Engineering (including its Technical Data Architects), who build the physical structures and pipelines.
* Review engineered outputs against the design; own the “what and how-connected,” while Engineering owns the build.

**Cross-System & Cross-Domain Harmonisation**

* Own [**Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing**] deeply; harmonise definitions, business rules and master data at the seams with the other two domain Leads.
* Align your domain to the enterprise standards set with the Director, so the three domain maps compose into one coherent backbone.

**Stakeholder Alignment & Translation**

* Work with business SMEs, the GSC Data Office, Data Engineering (including Technical Data Architects) and the BI & AI teams to capture requirements, align definitions and validate models.
* Act as the translator between business meaning and canonical data structure — simplifying complex technical concepts for non-technical partners.

**Standards, Tooling & Thought Leadership**

* Set modelling standards, templates, metadata standards and lineage practices for the [**Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing**] domain.
* Lead disciplined use of enterprise modelling tools (Erwin, ER/Studio, PowerDesigner) as a working expert.

**Enable AI & Autonomous Planning**

* Ensure models make [**Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing**] data joinable and trustworthy enough for AI and autonomous-supply chain use cases — data a machine can act on.
* **As the backbone matures (forward-looking):** design enterprise semantic models that support analytics and AI/ML — a growth area for the role rather than a day-one focus.

(External) English Qualifications:

**Essential**

* **8–12+ years** of hands-on data modelling experience, operating as a senior working expert.
* **Cross-system / integration / canonical modelling** as your core strength — source-to-target mapping and bridging heterogeneous systems, not warehouse build alone.
* **Deep understanding of how source systems structure data across a heterogeneous landscape** — SAP ERPs plus best-of-breed and external systems (e.g. Kinaxis, Manhattan, procurement platforms, ERPs)
* **Master data / MDM literacy** — comfortable designing around non-standard master data and coverage limitations.
* **A partnering mindset on data quality and authoritative sources** — able to translate business needs into backbone coverage and diagnose why data won’t join, working alongside the GSC Data Office.
* Grounding in **relational, Kimball dimensional and Data Vault 2.0** modelling as foundations.
* Strong data governance instincts — metadata, lineage, definitions and standards.

**Advantageous**

* SQL fluency, and the ability to design for cloud data platforms (AWS, Databricks) and semantic layers — understanding and designing for these, rather than building them.
* Experience contributing to a data backbone, control tower or enterprise-integration programme.

**Ways of Working**

* Structured, detail-oriented, with a strong problem-solving mindset.
* A clear communicator who can simplify complex technical concepts for business and technical audiences alike.
* Proven ability to operate in a global, matrixed organisation and harmonise across domains.

**WHY JOIN**

* Build the connective tissue of the Data Backbone — the bridge that lets GSC run AI and autonomous planning now, ahead of full T.U.K convergence.
* Own an enterprise asset end to end: the map of how [**Procurement/Planning & Logistics/Manufacturing**] data connects across the supply chain.
* Shape enterprise-wide modelling standards from the ground up in a newly formed, strategically-backed team — turning disconnected data into a foundation that machines can reason on.

Local Benefits (English):

**Rewards designed for you**

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)

* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)

Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
