title: Principal Engineer – QA systems
description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**  
  
The Senior Technical SME for QA Systems provides technical leadership across the Quality Assurance product family and technology platforms, including Veeva, SAP, Mendix and AI-enabled automation solutions. The role leads solution design, implementation, validation and troubleshooting, ensuring technical outputs align with approved architecture, product strategy and engineering standards. The role coordinates engineers, site teams, architects, Product Owners, Service Managers and suppliers, acting as the technical lead for complex delivery and operational issues. The job holder reviews technical specifications, configurations and test evidence, and leads root-cause analysis were operational, batch or data-integrity impact may exist. The role also combines hands-on AI-enabled & automation and software engineering with technical leadership to deliver reusable agents, automation components, integrations and engineering tools. Working closely with the Automation Manager from the Enterprise AI team, the role translates the Quality Assurance AI and automation strategy into practical solutions and drives the technical adoption of AI within the team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Design, develop, test and implement AI-enabled automation and agents capabilities supporting the Quality Assurance platform development team, implementing technical solution designs and configurations in accordance with approved architecture and product strategy.
* Perform troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, with timely escalation where manufacturing batches, product quality, patient supply or data integrity may be affected.
* Own technical quality for the assigned scope, including specifications, design documentation, configuration records and technical validation evidence, and design or configure interfaces, workflows, recipes, data models and environments, writing or reviewing related specifications and test scripts.
* Analyze logs, metrics, monitoring and system behavior to identify defects, performance issues and opportunities for improvement, and lead technical design and implementation across multiple projects, releases or sites.
* Review and approve key technical specifications, design documents, configurations, test scripts and validation evidence, and assess technical risks to ensure mitigation addresses security, compliance, resilience, data integrity and supportability.
* Provide technical direction during complex incidents, releases and stabilization and coordinate internal and supplier engineering resources.
* Maintain technical standards and reusable engineering assets for the assigned product family or platform, and establish reusable artificial intelligence engineering standards, reference architectures and design patterns, while coaching engineers and suppliers.
* Drive engineering lessons learned and cross-team continuous improvement, defining artificial intelligence evaluation strategies, acceptance criteria, test evidence and production-readiness decisions.
* Ensure appropriate controls for responsible artificial intelligence, data privacy, cybersecurity, human oversight, traceability and regulated change, and lead complex investigations into artificial intelligence quality, retrieval, data, integration and operational issues.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Automation, Data, Life Sciences or another technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with technical, cloud, integration, automation, data, validation, cyber security or engineering certifications.
* Minimum of five years of hands-on technical engineering experience in large-scale enterprise or operational technology environments.
* Experience leading technical design and implementation for a product family, platform, programme or multiple sites, and reviewing and approving specifications, design documents, configurations, test scripts and technical validation evidence.
* Experience leading troubleshooting and root-cause investigations across systems, interfaces, workflows, data and infrastructure, and coordinating internal engineers, site teams, vendors and specialist partners through design, deployment and stabilization activities.
* Experience assessing technical risk and ensuring security, data integrity, resilience, compliance and supportability requirements are met.
* Experience coaching engineers and converting lessons learned into reusable standards, patterns and knowledge assets.
* Experience leading at least one artificial intelligence or generative artificial intelligence solution from design through testing, controlled release and operational support.
* Experience supporting audits, inspections and formal technical assurance activities, and designing or providing technical assurance for intelligent automation solutions.
* Experience defining artificial intelligence evaluation datasets, measurable acceptance criteria and risk-based test strategies, and integrating artificial intelligence services with enterprise applications, data sources and workflow platforms.
* Experience providing technical directions to engineers, suppliers and multidisciplinary delivery teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Apply analytical and structured problem-solving methods to technical engineering and automation activities l and structured problem-solving skills applied to technical engineering and automation activities.
* Experience in Translating architecture and product direction into technical designs and implementation plans.
* Experience in Producing technical documentation and maintaining specifications, designs, test evidence and configuration records in line with governance requirements.
* Experience in interfaces, workflows, data, environments, monitoring and operational support practices.
* Experience in security, quality, validation, data integrity, resilience and change control requirements.
* Collaborates across global business, site, engineering, architecture, product, service and supplier teams, contributing to continuous improvement activities with focus on standardization, reuse, automation and knowledge sharing.
* Provides technical leadership by reviewing designs against requirements and standards, proposing improvements, and providing coaching and structured knowledge transfer within engineering and operations teams.
* Communicates technical risk and recommendations to governance forums and senior stakeholders using inclusive and accessible language, drawing on applied knowledge of generative artificial intelligence, large language models, machine learning and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Designs architectures that integrate artificial intelligence models with enterprise data, applications, application programming interfaces, and workflows.
* Knowledge of artificial intelligence evaluation, including correctness, groundedness, relevance, consistency, safety and regression testing, and knowledge of responsible artificial intelligence, privacy, cybersecurity, prompt injection, data leakage and human-in-the-loop controls.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. * Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.

* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.

* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.
* Extensive experience engineering shared network services such as Domain Name System, Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol and Internet Protocol address management.
* Strong knowledge of network access control, application programming interfaces, automation, monitoring and resilient service design.
* Evidence of improving service reliability, self service, deployment speed or operational efficiency.

* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.

* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Our Company**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**What You'll Do**

At Teradata, we're not just managing data; we're unleashing its full potential. Our Teradata AI Studio platform and pioneering Enterprise Vector Store are empowering the world's largest enterprises to derive unprecedented value from their most complex data. We're rapidly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with Artificial Intelligence, especially in the exciting realm of **autonomous and agentic systems**

We’re building intelligent systems that go far beyond automation — they observe, reason, adapt, and drive complex decision-making across large-scale enterprise environments. As a member of our AI engineering team, you’ll play a critical role in designing and deploying advanced AI agents that integrate deeply with business operations, turning data into insight, action, and measurable outcomes.

In this role, you’ll architect foundational components for production-grade AI systems — from agent frameworks and LLM pipelines to observability and evaluation layers that ensure reliability, accountability, and performance. You’ll be responsible not just for building models, but for making them measurable, debuggable, and trustworthy in real-world, high-stakes deployments.

You’ll work alongside a high-caliber team of AI researchers, engineers, and data scientists tackling some of the hardest problems in AI and enterprise software — from scalable multi-agent coordination and fine-tuned LLM applications, to real-time monitoring, drift detection, and closed-loop retraining systems.

If you're passionate about building intelligent systems that are not only powerful but observable, resilient, and production-ready, this role offers the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise AI from the ground up.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain robust backend microservices and APIs (REST, gRPC) to support Teradata AI Studio capabilities.
* Build, orchestrate, and deploy autonomous AI agents using frameworks like LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen.
* Implement tool calling, dynamic routing, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations for multi-agent workflows.
* Manage full application lifecycles, including application-level observability (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Langfuse) and production incident resolution.
* Integrate and optimize stateful data layers, including vector databases and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) for agent memory and RAG pipelines.
* Implement AI-specific observability and tracing for LLM pipelines and multi-agent workflows to monitor performance, token usage, and response quality.

**Who You'll Work With**

Imagine collaborating daily with some of the brightest minds in the company – individuals who champion diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to our success. You'll be part of a cohesive force, laser-focused on delivering high-quality, critical, and highly visible AI/ML functionality within the Teradata Cloud platform. Your insights will directly shape the future of our intelligent data solutions.

You'll report directly to the inspiring Sr. Manager, Software Engineering, who will champion your growth and empower your contributions.

**What Makes You A Qualified Candidate**

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field – your academic foundation is key.
* **Core Programming:** 3+ years of experience with any of the backend languages (Python, Go).
* **Agent Frameworks:** Hands-on experience building agents using frameworks like LangGraph, Langchain, CrewAI, etc. and integrating Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.
* Direct experience building applications with LLM frameworks and multi-agent orchestration systems.
* **Data Management:** Direct experience managing relational databases (PostgreSQL) and Vector stores.
* **API Design:** 2+ years in building and managing REST or gRPC APIs and microservices for the application layer.

**What You'll Bring**

* Hands-on experience with LLM observability, tracing, and evaluation platforms (e.g., Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or OpenTelemetry for AI).
* Experience with LLM-specific tools and frameworks (LangChain, vector databases, prompt engineering).
* Experience with infrastructure security and compliance standards.
* Contributions to open-source projects or technical communities.
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a collaborative team environment.
* Ownership mindset with a focus on reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement.

title: MS Teams with Enterprise Voice Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**  
As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation.
  
  
At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities. The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.
  
  
**What you will do**

As a Microsoft Teams Administrator with Enterprise Voice skills, you will:

* Design, configure, and manage Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice solutions, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Deploy and integrate Session Border Controllers (SBCs) with Microsoft Teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve voice-related issues in Microsoft Teams, including call quality, routing, and interoperability with PSTN providers.
* Manage and support Microsoft Teams policies, configurations, and voice-enabled features.
* Collaborate with network and security teams to ensure compliance and optimal performance.
* Perform migrations from legacy PBX systems to Microsoft Teams.
* Work with external vendors and telecom providers to ensure seamless voice connectivity.
* Monitor Teams Voice infrastructure using analytics and reporting tools to optimize call performance.
Provide end-user support and training on Microsoft Teams Phone features.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in Microsoft Teams Voice and Telephony Solutions.
* Experience in PBX to Microsoft Teams migrations.
* Knowledge of Power Automate and Power Apps for workflow automation in Teams.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Strong understanding of SIP, VoIP, PSTN connectivity, and SBC configurations (AudioCodes, Ribbon, etc.).
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), PowerShell scripting, and Teams Admin Center.
Knowledge of E911 compliance, call routing policies, dial plans, and number management  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Teams Administrator Associate (MS-700).
* Microsoft Certified: Teams Voice Engineer (MS-721).
Session Border Controller (SBC) certifications (AudioCodes/Ribbon).  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
description:

Together, we empower clients to drive innovation, create sustainable funding streams and deliver better student outcomes.  
  
Today, leaders of higher education institutions and academic medical centers are spending too much time reacting to market forces, rather than focusing on the essential priorities that help students, faculty and staff thrive. The most productive path forward requires an intentional approach and innovative thinking, whereby stakeholders across the entire institution rally around a shared vision and embrace the hard work of effecting change.  
  
You’ll help our clients to achieve organizational effectiveness, improve student outcomes, implement new technologies and align resources and investments to ensure long-term sustainability.  
  
Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

Huron is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (Senior SDET) to join its product engineering team. You will own the test automation strategy and framework architecture, ensuring reliability and accuracy across complex application workflows. Embedded in Agile delivery teams alongside developers, product managers, and designers, you bring a software engineering mindset to quality problems and set the quality bar the whole team works toward.

**Test automation and AI-assisted engineering**

* **AI agentic testing:** Configure and evaluate agentic workflows for autonomous test generation and self-healing locators; apply Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents to test tools, APIs, and data sources for end-to-end agentic test workflows; define system instructions, skills, and tool configurations for AI coding agents.
* Architect and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress for UI; REST Assured or similar for APIs; integrate into CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Write complex SQL queries to validate backend data integrity in **PostgreSQL (using DBeaver)**; build data-driven test suites for parallel and cross-browser execution.

**Defect management, collaboration, and mentorship**

* Isolate, document, and track defects in Azure DevOps; lead exploratory testing sessions and root-cause analysis on escaped defects.
* Serve as quality engineering lead across Agile delivery teams; participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, standups, and retrospectives.
* Conduct code reviews and coach developers and team members on shift-left testing practices and quality engineering standards.

**Core**

* B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science, MIS, or related discipline; 4 to 7 years in software quality engineering with the majority in test automation and framework development on a commercial product.
* Production-quality automation code in C#, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript; proficiency with Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress; API testing with REST Assured, Postman, or SoapUI.
* CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins); strong Git skills; cross-browser testing with BrowserStack or equivalent; solid SQL skills for database validation.
* Deep understanding of QA lifecycle and Agile/Iterative delivery; clear communicator able to produce test strategies and quality summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience with performance engineering, scalability design, and observability practices (logging, metrics, distributed tracing) in production systems.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services including Lambda, ECS, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and related cloud-native tooling.

**AI and agentic development tools**

* Practical daily use of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor) to write, refactor, and review test code; proven ability to craft effective prompts and system instructions.
* Solid understanding of AI agents, skills, and tool-calling; familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) — ability to connect AI models to internal tools, APIs, and test infrastructure for multi-step agentic workflows; working knowledge of an LLM API or orchestration framework (Anthropic API, LangChain, or similar) is a strong plus.

title: Backup & Recovery Expert
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**
=============

As a Backup & Recovery Infrastructure Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the availability, security, and recoverability of enterprise data across complex IT environments. Your primary focus will be on Veritas NetBackup administration, with secondary responsibility for Commvault platforms, supporting backup, recovery, disaster recovery, cyber-resilience, and automation initiatives.

You will manage and optimize enterprise backup infrastructures, monitor daily backup and recovery operations, troubleshoot critical issues, and ensure compliance with defined SLAs, RPOs, and RTOs. Working closely with infrastructure, cloud, storage, database, virtualization, and application teams, you will deliver reliable data protection solutions that support business continuity and operational excellence.

The role combines hands-on technical administration with strategic improvement initiatives, including automation, platform modernization, capacity optimization, security enhancement, and recovery readiness. You will drive continuous improvement through process standardization, proactive problem-solving, and operational best practices while expanding your expertise across enterprise technologies and cloud platforms.

  
  

**What You Will Do**
====================

* Manage and support enterprise backup and recovery environments using **Veritas NetBackup** and **Commvault** .
* Monitor daily backup jobs, replication activities, and recovery operations to ensure successful data protection.
* Troubleshoot backup failures, restore issues, storage problems, performance bottlenecks, and connectivity-related incidents.
* Perform backup and restore activities for servers, databases, virtual machines, applications, and cloud workloads.
* Execute disaster recovery (DR) tests, recovery validations, and restore requests to ensure business continuity.
* Administer NetBackup components including Master Servers, Media Servers, policies, storage units, disk pools, deduplication, and lifecycle policies.
* Manage Commvault infrastructure including CommServe, MediaAgents, storage policies, clients, and recovery operations.
* Perform platform maintenance activities such as patching, upgrades, agent installations, certificate management, and health checks.
* Monitor backup capacity, storage utilization, retention compliance, and infrastructure availability.
* Implement and maintain backup security controls such as encryption, immutability, access controls, and ransomware protection.
* Automate operational tasks using **PowerShell, Python, Shell scripting, and APIs** to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Collaborate with server, database, cloud, virtualization, storage, network, and application teams to resolve backup and recovery issues.
* Support incident, problem, change, configuration, and capacity management processes.
* Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, recovery procedures, technical documentation, and knowledge articles.
* Drive continuous improvements through automation, backup optimization, failure reduction, and operational standardization.
* **Participate in infrastructure projects, provide technical recommendations, and ensure backup requirements are incorporated into new deployments.**
  ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Your future at Kyndryl** 
 
**Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.**

title: Lead Engineer - IAM Lifecycle Management
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Job Purpose:**

  

The Lead Engineer, IAM Lifecycle Management will manage Azure DevOps pipeline engineering and release automation for secure IAM solutions, with primary responsibility for reusable YAML pipelines, artifact management, CI/CD, automated quality and security gates, deployment approvals, release traceability and rollback controls. The role will also deliver scalable lifecycle controls, microfrontend experiences and APIs using Next.js, Express.js, NestJS, GraphQL and .NET across cloud and on-premises environments.

You will establish and continuously improve Azure DevOps delivery capabilities for IAM applications, including pipeline architecture, reusable YAML templates, build and release automation, artifact management, automated testing, quality and security gates, environment promotion, deployment approvals, release evidence, operational traceability and rollback readiness. In partnership with product teams, application owners, HR, security, architecture, operations and audit stakeholders, you will then apply these capabilities to engineer and release secure IAM lifecycle solutions while improving automation, governance and identity-data quality.

**About the team**:

IAM Lifecycle Management owns the identity and account lifecycle end to end. The team ensures that people and non-human identities receive appropriate access when created, joining, moving, changing status or returning, and that access is suspended or removed promptly when no longer required across on-premises, cloud and SaaS systems.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Implement and enhance Azure DevOps pipeline engineering for IAM solutions, including reusable YAML templates, build and release automation, artifact management, automated testing, code-quality and security gates, secrets handling, environment promotion, deployment approvals, release evidence, end-to-end traceability and tested rollback controls.
* Deliver assigned lifecycle engineering work to agreed scope, quality, security and timelines, identifying delivery risks and dependencies early.
* Collaborate with product owners, architects and engineering stakeholders to translate business, security, regulatory and architectural requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable technical solutions.
* Engineer end-to-end identity and account lifecycle capabilities, including creation, provisioning, modification, suspension, recertification and deprovisioning across on-premises, cloud and SaaS systems.
* Implement and enhance joiner, mover, leaver, rehire, contractor and non-human identity workflows, including trigger events, approval paths, account states, exception handling and recovery controls.
* Integrate authoritative HR and identity sources with directories, governance platforms and target applications using connectors, APIs and event-driven services, while improving source-data quality and reconciliation.
* Create functional and technical test scenarios, maintain requirements traceability and implementation evidence, and support remediation of defects, audit findings and control gaps.
* Develop, enhance and support secure IAM applications using Next.js microfrontends, Express.js and NestJS services, GraphQL APIs and .NET components, applying reusable architecture patterns across the full solution stack.
* Design and deliver accessible, responsive Next.js user interfaces and secure Express.js, NestJS or ASP.NET APIs for IAM lifecycle applications, with reusable components, API versioning, validation, authentication, authorisation, error handling, observability and performance optimisation.
* Support colleagues through technical guidance, peer review, troubleshooting, reusable documentation and knowledge sharing.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and operating Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, including reusable YAML templates, pipeline-as-code practices, artifact and package management, automated unit and integration tests, code-quality and security gates, secrets handling, deployment approvals, environment promotion, release traceability and rollback controls.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in identity and access management, including implementation and support of identity and account lifecycle capabilities.
* Strong understanding of joiner, mover, leaver, rehire, employee, contractor and non-human identity lifecycle patterns and their associated governance controls.
* Experience designing and configuring provisioning and deprovisioning workflows, approval processes, birthright and role-based access, account-state transitions and exception handling.
* Experience integrating IAM platforms with HR systems, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP, databases, SaaS applications and custom applications.
* Knowledge of identity data models, account correlation, reconciliation, access reviews, certification, policy enforcement, orphan-account prevention and auditability.
* Strong hands-on development experience with Next.js, Express.js and NestJS, including microfrontend architecture, TypeScript, reusable user-interface components, secure backend services, authentication and authorisation integration, automated testing and performance optimisation.
* Experience delivering end-to-end UI and API solutions across Next.js microfrontends and Express.js, NestJS, GraphQL or .NET services, including responsive design, secure API development, input validation, automated testing, documentation and production troubleshooting.
* Hands-on engineering experience with .NET and ASP.NET Web APIs, including secure service design, authentication and authorisation, integration with IAM platforms, automated testing, performance optimisation and production support.
* Understanding of least privilege, segregation of duties, account ownership, privileged-access dependencies and application-security practices.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver work independently to a high standard, with strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation and stakeholder-communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Advanced experience architecting enterprise-scale Azure DevOps delivery platforms for Next.js, Express.js, NestJS, GraphQL and .NET solutions, including governed reusable YAML templates, artifact lifecycle management, multi-stage CI/CD, automated quality and security controls, deployment approvals, release traceability, resilience and rollback strategies.
* Advanced hands-on experience with SailPoint, Saviynt or a comparable IGA platform, including workflow, connector and policy configuration.
* Experience modernising or migrating identity lifecycle processes from legacy or bespoke solutions to a SaaS IGA platform.
* Integration experience with LDAP, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID and custom applications using REST, SOAP, Microsoft Graph, GraphQL, TypeScript, .NET or equivalent technologies.
* Experience applying microfrontend design patterns, modular Next.js architecture, API-first development across Express.js, NestJS, GraphQL and .NET, automated testing, secure coding and Azure DevOps-based delivery in enterprise applications.
* Experience designing serverless integration services or event-driven components in Microsoft Azure.

* Relevant certification such as CISSP, SailPoint, Saviynt, CIMP, Microsoft Azure or another IAM, cloud or security certification.

* Typical tools and technologies: Azure DevOps Pipelines and Artifacts; YAML, Git, CI/CD automation, quality and security gates, deployment approvals, release traceability and rollback controls; Next.js, React, TypeScript, microfrontend frameworks and UI component libraries; Express.js; .NET and ASP.NET Web APIs; REST and SOAP APIs, Microsoft Graph, JSON and SQL; SailPoint, Saviynt, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP and Azure integration services.

title: Subject Matter Expert
description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------

IT Services and Support is seeking an experienced Subject Matter Expert to support IT Service Desk Operations and Transition teams. * Experience in Admin or developer with AWS cloud services; Azure exposure is a must
* ServiceNow platform experience strongly preferred is a must
* ITIL certification preferred.
* Background in threat and vulnerability management, particularly as it relates to securing AI-integrated systems is a plus
* Ability to bridge infrastructure knowledge with agentic AI design -understanding how automation decisions affect the real IT estate (Active Directory, Windows Server, VMware) the agent acts on is must have

**How We’ll Take Care of You**

That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. title: Senior Principal - SN Automation Engineering Architect
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The SERVICENOW Automation Engineering Product Analyst supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with the Automation Engineering Architect, they help shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Automation Engineering Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the Product. In addition, this role supports the iTSM Service Catalog and will work in partnership with SERVICENOW Automation Engineering Architect for conversational/automation of forms and MSP service catalog factory for basic forms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Automation Engineering Architect to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
* Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
* Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
* Document functional and technical specifications needed to deliver changes and support configuration or code delivery by providing clear design inputs; maintain configuration repositories and version updates where applicable.
* Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
* Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
* Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
* Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
* Support the Automation Engineering Architect to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
* Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
* Support the Automation Engineering Architect to identify and implement automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. SAP certification in related area, Agile methodologies)

**Area of Specialisation**

* Strong business knowledge in a relevant functional domain (e.g., IT, Finance, R&D), with the ability to analyse business challenges using structured frameworks, model end-to-end processes (e.g., BPMN), and support delivery through familiarity with Agile practices (e.g., SAFe, Scrum, Kanban).

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 2–4 years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments; building process flows and facilitating stakeholder sessions.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.

**Skills/Background**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.

**Skills**

Architectural Design, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Automation, Cloud Computing, Container Orchestration, Data Center Management, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS), Leadership, Network Design, Serverless Platforms, Service Oriented Architecture (SOA), Stakeholder Management, Storage Area Network (SAN), Strategizing, System Monitors, Technical Architecture, Technical Architecture Design, Virtualization, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Google Cloud Expert
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

### **My Role**

* Serve as the primary technical leader and trusted advisor for clients throughout the project lifecycle.
* Gather business and technical requirements from stakeholders and translate them into cloud infrastructure solutions.
* Define solution architecture and align Google Cloud capabilities with client requirements.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance to project teams, delivery teams, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Lead solution design, architecture reviews, and cloud transformation initiatives.
* Engage with SMEs, vendors, governance teams, and project executives to ensure successful delivery.
* Drive innovation, cloud adoption, and best practices across enterprise infrastructure environments.
Own end-to-end solution delivery, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and according to quality standards.  

**What You Will Do**

* Design and implement secure, scalable, and highly available Google Cloud infrastructure solutions.
* Manage and optimize core GCP services, including Compute Engine, VPC, Load Balancing, Cloud Storage, IAM, GKE, and networking components.
* Lead cloud operations, including provisioning, monitoring, patching, backup, capacity planning, and lifecycle management.
* Plan and execute cloud migration, disaster recovery, and high-availability strategies to ensure business continuity.
* Automate infrastructure deployment and operations using Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, Python, Shell scripting, and Ansible.
* Implement cloud security, governance, monitoring, logging, and observability frameworks aligned with enterprise standards.
* Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive performance and cost optimization initiatives.
* Collaborate with application, network, security, database, SRE, and DevOps teams while maintaining architecture documentation, runbooks, and operational best practices.
    
    
  **Your future at Kyndryl**  
    
  Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**
==================================================

* 15+ years of experience in enterprise infrastructure design, implementation, and management.
* Expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) architecture and administration.
* Strong hands-on experience with: Compute Engine (GCE)VPC, Cloud Storage Load Balancing, Cloud DNSIAM, Cloud NATVPN / Cloud Interconnect Monitoring, Logging, and Security Services
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
* Experience in DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud automation.
* Proficiency in Google Cloud CLI, Shell Scripting, Python, and Ansible.
* Experience in large-scale cloud operations, migration, modernization, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Strong knowledge of: Cloud Security & IA Governance & Organizational Policies Encryption & Secrets Management Network Security Cost Optimization
* Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, performance and capacity management.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, incident management, and root cause analysis.
* Experience designing highly available, scalable, and resilient cloud solutions.
* Understanding of ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.

**Preferred Professional Experience:**
======================================

* Experience with **G** oogle Kubernetes Engine (GKE).
* Exposure to Google Cloud managed database services.
* Expertise in Cloud Interconnect and enterprise-scale GCE environments.
* Experience integrating GCP with on-premises infrastructure.
* Experience creating architecture documentation, operational standards, and runbooks.
* Focus on automation and continuous service improvement.
* Google Cloud Professional Certifications, such as: Professional Cloud Architect Professional Cloud Network Engineer Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
Experience in disaster recovery, high availability, and enterprise cloud modernization initiatives.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Manager, Technical Consulting- Slack
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**About the Role**
------------------

  
  

As a **Technical People Manager for the Slack Practice** within Salesforce Professional Services (GDC), you will build, coach, and lead a high-performing team of Slack technical consultants, developers, and architects. In this role, you will bridge the gap between people leadership, technical architecture, and enterprise delivery excellence.
  
You will partner closely with global practice leaders, onshore engagement managers, and enterprise customers to deliver complex Slack transformations—ranging from large-scale Enterprise Grid migrations and custom app development to next-generation Agentforce and Salesforce integrations.
  
  
This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a technical architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Industries Cloud.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Manage, mentor, and grow a team of 15 technical consultants, Slack developers, and technical architects.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, performance appraisals, goal-setting, and career progression planning.
* Drive team enablement initiatives, certification bootcamp ( Certified Slack Developer, Certified Slack Admin ), and hands-on skill development across emerging features ( Agentforce in Slack, Slack CLI).
* Lead recruitment, technical interviews, and onboarding to scale the Slack practice with top-tier talent.
* Cultivate an inclusive, collaborative, and innovation-driven culture within the GDC.
* Serve as a **Technical Architect** for Slack enterprise implementations, providing architectural oversight across client deliverables.

* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies:**
---------------------------------------------

  + Deep understanding of Slack Enterprise Grid topology, multi-workspace scoping, and enterprise governance.
  + Experience with identity lifecycle management: SAML 2.0 SSO (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) and SCIM directory sync.
  + Strong foundation in enterprise security, compliance, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), eDiscovery, Enterprise Key Management (EKM), and the Slack Audit Logs API.

  + Familiarity with the Slack CLI, modular app architecture, manifest files (manifest.json), and Workflow Builder custom functions.

  + Architectural knowledge of migrating from legacy communication platforms (Microsoft Teams, Mattermost, freemium/standalone Slack workspaces) to Slack Enterprise Grid.
  + Familiarity with user/channel mapping schemas, export/import APIs, data parity verification, and cutover runbook execution.
* **DevOps & Engineering Standards:**
  + Solid understanding of modern CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, automated testing frameworks, and secure API integration standards.
  + Experience hosting Slack apps on cloud infrastructure (Heroku, AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  
  

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**
-----------------------------------------

  
  

* **Total Experience:** 10-15+ years in software engineering, technical consulting, or enterprise cloud solutions.
* **Management Experience:** 5+ years of direct people management experience leading technical teams (software engineers, technical consultants, or architects) in a global delivery / consulting model.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):**

  + Hands-on experience or architectural knowledge of integrating Salesforce with Slack (Salesforce for Slack apps, CRM record sync, Agentforce integration).

title: Senior Principal - Platform Architect Segmentation
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Platform Architect owns the technical design of GSK's network segmentation and security platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the platform's services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations.

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Platform architecture in the relevant domain, covering reference architecture, patterns, standards and design assurance.
* Security and resilience by design, including AI reference patterns and GxP considerations where applicable.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 yearsTypically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud, network or digital workplace.
* Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard.
* Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context.
* Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet.
* Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations.
* Extensive experience designing enterprise network security and segmentation services.
* Deep knowledge of identity based access, firewalls, microsegmentation and secure zones across information and operational technology.
* Evidence of defining segmentation architectures that improved control coverage, risk reduction or secure access.

**Skills/Background**

* Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented.
* Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard.
* Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them.
* Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome.
* Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright.
* Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform.

**Skills**

Automation Technology, AWS Security Services, Cloud Based Services, Cloud Network Architecture, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Enterprise Network Security, Enterprise Security Architecture, Identity Governance, IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Network Architecture, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Wireless System Design, Zero Trust, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. **The Mission**
---------------

Kong Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native **SaaS** platform, powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a **multi-tenant** control plane, automation, and platform services that let customers securely deploy, operate, and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service. Behind that experience sits a distributed platform responsible for provisioning, fleet management, software lifecycle, zero-downtime upgrades, observability, security, and multi-region operations across globally distributed cloud infrastructure - built to a target of 99.99% availability, balancing reliability, performance, operational excellence, and infrastructure efficiency at global **SaaS** scale.

As a Software Engineering Manager for Managed Gateways Infrastructure, you will own and grow Kong's Bangalore-based engineering team, taking full accountability for this **multi-tenant SaaS** platform. Kong Cloud Gateways is growing 100% YoY, and as enterprises increasingly adopt AI alongside traditional APIs, this platform becomes an increasingly important part of Kong's API and AI strategy - every improvement in automation, scalability, and operational excellence you drive accelerates new platform capabilities and lets product teams innovate faster. Beyond the technical charter, you play a key role in shaping a dynamic engineering culture - one built on urgency, ownership, and first-principles thinking - as the team scales to match the pace of the business.

This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role - you're expected to stay close to the systems, dig into hard problems alongside your team, and not hesitate to get into the trenches when it matters.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own and grow Kong's Managed Gateways Infrastructure engineering team in Bangalore - scaling the team's capability, raising the technical bar, and staying hands-on in critical implementations and incidents, not just directing from a distance.
* Own the reliability and scalability of a multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure platform serving customers across regions and clouds - every architectural decision has to hold up under multi-tenant load, isolation, and blast-radius considerations, not just single-tenant assumptions.
* **Drive 4-9s (99.99%+)** availability across Kong's global infrastructure footprint - owning capacity, resilience, and failure-mode design across multi-region, multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP) so Cloud Gateways stays up for customers everywhere, at any scale.
* Act as a direct technical contributor when it counts - complex incidents, architecture reviews, and high-stakes implementations that materially move the needle on Managed Gateways' growth and reliability.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team building and operating Kong's **SaaS** infrastructure for Managed Gateways, in direct support of our critical enterprise customer base globally.
* Architect and implement robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud-native systems using technologies like Kubernetes, Golang, and major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Own the complete operational lifecycle end-to-end - infrastructure, reliability, on-call, incident response, and blameless post-mortems - as one integrated engineering charter, not a separate function.
* Drive developer delight and operational efficiency through automation, self-service tooling, and streamlined workflows for deploying and managing API gateways, while proactively preventing technical debt and reducing operational toil.
* Define, track, and report on key SLOs and SLIs, and advocate for architectural best practices that keep Managed Gateways performant and resilient as it scales.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, engineering, and support teams to influence roadmap decisions and ensure operational readiness for new features.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

### **The Toolkit:**

* Proven experience leading and managing software engineering teams responsible for infrastructure and reliability in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with a track record of staying technically hands-on rather than purely delegating.
* Deep, current expertise in designing, deploying, and operating highly available distributed systems on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - this role needs someone who can still open a terminal and debug production, not just review architecture diagrams.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s) and container orchestration in production environments.
* Proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for infrastructure automation and service development.
* Strong understanding of observability principles and experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar.
* Demonstrated ability to manage critical incidents personally when needed, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective preventative measures.
* Familiarity with API gateway technologies, service mesh, or network proxies is a significant plus.

### **The Kong DNA:**

* **Ownership:** You take full responsibility for the reliability and performance of systems, driving initiatives from conception to completion.
* **Urgency:** You thrive in dynamic environments, prioritizing critical issues and delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision.
* **Collaboration:** You build strong relationships, foster open communication, and work effectively across global teams to achieve shared goals.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience with open-source contributions or active participation in SRE/cloud-native communities.
* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (e.g., CKA, CKAD).
* Background in companies focused on developer tools, infrastructure software, or API management.

**About Kong:**

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.
