title: Lead Engineer- Platform & Data
description:
Bangalore, Karnataka, India
  
  
Job ID
  
68764552709
  
Date posted
  
10/27/2026
  
Department
  
Engineering
  
  
**About the team:**  
Eightfold offers a suite of AI-powered products, including Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Workforce Exchange, and AI Interviewer. The Analytics team builds the customer-facing solutions that show how Eightfold delivers value across these products. Our work helps customers’ leadership teams make strategic workforce decisions and helps their recruiting teams operate more effectively day to day.
  
  
**Our analytics portfolio includes:**  
**Native reporting platform:** a reporting experience built directly into the Eightfold product.
  
  
**Agentic Dashboard Authoring:** AI-assisted dashboard creation, so users can go from question to insight without building reports by hand.
  
  
**Conversational Analytics:** natural-language access to data, letting users ask questions and get answers in plain English.
  
  
**Secure Talent Lake connectivity:** secure pipelines that let customers ETL their Eightfold data into their own data warehouses.
  
  
We’re in the middle of a major revamp of our analytics stack. Today we run on Redshift and Databricks, and we’re migrating to StarRocks across 8+ regions distributed globally on AWS, Azure, and Oracle Cloud. As Lead Platform / Data Engineer, you’ll play a central role in shaping this migration and the multi-cloud platform that comes out of it.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**  
Architect and manage the lakehouse. Design and maintain Apache Iceberg tables, including schema evolution, partitioning strategies, snapshot management, compaction, and metadata optimization.
  
  
Own the analytical query layer. Deploy, operate, and performance-tune open-source datawarehouse clusters, covering FE/BE sizing, materialized views, query profiling, caching, and resource isolation.
  
  
Optimize storage formats. Make deliberate choices about Parquet file layout, including row group sizing, compression codecs, encoding, and predicate pushdown, so data stays cheap to store and fast to query.
  
  
Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines. Develop robust batch and streaming pipelines with strong guarantees around data quality, idempotency, backfills, and observability.
  
  
Run event-driven autoscaling on Kubernetes. Design and implement KEDA-based scaling for data workloads, triggered by queue depth, Kafka lag, or custom metrics, so you balance cost against latency.
  
  
Manage infrastructure as code. Provision and maintain cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure using tools like Terraform, Helm, and GitOps workflows (ArgoCD/Flux).
  
  
Tune self-hosted open-source warehouses. Diagnose bottlenecks across CPU, memory, I/O, and network. Tune configurations, run benchmarks, and drive measurable gains in query latency and cost efficiency.
  
  
Champion reliability. Define SLOs, build monitoring and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, or similar), participate in on-call, and lead incident retrospectives.
  
  
Mentor and influence. Review designs and code, mentor engineers, and help set technical direction for the data platform.
  
  
**What We Need:**  
5+ years of experience designing, building, and operating large-scale data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and distributed analytical systems
  
Hands-on expertise with Apache Iceberg / Hudi and Parquet, including partitioning, schema evolution, compaction, snapshot management, and storage optimization.
  
Experience operating and performance-tuning analytical query engines such as StarRocks, ClickHouse, Trino, or similar distributed data warehouses.
  
Proficiency in building reliable batch and streaming pipelines using Apache Spark and Flink, with strong fundamentals in data quality, idempotency, fault tolerance, and observability.
  
Experience operating production-grade, multi-region cloud platforms across AWS, Azure, or OCI, with a focus on scalability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.
  
Prior experience in mentoring engineers and leading projects while driving platform initiatives end-to-end.
  
  
**About Eightfold:**  
Eightfold is a global leader in an AI-native enterprise talent platform, trusted by the world’s largest & most respected Fortune 500 organizations. Our platform is built from the ground up, operating at scale across Azure and AWS, deployed in multiple regions globally, including IL4-compliant environments for US Government, supporting users in 100+ countries and 30+ languages. Today, Eightfold is at the forefront of agentic AI, delivering intelligent agents that actively drive outcomes across hiring and talent workflows, while much of the industry is still experimenting with prototypes. Backed by over $410M in funding and valued at $2B+, we are defining the next era of agentic talent systems.
  
  
What sets Eightfold apart is not just the technology & our mission, but the team behind it. We are a deeply technical, execution-driven organization that values ownership, collaboration, and high standards. Our engineers, product leaders, and go-to-market teams work closely together in person and across functions to build systems that scale in the real world. If you’re excited to work on hard problems, move with urgency, raise the bar every day, and help build agentic systems that transform how the world works, Eightfold is the place to do it.
  
  
Our customers
  
  
Press
  
  
**Founders:**  
Varun Kacholia (https://www.linkedin.com/in/varunkacholia/ ) &
  
  
Ashutosh Garg (https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashutoshgarg893/)
  
  
**Engineering Culture at Eightfold:**  
We are a team of self-starters who excel in their fields. We believe in giving you responsibility, not a task. We want you to have ownership and pride in your work and see your work's positive impact on your colleagues, our customers, and the world. We believe in providing transparency and support so you can do the best work of your career.

We’ve grown quickly since our inception in 2019, now with offices in Pune and Bangalore

This role requires a seasoned telecom technology leader with deep expertise in OSS/BSS, Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, RAN and transmission domains, network inventory transformation, solution architecture, data modelling, integration, and end-to-end delivery. The candidate should be able to translate complex business and network requirements into scalable architecture solutions, lead cross-functional teams, modernize legacy inventory platforms, and enable strategic transformation across wireless, IP, transport, assurance, and planning domains.

To lead architecture, design, integration, migration, and modernization initiatives across telecom network inventory and OSS platforms, with a strong focus on Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, Telstra-wide inventory transformation, unified data management, API-led integration, and domain federation. The role is accountable for shaping solution architecture, driving stakeholder alignment, enabling data quality improvements, and ensuring reliable delivery of business-critical inventory capabilities.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical architect and telecom solution leader with strong OSS/BSS and network inventory experience, particularly across Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, RAN, transmission, IP, transport, and enterprise inventory transformation. The candidate should combine deep technical knowledge with stakeholder leadership, delivery discipline, data architecture expertise, and the ability to modernize complex legacy inventory environments while protecting business continuity and driving measurable operational value.

**About the role**
------------------

Couchbase is hiring a Salesforce Developer with 3–5 years of experience to build and maintain the CRM platform that runs our lead-to-cash process. You will join the Business Applications team and deliver development across Sales Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, and a busy set of integrations with finance, marketing and revenue tools.

Our org has been live since well before 2018 and carries a mix of Apex, Flows, legacy Process Builder and approval-process automation. A large part of this role is helping modernise that automation safely while delivering new features for Sales, Deal Desk, Finance and Professional Services, with guidance from senior team members.

**Key responsibilities**

* Design, build and test Apex classes, triggers, batch and scheduled jobs, and Lightning Web Components to well-documented standards.
* Build and maintain record-triggered and scheduled Flows, and migrate legacy Process Builder, Workflow Rules and approval-process logic to Flow.

* Translate requests from Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, Marketing and PS into technical designs, estimates and documentation.

* Background in Quote-to-Cash architecture
* Experience with Custom Metadata Types, Platform Events, and Event-Driven Architectures

We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries.

**Who You Are**

**You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.** 
 
**Required Skillset**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **BCP & DR Architecture:** Comprehensive understanding of On-Premise, Off-Premise, and Hybrid IT-DR application architectures, including data protection, storage replication, and database native replication.
* **Resiliency Automation:** Proven ability to map manual DR-drill runbooks into modern orchestration platforms such as **Kyndryl Resiliency Orchestration (Sanovi DRM)** or **ServiceNow BCM** .
* **Workload Expertise:** Strong data protection experience across enterprise workloads including MS SQL, Exchange, Oracle, Active Directory (AD), VMware, Hyper-V, Azure, AWS, and Bluemix.

* **Design & Documentation:** Expertise in creating comprehensive Low-Level Designs (LLD), High-Level Designs (HLD), and end-to-end data management workflows.
* **Storage & Virtualization:** Deep practical knowledge of storage replication technologies, virtualization solutions, and diverse DR failure scenarios.

**Preferred Skillset**
----------------------

* **Documentation & Technical Writing:** Experience in developing and revising critical technical assets including Solution Design/Approach documents, Technical Reports, PPTs, FAQs, and White papers.
* **Enablement & Training:** Proven track record in developing and delivering operational/technical training content, live demos, and webinars for internal teams, channel partners, and enterprise customers.
* **Executive Engagement & On-Site Delivery:** Ability to participate in Executive Briefing Center sessions, acting as a technical evangelist, alongside hands-on experience leading on-site product implementations with customer and vendor teams.
* **Continuous Learning:** Proactive mindset geared toward continuous self-development and mastering cutting-edge developments in the Disaster Recovery and Data Protection landscape.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Lead Solutions Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**The Team:**

Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers' data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.

**The Role:**

  

In this role you will work across diverse enterprise source systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and cloud databases, with a strong focus on the Oracle technology ecosystem. You will drive data extraction from Oracle environments (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Database and Autonomous Database) and build integrations with Oracle's AI and automation infrastructure.

You will own complex, highly customized integration projects end to end, anticipate blockers before they surface, and shape the best long-term solution together with the customer and Celonis internal teams. You are a trusted technical advisor to customer IT, data, and security leaders, and a go-to partner for colleagues across Services, Product & Engineering, and Go-to-Market.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, you invest part of your time in growing the SA practice: building reusable assets, and driving small initiatives that advance team strategy, including our Oracle integration playbooks.

**The work you'll do:**

**Lead complex data integration and ingestion**

* Own Oracle data extraction. Architect and deliver ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, and Oracle Database / Autonomous Database, including JDBC and PL/SQL-based approaches, while understanding the underlying business processes in these systems.
* Build real-time and CDC integrations. Design change data capture and event-driven architectures using Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, and REST/SOAP APIs, and use them to power Celonis Action Flows.
* Deliver Oracle ERP and other enterprise connections. Lead Oracle ERP connections or cloud based equivalents (e.g. via Oracle BICC). Deliver customized JDBC setups, including Dockerized and real-time configurations.
* Build and own custom API connectors. Design advanced connectors, including complex authentication, pagination, and delta loads, and advise on API design topics such as synchronous versus asynchronous APIs and OData.
* Architect push-based and lakehouse pipelines. Lead Python-based pipelines with Celonis data ingestion API with data engineering and SDLC best practices, and design Landing Zone and lakehouse solutions (for example Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric), including zero copy solutions.
* Solve hard infrastructure problems. Work with customer IT on DMZs, network bridges, WAFs, proxies, certificates, on-premise agent deployments, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) networking.
* Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, optimize database and pipeline performance (for example on Oracle DB and Exadata), and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

**Actions, automation, and AI connectivity**

* Deliver advanced writebacks and automation. Configure Action Flows with customized agent settings and direct API-based integrations, including writebacks into Oracle systems, and advise on bot integrations, permissioning, and security.
* Connect Celonis to enterprise AI. Design AI integration patterns that connect Celonis Orchestration and Action Flows with OCI Generative AI Agents, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), or Oracle Digital Assistant, and guide customers in connecting Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP, covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

**Identity, security, and governance**

* Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as OCI IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.
* Lead security conversations. Coordinate with the Celonis security team on customer questionnaires, answer questions confidently on live calls, and explain architecture and data flows to customer security and compliance stakeholders.

**Customer and team impact**

* Act as a trusted advisor. Recommend solutions that set the customer up for long-term success, knowing when to build the ideal setup and when to compromise, drawing on best practices in data management, ETL, streaming, and project management.
* Be a recognized expert. Build deep expertise in Oracle integrations and other product areas, give structured feedback to Product & Engineering on Oracle connectors and AI agent capabilities, and become a source of trust for product managers and engineers.
* Advance team strategy. Set up and run initiatives such as knowledge bases and best-practice libraries (for example Oracle integration templates): define goals and success criteria, document the plan, and hold yourself and others accountable.

**The qualifications you need:**

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, technical consulting, or solutions architecture in a customer-facing role, including leading customer implementations.
* Oracle data engineering experience:hands-on experience extracting data from and understanding business processes in Oracle systems (Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, Oracle Database / Autonomous Database), with PL/SQL and Oracle SQL skills.
* Oracle Cloud: experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and its integration and data services such as Oracle Integration Cloud, alongside familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
* Python and SQL skills, and ETL pipeline creation for large volumes of enterprise data, including migration scripting and custom transformations.
* Hands-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, and API design concepts (synchronous and asynchronous APIs, OData).
* Network and security fluency at the level needed to engage customer enterprise IT (DMZ, WAF, proxies, certificates, VPNs), plus comfort with Linux environments.
* Excellent communication and storytelling across written, verbal, and slide formats, tailored to technical and executive audiences, and fluency in English.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Oracle Exadata, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), Oracle Digital Assistant, or Oracle Analytics.
* Familiarity with SAP (ECC/S/4HANA, PI/PO, SNC, RISE, CPI, BTP) or other enterprise ERPs.
* Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and with iPaaS or low-code tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Power Automate).
* Experience with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.
* Docker and Linux server administration experience.
* Relevant certifications (Celonis, Oracle/OCI, cloud, or SAP).

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Tech Lead – DAM Architecture & Operations
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.
  
  
**Tech Lead – DAM Architecture & Operations**
**Location:**
Chennai, India (Full-Time Onsite)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time Employee (FTE)
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Head of Digital Acquisition
  
  
**Job Level**
: I4
  
  
**Job Summary**
Logitech is seeking a visionary, highly autonomous
**Tech Lead – DAM Architecture & Operations**
to serve as the technical heartbeat of our next-generation "Marketing AI Operating System". Operating as a key strategic force within our global MarTech team in Chennai and reporting directly to the Head of Digital Acquisition, you will architect and scale an enterprise-wide asset intelligence engine serving over 3,000 global users and managing 1M+ high-value digital assets. In this high-impact role, you will lead the evolution of our enterprise Bynder DAM platform—transforming asset discovery and lifecycle management through cutting-edge AI-driven enrichment, robust metadata schema design, scalable enterprise taxonomies, and high-velocity API/Webhook integrations, all while driving disciplined Agile execution and System Integrator (SI) governance.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Architecture & Technical Strategy: Serve as the ultimate technical authority for Logitech's enterprise Bynder DAM ecosystem; design and maintain robust metadata schemata, enterprise taxonomies, controlled vocabularies, and complex workflow automation rules.
* AI-Driven Asset Intelligence: Pioneer and scale advanced AI/ML Capabilities—including automated metadata enrichment, visual search, intelligent auto-tagging, and Generative AI integrations—to power the core engine of our global Marketing AI OS.
* Integration & Systems Interoperability: Architect and maintain seamlessly scalable, high-throughput REST APIs and Webhook integrations connecting DAM with enterprise CMS, PIM, e-Commerce, and Adobe Creative Cloud platforms.
* Agile Execution & SI Governance: Lead technical execution within an Agile/Scrum framework; strictly govern deliverables from external System Integrators (SIs) to enforce high code quality, performance standards, and platform stability without operational debt.
* Leadership & Autonomy: Demonstrate high autonomy and a strong bias for action; proactively identify structural bottlenecks, solve complex architectural challenges, and mentor technical contributors across regions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 8+ years of progressive technical leadership in enterprise digital operations, MarTech architecture, or digital asset infrastructure supporting large-scale, multi-regional user populations.
* DAM Mastery: 3+ years of deep technical expertise architecting and administering enterprise DAM solutions, specifically Bynder (or top-tier equivalents like Adobe Experience Manager Assets, Acquia DAM/Widen).
* Technical Depth: Proven proficiency in taxonomy governance, metadata modeling, AI-driven asset discovery pipelines, REST API design, Webhook integrations, and middleware systems.
* Delivery Track Record: Extensive hands-on experience in Agile/Scrum delivery environments, driving sprint velocity, and technical governance over third-party System Integrator (SI) teams.
* Leadership Mindset: Exceptional strategic perspective, high autonomy, proactive problem-solving ability, and articulate communication skills across cross-functional engineering and business cohorts.
* Location & Onsite Presence: Based in or willing to relocate to Chennai, India, for full-time onsite collaboration.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certified Bynder Administrator or Technical Specialist.
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or equivalent technical Agile delivery certification.
* Demonstrated experience with AI/ML DAM plugins, Google Workspace Admin tools, and Google Drive Labels API.

title: AI Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description:**

AI Engineering Manager / Lead – Purple Fabric

**Company:**
Intellect Design Arena Ltd.

**Business Unit:**
Purple Fabric (Enterprise AI Platform)

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Experience:**
12–15 years (indicative; can be calibrated based on role seniority)

**Role Type:**
Full-time

**Mode of Work:**
Work From Office (WFO) – 5 days a week.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly experienced
**AI Engineering Manager / Lead**
to drive the architecture, development, and delivery of enterprise-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for Purple Fabric, Intellect Design Arena’s enterprise AI platform.

The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on technical expertise in AI engineering with strong engineering leadership, capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, reliable, and production-ready AI solutions. The role will involve building AI-powered applications, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and enterprise integrations while driving engineering excellence, innovation, and delivery outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Engineering & Solution Development**

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI applications leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI architectures.
* Architect and implement multi-agent systems, intelligent workflows, tool calling, and autonomous task execution with appropriate human oversight.
* Build scalable RAG pipelines integrating enterprise data sources, knowledge repositories, vector databases, and semantic search capabilities.
* Develop reusable AI components, frameworks, APIs, and services to accelerate product engineering and solution delivery.
* Drive end-to-end AI application development, from proof of concept and experimentation to production deployment and continuous improvement.

**2. AI Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Define and implement scalable AI application architectures aligned with enterprise requirements for performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Evaluate and integrate LLMs, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, vector databases, and other AI technologies based on business and technical requirements.
* Design robust prompt engineering, context management, agent orchestration, memory, and model interaction strategies.
* Establish engineering standards and best practices for AI application development, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
* Drive architectural decisions related to model selection, latency, token consumption, inference costs, and scalability.

**3. Enterprise Integration & Platform Engineering**

* Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, knowledge systems, and existing technology ecosystems.
* Build secure, reusable microservices and APIs to support enterprise AI workflows.
* Collaborate with platform, cloud, DevOps, and security teams to establish reliable deployment and operational practices.
* Enable interoperability across AI models, tools, enterprise systems, and data sources.
* Contribute to reusable platform capabilities supporting Purple Fabric’s enterprise AI and decisioning use cases.

**4. AI Quality, Governance & Responsible AI**

* Establish evaluation frameworks to assess AI output quality, factual accuracy, groundedness, relevance, and reliability.
* Implement guardrails to address hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe outputs, data leakage, and unauthorised tool execution.
* Drive observability and monitoring for AI applications, including tracing, latency, token usage, cost, and failure analysis.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, privacy, access control, auditability, and responsible AI practices.
* Implement continuous evaluation and regression testing to maintain AI solution quality as models, prompts, and data evolve.

**5. Engineering Management & Delivery**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of AI engineers, software engineers, and other technical specialists.
* Own technical delivery, engineering quality, resource planning, prioritisation, and execution against agreed timelines.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving sessions.
* Establish engineering KPIs covering delivery predictability, code quality, production stability, performance, and productivity.
* Work closely with Product Management, Solution Architects, Presales, and business stakeholders to translate product requirements into engineering deliverables.
* Foster a culture of technical ownership, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* **AI / GenAI:**
  Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI, LLM-based application development, and production AI systems.
* **Agentic AI:**
  Experience designing agent-based applications, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, and workflow automation.
* **RAG:**
  Strong understanding of document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval optimisation, reranking, and grounded response generation.
* **Programming:**
  Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade applications, services, and APIs.
* **LLM Frameworks:**
  Practical experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies.
* **Model Ecosystem:**
  Experience working with commercial or open-source LLMs, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Llama-based models.
* **Data & Integration:**
  Experience with REST APIs, databases, data pipelines, enterprise integrations, and distributed systems.
* **Cloud & Deployment:**
  Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; containerisation and deployment using Docker and Kubernetes.
* **AI Evaluation & Security:**
  Experience with LLM evaluation, observability, prompt security, guardrails, and production monitoring.
* **Engineering Practices:**
  Strong knowledge of software architecture, CI/CD, automated testing, Git, code reviews, and production support.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building enterprise AI platforms, reusable AI frameworks, or AI products at scale.
* Exposure to financial services, banking, payments, lending, fraud detection, risk, or other regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience with model gateways, model routing, inference optimisation, caching, and cost management.
* Familiarity with enterprise knowledge management, identity and access management, data governance, and audit requirements.
* Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model lifecycle management, and AI application observability.
* Exposure to on-premises or private-cloud AI deployments and enterprise security constraints.
* Experience taking AI products from 0-to-1 development through production rollout and scaling.

**Leadership & Competencies**

* Strong technical ownership and the ability to make sound architecture and engineering decisions.
* Proven ability to lead engineering teams and deliver complex technology initiatives.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to balance experimentation and innovation with production reliability and delivery commitments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex AI concepts to engineering teams, product leaders, and business stakeholders.

**Success Measures**

* Successful delivery of scalable, production-ready enterprise AI capabilities.
* Improved reliability, quality, and performance of AI applications and agentic workflows.
* Reduced inference costs and latency through effective architecture and optimisation.
* Strong engineering quality, predictable delivery, and effective team development.
* Reusable AI components that accelerate product development and enterprise adoption.
* Compliance with enterprise security, governance, and responsible AI standards.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a hands-on AI engineering leader who has
**built and scaled production-grade GenAI or Agentic AI solutions**
, rather than someone whose experience is limited to traditional machine learning, data science, AI research, or integrating basic LLM APIs.

The candidate should demonstrate the ability to architect end-to-end AI systems, lead engineering teams, solve enterprise-scale technical challenges, and translate AI capabilities into secure, reliable, business-ready products.

title: E-Commerce Lead
description:

title: Lead Engineer Network Observability
description:
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Lead Network Engineer, Architect - Observability to own the strategy and architecture behind how we see, understand, and act on the health of our global network. This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who has spent a decade or more in network engineering and now wants to define how a large, multi-region network gets monitored, correlated, and made predictable rather than reactive.
  
  
You'll be the architect of our observability capability end to end, spanning monitoring platforms, telemetry, analytics, and the roadmap that ties it all to business outcomes like uptime, mean time to resolution, and cost avoidance.
  
  
**What You'll Do
  
  
Observability Strategy and Architecture**

* Own and advance a multi-year observability maturity roadmap for the global network
* Architect unified observability solutions spanning our monitoring platforms rather than siloed point tools
* Define predictive alerting and anomaly detection capabilities to move the organization from reactive to proactive
* Build observability use cases grounded in business goals, not just technical coverage
* Set observability best practices and standards used across regions
* Evaluate emerging observability and AIOps technologies and recommend where they fit

**Analytics and Cross-Tool Integration**

* Design analytics workflows that combine data from multiple sources, such as wire data, infrastructure metrics, and flow analysis, into a coherent picture of network health
* Build predictive capacity planning models using historical performance data
* Create executive-level dashboards that correlate network health with business outcomes
* Develop anomaly detection and behavioral baseline analytics
* Design correlation logic across tools to speed up root cause analysis
* Advance visualization strategy across our reporting platforms

**Strategic Planning and Business Value**

* Lead tool portfolio rationalization and cost optimization reviews
* Build business cases and ROI models for observability investments
* Quantify the business value of monitoring capabilities in terms leadership cares about, such as uptime, MTTR, and cost avoidance
* Lead proof of concept evaluations for new observability technologies
* Assess build versus buy decisions for observability platforms and capabilities

**Leadership and Collaboration**

* Serve as the senior technical voice on observability across the global network organization
* Partner with regional network teams to ensure observability standards are adopted consistently
* Work with the NOC to operationalize telemetry, health checks, and alerting so findings turn into action
* Present observability strategy, roadmap, and business impact to executive stakeholders

**What You'll Bring**

* 10-15+ years of network engineering experience, with significant time spent in observability, monitoring architecture, or network analytics
* Demonstrated experience architecting observability solutions across multiple platforms in a large, multi-site environment
* Strong background in network protocols and infrastructure (routing, switching, SD-WAN) sufficient to understand what's being monitored, not just how to monitor it
* Experience with monitoring and analytics platforms such as NetScout, DX NetOps, NetFlow, Grafana, and PowerBI, or direct equivalents
* Track record of building predictive or anomaly detection capabilities, not just dashboards
* Experience developing business cases, ROI models, and executive-level communication around infrastructure investment
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across regional teams and translate technical capability into business value
* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience

**Why This Role Matters**
A global network is only as manageable as it is visible. This role defines how we see problems before they become outages, how we prove the value of what we monitor, and how we turn raw telemetry into decisions leadership can act on.

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
**Role Summary**
The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable.
  
  
The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix — Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions — ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks.
  
  
The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation
  
  

* Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments.
* Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology.

**Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build**

* Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained.
* Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership.

**Integration and Data Engineering**

* Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

**DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management**

* Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management.
* Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control.
* Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles.

**Vendor and Managed Service Delivery**

* Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance.
* Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Alignment**

* Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability.
* Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums.

**Organisational Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8–10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources.
* Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality.

**Compliance, Risk and Governance**

* Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements.
* Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management.

**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications

title: Director of Engineering, Data Platforms
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
13
  
  
We are seeking a strong technical and people leader to join as
**Director of Engineering, Data Platforms**
for our offshore team in India. In this role, you will partner closely with the core Databricks team to support the transition of existing data pipelines to the target platform, while continuing to refine, enhance, and operationalize those pipelines for scale, quality, reliability, and secure cloud-native delivery on AWS. AWS data engineering practices commonly emphasize automated and orchestrated data flows, metadata-driven pipelines, and alignment to platform guardrails and security controls.
  
  
This leader will manage a small, focused engineering team responsible for supporting offshore platform adoption and enabling asset-agnostic data onboarding into the enterprise data platform. The role is execution-oriented and collaborative in nature, with accountability for high-quality delivery, engineering rigor, and consistent partnership with global stakeholders.
  
  
You will also support integrations with the enterprise data mastering platform to help ensure trusted, standardized, and reusable data flows across the ecosystem. Experience with
**NeoXam DataHub**
is a strong plus, particularly in environments where master, market, reference, risk, and investment data are managed across the full lifecycle—from acquisition through distribution—to create a trusted single source of truth.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who combines hands-on data platform depth with practical team leadership, strong cross-geography collaboration, and experience establishing repeatable cloud data engineering patterns across modern lakehouse and mastering ecosystems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery
  
  

* Partner with the core Databricks team to plan and execute the transition of existing data pipelines to the target data platform.
* Lead the offshore team in enhancing, stabilizing, and optimizing pipelines after transition, with a focus on performance, scalability, maintainability, operational excellence, and secure AWS deployment patterns.
* Drive implementation of repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring across onboarded datasets.
* Ensure pipelines are built and managed in a way that supports long-term platform consistency, reliability, observability, and ease of support.
* Guide the design and operation of cloud-native data pipelines leveraging relevant AWS services such as Amazon S3 for durable storage, AWS Glue for integration and catalog-driven processing, and AWS Lake Formation for governed data lake controls. AWS training and prescriptive guidance for data engineering emphasize building, optimizing, and securing solutions with these services.
* Promote the use of AWS IAM, encryption, and environment-level controls to enforce secure access to platform resources and data products in line with enterprise governance expectations. AWS guidance highlights alignment with architectural guardrails and security controls for data engineering platforms.

Data Onboarding and Asset-Agnostic Enablement
  
  

* Lead a small team responsible for supporting offshore teams with onboarding data to the enterprise platform in an asset-agnostic manner.
* Define and operationalize onboarding patterns that can support a broad range of data assets, domains, and source systems without requiring bespoke platform redesign for each use case.
* Work with partner teams to simplify and standardize how data is ingested, transformed, governed, and published to the platform.
* Help offshore teams adopt common onboarding frameworks, technical standards, and delivery practices that improve speed and reduce friction.
* Establish reusable ingestion and processing patterns across batch and streaming use cases using technologies such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon Kinesis, or event-driven integrations where appropriate to support scalable enterprise onboarding. AWS data engineering curricula and roadmap materials consistently position these services as core building blocks for modern cloud data engineering.

Data Mastering Platform Integration
  
  

* Support integration of platform pipelines and datasets with the enterprise data mastering platform.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream stakeholders to ensure mastered data can be consumed reliably through standardized interfaces and governed data flows.
* Help establish data quality controls, reconciliation processes, metadata alignment, and stewardship workflows needed to support trusted mastered data in the platform.
* Contribute to issue resolution and continuous improvement related to mastering-related ingestion and distribution workflows.
* Support data mastering capabilities aligned with platforms such as NeoXam DataHub, including data acquisition, cleansing, enrichment, mastering, and downstream distribution of trusted data products. NeoXam positions DataHub as a configurable enterprise data management platform for the financial industry that manages the full lifecycle of master, market, risk, and investment data.
* Work with business and platform stakeholders to support golden record / golden copy generation and maintenance for key financial datasets, including reference data, instruments, business entities, and related mastered domains. NeoXam DataHub is specifically positioned to provide a single source of truth and has been used in financial services environments for enterprise-level golden copy data management.

Team Leadership and Delivery Management
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a small team of data engineers supporting offshore onboarding and pipeline engineering.
* Set clear priorities, manage team execution, and ensure delivery commitments are met with quality and accountability.
* Provide day-to-day coaching, technical guidance, and performance feedback to team members.
* Foster a strong engineering culture centered on collaboration, continuous improvement, documentation, operational discipline, and measurable service ownership.
* Drive engineering rigor across sprint delivery, production readiness, support models, and incident management for business-critical data platforms.

Collaboration, Governance, and Engineering Standards
  
  

* Partner effectively with global platform, architecture, governance, and Databricks-aligned teams to ensure offshore delivery aligns with enterprise standards.
* Contribute to design reviews, implementation planning, and technical discussions related to pipeline architecture, onboarding patterns, cloud platform controls, and mastering integrations.
* Support governance requirements through appropriate controls around lineage, schema consistency, data quality, retention, and secure access.
* Promote adoption of engineering best practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and production support readiness.
* Help establish cloud engineering standards for infrastructure as code, release automation, and environment promotion using tools and services such as AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and infrastructure automation frameworks where appropriate.
* Ensure monitoring and operational health practices are in place using logging, alerting, and telemetry patterns appropriate for enterprise data platforms, including AWS-native operational tooling where relevant.

**Required Qualifications**
Leadership and Delivery Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related engineering domains.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, preferably in a distributed or offshore delivery model.
* Proven ability to lead a small, high-performing technical team in an execution-focused environment.
* Experience partnering with global or onshore stakeholders to deliver platform and pipeline initiatives across time zones.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with modern data engineering and pipeline development, including batch and/or streaming data workflows.
* Experience working with Databricks-based data platforms and supporting migration or transition of pipelines into a lakehouse-oriented architecture.
* Strong familiarity with AWS cloud-native data engineering, including services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Lake Formation, and related orchestration, security, and monitoring capabilities used to build scalable and governed data platforms. AWS training materials for data engineering specifically emphasize designing, building, optimizing, and securing data solutions using AWS services.
* Working knowledge of technologies and concepts referenced in the source profile, such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Databricks Unity Catalog, with the ability to apply them in practical engineering delivery contexts.
* Experience supporting data integration patterns involving mastering, MDM, or trusted data distribution workflows.
* Solid understanding of data quality, schema management, lineage, metadata, access control, and operational support for production data pipelines.
* Experience with AWS IAM, data lake governance, and metadata-driven controls to support secure, policy-aligned platform operations. AWS prescriptive guidance highlights the use of metadata automation, platform guardrails, and security controls in enterprise data engineering.
* Familiarity with engineering best practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and monitoring.
* Experience designing or overseeing data platform observability and reliability practices, including alerting, monitoring, and operational dashboards.

Collaboration and Execution
  
  

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across offshore and global teams.
* Ability to translate broader architectural direction into actionable team deliverables and implementation plans.
* Comfortable operating in a role that blends technical leadership, people management, and hands-on delivery oversight.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting enterprise data onboarding frameworks across multiple business domains or asset types.
* Familiarity with enterprise data cataloging or metadata management environments, including integrations involving operational and business metadata platforms.
* Exposure to data mastering, MDM, reference data, market data, investment data, corporate actions, or golden record workflows in financial services environments.
* Knowledge of NeoXam DataHub is a strong plus, particularly for firms using it to centralize financial data, manage the data lifecycle from acquisition to distribution, enable automated workflows, and deliver a single source of truth for mastered datasets.
* Experience with NeoXam-style mastering workflows, including consolidation, cleansing, enrichment, reconciliation, and trusted downstream distribution of mastered data.
* Experience in regulated or complex enterprise environments where data governance, data controls, and auditability requirements are important.
* Databricks certifications, AWS certifications (such as AWS Certified Data Engineer or AWS Certified Solutions Architect), or equivalent practical platform experience are a plus. AWS certification paths remain relevant for modern cloud-native data engineering roles.

title: Application Support Engineering Associate Director
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
  
  
Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
  
  
The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
  
  
**Pay And Benefits**

* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
The Enterprise Application Support (EAS) team is responsible for providing technical application support for ITP and ECS lines of business. Within EAS, the Associate Director Application Support Engineering / SRE Lead (Site Reliability Engineer Lead) is a senior technical role responsible for driving the overall reliability, scalability, and performance of critical systems by implementing standard methodologies, participating in incident response, automating processes, and collaborating with development teams to ensure system stability and uptime across the organization, often acting as a technical partner in promoting a strong SRE culture within the company; key responsibilities include designing monitoring systems, capacity planning, and actively identifying and mitigating potential issues before they impact users.
  
  
The SRE team works closely with development teams, infrastructure and network partners, security partners, Scrum Masters, and internal / external clients to improve observability, operational supportability, resiliency, and mean time to restore service through driving improvements to support capabilities.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities**

* Scrum Participation: Join all project collaborators planning and design sessions, sprint zero and stand-ups for all new delivery, to champion SRE requirements reflective of a strong observability and resiliency traits.
* System Reliability Architecture: Drive Design and help implement reliable, resilient, and scalable systems, considering redundancy, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery strategies. Make design recommendations that will allow the application to recover without cleanup activities or create a recovery runbook for application support team to follow for improved application recovery times.
* Monitoring and Alerting: Develop comprehensive monitoring systems to identify potential issues proactively, define actionable alerts, and establish SLIs (Service Level Indicators) and SLOs (Service Level Objectives).
* Incident Management: Lead incident response during critical system outages, facilitating timely problem diagnosis and resolution, conducting post-mortem analysis to identify root causes and prevent future occurrences.
* Automation and Tooling: Develop and maintain automation scripts to streamline operational tasks, including self-healing, application deployments, scaling, and infrastructure management.
* Collaboration with Development Teams: Work closely with development teams to integrate SRE practices into the software development lifecycle, promoting code quality, reliability, and observability.
* Security Integration: Collaborate with security teams to ensure system resilience against cyber threats, implementing security best practices and supervising for vulnerabilities.
* Technical Expertise: Stay updated on emerging technologies and industry trends related to cloud computing, distributed systems, and reliability engineering.
* Operational Readiness: Attend and present operational readiness with application support (EAS L2) at each project management meeting - raise any operational risks and concerns. Test SRE requirements in UAT environments to validate effectiveness and completeness of operational capabilities.
* Risk Management: Partner with IT Embedded Risk Managers to identify strategic solutions for risk incidents.
* Metrics and Reporting: Demonstrate operational improvements through defined KPIs.
* Capacity Planning: Proactively assess system capacity needs, plan for future growth, and implement scaling strategies to ensure optimal performance under high load.
* Performance Optimization: Analyze system performance metrics to identify bottlenecks and implement optimization strategies to improve system responsiveness and efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 8 years of related experience
* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent experience

**Talents Needed For Success**

* Strong Programming Skills: Proficiency in one or more programming languages like Python, Java, Go, etc. including the use of AI technology (Amazon Q, Kiro), for automation and development of monitoring and SRE compliance validation tools.
* System Administration: Expertise in Linux/Unix operating systems, network administration, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Mainframe experience is a plus.
* Monitoring and Observability: Deep understanding of monitoring tools (Splunk, Grafana, Dynatrace, ITSI, etc.) and experience in designing robust monitoring systems.
* Incident Management: Proven track record to participate in incident response teams under pressure, effectively solving complex issues.
* Experience in the financial services industry is good to have

Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: SAP C-ALM
description:
**Position Executive Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Lead SAP Cloud ALM & Enterprise Toolchain Architect**
to define, govern, and operationalize the complete Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) strategy for our global Greenfield SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
  
  
Acting as the single point of accountability for SAP Cloud ALM adoption across all global regions and workstreams, the ideal candidate will establish cross-functional governance, build end-to-end lifecycle traceability, integrate enterprise toolchains, and drive quality engineering across all phases of the SAP Activate framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Core Governance**
  
  

* Cloud ALM Strategy & Governance
* Strategy Definition: Formulate and execute a comprehensive Cloud ALM strategy aligned with SAP Activate methodology across all global rollout templates.
* Governance Framework: Establish and enforce ALM governance standards across requirements gathering, business process hierarchy modeling, testing execution, defect management, deployment controls, and operations.
* Single Accountability: Serve as the central point of contact and accountability for Cloud ALM adoption across global regions, system integrators, and project workstreams.
* Enterprise Toolchain Integration & Traceability
* Toolchain Management: Architect and manage data flows across the integrated ALM toolchain, connecting SAP Cloud ALM with enterprise architecture, modeling, testing, and operational tools.
* End-to-End Lineage: Maintain complete vertical and horizontal traceability across the lifecycle: Business Scope → Process Design → Requirements/User Stories → Development Units → Test Cases → Defects → Transports/Deployments.
* Integration Engineering: Design and implement robust integration and real-time data synchronization between SAP Cloud ALM and enterprise solutions, including:

+ Process Modeling: Signavio
+ Architecture & Capability Mapping: LeanIX
+ Work Management & ITSM: Jira / ServiceNow
+ Test Management: Tricentis, HP ALM, or equivalent
+ Documentation Systems: Confluence, SharePoint

* Solution Enablement & Fit-to-Standard Execution
* Cloud ALM Configuration: Setup and configure SAP Cloud ALM for:

+ Business process hierarchy structure and solution documentation
+ Requirement, scope, and user story management
+ Test planning, script execution, and defect tracking
+ Task management and deployment tracking

* Fit-to-Standard Governance: Enable and support Fit-to-Standard workshops using standard SAP Best Practices content and Cloud ALM pre-delivered scope elements.
* Program Visibility: Design and maintain project scope baselines, milestone tracking, and real-time status dashboards for executive program leadership.
* Test Quality Management
* Test Strategy Formulation: Design and govern the program-wide testing framework (Unit Testing, System Integration Testing [SIT], User Acceptance Testing [UAT], and Regression Testing) inside SAP Cloud ALM.
* Multi-Regional Execution: Coordinate test execution across multi-regional teams, third-party system integrators, and varying time zones.
* Quality KPIs: Provide executive-level reporting on test coverage, defect burn-down rates, quality KPIs, and release readiness dashboards.
* Release, Deployment & Cutover Management
* Release Orchestration: Oversee release planning, deployment tracking, and release governance using Cloud ALM.
* CI/CD & Transport Integration: Connect Cloud ALM with SAP Transport Management and modern CI/CD delivery pipelines where applicable.
* Cutover Execution: Support cutover sequence planning, dependency mapping, and real-time deployment monitoring.
* Integration & Operations Readiness (Run / Hypercare Phase)
* Monitoring Setup: Configure operational monitoring within Cloud ALM, including:

+ Integration & Exception Monitoring
+ Business Process Monitoring
+ Automated Job Monitoring

* Operational Transition: Lead the transition of ALM artifacts from the project phase to Hypercare and steady-state operations (Run phase).
* Alerting & KPIs: Establish operational KPIs, threshold alerts, and health monitoring for steady-state governance.
* Stakeholder Leadership & Vendor Coaching
* Subject Matter Expert (SME): Act as the lead SME for the Program Management Office (PMO), System Integrator partners, SAP, and regional business leaders.
* Enablement & Upskilling: Coach and upskill project team members, functional leads, and regional business units on Cloud ALM best practices and standardized tool usage.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
SAP ALM & Program Expertise
  
  

* 7–10+ years of hands-on SAP implementation experience within large-scale enterprise environments.
* 3+ years direct experience configuring and leading SAP Cloud ALM (or SAP Solution Manager with a proven track record of Cloud ALM transition).
* Strong, practical knowledge of SAP Activate methodology across all project phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
* Proven experience in Greenfield SAP S/4HANA global implementations.

Functional & Technical Knowledge
  
  

* Solid comprehension of core SAP S/4HANA business processes (e.g., Finance, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Logistics).
* Hands-on familiarity with SAP Best Practices content and enterprise process models.
* Working knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g., Tricentis, CBTA).
* Familiarity with SAP integration technologies (SAP BTP, Cloud Integration / CPI) and SAP transport management concepts.

Leadership & Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven track record in stakeholder management within complex, multi-vendor, global environments.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across global teams, time zones, and diverse organizational cultures.
* Highly organized, structured, quality-focused, and proactive mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications (nice To Have)**

* Official SAP Cloud ALM Certification.
* Prior experience in large-scale rollouts (multi-country, multi-template architectures).
* Exposure to modern DevOps principles and CI/CD pipelines within SAP enterprise landscapes.
* Prior experience in roles such as Enterprise ALM Lead, QA Lead, or Test Manager.
