title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable.

The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix — Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions — ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks.

The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations.  
  
**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**  
**Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation**

* Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments.
* Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology.

**Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build**

* Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained.
* Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership.

**Integration and Data Engineering**

* Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

**DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management**

* Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management.
* Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control.
* Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles.

**Vendor and Managed Service Delivery**

* Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance.
* Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Alignment**

* Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability.
* Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums.

**Organisational Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8–10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources.
* Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality.

**Compliance, Risk and Governance**

* Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements.
* Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management.

**QUALIFICATIONS**  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application.
* Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies.
* Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline.
* Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management.
* Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred.
* Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness
* Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context.
* Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon).
* Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions.
* Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes.
* Recognised cloud or architecture certification.

**PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS**

Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work.  
  
**NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS**

Occasional travel up to 20%

Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare.  
  
**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**  
Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead.

Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation.

External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners.  
  
**RESOURCES MANAGED**  
**Financial Accountability**

Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation  
**Supervision**

Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects,integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleague's leadership.

  
Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

title: SFDC Architect
description:
We are seeking an experienced **Salesforce Solution Architect** with 10+ years of experience to lead the design, development, and evolution of enterprise Salesforce solutions supporting global B2B and B2C business operations.The ideal candidate will combine strong solution architecture capabilities with hands-on Salesforce technical expertise. The role requires someone who can translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions, guide development teams, make sound architectural decisions, and write or debug code when required.The architect will work across multiple Salesforce applications, external enterprise systems, country-specific business processes, and cross-functional technology teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and long-term business objectives.**Key Responsibilities1. Solution Architecture and Design**

* Own end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture, from requirements discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and production support.
* Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce architectures, technical designs, data models, integration patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
* Evaluate standard Salesforce capabilities, configuration, declarative automation, custom development, and external services to recommend the most appropriate solution.
* Define architectural standards, reusable components, coding guidelines, design patterns, and technical best practices.
* Assess the impact of proposed changes on existing applications, integrations, business processes, and future enhancements.
* Identify technical risks, scalability constraints, platform limitations, and opportunities for simplification.

**2. Hands-on Salesforce Development**

* Write, review, debug, and optimize Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and other Salesforce customizations when required.
* Develop proof-of-concepts and technical prototypes to validate architectural decisions and resolve complex technical challenges.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of Apex triggers, asynchronous processing, Batch Apex, Queueable Apex, platform events, transaction management, and governor limits.
* Ensure code follows bulkification, security, exception-handling, testability, and performance best practices.
* Review complex implementations and guide developers in resolving technical issues.
* Participate directly in critical development activities, production troubleshooting, and performance optimization when necessary.

**3. Salesforce Data Modeling and Governance**

* Design scalable Salesforce data models using standard and custom objects, appropriate relationships, and well-defined ownership and sharing strategies.
* Define data mastership, external identifiers, deduplication, matching, data migration, and reconciliation approaches.
* Design data models that support global customer identities, B2B relationships, B2C customer journeys, and country-specific business requirements.
* Ensure appropriate data access, privacy, auditability, and regulatory considerations are incorporated into the architecture.

**4. Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern integrations between Salesforce and enterprise platforms such as SAP, customer portals, identity providers, middleware, and marketing platforms.
* Define suitable integration patterns using REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, and middleware where appropriate.
* Address authentication, authorization, idempotency, retries, error handling, monitoring, reconciliation, and integration resilience.
* Collaborate with enterprise integration and platform teams to manage dependencies, API contracts, release sequencing, and system-wide changes.

**5. Global Platform and Release Governance**

* Support a global Salesforce platform operating across multiple countries and business markets.
* Balance global architecture standards with legitimate local business and regulatory requirements.
* Evaluate the impact of changes across countries, applications, integrations, and downstream systems before approving designs.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, development teams, QA, DevOps, security, and platform teams to ensure controlled delivery.
* Contribute to release planning, technical risk assessments, environment strategy, deployment readiness, and production stability.
* Prevent unnecessary customization and architectural fragmentation across markets.

**6. Technical Leadership and Team Enablement**

* Provide technical direction and architectural guidance to Salesforce developers, technical leads, QA engineers, and integration teams.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, design walkthroughs, and technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Establish development standards and reusable patterns that improve code quality, maintainability, and developer productivity.
* Mentor team members and support technical decision-making across distributed teams.
* Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

**7. Platform Evolution and Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, technical fit, and platform strategy.
* Identify opportunities to improve performance, reduce technical debt, simplify integrations, and optimize delivery costs.
* Contribute to Salesforce platform roadmaps and long-term architecture decisions.
* Support production incident analysis and implement sustainable solutions that prevent recurring issues.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* Hands-on experience with Apex, Triggers, LWC, SOQL, Salesforce security, and declarative automation.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling, sharing and visibility, governor limits, transaction boundaries, and platform architecture.
* Experience designing enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and asynchronous or event-driven patterns.
* Understanding of integration resilience, error handling, monitoring, data reconciliation, and API security.
* Experience with Salesforce deployments, source control, CI/CD, and release management.
* Familiarity with enterprise identity and access management, SSO, OAuth, and external identity solutions.
* Ability to diagnose complex technical issues and validate architectural decisions through working code or prototypes.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and customer engagement integrations.
* Exposure to Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud.
* Experience with SAP or other ERP integrations.
* Experience with middleware and integration platforms such as MuleSoft, SnapLogic, Informatica, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with multi-country Salesforce implementations and global platform governance.
* Experience with Experience Cloud portals, external users, customer identity, and large-scale customer data management.
* Familiarity with consent management, customer data privacy, and market-specific regulatory requirements.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Typically 10+ years of Salesforce or relevant enterprise CRM experience.
* Demonstrated experience owning solution architecture for complex Salesforce implementations.
* Proven experience leading technical teams and collaborating across business and technology functions.
* Salesforce Application Architect certification preferred; System Architect or relevant advanced certifications are an advantage.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.

**Success Criteria**The successful candidate will be expected to:

* Deliver scalable and maintainable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
* Make defensible design decisions with clear consideration of alternatives, risks, and trade-offs.
* Independently validate critical technical designs through code, prototypes, debugging, and code reviews.
* Minimize regression risk across existing systems, integrations, and country implementations.
* Improve engineering standards and enable development teams to deliver consistently.
* Maintain a balance between architectural leadership and hands-on technical contribution.

**Role Expectation**This is an architecture-led role with hands-on technical responsibilities. The candidate is not expected to spend every day implementing features, but must be capable of independently writing and debugging Apex and related Salesforce code when complex technical challenges, critical issues, or architectural validation require it.

Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹4,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

description:

About this opportunity:

We are seeking a Cloud Architect to design, define, and govern cloud-native infrastructure for SD SL core network deployments. The role covers the cloud platform that hosts 5G and 4G core network functions, including Cloud Network Functions (CNFs), and ensures they meet performance, availability, security, and operational requirements. The architect works across network, cloud, and delivery teams to move solutions from design through deployment and into operation.

What will you do:

* Define cloud platform architecture for CNF hosting, covering Kubernetes-based and NFV-based deployments as applicable.

* Understanding of 4G/5G core network architecture, including EPC and 5GC network functions and their interfaces.

* Experience working in multi-vendor environments and with customer-facing governance processes.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Location: Chennai | Type: Fulltime**

**About Newpage Solutions**

  

Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organisations which include, pharmaceutical, biotech and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges.

From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices.

We are proud to be a ‘Great Place to Work®’ certified company for the last three consecutive years. We also hold a top Glassdoor rating and are named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. As an organisation, we foster creativity, continuous learning and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people’s lives.

**Your Mission**

We are hiring Forward Deployed Engineers who treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built—not a tool to be cautious of, not something they are "exploring," but the medium they work in.

You will sit close to clients and product leaders, reframe vague problems into something concrete, and ship working software end-to-end. You won't wait for a refined backlog, a PM in the middle, or a separate platform team. You will shape the idea, build the thing, and stand it up in production yourself.

This is a builder-first individual-contributor role for engineers who live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.

**What You’ll Do**

**Problem / Opportunity Discovery**

* Sit with a business or clinical leader and reframe an idea or problem into something concrete and buildable.
* Know what to build by the end of the conversation; have a working prototype to react to by the end of the week.
* Partner closely with product, design, and client stakeholders to translate ambiguous ideas into software that ships.
* Demo live without a slide deck. Reframe problems out loud. Don't get stuck waiting for someone else to make the decision.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and internal research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques.

**Build (fast) with AI**

* When the brief is clear, head down and produce.
* Build modular backends in Python or TypeScript aligned with clean architecture, OOP, SOLID, and domain-driven design.
* Create fullstack applications, APIs, agents, workflows, and similar systems using frameworks such as Next.js, React, FastAPI, Fastify, FastMCP, and Hono.
* Architect and ship production-grade agentic applications using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration layer.
* Integrate frontier and self-hosted LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, open-weight models) with tools, data, and external systems through MCP and custom connectors.
* Apply RAG techniques where they actually help: vector databases (Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, pgvector), hybrid retrieval with ElasticSearch or Solr, and BM25 + similarity search.
* Work across relational, document, key-value, and graph stores as the problem demands; use event-driven patterns where they fit, not by default.
* Design prompt and context engineering frameworks that optimize accuracy, repeatability, cost, and latency.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codex) through structured workflows, native instructions, templates, and sub-agents—with discipline and review.
* Fine-tune or adapt models where the problem genuinely calls for it.

**Test, Deploy, Productionize**

* Spin up the infra, write the evals, wire up the MCP servers, deploy the agents, and harden the bits that survive contact with real users.
* Deploy on AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) or serverless—chosen for fit, not preference.
* Treat evals as a first-class discipline: hands-on harnesses, not theoretical frameworks. Build with a clear-eyed view of where current AI tooling helps and where it falls short.
* Apply engineering practices that hold up in production: TDD, secrets management and rotation, SAST/DAST, structured logging, metrics, tracing, and automated CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
* Own what you build end-to-end, including the infrastructure and operations that keep it running.
* Mentor others on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering best practices.

  

**What You Bring**

* 3+ years relevant experience building production applications using AI / agentic development approaches—fullstack applications, agents, workflows, MCPs, and more.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models. You have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and innovative approaches.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You've built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* End-to-end implementation experience with vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and eval harnesses.
* Cloud-native deployment experience across at least one of AWS, Azure, Cloudflare, or Vercel—with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A deep working understanding of how LLMs behave—and where they break—and how to optimize accuracy, latency, and cost.
* Clear writing and a willingness to reframe problems in conversation rather than wait for someone else to define them.
* A real, recent trail of built things: GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* MLOps and model serving experience (BentoML, MLflow, Vertex AI, SageMaker).

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

Seeking a visionary and hands-on Innovation Lead to drive the design, prototyping, and delivery of next-generation solutions across the organization. This leader will identify emerging technologies—particularly in Artificial Intelligence / Generative AI, cloud (AWS), and data platforms—and translate them into production-grade capabilities built on a strong .NET/Java engineering foundation. + Compute: Lambda, ECS/EKS, EC2

* Modernize legacy applications and migrate workloads to cloud-native architectures.

+ CI/CD and deployment automation
+ Testing (UI, API, end-to-end) using Playwright
+ Infrastructure provisioning and teardown
+ Data generation and environment setup

* Create configurable mock services, simulators, and stubs for third-party dependencies to enable independent development and testing (success/failure scenarios, timeouts, latency, rate limiting, auth failures, edge cases).

DevOps & Observability
  
  

* Champion DevOps culture—containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), automation, and continuous delivery.
* Implement monitoring, logging, tracing, and diagnostics for applications and infrastructure.
* Drive reliability, scalability, security, and execution speed across platforms.

Leadership & Collaboration
  
  

* Mentor and technically lead cross-functional engineering teams.
* Partner with product, business, and leadership stakeholders to align innovation with strategic goals.
* Communicate complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Evangelize best practices, reusable assets, and a culture of continuous learning.

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on experience with Generative AI / LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI).
* Experience with RAG, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases, and model evaluation.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks and MLOps concepts.

Programming & Application Development

AWS & Cloud Infrastructure

Databases & Data

Automation & DevOps

title: Manager, Cloud Infrastructure
description:
If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Manager, Cloud Infrastructure is a hands-on leader responsible for the reliability, resilience, performance, operational discipline, cost management, and continuous improvement of Nationwide’s cloud infrastructure and AI platform capabilities in India. This role leads cloud infrastructure and AI platform engineering work while partnering closely with Core Infrastructure, Security, Architecture, Application, Data, and business teams.
  
  
The successful candidate combines strong cloud and infrastructure judgment with an optimistic, people-centered leadership style. They will be visible in the work, comfortable engaging at both strategic and technical levels, and passionate about developing, coaching, and recognizing people so the organization builds durable cloud capability for the future.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead day-to-day delivery and operational performance across cloud infrastructure and AI platform capabilities.
* Liaise and coordinate with Nationwide US leadership team and frontline staff.
* Establish clear priorities, service expectations, ownership models, and escalation paths across participating teams.
* Maintain a strong focus on availability, resilience, performance, scalability, recoverability, security, and compliance.
* Provide hands-on leadership during complex cloud incidents, problem investigations, major changes, migrations, and service-improvement initiatives.
* Drive standardization, automation, infrastructure as code, platform enablement, lifecycle management, and reduction of operational toil.
* Partner with architecture and engineering leaders to shape practical, scalable cloud road maps and adoption patterns.
* Build disciplined practices for monitoring, observability, configuration management, patching, vulnerability remediation, disaster recovery, landing-zone governance, and technical debt reduction.
* Strengthen FinOps practices by improving cloud cost transparency, forecasting, demand management, utilization, tagging, chargeback or showback, and accountability across cloud services.
* Promote secure-by-default, resilient-by-design, and repeatable cloud engineering patterns.
* Coordinate dependencies across Cloud, Core Infrastructure, Security, Network, Data, Applications, and enterprise architecture to deliver integrated outcomes.
* Develop trusted relationships with internal partners, cloud providers, vendors, and service providers.
* Translate business needs into clear technical priorities, delivery plans, risks, and decisions for senior leadership.
* Ensure cloud processes and technical solutions support Nationwide’s risk-management, governance, and audit expectations.

**People leadership expectations**

* Create a positive, inclusive, and accountable team environment.
* Coach individuals through regular feedback, career conversations, mentoring, and meaningful development opportunities.
* Build a strong bench of cloud and platform talent through delegation, stretch assignments, knowledge sharing, and succession planning.
* Recognize contributions and reinforce behaviors that improve customer outcomes, teamwork, and reliability.
* Lead through change with transparency, empathy, consistency, and a bias toward constructive problem solving.
* Encourage healthy challenge, learning from incidents, and continuous improvement without blame.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Significant experience leading cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or cloud operations teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated experience designing, operating, or modernizing cloud infrastructure and platform services at enterprise scale.
* Experience leading critical incidents, operational reviews, service improvements, migrations, and cross-functional delivery.
* Strong understanding of cloud reliability, security, resilience, capacity, performance, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to coach and develop technical professionals and first-line leaders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical issues to senior and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with distributed teams, external partners, and global operating models.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a regulated, highly available, or financial-services environment.
* Experience with infrastructure as code, containers, platform engineering, observability, DevSecOps, and modern operational practices.
* Experience with cloud landing zones, identity and access management, network architecture, resiliency patterns, and disaster recovery.
* Experience managing budgets, vendor relationships, cloud-provider relationships, service providers, and technology road maps.
* Experience establishing or improving FinOps, IT service management, or reliability engineering practices.

**Leadership profile**
We are seeking a leader who is technically credible, calm under pressure, optimistic, collaborative, and committed to making the people and the platform better every day. The right candidate brings energy to difficult problems, stays close enough to the work to understand reality, and creates an environment where people can do their best work.
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technological solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!
  
  
The Technology Engineering Manager manages a team of infrastructure engineers who analyse, design, develop and implement hardware/software. You’ll determine hardware/software systems requirements; lead systems hardware/software design; plan projects; and establish priorities. You’ll also coordinate with other managers to integrate projects with other systems hardware/software. As a people leader, you have responsibility for project deployment, career development, performance management and pay determination. You also may have the opportunity to mentor associates on other teams.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manages a team that delivers on build and operational components for the product(s) aligned to a technology area, such as but not limited to, consulting, managing and development of new products, upgrade/patching efforts, annual budgeting, efficiency efforts, etc. and the function responsible for driving a competitive unit cost through efficient product lifecycle.
* Responsible for applying secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities.
* Leads a team accountable for product delivery and the first line of defense for risk and security management.
* Assigns and allocates roles, in partnership with the Technology Product Executive, based on capacity and demand (finance, marketing, etc.).
* Responsible for the design, development, modification and implementation of products and processes to aid in the overall product lifecycle and operational metrics.
* Manages a team who is accountable for product management across platforms (on-premises, off-premises and across premises) by providing engineering support for products/processes to improve productivity and reduce cost.
* Demonstrates user empathy by partnering with user advocates to understand and incorporate user sentiment.
* Understands and manages team skill maturity in context of effective product management.
* Oversee vendor management/relationships and sourcing, in collaboration with Technology Product Manager.
* Drives release cadence and business feature alignment leveraging automation to drive speed and actively drives continuous process improvement activities including Lean, process/product innovation, quality, cost reduction and other initiatives.
* Leads people through guidance and support on the execution of work; management of associates including but not limited to performance management, salary planning, training, development, workforce planning, hiring, and disciplinary actions; and attracts, hires, engages and develops the team through impactful recruitment, coaching and feedback.
* Participates in strategic initiatives/planning for core products including products that cross Technologies.
* Develops and manages project budgets and deployment, including training and development of personnel.

**Qualifications & Experience**
May perform other responsibilities as assigned.
  
  
**Education**
Undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, mathematics, or related field is strongly preferred.
  
  
**Experience**
Eight years knowledge of operational management concepts and techniques. Experience leading multiple teams and assets across various technology platforms. Three years of management experience is preferred. Experience with concepts and solutions: IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and package solutions.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Business Acumen
* Business Strategies
* Computer Science
* Financial Management
* IT Infrastructure
* Technical Acumen
* Vendor Management
* Technology Strategies

**Soft Skills & Attributes**

* Strong communication skills
* Ability to influence, negotiate, and set priorities
* Mentoring and coaching abilities to guide associates
* Identifying and removing blockers to progress
* Ability to work in agile and global environments
* Insurance/financial services industry knowledge a plus
* Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence

**Additional Information**
**Reporting Structure:**
Reports to Technology Executive – India
  
  
**Working Hours**
Aligned to India business hours with flexibility for global collaboration.
  
  
**Location Flexibility:**
[Hybrid/Remote/In-office] with periodic in-office collaboration.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Statement**
Nationwide is committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, gender, disability, religion, or other protected categories.

description:

**Company: Template.net**

**Location: Hyderabad, India**

**Employment Type: Full-Time | On-Site**

**About Template.net**

Template.net is an AI-native creation platform used by more than 4 million people worldwide every month.

We are building the next generation of AI-powered creation tools, where users simply describe what they need, and AI turns their ideas into finished, editable designs, videos, and documents—all in one place, from prompt to ready-to-use content in minutes.

We are a global product and technology company building scalable, high-performance AI products for users worldwide.

**About the Role**

We're looking for a hands-on Technical Lead / Engineering Lead who can own engineering end-to-end—from system architecture and writing production code to deployment, scaling, and production reliability.

This is not a management-only role. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys coding, solving complex technical challenges, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building high-performing engineering teams.

You'll work closely with Product to build, launch, and scale AI-powered applications used by millions of people worldwide.

**What You'll Do**

* Own end-to-end engineering: Lead system architecture, technical design, development, deployment, scaling, and production operations.
* Stay hands-on with coding: Actively write, review, debug, and ship production code while guiding the engineering team.
* Design scalable systems: Build reliable, high-performance applications using modern backend architectures, databases, APIs, caching, queues, and asynchronous processing.

* Own production reliability: Drive CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, security, performance optimization, and incident resolution.
* Accelerate engineering delivery: Leverage AI-assisted coding tools, automation, and modern development practices to ship high-quality software faster.
* Build and mentor the team: Hire, develop, and lead engineers while establishing strong engineering standards and a culture of ownership.
* Ship products quickly: Collaborate closely with Product to turn ideas into working software, launch features rapidly, and continuously improve them.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of software engineering experience, with proven hands-on coding skills and technical leadership.
* Engineer first, leader second: Someone who enjoys writing code, solving complex technical problems, and leading by example—not just managing people.
* Strong backend or full-stack expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, React, SQL, or comparable technologies.
* Deep understanding of system architecture, distributed systems, databases, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and scalable application design.
* End-to-end product engineering experience: Proven ability to independently design, build, deploy, scale, and troubleshoot production applications.
* Practical AI/GenAI experience: Experience integrating LLM APIs and building AI-powered applications. Exposure to image, video, or audio generation is an advantage.
* Strong production engineering skills in performance optimization, security, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and reliability.
* Experience leading and mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, making architectural decisions, and building high-performing teams.
* AI-first development mindset: Comfortable using AI coding tools, automation, and modern engineering workflows to accelerate development.
* Strong ownership and product thinking: Able to make pragmatic technical decisions, move quickly, avoid unnecessary complexity, and deliver reliable products that create real customer value.

**Why Join Template.net?**

* Build cutting-edge AI products used by millions of people worldwide.
* Work on challenging engineering problems across generative AI, image, video, documents, and design.
* Take real ownership of technical architecture, engineering decisions, and product delivery.
* Build and lead a talented engineering team while continuing to write production code.
* Work in a fast-moving, product-focused environment where your contributions have a direct impact.

* We're looking for a builder who leads by example—someone who can take a problem, design the solution, write the code, ship it to production

* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.
* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
We are looking for a Technical Team Lead (Engineering Manager) who exhibits a player-coach and servant leadership mentality to lead a highly autonomous, multidisciplinary team of AI software developers. You will act as the defining engineering voice serving as the bridge between ambitious business goals and the technical reality of building scalable, ethical, and high-impact AI solutions within a highly regulated healthcare environment. You will collaborate with AI Product Managers, consultants, subject matter experts, platforms leadership and engineers, Roche Digital Technology (Roche IT) and business stakeholders to define, build and operate various kinds of AI solutions, driven by generative AI, agentic and classical Machine Learning.
  
  
In this role, you must successfully balance being on the manager's- and maker's-schedule. You will likely step away from daily feature coding to guide system architecture and perform rigorous code reviews, while simultaneously providing empathetic people management necessary to cultivate a high-performing engineering squad.
  
  
**Description Of The Area**
At Roche Digital Technology, we are advancing the boundaries of Applied AI. The Applied AI Engineering Team focuses on architecting, building, and operating high-value AI solutions to solve complex business challenges in healthcare.
  
  
In the 2026 tech landscape, we operate in small agile teams (e.g. ~8 members) powered by advanced coding agents (like Claude Code) to develop and ship solutions faster than ever before (through applying Agentic SDLC). title: Software/Platform Engineer II
description:
**Senior Site Reliability Engineer – Data Platforms (Azure)**
**About The Role**
Our Data Platforms team builds and runs the cloud foundation that data products depend on. We are looking for a Senior SRE to help keep our Azure platform reliable, secure, and fully automated. You will work with engineers across teams. You will write code, not just run systems, and you will help set the standard for how we build and operate.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design, build, and run Azure infrastructure for our data platform, following the Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and landing zone principles.
* Write and maintain Infrastructure as Code with Terraform. This includes reusable modules, remote state, and safe, tested changes.
* Build and improve CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) for infrastructure and platform releases.
* Define SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets with product and engineering teams.
* Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Grafana or similar) so issues are found early.
* Lead incident response and write blameless post-incident reviews. Follow up until the fixes are done.
* Automate repetitive work to reduce manual effort.
* Work with security and governance teams so the platform meets policy, using Azure Policy, RBAC, and guardrails.
* Mentor engineers and share good practices across the team.

**What You Bring**

* 6–9 years in SRE, DevOps, or cloud engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (networking, identity, storage, compute, and governance).
* Good working knowledge of CAF and Azure landing zones.
* Strong Terraform skills, with proven delivery of production IaC.
* Solid DevOps practices: Git workflows, CI/CD, and automated testing.
* Scripting or coding skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Good understanding of observability, incident management, and capacity planning.
* Clear communication and a habit of working well with others.

**Nice to have**

* Hands-on experience with Azure Log Analytics and writing KQL queries for troubleshooting, dashboards, and alerts.
* Experience with data services such as Azure Databricks, Data Factory, Synapse, or Data Lake.
* Kubernetes (AKS) and containers.
* Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-400, or AZ-305, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
* Experience in a regulated industry, such as financial services or insurance.

**Why join us**
You will work on a platform that matters, with real ownership and room to shape how we do things. We value learning, automation, and a healthy on-call culture.

title: Senior Staff Solution Architect
description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
ServiceNow is seeking a Sr Staff Solution Architect to lead the design and delivery of scalable, intelligent, and high-impact solutions across the Connected Customer Experience portfolio. This is a senior-level, hands-on architecture role focused on enabling seamless digital workflows, integrating platform capabilities with AI/ML and data-driven insights, and ensuring technical excellence across customer-facing applications.
  
  
You will work at the intersection of product, engineering, platform, data, and AI teams to architect solutions that enhance user experience, deliver personalized customer journeys, and drive measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in enterprise SaaS architecture, CRM systems, solution design, AI/ML integration, and data platform engineering within Digital Technology (DT) environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Solution Architecture & Design**

* Architect scalable, secure, and compliant end-to-end solutions integrating platform capabilities with intelligent data-driven features across customer experience applications.
* Define architecture patterns for workflows, integrations, platform extensions, and API-driven services that extend ServiceNow capabilities while ensuring alignment with security and platform standards.
* Lead evolution of architectural standards, evaluate tools and frameworks, and partner with product and engineering leaders to translate business requirements into technical designs.

**AI/ML & Data Platform**

* Architect AI/ML capabilities for personalization, recommendations, semantic search, and conversational AI with service layers that enable easy consumption by product teams.
* Design unified data architecture bringing together customer signals across touchpoints, including data lakes, warehouses, real-time pipelines, and analytical products.
* Establish governance frameworks for data quality, privacy, security, and compliance (GDPR, CCPA) while ensuring data readiness and pipeline integration.
* Define architecture for model observability, performance monitoring, and continuous learning feedback loops.

**Technical Strategy & Leadership**

* Define multi-year architectural roadmaps and lead architectural reviews, governance processes, and critical modeling decisions across product verticals.
* Translate complex designs into accessible, secure services ensuring observability, performance, and operational excellence while mentoring architects and senior engineers.
* Provide thought leadership on emerging technologies and foster a culture of technical excellence.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 15+ years in enterprise software architecture, solution design, or technical leadership with significant CRM and enterprise SaaS platform experience.
* Proven track record designing production-grade solutions across customer service, digital workflows, CRM, or customer experience platforms.
* Deep expertise in microservices, event-driven architectures, API-first design, cloud-native technologies, and security best practices.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML systems with hands-on experience in personalization, NLP/NLU, semantic search, or conversational AI.
* Experience with data platform architecture including data modeling, ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming, data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks), and data governance.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face), MLOps tools, and data processing tools (Spark, dbt, Airflow).
* Excellent communication skills with ability to influence stakeholders across cross-functional, matrixed global organizations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with ServiceNow platform and extending its capabilities through custom applications or intelligent services.
* Deep understanding of CRM platforms (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, ServiceNow CSM) and their integration with customer experience ecosystems.
* Background in customer journey orchestration, personalized digital experiences, or recommendation engines in large-scale SaaS environments.
* Hands-on experience with LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG, and vector databases for GenAI applications.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and experience in global, matrixed organizations.

**What We Offer**

* A high-impact role shaping customer experience architecture within one of the world's leading enterprise platforms.
* The opportunity to define architectural strategies for mission-critical applications serving millions of users.
* A collaborative, innovation-focused culture with organizational influence and visibility to senior leadership.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**SENIOR NETWORK ENGINEER — JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Cloud Network Architecture | Enterprise Connectivity | Security | Automation & Technical Leadership**

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are seeking a Senior Network Engineer to define, design and lead resilient enterprise and cloud network solutions across AWS and Google Cloud Platform, with particular emphasis on GCP. This role translates business and product needs into secure, scalable technical architectures; provides senior technical direction across network engineering and operations; and partners with managed service providers, cloud providers and communications vendors to deliver reliable services. The successful candidate combines deep network expertise with an ownership mindset, strong problem management and modern infrastructure automation practices.

**SUCCESS PROFILE**

A successful Senior Network Engineer is a proactive technical leader who creates a clear vision for future network and security capabilities, builds consensus and drives solutions through execution. They manage multiple priorities, identify and address risk early, communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders, and develop others through guidance and cross-training. They remain curious, continuously broaden their expertise and take accountability for stable, secure and supportable outcomes.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES / WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**•**

Define cloud network requirements, establish target architecture, and create detailed designs, standards and roadmaps aligned with business goals.

**•**

Lead the implementation and support of enterprise LAN/WAN services, including routing, switching, firewalls, wireless, voice and video connectivity.

**•**

Architect and govern network connectivity across AWS and GCP, with particular focus on enterprise GCP VPC design and implementation.

**•**

Provide technical leadership across Network Engineering, NOC, managed service providers, cloud providers and communications vendors.

**•**

Recommend courses of action on complex technical and operational issues, build stakeholder consensus and drive decisions through execution.

**•**

Lead root-cause analysis and problem resolution, identifying risks, assessing business impact and defining corrective and preventive actions.

**•**

Leverage network telemetry, observability and advanced analytics platforms to enhance operational visibility, proactively identify performance risks and strengthen service reliability.

**•**

Design and maintain secure connectivity patterns, including VPNs, firewalls, proxies, private connectivity and other network security controls.

**•**

Drive infrastructure automation using Terraform, APIs and modern Infrastructure as Code practices to standardize repeatable network changes.

**•**

Set engineering standards and oversee network lifecycle activities, documentation, configuration governance, upgrades and technology currency.

**•**

Manage vendor relationships, evaluate product capabilities and new features, and support technical and commercial discussions as required.

**•**

Lead network deliverables across multiple concurrent initiatives, coordinating dependencies, priorities, risks and production impact.

**•**

Provide technical mentoring and cross-training to less experienced engineers and strengthen operational readiness across support teams.

**•**

Participate in an on-call or support rotation, including weekends when required, to support critical technologies and infrastructure.

**REQUIRED SKILLS**

**•**

Expert knowledge of enterprise cloud network architecture, design and implementation across AWS and GCP, with strong GCP expertise.

**•**

Expert knowledge of enterprise network infrastructure, protocols and standards, including BGP, MPLS, OSPF, TCP/IP, DNS, NTP and SNMP.

**•**

Deep experience with LAN/WAN, routing, switching, network segmentation, high availability, wireless and resilient connectivity patterns.

**•**

Experience deploying and managing AWS VPCs, Direct Connect, enterprise GCP VPCs and private cloud connectivity.

**•**

Strong knowledge of network and security infrastructure, including VPN access, firewalls, proxies and related security appliances and services.

**•**

Experience with infrastructure automation using Terraform, APIs and modern Infrastructure as Code practices.

**•**

Experience implementing proactive network monitoring, observability, performance management and capacity-planning solutions.

**•**

Strong problem management capabilities, including root-cause analysis, risk identification, impact assessment and corrective action planning.

**•**

Experience leading managed service providers, cloud providers, telecommunications partners and multiple technology vendors.

**•**

Ability to translate business and product requirements into resilient technical solutions, architecture decisions and executable delivery plans.

**•**

Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to influence technical, operational and management stakeholders.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**•**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**•**

Minimum eight years of progressive experience in network engineering within enterprise or business-critical technology environments.

**•**

Demonstrated senior-level technical leadership across network architecture, engineering delivery, operations and problem resolution.

**•**

Proven ownership mindset: proactive, curious, collaborative and accountable for driving issues and deliverables through to completion.

**•**

Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and operational priorities while balancing resilience, security, risk and business outcomes.

**•**

Commitment to continuous learning and ability to participate in a support rotation, including weekend coverage when required

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

**•**

Industry certifications such as CCNP, PCNSE, AWS, GCP or equivalent are preferred.

**•**

Experience with network automation or integration using APIs and scripting languages such as Python.

**•**

Experience designing hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity for globally distributed enterprise environments.

**•**

Experience supporting integrated wireless, voice or video services within a modern enterprise network portfolio.

**Job Description: Cloud Security Architect & Lead**
Role Summary
  
  
The Cloud Security Architect & Lead will own the security architecture, governance, compliance, and operational security posture across Minfy's multi-cloud environments spanning AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This leadership role is responsible for establishing security standards, driving cloud security transformation initiatives, enabling DevSecOps practices, and ensuring secure, compliant, and resilient cloud operations for both Minfy-managed and customer-managed environments.
  
  
The individual will work closely with SRE, Cloud Engineering, FinOps, Product Engineering, AI/ML teams, Customer Success, and Strategic Account teams to embed security into every aspect of cloud service delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Multi-Cloud Security Architecture
  
  

+ Define and maintain enterprise cloud security architecture standards across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
+ Develop secure landing zones, reference architectures, and cloud security guardrails.
+ Establish architecture patterns for:
+ Multi-cloud deployments
+ Hybrid cloud environments
+ SaaS platforms
+ AI/ML workloads
+ Kubernetes platforms
+ Review and approve security designs for new cloud initiatives and customer engagements.
+ Drive Zero Trust Architecture adoption across all cloud platforms.

Cloud Security Engineering & DevSecOps
  
  

+ Embed security controls into CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code pipelines.
+ Implement Security-as-Code and Policy-as-Code frameworks.
+ Automate compliance validation and security posture assessments.
+ Establish secure software supply chain controls.
+ Drive secure container, Kubernetes, and serverless security practices.
+ Integrate automated vulnerability and misconfiguration detection into engineering workflows.

Security Operations & Threat Management
  
  

+ Define and oversee cloud security monitoring, detection, and response capabilities.
+ Establish multi-cloud threat detection strategies.
+ Lead security incident response and forensic investigations.
+ Drive vulnerability management programs across cloud platforms.
+ Implement cloud-native threat intelligence and proactive threat hunting capabilities.
+ Develop operational runbooks and security response automation.

Governance, Risk & Compliance
  
  

+ Develop cloud security governance frameworks and policies.
+ Establish cloud risk management and control assessment processes.
+ Lead compliance initiatives including:
+ ISO 27001
+ SOC 2
+ PCI DSS
+ GDPR
+ HIPAA
+ NIST CSF
+ CIS Benchmarks
+ Support customer security reviews and regulatory audits.
+ Build continuous compliance monitoring capabilities.

Identity, Access & Data Security
  
  

+ Define enterprise IAM strategy across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
+ Implement Zero Trust and least-privilege access models.
+ Standardize:
+ MFA
+ SSO
+ Federated Identity
+ Privileged Access Management
+ Lead secrets management and encryption strategy.
+ Define enterprise data classification and protection controls.

AI & Emerging Security
  
  

+ Secure GenAI and AI/ML platforms deployed in cloud environments.
+ Establish governance controls for AI workloads.
+ Define security standards for LLM deployments and AI-assisted operations.
+ Assess risks associated with AI services and third-party integrations.
+ Collaborate with AI engineering teams to implement secure AI architectures.

Leadership & Organizational Responsibilities
  
  

+ Build and lead a Cloud Security Center of Excellence within SRE.
+ Mentor Cloud Security Engineers and Security Analysts.
+ Partner with Strategic Account Directors, TAMs, Cloud Architects, and Delivery Leaders.
+ Provide executive-level reporting on security posture, risks, and remediation plans.

+ Strong understanding of:

+ Kubernetes
+ DevSecOps
+ Identity Security
+ Compliance frameworks
+ Security Operations
+ Experience supporting enterprise-scale SaaS environments.
+ Strong customer-facing and consulting capabilities.

+ AWS Solutions Architect Professional
+ Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert
+ Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer
+ CISSP
+ CCSP
+ CISM
+ CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist)

Success Metrics (KPIs)
  
  

+ Reduction in critical cloud security findings.
+ Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) score improvement.
+ Compliance audit pass rates.
+ Security incident reduction.
+ MTTD and MTTR improvements.
+ Percentage of infrastructure compliant by default.
+ Vulnerability remediation SLA adherence.

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

At NTT DATA, we know that consistent service delivery builds lasting client trust. We invest in operational leaders who combine disciplined execution, technical understanding and strong people leadership to deliver reliable outcomes every day.
  
Role Purpose
  
The Client Delivery Manager (CDM) is accountable for day-to-day service delivery, operational governance, SLA/KPI performance, cost efficiency, resource management and continual service improvement across assigned Cloud, Infrastructure and Cybersecurity engagements.
  
  
Reporting into the Client Delivery Executive (CDE), the CDM converts contractual and client commitments into disciplined daily, weekly and monthly execution. Lead complex enterprise operations where service reliability, operational discipline and continuous improvement directly shape client confidence. The role operates in a clear three-in-a-box model: the CDE owns the business and client outcomes, the CDM runs service operations, and the Client Architect shapes technology strategy and transformation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Service Operations Delivery Control
  

* Own daily operations across relevant service towers and ensure delivery meets SLAs, KPIs, SLOs, contractual commitments and operating procedures.
* Run daily, weekly and monthly operating rhythms, including service reviews, delivery dashboards, action tracking and closure governance.
* Maintain operational stability, service quality and business continuity across global, multi-vendor and multi-tower environments.

Incident, Problem, Change Risk Management
  

* Lead operational response for major incidents, outages, missed SLAs and service escalations; ensure timely communication, restoration and follow-through.
* Drive root-cause analysis, problem management, corrective actions and service improvement plans to prevent recurrence.

Resource, Vendor Asset Management

Automation, AIOps Continual Improvement

description:

Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities.
