title: Platform Customer Engineer, Manufacturing and Conglomerates
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.
* Experience translating customer objectives into integrated cloud solutions across multiple domains.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data management, data analytics, Cloud AI, networking, migrations, security.
* Experience managing the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, or penetration testing).

**About the job**
-----------------

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business issues. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.

You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration testing within existing ones as a technical generalist. You will blend sales prowess, market knowledge and direct technical engagement.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting specific sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture to show the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots, and in-depth workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration, or implementation phases.

title: SENIOR CONSULTANT
description:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.

  

With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.  
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

  

**About Atos Group**

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.

**Job Description**

  

**Role summary**: Migrate existing Lambda/Dagster/dbt pipelines onto a Glue‑based, Redshift‑centric medallion architecture (S3 Bronze Redshift Silver Gold canonical model), embed data quality, lineage, security and CI/CD controls into every pipeline, and mentor engineers through domain‑by‑domain migration waves

  

**Key responsibilities**

* Inventory and baseline current Lambda functions, Dagster pipelines, dbt models, MySQL ODS flows and Kafka feeds, document lineage, schedules, SLAs and failure paths.
* Design and build Glue‑based ingestion, transformation, and cataloguing patterns (Glue jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) with Lambda/Step Functions/Event Bridge orchestration.
* Implement S3 Bronze landing with lifecycle/archive policies, Redshift Silver conformance and Gold canonical data products (Customer, Loan, Collections, Risk).
* Build automated data‑quality gates, reconciliation checks, and source‑to‑report lineage; support the enterprise data dictionary and certification of business‑critical reports
* Implement IAM, AWS‑native encryption, Secrets Manager and Gold‑layer RBAC/least‑privilege access.
* Establish Dev/Test environments, Git‑based CI/CD, schema version control (Liquibase) and controlled release promotion; monitoring and recovery via CloudWatch.
* Migrate and reconcile workloads wave by wave against baselines; decommission ODS dependencies and replace reverse flows with governed interfaces.
* Optimise Redshift performance and cost (WLM, sort/Dist keys, materialised views).
* Mentor engineers, own technical quality assurance of deliverables, and work with Data Owners/Champions and Atos architects in an Agile setup.

  

**Mandatory skills**

* 10+ years in data engineering, 5+ Experience in AWS data platforms.
* Amazon Redshift (deep): data modelling, performance tuning, WLM, RBAC, external schemas/Spectrum.
* AWS Glue (jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) and hands‑on medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) implementation on S3 + Redshift.
* AWS Lambda, Step Functions, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager.
* Advanced SQL, dimensional/canonical data modelling, ETL/ELT frameworks.
* Python (primary) — PySpark for Glue jobs.
* MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
* DBT— must be able to read, reverse‑engineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
* Data‑quality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
* Git, CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
* Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

  

**Nice to have**

* Dagster orchestration — for AS‑IS discovery and migration.
* Kafka / event‑driven streaming ingestion.
* Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR
* Tableau, Metabase serving‑layer knowledge.
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
* Data‑governance tooling (Glue Data Quality, Data Zone, Lake Formation).
* UK financial‑services experience: IFRS 9, BCBS 239, FCA/PRA reporting, UK GDPR.
* Preparing governed datasets for AI/ML use cases.

  

Here at Atos, diversity and inclusion are embedded in our DNA. Read more about our commitment to a fair work environment for all.

Atos is a recognized leader in its industry across Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria. Find out more on our CSR commitment.

**Choose your future. Choose Atos.**

title: Technology Architect
description:
**Project Role :** Technology Architect  
**Project Role Description :** Design and deliver technology architecture for a platform, product, or engagement. Define solutions to meet performance, capability, and scalability needs.
  
**Must have skills :** SAP BTP Application Development  
**Good to have skills :** Python (Programming Language), Node.js  
Minimum **18** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
The SAP Business AI Development Manager leads the design, engineering, and delivery of responsible, scalable AI solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP). The role combines hands-on SAP architecture and development expertise with engineering leadership, delivery governance, and stakeholder management. The manager will embed AI and generative AI capabilities into enterprise processes across SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, SAP Concur, supply chain, spend, and customer-experience solutions while maintaining clean-core, security, privacy, and responsible-AI standards.  
SAP BTP Development Manager  
  
SAP Business Technology Platform ,AI Engineering ,Generative AI ,Enterprise Application Development  
  
Role: SAP BTP & Business AI Development Manager, Architect  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
Solution strategy and architecture: Define solution approaches and reference architectures for embedded and side-by-side AI extensions on SAP BTP, balancing business value, scalability, security, maintainability, and clean-core principles.  
Engineering leadership: Lead multidisciplinary teams of AI engineers, SAP BTP developers, data engineers, integration specialists, and quality engineers plan capacity, allocate work, remove delivery impediments, and coach team members.  
AI Foundation delivery: Govern development using SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, and the generative AI hub, covering experimentation, model selection, deployment, inference, monitoring, and continuous improvement.  
Generative AI adoption: Establish standards for prompt engineering, prompt lifecycle management, model evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, grounding, and rapid prototyping.  
Business-process integration: Embed capabilities such as intelligent document processing, natural-language interfaces, workflow automation, recommendations, forecasting, and decision support into SAP and non-SAP processes.  
Application development: Oversee SAP CAP, ABAP Cloud, SAP Fiori/UI5, OData, SAP HANA Cloud, Cloud Foundry, and Kyma-based development, including APIs, events, integrations, and reusable services.  
AI-assisted engineering: Guide responsible use of Joule for Developers and SAP Build Code for code scaffolding, explanation, refactoring, test generation, and review support.  
Quality and DevSecOps: Ensure AI-generated and developer-created artifacts are reviewed, validated, tested, secured, traceable, and approved before release drive CI/CD, observability, automated testing, and production-support practices.  
Responsible AI and governance: Implement controls for privacy, security, transparency, content safety, bias mitigation, human oversight, model risk, auditability, and regulatory compliance throughout the AI lifecycle.  
Capability building: Create engineering standards, reusable accelerators, reference implementations, and learning plans that strengthen AI, application development, integration, analytics, and data-engineering capabilities.  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
Hands-on experience with SAP BTP and relevant services, including SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, the generative AI hub, SAP HANA Cloud, SAP Build Code, and SAP Integration Suite.  
Strong knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI observability.  
Proficiency in one or more SAP development stacks: SAP CAP with Node.js or Java, ABAP Cloud, SAP Fiori/UI5, OData, REST APIs, and event-driven integration.  
Experience designing cloud-native applications and microservices on Cloud Foundry and,or Kyma,Kubernetes, supported by Git, CI,CD, automated testing, and secure DevOps practices.  
Good understanding of SAP BTP security, including identity and access management, OAuth, role-based access, secrets management, data protection, and secure API design.  
Working knowledge of AI-enabled business processes in SAP S/4HANA and one or more SAP cloud applications such as SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur, Sales Cloud, or Signavio.  
Demonstrated ability to convert business opportunities into solution designs, delivery plans, estimates, risks, controls, and measurable outcomes.  
Strong people leadership, stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and delivery ownership.  
Preferred Qualifications  
SAP certification in BTP application development, integration, data, analytics, AI engineering, or a related specialization.  
Experience with SAP Joule Studio and the design or orchestration of AI agents.  
Experience with SAP Document AI, SAP Build Process Automation, Event Mesh, and asynchronous architectures.  
Knowledge of SAP HANA Cloud Predictive Analysis Library, Automated Predictive Library, and vector capabilities.  
Experience integrating models and services from Hyperscaler or SAP AI ecosystem partners through governed enterprise patterns.  
Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated environments with privacy, security, data residency, and compliance obligations.  
Familiarity with responsible-AI frameworks, model risk management, evaluation benchmarks, red teaming, and human-in-the-loop controls.  
Experience creating reusable assets, engineering playbooks, and communities of practice for enterprise AI adoption.  
Leadership Competencies  
Strategic orientation: Connect AI investments to business outcomes, adoption, and value realization.  
Technical judgment: Make pragmatic build, buy, reuse, and integration decisions across SAP and partner services.  
Delivery leadership: Manage scope, quality, schedule, cost, dependencies, and operational readiness across concurrent workstreams.  
Talent development: Build high-performing teams through coaching, feedback, knowledge sharing, and structured capability development.  
Executive communication: Explain complex AI concepts, design trade-offs, risks, and value in clear business language.  
Collaboration and ownership: Work effectively across business, architecture, engineering, data, security, legal, risk, and operations teams.  
Measures of Success  
AI use cases delivered on time, within agreed quality and risk thresholds, and with measurable business outcomes.  
Production reliability, security, performance, adoption, and responsible-AI compliance of deployed solutions.  
Reuse of approved architecture patterns, accelerators, components, and engineering standards.  
Improvement in engineering productivity, automated test coverage, release quality, and time to value.  
Stakeholder satisfaction and growth in the capability, proficiency, and retention of the engineering team.  
  
Additional Information:
  
Bachelor s or master s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, or a related discipline.  
Typically 10+ years of enterprise application or technology delivery experience, including 3+ years leading SAP BTP, AI/ML, data, or cloud engineering teams.

  
15 years full time education

title: Lead D&T Engineer - Product Information Capabilities
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

### **OVERVIEW:**

### **General Mills Digital & Technology department is developing a best-in-class Product Content Management capability - this will help General Mills to reduce time to market the products and play pivotal role to accelerate growth of ecommerce channel. Product Information Capabilities team is seeking a Lead Developer/ Architect STIBO, that will play the critical role of linking business objectives to core technological capabilities. This role will drive organized and effective requirements to build and enhance the STIBO solution. They will be responsible for partnering with the business analysts to collect the requirements from business, establishing processes, and coordinating the work with our technical development team. title: SENIOR CONSULTANT - DELIVERY
description:
**About Atos Group**

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 67,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €10 billion, operating in 61 countries under two brands — Atos for services and Eviden for products. European number one in cybersecurity, cloud and high performance computing, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is the brand under which Atos SE (Societas Europaea) operates. Atos SE is listed on Euronext Paris.

The purpose of Atos Group is to help design the future of the information space. Its expertise and services support the development of knowledge, education and research in a multicultural approach and contribute to the development of scientific and technological excellence. Across the world, the Group enables its customers and employees, and members of societies at large to live, work and develop sustainably, in a safe and secure information space.

  

### **Requirements**

* 12+ years of SAP experience with 5+ years of hands-on expertise in SAP BTP and implementation of Agentic AI / Generative AI solutions.
* Minimum two full-cycle SAP BTP implementations as a Technical Architect.
* Strong expertise in SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud (Vector Engine), and SAP BTP Integration Suite.
* Hands-on experience with CAP/RAP, Clean Core principles, and SAP S/4HANA standard APIs (OData, SOAP, RFC).
* Proficiency in Node.js, Python, or Java along with strong SQL/SQLScript skills.
* Experience with LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, vector embeddings, and RAG-based architectures.
* Knowledge of AI engineering frameworks such as LangChain and LlamaIndex, along with modern DevOps (Git, CI/CD).
* Strong stakeholder management, mentoring, and communication skills.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design and develop autonomous, multi-agent AI solutions using CAP/RAP on SAP BTP.
* Build and orchestrate AI-powered applications leveraging SAP AI Core, AI Launchpad, and LLM technologies.
* Implement and extend SAP Joule with custom skills, conversational workflows, and cross-application integrations.
* Architect semantic data pipelines using SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, and Vector Engine to support AI use cases and RAG solutions.
* Design secure, scalable, and clean-core compliant integrations using SAP Integration Suite and Event Mesh.
* Implement AI governance, security, audit logging, data privacy controls, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) frameworks.
* Lead technical architecture reviews, establish best practices, and drive enterprise AI adoption.
* Mentor cross-functional teams and collaborate with business stakeholders to deliver scalable AI-driven solutions.

  

Here at Atos, diversity and inclusion are embedded in our DNA. Read more about our commitment to a fair work environment for all.

Atos is a recognized leader in its industry across Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria. Find out more on our CSR commitment.

**Choose your future. Choose Atos.**

title: RIS Oracle Tech/AI SA Associate Manager
description:
Job Description Overview
  
As an Oracle Solution Architect, you will help organizations transform enterprises through Oracle solutions spanning HCM, finance, EPM, procurement, projects, supply chain, manufacturing, CX, sales, service, marketing, commerce, analytics, data, integration, cloud infrastructure, AI, and industry capabilities. You will define business strategies, design Oracle-enabled transformations, and architect scalable solutions that deliver measurable business value. Combines Oracle expertise, business consulting, and leadership.
  
  
**We Are:**  
Accenture helps organizations build their digital core, optimize operations, accelerate growth, and enhance services through technology, data, and AI.
  
The Oracle Business Group (OBG) brings industry expertise, transformation consulting, and Oracle application and technology capabilities to modernize enterprises across HCM, ERP, EPM, Procurement, Project Management, SCM, CX, Analytics, Integration, OCI, AI, and industry solutions.
  
Our Oracle Solution Architect Team partners with clients, account teams, and delivery organizations to shape Oracle transformation programs, leading solution strategy, architecture, estimation, and pursuits.
  
  
**You Are:**  
A client-focused Oracle Solution Architect who combines Oracle product knowledge with consulting, communication, and leadership skills. You translate requirements into Oracle solutions and lead architecture discussions, design sessions, and strategic pursuits.
  
  
**The Work:**  
Build Oracle solutions that transform clients' business operations
  
Design and test Oracle solutions, ensuring processes, integrations, data, reporting, and security work together
  
Work with project teams and clients to create solutions and transformation roadmaps
  
Lead discovery sessions, architecture discussions, solution design workshops, and executive presentations
  
Develop trusted client relationships
  
Support sales pursuits, including solution development, estimation, proposals, demonstrations, and solution reviews
  
Build Oracle technical, functional, industry, and business expertise
  
Travel may be required based on business need and client requirements.
  
  
**Here's What You Need:**  
Minimum of 5 years of Oracle Cloud implementation and delivery experience
  
Experience supporting or leading full lifecycle Oracle Cloud implementations, including design, configuration, testing, deployment, and stabilization
  
Experience leading solution architecture, business process design, and client workshops
  
Expertise in one or more Oracle areas, including HCM, ERP, EPM, Procurement, Project Management, SCM, Manufacturing, CX, Sales, Service, Marketing, Commerce, Analytics, Data Management, Integration, OCI, AI, or industry solutions
  
Experience translating business requirements into scalable Oracle solution designs
  
Fluency in AI Oracle Agentic AI & industry trends
  
Understanding of integration, reporting, security, data conversion, and testing
  
Experience supporting proposals, estimation, solution reviews, and sales pursuits
  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
  
Professional Skills Requirements
  
Oracle Cloud certifications relevant to your area
  
Experience working directly with clients
  
Ability to present solution recommendations and transformation strategies to executive stakeholders
  
Ability to facilitate client workshops, discovery sessions, and design discussions
  
Strong consulting, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
  
Experience collaborating across sales, consulting, delivery, industry, and technology teams
  
Ability to work effectively with global teams
  
  
**Bonus Points If:**  
You hold multiple Oracle Cloud certifications
  
You have expertise across multiple Oracle pillars, including SaaS, PaaS, OCI, data, integration, analytics, AI, or industry solutions
  
You have experience with AI-enabled business transformations and Oracle AI capabilities

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Mumbai

  

Sealed Air designs and delivers packaging solutions that protect essential goods transported worldwide, preserve food, enable e-commerce and digital connectivity, and help create a global supply chain that is touchless, safer, less wasteful, and more resilient. We strive to foster a caring, high-performance growth culture that will deliver consistent, sustainable profitable growth and accelerate our performance – a culture where accountability is clear and aligned, and where we reward business outcomes and impact. That culture guides everything we do, including how we partner with our customers and suppliers, how we attract and retain top talent, and how we create and deliver value to our stakeholders. In 2025, Sealed Air generated $5.4 billion in sales and has approximately 16,100 employees who serve customers in 119 countries/territories. To learn more, visit www.sealedair.com.

**Senior Platform Engineer (Azure)**
------------------------------------

The Senior Azure Platform Architect is responsible for the strategy, architecture, engineering, and governance of the enterprise Microsoft Azure platform. This role serves as the technical lead for cloud infrastructure, Azure networking and security, hybrid connectivity, automation, platform modernization, and cloud adoption initiatives.

Working across infrastructure, cybersecurity, networking, database, application, and operations teams, the Senior Azure Platform Architect designs secure, scalable, and resilient cloud solutions while establishing the standards and roadmaps that guide the organization's cloud strategy.

Azure platform architecture and engineering are the primary focus of this role. Disaster recovery, business continuity, and data protection technologies are supporting responsibilities that ensure overall platform resilience.

**What are we looking for in you ?**
------------------------------------

**Key Responsibilities**

**Azure Architecture & Strategy**

* Define and maintain the enterprise Azure architecture and cloud strategy.
* Establish platform standards, reference architectures, governance models, and engineering best practices.
* Develop technology roadmaps that support modernization, cloud adoption, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Evaluate new Azure services and capabilities to determine business and technical value.
* Serve as the organization's senior technical advisor for Azure technologies and cloud infrastructure decisions.

**Platform Engineering & Modernization**

* Lead the design and implementation of Azure infrastructure services, landing zones, subscription structures, and management frameworks.
* Partner with application, database, and infrastructure teams to design cloud-native and hybrid-cloud solutions.
* Provide architectural leadership for migration and modernization initiatives moving workloads from legacy platforms into Azure.
* Drive standardization, automation, and operational maturity across the Azure environment.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex platform issues in collaboration with internal teams, Microsoft, and strategic partners.

**Why do we need you ?**
------------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of infrastructure engineering, cloud engineering, or solution architecture experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure architecture and engineering experience.
* Deep expertise in Azure networking, hybrid connectivity, governance, security, and infrastructure services.
* Experience designing and supporting enterprise-scale cloud platforms.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure automation, cloud modernization, and migration strategies.
* Experience with cloud financial management and cost optimization.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Experience with Azure Virtual WAN, Azure Arc, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience supporting hybrid infrastructure and enterprise datacenter environments.
* Familiarity with Azure Site Recovery, Zerto, Cohesity, and enterprise disaster recovery practices.
* Experience evaluating cloud optimization and FinOps solutions.
* Knowledge of enterprise security, compliance, and governance frameworks.

**What are our core values?**
-----------------------------

Integrity

Determined

Innovative

Collaborative

title: Staff Technical Account Manager
description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

**The Opportunity**

Are you a customer-centric professional with a strong technical aptitude and exceptional communication skills, eager to take on the challenges of managing relationships with clients in a dynamic environment? If so, you would want to join our team as a **Staff Technical Account Manager** to play a crucial role in driving customer success and adoption of Nutanix products, while working in a collaborative, supportive culture alongside experienced professionals dedicated to innovation and excellence.

**About the Team**

The Staff Technical Account Manager will be joining the TAM team at Nutanix India. This team is dedicated to providing exceptional support and service to customers across the APAC region, fostering a strong customer-centric culture characterized by collaboration, transparency, and mutual respect. The mission of the team is to drive customer success and maximize the value of Nutanix products, ensuring that clients realize their full potential and return on investment through proactive engagement and expert guidance.

This role reports to the Service Delivery Leader – India and is primarily **on-site**, with the expectation of being based in **Mumbai** to support customer requirements and facilitate effective engagement with customers located in the region. Travel outside Mumbai is not a primary requirement for this role; however, occasional domestic travel may be necessary to support customer engagements, face-to-face meetings, or organizational requirements. The role primarily involves **on-site service delivery at customer locations**, with the flexibility to accommodate evolving customer needs and preferences.

**Your Role**

* Develop and maintain a comprehensive understanding of the **customer’s Nutanix environment,** including license consumption and activation, asset refresh opportunities, capacity utilization, software versions, support cases, and feature adoption.

description:
**Your Future Evolves Here**
Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.
  
  
Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.
  
  
Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**
**Department:**
Platform Engineering & Operations (PEO)Function / Team Platform Architecture
  
  
**Reports To:**
Director, Platform Architecture
  
  
**Location / Work Arrangement:**
Remote / Work at Home
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Date / Version:**
2026-09 / v1 (standard template)
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As a Platform Architect in Evolent's Platform Engineering & Operations (PEO) organization, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the cloud and infrastructure platforms that Evolent's applications run on. This role involves strategic thinking to solve high impactful organizational issues with expertise in major cloud platforms, specifically Microsoft Azure.
  
  
Why This Role Matters
  
  
Evolent is transforming how it builds and operates infrastructure under a refreshed Platform Engineering & Operations operating model, grounded in four principles: Architecture First, Automation by Default, Reliability is a Shared Responsibility and Golden Paths Over Custom Solutions. You will turn approved designs into provisioned, automated, and documented platforms, and you will do it transparently, through formal handoffs, Office Hours reviews, and documentation your peers can actually rely on.
  
  
**Agentic AI**
: Platform Engineering is moving toward agentic AI as a standard part of how the organization works. As agentic AI transforms the way we work, we expect our engineers to be at the forefront of that change, designing and building intelligent solutions rather than simply consuming them. This builder mentality is a core attribute we assess from the first conversation.
  
  
What You'll Be Doing
  
  

* Provision and change infrastructure exclusively as code, so that every environment is reproducible, reviewable, and free of manual drift.
* Reverse engineer the applications and infrastructure you inherit: trace dependencies, integrations, and data flows end to end until you can explain how a system actually works.
* Design and build agentic AI solutions for platform, delivery, and operations work: identify the toil worth automating, then build, evaluate, and harden the agent that removes it.
* Build security and compliance into the delivery path: least-privilege access, secrets handling, policy-as-code guardrails, and audit evidence produced by design rather than assembled under deadline.

*Scope note: This role works inside one PEO function and partners across the others. Platform Architecture defines and approves standards, DevOps provisions and delivers, Site Reliability Engineering operates production, Platform Enablement & Automation builds golden paths and guardrails, Database Administration owns data platforms, and Cloud Network Services owns the foundational cloud fabric and network. Hiring manager: add any boundary specific to your team here.*
What You'll Need to Be Successful
  
  

* Demonstrates humility, openness to feedback, and a team-first mindset.
* Comfortable with a high level of transparency, surfacing risks and mistakes early.
* Ability to create high-quality technical diagrams and documentation.
* Deep knowledge of agentic AI concepts: agents and tool use, orchestration, context and retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, and the limits of each. This is one of the most important requirements for the role, because every person in Platform Engineering & Operations is expected to become a builder of agentic AI solutions rather than only a user of them.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to reverse engineer application architecture: take an unfamiliar application and the infrastructure under it, trace its components, dependencies, and data flows.
* Working fluency in Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code. Terraform and Ansible are Evolent's standard tooling.

Domain Expertise — Platform Architecture
  
  

* Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and resilient workloads on the Azure platform
* Maintain overall cloud organization and standards such as the Azure Landing Zone architecture, the Azure Well Architected Framework, and Enterprise Policy Governance.
* Implement cloud security measures and controls set by Senior and Principal team members from regulatory compliance frameworks such as HITRUST & CIS.
* Proficiency with tools such as Azure Portal/CLI, Azure Advisor, Azure Policy, Azure Resource Graph, and VS Code.
* Analyze existing cloud architectures and recommend optimizations for cost efficiency, scalability, resiliency, and performance.

**Nice To Have (Preferred)**

* Experience applying agentic AI concepts, whether through professional experience, personal projects, academic work, or other relevant initiatives: what it does, the choices you made, what failed, and what you would change.
* Proficiency in a scripting or programming language used for automation and tooling, such as Python, Go, PowerShell, C#, or Bash.
* Experience in a regulated environment, for example healthcare and HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Relevant Azure certifications preferred, for example AZ-104 or AZ-305, AI-500 or AB-100
* ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity

Academic Qualification
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.
  
  
**Mandatory Requirements:**
Employees must have a high-speed broadband internet connection with a minimum speed of
**50 Mbps**
and the ability to set up a wired connection to their home network to ensure effective remote work. These requirements may be updated as needed by the business.
  
  
**Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.**
**If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact recruitingteam@evolent.com for further assistance.**

All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: Divisional Risk and Control Specialist, VP**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Corporate Title: VP**

**Role Description**

Corporate Banking is a technology-driven business operating in an increasingly real-time, interconnected environment, where clients expect seamless services, integrated platforms and trusted access to data. Corporate Bank (CB) Technology supports this ambition through a complex global ecosystem of business-critical applications, platforms, data services and infrastructure. We are seeking an experienced technology risk professional to play a key role in our Proactive Risk Testing Programme, delivering rigorous, risk-based assessments across this landscape. The role requires the ability to develop a deep understanding of applications and their end-to-end architecture, critically evaluate the design and effectiveness of implemented technology controls, and identify both existing and emerging IT and Information Security risks. Working closely with senior technology, business and control stakeholders, you will translate complex technical observations into clear risk insights, strengthen the testing strategy and drive sustainable improvements that enhance the resilience, security and control environment of mission-critical technology services.

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

**Your key responsibilities**

Reporting locally to the India Corporate Bank Technology Control Testing Lead in Pune and functionally to the CB Technology Testing Lead based in London, you will:

* Lead and deliver risk-based, end-to-end IT and Information Security assessments across the Corporate Bank (CB) Technology landscape, independently assessing the design, implementation and operating effectiveness of key controls.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of business services and their supporting technology, including application and platform architecture, infrastructure, databases, operating systems, cloud services, networks, interfaces, APIs, data flows, batch and real-time processing, and third-party dependencies.
* Perform technical deep dives across applications, platforms, databases and infrastructure to identify and assess existing and emerging IT and IS risks, control weaknesses, root causes, systemic themes and potential impacts on confidentiality, integrity, resilience and regulatory compliance.
* Assess technology lifecycle risks and controls including design, development and production considering aspects such as access management, security, operations and resilience.
* Apply professional judgement to define risk-based testing scope, develop risk and control matrices, determine sampling and testing approaches, analyze technical evidence, and produce clear, well-supported conclusions in line with testing standards.
* Challenge technology and control owners constructively, communicate complex technical risks in business terms and support agreement on pragmatic and sustainable remediation actions.
* Identify cross-application and thematic risks, emerging technology threats, control automation opportunities and opportunities to use data analytics and continuous monitoring to improve assurance coverage.
* Partner with Technology Application Teams, Architects, Engineering, Information Security, Control Owners, the Divisional Control Office, Group Audit and other stakeholders to promote transparency and sustainable risk mitigation.
Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of risk-based testing methodologies, standards, documentation and quality assurance, while providing guidance and technical coaching to colleagues where required.  

**Your skills and experience**

* Extensive experience in IT/Cyber security assessments, technology risk, information security, controls assurance or related discipline, including leading complex reviews in a large, regulated organization.
* In-depth understanding of enterprise technology and application architecture, including cloud and on-premises infrastructure, databases, operating systems, networks, APIs, middleware, data integration and third-party services.
* Demonstrable ability to analyze architecture diagrams, data flows, configurations, system logs, access models, vulnerability information and other technical evidence to identify control gaps and assess their business and risk impact.
* Strong knowledge of IT General Controls and Application Controls, cyber security, secure software development, identity and access management, privileged access management, network and cloud security, vulnerability management, data and cryptographic protection, security monitoring, incident management, operational resilience and technology lifecycle management.
* Awareness of emerging technology and risk areas, including cloud security, DevSecOps, automation, artificial intelligence, open-source software, third-party concentration and evolving cyber threats.
* Experience applying recognized frameworks and standards such as COBIT, NIST, ISO 27001, ITIL and relevant regulatory expectations; professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or equivalent is desirable.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders and translate complex technical matters into concise, risk-based findings and practical remediation actions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes.
Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments; knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its control environment would be an advantage.  

  

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career

* Coaching and support from experts in your team

* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression

A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs  



**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**Technical Account Engineer - I ( Noida)**

Sumo Logic helps companies keep applications reliable and secure. Our Technical Account Engineers are the people who make sure customers actually get value out of the platform, and they are the first point of contact for a portfolio of named post-sales accounts.

**About the Role**

Around 70% of the role is technical, hands-on-keyboard work: guiding customers through complex use cases, untangling deployment problems and showing practitioners how to get more out of the platform. The other 30% is building the kind of trust that makes you the first person customers call, whether that’s an engineer stuck on a query or a security lead thinking about renewal.

Our playbooks and automated health signals will give you a strong baseline, but at this level you’ll go well beyond them. You’ll know your named customers’ environments well enough to spot problems before they do and find the next use case before they ask. You’ll also design tailored plans when the standard play doesn’t fit, and bring in Support, Product, Engineering or Sales when a situation calls for it. You’ll help shape the playbooks themselves, and support Associate TAEs as they grow into the role.

You’ll have real visibility internally, including with senior leadership, and a genuine say in how we serve these customers.

**What You Will Actually Do**

* **Own your named accounts technically.**
  Be the go-to technical lead for a portfolio of customers, and know their environments, priorities and risks inside out.
* **Get customers using the platform extensively.**
  Build new use cases, bring in new data sources, teach advanced features and work through hard problems with security, DevSecOps and observability teams.
* **Craft success plans that can be measured.**
  Understand what customers are trying to achieve, turn it into a technical plan, help them deliver it and expand it as the value shows up.
* **See trouble coming.**
  Combine automated usage signals with your own judgement to spot adoption or technical risk early. Then pull the account team together to turn a wobbly account into an advocate.
* **Run the cadence.**
  Lead health checks and contribute to Business Reviews, building credibility with practitioners, team leads and executive stakeholders.
* **Help the accounts grow.**
  Work with Sales on renewals and expansion in a way that’s good for the customer and delivers additional value.
* **Make the team better.**
  Feed customer insight back to Product and Engineering and improve our playbooks.

**Where and When**

* This role is based in Noida, India, and candidates must be located in Noida.
* Shifts are designed to overlap core Australia and New Zealand business hours.
* You’ll join the local team in our Noida office from time to time, typically once a fortnight.

**What You Will Bring**

* 5 to 6 years in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, customer success engineering, professional services, solutions engineering, DevOps or SOC analysis.
* Real production experience across enterprise infrastructure: operating systems, virtualisation, databases, networking and security.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).
* SQL or query language skills, and the ability to look at usage data, work out what’s really going on and act on it.
* A track record of owning multiple customer accounts and building relationships from practitioners to senior stakeholders.
* Comfort with ambiguity: if something is unclear, you go and find out rather than waiting to be told.
* A strong team player who collaborates across GTM functions and gets things done with no fuss.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (B.Tech/BE or equivalent).

**The Technical Stuff We Would Love to See**

* Experience with Observability or SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, Dynatrace, CrowdStrike, QRadar, Exabeam).
* A background in alerting and monitoring in security, operations or DevSecOps settings.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and how they apply across customers’ lifecycle.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes (Helm), OTel, Prometheus and API scripting.
* Proficiency in using AI tools to accelerate day-to-day work. Certifications such as AWS AI Practitioner or Microsoft AI Fundamentals are a plus.
* Hyperscaler certifications at Associate level or above.
* Sumo Logic experience is a big plus but not required.

* Experience leading or mentoring a development team.

* **Strategic account planning:** Develop and maintain technical account plans, service roadmaps, and customer success plans with clear milestones, owners, and measurable outcomes.
* **Service delivery and governance:** Coordinate contracted service deliverables, track commitments and applicable service levels, and conduct regular operational reviews and executive business reviews.
* **Incident and escalation management:** Lead customer communication during critical incidents, coordinate support and engineering teams, track resolution activities, and drive follow-through on root cause analysis and preventive actions.
* **Proactive database health management:** Coordinate health checks, performance reviews, capacity assessments, and availability evaluations to identify risks and recommend improvements.
* **Database lifecycle planning:** Guide customers through database upgrades, migrations, patching, platform modernization, and cloud adoption, including readiness assessments and risk mitigation.
* **Availability and recovery:** Review high availability architectures, backup strategies, disaster recovery readiness, and recovery testing against customer recovery objectives.
* **Security and governance:** Advise on database security practices, access controls, encryption, auditing, and vulnerability remediation in collaboration with customer security teams.
* **Technology adoption:** Help customers evaluate relevant Oracle Database, OCI, automation, and AI capabilities based on business value and operational readiness.
* **Customer advocacy:** Represent customer priorities within Oracle, coordinate cross-functional resources, and communicate product feedback and recurring issues.
* **Continuous improvement:** Maintain account documentation, action registers, service dashboards, and technical recommendations that demonstrate progress and service value.

**Required Database and Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Oracle Database administration, architecture, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management, including Oracle Database 19c and familiarity with Oracle AI Database 26ai.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Multitenant architecture, including container databases, pluggable databases, provisioning, consolidation, and resource management.
* Experience with Oracle Real Application Clusters (RAC), Automatic Storage Management (ASM), Oracle Data Guard, and Active Data Guard.
* Strong database performance analysis and SQL tuning skills, including execution plans, indexing, optimizer statistics, wait events, AWR, ASH, and ADDM.
* Experience with RMAN backup and recovery, restore validation, disaster recovery planning, and recovery time and recovery point objectives.
* Knowledge of Oracle Exadata architecture, workload optimization, and operational considerations.
* Experience planning database migrations, upgrades, and patching using appropriate tools such as Data Pump, AutoUpgrade, GoldenGate, and Zero Downtime Migration.
* Familiarity with OCI database services, Oracle Autonomous AI Database, Exadata Database Service, and Exadata Cloud@Customer.
* Understanding of database security capabilities, including Transparent Data Encryption, privilege management, auditing, Oracle Data Safe, and Database Vault.
Proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL, Linux/Unix fundamentals, and scripting or automation using Python, shell scripts, Ansible, or Terraform.  

**Modern Database Skills — Preferred**

* Familiarity with Oracle AI Vector Search, vector embeddings, similarity search, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) use cases.
* Awareness of Select AI and natural language access to enterprise data.
* Understanding of JSON Relational Duality, modern SQL capabilities, and support for relational, JSON, spatial, and graph workloads.
* Knowledge of cloud database observability, infrastructure automation, and performance and cost optimization.
Ability to assess the operational, security, and governance requirements of AI-enabled database solutions.  

**Technical Account Management Skills**

* Strong stakeholder management, executive communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical issues through their business impact and recommended actions.
* Experience managing escalations, setting expectations, resolving conflicts, and maintaining customer confidence.
* Strong planning, prioritization, and coordination skills across multiple accounts or concurrent initiatives.
* Understanding of incident, problem, and change management practices, preferably aligned with ITIL.
* Ability to define and track service measures such as customer satisfaction, milestone completion, recurring incident reduction, and risk remediation.
Demonstrated ownership, analytical thinking, and effective collaboration across distributed teams.  

**Qualifications**

A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Relevant experience in Oracle Database technologies and customer-facing technical account management, consulting, enterprise support, or service delivery is required. Oracle Database, OCI, and ITIL certifications are desirable.

title: IAM -Japanese Language Expert

**The Role**

* Collaborate with technical teams, stakeholders, and clients to deliver effective IT solutions.
* Maintain accurate system documentation, incident records, and operational procedures.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization, automation, and business growth.
* Share technical expertise and best practices while contributing to knowledge-sharing initiatives.

**Your future at Kyndryl**  
There are lots of opportunities to gain certification and qualifications on the job, and you’ll continuously grow as a Cloud Hyperscaler. Many of our Infrastructure Specialists are on a path toward becoming either an Architect or Distinguished Engineer, and there are opportunities at every skill level to grow in either of these directions.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* JLPT N1 preferred / N2 /N3 minimum.
* 5 years' experience
* Strong Japanese reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills.
* Good English communication skills.
* Ability to understand Japanese business etiquette and workplace culture.
* Strong communication, coordination, and interpersonal skills.
Relevant experience working with Japanese clients or teams is an advantage.  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience:**  
  

* Automation experience, especially IaaS (infrastructure as a code)
* Vulnerability management
* Microsoft Active Directory and federation services

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

Build Oracle technical, functional, industry, and business expertise

Minimum of 5 years of Oracle Cloud implementation and delivery experience

Fluency in AI Oracle Agentic AI & industry trends

Experience supporting proposals, estimation, solution reviews, and sales pursuits
  
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

Oracle Cloud certifications relevant to your area
  
Experience working directly with clients
  
Ability to present solution recommendations and transformation strategies to executive stakeholders
  
Ability to facilitate client workshops, discovery sessions, and design discussions
  
Strong consulting, analytical, written, and verbal communication skills
  
Experience collaborating across sales, consulting, delivery, industry, and technology teams
  
Ability to work effectively with global teams

You hold multiple Oracle Cloud certifications
  
You have expertise across multiple Oracle pillars, including SaaS, PaaS, OCI, data, integration, analytics, AI, or industry solutions
  
You have experience with AI-enabled business transformations and Oracle AI capabilities

That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

title: Security Architect
description:
**Project Role :** Security Architect  
**Project Role Description :** Define the cloud security framework and architecture, ensuring it meets the business requirements and performance goals. Document the implementation of the cloud security controls and transition to cloud security-managed operations.
  
**Must have skills :** Security Penetration Testing  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **12** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:  
As a Security Architect specializing in Breach & Attack Simulation (BAS) and Attack Surface Management (ASM), the role involves designing, deploying, and operationalizing continuous security validation and attack surface visibility capabilities across the organization. This position combines offensive security expertise with external exposure management — emulating real-world threat actors through automated simulations while maintaining continuous discovery and monitoring of the organization's digital attack surface. The role requires close collaboration with security operations, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, infrastructure, cloud, and application teams to drive measurable improvement in security posture and control effectiveness.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:  

* Expected to be an SME collaborate and manage the team to perform across penetration testing, BAS and ASM operations at scale.
* Responsible for team decisions and expected to provide solutions to problems that apply across multiple teams.
* Engage with multiple teams including security operations, infrastructure, cloud, application and business units to contribute to key security decisions.
* Facilitate knowledge sharing and mentorship within the team to foster professional growth and technical excellence.
* Translate technical findings into clear business risks, decisions and actionable recommendations for executive and non-technical stakeholders.
* Develop training materials and conduct knowledge-transfer sessions for penetration testing, BAS and ASM operations teams.
* Deploy, configure, administer and maintain BAS platforms such as SafeBreach, AttackIQ, Cymulate, Picus Security, XM Cyber or Pentera, including simulator/agent deployment across endpoints, servers, network segments and cloud workloads.
* Design, schedule and execute automated attack simulations mapped to MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques and procedures (TTPs) across the full cyber kill chain — initial access, execution, persistence, privilege escalation, defense evasion, credential access, lateral movement, C2 and data exfiltration.
* Emulate real-world adversaries targeting financial services organizations, including ransomware operators, APT groups, phishing and BEC campaigns, using current Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI).
* Measure the effectiveness of security controls including EDR/XDR, SIEM, NGFW, IPS/IDS, WAF, Secure Email Gateway, Web Proxy/SWG, DLP, NAC and Active Directory security.
* Identify prevention and detection gaps, perform risk-based prioritization and drive remediation with control owners and platform teams.

Validate remediation through re-testing, track security control effectiveness and detection coverage trends over time, and support measurable security posture improvement.  

* Build and maintain custom attack scenarios, assessment templates and simulation playbooks using Python, PowerShell or Bash.
* Produce executive dashboards, KPIs/KRIs and technical reports on control efficacy, MITRE ATT&CK coverage and risk reduction for CISO, security leadership, internal audit and regulators.
* Design and implement Attack Surface Management (ASM) / External Attack Surface Management (EASM) capabilities to provide continuous visibility into the organization's digital attack surface.
* Define ASM processes, governance, workflows and operating models.

Perform continuous discovery and monitoring of internet-facing and digital assets including domains, subdomains, IP addresses, applications, APIs, cloud assets, certificates and exposed services.  

* Identify unknown, unmanaged, rogue and shadow IT assets perform asset attribution and establish ownership for discovered assets.
* Analyze exposed services, vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, security controls and other external exposures.
* Correlate ASM findings with Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence and CTEM processes.
* Develop risk-based prioritization strategies based on asset criticality, exploitability, exposure and business impact.
* Integrate ASM platforms with CMDB, SIEM, SOAR, ticketing and vulnerability management solutions.
* Support M&A and subsidiary environments by identifying and assessing newly acquired digital assets.
* Define dashboards, KPIs, KRIs, reports and management-level metrics for attack surface visibility.
* Develop ASM runbooks, standard operating procedures, assessment methodologies and remediation workflows.
* Evaluate ASM tools and capabilities support solution selection, PoCs and technical demonstrations.

  
Professional & Technical Skills:  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Security Penetration Testing with strong expertise in Breach & Attack Simulation (BAS) and Attack Surface Management (ASM/EASM).
* Strong working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, Cyber Kill Chain, adversary emulation and TTP analysis.

-Hands-on experience with BAS platforms — SafeBreach, AttackIQ, Cymulate, Picus, XM Cyber or equivalent — and ASM platforms such as CrowdStrike Falcon -Surface, Tenable ASM, Microsoft Defender EASM, CyCognito or BitSight.  

* Experience with SIEM platforms — Splunk, IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, ArcSight or Securonix — including query languages (SPL, KQL, AQL).

Experience with EDR/XDR solutions — CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne, Trellix or Carbon Black.  

* Solid understanding of network security, TCP/IP, firewalls, proxies, email security, Windows and Linux internals and Active Directory attack techniques (Kerberoasting, Pass-the-Hash, DCSync).
* Strong knowledge of ASM/EASM concepts including external asset discovery, DNS, domains, subdomains, IP addresses, certificates, cloud assets, APIs and exposed services.
* Knowledge of OSINT and reconnaissance techniques and tools.

Scripting and automation skills in Python and/or PowerShell to build and maintain simulation frameworks and ASM workflows.  

* Knowledge of incident response, log analysis, malware behavior and threat intelligence concepts (IOCs, IOAs, STIX/TAXII).
* Understanding of Vulnerability Management, Threat Intelligence and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM).
* Experience integrating security platforms with CMDB, SIEM, SOAR and ticketing systems.
* Awareness of financial services security regulations — PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, SOX and relevant regional regulatory frameworks.

Strong analytical, documentation and communication skills with the ability to present technical findings to non-technical and executive stakeholders.  
  
Additional Information:  

* The candidate should have a minimum of 12 years of overall cybersecurity experience, with at least 12 years in Security Penetration Testing, including 3–5 years of hands-on experience in Breach & Attack Simulation (BAS) and 2–4 years in Attack Surface Management (ASM/EASM).
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full-time education is required.

  
15 years full time education
