title: SAP C-ALM
description:
**Position Executive Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Lead SAP Cloud ALM & Enterprise Toolchain Architect**
to define, govern, and operationalize the complete Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) strategy for our global Greenfield SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
  
  
Acting as the single point of accountability for SAP Cloud ALM adoption across all global regions and workstreams, the ideal candidate will establish cross-functional governance, build end-to-end lifecycle traceability, integrate enterprise toolchains, and drive quality engineering across all phases of the SAP Activate framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Core Governance**
  
  

* Cloud ALM Strategy & Governance
* Strategy Definition: Formulate and execute a comprehensive Cloud ALM strategy aligned with SAP Activate methodology across all global rollout templates.
* Governance Framework: Establish and enforce ALM governance standards across requirements gathering, business process hierarchy modeling, testing execution, defect management, deployment controls, and operations.
* Single Accountability: Serve as the central point of contact and accountability for Cloud ALM adoption across global regions, system integrators, and project workstreams.
* Enterprise Toolchain Integration & Traceability
* Toolchain Management: Architect and manage data flows across the integrated ALM toolchain, connecting SAP Cloud ALM with enterprise architecture, modeling, testing, and operational tools.
* End-to-End Lineage: Maintain complete vertical and horizontal traceability across the lifecycle: Business Scope → Process Design → Requirements/User Stories → Development Units → Test Cases → Defects → Transports/Deployments.
* Integration Engineering: Design and implement robust integration and real-time data synchronization between SAP Cloud ALM and enterprise solutions, including:

+ Process Modeling: Signavio
+ Architecture & Capability Mapping: LeanIX
+ Work Management & ITSM: Jira / ServiceNow
+ Test Management: Tricentis, HP ALM, or equivalent
+ Documentation Systems: Confluence, SharePoint

* Solution Enablement & Fit-to-Standard Execution
* Cloud ALM Configuration: Setup and configure SAP Cloud ALM for:

+ Business process hierarchy structure and solution documentation
+ Requirement, scope, and user story management
+ Test planning, script execution, and defect tracking
+ Task management and deployment tracking

* Fit-to-Standard Governance: Enable and support Fit-to-Standard workshops using standard SAP Best Practices content and Cloud ALM pre-delivered scope elements.
* Program Visibility: Design and maintain project scope baselines, milestone tracking, and real-time status dashboards for executive program leadership.
* Test Quality Management
* Test Strategy Formulation: Design and govern the program-wide testing framework (Unit Testing, System Integration Testing [SIT], User Acceptance Testing [UAT], and Regression Testing) inside SAP Cloud ALM.
* Multi-Regional Execution: Coordinate test execution across multi-regional teams, third-party system integrators, and varying time zones.
* Quality KPIs: Provide executive-level reporting on test coverage, defect burn-down rates, quality KPIs, and release readiness dashboards.
* Release, Deployment & Cutover Management
* Release Orchestration: Oversee release planning, deployment tracking, and release governance using Cloud ALM.
* CI/CD & Transport Integration: Connect Cloud ALM with SAP Transport Management and modern CI/CD delivery pipelines where applicable.
* Cutover Execution: Support cutover sequence planning, dependency mapping, and real-time deployment monitoring.
* Integration & Operations Readiness (Run / Hypercare Phase)
* Monitoring Setup: Configure operational monitoring within Cloud ALM, including:

+ Integration & Exception Monitoring
+ Business Process Monitoring
+ Automated Job Monitoring

* Operational Transition: Lead the transition of ALM artifacts from the project phase to Hypercare and steady-state operations (Run phase).
* Alerting & KPIs: Establish operational KPIs, threshold alerts, and health monitoring for steady-state governance.
* Stakeholder Leadership & Vendor Coaching
* Subject Matter Expert (SME): Act as the lead SME for the Program Management Office (PMO), System Integrator partners, SAP, and regional business leaders.
* Enablement & Upskilling: Coach and upskill project team members, functional leads, and regional business units on Cloud ALM best practices and standardized tool usage.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
SAP ALM & Program Expertise
  
  

* 7–10+ years of hands-on SAP implementation experience within large-scale enterprise environments.
* 3+ years direct experience configuring and leading SAP Cloud ALM (or SAP Solution Manager with a proven track record of Cloud ALM transition).
* Strong, practical knowledge of SAP Activate methodology across all project phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
* Proven experience in Greenfield SAP S/4HANA global implementations.

Functional & Technical Knowledge
  
  

* Solid comprehension of core SAP S/4HANA business processes (e.g., Finance, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Logistics).
* Hands-on familiarity with SAP Best Practices content and enterprise process models.
* Working knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g., Tricentis, CBTA).
* Familiarity with SAP integration technologies (SAP BTP, Cloud Integration / CPI) and SAP transport management concepts.

Leadership & Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven track record in stakeholder management within complex, multi-vendor, global environments.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across global teams, time zones, and diverse organizational cultures.
* Highly organized, structured, quality-focused, and proactive mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications (nice To Have)**

* Official SAP Cloud ALM Certification.
* Prior experience in large-scale rollouts (multi-country, multi-template architectures).
* Exposure to modern DevOps principles and CI/CD pipelines within SAP enterprise landscapes.
* Prior experience in roles such as Enterprise ALM Lead, QA Lead, or Test Manager.

title: Solution Architect
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

About this opportunity:

We are seeking a Cloud Architect to design, define, and govern cloud-native infrastructure for SD SL core network deployments. The role covers the cloud platform that hosts 5G and 4G core network functions, including Cloud Network Functions (CNFs), and ensures they meet performance, availability, security, and operational requirements. The architect works across network, cloud, and delivery teams to move solutions from design through deployment and into operation.

What will you do:

* Design the end-to-end cloud infrastructure for core network workloads, including compute, storage, networking, and orchestration layers.
* Define cloud platform architecture for CNF hosting, covering Kubernetes-based and NFV-based deployments as applicable.
* Specify placement, resource allocation, and scaling strategies for core network functions such as AMF, SMF, UPF, PCF, UDM, AUSF, NRF, and NSSF.
* Ensure cloud designs meet telecom-grade requirements for latency, throughput, high availability, geo-redundancy, and disaster recovery.
* Define cloud security architecture, including network segmentation, identity and access management, secrets management, and compliance controls.
* Collaborate with core network architects on SBI, interworking, and protocol-level requirements that affect cloud design.
* Lead architecture reviews, design documentation, and solution approval with internal and customer stakeholders.
* Evaluate cloud vendors, platforms, and tools, and make technology recommendations with clear trade-off analysis.
* Support deployment planning, troubleshoot architecture-level issues during rollout, and provide guidance to delivery teams.
* Drive automation, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD practices for core network cloud environments.
* Establish and maintain architecture standards, reference designs, and best practices.

The skills you bring:

* Proven experience architecting cloud platforms for telecom or mission-critical workloads.
* Strong knowledge of cloud-native technologies, including Kubernetes, containers, and service mesh concepts.
* Working knowledge of virtualization and NFV concepts, including OpenStack or equivalent platforms.
* Understanding of 4G/5G core network architecture, including EPC and 5GC network functions and their interfaces.
* Familiarity with telecom protocols relevant to cloud deployment, such as HTTP/2, Diameter, GTPv2, and PFCP.
* Experience with infrastructure as code tools (for example, Terraform, Ansible, or Helm).
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including overlay and underlay networks, load balancing, and traffic steering.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present architecture decisions to executive and technical audiences.

  
Preferred Qualifications:

* Hands-on experience with 5G Standalone (SA) deployments in a cloud or CNF environment.
* Experience with EPC-to-5GC migration or interworking, including NSA to SA transition.
* Knowledge of network slicing, IMS, or VoNR architecture.
* Relevant certifications in cloud platforms (for example, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Red Hat OpenShift) or Kubernetes (CKA or CKAD).
* Experience working in multi-vendor environments and with customer-facing governance processes.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.

title: Technical Lead – AI & Data Engineering
description:
Job Title: Technical Lead – AI & Data Engineering Location: Hybrid – Ahmedabad Office / Remote Department: Data Engineering & AI Experience Level: 7+ Years (with at least 2+ years leading/managing technical teams)

About the Role We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Technical Lead – AI & Data Engineering to spearhead our data and AI initiatives from initial requirement gathering through to production deployment and monitoring. In this role, you will lead a cross functional team of data engineers and AI/ML developers, serving as the technical anchor for end-to-end delivery. You will drive architectural decisions across robust ETL/ELT pipelines, relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server), and Power BI semantic models (DAX), while designing enterprise-grade AI and Generative AI systems (RAG workflows, vector search, Azure OpenAI). The ideal candidate pairs deep technical mastery with proven team-handling experience, translating business challenges into production-ready software with strict performance, cost, and reliability benchmarks.

**Responsibilities**

* Key Responsibilities
* 1. End-to-End Solution Architecture & SDLC Ownership
* Own the entire engineering lifecycle: lead requirement discovery, translate business requirements into technical roadmaps, design high- and low-level architectures, and oversee deployment to production.
* Interface directly with product owners, stakeholders, and business analysts to clarify functional expectations, identify edge cases, and define acceptance criteria.
* Establish engineering standards, production deployment strategies (blue/green, canary), rollback procedures, and post-launch maintenance workflows.
* 2. Technical Leadership & Team Management
* Lead, mentor, and coach a team of junior-to-mid-level AI and data engineers, conducting 1-on-1s, technical goal setting, and skills development.
* Own resource planning, sprint estimation, sprint planning, task delegation, and delivery tracking in an Agile framework.
* Enforce rigorous code quality, schema management, and architectural integrity through strict PR reviews, testing standards, and Git workflows.
* 3. Data Engineering & Pipeline Governance
* Architect, automate, and govern resilient ETL/ELT data pipelines using Python and Azure cloud services.
* Direct data cleansing, validation, normalization, and semantic data layer development to provide clean data for downstream analytics and AI.
* Guide database modelling, stored procedure optimization, indexing strategies, and execution plan analysis across PostgreSQL and SQL Server (SSMS).
* Oversee programmatic extraction and tabular aggregation directly from Power BI reports and semantic models using DAX.
* 4. AI, GenAI & Model Performance Engineering
* Lead the design and integration of AI/GenAI architectures (RAG systems, prompt orchestration, vector search integrations with Azure OpenAI).
* Drive inference optimization strategies to maintain low latency and compute expenses: token usage control, caching, smart chunking, ONNX runtime conversion, quantization, batching, and hardware profiling (CPU/GPU).
* Implement enterprise MLOps/LLMOps monitoring for staging and production, tracking model throughput, latency, accuracy, regression, and data drift.
* 5. CI/CD, DevOps & Operational Excellence
* Own production deployment automation via robust CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).
* Define logging, telemetry, anomaly detection, and alerting standards to minimize production downtime and pipeline breakages.

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer - AI Infrastructure
description:
**Job Description**
As a Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the software design and development of major components of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. You should be a curious problem solver, a distributed systems generalist, and a hands-on software developer with exposure to Linux, systems fundamentals, and systems troubleshooting. You should be eager to explore different parts of the stack, understand low-level system behavior, and design and build scalable distributed services. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn.
  
  
This role resides within the Compute Bare Metal Provisioning team, which owns the critical infrastructure responsible for automating the full server lifecycle—from new platform and shape creation to hardware bring-up, customer-ready instance provisioning, and firmware management. Our services operate at the intersection of bare metal hardware and full-stack orchestration frameworks, bringing together distributed systems development, Linux, and firmware integration. The team interfaces directly with components such as BMCs, NICs, SmartNICs, ILOMs, GPUs, and custom firmware stacks.
  
  
You will write code, design services, and build tooling that provisions, configures, secures, and validates server platforms across OCI’s massive fleet of Compute and GPU infrastructure. You will partner closely with teams across Compute, Networking, Security, Data Center Engineering, and Hardware Development to help OCI launch, scale, and maintain new server platforms with high reliability and minimal operational overhead. You will work directly with cutting-edge GPU hardware and see the impact of your work on the business.
  
  
You will join a smart, motivated, and diverse team with the autonomy and support to do your best work. This role offers significant opportunities for growth and hands-on learning, allowing you to expand your skills in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Linux, hardware integration, and firmware orchestration. You will build on your existing strengths while developing new expertise through challenging engineering problems and collaboration with experienced colleagues.
  
  
If you are interested in building large-scale distributed infrastructure for the cloud, writing software for cutting-edge GPU infrastructure and the latest Compute systems, and expanding your Linux and systems skills, this is your team. Oracle is aggressively investing in Oracle Cloud to provide the broadest, most comprehensive cloud in the industry.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
You will own the software design and development of major components of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. You should be a strong, hands-on software developer, a driven problem solver, and a distributed systems generalist with exposure to Linux and systems fundamentals. You will design, develop, operate, and debug services across the stack, working with technologies such as Linux, Docker, Java web services, and Terraform to build reliable, scalable distributed infrastructure.
  
  
You should take initiative, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver results wherever needed. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn. This role offers substantial opportunities for growth through hands-on development, challenging engineering problems, and collaboration with experienced engineers. You will expand your skills in distributed systems, Linux, systems troubleshooting, and Compute and GPU infrastructure.
  
  
**Qualifications:**

* 3–8+ years of software development experience, including experience building or operating large-scale, highly available distributed systems.
* Strong hands-on coding skills in an object-oriented language such as Java or C++, and experience with a scripting language such as Python.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Exposure to Linux, operating systems concepts, and systems troubleshooting, with a willingness to deepen these skills.
* Familiarity with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform.
* Working familiarity with networking protocols such as TCP/IP and HTTP, and standard network architectures.
* Understanding of databases, NoSQL systems, storage, and distributed persistence technologies.
* Comfortable using AI agents and prompt engineering to support software development, code analysis, and debugging.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with an interest in developing expertise in performance tuning.
* A demonstrated ability to learn new technologies, take ownership, and collaborate across teams.
* Experience building multi-tenant or virtualized infrastructure is a strong plus.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Manager - Technical Bid & Solution
description:
**Role**
This is not a traditional Project Manager position. We are not looking for someone whose primary strength is maintaining Jira boards, scheduling meetings or updating project plans. We need someone who can read a 150-page government RFP and determine what Dash would actually have to build, migrate, integrate, test, deploy, support and manage if we win. The ideal person can move comfortably between technical and business conversations, challenge unrealistic assumptions, coordinate architects and engineers, build a credible delivery plan and make sure the proposal never promises something the delivery team cannot execute.
  
  
Technical RFP Analysis
  
  

* Analyze technical RFP requirements and decompose them into capabilities, workstreams, deliverables and dependencies.
* Identify mandatory technical requirements, integrations, security requirements, environments, data considerations, service levels and implementation constraints.
* Develop technical questions and clarification requests where requirements are ambiguous.

Solution Shaping
  
  

* Facilitate solution workshops with architects, developers, cloud/data specialists, project managers and other SMEs.
* Develop credible solution approaches for custom application development, modernization, cloud, data, AI, integration and managed-service engagements.
* Define scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and exclusions.
* Ensure proposed solutions are practical, supportable and aligned with Dash delivery capabilities.

Estimation & Delivery Planning
  
  

* Develop or coordinate work breakdown structures, staffing models, schedules, milestones and effort estimates.
* Validate whether the proposed team can realistically deliver within the requested schedule.
* Identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies and support pricing teams with clear resource, effort and timeline assumptions.

Technical Proposal Development
  
  

* Own or co-author technical approaches, implementation plans, transition plans, architecture narratives, project-management approaches and related proposal sections.
* Provide technical input to graphics, diagrams and solution architecture.
* Review technical proposal sections for accuracy, consistency and credibility.
* Participate in technical Red Team reviews.

Presentations & Pursuit-to-Delivery Continuity
  
  

* Support oral presentations, technical demonstrations, solution-defense sessions and clarification responses.
* Lead structured technical handoff after award so delivery receives proposal assumptions, commitments, staffing models, milestones and risks.
* Track lessons learned from actual project delivery and feed them back into future estimates and proposal approaches.

Reusable Solution Assets
  
  

* Develop reusable reference approaches for recurring SLED opportunities.
* Maintain solution patterns, estimation assumptions, team models and implementation approaches that can accelerate future pursuits.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 7-10+ years of experience across IT delivery, architecture, technical presales, solution consulting, bid management or technical project leadership.
* At least 3 years of meaningful involvement in RFP/RFI responses, presales or solutioning.
* Strong understanding of modern application development, cloud, integration, data and enterprise technology delivery.
* Ability to estimate teams, effort, timelines and implementation dependencies.
* Strong understanding of project risks, assumptions and delivery governance.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong professional writing and presentation skills and willingness to challenge unrealistic assumptions.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* U.S. public-sector or government-bid experience.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* PMP, Scrum, SAFe, cloud or architecture certifications.
* Experience with AI/ML, data platforms, application modernization or systems integration.
* Experience supporting fixed-price or deliverables-based IT services proposals.

The Personality We Are Looking For
  
  

* Wants to understand how things actually work rather than repeating buzzwords.
* Challenges an estimate that does not make sense.
* Is comfortable saying, "We should not promise this unless we can prove how we will deliver it."
* Connects commercial promises to delivery reality.
* Takes ownership from RFP analysis through award handoff.
* Can work effectively with strong technical personalities.
* Is practical, curious, organized and decisive.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within the first 90 days, major solution-based pursuits should have clearer scope, assumptions, estimates, staffing models, timelines and technical narratives, with stronger continuity between what Dash sells and what Dash ultimately delivers.

Network & Security

* Implement security best practices, access control and patch management

Servers & Systems

* Install, maintain and back up SQL Server databases; handle basic performance checks and user access
* Manage Microsoft 365: user and license management, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive and security settings
* Manage server backups, restoration and disaster recovery readiness

Communication & Devices

* Configure and support RingCentral and Vonage cloud telephony: users, extensions, call routing and number setup
* Install, configure and troubleshoot IP phones
* Configure and maintain eSSL biometric attendance and access control devices, including network integration
* Manage power backup systems (UPS) and ensure uptime of critical infrastructure

Team & Process

* Act as the L2/L3 escalation point and mentor L1 engineers
* Handle critical tickets and outages within SLA, with root cause analysis
* Maintain network diagrams, configuration backups and documentation
* Coordinate with ISPs, vendors and OEMs for support and replacements
* Proactively identify risks and recommend infrastructure improvements

Required Skills:

* Strong hands-on experience with Sophos firewall
* Strong knowledge of switching, routing and core networking (TCP/IP, VLANs, subnetting, VPN, NAT)
* Windows Server administration and Active Directory
* SQL Server installation, backup and basic administration
* Microsoft 365 administration
* RingCentral and Vonage telephony, plus IP phone setup
* Wireless access point configuration
* eSSL device configuration and UPS / power backup management
* Excellent English communication for US/UK clients
* Strong troubleshooting, ownership and ability to work under pressure

Preferred:

* CCNA / CCNP, Sophos Certified Engineer/Architect, Microsoft (MCSA / Azure / M365) certifications
* Experience in managed services or supporting international clients

Qualification:  
B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / MCA or equivalent in IT, Computer Science or related field

Shift Requirement:  
Must be comfortable with rotational US and UK shifts, including nights and weekends as per roster, and on-call support during critical issues.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

6+ years of experience building and operating production backend services, distributed systems, or large-scale data platforms.

Expertise in Python: Deep proficiency in the modern Python ecosystem (FastAPI, uv, async I/O, typing).

Database & Caching Mastery: Advanced knowledge of PostgreSQL (query optimization, ACID transactions, locking mechanisms, indexing) and Redis (caching strategies, pub/sub, distributed locks).

Container & Cloud Orchestration: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s), Docker, Helm, and AWS cloud architecture.

Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Proven track record with CDKTF (Cloud Development Kit for Terraform) or Terraform.

Workflow Orchestration: Production experience with pipeline orchestrators such as Dagster, Celery, or Apache Airflow.

Observability: Practical experience instrumenting systems with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog.

Distributed Systems Fundamentals: Clear understanding of race conditions, deadlocks, consensus primitives, and message-queue semantics.

**Good To Have**

Experience with Lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and CDC (Change Data Capture) via Debezium/Kafka.

Exposure to MLOps workflows (MLflow, Feature Stores, embedding pipelines).

Familiarity with consensus protocols and distributed coordination systems (Raft, Paxos, ZooKeeper, etcd).

Frontend familiarity with React, TypeScript, or Tailwind CSS.

Active contributions to open-source software.

**Roles and Key Responsibilities:**

1. Backend & Microservices Engineering:

Architect, build, and deploy low-latency, scalable APIs and microservices using modern Python (FastAPI, FastMCP, uv).

Integrate foundational AI/LLM models and external services (e.g., AWS Bedrock).

Define resilient service interfaces, API schemas, and data contracts between internal engineering teams.

2. Distributed Systems & Concurrency Management:

Design robust state-management patterns to handle high-concurrency race conditions across worker pools, message queues, and database rows.

Implement distributed synchronization mechanisms (e.g., distributed locks/mutexes, idempotency keys, and optimistic/pessimistic locking strategies).

Ensure reliable execution, deduplication, and zero-data-loss guarantees across asynchronous task workers.

3. Data Infrastructure & Orchestration:

Develop and maintain scalable job orchestration workflows for streaming and batch processing using Celery, Dagster, or Apache Airflow.

Design, optimize, and maintain relational datastores (PostgreSQL) and in-memory caches (Redis).

Build modern analytical pipelines and data storage layers leveraging Lakehouse architectures (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake) and Change Data Capture (CDC) patterns.

Enforce end-to-end data quality, governance, schema evolution, and lineage across platforms.

4. Cloud Infrastructure, Kubernetes & CI/CD

Own, automate, and maintain cloud environments on AWS using Infrastructure-as-Code (CDKTF / Terraform).

Containerize services with Docker and manage deployments, auto-scaling (HPA), and load-balancing on Kubernetes (k8s) using Helm.

Build, maintain, and optimize secure GitHub Actions CI/CD deployment pipelines.

5. Observability & Reliability Engineering

Ensure production uptime, high availability, and performance SLA/SLO benchmarks.

Build deep observability, tracing, and alerting stacks across all microservices and data pipelines using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, and Datadog.

**Note: Please send Cv only, who can attend the interview weekdays, with short notice period (max 15 days only)**

**Job Location: Cochin / Trivandrum, (work from office only) (Face to Face Interview only)**

**Employment Type: 1 Year Contract**

title: Lead Engineer - Converions/Migration
description:
**Skills**

SQL Server, ETL/Data Migration, Azure Data Factory (ADF)

**Years**

6 to 9 years

**Location**

Kochi/Trivandrum

**Job Role**

Lead Engineer - Conversion/Migration to work under the direction of the Data Conversion Architect, driving the hands-on design, build, and execution of data conversion and migration pipelines for enterprise client engagements.

**JD/Responsibilities**

•Strong hands-on expertise in SQL Server (T-SQL) and relational database design, with solid experience in data migration and conversion projects.

•Design and build ETL/ELT pipelines to convert data between source and target systems, following the mapping and transformation logic defined by the Architect.

•Good working knowledge of data mapping, source-to-target transformation logic, and reconciliation techniques for large datasets.

•Hands-on experience writing and optimizing SQL Server stored procedures, indexes, and queries for high-volume batch processing.

•Proficiency with ETL tooling such as SSIS, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent, along with scripting (PowerShell/Python) for data validation and automation.

•Good understanding of data quality, de-duplication, cleansing, and validation techniques.

•Working knowledge of cloud data platforms (Azure SQL, Azure Synapse, or AWS RDS/Redshift) and hybrid on-prem-to-cloud migration patterns.

•Awareness of data security and compliance considerations during migration, including encryption at rest/in transit and access controls.

•Ability to execute rollback, dry-run, and phased/parallel-run cutover activities under the guidance of the Architect.

•Ability to maintain data lineage, mapping documentation, and audit trails for validation and sign-off purposes.

•Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with experience resolving issues in large batch conversion jobs.

title: Advisory Solutions Engineer
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Your Role and Responsibilities
  
  
Solutions Engineers at Confluent play a critical role across the customer journey. They help customers evaluate the platform, design the right technical approach, prove value quickly, and build confidence in adopting data streaming patterns that solve meaningful business problems. This role sits at the intersection of technical depth, customer discovery, solution design, and business value articulation.
  
  
In this role, you will partner closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to uncover stated and unstated customer needs, shape strong technical strategies, and guide customers toward successful adoption of Confluent. You will be expected to lead technical discovery, own the technical win, and build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Lead technical discovery with prospects and customers to uncover business drivers, technical requirements, risks, and success criteria.
* Design and present solution architectures that clearly connect Confluent capabilities to customer outcomes, technical constraints, and long-term platform strategy.
* Own and drive technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and proof of value activities from initial scope through technical win.
* Run workshops, white boarding sessions, and architecture discussions with developers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders.
* Help customers adopt best practices for data streaming, cloud, hybrid, and event-driven architectures as they move from individual projects toward broader platform adoption.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Support, Professional Services, and Customer Success to remove blockers, shape solutions, and improve customer outcomes.
* Contribute to account strategy with Account Executives by helping qualify opportunities, build champions, and strengthen the technical and business case for change.
* Create reusable assets such as demos, presentations, reference architectures, discovery patterns, or enablement material that scale beyond a single account.
* Mentor other Solutions Engineers by sharing best practices, giving constructive feedback, and helping lift the technical quality of the wider team.

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* 5+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, or a similar customer-facing technical role.
* Experience working with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, streaming or messaging platforms, data integration, and modern data platforms.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, containers, Kubernetes, and modern application architectures.
* Ability to run high-quality discovery, map pain points to solution approaches, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience leading technical evaluations, workshops, and customer presentations in complex enterprise sales cycles.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging developers, architects, and senior customer stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with one or more of Java, Python, SQL, or similar technologies commonly used to build and integrate data-driven applications.
* A self-starter mindset with strong judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly, operate independently, and solve ambiguous technical problems.
* Proven ability to collaborate across functions and build trust with colleagues, customers, and partners.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Experience with Kafka, Apache Flink, stream processing, or real-time analytics platforms.
* Familiarity with value-based selling, MEDDPICC or similar qualification frameworks.
* Experience creating repeatable demos, technical content, playbooks, or enablement material for the broader field organization.
* A track record of mentoring peers and influencing team practices beyond your own accounts.
* Comfort engaging senior customer stakeholders and helping shape larger platform or transformation discussions.

**About RTX**
At RTX, 185,000 people come together with a shared purpose—to solve the world's most complex challenges and make a meaningful difference.With three industry-leading businesses, world-class operations, and significant investments in research and development, RTX brings together technology, innovation, and expertise to push the boundaries of what is possible.Together, we develop technologies that help connect and protect our world and shape the future of aerospace and defense.
  
  
**About Collins Aerospace**
Collins Aerospace, an RTX company, is a global leader in technologically advanced and intelligent aerospace and defense solutions.
  
  
With deep technical expertise and a comprehensive portfolio of products and services, Collins Aerospace helps customers address some of the most demanding challenges in the global aerospace industry.
  
  
Join us and be part of a team that is redefining aerospace through technology, innovation, and engineering excellence.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The SAP Basis Administrator will play a critical role in ensuring the performance, availability, security, and reliability of enterprise-critical SAP systems across a global environment. This role supports key business functions, including finance, order management, inventory, procurement, shipping, and engineering.
  
  
You will collaborate with global SAP, infrastructure, network, security, and business teams to maintain a stable SAP landscape, drive continuous improvement, identify automation opportunities, and support strategic technology initiatives. The role offers opportunities to make independent technical decisions and contribute to the evolution of the company’s SAP infrastructure and digital strategy.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* SAP Landscape Management: Execute SAP infrastructure and architecture roadmaps, ensuring system stability, availability, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* System Administration: Install, configure, patch, maintain, and refresh SAP applications and database systems.
* Performance Optimization: Monitor system performance, analyze resource utilization, perform tuning and capacity management, and proactively identify potential issues.
* Incident and Service Management: Handle service management tickets, troubleshoot system issues, perform health checks, and support break/fix activities.
* Infrastructure Collaboration: Partner with data center, network, storage, security, and database teams to deliver reliable and secure SAP solutions.
* High Availability and Disaster Recovery: Support SAP infrastructure design and initiatives involving high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Automation and Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate routine activities, improve operational efficiency, and enhance existing processes.
* Documentation: Develop and maintain technical specifications, system architecture diagrams, design documents, requirements, and test scripts.
* Business-Critical Support: Support SAP Digital Technology (DT) teams during critical system outages, planned maintenance, and operational activities.
* Global Support: Participate in on-call rotations, work in US hours as required, and provide weekend support when necessary.

**What You Will Learn**

* Gain exposure to a large, global SAP landscape supporting critical enterprise business functions.
* Develop deeper expertise in SAP infrastructure architecture, system performance, and landscape management.
* Understand high-availability solutions, disaster recovery strategies, and enterprise infrastructure standards.
* Explore automation opportunities and continuous improvement initiatives across SAP operations.
* Collaborate with global technical teams and business stakeholders on strategic SAP initiatives.
* Contribute to SAP modernization and digital transformation initiatives.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* 9+ years of experience working in an SAP Basis administration role.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, including networking, servers, storage, databases, and application architecture.
* Hands-on experience administering SAP ECC, BW, PI, Solution Manager, and SAP HANA systems.
* Knowledge of system architecture, performance monitoring, tuning, and capacity management methodologies and tools.
* Experience in scripting using Bash, Python, or similar scripting languages.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at different organizational levels, including leadership.
* Ability to work in a global support environment, including US working hours, on-call rotations, and occasional weekend support.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience working in a large, complex, global SAP environment.
* Knowledge of SAP technologies, architecture, interfaces, and batch processing.
* Experience with Oracle databases, SAP HANA, Linux, and cloud environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and/or Lean methodologies.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, CRM, SNC, SLT, Hybris, and SAP Web Dispatcher.
* Knowledge of web technologies, firewalls, proxy servers, and Single Sign-On (SSO) frameworks.
* Experience supporting SAP system upgrades, migrations, integrations, and infrastructure improvements.
* Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage projects, and drive process improvements within a technical domain.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree: Typically requires a bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM), or a related field, along with relevant experience.
* Advanced degree: A master’s or other advanced degree in a related field may be considered with the applicable level of relevant experience.
* Experience in lieu of education: Candidates without a degree may qualify with equivalent relevant professional experience, subject to company policy and applicable requirements.

**Digital Technology**
Do you want to be part of a new, exciting initiative to combine foundational IT with new digital technologies?  Our Digital Technology team is driving business efficiencies and a better customer experience by connecting technologies, people, information and processes. From making aircraft more electric, intelligent and integrated to building new software platforms such as Internet of Things, big data, artificial intelligence, and blockchain, there’s no better place to be right now than in digital. If you’re an agile thinker who enjoys utilizing modern technology to make big improvements, then you’re a perfect fit for this team. Join Collins Aerospace to help us revolutionize the aerospace industry today!
  
  
WE ARE REDEFINING AEROSPACE.
  
  

* Please consider the following role type definitions as you apply for this role.

Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.
  
  
Hybrid: Employees who are working in Hybrid roles will work regularly both onsite and offsite. Ratio of time working onsite will be determined in partnership with your leader.
  
  
Remote: Employees who are working in Remote roles will work primarily offsite (from home). An employee may be expected to travel to the site location as needed.
  
  
*Regardless of your role type, collaboration and innovation are critical to our business and all employees will have access to digital tools so they can work with colleagues around the world – and access to Collins sites when their work requires in-person meetings.*

title: Senior Information Technology Support Engineer
description:
**The Company Behind the Products**

Every business talks about “better customer conversations.” SaaS Labs builds products that actually make them happen.

From JustCall to CallPage to ServiceAgent.ai, we help thousands of businesses communicate better.

Here's where we are: With 300+ people across India, the US, and beyond, we’re at an inflection point as AI reshapes business communication.

What it's like to work here? Total ownership. We’re a team that moves with purpose, builds with ambition, and loves seeing our work make real impact.

And, if you're already nodding along, let's start the conversation.

With JustCall we’re leading the innovation on how sales and service teams connect with their customers— using AI — across calls, texts, emails, WhatsApp, and whatever comes next!It’s a multichannel communication system that helps 7000+ of our customers serve theirs better- with 24/7 AI Agents, on-point integrations, and other forward-looking features.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Sr. IT Support Engineer to own and deliver end-to-end technical support across access management, user onboarding and offboarding, application support, and infrastructure and network management.

Your goal is reliable IT operations: resolving network, system, and software issues, managing licenses and access permissions, and provisioning laptops for new joiners. That means minimal downtime, a productive workforce, and business continuity.

As a senior member of the IT team, you will be the go-to person for complex issues, set the standard for support quality, and drive improvements in processes, security, and automation. You’ll work closely with internal stakeholders and vendors in a fast-paced environment.

**Location:**
Bangalore (in-office 5 days a week, as collaboration and quick problem-solving are best enabled through close teamwork)

**What you'll do**

* **Technical Support:**
  Provide end-to-end troubleshooting for desktop systems, applications, and network connectivity; resolve hardware, software, and OS-related issues.
* **Monitoring & Troubleshooting:**
  Proactively monitor and troubleshoot network, internet, hardware, and system issues to keep IT operations running smoothly and minimise downtime.
* **Hardware & Software Maintenance:**
  Install, configure, and maintain computers, peripherals, and mobile devices; ensure timely updates across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
* **Laptop Provisioning & Allocation:**
  Manage laptop allocation, configuration, and handover for new joiners and existing employees, ensuring every device is ready and compliant on Day 1.
* **Network Management:**
  Support and troubleshoot LAN/WAN/VPN connectivity; manage routers, switches, and wireless networks to maintain secure and stable operations.
* **Access & Onboarding/Offboarding:**
  Manage user accounts, access permissions, and role assignments (JumpCloud, Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian). Own the onboarding and offboarding lifecycle, including account setup and asset recovery.
* **License & IT Asset Management:**
  Manage software licenses, track IT hardware and inventory, and maintain software compliance. Ensure license usage is optimised and audit-ready.
* **Vendor Coordination:**
  Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for procurement, repairs, replacements, and IT infrastructure maintenance and issue resolution.
* **Security & Compliance:**
  Implement and monitor IT security policies; assist with SOC/ISO/HIPAA audits and ensure compliance with organisational standards.
* **Documentation & Training:**
  Maintain documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles. Create user guides and conduct training sessions on common tools and workflows.
* **Process Improvement & Automation:**
  Identify recurring issues and automate repetitive tasks (PowerShell/Bash) to improve turnaround time and the employee experience.
* **Mentorship:**
  Guide junior team members, review their work, and help raise the overall support standard.

**What we're looking for**

* **Education**
  : Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* **Experience:**
  5–6 years as an IT Support, Desktop Support, or Systems Support Engineer, with hands-on expertise in access management, user onboarding/offboarding, laptop provisioning, and application management.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Strong working knowledge of macOS, Windows, and Linux, along with experience in Google Workspace, Slack, Atlassian, and other productivity tools.
* **Systems & Cloud:**
  Hands-on experience with identity and access management and device management platforms (JumpCloud, JAMF, Active Directory, LDAP). Exposure to cloud environments like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* **Networking & Troubleshooting:**
  Solid understanding of network fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi), diagnostics, and root-cause resolution of hardware and software issues.
* **Asset & License Management:**
  Experience maintaining IT inventory, tracking licenses, and keeping documentation audit-ready.
* **Security Awareness:**
  Working knowledge of endpoint security, access controls, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA).
* **Soft Skills:**
  Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving abilities with a customer-first approach. Able to work independently, take ownership, and collaborate across teams.

**Edges that help**

* Certifications such as CompTIA A+/Network+/Security+, ITIL Foundation, CCNA, or MCSE
* Scripting and automation skills (PowerShell/Bash)
* Experience with ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Jira Service Management)
* Experience with endpoint management solutions (MDM, SCCM, Intune)
* Prior experience mentoring or leading junior IT staff

**How we work**

SaaS Labs takes pride in being an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products, which is why we're committed to taking hiring or any employment decision regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic.

* Customer service orientated and pro-active thinking.
* Problem solver who is highly driven and self-organized.
* Great attention to detail.
* Good analytical and logical thinking.
* Excellent spoken and written communication skills.
* Team player with the ability to work well with others and in group with colleagues and stakeholders.

* Relevant level of Networking certifications such as CCNA, JNCIA, ACCA, PCNSA, CCSA etc. preferred.

description:
**Company Description**
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at
**Intuitive**
. As a global leader in
**robotic-assisted surgery**
and
**minimally invasive care**
, our technologies—like the
**da Vinci surgical system**
and
**Ion**
—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
  
  
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
  
  
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
  
  
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help
**transform the future of healthcare**
, you’ll find your purpose here.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Primary Function of Position**
The Learning Management Systems (LMS) Administrator 3 is responsible for the administration and maintenance of the company’s learning system technology to deliver online training to internal and/or external customers. Assists with data migrations, working with IT and outside vendors to test and troubleshoot systems issues; supports development of processes, content generation and loading; maintains training and user profile records; coordinates calendaring and enrollment, tracking, assessments, reporting and customer communications for learning events. In companies with training teams, may serve as a subject matter expert, training the community of business users to maximize the utilization of system features to create and manage learning events, training modules, assessments, and reports.
  
  
**Essential Job Duties**

* Develops knowledge of Intuitive’s LMS support model and system functionality.
* Escalate support issues as necessary.
* Provide training and support to users, such as instructors and learners, on how to effectively use the LMS and its features.
* Perform intermediate content management and configuration within LMS with assistance from LMS Admin Level 4 or IT.
* Assist with creation of user stories & UAT business scripts and support UAT business testing.
* Participate in LMS process improvement initiatives Support curriculum development and content management for assigned Business Units (BUs).
* Own content management within the LMS for assigned BUs.
* Act as consultant for BU Training Operations, BU Trainers, & BU Content Owners to ensure efficient program integration with LMS.
* Help train more junior LMS Admins.
* Utilizes Agile/Veeva workflow in ongoing implementation tasks.
* Ensure the product complies with all global legal and regulatory obligations.
* Monitoring, follow-up, and close out of LMS support incidents.
* Run system reports.
* Complete special projects as assigned.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills and Experience**

* Advanced ability to troubleshoot and resolve LMS technical issues quickly.
* Coordinate and execute multiple tasks, such as implementing learning programs, software updates, and system enhancements.
* Maintain and upgrade the system to maximize functionality and upload new content.
* Strong communication skills to work effectively in a team, assign tasks, track progress, and handle client requests.
* Strong customer service skills to support the ticketing system and interact with users and stakeholders effectively.
* Intermediate experience with LMS content management, issue troubleshooting, and tier 2 support.
* Experience training end users in LMS features and functionality.
* Ability to work well with a team and independently.
* Interpersonal and analytical skills.
* Ability to learn and grow.

**Required Education And Training**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent; vocational training and/or equivalent work experience.

**Working Conditions**

* Flexible to scheduling changes and periodic adjustments for global support and collaboration purposes.

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Typically requires 2-4 years of related experience.

title: Senior IT Analyst SAP Basis Administrator
description:
****Career Area:****
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****Job Purpose**
:**
Your Work Shapes the World. Whether it be groundbreaking products, best in class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do the work that matters at Caterpillar. With a 95-year legacy of quality and innovation and 150 locations in countries around the world, your impact spans the globe.
  
  
When you join Caterpillar, you are joining a team of makers, innovators, and doers. We are the people who roll up our sleeves and do the work to build a better world. We don’t just talk about progress and innovation. We make it happen. And we are proud of that because it helps our customers build and power the world we live in – the roads, hospitals, homes and infrastructure. Without a dedicated workforce Caterpillar could not effectively meet our customer’s needs. Join us.
  
  
****Job Summary****
We are seeking an experienced
**Senior IT Analyst Applications (SAP Basis Administrator)**
to join our
**Design Eng Processes team - CAT IT Division.**
**The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN**
**This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule.**
**Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST**
The Senior SAP Basis Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, optimization, and strategic support of enterprise SAP environments. This role ensures SAP systems are secure, highly available, scalable, and compliant while supporting upgrades, migrations, disaster recovery, performance tuning, and cloud transformation initiatives. The position collaborates closely with Infrastructure, Security, Development, Middleware, Database, and Functional teams to deliver reliable SAP services. This is a critical role that helps ensure our end users experience a well-equipped, efficient, and simple support touchpoint. Further, this role owns the Continuous Improvement journey for the department, with programs that improve automation, monitoring, and analytic capabilities.
  
  
****Job Duties:****

* Own and drive all incidents, service tasks, problem tickets and system optimization for operations portfolio, ensuring delivery against commitments, SLAs, and outcomes.
* Establish, monitor, and continuously improve standard work; ensure progress, risks, and dependencies are communicated effectively to stakeholders and leadership.
* Partner with business units and decision makers to support day-to-day operations, incident/problem resolution, and continuous service improvement.
* Technical responsibilities include:

+ SAP Landscape Administration (install, configure, maintain, and support SAP ecosystem)
+ Upgrade & Patch Management
+ System Performance & Availability
+ High Availability and Disaster Recovery Services
+ Security & Compliance
+ Print Management
+ Transport Management
+ Cloud & Automation
+ Level 4 Troubleshooting/Support.
+ SAP HANA & Database administration
+ Data Lifecycle Management configuration

****What You Will Have:****

* Strong functional and/or technical application design, architecture, implementation, and support knowledge.
* Deep technical expertise across the SAP technology stack, including SAP landscape administration, HANA/database administration, upgrades and patching, performance and availability, high availability/disaster recovery, security and compliance, transport and print management, cloud and automation, data lifecycle management, and Level 4 technical support.
* Gen AI Assisted Development or Support: Practical experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or automated agent workflows) to accelerate application development or support, cost or effort reduction, or support optimization. Demonstrated experience with AI tools
* A Lean or Continuous Improvement background.
* An ability to translate between technical and business language, creating a bridge between the support organization and the Caterpillar business they serve.

****Top Candidates Will Also Have:****

* Has the ability to lead, analyze and have a broader perspective on specific technology and related solutions. This requires a comprehensive understanding of application solutions, interfaces, security, data governance policies and procedures.
* Skilled in large scale application support and development
* Hana DBA Certification
* Basis Administration Certification
* Experience with SAP on Hyperscale’s, SAP Cloud Connector, SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM), SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), Test Data Migration Methodologies)
* Knowledge of automation (Python, Ansible)
* Prior experience in driving innovation and automation
* Extensive experience in working with cross-functional teams, along with proven history of strong job-related result's
* Strong stakeholder management skills

****Additional Duties****
Perform other related duties as assigned to support organizational objectives.
  
  
**Education / Experience**
: Requires a relevant computer science master’s or graduate degree and 9-plus years of progressively complex Information Services experience, including enterprise application architecture, development, support, and modernization. Requires a general understanding of business operations, including one or more of the following: general business processes, technical infrastructure, application development and support of major projects, and engineering functional applications. The incumbent must have the ability to provide strategic direction for application and technology roadmaps, including 2–5-year plans for Information Services. Requires the ability to work with diversified departments, along with effective oral and written communication skills. The incumbent must have a strong customer focus and business knowledge.
  
  
****Additional Info**
:**

* May require travel of up to 25%
* This role requires 5 days onsite.
* Relocation is unavailable.

Skill Descriptors
  
  
Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
* Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
* Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
* Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
* Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
* Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
* Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
* Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
* Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
* Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
* Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
* Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
* Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews.
* Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges.
* Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
* Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
* Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
* Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
* Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.
* Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase.
* Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
* Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
* Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
* Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.
* Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities.
* Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
* Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
* Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
****Posting Dates:****
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

title: Senior Systems Operations Analyst
description:
This role exists as part of Nasdaq Trade Surveillance Operations Team, to join the Bangalore Technology center. NTS is a web browser based SAAS application powering Surveillance and compliance for over 170+ market participants across over 200+ markets primarily focused on broker trade compliance. You will be part of global team working closely with teams from Sydney, London, and Toronto.
  
  
As a
**Senior analyst**
, your focus will be developing and implementing software solutions. Besides working closely with your colleagues in Bangalore, you will also work closely with Nasdaq teams in other countries.
  
  

* Linux System administration tasks and Linux based troubleshooting.
* L2/L3 technical support. Troubleshooting and RCA of ALL processing issues.
* Proactively supervise and resolves the production environment issues with the use of Zabbix as a monitoring tool.
* Perform BAU activities Which includes:
