title: Lead Engineer - Windows Patch Management
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage Windows Server vulnerability findings from identification and prioritization through remediation, validation, evidence capture, and closure.
* Assess CVEs, CVSS ratings, vulnerability scan results, Microsoft security updates, and security advisories to determine appropriate remediation and priority.
* Plan and execute monthly Patch Tuesday deployments, emergency/out-of-band updates, and zero-day remediation across test, development, and production environments.
* Coordinate maintenance windows, change records, incidents, dependencies, approvals, and stakeholder communications in ServiceNow.
* Troubleshoot patching and update failures using Windows Update, WSUS, SCCM or Tanium, DISM/SFC, CBS and Windows Update logs, registry, disk-space, and reboot diagnostics.
* Verify patch installation and server health after deployment; track pending reboots, failed patches, and remediation actions through closure.
* Monitor critical and high-severity findings, SLA adherence, aging items, exceptions, and recurring patch failures; escalate blockers and maintain accurate status.
* Support vulnerability assessments, PCI requirements, audits, and security reviews by preparing remediation evidence, compliance reports, and management updates.
* Coordinate documented risk exceptions, compensating controls, and remediation plans when findings cannot be resolved within the required SLA.
* Help address legacy and end-of-life Windows Server systems through upgrades, migration, Extended Security Updates (ESU), replacement, or decommissioning plans.
* Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts to support vulnerability checks, patch compliance, remediation workflows, and reporting.
* Collaborate with application and infrastructure teams to assess impact, resolve dependencies, and deliver remediation with minimal service disruption.
* Provide technical guidance to L1/L2 support teams and engage Microsoft or other vendors when escalation is required.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience administering and patching Windows Server in an enterprise environment.
* Experience with Windows Server 2012 R2, 2016, 2019, and/or 2022, including support for legacy systems.
* Practical experience with enterprise vulnerability management and patch remediation, including remediation SLAs and prioritization of CVEs/CVSS findings.
* Experience deploying Microsoft security updates using one or more of WSUS, SCCM, or Tanium.
* Strong PowerShell scripting skills for administration, automation, validation, or reporting.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows Update, Event Viewer, DISM, SFC, CBS, Windows Update logs, registry, disk space, and reboot-related issues.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, TCP/IP, firewalls, RDP/RDS, WinRM, SMB, and TLS/SSL.
* Experience with change, incident, and remediation tracking, and with producing clear technical evidence and status reports.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with security, compliance, application, infrastructure, and operations stakeholders.

title: Senior Endpoint Engineer – Windows & Intune (EUC Engineer III)
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.
  
  
**Job Description**
Location:
  
  
Bengaluru, KA
  
  
**About The Role**
The End User Compute (EUC) team delivers the endpoint platforms, tools and services that enable our colleagues to work securely and effectively.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on engineer to help shape and deliver improvements across device management, provisioning, automation and hardware lifecycles. Your primary expertise will be Windows endpoint management, particularly Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot and PowerShell. Experience administering both Windows and macOS is highly valued. Strong Windows engineers who are willing to learn and take increasing responsibility for Mac administration are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain and enhance our Microsoft Intune environments, including device enrolment, configuration, compliance and application management, ensuring services remain secure, reliable and scalable.
* Develop and improve light-touch provisioning using Windows Autopilot, with minimal manual IT intervention and a robust setup experience.
* Configure and troubleshoot the interactions between Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows Autopilot and Okta, working with identity teams to support reliable device provisioning, authentication and access.
* Plan and deliver endpoint migrations between Microsoft Entra ID tenants, managing dependencies, device transitions, user access, testing and communications while minimising disruption.
* Manage Windows update policies, deployment rings and operating system upgrades, including compatibility testing, pilot deployments, phased rollouts, compliance monitoring and remediation of failed updates.
* Package, test, deploy and maintain Windows applications, including installation and detection logic, dependencies, upgrades and removal. Use WinGet and other appropriate tools to improve application management and employee self-service.
* Develop reusable PowerShell scripts and automation to detect and remediate recurring endpoint issues, reduce manual administration and improve reporting. Apply appropriate testing, logging and error handling.
* Collaborate with Security teams to manage endpoint vulnerabilities, maintain endpoint security tools and implement controls such as encryption, security baselines and local administrator restrictions.

Investigate root causes, coordinate vendor escalations and implement lasting fixes through established incident, problem and change management processes.

title: Technical Support Engineer – Slurm
description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 30 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation fueled by great technology—and dynamic people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing—an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. NVIDIANs immerse themselves in a diverse, supportive environment that encourages everyone to do their best work. Join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
Slurm is a critical workload manager for many of the world’s most demanding AI and high-performance computing environments. We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer dedicated to supporting Slurm for NVIDIA’s customers. You will join a dedicated team of Slurm subject-matter guides, owning sophisticated support cases and helping customers run reliable, efficient, and highly scalable clusters. This role requires extensive production experience with Slurm and the ability to diagnose issues across the scheduler and the surrounding Linux, networking, storage, authentication, database, and GPU infrastructure.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own Slurm support cases from initial investigation through resolution for customers running production AI and HPC clusters.
* Diagnose complex problems involving slurmctld, slurmd, slurmdbd, job scheduling, node management, resource allocation, accounting, authentication, and high availability.
* Solve Slurm configuration and policy features, including partitions, reservations, priorities, fair-share, quality of service, backfill, preemption, GRES/TRES, cgroups, and job constraints.
* Investigate performance, reliability, and scalability issues using logs, diagnostic data, configuration analysis, reproductions, and source-level debugging when required.
* Isolate problems across Slurm and its surrounding dependencies, including Linux, MUNGE, databases, networking, parallel storage, containers, GPUs, and cluster-management systems.
* Advise customers on Slurm configuration, upgrades, operational practices, managing system resources, and safe recovery from production incidents.
* Collaborate with engineering teams by producing clear technical descriptions, reproducible test cases, and well-supported defect reports.
* Develop guides, knowledge-base articles, diagnostic tools, and internal training that strengthen Slurm expertise across the support organization.

**What We Need To See**

* BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience administering and supporting Slurm in production HPC or AI environments including business-critical outage incidents.
* Expert-level understanding of Slurm architecture, daemons, configuration, scheduling behavior, accounting, resource management, and failure modes.
* Capacity to identify sophisticated Slurm incidents independently and guide them to a technically sound resolution.
* In-depth Linux system-administration and solve experience, including systemd, cgroups, authentication, networking, and database-backed services.
* Experience operating Slurm across multi-user clusters with complex scheduling policies and heterogeneous compute resources.
* Strong analytical and research skills, showing proficiency in distinguishing Slurm defects from configuration, integration, infrastructure, and workload problems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn detailed technical findings into clear explanations and actionable recommendations.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience supporting large-scale Slurm environments containing thousands of nodes or GPUs.
* Experience diagnosing scheduler performance, job-throughput, controller-load, and database-scaling issues.
* Familiarity with Slurm source code, plugins, SPANK, Lua job-submit plugins, or upstream issue investigation.
* Experience with containers and HPC integration technologies such as Pyxis, Enroot, Apptainer, or Singularity.
* Previous experience integrating Slurm with NVIDIA Base Command Manager, Bright Cluster Manager, or another cluster-management platform.

title: Senior Lead - QC System - Empower
description:

This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.
  
  
Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Senior Lead - QC System - Empower will deliver and support Empower (CDS) solutions for Quality Control (QC) laboratories. The role includes project work and BAU support, platform delivery, upgrades, automation, L2/L3 support, version upgrades and practical exposure to automation capabilities.
  
  
The role diagnoses complex issues using logs, metrics, interfaces, data flows and system behaviour and implements approved corrective actions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Empower solution delivery and configuration**

* Configure and support Empower projects, methods, processing methods, reports and user security for QC labs.
* Translate QC and analytical requirements into Empower configurations following defined standards.
* Maintain Empower master data, templates and configuration items in line with global governance.
* Configuration and scripts held under version control, peer review before release, scripted or automated regression tests, and test evidence kept with the change.

**Projects and modernization**

* Contribute to the design and execution of Empower Citrix to Azure migration (environment build, cutover planning, testing and rollout).
* Support Empower version upgrades (assessment, remediation, regression testing, deployment).
* Work with infrastructure and platform teams to optimise performance, scalability and resilience in Azure.
* Participate in integration work (e.g. LIMS, instruments, archival solutions) as part of modernisation projects.

**Automation and optimisation**

* Use Empower automation capabilities (e.g. custom calculations, processing workflows, scheduling, scripts/macros where applicable) to streamline QC operations.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and standardise analytical workflows.
* Document and share reusable automation patterns and best practices within the team.
* Uses approved AI assistants to build and test Empower configuration and scripts and checks the output before submitting it for review.

**BAU support and operations**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for incidents, problems and service requests related to Empower.
* Perform root cause analysis for complex issues and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Deliver small enhancements and configuration changes through formal change management.
* Support periodic maintenance activities, including patching, housekeeping and performance tuning.
* Follow GxP, data integrity and quality procedures in all Empower changes and support activities.

**Key Relationships / Customers**
**Business and Site Stakeholders**

* Manufacturing, Quality, Laboratory, Supply Chain and MSAT stakeholders
* Site engineers, automation teams, super users and key users
* Business Process Owners and operational risk owners

**Digital & Technology Stakeholders**

* Product Managers and Product Owners
* Solution and Enterprise Architects
* Engineering, DevOps, Data and Integration teams
* Service Managers, Cyber Security and Infrastructure teams
* Validation, Quality and technical assurance teams

**Other**

* Technology vendors
* System integrators and specialist engineering partners
* Managed service and support providers

**Basic qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences or a relevant technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience with Empower CDS administration and configuration in QC / GMP environments.
* Experience supporting or implementing QC/analytical lab systems (preferably Empower) under GxP.
* Practical exposure to at least one of:
* Empower environment migrations (Citrix, virtualised or cloud-hosted setups).
* Empower version upgrades, including testing and validation.
* Empower automations (processing workflows, custom calculations, scripts, or scheduling tools).
* Good understanding of QC lab processes, chromatographic workflows and data integrity principles.
* Knowledge of CSV, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11 and data integrity (ALCOA+) in the context of CDS systems.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based service management and working with global support models.
* Exposure to scripting or automation tools used alongside Empower or other QC systems.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate architecture and product direction into clear technical designs and implementation activities.
* Clear technical writing and disciplined maintenance of specifications, designs, test evidence and configuration records.
* Understanding of interfaces, workflows, data, environments, monitoring and operational support.
* Awareness of security, quality, validation, data integrity, resilience and change controls.
* Ability to collaborate across global business, site, engineering, architecture, product, service and supplier teams.
* Continuous-improvement mindset with emphasis on standardisation, reuse, automation and knowledge sharing.

title: Subject Matter Expert
description:
**We Are Teva**
We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.
  
  
**Our Team, Your Impact**
IT Services and Support is seeking an experienced Subject Matter Expert to support IT Service Desk Operations and Transition teams. The expert drives end-to-end intelligent automation in IT service desks, designing RPA bots, multi-agent systems, and MLOps pipelines that handle incident routing, predictive maintenance, and remediation autonomously. By integrating LLMs with tools like ServiceNow and Azure, this role transforms reactive support into proactive, It fosters a hybrid human-AI environment, enhancing global scalability and compliance in high-volume environments.
  
  
**How You’ll Spend Your Day**

* Design and prototype Agentic AI workflows (LLM-based agents, optionally combined with RPA) for intelligent ticket classification, routing, and first-line resolution across incident, request, and change management.
* Architect secure integration points between AI agents and enterprise systems -ServiceNow, Active Directory/Windows Server, VMware, Power BI, and cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) -ensuring agents operate within existing identity, access, and network controls.
* Apply infrastructure and threat/vulnerability management expertise to assess and mitigate security risks introduced by AI agents with system- or API-level access.
* Build and maintain RAG-based knowledge retrieval so agent responses are grounded in verified enterprise knowledge bases, reducing hallucination risk.
* Develop PowerShell and/or Python automation to bridge AI agent actions with Windows Server, VMware, and cloud environments.
* Partner with delivery partners, vendors and internal ITSM stakeholders to translate business requirements into agent architecture and working prototypes.
* Monitor agent performance and reliability as part of the broader service desk platform, contributing to team-level uptime and SLA targets; lead root-cause analysis for automation or infrastructure failures.
* Conduct testing and validation, including A/B testing, to measure agent accuracy, safety, and ROI in production service desk scenarios.
* Contribute positively for HLD/LLD architecture – understand – all components and effectively contribute towards refining the same
* Document architecture, runbooks, and operational procedures; train service desk staff on AI tool usage and troubleshooting.
* Support cost-effective scaling of cloud resources for AI inference during high-volume periods.
* Evaluate emerging capabilities, such as multimodal AI for tickets containing screenshots, logs, or voice input, for future roadmap

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related Engineering discipline.
* 3+ years in IT infrastructure/systems administration (Windows Server, MECM, VMware, Active Directory), including hands-on exposure to LLM or agentic AI tooling (e.g., LangChain or equivalent) is a must

* Experience in Admin or developer with AWS cloud services; Azure exposure is a must
* ServiceNow platform experience strongly preferred is a must
* ITIL certification preferred.
* Background in threat and vulnerability management, particularly as it relates to securing AI-integrated systems is a plus
* Ability to bridge infrastructure knowledge with agentic AI design -understanding how automation decisions affect the real IT estate (Active Directory, Windows Server, VMware) the agent acts on is must have

**How We’ll Take Care Of You**
At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you’ll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging.
  
  
That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You’ll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community.
  
  
Your growth matters too. You’ll have opportunities to build future-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI-enabled Teva Twist program, R&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship.
  
  
Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together

Office

**Cloud, Infrastructure, and Networking**

* Manage and secure highly available, scalable, and cost-efficient AWS platforms.
* Design and govern VPCs, subnets, routing, Transit Gateway, VPC endpoints, DNS, VPN, Direct Connect, and hybrid connectivity.
* Design firewall and traffic-control solutions using AWS Network Firewall, security groups, network ACLs, and related technologies.
* Build reusable Terraform modules and automated provisioning workflows for multi-account and multi-environment deployments.

* Architect and operate enterprise CI/CD platforms using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and related tools.

* Use configuration management and infrastructure automation tools such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet to automate system configuration, software installation, and environment management.

* Apply strong knowledge of Linux internals, system services, process management, permissions, networking, storage, file systems, package management, and dependency management.
* Define containerization and orchestration strategies using Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS.

**Required Experience**

* 6-10+ years of experience in Linux Systems Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, AWS, or a related technical role.
* Strong hands-on Linux systems engineering and administration experience, particularly with Debian and Debian-derived distributions such as Ubuntu.
* Deep understanding of Linux internals, system services, process management, permissions, networking, storage, file systems, troubleshooting, and system configuration.
* Hands-on experience with Linux software packaging and package bundling, including building, maintaining, troubleshooting, and distributing Debian (.deb) packages.
* Strong understanding of Debian package management and dependency management, including APT and dpkg.
* Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.
* Proven experience architecting and operating enterprise AWS platforms.
* Strong expertise in Terraform, Infrastructure as Code, AWS networking, security, firewalls, and hybrid connectivity.
* Experience designing and automating Jenkins and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, builds, packaging, and deployments.
* Experience with Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and container platforms.

description:

**Good to Have:**

title: Hardware Systems Engineer

* Knowledge of configuration management principals, in particular we use salt to manage our fleet

**Bonus Points**

* Experience of managing large fleets comprising of thousands of servers
* Experience of observability and monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana, and the ability to observe trends over time

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
  
  
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
  
  
**Project Galileo**
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
  
  
**1.1.1.1**

title: Senior Principal - Platform Engineer Network Capabilities
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.
* Extensive experience engineering shared network services such as Domain Name System, Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol and Internet Protocol address management.
* Strong knowledge of network access control, application programming interfaces, automation, monitoring and resilient service design.
* Evidence of improving service reliability, self service, deployment speed or operational efficiency.

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

AI Programming, Automation, Automation Technology, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Data Distribution Service (DDS), Data Management and Integration (DMI), IP Address Management (IPAM), Leadership, Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Security Management, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Universal Description Discovery and Integration (UDDI), Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

title: Principal Engineer - Veeva Vault
description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.  
  
**Job Purpose:**

The Senior Technical SME (Subject Matter Expert) Veeva Quality Vault provides technical leadership within the Enterprise Veeva Quality Suite – technical Team, responsible for contributing to the technical solution design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Veeva Quality Suite across Content Management, Quality, Audit & Risk business processes.  
The role leads solution design, implementation, validation and troubleshooting and ensures technical outputs aligned with approved architecture, product strategy and engineering standards. The role acts as the technical lead for complex delivery and operational issues. The job holder reviews technical specifications, configurations and test evidence and leads root-cause analysis were operational, batch or data-integrity impact may exist. The role also develops engineering capability by coaching engineers and super users and converting lessons learned into reusable designs, standards, training and knowledge.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Provide product expertise in the Veeva Quality Suite as a certified Vault platform administrator and Veeva configuration specialist, while providing technical direction during complex incidents, releases and stabilization and coordinating internal and supplier engineering resources.
* Implement technical solution designs and configurations in accordance with approved architecture and product strategy.
* Own technical quality for the assigned scope, including specifications, design documentation, configuration records and technical validation evidence.
* Perform troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, with timely escalation where manufacturing batches, product quality, patient supply or data integrity may be affected.
* Design or configure interfaces, workflows, recipes, data models and environments and write or review related specifications and test scripts.
* Analyze logs, metrics, monitoring and system behavior to identify defects, performance issues and opportunities for improvement.
* Lead technical design and implementation across multiple projects, releases or sites, while coaching site engineers and super users and contributing to training, runbooks and knowledge articles.

**Job Purpose**

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's network segmentation and identity-based access platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by automating away toil.

title: Associate Director - IAM Advanced Authentication
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centered on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Job Purpose**:

Every person, workload and AI agent at GSK needs an identity it can prove, credentials that cannot be stolen and access that is just enough, just in time. As our applications move to the cloud and AI agents begin working alongside our people, authentication is becoming the foundation of trust for everything we do. The Associate Director, leads the engineering and delivery of that foundation, starting with single sign-on (SSO) and extending the same discipline to Azure and Google Cloud (GCP), non-human identities (NHI) and AI agents.

**Our vision:**

  

One trusted way to authenticate, whoever or whatever is asking for access: passwordless for people, secretless for workloads and tightly scoped for AI agents. Security should be invisible when everything is right and decisive when it is not. We will get there by using AI securely in our own work, setting the example for the rest of GSK.

**About the team:**

  

Authentication and Cloud Security is part of Identity & Access Management. We build and run SSO for GSK’s workforce and applications, and bring the same discipline to securing the accounts, credentials and authentication of cloud, non-human and AI agent identities. Together with PKI & Cryptographic Services, we protect the identities, secrets and keys that GSK’s cloud and AI future depends on.

**Key responsibilities:**

In this role, you will turn that vision into reality. Your responsibilities will include:

* **Build one team:** Lead and develop a global team of engineers across SSO, cloud, NHI and AI agent identity, working as one team with shared patterns rather than separate product silos.
* **Deliver the roadmap:** Own the engineering roadmap, delivery plans and service measures, turning the agreed architecture and standards into reliable services.
* **Make sign-in passwordless and trusted:** Run GSK’s SSO services (SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0), moving the workforce to passwordless, phishing-resistant authentication, with conditional access, strong identity verification for registration and account recovery, and the retirement of legacy authentication.
* **Secure the cloud:** Protect cloud accounts and access in Azure and GCP with strong authentication, workload identity federation, least privilege and just-in-time access, with no standing admin rights.
* **Bring workloads and AI agents into the fold:** Give non-human identities and AI agents unique, accountable identities kept separate from human ones, with protected credentials, scoped and revocable access and full audit logging, and promote integration with GSK’s identity lifecycle and governance processes.
* **Move from secrets to secretless:** Drive adoption of secrets vaulting and management, remove hard-coded credentials, favour short-lived and secretless authentication, and build secret scanning into engineering pipelines.
* **Partner with PKI:** Work with the PKI & Cryptographic Services lead to secure cloud, AI and secrets, with aligned roadmaps, clear ownership and a joined-up approach for stakeholders and auditors.
* **Use AI ourselves:** Apply AI to identity engineering and operations, such as risky sign-in analysis, anomaly detection, faster onboarding and incident triage, with human oversight and clear audit trails.
* **Set the example:** Show GSK what secure cloud and AI looks like through secure-by-default implementations, reusable patterns, automation and implementation guidelines.
* **Keep trust earned:** Ensure these services meet audit and compliance requirements, including GxP, SOX, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act, and lead major incidents and continual improvement with partner teams.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Degree in computer science, information technology, cyber security or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* At least 18 years’ experience in identity or security, including leading engineering teams that deliver and run enterprise identity or security services in a large organisation.
* Strong knowledge of SSO and modern authentication (SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0), conditional access, multi-factor authentication and passwordless authentication.
* Hands-on experience securing identity and access in Azure, including Microsoft Entra ID, Azure role-based access control and workload identities.
* Experience securing non-human identities and secrets, including vaulting, credential rotation and removing embedded secrets, and integrating them with identity lifecycle and governance processes.
* Working knowledge of AI and large language model security risks, such as agent permissions, data exposure and prompt injection.
* Strong leadership, delivery and communication skills, including managing roadmaps, suppliers and audits, and explaining technical risk to senior stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience delivering SSO at scale with Microsoft Entra ID or Ping Identity, including passwordless authentication and identity verification.
* Experience securing identity and access in Google Cloud (GCP), and with tools for securing non-human identity credentials and cloud privileged access.
* Experience with secrets vaulting and management platforms such as Akeyless, CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault or Google Secret Manager.
* Experience securing AI agents or platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI or Copilot, and familiarity with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.

title: MS Teams with Enterprise Voice Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**  
As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation.
  
  
At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities. The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.
  
  
**What you will do**

As a Microsoft Teams Administrator with Enterprise Voice skills, you will:

* Design, configure, and manage Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice solutions, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Deploy and integrate Session Border Controllers (SBCs) with Microsoft Teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve voice-related issues in Microsoft Teams, including call quality, routing, and interoperability with PSTN providers.
* Manage and support Microsoft Teams policies, configurations, and voice-enabled features.
* Collaborate with network and security teams to ensure compliance and optimal performance.
* Perform migrations from legacy PBX systems to Microsoft Teams.
* Work with external vendors and telecom providers to ensure seamless voice connectivity.
* Monitor Teams Voice infrastructure using analytics and reporting tools to optimize call performance.
Provide end-user support and training on Microsoft Teams Phone features.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in Microsoft Teams Voice and Telephony Solutions.
* Experience in PBX to Microsoft Teams migrations.
* Knowledge of Power Automate and Power Apps for workflow automation in Teams.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Strong understanding of SIP, VoIP, PSTN connectivity, and SBC configurations (AudioCodes, Ribbon, etc.).
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), PowerShell scripting, and Teams Admin Center.
Knowledge of E911 compliance, call routing policies, dial plans, and number management  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Teams Administrator Associate (MS-700).
* Microsoft Certified: Teams Voice Engineer (MS-721).
Session Border Controller (SBC) certifications (AudioCodes/Ribbon).  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Pension Systems Calculations Configuration Analyst
description:

H

Equiniti is a leading international provider of shareholder, pension, remediation, and credit technology. With over 6000 employees, it supports 37 million people in 120 countries.

EQ India began its operations in 2014 as a Global India Captive Centre for Equiniti, a leading fintech company specialising in shareholder management. EQ’s vision is to be the leading global share registrar, offering complementary services to its client base and our values set the core foundations to our success. **Role Summary**

We are looking for Pension Systems Calculations Configuration Analysts to join our team to be a part of the continual evolution of the Compendia and Administrator systems and rollout of our software to our client base.

It is an exciting opportunity to be a part of the team that is responsible for the core configuration of our pension platforms. This is a great role for you if you already have experience in configuring and/or testing complex calculations within packaged software platforms or through the use of spreadsheet functionality and are looking for that next step in your career.

The Pensions Systems Calculations Configuration Analyst is responsible for software configuration delivery to internal and external clients. Key aspects of the role are to:

* Configure, test, implement and maintain pension benefit calculations across both our pension platforms
* Continuously develop a professional, technical, and commercially aware approach to delivery of tasks

* Ability to understand basic data schema models
* Knowledge of PL/SQL scripts in either SQL or Oracle environment
* Knowledge of building calculation solutions using MS Excel and utilising ASPOSE to integrate into a consuming application
* Qualifications in either a financial services or IT environment
* Experience in the Pensions Industry, either as a Scheme Administrator or Business Analyst experienced in capturing requirements for Pensions IT Projects.
* Demonstrable software development capability.
* Demonstrate commercial awareness & operational efficiencies/income generation in current role.

**Essential Qualities**

* Be approachable and responsive to colleagues and users and have an open-minded and constructive approach to problem solving.
* Demonstrate effective and probing appraisal of situations. To consult with relevant parties in resolving issues.

**Performance Measures**

* Timely completion of own work / contribution to team workload
* Meeting targets for accuracy, quality, volume and agreed service levels
* Satisfactory resolution of queries
* Adherence to procedures and regulations
* Contribution to continuous improvement
* Ongoing development of own knowledge and skills
* Demonstrate willingness to contribute to team beyond own immediate tasks
* Quality of support given to colleagues
* Development of technical knowledge and skill
* Contribution to target achievement and team goals
* Successful delivery of task

**Benefits:**

Being a permanent member of the team at EQ you will be rewarded by our company benefits, these are just a few of what is on offer:

* 3 days of additional leaves on & above statutory requirement along with 2 days of voluntary leaves to pursue the CSR initiatives
* Business related certification expense reimbursement
* Comprehensive Medical Assurance coverage for dependents & Parents
* Cab transport for staff working in UK & US shift

Accidental & Life cover 3 times of concerned CTC

We are committed to equality of opportunity for all staff and applications from individuals are encouraged regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil partnerships. Please note any offer of employment is subject to satisfactory pre-employment screening checks.

title: Manager, Technical Consulting- Slack
description:

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**About the Role**
------------------

  
  

As a **Technical People Manager for the Slack Practice** within Salesforce Professional Services (GDC), you will build, coach, and lead a high-performing team of Slack technical consultants, developers, and architects. In this role, you will bridge the gap between people leadership, technical architecture, and enterprise delivery excellence.
  
You will partner closely with global practice leaders, onshore engagement managers, and enterprise customers to deliver complex Slack transformations—ranging from large-scale Enterprise Grid migrations and custom app development to next-generation Agentforce and Salesforce integrations.
  
  
This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a technical architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s Industries Cloud.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Manage, mentor, and grow a team of 15 technical consultants, Slack developers, and technical architects.
* Conduct regular 1:1s, performance appraisals, goal-setting, and career progression planning.
* Drive team enablement initiatives, certification bootcamp ( Certified Slack Developer, Certified Slack Admin ), and hands-on skill development across emerging features ( Agentforce in Slack, Slack CLI).
* Lead recruitment, technical interviews, and onboarding to scale the Slack practice with top-tier talent.
* Cultivate an inclusive, collaborative, and innovation-driven culture within the GDC.
* Serve as a **Technical Architect** for Slack enterprise implementations, providing architectural oversight across client deliverables.
* Establish best practices, reusable code repositories, standard operating frameworks, and review gates for Slack custom apps (Bolt framework, Block Kit, API limits, and security).
* Oversee enterprise migration architectures, ensuring best practices for identity mapping, data retention, DLP compliance, and cutover execution.
* Champion architecture reviews and guide technical teams through complex customer design challenges.
* Partner with Resource Management and Global Practice Directors to ensure optimal staffing, utilization, and project readiness.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Collaborate with onshore delivery teams to scope technical effort, review estimates, and ensure seamless global delivery collaboration.
* Lead practice initiatives around **Slack + Salesforce** convergence (e.g., Agentforce for Slack, Salesforce Channels, CRM integrations).
* Drive internal IP development, such as reusable Slack accelerators, migration automation scripts, and workflow templates.
  

  
  

**Required Technical Skills & Competencies:**
---------------------------------------------

  
  

* **Slack Enterprise Grid & Administration:**
  + Deep understanding of Slack Enterprise Grid topology, multi-workspace scoping, and enterprise governance.
  + Experience with identity lifecycle management: SAML 2.0 SSO (Okta, Azure AD, Ping) and SCIM directory sync.
  + Strong foundation in enterprise security, compliance, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), eDiscovery, Enterprise Key Management (EKM), and the Slack Audit Logs API.
  + Governance of Slack Connect, external collaboration policies, and app installation approval pipelines.
* **Slack App Development & APIs:**
  + Proven hands-on background in Slack app development using the **Bolt Framework** (Node.js or Python).
  + Mastery of **Block Kit** , interactive UI components, modals, and App Home tab architectures.
  + Thorough knowledge of the Slack Web API, Events API, Webhooks, Socket Mode vs. HTTP endpoint configurations, and rate-limiting best practices.
  + Familiarity with the Slack CLI, modular app architecture, manifest files (manifest.json), and Workflow Builder custom functions.
* **Enterprise Migration & Consolidation:**
  + Architectural knowledge of migrating from legacy communication platforms (Microsoft Teams, Mattermost, freemium/standalone Slack workspaces) to Slack Enterprise Grid.
  + Familiarity with user/channel mapping schemas, export/import APIs, data parity verification, and cutover runbook execution.
* **DevOps & Engineering Standards:**
  + Solid understanding of modern CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows, automated testing frameworks, and secure API integration standards.
  + Experience hosting Slack apps on cloud infrastructure (Heroku, AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  
  

**Required Qualifications & Experience:**
-----------------------------------------

  
  

* **Total Experience:** 10-15+ years in software engineering, technical consulting, or enterprise cloud solutions.
* **Management Experience:** 5+ years of direct people management experience leading technical teams (software engineers, technical consultants, or architects) in a global delivery / consulting model.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):**
--------------------------------------------

  
  

* **Salesforce Platform Knowledge:**
  + Familiarity with core Salesforce platform capabilities (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Platform Events, Apex, Flow).
  + Hands-on experience or architectural knowledge of integrating Salesforce with Slack (Salesforce for Slack apps, CRM record sync, Agentforce integration).
* **Certifications:**
  + **Certified Slack Administrator** or **Certified Slack Developer** (highly preferred).
  + Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Certified Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Platform Developer I).
* Experience working in large-scale professional services, system integration (SI) consultancies, or enterprise SaaS vendor delivery centers.

title: S2P System Configuration Administrator - Senior Member Technical

Broadridge Financial Solutions, Inc. (NYSE: BR) a global Fintech leader delivering advanced communications, technology, data, and analytics solutions to clients across the financial services industry. With over *$6 billion in revenues* and serving clients in over *100 countries*, Broadridge plays a vital role as a trusted partner to banks, broker-dealers, mutual funds, and corporate issuers, helping them operate efficiently and serve investors effectively.

At Broadridge, we foster innovation, collaboration, and excellence, providing an environment where technology and talent come together to make a meaningful impact.

This role bridges business needs and technology, ensuring the system remains effective, compliant, and user-friendly while supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

* Collaborate with procurement, sourcing, vendor management, and finance teams to translate business requirements into effective system configurations.
* Provide end-user support (Buyers, Suppliers), troubleshoot system issues, and manage access to ensure smooth operations.

* Develop and execute test plans to validate configuration changes against business needs.

* Support change management by communicating new features, training users, and driving system adoption.
* Manage communication and training related to supplier onboarding and template/process changes.
* Support catalog management, ensuring compliance with standard processes.
* Generate reports and analytics from the S2P platform to support procurement decision-making.
* Track and manage incidents, maintaining an internal issue log and providing metrics for business reviews.

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* **Experience:** 4 – 6 years in System Administration, Analyst, or similar technology-support role.

* Strong understanding of procurement, sourcing, invoicing, catalog, and vendor management processes.
* Experience with cXML integration setup and troubleshooting.
* Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and reporting skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Experience in process mapping, SOP creation, and change management.
* Familiarity with ERP systems and cloud-based procurement platforms.

* Proven team player who thrives in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment.

* **Career Growth:** Broadridge offers dynamic career pathways, professional development, and global mobility opportunities.

Functional (dotted line) reporting into the General Manager, Corporate Technology, Engineering

An experienced senior leader who has demonstrated success achieving measurable performance improvements across large and complex businesses.

* 15+ years’ experience preferably gained in Banking and Finance.
* Have hands-on experience working with the Ability to drive and influence senior level stakeholder engagement across business and technology.
* Leadership experience across multi-disciplinary teams
* Excellent communication skills, especially in relation to verbal communications and proven presentation skills to large audience.
* Experienced technologist that understands data platforms and their capabilities

**Technical Skills**

description:

Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

Bengaluru, KA

**About The Role:**

  

The End User Compute (EUC) team delivers the endpoint platforms, tools and services that enable our colleagues to work securely and effectively.

  

We are looking for a hands-on engineer to help shape and deliver improvements across device management, provisioning, automation and hardware lifecycles. Your primary expertise will be Windows endpoint management, particularly Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot and PowerShell. Experience administering both Windows and macOS is highly valued. Strong Windows engineers who are willing to learn and take increasing responsibility for Mac administration are encouraged to apply.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

  

* Maintain and enhance our Microsoft Intune environments, including device enrolment, configuration, compliance and application management, ensuring services remain secure, reliable and scalable.
* Develop and improve light-touch provisioning using Windows Autopilot, with minimal manual IT intervention and a robust setup experience.
* Configure and troubleshoot the interactions between Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows Autopilot and Okta, working with identity teams to support reliable device provisioning, authentication and access.
* Plan and deliver endpoint migrations between Microsoft Entra ID tenants, managing dependencies, device transitions, user access, testing and communications while minimising disruption.
* Manage Windows update policies, deployment rings and operating system upgrades, including compatibility testing, pilot deployments, phased rollouts, compliance monitoring and remediation of failed updates.
* Package, test, deploy and maintain Windows applications, including installation and detection logic, dependencies, upgrades and removal. Use WinGet and other appropriate tools to improve application management and employee self-service.
* Develop reusable PowerShell scripts and automation to detect and remediate recurring endpoint issues, reduce manual administration and improve reporting. Apply appropriate testing, logging and error handling.
* Collaborate with Security teams to manage endpoint vulnerabilities, maintain endpoint security tools and implement controls such as encryption, security baselines and local administrator restrictions.
* Provide L3 support for complex issues involving device enrolment, policy conflicts, application deployment, updates, authentication and device trust. Investigate root causes, coordinate vendor escalations and implement lasting fixes through established incident, problem and change management processes.
* Monitor and report on device health, patch and device compliance, provisioning success and application deployment outcomes. Use findings to prioritise improvements and reduce recurring incidents.
* Contribute to the EUC roadmap and own assigned improvements from investigation and design through testing, implementation and operational handover, with clear rollout and recovery plans.
Maintain technical documentation and runbooks, share knowledge, and provide training for technical teams and end users.  

  

**ESSENTIAL SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS**

  

* Proven experience in a senior endpoint engineering or L3 EUC role, with strong hands-on administration and troubleshooting of enterprise Windows environments.
* Strong Microsoft Intune expertise across device enrolment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, update management and troubleshooting.
* Practical experience implementing and supporting Windows Autopilot and automated device provisioning.
* Experience migrating Windows endpoints from one Microsoft Entra ID tenant to another, including planning, dependency assessment, execution and validation, with consideration for device enrolment, user profiles and data, authentication and application access.
* Experience managing Windows updates and operating system upgrades through controlled testing, deployment rings, compliance monitoring and remediation.
* Strong PowerShell scripting skills, with experience developing and maintaining scripts for endpoint administration, detection, remediation and reporting.
* Experience packaging and deploying Win32 applications, including installation contexts, detection rules, dependencies, upgrades and deployment failure investigation. Practical familiarity with WinGet.
* Experience managing endpoint hardware lifecycles, including asset records, warranty and support status, refresh planning, redeployment and secure decommissioning.
* A strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID device identities, join types, groups and the relationship between device compliance and Conditional Access.
* A strong understanding of Okta or an equivalent identity provider (IdP), including single sign-on, multifactor authentication and user lifecycle management, with the ability to investigate endpoint-related authentication issues.
* Familiarity with Google Chrome browser management.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, using logs, testing and evidence to identify root causes, recognise recurring problems and verify solutions.
* A practical, service-focused approach, with a willingness to learn macOS administration and actively contribute to both Windows and Mac endpoint services.
Strong communication skills in spoken and written English, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, provide timely updates on progress and risks, produce useful documentation and share knowledge effectively across global teams.  

  

**DESIRABLE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

  

* Enterprise macOS administration using Jamf Pro, including configuration profiles, application deployment, patching and troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with Apple Business Manager and Automated Device Enrolment.
* Experience using Microsoft Graph and REST APIs to automate endpoint administration, reporting and integrations.
* Experience with version control and maintaining shared scripts and technical documentation.
* Experience with endpoint detection and response, secure remote access or privileged access management tools.
* Experience implementing endpoint monitoring and telemetry tools to improve device reliability and employee experience.
* Familiarity with collaboration and service delivery platforms such as Jira, Slack and Zoom.
* Bash or shell scripting experience for macOS.
* Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or relevant Jamf certifications.

======================

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

We’ve grown quickly since our inception in 2019, now with offices in Pune and Bangalore  

  
  

Senior Domain Expert – Telecom OSS, Adaptive Inventory and Network Transformation

This role requires a seasoned telecom technology leader with deep expertise in OSS/BSS, Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, RAN and transmission domains, network inventory transformation, solution architecture, data modelling, integration, and end-to-end delivery. The candidate should be able to translate complex business and network requirements into scalable architecture solutions, lead cross-functional teams, modernize legacy inventory platforms, and enable strategic transformation across wireless, IP, transport, assurance, and planning domains.

Role Purpose

To lead architecture, design, integration, migration, and modernization initiatives across telecom network inventory and OSS platforms, with a strong focus on Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, Telstra-wide inventory transformation, unified data management, API-led integration, and domain federation. The role is accountable for shaping solution architecture, driving stakeholder alignment, enabling data quality improvements, and ensuring reliable delivery of business-critical inventory capabilities.

  

Focus of the role

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical architect and telecom solution leader with strong OSS/BSS and network inventory experience, particularly across Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, RAN, transmission, IP, transport, and enterprise inventory transformation. The candidate should combine deep technical knowledge with stakeholder leadership, delivery discipline, data architecture expertise, and the ability to modernize complex legacy inventory environments while protecting business continuity and driving measurable operational value.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

* Lead solution architecture and technical design for telecom OSS/BSS, Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, network inventory, planning, assurance, and transmission transformation initiatives.

* Translate customer, business, and network engineering requirements into tangible product solutions across RAN, wireless, IP, transport, and inventory domains.

* Define and execute architecture roadmaps covering inventory federation, data migration, metadata management, data modelling, synchronization, reconciliation, and strategic platform modernization.

* Drive end-to-end integration across upstream and downstream systems using standardized APIs, reusable components, microservices, APIGEE Gateway, and enterprise integration patterns.

* Establish unified data management practices, including object modelling, relationship mapping, data quality improvement, real-time and non-real-time synchronization, and reconciliation controls.

* Own SDLC and Agile delivery activities, including solution design, low-level design, development oversight, unit testing, system testing, integration testing, UAT coordination, documentation, training, and implementation support.

* Facilitate workshops, knowledge transfer sessions, stakeholder forums, architecture reviews, and customer engagement routines to ensure solution alignment and operational readiness.

* Collaborate with product, order management, provisioning, billing, assurance, planning, and service activation teams to define business needs and deliver integrated outcomes.

* Lead cross-functional onshore and offshore teams across strategic projects, application portfolios, reporting initiatives, and production support environments.

Required Experience

* 18+ years of experience in telecom technology delivery, OSS/BSS, network inventory, solution architecture, integration, business analysis, and production support.

* Strong experience with Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, Telstra inventory platforms, RAN inventory, transmission domain upgrades, network planning, assurance, fulfilment, and inventory federation.

* Proven background in information model development for wireless, IP, and transport networks, including object relationships, topology, connectivity patterns, service enablement, and customer experience abstraction.

* Experience leading complex application portfolios, vendor transitions, knowledge transfer, system modernization, strategic architecture migration, and operational support for large-scale inventory ecosystems.

* Hands-on experience with Oracle, PL/SQL, Java-based platforms, Perl-supported legacy systems, microservices, APIs, Linux/Solaris environments, Apache Tomcat, and network data quality remediation.

* Demonstrated ability to improve business outcomes through data standardization, process modernization, automation, reporting, performance improvements, cost reduction, and operational efficiency.

Technical Skills

* **Domain Knowledge:** Telecom OSS/BSS, Ericsson Adaptive Inventory, RAN inventory, transmission, optical transport, IP/MPLS, HFC, FTTP, assurance, fulfilment, network planning, topology, and service inventory.

* **Architecture and Delivery:** Solution architecture, technical architecture, business analysis, information modelling, data modelling, metadata management, data migration, inventory federation, SDLC, Agile, DevOps, and strategic architecture modernization.

* **Programming and Platforms:** Java, PL/SQL, Oracle, Perl-supported legacy systems, Apache Tomcat, Solaris, Linux, HTML, JSON, JavaScript, XML, and MySQL.

* **Cloud and Integration:** AWS, AWS EC2, microservices, reusable integration components, APIGEE Gateway, standardized APIs, REST-based integration, real-time and non-real-time synchronization, and reconciliation patterns.

* **Tools:** Eclipse, STS, GitHub, Jenkins, Bamboo, Splunk, MySQL Workbench, Postman, JIRA, Rally, GIT, and enterprise delivery toolchains.

Leadership and Stakeholder Management

* Ability to act as a trusted technical advisor for telecom customers, business teams, architecture groups, implementation teams, and operations stakeholders.

* Strong experience leading workshops, governance discussions, technical reviews, stakeholder alignment sessions, and cross-functional delivery forums.

* Proven capability to lead large onshore-offshore teams, implementation squads, business analysts, developers, testers, and production support groups across strategic and operational programs.

* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to assess network data, diagnose inventory quality issues, define corrective actions, and recommend scalable architecture options.
