* Monitor server health, availability, performance, and capacity; troubleshoot system-level issues.
* Perform Linux security hardening, access management, and compliance-related activities.
* Develop and maintain shell scripts using Bash or other scripting languages to automate routine administrative tasks.
* Troubleshoot operating system, hardware, networking, and application-related issues.
* Manage system logs, investigate incidents, and support root-cause analysis.
* Perform system performance tuning and support backup and restoration activities.
* Maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational records.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, network, security, and application teams to ensure reliable IT operations.

Required Skills — Priority 1 (Mandatory)

* Strong hands-on experience in
  **Linux system administration**
  .
* Expertise in
  **Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and/or Oracle Linux**
  .
* Practical experience with
  **Linux patching and patch management**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **Red Hat Satellite or Katello**
  .
* Experience in Linux server monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance analysis.
* Proficiency in
  **Bash/Shell scripting**
  .
* Strong understanding of Linux administration, system services, user permissions, storage, and package management.

Preferred Skills — Priority 2

* Experience with
  **Zabbix**
  or similar monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of
  **Ansible**
  for configuration management and automation.
* Experience in Linux security hardening and vulnerability remediation.
* Knowledge of log management, system performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Experience with enterprise backup and restore solutions.

Specialized Skills — Priority 3 (Added Advantage)

* Experience with
  **Oracle Exadata**
  infrastructure.
* Knowledge of
  **RoCE (RDMA over Converged Ethernet)**
  and
  **InfiniBand**
  networking.
* Exposure to
  **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**
  or hybrid cloud environments.
* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms such as
  **NetBackup and Cohesity**
  .
* Experience managing Linux virtual machines on VMware ESXi.
* Knowledge of Linux integration with Active Directory using LDAP, Kerberos, or Quest/One Identity Safeguard Authentication Services.
* Basic knowledge of Windows Server administration and hybrid infrastructure environments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on Linux Administrator with strong expertise in enterprise Linux operations, patch management, and troubleshooting. Candidates with the mandatory Linux skills should be prioritized; specialized experience in Exadata, RoCE, InfiniBand, and OCI will be considered a significant advantage.

title: Senior Manager/ AVP – IT Infrastructure & Trading Technology
description:
Abans Financial Services Ltd. is a listed, diversified financial services company offering a comprehensive suite of solutions across broking, commodity trading, asset management, financing, and investment advisory. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company operates with a strong presence in both Indian and global markets, serving institutional, corporate, and retail clients. As part of the larger Abans Group, the company continues to expand its footprint by delivering integrated financial services and building robust technology platforms to support its growing client base.
  
  
**Profile : Senior Manager/ AVP – IT Infrastructure & Trading Technology**
**Location: Nariman Point, Mumbai**
**Industry Preference: Stockbroking, Capital Markets, Trading, Brokerage, and Financial Services.**
**Job Purpose**
We are looking for an experienced IT Manager with expertise in IT infrastructure, trading technology, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance within the stockbroking industry. The candidate should have hands-on experience with hybrid infrastructure, exchange connectivity, CTCL trading applications, vendor licensing, and applicable SEBI and exchange regulations.
  
  
The role is responsible for ensuring the availability, security, and resilience of IT infrastructure and trading systems while supporting business operations and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* IT Infrastructure & Operations
* Manage on-premise and cloud infrastructure, including servers, storage, networks, and virtualisation.
* Ensure system availability, performance monitoring, capacity planning, and timely issue resolution.
* Manage backups, Disaster Recovery (DR), Business Continuity Planning (BCP), and periodic DR drills.
* Oversee IT asset management, software licensing, upgrades, and infrastructure maintenance.
* Stockbroking & Trading Technology
* Manage trading infrastructure like leased line connections, servers, licenses, etc for NSE, BSE, MCX, NCDEX, and other applicable exchanges and segments.
* Manage and coordinate with CTCL vendors such as Greeksoft, Resolute, ODIN, XTS, or similar trading platforms for software licences, vendor agreements, renewals, terminal registrations, and exchange-related approvals.
* Oversee configuration of CTCL/NNF IDs, terminal IDs, Location IDs, user IDs, and IP mapping, as applicable.
* Coordinate trading application installations, upgrades, testing, mock trading sessions, and exchange-mandated changes.
* Ensure integration and smooth functioning of trading applications, RMS, back-office systems, and market data feeds.
* Monitor trading-system performance and coordinate with vendors and internal teams to resolve technical issues.
* Exchange Connectivity & Network Management
* Manage leased lines, dedicated connectivity, internet links, VPNs, and network infrastructure for exchange connectivity.
* Handle IP whitelisting, firewall rules, routing, terminal mapping, and connectivity activation with exchanges and vendors.
* Ensure network redundancy, backup connectivity, failover, and business continuity.
* Monitor network performance, latency, and connectivity issues affecting trading operations.
* Cybersecurity & Security Management
* Manage firewalls, VPNs, antivirus, endpoint protection, and network security systems.
* Coordinate SOC operations, security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability assessments, and patch management.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, access management, and security policies in line with regulatory requirements.
* Ensure timely resolution and documentation of security incidents and vulnerabilities.
* Regulatory Compliance & IT Governance
* Ensure compliance with applicable SEBI, exchange, and other regulatory requirements relating to IT infrastructure, cybersecurity, and trading systems.
* Coordinate exchange inspections, IT and cybersecurity audits, and closure of audit observations.
* Maintain IT policies, SOPs, infrastructure documentation, access records, and compliance reports.
* Oversee DR/BCP compliance, technology risk management, and required regulatory reporting.
* Vendor & Team Management
* Manage CTCL, RMS, back-office, network, cloud, and cybersecurity vendors.
* Monitor vendor performance, support escalations, licence renewals, and service delivery.
* Lead the IT team, allocate responsibilities, and ensure timely resolution of critical issues.
* Coordinate with Operations, Compliance, Risk, and other departments to ensure uninterrupted business operations.

**Key Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong experience in IT infrastructure, networking, servers, virtualisation, and cloud environments.
* Prior experience in stockbroking, capital markets, or financial services IT.
* Good understanding of CTCL trading applications and vendor licensing, including Greeksoft, Resolute, ODIN, XTS, or equivalent platforms.
* Experience managing & coordinating third party vendors and Endpoint Security solutions (Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, Trend Micro, Symantec, McAfee, SentinelOne, etc.).
* Experience working with SOC operations, SIEM platforms, security monitoring, incident response, and threat management.
* Strong understanding of Cybersecurity frameworks, Zero Trust Architecture, Vulnerability Management, Patch Management, and Security Best Practices.
* Familiarity with RMS, back-office systems, market data feeds, and trading application integration.
* Knowledge of firewalls, endpoint security, SOC operations, vulnerability management, and cybersecurity controls.
* Understanding of SEBI and exchange IT, cybersecurity, DR, and BCP requirements.
* Experience in exchange audits, IT compliance documentation, vendor management, and incident resolution.
* Minimum 5+ years of team management/leadership experience.
* Prior experience in Trading, Broking, Capital Markets, Financial Services, or BFSI organisations is highly preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting multiple exchanges and trading segments in a stockbroking environment.
* Hands-on involvement in CTCL implementations, exchange mock tests, system upgrades, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with trading operations, RMS, clearing, depository, and back-office technology.

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a Data Center Engineer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team in Mumbai. In this role, you'll help build, maintain, and scale the critical infrastructure that powers our trading operations across APAC.
  
  
Working alongside experienced engineers and traders, you'll solve complex technical challenges in a fast-paced environment where reliability, performance, and speed matter. This is a hands-on role with real ownership, where your work directly contributes to the performance and resilience of our trading systems.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Optiver is a global market maker founded in Amsterdam, with offices in London, Chicago, Austin, New York, Sydney, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei and Mumbai. Established in 1986, today we are a leading liquidity provider, with close to 2,000 employees in offices around the world, united in our commitment to improve the market through competitive pricing, execution and risk management. By providing liquidity on multiple exchanges across the world in various financial instruments we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets. We provide liquidity to financial markets using our own capital, at our own risk, trading a wide range of products: listed derivatives, cash equities, ETFs, bonds and foreign currencies.
  
  
In Asia Pacific, Optiver was one of the first global market makers to establish a presence in the region, with the incorporation our Sydney office in 1996. Since then, we have expanded our footprint by establishing offices in Taipei (2005), Hong Kong (2007), Shanghai (2012) and Singapore (2021). The business in Mumbai is newly established and deemed to be an integral part of the APAC strategy, with an anticipation of significant growth over the coming years.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
You'll be responsible for our data center operations in India, as well as work closely with remote technicians and service partners to support infrastructure across our global footprint. Combining infrastructure expertise with a strong problem-solving mindset, you'll help maintain critical environments, improve operational processes, and deliver infrastructure projects from planning through to execution.
  
  
The majority of your work will be based in Mumbai, although occasional travel to other APAC locations may be required.
  
  
Key responsibilities include:
  
  
  

* Installing and maintaining cabling, servers, and network equipment across data center locations through:

+ On-site implementation.
+ Remote coordination of smart-hands and service partner personnel.

* Managing power and space, including monitoring and capacity planning.
* Maintaining a consistent and clean cable management philosophy.
* Managing spare parts and cabling inventory.
* Performing break-fix repairs to equipment in the data center environment, including replacing hard drives / memory / transceivers and other hardware related tasks, as required by our server and network teams.
* Assisting with planning equipment moves or new data center build-outs.
* Coordinating the packing, shipping, and logistics of equipment to and from remote colocation sites.
* Maintaining data center documentation.

Working hours will include a combination of:
  
  
  

* Core business hours for planning and monitoring
* Weekends and out-of-hours work for physical infrastructure changes (with time off provided during the week)

**Who You Are**
As our next Data Centre Engineer, you’ll need to have:
  
  
  

* Attention to detail within a data center.
* Ability to identify basic parts of network equipment – SFPs, line cards, chassis.
* Ability to identify basic parts of servers – memory, network card, hard drives, etc.
* Experience with identifying port locations for specific device manufacturers (Cisco, Arista, Juniper).
* Knowledge of structured cabling systems using cat 5, cat 6, multi-mode and single-mode fiber.
* Familiarity with both power and communications cabling standards.
* Experience configuring and using cable testers, for both fiber and copper, to troubleshoot cabling issues.
* Ability to perform basic installation, configuration and troubleshooting on server operating systems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluency in English.
* An understanding of change control processes.
* Strong documentation mentality.
* Strong communication skills (especially with remote engineers whose native language may not be English)..
* Ability to regularly work on weekends.

**What You'll Get**

* A performance-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool, fostering a truly collaborative environment.
* The chance to work alongside diverse and intelligent peers in a rewarding environment.
* Continuous learning, development and upskilling opportunities.
* Daily breakfast, lunch, and an in-house barista.
* Gym/Club membership, plus weekly massages.
* Corporate health insurance
* Uber business for daily commute
* Regular social events, including a company trip every two years.

**DIVERSITY STATEMENT**
Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion
  
  
We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process.
  
  
**Questions?**
Get in touch with the recruitment team at careers@optiver.com.au

title: Deskside Support Technician I
description:

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
  
  
**Purpose :**
The Digital Operations Technician is responsible for delivering hands on support for users and workplace technology in Mumbai, Maharashtra. The role provides frontline support for end user devices, office based technology, onboarding activities, conference rooms, and local smart hands requirements, helping ensure stable and responsive support.
  
  
The role supports a remote and operationally important location, requiring strong independence, responsiveness, and coordination with Digital Operations as well as Infrastructure & Operations teams.
  
  
The position serves as the primary local IT support presence and works closely with global IT teams to resolve incidents, fulfill service requests, maintain device readiness, and support day to day business operations. This is an individual contributor role requiring strong technical troubleshooting, sound judgement and a customer focused approach.
  
  
**The Role**

you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  

* End User Support:

+ Provide in person support for desktops, laptops, monitors, peripherals, printers and mobile devices.
+ Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, device and access related issues for local users.
+ Support new hire onboarding, workstation setup, user moves, and day to day break/fix activities.
+ Deliver timely user updates and ensure support activities are properly documented and managed through our approved ITSM processes.

* Workplace Technology & Site Support:

+ Support conference room and collaboration technology, including basic meeting room troubleshooting and readiness checks.
+ Assist with workstation setup, hot desk support, office moves, and shared workspace readiness.
+ Provide local smart hands assistance for infrastructure, network, telecom or vendor led onsite activities as required.
+ Coordinate with regional and global support teams to ensure smooth handling of issues requiring escalation.

* Device Lifecycle & Logistics:

+ Support termination hardware retrieval, end of lease handling, and eWaste / recycling processes in alignment with company standards.

+ Identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities affecting end user experience, support responsiveness or local site readiness.
+ Partner with Service Desk, Infrastructure Teams, and third party providers to help maintain stable service delivery.

+ Follow company processes for security, asset management, access, and technology handling.
+ Complete all required site or office inductions and work in accordance with local HSE expectations.

* Physical Demand/Work Environment:

+ The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to speak or listen. The employee frequently is required to walk and sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Visual Acuity: must be adequate to perform all required Job Description tasks in a safe manner. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. Work is usually done in an office setting and sometimes at a client facility or job site.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* Required:

+ Experience in deskside, desktop, field, or end user support within a business environment.
+ Strong hands on troubleshooting skills across Windows endpoints, standard business applications, peripherals and user access issues.
+ Experience providing in person support to end users, including onboarding, break/fix, and workplace technology support.
+ Familiarity with IT Service Management tools such as ServiceNow.
+ Ability to work independently with limited supervision and manage multiple priorities.
+ Strong communication skills and a customer focused approach to support delivery.

* Preferred:

+ Experience supporting conference room, meeting room, or collaboration technologies.
+ Experience supporting mobile devices, including iOS and Android.
+ Familiarity with hardware lifecycle processes including provisioning, refresh, returns, and disposal coordination.
+ Experience providing smart hands support for network, service, or infrastructure related onsite activities.
+ Experience working in engineering, industrial, operational, or multi site business environments.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
  
  
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Asset & Configuration Engineer
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

Must have 1-3 years of experience into Software Asset Management.

Installation and troubleshooting of Operating systems (Windows 10)
  
Assisting users for any issues in their day-to-day IT operations
  
Monitoring the pending tickets and ensure regular updates
  
Troubleshooting 1st level Local network related issues
  
Troubleshooting 1st level laptop hardware related issues
  
Monitor the ticket SLAs and act against the SLA warnings
  
Troubleshoot application related issues
  
Configure & update Antivirus software
  
Resolve all Hardware and Paper Jam Issues with respect to Printers
  
Coordinate with Hardware support teams and resolve any hardware failures in the printers
  
Resolve any issues for the print service due to virus in the network.

Should have knowledge of Windows patching and troubleshooting on endpoint devices

͏

The roles and responsibilities defined below indicate the co-ordinator as well as the configuration managers roles, rolled into one.

    Ensuring that all CI s are accurately registered
  
    Interfacing with other support organizations to ensure the effective use of the CMDB and Configuration Management System

    Ensuring that authorized procedures and work practices are followed
  
    Own the SACM process end to end
  
    Make sure all changes to the CIs and the CMS are controlled, audited and reported
  
    Make sure the CMS is up-to-date 
  
    Define the naming conventions for the CIs
  
    Own the CMS
  
    All updates to the CMS go through the Configuration Manager
  
    Take control of both the software and hardware CIs
  
    Control of all assets and liaison with the procurement team is one of the key responsibilities
  
    Define the asset disposal policy along with the customer
  
    Work closely with the change and release team to make sure the CMS is up-to-date
  
    Conduct scheduled and also ad hoc audits of the CIs
  
    Define an audit policy and audit process covering local as well as remote CIs
  
    Handle discrepancies resulting out of the audits
  
    Maintain libraries or other storage areas to hold CIs
  
    Safeguard the integrity of the logic of the CMDB and associated libraries

͏

* Supervise and control receipt, identification, storage and withdrawal of all supported CIs
* Supervise the functional design and support of the CMDB and associated libraries
* Assist in the identification of products and CIs
* Maintain and provide information on the status of CIs
* Number, record, store and distribute Configuration Management issues
* Record the receipt of authorized new or revised configurations and archive superseded configurations to the appropriate library
* Hold master copies of documents, software, etc.
* Notify holders of any changes to their products or CIs
* Assist in conducting audits

͏

**KEY SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES**
    Good analytic and decision-making skills. 
  
    Good communication skills. 
  
    Good presentation skills. 
  
    Must have conflict resolution abilities.

* Experience with cluster provisioning, system bring-up, validation, performance benchmarking, and acceptance testing.
* Knowledge of monitoring and observability tools such as Icinga, Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and NVIDIA DCGM.
* Automation and scripting experience using Python, Bash, Ansible, and Git.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across compute, networking, storage, Kubernetes, and AI software stacks.
* Excellent customer-facing skills with experience delivering workshops, technical documentation, deployment runbooks, and knowledge transfer sessions.

* Experience with NVIDIA AI Factory deployments and enterprise AI infrastructure.
* Knowledge of GPFS, VAST, DDN Data storage platforms.
* Experience with NVIDIA Cluster Validation Suite (CVS).

* Experience with direct liquid-cooled infrastructure.
* Knowledge of AI platform technologies including Run:AI, Rafay, ClearML, MLOps
* NVIDIA, Kubernetes, Red Hat, or AI infrastructure certifications.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Sealed Air designs and delivers packaging solutions that protect essential goods transported worldwide, preserve food, enable e-commerce and digital connectivity, and help create a global supply chain that is touchless, safer, less wasteful, and more resilient. We strive to foster a caring, high-performance growth culture that will deliver consistent, sustainable profitable growth and accelerate our performance – a culture where accountability is clear and aligned, and where we reward business outcomes and impact. That culture guides everything we do, including how we partner with our customers and suppliers, how we attract and retain top talent, and how we create and deliver value to our stakeholders. In 2025, Sealed Air generated $5.4 billion in sales and has approximately 16,100 employees who serve customers in 119 countries/territories. To learn more, visit www.sealedair.com.
  
  
Senior Platform Engineer
  
  
Sealed Air is seeking a highly skilled and self-motivated Senior Cloud Platform Migration Engineer to assume ownership of critical cloud infrastructure supporting customer-facing digital services and connected manufacturing capabilities.
  
  
The successful candidate will stabilize, operate, document, and modernize an existing AWS-based platform ecosystem while helping drive the long-term strategic transition to Microsoft Azure. The role requires practical experience with AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, automation, infrastructure-as-code, Linux, security, and cloud platform operations.
  
  
This is not primarily an application development role. The candidate must understand enough about application hosting patterns to support infrastructure decisions, troubleshoot platform-level issues, and partner effectively with application teams, but application code ownership and long-term application modernization.
  
  
What are we looking for in you?
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cloud Platform Ownership
  
  

* Own the operational health, reliability, security, and lifecycle management of assigned cloud-hosted infrastructure platforms.
* Administer current-state AWS platform components including IAM, networking, compute, storage, platform services, encryption, and security controls.
* Support and maintain Cloud Foundry and BOSH platform infrastructure, including stemcells, releases, manifests, routing dependencies, certificates, and operational procedures.
* Manage platform patching, operating system lifecycle activities, certificate renewals, vulnerability remediation, and related production maintenance activities.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, technical diagrams, and support procedures for inherited and future-state environments.

Azure Migration and Modernization
  
  

* Help lead infrastructure planning and execution for migration from AWS-hosted platform services to Azure-based target-state architecture.
* Assess current AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, Linux, networking, IAM, and platform service dependencies to define migration approach, risks, sequencing, and operational impacts.
* Design repeatable Azure infrastructure patterns aligned to enterprise standards, including identity, network, security, monitoring, backup, and operational support models.
* Partner with Jayaram's application team to ensure application workloads are migrated or modernized with a clear separation between application ownership and infrastructure platform ownership.
* Develop migration automation and validation patterns to reduce risk and improve repeatability across future transitions.

Why do we need you?
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, automation, or related infrastructure operations experience.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience, including operational support of production cloud infrastructure.
* Practical Azure knowledge and demonstrated ability to design or support cloud migration and modernization activities.
* Hands-on scripting and automation experience with Python and Shell/Bash.
* Experience with GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, Linux administration, infrastructure automation, and cloud security practices.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
* Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, documentation, and operational problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate independently in a partially documented inherited environment and convert ambiguity into structured technical action plans.
* Cloud Foundry administration experience, especially with self-managed or legacy platform environments.
* BOSH administration experience, including directors, stemcells, releases, manifests, and platform lifecycle management.
* Experience migrating workloads or platform services between public cloud providers, especially AWS to Azure.
* Experience with Azure landing zones, Azure networking, Azure identity, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure-native platform services.
* Experience administering self-hosted GitLab, including upgrades, runners, access controls, storage, backups, and migration to SaaS or alternate DevOps platforms.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, platform-as-a-service models, and modern application hosting patterns.
* Experience supporting industrial IoT, connected device, or manufacturing-adjacent cloud platforms.
* AWS, Azure, DevOps, security, or architecture certifications.

title: Service Desk – Tier 2
description:
**Position Summary**
The Service Desk – Tier 2 Support Specialist provides advanced technical support to employees. This position is for individuals with four to seven or more years of experience. The main responsibilities include resolving complex issues that Tier 1 support cannot handle, managing difficult incidents, and working with other teams to ensure quick and effective solutions. This role requires strong technical knowledge, excellent customer service, and the ability to work well under pressure.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Diagnose and resolve advanced problems with computers, software, and network connections that are passed on from Tier 1 support.
* Troubleshoot more difficult issues with applications and custom systems.
* Ensure problems with desktop, mobile, remote access, and VPN are fixed.
* Escalate unresolved issues to Tier 3 or external support, making sure the handover is smooth and timely.
* Act as a link between users and higher-level support teams, providing clear and detailed information about issues.
* Monitor and track incidents using helpdesk tools to ensure service standards are met.
* Analyze repeated problems to find the main cause and suggest permanent solutions.
* Manage user accounts, permissions, and access requests across different systems.
* Handle password resets, multi-factor authentication, and access control as needed.
* Support cloud-based applications and work with vendors and internal teams to manage updates and improvements.
* Keep detailed records of solutions and best practices in the helpdesk knowledge base.
* Suggest improvements to documentation and training materials.
* Deliver high-quality customer service, maintaining professionalism and clear communication at all times.
* Provide regular updates to users and internal teams about the progress and resolution of incidents.
* Support proactive monitoring of important systems to identify and report issues before they affect users.
* Help implement automated solutions to reduce repeated problems.
* Work with other IT teams (such as network, infrastructure, and security) to solve complex issues.
* Mentor and train Tier 1 support staff to help them improve their troubleshooting skills.

**Qualifications**
**Requirements:**

* Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to troubleshoot end user issues quickly and efficiently.
* Customer-Centric Approach: Strong communication skills with a focus on providing exceptional customer service.
* Attention to Detail: Precision in handling escalations, documenting solutions, and following procedures.
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with global teams and cross-functional departments.
* Adaptability: Comfort working in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with shifting priorities.
* Proactivity: Ability to anticipate potential problems and take preemptive action.

**Role Brief: Incident Manager (6-Day Work Week)**
We are seeking an experienced
**Critical Incident Manager (CIM)**
to lead the management and resolution of high-priority incidents impacting End User Computing (EUC) services across the organization. This role serves as the command center during critical outages, ensuring rapid service restoration, effective stakeholder communication, and minimal business disruption.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of EUC technologies, IT infrastructure, workplace services, and Major Incident Management processes. They will collaborate with cross-functional technical teams, service providers, senior leadership, and business stakeholders to drive resolution efforts while maintaining operational stability and exceptional customer experience.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Major Incident Management**

* Lead and manage Major Incidents impacting End User Computing services, ensuring rapid restoration of business-critical services.
* Serve as the central point of coordination during Priority 1 (P1) and Priority 2 (P2) incidents.
* Assess incident severity, business impact, and urgency to drive appropriate response actions.
* Coordinate technical teams, service providers, and stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle.
* Ensure incidents are identified, logged, categorized, prioritized, escalated, and resolved in accordance with defined SLAs.

**EUC Service Operations**

* Support incidents related to: Endpoint devices (Windows, macOS, Laptops, desktops), Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), Microsoft 365 services, Collaboration platforms (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint), Identity Access Management, Workplace technologies and end-user services, Device management platforms such as Intune, SCCM, Workspace ONE, etc.

**Stakeholder Communication**

* Act as the primary communication lead during major incidents.
* Provide timely, accurate, and business-focused updates to executives, leadership teams, customers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.
* Conduct incident bridges and facilitate collaboration between technical and business teams.
* Ensure transparent communication throughout incident resolution and recovery activities.

**Service Restoration Business Continuity**

* Drive teams toward quick service restoration while minimizing business impact.
* Ensure adherence to incident response procedures, escalation matrices, and recovery plans.
* Support business continuity initiatives and operational resilience programs.
* Make informed decisions during high-pressure situations to accelerate recovery efforts.

**Problem Management Continuous Improvement**

* Lead post-incident reviews and root cause analysis (RCA) discussions.
* Identify recurring issues and drive preventive and corrective actions.
* Develop and improve Major Incident Management processes, runbooks, and operational playbooks.
* Analyze incident trends and recommend service improvements.

**Leadership Coordination**

* Lead cross-functional technical teams without direct reporting authority.
* Coordinate multiple support groups, vendor partners, and service providers.
* Facilitate critical decision-making during service disruptions.
* Ensure all stakeholders understand their roles and responsibilities during incident response activities.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-6 years of experience in Major Incident Management, Critical Incident Management, IT Operations, Service Delivery, or EUC Support environments.
* Strong understanding of End User Computing technologies and enterprise workplace services.
* Experience managing high-severity incidents in large enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or similar tools.
* Excellent understanding of Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Service Operations processes.
* Knowledge of ITIL framework and best practices.

**Technical Skills**

* End User Computing (EUC) Services
* Microsoft 365 Suite
* Windows Operating Systems
* Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Management
* SCCM / MECM
* Active Directory Azure AD
* VDI Technologies (Citrix, VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop)
* IT Infrastructure Networking Fundamentals
* IT Service Management (ITSM)
* Incident Response Escalation Management
* Business Continuity Disaster Recovery

**Soft Skills Competencies**

* Excellent crisis and major incident management skills.
* Ability to remain calm and composed under pressure.
* Strong executive-level communication and presentation skills.

title: Consulting Engineer
description:
**Meet the Team**
CX Expert Care is a team of elite technical experts whose #1 focus is to help customers operate their networks effectively while delivering the best possible customer experience. Our success is validated through exceptional financial results, growing customer happiness metrics, industry recognition, and employee happiness scores. The team is a group of highly skilled, dynamic, diverse, and hardworking engineers who go above and beyond in assisting not just the customer but also their teammates and peers. “Work hard, play harder” is the motto of the team.
  
  
**Your Impact**
As a Consulting Engineer (CE) within Cisco Customer Experience (CX), you are a critical customer-facing technical leader responsible for driving customers’ business outcomes and increasing their loyalty and satisfaction through the value of Cisco’s technical services. Working with designated high-demand customers, you will ensure they receive premium-level technical support across every phase of the Data Center technology lifecycle. As the liaison between the customer and Cisco’s support organization, you will track everyone and everything that touches Cisco technical services—assessing the criticality of situations, resolving optimal path to resolution, and communicating directly with customers and partners during high-severity issues. You will review data and analyze trends to identify problems holistically and strengthen customer networks with proactive, analytics-driven solutions. With significant exposure both internally and externally, and collaborating across cross-functional teams to achieve key performance indicators, you will have a genuine opportunity to make a difference in the customer experience.
  
  

* Act as the technical focal point for complex Data Center network problem resolution, solve and resolving customer issues end-to-end across Cisco’s Data Center portfolio—including Nexus switching, ACI fabrics, UCS compute, and storage networking—spanning Layer 2/3 network fabric, overlays, virtualization, and compute/storage integration.
* Deliver thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) at both the infrastructure and application-interconnect levels, producing detailed technical documentation with root-cause findings, remediation steps, and proactive prevention recommendations, and provide software partner concern referrals for Cisco Data Center platforms (NX-OS, UCS firmware, ACI image bundles) to address critical or recurring problems.
* Continuously monitor and analyze operational trends in the customer’s Data Center environment, collaborating with the High Touch Operations Manager (HTOM) to deliver quarterly technical reviews of findings, metrics, and strategic action plans, and expedite resolution during critical partner concerns by leveraging deep knowledge of the customer’s architecture, operations model, and change-control practices.
* Partner with the Account Team, Cisco TAC, Product Business Unit, and HTOM to coordinate resolution strategies and enhance the quality of services delivered, serving as Lead Engineer across HTTS and TAC teams to drive persistent or recurring issues to full resolution.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships that drive high satisfaction and retention, provide remote or onsite deployment support for Data Center rollouts, migrations, and fabric expansions—including occasional travel for high-impact engagements—and give to Cisco’s intellectual capital through reusable tools, scripts, and best-practice documentation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Typically requires a BS in a technical field (CS/EE preferred) plus 10+ years of related experience, or an MS in a technical field (CS/EE preferred).
* Hands-on experience with core Cisco Data Center technologies, including Nexus switches (9K/7K/5K), ACI (Application Centric Infrastructure), and UCS (Unified Computing System).
* Experience with Data Center fabric architectures and overlay/underlay technologies such as VxLAN, EVPN, FabricPath, OTV, LISP, and Data Center Interconnect (DCI).
* Strong working knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, Multicast, STP, HSRP, VRRP, and QoS, including packet-level troubleshooting using tools such as Wireshark.
* Experience with SAN and storage networking (FC/FCoE), virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V, KVM), and Data Center troubleshooting tools such as Nexus Dashboard and UCS Manager/IMC.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cisco certifications such as CCNP or CCIE Data Center.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including executive-level presentation skills to convey complex solutions to non-technical audiences and help drive business growth and outcomes.
* Self-driven, with strong problem-solving and probing skills and a proven ability to work autonomously to resolve complex technical issues in Data Center networks.
* Understanding of Data Center security, segmentation, and zero-trust architecture.
* Exposure to network management systems (NMS), telemetry, and monitoring tools, with experience following agile methodology for fast solution delivery, testing, and value realization.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**
**Senior Platform Engineer (MLOps & DataOps)**
The MLOps & Data DevOps team enables Priceline’s data engineering, machine learning, and GenAI teams through secure, scalable, reliable, and governed platforms.
  
  
We build and operate the infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, observability, and self-service capabilities that allow engineering teams to deliver data and ML workloads safely to production.
  
  
If you enjoy working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, DevOps, SRE, data platforms, and machine learning operations, this role offers an opportunity to build platform capabilities used across Priceline.
  
  
**Why this job’s a big deal**
As Priceline expands its use of data, real-time analytics, machine learning, and GenAI, reliable platform engineering is critical to delivering business value safely and efficiently.
  
  
You will help operate the platform foundation behind data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and LLM workloads. Your work will improve deployment speed, platform reliability, cost visibility, security, and the self-service experience for data and ML engineering teams.
  
  
This role is focused on platform engineering and operations. Data and ML teams own business logic, model development, testing, and domain-level data quality; the MLOps & DataOps team owns the infrastructure, deployment paths, automation, governance, and reliability practices that enable those workloads
**.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* Cloud Platform Infrastructure & Automation
* Architect, govern, and scale enterprise-grade Terraform module registries and infrastructure-as-code strategies for GCP data and ML platform services.
* Provision, operate, and automate cloud data and ML platform services such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Vertex AI.
* Drive platform upgrades, lead capacity planning, and design operational improvements across development, QA, and production environments.
* Develop reusable automation and internal tools using Python and Shell scripting.
* Apply infrastructure-as-code, change-management, security, and auditability standards to platform changes.
* CI/CD, GitOps & Self-Service Enablement
* Define the CI/CD enterprise architecture and build governed pipelines for Airflow DAGs, Dataproc jobs, BigQuery changes, ML pipelines, and model-serving infrastructure.
* Implement reliable deployment, promotion, validation, rollback, and release processes using Git-based workflows.
* Set the strategy for GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, or equivalent CI/CD and GitOps tooling to improve developer experience and time to production.
* Design and engineer scalable self-service frameworks that allow data and ML teams to provision and deploy workloads safely without bypassing governance controls.
* Improve developer experience, deployment reliability, and time to production through standardization and automation.
* MLOps & LLMOps Platform Operations
* Architect and optimize production ML workflows covering model training, pipeline execution, model deployment, endpoint operations, batch inference, and retraining.
* Operate and improve ML platforms based on Vertex AI, Kubernetes/GKE, Docker, Kubeflow, or equivalent technologies.
* Support model gateway and LLM platform capabilities such as LiteLLM, including model onboarding, access management, rate limiting, usage visibility, cost controls, and reliability improvements.
* Define and enforce repeatable enterprise standards for model versioning, artifact management, model registries, feature stores, and data/model lineage.
* Drive GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities.
* Monitoring, Observability, Security & SRE
* Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services.
* Establish meaningful SLIs/SLOs, escalation paths, runbooks, and error-management practices.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.
* Participate in on-call support, lead blameless root-cause analysis (RCAs), and enforce corrective and preventative actions.
* Architect IAM, RBAC, service-account controls, vulnerability scanning, secrets management, and compliance guardrails into platform workflows.
* Cost, Governance, Leadership & Platform Enablement
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead complex cross-team technical initiatives, and establish engineering standards for the broader MLOps and DataOps domains.
* Own and optimize cloud architecture for cost efficiency, actively managing capacity and FinOps practices for large-scale data and ML workloads.
* Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues.

**Who You Are**

* Degree & Experience: B.Tech or B.E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant.
* Infrastructure as Code: Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes.
* Containers & Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments.
* CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.
* Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities.
* Data & Workflow Platforms: Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies.
* MLOps: Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations.
* Reliability & Operations: Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, on-call support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for production systems.
* Security & Governance: Working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, service accounts, secrets, vulnerability management, networking fundamentals, and secure cloud operations.
* Operational Mindset: Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience operating LLM gateways or GenAI platforms such as LiteLLM, Tyk, or equivalent model-access layers.
* Experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as Arize, LangSmith, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with GKE platform operations, GPU workloads, vector databases, RAG infrastructure, or model-serving systems.
* Experience implementing data, model, artifact, or pipeline lineage and reproducibility practices.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization, capacity management, and FinOps for data and ML workloads.
* Experience applying SRE, security, networking, or compliance practices to cloud data and ML platforms.

We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* 3-5 Years of expertise and strong understanding of end-to-end Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) capabilities and its processes, including Identity Lifecycle Management, Access Requests, Approvals, Access Reviews, RBAC, SoD, and Application Onboarding.

* Experience conducting IGA maturity assessments, current-state and future-state analysis, gap assessments, and providing strategic recommendations to improve governance, automation, and compliance.

Support continuous improvement initiatives related to KPI monitoring, service reliability, and operational excellence.

✅ SQL (Advanced Querying & Data Analysis)
  
  
✅ Splunk
  
  
Log Analysis
  
  
Search Processing Language (SPL)
  
  
Dashboard Development
  
  
Alert Configuration & Maintenance
  
  
✅ Tableau
  
  
Dashboard Development
  
  
Reporting & Visualization
  
  
Trend Analysis
  
  
✅ Snowflake
  
  
Data Investigation
  
  
Data Validation
  
  
Analytical Queries
  
  
✅ Microsoft Excel (Advanced)
  
  
Pivot Tables
  
  
VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
  
  
Advanced Formulas
  
  
Data Analysis & Reporting
  
  
✅ Dynatrace
  
  
Application Monitoring
  
  
Service Monitoring
  
  
Performance Analysis
  
  
Alert Investigation
  
  
✅ Incident Management & Escalation
  
  
✅ Data Analysis & Troubleshooting
  
  
Required Competencies
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Excellent troubleshooting and investigative mindset.
  
  
Ability to analyze large and complex datasets.
  
  
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  
  
Ability to prioritize multiple incidents and manage competing priorities.
  
  
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
  
  
Ability to work independently and as part of a global operations team.
  
  
Comfortable working in a fast-paced production support environment.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience in production monitoring, operational support, NOC, SRE, Business Operations, or KPI monitoring functions.
  
  
Knowledge of application performance monitoring tools and observability platforms.
  
  
Understanding of incident management frameworks and operational best practices.
  
  
Experience working within Agile or DevOps environments.

description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Data Center Operations designs, installs & maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
  
  
To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build & manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
  
  
The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cuttingedge data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:
  
  

* You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
* Your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
* You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
* You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
* You perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
* You participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
* You possess knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
* You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
* More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
* This position also has a physical component requiring the ability to lift & rack equipment up to 18kg; it may require working in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines.
* This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. * Evaluate new Microsoft/Apple endpoint capabilities, and recommend production adoption when they improve security, supportability or user experience.
* Create technical documentation, SOPs and runbooks; mentor other IT team members and transfer knowledge rather than becoming a single point of dependency.

**Required Skills - Must Have**

* Strong Windows Autopilot implementation and troubleshooting experience.
* Strong understanding of compliance policies, configuration profiles, security baselines and device lifecycle management.
* Hands-on application packaging/deployment using Win32 (.intunewin) or equivalent enterprise packaging methods, including detection and dependency logic.

* PIM, SSO concepts (SAML/OIDC), enterprise application registration and broader Entra identity administration.

**Adjacent Skills - Good To Have / Learn Quickly**

* BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM), Microsoft EPM or similar least-privilege tooling.
* CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or comparable endpoint security platforms.
* Microsoft 365 migration or tenant-to-tenant migration experience.
* ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR or similar control/compliance environments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Takes independent ownership of the Intune/Autopilot/Entra endpoint stack and becomes the escalation point for complex endpoint problems.
* Automates recurring endpoint work and reduces avoidable manual administration/tickets.
* Improves compliance, patching and endpoint security posture while keeping user experience practical.
* Builds working knowledge in adjacent areas such as Jamf/macOS, EPM and broader identity rather than remaining an Intune-only specialist.
* Demonstrates learnability: can identify a knowledge gap, self-learn, test in a lab/pilot, apply the capability in production, document it and transfer the knowledge to others.

* Demonstrated experience owning production systems and resolving complex technical problems, not only following predefined operational procedures.
* Experience working with distributed/global stakeholders and managing technical changes across business teams is preferred.

**Preferred Certifications**

description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
**About The Role**
Qualys is seeking an experienced
**Lead Implementation Engineer**
to join our Global Implementation organization.
  
  
This is a highly technical, customer-facing role responsible for leading the successful deployment, integration, and adoption of Qualys Enterprise Cybersecurity solutions across complex enterprise environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on implementation engineer with proven experience deploying enterprise cloud-based SaaS security platforms. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong customer engagement skills and is responsible for driving customers from technical discovery through successful production deployment.
  
  
As a Lead Implementation Engineer, you will serve as the primary technical owner during implementation engagements, collaborating with customers, Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success, and Technical Support to deliver successful business outcomes.
  
  
This role is designed with approximately
**75% focus on technical deployment, engineering, troubleshooting, and integrations**
, and
**25% focus on implementation consulting, technical discovery, and customer advisory**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Deployment & Engineering**

* Lead end-to-end deployment and implementation of Qualys cybersecurity solutions for enterprise customers.
* Serve as the primary technical owner throughout the customer implementation lifecycle.
* Configure, deploy, validate, optimize, and troubleshoot complex product deployments across enterprise environments.
* Design and implement integrations with customer infrastructure, cloud platforms, identity providers, enterprise applications, and security technologies.
* Troubleshoot complex deployment, networking, operating system, authentication, API, cloud, and integration challenges.
* Develop automation and deployment workflows using APIs and scripting to improve implementation efficiency and customer outcomes.
* Collaborate closely with Product Engineering and Technical Support to investigate product issues, validate fixes, and resolve customer escalations.
* Perform root cause analysis for implementation challenges and recommend scalable technical solutions.
* Serve as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) across assigned Qualys product portfolios.
* Mentor implementation engineers and contribute to implementation standards, best practices, and continuous process improvements.

**Customer Implementation & Consulting**

* Conduct technical discovery workshops to understand customer environments, security architecture, business requirements, and deployment objectives.
* Translate customer requirements into implementation strategies and deployment plans.
* Guide enterprise customers through implementation milestones, production readiness, and operational best practices.
* Deliver implementation documentation, technical knowledge transfer, and deployment recommendations.
* Build trusted relationships with customer Security, Infrastructure, Cloud, and IT Operations teams.
* Partner with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Product Management, and Engineering to ensure successful customer adoption.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience implementing enterprise cloud-based SaaS solutions.
* Proven experience leading enterprise customer implementations from technical discovery through production deployment.
* Strong customer-facing experience working with enterprise IT and Security organizations.
* Hands-on experience integrating enterprise platforms using REST APIs.
* Experience using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar to automate deployments, integrations, operational workflows, or troubleshooting tasks.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently lead multiple enterprise implementation engagements.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Experience**
Candidates with implementation experience in one or more of the following solution domains are highly preferred:
  
  

* Vulnerability & Exposure Management
* Patch Management
* Policy Compliance
* Endpoint Security / EDR
* Cloud Security (CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP)
* Container Security
* Web Application Security
* External Attack Surface Management
* Asset Management
* Identity & Access Management
* Security Information & Event Management (SIEM)

**Technical Skills**
**Candidates are not expected to possess expertise in every technology listed below. Successful candidates should demonstrate strong competency across multiple areas depending on their background and implementation experience.**
Experience in several of the following areas is preferred:
  
  

* Windows and Linux administration
* Enterprise networking (TCP/IP, DNS, Routing, Firewalls, VPNs, Proxy Servers, Load Balancers)
* Public cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform)
* Identity and authentication technologies (Active Directory, LDAP, SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect)
* REST APIs and API-based integrations
* Scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar languages
* Virtualization and container technologies (VMware, Docker, Kubernetes)
* Enterprise integrations such as ITSM, SIEM, or Identity platforms
* Enterprise security architecture and deployment best practices

**Preferred Industry Background**
Experience implementing enterprise cybersecurity or cloud-native SaaS solutions within customer environments is highly preferred. Candidates from organizations specializing in vulnerability management, cloud security, endpoint security, exposure management, identity security, or enterprise security platforms will be well suited for this role.

title: L1 Production Support – Fixed Income Trading
description:
**Why Mizuho**

At Mizuho, we provide the stability of an international industry leader with the career trajectory of a growing business. Our steady, strategic growth gives our people at all levels rewarding degrees of responsibility and richer work experience than a boutique firm or an established giant could offer alone

It’s the local expertise of our employees that makes our global network so powerful. By collaborating with colleagues and clients who have the same ambition and drive, you can amplify your sphere of influence and base of knowledge as part of one of the largest and growing banks in the world.

## Overview

We are looking for a proactive and highly responsive L1 Production Support Analyst to join our global Fixed Income Technology Support team.

The role will provide first-line support for trading applications used by Rates and Investment Grade Credit trading desks across the APAC region, primarily supporting traders in Tokyo and Singapore. The successful candidate will be responsible for monitoring platform health, managing production incidents, troubleshooting application issues, and ensuring a stable trading environment.

## Key Responsibilities

### Trading Application Support

• Provide first-line support for the ION Fixed Income trading platform and associated applications.

• Support front-office users including Rates and Investment Grade Credit traders.

• Investigate and resolve production incidents impacting trading, pricing, trade capture, and downstream trade flows.

• Monitor trading workflows and identify issues before they affect business users.

• Escalate incidents promptly to Level 2 support, development teams, infrastructure teams, or external vendors when required.

### Platform Monitoring & Operations

• Monitor application, server, and infrastructure health across the trading platform ecosystem.

• Monitor batch jobs, interfaces, trade feeds, and market data connectivity.

• Review system alerts and take appropriate action based on defined operational procedures.

• Perform start-of-day and end-of-day health checks.

• Ensure critical trading services remain available during market hours.

### Incident & Problem Management

• Manage incidents from identification through resolution.

• Communicate effectively with traders and support teams during outages and service degradation.

• Maintain clear records of incidents, actions taken, escalations, and resolutions.

• Follow up on outstanding issues and ensure closure within agreed service levels.

• Assist with root cause investigations and post-incident reviews.

### Stakeholder Communication

• Build strong working relationships with traders, technology teams, and operations teams.

• Provide timely updates on production issues and service incidents.

• Demonstrate ownership and accountability throughout the support lifecycle.

## Required Skills & Experience

### Business Knowledge

• Good understanding of Fixed Income products, including:

- Government Bonds / Treasuries

- Interest Rate Swaps

- Corporate Bonds

- Investment Grade Credit products

• Understanding of the trade lifecycle and front-office trading environment.

• Awareness of electronic trading workflows and market data concepts.

### Technical Skills

• Experience supporting the ION Fixed Income trading platform is strongly preferred.

• Strong Linux troubleshooting and operational support skills.

• Experience with Microsoft SQL Server.

• Ability to write SQL queries for analysis and troubleshooting.

• Ability to analyze logs, error messages, and application alerts.

• Familiarity with monitoring tools, production support processes, and incident management practices.

• Understanding of interfaces, trade feeds, and STP processes is desirable.

### Professional Skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Ability to act quickly and remain calm during production incidents.

• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

• Detail-oriented with disciplined follow-up and ownership.

• Strong escalation management skills.

• Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced trading environment.

• Self-motivated with a strong sense of accountability and urgency.

---

## Preferred Qualifications

• 5 years of Production Support / Application Support experience.

• Experience supporting Front Office trading applications.

• Exposure to Fixed Income trading environments.

• Familiarity with Bloomberg, Tradeweb, MarketAxess, or similar trading platforms.

• Basic scripting knowledge (Shell, Python, or PowerShell) is advantageous.

---

**Key Traits:**

• Sense of urgency

• Strong communicator

• Proactive and accountable

• Detail-oriented

• Team player

• Effective under pressure

• Escalates appropriately and follows through relentlessly until resolution

This role directly supports front-office trading activities and plays a critical part in maintaining the stability and reliability of the firm's fixed income trading platform.

**Organization Overview:**

Mizuho Global Services (MGS), Pune is an integral part of Mizuho Financial Group, one of the world’s leading financial institutions with a strong global presence across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia. Based in India, MGS Pune supports Mizuho’s international businesses by delivering high-quality, scalable, and resilient services across multiple functions.

MGS Pune plays a critical role in driving operational excellence, standardization, and innovation for Mizuho Americas. By combining deep domain expertise with strong process, technology, and analytical capabilities, it partners closely with regional and global teams to support corporate and investment banking, capital markets, and corporate services functions, while adhering to the highest standards of risk management, regulatory compliance, and control.

MGS Pune offers competitive compensation and benefits package aligned with industry standards and local market practices. MGS Pune is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. Employment is subject to applicable background verification checks in accordance with Indian laws and company policies.

title: Technology Support Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Technology Support Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Resolve incidents and problems across multiple business system components and ensure operational stability. Create and implement Requests for Change (RFC) and update knowledge base articles to support effective troubleshooting. Collaborate with vendors and help service management teams with issue analysis and resolution.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Microsoft Windows Server Administration
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 2 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As a Technology Support Engineer, a typical day involves addressing and resolving incidents and problems that affect various business system components to maintain smooth and stable operations. The role includes managing change requests and continuously updating documentation to enhance troubleshooting processes. Collaboration with external vendors and internal service management teams is a key part of the daily routine, ensuring timely analysis and resolution of technical issues to support business continuity and operational efficiency.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
A mid-level Windows Administrator with hands-on experience in managing enterprise Windows Server environments. This role independently handles L2 tickets, participates in change management, and contributes to infrastructure improvement initiatives. The candidate is expected to demonstrate strong troubleshooting skills and familiarity with virtualization platforms.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
L2 Incident & Problem Management
  
  
Own and resolve L2 incidents involving Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, and related services
  
  
Manage and execute change requests following ITIL change management processes
  
  
Coordinate scheduled maintenance windows and execute assigned changes
  
  
Proactively identify recurring issues and propose permanent fixes or workarounds
  
  
Advanced System Administration
  
  
Manage and troubleshoot Windows Failover Clustering, DFSR, and load-balanced services
  
  
Manage certificate lifecycle including SSL/TLS certificate issuance and renewal via PKI/CA
  
  
Perform capacity planning activities and report on infrastructure health metrics
  
  
Configure and manage Windows Server roles: File Server, Print Server, WDS, and Remote Desktop Services
  
  
Administer virtualization platforms (VMware vSphere / Hyper-V) at a beginner level
  
  
Security & Compliance
  
  
Implement and enforce security hardening standards (CIS Benchmarks) on Windows Servers
  
  
Manage antivirus/EDR tool deployments and ensure compliance across the server fleet
  
  
Assist in vulnerability assessment activities and coordinate remediation
  
  
Ensure servers comply with organizational security and audit policies
  
  
Mentorship & Collaboration
  
  
Participate in problem management meetings and contribute to knowledge base articles
  
  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Network, Storage, Applications) for integrated issue resolution Contribute to internal documentation, SOPs, and runbook improvements
  
  
**Required Skills & Competencies**
Technical Skills
  
  
Windows Server 2012R2 through 2022 – Administration and troubleshooting
  
  
Windows Clustering (WSFC) – administration and basic troubleshooting
  
  
Virtualization – VMware vSphere or Hyper-V intermediate administration
  
  
SCCM/MECM – software deployment, patch management, imaging
  
  
PowerShell scripting – basic to intermediate automation for admin tasks
  
  
Security hardening – CIS Benchmarks, vulnerability scanning basics
  
  
Soft Skills
  
  
Strong troubleshooting and analytical thinking
  
  
Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders
  
  
Ability to manage multiple incidents and priorities simultaneously
  
  
Proactive attitude toward identifying infrastructure gaps
  
  
Certifications
  
  
**Preferred / Advantageous Certifications**
Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ-800/801) – preferred
  
  
VMware Certified Professional – Data Center Virtualization (VCP-DCV) – advantageous
  
  
ITIL Foundation Certification – preferred
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Windows Server Administration.
* Experience with server installation, configuration, and maintenance.
* Knowledge of system security practices and disaster recovery procedures.
* Ability to troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and network issues related to Windows Server environments.
* Familiarity with scripting and automation tools to streamline administrative tasks.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 2 years of experience in Microsoft Windows Server Administration.
* This position is based at our Pune office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.
