title: Associate Applications Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Our clients need their systems to be reliable, secure, and available. As an Applications Engineer, you will help ensure that their applications and hosting environments run smoothly.
  
  
You will act as a bridge between our clients, technology, and engineering teams. You will understand client requirements, configure and deploy applications, troubleshoot technical issues, and support production environments.
  
  
This role is not limited to application support. It requires a combination of application support, troubleshooting, deployment, infrastructure knowledge, database skills, and basic coding/scripting knowledge. You will work with different technical teams to identify problems, implement solutions, automate repetitive tasks, and continuously improve application reliability.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Application Setup and Deployment**

* Install, configure, and deploy applications on servers and application services.
* Support application releases, code deployments, and environment setup.
* Handle client requests such as certificate installations, new sites, site updates, overwrites, and vanity URLs.
* Perform functional and integration testing before releases.
* Support application configuration and environment-related changes.

**Troubleshooting and Production Support**

* Investigate and resolve application errors, access issues, and performance problems.
* Analyze application and server logs to identify root causes.
* Monitor applications and servers and respond to production incidents.
* Troubleshoot issues across application, server, database, and network layers.
* Help maintain application availability, performance, and security.
* Follow change management procedures for installations, upgrades, and maintenance activities.

**Client and Team Collaboration**

* Act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal teams regarding hosting and application requests.
* Understand client requirements and communicate technical solutions clearly.
* Manage and prioritize cases in the hosting queue.
* Assign, update, and follow up on cases while keeping clients and hosting partners informed.
* Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) when handling support cases.
* Review case backlogs and ensure timely updates and resolution.
* Manage shared mailboxes and communication with hosting partners.

**Technical Skills, Coding, And Automation**

* Work with APIs, databases, and other systems integrated with application.
* Use basic coding or scripting skills to troubleshoot issues and automate repetitive tasks.
* Write or modify simple scripts using technologies such as PowerShell, SQL, or other scripting languages.
* Develop automation where possible to improve application reliability and reduce manual effort.
* Understand application configuration, web applications, and basic software development concepts.

**Documentation and Continuous Improvement**

* Create and maintain SOPs, process documentation, and technical notes for client environments.
* Identify recurring issues and suggest improvements to processes and applications.
* Learn and support Momentive's association management products.
* Work closely with developers, DevOps, infrastructure, QA, and business teams.
* Participate in the rotational on-call support schedule.

**What You Bring**

* 1+ years of experience in application support, application implementation, or a similar technical role.
* Good understanding of application troubleshooting and production support.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server, IIS, Remote Desktop, and Domain Controllers.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Nagios, CloudWatch, or Pingdom.
* Basic understanding of backups and recovery processes.
* Basic SQL Server knowledge, including writing and understanding simple SQL queries.
* Basic coding or scripting knowledge and the ability to understand or modify scripts.
* Experience with cloud-hosted applications or cloud environments.
* Experience using ticketing or IT service management systems.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting client environments, applications, servers, and networks.
* Experience supporting clients through phone, email, or ticketing systems.
* Understanding of change management and controlled deployment processes.
* Ability to analyze logs and troubleshoot technical issues systematically.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills.
* Engineering degree, MCA, MCM, or equivalent technical qualification.

**Nice to Have**

* AWS, Azure, or Microsoft certifications.
* PowerShell scripting experience.
* Knowledge of ITIL or Microsoft Operations Framework.
* Experience with change management tools.
* Experience monitoring and maintaining distributed applications or systems.
* Knowledge of security best practices and client data protection.
* Experience setting up websites and web applications.
* Basic understanding of firewalls, networking, DNS, and certificates.
* Experience working with APIs and application integrations.

**How You Work**
You build strong relationships with clients and colleagues and can work effectively both independently and as part of a team. You take ownership of issues, communicate clearly, and focus on delivering reliable solutions.
  
  
You are comfortable working on technical problems, learning new technologies, and going into the details when an issue is complex. You have a client-first mindset and are willing to support a rotational schedule and participate in on-call responsibilities.
  
  
**About Us**
Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. title: Security Hardening & Misconfiguration Remediation - Technical Specialist-Cloud & Infra Engg
description:
Locations: Pune, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Noida

Area(s) of responsibility

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Security Hardening & Misconfiguration Remediation Specialist to drive security configuration improvements across enterprise environments. The role involves identifying, analyzing, and remediating system misconfigurations while ensuring minimal business disruption. The candidate will work closely with application owners, infrastructure teams, and clients to strengthen security posture in alignment with industry standards.

Preferred Experience

2–5 years of experience in Security Hardening, Configuration Management, or Security Operations.

Experience in enterprise environments with structured change management processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

Security Hardening & Misconfiguration Management

Analyze security misconfigurations across servers, endpoints, and infrastructure components.

Drive remediation activities in coordination with infrastructure and application teams.

Evaluate operational and business impact before implementing configuration changes.

Understand and analyze application dependencies prior to remediation actions.

Document exceptions and risk acceptance with proper justification and approvals.

Vulnerability & Configuration Governance

Support vulnerability management processes (knowledge of vulnerability lifecycle is an added advantage).

Interpret security baselines and compliance standards such as NIST and CIS Benchmarks.

Review and remediate insecure configurations, policies, and legacy protocols.

Coordinate change implementation through ITSM tools such as ServiceNow (SNOW).

Engage with clients and internal stakeholders to provide remediation updates and clarifications.

Provide clear risk communication and remediation timelines.

**Technical Analysis & Implementation**

Perform Windows OS security configuration reviews.

Implement and validate registry-level changes and system hardening controls.

Execute and analyze Windows commands and scripts for configuration validation.

Identify and validate insecure services, permissions, and system-level misconfigurations.

title: Specialist, Technical Support
description:
**Our Mission**
You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.
  
  
We’re here to give power to the patient.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.
  
  
Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from
*seeking*
to
*getting*
. We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.
  
  
Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.
  
  
**Your Impact on our Mission**
Zocdoc’s most important asset is our people. As a Specialist, Technical Support, you’ll play a key role in ensuring our employees have the technology, tools, and support they need to do their best work. You’ll provide hands-on technical support to both onsite and remote employees, troubleshoot hardware and software issues across PC and Mac environments, and support critical IT operations including onboarding and offboarding, asset management, account administration, and workplace technology.
  
  
You’ll also have the opportunity to work with technologies such as Google Workspace, Azure AD, Intune, JAMF, Jira, Slack, and BetterCloud, while exploring how AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Glean, and Gemini can improve troubleshooting, documentation, automation, and everyday IT operations.
  
  
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys solving problems, delivering an excellent employee experience, and continuously learning new technologies. You’ll have the chance to take ownership of day-to-day IT support while identifying opportunities to automate and improve processes at scale—all while helping Zocdoc teams stay productive and focused on our mission to give power to the patient.
  
  
**Your day-to-day is**

* Work within the IT Support Team to provide excellent customer service, effective response times and expert insights into general and sometimes complex support issues.
* Working in Night shift (6 pm-3 am) Providing WFH/On-site.
* Experience in Google Workspace admin is a must.
* Supporting on-site/remote desktop computing issues (PCs/Macs) as well as submitting repair requests to manufacturers for damaged machines.
* Provides basic support and assistance for Zocdoc users in relation to a variety of software applications and hardware systems.
* Ensure quality of service guidelines for dealing with customers, completing services, and overall customer satisfaction are adhered to.
* Assist other IT support staff with operational procedures and troubleshooting issues.
* Create and maintain detailed documentation for systems and processes managed by the Enterprise IT team, for both end-users and other IT staff.
* Communicate promptly throughout the ticket lifecycle to maintain a high level of client satisfaction by responding promptly to client requests according to published SLAs.
* Performing IT support tasks such as desk setups, inventory counts, organizing, audits, meeting room setups, etc. and other duties as assigned.
* Systems administration of core IT services (on-prem and SaaS), including process automation, configurations, and improvements within these tools.
* Work with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Glean, and Gemini to support troubleshooting, research, documentation, and day-to-day IT operations.
* Identify and use AI-powered solutions to automate repetitive/manual IT support tasks and improve operational efficiency.
* Assist with integrating approved AI tools into internal applications, workflows, and support processes while following security and privacy requirements.
* Hardware and software asset management.
* Staff onboarding and off-boarding, including machine imaging and account creation/configuration.

**You’ll enjoy this role if you are…**

* A self starter and have an entrepreneurial mindset
* Excited about learning new technologies
* Excited to use technology to enhance the consumer experience

**You’ll be successful in this role if you have…**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field or a mixture of IT-related certifications and relevant experience.
* 2+ years experience in a progressively responsible technical support or helpdesk role
* Strong customer service background required.
* Experience with AzureAD, Intune Endpoints
* Ability to identify common user experience issues and analyze root causes, delivering and implementing viable solutions at scale.
* Experience with some of the following: G Suite Apps, JIRA, Confluence, Slack, and Bettercloud.
* On-site and remote desktop troubleshooting skills for PC and Mac, software and hardware.
* Proficiency with MS Windows domain environment (Windows Server, Active Directory, LDAP, DHCP, license management, workstation imaging, access controls)
* Proficiency with Single Sign-On and Multi-Factor authentication.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Glean, Gemini, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of how AI can be used for technical troubleshooting, documentation, research, and workflow automation.
* Ability to use AI responsibly, validate AI-generated outputs, and identify opportunities to improve IT support processes through automation.
* Familiar with JAMF/JSS Suite.
* Scripting experience (BASH, PowerShell, or similar).

**Benefits**

* An incredible team of smart and supportive people
* A competitive compensation package, including attractive medical insurance
* Flexible, hybrid work environment
* Amazing perks – think catered lunch every day, Ping Pong, etc.
* Daycare reimbursement
* The chance to create a better healthcare experience for millions of patients!
* Corporate wellness programs with Headspace
* Cellphone and wifi reimbursement
* Competitive parental leave
* Sabbatical leave (over 5 years)
* Annual sponsored health check-ups
* Sponsored counselling and therapy via Betterlyf
* Competitive PTO
* Zocdoc is certified as a Great Place to Work 2022-2026

**Location**

* Our office is located in Koregaon Park, looking for candidates who can work from office all 5 days

**About Us**
Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.
  
  
Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values -
*Together, Not Alone*
, we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. The ERP Support Engineer plays a key role in delivering technical support for QAD and Progress products. title: Information Technology Executive (CCTV Operations)
description:
**Job Title:**
IT Executive (CCTV Operations)

**Company:**
PALMONAS

**Department:**
Information Technology

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Work Mode:**
Work from Office

**About PALMONAS**

PALMONAS is a modern demi-fine jewellery and lifestyle brand with a growing retail presence. We are looking for a detail-oriented IT professional to manage CCTV operations, monitor surveillance systems, and ensure the smooth functioning of security infrastructure across our retail stores and other business locations.

**Role Overview**

The Executive – IT (CCTV Operations) will be responsible for monitoring CCTV surveillance systems, ensuring camera uptime, troubleshooting technical issues, coordinating with vendors and store teams, and maintaining surveillance records. The role requires strong technical knowledge, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders to ensure uninterrupted CCTV operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. CCTV Monitoring & Operations**

* Monitor CCTV surveillance systems across retail stores and other assigned locations.
* Ensure cameras, recording devices, and monitoring systems are operational and accessible.
* Identify camera downtime, connectivity issues, blind spots, and recording failures.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to address surveillance gaps and ensure continuous monitoring.
* Escalate suspicious activities, security incidents, and system failures to the concerned stakeholders.

**2. Installation & Configuration**

* Coordinate CCTV installation, commissioning, and configuration at new stores and existing locations.
* Assist with camera positioning, recording setup, network connectivity, and remote viewing access.
* Ensure CCTV systems are configured according to company requirements.
* Verify camera coverage and recording functionality after installation or maintenance.

**3. Technical Troubleshooting**

* Troubleshoot CCTV-related hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues.
* Coordinate with IT teams and external vendors to resolve technical problems.
* Monitor DVR/NVR systems, IP cameras, storage capacity, and recording availability.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical issues affecting surveillance operations.

**4. Vendor & Store Coordination**

* Coordinate with CCTV vendors, service providers, and retail store teams for installations, repairs, and maintenance.
* Track service requests, pending issues, and resolution timelines.
* Follow up with vendors to ensure timely maintenance and minimal downtime.
* Maintain records of vendor visits, repairs, installations, and system replacements.

**5. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain CCTV asset records, camera inventories, installation details, and location-wise system information.
* Prepare reports on camera downtime, system health, incidents, and maintenance activities.
* Maintain logs of technical issues, escalations, and corrective actions.
* Ensure surveillance footage is retrieved and shared with authorized stakeholders when required, following company policies.

**6. Preventive Maintenance & Compliance**

* Conduct periodic checks to verify camera functionality and recording availability.
* Support preventive maintenance of CCTV equipment and associated infrastructure.
* Ensure appropriate access controls for surveillance systems and footage.
* Follow company policies regarding data confidentiality, footage retention, and authorized access.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Diploma or bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in CCTV operations, surveillance systems, IT support, or network troubleshooting.
* Basic knowledge of IP cameras, DVR/NVR systems, and CCTV monitoring software.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, including IP addressing, LAN, routers, switches, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with remote CCTV access and camera configuration.
* Good problem-solving, documentation, and coordination skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple retail locations and external vendors.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience supporting CCTV systems across retail stores, warehouses, offices, or multiple locations.
* Exposure to CCTV installation, maintenance, and surveillance monitoring.
* Knowledge of video management systems (VMS), recording storage, and remote monitoring tools.
* Experience coordinating with store operations, IT teams, and security teams.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* CCTV system uptime and camera availability.
* Turnaround time for resolving CCTV-related issues.
* Timely installation and commissioning of CCTV systems at new stores.
* Completion of preventive maintenance activities.
* Accuracy of asset records and maintenance documentation.
* Timely escalation and resolution of surveillance-related incidents.

**Ideal Candidate**

A technically sound and proactive IT professional who can ensure reliable CCTV operations across retail locations, troubleshoot system issues, coordinate with vendors, and maintain effective surveillance infrastructure to support store security and business operations.

title: IT Support & Systems Engineer

What we stand for is simple: sovereign data, interoperable systems, decoupled intelligence — delivered the way modern software should be. No rip-and-replace. No multi-year transformation. Our CEO Anu Jain puts it well: we turn the "ball of yarn" of data integrations into a unified engine — less like assembling car parts, more like buying the car ready to drive. 85+ open-source tools pre-integrated. AI-native automations that deploy and self-heal the stack without human toil. Forward-deployed engineers who build shoulder-to-shoulder with customer teams — hands on keyboards, not just on decks.
  
  
It's working, and fast. We're tripling revenue year over year, backed by Insight Partners, and running in production in environments most vendors won't touch. Our platform processes credit risk data for 90%+ of US small businesses — 40M+ — every month. Intent signals for 300M+ subscribers monthly for Africa's largest telco. The data and AI layer for a Top 3 US bank.
  
  
We're 100+ people across the US and India, headquartered in Atlanta. We think big, move fast, and don't mistake activity for progress. We hire people who'd rather ship the rocket than brief someone on it.
  
  
Check out this podcast of Anu talking about our solution here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g8g50sv5GhQ
  
  
As we continue our journey, we are building a team of sharp, intelligent innovators who can move fast with great agility and passion. We are searching for an experienced
**IT Support & Systems Engineer**
to own both our IT systems and the day-to-day experience of the people who use them. Based in our Pune office and reporting to the Head of Information Technology in the US, you will be the hands-on owner of our devices, identities, and SaaS applications, and the first line of support for employees across NexusOne. You will work with the Security team to keep NexusOne productive, secure, and audit-ready. The ideal candidate takes end-to-end ownership, fixes problems at the root, documents what they do, and thrives working across time zones.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**
**End-User Support & Service Desk**

* Own the IT support queue: triage, prioritize, and resolve tickets in our ticketing system (Linear), and route Slack requests into a single tracked intake
* Provide Level 1/Level 2 support for macOS, Windows, Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Meet), Zoom, VPN, SSO/MFA, and core SaaS applications, escalating complex issues to US IT, Security, or vendors with clear documentation
* Meet defined response and resolution targets, and report on support metrics (ticket volume, first response time, resolution time, user satisfaction)
* Identify recurring issues, drive them to root cause, and close the loop with affected users
* Provide responsive, white-glove support for executives, including travel and account lockout scenarios
* Build and maintain a user-facing and AI ingested knowledge base of how-tos, FAQs, and self-service guides that reduce ticket volume
* Provide support coverage with partial overlap with US business hours, and help with urgent after-hours issues as needed

**Asset & Endpoint Management**

* Own the full lifecycle of laptops and IT assets in Pune: procurement, imaging, assignment, repair, refresh, recovery, and secure disposal
* Maintain an accurate asset inventory, with assignments, warranties, and chain of custody tracked for audits
* Administer Rippling MDM: device enrollment, configuration profiles, app deployment, OS/patch compliance, and remote lock/wipe
* Troubleshoot and resolve Rippling MDM issues (enrollment failures, policy conflicts, app deployment errors, non-compliant devices) and escalate to Rippling support when needed
* Support our partial transition to Apple devices, including Mac deployment, setup, and user onboarding to macOS

**Onboarding & Offboarding**

* Run device and access onboarding for new hires so laptops, accounts, and apps are ready on day one, including a first-day IT orientation
* Execute timely offboarding: access revocation, device recovery and wipe, and coordination of courier pickup/returns with vendors
* Partner with HR/People Ops on joiner, mover, and leaver workflows and keep evidence of completion

**Identity & Access Management**

* Administer user accounts, groups, and roles across Google Workspace, Rippling, and connected SaaS applications (including remaining Microsoft 365/Entra ID tenants)
* Apply least-privilege, role-based access; process access requests and support periodic access reviews
* Manage SSO/SAML application setup, MFA enforcement, and group-based provisioning
* Resolve account lockouts, MFA resets, and access issues quickly and securely

**License & SaaS Management**

* Track and optimize software licenses: assign, reclaim, and true-up seats, and flag unused spend
* Maintain the SaaS application inventory and support renewals and vendor evaluations

**Vendor & Office IT Operations**

* Manage local IT vendors in Pune (hardware suppliers, repair partners, ISPs, couriers), including quotes, POs, SLAs, and contract follow-ups
* Maintain office IT infrastructure: network, Wi-Fi, printers, meeting rooms, and AV

**Security & Compliance Collaboration**

* Work with the Security team on endpoint security (EDR, disk encryption, screen lock, patching), alert triage, and incident response
* Support with maintaining evidence for compliance programs (e.g., HITRUST, SOC 2) using Vanta, and remediate failing device and access controls
* Follow and help enforce IT and security policies, and educate staff on security best practices

**Coordination with US IT Leadership**

* Act as the on-site IT owner in Pune, reporting status, risks, and metrics to the Head of IT in the US
* Participate in cross-time-zone planning and prioritization, write runbooks and SOPs, and propose automation and process improvements that reduce manual work and ticket volume

**WHO YOU ARE:**

* 4–7 years of hands-on IT experience spanning both systems administration and end-user support, ideally in a fast-growing technology company or startup
* Proven service desk experience: owning a ticket queue, working to SLAs, and using a ticketing tool (Linear, Jira Service Management, Zendesk, or similar)
* Strong Windows and macOS troubleshooting skills, plus experience supporting Google Workspace users
* Strong hands-on experience with MDM (Rippling MDM preferred) for Windows and macOS
* Administrator experience with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365/Entra ID, including users, groups, roles, SSO/SAML, and MFA
* Proven experience running device lifecycles, onboarding/offboarding, and license management at scale
* Experience managing local vendors and procurement in India
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi, firewalls) and endpoint security tools
* Experience with remote support tools and supporting distributed users across time zones
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks and audit evidence collection (Vanta or similar is a plus)
* Scripting or automation skills (Bash, PowerShell, Python, Google Apps Script) are a plus

**Why You’ll Love Working at Nexus**
At Nexus, we value people who want to grow — and support each other while doing so.
  
  
You can expect:
  
  

* A collaborative team culture built on curiosity and respect
* Challenging work where your contributions clearly matter
* A leadership team that invests in learning and development
* The opportunity to work at the intersection of cloud, data, and AI innovation

**Ready to Apply?**
If this role sounds like a great fit — or even
*close*
to one — we’d love to hear from you. We know that no candidate checks every single box, and we’re excited to meet people who bring curiosity, talent, and a desire to build meaningful work together.

**About Quorum Software**

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. For more information, visit quorumsoftware.com

**Be a part of our legacy**

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies.

**Who we are looking for:**

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation.

**Job Purpose**

We're hiring a Lead AI Platform Engineer: a lead, hands-on engineer who will champion our AI Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) across engineering teams and design and build core parts of our AI platform, working day to day with our Pune and US AI platform team.

The team owns the Agentic AI Platform and drives AI adoption, including AIDLC, across the engineering departments. We don't hand work off after release: the team builds it, ships it, monitors it, and supports it in production.

This is an individual contributor role, not a team lead or people-management position. You lead through technical depth: owning hard problems, setting a high bar for quality, and helping the engineers around you do their best work.

**What You Will Own:**

You will own technical design and delivery for your areas of the AI platform, and help drive AIDLC adoption across engineering.

* **The Agentic AI Platform:** the agentic runtime and LLM gateway.
* **Shared platform services**: a growing set of services, such as a knowledge base built on a vector database.
* **AIDLC and AI adoption:** helping engineering teams across departments implement AIDLC, AI coding tools, and engineering automation.

**Responsibilities:**

**AIDLC and AI adoption**

* Make AI-assisted engineering the norm by championing AIDLC, AI coding tools, and engineering automation.
* Help engineering teams across departments implement AIDLC in their own workflows and codebases.

**Technical design**

* Take on the most complex platform work across the AI platform, Databricks, and shared services.
* Make design and trade-off decisions for your areas.
* Contribute to technical planning with the Pune and US teams.

**Hands-on engineering**

* Spend time writing, testing, and shipping code across Python, TypeScript, C#, and Elixir codebases.

**Engineering quality**

* Set a high bar for testing, code review, design documentation, and observability through your own work and reviews.
* Work closely with QA and DevOps so quality is built in, not inspected in.

**Production ownership**

* Make sure what you ship is deployed safely, monitored, and supported in production.
* Help lead the response when something breaks.

**Cross-site collaboration**

* Collaborate closely with the OPTI US team by sharing designs, aligning priorities, and keeping work moving across time zones.

* **And other duties as assigned.**

**Requirements:**

We care about lead-level capability, not a title. Manager experience is not required if you've been the person others go to for technical direction.

* Lead-level software engineering experience building and running production systems, typically 10+ years.
* Production experience in at least two of Python, TypeScript, Elixir, and C#, and the comfort to pick up the rest.
* A strong testing mindset: you design for testability and treat automated tests as part of the work.
* Hands-on experience with AI coding tools and engineering automation, and a view on how they change the way teams build software.
* Experience working with AIDLC or a similar structured approach to AI-assisted delivery.
* Experience owning services in production, including deployments, monitoring, and incident response.
* Experience supporting other engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussions.
* Clear written and spoken English, and confidence working with distributed teams across India and the US.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience building with LLMs, such as agents, tool use, orchestration, or an LLM gateway.
* Exposure to Databricks, Spark, or large-scale data pipelines.
* Azure knowledge, including CI/CD.
* Experience onboarding new team members.
* Background in enterprise software.

**Our Stack:**

* Languages: Python, TypeScript, Elixir, and C#
* Cloud and data: Azure and Azure Databricks
* AI platform: an in-house agentic runtime and LLM gateway
* Engineering: AI coding tools throughout the development lifecycle

**Additional Details**

* Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position.

We want to be the place where a diverse pool of talented people join us, stay with us and do their best work. With a diverse team of employees, we grow and learn better together. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression, and talent that our employees invest in their work represents not only part of our culture, but our reputation and our achievements. We are fully focused on equity and equality and believe deeply in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ethnicity, national origin, ability, neurodiversity and all the other characteristics that make us unique.

**SAP Basis Lead-SKF Automotive Business**

**Role Purpose**

The SAP Basis Lead is accountable for the **reliability, availability, security, performance and lifecycle management of the enterprise SAP platform**, across Business-as-Usual (BAU) operations and SAP transformation initiatives.

The role acts as the technical service owner and primary interface between internal IT, SAP application teams, **SAP RISE/ECS**, hyperscalers and AMS/service partners, ensuring a secure, resilient and efficiently operated SAP landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. RISE with SAP & Platform Governance**

* Own technical governance of **RISE with SAP / S/4HANA Private Cloud** and the broader SAP platform landscape.
* Govern the **RISE shared-responsibility model** across SAP ECS, internal IT, hyperscalers and service partners.
* Manage SAP/ECS service delivery, SLAs, planned maintenance, escalations and continual service improvement.
* Govern system provisioning, refreshes, patching, upgrades, capacity and technical lifecycle activities.
* Define and maintain SAP platform standards, architecture principles and technology roadmap.
* Ensure clear ownership and accountability across SAP, AMS and internal teams.

**2. BAU Operations & Service Reliability**

* Ensure stable **24x7 operation of business-critical SAP environments**.
* Govern incident, problem, change and major-incident management, including root-cause analysis and preventive actions.
* Oversee system availability, performance, interfaces, background jobs, databases, capacity and overall platform health.
* Govern kernel/support package upgrades, patching, system refreshes, client copies, housekeeping and transport management.
* Establish and monitor operational **SLAs, KPIs, runbooks and escalation procedures**.
* Drive proactive monitoring and observability across SAP systems, integrations, jobs and critical business processes.
* Drive automation and continual improvement to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents and technical debt.
* Leverage **SAP Cloud ALM, where applicable**, for monitoring, alerting and operational insights.

**3. S/4HANA Transformation, Release & Cutover**

* Act as BASIS technical lead for **S/4HANA implementations, upgrades, migrations and transformation programs**.
* Ensure technical environment readiness across DEV, QA, UAT, Pre-Production and Production.
* Lead technical cutovers, transport/release management, production deployment and hypercare.
* Coordinate technical dependencies across Functional, Development, Integration, Security, Data, Testing and Infrastructure teams.
* Ensure transformation activities are delivered without compromising BAU stability.
* Support landscape simplification and transition from legacy SAP platforms.

**4. Architecture, Integration & Lifecycle Management**

* Provide technical leadership across **S/4HANA, HANA, Fiori/Gateway, Cloud Connector and associated SAP platform technologies**.
* Govern connectivity across SAP cloud, on-premises and third-party platforms.
* Ensure architecture provides appropriate availability, resilience, performance, scalability and capacity.
* Govern authentication, certificates, SSO, connectivity and network dependencies.
* Evaluate new SAP technologies and platform capabilities in alignment with enterprise architecture and business requirements.
* Maintain lifecycle plans for SAP platforms, databases and related technical components.

**5. Security, Risk, Compliance & Resilience**

* Ensure SAP platforms comply with enterprise cybersecurity, **ITGC and audit requirements**.
* Govern vulnerability remediation, secure configurations, certificate management and privileged technical access.
* Maintain SAP platform risks and associated remediation plans.
* Govern backup/recovery, high availability and **Disaster Recovery** capabilities.
* Coordinate DR readiness and testing aligned with agreed **RTO/RPO** requirements.
* Support internal and external audits and ensure appropriate controls and evidence are maintained.

**6. Partner, Vendor & Team Leadership**

* Lead operational governance with **SAP/ECS, AMS providers, hyperscalers and other technology partners**.
* Monitor service delivery against contractual responsibilities, SLAs and KPIs.
* Act as the technical escalation point for critical SAP platform issues.
* Lead service reviews, corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Provide technical direction and mentoring to BASIS/platform specialists.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, SAP Application and business teams.
* Drive **automation, simplification, cost optimization and operational excellence** across the SAP platform.

**Experience & Core Skills**

* About 15 years of experience in **SAP**
* Strong experience leading **SAP BASIS/platform operations within a large enterprise environment**.
* Deep technical knowledge of **SAP S/4HANA and SAP HANA**.
* Strong experience with **RISE with SAP / S/4HANA Private Cloud**.
* Experience working with **SAP ECS and the RISE shared-responsibility model**.
* Strong experience in SAP BAU operations, performance management, upgrades, migrations, technical cutovers, system refreshes and transport management.
* Experience supporting large-scale **S/4HANA transformation and upgrade programs**.
* Strong understanding of **SAP architecture**, **Fiori/Gateway, Cloud Connector, interfaces and enterprise connectivity**.
* Strong understanding of ITSM processes including incident, problem, change and major-incident management.
* Knowledge of security, audit, compliance, HA/DR and business continuity requirements.
* Experience governing SAP, AMS and cloud service providers within an SLA-driven operating model.
* Strong **technical leadership, stakeholder management, vendor management and communication skills**.

**Good to Have**

* Working knowledge of **SAP BTP** and its interaction with the core SAP landscape.
* Experience with **SAP Cloud ALM (CALM)** for monitoring, alerting and operational insights.
* Experience transitioning monitoring/ALM capabilities from **SAP Solution Manager** to newer SAP tooling.
* Exposure to automation and observability solutions supporting SAP operations.
* Experience with global, multi-system and business-critical SAP landscapes.

  

**Role Success Profile**

The successful candidate combines **strong SAP BASIS technical depth with service ownership, governance and transformation leadership**.

The role is not intended to be primarily a hands-on BASIS administrator. The SAP BASIS Lead is accountable for ensuring that internal teams, **SAP/ECS, AMS and other technology partners collectively deliver a stable, secure and future-ready SAP platform**, while enabling S/4HANA transformation and maintaining BAU service continuity.

  

**If you want to go further**

This position will be located in Pune/Bangalore/Gurgaon. You will report to SAP Global Lead, who is located in Gurgaon, India. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Sonam Dalal, Talent Acquisition Specialist, by email sonam.dalal@skfvertevo.com. SKF Automotive: Bearings & aftermarket solutions since 1907

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**Role:**
Platform Engineer

**Function:**
Infrastructure / DevOps / Platform Engineering

**Location:**
Delhi

**Type:**
Full-time

**Industry:**
Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media

**About Company**

One of India's largest private FM radio networks, active since 2006. The company reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000+ towns, and 50,000 villages.

It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu and Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.

With a team of 740, the company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcasting and digital innovation.

**Position Overview**

The company is building a media super-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro-drama, news, and commerce on a single platform. This foundational individual-contributor role owns infrastructure and DevOps end-to-end — from cloud and Kubernetes to CI/CD, observability, and security. The Platform Engineer sets the operational standards every engineering team builds and ships on, directly shaping the reliability and velocity of the entire platform.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Own GCP infrastructure, Kubernetes clusters, Terraform-managed environments, CDN, storage, IAM, secrets management, and networking end-to-end
* Design and maintain a scalable, secure cloud infrastructure foundation supporting all content and commerce verticals of the super-app
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that enable engineering teams to ship quickly and reliably at scale
* Establish monitoring, alerting, and observability practices across services to ensure platform reliability and fast incident response
* Enforce infrastructure-as-code standards using Terraform to keep environments consistent and reproducible across all stages
* Partner with Backend and Frontend Architects to ensure infrastructure aligns with and supports evolving application architecture
* Drive infrastructure cost optimization and scalability planning as the platform scales beyond its initial launch phase

**Must Have Criteria**

* 5–8 years of hands-on infrastructure, DevOps, or platform engineering experience
* Deep expertise with GCP (or equivalent major cloud provider), Kubernetes, and Terraform in production environments
* Proven track record building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines at scale
* Strong working knowledge of monitoring, observability, and incident response practices in cloud-native systems
* Hands-on experience with IAM, secrets management, and networking security in a cloud-native environment
* Demonstrated ability to operate as a high-impact individual contributor — leading through technical authority rather than headcount

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in a media, content, or commerce super-app environment — particularly with CDN and content delivery at scale
* Prior 0→1 infrastructure experience at a high-growth startup
* GCP Professional Cloud Architect certification or equivalent cloud certification
* Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure cost optimization at scale

**What We Offer**

* Foundational ownership of infrastructure for a platform reaching 40M+ listeners — high visibility, high impact
* Direct collaboration with senior architects in a greenfield super-app build
* Full-time, individual-contributor role with the autonomy to set infrastructure standards organisation-wide
* Opportunity to shape the technical foundation of one of India's most recognised broadcast and digital media brands

title: IT Administrator
description:
**Job Description – IT Administrator**

**Department:** Information Technology (IT)  
**Job Title:** IT Administrator  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Location:** Delhi NCR

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled IT Administrator to manage and maintain the company's IT infrastructure, including desktops, laptops, servers, networks, internet connectivity, CCTV, EPBX, business applications, and user support. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth IT operations, data security, system backups, and timely resolution of technical issues across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Desktop, Laptop & End-User Support**

* Install, configure, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, operating systems, and software.
* Resolve employee IT complaints and provide timely technical support.
* Support macOS, MacBooks, Apple applications, and third-party software.

**2. Server & Backup Management**

* Monitor server performance and ensure smooth functioning.
* Manage daily backups, verify backup completion, and troubleshoot backup failures.
* Configure server settings and resolve server connectivity issues.

**3. Network, Internet & Security Management**

* Maintain LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, switches, routers, IP configurations, and network cabling.
* Troubleshoot internet connectivity and coordinate with internet service providers.
* Manage firewall rules, VPN, remote desktop (RDP), and network access policies.
* Maintain antivirus protection, system updates, and IT security controls.

**4. Email, User Accounts & Application Support**

* Manage Active Directory user accounts, passwords, permissions, and shared-folder access.
* Provide support for Microsoft 365, Outlook, email accounts, and Microsoft Office applications.

title: Lead AI Ops Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead AI Ops Engineer
  
  
AI Ops
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard's Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As AI agents move from POC to production, their behavior keeps changing in real time: the context they retrieve, the skills they select, how they resolve exceptions. These agents are never really “finished.” They keep learning from production outcomes, so their reliability, safety, and trustworthiness need to be actively operated, not just monitored. That is the job of AI Ops: making sure each agent’s reasoning stays correct, its context stays current, and its behavior stays governed as it learns.
  
  
**Role**

* Own end to end production monitoring for one or more AI agents, tracking key metrics, KPIs, accuracy, latency, SLA breaches, guardrail triggers, and out of scope rates through dedicated observability dashboards
* Serve as L1/L2 production support, providing first response monitoring, triage, and escalation to tech teams as new agentic services go live
* Identify and diagnose issues by monitoring eval scores and drift alerts, inspecting failing traces and patterns, and classifying root causes such as intent, tool, parameter, or hallucination errors
* Evaluate whether the agent’s reasoning remains correct in production, checking whether context retrieval stays current, whether resolutions match ground truth, and whether the learning loop is drifting
* Monitor and manage post production reliability, including API and authentication failures and issues originating from external AI endpoints, to protect revenue generating, client facing agents
* Partner with AI Engineering to prioritize fixes, run experiments on prompts, context, and routing in Dev, and validate improvements via evals before handing off proven changes for deployment
* Embed governance within the agent’s learning loop so that approval workflows and audit logging travel with every production change, rather than being added after the fact

**All About You**

* Experience monitoring or operating production AI/ML or agentic systems, including observability, evaluation, and drift detection practices
* Strong analytical skills to diagnose root causes across intent classification, tool selection, parameter errors, and hallucination patterns
* Understanding of AI/LLM observability concepts such as tracing, telemetry, guardrails, and evaluation engineering including benchmarks, automated evals, human review, and regression testing
* Familiarity with governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices such as PII detection, access control, audit logging, and policy enforcement is a plus
* Ability to work independently alongside existing Tech teams while owning a dedicated agent’s post launch health
* Excellent communication skills to translate production signals into clear, prioritized asks for AI Product and AI Engineering teams
* Comfort working in a fast evolving environment where the process itself, not just the throughput, is what is being continuously operated on and improved

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:

The engineer will work closely with Account Security Team, NTT Operations Teams, OEM vendors, and infrastructure teams to resolve technical issues, implement security controls, enforce security policies, and provide operational and security reporting. The role also supports continuous improvement of email security capabilities, threat protection, and service reliability.

* Administer and maintain enterprise email security platforms and services.
* Ensure high availability, performance, and operational health of email security infrastructure.
* Monitor email security gateways, cloud email security solutions, and supporting systems.
* Manage platform configurations, upgrades, patches, and lifecycle activities.
* Support capacity planning, performance tuning, and operational optimization.

* Support disaster recovery and business continuity processes related to email security platforms.

+ Phishing attacks
+ Business Email Compromise (BEC)
+ Malware campaigns
+ Spoofing attempts
+ Email-borne threats

* Investigate email security incidents and coordinate remediation activities.
* Support implementation of:

+ SPF
+ DKIM
+ DMARC
+ Anti-phishing controls
+ Email encryption controls

* Analyze email security trends and recommend improvements.

**OEM Vendor Coordination**

* Support security exception reviews and risk mitigation activities.

+ Email threat activity
+ Phishing detection rates
+ Malware detection statistics
+ Platform availability
+ SLA performance
+ Incident response metrics
+ Mail flow performance

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve email security controls and operational efficiency.

title: Storage Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
Join our team as a Storage Engineer where you will be responsible for managing and optimizing storage solutions in both NetApp and HPE environments. Your role will encompass critical event monitoring, network interface control, and maintaining data integrity through effective storage management. This role is crucial in ensuring our storage infrastructure remains robust, efficient, and secure.
  
  
**What you will do:**

* Monitor storage critical events and network interfaces.
* Check aggregate and volume usage using AIQUM.
* Configure and troubleshoot Snap Mirror and Snap Vault environments.
* Perform daily health checks for LUN, aggregate, and volume utilization.
* Manage Snap Restore and CIFS shares, and handle permissions for shared folders.
* Set up and troubleshoot V-Filer, NFS, CIFS, and SAN environments.
* Conduct ONTAP OS upgrades and manage LUN assignments.
* Resolve hardware issues in coordination with NetApp support.
* Perform volume resize, aggregate disk addition, and LUN resizing.
* Lun management (LUN creation, LUN snapshots, Manual and automatic igroup management, LUN restore) using Snap drive.
* Performed DR test for the environment.
* Snapshot, Lun clone, flex clone management.
* Setting up and troubleshooting V-Filer Environment.
* Setting up and troubleshooting NFS, CIFS, and SAN (FC and ISCSI) Environment.
* Configuring windows ISCSI Boot LUN for the environment.
* Managing the reports using operations manager.
* Working with qtree’s for efficient storage utilization for the users.
* Performing Deduplication for the volumes.
* Alias, zoning configuration for the servers connected in FC environment in brocade switches & Cisco Switches.
* Able to create/Expand aggregate, volume, Qtree for NAS environments, LUN’s, Igroups for SAN environments and also reclamation the LUN’s and SAN ports if any (De-commissioning projects).
* Provide storage infrastructure system management including capacity planning, performance monitoring and tuning, security management etc.
* Should Manage Tier-3 support following ITIL practice and incident management.
* Proven experience in complex, enterprise level NAS platform in a mission critical environment
* Should Leads technical assessments of hardware, software, tools, applications, firmware, middleware, and operating systems to support business operations.
* Strong product knowledge and troubleshooting skills on 3PAR/Primera, EVA, MSA, and nearline/StoreOnce products.
* Handle storage remediation tasks like HBA driver and firmware upgrades.
* Lead technical assessments and provide infrastructure support including design, planning, and project deployment.

**The skills you bring:**

* Minimum 2–6 years of experience in storage engineering, with a strong focus on NetApp, HP Primera, and HPE storage systems.
* Willingness to work in a 24x7 operational environment with rotating shifts, including weekends and holidays, to support critical infra and ensure minimal downtime
* Proficiency with NDMP backups and integration with third-party products.
* Experience in performing disaster recovery tests and storage remediation, including HBA driver and firmware upgrades.
* Knowledge of HPE 3PAR/Primera, EVA/MSA, and nearline/StoreOnce products.

Platform Operations & Service DeliveryLead a team of Scheduling Operators supporting the Tidal Workload Automation platform and ensure high availability and operational efficiency.

Maintain high-quality documentation of incident resolutions and service request outcomes for future reference and analysis.
  
  
Identify recurring issues and recommend candidates for Problem Management to drive long-term resolution.
  
  
Drive continuous improvements in incident and request management processes to improve service quality and operational efficiency.
  
  
Leadership & Team ManagementMonitor team workloads and ensure all incidents and requests are progressing within SLA commitments.

Develop and maintain internal operational processes that ensure consistency, quality, and governance across the service.
  
  
Knowledge Management & Continuous ImprovementContribute to maintaining service catalogs, knowledge bases, operational procedures, and support documentation.
  
  
Promote knowledge transfer within the team and across IT Service Delivery functions.
  
  
Identify cost-effective opportunities for operational improvements and recommend solutions that meet customer requirements.
  
  
Evaluate emerging technologies and industry best practices to enhance service capabilities and team effectiveness.
  
  
Stakeholder & Customer ManagementCommunicate effectively with internal teams, business stakeholders, and external customers.

Escalate customer concerns appropriately and work with management to deliver effective solutions.

* Experience of security controls, such as network access controls; identity, authentication, and access management controls (IAAM); and intrusion detection and prevention controls.

* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)
* Elastic Certified SIEM Analyst / Elastic Certified Engineer
* CompTIA Security+ / CySA+ or equivalent security certification is desirable.
* GIAC Security Operations Certified (GSOC)

**Soft Skills**

title: TC-CS-IAM-ISAM-Staff
description:

As part of our EY-cyber security team, you shall Engage in Identity & Access Management projects in the capacity of execution of deliverables. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Security Consultant in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with senior members of the team.

As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, including but not limited to security for customer applications using policy driven security, SSO, authentication and authorization, user provisioning/de-provisioning, and federation focusing on multiple protocols (SAML2.0, OpenID, OAuth2.0, WS-FED).
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage and contribute to the Identity & Access Management projects
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating Senior team members on progress

* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures
* Manage the performance management for the direct reportees, as per the organization policies
* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management solutions.
* Strong experience in designing and implementing Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) solutions, including customer registration, profile management, and self-service account capabilities.
* Knowledge of CIAM best practices, including customer lifecycle management, identity federation, consent management, privacy compliance, and secure customer onboarding.
* Hands-on experience on IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access end-to-end implementation involving requirement gathering, designing, implementation, customization and testing.
* Implementation experience in Web Module, Federation Module and Advance Access control module of IBAM/ISVA
* Hands-on experience with IBM ISAM WebSEAL administration, including configuration and management of various junction types, reverse proxy services.
* Experience implementing Single Sign on, Multi Factor Authentication, adaptive authentication, and customer/partner identity solutions using ISAM/ISVA.
* Working experience in application integration with header-based, SAML2.0, OIDC, OAuth2.0, WS-Fed protocols.
* Experience in implementing social login and third-party Identity Provider (IdP) integrations using ISAM/ISVA for secure authentication and federation use cases.
* Ability to design and customize authentication policies, access controls, identity workflows, and customer-facing access experiences.
* Experience in developing and integrating REST APIs, web services, and identity-related connectors to enable seamless customer and application integrations
* Ability to develop and maintain ISAM custom JavaScript mapping rules, API protection policies, and federation configurations.
* Proficiency in Java, JavaScript, and scripting technologies used for IAM customizations and automation.
* Experienced in diagnosing and resolving complex authentication, authorization, and federation issues.
* Experience in supporting platform administration activities, including upgrades, deployments, patching, and environment maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of certificate administration in ISAM, including troubleshooting SSL/TLS, signer, personal, and key database certificate-related issues.
* Understanding of IAM governance, configuration management, operational controls, and industry best practices.
* Willingness to work in a client-focused environment with flexibility to support evolving business and operational requirements.
* Should have knowledge of different integration and architecture in customer’s IAM environment such as Load Balancer, network components
* Understanding of latest technology such as Zero trust framework, Fine-grained authorization, Password less authentication, CIAM
* Ability to develop documentation such as business requirement document, high and low level design document, training and user procedures document.
* Should be flexible to work on new technologies in IAM domain.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 3-4 Years’ Work Experience

**Certification:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications

**What Working At EY Offers**

* Workplace Technology & Site Support:

+ Coordinate with regional and global support teams to ensure smooth handling of issues requiring escalation.

* Device Lifecycle & Logistics:

+ Support deployment, provisioning, refresh, rebuild, recovery, and replacement of endpoint devices.
+ Assist with asset handling activities including receipt, setup, collection, return, and local coordination of hardware movements.
+ Support termination hardware retrieval, end of lease handling, and eWaste / recycling processes in alignment with company standards.
+ Maintain awareness of local inventory, device readiness, and support requirements for site.

* Operational Support & Continuous Improvement:

+ Perform first line diagnosis, troubleshooting, and resolution of onsite IT issues, escalating where needed.
+ Identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities affecting end user experience, support responsiveness or local site readiness.
+ Partner with Service Desk, Infrastructure Teams, and third party providers to help maintain stable service delivery.
+ Contribute to consistent support practices, documentation, and service quality across the local environment.

* Health, Safety & Compliance:

+ Demonstrate commitment to health, safety and compliance requirements applicable to the office or site environment.
+ Follow company processes for security, asset management, access, and technology handling.
+ Complete all required site or office inductions and work in accordance with local HSE expectations.

* Physical Demand/Work Environment:

+ The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to speak or listen. The employee frequently is required to walk and sit. The employee is occasionally required to stand. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Visual Acuity: must be adequate to perform all required Job Description tasks in a safe manner. The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet. Work is usually done in an office setting and sometimes at a client facility or job site.

**About You**
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
  
  

* Required:

+ Experience in deskside, desktop, field, or end user support within a business environment.
+ Strong hands on troubleshooting skills across Windows endpoints, standard business applications, peripherals and user access issues.
+ Experience providing in person support to end users, including onboarding, break/fix, and workplace technology support.
+ Familiarity with IT Service Management tools such as ServiceNow.
+ Ability to work independently with limited supervision and manage multiple priorities.
+ Strong communication skills and a customer focused approach to support delivery.

* Preferred:

+ Experience supporting conference room, meeting room, or collaboration technologies.
+ Experience supporting mobile devices, including iOS and Android.
+ Familiarity with hardware lifecycle processes including provisioning, refresh, returns, and disposal coordination.
+ Experience providing smart hands support for network, service, or infrastructure related onsite activities.
+ Experience working in engineering, industrial, operational, or multi site business environments.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
  
  
And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.
