title: SAP C-ALM
description:
**Position Executive Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Lead SAP Cloud ALM & Enterprise Toolchain Architect**
to define, govern, and operationalize the complete Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) strategy for our global Greenfield SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
  
  
Acting as the single point of accountability for SAP Cloud ALM adoption across all global regions and workstreams, the ideal candidate will establish cross-functional governance, build end-to-end lifecycle traceability, integrate enterprise toolchains, and drive quality engineering across all phases of the SAP Activate framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Core Governance**
  
  

* Cloud ALM Strategy & Governance
* Strategy Definition: Formulate and execute a comprehensive Cloud ALM strategy aligned with SAP Activate methodology across all global rollout templates.
* Governance Framework: Establish and enforce ALM governance standards across requirements gathering, business process hierarchy modeling, testing execution, defect management, deployment controls, and operations.
* Single Accountability: Serve as the central point of contact and accountability for Cloud ALM adoption across global regions, system integrators, and project workstreams.
* Enterprise Toolchain Integration & Traceability
* Toolchain Management: Architect and manage data flows across the integrated ALM toolchain, connecting SAP Cloud ALM with enterprise architecture, modeling, testing, and operational tools.
* End-to-End Lineage: Maintain complete vertical and horizontal traceability across the lifecycle: Business Scope → Process Design → Requirements/User Stories → Development Units → Test Cases → Defects → Transports/Deployments.
* Integration Engineering: Design and implement robust integration and real-time data synchronization between SAP Cloud ALM and enterprise solutions, including:

+ Process Modeling: Signavio
+ Architecture & Capability Mapping: LeanIX
+ Work Management & ITSM: Jira / ServiceNow
+ Test Management: Tricentis, HP ALM, or equivalent
+ Documentation Systems: Confluence, SharePoint

* Solution Enablement & Fit-to-Standard Execution
* Cloud ALM Configuration: Setup and configure SAP Cloud ALM for:

+ Business process hierarchy structure and solution documentation
+ Requirement, scope, and user story management
+ Test planning, script execution, and defect tracking
+ Task management and deployment tracking

* Fit-to-Standard Governance: Enable and support Fit-to-Standard workshops using standard SAP Best Practices content and Cloud ALM pre-delivered scope elements.
* Program Visibility: Design and maintain project scope baselines, milestone tracking, and real-time status dashboards for executive program leadership.
* Test Quality Management
* Test Strategy Formulation: Design and govern the program-wide testing framework (Unit Testing, System Integration Testing [SIT], User Acceptance Testing [UAT], and Regression Testing) inside SAP Cloud ALM.
* Multi-Regional Execution: Coordinate test execution across multi-regional teams, third-party system integrators, and varying time zones.
* Quality KPIs: Provide executive-level reporting on test coverage, defect burn-down rates, quality KPIs, and release readiness dashboards.
* Release, Deployment & Cutover Management
* Release Orchestration: Oversee release planning, deployment tracking, and release governance using Cloud ALM.
* CI/CD & Transport Integration: Connect Cloud ALM with SAP Transport Management and modern CI/CD delivery pipelines where applicable.
* Cutover Execution: Support cutover sequence planning, dependency mapping, and real-time deployment monitoring.
* Integration & Operations Readiness (Run / Hypercare Phase)
* Monitoring Setup: Configure operational monitoring within Cloud ALM, including:

+ Integration & Exception Monitoring
+ Business Process Monitoring
+ Automated Job Monitoring

* Operational Transition: Lead the transition of ALM artifacts from the project phase to Hypercare and steady-state operations (Run phase).
* Alerting & KPIs: Establish operational KPIs, threshold alerts, and health monitoring for steady-state governance.
* Stakeholder Leadership & Vendor Coaching
* Subject Matter Expert (SME): Act as the lead SME for the Program Management Office (PMO), System Integrator partners, SAP, and regional business leaders.
* Enablement & Upskilling: Coach and upskill project team members, functional leads, and regional business units on Cloud ALM best practices and standardized tool usage.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
SAP ALM & Program Expertise
  
  

* 7–10+ years of hands-on SAP implementation experience within large-scale enterprise environments.
* 3+ years direct experience configuring and leading SAP Cloud ALM (or SAP Solution Manager with a proven track record of Cloud ALM transition).
* Strong, practical knowledge of SAP Activate methodology across all project phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
* Proven experience in Greenfield SAP S/4HANA global implementations.

Functional & Technical Knowledge
  
  

* Solid comprehension of core SAP S/4HANA business processes (e.g., Finance, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Logistics).
* Hands-on familiarity with SAP Best Practices content and enterprise process models.
* Working knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g., Tricentis, CBTA).
* Familiarity with SAP integration technologies (SAP BTP, Cloud Integration / CPI) and SAP transport management concepts.

Leadership & Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven track record in stakeholder management within complex, multi-vendor, global environments.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across global teams, time zones, and diverse organizational cultures.
* Highly organized, structured, quality-focused, and proactive mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications (nice To Have)**

* Official SAP Cloud ALM Certification.
* Prior experience in large-scale rollouts (multi-country, multi-template architectures).
* Exposure to modern DevOps principles and CI/CD pipelines within SAP enterprise landscapes.
* Prior experience in roles such as Enterprise ALM Lead, QA Lead, or Test Manager.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The OT Cybersecurity Executive will be responsible for supporting and implementing cybersecurity measures to safeguard the organization's Operational Technology (OT) environments. This includes ensuring the security of industrial control systems (ICS), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, and other OT assets that manage critical infrastructure. The role will focus on identifying vulnerabilities, responding to incidents, implementing best practices, and ensuring the security of OT systems against evolving cyber threats.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**OT Cybersecurity Executive**
**Operational Technology (OT) Security**
Implement and maintain cybersecurity measures to protect OT systems, including industrial control systems (ICS) and SCADA networks.
  
  
Perform regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing on OT systems to identify security weaknesses and recommend improvements.
  
  
Monitor OT networks and systems for signs of security breaches or anomalies, ensuring timely identification and mitigation of threats.
  
  
Collaborate with OT engineering teams to ensure secure integration of OT systems with IT infrastructure while preserving operational continuity.
  
  
**Incident Response And Management**
Respond to OT cybersecurity incidents, coordinating efforts to mitigate, resolve, and document security breaches or disruptions in OT systems.
  
  
Investigate and perform root-cause analysis for OT-related cybersecurity incidents, ensuring quick recovery and restoration of services.
  
  
Develop and implement incident response protocols specifically tailored to OT environments, including communication plans, reporting mechanisms, and escalation procedures.
  
  
**Collaboration With IT And OT Teams**
Work closely with IT cybersecurity teams to ensure coordination between IT and OT environments and mitigate the risk of cross-domain security breaches.
  
  
Collaborate with OT engineers, operations teams, and vendors to implement security controls that do not interfere with the operation of critical systems.
  
  
Promote awareness of cybersecurity best practices and provide guidance on securing OT systems.
  
  
**Vulnerability Management**
Monitor and assess the security vulnerabilities of OT systems and coordinate patching, remediation, and mitigation efforts in line with operational needs.
  
  
Conduct risk-based prioritization of vulnerabilities within OT systems, considering the potential impact on operational continuity and safety.
  
  
**Security Monitoring And Threat Intelligence**
Continuously monitor OT systems and networks for any unusual activities, security breaches, or threats using appropriate tools and techniques.
  
  
Leverage threat intelligence platforms to stay informed about the latest cyber threats targeting OT environments and recommend proactive defense measures.
  
  
Perform regular updates to OT security monitoring systems and tools to detect emerging threats.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
OT Cybersecurity Manager / Head of Cybersecurity
  
  
IT and Network Operations Teams
  
  
Engineering & Development Teams
  
  
Human Resources (HR)
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
OT equipment and software vendors
  
  
Third-party cybersecurity service providers
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  
  
Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA) in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a relevant discipline is highly desirable.
  
  
**Certification**
Relevant certifications such Global Industrial Cyber Security Practical experience with securing industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA systems, and other OT assets and with OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443, NERC CIP).
  
  
Knowledge of OT network protocols and systems, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and others commonly used in industrial environments and with security tools and technologies used in OT environments (e.g., intrusion detection systems, firewalls, SIEM).
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
3+ years of overall experience , with at least 1 year focused on OT or industrial control systems security.

We are looking for an experienced Senior System Administrator to manage, secure, maintain, and optimize the organization's IT infrastructure, servers, cloud environments, networks, Microsoft 365 services, and cybersecurity systems.

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Windows and Linux server administration, cloud infrastructure, Microsoft 365 administration, email security, network security, backup and disaster recovery, malware and ransomware prevention, monitoring, and incident management.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, confidentiality, and integrity of company systems and data while protecting corporate email accounts and infrastructure from phishing, unauthorized access, malware, ransomware, and other cyber threats.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Server and System Administration**

* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows Server and Linux environments.
* Manage Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file servers, user accounts, and access permissions.
* Monitor server performance, availability, CPU, memory, disk utilization, and system capacity.
* Perform operating system upgrades, security patching, updates, and routine maintenance.
* Troubleshoot complex server, operating system, software, and infrastructure issues.
* Maintain production and internal IT systems to meet agreed uptime and performance requirements.
* Manage user onboarding, offboarding, access provisioning, and permission revocation.

**B. Cloud and Infrastructure Management**

* Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Configure and maintain virtual machines, storage, cloud networking, security groups, IAM, and access policies.
* Manage virtualization platforms such as VMware and Microsoft Hyper-V.
* Monitor cloud resource utilization, availability, performance, and infrastructure costs.
* Implement infrastructure monitoring, alerting, automation, and capacity planning.

* Configure anti-phishing, anti-spam, anti-malware, malicious URL, and attachment protection policies.
* Monitor suspicious sign-ins, unusual login locations, repeated authentication failures, mailbox rule changes, and unauthorized email forwarding.
* Prevent and investigate Business Email Compromise (BEC), phishing, credential theft, and unauthorized email account access.

* Establish secure email account onboarding, offboarding, password reset, and access revocation procedures.
* Ensure appropriate retention, audit logging, and recovery settings are configured for corporate email services.

**D. Cybersecurity, Malware and Ransomware Prevention**

* Implement security controls to protect company systems against malware, ransomware, viruses, spyware, trojans, and other cyber threats.

* Monitor security alerts and investigate suspicious processes, malicious scripts, unauthorized software, and abnormal system behavior.
* Implement OS and application hardening, firewall rules, secure configurations, and endpoint security policies.
* Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation of identified security weaknesses.
* Protect servers, laptops, employee workstations, cloud infrastructure, and corporate networks against unauthorized access and exploitation.
* Monitor and investigate suspicious network traffic, brute-force attempts, unauthorized access, and other indicators of compromise.
* Implement controls to reduce risks associated with malicious attachments, harmful links, compromised credentials, and social engineering.
* Maintain secure backups, including immutable or offline copies where appropriate, to minimize the impact of ransomware.
* Perform root cause analysis after security incidents and implement preventive measures to avoid recurrence.

**E. Network and Access Security**

* Manage LAN, WAN, VPN, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, and network connectivity.
* Configure and maintain firewalls, network access controls, and secure remote access.
* Monitor network availability, traffic, suspicious connections, and potential security incidents.
* Implement secure administrator access, privileged account management, and least-privilege permissions.
* Review user accounts, administrative privileges, service accounts, and third-party access periodically.
* Secure Wi-Fi, remote access, and employee devices according to company security policies.
* Support network segmentation and restrict unnecessary access to critical servers and business systems.

**F. Security Monitoring and Incident Response**

* Monitor infrastructure and security alerts through available monitoring and security platforms.
* Investigate compromised email accounts, suspicious logins, malicious mailbox rules, and unauthorized forwarding configurations.
* Respond promptly to suspected cyber incidents by disabling or restricting compromised accounts, revoking active sessions and tokens, and resetting credentials as appropriate.

* Develop, document, and periodically test security incident response procedures.

* Monitor backup jobs and resolve failures promptly.
* Maintain disaster recovery and business continuity plans.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS Consulting – SAP Cloud ALM:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a skilled SAP CALM Consultant to implement, configure, and manage SAP Cloud ALM for Application Lifecycle Management across SAP S/4HANA and other cloud landscapes. The ideal candidate will drive implementation like project management, change and deployment, test management, other testing tools , operations like monitoring, business process operations, integration monitoring, and ensure efficient DevOps practices using SAP Cloud ALM.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4–7 years of experience in configuring and managing SAP Solution Manager.
* Extensive experience in configuring SAP Solution Manager functionalities, including CHARM, Focused Build, Solution Documentation, BPMON, Test Management, Template Management, and Best Practice Content.
* Proficient in configuring SAP Cloud ALM for Requirement Management, Change and Deployment Management, Process Management, Project Management, Documentation Management, Task Management, Test Management, and Analytics.
* Strong ability to design and configure SAP Solution Manager 7.2 and SAP Cloud ALM to support the implementation of SAP S/4HANA ERP solutions.
* Collaborate with functional, technical, and governance teams to optimize SAP Solution Manager and SAP Cloud ALM functionality.
* Utilize deep product knowledge to identify and communicate how IT solutions enhance operational efficiency.
* Lead SAP Solution Manager (SolMan) and SAP Cloud ALM initiatives, including developing and executing a strategic roadmap, driving new functionalities, and managing upgrades.
* Partner with governance, functional, and technical teams to improve and execute SolMan offerings effectively.
* Act as the product owner for Solution Manager and SAP Cloud ALM managing sprints, backlogs, and product priorities.
* Serve as the subject matter expert for operational execution, troubleshooting, and support, including leading and participating in projects, minor/major releases, and reviewing system-related tickets for accuracy and priority.
* Analyze, design, customize, and manage SAP Solution Manager and SAP Cloud ALM implementations, covering both technical usage and solution implementation. Strong working experience with RISE with SAP environments and operational activities.
* Strong documentation skills for system delivery, ensuring clear, structured, and audit‑ready technical documentation.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Experience in deploying Focused Build for S/4HANA implementation.
* Good knowledge of Focused Run, Focused Insights, and SAP Basis.
* Exposure to SAP Solution Manager / Focused Run is beneficial
* Valuable knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices
* Flexibility to handle SAP Basis activities as needed.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with clients and stakeholders.
* Good to have SAP Cloud ALM Certification and SAP BTP Certification

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Oracle Projects and Grants Functional Consultant
description:
**Overview**
We are looking for a skilled and motivated Oracle Cloud Projects and Grants Consultant to join our
  
  
team. This role involves managing and optimizing our Oracle Cloud Projects and Grants module. You
  
  
will work closely with various stakeholders to ensure successful implementation, configuration, and
  
  
ongoing maintenance of the system. Your key objective will be to streamline processes, improve
  
  
efficiency, and maximize resource utilization within project and grant management.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
 Implement and configure the Oracle Cloud Projects and Grants module in alignment with
  
  
organizational goals.
  
  
 Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and translate business requirements into
  
  
functional specifications for system customization and development.
  
  
 Develop and manage project plans, timelines, and budgets using the Oracle Cloud Projects
  
  
and Grants system.
  
  
 Design and implement workflows, approval processes, and reporting structures to enhance
  
  
project and grant management.
  
  
 Provide training and support to users for effective system utilization.
  
  
 Work with IT teams to troubleshoot and resolve system issues, ensuring minimal disruption
  
  
to operations.
  
  
 Perform regular system maintenance, including updates, patches, and upgrades, to
  
  
maintain reliability and security.
  
  
 Monitor system performance and analyze data to identify opportunities for improvement
  
  
and optimization.
  
  
 Stay updated on industry best practices and Oracle Cloud Projects and Grants
  
  
developments, recommending enhancements and upgrades as necessary.
  
  
 Serve as a subject matter expert on Oracle Cloud Projects and Grants, offering guidance
  
  
and expertise to internal teams and stakeholders.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
 Bachelor’s degree in Information technology, Computer Science, Business Administration,
  
  
or a related field. A master’s degree is preferred.
  
  
 At least 3 years of experience in implementing and managing the Oracle Cloud Projects and
  
  
Grants module.
  
  
 Strong understanding of project and grant management processes and best practices.
  
  
 Proficiency in Oracle Cloud Applications, particularly the Oracle Cloud Projects and Grants
  
  
module.
  
  
 Experience with system configuration, customization, and integration with other modules
  
  
and third-party applications.
  
  
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to convert business
  
  
requirements into technical solutions.
  
  
 Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively
  
  
with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  
  
 Experience in training end-users and providing ongoing support.
  
  
**Preferred Certification**
 Oracle certifications in relevant module
  
  
Skills: cloud,project,oracle

title: Specialist - Cloud Engineering
description:
**Role description**

**Job Title:** Specialist - Cloud Engineering

**Location:** Navi Mumbai

**Experience:** 5-7 years

**About the Role:** LTM is seeking a Specialist - Cloud Engineering to lead digital workplace and end-user services strategy, driving scalable hybrid cloud solutions, endpoint collaboration, and virtual workspaces to elevate enterprise productivity and operational excellence.

**Role and Responsibilities (What You'll Do):**

* Define the digital workplace vision, service portfolio, reference architecture, roadmap, standards, and experience-led operating model across enterprise environments.
* Architect endpoint management strategies for Windows, macOS, mobile, rugged devices, kiosks, and shared devices using on-premises and cloud-native management platforms.
* Design and govern Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity services, including collaboration, email, meeting rooms, telephony integration, file sharing, and user adoption.
* Lead modern management initiatives including Autopilot or equivalent provisioning, application packaging, software distribution, patching, compliance, endpoint analytics, and device lifecycle.
* Design VDI/DaaS and application virtualization across on-premises platforms and cloud services, addressing profile identity, image management, capacity, and resilience patterns.
* Embed zero trust, conditional access, encryption, DLP, endpoint detection, least privilege, secure browser, and compliance controls in collaboration with security teams.
* Manage OEMs, software vendors, managed service providers, licensing contracts, adoption financials, and service-level outcomes to optimize enterprise value.

**Qualifications (What You'll Bring):**

**Must-Have:**

* Demonstrated proficiency in endpoint management tools including Citrix XenApp-Xendesktop, UEM software distribution, patching, configuration, device compliance, and lifecycle management.
* Comprehensive expertise in Microsoft 365 Suites of Products, covering email, meetings, collaboration, file sharing, and adoption methodologies.
* Hands-on experience in virtual workspace architectures including VDI, DaaS, application virtualization, user profiles, image management, capacity planning, and user experience optimization.
* Proven knowledge of identity security frameworks such as Active Directory, cloud identity, MFA, conditional access, EDR, encryption, DLP, and privileged endpoint controls.
* Strong background in leadership, enterprise strategy, architecture, governance, transformation programs, vendor management, and executive communication.

**Preferred:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, complemented by relevant practical experience in complex enterprise environments.
* Industry certifications such as Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator or Architect, Azure Virtual Desktop or equivalent VDI certification, ITIL Foundation, or Security/Identity credentials.
* Strong domain expertise in digital workplace services, coupled with exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, presentation, and stakeholder-management capabilities.

**Why Join Us? (Company, Culture & Benefits):** LTM is an AI-centric global technology services company and the Business Creativity partner to the world’s largest and most disruptive enterprises. We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive health benefits, professional development opportunities, and flexible working arrangements.

**Our Commitment to You (Inclusivity & Process):** We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on merit. Please ensure you have the legal right to work in this specific location before applying. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

**Join Our Journey:** We are LTM, and our future is built by you. Bring your unique talent to a team that champions growth, innovation, and belonging. Apply now to start your journey.

 **Skills**

**Mandatory Skills :** Citrix Xenapp-Xendesktop, M365 Suites of Products

 **About LTM**  
LTM is an AI-centric global technology services company and the Business Creativity partner to the world’s largest and most disruptive enterprises. We bring human insights and intelligent systems together to help clients create greater value at the intersection of technology and domain expertise. Our capabilities span integrated operations, transformation, and business AI — enabling new ways of working, new productivity paradigms, and new roads to value. Together with over 87,000 employees across 40 countries and our global network of partners, LTM — a Larsen & Toubro company — owns business outcomes for our clients, helping them not just outperform the market, but to Outcreate it. Please also note that neither LTM nor any of its authorized recruitment agencies/partners charge any candidate registration fee or any other fees from talent (candidates) towards appearing for an interview or securing employment/internship. Candidates shall be solely responsible for verifying the credentials of any agency/consultant that claims to be working with LTM for recruitment. Please note that anyone who relies on the representations made by fraudulent employment agencies does so at their own risk, and LTM disclaims any liability in case of loss or damage suffered as a consequence of the same. title: Lead Infosec
description:
**About the Role**

Support client audit and security RFP requests, identify and automate manual GRC processes, build and maintain scripts and integrations between GRC platforms and other systems, and collaborate with teams to improve security and compliance automation while staying current on GRC automation tools and practices.

**Responsibilities**

* Support client audit and security RFP requests.
* Identify manual, repetitive GRC processes (security RFP response, evidence collection, control testing, risk scoring, reporting) and design automated workflows to replace them.
* Build and maintain scripts, workflows, and integrations that connect GRC platforms (e.g., Onspring, Archer, ServiceNow) with other security and IT systems.
* Automate evidence gathering and continuous control monitoring to support audits and reduce time spent on manual data pulls.
* Partner with GRC analysts and process owners to translate manual assessment and compliance processes into automated, repeatable workflows.
* Collaborate with other customer teams to identify opportunities for process improvement and automation across the security and compliance function.
* Stay current on GRC automation tools, low-code/no-code platforms, and scripting practices to continuously improve team efficiency.

title: GMS - Senior - Okta
description:

**Global Managed Service – Identity and access Management – Senior**
The Okta Provisioning Senior Consultant is a critical role responsible for overseeing and ensuring the effective management of user identities and access permissions within an organization using the Okta Identity Management platform. This senior-level position involves leading provisioning processes, developing strategies for integration and automation, and ensuring compliance with security policies and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**

* Lead the administration and management of user accounts, roles, and access rights within the Okta platform.
* Design and implement efficient user provisioning and de-provisioning workflows in collaboration with HR, IT, and security teams.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Okta authentication, authorization, SSO, and MFA solutions.
* Oversee the integration of new applications with Okta and ensure seamless SSO experiences across the organization.
* Develop and maintain IAM policies, procedures, and documentation, ensuring they are up-to-date and compliant with industry standards.
* Conduct regular access reviews and audits to identify and mitigate potential security risks.
* Provide advanced technical support and training to end-users and junior analysts regarding Okta functionalities and access management best practices.
* Drive identity governance initiatives and enhance role-based access control (RBAC) models.
* Recommend and implement improvements to IAM processes and the overall Okta environment.
* Stay informed about Okta updates, new features, and IAM industry trends to drive innovation within the organization.
* Develop and maintain documentation for processes, workflows, and configurations.
* Ensure compliance with security policies, standards, and IAM best practices.
* Provide ongoing support and guidance to end-users and stakeholders regarding identity management processes.
* Monitor and report on system performance, usage, and security issues.

**Preferred Skills**
:
  
  

* 3-5 years of experience in identity and access management, with a strong focus on Okta or similar IAM platforms.
* In-depth knowledge of IAM principles, SSO, MFA, directory services, and cloud identity management.
* Proven track record of managing complex user provisioning and de-provisioning scenarios.
* Familiarity with IT security standards and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR).
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills.
* Strong leadership abilities and experience mentoring junior staff.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with various stakeholders.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Okta Certified Administrator, Okta Certified Consultant, Okta Certified Professional) are highly desirable

**Education**
:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

**Work Requirements**
:
  
  

* Willingness to travel as required
* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required
* Willingness to work in shifts as required

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

title: Senior Database Engineer
description:
**About Us**

**Advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.**

Nokia is a global leader in connectivity for the AI era. With expertise across fixed, mobile and transport networks, powered by the innovation of Nokia Bell Labs, we’re advancing connectivity to secure a brighter world.

Learn more about life at Nokia.

**Description:**

Senior Database Performance & Benchmark Engineer, the responsible for designing and executing rigorous testing strategies across a complex hybrid environment consisting of large-scale on-premises SQL Server instances and public cloud managed database services. You will act as the bridge between infrastructure engineering, database administration, and application development to ensure our systems are resilient, highly scalable, and optimized for peak

production workloads.

**Your responsibilities**

* Hybrid Benchmarking & Load Testing: Design, script, and execute comprehensive load, stress, and endurance tests utilizing synthetic tools (e.g., HammerDB, OStress, Apache JMeter) and production replay tools (e.g., WorkloadTools, DEA).
* Performance Telemetry & Monitoring: Establish performance baselines and build continuous monitoring dashboards utilizing OS-level metrics (PerfMon/Linux Sysstat) and SQL Server Dynamic Management Views (DMVs).
* Cloud Migration & Scaling Validation: Benchmark on-premises workloads and simulate equivalent performance in public cloud environments (such as AWS RDS/EC2, Azure SQL, or GCP Cloud SQL) to accurately size cloud infrastructure and control costs.
* Bottleneck Isolation & Optimization: Analyze execution plans, identify plan regressions, and isolate resource contention bottlenecks (CPU, Memory, Disk I/O, TempDB, and network latency).
* Concurrency & Lock Management: Diagnose and resolve complex locking, blocking, and deadlock scenarios discovered during high-concurrency simulation cycles.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Performance QA, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Application teams to establish quality gates and provide actionable code/indexing optimization recommendations.

**Your skills and experience**

**Must-Have:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent with 7+ years of experience in dedicated database administration (DBA), database engineering, or specialized database performance testing experience.
* Hybrid Environment Mastery: Proven track record managing or benchmarking both traditional on-premises enterprise hardware and public cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Deep SQL Server Internals: Expert-level knowledge of SQL Server query optimization, execution plan analysis, Query Store, Extended Events (XEvents), and system DMVs and Extensive experience setting up and operating database benchmarking suites such as HammerDB, SQLQueryStress, OStress, or similar automated simulation frameworks.
* Solid understanding of underlying storage configurations (SAN, NVMe, Cloud IOPS allocations), virtualization layers, and network latency mechanics in hybrid setups and Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in PowerShell, T-SQL, or Python to automate test deployments, data generation, and telemetry collection.
* Experience with cloud native infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform) to spin up and tear down transient performance testing sandboxes and Experience with production workload masking and synchronization methodologies to generate high-fidelity, non-sensitive testing datasets.

**Nice-To-Have:**

* Relevant certifications such as Azure Database Administrator Associate or historical Microsoft SQL Server certifications.

**About RTX**
At RTX, 185,000 people come together with a shared purpose—to solve the world's most complex challenges and make a meaningful difference.With three industry-leading businesses, world-class operations, and significant investments in research and development, RTX brings together technology, innovation, and expertise to push the boundaries of what is possible.Together, we develop technologies that help connect and protect our world and shape the future of aerospace and defense.
  
  
**About Collins Aerospace**
Collins Aerospace, an RTX company, is a global leader in technologically advanced and intelligent aerospace and defense solutions.
  
  
With deep technical expertise and a comprehensive portfolio of products and services, Collins Aerospace helps customers address some of the most demanding challenges in the global aerospace industry.
  
  
Join us and be part of a team that is redefining aerospace through technology, innovation, and engineering excellence.
  
  
**Job Overview**
The SAP Basis Administrator will play a critical role in ensuring the performance, availability, security, and reliability of enterprise-critical SAP systems across a global environment. This role supports key business functions, including finance, order management, inventory, procurement, shipping, and engineering.
  
  
You will collaborate with global SAP, infrastructure, network, security, and business teams to maintain a stable SAP landscape, drive continuous improvement, identify automation opportunities, and support strategic technology initiatives. The role offers opportunities to make independent technical decisions and contribute to the evolution of the company’s SAP infrastructure and digital strategy.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* SAP Landscape Management: Execute SAP infrastructure and architecture roadmaps, ensuring system stability, availability, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* System Administration: Install, configure, patch, maintain, and refresh SAP applications and database systems.
* Performance Optimization: Monitor system performance, analyze resource utilization, perform tuning and capacity management, and proactively identify potential issues.
* Incident and Service Management: Handle service management tickets, troubleshoot system issues, perform health checks, and support break/fix activities.
* Infrastructure Collaboration: Partner with data center, network, storage, security, and database teams to deliver reliable and secure SAP solutions.
* High Availability and Disaster Recovery: Support SAP infrastructure design and initiatives involving high availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Automation and Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate routine activities, improve operational efficiency, and enhance existing processes.
* Documentation: Develop and maintain technical specifications, system architecture diagrams, design documents, requirements, and test scripts.
* Business-Critical Support: Support SAP Digital Technology (DT) teams during critical system outages, planned maintenance, and operational activities.
* Global Support: Participate in on-call rotations, work in US hours as required, and provide weekend support when necessary.

**What You Will Learn**

* Gain exposure to a large, global SAP landscape supporting critical enterprise business functions.
* Develop deeper expertise in SAP infrastructure architecture, system performance, and landscape management.
* Understand high-availability solutions, disaster recovery strategies, and enterprise infrastructure standards.
* Explore automation opportunities and continuous improvement initiatives across SAP operations.
* Collaborate with global technical teams and business stakeholders on strategic SAP initiatives.
* Contribute to SAP modernization and digital transformation initiatives.

**Qualifications You Must Have**

* 9+ years of experience working in an SAP Basis administration role.
* Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, including networking, servers, storage, databases, and application architecture.
* Hands-on experience administering SAP ECC, BW, PI, Solution Manager, and SAP HANA systems.
* Knowledge of system architecture, performance monitoring, tuning, and capacity management methodologies and tools.
* Experience in scripting using Bash, Python, or similar scripting languages.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at different organizational levels, including leadership.
* Ability to work in a global support environment, including US working hours, on-call rotations, and occasional weekend support.

**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience working in a large, complex, global SAP environment.
* Knowledge of SAP technologies, architecture, interfaces, and batch processing.
* Experience with Oracle databases, SAP HANA, Linux, and cloud environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL frameworks and/or Lean methodologies.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA, CRM, SNC, SLT, Hybris, and SAP Web Dispatcher.
* Knowledge of web technologies, firewalls, proxy servers, and Single Sign-On (SSO) frameworks.
* Experience supporting SAP system upgrades, migrations, integrations, and infrastructure improvements.
* Ability to lead technical initiatives, manage projects, and drive process improvements within a technical domain.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree: Typically requires a bachelor’s degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics (STEM), or a related field, along with relevant experience.
* Advanced degree: A master’s or other advanced degree in a related field may be considered with the applicable level of relevant experience.
* Experience in lieu of education: Candidates without a degree may qualify with equivalent relevant professional experience, subject to company policy and applicable requirements.

**Digital Technology**
Do you want to be part of a new, exciting initiative to combine foundational IT with new digital technologies?  Our Digital Technology team is driving business efficiencies and a better customer experience by connecting technologies, people, information and processes. From making aircraft more electric, intelligent and integrated to building new software platforms such as Internet of Things, big data, artificial intelligence, and blockchain, there’s no better place to be right now than in digital. If you’re an agile thinker who enjoys utilizing modern technology to make big improvements, then you’re a perfect fit for this team. Join Collins Aerospace to help us revolutionize the aerospace industry today!
  
  
WE ARE REDEFINING AEROSPACE.
  
  

* Please consider the following role type definitions as you apply for this role.

Onsite: Employees who are working in Onsite roles will work primarily onsite. This includes all production and maintenance employees, as they are essential to the development of our products.
  
  
Hybrid: Employees who are working in Hybrid roles will work regularly both onsite and offsite. Ratio of time working onsite will be determined in partnership with your leader.

title: Denoda Administrator
description:
Hiring location:
**Bangalore / Hyderabad**

Experience:
**8 years**

Role Name:
**Dendo Administrator**

**Key Job Responsibilities**

**1. Denodo Platform Administration**

* Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain the Denodo Data Virtualization platform.
* Manage Denodo servers, environments, clusters, and platform availability.
* Monitor system health, performance, and capacity utilization.

**2. Platform Support & Operations**

* Provide L2/L3 production support for Denodo environments.
* Troubleshoot performance issues, query bottlenecks, connectivity failures, and platform incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement preventive measures.

**3. Security & Governance**

* Configure authentication and authorization mechanisms (LDAP, Active Directory, SSO, Kerberos).
* Manage user roles, permissions, and data access controls.
* Ensure compliance with banking security standards and audit requirements.

**4. Performance Optimization**

* Tune virtual views, caches, and query execution plans.
* Optimize data federation and virtualization performance.
* Implement caching strategies to improve response times.

**5. Environment Management**

* Support Development, QA, UAT, and Production environments.
* Handle deployments, migrations, and release activities.
* Maintain backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures.

**6. Data Source Integration**

* Configure and manage connectivity to databases, data warehouses, cloud platforms, APIs, and files.
* Support integration with Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Snowflake, Hadoop, AWS, Azure, and other enterprise systems.

**7. Automation & DevOps**

title: Engineering Manager (Data Platform)
description:
Swiggy is India’s leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 700+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, and a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Profile: Engineering Manager (Data Platform)**
**Location:**
Bangalore | Karnataka
  
  
**Years of Experience:**
8–10
  
  
**About The Team**
Swiggy's Data Platform organization sits at the intersection of streaming infrastructure, data warehousing, lakehouse architecture, and data governance. The team owns the foundational systems that power real-time and batch data movement across the company — spanning ingestion pipelines, CDC connectors, orchestration, storage, and access control — enabling every downstream team, from analytics to ML to product engineering, to work with trusted, timely, and well-governed data.
  
  
The team is expected to go beyond keeping pipelines running and build durable platform capabilities into how data is ingested, processed, stored, secured, and consumed at scale — across systems like Kafka, Databricks, Snowflake, and AWS. This includes driving reliability and performance in streaming and batch workloads, enforcing fine-grained access control and data protection standards, and ensuring the platform scales cost-effectively as data volumes and use cases grow across the business.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Data Platform Manager, you will lead a team responsible for building and scaling Swiggy's core data infrastructure — spanning streaming pipelines, CDC connectors, lakehouse storage, access control, and cost observability across Kafka, Databricks, Snowflake, and AWS. This is not a generic data engineering role. It requires a leader who can combine deep systems expertise, architectural judgment, and strong execution to turn recurring reliability, scale, and governance challenges into durable platform capabilities.
  
  
You will operate across multiple modes: driving day-to-day pipeline reliability and incident response, improving the performance and cost-efficiency of streaming and batch workloads, shaping access control and data protection standards across the org, and building automation that prevents classes of data quality, schema, and scaling issues from recurring in production.
  
  
**What You Will Work On**

* Driving streaming and batch data platform reliability, including pipeline health, schema compatibility enforcement, and stronger production-readiness gates for critical data flows.
* Improving CDC and connector management by moving from manual debugging toward automated monitoring, alerting, and self-healing for Kafka-to-Snowflake and other sink/source connectors.
* Strengthening data access governance across Unity Catalog, including row-level security, attribute-based access control, and secure data-sharing patterns for sensitive datasets.
* Building better platform tooling and observability frameworks for cost visibility, capacity planning, and infrastructure/pipeline health with low operational overhead.
* Leading incident and escalation response for P0/P1 data platform issues, including war-room coordination, stakeholder communication, and closure discipline.
* Improving the quality of internal data quality validation so downstream analytics and ML issues are caught at the platform layer, not discovered by consuming teams.
* Partnering with platform, data engineering, and product teams on standards across ingestion, streaming architecture (Spark Structured Streaming, Kafka), warehousing (Snowflake, Databricks), and secure data delivery workflows.
* Managing and mentoring data platform engineers, setting operating rhythm, and ensuring the team scales through clarity, ownership, and repeatable execution.
* Own the execution and evolution of Swiggy's data streaming, warehousing, and platform governance programs.
* Build a high-trust operating model for pipeline reliability, incident response, escalations, and stakeholder communication.
* Ensure critical data issues are tracked with clear severity, explicit affected scope, accountable owners, and closure criteria.
* Drive platform reliability into the data lifecycle through automation such as schema validation, connector health checks, cost monitoring, and reusable detection workflows.
* Define secure and scalable patterns for data handling, especially where customer PII, cross-system CDC, or sensitive datasets are involved.
* Partner with engineering leaders to prioritize high-impact gaps and convert ad hoc fixes into platform capabilities and team-wide standards.
* Lead vendor/tool evaluations pragmatically, with clear success criteria around reliability, operational effort, performance impact, and cost.
* Manage, mentor, and grow a data platform engineering team with strong standards for ownership, technical quality, and execution excellence.

**Qualifications**
**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong hands-on depth in streaming infrastructure, data warehousing/lakehouse architecture, and platform-level system design.
* Good judgment on schema management, CDC/connector reliability, access control, data protection, and cost-performance trade-offs.
* Experience leading data platform engineers and operating across incident response, stakeholder management, and cross-functional execution.
* Ability to distinguish between a one-off fix and a durable platform capability that prevents repeat issues.
* Comfort working closely with data engineering, infrastructure, analytics/ML, and product engineering teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication, especially during escalations, reviews, and platform program discussions.
* Practical orientation toward automation, observability, and measurable reliability/cost improvements rather than checklist-driven operations.
* Experience with Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming, or large-scale CDC pipeline design and operations.
* Experience integrating platform reliability controls into CI/CD, schema registries, connector governance, or data tooling.
* Familiarity with cloud/infrastructure cost management, Unity Catalog access control, or data observability tooling.
* Experience operating in high-scale product and platform environments with multiple engineering teams and fast release cycles.

**Additional Information**
**Why This Role Matters**
Swiggy needs data platform leadership that can move the organization from fragmented pipelines and reactive firefighting toward proactive, embedded, and automatable platform controls. The role matters because the recurring problems are no longer just about fixing individual pipeline breaks; they are about preventing schema and connector issues from cascading downstream, reducing time-to-response on critical data incidents, protecting sensitive customer data, and creating platform systems that scale cost-effectively with engineering and business velocity.
  
  
If you want a leader who can combine data platform engineering depth, team leadership, systems thinking and execution rigor, this role should be framed exactly around that charter.
  
  
**Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes**

The Oracle Database Administrator seeks out and recognizes opportunities for process improvement, re-engineering, and automation, and employs practices intended to improve customer satisfaction and reduce costs. The Oracle Database Administrator is expected to consistently leverage their significant expertise and skillset by routinely providing guidance and mentorship to peers during informal knowledge transfer opportunities and formalized training, and acts as a point of escalation for needs within and outside of conventional business hours. **Qualifications**

title: Application Support Engineer
description:
**Project Role :**
Application Support Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Act as software detectives, provide a dynamic service identifying and solving issues within multiple components of critical business systems.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Microsoft SQL Server Administration
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 2 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Summary:
  
  
As an Application Support Engineer, a typical day involves acting as a software detective by actively monitoring and investigating issues across various critical business systems. This role requires a dynamic approach to identifying problems, analyzing system components, and ensuring smooth operation by promptly addressing disruptions. The position demands continuous vigilance and collaboration with different teams to maintain system reliability and support business continuity effectively.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure timely resolution of system issues and minimize downtime.
* Document troubleshooting steps and solutions to build a knowledge base for future reference.
* Assist junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on complex issues.

Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft SQL Server Administration.
* Experience in managing database performance, tuning, and optimization.
* Strong understanding of backup and recovery techniques for database systems.
* Ability to monitor and troubleshoot database connectivity and security issues.
* Familiarity with scripting and automation to streamline routine database tasks.

Additional Information:
  
  

* The candidate should have minimum 2 years of experience in Microsoft SQL Server Administration.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Senior IT Analyst Applications (SAP Basis Administrator)
description:
****Career Area:****
Technology, Digital and Data
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
****Job Purpose**
:**
Your Work Shapes the World. Whether it be groundbreaking products, best in class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do the work that matters at Caterpillar. With a 95-year legacy of quality and innovation and 150 locations in countries around the world, your impact spans the globe.
  
  
When you join Caterpillar, you are joining a team of makers, innovators, and doers. We are the people who roll up our sleeves and do the work to build a better world. We don’t just talk about progress and innovation. We make it happen. And we are proud of that because it helps our customers build and power the world we live in – the roads, hospitals, homes and infrastructure. Without a dedicated workforce Caterpillar could not effectively meet our customer’s needs. Join us.
  
  
****Job Summary****
We are seeking an experienced
**Senior IT Analyst Applications (SAP Basis Administrator)**
to join our
**Design Eng Processes team - CAT IT Division.**
**The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN**
**This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule.**
**Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST**
The Senior SAP Basis Administrator is responsible for the administration, maintenance, optimization, and strategic support of enterprise SAP environments. This role ensures SAP systems are secure, highly available, scalable, and compliant while supporting upgrades, migrations, disaster recovery, performance tuning, and cloud transformation initiatives. The position collaborates closely with Infrastructure, Security, Development, Middleware, Database, and Functional teams to deliver reliable SAP services. This is a critical role that helps ensure our end users experience a well-equipped, efficient, and simple support touchpoint. Further, this role owns the Continuous Improvement journey for the department, with programs that improve automation, monitoring, and analytic capabilities.
  
  
****Job Duties:****

* Own and drive all incidents, service tasks, problem tickets and system optimization for operations portfolio, ensuring delivery against commitments, SLAs, and outcomes.
* Establish, monitor, and continuously improve standard work; ensure progress, risks, and dependencies are communicated effectively to stakeholders and leadership.
* Partner with business units and decision makers to support day-to-day operations, incident/problem resolution, and continuous service improvement.
* Technical responsibilities include:

+ SAP Landscape Administration (install, configure, maintain, and support SAP ecosystem)
+ Upgrade & Patch Management
+ System Performance & Availability
+ High Availability and Disaster Recovery Services
+ Security & Compliance
+ Print Management
+ Transport Management
+ Cloud & Automation
+ Level 4 Troubleshooting/Support.
+ SAP HANA & Database administration
+ Data Lifecycle Management configuration

****What You Will Have:****

* Strong functional and/or technical application design, architecture, implementation, and support knowledge.
* Deep technical expertise across the SAP technology stack, including SAP landscape administration, HANA/database administration, upgrades and patching, performance and availability, high availability/disaster recovery, security and compliance, transport and print management, cloud and automation, data lifecycle management, and Level 4 technical support.
* Gen AI Assisted Development or Support: Practical experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools (such as GitHub Copilot or automated agent workflows) to accelerate application development or support, cost or effort reduction, or support optimization. Demonstrated experience with AI tools
* A Lean or Continuous Improvement background.
* An ability to translate between technical and business language, creating a bridge between the support organization and the Caterpillar business they serve.

****Top Candidates Will Also Have:****

* Has the ability to lead, analyze and have a broader perspective on specific technology and related solutions. This requires a comprehensive understanding of application solutions, interfaces, security, data governance policies and procedures.
* Skilled in large scale application support and development
* Hana DBA Certification
* Basis Administration Certification
* Experience with SAP on Hyperscale’s, SAP Cloud Connector, SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM), SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), Test Data Migration Methodologies)
* Knowledge of automation (Python, Ansible)
* Prior experience in driving innovation and automation
* Extensive experience in working with cross-functional teams, along with proven history of strong job-related result's
* Strong stakeholder management skills

****Additional Duties****
Perform other related duties as assigned to support organizational objectives.
  
  
**Education / Experience**
: Requires a relevant computer science master’s or graduate degree and 9-plus years of progressively complex Information Services experience, including enterprise application architecture, development, support, and modernization. Requires a general understanding of business operations, including one or more of the following: general business processes, technical infrastructure, application development and support of major projects, and engineering functional applications. The incumbent must have the ability to provide strategic direction for application and technology roadmaps, including 2–5-year plans for Information Services. Requires the ability to work with diversified departments, along with effective oral and written communication skills. The incumbent must have a strong customer focus and business knowledge.
  
  
****Additional Info**
:**

* May require travel of up to 25%
* This role requires 5 days onsite.
* Relocation is unavailable.

Skill Descriptors
  
  
Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
* Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
* Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
* Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
* Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
* Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
* Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
* Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
* Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
* Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
* Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
* Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
* Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
* Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
* Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
* Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design).
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
* Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
* Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
* Provides instant support for end users of application software.
* Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
* Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
* Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
* Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
* Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews.
* Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges.
* Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
* Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
* Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
* Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
* Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.
  
  
**Level Extensive Experience:**

* Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.
* Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase.
* Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
* Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
* Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
* Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.
* Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities.
* Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
* Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
* Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
****Posting Dates:****
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply
  
  
Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.
