title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
**Why Verifone**
For more than 30 years, Verifone has established a remarkable record of leadership in the electronic payment technology industry. Verifone is one of the leading electronic payment solutions brands and among the largest providers of electronic payment systems worldwide.
  
  
Verifone has a diverse, dynamic, and fast-paced work environment in which employees are focused on results and have opportunities to excel. We take pride in working with leading retailers, merchants, banks, and third-party partners to invent and deliver innovative payment solutions around the world. We strive for excellence in our products and services and are obsessed with customer happiness.
  
  
Across the globe, Verifone employees are leading the payments industry through experience, innovation, and an ambitious spirit. Whether it’s developing the next generation of secure payment systems or finding new ways to bring electronic payments to emerging markets, the Verifone team is dedicated to the success of our customers, partners, and investors. It is this passion for innovation that drives every Verifone employee toward personal and professional success.
  
  
Verifone is proudly an in-office work culture as we see immense benefits to career development and business results from our colleagues being physically co-located.
  
  
**What’s Exciting About The Role**
Verifone is looking for a Data Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team. Rather than being a single-technology specialist position, this is a unique opportunity to your generalist skillset to own and evolve a broad data platform that spans streaming pipelines, multiple database technologies, on prem and cloud infrastructure, and DevOps/SRE operational tooling.
  
  
We are looking for experience in core technologies including Kafka, Redis, Data Lake technologies and Cloud Engineering, with the opportunity to leverage other skills such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL Server and more. You will design and operate end-to-end data pipelines that power new AI and analytics initiatives, migrate streaming services to Kubernetes, and build the automation and tooling that reduces operational toil across the team.
  
  
*If you are energized by working across the full data stack—pipelines, databases, infrastructure, observability, and CI/CD—rather than going deep on a single technology, this role is built for you.*
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Platform & Pipeline Development**

* Design, build, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines—streaming and batch—that serve Verifone’s AI, machine learning, and analytics initiatives.
* Work with diverse data technologies and formats: streaming via Kafka, batch via ETL processes, file formats such as Parquet, and table formats such as Iceberg or Delta Lake.
* Collaborate with data engineering and development teams to enforce best practices for data flow, schema design, security, scalability, and performance.
* Continuously improve data pipeline reliability, latency, and throughput across the full SDLC.
* Support and integrate AWS data tooling including Athena, Glue, Redshift, and S3-based data lake patterns.

**Streaming Infrastructure (Kafka & Ecosystem)**

* Manage and support Apache Kafka clusters (including AWS MSK), Kafka Connect, and KSQL for high-throughput, fault-tolerant event streaming.
* Handle day-to-day Kafka operations: offset management, lag monitoring, consumer group management, cluster rebalancing, and partition tuning.
* Perform cluster maintenance: upgrades, configuration changes, scaling events, and health checks.
* Drive incident response and root cause analysis (RCA) for streaming platform issues.
* Participate in the active effort to migrate Kafka and related services to Kubernetes.

**Database Operations**

* Operate and support multiple database technologies in production: Redis, PostgreSQL and MySQL (indexing, replication, HA/DR, query tuning), and MongoDB.
* Perform routine maintenance across database platforms: upgrades, configuration tuning, health monitoring, and capacity planning.
* Support Snowflake data warehouse operations and integrations as part of the broader analytics stack.
* Implement and uphold data security practices including encryption-in-transit/at-rest, secrets management, and least-privilege access across all data stores.

**DevOps, SRE & Automation**

* Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python, Bash) to reduce manual toil and improve platform reliability.
* Design, implement, and manage CI/CD pipelines for patching, deployment, and configuration automation.
* Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Ansible, or similar tools.
* Containerize and orchestrate workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS: EC2, VPC, IAM, MSK, ElastiCache, CloudWatch, and related services.
* Set up and maintain observability tooling—metrics, logs, and tracing—and participate in on-call incident response.
* Support cloud migration tasks, moving workloads between on-prem and cloud environments.

**Required Qualifications / Skills**
We are looking for a well-rounded platform engineer with experience in Kafka, Redis, Data Lake technologies and Cloud Engineering. Candidates should demonstrate breadth across data, databases, DevOps and SRE skills:
  
  

* 5+ years of overall engineering experience, with demonstrated work across data pipelines, database operations, and infrastructure—not limited to a single technology.
* Hands-on experience with Kafka or another distributed streaming platform (Kafka, Kinesis, Pulsar) in a production environment.
* Operational experience with at least two of the following database technologies: Redis, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redshift or Snowflake.
* Proven data pipeline experience: building or maintaining ETL/ELT processes, batch jobs, or streaming pipelines that serve analytics or operational use cases.
* Strong scripting and automation skills (Python and/or Bash) with a track record of reducing manual toil.
* CI/CD pipeline development and Infrastructure-as-Code experience (Terraform preferred).
* Solid Linux fundamentals: networking basics, log analysis, system troubleshooting, process/memory/disk management.
* Cloud engineering experience, preferably AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, MSK/ElastiCache, CloudWatch).
* Familiarity with observability practices—metrics, logs, tracing—and incident response workflows.
* Understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: availability, consistency, partitions, backpressure.
* Strong communication skills including the ability to present platform status and technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders.
* Flexibility for on-call rotation and occasional weekend support.

**Preferred Skills (Highly Desired)**
**Data Engineering Depth**

* Experience with stream processing frameworks: Kafka Streams, Apache Flink, or similar.
* Familiarity with data lake table formats: Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.
* Hands-on experience with AWS data services: Athena, Glue, Redshift, or Lake Formation.
* Working knowledge of Snowflake—data loading, query optimization, or integration patterns.
* Understanding of data quality, data lineage, or schema registry concepts.

**Infrastructure & Security**

* Container/Kubernetes depth: deployments, StatefulSets, storage classes, Helm.
* On-prem infrastructure experience: VMware/KVM, SAN/NAS storage, network configuration.
* Security and compliance experience, particularly PCI-DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard).
* Secrets management tooling: HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, or similar.

**What We Offer**

* Broad platform ownership—you will work across Kafka, Redis, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, and more, growing as a well-rounded platform engineer rather than a single-tool specialist.
* Direct impact on Verifone’s global payment infrastructure—your work keeps billions of transactions flowing reliably every year.
* Ground-floor involvement in building the data pipelines that will drive Verifone’s AI, machine learning, and analytics strategy.
* Hands-on participation in a Kafka-to-Kubernetes migration—a meaningful infrastructure modernization project from day one.
* Mentorship from senior engineers and platform architects with deep production experience.
* Clear career progression path from mid-level to senior and lead engineer.
* Funded certification paths—Confluent (CCDAK, Certified Administrator), AWS (Solutions Architect, MSK Specialty), CKA, dbt—plus budget for courses and technical conferences.
* Hybrid/remote working flexibility with a collaborative team culture.
* Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives.

**Our Commitment**
Verifone is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Verifone is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.

title: Data Modeler
description:
**India T&M Special Bonus:**
**Req ID:**
395801
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Data Modeler to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Description – Data Modeler**
**Role Title:**
Data Modeler – Enterprise Data Architecture & Modeling
  
  
**Location:**
PAN India
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ years of overall experience, with strong hands-on experience in enterprise data modeling
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking an experienced
**Data Modeler**
to design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise data models supporting analytics, reporting, operational applications, data warehousing, and data integration initiatives.
  
  
The Data Modeler will collaborate closely with business stakeholders, Data Architects, Data Engineers, analysts, application teams, and governance teams to translate complex business requirements into well-defined
**conceptual, logical, and physical data models**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience in
**enterprise data modeling, relational and dimensional modeling, data warehousing, cloud data platforms, metadata management, and data governance**
. The role requires the ability to establish consistent data definitions, relationships, standards, and modeling practices across multiple business domains and technology platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enterprise Data Modeling**

* Design, develop, and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models for enterprise data platforms, analytics solutions, and business applications.
* Translate complex business requirements, business processes, and data requirements into scalable and reusable data structures.
* Develop and maintain:

+ Relational data models
+ Dimensional data models
+ Star schemas
+ Snowflake schemas
+ Domain-oriented data models

* Define entities, attributes, relationships, primary keys, foreign keys, business keys, hierarchies, and reference-data structures.
* Design models that appropriately support transactional, analytical, historical, and reporting requirements.
* Perform model normalization and denormalization based on application, integration, analytics, and performance requirements.

**Data Warehousing & Analytics Modeling**

* Design dimensional models for enterprise data warehouses, data marts, and modern analytics platforms.
* Define facts, dimensions, measures, hierarchies, and grain based on business and analytical requirements.
* Design appropriate approaches for maintaining historical information, including Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCDs).
* Ensure models support reporting, BI, advanced analytics, and downstream data-consumption requirements.
* Partner with Data Engineers to ensure models can be effectively implemented within ETL/ELT and data-processing pipelines.

**Data Standards & Governance**

* Define and enforce enterprise data-modeling standards, naming conventions, data types, and modeling best practices.
* Partner with business and technical stakeholders to establish consistent definitions for critical business data.
* Support master data, reference data, metadata management, and data-governance initiatives.
* Identify authoritative data sources and help establish consistent definitions and relationships across enterprise systems.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of business glossaries and data dictionaries.
* Participate in architecture and model design reviews to ensure proposed solutions comply with enterprise architecture and governance standards.

**Metadata, Lineage & Documentation**

* Maintain comprehensive documentation for conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
* Document:

+ Business definitions
+ Data entities and attributes
+ Source-to-target relationships
+ Data lineage
+ Business rules
+ Data ownership
+ Transformation requirements

* Maintain model metadata using enterprise modeling and/or data-cataloging platforms.
* Ensure appropriate traceability between business requirements, source systems, data models, transformation logic, and downstream consumption.

**Data Quality & Integrity**

* Contribute to data-quality frameworks by identifying:

+ Mandatory and optional data elements
+ Valid relationships
+ Referential-integrity requirements
+ Data constraints
+ Validation rules
+ Business rules

* Work with Data Engineering and Data Governance teams to identify and resolve data-quality and consistency issues.
* Ensure models appropriately support auditability, historical tracking, lineage, and data traceability.
* Identify data redundancies, inconsistencies, and opportunities for standardization and reuse.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in data management, data architecture, data warehousing, or related disciplines, with significant hands-on data-modeling experience.
* 7+ years of strong experience developing conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
* Deep understanding of:

+ Relational data modeling
+ Dimensional modeling
+ Star and snowflake schemas
+ Normalization and denormalization
+ Entity-relationship modeling
+ Data warehousing concepts

* Strong understanding of facts, dimensions, hierarchies, grain, surrogate keys, business keys, and Slowly Changing Dimensions.
* Strong experience defining entities, attributes, relationships, cardinality, primary/foreign keys, and referential-integrity rules.
* Experience translating complex business requirements into enterprise data structures and models.
* Strong knowledge of SQL and relational database concepts.
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms, data lakes, data warehouses, or lakehouse architectures.
* Understanding of ETL/ELT processes and data-integration patterns.
* Experience with metadata management, data lineage, data dictionaries, and business glossaries.
* Good understanding of Master Data Management (MDM), reference data, data quality, and data governance.
* Experience working with enterprise architecture, Data Engineering, analytics, and application-development teams.

**Data Modeling Tools**
Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise data-modeling tools such as:
  
  

* ER/Studio
* ERwin Data Modeler
* SAP PowerDesigner
* Visio
* Lucidchart
* Or equivalent enterprise modeling platforms

**Cloud & Technology Experience**
Experience with one or more modern data platforms is preferred, including:
  
  

* Snowflake
* Databricks
* Microsoft Azure / Azure Synapse
* AWS data services
* Google Cloud Platform / BigQuery
* SQL Server
* Oracle
* PostgreSQL or other enterprise relational databases

Exposure to modern architectures such as
**data lakehouse, data mesh, domain-oriented data architecture, and cloud-native analytics platforms**
is an advantage.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise data-transformation or modernization programs.
* Experience modeling data across multiple business domains and source systems.
* Experience working in complex environments involving both operational and analytical data.
* Knowledge of data cataloging and governance platforms such as Collibra, Alation, Microsoft Purview, or equivalent tools.
* Understanding of data privacy, security, retention, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience working in Healthcare, Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, or other regulated industries is preferred.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and enterprise architecture frameworks.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into structured data models.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data consistency and quality.
* Ability to communicate data concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration skills across business, architecture, engineering, governance, and analytics teams.
* Ability to independently lead data-modeling discussions and design reviews.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is a
**hands-on enterprise Data Modeler**
, rather than primarily a Data Engineer or BI Developer, who can demonstrate substantial experience creating and governing
**conceptual, logical, and physical models**
.
  
  
Candidates should be able to provide concrete examples of enterprise data models they have designed, explain their approach to
**relational versus dimensional modeling**
, and demonstrate strong knowledge of
**data warehousing, SCDs, metadata, lineage, governance, and modern cloud data architectures**
.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. title: Senior Escalation Support Engineer
description:
**What makes us Qlik?**
A Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik helps teams get more out of AI with trusted data products, a powerful analytics engine, and AI agents. This helps teams reduce risk and operating costs, while scaling AI responsibly.
  
  
Used by 75% of the Fortune 500, Qlik works with the systems organizations already use, maintaining flexibility without lock-in.
  
  
**The Senior Escalation Support Engineer Role**
At Qlik, our
**Escalation Support Engineers**
are technical problem-solvers who take ownership when customers face complex, business-critical challenges. As a
**Senior Escalation Support Engineer**
, you will lead high-impact escalations across the Qlik and Talend portfolio, provide trusted technical guidance to customers, and coordinate closely with Support, R&D, Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success and Account teams.
  
  
Beyond resolving individual incidents, you will drive root-cause analysis, identify recurring issues, influence product improvements, mentor other engineers and help reduce customer risk. You will also contribute to Qlik Advanced Support through proactive technical guidance, remediation sessions, knowledge sharing and awareness of customers’ critical projects.
  
  
**What makes this role interesting?**

* Lead technically complex, high-severity escalations for strategic and business-critical customers.
* Become a recognized technical authority and subject matter expert across the Support organization.
* Collaborate with global Support, R&D, Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success and Account teams.
* Influence product reliability by identifying recurring issues, defects and improvement opportunities.
* Coach and mentor engineers, share knowledge, and contribute to proactive Advanced Support engagement.

**Here’s How You’ll Be Making An Impact**

* Own escalations end to end, establish investigation direction, coordinate resources and drive issues through resolution.
* Perform deep troubleshooting across logs, traces, diagnostics, performance data, system behavior and integrated technologies; reproduce issues where possible and identify root cause and sustainable remediation.
* Partner directly with customers during critical incidents, communicate findings and action plans clearly, set expectations and provide regular updates.
* Work with R&D and Engineering by providing clear problem statements, reproduction steps, diagnostic evidence and business impact; validate fixes and communicate outcomes.
* Identify customer environment and deployment risks; support proactive technical sessions, remediation, retrospectives and preventive recommendations.
* Mentor Support Engineers and SMEs, lead knowledge-sharing and case reviews, and create reusable troubleshooting guides, technical articles and lessons learned.
* Lead or contribute to major-incident RCA, corrective and preventive actions, and improvements to support processes and product supportability.

**We’re Looking For a Teammate With**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years in enterprise technical support, escalation engineering, system administration or a related technical field, including complex customer escalations and business-critical production issues.
* Experience as a senior technical SME or equivalent technical leadership role, working with global customers and distributed teams.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills across complex, multi-layered environments.
* Strong database and SQL knowledge, including DDL, DML and TCL; experience with one or more RDBMS such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Teradata, MySQL or PostgreSQL.
* Strong Linux/Unix command-line troubleshooting; experience analyzing logs, traces, system metrics, network behavior and application diagnostics.
* Experience with data integration, replication, Change Data Capture (CDC), performance troubleshooting or production-critical data platforms is highly desirable.
* Experience with Qlik and/or Talend Data Integration products and complex product architectures is highly desirable.
* Talend product knowledge across Talend Studio DI, Talend Big Data, Talend ESB, Talend Administration Center, Talend Data Preparation & Data Stewardship, Talend Remote Engine and Talend Master Data Management (MDM) is an advantage.
* Ability to lead complex escalations independently, remain calm under pressure and influence technical decisions without direct authority.
* Excellent customer-facing, written and verbal communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder-management skills, with a passion for coaching engineers and sharing technical knowledge.

**The location for this role is:**
Bangalore, India.
  
  
(This is an India-based opportunity supporting Qlik’s APAC customer base and global Support organization. Customer engagement and working hours may vary based on business requirements, including collaboration across time zones and participation in critical production incidents) LI-APAC
  
  
**Apply now and help change how the world transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights and turns complex data challenges into new opportunities!**
**More About Qlik And Who We Are**
Find out more about ‘Life at Qlik’ on social: Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X/Twitter, and to see all other opportunities to join us and our values, check out our Careers Page.
  
  
**What else do we offer?**

* Genuine career progression pathways and mentoring programs.
* Culture of innovation, technology, collaboration, and openness.
* Flexible, diverse, and international work environment.

Giving back is a huge part of our culture. Alongside an extra “change the world” day plus another for personal development, we also highly encourage participation in our Corporate Responsibility Employee Programs
  
  
If you need assistance applying for a role due to a disability, please submit your request via email to accessibilityta@qlik.com. Any information you provide will be treated according to Qlik’s Recruitment Privacy Notice. Qlik may only respond to emails related to accommodation requests.
  
  
Qlik is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. Please, no phone calls or emails. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at Qlik via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written search agreement in place for this position will be deemed the sole property of Qlik. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Qlik as a result of the referral or through other means.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Data & AI
description:
At Warner Music Group, We’re a Global Collective Of Music Makers And Music Lovers, Tech Innovators And Inspired Entrepreneurs, Game-changing Creatives And Passionate Team Members. Here, We Turn Dreams Into Stardom And Audiences Into Fans. We Are Guided By Three Core Values That Underpin Everything We Do Across All Our Diverse Businesses
  
  

* Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
* Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
* Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog !
  
  
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
  
  
The new Forward Deployed Engineering Team within the Data and Insights Organization in WMG Global Tech is a specialized capability that focuses on solving a diverse range of problems across our business. This team will partner with our Product Solutions team and work with our key business stakeholders across Warner Music Group to rapidly build and deploy automation and solutions using data and AI. If you love working directly with customers on a variety of different problems while using world-class data platforms to create awesome solutions, and you’ve got strong software engineering and data fundamentals, this role might be a great fit.
  
  
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our organization. As an FDE, you will work directly with our most important business stakeholders across labels and global functions to deliver rapid solutions leveraging data and AI. Strong candidates will thrive when partnering with non-technical customers, have great product instincts, lots of empathy, and can intersect AI solutions with their pain points to turn painful tasks that take weeks into workflows that take minutes. This role entails full stack solution engineering, including data pipelining and interop, backend development in Python, dashboard and Streamlit app development, and leveraging Databricks and Snowflake AI tools such as Genie and Cortex to create solutions in hours that used to take days. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a world-class team using best-in-class AI tools to take the music business to the next level.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Deliver Impactful Solutions for Diverse Stakeholders: Proven capability to step into different problem spaces and work with diverse people to turn work that takes weeks into minutes.
* Full-Stack Engineering: Ability to flex across backend, frontend, data pipelines, AI tools, Python, React. When you aren’t a pro at something, you can use AI effectively to deliver and you know how to make sure that the engineering stays excellent along the way.
* AI Solutions Delivery: Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to design, build, and deploy production solutions to accelerate non-technical stakeholders.
* Product Sense and Impact: Ability to rapidly understand and develop a solution without having curated requirements. You can step into a problem space with little context, rapidly understand what needs to be done, and deliver impact.
* Empathy and Customer Communication: Strong ability to communicate in non-technical language to stakeholders from entry to executive level. Proven ability to both manage expectations and keep customers up to date.
* AI Solutions Engineering: Familiarity working with AI tools such as Gemini, Cortex Code, and Genie Code, and you can wield them to turn solution delivery from weeks into hours.
* Be Curious and Adaptable: You are eager to explore new technologies and you are happy to flex across a variety of problems and domains by the day. You are comfortable with dozens of different problems for different stakeholders at any given time.
* Stay Aligned: Proven ability to contribute to standards and leverage existing tools and systems to ensure the FDE solutions are aligned with the Data and Insights engineering roadmap.

**Who You Are**

* Experienced, Scrappy, and Creative: You have at least 3 years of software engineering experience. An ideal candidate will have exposure to customers, experience with Python, experience with data pipelining (e.g., ETL) and either Snowflake and/or Databricks (we build on both but one is sufficient for candidates). title: Data & Analytics
description:
**Immediate Joiner Only**

**Hybrid Mode**

**Experience:-5+ Years**

**Location:-Bangalore**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain batch and incremental pipelines in Python/PySpark on AWS Glue. You'll own their freshness, completeness and cost.
* **Fetch data from APIs:**
  build reliable ingestion from internal and third-party REST and GraphQL APIs. Handle authentication (API keys, OAuth 2.0), pagination, rate limits, retries with backoff, incremental extraction and schema changes.
* **Integrate APIs:**
  connect the data platform with source systems, SaaS platforms and partner endpoints using APIs, webhooks and event-driven flows (EventBridge, SQS, Lambda).
* **Build APIs:**
  design, build and deploy data APIs that serve curated datasets to applications and other teams, using Amazon API Gateway, Lambda and FastAPI. Own versioning, authentication, documentation (OpenAPI) and monitoring.
* Bring data from internal systems, APIs and files into the S3 data lake. Manage partitioning, schema changes and Apache Iceberg tables.
* Turn raw data into curated, documented layers (raw → staging → mart) that analysts can query directly in Athena.
* Use SageMaker Unified Studio to develop, catalogue and publish data assets: projects, SageMaker Lakehouse, SageMaker Catalog, notebooks and query editors.
* Make governed data available to AI agents. Build MCP servers or tool endpoints on top of curated datasets, and support Amazon Bedrock agents, knowledge bases and RAG use cases.
* Use AI coding agents (Amazon Q Developer, Claude, Kiro, Cursor or similar) to develop, refactor, test and document code. Code review and testing are still required before anything goes live.
* Orchestrate workflows with Airflow (MWAA), Step Functions or Glue Workflows, including retries, backfills and alerting.
* Set up data quality checks for schema, freshness, row counts and reconciliation with source systems. Trace issues to their root cause.
* Apply security and governance: least-privilege IAM, Lake Formation / SageMaker Catalog permissions, encryption, secrets management for API credentials, PII handling and retention.
* Tune Athena and Glue for performance and cost through partition design, file compaction, columnar formats and workgroup limits.
* Keep all code in Git with CI/CD, and deploy infrastructure as code.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* 3+ years of hands-on data engineering on production pipelines.
* **Python (strong):**
  production-quality code, pytest, PySpark, pandas, boto3.
* **SQL (strong):**
  window functions, CTEs, incremental logic, tuning queries on large partitioned tables.
* **APIs:**
* **Building APIs:**
  has designed and built REST APIs with FastAPI or Flask, and deployed them on AWS (API Gateway + Lambda, or containers)
* **Fetching data from APIs:**
  has built production ingestion from REST/GraphQL APIs with requests/httpx. Handles pagination, rate limits, retries and incremental loads
* **API integration:**
  OAuth 2.0 and API-key authentication, JSON/XML payloads, webhooks, and OpenAPI/Swagger specs
* **AWS data stack:**
* **AWS Glue:**
  ETL jobs, crawlers, Data Catalog, Glue Studio
* **Amazon Athena:**
  query authoring, workgroups, federated queries, cost controls
* **Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio:**
  projects, Lakehouse, Catalog, unified notebooks and query editor
* **Amazon S3:**
  data lake layout, partitioning, lifecycle policies
* **Supporting services:**
  Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, EventBridge, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, Lake Formation
* **Agentic and AI tools:**
  has used AI coding agents in real work, and understands Amazon Bedrock (agents, knowledge bases), Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool and prompt design, and RAG.
* Workflow orchestration with Airflow, Step Functions or an equivalent tool.
* Data modelling (dimensional and event-based), plus Git and CI/CD practice.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience running Apache Iceberg in production (compaction, time travel).
* Streaming with Kinesis, MSK (Kafka) or Spark Structured Streaming.
* Amazon AppFlow or managed connectors for SaaS ingestion (e.g. Salesforce, Google Analytics).
* GraphQL API development; async Python (asyncio, aiohttp) for high-volume API extraction.
* Redshift / Redshift Serverless or EMR.
* dbt; Terraform or CDK.
* Has built AI agents with Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents SDK, LangGraph or custom MCP servers.
* Vector stores and embedding pipelines (OpenSearch Serverless, pgvector).
* AWS certification: Data Engineer Associate or Machine Learning Engineer Associate.
* Experience with a BI tool such as QuickSight or Power BI.

title: Backup & Recovery Expert
description:

**The Role**

**Your Role**
=============

As a Backup & Recovery Infrastructure Specialist, you will be responsible for ensuring the availability, security, and recoverability of enterprise data across complex IT environments. Your primary focus will be on Veritas NetBackup administration, with secondary responsibility for Commvault platforms, supporting backup, recovery, disaster recovery, cyber-resilience, and automation initiatives.

You will manage and optimize enterprise backup infrastructures, monitor daily backup and recovery operations, troubleshoot critical issues, and ensure compliance with defined SLAs, RPOs, and RTOs. Working closely with infrastructure, cloud, storage, database, virtualization, and application teams, you will deliver reliable data protection solutions that support business continuity and operational excellence.

The role combines hands-on technical administration with strategic improvement initiatives, including automation, platform modernization, capacity optimization, security enhancement, and recovery readiness. You will drive continuous improvement through process standardization, proactive problem-solving, and operational best practices while expanding your expertise across enterprise technologies and cloud platforms.

  
  

**What You Will Do**
====================

* Manage and support enterprise backup and recovery environments using **Veritas NetBackup** and **Commvault** .
* Monitor daily backup jobs, replication activities, and recovery operations to ensure successful data protection.
* Troubleshoot backup failures, restore issues, storage problems, performance bottlenecks, and connectivity-related incidents.
* Perform backup and restore activities for servers, databases, virtual machines, applications, and cloud workloads.
* Execute disaster recovery (DR) tests, recovery validations, and restore requests to ensure business continuity.
* Administer NetBackup components including Master Servers, Media Servers, policies, storage units, disk pools, deduplication, and lifecycle policies.
* Manage Commvault infrastructure including CommServe, MediaAgents, storage policies, clients, and recovery operations.
* Perform platform maintenance activities such as patching, upgrades, agent installations, certificate management, and health checks.
* Monitor backup capacity, storage utilization, retention compliance, and infrastructure availability.
* Implement and maintain backup security controls such as encryption, immutability, access controls, and ransomware protection.
* Automate operational tasks using **PowerShell, Python, Shell scripting, and APIs** to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
* Collaborate with server, database, cloud, virtualization, storage, network, and application teams to resolve backup and recovery issues.
* Support incident, problem, change, configuration, and capacity management processes.
* Create and maintain runbooks, SOPs, recovery procedures, technical documentation, and knowledge articles.
* Drive continuous improvements through automation, backup optimization, failure reduction, and operational standardization.
* **Participate in infrastructure projects, provide technical recommendations, and ensure backup requirements are incorporated into new deployments.**

**Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**
==================================================

* 12+ years of experience in enterprise backup, recovery, and infrastructure operations.
* Expert-level knowledge of Veritas NetBackup, including Master Servers, Media Servers, policies, storage units, deduplication, appliances, and lifecycle policies.
* Strong hands-on experience with Commvault, including CommServe, MediaAgents, storage policies, backup/restore operations, and troubleshooting.
* Experience managing large-scale enterprise backup environments with ownership of backup SLAs, RPOs, RTOs, and recoverability.
* Strong expertise in backup failure analysis, restore troubleshooting, performance tuning, capacity management, and incident resolution.
* Hands-on experience supporting Windows/Linux servers, VMware, databases, applications, and cloud workloads (AWS/Azure/GCP).
* Knowledge of backup security and cyber resilience, including encryption, immutability, ransomware protection, and access controls.
* Experience with automation and scripting (PowerShell, Shell, Python, APIs) along with strong understanding of ITIL processes, RCA, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

**Preferred Professional Experience:**
======================================

* Veritas NetBackup Certification.
* Commvault Certification.
* AWS, Azure, or GCP Certifications.
* Experience with disaster recovery testing and cyber recovery solutions.
* Knowledge of enterprise storage, virtualization, and hybrid cloud backup architectures.
Exposure to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and advanced automation frameworks.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

title: Associate Director - IAM Advanced Authentication
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centered on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Job Purpose**:

Every person, workload and AI agent at GSK needs an identity it can prove, credentials that cannot be stolen and access that is just enough, just in time. As our applications move to the cloud and AI agents begin working alongside our people, authentication is becoming the foundation of trust for everything we do. The Associate Director, leads the engineering and delivery of that foundation, starting with single sign-on (SSO) and extending the same discipline to Azure and Google Cloud (GCP), non-human identities (NHI) and AI agents.

**Our vision:**

  

One trusted way to authenticate, whoever or whatever is asking for access: passwordless for people, secretless for workloads and tightly scoped for AI agents. Security should be invisible when everything is right and decisive when it is not. We will get there by using AI securely in our own work, setting the example for the rest of GSK.

**About the team:**

  

Authentication and Cloud Security is part of Identity & Access Management. We build and run SSO for GSK’s workforce and applications, and bring the same discipline to securing the accounts, credentials and authentication of cloud, non-human and AI agent identities. Together with PKI & Cryptographic Services, we protect the identities, secrets and keys that GSK’s cloud and AI future depends on.

**Key responsibilities:**

In this role, you will turn that vision into reality. Your responsibilities will include:

* **Build one team:** Lead and develop a global team of engineers across SSO, cloud, NHI and AI agent identity, working as one team with shared patterns rather than separate product silos.
* **Deliver the roadmap:** Own the engineering roadmap, delivery plans and service measures, turning the agreed architecture and standards into reliable services.
* **Make sign-in passwordless and trusted:** Run GSK’s SSO services (SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0), moving the workforce to passwordless, phishing-resistant authentication, with conditional access, strong identity verification for registration and account recovery, and the retirement of legacy authentication.
* **Secure the cloud:** Protect cloud accounts and access in Azure and GCP with strong authentication, workload identity federation, least privilege and just-in-time access, with no standing admin rights.
* **Bring workloads and AI agents into the fold:** Give non-human identities and AI agents unique, accountable identities kept separate from human ones, with protected credentials, scoped and revocable access and full audit logging, and promote integration with GSK’s identity lifecycle and governance processes.
* **Move from secrets to secretless:** Drive adoption of secrets vaulting and management, remove hard-coded credentials, favour short-lived and secretless authentication, and build secret scanning into engineering pipelines.
* **Partner with PKI:** Work with the PKI & Cryptographic Services lead to secure cloud, AI and secrets, with aligned roadmaps, clear ownership and a joined-up approach for stakeholders and auditors.
* **Use AI ourselves:** Apply AI to identity engineering and operations, such as risky sign-in analysis, anomaly detection, faster onboarding and incident triage, with human oversight and clear audit trails.
* **Set the example:** Show GSK what secure cloud and AI looks like through secure-by-default implementations, reusable patterns, automation and implementation guidelines.
* **Keep trust earned:** Ensure these services meet audit and compliance requirements, including GxP, SOX, ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 42001 and the EU AI Act, and lead major incidents and continual improvement with partner teams.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Degree in computer science, information technology, cyber security or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* At least 18 years’ experience in identity or security, including leading engineering teams that deliver and run enterprise identity or security services in a large organisation.
* Strong knowledge of SSO and modern authentication (SAML, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0), conditional access, multi-factor authentication and passwordless authentication.
* Hands-on experience securing identity and access in Azure, including Microsoft Entra ID, Azure role-based access control and workload identities.
* Experience securing non-human identities and secrets, including vaulting, credential rotation and removing embedded secrets, and integrating them with identity lifecycle and governance processes.
* Working knowledge of AI and large language model security risks, such as agent permissions, data exposure and prompt injection.
* Strong leadership, delivery and communication skills, including managing roadmaps, suppliers and audits, and explaining technical risk to senior stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience delivering SSO at scale with Microsoft Entra ID or Ping Identity, including passwordless authentication and identity verification.
* Experience securing identity and access in Google Cloud (GCP), and with tools for securing non-human identity credentials and cloud privileged access.
* Experience with secrets vaulting and management platforms such as Akeyless, CyberArk, HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault or Google Secret Manager.
* Experience securing AI agents or platforms such as Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI or Copilot, and familiarity with the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
* Working understanding of PKI and certificate-based authentication, and experience with Terraform and identity automation.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator, Azure Security Engineer or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer.
* Experience in pharmaceuticals or another highly regulated industry.

Typical tools and technologies: Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity, passkeys and FIDO2, Windows Hello for Business, Azure, Google Cloud, Akeyless, CyberArk, Azure Key Vault, Microsoft Graph, Terraform and CI/CD pipelines.

**Skills**

Account Lifecycle Management, Authentication, Authentication Systems, Automation Technology, Certificate Management, Cloud Based Services, Cloud IAM, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Database Management, Directory Services, Engineering Leadership, Identity Access Management (IAM), Identity Lifecycle Management, Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Infrastructure Security, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Secure Authentication, Security Controls, Server Security, System Monitors, Troubleshooting

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Technology Support Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Technology Support Engineer  
**Project Role Description :** Resolve incidents and problems across multiple business system components and ensure operational stability. Create and implement Requests for Change (RFC) and update knowledge base articles to support effective troubleshooting. Collaborate with vendors and help service management teams with issue analysis and resolution.
  
**Must have skills :** Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktop Architecture  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **3** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Role
  
Provide hands on operational support for in scope Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases. The role performs monitoring, incident resolution, approved configuration changes, backup and recovery activities, maintenance, performance analysis, reporting, documentation, and shift handover tasks.  
Key responsibilities  
Monitor database and server availability, jobs, sessions, blocking, processor, memory, disk, storage, growth, replication, backup, and performance indicators.  
Troubleshoot database incidents, collect evidence, restore service, monitor after recovery, and escalate risks or vendor issues.  
Maintain database backup configurations and execute agreed restore and recovery tests.  
Perform approved complete, point in time, data file, and other recovery activities using current procedures.  
Apply approved database and instance configuration changes and record results, testing, rollback status, and configuration updates.  
Perform housekeeping for logs, traces, temporary files, and other approved maintenance activities.  
Support performance tuning by capturing evidence, identifying likely constraints, implementing approved actions, and measuring results.  
Perform administrative imports or exports based on approved application team inputs.  
Maintain configuration templates, scripts, database records, topology relationships, and operational runbooks.  
Prepare monthly metric inputs and quarterly nonstandard database analysis as assigned.  
Produce complete shift handovers and participate in the Priority 1 and Priority 2 on call rotation.  
Operational and service management responsibilities  
Work within City of Hope incident, request, change, problem, and major incident processes.  
Monitor assigned queues, maintain accurate ticket updates, meet response and resolution targets, and escalate risks before a target is missed.  
Participate in weekly service reviews, monthly reporting, operational handovers, and service improvement planning.  
Maintain procedures, runbooks, configuration records, and knowledge articles after approved changes.  
Use approved access, tools, hardened templates, and change controls. Do not make unapproved production changes.  
Participate in transition, knowledge transfer, playback, service rehearsal, and readiness activities.  
Required technical skills  
Hands on Oracle or Microsoft SQL Server administration, with working knowledge of the other platform.  
Database backup, restore, recovery, high availability, clustering, replication, monitoring, performance tuning, and housekeeping.  
Ability to interpret database alerts, logs, execution information, sessions, waits, locking, storage, processor, memory, and disk indicators.  
Ability to write and safely use approved database queries, scripts, and administrative commands.  
Clear ticket, change, recovery, and handover documentation.  
Required experience  
Recommended experience: at least 4 years in production database administration.  
Experience with incidents, changes, backup, restore, recovery, performance troubleshooting, maintenance windows, and on call support.  
Experience in a controlled enterprise environment with approvals, runbooks, configuration records, and service targets.  
Expected deliverables  
Resolved incident and request records with technical evidence  
Approved change records and post implementation results  
Backup, restore, recovery, and maintenance evidence  
Monthly metrics and capacity inputs  
Current runbooks, scripts, configuration records, and handovers  
Timely database incident response and safe service restoration.  
Successful scheduled backups and proven recovery through agreed testing.  
Accurate changes, documentation, configuration records, and handovers.  
Early escalation of capacity, performance, replication, supportability, and security posture concerns.  
Reduced repeat incidents through documented corrective actions.  
On call expectations  
Participate in the documented on call rotation outside the staffed 16 hour weekday window for Priority 1 and Priority 2 incidents.  
Acknowledge the alert or assignment promptly, join the incident bridge when requested, troubleshoot within the role scope, and engage the required resolver groups.  
Maintain an effective handover between staffed shifts and on call coverage, including current impact, actions completed, next steps, owners, and risks.  
Ensure a primary and secondary contact is defined for the relevant technology tower. Rotation details and allowance terms must follow the approved operating model and local policy

  
15 years full time education

title: Senior Data Architect
description:
The Data Technical Architect is the design authority for the data architecture that underpins the Command Centre and enables the Control Tower. The role owns how operational data from source systems across product domains is ingested, integrated, resolved, modelled, certified, and served as a single, trusted, near real‑time view of the business.
  
  
This is a data‑architecture‑led role. The primary deliverable is the target‑state data architecture – layering, canonical models, event and entity design, the semantic and KPI layer, and the data quality and lineage framework – that allows the Control Tower to detect exceptions, trigger alerts, and support root‑cause analysis with confidence in the underlying data.
  
  
The role works closely with Command Centre operations, BI delivery, Data Engineering, GDA, Data Platform, source system owners, and Enterprise Architecture, and operates within the standards set by the Tech Governance Lead.
  
  
The Data Technical Architect is the design authority for the data architecture that underpins the Command Centre and enables the Control Tower. The role owns how operational data from source systems across product domains is ingested, integrated, resolved, modelled, certified, and served as a single, trusted, near real‑time view of the business.
  
  
This is a data‑architecture‑led role. The primary deliverable is the target‑state data architecture – layering, canonical models, event and entity design, the semantic and KPI layer, and the data quality and lineage framework – that allows the Control Tower to detect exceptions, trigger alerts, and support root‑cause analysis with confidence in the underlying data.
  
  
The role works closely with Command Centre operations, BI delivery, Data Engineering, GDA, Data Platform, source system owners, and Enterprise Architecture, and operates within the standards set by the Tech Governance Lead.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Data Architecture & Design
  
  
Own the end‑to‑end data architecture for the Command Centre – how data flows from operational source systems across product domains (e.g. Contracts, Ocean) through to the Control Tower consumption layer.
  
  
Define the target‑state data architecture and transition roadmap, including the layering model (landing, raw, integrated/curated, consumption) and the storage, compute, and serving choices at each layer.
  
  
Design the canonical, cross‑domain data layer that gives the Control Tower one consistent representation of the core business objects, independent of the source systems they originate from.
  
  
Define master and reference data requirements, entity resolution, and cross‑system key mapping so that events from different systems resolve to the same business entity.
  
  
Establish data domain boundaries, data ownership, and data product definitions aligned to the Command Centre operating model.
  
  
Produce and maintain core architecture artefacts – conceptual, logical, and physical data models, data flow and lineage diagrams, integration maps, and architecture decision records.
  
  
Data Integration & Pipeline Architecture
  
  
Architect real‑time, near real‑time, and batch ingestion patterns – streaming, event‑driven, CDC, API, and scheduled – and define which pattern applies to which source and use case.
  
  
Define the operational event model and payload standards for the milestones, status changes, and exceptions that drive Control Tower views.
  
  
Design pipeline patterns for reliability at scale: idempotency, replay, late‑arriving and out‑of‑order events, backfill, and reconciliation back to source.
  
  
Set standards for orchestration, dependency management, error and dead‑letter handling, and pipeline observability.
  
  
Define and agree data contracts and SLAs with source system teams, covering schema, frequency, volume, and change management.
  
  
Define latency, freshness, and throughput targets per data domain and ensure the architecture demonstrably meets them.
  
  
Data Modelling & Semantic / KPI Layer
  
  
Design the dimensional, event, and state models required for end‑to‑end milestone tracking, cycle time, dwell, and exception analysis.
  
  
Architect the semantic and KPI layer so that each metric is defined once, certified, and reused consistently across Control Tower views and downstream reporting.
  
  
Model for drill‑down, so an alert on the Control Tower can be traced to transaction‑level detail and root cause without leaving the platform.
  
  
Define the historisation approach – slowly changing dimensions, snapshots, and point‑in‑time reporting – to support trend and retrospective analysis.
  
  
Design aggregation, pre‑computation, and caching strategies so Control Tower dashboards meet response‑time expectations at production data volumes.
  
  
Data Quality, Governance & Security
  
  
Define data quality dimensions, rules, and thresholds at each architectural layer, and design how failures are detected, quarantined, and escalated.
  
  
Ensure Control Tower alerting is built on trusted data – design the freshness, completeness, and validity checks that gate what is surfaced to operations.
  
  
Design end‑to‑end metadata and lineage capture, from source system field through to published KPI.
  
  
Design role‑based access, row and column level security, masking, retention, and audit into the data architecture rather than bolting it on later.
  
  
Ensure alignment with enterprise data architecture, cloud strategy, and BI governance standards, and work with the Tech Governance Lead on dataset certification.
  
  
Identify, document, and drive remediation of data architecture technical debt.
  
  
Delivery & Execution
  
  
Translate the architecture into sprint‑ready designs, data contracts, and backlog items for data engineering and BI delivery teams.
  
  
Provide hands‑on technical direction – prototypes, proofs of concept, performance tuning, and resolution of complex modelling and pipeline problems.
  
  
Review data models, pipelines, and semantic layers for adherence to the agreed architecture.
  
  
Own volumetrics and capacity planning, and support performance, resilience, and reconciliation testing ahead of each Control Tower release.
  
  
Drive reuse of data products, models, and patterns across Command Centre use cases to reduce duplication and rework.
  
  
Stakeholder & Cross-functional Collaboration
  
  
Partner with Command Centre operations and business owners to translate operational visibility and exception‑management needs into concrete data requirements.
  
  
Collaborate closely with Data Engineering and Platform teams, GDA, source system owners, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure and Cloud teams.
  
  
Present data architecture proposals to design authorities and governance forums for review and approval.
  
  
Communicate data design trade‑offs, risks, and dependencies clearly to non‑technical stakeholders.
  
  
Mentor data engineers and modellers on architecture patterns, modelling standards, and design quality.
  
  
**Required Qualifications / Skills**
Education & Experience
  
  
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  
  
Extensive experience as a data architect designing large‑scale, multi‑source data platforms, with hands‑on delivery experience rather than documentation only.
  
  
Proven experience designing the data architecture behind a control tower, command centre, or comparable real‑time operational visibility solution.
  
  
Track record of integrating operational and transactional source systems across multiple business domains.
  
  
Certifications in cloud data platforms, data architecture, or frameworks such as DAMA‑DMBOK or TOGAF are a plus.
  
  
Technical Competencies
  
  

* Deep data modelling expertise – conceptual, logical, and physical modelling; dimensional (Kimball), Data Vault, and event/state modelling.
* Strong experience with cloud data platforms, lakehouse and warehouse architectures, and layered (medallion‑style) design.
* Hands‑on experience with streaming and event‑driven architectures, CDC, message/event platforms, and API‑based integration.
* Advanced SQL and data performance engineering – partitioning, clustering, incremental processing, query tuning, and cost optimisation.
* Experience with orchestration and transformation frameworks and with data quality and observability tooling.
* Working knowledge of master data management, reference data, and entity resolution techniques.
* Experience with metadata, lineage, and data catalogue tooling, and with certified dataset practices.
* Strong understanding of data security, privacy, compliance, and governance, and the ability to design to them.
* Sufficient BI and visualisation knowledge to design a semantic layer that Control Tower dashboards can consume efficiently.

Leadership & Behavioural Competencies
  
  
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, particularly with source system owners.
  
  
Ability to communicate complex data concepts clearly and effectively.
  
  
High attention to detail combined with strategic, big‑picture thinking.
  
  
Sound judgement under operational pressure and in incident‑driven environments.
  
  
Proven ability to work across teams and drive alignment without direct authority.

title: E-Commerce Lead
description:

This role demands a deep understanding of various commerce technologies, including; Commerce, Order Management, Merchant of Record (MOR), Fraud Management, Tax, and Payment Providers. Key skills include strong technical expertise, hands-on development, collaboration across teams, and a focus on optimizing system performance and resource management.

In this role you will
  
  

* Demonstrate a comprehensive grasp of architectural patterns and industry-standard development methodologies. Develop and implement the e-commerce ecosystem, including; B2C commerce platforms, order management, payment systems, tax, fraud, order tracking systems.
* Assess diverse architectural design paths to identify the most suitable solution based on metrics such as maintainability, scalability, performance, complexity, and implementation effort.
* Develop and maintain integrations between core order lifecycle systems, including Merchant of Record (MOR) solutions, warehouse and inventory management, ensuring seamless flow from order placement to fulfillment.
* Support the integration strategy for expanded commercial channels such as marketplaces, social commerce, and reseller platforms, ensuring robust architecture for expanding to omnichannel models.
* Ensure systems are optimized for performance, security, and compliance.
* Collaborate with team members, participate in code reviews, and follow best practices while assisting with feature development and solutioning.
* Collaborate with business, product, and IT teams to ensure technical solutions align with business objectives.
* In conjunction with Product Owner develop technical roadmaps that balance short-term needs with long-term goals to future-proof DTC platforms.
* Identify key dependencies across platforms to mitigate risks and avoid bottlenecks.
* Support efforts to modernize, maintain, and continuously improve system architecture for long-term stability, addressing performance bottlenecks and security vulnerabilities.

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).
  
  
–Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
  
  
–Design performance and load testing.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:
  
  
–Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
  
  
–Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
  
  
–Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
  
  
–Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:
  
  
–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
  
  
–Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health..
  
  
System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:
  
  
–Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
  
  
–Design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.
  
  
–Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability.
  
  
Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:
  
  
–Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes.
  
  
–Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
  
  
–Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance.
  
  
–Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation.
  
  
–Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations.
  
  
Compliance & Security:
  
  
–Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls.
  
  
–Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps.
  
  
–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date.
  
  
Automation & Change Management:
  
  
–Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
  
  
–Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Planning & Execution:
  
  
–Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines.
  
  
Collaboration & Partnership:
  
  
–Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.
  
  
Problem Solving:
  
  
–Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies.
  
  
Continuous Learning:
  
  
–Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams.
  
  
Continuous Improvement:
  
  
–Develops ideas, recommends updates, and/or collaborates on the implementation of process improvements to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across teams, and evaluates the impact on key stakeholders. Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.
  
  
Performance and Development:
  
  
–Contributes to the talent development pipeline by participating in candidate interviews, assessing candidates, and providing hiring recommendations.
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
