description:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.
  
  
With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
  
  
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.
  
  
**About Atos Group**
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role summary**
Migrate existing Lambda/Dagster/dbt pipelines onto a Glue‑based, Redshift‑centric medallion architecture (S3 Bronze → Redshift Silver → Gold canonical model), embed data quality, lineage, security and CI/CD controls into every pipeline, and mentor engineers through domain‑by‑domain migration waves
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Inventory and baseline current Lambda functions, Dagster pipelines, dbt models, MySQL ODS flows and Kafka feeds, document lineage, schedules, SLAs and failure paths.
* Design and build Glue‑based ingestion, transformation, and cataloguing patterns (Glue jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) with Lambda/Step Functions/Event Bridge orchestration.
* Implement S3 Bronze landing with lifecycle/archive policies, Redshift Silver conformance and Gold canonical data products (Customer, Loan, Collections, Risk).
* Build automated data‑quality gates, reconciliation checks, and source‑to‑report lineage; support the enterprise data dictionary and certification of business‑critical reports
* Implement IAM, AWS‑native encryption, Secrets Manager and Gold‑layer RBAC/least‑privilege access.
* Establish Dev/Test environments, Git‑based CI/CD, schema version control (Liquibase) and controlled release promotion; monitoring and recovery via CloudWatch.
* Migrate and reconcile workloads wave by wave against baselines; decommission ODS dependencies and replace reverse flows with governed interfaces.
* Optimise Redshift performance and cost (WLM, sort/Dist keys, materialised views).
* Mentor engineers, own technical quality assurance of deliverables, and work with Data Owners/Champions and Atos architects in an Agile setup.

**Mandatory Skills**

* 10+ years in data engineering, 5+ Experience in AWS data platforms.
* Amazon Redshift (deep) data modelling, performance tuning, WLM, RBAC, external schemas/Spectrum.
* AWS Glue (jobs, Glue Catalog, Crawlers) and hands‑on medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) implementation on S3 + Redshift.
* AWS Lambda, Step Functions, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager.
* Advanced SQL, dimensional/canonical data modelling, ETL/ELT frameworks.
* Python (primary) — PySpark for Glue jobs.
* MySQL (operational data store) and CDC/batch extraction patterns.
* DBT— must be able to read, reverse‑engineer, and migrate existing dbt models.
* Data‑quality frameworks, reconciliation, and lineage/metadata practices.
* Git, CI/CD pipelines, database schema version control (Liquibase or equivalent), Dev/Test/Prod promotion.
* Leadership, mentoring, stakeholder management; ability to work independently in Agile.

**Nice to have**

* Dagster orchestration — for AS‑IS discovery and migration.
* Kafka / event‑driven streaming ingestion.
* Apache Iceberg on S3, Apache Spark/EMR
* Tableau, Metabase serving‑layer knowledge.
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation).
* Data‑governance tooling (Glue Data Quality, Data Zone, Lake Formation).
* UK financial‑services experience IFRS 9, BCBS 239, FCA/PRA reporting, UK GDPR.
* Preparing governed datasets for AI/ML use cases.

The Reconciliation Developer – Officer (C11) is a hands-on technical individual contributor responsible for developing, configuring, testing, and supporting data reconciliations and automated data controls.
  
  
Working under the guidance of senior technical leads, the developer focuses on implementing matching rules, maintaining data feeds, resolving technical breaks, and executing scheduled and ad-hoc reconciliation requests across financial systems and data distribution pipelines.
  
  
**Hybrid Schedule:**
2 or 3 full days per week on-site in the office, with remaining days worked remotely in accordance with enterprise hybrid work policies.
  
  
**Reconciliation Rule Build:**
Configure, test, and maintain multi-way matching rules, tolerance checks, and automated exception routing on enterprise reconciliation platforms (e.g., TLM SmartStream, Duco, Gresham, or internal reconciliation engines).
  
  
**Break Analysis & Triage:**
Investigate reconciliation breaks and discrepancies, identify root causes in data transformations, and apply rule adjustments or fixes.
  
  
**Data Processing & Scripting:**
Write and optimize Python scripts and SQL queries to extract, transform, and load transactional and ledger data into reconciliation engines.
  
  
**Requirements Implementation:**
Review Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and technical specifications to implement mapping rules, data schemas, and validation checks.
  
  
**Data Feed Maintenance**
: Monitor daily reconciliation runs, batch feeds, and automated jobs, ensuring successful data ingestion from upstream systems.
  
  
**Assisting Backlog Remediation:**
Actively deliver user stories and tasks to address the operational backlog of scheduled and ad-hoc reconciliation requests.
  
  
**Testing & Deployment Support:**
Perform unit testing, assist with User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and prepare deployment artifacts using Git and CI/CD pipelines
  
  
**Team Participation:**
Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and backlog refinement sessions within an Agile framework.
  
  
Operational Collaboration: Work closely with operations users, business analysts, and quality assurance testers to clarify requirements and resolve defect tickets.
  
  
**Technology Adoption:**
Learn and apply emerging tools and automation techniques, including data processing utilities (e.g., PySpark, Airflow) and automated anomaly detection workflows.
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field.
* 4-8 years of hands-on software development, data manipulation, or reconciliation configuration experience in Financial Services or IT.
* Solid foundation as a technical individual contributor executing assigned tasks with quality.

* Familiarity with scheduled workflow tools (e.g., Apache Airflow) and messaging/event concepts (e.g., Kafka).
* Exposure to cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, or GCP) is advantageous.

title: Oracle Tech Architecture And Middleware-Oracle Cloud technical-HCM Tech-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Oracle HCM- Technical Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an Oracle HCM Technical Consultant with total experience of 4+ years who can understand business requirement and other technical specifications.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Ability to work with clients to identify business challenges and contribute to client deliverables
* Technical Design, Identification and Implementation of re-usable assets/components
* Identification of root causes and providing necessary technical solution and implementation
* Contribution to process review and improvement
* Deliver PoCs, Mentoring team
* Implement best practices, following development life cycle process

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Should be technically strong on SQL, PLSQL and developing RICE components in Oracle Fusion environment.
* Proficient in BI Publisher and OTBI Reports.
* Proficient in writing HCM Extracts.
* Proficient in preparing HDL files for Data Load.
* Proficient in writing Fast Formulas.
* Should have worked on Data Migration, Integration of Oracle Fusion HCM with third Party Applications.
* Experience in creating HCM Extensions.
* Should have knowledge of Core HR module.
* Experience working on Integrations using webservices/REST Services
* Willing to learn and work on new technologies
* Experience of having worked in a CMMI environment would be a plus
* Should have the ability to collect requirements, build high level design documents, low level design documents, and deployments documents.
* Multi domain expertise and knowledge on other integration tools is an advantage.
* Knowledge on Agile scrum and waterfall methodology
* Strong communication skills both written and verbal
* Any Oracle Certification is an added key advantage.

**What We Look For**

* Must have minimum 4+ years of technical experience with at least 2 years of End-to-End implementations experience)
* Excellent Oracle technical skills with the ability to build HCM Extracts and HCM Data Loader Files.
* Must have experience in functional specifications, OTBI reports and analytics, configuration of Oracle templates in BI Publisher
* Must have experience in Oracle Core HR
* Awareness of OIC would be a plus
* Excellent communication skills, able to discuss technical & functional issues/solutions, in highly escalated situations, with executives, support & customer personnel.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Data Operations Analyst / Team Lead
description:
**Position: Senior Data Operations Analyst / Team Lead**
Location: Chennai - Onsite/Hybrid/Remote
  
Shift Timing: 3.00AM - 12.00PM PST (US Pacific Time)
  
  
**About the role:**
We are seeking a Senior Data Operations Analyst to lead day-to-day operational support for an enterprise data platform. This role will act as the primary operational lead, oversee support queues, manage critical incidents, drive process improvements, and maintain stakeholder communication.

* Drive incident management and root-cause analysis activities.
* Establish operational runbooks and support processes.
* Maintain applications and ownership inventory.
* Generate service performance reports and dashboards.
* Support governance, compliance, and audit requirements related to data access and sensitive information.

* Snowflake
* Power BI
* Qlik
* Data Warehousing concepts
* Incident Management and Service Delivery experience.
* Strong stakeholder management skills.

* Experience supporting healthcare or life sciences customers.
* Exposure to PHI/PII governance and access controls.
* Basic SQL troubleshooting capability.
* Experience building operational dashboards and KPIs.

title: Lead Engineer - Condition Monitoring Systems integration
description:
**Vestas is the world leader in wind technology and a driving force in the development of the wind power industry. Vestas’ core business comprises the development, manufacture, sale, marketing, and maintenance of wind turbines. Come and join us at Vestas!**
**Product Applications & Controls R&D > Modelling & Analytics Module > Plant Monitoring & Reliability**
Plant Monitoring & Reliability Sub Module, within Modelling & Analytics Module (M&A), Part of Vestas Power Solutions, is responsible for the products and services related to Vestas Monitoring and Reliability solutions and offerings. We have a skilled and diverse team that consists of everything from Health Monitoring Engineers/Specialists and Reliability Engineers/Specialists, Data engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Scientists. The department is responsible for developing advanced Plant Monitoring Products & Solutions - Health Monitoring, Condition Monitoring, Power Quality Monitoring, Reliability and VTMs. This ranges across real-time data collection from thousands of power plants with Health Monitoring systems, and data analytics on a Health Monitoring & Reliability setup supporting multiple data applications, Diagnostics, Monitoring solutions for our customers. The goal is to bring down the cost of energy by leveraging the vast amount of data that Vestas collects and stores from power plants around the globe.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement back-end infrastructure systems and processes
* Manage product implementation, communications, and acceptance in the company
* To work on CMS development Projects based on the project requirements
* You will be responsible for industrialize the CMS product to the WTG platform needs
* Develop and improve data collection tools, data quality, methods and processes
* Establish training material/troubleshooting user guides for various stakeholders
* Support Vestas value chain stakeholders & the CMS organization with data analysis, RCA and technical advice
* Collect customer feedback and develop case stories & maintain best practices
* Close engagement with CMS vendor and guiding the continuous development of product requirements
* Deep understanding of the SKF CMS System

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's/Master's / PhD in IT Systems / IoT Systems / Electrical / Mechanical / Data scientist / Similar specialization
* Minimum3+ years of relevant system Integration experience with TCM CMS Systems
* Knowledge on remote monitoring and diagnostics processes and how it works
* Integrator of IT systems (System Integration experience of CMS systems)
* Knowledgeable around IT security, network architecture and IoT systems
* Scripting skills in Python and or similar
* Possess solid statistical skills & data-crunching and data-mining abilities
* Very good working knowledge on database tools like MS-SQL
* Knowledge on DMAIC Six Sigma Methodology

**Competencies**
Ability to interface with diverse groups (scientific teams, developers, business users) and understand end-to-end requirements
  
  
Solid written and oral presentation and communication skills
  
  
Takes initiative. Ability to plan, organize, prioritize tasks and to complete assigned projects with minimal Supervisions
  
  
Systematic problem-solving skills with a solid sense of ownership
  
  
Aptitude to learn new methods and technologies separately and continuously
  
  
**What We Offer**
We offer you the opportunity to leverage your skills and to work in a multicultural and international company, where you have the possibility to improve your skills and develop professionally
  
  
**Additional Information**
Your primary workplace will be in Chennai, India.
  
  
Please note: We do amend or withdraw our jobs and reserve the right to do so at any time, including prior to the advertised closing date. Please be advised to apply on or before 31st October 2026.
  
  
**Our commitment to a fair hiring**
At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.
  
  
**DEIB Statement**
At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.
  
  
**BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process
  
  
**About Vestas**
Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore.
  
  
Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 185 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field.
  
  
With 30,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future.
  
  
Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity.
  
  
To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

title: MS Dynamics Technical- Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**MS Dynamics Technical- Senior Consultant Technical Transformation**
**Enterprise Performance**
Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise package insights and platform technology, working across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations to support delivery of holistic performance improvement and package led large scale digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business insights and collaborate with the businesses as they navigate their enterprise growth and transformation journeys.
  
  
**Level**
: Sr Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As a Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) Technical practitioner at Deloitte USI Consulting Services, you will design, build, and deploy enterprise-scale D365 F&O technical solutions spanning custom development, integrations, data migrations, and reporting, collaborating with cross-functional and global teams to translate client functional and technical requirements into robust, scalable, and high-quality deliverables. You will independently manage technical workstream responsibilities while guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, from estimation and planning through build, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support, ensuring timely delivery of solutions that meet client needs and project delivery standards.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation on the Emerging ERP Solutions team, you will be responsible for designing, building, testing, and supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations technical solutions across the project lifecycle.
  
  

* Design, develop, and support technical solutions in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, including customizations, extensions, reports, and integrations
* Translate business, functional, and integration requirements into scalable technical designs and implementation deliverables
* Support data migration, testing, deployment, cutover, and post-go-live activities across implementation engagements
* Collaborate with functional, integration, onsite, offshore, and client technology teams to support end-to-end solution delivery
* Create technical documentation, resolve defects, and contribute to delivery standards, reuse, and quality across project workstreams

**The team**
The Emerging ERP Solutions offering provides advice, planning, and implementation of Cloud ERP solutions like Workday, MS Dynamics and Infor, featuring built-in industry-specific capabilities. The USI team plays a crucial role throughout the entire engagement lifecycle, from initial pursuits to final delivery. Specializing in Financials and Supply Chain transformations, the team also implements Adaptive Planning Solutions across various industries. Their deep expertise in both technology and domain ensures effective, tailored solutions that drive value and operational excellence for clients.
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Shift Timings:**
11 AM to 8 PM or 2 PM to 11 PM IST as per business requirements
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 6+ years of consulting or relevant industry experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations technical roles
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations technical capabilities including SQL Server Reporting Services, X++, C#, Business Event Framework, web services, Logic Apps, Azure Data Lake, Power Platform, Data Management Framework, workflows, reporting, and integration patterns including file-based integrations, dual-write, virtual entities, and OData
* Experience on at least 1 end-to-end Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations enterprise resource planning implementation project in a technical role
* Experience translating functional and integration requirements into technical designs, integrations, enhancements, and data entity solutions
* Experience with Microsoft Lifecycle Services and Azure DevOps for environment management, source control, build pipelines, and continuous integration/continuous deployment automation
* Experience creating technical design documents, conducting unit testing, supporting test cycles, and resolving technical defects
* Bachelor of Engineering, Bachelor of Technology, Master of Computer Applications, Master of Science in Computer Science, or equivalent degree from an accredited university

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with data migrations and extract, transformation, and load processes
* Experience coordinating end-to-end testing and cutover activities with client technology teams and boundary systems
* Experience designing or implementing security roles, duties, privileges, and permission sets in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations
* Experience with Dataverse for data modeling, integration, and extension of Microsoft Dynamics 365 solutions
* Experience with Copilot agents and artificial intelligence-driven extensions within the Microsoft ecosystem
* Active Microsoft Dynamics certification

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
VNDLY, a Workday company, is a next-generation vendor management SaaS platform designed for procurement executives, talent acquisition teams, suppliers, and Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to optimize contingent workforce management. We develop cloud software that simplifies talent sourcing and acquisition across various channels, including staffing agencies, job boards, and freelance management systems. Our aim is to create intuitive software that enables customers to efficiently acquire top talent (contractors or full-time employees) through data-driven insights and transparent dashboards.
  
  
As part of Workday, we are committed to becoming the most customer-centric enterprise software company in the world. We prioritize enabling our customers to connect to the talent they need to excel, achieved by fostering an exceptional engineering team committed to code quality and innovative design.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Software Development Engineer, you will be joining a team in Chennai responsible for maintaining and building our pay-related features. This is a hands-on-keyboard role where you will not only build features but also own the design, scalability, and resilience of critical services.
  
  
You will tackle complex challenges related to how contingent workers are onboarded, managed, and paid, working on key features like Jobs, Worker Provisioning, Contracts, and Integrations. You will be a key voice in our architectural decisions and will guide the team in building robust solutions using our stack: Python (backend), React (frontend), and AWS.
  
  
**About You**
This role is for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving complex software problems. The ideal candidate will join an established office of 15 VNDLY colleagues and will be at the forefront of building our engineering presence as part of Workday's larger investment in Chennai!
  
  
Beyond a desire for solving complex and writing high-quality, efficient code, this person must be an exceptional communicator, acting as a key technical connection between our established U.S. teams and the new Chennai office. The ability to work independently, while also working effectively within a large, distributed team, is essential.

* 4+ years shown experience in software development, including experience in designing, building, and maintaining RESTful web services and working with SQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Deep proficiency in Python and experience with at least one Python web framework (e.g., Django, Flask).
* Strong experience with JavaScript frameworks, specifically React.js.

**Other Qualifications**

* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools (e.g., Git).
* Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda).
* Knowledge of SaaS applications, multi-tenant architectures, and DevOps/CI/CD practices.
* Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment.

Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans during our application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, contact us at accommodations@workday.com.

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. title: SAP C-ALM
description:
**Position Executive Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Lead SAP Cloud ALM & Enterprise Toolchain Architect**
to define, govern, and operationalize the complete Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) strategy for our global Greenfield SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
  
  
Acting as the single point of accountability for SAP Cloud ALM adoption across all global regions and workstreams, the ideal candidate will establish cross-functional governance, build end-to-end lifecycle traceability, integrate enterprise toolchains, and drive quality engineering across all phases of the SAP Activate framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Core Governance**
  
  

* Cloud ALM Strategy & Governance
* Strategy Definition: Formulate and execute a comprehensive Cloud ALM strategy aligned with SAP Activate methodology across all global rollout templates.
* Governance Framework: Establish and enforce ALM governance standards across requirements gathering, business process hierarchy modeling, testing execution, defect management, deployment controls, and operations.
* Single Accountability: Serve as the central point of contact and accountability for Cloud ALM adoption across global regions, system integrators, and project workstreams.
* Enterprise Toolchain Integration & Traceability
* Toolchain Management: Architect and manage data flows across the integrated ALM toolchain, connecting SAP Cloud ALM with enterprise architecture, modeling, testing, and operational tools.
* End-to-End Lineage: Maintain complete vertical and horizontal traceability across the lifecycle: Business Scope → Process Design → Requirements/User Stories → Development Units → Test Cases → Defects → Transports/Deployments.
* Integration Engineering: Design and implement robust integration and real-time data synchronization between SAP Cloud ALM and enterprise solutions, including:

+ Process Modeling: Signavio
+ Architecture & Capability Mapping: LeanIX
+ Work Management & ITSM: Jira / ServiceNow
+ Test Management: Tricentis, HP ALM, or equivalent
+ Documentation Systems: Confluence, SharePoint

* Solution Enablement & Fit-to-Standard Execution
* Cloud ALM Configuration: Setup and configure SAP Cloud ALM for:

+ Business process hierarchy structure and solution documentation
+ Requirement, scope, and user story management
+ Test planning, script execution, and defect tracking
+ Task management and deployment tracking

* Fit-to-Standard Governance: Enable and support Fit-to-Standard workshops using standard SAP Best Practices content and Cloud ALM pre-delivered scope elements.
* Program Visibility: Design and maintain project scope baselines, milestone tracking, and real-time status dashboards for executive program leadership.
* Test Quality Management
* Test Strategy Formulation: Design and govern the program-wide testing framework (Unit Testing, System Integration Testing [SIT], User Acceptance Testing [UAT], and Regression Testing) inside SAP Cloud ALM.
* Multi-Regional Execution: Coordinate test execution across multi-regional teams, third-party system integrators, and varying time zones.
* Quality KPIs: Provide executive-level reporting on test coverage, defect burn-down rates, quality KPIs, and release readiness dashboards.
* Release, Deployment & Cutover Management
* Release Orchestration: Oversee release planning, deployment tracking, and release governance using Cloud ALM.
* CI/CD & Transport Integration: Connect Cloud ALM with SAP Transport Management and modern CI/CD delivery pipelines where applicable.
* Cutover Execution: Support cutover sequence planning, dependency mapping, and real-time deployment monitoring.
* Integration & Operations Readiness (Run / Hypercare Phase)
* Monitoring Setup: Configure operational monitoring within Cloud ALM, including:

+ Integration & Exception Monitoring
+ Business Process Monitoring
+ Automated Job Monitoring

* Operational Transition: Lead the transition of ALM artifacts from the project phase to Hypercare and steady-state operations (Run phase).
* Alerting & KPIs: Establish operational KPIs, threshold alerts, and health monitoring for steady-state governance.
* Stakeholder Leadership & Vendor Coaching
* Subject Matter Expert (SME): Act as the lead SME for the Program Management Office (PMO), System Integrator partners, SAP, and regional business leaders.
* Enablement & Upskilling: Coach and upskill project team members, functional leads, and regional business units on Cloud ALM best practices and standardized tool usage.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
SAP ALM & Program Expertise
  
  

* 7–10+ years of hands-on SAP implementation experience within large-scale enterprise environments.
* 3+ years direct experience configuring and leading SAP Cloud ALM (or SAP Solution Manager with a proven track record of Cloud ALM transition).
* Strong, practical knowledge of SAP Activate methodology across all project phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
* Proven experience in Greenfield SAP S/4HANA global implementations.

Functional & Technical Knowledge
  
  

* Solid comprehension of core SAP S/4HANA business processes (e.g., Finance, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Logistics).
* Hands-on familiarity with SAP Best Practices content and enterprise process models.
* Working knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g., Tricentis, CBTA).
* Familiarity with SAP integration technologies (SAP BTP, Cloud Integration / CPI) and SAP transport management concepts.

Leadership & Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven track record in stakeholder management within complex, multi-vendor, global environments.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across global teams, time zones, and diverse organizational cultures.
* Highly organized, structured, quality-focused, and proactive mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications (nice To Have)**

* Official SAP Cloud ALM Certification.

title: Director of Engineering, Data Platforms
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
13
  
  
We are seeking a strong technical and people leader to join as
**Director of Engineering, Data Platforms**
for our offshore team in India. In this role, you will partner closely with the core Databricks team to support the transition of existing data pipelines to the target platform, while continuing to refine, enhance, and operationalize those pipelines for scale, quality, reliability, and secure cloud-native delivery on AWS. AWS data engineering practices commonly emphasize automated and orchestrated data flows, metadata-driven pipelines, and alignment to platform guardrails and security controls.
  
  
This leader will manage a small, focused engineering team responsible for supporting offshore platform adoption and enabling asset-agnostic data onboarding into the enterprise data platform. The role is execution-oriented and collaborative in nature, with accountability for high-quality delivery, engineering rigor, and consistent partnership with global stakeholders.
  
  
You will also support integrations with the enterprise data mastering platform to help ensure trusted, standardized, and reusable data flows across the ecosystem. Experience with
**NeoXam DataHub**
is a strong plus, particularly in environments where master, market, reference, risk, and investment data are managed across the full lifecycle—from acquisition through distribution—to create a trusted single source of truth.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who combines hands-on data platform depth with practical team leadership, strong cross-geography collaboration, and experience establishing repeatable cloud data engineering patterns across modern lakehouse and mastering ecosystems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery
  
  

* Partner with the core Databricks team to plan and execute the transition of existing data pipelines to the target data platform.
* Lead the offshore team in enhancing, stabilizing, and optimizing pipelines after transition, with a focus on performance, scalability, maintainability, operational excellence, and secure AWS deployment patterns.
* Drive implementation of repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring across onboarded datasets.
* Ensure pipelines are built and managed in a way that supports long-term platform consistency, reliability, observability, and ease of support.
* Guide the design and operation of cloud-native data pipelines leveraging relevant AWS services such as Amazon S3 for durable storage, AWS Glue for integration and catalog-driven processing, and AWS Lake Formation for governed data lake controls. AWS training and prescriptive guidance for data engineering emphasize building, optimizing, and securing solutions with these services.
* Promote the use of AWS IAM, encryption, and environment-level controls to enforce secure access to platform resources and data products in line with enterprise governance expectations. AWS guidance highlights alignment with architectural guardrails and security controls for data engineering platforms.

Data Onboarding and Asset-Agnostic Enablement
  
  

* Lead a small team responsible for supporting offshore teams with onboarding data to the enterprise platform in an asset-agnostic manner.
* Define and operationalize onboarding patterns that can support a broad range of data assets, domains, and source systems without requiring bespoke platform redesign for each use case.
* Work with partner teams to simplify and standardize how data is ingested, transformed, governed, and published to the platform.
* Help offshore teams adopt common onboarding frameworks, technical standards, and delivery practices that improve speed and reduce friction.
* Establish reusable ingestion and processing patterns across batch and streaming use cases using technologies such as AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, Amazon Kinesis, or event-driven integrations where appropriate to support scalable enterprise onboarding. AWS data engineering curricula and roadmap materials consistently position these services as core building blocks for modern cloud data engineering.

Data Mastering Platform Integration
  
  

* Support integration of platform pipelines and datasets with the enterprise data mastering platform.
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream stakeholders to ensure mastered data can be consumed reliably through standardized interfaces and governed data flows.
* Help establish data quality controls, reconciliation processes, metadata alignment, and stewardship workflows needed to support trusted mastered data in the platform.
* Contribute to issue resolution and continuous improvement related to mastering-related ingestion and distribution workflows.
* Support data mastering capabilities aligned with platforms such as NeoXam DataHub, including data acquisition, cleansing, enrichment, mastering, and downstream distribution of trusted data products. NeoXam positions DataHub as a configurable enterprise data management platform for the financial industry that manages the full lifecycle of master, market, risk, and investment data.
* Work with business and platform stakeholders to support golden record / golden copy generation and maintenance for key financial datasets, including reference data, instruments, business entities, and related mastered domains. NeoXam DataHub is specifically positioned to provide a single source of truth and has been used in financial services environments for enterprise-level golden copy data management.

Team Leadership and Delivery Management
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a small team of data engineers supporting offshore onboarding and pipeline engineering.
* Set clear priorities, manage team execution, and ensure delivery commitments are met with quality and accountability.
* Provide day-to-day coaching, technical guidance, and performance feedback to team members.
* Foster a strong engineering culture centered on collaboration, continuous improvement, documentation, operational discipline, and measurable service ownership.
* Drive engineering rigor across sprint delivery, production readiness, support models, and incident management for business-critical data platforms.

Collaboration, Governance, and Engineering Standards
  
  

* Partner effectively with global platform, architecture, governance, and Databricks-aligned teams to ensure offshore delivery aligns with enterprise standards.
* Contribute to design reviews, implementation planning, and technical discussions related to pipeline architecture, onboarding patterns, cloud platform controls, and mastering integrations.
* Support governance requirements through appropriate controls around lineage, schema consistency, data quality, retention, and secure access.
* Promote adoption of engineering best practices including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and production support readiness.
* Help establish cloud engineering standards for infrastructure as code, release automation, and environment promotion using tools and services such as AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and infrastructure automation frameworks where appropriate.
* Ensure monitoring and operational health practices are in place using logging, alerting, and telemetry patterns appropriate for enterprise data platforms, including AWS-native operational tooling where relevant.

**Required Qualifications**
Leadership and Delivery Experience
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, or related engineering domains.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, preferably in a distributed or offshore delivery model.
* Proven ability to lead a small, high-performing technical team in an execution-focused environment.
* Experience partnering with global or onshore stakeholders to deliver platform and pipeline initiatives across time zones.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience with modern data engineering and pipeline development, including batch and/or streaming data workflows.
* Experience working with Databricks-based data platforms and supporting migration or transition of pipelines into a lakehouse-oriented architecture.
* Strong familiarity with AWS cloud-native data engineering, including services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lambda, AWS Lake Formation, and related orchestration, security, and monitoring capabilities used to build scalable and governed data platforms. AWS training materials for data engineering specifically emphasize designing, building, optimizing, and securing data solutions using AWS services.
* Working knowledge of technologies and concepts referenced in the source profile, such as Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and Databricks Unity Catalog, with the ability to apply them in practical engineering delivery contexts.
* Experience supporting data integration patterns involving mastering, MDM, or trusted data distribution workflows.
* Solid understanding of data quality, schema management, lineage, metadata, access control, and operational support for production data pipelines.
* Experience with AWS IAM, data lake governance, and metadata-driven controls to support secure, policy-aligned platform operations. AWS prescriptive guidance highlights the use of metadata automation, platform guardrails, and security controls in enterprise data engineering.
* Familiarity with engineering best practices such as version control, automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, and monitoring.
* Experience designing or overseeing data platform observability and reliability practices, including alerting, monitoring, and operational dashboards.

Collaboration and Execution
  
  

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across offshore and global teams.
* Ability to translate broader architectural direction into actionable team deliverables and implementation plans.
* Comfortable operating in a role that blends technical leadership, people management, and hands-on delivery oversight.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting enterprise data onboarding frameworks across multiple business domains or asset types.
* Familiarity with enterprise data cataloging or metadata management environments, including integrations involving operational and business metadata platforms.
* Exposure to data mastering, MDM, reference data, market data, investment data, corporate actions, or golden record workflows in financial services environments.
* Knowledge of NeoXam DataHub is a strong plus, particularly for firms using it to centralize financial data, manage the data lifecycle from acquisition to distribution, enable automated workflows, and deliver a single source of truth for mastered datasets.
* Experience with NeoXam-style mastering workflows, including consolidation, cleansing, enrichment, reconciliation, and trusted downstream distribution of mastered data.
* Experience in regulated or complex enterprise environments where data governance, data controls, and auditability requirements are important.
* Databricks certifications, AWS certifications (such as AWS Certified Data Engineer or AWS Certified Solutions Architect), or equivalent practical platform experience are a plus. AWS certification paths remain relevant for modern cloud-native data engineering roles.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

You'll build on top of Saras IQ Product to own the solution and the build for a client requirement - from the first requirements conversation and live customer demos to validated data, one trusted set of metrics, live dashboards, and clean data every morning - as the accountable owner of what gets built as a repeatable product capability.

**About Saras Analytics**

Saras Analytics is an AI and data analytics firm built for ecommerce and omnichannel brands. We help fast growing SMBs and mid-market brands turn disconnected, messy data into decisions — covering ingestion, transformation, and consumption, backed by our own products (Daton and Saras IQ) as the data infrastructure in every engagement.

**Why Now**

Saras is profitable and bootstrapped. We run flat: talent and good ideas move fast here regardless of tenure or title. AI-assisted tooling now lets one engineer take a client from the first requirements conversation to a live, trusted dashboard without waiting on a queue of hand-offs. The Forward Deployed Engineer role is built around that: one owner, end to end, with the tooling to make it fast. Because you build on top of our products rather than around them, what you create for one client requirement becomes capability that every client can use. An FDE joining now helps define what that role looks like at its best.

**The Role**

You'll own the solution and the build for one client account, reporting to an FDE Lead. You build on top of our product, Saras IQ, extending it with software you design and code. You are responsible for interacting directly with the customer — running discovery, demoing what you build, and presenting it to client stakeholders — as well as with the product teams, and you contribute to the product roadmap. Whatever you build, you then become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product: you create repeatable solutions that expand what the product can do and maximize revenue impact. On that account you work alongside a Strategic Account Manager, who owns the client relationship and the commercial outcomes, and a Product Manager, who owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it. You own what gets built and whether it is right — requirements, software, data, metrics, dashboards, and data quality — with our AI-assisted tooling and our SME leads behind you for the hardest problems.

**The Bar**

Speed & Delivery quality are the top priorities for this role: what you ship is correct, validated against the source of truth before the client sees it, and there on the date you committed to. Speed matters because clients feel it — the shortest path from signed-off requirements to a live, trusted dashboard — but never at the cost of numbers the client can rely on. You build to product standard: what you write is well designed, tested, version-controlled, and reusable, because it is part of the product. You surface risks before they block delivery, and you close every issue with a root cause and a fix, you internally escalate the dependencies on time. The lanes are explicit: you own the solution and the build; the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial outcomes; the Product Manager owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Own discovery and requirements.**
Join the sales handover to close open questions and call out risks early. Run discovery sessions directly with client stakeholders on the client's core use cases — sales and marketing, contribution margin, customer cohorts, product and inventory — co-design the solution with them, and write the business requirements and metric definitions using Saras' standard templates, reviewing them internally before client sign-off. Build the mock-ups that let clients react before anything is built, demo working builds live to the client at every milestone and take their feedback directly, write the test cases every requirement will be validated against, and track change requests so scope stays visible to you and the Account Manager.

**2. Own the data build.**
Set up integrations and access with our data-ingestion team, translate requirements into technical specifications, and build the staging, master, and presentation datasets with Saras' AI-assisted data-engineering tools, following our data-model conventions (dbt, BigQuery, Git). Apply PII masking, and keep the data dictionary and lineage documentation current. When a problem goes beyond your account — a complex architecture choice or a platform limit — take it to the senior data-engineering lead with a proposed workaround, and keep ownership of the outcome.

**3. Build on top of the product, end to end.**
You are not only modelling data: you build complete solutions on top of Saras IQ, and that takes software & data engineering & Analytics skills. Design and code the services, APIs, integrations, automation, and application logic around the data layer, and apply sound engineering practice — modular design, code review, automated tests, version control, and CI/CD. Write code that others can maintain and extend, because it may become part of the product.

**4. Turn what you build into product.**
Whatever you build, you become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product. Package it as a repeatable, configurable solution rather than a one-off, document it, and help other FDEs and accounts adopt it, so each engagement expands what the product can do and maximizes its revenue impact.

**5. Own the client's metric definitions.**
Configure one certified set of metrics and dimensions for each client in Saras IQ's semantic layer, so that every dashboard, self-serve question, and AI answer draws on the same definitions.

**6. Own validation before anything reaches the client**
. Reconcile every dataset against its source of truth, certify it, and run the internal sign-off against agreed criteria for sending work back. Set up the data quality and completeness checks, validate against the requirement test cases and against a benchmark set of business questions the AI analyst must answer correctly, then walk the Account Manager through the build in a final review before it goes to the client.

**7. Own the consumption layer.**
Build dashboards natively in Saras IQ (and in Tableau, Luzmo, or Power BI where the contract specifies), drawing their metrics from the client's certified definitions. Build and maintain the business context that powers Saras IQ Analyst, our AI analyst; set it up and provision it for client users in Slack and their AI tools; and keep refining that context from what users ask it. The Account Manager leads the launch and adoption, and the Product Manager leads enablement.

**8. Own data quality every day.**
Run the daily data-quality cycle: confirm the overnight pipelines and checks have completed, resolve what they flag, escalate anything still open — or late upstream data — to the senior data-engineering lead, re-run and re-test what you fixed, and send the client a routine data-quality status (with any help you need from them), copying the Account Manager. Configure latency and dashboard alerts, and close every bug and change request with a root cause and a fix. When an issue breaches its SLA or stays open past a day, the Account Manager takes the client escalation and you drive the fix.

**9. Run your delivery hygiene.**
Keep your onboarding and project documentation, task tracker, and timesheets current, so anyone can see where your account stands.

**10. Partner across the lanes.**
Be the direct technical voice to customers and to the product teams, and contribute to the product roadmap. Support your Account Manager with the technical answers behind success criteria, client acceptance testing, and adoption, and demo what you built and walk client users through its logic yourself, while the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial conversations; work with the Product Manager and the product teams to turn what you hear from customers and learn from your builds into roadmap priorities; and work with our data-ingestion and data-engineering teams to unblock ingestion, data quality, and architecture issues.

**What Winning Looks Like**

**First 90 days:**

you know your account's data and metric definitions in depth, you run the daily data-quality cycle reliably, and you've taken at least one deliverable from signed-off requirements to a validated, live dashboard on your own, demoing it to the client yourself.

**Steady state:**

you deliver datasets and dashboards independently and on the committed date, your validation catches issues before clients ever do, your client's mornings start with clean data, your FDE Lead trusts what you ship without re-checking every number, your teammates enjoy working with you, what you've built is reusable and part of the product, you contribute to the roadmap, and you're ready to own a new account launch end to end.

**Who Thrives Here**

Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them, you bring 3+ years (typically 3–6) of hands-on data and software work — some of it building in SQL and code, and some of it facing clients, including demos.

• You've been a business or data analyst who wrote requirements and specifications, worked hands-on in SQL, and are ready to own the build as well as the brief.

• You've been an analytics or data engineer who built layered data models — raw, staging, masters, presentation — and are ready to own the client conversation as well as the pipeline.

• You've delivered data or BI projects in an analytics consulting or services firm, end to end, directly with clients.

• You've been a software engineer who built backend or full-stack applications and data-heavy products, and are ready to take on analytics, data modelling, and the client conversation.

**Whichever route you come from, you have:**

• A degree from a reputed engineering college.

• Strong SQL and data-modelling fundamentals across the raw → staging → master → presentation layers.

• Software engineering fundamentals: proficiency in Python (or a comparable language such as Java, TypeScript, or Go), data structures, and the ability to write clean, modular, tested, maintainable code.

• Software design skills: you can design the architecture of an end-to-end solution — services, APIs, data flows, and integrations — weigh the trade-offs, and build it to be reusable and extensible.

• Engineering practice: code review, unit and integration testing, CI/CD, and debugging in production. • Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool — Tableau, Power BI, or similar.

• A foundational understanding of statistics — enough to know when a number is meaningful and when it isn't.

• Working knowledge of dbt and BigQuery (or the ability to ramp up quickly), and everyday use of Git.

• Comfort with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or GitHub Copilot — we'll train you on Saras' own tooling.

• The ability to turn an ambiguous client ask into clear, testable requirements and a technical specification.

• Clear, confident client communication — you can own a delivery conversation without a go-between, run live product demos, and present to client and product stakeholders.

• The ability to work with product teams and contribute to a roadmap: you can turn customer needs and what you've built into reusable product capabilities.

**It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:**

• An engineering degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Analytics, or Data Science.

• Ecommerce data fluency: you know how contribution margin, customer cohorts, attribution, and inventory are really calculated — and where the source data misleads.

• Experience with a semantic or metrics layer, or with data-quality and observability frameworks.

• Dashboards you've built that clients actually use, and the instinct for what makes one trustworthy.

• Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• Experience building APIs, integrations, or full-stack applications, and with cloud services (GCP preferred) and containerization.

• You've presented analysis directly to a client or senior stakeholder, not just to your own team.

**Location**

Hyderabad. Standard working hours are noon to 9 PM IST.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses, comprehensive health insurance, relocation support, and ongoing professional development. Saras Analytics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace for all. If you want to own what gets built, end to end, on top of our product, and see it land with the client, then make it part of the product, we want to talk to you.

  ).

  (branching, merging, pull requests).
* **Education:**

****Job Description****
**Specialist, Cloud Data Engineering**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  
A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  
****Role Overview****
We are looking for Software Engineers (SE) who can break down and solve complex problems with a strong motivation to get things done with a boots-on-the-ground, pragmatic mindset! Our engineers own their products end to end and influence the way how our products and technology are deployed to facilitate most aspects of drug discovery impacting hundreds of thousands of patients around the world. We are looking for engineers who can creatively handle complex dependencies and ambiguous requirements, competing business priorities, while producing fit-for-purpose, optimal solutions.
  
  
We are hoping that you are passionate about collaborating across the interface between hard-core software development and research and discovery data analysis.
  
  
Our Engineering team builds core components used by our company's Research Labs’ data analytics, visualization, and management workflows. The analysis tools and pipelines built for data processing by our team in partnership with our scientists aim to accelerate research and the discovery of new therapies for our patients.
  
  
We collect, annotate, analyze petabytes of scientific data (multi-omics, chemistry, imaging, safety) used in biomarker research, drug safety/efficacy, drug target discovery, and compendium diagnostic development. We help our scientists to process, analyze scientific data at scale by developing highly parallelized analytical workflows ran on HPC infrastructure (on-prem & cloud); to manage, explore and visualize various scientific data modalities by developing bespoke data models, bioinformatics ETL processes, data retrieval and visualization services using distributed micro-service architecture, FAIR data principles, SPA type dashboards, industry specific regulatory compliant data integrity, auditing, and security access controls.
  
  
We are a creative and disciplined software engineering team, using agile practices and established technology stacks to design and develop large-scale data analytics, visualization, and management software solutions for local and on-cloud hosted HPC datacenters, as well as to integrate 3rd party analytical platforms with internal data workflows to address pressing engineering and data science challenges of life-science.
  
  
****What Will You Do In This Role****

* Engineering support of day-to-day activities/needs in our infrastructure.
* Execute scientific pipelines, support data movement.
* Promote and help with the adoption of development, design, architecture, and DevOps best practices, with a particular focus on agile deliver mindset .
* Manage technical and business dependencies and bottlenecks; balance technical constraints with business requirements; and deliver maximum business impact with solid customer experience.
* Strong collaboration, organization skills in cross-functional teams; ability to effectively communicate with technical and non-technical audiences; work closely with scientists, peers, and business leaders in different geographical locations to define and deliver complex engineering features.

****What Should You Have****

* BS or MS in Computer Science/engineering or equivalent technical field.
* 3 to 6 years of experience in Cloud Data Engineering.

****Required Skills****

* Proficient (3+ years hands-on experience) with Python.
* Proven ability (3+ years hands-on experience).
* Data manipulation using Linux command line tools, batch processing.
* Large data processing, data consistency validation.
* Experience with bioinformation pipeline, data formats (FastQ, BAM) is huge advantage.
* Experience with AWS CLI for data manipulation (aws cli, boto3..).
* Experience with AWS filesystem (s3, efs, ebs).
* Experience with Linux filesystems (nfs).

****Primary Skills (Must Have)****

* Python (3+ years hands-on experience)
* Linux Command Line Tools
* Large-Scale Data Processing
* Data Consistency Validation
* Scientific/Data Pipeline Support
* AWS CLI (AWS CLI, Boto3)
* AWS Storage Services (S3, EFS, EBS)
* Linux File Systems (NFS)
* Data Movement & Infrastructure Support

****Secondary Skills (Nice To Have)****

* Bioinformatics Pipelines
* FastQ & BAM Data Formats
* with using IaC frameworks (CloudFormation, Ansible, Terraform)
* AWS compute services (ec2, lambda)
* Data Engineering
* DevOps Practices
* Agile Development
* Batch Processing
* Strong collaborator, communicator,
* Strong problem-solving skills
* Experienced with making technical partnerships with research and business teams.

****Who We Are****
We are known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the world's most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  
****What We Look For****
Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

title: Contract Position : WebApps Systems Administration Specialist
description:
Experience: 5 - 19 years

WebApps Middleware - Web & Application Server Administrator
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
NTT DATA is seeking --years of Web & Middleware Administrator is responsible for installing, configuring, securing, optimizing, and supporting enterprise grade web servers, application servers, and middleware platforms across on premise and cloud environments. This role ensures highly available, scalable, and secure hosting for business applications while collaborating closely with development, security, DevOps, cloud, and infrastructure teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Web Server Administration (Apache HTTP, IBM IHS, NGINX, IIS)

Install, configure, and maintain Apache HTTP, IBM IHS, NGINX, and IIS across Linux/Windows environments.
  
  
Configure virtual hosts, reverse proxies, load balancing, SSL/TLS, mod\_security, mod\_jk/mod\_proxy, WAF rules, and request routing.
  
  
Manage certificates, keystores, aliasing, and automated certificate renewals.
  
  
Implement hardening guidelines (headers, ciphers, rate limits, firewall rules).
  
  
Monitor web traffic patterns, tune performance, and troubleshoot HTTP/HTTPS/SSL issues.
  
  

* Java Application Server Administration (WebLogic, WebSphere, JBoss, Tomcat, Oracle AS)

Install, configure, patch, and upgrade Oracle WebLogic, IBM WebSphere, JBoss EAP/WildFly, Apache Tomcat, and Oracle Application Server.
  
  
Manage JVM tuning, heap sizing, thread pools, JDBC data sources, JMS resources, session replication, and clusters.
  
  
Deploy EAR/WAR/JAR applications manually and via CI/CD pipelines.
  
  
Troubleshoot application issues: classloader conflicts, memory leaks, thread dumps, GC tuning, connection pool bottlenecks.
  
  
Configure multi node clustering, domain creation, admin nodes, managed servers, and load balancers.
  
  
Set up security realms, LDAP/AD integration, JAAS, J2EE/Jakarta EE security policies.
  
  

* Performance Engineering & Monitoring

Configure and optimize caching, compression, keep alive, connection handling, request limits, and tuning parameters.
  
  
Monitor JVM performance, GC logs, thread/heap usage, and server KPIs.
  
  
Use monitoring tools (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Prometheus/Grafana, Splunk/ELK).
  
  

* Automation, DevOps & CI/CD Support

Automate server builds, deployments, and configurations using Shell, Python, PowerShell, Ansible, or Jenkins pipelines.
  
  
Integrate web/app servers with CI/CD (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins).
  
  
Maintain configuration-as-code for repeatable and compliant deployments.
  
  

* Security, Compliance & Hardening

Implement SSL/TLS, certificate rotation, PKI, keystore/truststore management.
  
  
Apply CIS, OWASP, STIG, and organization hardening benchmarks.
  
  
Manage access controls, RBAC, authentication modules, and secure admin interfaces.
  
  
Patch vulnerabilities, perform upgrades, and support security audits.
  
  

* High Availability, DR & Scalability

Set up clustering & load balancing for WebLogic, WebSphere, JBoss, Tomcat, and NGINX/IHS/IIS.
  
  
Manage horizontal/vertical scaling strategies.
  
  
Build and maintain DR environments, backups, replication, and failover testing.
  
  

* Troubleshooting & Operational Support

Diagnose issues across layers: OS, network, DNS, load balancing, reverse proxy, JVM, application code, backend integration.
  
  
Manage incident response, RCA, and preventive actions.
  
  
Provide 24×7 on call support (if required).
