title: Senior SAP Basis and Security Administration Engineer
description:
**Business Unit:**
Cubic Corporation
  
  
**Company Details:**
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior SAP Basis Administration Engineer to support the administration, security execution, and integration maintenance for our SAP ECC 6.0 on HANA landscape under the direction of the SAP Basis & Security Manager. Our SAP infrastructure is hosted and managed by a third-party hosting/managed-services hosting partner, so this role is heavily focused on technical oversight, working with hosting partner governance, and ensuring the hosting partner executes Basis operations to our standards. This is an equally weighted Basis and Security role: the ideal candidate has deep SAP ECC/HANA Basis expertise and hands-on ownership of SAP security administration, plus proven experience configuring integrations using PI/PO, SFTP, cloud-based integration agents and supporting enterprise archiving workflow.
  
  
**Job Details:**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
SAP Basis Administration (Hosting Partner Environment)
  
  

* Execute and coordinate day-to-day technical operational interactions with the third-party hosting partner for all SAP ECC 6.0 on HANA Basis activities — driving accountability.
* Support patch, kernel upgrade, and support pack revision update, and system enhancement initiatives following established governance and architecture.
* Work with SAP functional and technical teams to support systems refreshes, client copies, transport management, and landscape maintenance.
* Relentlessly monitor SAP ECC/HANA system performance, verify hosting partner SLAs (performance, availability, response times), and escalate issues to internal leadership when standards slip.
* Perform systems performance analysis and capacity trending. Analyze usage patterns, system headroom, and assist in executing database archiving strategies and capacity plans per lead direction.
* Support disaster recovery planning, testing (backup/restore, HANA system replication/HSR, failover), and validation activities to ensure business continuity readiness.
* Maintain rigorous operational documentation, execution logs, and internal oversight records.

SAP Security Administration
  
  

* Maintain and support the SAP authorization concept — roles, composite roles, profiles, and organizational-level restrictions — across the ECC 6.0/HANA landscape in accordance with established security policies.
* Execute user access lifecycle management, including provisioning, de-provisioning, access recertification, and enforcement of least-privilege principles across all clients and environments (Dev/QA/Prod).
* Drive Perform segregation of duties (SoD) analysis and remediation, proactively identifying and resolving conflicting access before it becomes an audit finding, and maintaining a clean SoD ruleset aligned to business risk.
* Support Internal Audit, InfoSec, and external auditors on all SAP security assessments.
* Proactively monitor for anomalous access patterns, dormant accounts, and emerging authorization risk, bringing forward remediation plans before issues are flagged externally.
* Define, document, and enforce SAP security standards, naming conventions, and role-build methodology, ensuring consistency and auditability across the entire authorization landscape.

Integration Configuration
  
  

* Configure and support of interfaces built on SAP PI/PO (IDoc, RFC, SOAP, REST, File adapters), driving configuration, proactive monitoring, and rapid troubleshooting across every SAP-to-third-party connection.
* Support and maintain SFTP-based data exchange processes, including connection monitoring, key/credential management, SSL/TLS certificate updates, and coordinating network/firewall changes with the hosting partner.
* Practical experience on SAP SAML configuration.
* Configure, maintain, and support cloud-based integration agents/connectors (e.g., SAP Cloud Connector or equivalent middleware agents), ensuring a secure, reliable bridge between the hosting partner's ECC environment and cloud/third-party applications.
* Guarantee that integration channels remain secure, thoroughly documented, and resilient against disruption from hosting partner-side changes (e.g., patching, network reconfiguration) — anticipating issues before they impact the business.
* Support enterprise background processing and automated workflows (e.g., SAP Redwood job schedulers).

**Required Qualifications**
Basis and Security
  
  

* 5-7 years of hands-on SAP Basis and security administration experience, including at least 2–3 years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Strong, specific experience with SAP ECC 6.0 on HANA — architecture, transport management, and system landscape design.
* Working knowledge of HANA database administration concepts and SLT.
* Proven ownership of SAP authorization concepts across a large, complex landscape, including experience leading audit responses and access recertification cycles.
* Experience working with SLA management and change governance.
* Experience in executing archiving large tables and overall systems performance tuning.
* Practical experience setting up and maintaining SFTP connections for secure file-based integrations.
* Experience configuring and managing cloud-based integration agents (e.g., SAP Cloud Connector or similar).
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and documentation skills, with the ability to assess hosting-partner-delivered work critically.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of SAP best-practice data archiving strategies (e.g., SARA/archive object configuration, retention policies, and database growth management) to support long-term system performance and storage optimization.
* Experience with enterprise job scheduling systems (e.g., SAP Redwood CPS/BPA).
* Exposure to OpenText solutions (Vendor Invoice Management / VIM, Content Server, or Archive Center).
* Experience with tax system interface maintenance (e.g., Vertex updates/patching).
* Familiarity supporting connections to enterprise cloud integration and analytics tools (e.g., Workato, Palantir connectors, Tableau, Alteryx, BOBJ).
* SAP certification(s) in Basis, Security, or Integration technologies.
* Experience with SAP GRC Access Control (Access Risk Analysis, Emergency Access Management, Access Request Management) and automated access review tools.
* Experience and knowledge in PI/PO a plus,

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, India
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
  
  
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.
  
  
**About The Role**
Notion is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer focused on migrations to join our growing team in India. You will help deliver complex, production-grade data migrations, integrations, and automations for customers across APAC.
  
  
This is initially an internally focused, hands-on engineering role. You will partner closely with regional Forward Deployed Engineers, who own customer discovery, solution architecture, stakeholder communication, risk management, and final customer validation. You will own the behind-the-scenes technical execution layer from feasibility assessment and implementation through testing, production rollout, QA, reconciliation, reporting, and operational handoff.
  
  
You will work across multiple customer environments and source systems, often with incomplete requirements, imperfect data, and real-world constraints. Success requires strong engineering fundamentals, sound judgment, careful validation, and the ability to turn one-off delivery work into reusable tools and repeatable playbooks.
  
  
As a founding engineer in India, you will help build a new regional engineering capability from the ground up. You will create migration infrastructure, standards, and reusable tooling used by FDEs across APAC, while establishing practices that can scale globally. The role offers an opportunity to become a technical authority for production migration delivery, shaping how Notion approaches reliability, validation, and operational quality across complex customer environments. As the team grows, the role may also expand toward customer-facing FDE work, technical leadership, or a deeper engineering path, depending on business needs and demonstrated capability.
  
  
**What You'll Achieve**

* Own the technical execution layer after customer requirements, scope, and solution architecture have been established with the regional FDE. Contribute to feasibility assessment, estimation, implementation planning, and risk identification while the regional FDE remains accountable for customer discovery, scope, architecture, stakeholder communication, and final acceptance.
* Apply a repeatable migration lifecycle covering source inventory and sampling, scope and pruning decisions, compatibility and degradation assessment, transformation design, pilot or dry run, user acceptance testing, production cutover, reconciliation, remediation, hypercare, and documented handoff.
* Translate approved customer and regional FDE requirements into clear technical designs, implementation plans, test strategies, runbooks, and delivery estimates.
* Build production-quality migration utilities, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, and automations using Python, SQL, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.
* Investigate source-system behavior, data quality issues, permissions, rate limits, authentication constraints, and edge cases, then recommend practical solutions.
* Design and validate permissions, ownership, and inheritance mappings against the approved migration plan. Make unsupported or ambiguous access requirements explicit, obtain the required decision or approval, and preserve evidence of validation.
* Design migrations for reliability, scale, security, observability, idempotency, failure recovery, and safe reruns.
* Execute migrations only through approved environments, devices, accounts, and tooling. Follow least-privilege access, customer-specific security and data-residency requirements, and approved handling procedures. Do not store customer data in unmanaged local or external systems, and escalate privacy, security, or sovereignty concerns before execution.
* Build validation and reconciliation frameworks that provide clear evidence of migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions.
* Debug failures across application code, infrastructure, customer data, third-party systems, and the Notion platform, then drive issues through resolution.
* Manage multiple implementation workstreams, dependencies, and priorities while communicating scope, progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly.
* Surface scope changes, unsupported requirements, timeline risks, and material effort increases early. Document assumptions and trade-offs, and escalate with options and a recommended path rather than silently absorbing additional work.
* Maintain an auditable record of scope, decisions, risks, approvals, validation evidence, and customer acceptance criteria in the agreed shared workspace or channel.
* Convert repeated delivery patterns into reusable components, automation, documentation, and playbooks that improve speed, quality, and cost over time.
* Bring field learnings back to Notion's Product and Engineering teams as actionable platform feedback and technical requirements.

**Skills You'll Need To Bring**

* 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in backend engineering, data engineering, integration engineering, implementation engineering, technical consulting, solutions engineering, or a similar technical role.
* Strong hands-on Python development experience.
* Working experience with Node.js, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational databases, data modeling, and data transformation.
* Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, authentication, webhooks, and system integrations.
* Experience owning a production migration, integration, or technical implementation through mapping, transformation, testing, rollout, validation, and handoff.
* Experience taking a technical problem from requirements and design through development, testing, deployment, and production operation.
* Experience with Git, code review, automated testing, release practices, and production deployment.
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills across code, data, infrastructure, and external systems.
* Evidence of working on production systems, not only prototypes or proof-of-concept projects.
* Clear written and verbal English communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions, constraints, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* High agency and ownership. You are comfortable making progress with incomplete information, challenging assumptions, and escalating with options and a recommendation.

**Nice To Haves**

* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, job orchestration, or infrastructure automation.
* Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Familiarity with message queues, event-driven systems, distributed-system patterns, retries, concurrency, and rate limits.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, or other observability tools.
* Experience with enterprise SaaS applications, professional services, or large-scale customer implementations.
* Experience migrating large volumes of content or structured data between enterprise platforms.
* Experience with AI or LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, or agentic workflows.
* Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, Notion Workers, Custom Agents, or similar extensibility platforms.
* Experience working with distributed global or APAC teams.

**What Success Looks Like**
**In your first 90 days, you will:**

* Learn Notion's migration and implementation ecosystem, engineering standards, and APAC delivery model.
* Establish a productive working rhythm with regional FDE partners.
* Contribute to at least one migration or integration workstream through production delivery.
* Leave behind clear technical documentation, validation evidence, and an operational runbook.

**Within Your First Six Months, You Will**

* Independently own production migration or integration workstreams from technical design through rollout and handoff.
* Deliver measurable improvements in migration turnaround time, validation quality, delivery cost, or regional FDE execution hours through reusable engineering.
* Help establish repeatable quality controls, code review practices, runbooks, and observability patterns for the India team.
* Demonstrate effective prioritization and communication across multiple concurrent APAC engagements.
* Turn at least one repeated delivery pattern into a reusable tool, component, or playbook that is adopted by a subsequent engagement.

description:
**Overview**
The Data (Master & Transactional) Quality Lead will act as a subject matter expert and individual contributor, enforcing Enterprise Data Management standards and governance practices to ensure successful business transformations across SAP S/4HANA programs.
  
  
The role will be responsible for driving end-to-end data quality, migration validation, and reconciliation activities for both Master Data and Transactional Data throughout the migration lifecycle. This includes data readiness assessments, migration quality controls, pre- and post-load validations, defect management, and business sign-off support. The individual will work closely with Data Migration, Functional, Technical, and Business teams to ensure migrated data is complete, accurate, reconciled, and aligned with Global Template standards.
  
  
Experience in SAP S/4HANA Data Migration programs, particularly in data validation and post-migration validation activities, is essential. Exposure to SNP CrystalBridge migration and validation solutions is highly desirable.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead data quality and validation activities across SAP S/4HANA migration programs.
* Define and execute validation strategies for Master Data and Transactional Data throughout mock cycles, dress rehearsals, and production cutovers.
* Partner with Data Migration and Data Validation teams to ensure completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity of migrated data.
* Establish and execute reconciliation frameworks including record counts, financial balancing, business process validations, and exception reporting.
* Manage questions and provide clear direction to development and validation teams during solution build, testing, and deployment phases.
* Monitor data quality metrics, identify issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive remediation activities.
* Work with Global teams to implement new validation patterns, controls, and automation opportunities.
* Maintain overall migration validation trackers, reporting dashboards, and conversion readiness statistics.
* Collaborate with business process teams (OTC, P2P, RTR, MTD, etc.) and data owners to validate business-critical data and transactions.
* Support cutover planning, mock migrations, dress rehearsals, hypercare, and post-go-live validation activities.
* Ensure global data standards, governance policies, and target-state data models are consistently adopted across deployments.
* Drive continuous improvement of migration validation processes, tools, and quality assurance methodologies.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelor’s degree is required. Computer Science or Information Systems is preferred..
* Minimum 10 years of experience in ERP transformation programs with a strong focus on Data Management, Data Migration, Data Quality, and Data Validation.
* Proven experience in at least 3 end-to-end SAP ERP/ECC to SAP S/4HANA migration programs.
* Extensive hands-on experience in migration validation and post-migration reconciliation of both Master Data and Transactional Data.
* Strong understanding of SAP data models including Customer, Vendor, Material, Finance, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing domains.
* Experience defining and executing:

+ Data Completeness Validations
+ Data Reconciliation Processes
+ Record Count Validations
+ Financial Reconciliations
+ Business Process Validations
+ Data Quality Assessments

* Experience working with large-scale datasets and enterprise migration tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate and resolve complex data issues.
* Experience collaborating with global business stakeholders, data owners, and functional teams.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**GENERAL DESCRIPTION**

The Business Intelligence (BI) Senior Analyst partners with business stakeholders to transform data into actionable insights that drive strategic and operational decision-making. This role blends data analysis, visualization, and business acumen to design scalable reporting solutions, ensure data quality, and enable self-service analytics across the organization.
  

The BI Senior Analyst serves as a trusted advisor and liaison between business units and technical teams, translating business needs into data requirements, developing dashboards and data models, and promoting data literacy. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, detail-oriented, and experienced in modern BI tools, data warehousing concepts, and data governance practices.

* Partner with business stakeholders to identify reporting and analytics needs aligned with strategic objectives
* Conduct discovery sessions, workshops, and interviews to gather and document requirements
* Translate business questions into technical specifications, KPIs, and data definitions
* Act as the primary BI point of contact for assigned business domains

**2. Data Analysis & Insights Generation (25%)**

* Analyze large, complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities
* Perform exploratory data analysis and root cause investigations
* Deliver actionable insights and recommendations to improve business performance
* Apply statistical methods and analytical techniques where appropriate

* Extract, transform, and analyze data from data warehouses and multiple sources using SQL and other querying tools
* Validate data accuracy, consistency, and completeness across systems
* Collaborate with data engineering teams on data pipelines, data models, and ETL processes

**5. Data Governance & Quality (5%)**

* Support data governance initiatives including data definitions, lineage, and cataloging
* Ensure compliance with data standards, security policies, and regulatory requirements
* Identify and resolve data quality issues and implement controls to prevent recurrence

**6. Product & Process Improvement (5%)**

* Evaluate internal and external data products to identify opportunities for innovation and efficiency
* Participate in product development lifecycle (Agile ceremonies, backlog grooming, sprint planning)

* Present findings and recommendations to leadership in a clear and compelling manner
* Translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly language
* Prepare executive-level summaries, scorecards, and performance reports

* Advanced SQL skills and experience working with structured and semi-structured data
* Ability to connect business context with analytical outputs

**Communication & Business Acumen**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to influence stakeholders and drive data-driven decision-making
* Skilled in data storytelling and presenting insights to non-technical audiences

Star Union Dai-ichi Life Insurance (SUD Life) is a joint venture formed in 2007 between two major Indian PSU banks - Bank of India and Union Bank of India - and Japan's Dai-ichi Life Holdings.
  
  
We have served over 15 million customers through more than 19,500 bank branches across India. Our network includes 1,950 rural bank branches, ensuring insurance reaches remote areas.
  
  
SUD Life focuses on creating insurance products that meet different customer needs across all segments of society. With our promoters' 100+ years of commitment and combined strengths, we aim to become a leading name in India's life insurance sector while delivering value to all stakeholders.
  
  
Established in 1902, Dai-ichi Life is the second largest life insurance company of Japan and is one of the top ten life insurers globally, renowned for sound product knowledge, superior asset management skills, and strong operational capabilities to manage life insurance businesses.
  
  
At SUD Life, our customers are our priority. We are committed to providing insurance products that serve our customers’ unique needs across various strata of society and geographies.
  
  
The promoters of SUD Life have a long-term commitment towards their customers and stakeholder. These strengths and values have been inherited by SUD Life, as we make our way to becoming the next rising star in the Indian life insurance business, promising exceptional value to all.
  
  
**To Know More About Us Please Visit:**
Our Website: https://www.sudlife.in/
  
  
Our LinkedIn Page: https://www.linkedin.com/company/13201422
  
  
**Our Talent Philosophy**
At Star Union Dai-ichi Life Insurance, we will ensure to nurture our people and provide opportunities to learn, succeed and build careers to the best of their abilities, thus creating and unlocking value for self, the organization, and the society at large.
  
  
****About The Role****
**Function:**
IT – Data & AI
  
  
**Role:**
Data Engineer (Data Warehouse, Power BI & API Development)
  
  
**Experience:**
4–7 years
  
  
**Location:**
Navi Mumbai
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
****Job Overview:****
The incumbent will be responsible for the design, development, modernization, integration and production support of enterprise data and analytics platforms, covering On-Premises DWH, Microsoft Fabric, API/application services, Power BI, semantic models and analytics.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on capabilities across the complete technology lifecycle:
  
  
Source Systems → APIs & Integration → DWH/Fabric → Semantic Layer → Power BI/MIS
  
  
The candidate should be capable of building enterprise-grade solutions while ensuring scalability, performance, security, data quality, automation, monitoring and production reliability.
  
  

* DWH – On-Premises & Microsoft Fabric

****Key Responsibilities****

* Design, develop and support enterprise data warehouse solutions across On-Premises and Microsoft Fabric.
* Build scalable ETL/ELT and data-integration frameworks for structured and semi-structured enterprise data.
* Design Lakehouse, Warehouse and Medallion architecture patterns based on solution requirements.
* Develop and maintain ingestion, transformation and orchestration pipelines.
* Build curated data layers for operational MIS, regulatory reporting, management reporting, Power BI, APIs consumption.
* Perform complex data transformation using SQL/T-SQL, Spark/PySpark and Fabric-native technologies.
* Modernize/migrate existing on-premises data warehouse workloads to Microsoft Fabric.
* Implement data validation, reconciliation and data-quality controls.
* Perform performance optimization of SQL, pipelines, data models and Fabric workloads.
* Monitor DWH jobs, pipelines and production data processing, including root-cause analysis of failures.
* Implement appropriate security, access control, governance, deployment and monitoring practices.
* API Development & Application Support

This should be treated as an
**equal core capability to DWH/Fabric**
, rather than a secondary integration skill.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Design, develop, enhance and support enterprise APIs and data/application integration services.
* Build RESTful APIs and services for integration between enterprise applications, DWH, analytics platforms and downstream consumer systems.
* Design reusable and scalable integration services.
* Implement authentication, authorization, validation, structured logging and appropriate error handling.
* Support APIs used by customer-facing and internal enterprise applications.
* Perform L2/L3 production support and root-cause analysis for APIs and data-related applications.
* Investigate API failures, performance degradation, integration issues and data discrepancies.
* Maintain API documentation and interface specifications.
* Manage API testing, release, deployment and post-production monitoring.
* Coordinate with application, infrastructure, database, security, vendor and business teams during incident resolution.
* Develop APIs/services for data consumption by digital channels, enterprise applications
* Power BI Dashboard Development

****Key Responsibilities****

* Design and develop enterprise-grade Power BI dashboards and analytical reports.
* Convert complex business requirements into intuitive management and operational dashboards.
* Develop KPIs, measures, calculations, drill-through and analytical views.
* Implement advanced DAX calculations.
* Optimize dashboard performance and user experience.
* Develop reports connecting to Microsoft Fabric and enterprise data sources.
* Modernize legacy/static MIS into Power BI solutions where appropriate.
* Implement Row-Level Security and appropriate report access controls.
* Troubleshoot production dashboard and refresh issues.
* Support report deployment, versioning and lifecycle management.
* Semantic Model Design & Development

****Key Responsibilities****

* Design enterprise semantic models as the standardized consumption layer between enterprise data and reporting.
* Develop reusable dimensions, measures, calculations, relationships and hierarchies.
* Establish common KPI definitions and business logic across reports.
* Develop scalable star-schema-based semantic models.
* Implement advanced DAX measures and calculation logic.
* Optimize semantic models for performance and scalability.
* Support Direct Lake, Import and DirectQuery scenarios based on appropriate architecture.
* Implement model-level data security.
* Reduce duplicated business logic across individual dashboards.
* Make semantic models suitable for Power BI, self-service analytics.

****Core Technical Skills Required:****
**CData Engineering & Analytics**

* Microsoft Fabric
* SQL Server, T-SQL
* Data Warehousing (DWH)
* Lakehouse & Warehouse Architecture
* OneLake
* ETL/ELT Development
* Data Factory & Data Pipelines
* Power BI
* DAX
* Semantic Models

**Modern Data Engineering & AI Enablement**

* PySpark, Apache Spark
* Delta Lake & Parquet
* Medallion Architecture
* Fabric Notebooks
* Direct Lake
* Real-Time Intelligence
* Kusto Query Language (KQL)
* Python
* Microsoft Fabric Data Agents
* Copilot Studio
* Microsoft Foundry
* LLM Concepts
* MCP (Model Context Protocol) Awareness
* Conversational Analytics

**API & Integration Engineering**

* Java
* Spring Boot
* REST APIs
* Microservices Architecture
* OpenAPI / Swagger
* JPA / Hibernate
* JSON
* GraphQL
* OAuth 2.0
* JWT Authentication
* Microsoft Entra ID
* API Management Concepts

**DevOps, Monitoring & Production Support**

* Git
* CI/CD Pipelines
* Deployment Automation
* API Testing
* Monitoring & Observability
* Logging & Diagnostics
* Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* Performance Tuning & Optimization
* L2/L3 Production Support

****Qualification & Experience:****

* 4–7+ years overall experience in Data Engineering, DWH, BI, API/Application Development or related technologies.
* Strong hands-on experience in DWH and enterprise API/application development.
* Strong working knowledge of the Microsoft data and analytics technology stack.
* Experience in production support, performance troubleshooting and RCA.
* Experience modernizing legacy/on-premises solutions to cloud/data-platform architectures.
* Experience working with business, technology, infrastructure and vendor stakeholders.

title: Risk Architecture Associate
description:
**Job Description**
The candidate will be responsible for building data monitoring & controls primarily for Risk Decision Engines and Third-party services within Consumer & Community Banking. The candidate will be expected to have a detailed understanding of system requirements, data quality and lineage controls. The candidate is will also be responsible for data monitoring and reporting and supporting post implementation validations during releases for any changes made to decision engines to ensure accuracy of decisioning and support root cause analysis in case of production issues or defects.
  
  
A balance of initiative, leadership, influence, and matrixed management skills are important success factors for this role. The right candidate will be comfortable working independently or as part of small project teams. S/he has strong analytical skills, is highly confident and possesses strong communication skills.
  
  
This is a critical role and will require both technical and analytical skills and the ability to engage with stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Data Quality & Risk Management: Design, validate, and monitor data quality controls and detective controls to mitigate risks arising from decision engine, strategy, and system changes.
* Data Analysis & Validation: Leverage SAS, SQL, Python, and reporting tools to analyze large datasets, perform reconciliations, trend analysis, outlier detection, and post-implementation validations.
* Stakeholder Collaboration & Issue Resolution: Partner with business, technology, and risk stakeholders to gather requirements, define business rules, investigate production issues, and drive resolution and process improvements.
* Automation & Governance: Lead reporting and monitoring automation initiatives, maintain documentation and lineage controls, and ensure compliance with risk governance, RCSA, and control requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Strong programming and database skills, including SAS, SQL, Python, and experience with Oracle, Teradata, or similar platforms.
* Solid analytical and problem-solving abilities with expertise in data analysis, data warehousing, and data quality management.
* Hands-on experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, QlikView, Alteryx, and the Big Data ecosystem.
* Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Experience working in Agile frameworks, managing time-sensitive deliverables, and maintaining a high level of attention to detail.

Morgan and Chase brands. Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.

title: Senior MERN Stack Engineer
description:
**Senior MERN Stack Engineer**

**Location:**
Remote (India)

**Experience:**
5–9 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Full Stack Engineer**
to take end-to-end ownership of an enterprise Talent Development Platform. The role involves building and maintaining scalable frontend and backend applications, managing production databases, developing enterprise integrations, and ensuring application security, performance, and reliability.

You will work across the entire product lifecycle, from requirement analysis and architecture to development, testing, deployment, and production support. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience owning a live, multi-tenant B2B SaaS application and can balance rapid feature delivery with technical quality, security, and maintainability.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance frontend and backend applications using React, TypeScript, Node.js, Drizzle ORM, and PostgreSQL.
* Own PostgreSQL database design and production readiness, including schema changes, migrations, indexing, transactions, performance optimization, and row-level security (RLS).
* Build secure REST APIs, backend services, validation mechanisms, authorization workflows, and multi-tenant functionality.
* Develop enterprise integrations, including inbound webhooks, identity integrations, bulk employee and organization imports, background jobs, file storage, and notification services.
* Maintain and enhance product experiences for employees, managers, HR teams, and executives.
* Develop features across competency management, assessments, development plans, evidence tracking, coaching, reassessment, and workforce intelligence.
* Manage day-to-day application CI/CD operations, deployment workflows, and release readiness.
* Implement observability, health checks, structured logging, error handling, and production diagnostics.
* Ensure complete English and Arabic language support, including right-to-left (RTL) layouts wherever applicable.
* Implement AI-powered features with structured outputs, usage controls, validation, auditability, and safe failure handling.
* Review and validate AI-generated code before merging or deploying it to production.
* Write and maintain automated tests covering business logic, authorization, database operations, tenant isolation, and critical user journeys.
* Troubleshoot production issues, investigate regressions and performance bottlenecks, and perform root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with the Integration Lead to develop reusable integration capabilities and implement client-specific product enhancements.
* Maintain clean architecture, promote code reusability, and prevent unnecessary technical debt or duplication of models and workflows.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–9 years of experience in full-stack software development.
* At least 2 years of experience as a Senior or Lead Engineer with significant ownership of a production-grade, multi-tenant B2B SaaS application.
* Strong hands-on experience with React and TypeScript.
* Proficiency in Node.js backend development and API design.
* Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and SQL, including database design, schema migrations, indexing, transactions, and performance troubleshooting.
* Practical experience implementing authorization, tenant isolation, and database-level or policy-based access controls.
* Experience building REST APIs, webhooks, scheduled tasks, background jobs, and third-party integrations.
* Strong automated testing practices across unit, integration, security, and database-backed workflows.
* Experience with Git, GitHub, Docker, and day-to-day CI/CD operations.
* Working knowledge of cloud deployments, application monitoring, observability, production troubleshooting, and incident support.
* Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS security, idempotency, auditability, and secure secret management.
* Ability to critically evaluate AI-assisted and AI-generated code, with a strong focus on correctness, security, and maintainability.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of features from requirements through deployment and production support.

**Good to Have**

* Experience with Drizzle ORM and PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS).
* Experience with MySQL-to-PostgreSQL migration or production database cutovers.
* Background in B2B or enterprise SaaS product development.
* Experience in HR technology, talent management, assessments, LMS/LXP, or workforce platforms.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, or SAML-based authentication.
* Experience building multilingual applications, particularly Arabic and RTL interfaces.
* Experience integrating AI APIs with strict structured-output requirements.
* Exposure to Azure services, including managed PostgreSQL, cloud storage, secrets management, monitoring, and application hosting.
* Experience with queues, notifications, file storage, webhooks, and production observability.
* Experience working in small, fast-paced product teams with broad engineering ownership.

**About the Product**

You will contribute to an enterprise Talent Development Platform that helps organizations manage job architecture, competency frameworks, employee assessments, development plans, coaching, reassessment, and workforce intelligence.

The platform also supports integrations with enterprise HR systems and is built around a modern technology stack comprising
**React, TypeScript, Node.js, Drizzle ORM, and PostgreSQL**
, with PostgreSQL Row-Level Security supporting tenant isolation.

The role requires a product engineering mindset, with a focus on building reliable, secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions for enterprise customers.

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for a hands-on senior engineer who is comfortable working across frontend development, backend services, databases, security, testing, integrations, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting.

You should have experience taking meaningful ownership of a live multi-tenant SaaS product and be comfortable using AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity without compromising engineering quality.

Strong communication skills, a practical approach to problem-solving, and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment are essential.

title: Linux Administrator

Remote

Contract-to-Hire (C2H)

**Immediate Joiner Only**

**Role:**
Linux Administrator

Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced
**Linux Administrator**
to manage, maintain, patch, monitor, and troubleshoot Linux server infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with
**Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Oracle Linux, Linux patching, and Red Hat Satellite/Katello**
.

The role involves ensuring server availability, security, stability, and performance while supporting enterprise infrastructure. Experience with automation, monitoring tools, Linux hardening, and enterprise environments will be an added advantage.

* Perform Linux patching, security updates, and system upgrades using
  **Red Hat Satellite, Katello, or similar patch management tools**
  .
* Administer RHEL and Oracle Linux environments, including user management, disk management, package management, and system services.
* Monitor server health, availability, performance, and capacity; troubleshoot system-level issues.
* Perform Linux security hardening, access management, and compliance-related activities.
* Develop and maintain shell scripts using Bash or other scripting languages to automate routine administrative tasks.
* Troubleshoot operating system, hardware, networking, and application-related issues.
* Manage system logs, investigate incidents, and support root-cause analysis.
* Perform system performance tuning and support backup and restoration activities.
* Maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and operational records.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, network, security, and application teams to ensure reliable IT operations.

Required Skills — Priority 1 (Mandatory)

* Strong hands-on experience in
  **Linux system administration**
  .
* Expertise in
  **Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and/or Oracle Linux**
  .
* Practical experience with
  **Linux patching and patch management**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **Red Hat Satellite or Katello**
  .
* Experience in Linux server monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance analysis.
* Proficiency in
  **Bash/Shell scripting**
  .
* Strong understanding of Linux administration, system services, user permissions, storage, and package management.

Preferred Skills — Priority 2

* Experience with
  **Zabbix**
  or similar monitoring tools.
* Knowledge of
  **Ansible**
  for configuration management and automation.
* Experience in Linux security hardening and vulnerability remediation.
* Knowledge of log management, system performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
* Experience with enterprise backup and restore solutions.

Specialized Skills — Priority 3 (Added Advantage)

* Experience with
  **Oracle Exadata**
  infrastructure.
* Knowledge of
  **RoCE (RDMA over Converged Ethernet)**
  and
  **InfiniBand**
  networking.
* Exposure to
  **Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)**
  or hybrid cloud environments.
* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms such as
  **NetBackup and Cohesity**
  .
* Experience managing Linux virtual machines on VMware ESXi.
* Knowledge of Linux integration with Active Directory using LDAP, Kerberos, or Quest/One Identity Safeguard Authentication Services.
* Basic knowledge of Windows Server administration and hybrid infrastructure environments.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on Linux Administrator with strong expertise in enterprise Linux operations, patch management, and troubleshooting. Candidates with the mandatory Linux skills should be prioritized; specialized experience in Exadata, RoCE, InfiniBand, and OCI will be considered a significant advantage.

title: Data Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for a skilled Data Consultant with 3-5 years of experience in building and developed enterprise-grade applications. You will work within the Digital Solutions team to build scalable, secure, and high performing business applications used across major global infrastructure and environmental projects.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to support the ongoing development of digital solutions for our client’s, unlocking solutions to the world’s most critical challenges. This includes the delivery of future net zero, renewable energy, transport and water infrastructure solutions in the UK and globally. Demand for their services is higher than ever, and we need experienced people who will grow and succeed with us.
  
  
You will take a developer role in our established Digital Solutions team, working with the latest technologies, helping deliver high quality, bespoke solutions to our clients. The role is a blend of development, operations & system administration to assist in expanding the deployment of our templated solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytical solutions using SQL Server and Python, ensuring data quality, performance optimization, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Integrate, extract, transform, and model data from diverse sources including SQL databases, SharePoint, APIs, ArcGIS, and Python-based data services to support enterprise ETL and analytics requirements.
* Develop and deliver robust reporting and data solutions by collaborating with business stakeholders and technical teams, translating complex requirements into actionable insights and scalable data products.
* Build and support automated data ingestion, transformation, and incremental loading processes, while monitoring and maintaining data pipelines to ensure reliability, accuracy, and availability of business-critical reporting.
* Apply data governance and best practices, including data security, role-based access control, version control, deployment pipelines, and lifecycle management across analytical platforms.
* Leverage Python and AI-powered capabilities to automate repetitive tasks, enhance data processing workflows, and support the development of foundational Generative AI and AI Agent solutions, including prompt-driven automation and intelligent data retrieval processes.
* Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including database schemas, ETL workflows, SQL procedures, Python scripts, API integrations, AI solution architectures, and operational runbooks to support governance, maintenance, and knowledge sharing.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for process improvement through data engineering, automation, machine learning, and emerging AI technologies

**Required Essential Skills And Expertise**

* 3-5 years of hands-on experience in Python and SQL, with strong expertise in data modeling, query optimization, and developing scalable data solutions.
* Proficient in Python-based data engineering, automation, and analytical workflows, including data extraction, transformation, processing, and performance tuning.
* Strong expertise in SQL Server database design, relational data modeling, schema architecture, query optimization, and efficient management of large-scale datasets.
* Experienced in building AI-enabled and Generative AI solutions, including prompt engineering, AI-assisted automation, intelligent data processing, and integration of AI capabilities within Python and SQL-based applications.
* Advanced knowledge of SQL development, including complex queries, joins, stored procedures, indexing strategies, and performance optimization techniques.
* Skilled in integrating data from multiple enterprise and external sources, including REST APIs, SharePoint Online, SQL databases, enterprise systems, and cloud-based services.
* Strong understanding of RESTful services, JSON, OData queries, and API-driven architectures for automated and dynamic data ingestion.
* Experience developing AI-powered analytical solutions that combine Python, SQL, and machine learning techniques to generate actionable business insights and improve decision-making.
* Proficient in designing and implementing scalable data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and automated workflows using Python and SQL technologies.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills with the ability to translate business requirements into efficient data and AI-driven solutions.
* Experience with GitHub, Azure DevOps, and modern software development practices, including version control, CI/CD, and application lifecycle management.
* Good understanding of Power BI integration with Python, SQL Server, APIs, Power Apps, Power Automate, and Dataverse to deliver intelligent and scalable business solutions.
* Knowledge of enterprise data governance, security, deployment pipelines, row-level security (RLS), workspace management, and data refresh strategies.
* Ability to leverage Generative AI, Python, and SQL to automate business processes, enhance productivity, and develop innovative data-driven solutions.
* Skilled in extracting, transforming, modeling, and analyzing complex datasets using Python, SQL Server, and AI technologies, enabling continuous process improvement and advanced analytics.

**Qualifications**
**Education / Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or related field (or equivalent experience)
* With at least 5+ years of experience in Microsoft Power BI Platform Technology.

description:
ITP Media Group
  
  
www.itp.com

.

**Database Manager – B2B Media / Events**
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Database Manager to oversee the design, maintenance, integrity, and security of our organization's databases, which support both our magazine publishing and event management operations. **-**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business analytics, supply chain, operations, finance, or a related field.

* 5+ years of overall experience in technology consulting, analytics, enterprise applications, data solutions, or business process transformation.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, data quality checks, and performance-aware query design.
* Ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation in a techno-functional role.
* Experience with requirements gathering solution design, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Understanding of data models, integrations, business rules, workflows, and enterprise application delivery.

* Prior hands-on Aera experience is a strong plus.
* Experience in Decision Intelligence, supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial, or finance use cases.
* Exposure to cloud data platforms, APIs, ETL/ELT, reporting, Python, or advanced analytics.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models and distributed global teams.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery-focused mindset.
* Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

description:

**Title And Summary**
Associate Analyst

Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Associate Analyst, Analytics & Metrics to join our KPI Monitoring Team part of Non API Integrations team in Open Finance. In this role, you will be responsible for proactive monitoring of critical business and operational KPIs, investigating alerts and production issues, analyzing large datasets, identifying trends and anomalies, and supporting incident management activities.

This position plays a key role in ensuring service reliability, operational excellence, and timely resolution of incidents impacting business-critical services.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
KPI Monitoring & Operational Support
  
  
Proactively monitor applications, platforms, services, and key business KPIs using established monitoring tools.
  
  
Monitor production environments to detect anomalies, performance degradation, service disruptions, and operational issues.
  
  
Investigate alerts, incidents, and service failures and take appropriate actions based on defined procedures.
  
  
Ensure timely escalation and communication of critical issues to relevant stakeholders.
  
  
Support 24x7 operational monitoring through rotational shift coverage.
  
  
Troubleshooting & Incident Management
  
  
Perform detailed troubleshooting and root cause analysis of production incidents.
  
  
Analyze application logs, system behavior, and performance metrics to identify underlying issues.
  
  
Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Data, Infrastructure, and Support teams to drive incident resolution.
  
  
Participate in incident bridges, production support calls, and post-incident reviews.
  
  
Document findings, corrective actions, and preventive recommendations.

Analyze data using SQL, Snowflake, Tableau, Splunk, and Excel to identify trends, patterns, and operational insights.
  
  
Develop and maintain dashboards, visualizations, reports, and performance scorecards.
  
  
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports for stakeholders and leadership teams.
  
  
Convert analytical findings into actionable recommendations that improve operational performance and KPI health.
  
  
Monitoring Automation & Continuous Improvement
  
  
Create and maintain Splunk searches, dashboards, reports, and automated alerts.
  
  
Enhance monitoring capabilities by identifying opportunities for automation and operational efficiency.
  
  
Track recurring incidents and recommend process improvements to reduce operational risk.
  
  
Support continuous improvement initiatives related to KPI monitoring, service reliability, and operational excellence.

Technical Skills
  
  
✅ SQL (Advanced Querying & Data Analysis)
  
  
✅ Splunk
  
  
Log Analysis
  
  
Search Processing Language (SPL)
  
  
Dashboard Development
  
  
Alert Configuration & Maintenance
  
  
✅ Tableau
  
  
Dashboard Development
  
  
Reporting & Visualization
  
  
Trend Analysis
  
  
✅ Snowflake
  
  
Data Investigation
  
  
Data Validation
  
  
Analytical Queries
  
  
✅ Microsoft Excel (Advanced)
  
  
Pivot Tables
  
  
VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP
  
  
Advanced Formulas
  
  
Data Analysis & Reporting
  
  
✅ Dynatrace
  
  
Application Monitoring
  
  
Service Monitoring
  
  
Performance Analysis
  
  
Alert Investigation
  
  
✅ Incident Management & Escalation
  
  
✅ Data Analysis & Troubleshooting
  
  
Required Competencies
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Excellent troubleshooting and investigative mindset.
  
  
Ability to analyze large and complex datasets.
  
  
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  
  
Ability to prioritize multiple incidents and manage competing priorities.
  
  
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
  
  
Ability to work independently and as part of a global operations team.
  
  
Comfortable working in a fast-paced production support environment.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience in production monitoring, operational support, NOC, SRE, Business Operations, or KPI monitoring functions.
  
  
Knowledge of application performance monitoring tools and observability platforms.
  
  
Understanding of incident management frameworks and operational best practices.
  
  
Experience working within Agile or DevOps environments.
  
  
Exposure to financial services, fintech, payment processing, or data-driven operational environments is a plus.
  
  
Education & Experience
  
  
Bachelor's Degree in any field.
  
  
1-3 years of experience in analytics, monitoring, production support, operations, or incident management roles.
  
  
Hands-on experience with Excel, SQL and data analysis tools preferred.
  
  
Shift Requirement
  
  
This position requires participation in a 24x7 rotational shift model, including weekends, public holidays, and on-call support as needed to ensure operational coverage.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

* Drive GenAI, RAG, model evaluation, guardrails, and AI observability capabilities.

* Define and operate monitoring, logging, alerting, and reliability practices for data pipelines, ML pipelines, model endpoints, and platform services.

* Lead tier-3 incident response for complex infrastructure failures and drive systemic architectural changes to prevent recurrence.

* Cost, Governance, Leadership & Platform Enablement
* Mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead complex cross-team technical initiatives, and establish engineering standards for the broader MLOps and DataOps domains.
* Own and optimize cloud architecture for cost efficiency, actively managing capacity and FinOps practices for large-scale data and ML workloads.
* Evaluate, adopt, and operationalize platform capabilities that improve reliability, security, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with Cloud Infrastructure, SRE, InfoSec, Data Engineering, Data Science, and ML teams to resolve platform and operational issues.

**Who You Are**

* Degree & Experience: B.Tech or B.E in Computer Science, Information technology, or equivalent practical experience, with 7+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, cloud platform engineering, MLOps, DataOps, or a closely related discipline.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform or equivalent public cloud technologies. Experience with GCP services such as Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery, Google Cloud Storage, or Vertex AI is highly relevant.
* Infrastructure as Code: Strong practical experience with Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, reusable modules, and controlled production changes.
* Containers & Kubernetes: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Experience with GKE is preferred for GCP environments.
* CI/CD & GitOps: Experience building or operating CI/CD pipelines and Git-based deployment workflows using GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Codefresh, Jenkins, or equivalent tools.
* Automation & Scripting: Proficiency in Python and Shell scripting for platform automation, operational tooling, pipeline hooks, and internal utilities.
* Data & Workflow Platforms: Experience supporting Apache Airflow/Composer, Dataproc, Dataflow, Spark, BigQuery, or comparable data-processing and workflow-orchestration technologies.
* MLOps: Experience supporting ML pipelines, model deployments, inference endpoints, model-serving infrastructure, or ML platform operations.
* Reliability & Operations: Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident response, on-call support, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis for production systems.
* Security & Governance: Working knowledge of IAM, RBAC, service accounts, secrets, vulnerability management, networking fundamentals, and secure cloud operations.
* Operational Mindset: Strong ownership, structured problem-solving, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience with ML/LLM observability and evaluation platforms such as Arize, LangSmith, or equivalent tools.
* Experience with GKE platform operations, GPU workloads, vector databases, RAG infrastructure, or model-serving systems.
* Experience implementing data, model, artifact, or pipeline lineage and reproducibility practices.

title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Sales
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

description:

NA

ROLE INFORMATION
  
  
Project Role: Senior Storage Engineer – Nasuni, AWS Cloud & Backup
  
  
Project Role Description: Design, implement, and manage enterprise hybrid cloud storage solutions using Nasuni, AWS cloud-native backup services, with good-to-have skills in Dell EMC ECS and Tintri VM-aware storage. Act as a storage SME to identify, diagnose, and resolve complex storage incidents across critical business systems.
  
  
Must Have Skills: Nasuni Cloud Storage, AWS Storage & Cloud-Native Backup
  
  
Good To Have Skills: Dell EMC ECS (Elastic Cloud Storage), Tintri VM-Aware Storage
  
  
Minimum Experience Required: 5+ years of experience in enterprise storage administration
  
  
Educational Qualification: 15 years full time education (B.E. / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent)
  
  
**Summary**
Design, build, configure, and manage hybrid cloud storage environments integrating Nasuni cloud file services with AWS-native storage and backup solutions. The role involves administering storage platforms across cloud and on-premises infrastructure to meet business continuity, performance, and compliance requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
As an experienced Storage Administrator, the role will involve providing Storage technical administration support and storage development services. The person must possess confidence in technical abilities to perform day-to-day storage administration, project migration, and production issue troubleshooting.
  
  
Technical Experience:
  
  
Hands-on experience with Nasuni UniFS global file system, Edge Appliances, and Nasuni Management Console (NMC).
  
  
Expertise in AWS storage services: S3, EFS, AWS Backup, Data Sync, and Storage Gateway.
  
  
Deep knowledge of AWS cloud-native backup strategies including backup policies, lifecycle rules, cross-region replication, and disaster recovery.
  
  
Configure and manage Nasuni integration with AWS S3 as the cloud object storage backend.
  
  
Manage Nasuni snapshot versioning, ransomware protection, and global file locking for distributed environments.
  
  
Design and implement AWS IAM policies, S3 bucket policies, and Object Lock for data governance and compliance.
  
  
Experience in Nasuni migration activities from legacy NAS platforms (NetApp, Isilon, Windows File Server).
  
  
Automate storage operations using Python, PowerShell, Bash, Terraform, or AWS CloudFormation.
  
  
Good to have: Dell EMC ECS object storage cluster administration, namespace/bucket configuration, and S3-compatible API integration.
  
  
Good to have: Tintri VMstore administration, per-VM QoS, snapshot management, and VMware vCenter integration.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
Expected to perform independently and become an SME in Nasuni and AWS cloud storage domains.
  
  
Required active participation and contribution in team discussions, architecture reviews, and change advisory board (CAB) processes.
  
  
Contribute in providing solutions to work-related storage problems, including capacity planning and performance optimization.
  
  
Assist in monitoring system performance and proactively identify potential issues to prevent downtime across Nasuni, AWS, ECS, and Tintri platforms.
  
  
Support junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance on technical challenges related to cloud and on-premises storage.
  
  
Participate in the development and improvement of operational runbooks, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and storage automation scripts.
  
  
Engage in continuous learning to stay updated with Nasuni product updates, AWS storage services, and industry best practices.
  
  
Coordinate with vendors (Nasuni, AWS, Dell EMC, Tintri) for escalation, issue resolution, and product licensing.
  
  
Provide 24/7 on-call support for critical storage incidents and backup/restore operations.
  
  
**Professional & Technical Skills**
Must Have Skills:
  
  
Nasuni Cloud Storage: Proficiency in Nasuni UniFS, Edge Appliances, NMC, snapshot policies, ransomware recovery, and cloud backend integration.
  
  
AWS Storage & Backup: Expertise in S3, EFS, FSx, AWS Backup, DataSync, Storage Gateway, and cost optimization strategies.
  
  
Backup & Recovery: Strong understanding of backup architectures, RPO/RTO objectives, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity.
  
  
Protocols: Strong knowledge of NFS, SMB/CIFS, S3, iSCSI, and Fibre Channel storage protocols.
  
  
Security & Compliance: Understanding of data encryption (at-rest and in-transit), RBAC, IAM, and compliance frameworks (SOX, GDPR, HIPAA).
  
  
Monitoring: Experience with AWS CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, or equivalent monitoring and alerting platforms.
  
  
Active Directory & LDAP: Experience integrating file storage platforms with enterprise identity and access management systems.
  
  
Good to Have Skills:
  
  
Dell EMC ECS: Object storage administration, erasure coding, geo-distribution, and S3-compatible API integration.
  
  
Tintri Storage: VMstore administration, VM-aware QoS, ReplicateVM, Tintri Global Center (TGC) management.
  
  
**Additional Information**
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to think logically through complex storage problems. Must have the initiative, tenacity, and commitment to see problems through resolution.
  
  
Ability to work shift patterns and provide 24/7 support for critical storage and backup systems.
  
  
Good third-party liaison skills — able to engage effectively with suppliers of storage products, hardware vendors, and cloud service providers.
  
  
The candidate should have a minimum of 7 years of experience in Nasuni cloud storage and AWS cloud-native backup solutions.
  
  
Experience with Nasuni and AWS in production environments supporting large-scale, mission-critical workloads is highly preferred.
  
  
Strong documentation skills — ability to produce architecture diagrams, runbooks, capacity reports, and incident post-mortems.
  
  
A 15-year full-time education (B.E. / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, or Engineering) is required.

title: Associate Applications Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Our clients need their systems to be reliable, secure, and available. As an Applications Engineer, you will help ensure that their applications and hosting environments run smoothly.
  
  
You will act as a bridge between our clients, technology, and engineering teams. You will understand client requirements, configure and deploy applications, troubleshoot technical issues, and support production environments.
  
  
This role is not limited to application support. It requires a combination of application support, troubleshooting, deployment, infrastructure knowledge, database skills, and basic coding/scripting knowledge. You will work with different technical teams to identify problems, implement solutions, automate repetitive tasks, and continuously improve application reliability.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Application Setup and Deployment**

* Install, configure, and deploy applications on servers and application services.
* Support application releases, code deployments, and environment setup.
* Handle client requests such as certificate installations, new sites, site updates, overwrites, and vanity URLs.
* Perform functional and integration testing before releases.
* Support application configuration and environment-related changes.

**Troubleshooting and Production Support**

* Investigate and resolve application errors, access issues, and performance problems.
* Analyze application and server logs to identify root causes.
* Monitor applications and servers and respond to production incidents.
* Troubleshoot issues across application, server, database, and network layers.
* Help maintain application availability, performance, and security.
* Follow change management procedures for installations, upgrades, and maintenance activities.

**Client and Team Collaboration**

* Act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal teams regarding hosting and application requests.
* Understand client requirements and communicate technical solutions clearly.
* Manage and prioritize cases in the hosting queue.
* Assign, update, and follow up on cases while keeping clients and hosting partners informed.
* Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) when handling support cases.
* Review case backlogs and ensure timely updates and resolution.
* Manage shared mailboxes and communication with hosting partners.

**Technical Skills, Coding, And Automation**

* Work with APIs, databases, and other systems integrated with application.
* Use basic coding or scripting skills to troubleshoot issues and automate repetitive tasks.
* Write or modify simple scripts using technologies such as PowerShell, SQL, or other scripting languages.
* Develop automation where possible to improve application reliability and reduce manual effort.
* Understand application configuration, web applications, and basic software development concepts.

**Documentation and Continuous Improvement**

* Create and maintain SOPs, process documentation, and technical notes for client environments.
* Identify recurring issues and suggest improvements to processes and applications.
* Learn and support Momentive's association management products.
* Work closely with developers, DevOps, infrastructure, QA, and business teams.
* Participate in the rotational on-call support schedule.

**What You Bring**

* 1+ years of experience in application support, application implementation, or a similar technical role.
* Good understanding of application troubleshooting and production support.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server, IIS, Remote Desktop, and Domain Controllers.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Nagios, CloudWatch, or Pingdom.
* Basic understanding of backups and recovery processes.
* Basic SQL Server knowledge, including writing and understanding simple SQL queries.
* Basic coding or scripting knowledge and the ability to understand or modify scripts.
* Experience with cloud-hosted applications or cloud environments.
* Experience using ticketing or IT service management systems.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting client environments, applications, servers, and networks.
* Experience supporting clients through phone, email, or ticketing systems.
* Understanding of change management and controlled deployment processes.
* Ability to analyze logs and troubleshoot technical issues systematically.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills.
* Engineering degree, MCA, MCM, or equivalent technical qualification.

**Nice to Have**

* AWS, Azure, or Microsoft certifications.
* PowerShell scripting experience.
* Knowledge of ITIL or Microsoft Operations Framework.
* Experience with change management tools.
* Experience monitoring and maintaining distributed applications or systems.
* Knowledge of security best practices and client data protection.
* Experience setting up websites and web applications.
* Basic understanding of firewalls, networking, DNS, and certificates.
* Experience working with APIs and application integrations.

**How You Work**
You build strong relationships with clients and colleagues and can work effectively both independently and as part of a team. You take ownership of issues, communicate clearly, and focus on delivering reliable solutions.
  
  
You are comfortable working on technical problems, learning new technologies, and going into the details when an issue is complex. You have a client-first mindset and are willing to support a rotational schedule and participate in on-call responsibilities.
  
  
**About Us**
Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Mission-driven nonprofits and associations rely on Momentive’s cloud-based software and services to address their most pressing challenges – from engaging their communities to simplifying operations and growing revenue. Designed to help organizations connect more, manage more, and ultimately expect more, Momentive's solutions are built with reliability at the core and strategically focus on fundraising, learning, events, careers, volunteering, accounting, and association management. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com.

At Momentive Software, we’re a team of passionate problem-solvers, innovators, and volunteers who believe in using technology to make a real difference. We dream big, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that help our customers drive meaningful change. If you’re looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are valued, you’ll find it here.

description:

+ Conduct code reviews and ensure the quality, performance, and maintainability of data solutions
