title: Lead Security Reliability Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
In this opportunity as Lead Security Reliability Engineer, you will:
  
  

* Act as the technical lead for security across application, cloud, and infrastructure. Set technical direction, make the key calls, own the shape and quality of the security backlog end to end, and serve as the point of escalation for complex security and remediation work, without direct line-management responsibility.
* Design and build security controls across layers such as operating systems, container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, cloud configuration, and network boundaries, to defend against sophisticated adversaries and insider threats.
* Design new security processes and ways of working, revamping patching cycles and golden-image and base-image refreshes across cloud and on-prem, so the team can move fast without sacrificing safety.
* Come to the table with ideas: identify where security and remediation processes can be improved, propose better approaches, and turn them into standards the team adopts.
* Set the technical approach across the full security scope: application and open-source dependency fixes, infrastructure patching, cloud configuration and guardrails, WAF, network isolation, and secrets and machine-identity management. Prioritize by risk in line with industry best practice such as CISA guidance (CISA KEV, CVSS/EPSS, and SLA-driven burndown), and champion adoption of AI-augmented security tooling, including SAST and SCA.
* Raise the technical bar by reviewing fixes and mentoring engineers, and coordinate with the wider security team across regions to keep standards and priorities aligned across time zones.
* Own clear reporting and metrics, and build the runbooks, standards, and escalation paths that make security a repeatable, auditable capability.

**About You**
You're a fit for the role of Lead Security Reliability Engineer if your background includes:
  
  

* 8+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, vulnerability management, or cloud and infrastructure security, including time as a technical lead or senior individual contributor setting direction and guiding the technical work of other engineers, plus a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* A deep understanding of security principles, common vulnerabilities, and best practice across application, cloud, and infrastructure layers.
* A working command of vulnerability management at scale: prioritization frameworks, CVSS/EPSS, CISA KEV, and SLA-driven burndown.
* Breadth across the security stack: application and dependency vulnerabilities, infrastructure patching, guardrails, WAF, network isolation, and identity and access controls, with multi-cloud experience across two or more of AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI (all four an advantage) alongside on-premises infrastructure.
* A track record of designing and improving technical processes, such as patching cycles, image or GAMI refreshes, or remediation workflows, rather than only executing them, with a proactive mindset for identifying and closing security gaps through automation and tooling; experience with AI-assisted or automated security tooling is an advantage.
* Strong judgment on balancing risk reduction against operational and customer impact.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, comfortable operating across security, engineering, and business audiences and able to convey complex security concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders, with enthusiasm for collaborating with cross-functional teams to build secure, reliable systems that scale globally.

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.

title: AI Security Engineer / Researcher (IR-558)
description:
Intellectsoft is a software development company delivering innovative solutions since 2007. We operate across North America, Latin America, the Nordic region, the UK, and Europe. We specialize in industries like Fintech, Healthcare, EdTech, Construction, Hospitality, and more, partnering with startups, mid-sized businesses, and Fortune 500 companies to drive innovation and scalability. Our clients include Jaguar Motors, Universal Pictures, Harley-Davidson, and many more where our teams are making daily impactTogether, our team delivers solutions that make a difference. Learn more at www.intellectsoft.net
  
  
Our client is establishing a dedicated research capability focused at the critical intersection of cybersecurity and artificial intelligence. This role owns end-to-end AI security research problems across the entire modern AI stack - encompassing generative and agentic systems, LLM copilots, machine learning models, training/data pipelines, and enterprise AI governance. The core objective is turning open security challenges into adversarially testable hypotheses and developing exploits and defensive controls that generalize across models and enterprise environments
  
  
**Requirements**

* Experience: 3+ years in security research, offensive security, ML/AI security, detection engineering, or a related discipline
* Engineering Stack: Strong Python development skills for building research-grade tooling, async services, CLIs, SDKs, and automated reporting pipelines
* AI & AppSec Fundamentals: Strong foundations in application security, threat modeling, and failure modes specific to autonomous and transformer-based systems
* Attack Surface Fluency: Hands-on expertise in at least one major AI attack surface (LLM apps, agentic/tool-using workflows, or ML training/inference pipelines)
* Security Domains: Demonstrated experience in vulnerability analysis, detection engineering, adversarial ML, policy-as-code/authorization, red-teaming, or secure SDLC practices
* GenAI / LLM Architecture: Solid grasp of LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt injection, and tool calling
* Research Judgment: Ability to design experiments with held-out evaluations and statistically rigorous metrics; ability to distinguish exploitable vulnerabilities from theoretical edge cases, eliminate evaluation test leakage, and verify genuine generalization
* CVE & Literature Translation: Capacity to evaluate cutting-edge security literature, advisories, and CVE disclosures and convert them into operational exploits and defensive mechanisms
* Tooling Familiarity: Working familiarity with representative tools across categories, including:
* Languages & ML: Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers
* Agent Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, MCP, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs
* AI Red-Teaming & Guardrails: Garak, PyRIT, promptfoo, Giskard, ART, NeMo Guardrails, Guardrails AI, LLM Guard, Rebuff
* AppSec & Scanners: Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Semgrep, Nuclei, ModelScan, picklescan
* Policy & Observability: OPA/Cedar, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, cloud providers (AWS/Azure/GCP), and tracing tools (OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Langfuse).

**Nice to have**

* Dual experience spanning both offensive red-teaming and defensive engineering (detection, policy enforcement, governance)
* Practical experience working with agentic architectures, MCP ecosystems, and multi-agent frameworks
* Applied knowledge of AI governance and risk frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP LLM & ASI Top 10)
* Experience implementing policy-as-code (Cedar, OPA), applied cryptography (digital signatures, hash-chained audit logs), or CI/CD security quality gates
* Proven track record in cross-framework, cross-dataset, or real-world validation of security controls
* Published security research, CVE disclosures, security advisories, or competitive CTF / red-teaming accomplishments

**Responsibilities**

* Harness & Orchestration Architecture: Design and build core agent harnesses, covering function calling, tool interfaces, context assembly, retrieval integration, subagent delegation, retry logic, and failure handling
* Prototype to Production Delivery: Take agentic systems from initial concept to scalable production, managing deployment, monitoring, cost, latency, and operational support against live enterprise client data
* Evaluation Infrastructure: Build and maintain rigorous evaluation suites, task benchmarks, scoring rubrics, and regression tests using tools like Langfuse, Pydantic Logfire, or custom SDKs to drive architectural decisions
* System & Tool Integration: Integrate client enterprise systems, data sources, and internal APIs as accessible agent tools, including building and managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
* Solution Consulting & Requirements Translation: Translate ambiguous client requirements into robust agent architectures, clearly advising stakeholders when an agentic pattern is—or is not—the right solution
* Stakeholder Communication: Interface directly with client stakeholders and articulate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences
* Tooling Transfer & Documentation: Contribute reusable harness components to shared internal tooling and document design decisions to meet audit, validation, and handover standards.

**Benefits**

* Employment-based cooperation
* Comprehensive insurance for you and your family (health, life, and accident)
* Paid PTO policy (vacation, sick leaves, and public holidays)
* Tech equipment provided
* Udemy courses, workshops, trainings & expert knowledge-sharing
* Flexible hours & work setup

For further information on Enerpac Tool Group and its businesses, visit the Company's website at
**https://www.enerpactoolgroup.com/**
**What You Will Do**
***Governance, Policies & Standards***

* Establish and maintain the company's IT and cybersecurity GRC framework.
* Develop, document, maintain, and communicate security policies, standards, procedures, and guidelines.
* Map policies and controls to applicable regulatory, industry, and customer requirements.
* Establish processes for periodic policy review, approval, exception management, and attestation.
* Help define and maintain security control objectives and supporting documentation.

***Risk Management***

* Coordinate IT and cybersecurity risk assessments across the organization.
* Maintain the enterprise IT and cybersecurity risk register, including risk identification, ownership, mitigation plans, and reporting.
* Track remediation activities and risk acceptance/exceptions through completion.
* Support risk reporting and metrics for IT leadership and other stakeholders.
* Help establish a consistent approach for assessing and prioritizing technology and cybersecurity risks.

***Compliance & Controls***

* Support the company's compliance obligations and control activities, including but not limited to SOX, CMMC, UK Cyber Essentials, and other applicable regulatory, contractual, customer, and industry requirements.
* Monitor changes in applicable compliance requirements and assess their impact on the organization.
* Coordinate evidence collection, control testing, remediation, and audit requests.
* Support internal and external audits and assessments.
* Develop and maintain compliance/control matrices and documentation.
* Identify gaps and work with control owners to develop remediation plans.

***Security Awareness & Training***

* Support the development and administration of security awareness and training programs.
* Coordinate required cybersecurity training and employee communications.
* Track training completion and follow up on outstanding requirements.
* Help develop security awareness content, campaigns, and communications tailored to different employee audiences.
* Coordinate and execute quarterly phishing simulation activities, to include follow on learning for any failures.

***Third-Party & Supply Chain Risk***

* Establish and manage a third-party cybersecurity risk management process in partnership with Procurement, Legal, IT, and business stakeholders.
* Perform or coordinate security risk assessments of vendors, suppliers, and other third parties.
* Review security questionnaires, SOC reports, certifications, and other third-party security documentation.
* Track identified vendor risks, remediation activities, and risk acceptances.
* Help establish security requirements and ongoing monitoring practices for critical suppliers and service providers.

***Reporting & Program Development***

* Develop GRC metrics, dashboards, and management reports.
* Maintain accurate GRC documentation and records.
* Help identify opportunities to automate and improve GRC processes.
* Support cybersecurity initiatives and other activities as needed within a small, collaborative IT and Cybersecurity team.

**What Makes You an Ideal Candidate**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Information Systems, Risk Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 7–10 years of experience in cybersecurity, IT risk, GRC, IT audit, compliance, or a related field, including oversight and responsibilities pertaining to SOX ITGCs.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity principles, IT controls, risk management, and compliance frameworks.
* Experience developing or managing policies, standards, controls, risk assessments, or compliance programs.
* Strong analytical, organizational, documentation, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders across a global organization.
* Comfortable working independently and building processes in an environment where GRC capabilities are still being established.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

* OWNERSHIP - We will own our commitments, act with a sense of urgency, and deliver what

is expected of us on time, or ask for help early enough.
  
  

* TEAMWORK - We will act as one Enerpac team, operate with an enterprise-wide mindset, and

support each other to deliver for our stakeholders.
  
  

* AGILITY - We will act with purpose and speed, and we will adapt quickly to changing

circumstances

Our employee benefits including flexible workplace policies, employee resource groups, learning and development resources, career progression pathways, and community engagement initiatives are some of the reasons why we have had great success in bringing in new talent. In addition, our global employee wellness programs are crafted to support the physical, emotional, and financial well-being of our employees.

If you’re looking for a unique, exciting career with variety and potential for growth, Enerpac Tool Group offers challenges & extraordinary rewards for people on a global scale.

title: Lead Identity Engineer - PKI / Venafi
description:
**About the Role:**
We are seeking a highly motivated and self-driven PKI/Venafi Engineer with strong experience in Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Certificate Lifecycle Management (CLM), and cryptographic security solutions. The candidate will be responsible for managing enterprise PKI platforms, automating certificate lifecycle processes, supporting code-signing solutions, and driving strategic PKI modernization initiatives across on-premises and cloud environments.
  
  
The role requires hands-on expertise in Microsoft ADCS, Venafi, Sectigo CLM, cloud-native certificate management, and associated cryptographic technologies. The individual should be capable of independently driving projects end-to-end with minimal supervision while collaborating effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**

* Administer and support enterprise PKI environments, including Microsoft ADCS, Root & Issuing CAs, OCSP, CDP, NDES, certificate templates, and registration authorities.
* Manage the complete certificate lifecycle including issuance, renewal, revocation, replacement, monitoring, and compliance.
* Administer Venafi TLS Protect, Sectigo CLM, and AppViewX (preferred), driving certificate automation and reducing manual processes.
* Implement and support automated certificate management for short-lived certificates and enterprise-wide renewal programs.
* Configure Venafi policies, workflows, integrations, certificate discovery, inventory management, and compliance monitoring.
* Design and support code-signing, S/MIME, and cryptographic services, integrating with CI/CD and development platforms.
* Enable certificate automation across AWS, Kubernetes, cloud-native platforms, load balancers, application gateways, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Manage PKI infrastructure components including ADCS clusters, Entrust HSM, Venafi, Sectigo CLM, OCSP responders, NDES, and external CAs.
* Identify and remediate certificate-related risks, vulnerabilities, expired, self-signed, rogue, and non-compliant certificates.
* Provide L2/L3 support for PKI, TLS/SSL, trust-chain, certificate enrolment, renewal, platform integration, and ServiceNow workflow issues.
* Lead PKI transformation, certificate automation, and cloud security projects while partnering with infrastructure, security, DevOps, and application teams.
* Create and maintain architecture documents, SOPs, runbooks, DR procedures, and provide technical guidance and knowledge-transfer sessions

**What You Bring:**

* 5+ years of experience in PKI, Certificate Lifecycle Management, and Cryptography.
* Proven expertise in installing, configuring, and managing Microsoft Certificate Authorities (ADCS).
* Hands-on administration of Venafi and/or Sectigo CLM platforms.
* Experience delivering certificate automation, code-signing, cloud integration, and PKI transformation projects.
* Exposure to cloud, containerized, and hybrid infrastructure environments
* Strong knowledge of PKI, X.509 Certificates, Digital Signatures, TLS/SSL, Symmetric & Asymmetric Encryption, CRL, OCSP, NDES, Certificate Templates, CA/RA, and HSM technologies.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft ADCS, Venafi TLS Protect, Sectigo CLM, AppViewX (preferred), Entrust HSM, Code Signing, and S/MIME solutions.
* Strong administration skills on Windows and Linux servers.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting, REST APIs, automation frameworks, ServiceNow, AWS ACM, and Kubernetes certificate management

**Preferred Certifications**

* Venafi Certified Professional
* Microsoft Security / Windows Server Certifications
* CISSP, CISM, or CompTIA Security+

**About Simeio And What We Do**
Simeio has over 650 talented employees across the globe. We have offices in USA (Atlanta HQ and Texas), India, Canada, Costa Rica and UK.
  
  
Founded in 2007, and now backed by private equity company ZMC, Simeio is recognized as a top IAM provider by industry analysts.
  
  
Alongside Simeio’s identity orchestration tool ‘Simeio IO’ - Simeio also partners with industry leading IAM software vendors to provide access management, identity governance and administration, privileged access management and risk intelligence services across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid technology environments.
  
  
Simeio provides services to numerous Fortune 1000 companies across all industries including financial services, technology, healthcare, media, retail, public sector, utilities and education.

**Primary Role – Quality Assurance Testing: Oracle Fusion and Integrated Systems**

* Develop, maintain and execute test cases, test scripts and test scenarios for Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement, based on functional design documents, configuration workbooks and business requirements.

* Build and maintain automated test scripts and regression suites where automation adds value, and maintain those assets as configurations and business processes change.
* Prepare and maintain test data sets across development, test and staging environments, coordinating environment readiness and refreshes with the technical team.

* undefined

Experience with test automation tools and frameworks, such as Oracle Test Automation, Tricentis Tosca, Selenium or similar, is preferred; a willingness to develop and expand automation capability is required.

* Oversee incident, defect, and change management related to Reltio, ensuring SLAs are met, root causes addressed, and changes follow SOPs for source code, change, and release management.

* Contribute to ongoing monitoring and service reviews (weekly and monthly meetings with Product Owner, Business Owner, Tech Lead, Service Owner, Service Manager) to track SLA and performance against quality standards.

**Required skills and experience:**

* 10+years of over professional experience with Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
* Architecture and design experience in Reltio MDM and Rest APIs
* Proven experience acting as Tech Lead or equivalent: governing code quality, design reviews, defect resolution, and technical sign-offs.
* Ability to translate business requirements into scalable Reltio solutions.

title: Senior Analyst-Risk Management
description:
**Overview of The Department**

Commercial Rating and Underwriting (CRU) sits within the Credit and Fraud Risk (CFR) division and forms the institutional credit risk management function within American Express. The CRU team plays the critical role of assessing and managing the risk of institutional exposures across all business units within American Express, and in all regions globally. Credit exposures are primarily generated through corporate and small business card programs, via merchant service relationships where non-delivery risk exists, and among the securities portfolio held for firm-wide liquidity. CRU is led from Salt Lake City with regional teams in New York, London, Singapore , Sydney and India.

In addition to determining the internal credit rating which drives the probability of default of each exposure, CRU also calculates the loss given default of these obligors while underwriting card programs. As a bank holding company, American Express must comply with the highest global banking standards set by Basel and implemented by the bank’s primarily regulatory, the Federal Reserve.

  

**Qualifications**

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

title: Security Transformation Senior Analyst
description:
**Role Summary**

The Security Transformation Specialist supports enterprise vulnerability and compliance programs by translating security standards into measurable controls, developing and validating controls across cloud and on-premises environments, and driving remediation with business and technology stakeholders. The role serves as a technical subject-matter expert for vulnerability and compliance operations while contributing to automation, reporting, governance and continuous improvement.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Hands-on experience in cloud security and Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) platforms such as Wiz or Prisma Cloud.
* Strong expertise in Qualys Policy Compliance, including policy assessment, control validation and investigation of compliance findings.
* Good understanding of cloud-native security, operating-system-level security and security configuration standards.
* Working knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Solid networking and/or server administration knowledge, including the OSI model, encryption, common protocols, ports and network security concepts.
* Ability to interpret security standards and convert requirements into testable technical controls and scenarios.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to business and technology stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to coordinate across geographically distributed, cross-functional teams.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Working knowledge of Python and/or shell scripting for automation, data handling and control validation.
* Experience with security-control development, cloud query languages, reporting and workflow automation.
* Relevant security certifications such as CCSP, CEH or CompTIA Security+.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

* Work with CSPM platforms and Qualys Policy Compliance to support control development, assessment and operational compliance activities.
* Interpret organizational security standards and translate requirements into control logic, test scenarios and measurable validation criteria.
* Develop, test and validate cloud-native and operating-system security controls before production deployment.
* Present new or enhanced controls in governance and review forums, clearly explaining the requirement, logic, test evidence, coverage and expected impact.
* Investigate false positives, approved variances, scan inaccuracies and control exceptions; document findings and coordinate corrective action.
* Partner with server, network, cloud, database and application teams to address vulnerabilities, configuration gaps and compliance findings.
* Provide remediation guidance and respond to stakeholder questions related to vulnerability patching and configuration changes required to align with organizational security standards.
* Act as a primary point of contact for vulnerability and compliance operational queries and coordinate issues through resolution.
* Conduct periodic reviews with business stakeholders covering risk posture, remediation progress, aging items, dependencies and blockers.
* Collaborate with tool vendors and internal platform teams to troubleshoot product issues, coverage gaps, scan failures and inaccurate findings.
* Facilitate discussions on security-control gaps and recommend practical remediation or control-enhancement options.
* Perform user acceptance testing for security-control enhancements using predefined scenarios and maintain clear evidence of results.
* Monitor assessment and scan coverage to help ensure in-scope infrastructure assets are evaluated according to the defined schedule.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports, dashboards, control evidence and governance records.
* Support governance and audit-readiness activities through regular reviews of processes, controls, evidence and operational performance.
* Identify opportunities to improve process efficiency, automate repeatable activities and strengthen the overall security posture.
* Perform authorized administrative and operational activities within security tools in accordance with documented procedures and access controls.

**Technical Experience**

* 4 -7 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, compliance operations, cloud security or security-control engineering.
* Practical experience with Qualys Policy Compliance and at least one CSPM platform, preferably Wiz or Prisma Cloud.
* Experience validating security controls across cloud platforms, servers, operating systems and network technologies.
* Exposure to issue tracking, evidence management, reporting and governance workflows.

**Professional Competencies**

* Analytical problem-solving and attention to detail.
* Ownership and accountability for assigned controls, findings and stakeholder commitments.
* Ability to prioritize work, manage dependencies and communicate risks or blockers promptly.
* Clear documentation, presentation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Continuous-improvement mindset with a focus on quality, consistency and measurable outcomes.

  
To be filled by recruiter

description:

Senior Operation Manager for D&A

Are you passionate about turning business needs into practical, AI-enabled solutions and excited to be part of a global company transforming industry with cutting-edge technology? ABB is looking for an **AI Solution Engineer** to join our **Automation IS** team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business needs and practical AI-enabled solutions. You will stay hands-on throughout delivery, working with Data Analysts, Snowflake Developers, Power BI/Fabric Developers, Data Engineers and other specialists to build, validate and hand over working solutions. **Ways of working**

The Information Security Analyst is responsible for supporting customer and contractual security obligations related to vulnerability management. This role serves as the liaison between security teams, application owners, infrastructure teams, and customer-facing stakeholders to ensure vulnerabilities are tracked, remediated within required service levels, and documented appropriately for internal governance and external customer reporting purposes.

The analyst will coordinate vulnerability remediation activities, monitor compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements, maintain accurate remediation evidence, support customer audits and questionnaires, and develop executive and customer-ready reporting that demonstrates effective management of security risks.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Vulnerability Tracking & Governance
  + Track identified vulnerabilities from discovery through remediation and closure
  + Monitor remediation progress against internal policies, SLAs, customer contractual requirements, and regulatory obligations
  + Review vulnerability exception requests and ensure appropriate documentation and approvals are obtained
  + Escalate overdue vulnerabilities to appropriate management and stakeholders
  + Validate remediation status and supporting evidence prior to closure
  + Support remediation governance meetings and maintain action item tracking
* Customer Contractual Compliance
  + Interpret customer security requirements related to vulnerability management
  + Ensure remediation activities comply with contractual commitments and customer-specific timelines
  + Provide customers and internal account teams with vulnerability remediation status updates
  + Support customer security reviews, audits, assessments, and questionnaires
  + Maintain documentation supporting contractual security obligations
  + Coordinate responses to customer requests for remediation evidence and security reporting
* Documentation and Evidence Management
  + Maintain detailed remediation records and supporting evidence
  + Develop remediation summaries, executive reports, and customer-facing status reports
  + Ensure audit-ready documentation exists for vulnerability findings and corrective actions
  + Track historical remediation efforts and maintain records for compliance reviews
  + Create and update procedures, standards, and operational documentation
* Reporting & Metrics
  + Produce recurring vulnerability management reports and dashboards

**Job Responsibilities**

**India**

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.

Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly **Build What Matters.**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Tester for , a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.

The QA Tester is responsible for the design, execution and documentation of testing across Oracle Fusion Cloud environment and the integrations, interfaces, reports and business processes that surround it. The role supports both the in-flight Oracle implementation – including system integration testing, user acceptance testing support, data conversion validation and cutover readiness – and the ongoing steady-state testing that follows go-live, including enhancement testing, defect regression and validation of Oracle’s quarterly release updates. The QA Tester partners closely with US-based IT leadership, functional and technical analysts, system integration partners and business process owners to ensure that changes to the Oracle ecosystem are delivered accurately, are thoroughly documented and do not disrupt downstream finance and operations processes.

**Primary Role – Quality Assurance Testing: Oracle Fusion and Integrated Systems**

  

* Develop, maintain and execute test cases, test scripts and test scenarios for Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement, based on functional design documents, configuration workbooks and business requirements.
* Execute system integration testing, regression testing and end-to-end process testing across Oracle and the surrounding application landscape, as assigned by the QA Lead.
* Execute system integration testing, regression testing and end-to-end process testing across Oracle and the surrounding application landscape, validating that business processes function correctly from source system, through Oracle, and out to downstream consumers.
* Test inbound and outbound integrations between Oracle Fusion and property management, banking, treasury, payroll, procurement and reporting systems, including file-based interfaces, APIs and Oracle Integration Cloud flows; validate payload accuracy, error handling, reprocessing and exception reporting.
* Validate data conversion and migration activities, including reconciliation of converted balances, master data and historical transactions between legacy systems and Oracle.
* Test reports, dashboards and analytics developed in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio and Fusion Data Intelligence, reconciling output to source data and confirming correct parameters, security and formatting.
* Support user acceptance testing, including preparation of business-facing test scripts, coordination of tester schedules, hands-on support to business users during execution, and tracking of UAT results through to closure.
* Plan and execute regression testing for Oracle’s quarterly release updates, assessing the impact of new features and patches on existing configurations, integrations, reports and extensions.
* Log, triage, document and track defects through resolution in the program’s defect management tool, including clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence and appropriate severity and priority classification, and partner with functional and technical teams on root cause analysis and retest.
* Maintain the test case repository, requirements traceability matrices and test evidence to ensure complete coverage of requirements and to satisfy internal control, audit and SOX documentation standards.
* Build and maintain automated test scripts and regression suites where automation adds value, and maintain those assets as configurations and business processes change.
* Prepare and maintain test data sets across development, test and staging environments, coordinating environment readiness and refreshes with the technical team.
* Provide accurate daily updates on test execution progress, blockers and open defects to leadership.
* Participate in requirements and design reviews to identify testability gaps, ambiguous requirements and delivery risks early in the lifecycle.Validate security roles, user provisioning and segregation of duties configurations as part of testing cycles.
* Support cutover and post-go-live validation activities, including production smoke testing, hypercare defect triage and verification of fixes in the production environment.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA standards, templates, testing methodology and automation coverage across the Oracle program.
* Must be able to work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with a shift aligned to US Central Time and available until 11:00 AM CT Flexibility is expected during testing cycles, cutover events, quarterly update windows and other peak periods.
* daily.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, accounting or a related field is required.

Minimum of three years of software quality assurance and testing experience, including at least one year testing enterprise ERP applications, is required.

* Must have hands-on testing experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP is required; coverage across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management or Procurement is preferred.

  

* Experience supporting at least one full-lifecycle ERP implementation, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing and cutover, is strongly preferred.

  

* Demonstrated experience testing system integrations and interfaces, including file-based feeds, web services and APIs, and middleware such as Oracle Integration Cloud, is required.

  

* Experience validating reports and data in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio or Fusion Data Intelligence is preferred.

  

* Working knowledge of SQL sufficient to independently query and reconcile data between source systems and Oracle is preferred.

  

* Experience with test automation tools and frameworks, such as Oracle Test Automation, Tricentis Tosca, Selenium or similar, is preferred; a willingness to develop and expand automation capability is required.

  

* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, qTest or similar is required.

  

* Familiarity with Oracle’s quarterly update cycle and the associated regression testing approach is preferred.

  

* Working understanding of core finance and accounting processes, including record to report, procure to pay and order to cash, sufficient to test business scenarios meaningfully; real estate, property management or student housing experience is an advantage.

  

* Familiarity with SOX and IT general control requirements as they relate to testing documentation and evidence retention is preferred.

  

* ISTQB certification or an equivalent quality assurance credential would be a plus .

  

* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, with emphasis on Excel.

  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the discipline to document findings clearly and completely.

  

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain defects, test results and risks clearly to onshore technical and business stakeholders.

  

* Ability to manage multiple concurrent testing priorities against fixed delivery deadlines and to work independently with limited onshore supervision.

  

* Demonstrates a positive attitude and maintains a high level of professionalism when working with onshore stakeholders and leadership across time zones.

title: Lead Engineer Network Observability
description:
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Lead Network Engineer, Architect - Observability to own the strategy and architecture behind how we see, understand, and act on the health of our global network. This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who has spent a decade or more in network engineering and now wants to define how a large, multi-region network gets monitored, correlated, and made predictable rather than reactive.
  
  
You'll be the architect of our observability capability end to end, spanning monitoring platforms, telemetry, analytics, and the roadmap that ties it all to business outcomes like uptime, mean time to resolution, and cost avoidance.
  
  
**What You'll Do
  
  
Observability Strategy and Architecture**

* Own and advance a multi-year observability maturity roadmap for the global network
* Architect unified observability solutions spanning our monitoring platforms rather than siloed point tools
* Define predictive alerting and anomaly detection capabilities to move the organization from reactive to proactive
* Build observability use cases grounded in business goals, not just technical coverage
* Set observability best practices and standards used across regions
* Evaluate emerging observability and AIOps technologies and recommend where they fit

**Analytics and Cross-Tool Integration**

* Design analytics workflows that combine data from multiple sources, such as wire data, infrastructure metrics, and flow analysis, into a coherent picture of network health
* Build predictive capacity planning models using historical performance data
* Create executive-level dashboards that correlate network health with business outcomes
* Develop anomaly detection and behavioral baseline analytics
* Design correlation logic across tools to speed up root cause analysis
* Advance visualization strategy across our reporting platforms

**Strategic Planning and Business Value**

* Lead tool portfolio rationalization and cost optimization reviews
* Build business cases and ROI models for observability investments
* Quantify the business value of monitoring capabilities in terms leadership cares about, such as uptime, MTTR, and cost avoidance
* Lead proof of concept evaluations for new observability technologies
* Assess build versus buy decisions for observability platforms and capabilities

**Leadership and Collaboration**

* Serve as the senior technical voice on observability across the global network organization
* Partner with regional network teams to ensure observability standards are adopted consistently
* Work with the NOC to operationalize telemetry, health checks, and alerting so findings turn into action
* Present observability strategy, roadmap, and business impact to executive stakeholders

**What You'll Bring**

* 10-15+ years of network engineering experience, with significant time spent in observability, monitoring architecture, or network analytics
* Demonstrated experience architecting observability solutions across multiple platforms in a large, multi-site environment
* Strong background in network protocols and infrastructure (routing, switching, SD-WAN) sufficient to understand what's being monitored, not just how to monitor it
* Experience with monitoring and analytics platforms such as NetScout, DX NetOps, NetFlow, Grafana, and PowerBI, or direct equivalents
* Track record of building predictive or anomaly detection capabilities, not just dashboards
* Experience developing business cases, ROI models, and executive-level communication around infrastructure investment

**Why This Role Matters**
A global network is only as manageable as it is visible. This role defines how we see problems before they become outages, how we prove the value of what we monitor, and how we turn raw telemetry into decisions leadership can act on.

title: Security Specialist
description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**
Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.
  
  
At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping future of business.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Security Specialist, you will be responsible for monitoring, triaging, analysing, and responding to cybersecurity alerts and incidents within a 24x7 Security Operations Centre environment. You will work closely with SOC leadership, security engineers, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to strengthen the organisation's cyber defence capabilities and ensure timely response to security threats.
  
  
This role provides the opportunity to develop deep technical expertise in threat detection, incident response, security monitoring, use case optimisation, and cybersecurity reporting while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance the overall security posture of the organisation.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Triage security alerts generated by SIEM platforms within defined SLAs and determine validity, criticality, and ownership.
* Investigate confirmed security incidents and provide detailed analysis, recommendations, and remediation guidance to relevant stakeholders.
* Follow established SOPs and playbooks for alert triage, investigation, and incident management activities.
* Handle SOC-related requests and support activities in a timely and professional manner.
* Own and manage one or more log source types, ensuring log quality, relevance, and coverage for security monitoring.
* Document log event types and maintain log source documentation.
* Map security use cases to available log sources and recommend new detection opportunities.
* Generate scheduled security reports, provide investigation summaries, and communicate findings to stakeholders.
* Support SOC leadership in creating and maintaining SOPs, playbooks, and operational processes.
* Recommend improvements to existing detection use cases, workflows, and response procedures based on emerging threats and lessons learned.
* Produce detailed investigation reports and provide actionable recommendations to improve security posture.
* Support automation initiatives, strategic cybersecurity projects, and continuous improvement efforts.
* Stay updated on emerging threats, security technologies, and industry best practices.
* Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and foster an inclusive culture.

**What You Must Have To Be Considered**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3+ years of experience in a Security Operations Centre (SOC) environment.
* Strong understanding of Networking, TCP/IP, OSI Model, Windows and Linux Operating Systems.
* Knowledge of Web Applications, Databases, and common cyber attack techniques.
* Experience with SIEM platforms and security monitoring processes.
* Strong analytical and incident investigation skills.
* Ability to communicate technical risks and findings effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with SOPs, security procedures, and incident management processes.
* A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good.
* The embodiment of Cognizant's Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The Right Thing, and Own It.

  
  
**These will help you succeed**

* Cybersecurity certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, SC-200, CySA+, GCIH, Splunk Certified User, or equivalent.
* Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, or similar SIEM technologies.
* Experience with threat hunting, EDR/XDR, and security automation.
* Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK framework and modern threat actor techniques.
* Experience creating SOPs, playbooks, and security reports.
* Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to mentor team members and support knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Continuous learning mindset with a passion for cybersecurity research and innovation.

**Work model –**
Hybrid - Chennai
  
  
We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position based in Chennai and will support 24x7 SOC operations through rotational shifts. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programmes.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

**About The Role**
We are seeking a curious, detail-oriented Security Analyst to join our new Integrated Security Operations Center (ISOC) in Bengaluru.
  
  
You will monitor, investigate, and respond to security alerts across our technology environment. Your core responsibility is 24x7 alert triage: separating suspicious activity from routine events, assessing impact, and taking timely, authorized action.
  
  
As operational needs and your skills evolve, you will also contribute to incident response, detection engineering, threat intelligence, and security improvement projects.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
**Security monitoring, triage, and response**

* Monitor and investigate alerts from SIEM, EDR, identity, email, network, and cloud security platforms.
* Correlate logs and evidence to assess alert validity, severity, scope, and business impact.
* Follow response playbooks; perform authorized containment and remediation; escalate complex or high-impact issues.
* Maintain clear investigation records, document decisions, and provide thorough shift handoffs.
* Partner with security, IT, and business teams to resolve issues and strengthen response quality.

**Incident response and improvement**

* Support incident response through evidence collection, timeline development, scoping, containment, and recovery.
* Contribute to post-incident reviews and improvements to playbooks, procedures, and operational knowledge.
* Identify recurring alert patterns, workflow gaps, and automation opportunities.

description:

**Job Title: Sr. Agentic AI Engineer**

Cybersecurity is seeking a
**Sr. Agentic AI Engineer**
to join the Cyber Analytics and Data Science team. This role focuses on designing, building, and operationalizing
**agentic AI systems**
, multi-agent frameworks, and intelligent automation solutions that enhance our cybersecurity posture. The ideal candidate will leverage advanced machine learning, LLM engineering, reasoning systems, and data engineering to solve enterprise-scale problems and drive the next generation of autonomous cyber-analytics capabilities.
  
  
You will be directly responsible for the
**architecture, development, deployment, and automation**
of agentic AI applications that support predictive, prescriptive, and autonomous cybersecurity operations. This role partners closely with key stakeholders across Cybersecurity, IT, and Data Engineering to accelerate the adoption of multi-agent systems, RAG-enhanced intelligence, and enterprise AI platforms.
  
  
The Sr. Agentic AI Engineer is a hands-on technologist, creative problem solver, and trusted advisor who brings deep experience with emerging AI technologies and a passion for building scalable, production-grade autonomous systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Agentic AI And Multi-Agent System Development**

* Architect, design, and deploy agentic AI workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and related orchestration libraries.
* Build multi-agent systems capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, task delegation, and collaboration across cybersecurity functions.
* Implement agent-to-agent coordination strategies, including shared memory, messaging, goal decomposition, and tool-use patterns.
* Design and optimize Agent Development Kit (ADK)–based pipelines for secure, scalable agent deployment.

**RAG Systems And Knowledge Integration**

* Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines enabling agents to interact with real-time knowledge sources, logs, cybersecurity datasets, and enterprise APIs.
* Optimize vector embeddings, indexing strategies, and memory structures for high-accuracy decision support.
* Ensure grounded, auditable, and explainable outputs from LLM-based agents.

**LLM Engineering And Advanced Reasoning**

* Fine-tune, prompt-engineer, and configure LLMs/SLMs for specialized cybersecurity and automation tasks.
* Build reasoning, planning, and self-critique modules for agents to operate autonomously and safely.
* Integrate external LLM APIs, embeddings, synthetic data, and custom model endpoints.

**Enterprise Agentic AI Platform**

* Lead the development of an enterprise-grade platform enabling orchestration of LLMs, RAG components, vector databases, and multi-agent protocols.
* Standardize the use of Model Context Protocol (MCP) for consistent context-sharing, memory management, and interoperability across agents.
* Build reusable agent templates, toolkits, and internal libraries to accelerate development across Cyber teams.

**MLOps, Observability And Automation**

* Implement CI/CD, pipeline orchestration, versioning, and agent lifecycle management.
* Establish monitoring, tracing, and observability practices for autonomous system behavior.
* Automate manual cybersecurity processes through AI-driven workflow orchestration and dynamic agents.

**Data Engineering And Cyber Analytics**

* Extract, transform, and aggregate data from disparate cybersecurity sources such as SIEM, IAM, SOAR, endpoint telemetry, and API-driven security tools.
* Apply ML and statistical modeling techniques for anomaly detection, classification, optimization, and pattern recognition.
* Translate complex findings into intuitive visualizations and actionable insights for leadership.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with cybersecurity SMEs, analysts, and engineers to identify opportunities for autonomous decision systems.
* Communicate complex AI concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Drive innovation and advocate for emerging AI technologies across the organization.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills**

* 5+ years total experience in software development, AI/ML engineering, or data science.
* 1+ year of Cybersecurity domain exposure, especially IAM (SailPoint, CyberArk) and SIEM/SOAR (Splunk, QRadar, etc.).
* 1+ year of hands-on experience building agentic AI or multi-agent applications, including LLM-driven workflows or reasoning systems.
* Strong Python skills and working knowledge of SQL.
* Direct experience with LLM/SLM APIs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG architecture, and memory systems.
* Experience deploying AI workloads on GCP (Vertex AI) and IBM WatsonX.
* Familiarity with agentic AI protocols, ADKs, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar orchestration tools.
* Practical experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) for agent-level context management.
* 1+ year experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Cohere, Anthropic, or similar frameworks.

**Preferred**

title: Apps Dev Tech Lead Analyst - C13 - CHENNAI
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking a senior, hands-on **Fenergo Technical Configurator** at the Vice President level to lead the end-to-end functional platform configuration across our global KYCX (Know Your Customer / Client Experience) estate.

This is a senior **Individual Contributor** role. You will be responsible for the technical configuration design and hands-on implementation of client journeys, policy rule sets, dynamic document models, risk rating logic, and security entitlements within Fenergo CLM. The position requires a deep technical understanding of Fenergo's declarative framework, data model, and workflow engine to translate complex institutional compliance requirements into scalable, maintainable platform configurations without writing custom application code.

**Core Accountabilities**
=========================

**1. Journey & Workflow Engine Configuration**
----------------------------------------------

* Own the technical design, configuration, and end-to-end testing of complex client lifecycle journeys across Corporate, Institutional, and Commercial Banking lines of business.

* Build and maintain workflows for Net-New Onboarding, Periodic KYC Refreshes, Event-Driven/Triggered Reviews, Material Change Ingestion, and Offboarding.

* Configure dynamic stage-gates, milestone triggers, complex decision splits, task orchestration, operational handoffs, and parallel processing branches.

* Implement SLA trackers, escalation paths, and automated fallback/exception handling mechanisms across jurisdictional booking locations.

**2. Policy, Risk & Regulatory Rules Setup**
--------------------------------------------

* Configure and maintain the Fenergo Policy Manager, Regulatory Rule Engine, and Entity Requirement Matrices across major regimes (e.g., FinCEN CDD, FATCA/CRS, EU 5MLD/6MLD, MiFID II, Dodd-Frank, MAS, HKMA, FCA).

* Set up dynamic Document Requirement Matrices, conditional document triggers, and Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) calculation rules based on entity types, ownership thresholds, and control structures.

* Configure risk scoring criteria, automated SDD/CDD/EDD triggers, and integration points for screening triggers (Sanctions, PEPs, Adverse Media).

**3. Entitlements, Security & Data Visibility**
-----------------------------------------------

* Design and configure granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), functional permission sets, user profiles, and multi-tier approval hierarchies.

* Configure strict data segregation and entitlement rules to enforce cross-border data privacy constraints and regional booking center restrictions.

* Implement Maker-Checker (Four-Eyes principle) controls, operational segregation of duties (SoD), and compliance sign-off stage-gates.

**4. Data Modeling, UI Forms & Business Rules**
-----------------------------------------------

* Configure entity data models, complex multi-tier parent-subsidiary hierarchies, fund structures, authorized signers, and related parties in Fenergo.

* Build dynamic, conditional UI forms, custom data groups, dropdown hierarchies, and field-level validation rules.

* Configure data validation rules, format masking, and conditional visibility logic across various stages of the client journey.

**5. Technical Governance, Packaging & Releases**
-------------------------------------------------

* Manage configuration asset version control, configuration deltas, XML/JSON deployment packages, and migration scripts across Dev, UAT, Staging, and Production environments.

* Perform pre-release impact assessments for Fenergo core upgrades, service packs, and policy changes to ensure backward compatibility and prevent configuration regressions.

* Troubleshoot advanced configuration defects, data structure inconsistencies, and journey bottlenecks in production and pre-production environments.

**Skills & Qualifications**
===========================

**Must-Have Technical Expertise (Mandatory)**
---------------------------------------------

* **Banking & Domain Background:** 12 to 15 years of solid experience in Corporate/Investment Banking or Wholesale Financial Services, with deep exposure to KYC/AML, Client Onboarding, Due Diligence (CDD/EDD), and regulatory compliance operations.

* **Senior Fenergo Hands-On Experience:** Demonstrable, in-depth configuration experience on enterprise Fenergo CLM platforms (v8.x, v9.x, and/or SaaS/Cloud editions).

* **Fenergo Journey & Workflow Mastery:** Extensive track record building and debugging complex, multi-entity journeys, stage-gates, parallel branches, and exception routing rules.

* **Policy Engine & Rules Configuration:** Proven hands-on capability in configuring Fenergo Policy Manager, Entity Requirements Matrix, Dynamic Document Engine, and UBO threshold rules.

* **Entitlement & Access Model Setup:** Direct experience configuring complex user roles, permissions, data-level visibility rules, and cross-jurisdictional entitlement frameworks.

* **Entity Data Modeling:** Deep expertise in configuring Fenergo data dictionaries, custom attributes, entity relationship mapping, and dynamic UI forms.

* **Environment & Package Management:** Hands-on experience preparing configuration packages, managing environment-specific variables, and executing zero-downtime configuration deployments across multi-tier environments.

**Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred)**
-----------------------------------

* **Fenergo Certification:** Fenergo Certified Product/Configuration Professional.

* **API & Interface Payload Understanding:** Strong functional familiarity with REST API / JSON / XML payload structures and data mapping dictionaries for integrating Fenergo with external screening engines (e.g., Fircosoft, World-Check), Core Banking, and Document Repositories.

* **External Data Provider Integration:** Experience configuring data enrichment lookups and connectors (e.g., Dun & Bradstreet, Bureau van Dijk/Orbis, Companies House, Refinitiv, GLEIF).

* **Industry Compliance Certifications:** ACAMS (CAMS) or ICA Diploma in AML/KYC.

* **Agile Delivery:** Experience working in JIRA/Confluence within a Scrum/SAFe technical delivery model.

**Scope & Non-Requirements**
============================

* **Individual Contributor Scope:** This is a dedicated technical and functional configuration role with no line management or people management responsibilities. The candidate will own technical deliverables, solution designs, and platform setup directly.

* **No Software Coding Required:** This role does not require software engineering or programming background (such as Java, C#, C++, Python, or web UI development). The focus is entirely on declarative platform configuration, rules engine authoring, data modeling, and workflow orchestration using Fenergo native configuration tools.

Built on institutional-grade compliance and on-chain accountability, their platform uses a governance token to connect capital with high-impact projects across emerging markets, aligning long-term economic growth with measurable social and environmental outcomes.

You will operate as part of an Embedded Capability Team that moves in lockstep with the client’s internal rhythms, working as a true extension of their in-house team rather than a separate vendor track. The engagement is designed for long-term capability building, shared ownership of outcomes, and deep domain expertise in sustainability, impact, and financial data over time.

* Manage and maintain core company platforms including cloud workspaces (AWS Workspaces, Google Workspace), collaboration tools (Slack, Microsoft Teams, email systems), and business intelligence platforms like Power BI.
* Provision and administer user accounts, access controls, and permissions across all systems, including Power BI workspaces, datasets, and gateways, with strong adherence to least-privilege and ISO 27001 compliance standards.
* Support integration between core business systems (CRM, financial tools, HR platforms, Power BI, document management) ensuring seamless data flow and user experience.
* Provide hands-on troubleshooting and incident response for IT issues across endpoints, networks, applications, BI tools, and integrations, minimizing downtime through systematic root cause analysis.
* Deploy and maintain endpoint security solutions, backups, antivirus, and patch management for workstations, laptops, and mobile devices.
* Monitor system health, performance, and security posture using enterprise monitoring tools, with automated alerting and basic AI-assisted anomaly detection across BI and operational systems.
* Automate routine operational tasks (user onboarding/offboarding, system backups, compliance reporting, Power BI refresh schedules, software deployments) using scripting and workflow tools.
* Document IT processes, configurations, and standard operating procedures, including BI data governance and integration patterns, to ensure knowledge transfer and operational continuity.
* Collaborate with business users, analysts, and engineering teams to resolve technical issues and support feature delivery without operational disruption.

**Required skills and experience**

* Strong hands-on experience administering cloud workspaces, productivity platforms, and business intelligence tools like Power BI (workspaces, gateways, data sources, DAX/refresh management).
* Proficiency managing collaboration and business systems (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, CRM integrations, financial/ERP tools, Microsoft 365 ecosystem).

title: Infrastructure Security Specialist
description:
**Role Purpose**
The On-Premises Security Engineer is responsible for protecting enterprise data center infrastructure, with specialized ownership of security engineering for VMware vSphere, vCenter Server, ESXi hosts, virtual machines, and the supporting identity, network, storage, backup, logging, and management services. The role establishes and maintains secure configurations, monitors for threats and control failures, drives vulnerability remediation, supports incident response, and provides security guidance throughout the infrastructure lifecycle.
  
  
Working closely with On-Premises Operations, Security Operations, Infrastructure Engineering, Network, Storage, Backup, R&D, QA, Compliance, and corporate IT teams, the engineer converts security requirements into practical, supportable controls that protect availability, integrity, confidentiality, and recoverability without introducing unnecessary operational risk.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
**VMware Platform Security Engineering/ On-Premises Infrastructure Security**

* Design, implement, maintain, and continuously improve security controls for VMware vSphere, vCenter Server Appliance, ESXi hosts, clusters, virtual machines, templates, datastores, management networks, and virtual networking.
* Develop and enforce secure configuration baselines for ESXi and vCenter, including lockdown mode, Secure Boot, TPM attestation, host firewall rules, SSH and shell restrictions, certificate management, time synchronization, persistent logging, and control-state monitoring.
* Assess VMware architecture and configuration changes for security impact; document requirements, risks, exceptions, compensating controls, validation steps, and rollback considerations.
* Partner with platform owners on lifecycle management, patching, upgrades, certificate renewal, version supportability, hardware refresh, and secure decommissioning.

**Identity, Access, and Privileged Administration**

* Implement and review least-privilege access, role-based access control, separation of duties, privileged access workflows, service accounts, and administrative group membership across VMware management services.
* Secure vCenter Single Sign-On and connected identity sources, including Active Directory or federated identity integrations; review authentication, authorization, and privileged activity for anomalous or unauthorized behavior.
* Coordinate periodic access reviews and provide evidence for audit, compliance, and control-assurance activities.

**Vulnerability and Configuration Management**

* Perform or coordinate vulnerability assessments, configuration reviews, and security testing across hypervisors, management appliances, guest operating systems, and supporting infrastructure.
* Analyze vendor advisories, CVEs, scan results, and threat intelligence; prioritize remediation based on exploitability, exposure, asset criticality, operational risk, and available compensating controls.
* Track remediation through closure, validate corrective actions, and document accepted risks or approved exceptions in accordance with governance requirements.
* Coordinate operating system and application hardening for Windows and Linux virtual machines using approved enterprise standards.

**Security Monitoring, Detection, and Incident Response**

* Integrate VMware and supporting infrastructure telemetry with the enterprise SIEM and security monitoring ecosystem; ensure security-relevant events are collected, normalized, retained, and usable for investigation.
* Develop and tune detection use cases for authentication anomalies, privilege escalation, unauthorized configuration changes, control tampering, suspicious VM lifecycle activity, persistence, destructive actions, backup interference, and ransomware indicators.
* Monitor security alerts and infrastructure logs; investigate anomalous activity, preserve evidence, determine scope and impact, and coordinate containment, eradication, and recovery with Security Operations and infrastructure teams.
* Lead or support root-cause analysis and post-incident reviews; translate lessons learned into corrective actions, improved detections, updated baselines, and stronger operational procedures.

**Data Center Consolidation & Migration Security**

* Provide security engineering and assurance throughout data-center consolidation and workload migration activities, including pre-migration risk assessments, target-state security requirements, migration validation, and post-migration control verification.
* Validate that security controls, logging, endpoint protection, network segmentation, privileged access, vulnerability management, backup/recovery, and monitoring remain effective before, during, and after workload migrations.
* Identify legacy dependencies, unsupported platforms, security-control gaps, and technical debt that could introduce risk during migration, and track remediation or approved exceptions through closure.
* Work with relevant stakeholders across security, technology, and business functions to establish security requirements and validate migrated workloads.

**Resilience, Recovery, and Operational Assurance**

* Validate that VMware security controls align with backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity requirements, including administrative isolation and recoverability of critical workloads.
* Participate in recovery testing, tabletop exercises, security validation, and major infrastructure changes; document findings and track corrective actions.
* Create dashboards, metrics, and reporting for vulnerability exposure, configuration compliance, privileged access, logging coverage, remediation status, exceptions, and security control health.
* Maintain technical standards, procedures, runbooks, architecture diagrams, control evidence, and operational documentation.

**Collaboration and Governance**

* Provide security subject-matter expertise to infrastructure, engineering, application, compliance, and business teams on secure on-premises architecture and VMware operations.
* Contribute to security roadmaps, platform modernization, technical proposals, design reviews, audit responses, risk assessments, and policy or standard development.
* Communicate technical risks and recommended actions clearly to both technical teams and leadership; escalate material risks, control failures, and unresolved remediation issues through established governance channels.
* Participate in an on-call or incident-response rotation as required by the operating model.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in information security, infrastructure security, systems engineering, or data center operations, including substantial experience securing VMware environments.
* Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere, vCenter Server, ESXi, clusters, virtual networking, datastores, permissions, certificates, logging, patching, and lifecycle management.
* Strong knowledge of infrastructure security principles, including system hardening, vulnerability management, privileged access, network segmentation, encryption, logging, monitoring, incident response, backup security, and disaster recovery.
* Experience securing Windows Server and Linux systems and working with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, PKI/certificates, enterprise networking, firewalls, load balancers, shared storage, and backup platforms.
* Experience with SIEM, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, configuration compliance, and security incident-management tools.
* Ability to interpret technical logs and security alerts, perform structured troubleshooting, collect defensible evidence, assess risk, and coordinate remediation across multiple teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, disciplined documentation practices, and the ability to explain technical risk to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, CrowdStrike, or a comparable SIEM, including log onboarding, use-case development, detection tuning, dashboards, and incident investigation.
* Experience with PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar scripting and automation technologies.
* Knowledge of CIS Benchmarks, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, MITRE ATT&CK, CVSS, and risk-based control assessment.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GIAC, Security+, VMware VCP or VCAP, or comparable infrastructure and security credentials.
* Experience supporting regulated, validated, or audit-sensitive environments.

**Technical Knowledge Areas**
**VMware Security**

* vSphere, vCenter Server, ESXi, HA/DRS concepts, permissions, SSO, certificates, Secure Boot, TPM, lockdown mode, host firewall, logging, patching, hardening, and lifecycle security.

**Identity & Access**

* Active Directory, federation concepts, RBAC, least privilege, privileged access, service accounts, access reviews, authentication, and authorization monitoring.

**Infrastructure**

* Windows Server, Linux, server hardware, shared storage, backup and recovery, PKI, DNS/DHCP, VLANs, routing, load balancers, firewalls, and management networks.

**Security Operations**

* SIEM, event correlation, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, threat detection, incident response, evidence preservation, root-cause analysis, and remediation tracking.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Security standards, risk assessments, control testing, exceptions, audit evidence, metrics, policy implementation, and technical documentation.

**Automation**

* PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, Bash, APIs, configuration validation, reporting automation, and repeatable security control checks.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Security ownership and sound judgment, with the ability to balance risk reduction, service availability, and operational practicality.
* Analytical troubleshooting and disciplined decision-making during high-impact security or infrastructure incidents.
* Attention to detail in production changes, access control, evidence collection, remediation validation, and technical documentation.
* Clear, respectful communication and effective collaboration across security, infrastructure, engineering, compliance, and vendor teams.
* Continuous-improvement mindset with a focus on automation, measurable controls, resilience, and reduction of recurring risk.
* Ability to work independently, manage concurrent priorities, and operate effectively across regions and time zones

**Key Accountabilities**
**Strategic**

* Advance the VMware and on-premises security roadmap, architecture, lifecycle, and modernization priorities.

**Operational**

* Maintain secure operations, investigate incidents, reduce vulnerabilities, validate changes, and support reliable recovery.

**Assurance**

* Measure control effectiveness, maintain evidence, report risk and remediation status, and support audits and compliance reviews.
