**Role Title** : **Identity Governance User Reconciliation Senior Analyst (L9)**

**Company Overview:** Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a premier consumer financial services company delivering one of the industry’s most complete digitally enabled product suites. Our experience, expertise and scale encompass a broad spectrum of industries including digital, health and wellness, retail, telecommunications, home, auto, outdoors, pet and more.

* We have recently been ranked #5 among India’s Best Companies to Work for 2023, #21 under LinkedIn Top Companies in India list, and received Top 25 BFSI recognition from Great Place To Work India. We have been ranked Top 5 among India’s Best Workplaces in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion, and Top 10 among India’s Best Workplaces for Women in 2022.
* We offer 100% Work from Home flexibility for all our Functional employees and provide some of the best-in-class Employee Benefits and Programs catering to work-life balance and overall well-being. In addition to this, we also have Regional Engagement Hubs across India and a co-working space in Bangalore.

**Organizational Overview:** This role will be part of Synchrony Identity and Access Management Technology and Governance team which ties to Synchrony Information Security team.

**Role Summary/Purpose:** The Identity Governance User Reconciliation Senior Analyst is responsible for the validation of access between Synchrony systems and Synchrony’s identity governance platform. Synchrony leverages SailPoint Identity IQ for its identity governance platform. An access reconciliation portal was created to reconcile access and role data between SailPoint Identity IQ and the target Synchrony system. This role will have the responsibility to ensure all access and role information in Synchrony’s identity governance platform matches exactly with the respective access in each Synchrony system. This role will be a critical member of Synchrony’s identity governance configuration management agile product team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Ensure access and role information in Synchrony’s identity governance platform matches with the access information in the respective Synchrony system.
* Ensure roles and privileges that exist in the target system have an IT Role in Synchrony’s identity governance platform.

* Work with Synchrony’s Role Based Access Control (RBAC) team to have IT Roles created for any roles that exist in the target system, but not in Synchrony’s identity governance platform.
* All role and access discrepancies must be remediated with the help of the technology owner and Synchrony’s security administration team. Any remaining discrepancies must certified outside Synchrony’s identity governance platform and appropriately risk treated.
* For any systems that are not onboarded onto the access reconciliation portal, a manual reconciliation of access must be performed in accordance to the published job aid.
* Partner with technology owners, the IAM security administration team and the access reconciliation portal development team to ensure accurate and complete role and workgroup configurations.
* Ensure all access reconciliation job aids and end user guides are accurate, maintained and effectively communicated regularly.
* Actively participate as a critical member of the SIAM Configuration Management agile product team. Develop, prioritize and ensure timely execution of all agile stories as assigned by the VP, Identity Governance Configuration Process.
* Provide training and education to technology owners and stakeholders on access management best practices and standards.
* Identify, propose and remediate process and technical gaps in Synchrony’s access reconciliation service.

**Required Skills/Knowledge :**

* 2 – 4 years of information technology (IT) experience with at least 2 years of experience in the Identity Access Management (IAM) domain.
* Minimum 2 years of role administration experience within SailPoint IdentityIQ.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge :**

* Working knowledge of Jira and SAFE agile framework
* Working knowledge of entitlements and IT roles.
* Working experience managing ServiceNow requests and incidents, resolving tickets within SLA.
* Proven strong analytical and problem solving skills
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Strong interpersonal skills
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Teams, SharePoint and Excel
* Knowledge of security related regulatory standards including HIPAA, PCI, SOX, NIST
* Good understanding of AWS and O365 environments
* Working knowledge of Oracle Database and SQL.

**Eligibility Criteria:**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 2 to 4 years of relevant IT work experience of information technology (IT) experience with at least 2 years of experience in the Identity Access Management (IAM) domain.

**Work timings**: **1:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST**
  
This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: TC-CS-CTM-VM-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Position Title: TEM Senior – Vulnerability Management**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
As a Senior with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) Cybersecurity Team, you will contribute technically to client engagements and internal initiatives. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen client’s relationships. You will also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements, and report and escalate any engagement related issues to senior team members as appropriate.
  
  
**The opportunity**
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards, and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help senior members with business development activities.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Must have handled a Vulnerability Management process for a large enterprise using any one of the solutions: Qualys / Nexpose / Tenable or similar
* Must have thorough understanding about the Vulnerability Management and Exception & Exemption process on Cloud hosted systems, databases, web services and other widely deployed infrastructure components
* Ability to work both independently as well as lead a team of experienced staff to manage the vulnerability management program.
* Provide technical leadership and advise to team members in order to ensure the effectiveness of the program.
* Provide guidance on risk management principles and practices to junior staff regularly.
* Lead analysis of the current environment to detect critical deficiencies and recommends solutions for improvement
* Review findings from and identify root causes for common issues and provide recommendations for sustainable improvements
* Able to identify and exploit security vulnerabilities in a wide array of systems in a variety of situations
* Research and report on security vulnerabilities and latest advancements in the vulnerability management lifecycle
* Understand EY and its service lines and actively assess what the firm can deliver to serve clients.
* Facilitate discussions / knowledge sharing with key client personnel and contribute to EY’s thought leadership
* Maintain a strong client focus by effectively serving client needs and developing productive working relationships with client personnel. Stay abreast of current business and economic developments and new pronouncements/standards relevant to the client's business.
* Demonstrate industry expertise (deep understanding of the industry, emerging trends, issues/challenges, key players & leading practices)
* Actively contribute to improving operational efficiency through standardization and process automation on client engagements and internal initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Knowledge of Windows, Linux, UNIX, any other major operating systems.
* Deep understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Understanding of network security and popular attacks vectors.
* Familiarized with the latest security vulnerabilities and exploit, understanding of web-based application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10), cloud security and architecture
* Experience with scripting / programming skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell)
* Hands on operational experience with vulnerability management tools (e.g. Qualys, Nexpose) including the ability to deploy, configure, and run these tools
* Fluency in English, other language skills are considered an asset
* Experience in handling data using Pandas, XML libraries
* Exposure to handling computer networking and operating systems use cases using python.
* Exposure and experience in analytical thinking with tools like power bi, tableu.
* Required knowledge for Python libraries: netaddr, ipaddress, qualysapi, lxml, pandas, numpy

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Graduates / BE / BTech / MSc / MTech / MBA in the fields of Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business or related major with minimum 3 years of work experience especially in penetration testing and vulnerability assessment.
* Any one of the following technical certifications: CEH, Qualys Certified Specialist, CISM
* Knowledge of Windows, Linux, UNIX, any other major operating systems
* Willingness to work in shifts

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills
* Certifications: CEH, Qualys Certified Specialist, CISM

**What We Look For**
Who can perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing and provide analysis for the testing results.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Control Resilience Assessor
description:
**Description**
**About The Company:**
WTW (NASDAQ: WTW) is in the business of people, risk and capital. With roots dating to 1828, our company has over 45,000 colleagues serving more than 140 countries and markets. Our values – client focus, teamwork, integrity, respect and excellence – underlie all that we do, including how we behave and interact with each other. They are part of our WTW DNA. We design and deliver solutions that manage risk, optimize benefits, cultivate talent, and expand the power of capital to protect and strengthen institutions and individuals. Our unique perspective allows us to see the critical intersections between talent, assets, and ideas — the dynamic formula that drives business performance. Together, we unlock potential. We are located on the internet at wtwco.com

The Information Security (InfoSec) team is responsible for protecting the organization's information, systems, and data from security threats. The team delivers security services that help identify, prevent, detect, and respond to cyber risks while supporting business and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**The Role**

* Perform controls testing across On-Premise and Cloud environments, assessing Control Design Adequacy and Control Operating Effectiveness.
* Demonstrate knowledge of audit and compliance frameworks such as Sarbanes–Oxley Act Section 404 (SOX 404), SOC 2, SSAE 18, and New York Department of Financial Services Cybersecurity Regulation (NYDFS).

* Gather audit evidence, perform testing, and document results in accordance with organizational standards.
* Adapt quickly to new domains and complex assessment activities while ensuring high-quality testing execution.
* Lead assigned projects independently, ensuring end-to-end ownership and timely delivery.
* Support team members through knowledge sharing, guidance, and collaboration.
* Identify, report, and track control gaps across on-prem and cloud environments, including ineffective or inadequate controls.
* Assess risk impact and severity associated with identified control deficiencies.
* Recommend improvements to control design and implementation to strengthen security and compliance posture.
* Support control owners in designing, implementing, and maintaining controls and documentation.
* Prepare comprehensive control testing reports including issue descriptions, evidence analysis, and recommendations.
* Perform additional tasks and responsibilities assigned by management.
* Stay updated with evolving information security regulations, standards, and industry best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Educated to degree level or equivalent
* 7-8 years’ experience with IT and technology controls/audit related engagements
* Experience of working within a Global Financial organization
* Problem Solving
* Delivery focused
* Strong communications and stakeholder management

* Stage 1: Online application and recruiter review
* Stage 2: Pre-recorded video interview
* Stage 3: Live video or in person interview with hiring manager and team
* Stage 4: Offer and onboarding

Tata Communications Redefines Connectivity with Innovation and IntelligenceDriving the next level of intelligence powered by Cloud, Mobility, Internet of Things, Collaboration, Security, Media services and Network services, we at Tata Communications are envisaging a New World of Communications
  
  
**Job Description – GRC / RSA Archer Consultant**
**Experience:**
5–6 Years
  
  
**Role:**
GRC / RSA Archer Consultant
  
  
**Archer Experience:**
Preferably 3 Years
  
  
**Primary Skills:**
RSA Archer, GRC, IT Risk, Cybersecurity Risk, Compliance, Audit, TPRM, Risk Assessment, Reporting & Dashboard
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced
**GRC professional with strong hands-on expertise in RSA Archer**
to manage and support Governance, Risk, Compliance, Information Security Risk, Audit, and Regulatory Compliance processes.
  
  
The candidate will be responsible for administration, configuration, implementation, workflow management, reporting, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of the Archer GRC platform while working closely with Information Security, Risk, Audit, Compliance, IT, business teams, and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**RSA Archer – Platform & Administration**

* Administer and support the RSA Archer GRC platform.
* Configure applications, questionnaires, dashboards, reports, data feeds, notifications, workflows, and access controls.
* Develop and maintain Archer applications and use cases based on business and regulatory requirements.
* Configure user roles, permissions, access control, and security groups.
* Troubleshoot Archer application, workflow, data, and integration-related issues.
* Perform platform health checks and coordinate with OEM/vendor for product-related issues.
* Manage application changes, enhancements, releases, and upgrades.
* Maintain Archer configuration documentation and operational procedures.

**GRC & Risk Management**

* Support implementation and management of Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) processes.
* Manage Information Security and IT Risk assessments through Archer.
* Develop and maintain risk registers, risk assessments, risk treatment plans, and remediation tracking.
* Support identification, assessment, monitoring, and reporting of technology and cybersecurity risks.
* Define and monitor risk indicators, including KRIs and KPIs.
* Support risk acceptance, exception management, and risk remediation processes.

**Audit & Issue Management**

* Manage internal and external audit activities using Archer.
* Configure audit engagements, control testing, observations, findings, and remediation workflows.
* Track audit issues and action plans through closure.
* Generate management dashboards and reports for audit and compliance status.
* Coordinate with control owners and stakeholders for timely closure of findings.

**Third-Party / Vendor Risk Management**

* Support Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) processes using Archer.
* Configure vendor assessments, inherent risk assessments, questionnaires, and due diligence workflows.
* Track vendor risks, exceptions, remediation actions, and compliance status.
* Support periodic vendor reassessment and reporting.

**Reporting & Dashboard**
**Develop Management Dashboards And Reports For**

* Enterprise Risk
* Cybersecurity Risk
* Compliance
* Audit
* Third-Party Risk
* Policy compliance
* Exceptions
* Remediation status
* Provide MIS and executive-level reporting to senior management.
* Analyze GRC data and identify trends, recurring issues, and areas of improvement.

**Integration & Automation**

* Work with application, security, and infrastructure teams for integration of Archer with enterprise systems.
* Support integration through APIs, data feeds, and other available mechanisms.
* Automate repetitive GRC processes and reporting wherever possible.
* Troubleshoot data synchronization and integration issues.

title: Technical Consulting Engineer
description:
This role provides assistance to customers' technical support requests by applying technical expertise to conduct advanced troubleshooting and resolve issues, handling technical problems within specific technologies and architectures such as Security and Networking across a broad range of problem complexity. At senior levels, the position manages increasingly complex and integrated solutions, operating in a highly complex technical environment that often requires deep, cross-product knowledge and systems-level thinking. The role involves collaboration with customers, partners, engineering, and internal stakeholders to drive resolution and continuous improvement, and contributes to product quality by submitting bugs, defects, and quality escalations to Engineering. Additionally, the position utilizes and enhances lab environments and digital intellectual capital to deepen expertise, support troubleshooting, and scale solutions across the team, while leveraging TAC AI capabilities, software, automation, and diagnostic tools to support quality and efficiency, and proactively identify and address issues. The role may also include mentoring peers and team members for individual and team development.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Supports premium offers and solution support
* Is a technical expert in more than one area and has clear understanding of entire solutions
* Operates independently on case resolution focusing on complex and diverse cases requiring in-depth evaluation & analysis and thinking beyond the fix to prevent future problems
* Serves an as early adopter of processes/tools and helps drive TCE specific priorities
* Impacts within workgroup, shift, site, region as well as product
* Applies expert knowledge and experience with global customer issues, trends and patterns, and the customer experience to participate in proactive engagements with Engineering
* Advises other TCEs on customer problems
* Develops and helps team develop productive relationships with customers and takes ownership for customer success
* Submits effective escalations with Engineering teams and advises peers on effective engagement with the Engineering teams
* May act as a global TAC Sponsor to review and approve formal engineering escalations (e.g., BEMS, Jira submissions)
* Proactively identifies and documents pervasive bugs and systemic issues within the technology domain
* Mentors, develops and coaches others on bug quality, submission review, and other regional best practices
* Provides escalation support, and lab setup expertise. Builds shared and reusable lab setups and provides resolutions for errors and gaps
* Interprets technical documentation, functional specs, and RFCs and applies expected product behavior across industry standards
* Leverages advanced knowledge of software skills and tools to configure, deploy and/or troubleshoot Cisco products and solutions
* Adopts and encourages adoption of AI and automation tools to improve resolution speed and accuracy, productivity, and quality
* Develops and disseminates intellectual capital (e.g., advanced diagnostics, automation workflows, and AI-assisted troubleshooting guides) that supports global reuse across internal teams, Global Delivery Partners, and customers
* Actively adopts TAC Tools essential for solving TAC SRs as well as for TAC Efficiencies (e.g. docs, training, processes) and advocates their adoption within their teams
* Frequently liaises between team and Technology Owners, Technology Group Leaders, Senior Technical Talent and TAC Technical Leaders
* Acts as a bridge between support and engineering strategy
* Guides peers in effective cross-functional engagement and actively mentors junior TCEs, contributing to their development and strengthening team performance through knowledge sharing and support

**Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelors + 7 years of related experience, or
  
  
Masters + 4 years of related experience, or
  
  
PhD + 1 year of related experience, or equivalent relevant work experience
  
  
Expert level (e.g., CCIE) or equivalent relevant certification expected
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Associate Analyst

Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Associate Analyst, Analytics & Metrics to join our KPI Monitoring Team part of Non API Integrations team in Open Finance. In this role, you will be responsible for proactive monitoring of critical business and operational KPIs, investigating alerts and production issues, analyzing large datasets, identifying trends and anomalies, and supporting incident management activities.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, hands-on experience with monitoring and reporting tools, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced production support environment. This position plays a key role in ensuring service reliability, operational excellence, and timely resolution of incidents impacting business-critical services.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
KPI Monitoring & Operational Support
  
  
Proactively monitor applications, platforms, services, and key business KPIs using established monitoring tools.
  
  
Monitor production environments to detect anomalies, performance degradation, service disruptions, and operational issues.
  
  
Investigate alerts, incidents, and service failures and take appropriate actions based on defined procedures.
  
  
Ensure timely escalation and communication of critical issues to relevant stakeholders.

Troubleshooting & Incident Management

Develop and maintain dashboards, visualizations, reports, and performance scorecards.

Convert analytical findings into actionable recommendations that improve operational performance and KPI health.
  
  
Monitoring Automation & Continuous Improvement
  
  
Create and maintain Splunk searches, dashboards, reports, and automated alerts.
  
  
Enhance monitoring capabilities by identifying opportunities for automation and operational efficiency.
  
  
Track recurring incidents and recommend process improvements to reduce operational risk.
  
  
Support continuous improvement initiatives related to KPI monitoring, service reliability, and operational excellence.

Required Competencies
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
Excellent troubleshooting and investigative mindset.
  
  
Ability to analyze large and complex datasets.
  
  
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  
  
Ability to prioritize multiple incidents and manage competing priorities.
  
  
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
  
  
Ability to work independently and as part of a global operations team.
  
  
Comfortable working in a fast-paced production support environment.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
Experience in production monitoring, operational support, NOC, SRE, Business Operations, or KPI monitoring functions.
  
  
Knowledge of application performance monitoring tools and observability platforms.
  
  
Understanding of incident management frameworks and operational best practices.
  
  
Experience working within Agile or DevOps environments.
  
  
Exposure to financial services, fintech, payment processing, or data-driven operational environments is a plus.
  
  
Education & Experience
  
  
Bachelor's Degree in any field.
  
  
1-3 years of experience in analytics, monitoring, production support, operations, or incident management roles.
  
  
Hands-on experience with Excel, SQL and data analysis tools preferred.

This position requires participation in a 24x7 rotational shift model, including weekends, public holidays, and on-call support as needed to ensure operational coverage.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Sealed Air designs and delivers packaging solutions that protect essential goods transported worldwide, preserve food, enable e-commerce and digital connectivity, and help create a global supply chain that is touchless, safer, less wasteful, and more resilient. We strive to foster a caring, high-performance growth culture that will deliver consistent, sustainable profitable growth and accelerate our performance – a culture where accountability is clear and aligned, and where we reward business outcomes and impact. That culture guides everything we do, including how we partner with our customers and suppliers, how we attract and retain top talent, and how we create and deliver value to our stakeholders. In 2025, Sealed Air generated $5.4 billion in sales and has approximately 16,100 employees who serve customers in 119 countries/territories. To learn more, visit www.sealedair.com.
  
  
Senior Platform Engineer
  
  
Sealed Air is seeking a highly skilled and self-motivated Senior Cloud Platform Migration Engineer to assume ownership of critical cloud infrastructure supporting customer-facing digital services and connected manufacturing capabilities.
  
  
The successful candidate will stabilize, operate, document, and modernize an existing AWS-based platform ecosystem while helping drive the long-term strategic transition to Microsoft Azure. The role requires practical experience with AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, automation, infrastructure-as-code, Linux, security, and cloud platform operations.
  
  
This is not primarily an application development role. The candidate must understand enough about application hosting patterns to support infrastructure decisions, troubleshoot platform-level issues, and partner effectively with application teams, but application code ownership and long-term application modernization.
  
  
What are we looking for in you?
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Cloud Platform Ownership
  
  

* Own the operational health, reliability, security, and lifecycle management of assigned cloud-hosted infrastructure platforms.
* Administer current-state AWS platform components including IAM, networking, compute, storage, platform services, encryption, and security controls.
* Support and maintain Cloud Foundry and BOSH platform infrastructure, including stemcells, releases, manifests, routing dependencies, certificates, and operational procedures.
* Manage platform patching, operating system lifecycle activities, certificate renewals, vulnerability remediation, and related production maintenance activities.
* Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, technical diagrams, and support procedures for inherited and future-state environments.

Azure Migration and Modernization
  
  

* Help lead infrastructure planning and execution for migration from AWS-hosted platform services to Azure-based target-state architecture.
* Assess current AWS, Cloud Foundry, GitLab, Linux, networking, IAM, and platform service dependencies to define migration approach, risks, sequencing, and operational impacts.
* Design repeatable Azure infrastructure patterns aligned to enterprise standards, including identity, network, security, monitoring, backup, and operational support models.
* Partner with Jayaram's application team to ensure application workloads are migrated or modernized with a clear separation between application ownership and infrastructure platform ownership.
* Develop migration automation and validation patterns to reduce risk and improve repeatability across future transitions.

Why do we need you?
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, DevOps, automation, or related infrastructure operations experience.
* Strong hands-on AWS experience, including operational support of production cloud infrastructure.
* Practical Azure knowledge and demonstrated ability to design or support cloud migration and modernization activities.
* Hands-on scripting and automation experience with Python and Shell/Bash.
* Experience with GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, Linux administration, infrastructure automation, and cloud security practices.
* Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and/or CloudFormation.
* Strong troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, documentation, and operational problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to operate independently in a partially documented inherited environment and convert ambiguity into structured technical action plans.
* Cloud Foundry administration experience, especially with self-managed or legacy platform environments.
* BOSH administration experience, including directors, stemcells, releases, manifests, and platform lifecycle management.
* Experience migrating workloads or platform services between public cloud providers, especially AWS to Azure.
* Experience with Azure landing zones, Azure networking, Azure identity, Azure Monitor, Azure Policy, and Azure-native platform services.
* Experience administering self-hosted GitLab, including upgrades, runners, access controls, storage, backups, and migration to SaaS or alternate DevOps platforms.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, containers, platform-as-a-service models, and modern application hosting patterns.
* Experience supporting industrial IoT, connected device, or manufacturing-adjacent cloud platforms.
* AWS, Azure, DevOps, security, or architecture certifications.

**Role Brief: Incident Manager (6-Day Work Week)**

**Service Restoration Business Continuity**

* Drive teams toward quick service restoration while minimizing business impact.
* Ensure adherence to incident response procedures, escalation matrices, and recovery plans.
* Support business continuity initiatives and operational resilience programs.

* Facilitate critical decision-making during service disruptions.
* Ensure all stakeholders understand their roles and responsibilities during incident response activities.

* 5-6 years of experience in Major Incident Management, Critical Incident Management, IT Operations, Service Delivery, or EUC Support environments.
* Strong understanding of End User Computing technologies and enterprise workplace services.
* Experience managing high-severity incidents in large enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, Remedy, or similar tools.
* Excellent understanding of Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Service Operations processes.

* Active Directory Azure AD

title: Solutions Architect IAM
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced
**Solution Architect – IAM / Identity Security**
with
**8–15 years of overall experience**
and strong expertise in Identity and Access Management, Identity Governance, and enterprise identity security.

The role will be responsible for architecting complex enterprise identity environments and translating business and security requirements into scalable, secure, and implementable identity solutions using the Cymmetri platform.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working directly with
**CIOs, CISOs, enterprise security teams, customers, partners, Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams**
. The role requires someone who can think beyond implementation and own the complete journey from
**Business Requirement → Identity Architecture → Integration → Security → Deployment → Successful Production Rollout**
.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Identity Architecture & Solution Design**
  : Understand complex business, security, and technical requirements and design scalable end-to-end IAM/IGA and Identity Security architectures.
* **IAM & Identity Governance**
  : Design solutions covering Identity Governance, Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML), Access Governance, RBAC, Segregation of Duties (SoD), Access Reviews, provisioning, and de-provisioning.
* **Authentication & Federation**
  : Design and guide enterprise authentication and federation solutions involving SSO, MFA, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, and LDAP.
* **Enterprise Integrations**
  : Architect integrations with Active Directory/Entra ID, HRMS platforms, SAP, databases, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications, ensuring secure and reliable identity and access flows.
* **Security Architecture**
  : Incorporate security principles across identity solutions, including PAM, Identity Risk, Identity Threat Detection & Response (ITDR), Zero Trust, least privilege, and access controls.
* **Infrastructure & Deployment Architecture**
  : Design solutions across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid environments, including considerations for High Availability (HA), Disaster Recovery (DR), scalability, performance, and business continuity.
* **Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**
  : Lead architecture discussions, workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and technical presentations with CIOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, security teams, and other senior stakeholders.
* **Pre-Sales & Solution Consulting**
  : Support Sales and Pre-Sales teams with technical discovery, RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, architecture presentations, demonstrations, and Proofs of Concept (POCs).
* **Implementation & Production Rollout**
  : Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams to translate architecture into implementation plans and provide technical guidance through integration, testing, deployment, and production rollout.
* **Technical Problem Solving**
  : Identify architectural risks, integration challenges, and technical dependencies and work with relevant teams to develop effective solutions.
* **Architecture Documentation**
  : Create and maintain solution architecture documents, integration designs, data flows, deployment architectures, security designs, and technical specifications.
* **Technology & Product Collaboration**
  : Work with Product and Engineering teams to identify product capabilities, technical gaps, and opportunities to improve enterprise solution design.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **8–15 years**
  of overall experience with significant experience in IAM, IGA, Identity Security, Cybersecurity, or Enterprise Security Architecture.
* Strong hands-on understanding of: Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML), Access Governance, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Segregation of Duties (SoD), Access Reviews / Certifications, Identity Lifecycle Management, Provisioning & De-provisioning
* Strong knowledge of SSO, MFA, SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SCIM, and LDAP.
* Experience designing integrations with Active Directory/Entra ID, SAP, HRMS, databases, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications.
* Understanding of PAM, Identity Risk, ITDR, Zero Trust, least privilege, and identity security principles.
* Experience designing HA/DR, on-premise, cloud, and hybrid architectures.
* Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, AKS/EKS or similar container and orchestration technologies is an advantage.
* Experience with enterprise IAM/IGA platforms is preferred.
* Strong understanding of APIs, application integration patterns, databases, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Excellent communication, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical capabilities with an ability to assess technical trade-offs and recommend appropriate solutions.

**Role - Full time in office**

* 1+ year of Cybersecurity domain exposure, especially IAM (SailPoint, CyberArk) and SIEM/SOAR (Splunk, QRadar, etc.).

title: Head of West India IMM, India BCO
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor:**

HSBC Corporate and Institutional Banking is a markets-led, financing-focused business that provides investment and financial solutions. Through our international network, we connect emerging and mature markets, covering key growth areas. We partner with our corporate, government and institutional clients to help them achieve consistent, long-term performance. Our products and services include advisory, financing, prime services, research and analysis, securities services, trading and sales and transaction banking.

**Role Purpose:**

Credit & Capital Management (CCM) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model. A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first line credit management office, the Business Credit Office (BCO)

The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors including Credit Analysis Unit, Credit Analysts, and RMs (Relationship Managers) in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and docs negotiation with WCMR and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all C&L tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated.

The BCO Team Lead will be responsible for developing and leading a high performing, client centric BCO team and ensuring exemplary risk management acumen and control standards are embedded within the end-to-end C&L process. In discharging their duties, the role holder must implement a common, reliable, and predictable underwriting and lending process, that protects the business from exposure, whilst responding to clients borrowing needs. The role holder will work closely with the Coverage and Transaction Support teams to ensure seamless customer experience and consistency of service globally.

The BCO team lead will need to be a strategic thinker with an innovation driven mindset, an effective collaborator and skilled stakeholder manager, successfully navigating complex landscape to deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers and stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the delivery of BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs
* Lead and manage the end-to-end C&L journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders.
* Continuously drive improvement in productivity of the BCO team whilst enhancing client experience.
* Drive adoption of technology/digital and customer experience improvement initiatives, aligning with a global C&L operating model.
* Monitor and analyse customer and stakeholder feedback, identifying key areas of focus to improve customer outcomes.
* Work with the Head of BCO to ensure risks and issues related to C&L are escalated to country, regional and global stakeholders and resolved in a satisfactory manner.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across credit analysis activities to deliver a high and consistent standard, including training initiatives across the teams

Department: Compliance Risk Management (CRM) delivers a compliance risk framework that enables the

businesses and functions to comply with applicable internal and external rules and regulations, maintain

risk levels within MetLife’s risk appetite, and integrate ethics and compliance principles across MetLife.

Within CRM, the MIM Compliance department provides oversight and coverage to MetLife Investment

Management (MIM), MetLife’s institutional investment management business, and to MetLife’s brokerdealers.

The Role: MIM Compliance is seeking an engaged, detail oriented, and self-motivated Compliance Officer

to join the team. The Compliance Officer will be primarily responsible for key investment adviser and

broker-dealer compliance activities, including but not limited to code of ethics, gifts & entertainment,

outside business activities, email surveillance, regulatory reporting, and electronic communications. This

role will work closely with other members of MIM Compliance as well as other functional partner and

business stakeholders as needed.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the Code of Ethics Compliance Program, including reviewing personal trading requests, account

disclosures, certifications, restricted lists, and employee compliance monitoring.

interest assessments.

* Support the broker-dealer branch office inspection program by preparing documentation, reports, and

assisting with risk assessments.

* Review outside business activities and private securities transaction reviews, including risk assessments,

approvals, ongoing oversight, and conflict management.

* Conduct electronic communications surveillance, investigate alerts and exceptions, and escalate

potential policy or regulatory violations as appropriate.

* Coordinate and support certain broker-dealer regulatory filings, including complaints reporting.
* Execute compliance monitoring and testing activities, document findings, track remediation efforts, and

identify opportunities to strengthen controls.

* Maintain and enhance compliance policies, procedures, training, and governance processes to address

evolving regulatory requirements and business activities.

* Respond to questions and requests from business stakeholders.
* Prepare quarterly metrics and reports based on the above activities.
* Draft and maintain compliance procedures for code of ethics / personal trading, gifts & entertainment,

outside business activities, email surveillance, regulatory reporting, electronic communications and

other topics as needed.

* Provide other ad hoc compliance support to the broader MIM Compliance team.

**Key Relationships:**

* Reports to: Vice President, Core Compliance
* Key Stakeholders: Compliance, Legal, other functional partners and business stakeholders

**Candidate Qualifications, Essential Business Experience, Competencies, and Technical Skills:**

* 5+ years of compliance experience, including experience preparing regulatory filings across multiple

legal entities and jurisdictions.

* Broad understanding of key US regulatory requirements applicable to registered investment advisers

and broker-dealers and ability and desire to learn over time.

* Exceptional organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to think proactively, identify issues and make recommendations for improvement of processes.
* Excellent interpersonal skills required to develop partnerships and relationships throughout the

organization.

* Must be a dedicated, self-motivated individual with an ability to work independently under moderate

supervision.

* High degree of professionalism, sound judgment and discretion.
* Educational background – minimum bachelor’s degree.
* Licensing / registrations – FINRA licenses or other industry credentials a plus, but not required.
* Systems – StarCompliance experience a plus.

* Act with Urgency – Demonstrate speed to action with agility and determination
* Seek Diverse Perspectives – Source ideas and feedback to expand thinking and make informed

decisions

* Champion Inclusion – Foster an environment where everyone is valued, heard, and can speak up

title: IT Cybersecurity Administrator
description:
**Job Purpose**
Navitas Semiconductor (Nasdaq: NVTS) is a high-growth, publicly traded technology company seeking an IT Cybersecurity Administrator to protect the company’s on-premises and cloud environments against evolving threats. The ideal candidate will be self-motivated, detail-oriented, and security-minded, with hands-on experience hardening systems, monitoring for and responding to threats, and supporting compliance across a hybrid, multi-region infrastructure, and understands the dynamics of a fast-growing, publicly traded company with global operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities And Duties**

* Administer and maintain security controls across on-premises and cloud environments (GCP / AWS, Microsoft 365 / Azure), including firewalls, endpoint protection, and identity systems
* Collaborate with the global cybersecurity team to align on security standards, share threat intelligence, and coordinate incident response across regions
* Monitor security alerts and events through SIEM / MDR and managed detection tooling; triage, investigate, and escalate incidents as needed
* Lead and support incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident documentation
* Manage vulnerability scanning, patch management, and remediation tracking across servers, endpoints, and cloud workloads
* Configure and maintain identity and access management, including MFA, conditional access, privileged access, and periodic access reviews in Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID
* Administer the Fortinet network security stack (FortiGate, FortiSwitch), including firewall policies, VPN, and network segmentation
* Implement and maintain endpoint security and compliance through Intune / MDM and EDR platforms
* Administer email security controls (e.g., Proofpoint), including anti-phishing, anti-malware, anti-spam, and email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
* Administer data loss prevention (DLP) controls (e.g., Mimecast), protecting sensitive data across email, endpoints, and cloud services
* Support cloud security posture management (CSPM) and workload protection across GCP / AWS and Microsoft 365
* Develop, document, and enforce security policies, standards, and operating procedures
* Support SOX, data privacy, and regulatory compliance efforts, including evidence collection and control testing across global locations (US, China, Taiwan, and India)
* Conduct security awareness initiatives, including phishing simulations and end-user training campaigns
* Evaluate and onboard security tools and vendors; assist with security assessments, penetration tests, and audits
* Maintain accurate documentation of the security environment, configurations, and risk register
* Any and all other duties, as assigned

**Qualifications**
**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:**

* Solid understanding of cybersecurity principles, frameworks (NIST CSF, CIS Controls, ISO 27001), and defense-in-depth strategies
* Hands-on experience securing both on-premises and cloud environments (GCP / AWS, Microsoft 365 / Azure)
* Working knowledge of firewalls and network security (Fortinet preferred), VPN, segmentation, and zero-trust concepts
* Experience with SIEM / MDR, EDR, and vulnerability management tools
* Strong proficiency with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), conditional access, and MFA
* Familiarity with endpoint management and compliance tooling (Intune, SCCM, or MDM)
* Working knowledge of securing and administering Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoints alongside Microsoft 365 / MS Office
* Understanding of identity and access management, encryption, and data protection
* Experience supporting compliance and audit activities (SOX, SOC 2, or similar)
* Experience using AI-powered tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude, AI assistants) to investigate threats, draft documentation, and improve security operations
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk-assessment skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate technical risk to non-technical stakeholders
* Maintains accountability for actions and handles sensitive information with discretion

**Requirements**
Basic
  
  

* 3+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, or IT administration with a security focus
* Demonstrated experience securing Windows, Microsoft 365, and Active Directory / Entra ID environments
* Hands-on experience with firewalls, endpoint protection, and identity / access management

**Preferred**

* BS in computer science, cybersecurity, information systems, or a similar discipline
* 5+ years of experience in a cybersecurity or security administration role
* Industry certifications such as Security+, CySA+, AWS Certified Security, or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer
* Hands-on experience with Fortinet products, GCP / AWS security, and cloud security posture management (CSPM) tools
* Scripting experience with PowerShell, Python, or similar for security automation
* Experience supporting publicly traded companies and SOX / regulatory compliance

title: Senior Data Security Engineer - Purview & AI Governance
description:
**About Onit**
We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.
  
  
We’re a team of innovators using
**AI at the core**
to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.
  
  
If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**What This Role Is Expected To Deliver**

* Build and mature Onit's Microsoft Purview information protection and DLP capabilities across Microsoft 365 and endpoints.
* Improve protection of sensitive data across SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams and endpoints, including labeling, access/oversharing risk and data lifecycle controls.
* Make the Microsoft 365 data estate safer for generative AI and other approved AI tools and use cases by understanding what AI can access and where sensitive data may be exposed.
* Translate emerging AI/data-governance requirements into practical technical controls, operating processes and measurable improvements.
* Implement and operationalize any CASB, SSPM, DSPM and Shadow AI discovery/governance solutions to identify risk, enforce controls, remediate exposure and improve SaaS/AI security posture.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, tune and operate Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP), including Microsoft 365 and Endpoint DLP scenarios.
* Own Microsoft Purview Information Protection capabilities including sensitivity labels, publishing policies, auto-labeling, Sensitive Information Types (SITs), trainable/classification concepts and policy tuning.
* Implement and support retention, records/data lifecycle, legal hold, Content Search, Core/Advanced eDiscovery workflows, audit and evidence-preservation processes where required.
* Partner with business, legal, privacy, security and IT stakeholders to translate data-protection requirements into workable Purview policies without creating excessive user friction or false positives.
* Assess and improve sensitive-data exposure across SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams, including oversharing, external sharing, broad group access and inherited/direct permissions in collaboration with M365 platform owners.
* Support data-security readiness for Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Anthropic, Cursor and other enterprise AI tools by identifying sensitive content exposure, access pathways and control gaps before broader AI enablement.
* Develop capability in AI data security and governance areas such as DSPM for AI, Shadow AI discovery, sanctioned/unsanctioned AI use, prompt/data leakage risk, AI application inventory and policy/control mapping.
* Work with CASB/SSE/SASE or SaaS discovery capabilities where they contribute to identifying Shadow AI/Shadow IT and controlling risky data movement; deep SAM/licensing expertise is not a requirement for this role.
* Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and Microsoft 365 reporting capabilities to automate policy validation, reporting, investigation support and recurring operational tasks.
* Own complex L3 troubleshooting for Purview/DLP policy behavior, classification, labeling, endpoint DLP, eDiscovery/legal-hold and Microsoft 365 data-protection issues.
* Evaluate new Microsoft Purview, Copilot security and AI-governance capabilities through structured lab/POV testing and recommend production adoption based on risk reduction and operational value.
* Create technical designs, SOPs, runbooks and decision records; mentor IT team members and transfer data-security knowledge across the team.
* Lead data-security and AI-governance projects from requirements and pilot through rollout, change communication, validation and steady-state handover.

**Required Skills - Must Have**

* Strong hands-on Microsoft Purview experience in an enterprise Microsoft 365 environment.
* Hands-on DLP experience, including policy design/tuning and practical understanding of false positives, exceptions and business impact.
* Strong Information Protection experience: sensitivity labels, publishing, auto-labeling and classification/Sensitive Information Type concepts.
* Hands-on experience with retention, legal hold/eDiscovery, audit or related Microsoft Purview data lifecycle/investigation capabilities.
* Microsoft Purview DSPM / Data Security Posture Management and AI data-security capabilities.
* CASB/SSE/SASE, Shadow IT or Shadow AI discovery/control concepts.
* Strong understanding of SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams as data repositories and how permissions/sharing affect data security.
* Working Microsoft Entra ID knowledge sufficient to understand identity, group membership and access dependencies that affect data protection.
* Strong L3 troubleshooting and analytical skills across Purview, Microsoft 365 and data-security controls.
* Ability to independently plan and execute technical projects/changes, including requirements, pilot, stakeholder communication, risk management, validation and documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication, particularly the ability to explain data-security controls to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Adjacent Skills - Good To Have / Learn Quickly**

* Leading AI Tools security/readiness, generative-AI data exposure assessment or AI application governance.
* AI governance frameworks such as ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, Responsible AI principles or similar governance models.
* PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for Microsoft 365/Purview operations.
* Privacy/regulatory environments such as GDPR and ISO 27001; exposure to legal/compliance workflows is useful.
* SaaS discovery, SSPM or SAM concepts are useful adjacent knowledge.
* Demonstrates learnability: can move from an unfamiliar security/governance requirement to research, lab/POV, production design, implementation, documentation and knowledge transfer.
* Shows evidence of expanding beyond one Microsoft Purview feature into broader data-security, cloud-security or AI-security responsibilities.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Takes technical ownership of all Data security, AI Governance, Purview DLP, labels and data lifecycle/eDiscovery capabilities and reduces dependency on external expertise.
* Improves the organization's visibility and control of sensitive data across Microsoft 365 and endpoints.
* Builds practical AI data-security capability around Copilot/GenAI readiness, Shadow AI and sensitive-data exposure rather than remaining a traditional DLP-only specialist.
* Turns new data-security and AI-governance requirements into implemented, documented and supportable controls.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 9+ years relevant experience across enterprise IT, Microsoft 365, endpoint/security or related infrastructure disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience owning production systems and resolving complex technical problems, not only following predefined operational procedures.
* Experience working with distributed/global stakeholders and managing technical changes across business teams is preferred.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate (SC-401) - strongly preferred
* Microsoft Purview / information protection / compliance certification experience (SC-400 legacy or equivalent) - advantage
* Microsoft 365 Administrator / MS-102 - advantage

**Benefits & Perks That Support You**
Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:
  
  
Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.
  
  
Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually.
  
  
Family Support:
***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***
Income Protection:
***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***
Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident
***.***
Tax-Advantaged Accounts:
***Flexi, NPS***
.
  
  
Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.

**Customer First -**
Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.

Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.
  
  
**Win as One -**
Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly.

Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth.

And:

title: Senior Modern Workplace Engineer
description:
**About Onit**
We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.
  
  
We’re a team of innovators using

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
**Position Summary**
This is a hands-on Senior Modern workplace engineer role focused on modern endpoint engineering, device identity, security, automation and lifecycle management. The role will own and evolve Microsoft's modern workplace stack with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot at its core, integrated with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, endpoint security, application deployment and patching. The successful candidate should be strong enough to solve complex L3 issues independently, but broad enough to understand how endpoint, identity, security and user experience work together.
  
  
**Onit's technology environment changes quickly. The successful candidate will be evaluated not only on what they already know, but on how effectively they learn, apply and operationalize new capabilities.**
**What This Role Is Expected To Deliver**

* Build a secure, scalable and low-touch endpoint platform for Windows devices, with increasing capability across macOS.
* Reduce manual administration through PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and proactive remediation/automation.
* Improve device compliance, deployment quality, patch posture and endpoint security without creating unnecessary friction for users.
* Own endpoint-related projects from design and pilot through production rollout, documentation, change communication and operational handover.
* EPM, SAAS Management, Shadow IT/AI and AI Governance are key projects in Pipeline.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy and administer Microsoft Intune for device compliance, configuration profiles, security baselines, enrollment, application deployment and update management.
* Own Windows Autopilot end to end, including device registration, hardware hashes, deployment profiles, Enrollment Status Page (ESP), user-driven and pre-provisioned scenarios, troubleshooting and lifecycle operations.
* Design and maintain Conditional Access controls tied to compliant/corporate devices, MFA and Zero Trust access principles in partnership with security and identity stakeholders.
* Manage the endpoint-related Microsoft Entra ID surface, including device identity, registration, join states, authentication dependencies and access troubleshooting.
* Package, test and deploy Win32, Microsoft Store and line-of-business applications, including detection rules, dependencies, install/uninstall logic and remediation of failed deployments.
* Build PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for reporting, compliance, device operations, configuration validation and repetitive administration.
* Create and maintain proactive remediation/detection-remediation logic to address configuration drift, device health and recurring endpoint issues before they become tickets.
* Own Windows patch/update strategy using Windows Update for Business, update rings and related Microsoft capabilities; support application patching and verification processes.
* Implement and improve endpoint security controls including BitLocker, LAPS, attack-surface reduction/security baselines and integration with enterprise security tooling such as CrowdStrike or Microsoft Defender concepts.
* Support and progressively deepen macOS management capability using Jamf Pro/Apple Business Manager, ADE, FileVault and macOS compliance where applicable.
* Act as the L3 escalation point for complex enrollment failures, policy conflicts, Autopilot provisioning issues, application deployment failures and device compliance problems.
* Work across Microsoft 365 services such as OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams and Exchange Online where endpoint or identity policies intersect with the user experience.
* Evaluate new Microsoft/Apple endpoint capabilities, and recommend production adoption when they improve security, supportability or user experience.
* Create technical documentation, SOPs and runbooks; mentor other IT team members and transfer knowledge rather than becoming a single point of dependency.

**Required Skills - Must Have**

* Strong hands-on Microsoft Intune administration in an enterprise environment.
* Strong Windows Autopilot implementation and troubleshooting experience.
* Strong understanding of compliance policies, configuration profiles, security baselines and device lifecycle management.
* Hands-on application packaging/deployment using Win32 (.intunewin) or equivalent enterprise packaging methods, including detection and dependency logic.
* Hands-on Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access experience, especially device-based access and compliance scenarios.
* Strong L3 troubleshooting ability across enrollment, policy, application deployment, authentication and compliance issues.
* Strong PowerShell scripting skills for automation and troubleshooting.
* Practical endpoint security knowledge including disk encryption, endpoint hardening, patching and least-privilege concepts.
* Ability to independently plan and execute technical changes/projects with pilots, rollback thinking, stakeholder communication and post-change validation.
* PIM, SSO concepts (SAML/OIDC), enterprise application registration and broader Entra identity administration.
* Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager/ADE, FileVault and macOS administration.

**Adjacent Skills - Good To Have / Learn Quickly**

* Microsoft Graph API automation and reporting.
* BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM), Microsoft EPM or similar least-privilege tooling.
* CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or comparable endpoint security platforms.
* Microsoft 365 migration or tenant-to-tenant migration experience.
* ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR or similar control/compliance environments.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Takes independent ownership of the Intune/Autopilot/Entra endpoint stack and becomes the escalation point for complex endpoint problems.
* Automates recurring endpoint work and reduces avoidable manual administration/tickets.
* Improves compliance, patching and endpoint security posture while keeping user experience practical.
* Builds working knowledge in adjacent areas such as Jamf/macOS, EPM and broader identity rather than remaining an Intune-only specialist.
* Demonstrates learnability: can identify a knowledge gap, self-learn, test in a lab/pilot, apply the capability in production, document it and transfer the knowledge to others.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 8+ years relevant experience across enterprise IT, Microsoft 365, endpoint/security or related infrastructure disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience owning production systems and resolving complex technical problems, not only following predefined operational procedures.
* Experience working with distributed/global stakeholders and managing technical changes across business teams is preferred.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
* Microsoft 365 Administrator / MS-102 or equivalent Microsoft 365 administration certification
* Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300) - preferred
* Jamf certification - advantage, not mandatory

**Benefits & Perks That Support You**
Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:
  
  
Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.
  
  
Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually.
  
  
Family Support:
***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***
Income Protection:
***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***
Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident
***.***
Tax-Advantaged Accounts:
***Flexi, NPS***
.
  
  
Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.
  
  
**Our Commitment to Applicants**
We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.
  
  
**Onit Values**
**Customer First -**
Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.
  
  
**Purposeful Innovation -**
Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.
  
  
**Win as One -**
Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly.
  
  
**Intentional Growth -**
Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

The End User Technology (EUT) Platform Engineer is responsible for the design, deployment, administration, support, and continuous improvement of enterprise end-user computing environments across both Windows and macOS platforms. This role provides advanced technical support, manages device lifecycle and software deployment processes, delivers platform engineering and packaging services, and ensures security, compliance, performance, and user experience across desktop and mobile technologies.

**Platform Engineering & Administration**

* Manage endpoint lifecycle activities including provisioning, imaging, deployment, configuration, upgrades, patching, and decommissioning.
* Administer endpoint management platforms including Microsoft Intune and other Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions.
* Develop, implement, and maintain endpoint policies, configurations, and compliance standards.
* Manage software distribution processes, application updates, and deployment strategies.
* Develop deployment automation and packaging solutions using scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
* Collaborate with business and technical teams to validate application compatibility and deployment readiness.

**Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide Level 3 support for complex endpoint-related incidents involving hardware, operating systems, applications, and device management technologies.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Windows, macOS, mobile devices, software deployments, and endpoint security.
