title: Engineer II - Vulnerability Detection
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
  
  
****The Product Group:****
IOT Security Product Group is focussed on developing products and solutions for ICS/ OT and other IOT verticals like Healthcare. The charter for the team is to use CrowdStrike's platform capabilities and threat intelligence, and build modules and features, integrate with partner products and platforms to establish ourselves as the leading security vendor in this space.
  
  
****About The Role:****
This role will have a solid understanding of the IOT ICS domain. He/ she will understand the Purdue model, the assets, criticality and the data pertaining to security and its sources to provide accurate asset visibility, vulnerabilities. This involves understanding the domain and systems and software like SCADA servers, HMI, EW, DCS and understanding how adversaries may exploit these resources to advance their modes of interest. This person will be required to identify the data sources, gather the data, analyse the data, identify its criticality, and also automate simple tasks. They will also be responsible for troubleshooting issues with current data and making enhancements.

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**Metro Global Solution Center (MGSC)**
is internal solution partner for METRO, a €31.6 Billion international wholesaler with operations in more than 30 countries. The store network comprises a total of 623 stores in 21 countries, of which 522 offer out-of-store delivery (OOS), and 94 dedicated depots. In 12 countries, METRO runs only the delivery business by its delivery companies (Food Service Distribution, FSD).
  
  
HoReCa and Traders are core customer groups of METRO. The HoReCa section includes hotels, restaurants, catering companies as well as bars, cafés and canteen operators. The Traders section includes small grocery stores and kiosks. The majority of all customer groups are small and medium-sized enterprises as well as sole traders. METRO helps them manage their business challenges more effectively.
  
  
MGSC, location wise is present in Pune (India), Düsseldorf (Germany) and Szczecin (Poland). We provide HR, Finance, IT, Strategy, Branding & Business operations support to 31 countries, speak 24+ languages and process over 18,000 transactions a day. We are setting tomorrow’s standards for customer focus, digital solutions, and sustainable business models. For over 10 years, we have been providing services and solutions from our two locations in Pune and Szczecin. This has allowed us to gain extensive experience in how we can best serve our internal customers with high quality and passion. We believe that we can add value, drive efficiency, and satisfy our customers.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Embed application security controls into CI/CD pipelines to provide accurate, actionable, and timely feedback to engineers.
* Support the investigation, remediation, and validation of application security findings including the management of exceptions and false positives.
* Conduct targeted code reviews in partnership with engineers and platform teams to identify security issues early and improve coding practices
* Implement and maintain security controls, integrations, and automations required to ensure security and privacy by default across applications and their APIs.
* Perform threat modeling exercises to identify abuse cases, threat actors, and appropriate preventative and detective controls

**Qualifications**
Security experience in one, or more of the following:

* Hands on experience writing and reviewing code and contributing to developer workflows such as design reviews, planning, and implementation.
* Proven experience designing, implementing, and improving security tooling and CI/CD integrations, with focus on reducing noise and prioritizing risk.
* Strong focus on developer experience with the ability to communicate security issues clearly.
* Familiarity with application architectures, including monolithic and microservice based designs.
* Solid understanding of frameworks such as OWASP Top 10, SAMM, ASVS, and FIRST principles
* Comfort working across one or more programming languages such as Java, C++, Python, JavaScript or similar.

And:
  
  

* Experience with LLMs, AI, and agentic coding platforms such as Github Co-pilot, Gemini, or Claude Code.
* Proven experience as a security subject-matter expert, mentoring and raising awareness to security mandates.

title: Lead Implementation Engineer
description:

**About The Role**

**Lead Implementation Engineer**
to join our Global Implementation organization.
  
  
This is a highly technical, customer-facing role responsible for leading the successful deployment, integration, and adoption of Qualys Enterprise Cybersecurity solutions across complex enterprise environments.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on implementation engineer with proven experience deploying enterprise cloud-based SaaS security platforms. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong customer engagement skills and is responsible for driving customers from technical discovery through successful production deployment.
  
  
As a Lead Implementation Engineer, you will serve as the primary technical owner during implementation engagements, collaborating with customers, Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success, and Technical Support to deliver successful business outcomes.
  
  
This role is designed with approximately
**75% focus on technical deployment, engineering, troubleshooting, and integrations**
, and
**25% focus on implementation consulting, technical discovery, and customer advisory**
.

**Technical Deployment & Engineering**

* Hands-on experience integrating enterprise platforms using REST APIs.

* Container Security
* Web Application Security
* External Attack Surface Management

title: Divisional Risk and Control Specialist, VP
description:
**Position Overview**
**Job Title: Divisional Risk and Control Specialist, VP**
**Location: Pune, India**
**Corporate Title: VP**
**Role Description**
Corporate Banking is a technology-driven business operating in an increasingly real-time, interconnected environment, where clients expect seamless services, integrated platforms and trusted access to data. Corporate Bank (CB) Technology supports this ambition through a complex global ecosystem of business-critical applications, platforms, data services and infrastructure. We are seeking an experienced technology risk professional to play a key role in our Proactive Risk Testing Programme, delivering rigorous, risk-based assessments across this landscape. The role requires the ability to develop a deep understanding of applications and their end-to-end architecture, critically evaluate the design and effectiveness of implemented technology controls, and identify both existing and emerging IT and Information Security risks. Working closely with senior technology, business and control stakeholders, you will translate complex technical observations into clear risk insights, strengthen the testing strategy and drive sustainable improvements that enhance the resilience, security and control environment of mission-critical technology services.
  
  
**What We’ll Offer You**
As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
  
  

* Best in class leave policy
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
* Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

**Your Key Responsibilities**
Reporting locally to the India Corporate Bank Technology Control Testing Lead in Pune and functionally to the CB Technology Testing Lead based in London, you will:
  
  

* Lead and deliver risk-based, end-to-end IT and Information Security assessments across the Corporate Bank (CB) Technology landscape, independently assessing the design, implementation and operating effectiveness of key controls.
* Develop an in-depth understanding of business services and their supporting technology, including application and platform architecture, infrastructure, databases, operating systems, cloud services, networks, interfaces, APIs, data flows, batch and real-time processing, and third-party dependencies.
* Perform technical deep dives across applications, platforms, databases and infrastructure to identify and assess existing and emerging IT and IS risks, control weaknesses, root causes, systemic themes and potential impacts on confidentiality, integrity, resilience and regulatory compliance.
* Assess technology lifecycle risks and controls including design, development and production considering aspects such as access management, security, operations and resilience.
* Apply professional judgement to define risk-based testing scope, develop risk and control matrices, determine sampling and testing approaches, analyze technical evidence, and produce clear, well-supported conclusions in line with testing standards.
* Challenge technology and control owners constructively, communicate complex technical risks in business terms and support agreement on pragmatic and sustainable remediation actions.
* Identify cross-application and thematic risks, emerging technology threats, control automation opportunities and opportunities to use data analytics and continuous monitoring to improve assurance coverage.
* Partner with Technology Application Teams, Architects, Engineering, Information Security, Control Owners, the Divisional Control Office, Group Audit and other stakeholders to promote transparency and sustainable risk mitigation.
* Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of risk-based testing methodologies, standards, documentation and quality assurance, while providing guidance and technical coaching to colleagues where required.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Extensive experience in IT/Cyber security assessments, technology risk, information security, controls assurance or related discipline, including leading complex reviews in a large, regulated organization.
* In-depth understanding of enterprise technology and application architecture, including cloud and on-premises infrastructure, databases, operating systems, networks, APIs, middleware, data integration and third-party services.
* Demonstrable ability to analyze architecture diagrams, data flows, configurations, system logs, access models, vulnerability information and other technical evidence to identify control gaps and assess their business and risk impact.
* Strong knowledge of IT General Controls and Application Controls, cyber security, secure software development, identity and access management, privileged access management, network and cloud security, vulnerability management, data and cryptographic protection, security monitoring, incident management, operational resilience and technology lifecycle management.
* Awareness of emerging technology and risk areas, including cloud security, DevSecOps, automation, artificial intelligence, open-source software, third-party concentration and evolving cyber threats.
* Experience applying recognized frameworks and standards such as COBIT, NIST, ISO 27001, ITIL and relevant regulatory expectations; professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or equivalent is desirable.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders and translate complex technical matters into concise, risk-based findings and practical remediation actions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes.
* Experience working in Agile and DevOps environments; knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its control environment would be an advantage.

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**
**How We’ll Support You**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
* A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

description:

In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

The Business Unit Cyber Specialist will be responsible for providing specialized cybersecurity expertise and support within a specific business unit. This role focuses on identifying, assessing, and mitigating cybersecurity risks while ensuring that security practices align with business objectives. The Cyber Specialist will act as the main point of contact for all cybersecurity-related issues within the business unit, ensuring that all security requirements are met and that the business unit operates within a secure, compliant, and risk-managed environment.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**BU Cyber Specialist**
**Cybersecurity Risk Identification And Mitigation**
Identify cybersecurity risks within the business unit’s operations, including systems, processes, and workflows.
  
  
Work with cross-functional teams to implement appropriate security measures and controls to reduce risk.
  
  
Provide guidance on threat mitigation strategies and assist with implementing security measures to address identified vulnerabilities.
  
  
**Security Incident Response**
Act as a key contributor to the business unit’s cybersecurity incident response plan.
  
  
Assist in investigating and analyzing security incidents, ensuring timely detection, containment, and resolution of security breaches.
  
  
Work closely with the incident response team to execute response strategies and remediate vulnerabilities.
  
  
**Collaboration With IT And Business Teams**
Partner with IT teams to ensure secure implementation and maintenance of business unit systems and applications.
  
  
Collaborate with business unit leaders to integrate cybersecurity best practices into daily operations, projects, and system development.
  
  
Provide security guidance and support to business units when implementing new technologies, applications, or processes.
  
  
**Compliance And Regulatory Support**
Ensure the business unit complies with relevant cybersecurity regulations, standards, and internal policies (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, NIST).
  
  
Assist with audits and assessments to verify compliance with industry-specific cybersecurity requirements.
  
  
Provide recommendations for improving security posture to ensure compliance with relevant regulations.
  
  
**Security Awareness And Training**
Assist in the development and delivery of cybersecurity awareness and training programs tailored to the business unit’s needs.
  
  
Provide guidance to business unit staff on security best practices, including data protection, password management, and secure communication.
  
  
Promote a security-conscious culture within the business unit by conducting ongoing awareness activities and security drills.
  
  
**Security Tools And Technologies**
Support the implementation, configuration, and management of cybersecurity tools and technologies within the business unit.
  
  
Assist with monitoring and maintaining the security of business unit systems, including vulnerability scanning, network monitoring, and endpoint protection.
  
  
Provide recommendations on security tools and technologies that align with the business unit’s needs and the organization's overall cybersecurity strategy.
  
  
**Reporting And Communication**
Report on cybersecurity risks, incidents, and initiatives to the Business Unit Cyber Lead and other relevant stakeholders.
  
  
Maintain documentation of security activities, incidents, and ongoing efforts to improve cybersecurity posture.
  
  
Communicate security risks and recommended actions to business unit leadership in a clear and concise manner.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement And Best Practices**
Stay up to date with the latest cybersecurity trends, threats, and technologies to ensure that the business unit remains secure against emerging risks.
  
  
Continuously evaluate and improve cybersecurity practices and procedures within the business unit to adapt to the evolving threat landscape.
  
  
Assist in the development and implementation of security best practices for the business unit.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Business Unit Heads and Department Heads
  
  
Business Unit Cyber Lead
  
  
Information Security and IT teams
  
  
Legal, HR, and Compliance teams
  
  
Risk Management Teams
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Regulatory Authorities and Compliance Organizations
  
  
Security Vendors and Third-Party Service Providers
  
  
External Auditors
  
  
**Educational Qualification**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

Solid understanding of cybersecurity risks, policies, and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR).

title: Assistant Manager
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The OT Cybersecurity Executive will be responsible for supporting and implementing cybersecurity measures to safeguard the organization's Operational Technology (OT) environments. This includes ensuring the security of industrial control systems (ICS), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, and other OT assets that manage critical infrastructure. The role will focus on identifying vulnerabilities, responding to incidents, implementing best practices, and ensuring the security of OT systems against evolving cyber threats.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**OT Cybersecurity Executive**
**Operational Technology (OT) Security**
Implement and maintain cybersecurity measures to protect OT systems, including industrial control systems (ICS) and SCADA networks.
  
  
Perform regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing on OT systems to identify security weaknesses and recommend improvements.
  
  
Monitor OT networks and systems for signs of security breaches or anomalies, ensuring timely identification and mitigation of threats.
  
  
Collaborate with OT engineering teams to ensure secure integration of OT systems with IT infrastructure while preserving operational continuity.
  
  
**Incident Response And Management**
Respond to OT cybersecurity incidents, coordinating efforts to mitigate, resolve, and document security breaches or disruptions in OT systems.
  
  
Investigate and perform root-cause analysis for OT-related cybersecurity incidents, ensuring quick recovery and restoration of services.
  
  
Develop and implement incident response protocols specifically tailored to OT environments, including communication plans, reporting mechanisms, and escalation procedures.
  
  
**Collaboration With IT And OT Teams**
Work closely with IT cybersecurity teams to ensure coordination between IT and OT environments and mitigate the risk of cross-domain security breaches.
  
  
Collaborate with OT engineers, operations teams, and vendors to implement security controls that do not interfere with the operation of critical systems.
  
  
Promote awareness of cybersecurity best practices and provide guidance on securing OT systems.
  
  
**Vulnerability Management**
Monitor and assess the security vulnerabilities of OT systems and coordinate patching, remediation, and mitigation efforts in line with operational needs.
  
  
Conduct risk-based prioritization of vulnerabilities within OT systems, considering the potential impact on operational continuity and safety.
  
  
**Security Monitoring And Threat Intelligence**
Continuously monitor OT systems and networks for any unusual activities, security breaches, or threats using appropriate tools and techniques.
  
  
Leverage threat intelligence platforms to stay informed about the latest cyber threats targeting OT environments and recommend proactive defense measures.
  
  
Perform regular updates to OT security monitoring systems and tools to detect emerging threats.

OT Cybersecurity Manager / Head of Cybersecurity

title: Customer Solutions Engineer
description:
**About Us**
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
  
  
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
  
  
**Official Title - Center of Excellence Engineer**
**Available Locations: Bengaluru, India**
**About the Role:-**
As a Center of Excellence Engineer (Customer Solutions Engineer), you will provide technical guidance to Cloudflare customers. Working within the GTM organization and reporting to a Center of Excellence Leader, the Center of Excellence Engineer (CEE) helps Cloudflare customers and internal teams through structured onboarding, technical guidance, adoption support, and scalable enablement. You will guide customers as they move from provisioned accounts to a live, value-generating deployment. You are a Cloudflare product expert and will leverage your knowledge to ensure our customers understand and utilize the Cloudflare platform to its fullest extent. This is a customer-facing technical role focused on post-sale onboarding, technical advisory, 1:1 technical engagements and 1:many technical events. You will be collaborating with CEs, AEs, Support and other internal teams to ensure no customer falls through the cracks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Customer Onboarding and Deployment Readiness: Own the end-to-end technical onboarding experience for assigned customers post-provision. Lead structured onboarding calls, guide customers to configure initial Cloudflare settings (e.g., DNS records, SSL/TLS modes, WAF rules, Zero Trust policies), and validate that traffic is behaving as expected before the customer is declared live. Guide customers through onboarding and implementation runbooks and identify when an engagement requires escalation to the appropriate Cloudflare team. Troubleshoot common onboarding issues including DNS resolution failures, SSL/TLS certificate errors, caching misconfigurations, and authentication failures.
* Cloudflare Configuration Guidance: Guide customers through Cloudflare configuration steps for applicable platform capabilities, including DNS, SSL/TLS, CDN, Application Security, Zero Trust/SASE, Network Services, and other Cloudflare products as assigned. Help customers understand configuration options, operational best practices, and standard deployment patterns.
* Customer Technical Guidance and Enablement: Deliver standardized customer guidance sessions, technical walkthroughs, workshops, bootcamps, 1:1 technical engagements and 1:many technical sessions covering Cloudflare product specific best practices, migration procedures, and post-deployment administration. Explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical customer stakeholders.
* Documentation and Engagement Hygiene: Produce and maintain clear technical and operational artifacts, including call summaries, action item trackers, onboarding plans, runbooks, and handoff materials. Keep relevant internal systems updated after customer touchpoints and maintain high-quality documentation for continuity across teams.
* Cross-Functional Coordination and Escalation Management: Coordinate with Cloudflare Customer Engineering, Support, Product, Engineering, Account, and other internal teams to route complex technical issues, document blockers, support escalations, and maintain continuity of customer outcomes.
* Operational Improvement and Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to reusable templates, procedures, technical guides, internal knowledge articles, automation scripts, AI-assisted workflows, and process improvements that improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of customer onboarding and customer engineering activities.
* Technical Breadth and Continuous Development: Build and maintain working knowledge across Cloudflare product foundations, including Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services, at a depth appropriate to onboarding, adoption, troubleshooting, and technical advisory scenarios. Stay current on Cloudflare product releases, internal process updates, and relevant certifications. Be familiar with and leverage AI technology available to you to create new and innovative tools to support your work.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5-12 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Customer Engineer, Technical Support, Implementation Engineer, Onboarding Engineer, Sales/Systems Engineer, Technical Account Manager, or NOC/SOC analyst or equivalent hands-on technical experience managing customer deployments.
* Cloudflare product foundations: working knowledge of Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services.
* Networking fundamentals: understanding of DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP/HTTPS, CIDR, NAT, and BGP.
* Web security basics: familiarity with OWASP, WAF rules, OAuth, SAML, MFA, and Zero Trust principles.
* Configuration and integration: hands-on experience with the Cloudflare Dashboard, and comfort with Terraform, API-based configurations, or identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, and SAML/OIDC integrations.
* Observability: ability to read and interpret Security Events, Logs, cURL outputs, and HAR files; awareness of common causes of 5xx/4xx errors post-onboarding.
* Scripting and APIs: ability to read and debug REST API calls; basic proficiency with Python and Bash.

**Working Style:**

* Customer empathy: explains technical concepts without jargon; calms frustrated customers.
* Structured communication: clear agendas, concise summaries, documented next steps.
* Bias for action: progresses onboarding rather than waiting; knows when to escalate appropriately.
* Curiosity: digs into why something works and learns unfamiliar Cloudflare products quickly.
* Resilience: handles ambiguity, incomplete requirements, and changing priorities.
* Coachability: accepts feedback and improves from every onboarding engagement.
* Time management: juggles a portfolio of onboarding customers and meets committed timelines.

**Communication:**
Strong written and verbal communication skills. Able to document clearly, summarize concisely, and interact professionally with both technical and non-technical customer contacts. Regulatory and Security Awareness (Nice-to-Haves): Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 is a plus.
  
  
**Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The Good-to-Haves):**

* Cloudflare Certifications: Existing Cloudflare certifications (e.g., Cloudflare Fundamentals, Cloudflare for Teams, or Cloudflare for Developers).
* Prior Cloudflare Experience: Direct experience onboarding or administering Cloudflare in a production environment.
* Automation Mindset: Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi) or CI/CD pipelines for configuration management.
* AI-Augmented Workflow: Comfort using AI assistants, LLM-based tools, or scripting to accelerate routine onboarding tasks, log analysis, or documentation.
* Fluency in English is required.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?
  
  
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
  
  
**Project Galileo**
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
  
  
**Athenian Project**
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
  
  
**1.1.1.1**
: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
  
  
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
  
  
Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.
  
  
This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
  
  
Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.
  
  
Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

title: Deployment Engineer
description:
ComplyDP is an AI-native compliance platform for India’s Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act. We find personal data across an organisation’s systems: databases, file shares, cloud accounts and endpoints. Then we map it to the obligations the law imposes. Our customers include regulated financial services groups, and our software runs inside their environments, on-premise or in their own cloud accounts. Their data never leaves.

**The role**

**You will own getting ComplyDP running inside customer environments. That means planning the install with the customer’s IT and security teams, deploying our stack in their data centre or their Azure/AWS tenancy, getting it through their security review, and keeping it healthy after go-live. You’ll be the person a bank’s infra team works with day to day, so you need to be calm, precise and credible in that room.**

**What you’ll do**

* Deploy and upgrade ComplyDP on customer infrastructure using Docker and Kubernetes, including air-gapped and restricted-network setups
* Work through firewall rules, proxies, service accounts, certificates and access approvals with customer IT, network and InfoSec teams
* Deploy into customer-owned cloud accounts (Azure first, AWS a plus)
* Write and maintain install runbooks, pre-deployment checklists and architecture notes that customer security teams will review
* Troubleshoot issues across Linux, networking, storage and databases. Stay with the issue until it’s fixed.
* Feed what you learn back to engineering so every deployment gets easier than the last
* Travel to customer sites in Mumbai and Delhi when a deployment needs it

**What we’re looking for**

* 3–6 years in implementation, deployment, DevOps or solutions engineering, ideally shipping software into enterprise or BFSI environments
* Strong hands-on Linux, Docker and Kubernetes (Helm, ingress, storage, troubleshooting live clusters)
* Solid networking fundamentals: DNS, TLS, proxies, firewalls, VPNs
* Comfort with at least one cloud platform; Azure preferred
* Scripting in Bash or Python
* Clear written communication. Your runbooks will be read by bank security teams.
* Bonus: experience with enterprise security reviews, Windows Server/AD environments, or database administration (Oracle, MSSQL, PostgreSQL)

**Details**

* **Full-time, permanent · Bengaluru · ₹12–22 LPA fixed**

title: Platform Architect
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Platform Architect to define and own the end-to-end deployment, runtime, and lifecycle architecture for our industrial data-collection platform.

In this role, you will be the primary technical authority governing how our software runs inside mission-critical customer environments—spanning customer-hosted Windows servers and lightweight, resource-constrained edge Kubernetes appliances. You will design resilient deployment models, optimize resource budgeting, ensure seamless upgrades and rollbacks, and align platform interfaces alongside cross-functional security and software architects.

**Key Responsibilities**

●
**Platform & Runtime Architecture:**
Own the complete system architecture, sizing models, and runtime environment across customer-hosted Windows Server infrastructure and edge Kubernetes appliances.

●
**Packaging & Lifecycle Operations:**
Design robust, automated mechanisms for deployment, seamless zero-downtime upgrades, atomic rollbacks, and disaster recovery (backup/restoration) in customer-managed environments.

●
**Resource Optimization:**
Conduct strict CPU, memory, and storage budgeting to ensure peak reliability on resource-constrained hardware.

●
**Networking & OT Security Integration:**
Define network and security architectures tailored for OT-adjacent and factory-floor environments (firewalls, proxies, VLANs, and isolated networks).

●
**Technical Leadership & Alignment:**
Lead platform design reviews, mentor engineering teams, and collaborate directly with Cybersecurity, DevSecOps, and Software Architects to ensure clean component interfaces.

**Key Qualifications & Skills**

**Must-Have Requirements:**

●
**10+ years of experience**
in Platform Architecture, Systems Engineering, or Infrastructure Architecture for complex, distributed software.

●
**Kubernetes & Virtualization on Constrained Hardware:**
Hands-on expertise running lightweight Kubernetes clusters or virtualized environments on constrained edge hardware, including precise memory and storage budgeting.

●
**Windows Server Architecture:**
Deep knowledge of Windows Server environments, automated installers (MSI/Inno/WiX), system services, and domain/workgroup identity models (Active Directory).

●
**Edge Lifecycle Management:**
Proven track record designing deployment, zero-downtime upgrade, automated rollback, and backup/recovery strategies for edge and customer-hosted environments.

●
**OT-Adjacent Networking:**
Strong understanding of network architecture, segmentation, and security considerations when deploying near Operational Technology (OT) networks.

●
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

●
**Communication:**
Exceptional oral and written technical communication skills with a track record of driving consensus across architectural domains.

**SAP Integration Technical Engineer**
Signify is amid the design, build and deployment of a global greenfield S/4HANA solution. To support the deployment and ensure stable operations and continuous optimization, we are establishing a global application maintenance organization.
  
  
The
**SAP Integration Technical Engineer**
is responsible for operational support in S/4 HANA deployments and developing, supporting, and optimizing integration solutions across SAP S/4HANA, SAP ECC, SAP BTP, cloud applications, third-party systems, and B2B/3PL partners in a post go-live application maintenance environment. Collaborates within a global team and works closely with Solution Architects, Product Owners, business stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to ensure stable, scalable, secure, and compliant end-to-end data exchange. The role focuses on technical interface design, issue resolution, system stability, performance optimization, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Areas of Responsibility**

* Support technical integration delivery aligned to the global template and deploy the global S/4 HANA implementation on a local level while providing technical support for legacy SAP ECC and SAP PI/PO interfaces where required.
* Design, develop, enhance, and maintain integration flows (iFlows) using SAP Integration Suite on SAP BTP (CPI), API Management, Event Mesh, and SAP PI/PO 7.5 Single Stack.
* Provide end-to-end technical support in an AMS environment including incident management, service requests, defect resolution, root cause analysis (RCA), and interface debugging in line with agreed service levels.
* Manage B2B/EDI and A2A integrations (including EDIFACT, ANSI X12, and XML) over secure protocols (AS2, SFTP, VANs, HTTPS, APIs) for global EDI onboarding and 3PL/carrier integration.
* Conduct technical impact analysis, unit testing, and regression testing to ensure quality delivery of interface changes, enhancements, and custom Groovy scripting.
* Monitor CPI iFlows, PI/PO channels, IDocs, ABAP Proxies, API traffic, queues, and background scheduling frameworks to ensure operational continuity.
* Support migration activities of legacy SAP PI/PO interfaces to SAP Integration Suite on BTP and participate in custom interface remediation.
* Collaborate with Functional Consultants (across SD, FI, MM, PP, BW, O2C, MTO, and Logistics domains), Basis, Security, and external suppliers to resolve cross-system issues.
* Maintain comprehensive integration documentation, mapping standards, naming conventions, and operational runbooks to support governance and knowledge sharing.

**Critical Experiences And Skills**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience in building, troubleshooting, and tuning end-to-end integration flows using SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI), SAP Cloud Connector, Groovy Scripting, REST/SOAP APIs, and legacy SAP PI/PO 7.5 platforms.
* Strong technical expertise in SAP BTP Integration Suite, Cloud Integration (CPI), API Management, Event Mesh, and Cloud Connector configurations.
* Extensive experience with SAP integration protocols and technical objects including IDocs, BAPIs, RFCs, ABAP Proxies, OAuth, SSL Certificates, and IAS/IPS security.
* Experience in B2B/EDI integrations, handling EDI standards (EDIFACT, ANSI X12, XML) and external 3PL/WMS/carrier integrations.
* Experience working in a global application maintenance support or production support environment including stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Strong understanding of SAP functional domain dependencies and logistical processes, particularly Order-to-Cash (O2C) and Make-to-Order (MTO).
* Good understanding of non-SAP integration platforms (e.g., IBM Sterling, Boomi, MuleSoft) and exposure to AI tools like SAP Joule is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* SAP Integration Suite certification is an advantage.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, complex and highly integrated business environment.

**Grading Differentiators**

* Good knowledge of SAP Integration architecture, BTP services, security models, and ITIL-aligned incident management practices.
* Operates independently within assigned technical scope and delivers with limited supervision.
* Able to resolve moderately complex technical and interface issues across integrated SAP and non-SAP landscapes.
* Contributes effectively to support, enhancement, architectural compliance, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Everything we’ll do for you**
You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.
  
  
Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

description:

**Responsibilities**
The Staff Engineer will drive the technical direction, development, and sustenance of network functions and platform components for the Wireless team. This role combines deep technical contribution, architectural leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring to ensure scalable, reliable, and high-quality product delivery.
  
  
The Staff Engineer will lead complex technical initiatives, coordinate execution across multiple software subsystems, resolve critical engineering challenges, and contribute to strategic technology and product decisions.
  
  

* Drive the development and sustenance of Wireless Network Functions and platform components across the complete product lifecycle.
* Define scalable solution architectures, technical designs, and implementation approaches aligned with product and business requirements.
* Lead planning, requirements analysis, design, implementation, integration, verification, validation, and field-testing activities.
* Analyze and prioritize complex features across multiple subsystems to enable synchronized and phased product delivery.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, partners, and stakeholders to manage technical dependencies and ensure successful system integration.
* Drive the resolution of complex technical challenges, integration issues, and delivery risks through structured problem-solving.
* Review architecture, designs, code, and technical deliverables to ensure quality, consistency, scalability, and maintainability.
* Continuously improve system performance, reliability, scalability, operational efficiency, and overall product quality.
* Mentor engineers and technical leads through technical guidance, design discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
* Contribute to technical roadmaps while promoting engineering best practices, automation, reusable solutions, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**
Experience: 10 to 15 years’ experience from Telecommunication or Networking background.
  
  
Education: B.Tech/BE (CSE/ECE/EEE/IS) or any other equivalent degree
  
  
Candidate should have good coding skills in C/C++
  
  
**About Us**
Tejas Networks is a global broadband, optical and wireless networking company, with a focus on technology, innovation and R&D. We design and manufacture high-performance wireline and wireless networking products for telecommunications service providers, internet service providers, utilities, defence and government entities in over 75 countries. Tejas has an extensive portfolio of leading-edge telecom products for building end-to-end telecom networks based on the latest technologies and global standards with IPR ownership. We are a part of the Tata Group, with Panatone Finvest Ltd. (a subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) being the majority shareholder. Tejas has a rich portfolio of patents and has shipped more than 900,000 systems across the globe with an uptime of 99.999%. Our product portfolio encompasses wireless technologies (4G/5G based on 3GPP and O-RAN standards), fiber broadband (GPON/XGS-PON), carrier-grade optical transmission (DWDM/OTN), packet switching and routing (Ethernet, PTN, IP/MPLS) and Direct-to-Mobile and Satellite-IoT communication platforms. Our unified network management suite simplifies network deployments and service implementation across all our products with advanced capabilities for predictive fault detection and resolution. As an R&D-driven company, we recognize that human intelligence is a core asset that drives the organization’s long-term success. Over 60% of our employees are in R&D, we are reshaping telecom networks, one innovation at a time.

Our portfolio encompasses Radio Access Network solutions including Remote Radio Heads (RRHs) or Radio Units (RUs), Massive MIMO Radios (Advanced Antenna Systems, AAS) and Base Band Units (BBUs), Distributed Units (DUs) and Centralized Units (CUs), Mobile Packet Core and an Advanced Network management solution.

Tejas solutions are unique with inhouse Radio designs developed by seasoned experts in ASIC chip design involving 4G LTE Radio and 5G NR Radios.
  
  
Tejas offers best Network Management solution for the entire portfolio of 4G and 5G device ecosystem management.
  
  
Tejas Wireless offering include an advanced Mobile Packet Core, solution is critical for ensuring seamless, high-performance connectivity.
  
  
Engineering Program Management, which plays a crucial role in overseeing and coordinating the successful execution of engineering projects or programs.
  
  
All Tejas Wireless solutions are monitored by Network Support Group who constantly handle various aspects like validation of the solutions.

title: Lead WLAN Test Engineer
description:
**Lead WLAN Test Engineer**

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India

**Experience:**
8–12 years

**About the Company**

Rohde & Schwarz is a telecommunications company working to ensure a safer and connected world. Its business is organized around Test & Measurement, Aerospace & Defense, and Critical Infrastructure & Networks. Across these divisions, the company develops solutions for industrial, regulatory, and government customers facing technology and connectivity challenges. This work places testing, communications, and dependable technical systems at the center of the company’s business. Rohde & Schwarz states that it stands for independence, stability, and long-term relationships with customers and partners. These commitments reflect an emphasis on sustained customer and partner engagement alongside its work in technology markets. The company’s activities span multiple areas where reliable connectivity and technical performance matter, from measurement and communications to infrastructure and networks. The Bengaluru-based engineering opportunity supports its work in wireless testing and validation within the telecommunications domain, contributing to the development and assessment of WLAN technologies. Rohde & Schwarz operates under its own name and brings together its divisions to address complex connectivity needs across the sectors it serves.

**About the Role**

As a full-time, on-site WLAN Test Engineer in Bengaluru, you will lead wireless test strategy and validation in a telecommunications engineering environment. You will develop test plans, build Python-based automation, and assess Wi-Fi performance and RF behavior against relevant 802.11 standards. The role combines hands-on network and protocol testing with analysis, troubleshooting, and clear documentation of test procedures and findings. You will work with engineering teams to investigate defects and resolve wireless connectivity issues, while mentoring junior test engineers and strengthening test execution. This position suits an experienced engineer with a background in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing who can take ownership of test quality and help deliver reliable wireless systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead WLAN test strategy development and translate product and validation needs into effective test coverage. Align test priorities with engineering objectives and relevant wireless standards.
* Design wireless test plans covering Wi-Fi performance, network behavior, protocols, and RF system validation. Define test scenarios and procedures that support consistent, repeatable execution.
* Build and maintain Python test automation frameworks for WLAN validation. Use automation to improve test execution and support reliable assessment of wireless system behavior.
* Execute Wi-Fi performance, network, protocol, and RF tests against applicable 802.11 standards. Record outcomes and identify defects or unexpected system behavior.
* Analyze test results and defects, troubleshoot wireless connectivity issues, and support engineering teams in investigating root causes. Communicate findings clearly to enable resolution.
* Document test procedures, execution details, and findings to maintain useful validation records. Share relevant results and technical observations with engineering stakeholders.
* Collaborate with engineering teams throughout test planning and execution, and mentor junior test engineers. Support effective knowledge sharing and consistent testing practices.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Strong WLAN and Wi-Fi testing capability, including practical wireless validation experience. Apply relevant 802.11 standards when planning and assessing test coverage.
* Experience with radio frequency testing and RF system behavior. Evaluate wireless performance and interpret results in the context of system validation.
* Python programming skills for building test automation frameworks. Develop automation that supports structured, repeatable WLAN test execution.
* Knowledge of network testing and protocol testing for wireless systems. Design and execute test scenarios that assess connectivity and protocol behavior.
* Test planning and test execution skills, including designing wireless test plans and carrying them through to documented results. Maintain clarity and consistency across validation activities.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills for investigating wireless connectivity issues, reviewing test results, and assessing defects. Explain findings to support engineering resolution.
* Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Relevant specialization in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience across telecommunications, telecom or ISP environments, or computers and electronics manufacturing can provide useful context for wireless product validation.
* Background in mentoring junior test engineers and collaborating with engineering teams can support effective knowledge sharing and coordinated defect investigation.

**What You'll Bring**

* Eight to twelve years of relevant experience in WLAN, wireless communications, or RF testing, with the ability to take ownership of test strategy and validation outcomes.
* A Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering, complemented by relevant wireless or RF specialization.
* Practical strength in Python automation, 802.11 standards, network and protocol testing, test planning, execution, and defect analysis.
* Professional English communication skills, sound documentation habits, and the ability to work on-site in Bengaluru while collaborating with engineering teams and mentoring junior colleagues.

**Why Join Us**

Join Rohde & Schwarz and contribute to work that supports a safer, connected world. The company operates across Test & Measurement, Aerospace & Defense, and Critical Infrastructure & Networks, developing solutions for industrial, regulatory, and government customers with technology and connectivity challenges. In this engineering role, your work will focus on WLAN strategy, Wi-Fi performance testing, RF validation, and Python test automation. You will help turn test requirements into structured plans, investigate connectivity issues, and communicate findings that engineering teams can act on. The opportunity brings together hands-on wireless testing and technical leadership through collaboration and mentorship. Rohde & Schwarz identifies independence, stability, and long-term relationships with customers and partners as company values. You can apply your experience in a telecommunications environment where connectivity and dependable technical systems are central to the work. The position is full-time and on-site in Bengaluru, with scope to contribute directly to wireless validation and improve the quality and consistency of testing practices.

**What We Offer**

* A full-time, on-site engineering opportunity in Bengaluru, focused on WLAN validation, Wi-Fi performance, RF behavior, and test automation.
* Ownership of WLAN test strategy and plans, with practical scope to execute testing, analyze defects, and collaborate with engineering teams.
* The opportunity to contribute to telecommunications work supporting Rohde & Schwarz’s broader focus on connectivity and technology challenges.

title: WLAN RDK-B Architect
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Architect and develop WLAN and EasyMesh features on RDK-B broadband gateways, routers, extenders, and access points.
* Design and implement Wi-Fi functionalities including SSID management, band steering, client steering, channel optimization, load balancing, roaming, QoS, DFS, WPA2/WPA3 security, and Wi-Fi 6/6E/7 capabilities.
* Lead the implementation and integration of Wi-Fi Alliance EasyMesh (Controller and Agent) within RDK-B platforms.
* Integrate and customize OpenSync, EasyMesh, hostapd, wpa\_supplicant, OneWiFi, and vendor-specific WLAN SDKs.
* Define software architecture for carrier-grade Wi-Fi and mesh deployments supporting broadband operators.
* Troubleshoot complex WLAN and EasyMesh interoperability, roaming, backhaul, and performance issues.
* Ensure compliance with Wi-Fi Alliance EasyMesh, TR-181, TR-069/TR-369 (USP), and operator requirements.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10+ years of embedded software development experience with at least 5 years in RDK-B.
* Strong expertise in WLAN technologies including IEEE 802.11n/ac/ax/be (Wi-Fi 4/5/6/6E/7).
* Hands-on experience with Wi-Fi Alliance EasyMesh architecture, Controller-Agent implementation, Multi-AP standards, and mesh networking solutions.
* Deep understanding of RDK-B components including CCSP, RBUS, HAL, OneWiFi, WebConfig, and telemetry frameworks.
* Experience integrating OpenSync, EasyMesh, hostapd, wpa\_supplicant, steering managers, and WLAN drivers.

title: Staff System Architect - OLS
description:
**Job Description**
Working from business requirements, customer use cases and industry standards (such as ITU-T and IEEE), you will make and document trade-offs among cost, function, capacity and performance for network elements such as ROADMs and optical amplifiers.
  
  
**NILightpath**
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
**In this role, you will own the requirements and architecture of assigned Layer0 feature areas, and be accountable for their technical success from concept through release. Your key responsibilities will include:**

* Shaping product features and requirements with Product Line Management, and recommending solutions to new feature requests based on feasibility, cost and risk
* Owning the system requirements, architecture specifications and acceptance criteria for these feature areas, and guiding development teams through implementation and validation
* Driving the system architecture of these feature areas with fellow architects and development leads, including interfaces and data models
* Architecting and validating the distributed, link-level control loops in these feature areas, such as power control, gain and tilt equalization and transient suppression
* Defining the system design rules and optical performance models these feature areas rely on, such as target power profiles and OSNR estimation
* Partnering with the product documentation team to describe features and operational concepts for customers
* Leading cross-functional feature teams to build consensus on architecture and technical concepts, and influencing their plans and priorities
* Representing these feature areas in technical engagements and demonstrations with key customers
* Mentoring engineers and architects on the team

**Key Skills And Experience**
**Knowledge / Skills / Abilities**

* Deep understanding of fiber transmission effects, such as power and OSNR evolution and fiber nonlinearities, and their impact on optical line system design
* Hands-on experience with optical networking equipment, including coherent transponders, EDFAs, Raman amplifiers and ROADM/WSS, and knowledge of OTN, Ethernet and SDN/GMPLS control plane
* Experience designing and validating closed- and open-loop, link-level control algorithms and optical performance monitoring to optimize end-to-end transmission
* Broad systems expertise, with a track record of writing and leading high-quality requirements and architecture specifications for robust, reliable end-to-end systems
* Extensive experience defining fault, performance and configuration management, service provisioning and control plane requirements for multi-layer networking products, especially at L0 and L1
* Working knowledge of data models for operating and monitoring optical networks, including YANG, ONF TAPI, OpenROADM and OpenConfig
* Familiarity with the SONiC Optical Transport Network Working Group, including the Optical Transport Abstraction Interface (OTAI)
* Sound, independent judgment on ambiguous and novel technical problems
* Excellent communication and presentation skills for internal and customer audiences
* Highly motivated collaborator, effective in cross-functional, cross-cultural and international teams

**Education & Experience Requirements:**

* Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Optics, Physics or a related field + minimum 5 years of relevant work experience in optical transport or a related telecommunications area
* M.Sc. in the same fields + minimum 6 years of relevant work experience in optical transport or a related telecommunications area

title: Infrastructure Engineer, TechOps CICD (Hybrid, IND)
description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
  
  
****About The Role:****
Are you an infrastructure engineer with a passion for virtualization, automation, and cloud platforms? As an Infrastructure Engineer on CrowdStrike's TechOps CICD team, you'll take ownership of IaaS platforms and virtualization environments that power our software factory. You'll lead Infrastructure as Code initiatives, drive configuration management practices, and build automation workflows that keep our developer environments running at scale - with a deep focus on KVM-based on-premises infrastructure and cloud operations.
  
  
****What You'll Do:****

title: Senior Principal - Platform Engineer Network Capabilities
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.
  
  
This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.
* Extensive experience engineering shared network services such as Domain Name System, Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol and Internet Protocol address management.
* Strong knowledge of network access control, application programming interfaces, automation, monitoring and resilient service design.
* Evidence of improving service reliability, self service, deployment speed or operational efficiency.

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
AI Programming, Automation, Automation Technology, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Data Distribution Service (DDS), Data Management and Integration (DMI), IP Address Management (IPAM), Leadership, Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Security Management, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Universal Description Discovery and Integration (UDDI), Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. title: Principal - Platform Engineer Segmentation
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's network segmentation and identity-based access platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by automating away toil.
  
  
This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across network segmentation and identity-based access to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Adopt engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Work with principal engineers and partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 10 years and typically 5-7 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.
* Strong experience engineering enterprise network security, segmentation or identity based access.
* Deep knowledge of 802.1X authentication, network access control, firewalls, routing and resilient service design.
* Evidence of implementing segmentation that improved security coverage, access control or operational resilience.

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
Automation Technology, CI/CD, Cloud Based Services, Cloud Networking, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Infrastructure As Code (IaC), IP Address Management (IPAM), Load Balancers, Microsegmentation, Network Design, Network Segmentation, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), SRE Observability, System Monitors, Terraform (Software), Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture, Zscaler Architecture
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
