title: Principal Professional Services Consultant - Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW)
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking a highly strategic and technical Principal Consultant to lead the architecture, engineering, and deployment of enterprise-grade Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) solutions. In this senior-level role, you will act as a trusted advisor to C-level executives and enterprise architects, guiding them through complex network security transformations and Zero Trust network designs. You will handle the most critical technical escalations, spearhead massive infrastructure migrations, and provide mentorship to a team of security engineers.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Architecture & Strategic Design
  
  

* Design comprehensive High-Level (HLD) and Low-Level (LLD) architectures for global firewall deployments across on-premises, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Lead technical workshops with enterprise clients to align business requirements with robust, scalable, and secure network architectures.
* Architect and standardize Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) frameworks, micro-segmentation strategies, and advanced threat protection models.

Implementation & Advanced Migrations
  
  

* Oversee the end-to-end deployment of massive-scale NGFW clusters, Panorama management systems, and GlobalProtect infrastructure.
* Spearhead complex, multi-vendor firewall migrations (e.g., transitioning from Cisco ASA/Firepower, Check Point, or Fortinet to Palo Alto Networks) using advanced scripting and migration tools.
* Develop automated workflows for firewall provisioning, policy management, and log analysis utilizing Python, REST APIs, and Ansible.

Technical Escalation & Team Leadership
  
  

* Serve as the ultimate escalation point for complex P1/P2 deployment issues, performing deep packet inspection and advanced routing (BGP, OSPF) troubleshooting.
* Mentor senior and junior consultants, establishing best practices, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and deployment templates.

**Qualifications**
Qualifications & Skills
  
  

* 12+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network security architecture and engineering.
* Expert-level knowledge of Palo Alto Networks NGFW, Panorama, App-ID, User-ID, SSL Decryption, and Threat Prevention configurations.
* Extensive experience with public cloud networking and securing multi-cloud perimeters.
* Strong proficiency in dynamic routing protocols, TCP/IP fundamentals, and packet-level analysis.
* Preferred Certifications: PCNSE (Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer) is required; PCNSC (Certified Network Security Consultant) or PCSAE is highly desired.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

description:

**EY- Cyber Security (OT Security) – Technology Consulting – Senior**
**:**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. The GDS Cyber Architecture Operational Technology & Engineering (CAOE) services help our clients tackle the many security challenges they face on a daily basis and develop effective solutions using people, processes and technology, while enabling better security and risk decisions, and reducing costs related to manging security risks. The CAOE team is looking for individuals who will play a direct role in delivery of Operational Technology (OT) security engagements, development of proposals in this area, and develop OT security solutions. * Understanding of IT/OT/IoT communication protocols e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, DNP3, Modbus, IEC 61850, OPC, OPC UA, PROFINET, BLE, Zigbee
* Knowledge of standards such as ISO 27001/2, ISO 22301, ISO 27018, NIST standards on Cyber Security, HITRUST, etc. is a plus

* CompTIA Network+

description:

Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi-turn agents, code generation, and long-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state-of-the-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value.

title: Senior Network Automation & Agentic AI Developer
description:
**Experience: 10+years**

**Work Mode: Hybrid/ 24/7 shift**

**Work Location:**
**Hyderabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Pune, Kochi**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a visionary and hands-on Senior Network Automation & Agentic AI Developer to pioneer the next generation of intent-based, self-healing network infrastructures. In this role, you will bridge the gap between traditional enterprise networking and cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence. You will not just write scripts; you will architect autonomous AI Agents capable of diagnosing infrastructure faults, correlating real-time telemetry, and safely executing deterministic changes across a global multi-vendor environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Advanced Ansible Engineering: Architect scalable, production-grade network configuration playbooks, custom roles, and execution environments using Ansible Automation Platform / AWX. Develop custom Python plugins/modules to extend Ansible functionality where native vendor support is limited.
* Multi-Vendor API Integration: Write highly concurrent Python middleware to interface natively with the REST APIs and SDKs of our core infrastructure stack (Cisco Nexus/ACI, Meraki Dashboard, Versa Director, and Zscaler).
* AI Agent Orchestration: Design, develop, and deploy autonomous multi-agent workflows using Generative AI frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, LangChain) to automate complex network troubleshooting, validation, and root-cause analysis (RCA).
* Model Context Protocol (MCP): Build and maintain custom MCP clients and servers to securely expose internal networking tools, documentation (RAG), and script suites as executable "tools" for LLMs.
* Event-Driven Remediation: Build closed-loop automation systems using Event-Driven Ansible (EDA) or asynchronous message queues (Celery/Redis/Kafka) to ingest real-time syslogs and trigger proactive self-healing workflows.
* Guardrails & Safety Architecture: Implement strict software boundaries and input validation schemas (e.g., Pydantic) ensuring LLM-generated variables are deterministically parsed, with mandatory Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval gates before configuration changes impact production.

**Required Technical Skill Set**

* **Automation & Programming**
  : Advanced Ansible AAP, Python (Object-Oriented, Asyncio, FastAPI), robust try/except exception handling, Ansible Core, AWX/Tower, and Jinja2 templating.
* **AI & GenAI Ecosystems**
  : Deep practical experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or CrewAI; strict JSON/Function Calling; Model Context Protocol (MCP); Semantic Routing; and vector databases (Milvus, Chroma) for network RAG pipelines.
* **Enterprise Networking & Security:**
  Solid understanding of L2/L3 routing (BGP, OSPF, VXLAN EVPN), SD-WAN architectures, and Secure Service Edge (SSE) frameworks.
* **Target Vendor Stack (Highly Desirable):**
  Hands-on API experience with Cisco IOS-XE/NX-OS, Meraki SDK, Versa Analytics, and pyZscaler.
* DevOps & Observability: Git/GitOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI), and log streaming architectures (ELK Stack, Kafka, or Splunk).

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Total Experience: 10+ years in Enterprise Network Engineering, DevOps, or Systems Automation.
* Automation Focus: 3+ years of dedicated experience building infrastructure automation or developer toolchains.
* AI Exposure: 1+ years of hands-on application development involving LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or local Ollama engines).
* Certifications (a plus): Cisco/Red Hat/Ansible

Potential progression into Engineering Systems SME, Engineering AI Product Analyst, Product Owner, or Digital Engineering lead roles within DES.

description:

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

**The Mission**
---------------

Kong Cloud Gateways is Kong's foundational cloud-native **SaaS** platform, powering its managed API and AI Gateway offerings. It provides a **multi-tenant** control plane, automation, and platform services that let customers securely deploy, operate, and scale dedicated gateway infrastructure with the simplicity of a fully managed cloud service. Behind that experience sits a distributed platform responsible for provisioning, fleet management, software lifecycle, zero-downtime upgrades, observability, security, and multi-region operations across globally distributed cloud infrastructure - built to a target of 99.99% availability, balancing reliability, performance, operational excellence, and infrastructure efficiency at global **SaaS** scale.

As a Software Engineering Manager for Managed Gateways Infrastructure, you will own and grow Kong's Bangalore-based engineering team, taking full accountability for this **multi-tenant SaaS** platform. Kong Cloud Gateways is growing 100% YoY, and as enterprises increasingly adopt AI alongside traditional APIs, this platform becomes an increasingly important part of Kong's API and AI strategy - every improvement in automation, scalability, and operational excellence you drive accelerates new platform capabilities and lets product teams innovate faster. Beyond the technical charter, you play a key role in shaping a dynamic engineering culture - one built on urgency, ownership, and first-principles thinking - as the team scales to match the pace of the business.

This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role - you're expected to stay close to the systems, dig into hard problems alongside your team, and not hesitate to get into the trenches when it matters.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own and grow Kong's Managed Gateways Infrastructure engineering team in Bangalore - scaling the team's capability, raising the technical bar, and staying hands-on in critical implementations and incidents, not just directing from a distance.
* Own the reliability and scalability of a multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure platform serving customers across regions and clouds - every architectural decision has to hold up under multi-tenant load, isolation, and blast-radius considerations, not just single-tenant assumptions.
* **Drive 4-9s (99.99%+)** availability across Kong's global infrastructure footprint - owning capacity, resilience, and failure-mode design across multi-region, multi-cloud deployments (AWS, Azure, GCP) so Cloud Gateways stays up for customers everywhere, at any scale.
* Act as a direct technical contributor when it counts - complex incidents, architecture reviews, and high-stakes implementations that materially move the needle on Managed Gateways' growth and reliability.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing engineering team building and operating Kong's **SaaS** infrastructure for Managed Gateways, in direct support of our critical enterprise customer base globally.
* Architect and implement robust, scalable, and fault-tolerant cloud-native systems using technologies like Kubernetes, Golang, and major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Own the complete operational lifecycle end-to-end - infrastructure, reliability, on-call, incident response, and blameless post-mortems - as one integrated engineering charter, not a separate function.
* Drive developer delight and operational efficiency through automation, self-service tooling, and streamlined workflows for deploying and managing API gateways, while proactively preventing technical debt and reducing operational toil.
* Define, track, and report on key SLOs and SLIs, and advocate for architectural best practices that keep Managed Gateways performant and resilient as it scales.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, engineering, and support teams to influence roadmap decisions and ensure operational readiness for new features.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

### **The Toolkit:**

* Proven experience leading and managing software engineering teams responsible for infrastructure and reliability in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, with a track record of staying technically hands-on rather than purely delegating.
* Deep, current expertise in designing, deploying, and operating highly available distributed systems on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - this role needs someone who can still open a terminal and debug production, not just review architecture diagrams.
* Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes (k8s) and container orchestration in production environments.
* Proficiency in Golang or similar modern programming languages for infrastructure automation and service development.
* Strong understanding of observability principles and experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar.
* Demonstrated ability to manage critical incidents personally when needed, perform root cause analysis, and implement effective preventative measures.
* Familiarity with API gateway technologies, service mesh, or network proxies is a significant plus.

### **The Kong DNA:**

* **Ownership:** You take full responsibility for the reliability and performance of systems, driving initiatives from conception to completion.
* **Urgency:** You thrive in dynamic environments, prioritizing critical issues and delivering impactful solutions with speed and precision.
* **Collaboration:** You build strong relationships, foster open communication, and work effectively across global teams to achieve shared goals.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* Experience with open-source contributions or active participation in SRE/cloud-native communities.
* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or Kubernetes (e.g., CKA, CKAD).
* Background in companies focused on developer tools, infrastructure software, or API management.

**About Kong:**

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

title: Software Development Manager, Sports Data Platform - Prime Video Sports
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Ever wondered how millions of sports fans worldwide get the right notification at the perfect moment during a live game, or how a match result instantly updates across every screen? Come build the systems that make it happen.  
  
We're looking for a Software Development Manager to lead a team in Bangalore, India, that sits at the intersection of real time sports data and customer experience for one of the world's largest streaming platforms. You'll own and drive the technical vision for three critical areas:  
  
You'll lead the team building intelligent, real time notification systems that reach fans during the moments that matter most, think close game alerts, score updates, and live activity feeds across devices. Your systems will process live sports signals and make split second decisions about what to send, when, and to whom, at global scale.  
  
What you'll do:  
  
You will hire and grow a high performing engineering team, define the technical roadmap, and deliver systems that directly shape how customers experience live sports. You'll work closely with product, design, and partner teams across multiple time zones to solve ambiguous, high impact problems. Your decisions will be visible at the highest levels of the organization and felt by millions of customers on game day.  
  
Why this role:  
  
This is a rare opportunity to build from the ground up in a fast growing, high visibility space. Sports on streaming is still early innings, and the problems here are genuinely hard: real time data at scale, intelligent automation, and matching across thousands of global sports entities. You'll have the autonomy to define and drive innovative features.  
  
If you love building systems that delight customers in real time and want to be a part of shaping the future of live sports experiences, we'd love to talk.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
A Manager III (SDM III) is a hybrid of system designer, people manager, roadmap/customer satisfaction driver, and project manager. They own the full technology lifecycle of their systems, including development, operations, and deprecation, and are responsible for both the technology vision and business vision of their team.  
  

* Ambiguity: Leads a team where the business problem or strategy may not yet be defined, with limited guidance
* Team Management: Manages a two pizza team of SDEs, potentially across locations
* Technical Leadership: Drives the team to invent, evolve, and deprecate data solutions; scopes projects and evaluates releases against business needs
* Delivery: Establishes structures for delivering large systems; drives schedules, reprioritizes, and mitigates risks proactively
* Engineering Excellence: Demonstrates technical breadth and depth; solves problems at root cause; builds flexible systems without over engineering
* People Development: Hires the right mix of SDEs, manages performance, develops and promotes engineers
* Communication: Writes narratives and strategic docs, fosters constructive dialogue, escalates risks proactively

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of engineering experience
* 3+ years of engineering team management experience
* 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Senior Escalation Support Engineer
description:
**What makes us Qlik?**

A Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik helps teams get more out of AI with trusted data products, a powerful analytics engine, and AI agents. This helps teams reduce risk and operating costs, while scaling AI responsibly.

Used by 75% of the Fortune 500, Qlik works with the systems organizations already use, maintaining flexibility without lock-in.

**The Senior Escalation Support Engineer Role**

At Qlik, our **Escalation Support Engineers** are technical problem-solvers who take ownership when customers face complex, business-critical challenges. As a **Senior Escalation Support Engineer**, you will lead high-impact escalations across the Qlik and Talend portfolio, provide trusted technical guidance to customers, and coordinate closely with Support, R&D, Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success and Account teams.

Beyond resolving individual incidents, you will drive root-cause analysis, identify recurring issues, influence product improvements, mentor other engineers and help reduce customer risk. You will also contribute to Qlik Advanced Support through proactive technical guidance, remediation sessions, knowledge sharing and awareness of customers’ critical projects.

**What makes this role interesting?**

* Lead technically complex, high-severity escalations for strategic and business-critical customers.
* Become a recognized technical authority and subject matter expert across the Support organization.
* Collaborate with global Support, R&D, Engineering, Product Management, Customer Success and Account teams.
* Influence product reliability by identifying recurring issues, defects and improvement opportunities.
* Coach and mentor engineers, share knowledge, and contribute to proactive Advanced Support engagement.

**Here’s how you’ll be making an impact:**

* Own escalations end to end, establish investigation direction, coordinate resources and drive issues through resolution.
* Perform deep troubleshooting across logs, traces, diagnostics, performance data, system behavior and integrated technologies; reproduce issues where possible and identify root cause and sustainable remediation.
* Partner directly with customers during critical incidents, communicate findings and action plans clearly, set expectations and provide regular updates.
* Work with R&D and Engineering by providing clear problem statements, reproduction steps, diagnostic evidence and business impact; validate fixes and communicate outcomes.
* Identify customer environment and deployment risks; support proactive technical sessions, remediation, retrospectives and preventive recommendations.
* Mentor Support Engineers and SMEs, lead knowledge-sharing and case reviews, and create reusable troubleshooting guides, technical articles and lessons learned.
* Lead or contribute to major-incident RCA, corrective and preventive actions, and improvements to support processes and product supportability.

**We’re looking for a teammate with:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* **5+ years** in enterprise technical support, escalation engineering, system administration or a related technical field, including complex customer escalations and business-critical production issues.
* Experience as a senior technical SME or equivalent technical leadership role, working with global customers and distributed teams.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills across complex, multi-layered environments.
* Strong database and **SQL knowledge, including DDL, DML and TCL; experience with one or more RDBMS such as Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Teradata, MySQL or PostgreSQL.**
* **Strong Linux/Unix** command-line troubleshooting; experience analyzing logs, traces, system metrics, network behavior and application diagnostics.
* Experience with data integration, replication, Change Data Capture (CDC), performance troubleshooting or production-critical data platforms is highly desirable.
* Experience with Qlik and/or Talend Data Integration products and complex product architectures is highly desirable.
* Talend product knowledge across **Talend Studio DI, Talend Big Data, Talend ESB, Talend Administration Center, Talend Data Preparation & Data Stewardship, Talend Remote Engine and Talend Master Data Management (MDM)** is an advantage.
* Ability to lead complex escalations independently, remain calm under pressure and influence technical decisions without direct authority.
* Excellent customer-facing, written and verbal communication skills; able to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder-management skills, with a passion for coaching engineers and sharing technical knowledge.

**The location for this role is:**

Bangalore, India.

(This is an India-based opportunity supporting Qlik’s APAC customer base and global Support organization. Customer engagement and working hours may vary based on business requirements, including collaboration across time zones and participation in critical production incidents) LI-APAC

**Apply now and help change how the world transforms complex data landscapes into actionable insights and turns complex data challenges into new opportunities!**

**More about Qlik and who we are:**

Find out more about ‘Life at Qlik’ on social: Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X/Twitter, and to see all other opportunities to join us and our values, check out our Careers Page.

**What else do we offer?**

* Genuine career progression pathways and mentoring programs.
* Culture of innovation, technology, collaboration, and openness.
* Flexible, diverse, and international work environment.

Giving back is a huge part of our culture. Alongside an extra “change the world” day plus another for personal development, we also highly encourage participation in our Corporate Responsibility Employee Programs

title: MANAGER II ENTERPRISE SYSTEMS
description:
Job Title: MANAGER II ENTERPRISE SYSTEMS

**At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.**

:

Role Overview
  
Lead the strategy, lifecycle, service delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement of enterprise engineering systems. The role manages engineering applications and related processes, partnering with business units, vendors, technology teams and end users to deliver reliable, scalable and value-driven solutions. The role also promotes AI, automation, digital assessment and engineering transformation opportunities that improve user experience, productivity and business value.

  

**Key Responsibilities :**

* Engineering systems leadership: Own the roadmap, lifecycle, operational performance, and continuous improvement of enterprise engineering applications and related processes.
* Engineering systems domain: Guide implementation and administration of standard and custom CAD, CAE, PDM, and related engineering tools, with strong specialization in PTC and Ansys products and exposure to broader industry solutions.
* Application lifecycle management: Drive planning, evaluation, implementation, upgrade, maintenance, support, and retirement activities, with specific focus on PTC and Ansys product portfolios.
* Software, licensing, and contracts: Manage software modules, entitlement models, license demand, utilization, renewals, vendor proposals, contracts, and cost optimization in collaboration with Procurement and business stakeholders.
* Service management: Establish and monitor application support, helpdesk, incident, request, problem, knowledge, and escalation processes to deliver consistent user service.
* Change management and adoption: Lead change-impact planning, stakeholder communication, user readiness, training, application promotion, feedback collection, and adoption measurement for engineering tools.
* Stakeholder and BU partnership: Build trusted relationships with business units, engineering leaders, users, vendors, and technology teams; translate business needs into prioritized system capabilities and service improvements.
* Governance and performance: Define service metrics, review delivery performance, manage risks and dependencies, support budgeting and forecasting, and provide clear updates to leadership.
* Customer success and value realization: Establish business partnerships, develop capability-building plans, influence strategic priorities through awareness, training, and consulting, and maximize technology adoption and measurable business value.
* AI and automation: Identify and promote practical AI, engineering automation, CAD automation, analytics, and workflow improvement opportunities; coordinate pilots, governance, adoption, and value tracking.
* Demand management: Monitor and meter application usage, forecast demand, establish appropriate contracts and build an effective external ecosystem of workforce and application vendors.
  

**Required Qualifications and Experience :**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or an equivalent engineering discipline.
* Strong exposure to engineering systems and processes, including application lifecycle management for PTC and Ansys products.
* Experience with software modules, licensing models, demand planning, utilization, commercial negotiations, renewals, and contract management.
* Working knowledge of service management and helpdesk processes, including incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, and escalation management.
* Experience planning and delivering user training, application communications, product promotions, and adoption campaigns.
* Demonstrated experience leading change management and user adoption for engineering tools and process transformations.
* Exposure to AI and automation applied to engineering applications, processes, user support, or productivity improvement.
  

**Leadership and Core Competencies :**

* Stakeholder management: Demonstrated ability to build and sustain strong business-unit relationships, align diverse stakeholders, manage expectations, and drive decisions.
* Customer focus: Strong service mindset with a practical understanding of engineering-user needs and business priorities.
* Learning agility and coaching: Ability to learn new technologies quickly, coach colleagues, strengthen team capability, and develop talent and future leaders.
* Operational excellence: Exposure to Lean IT, continuous-improvement methods, or TEOA-style practices for improving service quality, flow, productivity, and customer experience.
* Organizational change management: Experience planning and implementing stakeholder, communication, readiness, training, reinforcement, and adoption activities.
* People leadership: Ability to lead global teams, coach talent, develop capability, delegate effectively, and create accountability for service and delivery outcomes.
  

**Preferred Qualifications :**

* Experience with PTC solutions such as Creo, Windchill/PDMLink and related engineering applications.
* Experience with Ansys or other industry-leading simulation and engineering analysis tools.
* Exposure to industry leading broader CAD, CAE, PDM, and engineering application suites.
* Familiarity with IT service management frameworks and application management

**Job description**
-------------------

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- SailPoint ISC Senior**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

  

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

  

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

  

Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

  

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. They will own roadmap delivery over a 2–4 quarter horizon, hire and develop engineers, and guide architecture for high-throughput distributed systems with strong data correctness, fault tolerance, and availability. The role includes overseeing batch and streaming data pipelines using managed distributed processing platforms such as Data Flow. Responsibilities include setting engineering standards and SLOs; driving performance optimization, observability, reconciliation, and recovery; ensuring operational readiness and effective on-call coverage; and overseeing security, automation, and safe deployments and rollbacks. The manager will partner with compute, networking, storage, and commercial platform teams to deliver reliable metering capabilities and support new consumption models. Experience with Java, Python, Spark, and cloud data processing platforms is preferred.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**System Design & Architecture – System Scalability:**

* Manages the development and implementation of scalable distributed systems and components across multiple teams, including the effective use of distributed state management tools.

* Guides teams to define scalability requirements for owned components and ensures design and implementation requirements are met.
* Manages the use of data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing.
* Ensures team accurately designs performance and load testing.

**System Design & Architecture – System Reliability Design:**

* Manages the strategy for building fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by guiding the implementation of redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms.
* Develops design strategies for systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.
* Leads implementation and optimization initiatives across teams for approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.
* Guides teams to design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department.

**System Design & Architecture – System Reliability Performance:**

* Provides oversight in defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems.
* Oversees the building and customization of moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health.

**System Design & Architecture – Correctness / Availability:**

* Oversees the design and implementation of functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems.
* Guides teams to design complex test scenarios (e.g., fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness.

**Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:**

* Guides teams to be proactive when diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation.
* Ensures teams leverage expertise to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.
* Oversees operational readiness protocol and ensures teams remain knowledgeable of owned components and systems to support effective troubleshooting and performance.
* Oversees and approves schedules for operational support rotations.

**Compliance & Security:**

* Oversees implementation of robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, ensuring team strategies incorporate encryption techniques and access controls.
* Directs execution of remediation plans to address identified security gaps, promoting continuous improvement of security measures.
* Ensures comprehensive documentation and cloud infrastructure compliance with industry standards and regulations.

**Automation & Change Management:**

* Oversees the development and maintenance of automation scripts and tools (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure.
* Works with teams to create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and guides development of components to allow for automation of these processes.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets (when applicable) are monitored and met.
* Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs.
* Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success.
* Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues, as well as guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions.
* Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping teams to identify potential solutions.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements.
* Identifies skill gaps across teams and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge-sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas, coaching them to apply learnings to advance the organization.

**Performance and Development:**

title: Senior Engineer
description:
**Job Description: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer**

***Position Overview***

We are seeking a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer with at least 7 years of experience in full-stack software development, web crawling, network protocol analysis, and enterprise data telemetry. In this role, you will bridge the gap between application architecture, web scraper engineering, network traffic analysis, and data analytics.

Using Node.js as your primary backend environment, you will design automated crawling engines, analyze client-side rendering mechanics, monitor live application traffic in New Relic, and join web-level findings with data warehouse records to produce high-impact analytical reports.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Full-Stack Engineering & Web Crawling

Full-Stack Development: Architect, develop, and maintain robust services and analytics applications using Node.js (TypeScript/JavaScript) on the backend along with modern frontend frameworks.

Scalable Web Crawling: Design and scale high-throughput crawling suites using Node.js automation libraries (Playwright, Puppeteer) to inspect complex DOM structures, handle dynamic client-side rendering, and extract structured metadata.

DOM & Rendering Analysis: Evaluate the browser rendering lifecycle—including HTML/CSS parsing, JavaScript execution, DOM tree construction, layout, and visual paint—to detect client-side performance bottlenecks or script execution failures.

**2. HTTP Protocol & Network Traffic Analysis**

Network & Payload Inspection: Perform deep-dive analysis on inbound and outbound HTTP/HTTPS traffic, inspecting request/response headers, status codes, cookies, session tokens, payloads, and API endpoints.

APM & Traffic Patterns: Monitor real-time traffic volumes, request distribution, latency metrics, and error rates using New Relic (or equivalent APM systems) to detect operational anomalies and traffic spikes.

Full-Trace Mapping: Correlate client-side event triggers and tracking calls with server logs, microservice calls, and backend API responses.

**3. Data Warehouse Integration & Reporting**

Data Warehouse Querying: Write complex, optimized SQL queries and manage data pipelines to extract and aggregate large-scale records from platforms like Snowflake, BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift.

**Data Synthesis:** Merge web crawling datasets, HTTP payload logs, and APM telemetry with warehouse transaction history to perform root-cause analysis and pattern identification.

Technical Reporting: Build and deliver comprehensive technical reports, automated executive dashboards, and actionable recommendations for product, platform, and data teams.

**Required Qualifications**

Professional Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in full-stack software engineering, with a strong focus on backend systems, web scraping, and data-driven web analytics.

Node.js Expertise: 7+ years of deep technical proficiency in Node.js (TypeScript/JavaScript), microservices architecture, and asynchronous runtime performance tuning.

Frontend Mechanics: Master-level understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript runtime engines, browser rendering paths, DOM structures, and DevTools.

Browser Automation: Demonstrated track record building resilient, production-grade scrapers using Puppeteer, Playwright, or Selenium within a Node.js ecosystem.

Networking & Protocols: Expert knowledge of network protocols (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTPS), RESTful APIs, GraphQL, CORS, cookies, and HTTP request/response lifecycle mechanics.

Telemetry & APM: Hands-on expertise with New Relic or similar enterprise monitoring suites to analyze system performance, network payloads, and user traffic behavior.

**Preferred Qualifications**

5+ years in a senior or lead technical capacity guiding web architecture, data engineering pipelines, or scraping infrastructure.

Data Warehouse & SQL: Advanced SQL skills and extensive experience extracting, transforming, and loading data across cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

Familiarity with bypassing advanced anti-bot protections, IP rotation systems, and browser fingerprinting challenges.

Practical experience deploying serverless microservices (AWS Lambda, Cloudflare Workers) for distributed web crawling tasks.

title: Senior Principal - Platform Engineer Network Capabilities
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal Engineer builds and runs GSK's shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management platform as automated, secure, self-service infrastructure, sets the engineering standard within that platform, mentors the engineers around them, and treats the teams who consume the platform as customers. The role works through infrastructure-as-code and golden paths rather than manual configuration, uses AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and engineers reliability in by defining SLOs, instrumenting for observability and automating away toil.

This is the senior hands-on engineering role in the platform team, working across shared network capabilities such as DNS, DHCP and IP address management to integrate and assure delivery as well as building. Engineering roadmap and direction sit with the Engineering Director, reference architecture and standards sit with the Platform Architect, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, and deep reliability engineering sits with the Site Reliability Engineer deployed from Reliability Engineering & Operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build and automate platform infrastructure using infrastructure-as-code and golden paths, so that provisioning is repeatable rather than reconstructed each time.
* Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing to accelerate delivery and raise quality, reviewing AI-generated output before it is merged.
* Build self-service capabilities and paved roads that reduce friction for consuming teams, so adoption does not depend on the platform team's availability.
* Engineer for reliability by defining SLOs, instrumenting platforms for observability and automating to reduce toil, working with the Site Reliability Engineer on standards.
* Set and uphold engineering standards, secure-by-default practices and code quality within the platform, and hold them in code review.
* Contribute to incident response and drive permanent automated fixes with Reliability Engineering rather than repeating manual recovery.
* Mentor and technically lead other engineers, including partner engineers, linking engineering work to platform OKRs and outcomes.
* Integrate and assure supplier or managed-service components, holding partner-delivered engineering to the same standards and code quality as internal work.
* Work the platform's manual task and toil backlog, converting identified candidates into automation and evidencing the effort removed.
* Close observability coverage gaps for the platform, so that reliability can be measured rather than inferred.
* Contribute engineering-led items to the platform backlog held by the Product Owner, including technical debt, upgrade and automation work, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* Apply the reference architectures and patterns set by the Platform Architect, and raise a case for change rather than diverging locally.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Deep hands-on depth in the relevant platform domain, whether cloud and hosting, network or digital workplace.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, and with containers and Kubernetes where relevant to the platform.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.
* Extensive experience engineering shared network services such as Domain Name System, Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol and Internet Protocol address management.
* Strong knowledge of network access control, application programming interfaces, automation, monitoring and resilient service design.
* Evidence of improving service reliability, self service, deployment speed or operational efficiency.

**Skills/Background**

* Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.
* Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.
* Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.
* Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.
* Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.
* Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

AI Programming, Automation, Automation Technology, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Data Distribution Service (DDS), Data Management and Integration (DMI), IP Address Management (IPAM), Leadership, Load Balancers, Network Design, Operational Technology (OT), Packet Switching, Security Engineering, Security Management, Software-Defined Networking Wide Area Network (SD-WAN), System Monitors, Universal Description Discovery and Integration (UDDI), Wireless System Design, Zero Trust Architecture

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

title: Principal I, Cloud & Middleware Architecture (Platform Engineering)
description:
**Summary of Position:**

  

We are seeking a **Principal Platform Engineer** to help lead the design, engineering, automation, and operation of enterprise cloud and Kubernetes platforms supporting cloud, datacenter, manufacturing, and edge environments.

The selected candidate will serve as a senior technical leader responsible for transforming architecture strategy into secure, scalable, automated, and supportable platform capabilities. The role combines deep hands-on engineering expertise with technical leadership and close collaboration across architecture, security, infrastructure, operations, and application teams.

The successful candidate will help drive modernization initiatives through cloud-native technologies, platform engineering practices, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps, GitOps, and automation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Platform Engineering**
------------------------

* Design, build, and operate enterprise cloud and Kubernetes platform capabilities across AWS, Azure, hybrid, on-premises, and edge environments.
* Translate architectural standards into reusable engineering patterns, automation, platform services, and operational capabilities.
* Lead technical design and implementation activities for strategic platform initiatives.
* Establish engineering best practices for platform development, deployment, lifecycle management, and operational support.
* Mentor engineering teams and provide technical guidance across platform-related initiatives.

**Kubernetes & Cloud-Native Platforms**
---------------------------------------

* Design and implement Kubernetes platform capabilities including:
  + Cluster lifecycle management
  + Worker node design and scaling
  + Networking and ingress
  + Storage integration
  + Secrets and certificate management
  + Platform observability
  + Backup and recovery
  + Security controls and policy enforcement
* Support deployment patterns for:
  + Engineering & Validation environments
  + Production Edge environments
  + MES/SCADA-supporting platforms
  + GPU-enabled workloads
* Guide Kubernetes version management, upgrade strategies, supportability, and operational readiness.

**Infrastructure as Code & Automation**
---------------------------------------

* Develop reusable infrastructure modules and deployment frameworks using Terraform and approved automation technologies.
* Implement GitOps deployment patterns using Argo CD, or approved alternatives.
* Drive automation-first approaches for provisioning, configuration management, upgrades, compliance validation, and operational support.
* Build repeatable deployment patterns that reduce operational effort while improving consistency and quality.

**DevSecOps & Platform Reliability**
------------------------------------

* Integrate security, compliance, and operational controls into platform delivery processes.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure, platform services, and Kubernetes lifecycle activities.
* Support vulnerability management, policy enforcement, secrets management, and certificate management capabilities.
* Define and improve platform reliability, availability, observability, backup, and recovery capabilities.

**Qualification, Testing & Continuous Improvement**
---------------------------------------------------

* Develop automated validation and qualification frameworks for:
  + Kubernetes releases
  + Infrastructure profiles
  + Storage integrations
  + Network integrations
  + Security controls
  + Platform services
  + Edge deployments
  + GPU-enabled configurations
* Contribute to platform certification and supportability programs.
* Support development of platform standards, support matrices, and operational runbooks.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, standardization, measurement, and operational feedback.

**Collaboration & Technical Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Partner with architects, security teams, infrastructure teams, operations teams, and application teams to deliver platform capabilities.
* Participate in architecture reviews and technology evaluations.
* Help define engineering roadmaps and implementation plans.
* Contribute to platform strategy through practical implementation experience and operational insights.

**Key** **Responsibilities/Minimum** **Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's or Master's Degree with 5+ years of total experience.

* Experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Infrastructure Engineering, or related technical disciplines.
* Strong knowledge of AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
* Hands-on experience with **Kubernetes platforms** such as Amazon EKS, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), OpenShift, RKE2, or equivalent enterprise Kubernetes platforms
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred), CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, Linux administration, Containers and container platforms, Cloud networking and security, Observability and monitoring solutions
* Experience implementing highly available, secure, and scalable platform solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with AWS Control Tower, Landing Zones, Account Governance, and Cloud Security services.
* Experience with Argo CD, Helm, and modern Kubernetes platform tooling.
* Experience with JFrog Artifactory or enterprise artifact management solutions.
* Experience with Security Hub, CloudTrail, CloudFront, Audit Manager, Azure security services, and related governance tooling.
* Experience in manufacturing, edge computing, industrial, or distributed platform environments.
* Experience supporting disconnected or intermittently connected environments.
* Experience with GPU-enabled infrastructure and AI/ML platforms.
* Experience with platform qualification, testing, and release certification practices.
* Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, PowerShell, Bash, JavaScript, or similar technologies.
* Relevant cloud, DevOps, Terraform, Kubernetes, or security certifications.

**Measures of Success:**

Success in this role will be demonstrated by:

* Delivery of secure, reliable, and reusable platform capabilities.
* Successful implementation of cloud and Kubernetes platform services aligned to roadmap objectives.
* Increased automation and reduction of manual operational effort.
* Improved platform reliability, security, scalability, and supportability.
* Reduced onboarding time for applications, environments, and infrastructure consumers.
* Effective qualification, testing, and lifecycle management of platform technologies.
* Successful mentoring and technical leadership of engineering teams.
* Measurable improvement in platform adoption, operational efficiency, and delivery velocity.
* This role offers an opportunity to shape the future of cloud, Kubernetes, platform engineering, and edge computing capabilities while remaining deeply engaged in hands-on technical delivery and engineering leadership.

title: MS Teams with Enterprise Voice Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**  
As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation.
  
  
At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities. The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.
  
  
**What you will do**

As a Microsoft Teams Administrator with Enterprise Voice skills, you will:

* Design, configure, and manage Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice solutions, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Deploy and integrate Session Border Controllers (SBCs) with Microsoft Teams.
* Troubleshoot and resolve voice-related issues in Microsoft Teams, including call quality, routing, and interoperability with PSTN providers.
* Manage and support Microsoft Teams policies, configurations, and voice-enabled features.
* Collaborate with network and security teams to ensure compliance and optimal performance.
* Perform migrations from legacy PBX systems to Microsoft Teams.
* Work with external vendors and telecom providers to ensure seamless voice connectivity.
* Monitor Teams Voice infrastructure using analytics and reporting tools to optimize call performance.
Provide end-user support and training on Microsoft Teams Phone features.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise:**

  

* 5+ years of experience in Microsoft Teams Voice and Telephony Solutions.
* Experience in PBX to Microsoft Teams migrations.
* Knowledge of Power Automate and Power Apps for workflow automation in Teams.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Teams Enterprise Voice, including Direct Routing, Calling Plans, and Operator Connect.
* Strong understanding of SIP, VoIP, PSTN connectivity, and SBC configurations (AudioCodes, Ribbon, etc.).
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), PowerShell scripting, and Teams Admin Center.
Knowledge of E911 compliance, call routing policies, dial plans, and number management  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience:**

  

* Microsoft 365 Certified: Teams Administrator Associate (MS-700).
* Microsoft Certified: Teams Voice Engineer (MS-721).
Session Border Controller (SBC) certifications (AudioCodes/Ribbon).  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Product Development Engineer (Career Rotation Program)
description:
**Your Job**

**Engineering Rotational Program**

Phillips Medisize, a Molex Company is seeking a dynamic, curious engineer to join our Engineering Rotational Program, a dynamic opportunity to develop solutions in medical devices that improve patient lives. As a part of the global rotational program, you'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to work on platform medical devices to help design and solve some of the challenging global problems.

The Engineering Rotational Program is designed for aspiring engineers to gain experience in various areas of engineering and determine an area to further develop in their career. The Rotational Program involves 6-month rotations across Phillips Medisize / Molex locations within Asia.

**What We Offer**

The Engineering Rotational Program is designed to develop the next generation of technical and business leaders. You will be given technical leadership opportunities and skills training, rotational work assignments, team interface and interaction and exposure to Senior and Executive Management. Engineers complete rotational assignments within a variety of focused areas in their engineering discipline over a 18-month period. This opportunity is created to provide challenging and enriching work assignments, an opportunity to gain familiarity with global systems and practices across the organization, and a chance to explore individual interests.

**You Will Gain**

* Hands on technical and leadership development
* Exposure and work assignments across various engineering groups over the two-year program, based on your skills and business needs
* Opportunities to collaborate with senior leaders and executive management
* Challenging assignments that build familiarity with Molex Systems' practices across the organization
* The opportunity to explore individual interest aligned with company objectives

**What You Will Do**

* Comprehensive understanding of the organization's engineering operations to collaborate for new business.
* Product design transfer to manufacturing facilities within global R & D sites.
* Technical support for design transfer and setting up manufacturing capabilities.
* Facilitate knowledge transfer, and helps build strong professional network.
* Share application knowledge and product development activities to the global team.
* Develop a well-rounded engineer with a deep understanding of the organization's operations.
* Contribute innovative ideas and state of the art thinking to improve business performance
* Participate in programs, projects, and initiatives aligned with company's culture and strategy

title: Principal - IAM Advanced Authentication
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centered on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**:

The Principal Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for designing, building, automating and improving GSK’s enterprise certificate services. Reporting to the Lead, PKI, the role translates approved architecture, security standards and service priorities into secure, resilient production capabilities; makes day-to-day engineering decisions within those guardrails; and serves as a technical escalation point for complex PKI issues.

**About the team**:

The PKI team provides trusted machine, device, user and application identities across GSK. The team engineers and operates enterprise certificate authorities and certificate lifecycle services, enables automated certificate issuance and renewal, and supports secure communications across on-premises, cloud and operational technology environments. It works with security architecture, platform operations, application teams and service partners to maintain clear ownership from solution design through production support.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to deliver key engineering activities and deepen your technical expertise. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Design, build, configure and maintain enterprise certificate authority and registration authority services.
* Engineer secure certificate issuance, renewal, revocation and recovery processes for users, devices, applications and workloads.
* Automate certificate discovery, inventory, issuance, renewal, revocation and reporting using APIs, scripting, infrastructure as code and enterprise certificate lifecycle management platforms.
* Integrate PKI with Microsoft and Linux platforms, network and security devices, cloud services, DevOps pipelines, applications, mobile and endpoint management platforms, and operational technology environments.
* Implement certificate profiles, templates and policy controls in line with approved architecture, Certificate Policy and Certification Practice Statement requirements, security standards and cryptographic requirements.
* Monitor service health, capacity, availability, certificate expiry, issuance quality and control effectiveness; define actionable alerting and operational thresholds; and remediate vulnerabilities, performance constraints or configuration drift.
* Troubleshoot complex certificate, trust-chain, revocation, protocol and interoperability issues and provide technical leadership during incidents.
* Plan and execute upgrades, migrations, key ceremonies, backup and restoration validation, disaster recovery tests and service improvements with appropriate change, security and evidence controls.
* Produce and maintain engineering designs, build documentation, runbooks, test evidence and integration guidance.
* Partner with the PKI Lead, operations, architecture, security, audit, application teams and service partners; mentor engineers; review technical designs and changes; and communicate engineering risks, dependencies and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* At least five years of hands-on experience engineering and supporting enterprise PKI or certificate lifecycle services, including responsibility for production design, implementation, troubleshooting and continuous improvement.
* Strong knowledge of X.509 certificates, certificate chains and path validation, enrollment, revocation, OCSP, CRLs, key management, cryptographic algorithms and core PKI security principles.
* Practical experience with Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services or a comparable enterprise certificate authority platform.
* Experience integrating certificates with Windows, Linux, network devices, applications or cloud services, including relevant dependencies on Active Directory, DNS, privileged access and service identities.
* Ability to automate technical processes using PowerShell, Python, APIs or infrastructure-as-code tooling.
* Experience diagnosing complex production issues and implementing sustainable corrective actions.
* Strong documentation, collaboration and communication skills in a global engineering environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience with certificate lifecycle management platforms and automated enrollment protocols such as SCEP, EST or ACME.
* Experience with hardware security modules, protected key operations and formal key ceremonies.
* Knowledge of cloud-native certificate services and workload identity patterns in Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* Experience supporting device, network, operational technology or code-signing certificate use cases.
* Familiarity with cryptographic standards, audit controls and regulated-industry requirements.

* Relevant certification in Microsoft, cloud, security or PKI technologies.
* Typical tools and technologies: Microsoft Active Directory Certificate Services, enterprise certificate lifecycle management platforms, hardware security modules, Azure Key Vault, X.509, TLS, SCEP, EST, ACME, OCSP, CRLs, PowerShell, Python, REST APIs and infrastructure as code.

**Skills**

Account Lifecycle Management, Authentication Systems, Automation Technology, Certificate Management, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Cryptography, Database Management, Directory Services, Enterprise Systems Engineering, Identity Access Management (IAM), Identity Lifecycle Management, Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Infrastructure Security, Key Management, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Security Controls, Service Integration, System Monitors, Systems Troubleshooting, Troubleshooting

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. title: Google Cloud Expert
description:
