title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer - AI Infrastructure
description:
**Job Description**
As a Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the software design and development of major components of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. You should be a curious problem solver, a distributed systems generalist, and a hands-on software developer with exposure to Linux, systems fundamentals, and systems troubleshooting. You should be eager to explore different parts of the stack, understand low-level system behavior, and design and build scalable distributed services. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn.
  
  
This role resides within the Compute Bare Metal Provisioning team, which owns the critical infrastructure responsible for automating the full server lifecycle—from new platform and shape creation to hardware bring-up, customer-ready instance provisioning, and firmware management. Our services operate at the intersection of bare metal hardware and full-stack orchestration frameworks, bringing together distributed systems development, Linux, and firmware integration. The team interfaces directly with components such as BMCs, NICs, SmartNICs, ILOMs, GPUs, and custom firmware stacks.
  
  
You will write code, design services, and build tooling that provisions, configures, secures, and validates server platforms across OCI’s massive fleet of Compute and GPU infrastructure. You will partner closely with teams across Compute, Networking, Security, Data Center Engineering, and Hardware Development to help OCI launch, scale, and maintain new server platforms with high reliability and minimal operational overhead. You will work directly with cutting-edge GPU hardware and see the impact of your work on the business.
  
  
You will join a smart, motivated, and diverse team with the autonomy and support to do your best work. This role offers significant opportunities for growth and hands-on learning, allowing you to expand your skills in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Linux, hardware integration, and firmware orchestration. You will build on your existing strengths while developing new expertise through challenging engineering problems and collaboration with experienced colleagues.
  
  
If you are interested in building large-scale distributed infrastructure for the cloud, writing software for cutting-edge GPU infrastructure and the latest Compute systems, and expanding your Linux and systems skills, this is your team. Oracle is aggressively investing in Oracle Cloud to provide the broadest, most comprehensive cloud in the industry.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
You will own the software design and development of major components of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. You should be a strong, hands-on software developer, a driven problem solver, and a distributed systems generalist with exposure to Linux and systems fundamentals. You will design, develop, operate, and debug services across the stack, working with technologies such as Linux, Docker, Java web services, and Terraform to build reliable, scalable distributed infrastructure.
  
  
You should take initiative, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver results wherever needed. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn. This role offers substantial opportunities for growth through hands-on development, challenging engineering problems, and collaboration with experienced engineers. You will expand your skills in distributed systems, Linux, systems troubleshooting, and Compute and GPU infrastructure.
  
  
**Qualifications:**

* 3–8+ years of software development experience, including experience building or operating large-scale, highly available distributed systems.
* Strong hands-on coding skills in an object-oriented language such as Java or C++, and experience with a scripting language such as Python.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems fundamentals.
* Exposure to Linux, operating systems concepts, and systems troubleshooting, with a willingness to deepen these skills.
* Familiarity with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform.
* Working familiarity with networking protocols such as TCP/IP and HTTP, and standard network architectures.
* Understanding of databases, NoSQL systems, storage, and distributed persistence technologies.
* Comfortable using AI agents and prompt engineering to support software development, code analysis, and debugging.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, with an interest in developing expertise in performance tuning.
* A demonstrated ability to learn new technologies, take ownership, and collaborate across teams.
* Experience building multi-tenant or virtualized infrastructure is a strong plus.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

**:**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The GDS Cyber Architecture Operational Technology & Engineering (CAOE) services help our clients tackle the many security challenges they face on a daily basis and develop effective solutions using people, processes and technology, while enabling better security and risk decisions, and reducing costs related to manging security risks. The CAOE team is looking for individuals who will play a direct role in delivery of Operational Technology (OT) security engagements, development of proposals in this area, and develop OT security solutions. You will play a key role in supporting our clients to secure their IT/OT environments, either through advisory and/or implementation support.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor OT networks using specialized OT SOC and network monitoring tools
* Analyse alerts from OT security monitoring solutions (e.g., Nozomi, Claroty, Tenable.ot, Defender for IoT, etc.)
* Identify suspicious activities, anomalies, and indicators of compromise (IoCs) affecting ICS environments
* Perform Level 2 alert triage and investigation for OT incidents
* Support for OT cybersecurity incident response activities
* Understanding of security-related operational processes in the OT-ICS environments
* Understanding of technologies (typical assets, communication protocols, technical architectures) utilized by OT-ICS systems and networks
* Knowledge of cyber / information security concepts, risk and controls concepts
* Understanding of aspects of functional safety (SIS)
* Knowledge of TCP/IP, concepts of OSI layer and protocols, networking and security concepts
* Knowledge of the technical security solutions utilized within OT-ICS systems and networks
* Knowledge of OS (Windows / Linux) security, Database security
* Prior experience working alongside delivery leads and architects to Identify and manage risks is a plus

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Completed technical higher education in the field of industrial automation, computer science, electronics or other relevant fields
* Certificates or education related to industrial automation / engineering etc.
* Knowledge on OT network monitoring solution such as Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, DarkTrace, Azure Defender
* Knowledge on tools like Nessus, BackTrack, NMAP, BurpSuite, etc. is a plus
* Knowledge of OT-ICS Security standards, including ISA/IEC 62443, NIST 800-82, NERC-CIP
* Understanding of IT/OT/IoT communication protocols e.g., TCP/IP, UDP, DNP3, Modbus, IEC 61850, OPC, OPC UA, PROFINET, BLE, Zigbee
* Knowledge of standards such as ISO 27001/2, ISO 22301, ISO 27018, NIST standards on Cyber Security, HITRUST, etc. is a plus

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 5+ years of experience in the Cyber Security and OT Security Domain
* Minimum B. Tech. or equivalent educational qualification
* ISA/IEC 62443 Fundamentals Specialist

title: IoT Engineer (Development & Implementation)
description:
**IoT Engineer (Development & Implementation)**

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a hands-on IoT Engineer with end-to-end expertise in designing, developing, and deploying scalable Internet of Things (IoT) solutions. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between physical hardware (sensors, actuators, edge gateways) and cloud/on-premise data platforms. You will be responsible for taking IoT initiatives from laboratory prototyping through to ruggedized field implementation across distributed sites.

**Key Responsibilities**

**● End-to-End Architecture:**
Design and build full-stack IoT architectures encompassing sensor nodes, edge computing gateways, communication networks, and central data ingestion pipelines.

**● Firmware & Edge Development:**
Write, test, and optimize embedded code and edge software (C/C++, Python, Embedded Linux) for microcontrollers and industrial gateways.

**● Protocol & Network Integration:**
Implement reliable device-to-cloud and device-to-device communication using industrial and IoT protocols (MQTT, CoAP, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC-UA, HTTP/HTTPS, LoRaWAN, BLE, or Cellular/4G/5G).

**● Field Deployment & Commissioning:**
Lead on-site installation, sensor calibration, gateway provisioning, and network troubleshooting across operational facilities.

**● Data Pipeline & Dashboarding:**
Integrate telemetry streams into time-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) and enterprise systems (ERP/SCADA/Cloud IoT cores), building real-time monitoring and alerting dashboards.

**● Security & Fleet Management:**
Implement device-level security (TLS/SSL, secure boot, encrypted credentials) and manage Over-The-Air (OTA) firmware updates for deployed fleets.

**● Reliability & Maintenance:**
Diagnose hardware failures, signal dropouts, and power-consumption bottlenecks in harsh or remote operating environments.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

● Education: B.Tech/B.E. in Electronics & Communication, Electrical, Instrumentation, Computer Science, or a related engineering field.

● Experience: 3–6+ years of demonstrable experience in full-cycle IoT development and field deployment (Industrial IoT/IIoT experience is highly preferred).

● Hardware Proficiency: Hands-on experience with MCUs/SoCs (ESP32, STM32, ARM Cortex), Single Board Computers (Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson, Industrial Edge PCs), and industrial PLCs/sensors.

● Software & Cloud: Proficiency in C/C++ and Python; experience with Docker at the edge, Linux administration, and IoT platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT, ThingsBoard, or custom self-hosted stacks).

● Tooling: Ability to use hardware debugging tools (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers) and schematic/PCB review tools.

title: Director- Partner FTTH Networks in Telecom
company: Client of Talent Leads HR Solutions Pvt Ltd
description:
The Director – Partner Networks is the senior leader accountable for the quality, reliability and

customer experience of company’s partner-operated FTTH networks across India. The role leads two pillars: on-ground partner network assurance (through the AVPs – Partner Network Assurance and their regional teams) and the Partner Support Centre, a technical call centre that resolves network, hardware and firmware issues for partners.

Beyond running operations, this role sets the direction: the policies, processes, architecture

standards and governance frameworks that make a large partner network perform like one high-

quality network. We are looking for a leader who has run partner and direct operations hands-on,

and who has since spent the last few years driving process excellence and policy from a central

command role.

Leadership is the core of this role. Technical depth is expected, but success will be defined by

the quality of leadership, critical thinking, judgement and data-based decision making: the ability to lead senior leaders, cut through complexity, make sound calls with incomplete information, and

align partners and cross-functional teams behind clear priorities.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Strategy and function leadership**

Define the vision, operating model and multi-year roadmap for Partner Networks, aligned with

business growth and customer experience goals.

Set annual targets for network quality, complaint ratios, MTTR and partner performance; cascade

them to AVPs, regions and partners.

Own the function’s budget, headcount plan and organisation design.

**2. Partner network quality governance**

Hold overall accountability for complaint ratios, MTTR, uptime and customer experience across

all partner networks.

Lead the AVPs – Partner Network Assurance, ensuring consistent standards and execution across

regions.

Run a strong governance rhythm: daily dashboards, weekly regional reviews, monthly business

reviews and quarterly partner performance reviews.

Drive escalation and recovery plans for chronic or high-impact partner networks, including

turnaround or exit decisions.

**3. Process excellence and policy making**

Design and continuously improve the end-to-end processes for partner operations: installation,

fault management, maintenance, escalation and partner onboarding.

Frame policies on partner SLAs, incentives and penalties, quality certification, compliance and

audits.

Apply process excellence methods (Lean, Six Sigma, root-cause analysis) to remove failure points

and reduce cost and effort.

Define clear RACI between partners, field teams, support centre, NOC and other functions.

**4. Network architecture and standards**

Own the reference FTTH architecture and deployment standards for partner networks, including

design, optical power budgets and equipment standards.

Approve solution designs for new geographies, high-density clusters and network upgrades.

Evaluate and standardise equipment (OLT, ONU, switches, passives) with Technology,

Procurement and vendors.

**5. Partner Support Centre**

Lead the AVP – Partner Support Centre in running a high-performing technical call centre for

partners.

Set the support model: tiered resolution, tele-engineer skill levels, knowledge base and

escalation paths to NOC, firmware teams and field teams.

Drive first-call resolution, response and resolution times, and partner satisfaction with the centre.

Use support centre data to spot systemic network, firmware and hardware issues and drive

permanent fixes.

**6. Technology, tools and automation**

Champion the use of NMS, ticketing, field force and analytics tools to give real-time visibility of

partner network health.

Drive automation of monitoring, alerting, fault detection and reporting; partner with Product and

IT on system roadmaps.

Build data-driven early-warning mechanisms for network degradation and partner under-

performance.

**7. People leadership and capability**

Lead, coach and develop the AVPs and their leadership teams; build a strong succession bench.

Build capability across company teams and partners through structured training, certification and

knowledge programmes.

Foster a culture of ownership, discipline and customer focus.

**8. Cross-functional and executive stakeholder management**

Work closely with NOC, Core Network, Technology, Firmware, Customer Service, Sales and

Partner Business leadership.

Represent Partner Networks in leadership forums; present performance, risks and investment

cases to senior management.

Build trusted relationships with key partners to align them with company quality agenda.

Key performance indicators

KPI What it measures

Complaint ratio Network complaints per active subscriber, pan-India and by region

MTTR Average time to resolve partner-network faults

Repeat complaint rate Customers raising the same issue again within a set window

Network uptime Availability of partner-run networks

Major outage restoration time

Time to restore area-wide and mass disruptions

Installation TAT and first-time-right

Speed and quality of new connections by partners

Partner performance mix Share of partners meeting quality benchmarks; chronic partners turned around Support centre performance First-call resolution, response and resolution times, partner satisfaction

Process and policy adoption SOP compliance and audit scores across regions and partners

Cost efficiency Cost of network operations and support per subscriber

Team health Leadership bench strength, attrition and capability-building coverage

**Key skills and competencies**

Leadership, critical thinking and decision making (Critical)

Leading through senior leaders: setting direction, building leadership teams and driving

outcomes at scale.

Critical and structured thinking: breaking down complex, ambiguous problems, weighing trade-

offs and arriving at clear, well-reasoned decisions.

Data-based decision making: framing the right questions, reading data with rigour, separating

signal from noise and acting on evidence rather than opinion.

Sound judgement under pressure and with incomplete information, especially during large-scale

disruptions.

Stakeholder influence and negotiation with partners, peers and senior management.

Change leadership: driving adoption of new processes, policies and ways of working across

teams and partners.

Strategic and process leadership (Expert)

Designing operating models, governance frameworks and policies for large, distributed

operations.

Process excellence: process mapping and redesign, Lean / Six Sigma, structured RCA and

continuous improvement.

Designing partner SLAs, scorecards, incentive and penalty structures.

FTTH and network architecture (Expert)

GPON/XGS-PON FTTH architecture, splitter design, optical power budgeting and deployment

standards.

Strong foundational knowledge of OLT, ONU and MPLS / aggregation switches at hardware and

firmware level.

Ability to review solution designs and guide complex, multi-layer troubleshooting.

Partner and field operations (Expert)

Running FTTH operations at scale through both LCO / partner networks and direct field teams.

Driving complaint ratios, MTTR, uptime and installation performance across many regions.

Managing large-scale disruptions and crisis situations.

Technical support operations (Strong)

Setting up and running technical support or NOC-style centres: tiered support, knowledge

management, SLAs and escalation design.

Tools, data and automation (Strong)

NMS/EMS, ticketing, field force and analytics platforms.

Using data and dashboards to run the function, spot trends and make decisions.

Defining requirements for automation and system improvements with Product and IT teams.

**Requirements:**

Qualifications

B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Telecommunications, Electrical or Computer Science.

MBA or equivalent management qualification preferred.

Lean / Six Sigma or process excellence certification is an advantage.

Leadership traits (critical for this role)

For this role, leadership and behavioural strengths carry as much weight as technical expertise.

Technical Support Manager / Senior Technical Support Engineer Renewable Energy & Weather Monitoring Systems Department Industry Technical Support / Engineering Renewable Energy – Solar Resource Assessment (SRA) & Wind Monitoring Systems (WMS) Location Noida, Uttar Pradesh (with travel to project sites) Employment Type Full-time Experience 4–7 years preferred Reports To Director – Technical Operations 1. Role Overview We are seeking an accomplished Technical Support Manager / Senior Technical Support Engineer to lead end-to-end technical support for renewable-energy monitoring infrastructure. The role covers commissioning, configuration, remote diagnostics, data validation, Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) integration, firmware management, Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) coordination and field service for Solar Resource Assessment (SRA) and Wind Monitoring System (WMS) installations, weather stations, data acquisition systems, sensors and dataloggers. The successful candidate will own the complete signal chain — Sensor → RS485 → Datalogger → Ethernet/4G → Server → SCADA — and will resolve issues independently, without dependence on OEMs for routine troubleshooting. This is a hybrid of instrumentation engineer, datalogger specialist, communications/SCADA engineer, field-service lead and team manager, and is not a conventional IT helpdesk position. 2. Key Responsibilities • Support & troubleshooting: provide first-level and advanced support; diagnose sensor, wiring, power, surge-protection, datalogger, firmware, communication, network/IoT SIM, SCADA/PLC, configuration and data-processing faults, remotely (AnyDesk, UltraViewer, TeamViewer, FTP/SFTP, SSH, command-line, Modbus and MQTT tools) or on site; deliver workarounds, permanent fixes and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports. • Commissioning & field service: WMS/SRA commissioning, sensor installation checks and replacement, logger configuration, firmware upgrades, preventive maintenance, and SCADA integration, often at remote sites. • Data validation: analyse logger backups, configuration files, communication logs and historical datasets; detect gaps, duplicates, spikes, timestamp, scaling and unit errors. • Customer & OEM coordination: handle customer queries and online sessions; raise and track OEM tickets, test and validate firmware, and follow every case to closure. • Team & support management: allocate tasks, prioritise critical sites, review reports, train junior engineers, and track recurring issues to reduce dependence on individuals. • Documentation & ticketing: maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), commissioning and RCA reports, configuration sheets, Modbus register maps, firmware records, and a support register (client, warranty status, task, dates, assignee, problem, root cause, resolution, SOP status, task status). 3. Technical Expertise & Required Level Domain Scope Level A. Measurement Instrumentation Solar radiation & PV soiling Pyranometers, pyrgeometers, net radiometers and 4component radiometers (EKO MS-80S/80SH Plus, CNR4, RaZON+); GHI, GTI/POA irradiance; W/m², Wh/m², kWh/m²; averaging, daily/monthly accumulation, missing-data handling; calibration, cleaning, levelling; soiling monitoring (DustIQ) Advanced Wind & meteorological sensors Cup anemometers, wind vanes and ultrasonic anemometers (NRG 40C/M83200, Gill WindSonic/WS75, Comptus A75104CM/302M); Lufft WS600 compact weather sensor (UMB protocol); temperature, humidity and pressure sensors; sensor addressing, diagnostics and inter-sensor comparison Advanced Precipitation measurement Tipping-bucket rain gauges, Lufft WS600 precipitation, Parsivel² optical disdrometer; precipitation registers, daily/monthly accumulation Advanced B. Data Acquisition Dataloggers Campbell Scientific CR1000X/CR300/CR6 (LoggerNet, programming, data tables, backup/restore, logger-toPLC/SCADA diagnosis); Ammonit Meteo42/42A/42M/42L/40A (sensor and Modbus configuration, register mapping, scaling, statistics, solar and rain accumulation, FTP/SFTP and SMTP setup, firmware, backup extraction); exposure to EasyLog GSM and LPNet Advanced C. Communication & Systems Integration Serial interfaces RS232 and RS485: wiring, A/B polarity, termination, shielding, UART settings (baud rate, parity, stop bits), converters Advanced Modbus protocol Modbus RTU and Modbus TCP: slave IDs, function codes, holding/input registers, signed/unsigned 16-bit and 32-bit values, IEEE-754 floating point, byte/word order, scaling, polling interval, timeouts, multiple slaves, simulation tools (e.g., Modbus Slave) Advanced Networking & remote access TCP/IP, Ethernet, port and firewall verification, HTTP/HTTPS, SSH, remote-desktop tools (AnyDesk, UltraViewer, TeamViewer), command-line network diagnostics Intermediate–Advanced File transfer & email FTP/SFTP server configuration, backup and historical CSV retrieval, firmware/configuration transfer; SMTP (including Gmail and Microsoft 365) for logger email FTP/SFTP Advanced; SMTP Intermediate Time synchronisation NTP configuration and GPS time synchronisation for loggers Intermediate MQTT messaging Brokers, clients, topics, authentication, QoS, ports 1883/8883, TLS/SSL and CA certificates, Mosquitto (mosquitto\_pub/mosquitto\_sub); Device → Broker → Topic → Server testing Intermediate–Advanced Cellular & IoT connectivity GSM/4G routers, IoT SIMs, APN, public/private IP, port forwarding, IP whitelisting, firewall and SIM restrictions; isolating logger vs router vs SIM vs firewall vs server faults Intermediate–Advanced SCADA & PLC integration Modbus register mapping for instantaneous, statistical and daily/monthly values; scaling, data types, polling; validating SCADA values against logger data and resolving logger-vsSCADA discrepancies SCADA IntermediateAdvanced; PLC Intermediate Domain Scope Level D. Data Analysis & Automation Data validation & analysis CSV and time-series analysis in Excel and Python (Pandas); detecting missing, duplicate and repeated values, spikes, outliers, invalid values, communication gaps, timestamp, scaling and unit-conversion errors Excel Advanced; Analysis IntermediateAdvanced; Python Intermediate Scripting & automation Python scripting (JSON, APIs, report generation, data conversion), Node-RED (serial/TCP/MQTT/FTP workflows), Linux and Windows command line Linux/CLI Intermediate; Node-RED BasicIntermediate E. Electrical & Field Hardware Electrical troubleshooting 12/24 VDC power systems, multimeter and continuity testing, grounding, fuses, terminal blocks, surge and lightning protection, Ethernet cabling, industrial connectors; reading wiring diagrams, pinouts and equipment manuals Intermediate–Advanced F. Support Process & Management Firmware & configuration management Controlled firmware upgrades, regression checks, version records, configuration backups Advanced OEM coordination Raising and tracking OEM tickets, sharing logs and configurations, validating fixes, requesting features with Indian and international OEMs Advanced Documentation & customer support SOPs, manuals, RCA and site-visit reports, technical emails, online sessions, escalation handling Advanced Team management Task allocation, mentoring, knowledge base, support register, SLA tracking Intermediate–Advanced Rows rated Advanced or Intermediate–Advanced are mandatory; Node-RED and Python are desirable. 4. Qualifications & Candidate Profile • Education: B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Computer Science, IT or a related discipline. • Experience: 4–7 years, preferably in renewable energy, solar or wind monitoring, meteorological instrumentation, SCADA, IoT or industrial automation. • Ideal profile: independently handles the full cycle — complaint → remote diagnosis → data collection → analysis → root cause → OEM coordination → fix → validation → documentation → closure — communicates precisely, leads a team and is comfortable travelling to remote sites. 5. Key Performance Indicators Tickets closed within SLA; first-time resolution and repeat-issue reduction; RCA accuracy; customer satisfaction; OEM closure time; site downtime and data availability; commissioning success; SOP completion; junior-engineer training and reduced dependency on senior management. 6. Role Summary A technical-support leader accountable for end-to-end support, commissioning, troubleshooting and integration of renewable-energy WMS/SRA systems — dataloggers, sensors, SCADA, Modbus, MQTT, IoT communication and data acquisition — together with customer support, OEM coordination, field service, RCA, automation and documentation.

title: Tech Lead
description:
**Tech Lead**

**Department**: Information Technology**, Location**: Head office, Kolkata**, Reports to**: CEO**, Team**: IT Network / Hardware & Access Manager (IT Central Support under him) · Product Engineer ×4**, Dotted line**: Site IT Support at the sites — functional, through the IT Network / Hardware & Access Manager.

*Every process in the Company Master is to run on a system by 31 March 2027, mostly on Crystal’s own tools. The Tech Lead will own the IT function and every in-house tool: The tools stay up and correct, every release is safe, and the knowledge to run them sits in documentation, not in one developer’s head.*

**Responsibilities:**

*Run the function*

* The request queue is prioritised weekly with each tool owner; every feature, change and bug sits in a release — nothing reaches a developer directly,
* P1 and P2 turnaround times are published and met; every bug and integration failure is closed with its cause,
* Every integration is listed with an owner and a developer,
* No release reaches production without the tool owner’s sign-off, updated documentation and a rollback plan; only the Tech Lead deploys,
* Every in-house tool outage is owned until restored, root cause logged within 3 days; any cyber incident reaches the CEO the same day.

*The 31 March build*

* Every process on the Implementation List runs on a system by 31 March 2027; build vs plan reaches the Program Lead and CEO weekly,
* Sprints run every two weeks on developer estimates, process engine first, each piloted at one large and one small site,
* The process engine has an owner and backup developer, a configuration backlog and a published turnaround once a process is signed,
* Every build runs from the Master’s spec — governance tracker entry, second-developer code review, owner test sign-off, signed handover,
* No control — checker, approval, gate — is released without a test that tries to bypass it; every merge touching a control is reviewed,
* Every need is assessed build vs buy — process engine, then a tool, then buy — with at least two options compared for the CEO.

*Service to sites and functions*

* Legacy data is cleaned, loaded and checked by the tool owner at each go-live; developers give first-line app support through each support window,
* Each tool is IT-ready before go-live — users trained by the Training & Content Specialist, access loaded by the IT Network Manager,
* Usage per tool per site is reported monthly from system logs, with workarounds seen; gaps reach the owning function head,
* IT sets the standard, tools and calendar for Site IT Support at every site and co-rates them with the Site Lead.

*Security, data and audit*

* The security standard — patching, firewall, incident response — is set and reviewed yearly; the IT Network Manager runs it,
* Cloud admin accounts are named with 2FA; no configuration change takes effect without a ticket and a backup before and after,
* The backup and restore standard is set; the half-yearly restore drill result reaches the CEO with gaps and dates,
* The held processes start once the seat is filled: external IT and cyber audit reporting to the CEO, data retention, personal-data protection with Legal.

*Money, vendors and assets*

* The IT budget — devices, links, cloud, licences, AMCs, contract developers — is built with the IT Network Manager and spend explained monthly,
* Contract developers work to the code policy — company GitHub only, no keys in code, coding tools on company accounts,
* All code, documentation and cloud accounts sit on company accounts, never personal ones.

*Knowledge and review*

* Every tool has an owner and backup developer and passes the quarterly pick-up test from its pack alone; gaps close within two weeks,
* The one-page IT pack goes out in the first week of each month for the CEO’s IT review; actions are logged with owners and dates,
* One measurable IT improvement is delivered each quarter, chosen from the IT review.

*Leading the team*

* Every team member knows their role card, monthly targets and priorities; the weekly team review is held as set in the Meetings Master,
* Each direct report has a monthly one-on-one — progress, honest feedback, help where stuck,
* Performance is reviewed on the PMS calendar, on evidence; weak performance gets an improvement plan early, not at appraisal,
* Every direct report has a development plan that is worked on — coaching on the job, training, stretch work,
* Strong performers are recognised and kept; every critical seat, including this one, has a ready backup,
* Open seats are filled with HR and new joiners inducted well; attendance, conduct and discipline are handled fairly and on time.

Pay: Up to ₹2,400,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

* What IT product and tool you have built personally, not by your team, only by you?
* Which warehouse or logistics operations have you built tools for?
* Walk me through the most complex tool you personally built from scratch. What did you write yourself — code, scripts, data model — and on what stack?
* Take one tool you built for operations. How did you gather the requirements, what architecture did you choose — front end, database, integrations, user access — and why?
* How big was the development team you managed and what were their roles? How did you run a typical week — planning, task assignment, code review, releases?
* What is your Current CTC per annum?
* What is your Expected CTC per annum?
* What is your Notice Period?

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‑throughput, hyper‑scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‑scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‑shedding, throttling, and rate‑limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‑management plans.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:
  
  
–Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools.
  
  
–Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems.
  
  
–Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met.
  
  
–Design systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer - AI Infrastructure

As a Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the software design and development of major components of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. You should be a curious problem solver, a distributed systems generalist, and a hands-on software developer with exposure to Linux, systems fundamentals, and systems troubleshooting. You should be eager to explore different parts of the stack, understand low-level system behavior, and design and build scalable distributed services. This role resides within the Compute Bare Metal Provisioning team, which owns the critical infrastructure responsible for automating the full server lifecycle—from new platform and shape creation to hardware bring-up, customer-ready instance provisioning, and firmware management. Our services operate at the intersection of bare metal hardware and full-stack orchestration frameworks, bringing together distributed systems development, Linux, and firmware integration. description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The OT Cybersecurity Executive will be responsible for supporting and implementing cybersecurity measures to safeguard the organization's Operational Technology (OT) environments. This includes ensuring the security of industrial control systems (ICS), supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) systems, and other OT assets that manage critical infrastructure. The role will focus on identifying vulnerabilities, responding to incidents, implementing best practices, and ensuring the security of OT systems against evolving cyber threats.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**OT Cybersecurity Executive**
**Operational Technology (OT) Security**
Implement and maintain cybersecurity measures to protect OT systems, including industrial control systems (ICS) and SCADA networks.
  
  
Perform regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing on OT systems to identify security weaknesses and recommend improvements.
  
  
Monitor OT networks and systems for signs of security breaches or anomalies, ensuring timely identification and mitigation of threats.
  
  
Collaborate with OT engineering teams to ensure secure integration of OT systems with IT infrastructure while preserving operational continuity.
  
  
**Incident Response And Management**
Respond to OT cybersecurity incidents, coordinating efforts to mitigate, resolve, and document security breaches or disruptions in OT systems.
  
  
Investigate and perform root-cause analysis for OT-related cybersecurity incidents, ensuring quick recovery and restoration of services.
  
  
Develop and implement incident response protocols specifically tailored to OT environments, including communication plans, reporting mechanisms, and escalation procedures.
  
  
**Collaboration With IT And OT Teams**
Work closely with IT cybersecurity teams to ensure coordination between IT and OT environments and mitigate the risk of cross-domain security breaches.
  
  
Collaborate with OT engineers, operations teams, and vendors to implement security controls that do not interfere with the operation of critical systems.
  
  
Promote awareness of cybersecurity best practices and provide guidance on securing OT systems.
  
  
**Vulnerability Management**
Monitor and assess the security vulnerabilities of OT systems and coordinate patching, remediation, and mitigation efforts in line with operational needs.
  
  
Conduct risk-based prioritization of vulnerabilities within OT systems, considering the potential impact on operational continuity and safety.
  
  
**Security Monitoring And Threat Intelligence**
Continuously monitor OT systems and networks for any unusual activities, security breaches, or threats using appropriate tools and techniques.
  
  
Leverage threat intelligence platforms to stay informed about the latest cyber threats targeting OT environments and recommend proactive defense measures.
  
  
Perform regular updates to OT security monitoring systems and tools to detect emerging threats.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
OT Cybersecurity Manager / Head of Cybersecurity
  
  
IT and Network Operations Teams
  
  
Engineering & Development Teams
  
  
Human Resources (HR)
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
OT equipment and software vendors
  
  
Third-party cybersecurity service providers
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  
  
Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, MBA) in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or a relevant discipline is highly desirable.
  
  
**Certification**
Relevant certifications such Global Industrial Cyber Security Practical experience with securing industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA systems, and other OT assets and with OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., NIST, IEC 62443, NERC CIP).
  
  
Knowledge of OT network protocols and systems, including Modbus, DNP3, OPC, and others commonly used in industrial environments and with security tools and technologies used in OT environments (e.g., intrusion detection systems, firewalls, SIEM).
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
3+ years of overall experience , with at least 1 year focused on OT or industrial control systems security.

title: Kaseya Administrator
description:
**Secure the Technology Behind America's Essential Healthcare Products**

Make your infrastructure expertise essential to healthcare operations. Join Emapta as a
**Kaseya Administrator**
and lead Kaseya VSA X administration, endpoint security, and IT automation for a US pharmaceutical manufacturer. Strengthen system reliability, cybersecurity, and operational continuity while enjoying remote flexibility, international collaboration, professional mentorship, and long-term global career opportunities designed for top 1% talent.

**Job Overview**

* Employment Type: Full-time
* Shift: Night Shift, Weekends Off

**Exciting Perks Await!**

* Competitive package
* Medical life insurance
* Work from home arrangement
* Standard government and Emapta benefits
* Well-equipped, modern, and accessible offices
* Employee engagement initiatives
* Mentorship and exposure to global leaders and teams
* Diverse, inclusive, and supportive culture
* Transparent performance management
* Unlimited upskilling through Emapta Academy courses (Want to know more? Visit:
  **https://emapta.com/training-calendar/**
  )

**The Qualifications We Seek**

Education, Certifications, and Professional Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience and certifications may be considered
* **3 to 5 years of hands-on experience administering Kaseya VSA X in a production environment, including platform configuration and ownership beyond technician-level remote support**
* Current Kaseya VSA X Administrator- or Expert-level certification, or an equivalent certification demonstrating advanced platform administration
* Additional Kaseya product certifications strongly preferred

Kaseya Platform and Ecosystem Expertise

* Expert knowledge of
  **Kaseya VSA X**
  **modules**
  , including endpoint management, automation, monitoring, alerting, scripting, patch management, software deployment, inventory, reporting, policy management, integrations, and security administration
* Hands-on experience with
  **IT Glue**
  and at least one Datto product family
* Experience with additional Kaseya solutions, such as KaseyaOne, BMS/Vorex, Autotask PSA, Datto EDR/AV, Datto Endpoint Backup, Datto BCDR, Datto Networking, Spanning Backup, Unitrends, or RapidFire Tools, preferred
* Experience managing large endpoint populations across multiple sites through standardized policies and staged deployments
* Experience using
  **APIs, webhooks, Power Automate, source control, or reporting tools to improve Kaseya workflows and data visibility**
* Experience
  **integrating Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM)**
  platforms with
  **IT Service Management (ITSM)**
  ,
  **Professional Services Automation (PSA)**
  , documentation, security, backup, identity, and business intelligence systems

Systems Administration, Automation, and Security

* Advanced
  **PowerShell**
  scripting skills, including secure script design, parameterization, return-code handling, logging, testing, deployment, and troubleshooting
* Working knowledge of
  **Windows desktop and server administration**
  , i
  **dentity and access management, networking fundamentals, endpoint security, backup and recovery, and IT service management**
* Experience with
  **Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, Windows Server, Microsoft Intune**
  ,
  **CrowdStrike**
  , vulnerability management platforms, and enterprise email and web security tools
* Knowledge of
  **ITIL practices**
  , formal change control, regulated documentation, validation, audit evidence, and quality system requirements
* Relevant Microsoft, CompTIA, ITIL, PowerShell, cybersecurity, backup, or endpoint management certifications preferred

Professional and Collaboration Skills

* Excellent analytical, documentation, communication, and vendor management skills
* Ability to communicate technical risks and operational outcomes clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Your Daily Tasks**

Kaseya VSA X Platform Ownership

* Manage the daily administration, configuration, performance, security, and lifecycle of Kaseya VSA X
* Administer VSA X modules for agent deployment, endpoint inventory, system monitoring, alert management, remote management, software deployment, patch management, policy management, reporting, dashboards, workflows, integrations, and role-based access
* Design and maintain organizational structures, device groups, tags, policies, scopes, user roles, permissions, service accounts, and administrative access in accordance with least-privilege principles
* Monitor agent health, check-in status, job execution, alert queues, policy compliance, platform capacity, and integration health; investigate and resolve exceptions
* Administer Windows endpoints and servers through VSA X, with support for macOS and Linux environments where applicable
* Maintain secure administrative practices, including multifactor authentication (MFA), separate privileged accounts, auditable changes, credential protection, and documented emergency access procedures

Automation, Scripting, and Process Improvement

* Design, test, document, deploy, and maintain VSA X automations and workflows for recurring operational tasks
* Develop and troubleshoot PowerShell scripts, batch scripts, command-line tools, APIs, webhooks, and other automation components within Kaseya
* Automate software deployment and removal, configuration enforcement, service remediation, vulnerability remediation, local administrator cleanup, health checks, asset data collection, disk space cleanup, agent repair, alert triage, and scheduled maintenance
* Implement automation safeguards, including pilot groups, pre-deployment checks, activity logs, controlled rollouts, failure management, rollback procedures, change records, and post-deployment validation
* Identify repetitive tasks and control gaps, establish performance baselines, implement workflow improvements, and report measurable outcomes, such as time savings, faster remediation, fewer failed jobs, improved compliance, and reduced ticket volume
* Maintain a version-controlled script and automation library with documented purposes, owners, dependencies, parameters, test evidence, approval status, and recovery instructions

Patching, Monitoring, and Endpoint Operations

* Configure and maintain operating system and third-party application patch policies, maintenance windows, approval rules, deployment rings, reboot behavior, exclusions, and exception procedures
* Review patch and configuration compliance, investigate deployment failures, coordinate remediation, and prepare management-ready status reports
* Develop actionable monitoring policies and alert thresholds to reduce unnecessary alerts while maintaining visibility into critical services, security events, backup conditions, and endpoint health
* Coordinate upgrades to agents, platform features, integrations, scripts, policies, and related components through documented tests and change management procedures
* Support incident response and problem management through endpoint telemetry, remote access, audit histories, automation evidence, and corrective actions

Kaseya Ecosystem and Integrations

* Administer and optimize IT Glue, including user and access management, security controls, documentation standards, configurations, flexible assets, relationships, integrations, exports, and documentation quality reviews
* Administer or support relevant Datto solutions, including Datto Endpoint Backup, Datto BCDR, Datto EDR/AV, and Datto Networking, with responsibility for deployment, system monitoring, alert reviews, restore validation, incident response, and reporting
* Configure and maintain integrations between VSA X and Kaseya ecosystem products, including IT Glue, Datto, KaseyaOne, BMS/Vorex, Autotask PSA, and other licensed solutions
* Validate data synchronization, organization and device mapping, alert-to-ticket workflows, remote-control access, password and documentation access, and data integrity across integrated platforms
* Evaluate additional Kaseya modules and capabilities, assess business value and risks, and lead approved implementations

Documentation, Governance, and Collaboration

* Develop and maintain platform architecture documentation, technical standards, standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, support procedures, inventories, change records, upgrade plans, and recovery procedures
* Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, service desk, application, quality, and business teams to translate operational requirements into sustainable Kaseya policies and workflows
* Train IT personnel on platform administration, automation safety, troubleshooting procedures, documentation standards, and effective use of integrated Kaseya products
* Manage vendor escalations, track defects and enhancement requests, and communicate operational risks, project status, and recommendations to IT leadership
* Support software licensing, renewal plans, utilization reviews, and cost optimization across the Kaseya product portfolio

Physical Requirements

* Remain seated for extended periods while performing computer-based tasks
* Use hands and fingers frequently to type and operate standard office equipment
* Stand, walk, bend, and reach occasionally as required

**About the Client**

Our client is
**a leading US pharmaceutical manufacturer, packager, and distributor specializing in over-the-counter medicines and consumer healthcare products.**
Established in 1988, they provide private-label pharmaceutical solutions to major retailers nationwide. Their expertise spans product development, manufacturing, packaging, quality assurance, and distribution, with offerings across pain relief, allergy care, digestive health, and wellness. Through advanced facilities, regulatory compliance, innovative technology, and rigorous quality standards, they deliver safe, affordable, and accessible healthcare products that support healthier communities and improve everyday lives across America.

Join us at Emapta, and let your professional journey flourish in the heart of India's vibrant culture!

Recognized as one of Asia's rising tech and outsourcing destinations, we offer a wealth of opportunities to showcase your talent to the world. At Emapta, we connect you with global clients, giving you international exposure without leaving the comfort of your home country. With
**over 1,200 international clients**
and a decade of proven success, we provide a strong foundation for your career growth. Here, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning are part of everyday life, and work-life balance is more than just a promise-it's a reality.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
As a Senior with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) Cybersecurity Team, you will contribute technically to client engagements and internal initiatives. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen client’s relationships. You will also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements, and report and escalate any engagement related issues to senior team members as appropriate.
  
  
**The opportunity**
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards, and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help senior members with business development activities.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Must have handled a Vulnerability Management process for a large enterprise using any one of the solutions: Qualys / Nexpose / Tenable or similar
* Must have thorough understanding about the Vulnerability Management and Exception & Exemption process on Cloud hosted systems, databases, web services and other widely deployed infrastructure components
* Ability to work both independently as well as lead a team of experienced staff to manage the vulnerability management program.
* Provide technical leadership and advise to team members in order to ensure the effectiveness of the program.
* Provide guidance on risk management principles and practices to junior staff regularly.
* Lead analysis of the current environment to detect critical deficiencies and recommends solutions for improvement
* Review findings from and identify root causes for common issues and provide recommendations for sustainable improvements
* Able to identify and exploit security vulnerabilities in a wide array of systems in a variety of situations
* Research and report on security vulnerabilities and latest advancements in the vulnerability management lifecycle
* Understand EY and its service lines and actively assess what the firm can deliver to serve clients.
* Facilitate discussions / knowledge sharing with key client personnel and contribute to EY’s thought leadership
* Maintain a strong client focus by effectively serving client needs and developing productive working relationships with client personnel. Stay abreast of current business and economic developments and new pronouncements/standards relevant to the client's business.
* Demonstrate industry expertise (deep understanding of the industry, emerging trends, issues/challenges, key players & leading practices)
* Actively contribute to improving operational efficiency through standardization and process automation on client engagements and internal initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Knowledge of Windows, Linux, UNIX, any other major operating systems.
* Deep understanding of TCP/IP network protocols.
* Understanding of network security and popular attacks vectors.
* Familiarized with the latest security vulnerabilities and exploit, understanding of web-based application vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10), cloud security and architecture
* Experience with scripting / programming skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell)
* Hands on operational experience with vulnerability management tools (e.g. Qualys, Nexpose) including the ability to deploy, configure, and run these tools
* Fluency in English, other language skills are considered an asset
* Experience in handling data using Pandas, XML libraries
* Exposure to handling computer networking and operating systems use cases using python.
* Exposure and experience in analytical thinking with tools like power bi, tableu.
* Required knowledge for Python libraries: netaddr, ipaddress, qualysapi, lxml, pandas, numpy

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Graduates / BE / BTech / MSc / MTech / MBA in the fields of Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business or related major with minimum 3 years of work experience especially in penetration testing and vulnerability assessment.
* Any one of the following technical certifications: CEH, Qualys Certified Specialist, CISM
* Knowledge of Windows, Linux, UNIX, any other major operating systems
* Willingness to work in shifts

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills
* Certifications: CEH, Qualys Certified Specialist, CISM

**What We Look For**
Who can perform penetration testing which includes internet, intranet, wireless, web application, social engineering and physical penetration testing and provide analysis for the testing results.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

title: Procurement Officer
description:
Procurement Officer – Construction Industry

**Department:** Procurement / Purchase  
**Experience:** 3–8 Years  
**Industry:** Construction / Real Estate  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Procurement Manager / Purchase Head / Management  
**Job Location:** As per company requirements

1. Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Procurement Officer to manage material purchasing, vendor handling, price negotiations, supplier coordination, and timely delivery of construction materials. The candidate should have a strong understanding of construction materials, market rates, vendor management, and cost control to ensure efficient procurement operations and uninterrupted project execution.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Material Procurement & Purchasing**

* Handle the purchase of construction materials, including cement, steel, sand, aggregates, electrical items, plumbing materials, hardware, and finishing materials.
* Collect material requirements from site engineers and project managers and arrange timely procurement.
* Obtain quotations from multiple vendors and compare prices, quality, specifications, and delivery terms.
* Prepare purchase orders and obtain the necessary approvals before placing orders.
* Ensure materials are procured within approved budgets and delivered according to project schedules.
* Monitor pending purchase requests and prioritise urgent material requirements.

**B. Vendor Handling & Relationship Management**

* Identify, source, evaluate, and onboard reliable vendors, suppliers, and material dealers.
* Develop and maintain a strong network of vendors for different categories of construction materials.
* Handle day-to-day vendor communication regarding quotations, material availability, order confirmation, delivery schedules, and payment terms.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with existing and new vendors.
* Follow up regularly with vendors to ensure timely delivery and resolve supply-related issues.
* Maintain an updated vendor database containing contact details, pricing, negotiated rates, credit periods, and delivery terms.
* Evaluate vendor performance based on pricing, quality, reliability, service, and delivery timelines.
* Develop alternative vendor sources to minimise supply disruptions and dependency on a single supplier.
* Handle vendor complaints, material discrepancies, delayed supplies, and replacement requests.
* Ensure vendors comply with company procurement procedures and agreed commercial terms.

**C. Price Negotiation & Cost Control**

* Negotiate prices, discounts, credit periods, payment terms, transportation charges, and other commercial conditions.
* Conduct market research to understand current material prices and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Prepare comparative statements and submit recommendations for management approval.
* Ensure purchases meet the required quality standards at competitive prices.
* Track procurement costs and maintain records of negotiated rates and cost savings.
* Coordinate with project teams to identify cost-effective alternatives without compromising quality or specifications.

**D. Site & Inventory Coordination**

* Coordinate with site engineers, project managers, storekeepers, and accounts personnel to understand material requirements.
* Review material indents and ensure purchases are aligned with project priorities.
* Check stock availability before placing new orders to avoid unnecessary purchases and excess inventory.
* Coordinate material transportation and delivery to the appropriate project sites.
* Follow up on material receipt and resolve shortages, incorrect supplies, or quality issues.
* Support proper inventory monitoring and minimise material wastage.

**E. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain purchase orders, quotations, comparative statements, vendor records, invoices, and delivery challans.
* Prepare daily or weekly procurement status reports as required by management.
* Track pending purchase orders, delayed deliveries, urgent requirements, and outstanding vendor issues.
* Coordinate with the accounts department regarding vendor invoices, payment follow-ups, and outstanding balances.
* Ensure procurement records are accurate and maintained according to company policies.
* Submit procurement updates and cost-related reports to management whenever required.

3. Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in construction procurement is preferred.

4. Experience & Skills Required

* 3–8 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, or vendor management, preferably in the construction or real estate industry.
* Good knowledge of construction materials, specifications, brands, and market rates.
* Strong vendor-handling, relationship-management, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to compare quotations and evaluate suppliers effectively.
* Good communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and purchase documentation.
* Experience with ERP or procurement software is an advantage.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, urgent requirements, and changing priorities.
* Strong commercial awareness, cost-control skills, and problem-solving ability.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed based on the following parameters:

* Timely procurement and delivery of construction materials.
* Cost savings achieved through price negotiation.
* Vendor reliability and supplier performance.
* Accuracy and timely completion of purchase orders.
* Compliance with approved budgets and procurement procedures.
* Reduction in material shortages and procurement delays.
* Effective vendor handling and resolution of supply-related issues.
* Proper maintenance of procurement documentation.
* Coordination with site teams and timely closure of purchase requests.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

* Engineering degree or above in Electrical & Electronics (EEE), Electronics & Communication (ECE), Biomedical Engineering, Bioelectronics, or equivalent.

**TECHNICAL COMPETENCY: (ESSENTIALS)**

* 4–5 years of professional experience in system testing of embedded products.
* Practical experience in requirement analysis, test-case design, test execution, defect reporting, and test closure.
* Good understanding of product development and structured verification processes.
* Working knowledge of risk-based testing and the ability to translate identified risks and risk controls into suitable verification scenarios.
