title: Lead WLAN Test Engineer
description:
**Lead WLAN Test Engineer**

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India

**Experience:**
8–12 years

**About the Company**

Rohde & Schwarz is a telecommunications company working to ensure a safer and connected world. Its business is organized around Test & Measurement, Aerospace & Defense, and Critical Infrastructure & Networks. Across these divisions, the company develops solutions for industrial, regulatory, and government customers facing technology and connectivity challenges. This work places testing, communications, and dependable technical systems at the center of the company’s business. Rohde & Schwarz states that it stands for independence, stability, and long-term relationships with customers and partners. These commitments reflect an emphasis on sustained customer and partner engagement alongside its work in technology markets. The company’s activities span multiple areas where reliable connectivity and technical performance matter, from measurement and communications to infrastructure and networks. The Bengaluru-based engineering opportunity supports its work in wireless testing and validation within the telecommunications domain, contributing to the development and assessment of WLAN technologies. Rohde & Schwarz operates under its own name and brings together its divisions to address complex connectivity needs across the sectors it serves.

**About the Role**

As a full-time, on-site WLAN Test Engineer in Bengaluru, you will lead wireless test strategy and validation in a telecommunications engineering environment. You will develop test plans, build Python-based automation, and assess Wi-Fi performance and RF behavior against relevant 802.11 standards. The role combines hands-on network and protocol testing with analysis, troubleshooting, and clear documentation of test procedures and findings. You will work with engineering teams to investigate defects and resolve wireless connectivity issues, while mentoring junior test engineers and strengthening test execution. This position suits an experienced engineer with a background in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing who can take ownership of test quality and help deliver reliable wireless systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead WLAN test strategy development and translate product and validation needs into effective test coverage. Align test priorities with engineering objectives and relevant wireless standards.
* Design wireless test plans covering Wi-Fi performance, network behavior, protocols, and RF system validation. Define test scenarios and procedures that support consistent, repeatable execution.
* Build and maintain Python test automation frameworks for WLAN validation. Use automation to improve test execution and support reliable assessment of wireless system behavior.
* Execute Wi-Fi performance, network, protocol, and RF tests against applicable 802.11 standards. Record outcomes and identify defects or unexpected system behavior.
* Analyze test results and defects, troubleshoot wireless connectivity issues, and support engineering teams in investigating root causes. Communicate findings clearly to enable resolution.
* Document test procedures, execution details, and findings to maintain useful validation records. Share relevant results and technical observations with engineering stakeholders.
* Collaborate with engineering teams throughout test planning and execution, and mentor junior test engineers. Support effective knowledge sharing and consistent testing practices.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Strong WLAN and Wi-Fi testing capability, including practical wireless validation experience. Apply relevant 802.11 standards when planning and assessing test coverage.
* Experience with radio frequency testing and RF system behavior. Evaluate wireless performance and interpret results in the context of system validation.
* Python programming skills for building test automation frameworks. Develop automation that supports structured, repeatable WLAN test execution.
* Knowledge of network testing and protocol testing for wireless systems. Design and execute test scenarios that assess connectivity and protocol behavior.
* Test planning and test execution skills, including designing wireless test plans and carrying them through to documented results. Maintain clarity and consistency across validation activities.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills for investigating wireless connectivity issues, reviewing test results, and assessing defects. Explain findings to support engineering resolution.
* Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering. Relevant specialization in WLAN testing, wireless communications, or RF testing.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience across telecommunications, telecom or ISP environments, or computers and electronics manufacturing can provide useful context for wireless product validation.
* Background in mentoring junior test engineers and collaborating with engineering teams can support effective knowledge sharing and coordinated defect investigation.

**What You'll Bring**

* Eight to twelve years of relevant experience in WLAN, wireless communications, or RF testing, with the ability to take ownership of test strategy and validation outcomes.
* A Bachelor of Technology in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical and Electronics Engineering, complemented by relevant wireless or RF specialization.
* Practical strength in Python automation, 802.11 standards, network and protocol testing, test planning, execution, and defect analysis.
* Professional English communication skills, sound documentation habits, and the ability to work on-site in Bengaluru while collaborating with engineering teams and mentoring junior colleagues.

**Why Join Us**

Join Rohde & Schwarz and contribute to work that supports a safer, connected world. The company operates across Test & Measurement, Aerospace & Defense, and Critical Infrastructure & Networks, developing solutions for industrial, regulatory, and government customers with technology and connectivity challenges. In this engineering role, your work will focus on WLAN strategy, Wi-Fi performance testing, RF validation, and Python test automation. You will help turn test requirements into structured plans, investigate connectivity issues, and communicate findings that engineering teams can act on. The opportunity brings together hands-on wireless testing and technical leadership through collaboration and mentorship. Rohde & Schwarz identifies independence, stability, and long-term relationships with customers and partners as company values. You can apply your experience in a telecommunications environment where connectivity and dependable technical systems are central to the work. The position is full-time and on-site in Bengaluru, with scope to contribute directly to wireless validation and improve the quality and consistency of testing practices.

**What We Offer**

* A full-time, on-site engineering opportunity in Bengaluru, focused on WLAN validation, Wi-Fi performance, RF behavior, and test automation.
* Ownership of WLAN test strategy and plans, with practical scope to execute testing, analyze defects, and collaborate with engineering teams.
* The opportunity to contribute to telecommunications work supporting Rohde & Schwarz’s broader focus on connectivity and technology challenges.

title: Lead/Staff AI/ML Validation Engineer
description:
**WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING**
At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.
**Together, we advance your career.**
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**SMTS Software Quality Engineer**
to join the
**HIP Runtime Quality Engineering**
team within the ROCm ecosystem. In this role, you will focus on
**defect triage, root‑cause analysis, and scalable test automation**
for the HIP runtime, ensuring robustness, portability, and performance across AMD and NVIDIA GPU backends.
  
  
The role sits at the intersection of
**runtime systems, GPU APIs, and CI-driven quality assurance**
, working closely with HIP runtime developers, compiler teams, and system software engineers to improve test coverage and accelerate issue resolution across a fast-evolving open‑source stack.
  
  
HIP is a C++ runtime API and kernel language designed for CUDA portability and heterogeneous GPU programming in the ROCm platform.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Defect Triage & Root Cause Analysis
  
  

* Own end-to-end triage of HIP runtime failures observed in CI, nightly, and release testing pipelines.
* Analyze failures across HIP runtime APIs, including memory management, streams, events, kernels, graphs, and device management.
* Perform log analysis, repro reduction, and backtrace debugging across Linux and Windows environments.
* Correlate failures across:

+ ROCr system runtime
+ HIP runtime
+ Driver / firmware interfaces
+ Compiler (hipcc / clang) interactions

* File high‑quality bug reports with clear reproduction steps, root cause hypotheses, and impact assessment.

Test Automation & Framework Development
  
  

* Design, enhance, and maintain automated test frameworks for HIP runtime validation using existing HIP test infrastructure (Catch2-based and custom harnesses).
* Expand functional, negative, stress, and regression coverage for:

+ HIP Runtime APIs
+ Graph APIs
+ Memory copy variants (1D/2D/3D, async/sync)
+ Multi-GPU and peer-to-peer use cases

* Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines with actionable failure reporting.
* Develop Python, C++, and shell-based automation for test execution, result aggregation, and trend analysis.
* Drive test flakiness reduction and improve signal-to-noise ratio in large-scale CI.

Cross-Team Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with HIP runtime developers to:

+ Review test gaps for new features and APIs
+ Validate bug fixes and performance-sensitive code paths

* Collaborate with:

+ Compiler and language runtime teams
+ ROCr system runtime teams
+ Release engineering and CI infrastructure teams

* Contribute test fixes and enhancements upstream in open-source HIP/ROCm repositories.

Quality Metrics & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Define and track quality metrics such as failure escape rate, test coverage, and mean-time-to-resolution (MTTR).
* Identify systemic issues and propose data-driven quality improvements.
* Participate in release readiness assessments for HIP runtime drops.

**Required Qualifications**
Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles.
* Solid proficiency in C++ with debugging experience (gdb/lldb).
* Working knowledge of HIP or CUDA runtime concepts, including kernels, streams, memory models, and device execution.
* Experience with Linux-based development and debugging.
* Familiarity with CI systems (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar).
* Experience writing and maintaining automated tests for low-level systems or runtime libraries.

Debugging & Analysis Skills
  
  

* Ability to reason about runtime abstractions, concurrency, and asynchronous execution.
* Strong skills in failure reproduction, minimization, and log-driven debugging.
* Experience triaging issues across hardware–software boundaries is a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with GPU programming models (HIP, CUDA, OpenCL).
* Familiarity with ROCm stack components (HIP, ROCr, compilers, drivers).
* Experience testing graph APIs, async execution models, or multi-GPU systems.
* Prior contributions to open-source system software or test frameworks.
* Knowledge of Python-based test orchestration and reporting tools.
* Knowledge and application of AI tools in validation and testing.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Faster, higher-quality issue triage with actionable root cause insights.
* Improved automation coverage for HIP runtime APIs and edge cases.
* Reduced CI noise and faster feedback for developers.
* Strong collaboration with runtime and compiler engineers to ship stable, high-quality HIP releases.

We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.*

**General Description Of Role**
About the Role
  
  
As a QA Engineer within the Assessment Solutions business, you will play an important role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of the Aon Assessment Platform — the enterprise solution for accurate and fair workforce assessments at scale, used by millions of participants worldwide.
  
  
You will work closely with developers, product managers, and fellow QA team members to design and execute testing strategies, identify defects early, and contribute to building a platform that delivers a superior experience for candidates and administrators alike. Key Responsibilities
  
  
Test Planning & Design
  
  

* Design, develop, and execute detailed test plans and test cases for web-based applications, ensuring comprehensive coverage of functional and non-functional requirements.
* Identify test scenarios — including edge cases and critical breaking points — that reflect how the platform is actually used, not just the happy path.
* Perform thorough regression testing, system integration testing, and user acceptance testing to validate new features and detect potential breaking points.

Defect Management
  
  

* Identify, document, and track software defects, collaborating closely with developers to drive timely resolution and maintain product quality.
* Write clear, well-structured defect reports with enough detail — reproduction steps, environment, evidence — for engineers to act on without back-and-forth.

Automation & Tooling
  
  

* Contribute to the development and maintenance of test automation scripts within the team's existing frameworks, improving test coverage and execution speed.
* Actively explore and adopt AI-assisted testing tools and techniques as they become available, contributing ideas for how automation and intelligent tooling can improve team efficiency.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Maintain and update QA documentation, including test scenarios, test results, and quality metrics, to support transparency and continual improvement.
* Ensure adherence to QA methodologies, organisational best practices, and industry standards throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Champion quality and accessibility — proactively identifying risks and opportunities to enhance usability, accessibility, and compliance with web standards.

Collaboration
  
  

* Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to prioritise testing activities and deliverables, managing tasks across multiple features and competing deadlines.
* Work closely with developers and Business Analysts to clarify requirements and acceptance criteria before and during test design.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 1+ years of proven work experience in a Quality Assurance role.
* Hands-on experience in web application testing with a solid understanding of critical breaking points and edge cases within complex applications.
* Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes, along with experience documenting test tasks and findings.
* Experience identifying test scenarios and writing thorough, well-structured test cases.
* Familiarity with test automation concepts and scripting experience in at least one framework (e.g., Selenium, Playwright).
* Excellent attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a structured approach to problem-solving.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within a cross-functional team.
* Ability to manage time and tasks effectively, handling multiple workstreams with competing priorities.
* Knowledge of web standards, technologies, and accessibility compliance (e.g., WCAG).
* Solid understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle and Agile delivery practices.
* A positive, curious attitude toward AI adoption — open to exploring AI-powered testing tools, automated defect analysis, and other emerging techniques to work more effectively. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with automated pipeline-based unit testing, including familiarity with CI/CD tools and integration of automated tests into development workflows.
* Exposure to HR technology, talent assessment, or recruitment platform domains.
* Working knowledge of SQL for data validation during testing.

title: Senior QA Engineer - Vehicle Networks and Telematics
description:
**Netradyne**
harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. With growth exceeding 4x year over year, our solution is quickly being recognized as a significant disruptive technology. Our team is growing, and we need forward-thinking, uncompromising, competitive team members to continue to facilitate our growth.
  
  
**Senior QA Engineer - Vehicle Networks and Telematics**
**Role Overview**
As a Senior QA Engineer in the CAN QA team, you will own validation of how our devices read, interpret and report vehicle data, from the CAN bus through the device to the cloud. You will develop test strategies for J1939 and OBD-II integrations, automate protocol and signal-level testing, investigate complex field issues, and provide evidence-based release-readiness recommendations.
  
  
This is a hands-on role for someone equally at home with a CAN trace, a bench power supply and a truck cab, and who can convert requirements, DBCs, logs and field evidence into reliable qualification coverage.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Validation strategy and release qualification for CAN-based vehicle features, new vehicle onboarding and customer configurations.
* Requirement-to-test coverage for vehicle signals, diagnostics, power modes and end-to-end telematics workflows.
* Root-cause investigation of signal mismatches, intermittent CAN failures and vehicle-specific field issues.
* Reusable CAN simulation, trace replay, fault-injection and automated regression capabilities.
* Technical guidance through test-design reviews, automation reviews and structured defect triage.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Vehicle Networks and Diagnostics**

* Validate SAE J1939 PGN/SPN decoding for vehicle speed, odometer, engine hours, fuel, DM1/DM2 faults and other supported signals.
* Validate OBD-II modes, PIDs, DTCs and VIN handling using SAE J1979 and ISO 15765-4.
* Verify scaling, offsets, units, ranges, rollover, timeouts, stale data, source-address handling and not-available values.
* Test J1939 transport protocol (BAM and RTS/CTS), request messages, address claim and bus-off recovery.
* Correlate device-decoded values with trusted CAN tools and OEM or dealer diagnostic systems.

**Power Modes and CAN Wake-up**

* Validate wake-up on CAN traffic and ignition, sleep after bus silence, shutdown and recovery across supported configurations.
* Measure quiescent current and verify that the device causes no unwanted wake-ups, excessive bus traffic or vehicle battery drain.
* Validate ignition (KL15) and battery (KL30) scenarios, brownouts, power interruptions and repeated ignition cycles.

**Bench, HIL and Vehicle Testing**

* Set up and execute bench, HIL and in-vehicle tests using CAN interfaces, programmable power supplies, ignition control and harnesses.
* Simulate ECUs, replay recorded traces, inject protocol and signal faults, and reproduce field scenarios in the lab.
* Validate integrations across commercial and passenger vehicles, makes, models and model years, including in fleet yards and at customer sites.

**End-to-End Feature Validation**

* Validate CAN-derived data from vehicle bus to cloud for fleet features such as fuel consumption, fuel-level trends, idle fuel, refueling and suspected fuel theft.
* Validate CAN-derived inputs supporting ELD/HOS workflows, including engine power state, vehicle motion, distance, engine hours and malfunction scenarios, against product requirements and the FMCSA ELD rule.
* Support validation of EV signals (state of charge, charging state, energy usage) and OTA/firmware regression for vehicle-specific releases.

**Test Design, Automation and Debugging**

* Translate product requirements, protocol specifications, DBC files and field use cases into risk-based, traceable test plans.
* Build maintainable Python, CAPL or equivalent automation for CAN simulation, trace replay, signal verification, negative testing and regression.
* Analyze CAN traces, device and application logs, power measurements and cloud telemetry to isolate failures across the vehicle, harness, firmware, configuration and cloud layers.
* Create clear defect reports with reproducible steps, trace evidence, expected versus actual behavior and impact.
* Work with development teams to close gaps in testability, diagnostics and observability.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in QA or validation of embedded, automotive, telematics or IoT products, with substantial hands-on CAN work and a track record of owning test strategy, traceability and release-readiness decisions.
* Strong CAN 2.0A/B fundamentals, including 11-bit and 29-bit identifiers, arbitration, error handling and bus-off behavior.
* Hands-on expertise in SAE J1939, with working knowledge of OBD-II.
* Experience interpreting DBC files and validating raw frames, decoded signals, scaling, timing and invalid-data behavior.
* Hands-on experience with one or more CAN analysis and simulation platforms, such as Vector CANalyzer/CANoe, Intrepid Vehicle Spy, PEAK PCAN or Kvaser, and scripting in Python, CAPL or an equivalent language.
* Strong embedded-system debugging and root-cause analysis skills across hardware, firmware, network and backend boundaries, with the ability to explain technical risks and evidence clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Understanding of CAN wake-up and sleep behavior, ignition concepts, power-state transitions and sleep-current measurement.
* Comfort working with vehicle harnesses, multimeters, programmable power supplies and bench equipment.
* Working knowledge of UDS (ISO 14229) and ISO-TP, including diagnostic sessions, reading and clearing DTCs, and reading data identifiers.
* Awareness of CAN FD and experience with HIL systems or ECU/network simulation.
* Exposure to J1708/J1587 on older heavy-duty vehicles.
* Python experience with libraries and frameworks such as python-can and pytest, including data-driven and parameterized testing.
* Experience with Linux-based environments, SocketCAN and can-utils (candump, cansend), shell tools, log analysis, Git and code-review workflows.
* Experience in fuel management, ELD/HOS (FMCSA), vehicle diagnostics, EV telemetry or other CAN-based fleet features.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools for test design, log triage or trace analysis.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence and CI-based automated testing for traceability, defect management and qualification reporting.

description:
**Building Management Systems | Product Qualification | UL 864 Readiness**

We are seeking an experienced System Integration HW & SW Test Engineer to qualify Building Management System (BMS) products and solutions, with a particular focus on system-level testing and UL 864 certification readiness.

The role combines hands-on hardware and software testing with the design and development of physical system test environments. The successful candidate will build representative BMS test systems, integrate hardware and software components, develop structured test suites, and execute system-level qualification testing.

A key responsibility will be preparing products and systems for UL 864 certification through comprehensive pre-certification testing, as well as executing applicable self-certification and internal qualification testing.

The engineer will work closely with software development, hardware development, system engineering, product management, and certification specialists to identify issues early and ensure that products meet functional, system, and certification requirements.

The role will initially have a strong focus on establishing the test environment and performing hands-on testing. Over time, the engineer will develop repeatable test suites and identify opportunities for test automation, either implementing automation directly or working together with test automation and software development colleagues.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, configure, and maintain physical system integration test environments for BMS products and solutions.

* Develop and maintain structured system-level test plans, test cases, and reusable test suites.
* Perform pre-certification testing to identify issues before formal UL 864 certification activities.
* Execute applicable self-certification, qualification, and compliance test activities.
* Interpret UL 864 requirements and translate relevant requirements into practical system test scenarios and test cases.
* Reproduce, analyze, document, and communicate defects discovered during system testing.
* Work closely with software and hardware development teams to support root-cause investigation and verification of corrections.
* Maintain test configurations and ensure that test setups are repeatable and representative of intended product configurations.
* Document test results and provide clear evidence of system behavior and compliance.
* Identify opportunities for test automation and develop test cases with automation in mind.
* Automate suitable system tests directly or collaborate with software developers and test automation engineers to implement automated testing.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of system integration, qualification, and certification processes.
* Support formal certification activities by providing tested configurations, test evidence, technical information, and engineering support.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience in system testing, system integration testing, or HW/SW integration testing.
* Strong hands-on experience working with systems containing both hardware and software components.
* Experience designing, setting up, configuring, and troubleshooting physical test systems.
* Strong knowledge and practical experience with UL 864 requirements and testing.
* Ability to translate system and certification requirements into structured and repeatable test cases.
* Experience developing test plans, test cases, test procedures, and test reports.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills across hardware, software, communication, and system boundaries.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex system-level test activities.
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively with hardware engineers, software developers, system engineers, and certification specialists.
* Good English communication skills, both spoken and written, including the ability to clearly document test procedures, results, issues, and technical findings.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Building Management Systems (BMS), Building Automation Systems (BAS), fire systems, smoke-control systems, or related building-control technologies.
* Experience preparing products or systems for third-party certification.
* Experience working directly with certification organizations or certification laboratories.
* Experience with automated system testing and test frameworks.
* Programming or scripting experience, for example Python or similar technologies used for test automation.
* Experience testing communication networks, field buses, controllers, I/O, sensors, actuators, or other connected building-system components.
* Experience with issue-tracking, requirements-management, test-management, and CI/CD tools.
* Experience with Agile software and product-development processes.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A robust and representative physical system test environment is established and maintained.
* HW/SW integration issues are identified early in the product-development lifecycle.
* Product releases are systematically pre-tested against applicable UL 864 requirements before formal certification activities.
* Certification-related test cases are documented, repeatable, and traceable.
* Test suites evolve from individual manual tests into structured and reusable system test suites.
* Suitable tests are progressively automated, reducing repetitive manual testing and improving regression-test coverage.
* Test results and identified issues are clearly documented and effectively communicated to engineering teams.
* Software, hardware, systems, and certification teams have a common understanding of product readiness and remaining technical risks.
* Certification activities become more predictable because issues are discovered during internal qualification rather than during formal certification.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
Job Details
  
  
**Description**
**About Archer**
A new regulatory change lands somewhere in the world every six minutes, and agentic AI is outpacing most teams' ability to govern it. At Archer, we help the enterprises powering the global economy turn that pressure into an advantage.
  
  
Mandates like the EU AI Act and the SEC cybersecurity disclosure rules are driving the most significant GRC buying cycle we have seen in years. That demand is why we are growing this team.
  
  
This is hard work that matters. Our customers span energy, utilities, financial services, pharmaceuticals, and the public institutions communities depend on. People choose Archer because they get to partner with the most trusted brands in the world, on work that protects the customers and communities those brands serve.
  
  
If that sounds like your kind of work, let's chat.
  
  
**The Role**
Quality is not something we inspect at the end of a release; it's something we build into every stage of engineering. As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for elevating product quality through intelligent test strategies, automation, continuous validation, performance engineering, and close partnership with engineering and product teams. You'll help teams identify risks early, find defects quickly, and ensure every release meets high standards for functionality, performance, security, and reliability. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of quality engineering by leveraging modern CI/CD practices, AI-powered engineering tools, and data-driven decision making while collaborating with globally distributed teams
  
  

* Name the team, key stakeholders this person will work with, who they report to and the one or two main areas of ownership.

**What You’ll Do**
**Quality Strategy & Risk-Based Testing**

* Lead quality planning and risk assessment activities across product initiatives and releases.
* Analyze code changes, feature implementations, and architectural impacts to determine optimal test coverage and identify high-risk areas before defects reach customers.
* Drive a shift-left quality culture by partnering with engineering teams to prevent defects early in the software development lifecycle.

**Test Automation Excellence**

* Build and evolve scalable automation frameworks that improve test coverage, execution speed, and maintainability.
* Drive automation across UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing layers.
* Continuously optimize automated validation to reduce manual effort and accelerate release confidence.
* Expert knowledge in Playwright tool

**CI/CD & Continuous Quality Engineering**

* Own quality gates within CI/CD pipelines to provide fast, actionable feedback on every change.
* Partner with engineering and DevOps teams to integrate automated testing, code quality checks, and release validation into deployment workflows.
* Drive improvements that reduce production defects, improve deployment confidence, and shorten feedback cycles.

**Performance Engineering & Reliability**

* Lead performance testing initiatives to validate scalability, reliability, and responsiveness of applications under varying workloads.
* Build performance benchmarks and proactively identify bottlenecks before they impact customers.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve application resilience, capacity planning, and operational readiness.
* Knowledge in performance testing tools such as K6, JMeter or similar platforms.

**Security & Secure Development Reviews**

* Drive quality reviews focused on security, vulnerability prevention, and secure coding practices.
* Partner with development teams to identify potential security gaps through code reviews, automated scanning, and risk assessments.
* Ensure security validation becomes an integral part of the software delivery lifecycle rather than a release-stage activity.

**AI-Driven Quality Innovation**

* Evaluate and adopt AI-powered solutions that improve test creation, defect detection, root cause analysis, and engineering productivity.
* Experiment with emerging AI technologies to modernize quality engineering practices.
* Champion innovative approaches that improve quality outcomes while reducing engineering effort.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution**

* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and global stakeholders to deliver high-quality customer outcomes.
* Drive resolution of complex quality challenges with a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability.
* Influence technical decisions through collaboration, data-driven insights, and a continuous improvement mindset.

**What You Bring**

* Extensive experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or Software Quality Assurance within modern Agile development environments.
* Proven ability to quickly identify product risks, uncover defects, perform root cause analysis, and drive issues to resolution.
* Strong hands-on experience with automation frameworks and programming/scripting languages used for test automation.
* Experience integrating automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze source code changes, pull requests, and feature implementations to determine effective test coverage and risk areas.
* Strong understanding of performance testing concepts and tools used to validate scalability and reliability.
* Experience collaborating effectively with cross-functional and globally distributed teams.
* A proactive, execution-oriented mindset with strong ownership, urgency, and a passion for continuously improving quality

**Even Better If You Have**

* Experience applying AI/GenAI technologies to software testing, quality engineering, or developer productivity.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud-native application architectures.
* Experience with security testing, vulnerability management, and secure software development practices.
* Experience leading quality transformation initiatives, mentoring engineers, or driving enterprise-scale quality programs.
* Experience with modern observability, monitoring, and reliability engineering platforms such as Coralogix, Grafana, Datadog or similar tools

With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.
  
  
**About The Role**
Are you passionate about software quality, security, and being a member of a high-impact team? Join Black Duck, a leader in application security, where we deliver intelligent, context-aware risk management solutions. We seek a
**Software Engineer - SDET 3**
to contribute into the QA Automation strategy, mentor engineers, suggest and implement improvements to our overall QA process, and safeguard code quality for the Continuous Dynamic product line.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with the QA Automation Engineering team & Lead to define testing strategies and ensure code quality for the Continuous Dynamic product line through comprehensive manual, automated, and exploratory testing of web applications.
* Provide mentorship to other junior QA Engineers while coordinating and assigning work for the Automation team.
* Responsibilities include creating and refining automated tests, validating product quality in pre‑prod and production, and managing our growing portfolio of automation workflows.
* Understand and leverage container technologies such as Kubernetes and Docker, in a continuous integration lifecycle.
* Partner cross‑functionally to perform acceptance, regression, usability, and exploratory testing to ensure product quality and enhance the user experience.

**Mandatory Skills And Experience**

* 8+ years’ experience in a technical, hands-on QA role, focusing on web applications, in an Agile/Scrum setting.

**Demonstrate Expertise In The Following Areas**

* Programming/coding concepts, advanced Linux command line scripting, and at least one scripting language (Python).
* Automated and manual testing of web applications.
* Troubleshooting/working with containerized services (Kubernetes, Docker).
* At least one of the Web automation frameworks (preferably Selenium Webdriver and Robot Framework).
* Exhibit advanced expertise in acceptance, regression, exploratory, and usability testing, providing strategic guidance on test approaches and driving quality across complex product areas.
* Leverage deep knowledge of defect‑tracking systems such as JIRA, Bugzilla, or equivalent platforms to lead efficient triage processes, optimize workflows, and ensure high‑quality issue management across teams.
* Excellent troubleshooting, defect reporting, planning, and communication skills are required.
* Strong experience in API testing and automation using Postman.
* Experience with version control software (preferably GIT).
* Must be a team player and possess a desire for building consensus.
* BA/BS Degree in an Engineering, or related field; or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Kubernetes and Docker.
* Experience creating test cases based on design documentation (knowledge of TestLink is a plus).
* Experience with continuous integration.
* Exposure to security testing or application security tools is a plus.

title: QA & Testing Associate Analyst - Cigna Healthcare
description:
QA Testing Associate Analyst – [Accessibility Testing]
  
Band 2
  
  
**About Cigna:**  
Cigna exists to improve lives. With 74,000 employees worldwide supporting Cigna, Express Scripts, and affiliate customers, we aim to make health services more affordable and accessible to millions.
  
As part of our international growth strategy, we are driving a multi-year effort to deliver a consistent digital strategy for international markets.
  
  
**The Position:**  
We are looking for a QA Testing Associate Analyst to support accessibility testing for digital applications by validating user journeys, identifying accessibility barriers, and collaborating with Product, Design, Development, and Quality Engineering teams to improve inclusive user experiences.
  
  
**Main Duties / Responsibilities:**  

* Support accessibility test planning, scenario preparation, execution, evidence capture, status reporting, and closure activities.
* Validate key web and mobile user journeys using keyboard navigation, screen readers, zoom, colour contrast checks, and other relevant assistive-technology methods.
* Identify accessibility barriers related to focus order, labels, headings, reading order, forms, errors, buttons, links, navigation, content visibility, and screen-reader interaction.
* Use accessibility tools where applicable, review findings, and perform basic manual validation with guidance when needed.
* Log clear defects with steps, evidence, actual and expected results, assistive-technology context, and user impact.
* Participate in defect triage, retesting, regression testing, Agile ceremonies, and release-readiness discussions.
* Maintain test cases, checklists, trackers, evidence, risks, blockers, and learning documentation as required.

**Required Skills and Experience:**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education, certification, training, or practical exposure in IT, Software Testing, Digital Accessibility, Assistive Technology, or a related area.
* Training or hands-on exposure in accessibility testing, software QA, assistive technologies, or inclusive digital usage.
* Foundational understanding of accessibility concepts, WCAG/POUR principles, and common digital barriers experienced by users with disabilities.
* Basic familiarity with screen readers or assistive technologies such as NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack, magnification, voice access, or keyboard-only navigation.
* Ability to observe, document, and communicate accessibility findings clearly with steps, evidence, expected behaviour, and user impact.
* Basic knowledge of STLC, defect lifecycle, test execution, retesting, regression testing, and Agile ways of working.
* Good observation, communication, collaboration, and learning mindset, with openness to follow defined processes, ask for clarification, and apply feedback.

**Desirable Skills and Experience:**  

* Exposure to accessibility tools such as Evinced, BrowserStack, axe, Accessibility Insights, Lighthouse, WAVE, or equivalent tools.
* Awareness of HTML, ARIA, mobile accessibility, accessible documents, or automation-assisted accessibility checks.
* Healthcare, insurance, finance, claims, member, provider, or servicing-domain awareness.
* IAAP, ISTQB, or equivalent accessibility/testing certification or learning progress is desirable.

Equal Employment Opportunity
  
Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, colour, age, disability, sex, childbirth (including pregnancy) or related medical conditions including but not limited to lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital or familial status, genetic information, status with regard to public assistance, citizenship status or any other characteristic protected by applicable equal employment opportunity laws.

Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. **ABOUT REVANTAGE**

Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.

With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.

In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.

**India**

With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.

Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly **Build What Matters.**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Tester for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.

The QA Tester is responsible for the design, execution and documentation of testing across ACC’s Oracle Fusion Cloud environment and the integrations, interfaces, reports and business processes that surround it. The role supports both the in-flight Oracle implementation – including system integration testing, user acceptance testing support, data conversion validation and cutover readiness – and the ongoing steady-state testing that follows go-live, including enhancement testing, defect regression and validation of Oracle’s quarterly release updates. The QA Tester partners closely with US-based IT leadership, functional and technical analysts, system integration partners and business process owners to ensure that changes to the Oracle ecosystem are delivered accurately, are thoroughly documented and do not disrupt downstream finance and operations processes.

**Primary Role – Quality Assurance Testing: Oracle Fusion and Integrated Systems**

  

* Own the overall test strategy, test plans and testing approach for the Oracle Fusion Cloud program, covering Financials modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement
* Develop, maintain and execute test cases, test scripts and test scenarios for Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management and Procurement, based on functional design documents, configuration workbooks and business requirements.
* Execute system integration testing, regression testing and end-to-end process testing across Oracle and the surrounding application landscape, validating that business processes function correctly from source system, through Oracle, and out to downstream consumers.
* Test inbound and outbound integrations between Oracle Fusion and property management, banking, treasury, payroll, procurement and reporting systems, including file-based interfaces, APIs and Oracle Integration Cloud flows; validate payload accuracy, error handling, reprocessing and exception reporting.
* Validate data conversion and migration activities, including reconciliation of converted balances, master data and historical transactions between legacy systems and Oracle.
* Test reports, dashboards and analytics developed in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio and Fusion Data Intelligence, reconciling output to source data and confirming correct parameters, security and formatting.
* Support user acceptance testing, including preparation of business-facing test scripts, coordination of tester schedules, hands-on support to business users during execution, and tracking of UAT results through to closure.
* Plan and execute regression testing for Oracle’s quarterly release updates, assessing the impact of new features and patches on existing configurations, integrations, reports and extensions.
* Log, triage, document and track defects through resolution in the program’s defect management tool, including clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence and appropriate severity and priority classification, and partner with functional and technical teams on root cause analysis and retest.
* Maintain the test case repository, requirements traceability matrices and test evidence to ensure complete coverage of requirements and to satisfy internal control, audit and SOX documentation standards.
* Build and maintain automated test scripts and regression suites where automation adds value, and maintain those assets as configurations and business processes change.
* Prepare and maintain test data sets across development, test and staging environments, coordinating environment readiness and refreshes with the technical team.
* Produce clear and timely test status reporting, including execution progress, pass and fail rates, open defects by severity, and risks to the delivery schedule, for project leadership and stakeholders.
* Participate in requirements and design reviews to identify testability gaps, ambiguous requirements and delivery risks early in the lifecycle
* Lead, mentor and coordinate a team of QA engineers, including work allocation, estimation, daily prioritization and review of test cases, scripts and evidence for quality and completeness.
* Validate security roles, user provisioning and segregation of duties configurations as part of testing cycles.
* Support cutover and post-go-live validation activities, including production smoke testing, hypercare defect triage and verification of fixes in the production environment.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA standards, templates, testing methodology and automation coverage across the Oracle program.
* Must be able to work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with a shift aligned to US Central Time and available until 11:00 AM CT Flexibility is expected during testing cycles, cutover events, quarterly update windows and other peak periods.daily.Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, engineering, accounting or a related field is required.

  

* undefined
* Minimum of eight years of software quality assurance and testing experience, including at least four years testing enterprise ERP applications and at least two years leading a QA team, is required.
* undefinedLead and manage a small to mid-sized QA team (2–5 engineers), including task allocation, daily progress tracking, deliverable reviews, mentoring and onboarding of new team members.Must have hands-on testing experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP is required; coverage across General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management or Procurement is preferred. Experience supporting at least one full-lifecycle ERP implementation, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing and cutover, is strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience testing system integrations and interfaces, including file-based feeds, web services and APIs, and middleware such as Oracle Integration Cloud, is required. Experience validating reports and data in OTBI, BI Publisher, Financial Reporting Studio or Fusion Data Intelligence is preferred. Working knowledge of SQL sufficient to independently query and reconcile data between source systems and Oracle is preferred. Experience with test automation tools and frameworks, such as Oracle Test Automation, Tricentis Tosca, Selenium or similar, is preferred; a willingness to develop and expand automation capability is required.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, qTest or similar is required.

  

* Familiarity with Oracle’s quarterly update cycle and the associated regression testing approach is preferred.

  

* Working understanding of core finance and accounting processes, including record to report, procure to pay and order to cash, sufficient to test business scenarios meaningfully; real estate, property management or student housing experience is an advantage.

  

* Familiarity with SOX and IT general control requirements as they relate to testing documentation and evidence retention is preferred.

  

* ISTQB certification or an equivalent quality assurance credential would be a plus .

  

* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, with emphasis on Excel.

  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail and the discipline to document findings clearly and completely.

  

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain defects, test results and risks clearly to onshore technical and business stakeholders.

  

* Ability to manage multiple concurrent testing priorities against fixed delivery deadlines and to work independently with limited onshore supervision.

Wind River helps customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries solve complex technology challenges on their journey toward the new intelligent machine economy. Examples include playing a key role in NASA space missions such as Artemis I, the James Webb Space Telescope, and multiple Mars rovers. We’ve achieved recent 5G milestones including the world’s first successful 5G data session with Verizon and building one of the largest Open RAN networks in the world with Vodafone.
  
  
The company has received industry recognition for its technology innovation and leadership, and for its workplace culture, including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten consecutive years. If you want to be part of a unique culture where the lived experience is based on our cultural attributes of growth mindset, customer-focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging, come join us and help advance the future software defined world.
  
  
**YOUR ROLE**
We are seeking a skilled Validation and Testing Developer to join our team in developing the next generation Real-Time Operating System (RTOS).
  
  
As a Member of Technical Staff for verification and validation testing, you will contribute to researching, evaluating, and selecting validation tooling, as well as designing and implementing the test framework used for both certified and non-certified software components. You will also be contributing to designing and implementing system testing and V&V test development.
  
  
In your daily job you will:
  
  

* Work with technical leads to evaluate next-generation validation and verification tools and recommend tools best suited for certification objectives (all Design Assurance Levels) for DO-178C and other standards
* Assess tool qualification requirements per Software Tool Qualification Considerations
* Participate in architecting and developing a scalable, maintainable test framework for the RTOS to support both certified (DO-178C) and non-certified testing workflows, such as requirements-based testing, structural coverage analysis, and traceability
* Implement automation capabilities for continuous integration and regression testing
* Develop system-level tests to validate RTOS functionality, performance, and timing behavior
* Create and execute verification and validation (V&V) test cases traceable to system and software requirements
* Collaborate with systems and software engineers to ensure complete requirements coverage
* Take initiative to improve the RTOS product and processes
* Collaborate and engage effectively with global software engineering teams.
* Work in an Agile Scrum Teams and follow Agile processes

**How You Will Contribute**
Key skills and competencies for succeeding in this role are:
  
  

* BTech / MTech degree (Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or equivalent technical degree).
* 8+ years of experience in software testing, verification, or validation
* Strong understanding of RTOS concepts (scheduling, concurrency, determinism, resource management)
* Experience with DO-178C (or DO-178B) software lifecycle and verification objectives is a plus
* Familiarity with DO-330 tool qualification processes is a plus
* Proficiency in test automation and framework development (e.g., Python, C, C++)
* Experience with requirements-based testing and traceability
* Experience with static analysis, model-based testing, or formal methods
* Knowledge of structural coverage tools and techniques (MC/DC, branch, statement)
* Experience with commercial or open-source RTOS platforms (e.g., VxWorks, RTEMS, Zephyr, FreeRTOS) is a plus
* Familiarity with verification tools such as VectorCAST, LDRA, Parasoft, Rapita, or equivalent is a plus
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with firmware bringup and boot up is a plus

In a world increasingly driven by software innovation, Wind River is pioneering the technologies that accelerate the digital transformation of our customers with a new generation of mission‑critical AI systems—built for an AI‑first world with the most exacting safety, security, performance, and reliability standards. Our success depends on our ability to innovate with velocity and deliver solutions that help customers solve their toughest challenges.
  
  
Wind River is a global leader in mission‑critical intelligent systems. For more than four decades, we have been an innovator and pioneer, powering billions of systems that demand the highest levels of security, safety, and reliability. We support customers across automotive, aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, and telecommunications industries as they build the next generation of intelligent machines.
  
  
Wind River’s technology has supported historic achievements—from NASA’s Artemis I and the James Webb Space Telescope to multiple Mars rovers, as well as the world’s first successful 5G data session with Verizon and one of the largest Open RAN networks with Vodafone.
  
  
With industry recognition for innovation, leadership, and workplace excellence—including global Great Place to Work certification and being named a “Top Workplace” for ten straight years—Wind River offers a culture built on growth mindset, customer focus, and diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging.

title: Software Quality Engineer
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.
  
  
****What You'll Do****
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Software Quality Engineer**
**Responsibilities:**
The selected Software QA Engineer will join a world-class software team to architect, implement, and scale test automation solutions that drive quality across KLA products. They will be a technically strong individual contributor and leader, responsible for building AI-augmented automation frameworks that ensure the reliability of all released products. They will champion modern testing practices with a sharp focus on automation coverage, infrastructure excellence, and continuous improvement of the qualification process. They must be able to partner with cross-functional teams globally to resolve quality issues quickly.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include:**

* Identify, evaluate, and implement test automation frameworks and tools that deliver measurable value across the qualification lifecycle — including functional, regression, performance, and reliability testing.
* Own and drive automated test coverage for both UI and API layers across KLA products, designing robust test suites and publishing results, recommendations, and best known methods.
* Integrate AI capabilities into the test automation framework — including self-healing locators, intelligent test generation, and autonomous test execution — to improve test resilience and reduce maintenance overhead.
* Leverage deep knowledge of software systems and application architecture to design scalable infrastructure solutions that empower the test automation team.
* Assess automation feasibility of test cases and script them for automatic execution across new and existing product features.
* Technically interact with Algorithms, System Engineering, Application Engineering, Marketing and Manufacturing, and Customer Support teams across global locations for various requirements.
* Participate in all stages of software development including deployment and troubleshooting at customer sites. Represent the SQE team in product lifecycle and key program meetings.
* Travel to customer fabrication facilities to understand customer use cases, deploy software, and troubleshoot.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Must have Master's Level Degree in CS or related fields
* Must have excellent communication, analytical and interpersonal skill. Must also be self-driven, yet a strong team player
* Background in IC processing/Semiconductor equipment is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with automation tools is a plus
* Must be desiring to travel and enjoy working in other cultures.

****Minimum Qualifications****
Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
  
  
****About KLA****
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Senior Engineer I - QA
description:
**What is Contentstack?**
Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.
  
  
While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.
  
  
Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.
  
  
Learn more at www.contentstack.com.
  
  
**Who Are We?**
At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let's go!

* Own the test strategy for Platform (Web and API): decide what runs on every PR, nightly and at release
* Perform frontend and backend testing (Platform - Web, REST APIs, analytics and data pipelines)
* Perform regression and sanity testing across environments and cloud regions (AWS, GCP, Azure) and give a clear go/no-go for releases
* Design, build and maintain the UI and API automation frameworks (Playwright/Selenium), including shared page objects, fixtures, test data and stable selectors
* Add automated quality gates to CI/CD pipelines, and track and fix flaky tests
* Plan and run performance and load tests for APIs and data pipelines
* Validate data correctness for analytics and metering pipelines (completeness, duplicates, reconciliation)
* Build internal scripts and tools to automate QA processes and test data creation Generate testing reports, status reports and QA metrics (pass rate, defect escape rate) Create and maintain the test case repository
* Provide feedback to the developers, review test code and pull requests
* Mentor junior QA engineers and help developers write better tests
* Complete tasks in a timely manner
* Update internal product documentation

* 3 to 5 years of QA experience, with at least 2 years in test automation
* Strong experience with JavaScript/TypeScript based E2E frameworks like Playwright or Cypress.io Experience designing an automation framework from scratch (page objects, fixtures, reporting)
* Strong knowledge of JSON and REST, and API test automation (Postman/Newman, REST Assured, Playwright API or similar)
* Experience in Load Testing with tools like JMeter, k6 or Locust
* Knowledge of Continuous Integration and hands-on experience with Jenkins, GoCD or GitHub Actions
* Experience in using Github and Git, including code reviews
* Experience in any bug reporting and test management tool such as JIRA
* Strong knowledge of the system development life cycle and the testing life cycle
* Experience in Agile/Scrum
* Good SQL and data validation skills; experience testing data or analytics pipelines is preferred
* Experience with logs and monitoring tools (Observe, Datadog or similar) for root cause analysis is preferred
* Basic knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure) is preferred Self-Directed - Ability to detect and solve problems

**What Do We Offer?**
**Interesting Work |**
We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the "challenge yourself" role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you're doing it.

This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

2 or 3 full days per week on-site in the office, with remaining days worked remotely in accordance with enterprise hybrid work policies.

Configure, test, and maintain multi-way matching rules, tolerance checks, and automated exception routing on enterprise reconciliation platforms (e.g., TLM SmartStream, Duco, Gresham, or internal reconciliation engines).
  
  
**Break Analysis & Triage:**
Investigate reconciliation breaks and discrepancies, identify root causes in data transformations, and apply rule adjustments or fixes.

Write and optimize Python scripts and SQL queries to extract, transform, and load transactional and ledger data into reconciliation engines.
  
  
**Requirements Implementation:**
Review Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and technical specifications to implement mapping rules, data schemas, and validation checks.

: Monitor daily reconciliation runs, batch feeds, and automated jobs, ensuring successful data ingestion from upstream systems.
  
  
**Assisting Backlog Remediation:**
Actively deliver user stories and tasks to address the operational backlog of scheduled and ad-hoc reconciliation requests.

Learn and apply emerging tools and automation techniques, including data processing utilities (e.g., PySpark, Airflow) and automated anomaly detection workflows.

* 4-8 years of hands-on software development, data manipulation, or reconciliation configuration experience in Financial Services or IT.
* Solid foundation as a technical individual contributor executing assigned tasks with quality.

Full-time

Chennai, India

Kaleris is a private equity-backed software company focused on supply chain optimization. We are hiring Technical Product Support Engineers to join our Global Customer Support team supporting Terminal Operating System products including N4, Master Terminal and Octopi.

Role Purpose

The Technical Product Support Engineer serves as a product expert for Kaleris/Navis solutions and works directly with customers to diagnose product-related issues, answer functional and technical questions, and ensure successful use of the software. This role bridges customers, Product Management, Engineering, and Services teams through technical analysis and customer advocacy without performing software development or production operations activities.

Responsibilities

* Gain expertise in product functionalities, configurations, and workflows across multiple modules through structured product training, internal documentation, knowledge bases, and hands-on learning.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve customer-reported issues related to product functionality, root-cause-analysis, workflows, configurations, business use cases and customer-facing technical support.
* Own customer support cases from initial triage through resolution, ensuring timely communication, documentation, and follow-up.
* Reproduce customer-reported issues in test environments, isolate root causes, and determine whether issues are related to product defects, configuration, integrations, or customer processes.
* Analyze application logs, system artifacts, product behavior, and configuration data to identify probable causes and recommended actions.
* Answer customer questions using product documentation, case history, knowledge bases, release notes, and internal resources.
* Act as the voice of the customer by communicating product feedback, enhancement requests, and recurring issues to internal teams.
* Participate in a global support escalation rotation for critical business-impacting product issues, focusing on investigation and resolution management rather than infrastructure operations.
* Engage with designated customer accounts through support reviews, issue discussions, project go-live support, and service meetings.
* Apply strong analytical thinking and technical troubleshooting skills across multiple technologies and product areas.
* Learn and support new products, technologies, and service offerings.
* Work in shifts and collaborate with global teams as required.
* Travel occasionally and work extended hours when business needs require.

What This Role Is Not

* Not a software development role or responsible for modifying product source code.
* Not a production or infrastructure operations support role.
* Not responsible for application deployments, release management, server administration, monitoring, or database administration.

Requirements

Education

Engineering Degree (B.E/B.Tech ) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related disciplines (or) BCA and MCA full time, with CGPA 7.5 or higher.

Experience

* 2-4 years of experience in Technical Product Support (Level 2 or 3), Enterprise Software Support, Customer Support Engineering, or similar customer-facing technical support roles supporting commercial software products.
* Knowledge of Navis SPARCS, Navis N4/XPS or experience in container terminal operations is an advantage.
* Experience primarily focused on production operations or infrastructure support is not aligned with this role.

Technical Skills

* Strong analytical and technical troubleshooting skills across enterprise applications and technologies.
* Ability to learn complex software functionality and independently support customers across a broad range of features and use cases.
* Ability to read and interpret application logs, stack traces, XML configurations, and client-server application behavior.
* Experience working with Java-based enterprise applications, XML, Apache technologies, and client-server architectures is preferred.
* Understanding of relational databases and web-based enterprise solutions.
* Familiarity with Core Java or Groovy for troubleshooting and understanding application behavior is advantageous but not required. The role does not involve software development responsibilities.

Soft Skills

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong customer-service orientation.
* Detail-oriented, self-motivated, and assertive communicator.
* Strong learning agility, leadership potential, time management, and organizational skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively in global and virtual teams.

* Design and execute test cases for data integration, functional testing, regression testing, and end-to-end validation.
* Use Python/PySpark to automate data validation and reconciliation wherever required.

* Maintain test scripts, reconciliation reports, test evidence, and data quality documentation.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, subqueries, and data comparison.
* Experience in ETL testing, data warehouse testing, data validation, and reconciliation.
* Practical experience with Databricks and Delta Lake.
* Understanding of data pipelines, data transformations, and source-to-target mapping.
* Experience in test case design, defect tracking, and regression testing.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Python and PySpark for test automation and data validation.
* Experience with AWS data services and cloud-based data platforms.
* Familiarity with data warehouse concepts, data modelling, and incremental data processing.

* Experience working in Agile teams using tools such as Jira or similar test management platforms.
