title: Senior Digital Health Technologies Specialist
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Digital Health Technologies Specialist to join our team in a Hyderabad On-site capacity. As a Senior Digital Health Technologies Specialist, you will support clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in digital tool implementation, study execution, regulatory compliance, and ensuring seamless integration of digital health technologies across clinical trials. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams including Clinical Trial Management, Procurement, Legal, and Finance, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to study operations from planning through closeout.
  
  
Responsibilities include managing digital health technology implementations, overseeing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities, ensuring licensing compliance, and supporting vendor relationships. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Digital Health Technologies Specialist can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research operations and digital innovation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day digital tool and technology support, collaborating with vendors and internal cross-functional teams to ensure smooth study operations and timely resolution of technical issues
* Monitor compliance for assigned digital health technology studies and escalate compliance issues to the Digital Health Technologies Manager, contributing to compliance action plan development and implementation
* Drive User Acceptance Testing (UAT) strategy, planning, execution, and oversight by reviewing test plans, drafting UAT documentation, and directly participating in sponsor-level testing activities when applicable
* Research and determine appropriate copyright holders for clinical outcome assessment (COA) instruments and establish licensing requirements in collaboration with internal stakeholders
* Secure necessary digital tool and technology permissions and license agreements, reviewing terms and conditions to ensure alignment with study requirements and regulatory standards
* Track and communicate licensing and contract agreement status, serving as the central point of contact for internal and external stakeholders regarding licensing matters in clinical trials
* Review and coordinate payment of licensing invoices with internal finance functions to ensure timely and accurate processing
* Support end-to-end translation processes for digital tools and technologies, ensuring accurate and compliant localization for international studies
* Maintain and update database of license holders and digital tool agreements, ensuring ongoing compliance with contract terms and conditions
* Escalate operational risks and project challenges to the Digital Health Technologies Manager with proactive recommendations and action plans
* Participate in Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) revisions and departmental initiatives to drive continuous process improvement and operational excellence

**Candidate Profile**
**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple digital health technology projects simultaneously
* Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and with external vendors
* A patient-focused mindset and commitment to ensuring digital health technologies enhance clinical trial quality and patient safety
* Proactive problem-solving abilities with the capacity to recognize project challenges, implement action plans, and escalate risks in a timely manner
* Self-discipline and strong time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines and prioritize competing demands

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant industry experience
* Minimum of 4+ years of relevant industry experience in clinical research, study operations, or digital health technology support
* General knowledge and awareness of systems development processes and digital tool implementation
* Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes
* Ability to acquire working knowledge of copyright law and licensing/permission requirements for digital tools and technologies
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), electronic Trial Master Files (eTMF), or Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems
* Familiarity with digital health technologies, wearables, or mobile health applications in clinical trials
* Basic familiarity with clinical drug development processes and study phases
* Experience managing vendor relationships and contract negotiations
* Experience with User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning and execution

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Associate IS Engineer
description:
**About Amgen**
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today.
  
  
**Role Description**
We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions.
  
  
This is a blended application engineering role combining IT application support, application lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, integration support, and software development. The successful candidate will work across both run/support activities and change/development initiatives, helping ensure applications remain reliable, secure, compliant, and fit for business needs.
  
  
Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams.
  
  
The role will also contribute to full-stack development and application enhancements, including front-end development, API integration, back-end development, testing, and deployment where required.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day technical and operational support for enterprise applications and associated integrations which could be either of these SaaS, COTS and Custom-built application
* Monitor application health, availability, interfaces, scheduled jobs, and other operational components, and proactively identify potential issues.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents, defects, integration failures, data issues, and performance problems.
* Perform technical root-cause analysis and support implementation of corrective and preventive measures for recurring problems.
* Support incident, problem, request, and change-management processes in accordance with established IT service-management practices.
* Work with business users, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, integration teams, and external vendors to resolve technical issues.
* Support application configuration, upgrades, patches, releases, environment changes, and production deployments.
* Support application integrations with enterprise platforms, databases, APIs, identity and access-management solutions, and cloud services.
* Maintain application documentation including architecture and interface details, configuration information, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and support knowledge articles.
* Contribute to application lifecycle activities including technical assessments, upgrades, modernization, remediation, and application retirement where applicable.
* Participate in periodic operational, security, compliance, and application health activities as required.

**Software Development & Enhancement**

* Contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of application enhancements and software solutions.
* Manage the application SDLC and supporting ITIL Lifecyle completely
* Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable and user-friendly application functionality.
* Develop or enhance front-end applications using technologies such as React, Vite, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Build reusable, responsive, accessible user-interface components following enterprise design standards.
* Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, enterprise services, databases, and third-party platforms.
* Contribute to back-end development using Python and FastAPI, or comparable technologies, under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Participate in technical design discussions, peer code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and technical walkthroughs.
* Follow coding standards, secure-development practices, reusable software-design patterns, and established engineering practices.
* Develop and maintain appropriate unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated tests.
* Support CI/CD processes for automated builds, testing, security scanning, and deployment.
* Analyse and remediate application vulnerabilities, software dependency issues, and technical debt in collaboration with senior engineers.

**Testing, Release & Operational Readiness**

* Create and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end tests for application changes and releases.
* Support user acceptance testing and resolution of defects identified during testing.
* Validate APIs and system integrations using tools such as Postman or equivalent.
* Support release planning, deployment validation, and post-production verification.
* Ensure appropriate technical and support documentation is available before solutions transition into production.
* Work with support teams to ensure operational readiness for new applications, enhancements, integrations, and releases.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, application owners, developers, QA professionals, DevOps teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve application reliability, automate repetitive operational activities, and reduce recurring support issues.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and practices across application development, cloud, DevOps, API integration, observability, cybersecurity, automation, and AI.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience**

* Master's / Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience may include a combination of application development, application engineering, production/application support, system integration, testing, or IT operations.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Good understanding of information systems, application architecture, software-development lifecycle, and application-support lifecycle.
* Experience supporting business or enterprise applications in development, test, and/or production environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate application incidents, software defects, integration failures, and data-related issues.
* Understanding of incident, problem, change, and release-management processes.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs and application integrations.
* Understanding of relational databases, SQL, and basic data-access concepts.
* Hands-on experience with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
* Familiarity with React and Vite, Angular, Vue.js, or another modern front-end framework.
* Basic knowledge of Python and FastAPI, or a comparable back-end technology.
* Experience developing, testing, debugging, supporting, and deploying software applications.
* Understanding of software-testing methodologies including functional, integration, regression, smoke, end-to-end, and user acceptance testing.
* Experience creating and executing test cases and documenting test results.
* Familiarity with unit and UI testing frameworks such as Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with API testing using Postman or equivalent tools.
* Familiarity with defect and work-management platforms such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with Git-based version control, branching, pull requests, and code reviews.
* Understanding of Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies.
* Basic understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment.
* Understanding of secure coding principles, OWASP guidance, authentication, authorization, dependency management, and application security.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with business users, technical teams, and external vendors.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Exposure to GxP or regulated systems and associated validation/compliance activities.
* Experience supporting enterprise applications in a production environment.
* Familiarity with IT service-management processes and tools such as ServiceNow.
* Experience working with SaaS and/or vendor-managed enterprise applications.
* Understanding of cloud platforms and cloud-hosted application architectures.
* Exposure to monitoring, logging, alerting, or application observability tools.
* Experience supporting API-based or middleware-based system integrations.
* Exposure to application lifecycle management, vulnerability remediation, upgrades, patching, and technical-debt remediation.
* Experience working in cross-functional teams involving business stakeholders, vendors, infrastructure, security, and application-development teams.

title: Quality Audit  Lead -  Analyst
description:
Quality Audit Lead - Finance Controls & Process Analyst
  
  
Responsible for independently conducting quality audits and controls reviews across Order to Cash (OTC) sub-processes, applying risk-based sampling and RCA/CAPA discipline to strengthen process accuracy, internal controls, and audit governance.
  
  
**Essential Duties**

* Independently plan and execute transaction-level audits across Billing, Cash Application, Collections, and Dispute Resolution using approved scorecards and quality dimensions.
* Apply and refine risk-based sampling methodologies by process/subprocess, adjusting sample rates for repeat defects, declining quality trends, or elevated risk.
* Drive root cause analysis (RCA) for identified defects and own corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans through containment, validation, and closure.
* Apply standardized critical/non-critical error definitions consistently; participate actively in calibration sessions and help resolve scoring disputes.
* Maintain and strengthen control documentation, audit workpapers, and evidence in line with SOX/statutory and internal audit-readiness requirements.
* Develop and maintain quality scorecards and dashboards, providing visibility into audit pass rates, defect trends, critical error rates, and CAPA closure.
* Partner with process owners and cross-functional stakeholders to socialize audit findings and drive resolution of recurring issues.
* Support quality oversight during transitions, migrations, or process changes by validating readiness and reviewing documentation.
* Identify and recommend SOP updates, job aids, control redesign, and automation opportunities to improve audit efficiency and traceability.
* Contribute to daily quality huddles, weekly calibration sessions, and monthly quality/operations reviews.

Performs other duties as assigned.
  
  
**Minimum Education**
Bachelor's degree/equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Commerce, Management Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Minimum Experience**
Two (2) to five (5) years of progressive experience in Order to Cash, Accounts Receivable, Finance Shared Services, Quality Audit, Controls, or Operational Excellence roles.
  
  
**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Demonstrated experience across OTC sub-processes, including AR reporting and reconciliations.
* Working knowledge of audit frameworks, scorecards, sampling plans, defect management, and RCA/CAPA processes.
* Solid understanding of internal controls, SOX or compliance requirements, and process documentation standards.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating across cross-functional and vendor teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and quality/analytics reporting tools; exposure to workflow automation tools is a plus.

**📋 Core Qualifications**
Qualification Area Requirement Details
  
  
Education Bachelor's degree/equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Commerce, Management Information Systems, or a related discipline.
  
  
Experience Two (2) to five (5) years of progressive experience in Order to Cash, Accounts Receivable, Finance Shared Services, Quality Audit, Controls, or Operational Excellence roles.
  
  
Certifications (Preferred) Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent quality/audit certification preferred. CPA, CA, or progress toward a relevant finance/controls certification is a plus. Exposure to internal controls or compliance training (e.g., SOX awareness) is a plus QDM Expert certification preferred If no certification is currently held, pursuit of a relevant certification is encouraged within 12 months of accepting the position.
  
  
Analytical Skills;Numerical Skills;Presentation Skills;Interpersonal Skills;Judgement & Decision Making Skills

title: Copy of Lead, QA
description:
Ayr designs and manufactures critical power grid equipment including power transformers, distribution transformers, special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear. They serve markets such as renewables, data centers, utilities, oil & gas, and industrial sectors. They position themselves as partners in power projects, offering lifecycle support and working to deliver faster than average industry timelines.
  
  
Website: https://ayr.energy
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Own in-process quality for medium and power transformers (33–400 kV), ensuring products meet applicable standards, customer specifications, and Ayr Energy's Quality Management System (QMS). Lead stage-wise quality controls across core, coil, tanking, assembly, oil processing, and final tests to achieve first-time-right builds, reduce rework, and elevate
  
  
customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Quality System & Documentation
* Create and maintain Control Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), stage checklists, work instructions, and traveler/route cards; enforce hold/witness points.
* Own NCR/CAPA—facilitate structured root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone), implement fixes, and verify effectiveness; drive defect prevention.
* Maintain device history records, test certificates, as-built dossiers, and customer documentation packs for shipment and FAT.
* Supplier & Customer Interface
* Qualify and develop suppliers for critical items (CRGO, copper, bushings, OLTC, radiators, tanks); conduct audits and PPAP/FAI where applicable.
* Lead customer stage and final inspections (FAT), coordinate third-party inspections/test labs, and close observations promptly.
* Data, Metrics & Continuous Improvement
* Track FPY, rework/repair hours, supplier PPM, test bay failures, and COPQ; publish weekly/monthly dashboards.
* Apply 7 QC tools, MSA (GR&R), process capability (Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk), and SPC to stabilize and improve processes.
* Run kaizens to reduce defects (e.g., oil leaks, winding shorts, paint defects) and cycle time at critical stages.

Compliance & Standards
  
  

* ISO 9001:2015 QMS; ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 (EHS) – adhere to procedures and participate in audits.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: BE/B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering (Electrical preferred).
* Experience: 8–15 years in transformer manufacturing quality; at least 5 years hands-on in-process/stage inspection and test bay exposure for 66 kV+ class.
* Certifications (preferred): Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, ASQ CQA/CQE, NDT Level II (VT/PT), Lead Auditor (ISO 9001).

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of transformer construction, drawings (GA, core/coil, schematic), tolerances, and insulation systems.
* Proficiency with electrical tests (TTR, WR, IR/PI, tan δ/PF, SFRA, AC withstand) and interpretation of results.
* Hands-on with metrology and torque tools; ability to set up gauges/fixtures and verify special processes.
* QMS documentation, RCA/CAPA, statistical analysis (MSA, Cp/Cpk), and SPC; working knowledge of ERP/MES and Minitab/Excel.
* Clear written/verbal communication; ability to coach operators, manage audits, and interface with customers and TPI bodies.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* First-pass yield at critical stages and final test
* Supplier PPM and on-time NCR closure
* Defect/rework reduction (%), COPQ trend
* Calibration compliance and audit scores
* On-time documentation pack readiness and shipment clearance

**Why Join Ayr Energy**
Be part of a fast-growing grid hardware company building mission-critical products. You will shape world-class manufacturing systems, work with global suppliers and utilities, and grow into leadership roles with clear impact on reliability and safety of power networks.
  
  
**Work Conditions**

* Primarily shop-floor based role with regular presence in test bay and oil processing areas.
* Shift and weekend support during critical builds or customer inspections as needed.
* Travel up to 60% for supplier audits, customer FATs, or type test witnessing.

title: Sr. BA II
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Job Description**
Invesco understands data and the products created from data are the lifeblood of our business. Data-first functions work together seamlessly to enable Invesco to achieve the true value of data and data products. Invesco leverages data as a strategic asset by making quality, trusted data and content available to the right people, at the right time, in the right format, in the most efficient way possible to enable both large transformations and day-to-day operations.
  
  
This Senior Business Analyst role sits within the Product Engagement part of our Digital, Distribution and Enterprise Engineering (D2E2) organization. They maintain good relationships with internal partners and collaborate with their peers across the Distribution business domain. They develop a strong understanding of the investments and distribution data and business processes, including both how it is produced and consumed across all Distribution channels and how to apply Invesco’s Data strategy and practices to drive Distribution’s data capabilities forward.
  
  
The focus of this position is to work closely with the business units to gain in-depth understanding of customer's business strategy, processes, services, roadmap and the context in which the business operates. This role will be key to understanding and documenting capabilities needed to address business challenges. Under the general supervision, gather business and data requirements, convert the business and data requirements into technical requirements for solution development. The senior business analyst supports the product owner(s) in managing the scope of the assigned project(s), resolves any impediments from requirements perspective for development team, supports the system testing and user acceptance testing. The business analyst also performs validation of deliverables against requirements ensuring that solution is meeting the objectives.
  
  
You will be responsible for:
  

* The Senior Business Analyst is responsible for reviewing assigned business processes from end-to-end to identify and address operational, financial and technological risks.
* Analyzing and understanding the end-to-end Distribution processes and the data associated with multiple business processes having cross domain.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
* Responsibilities will include a full range of activities from leading small to mid-size projects to assisting product owners on larger more complex projects.
* Under the guidance of the product owners, the senior business analyst should be able to work with business stakeholders to document the functional and non-functional requirements.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is understandable to developers/project team.
* Demonstrate strong Problem-solving skills.
* Attending regular team and other required meetings daily/weekly.
* Ensuring clear and accurate communication and responding to data, business, and technology partners and peers in a timely manner.
* Provides updates to senior management, project stakeholders on the progress of the project and or assigned tasks.
* Reports weekly status to senior management and project team as applicable
* Conduct UAT testing when rolling out new regulatory filings or added data sources
* Identify, research, document and / or remediate exceptions
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.

This individual:
  

* Must be comfortable working in a scaled agile development environment
* Have an ability to handle multiple requests from varied stakeholders, in a way that maintains clear priority, and ability to adjust when needed
* Be an effective “translator” of business needs into technical requirements
* Demonstrate an ability to build relationships, collaborate, and influence internal and external teams
* Be able to work under guidance of senior team member, take initiative, and get projects completed with great attention to detail and on time.

The experience you bring:
  

* A bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, Information Technology.
* Minimum 5-6 years of business and data analysis experience
* Minimum 4-7 year of experience in the Investment Management industry/Asset Management/Financial Services industry.
* Strong scripting skills in programming languages like SQL and Python, as you will be responsible for writing queries and other data transformation scripts.
* Solid knowledge of Data Life cycle, data governance, data risk, Master data management concepts, data modeling, Business intelligence and analytics concepts.
* Ability to work in a team/group setting.
* Ability to interpret complex or vague instructions and successfully produce results.
* Proactively identifies, analyzes, and resolves procedural fail points.
* Demonstrates superior judgement, reasoning, and follow-up skills.
* Demonstrates a high level of initiative, assertiveness, and self-confidence.
* Proactively identifies and analyzes procedural improvements. Initiate projects/workflow that would enhance the department's functions.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office products
* Shares information efficiently between team members.
* Promotes Teamwork.
* Effectively manages multiple responsibilities and meets deadlines.
* An understanding of the concepts related to data modelling, coding and process flow design
* Excellent analytical, mathematical, and creative problem-solving skills
* Excellent listening, interpersonal, written and oral communication skills
* Logical and efficient, with attention to detail

**Full Time / Part Time**
Full time
  
  
**Worker Type**
Employee
  
  
**Job Exempt (Yes / No)**
No
  
  
**Workplace Model**
At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office.
  
  
**Why Invesco**
In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each other’s identities, lives, health, and well-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by building on different voices and perspectives. We nurture and encourage each other to ensure our meaningful growth, both personally and professionally.
  
  
We believe in diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone feels equally valued, and this starts at the top with our senior leaders having diversity and inclusion goals. Our global focus on diversity and inclusion has grown exponentially and we encourage connection and community through our many employee-led Business Resource Groups (BRGs).
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**
As an organization we support personal needs, diverse backgrounds and provide internal networks, as well as opportunities to get involved in the community and in the world.
  
  
Our benefit policy includes but not limited to:

title: Staff Manager – Bluetooth Testing and Automation
description:
**Company**
Qualcomm India Private Limited
  
  
**Job Area**
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Systems Test Engineering
  
  
**General Summary**
We are seeking a Technical Manager to lead Bluetooth validation and test automation for Qualcomm connectivity solutions. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with team leadership and ownership of test strategy, execution, and release quality across Bluetooth Classic (BR/EDR), Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), and HDT.
  
  
You will work closely with development and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality Bluetooth features for handsets, wearables, industrial IoT, and voice and music products. You will guide engineers, drive complex issue resolution, and strengthen automation and quality processes across the validation lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end Bluetooth validation, including test planning, functional and protocol testing, regression execution, and release-readiness assessment.
* Translate product and feature requirements into test strategies, coverage plans, priorities, and execution milestones.
* Manage validation priorities, resource allocation, and dependencies; communicate progress, quality risks, and mitigation plans to stakeholders.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership in debugging Bluetooth issues using protocol traces, network analyzers, and system logs; collaborate with development teams on root-cause analysis and resolution.
* Drive test automation and framework enhancements to improve coverage, repeatability, and execution efficiency.
* Lead validation of throughput, CPU utilization, battery-current consumption, and Bluetooth certification requirements.
* Mentor engineers, review test plans and technical findings, and build team capability in Bluetooth protocols, debugging, and automation.
* Maintain disciplined QA processes, clear documentation, and effective cross-functional communication to support customer deliverables.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in Bluetooth testing and validation, with experience leading technical execution and guiding engineers.
* Strong knowledge of Bluetooth BR/EDR, BLE, and HDT, including protocol and feature testing, system-level debugging, and optimization.
* Hands-on experience with Bluetooth protocol analyzers such as Frontline and Ellisys, supported by strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Knowledge of Bluetooth profiles including AVRCP, PBAP, A2DP, HFP, OPP, PAN, and A2DP Sink.
* Familiarity with Bluetooth 5.0 features and Bluetooth certification testing.
* Experience evaluating Bluetooth throughput, CPU utilization, and battery-current consumption.
* Strong test automation and framework-development experience using one or more of Python, C++, Perl, Tcl, or shell scripting.
* Good understanding of networking concepts and TCP/IP protocols.
* Ability to own project requirements independently, prioritize competing needs, and coordinate delivery across teams.
* Strong communication, documentation, organizational, and mentoring skills.

**Preferred Experience**
Hands-on BT testing experience.
  
  

* Experience supporting Bluetooth validation for handsets, wearables, industrial IoT, or voice and music products.
* Experience improving validation processes and scaling automation across features or product programs.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

OR
  
  
Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.
  
  
OR
  
  
PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Systems Test Engineering or related work experience.

title: Teamcenter Design Analyst
description:
The Solution Design Analyst translates business and S/4 HANA data requirements into detailed PLM–ERP integration designs. Working under the PLM/ERP Lead Architect, the analyst documents the Teamcenter-to-S/4 HANA integration for Part, BOM, BOP, and Change, specifies Teamcenter enhancements, and drives sign-off of system requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Align PLM and target-state ERP processes and update process maps to the BPMN 2.0 format.

Revisit and reconcile PLM Key Design Decisions (KDDs) that are not aligned with program policy.

Author functional and technical design specifications for the Teamcenter–S/4 HANA integration of Part, Item Master, BOM, BOP, and Change objects.

Define data mapping, transformation rules, and field-level integration requirements between Teamcenter and S/4 HANA.

Specify Teamcenter enhancements required for the PLM-ERP integration and capture acceptance criteria.

Prepare and facilitate design reviews and drive customer sign-off of system requirements.

Support build and unit-test teams by clarifying design intent and resolving design questions.

Maintain traceability between requirements, design, and test cases within the PMO governance framework.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.

3+ years of experience in PLM solution design or PLM/ERP integration projects.

Working knowledge of Siemens Teamcenter data model (Items, BOM, BOP, Change Management).

Familiarity with SAP S/4 HANA master data (Material/Item Master, BOM, Routing).

Experience authoring functional/technical design documents and requirements traceability.

Strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder-facing communication skills.

Preferred / Additional Skills

Exposure to T4ST / Teamcenter-for-SAP or similar PLM-ERP integration middleware.

Manufacturing / discrete or medical-device industry domain knowledge.

title: Software Development Engineer III - Gainsight
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
The Software Development Engineer (SDE) serves as a primary contact for any questions related to how IT systems work from both a business and technical perspective in Gainsight & Salesforce. The SDE will support business operations by resolving production issues and completing work requests in a scrum environment. The SDE partners with business liaisons/PO/PM to help translate software requirements into technical specifications and partners with Business Systems Analysts and QA analysts to develop logical technical processes. The SDE also performs basic cost-benefit calculations, interdependency analysis, and prioritization exercises related to systems changes.
  
  
The SDE has extensive experience in the analysis of complex business problems, determining appropriate systems solutions within Gainsight and other platform integrations. Provides project management of different groups to achieve results. Provides experienced technical expertise in identifying, evaluating and developing systems and procedures that are cost effective and improve work efficiency.
  
  
This position provides production support for Services Applications. In this position, you will work with cross functional IT and business teams to troubleshoot problems, propose solutions, and apply fixes to quickly resolve issues or restore service. Additionally, this role will look for opportunities to improve operational efficiency, or improve customer experience. This position also partners with IT delivery teams to create or enhance Gainsight solutions on the Gainsight NXT platform and transition capabilities to IT Operations.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
Release / Project Support (40% of time)
  
  

* Analyzing, designing solutions, developing an approach, driving the development of the solution with the developer and managing/maintaining solutions built on the Gainsight and Salesforce.com platform (Should be willing to do hands-on development if need be).
* Perform testing on Salesforce platform applications.
* Drive Development, test, manage the implementation of features and maintain application software working with established processes.
* Communicate effectively with developers, business, and QA teams.
* Identify opportunities to fine-tune and optimize applications of developed projects and processes.
* Provide technical support and consultation for application and infrastructure questions.
* Ensure that the work delivered by the team is of high quality by performing testing/validation and owning the functional area assigned.
* Work with business users to prioritize production issues for resolution

Application Expertise (30% of time)

* Troubleshoot technical issues related to Gainsight and Salesforce Administration.
* Engage business and extract details that may be unclear as issues are described.
* Engage the appropriate IT teams and third-party vendors during service interruption issues to ensure quick resolution.
* Lead critical incident troubleshooting efforts of cross functional teams and third-party vendors to drive resolution of service interruption.
* Responsibility, at a high level, includes application availability, reliability, and stability on a 7 x 24 x 365 basis.
* Ensure timely resolution of all production issues meeting or exceeding SLAs.

* More than three (3) year Gainsight platform knowledge and experience.
* Ability to explore new features in Gainsight platform, thus applying them to resolve and improve the productivity of current CSMs way of working.

* Practical experience developing AI-powered agents or automation solutions integrated into business processes.

* Self-motivated and discipline to meet deadlines with speed, accuracy and professional attitude.

* More than three (3) year Gainsight platform knowledge and experience. Gainsight NXT knowledge and experience preferred.
* Gainsight NXT Administrator Certified, a plus.

title: Associate Software Quality & Test Analyst
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an Associate Software Quality and Test Analyst (Software Quality Analyst, Test Analyst, Computer System Validation Analyst) to join our life sciences and clinical research team. As an Associate Software Quality and Test Analyst, you will support software quality, system validation, testing, and compliance activities for regulated business applications. This position plays a key role in validation deliverables, change requests, test case creation and execution, and quality documentation, helping ensure that systems remain compliant and audit ready.
  
  
You'll collaborate with business, IT, Quality, and vendor teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to system enhancements and projects. Responsibilities include system validation support, test execution, quality documentation, change request support, and traceability, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence system quality and compliance outcomes.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through validation, testing, and quality activities that keep systems compliant, traceable, and inspection ready. Your work helps protect data integrity and the reliability of the systems that support the delivery of new therapies to patients. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Associate Software Quality and Test Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support system validation and qualification activities for software applications
* Develop and execute test cases, test scripts, and user acceptance testing (UAT) scenarios
* Create, review, and maintain validation and quality documentation.
* Support change request assessment, testing, and implementation activities
* Document test results, defects, and testing evidence
* Ensure traceability between requirements, testing, and validation deliverables
* Assist with audit readiness by maintaining accurate and inspection-ready records
* Collaborate with business, IT, Quality, and vendor teams on system enhancements and projects

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strengths in software testing and UAT, system validation, and quality documentation
* An understanding of regulated environments and the documentation and compliance standards they require
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly
* A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail
* Comfort working with change management and defect tracking processes

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field
* 1-3 years of experience in software testing, validation, quality assurance, or related roles
* Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), software testing methodologies, and user acceptance testing (UAT) processes
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Computer System Validation (CSV)
* Knowledge of Good Practice (GxP), Good Automated Manufacturing Practice (GAMP 5), and FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures) requirements
* Experience with change control and quality management processes
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, HP ALM, and similar tools

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Sr. BA II
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Job Description**
Invesco understands data and the products created from data are the lifeblood of our business. Data-first functions work together seamlessly to enable Invesco to achieve the true value of data and data products. Invesco leverages data as a strategic asset by making quality, trusted data and content available to the right people, at the right time, in the right format, in the most efficient way possible to enable both large transformations and day-to-day operations.
  
  
This Senior Business Analyst role sits within the Product Engagement part of our Digital, Distribution and Enterprise Engineering (D2E2) organization. They maintain good relationships with internal partners and collaborate with their peers across the Distribution business domain. They develop a strong understanding of the investments and distribution data and business processes, including both how it is produced and consumed across all Distribution channels and how to apply Invesco’s Data strategy and practices to drive Distribution’s data capabilities forward.
  
  
The focus of this position is to work closely with the business units to gain in-depth understanding of customer's business strategy, processes, services, roadmap and the context in which the business operates. This role will be key to understanding and documenting capabilities needed to address business challenges. Under the general supervision, gather business and data requirements, convert the business and data requirements into technical requirements for solution development. The senior business analyst supports the product owner(s) in managing the scope of the assigned project(s), resolves any impediments from requirements perspective for development team, supports the system testing and user acceptance testing. The business analyst also performs validation of deliverables against requirements ensuring that solution is meeting the objectives.
  
  
You will be responsible for:
  

* The Senior Business Analyst is responsible for reviewing assigned business processes from end-to-end to identify and address operational, financial and technological risks.
* Analyzing and understanding the end-to-end Distribution processes and the data associated with multiple business processes having cross domain.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
* Responsibilities will include a full range of activities from leading small to mid-size projects to assisting product owners on larger more complex projects.
* Under the guidance of the product owners, the senior business analyst should be able to work with business stakeholders to document the functional and non-functional requirements.

* Conduct UAT testing when rolling out new regulatory filings or added data sources
* Identify, research, document and / or remediate exceptions
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.

This individual:
  

* Must be comfortable working in a scaled agile development environment
* Have an ability to handle multiple requests from varied stakeholders, in a way that maintains clear priority, and ability to adjust when needed
* Be an effective “translator” of business needs into technical requirements
* Demonstrate an ability to build relationships, collaborate, and influence internal and external teams
* Be able to work under guidance of senior team member, take initiative, and get projects completed with great attention to detail and on time.

The experience you bring:
  

* A bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, Information Technology.
* Minimum 5-6 years of business and data analysis experience
* Minimum 4-7 year of experience in the Investment Management industry/Asset Management/Financial Services industry.
* Strong scripting skills in programming languages like SQL and Python, as you will be responsible for writing queries and other data transformation scripts.
* Solid knowledge of Data Life cycle, data governance, data risk, Master data management concepts, data modeling, Business intelligence and analytics concepts.
* Ability to work in a team/group setting.
* Ability to interpret complex or vague instructions and successfully produce results.
* Proactively identifies, analyzes, and resolves procedural fail points.
* Demonstrates superior judgement, reasoning, and follow-up skills.
* Demonstrates a high level of initiative, assertiveness, and self-confidence.
* Proactively identifies and analyzes procedural improvements. Initiate projects/workflow that would enhance the department's functions.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office products
* Shares information efficiently between team members.
* Promotes Teamwork.
* Effectively manages multiple responsibilities and meets deadlines.
* An understanding of the concepts related to data modelling, coding and process flow design
* Excellent analytical, mathematical, and creative problem-solving skills
* Excellent listening, interpersonal, written and oral communication skills

**Full Time / Part Time**
Full time

Employee

As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office.

* Contribute to process improvement and environment reliability initiatives.
* Maintain structured documentation including environment diagrams, runbooks, and change impact assessments.
* Ensure high standards of quality, operational consistency, and repeatability across supported environments.

Experience and Skills
  
  

* Mid-level system administration experience across Windows Server and Linux.
* CI/CD experience including Jenkins and automated deployment processes.
* Experience with Workflow and the Chorus application
* Scripting proficiency in Bash, PowerShell, or Python.
* Programming/database competency: C#, Python, MS SQL, Oracle SQL.

* Strong understanding of:

+ Operating systems internals
+ Logs and service management
+ Scheduled tasks/cron
+ Permissions and access models

Personal attributes
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to isolate and diagnose complex environment issues.

Required Skills & Experience

* Hands-on exposure to functional testing, integration testing, test-case preparation, defect tracking, and UAT.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Apps and Power Automate; exposure to Power BI or Copilot Studio is an advantage.
* Life Sciences or pharmaceutical domain experience, preferably involving regulated business processes.
* Ability to evaluate AI outputs against defined business requirements and expected results.
* Strong analytical, documentation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments is preferred.

Key Competencies

Business Analysis | AI Use Case Development | Microsoft Power Platform | Life Sciences | QA & Functional Testing | AI Response Validation | Requirements Management | User Stories & Acceptance Criteria | UAT | Test Documentation | Stakeholder Management

We are seeking an experienced Quality Engineer to own product quality across our orthopedic surgical instrument manufacturing business. In this role, you will drive first-pass yield up and customer rejects down. You will lead root cause investigations, close the gap between our inspection results and our customers' incoming inspection, and work closely with our manufacturing partners to raise the quality of the parts we receive from them.

Please find more information about the company here: https://ccplengg.com/

·      Partner process control: Get control plans, PFMEA, in-process checks and SPC in place at partner sites for critical features, so defects are caught at the source.

·      Reduce rejects and improve yield: Track first-pass yield, scrap, rework and customer rejects by part and supplier; lead projects that measurably bring them down.

·      Root cause and CAPA: Lead structured investigations (8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa) into nonconformances and customer complaints; own corrective actions through to verified effectiveness.

·      Drawing and GD&T review: Review customer drawings per ASME Y14.5 before production; flag unspecified dimensions, ambiguous datums and malformed callouts with the customer up front.

·      Quality system: Keep our processes and records aligned with ISO 13485 and FDA QMSR (21 CFR 820) expectations as a registered contract manufacturer — NCR/MRB, device history records, document control and audit readiness.

·      Customer communication: Act as the technical quality contact for international customers — investigation reports, SCAR responses and clear written updates.

**Required Qualifications:**

·      B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial or Metallurgical Engineering, or a related field.

·      At least 5 years of hands-on quality engineering experience in medical device, pharmaceutical equipment or aerospace manufacturing.

·      Strong command of GD&T (ASME Y14.5) and reading complex engineering drawings.

·      Proven record of quality projects that increased throughput or reduced rejects, with numbers to show for it.

·      Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

·      Ability to work on multiple projects across different industries.

**Preferred Skills:**

·      Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt, or a Lean manufacturing certification.

·      Experience working within a customer's quality system as a supplier or contract manufacturer.

·      Experience with orthopedic instruments or implants, and stainless steel (420, 17-4 PH, 465) or titanium parts.

·      Supplier quality engineering experience, driving improvement at external manufacturers.

**Perks & Benefits:**

·      A high-impact role with direct ownership of quality outcomes for Global medical device customers.

·      The chance to shape CCPL's supplier quality program and how we work with our manufacturing partners.

·      Work in a collaborative, close-knit team with direct access to leadership.

·      Competitive compensation aligned with industry benchmarks, with strong potential for career and salary growth.

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.

**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.

title: Data Coordinator (contract)
description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
  
  
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To coordinate and drive the governance of commercial data quality across SAPAC — ensuring the accuracy, integrity and reliability of key commercial data and analytics — with ownership of the data remaining with the region's markets and functions.
  
  
The Data Coordinator leads the regional data governance function: monitoring data quality, facilitating improvement, coordinating audits, controls, standards, reporting and market execution, making issues transparent and escalating where necessary, while serving as SAPAC's representative in Getinge's global data governance network. Alongside the Data Steward, the role runs the region's verification and audit cadence and supports designated markets directly; as Lead, it additionally owns the Steering Committee reporting pack and carries named accountability for the regional baseline and governance plan.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**
**Establish the capability (first 90 days)**

* Be formally registered as SAPAC Data Coordinator with Global Master Data Management; join the global Data Coordinator network and cadence; receive the relevant global data quality reporting, including the installed base quality report
* Adopt the global governance principles, definitions and available standards as the starting point for all regional work; identify where global standards apply before any regional standard is considered
* Establish the regional data governance scorecard and baseline each market against it, presenting it as the Steering Committee's standing Data Health Dashboard (named accountability)
* Stand up the Steering Committee reporting pack and a monthly service-findings call with the SAPAC Service Director
* Agree with the Steering Committee which markets are designated for direct execution, and establish the review-and-approval workflow with each market's Finance Director or nominated data owner
* With the Data Steward, agree the allocation of markets and recurring tasks between the two roles for committee approval

**Lead accountabilities (ongoing)**

* Prepare the Steering Committee pack each cycle: scorecard movement, audit findings, execution volumes, governance/execution time split, escalations
* Represent SAPAC in the global Data Coordinator network: bring regional issues, gaps and requirements into the global governance process
* Escalate systemic issues that cannot be resolved regionally through the global process rather than creating local workarounds
* Facilitate business-owned regional standards (see below) and monitor their adoption by market
* Apply the agreed prioritisation rule between committee meetings; escalate unresolved conflicts to the chair

**Run the regional governance cadence**

* Quarterly audit of annual price-increase application by market — timeliness of list and contract price application, with revenue impact of any delay (distinct from the per-load accuracy verification run by the Data Steward)
* Quarterly credit-note root-cause analysis and trending by market and category — asking why each pattern occurs and which process or ownership issue sits behind it
* Quarterly reporting of service-contract renewal timing against the regional standard
* Half-yearly field-safety traceability tests: verify that sampled equipment can be located to a functional location and customer within target time
* Coordinate the installed base accuracy programme: the global IB report relationship, the country accuracy score, and escalations — data ownership stays with the market and service organisation; corrections are executed by the Data Steward
* Interpret cost-to-price reconciliation results in the quarterly report (reconciliations are run by the Data Steward)
* Share recurring verification and reporting across markets with the Data Steward under the agreed allocation

**Execution for designated markets**

* Review price files prepared by the Data Steward before load, and coordinate the Finance Director sign-off workflow for each designated market
* Ensure every executed change carries a documented market approval so ownership and audit trail stay with the market
* Execute directly under the agreed market allocation where capacity requires

**Facilitate regional standards**

* Controlled price-override standard, and a lightweight pricing-discrepancy case log with root-cause categories distinguishing data error, process error and customer-side causes (Regional Finance)
* Two-person validation standard for pricing and master data changes (Regional Finance)
* Service-contract renewal-timing standard — renewal gaps and backdating (SAPAC Service Director)
* Service-contract structure that makes preventive-maintenance parts inclusion visible in the system (SAPAC Service Director)
* Regional renewal-approval standard — documented multi-level sign-off, drawing on existing good practice in the region (SAPAC Service Director with SSU leadership)
* Distributor installed-base collection standard, building on existing good practice in the region (SAPAC Service Director with market leadership)
* Consistent service-hours definitions — billable / non-billable / non-productive (SAPAC Service Director)
* Structured escalation of issues outside the region's control to global process owners, with documented business impact (Global MDM / global process owners)

**Phase 2 (from month 6, gated on Phase 1 results)**

* Validate the data feeding the global contract profitability reports and supplement with regional analysis, with Finance as business partner
* Like-for-like benchmarking of pricing and service KPIs across markets once definitions are standardised
* Scope further analytics with the Steering Committee

**Requirements**
**Must have**

* 4–8 years in data governance, master data management, finance operations or commercial operations, with experience facilitating standards or controls and getting them adopted across teams
* Working knowledge of SAP master data: customer master, material master, pricing conditions, equipment and installed base, service contracts
* Strong analytical skills in Excel and Power BI; comfortable profiling data, building reconciliations and presenting exceptions to senior stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to influence without formal authority — across markets, functions and cultures, with people who do not report to you
* The ability to distinguish a data-quality symptom from the underlying process or ownership issue, and to drive prevention of recurrence rather than repeated correction
* Fluent written and spoken English; clear, concise written reporting
* Resilience and persistence — establishing a new regional capability is a marathon rather than a project

**Good to have**

* An analytics background or a clear ambition to grow into analytics — the role has a defined Phase 2 pathway into regional analytics and benchmarking
* Experience in a regulated medical-technology or life-sciences environment (ISO 13485 awareness, field safety corrective action traceability)
* Familiarity with CPQ, Salesforce or service-management systems
* Experience working with distributor channel data

**About Us**
With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Production And Quality Manager
description:
**Primary purpose of the role**

The
**Quality Control Manager**
plays a pivotal role in ensuring that both internal processes and external suppliers consistently meet the company’s quality standards and regulatory requirements. This role involves managing
**in-process and final inspections**
for the full range of
**Optical Emission Spectroscopy (OES)**
and
**Rotating Disc Electrode (RDE)**

**supplier quality engineering**
initiatives

: This KRA focuses on the overall quality of the products, ensuring that the defect rates are minimized, and that all quality protocols during the final inspection stage are adhered to before shipment.

•
**Process Control and Monitoring**
: This involves monitoring the manufacturing processes to detect and correct defects at early stages and maintaining process capability at an acceptable level to ensure product consistency.

•
**Testing and Validation**
: Ensuring raw materials and components are tested according to established protocols, as well as keeping all testing and calibration equipment within compliance.

•
**Continuous Improvement Initiatives**
: The QC Manager is responsible for driving continuous improvement initiatives like Kaizen and Six Sigma, aimed at reducing waste, rework, and improving overall product quality.

**Key Responsibility Areas**

1. Control the In-process and Final Inspection for entire range of OES & RDE with documentation & records of in-process and Final inspection., ensuring optimum utilization of resources with quality output. Escalate to the HOD if abnormality cannot be recovered.

2.Monitor and maintain Inward, In process and ICT failure rejection data.

3.Analysis of in process and ICT failure & coordinate with concern dept. (Service, Production & R&D) for root cause & corrective action.

4.Ensure the zero-defect product is delivered to the customer.

5.Support to sales team for demo & Quality inspection by customer or third-party inspection for tender and Export orders.

6.Maintenance of QMS ISO 9001:2015 like Internal and external Audit plan vs actual, ISO documentation & records, Calibrations of measuring & monitoring equipment.

7.Work closely with warehouse team, production team, calibration team, R&D team, Sales team and packing team to compliance the customer requirement.

8.Actively participate in the ramp-up journey of MPA to enhance the Quality as per company’s objective.

9.Active participation in design team / product reviews & SAP reviews for OES. Support R&D team in resolving product related issues to have smooth & trouble-free operation.

10.Take responsibility for people management related actions including employee communication, training & discipline for your team.

11.HEALTH, SAFETY, & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE: Ensure proper compliance with all relevant Health, Safety, Environmental, Regulatory and ISO requirements.

12.Actively take lead in solving problems on the shop floor through Lean Boot Camp for Problem solving, daily management.

13.Monitor and communicate shop floor performance and identify required improvements individually on time, if required.

14.Skill evaluation / enhancement of your team.
