Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
  
  
Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**

* Effectue l'intégration des composants et des produits. Toutes les activités qui englobent plusieurs composants et produits et concernées par l'intégration des solutions pour une performance et une opérabilité maximales. Gère les exigences, les spécifications et les flux de produits et de systèmes. Dirige les activités de validation et de vérification pour l'ensemble du produit/système, comprenant les tests au niveau du système. Responsable de la définition des exigences produits pour les équipes module/composant/sous-traitants et partenaires. Gère l'interface entre les composants et les organisations d'exécution. Responsable de la gestion des transactions de CTQ/Risque au sein des équipes chargées de la conception des composants. Gère la configuration globale du produit et le système de contrôle de la configuration.
* Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.
* Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions.
* Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe.

**Qualifications De Base**


* Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).

**Caractéristiques souhaitées**

* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.

title: Quality Control Engineer
description:
Hiring: QC Engineer – Civil

**Company:**
Gauri Buildcon Pvt. Ltd.

Golf Course Road, DLF Phase 5, Near Sector 54 Chowk Metro Station, Gurugram, Haryana

Minimum 2 Years

Full-time

On-site

6 days a week

9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

About the Role

Gauri Buildcon Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a technically proficient and detail-oriented QC Engineer – Civil with hands-on experience in construction material testing, concrete quality control, and site laboratory operations.

The ideal candidate should understand civil construction materials, testing procedures, applicable IS Codes, and quality documentation, with additional knowledge of civil measurements, BOQ, MB, and billing.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct civil construction material testing, including Slump Test, Concrete Cube Test, UPV Test, Rebound Hammer Test, Sieve Analysis, Silt Content Test, Specific Gravity Test, and other relevant tests.
* Ensure concrete quality control before, during, and after casting.
* Inspect and assess the quality of cement, sand, aggregates, reinforcement steel, bricks, and other construction materials.
* Monitor concrete mixing, workability, placing, curing, and compressive strength.
* Establish, operate, and maintain the site laboratory and testing equipment.
* Maintain testing equipment calibration records and ensure equipment is fit for use.
* Maintain material testing registers, material inspection reports, concrete test reports, and daily QC reports.
* Ensure compliance with relevant IS Codes, approved drawings, project specifications, and quality standards.
* Identify material defects and quality issues and coordinate corrective actions with the site team.
* Coordinate with site engineers, contractors, and project teams to resolve quality-related issues.
* Maintain proper documentation and traceability of material samples and test results.
* Apply basic knowledge of AutoCAD and civil measurements for drawing interpretation and quantity checks.
* Assist with BOQ verification, Measurement Books (MB), and billing-related quantity checks when required.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* B.Tech / B.E. in Civil Engineering.
* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in civil construction quality control or material testing.
* Practical knowledge of concrete testing and construction material testing procedures.
* Familiarity with Slump Test, Cube Test, UPV, Rebound Hammer, Sieve Analysis, Silt Content, and Specific Gravity tests.
* Understanding of concrete mix quality, curing practices, and compressive strength requirements.
* Knowledge of relevant IS Codes and construction quality standards.
* Experience in site laboratory management, testing equipment, calibration records, and QC documentation.
* Basic working knowledge of AutoCAD.
* Basic understanding of civil measurements, BOQ, Measurement Books (MB), and billing.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability.

Work Location and Schedule

**Location:**
Golf Course Road, DLF Phase 5, near Sector 54 Chowk Metro Station, Gurugram, Haryana.

* Working hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
* Working days: 6 days a week
* Work arrangement: Full-time, on-site

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should apply with their updated resume and provide the following details:

1. Total years of relevant experience.
2. Current or last company name.
3. Current or last drawn monthly salary.
4. Expected monthly salary.
5. Notice period and earliest joining date.

Candidates with practical experience in construction material testing, concrete quality control, and site laboratory operations are encouraged to apply.

* **Join Gauri Buildcon Pvt. Ltd. and contribute to quality-driven construction projects.**

+ Coordinate across cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and run solution ideation with vendor partners.
+ Bring a strong understanding of D2C business processes and act as the bridge between business, operations, and technology.
+ Present to senior leadership (including the CIO) and run regular status-update / governance meetings.

title: Mobility Technology:  OBT Functional Testing Specialist
description:
**About The Role**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Functional Testing Specialist to join the Mobility Technology / Digital Enablement team. The role will focus on manual testing of internal travel applications, particularly Online Booking Tools (OBTs) and integrated travel-technology platforms.
  
  
**Primary Objective**
Own end-to-end quality assurance for reservation platforms and help ensure reliable operation of corporate travel policy engines, air and hotel booking workflows, GDS/NDC integrations, payment gateways, and downstream systems.
  
  
**Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing. They will combine analytical thinking and attention to detail with effective cross-functional collaboration and a sound understanding of travel-domain processes. Prior travel-industry experience is preferred.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Test Planning and Design: Create, document, and maintain detailed manual test cases for internal travel applications, with particular emphasis on Online Booking Tools.
* Requirements Analysis: Understand travel business processes and translate business and technical requirements into clear, practical, and testable scenarios.
* Test Execution: Perform functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, integration, and end-to-end testing across releases and sprint cycles.
* Booking-Path Validation: Test complex, multi-tier booking journeys across air, hotel, rail, and car rental, including corporate travel policies, approval workflows, and profile synchronization.
* API and Integration Testing: Validate XML/JSON RESTful and SOAP integrations between the OBT and GDS platforms such as Sabre, Amadeus, and Travelport, as well as NDC aggregators and direct supplier connections.
* Payment and Downstream-System Validation: Verify corporate, virtual, and ghost-card processing and confirm accurate data transmission to mid-office, back-office, and expense-management systems, including SAP Concur and Chrome River.
* Defect Management: Identify, isolate, document, prioritize, and track defects in Azure DevOps or Jira, providing clear reproduction steps, appropriate severity levels, and supporting evidence.
* Retesting and Resolution: Collaborate with development teams to resolve defects and complete retesting to confirm that fixes work as expected.
* Delivery Planning: Estimate testing effort, identify risks, and support mitigation planning to enable timely, high-quality releases.
* Agile Delivery: Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, requirement discussions, development cycles, and retrospectives, providing timely quality-assurance input.
* Stakeholder Communication: Keep Product, Technology, and business stakeholders informed about testing progress, risks, blockers, quality concerns, and release readiness.
* Data Validation: Query databases to verify backend transaction states, profile-data mapping, and Passenger Name Record (PNR) generation.
* AI-Enabled Testing: Use AI tools where appropriate to support test-case creation, test-data preparation, defect analysis, and defect summarization.
* Continuous Improvement: Analyse user feedback and improve testing processes, documentation, test coverage, and overall quality-assurance practices.

**Must have**

* 6-8+ years of overall software testing experience.
* Strong hands-on experience in manual testing.
* 15 years of formal education.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Proactive, curious and continuous-improvement mindset.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with AI, data analytics and digital technologies.
* Experience in UAT and working with cross-functional teams.
* Excellent attention to detail
* Ability to simplify complex themes
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic understanding of the product development lifecycle.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology is a plus.
* Knowledge of tools such as Jira, Trello, Notion, Excel, or Google Sheets is preferred.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Eagerness to learn and take ownership of tasks.
* Basic understanding of UI/UX principles.
* Familiarity with SQL, analytics tools, or wireframing tools is an added advantage.

**Required Skills:**
The person in this role will need strong skills and experience in:
  
  

* 6 to 8 years of core software testing experience, with at least 5+ years dedicated to online tech platforms B2B and B2C
* Experience in a cross-border global role, successfully managing multiple complex projects at a global level
* Outstanding communication skills

**Optional/Preferred skills:**

* 3 to 6 years of core software testing experience, with at least 2+ years dedicated to travel-tech platforms, corporate travel booking engines, or OTA (Online Travel Agency) ecosystems.
* Experience or working knowledge of the travel domain, especially online booking applications and travel business processes.
* Understanding of the travel lifecycle, including PNR creation, ticketing, modifications, cancellations, refunds, void windows, and corporate travel policy configurations.
* proficiency with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, SoapUI).Solid hands-on experience using test management software (e.g., Jira/Zephyr, ALM, Azure DevOps).
* Intermediate proficiency in SQL for backend database verification (joins, indexing, basic data manipulation).
* Familiarity with web debugging tools (Chrome DevTools) to analyse network traffic, errors, and payloads.
* Conceptual understanding or basic exposure to automation testing frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, or RestAssured) to help transition manual workflows to automation.

**Certifications:**
ISTQB or equivalent software testing certification Preferred Not mandatory
  
  
**Work Experience:**
8-10 Years of end-to-end functional testing of any online B2C/B2B product preferably travel booking systems

title: Lead AI Ops Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead AI Ops Engineer
  
  
AI Ops
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard's Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As AI agents move from POC to production, their behavior keeps changing in real time: the context they retrieve, the skills they select, how they resolve exceptions. These agents are never really “finished.” They keep learning from production outcomes, so their reliability, safety, and trustworthiness need to be actively operated, not just monitored. That is the job of AI Ops: making sure each agent’s reasoning stays correct, its context stays current, and its behavior stays governed as it learns.
  
  
**Role**

* Own end to end production monitoring for one or more AI agents, tracking key metrics, KPIs, accuracy, latency, SLA breaches, guardrail triggers, and out of scope rates through dedicated observability dashboards
* Serve as L1/L2 production support, providing first response monitoring, triage, and escalation to tech teams as new agentic services go live
* Identify and diagnose issues by monitoring eval scores and drift alerts, inspecting failing traces and patterns, and classifying root causes such as intent, tool, parameter, or hallucination errors
* Evaluate whether the agent’s reasoning remains correct in production, checking whether context retrieval stays current, whether resolutions match ground truth, and whether the learning loop is drifting
* Monitor and manage post production reliability, including API and authentication failures and issues originating from external AI endpoints, to protect revenue generating, client facing agents
* Partner with AI Engineering to prioritize fixes, run experiments on prompts, context, and routing in Dev, and validate improvements via evals before handing off proven changes for deployment
* Embed governance within the agent’s learning loop so that approval workflows and audit logging travel with every production change, rather than being added after the fact

**All About You**

* Experience monitoring or operating production AI/ML or agentic systems, including observability, evaluation, and drift detection practices
* Strong analytical skills to diagnose root causes across intent classification, tool selection, parameter errors, and hallucination patterns
* Understanding of AI/LLM observability concepts such as tracing, telemetry, guardrails, and evaluation engineering including benchmarks, automated evals, human review, and regression testing
* Familiarity with governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices such as PII detection, access control, audit logging, and policy enforcement is a plus
* Ability to work independently alongside existing Tech teams while owning a dedicated agent’s post launch health
* Excellent communication skills to translate production signals into clear, prioritized asks for AI Product and AI Engineering teams
* Comfort working in a fast evolving environment where the process itself, not just the throughput, is what is being continuously operated on and improved

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**AON IS IN THE BUSINESS OF BETTER DECISIONS**
At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As an organization, we are committed to our purpose as one firm, united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.
  
  
**General Description Of Role**
About the Role
  
  
As a Business Analyst within the Assessment Solutions business, you will own the translation of business and product needs into clear, structured requirements that engineering teams can design and build from. The Aon Assessment Platform is the enterprise solution for accurate and fair workforce assessments at scale, used by millions of participants worldwide — and the quality of what engineering delivers depends heavily on the quality of what goes into the pipeline.
  
  
You are the primary bridge between product stakeholders, business owners, and the engineering group. Your central deliverable is the Product Requirement Definition (PRD) document: a clear, well-structured articulation of what needs to be built, why, and within what constraints — including acceptance criteria that QA and engineers can actually test against. Engineering Team Leads and Solution Architects take your PRDs as their starting point; if requirements are ambiguous, incomplete, or contradictory, the cost shows up in rework, delayed delivery, and misaligned solutions.
  
  
This role demands rigour, curiosity, and strong analytical thinking. Our platform is large and deeply interconnected; understanding the downstream impact of a new requirement — on existing workflows, integrations, data structures, and non-functional behaviour — is as important as capturing the requirement itself.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Requirements Elicitation & Analysis
  
  

* Lead requirements elicitation sessions with product owners, business stakeholders, and subject matter experts — translating business needs, user journeys, and product vision into structured, implementation-ready requirements.
* Analyse incoming requests critically: identify ambiguities, contradictions, and missing detail before handing requirements to engineering — not after design has begun.
* Map the impact of new requirements on existing platform features, integrations, and data flows; surface dependencies and risks that stakeholders may not have considered.
* Distinguish clearly between business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements (performance, accessibility, security, data privacy) — ensuring all are captured, not just the functional happy path.

PRD Authorship & Maintenance
  
  

* Author and maintain Product Requirement Definition (PRD) documents that Engineering Team Leads and Solution Architects can translate into Technical Specification Documents (TSDs) with confidence.
* Write acceptance criteria that are specific, testable, and unambiguous — criteria that QA can use directly to build test cases without requiring interpretation.
* Maintain a clear, versioned record of requirement decisions and changes — documenting the rationale behind scope inclusions and exclusions so that context is not lost as delivery progresses.
* Ensure PRDs account for the full scope of a feature: not just the core user journey but edge cases, error states, integration behaviour, and non-functional expectations.

Stakeholder Management & Communication
  
  

* Manage a diverse stakeholder group across product, commercial, operations, and technology — building trusted relationships and navigating competing priorities effectively.
* Facilitate workshops and collaborative sessions to align stakeholders on requirements, priorities, and tradeoffs — driving decisions rather than documenting disagreements.
* Communicate requirement status, risks, and dependencies clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Work effectively in an international environment across time zones and cultures (our squads span Germany and India).

Delivery Collaboration
  
  

* Partner closely with Engineering Team Leads, Solution Architects, QA, and Project Managers throughout delivery — answering clarification questions quickly, managing scope change, and ensuring the team always has the information it needs to move forward.
* Support the QA team in translating acceptance criteria into test coverage, and participate in acceptance testing to validate that delivered features meet the original intent.
* Contribute to sprint planning and backlog refinement — ensuring stories are well-formed, appropriately sized, and ready for engineering commitment.
* Proactively raise scope creep, unplanned dependencies, and requirement changes that affect delivery timelines — giving the project manager the visibility needed to manage accordingly.

Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Identify patterns across requirements that point to recurring business pain points or missing platform capabilities — feeding these back into product planning.
* Evolve BA practices, templates, and tooling within the team to improve the consistency and quality of requirements over time.
* Use AI tools in your day-to-day work — for requirements drafting, gap analysis, acceptance criteria generation, and documentation — and apply them effectively and responsibly. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 4–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst or Product Analyst in a software product or SaaS environment — experience working directly with engineering teams as part of an Agile delivery process.
* Proven ability to produce high-quality PRDs and functional specifications: clear, complete, and structured well enough that engineers can design from them without requiring repeated clarification.
* Strong analytical thinking — able to map complex workflows, identify dependencies and edge cases, and reason about the downstream impact of requirements on an interconnected platform.
* Demonstrated experience writing testable acceptance criteria that QA teams can work from directly.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills: able to navigate competing priorities, drive decisions in workshops, and maintain trusted relationships across business and technical audiences.
* Solid understanding of Agile delivery practices and how BA work fits within sprint cycles and release planning.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for an international team — clear, precise, and comfortable adapting tone for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Organised and self-directed: able to manage multiple concurrent requirements streams without losing track of quality or detail.
* Day-to-day use of AI tools in analytical and documentation work. This is a core expectation, not a nice-to-have.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience working in HR technology, talent assessment, recruitment, or a related domain.
* Familiarity with API-driven product behaviour and integration requirements — able to specify data exchange, field mappings, and integration acceptance criteria clearly.
* Exposure to non-functional requirements in large-scale platforms: performance, accessibility (WCAG), data privacy (GDPR), and security considerations.
* Experience with enterprise ATS platforms (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Taleo, or equivalent) from a functional or integration requirements perspective.
* Working knowledge of SQL at a query-reading level — able to validate data behaviour during acceptance testing without requiring engineering support for every check.
* Experience with requirements and collaboration tooling (Confluence, Jira, or equivalent).

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Cyber Security-IAM- Tech BA- Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
  
  
In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
  
  
As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* 3-5 Years of expertise and strong understanding of end-to-end Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) capabilities and its processes, including Identity Lifecycle Management, Access Requests, Approvals, Access Reviews, RBAC, SoD, and Application Onboarding.
* Proven ability to gather, analyse, and document business and technical requirements, translating stakeholder needs into functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and implementation-ready requirements.
* Hands-on experience in application onboarding, RBAC, SoD, compliance, and governance initiatives, ensuring alignment with security policies, audit requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and documentation skills, with the ability to independently lead workshops and discussions with application owners, business stakeholders, and technical teams for assessments, discovery, and requirements elicitation.
* Experience conducting IGA maturity assessments, current-state and future-state analysis, gap assessments, and providing strategic recommendations to improve governance, automation, and compliance.
* Ability to drive testing, user acceptance, deployment readiness, and adoption activities, ensuring successful implementation and business adoption of IGA solutions

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Sr Executive/Asst. Manager
description:
Cotecna is a leading provider of testing, inspection and certification services. Founded in Switzerland in 1974, Cotecna started off as a family business and has now grown to become a world-class international player with over 7000 employees in more than 140 offices across 50 countries.
  
  
Mission of the Role
  
  
The position will have the responsibility for execution of Food Safety Audit/Training
  
  
Main Accountabilities
  
  

* Execution of food audits as per standard procedure for various standards (GMP, HACCP, ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, FSSAI, 2nd party audits etc)
* Execution of trainings as per standard procedure for various Food Standards
* Submission of audit reports, trainings packs as per defined TAT.
* Developments and executions of new audits/ trainings modules as per requirements
* Acting for compliance against accreditation requirements
* Supporting Sales team with customer referral and business meeting

**Qualifications, Experience And Technical Skills**

* The auditor has a degree (or equivalent qualification) in a food or bio science related discipline
* Experience in the food or associated industry including at least 2 years’ full-time work in quality assurance or food safety functions in food production or manufacturing, retailing, inspection or enforcement or the equivalent. (For food safety and quality consultancy experience in a food or associated industry can be used to meet a maximum of 6 months of the work experience requirement. The number of mandays of consultancy provided shall be equivalent to the duration allocated towards work experience). 3rd party audit experience within the food industry will be considered as relevant work experience.
* The auditor has completed Food Safety Management System Lead Auditor Training – minimum duration of 40 hours (5 days); or ISO 9001 Lead Auditor training (minimum 40 hours) and ISO 22000 or FSSC 22000 conversion course or ISO 22000 Foundation Self study course.
* Successful completion of minimum 2 days (Minimum 8 hours in a day) HACCP training along with exam
* Successful completion of Food Fraud and Food Defence training including an exam (Specific to FSSC)
* Knowledge on applicable Country specific Food regulation

APPLY FOR THE JOB

**Business Analysis/Operational Technology/Control Systems (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA)**

* Should be well versed with functional concepts of BA with relevant knowledge in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA) and Gap analysis
* Should be well conversant in OT/CS (ADMS, OMS, DERMS, AMI, SCADA), products/technologies, frameworks, business metadata management and relevant architectural components.
* Strong business analysis skills
* Strong command over business process design

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Good Communication skills
* Maintaining end-to-end accountability and expectations for customer satisfaction and overall delivery excellence
* Prioritize deliveries in conjunction with implementation team
* Adopt a proactive, logical and organized approach to problem resolution

**What We Look For**

* An opportunity to be a part of Global, market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 10000 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. title: Functional Consultant Business Central
description:

•   Help build our toolkit: manufacturing discovery questionnaire, fit-gap template, migration templates and a demo company.

•   5+ years as a functional consultant on Business Central or Dynamics NAV.

•   At least 2 end-to-end manufacturing implementations taken live in BC or NAV, with your role in each clearly stated.

•   Hands-on configuration of production BOMs, routings, work/machine centers and the full production order lifecycle.

•   Working knowledge of MRP/MPS in BC and of why the planning worksheet suggests what it does.

•   Solid understanding of manufacturing costing in BC: standard, FIFO and average costing, overheads, variances and cost adjustment.

•   Ability to run client workshops and write clear functional specifications in English.

•   Experience with BC SaaS (cloud), not only on-premises NAV.

**Nice to have**

•   Microsoft certification MB-800 (Business Central Functional Consultant Associate).

•   Background as a production, planning or cost accountant in a manufacturing company before consulting.

•   Experience with Indian manufacturers and BC India localization (GST, TDS, e-invoicing).

•   Experience with manufacturing add-ons from AppSource (process manufacturing, quality control, shop-floor data capture, scheduling).

•   Exposure to warehouse management (directed put-away and pick) for production.

•   Experience with Copilot or agent features in Business Central.

•   Hindi or Gujarati, for workshops with shop-floor staff in Gujarat.

title: Executive, QC Instrumentation
description:
**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
This role is responsible for managing, calibrating, and maintaining quality control instrumentation and equipment in compliance with established standards and regulatory requirements within a global pharmaceutical manufacturing environment. The incumbent ensures that all quality control instruments are properly calibrated, qualified, and maintained to support accurate and reliable analytical testing. The position identifies instrumentation issues and takes proactive measures to prevent potential equipment failures that could impact product quality or testing reliability. It applies knowledge of instrument qualification, calibration standards, and regulatory frameworks to maintain a compliant instrumentation program. The role audits and monitors instrumentation performance and maintenance activities against both internal and regulatory standards to uphold compliance. It supports the qualification and validation of new instruments and equipment introduced into the quality control laboratory. The position reports instrumentation deviations and equipment failures to the appropriate quality and maintenance stakeholders. It supports the organization's commitment to maintaining a reliable and compliant instrumentation infrastructure that underpins quality control operations.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Manage, calibrate, and maintain quality control instrumentation and equipment in accordance with established specifications and regulatory requirements
* Ensure all quality control instruments are properly calibrated, qualified, and maintained to support accurate and reliable analytical testing
* Identify instrumentation issues and implement preventive measures to avoid potential equipment failures impacting product quality or testing reliability
* Apply knowledge of instrument qualification, calibration standards, and regulatory frameworks to maintain a compliant instrumentation program
* Audit and monitor instrumentation performance and maintenance activities against defined internal and regulatory quality standards
* Support the qualification and validation of new instruments and equipment introduced into the quality control laboratory
* Report instrumentation deviations and equipment failures to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance instrumentation management and calibration programs
* Maintain accurate and complete documentation of all instrumentation activities in compliance with GMP and GLP requirements

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Perform daily verification of instruments (e.g., pH meter, conductivity meter, balance, TOC).
* Prepare and execute planners for calibration, preventive maintenance, and Computer System Validation (CSV)
* Manage procurement and inventory of instrument spares and PM kits.
* Manage procurement and inventory of reference standard, chemicals and HPLC/GC columns.
* Initiate CCFs, prepare URS and QRM documents, and support vendors during IQ, OQ, and PQ qualification activities.
* Participate in and support investigations related to Out of Specification (OOS), Out of Alert Limit (OOAL), deviations, and incidents.

**Education**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelors Degree (BA/BS) B.E. - Required
* Master Degree (MS/MA) ME - Preferred

**Experience:**

* 5 years or more in 5 - 8 Years

**Specialized Knowledge:**
**Licenses:**

title: Quality Assurance Rater - English speakers in India
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

**A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater**

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
* Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
* Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
* Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
* Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
* Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
* Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

**TELUS Digital AI Community**

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.

Qualification path

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

**Basic Requirements**

* **Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in English.**
* **Resident in India for the last 5 consecutive years.**
* Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
* Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
* Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
* Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
* Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
* High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
* Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
* Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
* Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

**Equal Opportunity**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role title**
**Job Description**
**Supervising Associate – Service Excellence**
**Job Summary**
Talent Services act as operational business partners to regional talent teams and global functions, offering dedicated support to candidates and employees. Team provides expert advise and facilitate scalable, high-quality services at an economical cost model. We are a crucial part of the EY global talent operating model, supporting its ‘All In’ strategy.
  
  
Support the analysis, mapping, and re imagining of Talent processes as part of EY GDS Service Excellence and Enablement transformation initiatives, with strong ownership of process artefacts, governance, and documentation quality across the deployment lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Role And Responsibilities**
The role supports EY GDS Enablement Services by executing high quality process analysis and documentation for Talent transformation programmes. The Supervising Associate will work closely with Config, Product, Business Analysis, Data, and Change & Integration teams to ensure that current state and future state Talent processes are accurately mapped, validated, governed, and ready for deployment, while embedding Service Excellence, continuous improvement, and change readiness principles.
  
  
**Process Analysis, Mapping & Documentation Excellence**

* Document current state (L4) and future state (L5) Talent processes using standard programme templates and EY methodologies.
* Develop and maintain L5 blueprints, user journeys (UJs), swimlane diagrams, and process variants, ensuring traceability to design decisions and business outcomes.
* Perform structured analysis of process variants, edge cases, handoffs, and dependencies across Talent sub processes.
* Update UJs, L4s, and L5s in line with configuration, design, data, and integration decisions.
* Support creation of methods documents and process playbooks where required.

**Delivery Support, Governance & Execution Discipline**

* Participate in design workshops, playback sessions, focus groups, and usability testing; take structured, decision oriented notes and translate them into validated artefacts.
* Maintain the Process & Enablement (P&E) repository, documentation tracker, and version control logs to ensure audit ready governance.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned deliverables with disciplined execution, accuracy, and attention to detail.
* Act as a Business Analyst for Talent technology initiatives where process design is tightly coupled with system implementation.

**Change, Adoption & Capability Enablement**

* Support development of training materials, job aids, and playback decks aligned to future state processes.

* Support broader continuous improvement and transformation initiatives within Talent and Enablement Services.

* Contribute to process maturity assessments, KPI definition, and benefits tracking for Talent processes.
* Support RCA workshops, issue analysis, and closure tracking where process gaps are identified.

* Align process deliverables to EY’s Service Excellence, Quality, Agile, and Business Excellence frameworks.

**Experience**
**Skills & Experience Required**

* 3–5 years of experience in business analysis, HR operations, Talent processes, or process documentation roles.
* Hands on experience supporting process transformation, technology enablement, or large scale deployments.
* Prior exposure to global delivery / shared services / consulting environments preferred.

**Core Skills**

* Strong attention to detail, logical structuring, and process thinking.
* Proficiency with Visio, Excel, PowerPoint, and structured documentation templates.
* Ability to collaborate with Config, Product, BA, Data, and Change & Integration stakeholders to refine artefacts.
* Strong written and visual communication skills suitable for senior stakeholder playback.
* Foundational understanding of process re engineering, metrics, and quality concepts (Lean / Six Sigma exposure is an advantage).
* Comfort working in fast paced transformation programmes with evolving requirements.

We invite you to take on this crucial role to facilitate transformative change and enhance excellence within our Talent service delivery operations. Your leadership and expertise will be essential in achieving our objectives and upholding EY’s standard of excellence.

* Strong technical foundation
* Process Reengineering and Technology mindset
* Disciplined Execution of the tasks.
* Global Mindset
* Influencing and Negotiation skills
* Change Management, Adaptability and Agility
* Innovative mindset and ability to relevant models suiting the context

**What We Look For**
A person who has the energy and enthusiasm to initiate change with appropriate intentions. Demonstrates a commitment to positively impacting the overall situation. Focus on finding solutions and is willing to ask questions to develop creative resolutions. Genuine, approachable, and capable of uniting a team to work collaboratively towards a shared vision.
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

Huron is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (Senior SDET) to join its product engineering team. You will own the test automation strategy and framework architecture, ensuring reliability and accuracy across complex application workflows. Embedded in Agile delivery teams alongside developers, product managers, and designers, you bring a software engineering mindset to quality problems and set the quality bar the whole team works toward.

**Primary responsibilities**

**Test strategy and technical leadership**

* Define and own the test strategy, framework architecture, and tooling roadmap for assigned product areas.
* Translate business requirements into traceable test cases across functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end dimensions; lead test plan reviews with developers, product owners, and project managers.
* Define test coverage metrics and quality gates; produce risk-based release readiness reports for engineering leadership at each milestone.

**Test automation and AI-assisted engineering**

* **AI-assisted development:** Leverage GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, and comparable AI coding assistants to accelerate test script authorship, generate edge-case scenarios, and perform intelligent code review.
* **AI agentic testing:** Configure and evaluate agentic workflows for autonomous test generation and self-healing locators; apply Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents to test tools, APIs, and data sources for end-to-end agentic test workflows; define system instructions, skills, and tool configurations for AI coding agents.
* Architect and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress for UI; REST Assured or similar for APIs; integrate into CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Write complex SQL queries to validate backend data integrity in **PostgreSQL (using DBeaver)**; build data-driven test suites for parallel and cross-browser execution.

**Defect management, collaboration, and mentorship**

* Isolate, document, and track defects in Azure DevOps; lead exploratory testing sessions and root-cause analysis on escaped defects.
* Serve as quality engineering lead across Agile delivery teams; participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, standups, and retrospectives.
* Conduct code reviews and coach developers and team members on shift-left testing practices and quality engineering standards.

**Required qualifications**

**Core**

* B.E./B.Tech. in Computer Science, MIS, or related discipline; 4 to 7 years in software quality engineering with the majority in test automation and framework development on a commercial product.
* Production-quality automation code in C#, Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript; proficiency with Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress; API testing with REST Assured, Postman, or SoapUI.
* CI/CD pipeline experience (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins); strong Git skills; cross-browser testing with BrowserStack or equivalent; solid SQL skills for database validation.
* Deep understanding of QA lifecycle and Agile/Iterative delivery; clear communicator able to produce test strategies and quality summaries for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated experience with performance engineering, scalability design, and observability practices (logging, metrics, distributed tracing) in production systems.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services including Lambda, ECS, RDS, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and related cloud-native tooling.

**AI and agentic development tools**

* Practical daily use of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or Cursor) to write, refactor, and review test code; proven ability to craft effective prompts and system instructions.
* Solid understanding of AI agents, skills, and tool-calling; familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) — ability to connect AI models to internal tools, APIs, and test infrastructure for multi-step agentic workflows; working knowledge of an LLM API or orchestration framework (Anthropic API, LangChain, or similar) is a strong plus.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Performance and/or security testing (JMeter, k6, OWASP ZAP); TDD/BDD methodologies (Cucumber, Reqnroll); containerized test environments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript; familiarity with Visual Studio and the Microsoft development ecosystem; ISTQB certification or equivalent credential.
* Knowledge of AWS services (SNS, S3, EC2, Lambda, etc.) is an advantage; familiarity with cloud-based test environment provisioning and infrastructure as code.

title: Senior Engineer I - QA
description:
**What is Contentstack?**
Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.
  
  
While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.
  
  
Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.
  
  
Learn more at www.contentstack.com.
  
  
**Who Are We?**
At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let's go!

* Own the test strategy for Platform (Web and API): decide what runs on every PR, nightly and at release

* Design, build and maintain the UI and API automation frameworks (Playwright/Selenium), including shared page objects, fixtures, test data and stable selectors
* Add automated quality gates to CI/CD pipelines, and track and fix flaky tests

* Provide feedback to the developers, review test code and pull requests
* Mentor junior QA engineers and help developers write better tests
* Complete tasks in a timely manner
* Update internal product documentation

* 3 to 5 years of QA experience, with at least 2 years in test automation

**Interesting Work |**
We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the "challenge yourself" role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you're doing it.

| We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict "no a\*\*hole policy" and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.
  
  
**Bragging Rights**
| We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!

title: Software Quality Engineer
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. KLA's Central Engineering organization is made up of nine Centers of Excellence (CoEs) spanning disciplines like automation, motion control, sensors, platform design, and packaging. Each CoE contributes not only technical deliverables but also deep expertise, best practices, and advanced tools that elevate both what we build—and how we build it.
  
  
****What You'll Do****
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**Software Quality Engineer**
**Responsibilities:**
The selected Software QA Engineer will join a world-class software team to architect, implement, and scale test automation solutions that drive quality across KLA products. They will be a technically strong individual contributor and leader, responsible for building AI-augmented automation frameworks that ensure the reliability of all released products. They will champion modern testing practices with a sharp focus on automation coverage, infrastructure excellence, and continuous improvement of the qualification process. They must be able to partner with cross-functional teams globally to resolve quality issues quickly.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include:**

* Identify, evaluate, and implement test automation frameworks and tools that deliver measurable value across the qualification lifecycle — including functional, regression, performance, and reliability testing.
* Own and drive automated test coverage for both UI and API layers across KLA products, designing robust test suites and publishing results, recommendations, and best known methods.
* Integrate AI capabilities into the test automation framework — including self-healing locators, intelligent test generation, and autonomous test execution — to improve test resilience and reduce maintenance overhead.
* Leverage deep knowledge of software systems and application architecture to design scalable infrastructure solutions that empower the test automation team.
* Assess automation feasibility of test cases and script them for automatic execution across new and existing product features.
* Technically interact with Algorithms, System Engineering, Application Engineering, Marketing and Manufacturing, and Customer Support teams across global locations for various requirements.
* Participate in all stages of software development including deployment and troubleshooting at customer sites. Represent the SQE team in product lifecycle and key program meetings.
* Travel to customer fabrication facilities to understand customer use cases, deploy software, and troubleshoot.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Must have Master's Level Degree in CS or related fields
* Must have excellent communication, analytical and interpersonal skill. Must also be self-driven, yet a strong team player
* Background in IC processing/Semiconductor equipment is a plus.
* Hands-on experience with automation tools is a plus
* Must be desiring to travel and enjoy working in other cultures.

****Minimum Qualifications****
Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
  
  
****About KLA****
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
**Role Summary**
The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable.
  
  
The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix — Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions — ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks.
  
  
The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation
  
  

* Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments.
* Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology.

**Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build**

* Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained.
* Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership.

**Integration and Data Engineering**

* Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

**DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management**

* Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management.
* Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control.
* Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles.

**Vendor and Managed Service Delivery**

* Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance.
* Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Alignment**

* Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability.
* Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums.

**Organisational Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8–10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources.
* Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality.

**Compliance, Risk and Governance**

* Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements.
* Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management.

**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application.
* Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies.
* Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline.
* Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management.
* Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred.
* Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness
* Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context.
* Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon).
* Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions.
* Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes.
* Recognised cloud or architecture certification.

**Physical/Mental Requirements**
Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work.
  
  
**Non-standard Work Schedule, Travel Or Environment Requirements**
Occasional travel up to 20%
  
  
Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare.
  
  
**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**
Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead.
  
  
Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation.
  
  
External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners.
  
  
**RESOURCES MANAGED
  
  
Financial Accountability**
Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation
  
  
**Supervision**
Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects,integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleague's leadership.
  
  
Work Location Assignment: Hybrid
