title: Senior Software Development Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**
Inovalon was founded in 1998 on the belief that technology, and data specifically, would empower the transformation of the entire healthcare ecosystem for the better, improving both outcomes and economics. At Inovalon, we believe that when our customers are successful in their missions, healthcare improves. Therefore, we focus on empowering them with data-driven solutions. And the momentum is building.
  
  
Together, as ONE Inovalon, we are a united force delivering solutions that address healthcare’s greatest needs. Through our mission-based culture of inclusion and innovation, our organization brings value not just to our customers, but to the millions of patients and members they serve.
  
  
**Who You Are**
As a Senior Software Development Engineer, you help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of broadly used software capabilities by designing, executing, and improving effective testing practices. You work closely with developers and cross-functional partners to validate requirements, identify issues early, and support high-quality releases in an Agile environment. Your work helps strengthen product performance and user experience for internal teams, clients, and the people they serve.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Execute test scripts for complex, widely used product capabilities and components across integration, functional, API, data, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.
* Create, maintain, and extend comprehensive test plans and test cases for user stories, defects, and technical enhancements to ensure requirements and specifications are fully validated.
* Design structured, reusable, automation-ready test cases that can be used by Quality Engineers and automated test frameworks.
* Use AI-assisted tools to accelerate test case creation, expand test coverage, identify edge cases, and improve test effectiveness while applying human judgment to validate and refine outputs.
* Analyze functional requirements and specifications to identify gaps, clarify expected behavior, and define test strategies that verify complete coverage.
* Partner with developers to troubleshoot defects, isolate complex issues involving dependent software components, and communicate findings clearly to stakeholders.
* Set up, perform, and interpret performance and load tests to evaluate product behavior under expected and stressed conditions.
* Analyze, document, and report test results, quality metrics, and testing status from an overall product perspective.
* Develop and maintain test scripts, test cases, and software test and performance measurement tools using appropriate programming languages and software applications.
* Continuously improve test plans, scripts, and cases based on quality data, production incidents, lessons learned, and team priorities.

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of demonstrated QA and testing experience or equivalent experience required.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Information Technology or equivalent combination of education and experience required.
* Experience developing test cases and test scripts.
* Good knowledge of basic test techniques, including positive and negative testing, interface testing, and database testing.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience across all phases of software testing, including integration, functional, API, data, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.
* Experience with test tools and source control tools such as Microsoft Azure DevOps and/or GitHub.
* Thorough understanding of the software development life cycle, quality before design, Agile software development, and current QA best practices, methodologies, standards, and testing approaches.
* Experience validating the effectiveness of application user experience.
* Ability to communicate effectively across a variety of staff levels and lead work effectively within a team environment.
* Growth Potential & Learning Agility: You actively build your knowledge of product behavior, testing methods, tools, and emerging technologies, and apply new learning to improve test quality and team outcomes.
* Leadership: You influence through collaboration, communicate clearly with developers and peers, support shared quality goals, and help move issues to resolution when perspectives differ.
* Adaptability: You adjust quickly to changing priorities, evolving requirements, and shifting release needs while staying focused on quality and delivery outcomes.
* Creative Thinking: You develop practical, effective ways to improve test coverage, uncover edge cases, and strengthen quality processes across complex product areas.
* Analytical Skills: You interpret test results, identify patterns and root causes, break down complex issues, and use evidence to guide decisions and recommendations.
* Nice to have: Experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright and an understanding of databases.

**Our Shared Commitments**

* Maintain compliance with Inovalon’s policies, procedures and mission statement;
* Adhere to all confidentiality and HIPAA requirements as outlined within Inovalon’s Operating Policies and Procedures in all ways and at all times with respect to any aspect of the data handled or services rendered in the undertaking of the position; and
* Fulfill those responsibilities and/or duties that may be reasonably provided by Inovalon for the purpose of achieving operational and financial success of Employer.

**Work Environment**
This is primarily a computer-based role performed in a remote, hybrid, or office environment. The role requires prolonged periods of computer use and frequent communication and interaction with others, either virtually and/or in person. The role may occasionally require transporting or moving work-related equipment weighing up to 10 pounds, such as a laptop and related materials. Some travel may be required, depending on the needs of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position, consistent with applicable law.
  
  
*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)*
*If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
*By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.*

title: Databricks QA / Data Reconciliation Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Databricks QA / Data Reconciliation Engineer**
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a Data QA / Reconciliation Engineer with hands-on experience in Databricks, SQL, and data validation. The candidate will be responsible for validating data pipelines, reconciling data between source and target systems, verifying transformation logic, and ensuring data accuracy and consistency across data processing layers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform end-to-end data validation and reconciliation across source systems, staging tables, and target datasets in Databricks.
* Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, data transformations, and source-to-target mappings.
* Write complex SQL queries to verify record counts, totals, aggregations, data completeness, and accuracy.
* Identify and investigate data mismatches, missing records, duplicate records, and transformation errors.
* Perform data quality checks across Databricks Delta tables and Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers.
* Design and execute test cases for data integration, functional testing, regression testing, and end-to-end validation.
* Use Python/PySpark to automate data validation and reconciliation wherever required.
* Validate schema changes, business rules, derived fields, and incremental data loads.
* Log defects, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate with data engineering teams to resolve issues.
* Maintain test scripts, reconciliation reports, test evidence, and data quality documentation.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience in SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, subqueries, and data comparison.
* Experience in ETL testing, data warehouse testing, data validation, and reconciliation.
* Practical experience with Databricks and Delta Lake.
* Understanding of data pipelines, data transformations, and source-to-target mapping.
* Experience in test case design, defect tracking, and regression testing.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Python and PySpark for test automation and data validation.
* Experience with AWS data services and cloud-based data platforms.
* Familiarity with data warehouse concepts, data modelling, and incremental data processing.
* Exposure to automated data quality frameworks and CI/CD processes.
* Experience working in Agile teams using tools such as Jira or similar test management platforms.

You'll work inside the codebase alongside developers to make CDM testable at every level, pushing coverage down the test pyramid so that most quality is proven by fast, reliable unit, component, and integration tests rather than slow end-to-end suites. Working closely with development and DevOps, you'll help ensure CDM ships reliable, high-quality releases to enterprise customers.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Refactor production C# code to improve testability: introduce dependency injection, create seams, decouple components, and remove hard-coded dependencies.
* Write characterization tests to safely bring legacy code under test before changing it.
* Pair with developers on design and on unit, component, and integration test strategy, and help them write better tests themselves.
* Use AI coding agents to write and refactor tests and production code. Own the agent rule files and tooling that govern how they write tests (e.g., AGENTS.md, MCP servers).
* Define and evolve the team's test architecture, deciding what belongs at each level of the pyramid and actively shrinking reliance on E2E tests.
* Review PRs, including agent-generated changes, for testability, test quality, and coverage, not just for whether tests exist.
* Review requirements and acceptance criteria early to shape testable designs.
* Build and maintain quality gates in CI pipelines (test stages, coverage, reporting, flaky-test detection).
* Develop reusable test libraries, fixtures, and test data builders in C#.
* Maintain a lean, targeted set of E2E and UI tests (Selenium, Ranorex) for critical user journeys across web and desktop.
* Contribute to API and performance testing.
* Participate in stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

**What You Bring**
*Core Skills*

* Strong proficiency in C# and .NET, with experience writing and refactoring production code, not only test code.
* Deep experience with unit testing frameworks (xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest) and mocking libraries (Moq, NSubstitute, or similar).
* Solid understanding of dependency injection, SOLID principles, and techniques for breaking dependencies in legacy code.
* Hands-on experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot agent mode, Cursor), the judgment to spot weak or incorrect agent output, and the ability to teach others to do the same.
* Experience writing integration and component tests (e.g., WebApplicationFactory, Testcontainers, in-memory or containerized databases).
* A clear point of view on the test pyramid and when each type of test is the right tool.
* Experience with CI/CD and source control (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Git, Bitbucket).
* Working experience with UI automation (Selenium, Ranorex, or similar).
* Experience in Agile Scrum/Kanban teams.

*Nice to Have*

* TDD experience.
* BDD experience (e.g., Reqnroll, SpecFlow, Gherkin).
* Contract testing (e.g., Pact), mutation testing (e.g., Stryker.NET), coverage tooling (e.g., Coverlet).
* Performance or load testing experience.
* Experience in financial reporting or other regulated domains.

**Experience**

* 4+ years of software development experience, including writing and refactoring production C# code.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

**Additional Information**
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

This position owns the testing function across the software development life cycle, designs and maintains automated test frameworks, sets standards for unit and integration testing in collaboration with development teams, and leads a team of software test engineers.
  
  
Working within a Microsoft-centered technology stack, the Testing Lead brings a software development background to quality engineering: writing and reviewing testing code, building automated regression testing, integrating tests into Azure DevOps pipelines, and building report testing meeting acceptability thresholds. The role also serves as the quality escalation point for release readiness decisions and reports quality metrics to technology and engagement leadership.
  
  
**What it means to work for EisnerAmper:**

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards

+ We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions
+ We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
+ Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work
+ Numerous Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) to support our Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion (DE&I) efforts

**What work you will be responsible for:**
**Test Strategy and Quality Leadership**

* Owns the overall test strategy for assigned applications and engagements, covering unit, integration, system, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing.
* Establishes and maintains quality assurance standards, methodologies, entry and exit criteria, and metrics, and drives their adoption across development teams.
* Serves as the quality decision point for release readiness, presenting risk assessments and recommendations to technology and engagement leadership.
* Estimates testing effort and resources, prioritizes the test backlog, and confirms that testing tasks are delivered on schedule.
* Evaluates and recommends testing tools, frameworks, and platform investments, including build-versus-buy analysis and proof-of-concept work.

**Automated Test Development**

* Designs, codes, reviews, and maintains automated test frameworks and reusable libraries in C# / .NET for UI, API, database, and end-to-end scenarios.
* Builds data-driven and behavior-driven automated suites, including test data management, environment configuration, and reporting.
* Integrates automated regression and smoke suites into Azure DevOps pipelines with gated builds, quality gates, and automated result publication.
* Monitors automation health — flaky test rates, execution time, and coverage — and refactors suites to keep results trustworthy and fast.
* Sets automation targets by release and reports progress against manual-to-automated conversion goals.

**Unit Testing and Shift-Left Quality**

* Advises developers on unit test design, test doubles, and mocking strategy, and participates in code review with a focus on testability and coverage.
* Defines code coverage thresholds and static analysis rules with development leadership, and monitors adherence through build reporting.
* Writes unit and integration tests directly when supporting shared components, remediation work, or teams building new test capability.
* Promotes early defect detection through requirements review, design review, and acceptance criteria refinement before development begins.

**Test Case Design and Execution**

* Analyzes requirements and design specifications to produce comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts with expected results and traceability to acceptance criteria.
* Applies risk-based, boundary, negative, and equivalence-partitioning techniques to focus coverage where defect probability and business impact are highest.
* Reviews and approves test cases authored by team members, providing written feedback on coverage gaps, clarity, and reusability.
* Directs system, functional, regression, and end-to-end business scenario testing for new applications and enhancements.
* Maintains and manages manual test scripts, automated suites, and test databases under version control.
* Coordinates user acceptance testing with business stakeholders, including scenario preparation, facilitation, and results documentation.

**Defect Management and Metrics**

* Verifies and traces evidence of reproduction for reported faults, and validates fixes along with impact analysis for related functionality.
* Manages the defect life cycle through triage, prioritization, assignment, and closure, and escalates aging or high-severity items.
* Tracks and reports quality metrics such as defect density, escape rate, open defect counts, coverage, and cycle time, and uses trends to guide process improvement.
* Leads root cause analysis on production escapes and translates findings into concrete process or automation changes.

**Collaboration and Communication**

* Serves as liaison among analysts, developers, architects, and business domain owners to clarify requirements and produce effective test scripts.
* Keeps development teams, project management, and internal customers informed of testing progress, risks, and significant issues.
* Produces well-written internal and external documentation, and conducts workshops or training on areas of knowledge as needed.
* Assists and advises internal customers on technical issues, resolving assigned incidents in a timely manner and retaining ownership until closure.
* Builds and maintains trusted relationships with a diverse group of clients, team members, managers, and subject matter contacts.

**Team Leadership And Firm Responsibilities**

* Leads, coaches, and develops software test engineers, including work assignment, code and test case review, on-the-job training, and performance feedback.
* Participates in hiring, onboarding, and skills development planning for the testing team, including automation upskilling.
* Works with supervisors to identify and understand engagement scope, manages day-to-day activities of completing work, and assists with oversight of overall quality control of client deliverables.
* Monitors workload to meet billable hour expectations and performs timely reviews of work products prior to submission to a supervisor.
* Maintains the required CPE for firm and licensing requirements.
* Complies with professional and firm requirements (e.g., employee handbook requirements, time entry procedures).

**Other Duties:**

* Provides courteous and prompt service to all internal and external parties. Prioritizes and addresses requests and assignments in a professional and cooperative manner.
* Identifies opportunities and recommends methods to improve service, work processes, and financial performance (e.g., procedure optimization). Assists in the implementation of quality improvement initiatives.
* Assists co-workers in the completion of tasks and assignments to support continuity of service. Actively supports teamwork throughout the organization.
* Performs other services as assigned.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Systems and Decision Sciences is required. Coursework in data structures, algorithms, and software design is expected.
* ISTQB Advanced Level (Test Manager or Test Analyst) is preferred.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate, Azure DevOps Engineer, or comparable Microsoft credential is preferred.
* Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent agile credential is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in software quality engineering and test automation across the full system development life cycle is required.
* 6+ years of experience leading, building, and developing test teams, including work assignment, review, and performance feedback, is required.
* 6+ years of hands-on experience designing, coding, and maintaining automated test suites — UI, API, and data layer is required.
* 6+ years of software development experience within the Microsoft stack, including C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET, and SQL Server / T-SQL, is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience writing and reviewing unit tests is required.
* Demonstrated experience authoring test plans, test cases, and test scripts from requirements and design specifications, including boundary, negative, and risk-based case design with traceability back to acceptance criteria, is required.
* Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, including gated builds and release quality gates, is required.
* Experience with agile delivery, system development life cycle governance, and tools such as Azure DevOps (Boards, Repos, Pipelines, Test Plans), JIRA, Confluence, Zephyr, Xray, or TestRail is preferred.
* Experience with performance and load testing (JMeter, k6, Azure Load Testing), accessibility testing, or application security testing concepts is preferred.
* Experience in professional services, accounting, tax, or another regulated environment — including testing of financial calculations and data migrations — is preferred.
* Languages: C#, .NET / .NET Core, T-SQL, PowerShell, and JavaScript or TypeScript.
* Microsoft platform: Azure DevOps, Azure (App Service, Functions, SQL), SQL Server, Power BI, Power Platform, Dynamics 365, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365.
* Source control and branching strategy in Git, including pull request review and code review participation.
* Working knowledge of API design (REST, JSON, XML), relational data modeling, and query optimization sufficient to validate results independently.
* Working knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, or other agile methodologies, including estimation and sprint planning.
* Depth of knowledge in quality assurance and quality control processes, defect life cycle management, and release governance.
* Ability to translate technical quality data into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work in a dynamic, fast-paced, and continuously changing environment while holding the team to consistent standards.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and tasks with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally and appropriately with a diverse group of individuals.
* Demonstrates a positive attitude, proactive nature, and a high degree of professionalism, and maintains the highest level of confidentiality.
* Ability to work independently and within a team, and to coach others toward the same standard.
* Computer literacy at an intermediate or advanced level with the Microsoft Office suite of products (specifically Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint).

We strongly believe in a supportive work environment where all our colleagues can succeed. EisnerAmper India is proud to be an Equal Opportunity merit-based employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of caste & religion, disabilities, gender, sexual orientation, age or marital status.
  
  
**About our Technology Team:**
The EisnerAmper Technology Testing team owns quality assurance for custom internal and client-facing applications and custom reporting. Working within a Microsoft-centered technology stack, the team designs and maintains automated test frameworks, sets standards for unit and integration testing alongside development teams, and provides release readiness recommendations and quality metrics to technology and engagement leadership.
  
  
By instilling a culture of collaboration, teamwork, and trust across the department, we’re committed to building our people into tomorrow’s industry leaders. At all levels, employees are encouraged to take on new responsibilities and challenges in order to grow both as individuals and a team.
  
  
Our core values of trust, integrity and accountability allow us to act as strategic innovators. Because when we build trust with each other, we can bring new ideas to the table and execute them without fear of failure.
  
  
**About EisnerAmper:**
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with nearly 5,000 employees including 450 partners across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
  
  
Our clients are enterprises as diverse as sophisticated financial institutions and start-ups, global public firms, and middle-market companies, as well as high net worth individuals, family offices, not-for-profit organizations, and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, and investors who serve these clients.
  
  
**About EisnerAmper India:**
EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of EisnerAmper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
  
  
EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Bangalore, Hyderabad and Ahmedabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 1000 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.
  
  
Should you need any accommodations to complete this application please email: indiata@eisneramper.com
  
  
Preferred Location:
  
  
Hyderabad

title: Calling all Software Engineers!
description:
**About ValGenesis**
ValGenesis is a leading digital validation platform provider for life sciences companies. ValGenesis suite of products are used by 30 of the top 50 global pharmaceutical and biotech companies to achieve digital transformation, total compliance and manufacturing excellence/intelligence across their product lifecycle.
  
  
Learn more about working for ValGenesis, the de facto standard for paperless validation in Life Sciences: https://www.valgenesis.com/about
  
  
About the Role:
  
  
**🚀 We're Hiring Engineers Across All Levels! 🚀**
Are you ready to build the future with us? At
**ValGenesis**
, we're scaling rapidly and expanding our engineering teams across multiple functions. Whether you're a seasoned expert or an emerging talent, we have exciting opportunities for you to grow, innovate, and make an impact.
  
  
**Location:**
Our Offices are in the following locations:
  
  
Chennai: Taramani, Chennai
  
  
Bengaluru: Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
  
Hyderabad: Ranga Reddy, Telangana
  
  
🔧 What We’re Hiring For 🔧:
  
  
We’re looking for engineers with
**2 to 12 years of experience**
across a variety of disciplines, including but not limited to:
  
  
**Software Engineering**
(Frontend, Backend, Full Stack)
  
  
**DevOps & Infrastructure**
**Data Engineering & Analytics**
**Machine Learning & AI**
**Quality Assurance & Automation**
**Embedded Systems & Hardware**
**Product & Platform Engineering**
🌟 What You’ll Do 🌟:
  
  
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, build, and scale cutting-edge solutions.
  
  
Solve complex technical challenges with creativity and efficiency.
  
  
Contribute to a culture of innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  
  
🎯 What We’re Looking For🎯 :
  
  
Proven experience in engineering roles (2–12 years).
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for technology.
  
  
Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  
  
Experience with modern tools, frameworks, and methodologies relevant to your domain.
  
  
**Ready to take the next step?**
Apply now. Let’s build something amazing together.
  
  
**We’re on a Mission**
In 2005, we disrupted the life sciences industry by introducing the world’s first digital validation lifecycle management system. ValGenesis VLMS® revolutionized compliance-based corporate validation activities and has remained the industry standard.
  
  
Today, we continue to push the boundaries of innovation ― enhancing and expanding our portfolio beyond validation with an end-to-end digital transformation platform. We combine our purpose-built systems with world-class consulting services to help every facet of GxP meet evolving regulations and quality expectations.
  
  
**The Team You’ll Join**
Our customers’ success is our success. We keep the customer experience centered in our decisions, from product to marketing to sales to services to support. Life sciences companies exist to improve humanity’s quality of life, and we honor that mission.
  
  
We work together. We communicate openly, support each other without reservation, and never hesitate to wear multiple hats to get the job done.
  
  
We think big. Innovation is the heart of ValGenesis. That spirit drives product development as well as personal growth. We never stop aiming upward.
  
  
We’re in it to win it. We’re on a path to becoming the number one intelligent validation platform in the market, and we won’t settle for anything less than being a market leader.
  
  
**How We Work**
Our Chennai, Hyderabad and Bangalore offices are onsite, 5 days per week. We believe that in-person interaction and collaboration fosters creativity, and a sense of community, and is critical to our future success as a company.
  
  
ValGenesis is an equal-opportunity employer that makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. Our goal is to have the best-qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristics protected by local law.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Digital Portfolio QA Manager
description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
Kidde Global Solutions is seeking an experienced Digital Portfolio QA Manager to lead quality assurance for mobile, web, cloud, desktop software, API, and connected digital applications. The role will build and guide a strong QA team, strengthen automation and testing practices, adopt practical AI methods in day-to-day QA work, and ensure reliable, secure, and scalable digital experiences across IoT, intrusion, video, and access-control product ecosystems
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Digital Portfolio QA Manager will be responsible for defining and executing the QA approach across web, mobile, API, cloud, desktop software, and connected product platforms. This includes planning test coverage, improving automation, using AI to make testing faster and smarter, managing release readiness, and driving measurable quality outcomes for applications and tools used to configure, commission, monitor, and manage hardware devices.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The role is accountable for team leadership, QA planning, automation, AI adoption in testing, and release confidence across mobile, web, API, cloud, desktop software, and connected digital applications. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* QA strategy and ownership: Define and continuously improve the quality engineering strategy for web, mobile, API, cloud, desktop software, and connected digital application releases in alignment with product, engineering, and business objectives.
* Team leadership: Lead, mentor, and develop a team of QA engineers responsible for mobile and web-based digital applications, promoting accountability, engineering discipline, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* AI adoption in QA: Use practical AI methods to improve testing, including AI-assisted test case creation, test data generation, automation support, defect analysis, risk identification, and quality reporting.
* Testing and automation methods: Lead manual, automated, regression, integration, API, mobile, web, desktop, and end-to-end testing using scalable frameworks, reusable test assets, CI/CD integration, and clear effectiveness metrics.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

description:

Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
**Software Development Engineer II - Security**
**Position Summary:**
The
**Software Engineer II**
is responsible for supporting the research, analysis, and validation of emerging cyber threats targeting applications, APIs, AI/LLM systems, cloud native environments, and modern enterprise infrastructure. This engineer contributes to proof of concept attacks, detection techniques, security validation frameworks, and security tools that help strengthen the F5 Application Delivery and Security Platform (ADSP).
  
  
This role combines threat intelligence, security research, automation, security tool development, and technical content creation to improve F5 security products and support technical marketing engineering with demos, validation assets, tools, and customer facing content. The engineer works closely with Product Security, Engineering, Product Management, Security Research, Threat Intelligence, Technical Marketing Engineering, and architects to help identify attack trends, validate F5 protections, and build reusable technical assets.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Support research into emerging cyber threats targeting web applications, APIs, AI/LLM applications, cloud workloads, Kubernetes, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Analyze attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, MITRE ATLAS, OWASP Web Application Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and OWASP LLM Top 10.
* Develop and execute proof of concept exploits, attack simulations, and threat emulation scenarios under guidance from senior engineers.
* Implement and maintain automated security validation frameworks, detection tools, and supporting security tools for testing and mitigation.
* Evaluate F5 security products and platform capabilities against emerging threats and evolving attack techniques.
* Build reusable tools, scripts, demos, and validation assets that support technical marketing engineering use cases and customer demonstrations.
* Create technical content, demos, and security focused materials for internal teams and customers.
* Participate in code reviews by contributing scripts, incorporating feedback, and reviewing automation and tooling from other team members.
* Contribute to repeatable methodologies for security testing, threat emulation, and use case validation.

**Knowledge and Skills:**

* Good knowledge of application security, API security, cloud security, and AI/LLM security.
* Good understanding of OWASP Web Application Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and OWASP LLM Top 10.
* Strong programming skills in Python for automation, tooling, validation, and security research.
* Knowledge of threat intelligence, attack techniques, threat detection, and security validation using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and MITRE ATLAS.
* Good knowledge of security and networking fundamentals.
* Experience building or supporting security tools, automation frameworks, validation environments, or threat simulation capabilities.
* Experience with offensive security tools such as Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit, ffuf, sqlmap, or similar, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of HTTP, DNS, TCP/IP, and L2/L3 network protocol testing.
* Experience with GitHub or other source control tools preferred.
* Experience with CI/CD, Agile software development, and test automation.
* Ability to support technical marketing engineering through demos, validation assets, technical tools, and customer facing technical content.
* Strong organizational, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem solving skills.

**Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of professional experience in software development, testing, security validation, or security engineering, preferably in a Linux environment.
* Experience working with geographically dispersed teams preferred.
* BA/BS degree in computer science, engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience.

The Job Description is intended to be a general representation of the responsibilities and requirements of the job. However, the description may not be all-inclusive, and responsibilities and requirements are subject to change.

**@myworkday.com)**

description:
**About Us**
Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
  
  
At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected - and empowered - to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
  
  
**Why We Do What We Do**
In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
  
  
Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award-winning culture.
  
  
**Position Overview**

* Perform end to end testing to ensure appropriate functionality, product integrity, accuracy, and quality of all changes and enhancements of the edit platform, Data Driven Edits PriZem (in-house system), Visium through the Payment Integrity (Claims Editing) process.
* Analyze clinical and technical requirements and define the scope of UAT testing. Setup, develop and maintain detailed test scenarios, test suites, data, checklist and/or other documents as specified, ensuring test scenarios align to requirements, adhering to claim adjudication guidelines. While using best practices for software testing methodology and techniques.
* Analyze and troubleshoot erroneous results, determine root cause, and suggest solutions.
* Produce documents that are detailed, accurate, and in a consistent format, demonstrating strong analytical and documentation skills.
* Continuous improvement and refinement of tests-based pre-production validation, post-production results and feedback from other groups (Configuration Department, Content Department and Operations teams) as needed.
* Support multiple projects, initiatives, tasks, and maintenance releases while adhering to deadlines.
* Maintain awareness of and ensure adherence to Zelis standards regarding privacy.

**What You Will Bring**

* Highly organized and results driven.
* Excellent problem solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent projects.
* Ability to work through others without direct supervisory responsibility within departments and across the organization.
* Understanding of medical coding and medical claims.
* Understanding of the life of a claim, including adjusted/corrected claims.
* Excellent attention to detail to assess issues and resolve in a timely manner.
* Basic database skills using MS SQL.
* Ability to identify key factors and decisions that will make a project successful.
* Ability to see the big picture and learn new processes, technologies and envision how they could benefit Zelis.
* Must have excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively interface with team members.

**Education**

* 5+ years of relevant experience or equivalent combination of education & work within healthcare payer or provider.
* Knowledge of healthcare reimbursement methodologies and acceptable billing practices.
* Knowledge of payer reimbursement policies, state and federal regulations and applicable industry standards.
* Knowledge of claims adjudication process and interpret claim editing rules.
* Certified coder (CCS, CCS-P or CPC), or registered health information technician (RHIA/RHIT), or RN, LPN with coding knowledge a plus.
* Understanding of SQL Server 2000/2005/2008 is a plus.
* Project management experience a plus.
* Excellent written, oral and presentation skills and ability to communicate complex concepts.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, Word, Excel.

**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
  
  
**Accessibility Support**
We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Associate Software Quality & Test Analyst
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an Associate Software Quality and Test Analyst (Software Quality Analyst, Test Analyst, Computer System Validation Analyst) to join our life sciences and clinical research team. As an Associate Software Quality and Test Analyst, you will support software quality, system validation, testing, and compliance activities for regulated business applications. This position plays a key role in validation deliverables, change requests, test case creation and execution, and quality documentation, helping ensure that systems remain compliant and audit ready.
  
  
You'll collaborate with business, IT, Quality, and vendor teams, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to system enhancements and projects. Responsibilities include system validation support, test execution, quality documentation, change request support, and traceability, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence system quality and compliance outcomes.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through validation, testing, and quality activities that keep systems compliant, traceable, and inspection ready. Your work helps protect data integrity and the reliability of the systems that support the delivery of new therapies to patients. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Associate Software Quality and Test Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support system validation and qualification activities for software applications
* Develop and execute test cases, test scripts, and user acceptance testing (UAT) scenarios
* Create, review, and maintain validation and quality documentation.
* Support change request assessment, testing, and implementation activities
* Document test results, defects, and testing evidence
* Ensure traceability between requirements, testing, and validation deliverables
* Assist with audit readiness by maintaining accurate and inspection-ready records
* Collaborate with business, IT, Quality, and vendor teams on system enhancements and projects

**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strengths in software testing and UAT, system validation, and quality documentation
* An understanding of regulated environments and the documentation and compliance standards they require
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly
* A patient-focused mindset and strong attention to detail
* Comfort working with change management and defect tracking processes

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field
* 1-3 years of experience in software testing, validation, quality assurance, or related roles
* Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), software testing methodologies, and user acceptance testing (UAT) processes
* Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Computer System Validation (CSV)
* Knowledge of Good Practice (GxP), Good Automated Manufacturing Practice (GAMP 5), and FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (Electronic Records and Electronic Signatures) requirements
* Experience with change control and quality management processes
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, HP ALM, and similar tools

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III**
**Role Overview:**
As an Applied AI Site Reliability Engineer III , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to the reliability, performance, and operational integrity of high-visibility products and platforms and the environments they run in. Your expertise will be pivotal in keeping production safe, performant, and cost-effective, while driving tangible value for Deloitte’s engineering investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftsmanship across cloud platform engineering, observability, and performance and reliability engineering—together with applied AI fluency that lets you reliably operate AI and agentic workloads alongside the rest of the portfolio—consistently demonstrating your strong track record in operating high-quality, resilient systems at scale. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to uphold production standards, safeguard environments, and admit systems into production with confidence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for reliability, performance, and cost outcomes, measured in service-level objectives and error budgets, not raw uptime. Operate the products, platforms, and environments you support to meet their SLOs within budget, and track incident trends and toil to prioritize the work that most improves reliability—ensuring high-quality, lean operational designs that keep production safe and resilient.
* Serve as the technical advocate for production reliability and operability, ensuring systems are admissible, performant, safe to run, and able to degrade gracefully when failure occurs. Uphold production standards, lead the design of observability, performance and resilience testing, and operational tooling, and own the admission of systems into production—gating release on error budgets and automated reliability checks, and owning the readiness verification, environment integrity, and operational support that follow.
* Maintain accountability for the operational integrity of production and pre-production environments, and for the production standards that systems are admitted against. Own SLOs and error budgets; build and operate production observability—codified, version-controlled dashboards and SLO-driven, actionable alerting that detects before impact, plus the feedback loop into engineering; run performance, ambient-noise, and chaos testing to verify readiness; and guard environments against drift. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks—operating as an infrastructure-focused engineer, not a tool operator. Create technical specifications, runbooks, and shared playbooks; lead blameless postmortems that turn incidents into learning and systemic fixes; write high-quality, supportable automation to ensure all reliability KPIs (availability, performance, and cost) are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.
* Develop lean operational solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to meet the reliability needs of the engineering teams and the business. Engage with those teams before, during, and after delivery, co-defining service-level objectives and operational readiness so the right safeguards are in place at the right time, without becoming a bottleneck to delivery.
* Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a leaning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, hardening reliability through incremental, measurable improvements—progressive resilience testing and SLO refinement—rather than big-bang interventions, and keeping operations supportable and maintainable.
* Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional partners: engineering, platform engineering, security and risk, data governance, and engineering leadership and architecture. Uphold production standards and integrate their constraints so that the reliable, performant, and compliant path is the operative path. Co-define service-level objectives with the teams you support, verify readiness, and own the admission decision into production—holding the segregation-of-duties line as a dedicated, embedded function while partnering with security and risk on the control objectives you enforce. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.
* Possess expertise in site reliability and modern production engineering—cloud platform ownership, observability (metrics, tracing, logging), performance and capacity engineering, chaos engineering, and cloud/AI cost engineering—together with applied AI fluency to operate AI and agentic workloads reliably, including AI and Agentic SSDLC, delivering production operations with full automation from discovery to production to operations and all quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize reliability, performance, and operational delivery. Demonstrate strong understanding of the full lifecycle of platform and product development, focusing on continuous improvement and learning.
* Quickly acquire domain knowledge of the products and platforms you operate—and, where they are AI-infused, their distinct production failure modes such as drift, train/serve skew, latency and output variance, and token/GPU cost anomalies. Translate reliability needs, reference architectures, and operational requirements into service-level objectives, runbooks, and production tooling. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.
* Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.
* Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

**The team:**
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.
  
  
**The successful candidate will possess:**

* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care.

**Required Qualifications:**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor.
* 5+ years of software engineering and site reliability engineering experience operating large-scale, distributed, cloud-native systems in production, with experience in most of the following: Python, Go, Bash, Java, C#/.NET, SQL/NoSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, as well as CI/CD and observability stacks.
* 3+ years of experience in site reliability or production engineering for large-scale systems—defining and owning SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs; error budgets; incident command and on-call; building and operating production observability (metrics, tracing, logging—e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Dynatrace, Amazon CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, SolarWinds, Splunk); environment integrity and drift prevention across pre-production and production; and segregation-of-duties controls (least-privilege/RBAC, deploy approvals, secrets management) in partnership with security and risk.
* 3+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering and cloud platform ownership on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure—including their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI—plus container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker), infrastructure-as-code, networking, and multi-environment management.
* Prior experience operating AI/ML and agentic workloads in production—their reliability failure modes (drift, train/serve skew, output variance), MLOps/LLMOps, and the AI control plane (model/LLM gateway, guardrails) from the operability and performance side.
* Prior experience with load and performance testing under simulated production traffic (e.g., LoadRunner, k6, or JMeter), chaos engineering (e.g., Azure Chaos Studio, AWS Fault Injector), capacity planning, autoscaling, and cloud/AI cost engineering (FinOps tooling/dashboards, including GPU/inference and token cost attribution).
* Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development.
* Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e.g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to operate high-quality, resilient platforms and products at scale.

**Other:**

* Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.
* Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

description:

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

title: CSV & Software Validation Lead / Specialist
description:
**Designation: CSV & Software Validation Lead / Specialist**

**Preferred Experience: 3+ Years**

**Job Summary**

Aventior is seeking a CSV & Software Validation Specialist with experience in the biopharmaceutical, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of regulatory compliance, quality management, computerized system validation (CSV), and software testing within regulated environments.

The role involves ensuring that software applications and computerized systems meet applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, and business specifications. The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing test cases, validating system functionality, documenting test results, managing defects, and supporting compliance activities in accordance with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and other relevant regulatory frameworks.

The candidate will collaborate with Quality Assurance, Software Development, Clinical Operations, IT, and Regulatory Affairs teams to ensure software quality, data integrity, and regulatory compliance throughout the software development and validation lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Ensure adherence to applicable GxP requirements, including GMP, GCP, and GLP, based on project and system requirements.
* Support compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU and UK regulations for electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, and access controls.
* Apply GAMP 5 principles and risk-based approaches to computerized system validation and software testing.
* Review and maintain SOPs, work instructions, validation documents, and quality records.
* Support compliance assessments, internal and external audits, client audits, and regulatory inspection readiness.
* Assist with deviation management, CAPA, change control, risk assessments, and compliance remediation activities.
* Support data integrity, security, traceability, and documentation requirements for regulated systems.

**2. Software Testing & Quality Engineering**

* Review business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documentation to identify test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Prepare and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test scenarios for software applications used in biopharma and life sciences.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT), as applicable.
* Validate application workflows, data processing, user permissions, audit trails, electronic signatures, and system interfaces.
* Identify, document, track, and retest software defects in collaboration with development and QA teams.
* Maintain requirements traceability matrices (RTMs) to establish traceability between requirements, risks, test cases, and test results.
* Ensure testing activities are documented, reproducible, and aligned with approved procedures and validation protocols.
* Support test execution, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution verification.
* Participate in release testing, regression testing, and post-implementation verification.

**3. Computerized System Validation (CSV)**

* Support validation activities for GxP-regulated software applications and computerized systems.
* Prepare and maintain validation lifecycle documentation, including User Requirements Specifications (URS), risk assessments, validation plans, and test protocols.
* Execute or support Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ), where applicable.
* Assist with validation of new systems, system upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, and software releases.
* Ensure validation evidence is complete, accurate, approved, and audit-ready.
* Support periodic reviews, change impact assessments, and revalidation activities based on risk and regulatory requirements.
* Apply risk-based validation principles in accordance with GAMP 5 and organizational quality procedures.

**4. Biopharma & Life Sciences Application Testing**

* Test and validate applications supporting clinical trials, clinical data management, pharmaceutical quality processes, laboratory operations, and regulatory workflows.
* Understand regulated-system requirements relating to patient data, clinical trial records, laboratory data, and electronic documentation.
* Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, access controls, audit trails, and system-generated records.
* Support testing of integrations between clinical, laboratory, quality management, and other enterprise applications.
* Help ensure that software changes do not compromise patient safety, product quality, data integrity, or regulatory compliance.
* Support HIPAA-related privacy and security requirements when applications handle protected health information (PHI).

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Computer Science, Information Technology, Quality Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in compliance, software testing, quality assurance, or computerized system validation within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research, or life sciences environments.
* Strong understanding of GxP regulations, including GMP, GCP, and GLP.
* Working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, EU and UK regulations, and electronic records and electronic signature requirements.
* Hands-on experience in manual software testing, test case preparation, test execution, defect tracking, and regression testing.
* Hands on experience with QMS platforms like ServiceNow, Veeva, Master Control a huge plus.
* Experience preparing or executing validation protocols and maintaining validation documentation, including URS, IQ, OQ, PQ, and RTMs, as applicable.
* Knowledge of SDLC, STLC, requirements traceability, risk-based testing, and change management.
* Experience with CAPA, deviation management, change control, and audit documentation.
* Understanding of data integrity, audit trails, access controls, and security requirements in regulated systems.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple testing and compliance activities.

**Company Overview:**

**Aventior**

is a leading provider of innovative, end-to-end technology solutions, empowering businesses across diverse industries to solve complex challenges and accelerate growth. We harness the power of cutting-edge technologies such as
**artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), MLOps, and DevOps**

to build scalable, future-ready solutions that drive measurable business outcomes for the life science industry.

Our expertise extends across the entire data lifecycle. We offer comprehensive data development and management services, including
**cloud data architecture, universal data models, Data Transformation & ETL, data lakes, user management, Analytics & visualization,**

and
**automated data capture**

for unstructured and semi-structured sources such as scanned documents. These capabilities enable organizations to unlock the full value of their data and make faster, more informed decisions.

At Aventior, our strength lies in combining
**deep industry expertise**

with
**advanced technical capabilities**

. Our teams work closely with clients to design and deliver tailored solutions that align with their unique business needs—whether it’s optimizing operations, enhancing customer experiences, or driving strategic decision-making.

We bring a
**holistic, cross-industry perspective**

to every engagement, supported by a strong foundation in
**design, implementation, innovation, migration, and ongoing support**

. With a
**global delivery model**

, a
**multi-country presence**

, and a team of highly skilled professionals, Aventior is well-positioned to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes at scale.
