title: Delivery Manager-Test Lead
description:
**Job Purpose**
Looking for a Test Lead / Data QA Engineer to drive and oversee data validation, manual testing, and regression testing activities across capital markets data pipelines spanning both legacy and modern platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and adherence to business rules through source-to-target validation, schema verification, data reconciliation, lineage analysis, and automation-led regression testing.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong data QA and testing expertise, hands-on automation skills, capital markets domain knowledge, and a proactive ownership mindset to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across environments.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead test delivery, manage and coordinate offshore QA resources, and engage closely with business and technology stakeholders to maintain high-quality data across post-trade and enterprise data ecosystems. Key responsibilities include building reusable Python- and SQL-based validation frameworks, supporting batch and cloud-based execution models, identifying data anomalies, validating end-to-end data flows, and embedding robust data quality controls throughout the development lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end test planning, execution, and delivery for data validation and regression testing initiatives, ensuring quality, schedule, and stakeholder expectations are met.
* Manage and mentor offshore/onshore QA teams, including resource planning, task allocation, deliverable reviews, and adherence to testing best practices.
* Drive test governance, including test strategy, defect management, risk tracking, quality metrics, status reporting, and release readiness assessments.
* Collaborate with business, engineering, and product teams to define requirements, resolve issues, ensure test coverage, and embed quality controls across the delivery lifecycle.
* Perform source-to-target data validation across legacy and modern systems, including SQL Server and cloud-based data environments.
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication handling, referential integrity, schema structures, metadata, lineage, and business-rule conformance.
* Build and maintain automation-first regression testing frameworks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable validation utilities.
* Execute field-level, dataset-level, transformation-level, and aggregate-level data checks across source, staging, warehouse, data lake, and downstream systems.
* Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, post-trade data flows, stored procedures, batch jobs, and cloud-based execution workflows.
* Design reusable test cases, validation scenarios, reconciliation checks, automated scripts, and regression packs for repeatable data-quality assurance.
* Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and stored procedures across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms.
* Translate business rules, stored procedure logic, and post-trade process flows into automated validation scripts and assertions.
* Build Python-based utilities, APIs, CLI tools, and reusable frameworks to support data validation, orchestration, API integrations, and reporting workflows.
* Integrate regression tests, data validation checks, SQL deployables, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent tools.
* Automate execution of AutoSys jobs, batch processes, stored procedures, and validation scripts across development, UAT, and production environments.
* Work with engineering teams to embed data quality controls into pipelines, releases, and operational workflows.
* Identify data anomalies, schema mismatches, duplicate records, null-handling issues, transformation failures, reconciliation breaks, and integrity violations.
* Log defects with clear evidence, impact analysis, root-cause observations, and business context.
* Support capital markets and post-trade validation across allocations, clearing, settlement, confirmations, reconciliations, market data, reference data, and downstream reporting.

**Key competencies**

* 8–12 years of hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles and proven experience leading QA teams, test planning, estimation, execution, defect management, and end-to-end test delivery across complex data programs.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate test status, risks, quality metrics, and release readiness to business and technology leadership.
* Experience establishing test strategies, governance frameworks, quality standards, resource planning, and mentoring distributed QA teams.
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional collaboration, manage competing priorities, mitigate delivery risks, and ensure

successful project outcomes in Agile environments.
  
  

* Strong Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification.
* Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets.
* Solid SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis.
* Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms.
* Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities.
* Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance.
* Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
* Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow.
* Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios.
* Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Domain Experience (Must Have)
* Strong experience in Fixed Income Capital Markets domain
* Good understanding of Fixed Income products, reference data, pricing, securities, positions, settlements, and trade lifecycle concepts
* Experience working with market data, reference data, and regulatory reporting-related data sets

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to Azure, AWS, ADF, containers, Kubernetes, or cloud-based data platforms.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar platforms.
* Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, cloud data lakes, and Big Data validation.
* Experience validating batch, streaming, real-time, and Kafka-based ingestion pipelines.
* Capital markets domain exposure, especially post-trade, market data, reference data, trade data, or ION/blotter platform

integrations.
  
  

* Exposure to DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and code quality tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Sonar, Mend, or ZAP.

title: Performance Engineering Architect
description:
**About Avaya**
Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

**Job Information**
Job Code: 00194001
  
  
Job Family: Research and Development
  
  
Job Function: Software Engineering
  
  
**About The Job**
We are seeking a Performance Architect – QA to join our R&D team as a senior individual contributor. The ideal candidate is a hands-on performance engineering expert with a deep architectural pedigree in core products, platforms, or large-scale enterprise software. You will shape our overarching performance strategy and partner closely with Product Engineering, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, and R&D teams to deliver highly scalable, resilient, and low-latency products.
  
  
In this role, you will own the performance engineering domain from an architectural perspective—driving strategies that build performance into the core system design. While performance remains your primary focus, you will also bring critical insights into end-to-end, system-level Quality Assurance. By bridging the gap between functional automation and non-functional engineering, you will ensure a holistic approach to system reliability, helping elevate our entire QA framework. This role involves technical ownership and cross-functional influence, with no people-management responsibilities.
  
  
**About You**

* Experience: 15+ years in QA, software/performance engineering, and automation, with 10+ years of hands-on SaaS experience. Mandatory background in a Core Product or R&D organization.
* Architecture & Systems: Expertise in distributed systems, microservices, cloud-native patterns, multi-tenant platforms, and load balancing (e.g., Istio service mesh).
* Performance & Reliability: Experience establishing data-driven SLOs/SLIs and error budgets. Proven ability to lead chaos engineering initiatives (fault injection, failovers) and capacity planning using real-time SRE/APM telemetry.
* Testing & Tooling: Expert in performance testing frameworks (K6, JMeter, Gatling, or custom simulators) and stateful/protocol-level fuzzing (HTTP/2, gRPC, WebSocket). Advanced proficiency in functional automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium).
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on with Docker, Terraform, and Kubernetes (AKS preferred) for autoscaling and high availability.
* Development & CI/CD: Strong programming skills in Java, Python, C#, or Go. Seamless integration of continuous verification into CI/CD pipelines.
* Observability: Mastery of APM tools, distributed tracing, database tuning, Prometheus, and Grafana.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

**Why Join & Who Should Apply**
This is a high-impact role focused heavily on technical depth, engineering judgment, and cross-functional mentorship. You are a strong fit if you:
  
  

* Have scaled complex, distributed products in an R&D environment and deeply understand the entire product lifecycle.
* Can authoritatively influence architectural decisions using data-driven performance insights.
* Possess a big-picture vision for end-to-end QA, optimizing both functional boundaries and non-functional baselines.
* Can perfectly balance hands-on coding, debugging, and production analysis with strategic architecture ownership.

**Education**
Bachelor degree or equivalent experience
  
  
Advance Degree preferred
  
  
**Preferred Certifications**
**Footer**
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.
  
  
Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. title: Senior Engineer, Agent Harness Engineering (IR-557)
description:
Intellectsoft is a software development company delivering innovative solutions since 2007. We operate across North America, Latin America, the Nordic region, the UK, and Europe. We specialize in industries like Fintech, Healthcare, EdTech, Construction, Hospitality, and more, partnering with startups, mid-sized businesses, and Fortune 500 companies to drive innovation and scalability. Our clients include Jaguar Motors, Universal Pictures, Harley-Davidson, and many more where our teams are making daily impactTogether, our team delivers solutions that make a difference. Learn more at www.intellectsoft.net
  
  
Our customer advises global pharmaceutical and life sciences clients across commercial strategy, clinical development, regulatory operations, and medical affairs. An increasing share of this work is powered by AI agents designed to handle complex scientific and commercial datasets. This role is split roughly evenly between internal research (developing reusable agent harness components, benchmark evaluations, and reliability frameworks) and client delivery (architecting, deploying, and scaling production-ready agentic systems).
  
  
**Requirements**

* Professional Experience: 2-3 years of professional software engineering experience, including substantive work building LLM-based or agentic systems (beyond prompt-level experimentation)
* Production Deployment: Proven track record of deploying user-facing AI applications to production, including operational experience with monitoring, versioning, rate limiting, cost control, and incident response
* Core Software Engineering & Python: Strong Python skills with production-grade test coverage, typing, asyncio, Pydantic, Pytest, packaging, version control, CI/CD, and robust API design
* LLM & Agent Frameworks: Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming, and context window management. Experience building or extending orchestration frameworks (such as LangGraph, deepagents, OpenAI Agents SDK, or custom harnesses) with a clear view on framework utility
* Non-Deterministic Evaluation: Ability to define success criteria, design evaluation datasets, and systematically evaluate non-deterministic AI outputs
* Cloud & Shipping: Working knowledge of containerization and at least one major cloud provider to ship and maintain services independently
* Communication & Adaptability: Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to represent technical positions credibly and thrive amid shifting project priorities.

**Nice to have**

* Domain Knowledge: Prior exposure to healthcare, pharma, or biotech data (clinical trial data, real-world evidence, regulatory submissions, pharmacovigilance, or commercial analytics) and standards (CDISC, SNOMED, MedDRA)
* Regulated Environments: Familiarity with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA, GDPR, audit logging, and formal system validation
* Observability & Protocols: Hands-on experience with LLM tracing tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, Braintrust, OpenTelemetry) or developing and hosting MCP servers
* Retrieval & Models: Experience with RAG pipelines, vector search (pgvector, Qdrant, Weaviate), fine-tuning, distillation, or model serving (vLLM, Bedrock, Vertex AI)
* DevOps & Data Engineering: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, GitHub Actions, AWS/Azure) alongside large-scale data processing using Polars, Pandas, DuckDB, and advanced SQL
* Consulting & Ecosystem Engagement: Prior consulting/client services experience, active use of agentic developer tooling (such as Claude Code), or open-source contributions/publications in agent architectures and evaluations

**Responsibilities**

* Harness & Orchestration Architecture: Design and build core agent harnesses, covering function calling, tool interfaces, context assembly, retrieval integration, subagent delegation, retry logic, and failure handling
* Prototype to Production Delivery: Take agentic systems from initial concept to scalable production, managing deployment, monitoring, cost, latency, and operational support against live enterprise client data
* Evaluation Infrastructure: Build and maintain rigorous evaluation suites, task benchmarks, scoring rubrics, and regression tests using tools like Langfuse, Pydantic Logfire, or custom SDKs to drive architectural decisions
* System & Tool Integration: Integrate client enterprise systems, data sources, and internal APIs as accessible agent tools, including building and managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers
* Solution Consulting & Requirements Translation: Translate ambiguous client requirements into robust agent architectures, clearly advising stakeholders when an agentic pattern is—or is not—the right solution
* Stakeholder Communication: Interface directly with client stakeholders and articulate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical audiences
* Tooling Transfer & Documentation: Contribute reusable harness components to shared internal tooling and document design decisions to meet audit, validation, and handover standards

**Benefits**

* Employment-based cooperation
* Comprehensive insurance for you and your family (health, life, and accident)
* Paid PTO policy (vacation, sick leaves, and public holidays)
* Tech equipment provided
* Udemy courses, workshops, trainings & expert knowledge-sharing
* Flexible hours & work setup

The Systems Engineer will lead the V&V effort / with a Product V&V focus collaborates closely with Engineers, Architects, and Test in the Ventilation business to develop and commercialize Class 2 medical devices.

description:
Job Description

**Our Story**

Thanks to the work of every colleague, Alight has received multiple awards of recognition including “Great Place to Work” for the past 7 years and Fortune’s “Best Companies to Work For.” To learn more about our company culture and awards
**Click Here.**

We invite you to join our team! Learn more at careers.alight.com.

**(THE ROLE)**

The Senior Testing Specialist is accountable to test and sign off on the quality of CBA solutions, ensuring that delivery meets client requirements and acceptance criteria. The role leverages deep domain expertise, test design discipline, realistic test data setup, defect analysis, and stakeholder communication to identify quality risks and support production-ready releases. This updated role also requires responsible use of AI as a productivity accelerator for data quality analysis, test design, SQL validation, issue summarization, and documentation.

**AI capability requirement**

Candidates must demonstrate practical, responsible use of generative AI to accelerate data profiling, data quality rule design, test case creation, SQL analysis, and issue summarization. AI-generated checks, summaries, or SQL must be validated, corrected, and explained before use.

**(RESPONSIBILITIES)**

Primary Responsibilities

· Participate in requirements meetings to understand client impact, acceptance criteria, testing coverage, environment needs, non-functional requirements, and testing effort.

· Participate in sprint planning by reviewing user stories, identifying testing tasks, providing estimates, and confirming readiness of test data and environments.

· Create, document, execute, track, and report manual and automated test cases for assigned projects, enhancements, and defects.

· Create realistic participant, provision, configuration, and environment data needed for development, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT preparation.

· Capture, analyze, log, and retest defects; identify quality risks; and partner with developers, product owners, and solution leaders to resolve issues or prioritize backlog items.

· Execute functional and non-functional testing, including regression, data validation, configuration validation, and release-readiness testing.

· Support UAT by preparing environments and test participants, validating test scenarios, and documenting results, risks, and required follow-up.

· Use AI-assisted QA and data analysis tools to accelerate test design, data quality checks, SQL validation, issue summaries, and documentation while independently validating outputs.

Required Skills and Experience

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, Math, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

· 4-6 years of software quality assurance, data testing, or related experience.

· Experience with SQL-based testing and data validation.

· Experience creating and executing manual tests, with exposure to test automation or automated data-validation approaches; familiarity with Agile testing methodologies, test planning, test case creation, defect management, and release validation.

· Experience with QA automation frameworks, test-management tools, or automated SQL/data-quality validation is a plus.

· Strong knowledge of CBA domain, product behavior, environment setup, test data preparation, client impact, and quality risk analysis.

· Ability to analyze requirements, identify edge cases, distinguish true defects from expected business variance, and communicate findings clearly.

· SQL and data quality fundamentals, including joins, aggregations, exception queries, duplicate detection, null analysis, referential integrity checks, record-count validation, and trend analysis.

· Strong secure data handling discipline, including preventing confidential, proprietary, client, colleague, production, PII, or PHI data from being entered into public AI tools.

AI Required and Preferred Skills.

**(REQUIREMENTS)**

**Skill Area**

**Requirement / Posting Language**

**AI-assisted data analysis**

Experience using generative AI tools to accelerate data profiling, SQL analysis, data quality rule design, query explanation, documentation, and issue summarization.

**Prompt engineering**

Ability to write clear prompts for data validation scenarios, anomaly detection logic, SQL troubleshooting, reconciliation checks, and data quality reporting.

**AI output validation**

Ability to critically review AI-generated SQL, data quality rules, test cases, and summaries for accuracy, completeness, privacy, and business relevance.

**Data analysis and RCA**

Ability to profile datasets, identify patterns, isolate root causes, document evidence, and recommend corrective actions.

**Preferred AI usage**

Experience with ETL validation, source-to-target reconciliation, data lineage, data observability, BI/report validation, data governance, and automated data quality checks.

**Application and Interview**

By applying for a position with Alight, you understand that, should you be made an offer, it will be contingent on your undergoing and successfully completing a background check consistent with Alight’s employment policies. Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: Government ID validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.

Alight requires all virtual interviews to be conducted on video. Please be aware that Alight is a camera-on culture and may require occasional travel to one of our physical office locations.

**Our commitment to Inclusion**

description:

382656
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

The Storage Engineering team is seeking a Senior / Lead Infrastructure Engineer with deep expertise in enterprise storage platforms, data protection ecosystems, and automation frameworks to lead validation and testing efforts. This role will drive automation strategy, testing frameworks, and large-scale validation to ensure the reliability, performance, and resilience of storage systems, with a primary focus on accelerating patching across the environment.
  
  
**In this role, you will:**

* Lead automation frameworks (Python, Playwright/Selenium) for validating storage and data workflows supporting accelerated patching
* Design and execute validation for:

+ High-velocity patch distribution and deployment workflows
+ Storage performance during patching (IOPS, throughput, latency)
+ API and distributed system integration for patch orchestration

* Define and execute validation strategies across:

+ PowerMax / PowerFlex (high-performance block storage)
+ NetApp FAS (multi-protocol access for distributed repositories)
+ StorageGRID (S3 object storage for artifacts, staging, and distribution)
+ Cohesity (backup, recovery, and cyber resilience)

* Validate data protection, replication, and disaster recovery for storage systems supporting accelerated patching
* Build reusable automation frameworks and integrate into CI/CD pipelines for continuous validation
* Use Terraform (IaC) to provision and validate storage environments optimized for rapid patching
* Drive testing for:

+ Data integrity and consistency of patch artifacts
+ High-volume data movement across environments and endpoints

* Lead deep troubleshooting and root cause analysis across storage and patch deployment workflows

**Platform Focus Areas**

* Cohesity: Backup/restore, cyber recovery, and protection of repositories and configurations
* PowerMax / PowerFlex: Low-latency, high-throughput storage to support rapid patch deployment
* NetApp FAS: Shared access (NFS/SMB/iSCSI/FC) for staging, repositories, and lifecycle management
* StorageGRID: S3 object storage for artifact storage, ingestion, and large-scale distribution

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 5+ years in storage, automation, or infrastructure engineering
* Strong Python and automation experience
* Knowledge of block, file, object storage, and data protection

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 5+ years with enterprise storage platforms (Cohesity, PowerMax/PowerFlex, NetApp, StorageGRID)
* Experience leading automation and validation for distributed infrastructure systems and patch deployment processes
* Expertise in:

+ High-volume data delivery and validation
+ Backup/restore, replication, and DR at scale
+ Data integrity and large artifact handling
+ Terraform (IaC) and CI/CD integration
+ Advanced troubleshooting across storage, compute, and distributed systems

**Desired Qualifications**

* Direct experience supporting accelerated patching initiatives or large-scale update delivery environments
* Multi-cloud storage architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Kubernetes/CSI storage integrations
* Performance benchmarking for high-throughput systems
* Observability tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk)

**Job Expectations**

* Act as SME for storage and data infrastructure with a focus on accelerating patching across storage systems
* Lead cross-functional initiatives across Storage, DevOps, and Platform Engineering teams
* Deliver scalable, production-grade automation for validation and patch delivery workflows
* Drive improvements in system performance, scalability, resiliency, and patch deployment velocity
* Mentor engineers and provide clear technical insights and recommendations

title: IoT Engineer (Development & Implementation)
description:
**IoT Engineer (Development & Implementation)**

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a hands-on IoT Engineer with end-to-end expertise in designing, developing, and deploying scalable Internet of Things (IoT) solutions. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between physical hardware (sensors, actuators, edge gateways) and cloud/on-premise data platforms. You will be responsible for taking IoT initiatives from laboratory prototyping through to ruggedized field implementation across distributed sites.

**Key Responsibilities**

**● End-to-End Architecture:**
Design and build full-stack IoT architectures encompassing sensor nodes, edge computing gateways, communication networks, and central data ingestion pipelines.

**● Firmware & Edge Development:**
Write, test, and optimize embedded code and edge software (C/C++, Python, Embedded Linux) for microcontrollers and industrial gateways.

**● Protocol & Network Integration:**
Implement reliable device-to-cloud and device-to-device communication using industrial and IoT protocols (MQTT, CoAP, Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC-UA, HTTP/HTTPS, LoRaWAN, BLE, or Cellular/4G/5G).

**● Field Deployment & Commissioning:**
Lead on-site installation, sensor calibration, gateway provisioning, and network troubleshooting across operational facilities.

**● Data Pipeline & Dashboarding:**
Integrate telemetry streams into time-series databases (InfluxDB, TimescaleDB) and enterprise systems (ERP/SCADA/Cloud IoT cores), building real-time monitoring and alerting dashboards.

**● Security & Fleet Management:**
Implement device-level security (TLS/SSL, secure boot, encrypted credentials) and manage Over-The-Air (OTA) firmware updates for deployed fleets.

**● Reliability & Maintenance:**
Diagnose hardware failures, signal dropouts, and power-consumption bottlenecks in harsh or remote operating environments.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

● Education: B.Tech/B.E. in Electronics & Communication, Electrical, Instrumentation, Computer Science, or a related engineering field.

● Experience: 3–6+ years of demonstrable experience in full-cycle IoT development and field deployment (Industrial IoT/IIoT experience is highly preferred).

● Hardware Proficiency: Hands-on experience with MCUs/SoCs (ESP32, STM32, ARM Cortex), Single Board Computers (Raspberry Pi, NVIDIA Jetson, Industrial Edge PCs), and industrial PLCs/sensors.

● Software & Cloud: Proficiency in C/C++ and Python; experience with Docker at the edge, Linux administration, and IoT platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT, ThingsBoard, or custom self-hosted stacks).

● Tooling: Ability to use hardware debugging tools (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers) and schematic/PCB review tools.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Visiblaze is building Visiblaze IQ, an AI-powered cybersecurity posture management, threat investigation, and compliance automation platform designed to help organizations strengthen their cloud security.

By combining artificial intelligence, autonomous agents, cloud-native technologies, and intelligent automation, we aim to transform how organizations detect, investigate, and respond to security risks.

We are looking for motivated and technically capable AI Software Engineers who are passionate about building intelligent, scalable, and reliable software systems.

The position begins with a structured six-month internship, providing hands-on experience in AI engineering, agentic architectures, backend systems, and cloud technologies. High-performing candidates will be considered for a full-time Software Engineer position.

AI & Agentic Systems Engineering

* Design, develop, and integrate AI-powered capabilities into the Visiblaze IQ platform.
* Build and enhance applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), autonomous AI agents, and agentic workflows.
* Implement LLM integrations, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and context-aware AI interactions.
* Contribute to AI-driven security investigations, automated reasoning, and intelligent decision-support systems.
* Explore and implement agent orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and related technologies.
* Evaluate and optimize AI systems for accuracy, reliability, performance, and scalability.

Software & Backend Engineering

* Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and platform components.
* Build integrations between AI systems, cloud services, databases, and internal applications.
* Develop modular, maintainable, and secure software following established engineering practices.
* Contribute to asynchronous processing, event-driven workflows, and distributed system components.
* Participate in code reviews, debugging, automated testing, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Cloud & Cybersecurity Integration

* Develop integrations with cloud infrastructure, security services, and third-party platforms.
* Work with AWS and cloud-native architectures to support scalable AI-powered applications.
* Contribute to intelligent security monitoring, threat investigation, and compliance automation capabilities.
* Gain practical exposure to cloud identity management, security events, infrastructure monitoring, and security best practices.

Research & Innovation

* Research emerging technologies in Generative AI, autonomous agents, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and intelligent automation.
* Prototype and evaluate new AI capabilities for real-world product applications.
* Explore techniques for improving AI reasoning, retrieval, context management, and workflow orchestration.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to translate technical research into production-ready solutions.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming.
* Foundational knowledge of software development, APIs, databases, and system architecture.
* Basic understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models, and AI application development.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and modern software integration practices.
* Understanding of relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Familiarity with version control systems, particularly Git.
* Strong analytical thinking, debugging, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to understand technical requirements and translate them into functional implementations.
* Effective communication, collaboration, and documentation skills.
* Willingness to learn, adapt, and work in a fast-paced engineering environment.
* Availability to work on-site in Gurugram.

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to one or more of the following technologies or concepts would be advantageous:

* Generative AI & LLMs: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, or open-source language models.
* Agentic AI Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or equivalent orchestration frameworks.
* AI Agent Development: Tool calling, autonomous workflows, multi-step reasoning, agent coordination, and workflow automation.
* Retrieval & Knowledge Systems: RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and context retrieval.
* Cloud Technologies: AWS, GCP, Azure, and cloud-native application architectures.
* DevOps & Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and GitHub Actions.
* Distributed Systems: Microservices, asynchronous processing, message queues, and event-driven architectures.
* Cybersecurity Fundamentals: Cloud security, IAM, threat detection, security monitoring, and compliance.
* Practical Experience: Academic projects, internships, open-source contributions, or independently developed AI applications.

Prior professional experience in AI development is not mandatory. Candidates demonstrating strong engineering fundamentals, practical project experience, and the ability to independently explore and implement new technologies are encouraged to apply.

Expectations During the First Six Months

Successful candidates are expected to:

* Contribute to the development and delivery of AI-powered product features.
* Develop practical proficiency in LLM integrations, agentic workflows, and AI orchestration.
* Participate in designing and implementing end-to-end AI and backend workflows.
* Gain hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, distributed services, and SaaS engineering practices.
* Build foundational knowledge of cybersecurity operations and intelligent security automation.
* Demonstrate consistent improvement in technical execution, code quality, and problem-solving.
* Progress from supervised assignments toward independent ownership of defined features or modules.

Performance during the internship will be evaluated based on technical competency, quality of deliverables, ownership, collaboration, and overall contribution.

Why Join Visiblaze?

* AI-First Product Engineering: Contribute to the development of intelligent cybersecurity systems powered by Generative AI and autonomous agents.
* Practical Engineering Exposure: Work on real-world challenges involving AI orchestration, backend development, cloud infrastructure, and cybersecurity.
* Technical Mentorship: Collaborate closely with experienced engineers and company leadership.
* Meaningful Ownership: Participate in the complete engineering lifecycle, from technical design and implementation to testing and deployment.
* Accelerated Professional Growth: Opportunities to take ownership of significant product features and engineering modules within 12–18 months.
* Innovation-Driven Environment: Work in a collaborative engineering culture that encourages experimentation, continuous learning, and technical excellence.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are seeking individuals who combine strong software engineering fundamentals with a genuine interest in artificial intelligence and emerging technologies.

The ideal candidate demonstrates curiosity about how intelligent systems work, approaches technical challenges systematically, and can translate complex requirements into reliable software solutions.

We value technical depth, problem-solving ability, engineering discipline, adaptability, and a strong sense of ownership.

At Visiblaze, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of AI-powered cybersecurity technologies while building a strong foundation in modern software and AI engineering.

title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
As a Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will design, build, and optimize the software and systems that power OCI AI compute infrastructure, including the GPU control plane and GPU data plane. You will combine software development and systems expertise to improve how GPU and bare metal resources are tested, provisioned, and operated. You will work with engineering, operations, and product teams to solve infrastructure problems, improve workload performance, and deliver a reliable customer experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop scalable infrastructure services and features for the GPU control plane, GPU data plane, and bare metal systems supporting customer AI workloads.
* Build and improve automation for testing, provisioning, and validating GPU and bare metal compute resources to support reliable customer delivery.
* Develop modular, reusable infrastructure components with clear interfaces, security and compliance controls, diagnostics, telemetry, and production monitoring.
* Apply system design and distributed systems principles to resolve infrastructure bottlenecks and improve scalability, reliability, and workload performance.
* Collaborate with development, operations, and product management teams to translate requirements into practical infrastructure and orchestration solutions.
* Define benchmarks and automate performance and reliability measurements across customer workloads and the underlying infrastructure stack.
* Provide technical guidance on ambiguous problems, mentor junior developers, and strengthen design reviews, coding standards, code reviews, unit testing, and integration testing.
* Provide operational support and drive continuous improvements to enable GPU delivery to customers at scale.
* Collaborate across geographies to deliver features, bug fixes, and operational enhancements.
* Take end-to-end ownership and accountability for IDC-owned scope, including feature development and program delivery.

**Qualifications & Skills Mandatory**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of software development experience using one or more languages such as Java, Go, C, C++, C#, or Rust.
* At least 3 years of experience designing and developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, and services.
* At least 1 year of experience providing technical leadership and bringing clarity to cross-functional projects while collaborating with stakeholders.
* Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals, including system design, distributed systems concepts, and systematic troubleshooting across software and infrastructure.
* Clear communication, ownership of outcomes, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Hands-on software development experience in Java or Go; these are the preferred languages for the team.
* Experience combining GPU infrastructure knowledge with software development, particularly in testing, provisioning, or operating GPU systems.
* Experience developing software for bare metal systems or cloud infrastructure, providing a relevant foundation for GPU infrastructure work.
* Cloud native engineering experience, including Docker, Kubernetes, or related containerization and orchestration technologies.
* Experience scheduling high-performance workloads using Kubernetes or Slurm.
* Experience building or managing cloud infrastructure at very large scale, including environments with hundreds of thousands of servers.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I meet the required software development experience, and can I explain software I have built and maintained in a relevant programming language?
* Can I describe at least 3 years of work designing or developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems, or services, including key design tradeoffs?
* Can I demonstrate how I used both software and systems knowledge to diagnose an infrastructure problem and improve reliability or performance?
* Can I share examples from at least 1 year of providing technical direction and resolving ambiguity while working with cross-functional stakeholders?
* Can I explain how I take ownership of delivery, communicate technical decisions clearly, and manage competing priorities?

That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer - AI Infrastructure
description:
**Job Description**
As a Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer, you will own the software design and development of major components of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. You should be a curious problem solver, a distributed systems generalist, and a hands-on software developer with exposure to Linux, systems fundamentals, and systems troubleshooting. You should be eager to explore different parts of the stack, understand low-level system behavior, and design and build scalable distributed services. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn.
  
  
This role resides within the Compute Bare Metal Provisioning team, which owns the critical infrastructure responsible for automating the full server lifecycle—from new platform and shape creation to hardware bring-up, customer-ready instance provisioning, and firmware management. Our services operate at the intersection of bare metal hardware and full-stack orchestration frameworks, bringing together distributed systems development, Linux, and firmware integration. The team interfaces directly with components such as BMCs, NICs, SmartNICs, ILOMs, GPUs, and custom firmware stacks.
  
  
You will write code, design services, and build tooling that provisions, configures, secures, and validates server platforms across OCI’s massive fleet of Compute and GPU infrastructure. You will partner closely with teams across Compute, Networking, Security, Data Center Engineering, and Hardware Development to help OCI launch, scale, and maintain new server platforms with high reliability and minimal operational overhead. You will work directly with cutting-edge GPU hardware and see the impact of your work on the business.
  
  
You will join a smart, motivated, and diverse team with the autonomy and support to do your best work. This role offers significant opportunities for growth and hands-on learning, allowing you to expand your skills in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Linux, hardware integration, and firmware orchestration. You will build on your existing strengths while developing new expertise through challenging engineering problems and collaboration with experienced colleagues.
  
  
If you are interested in building large-scale distributed infrastructure for the cloud, writing software for cutting-edge GPU infrastructure and the latest Compute systems, and expanding your Linux and systems skills, this is your team. Oracle is aggressively investing in Oracle Cloud to provide the broadest, most comprehensive cloud in the industry.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

You should be a strong, hands-on software developer, a driven problem solver, and a distributed systems generalist with exposure to Linux and systems fundamentals. You will design, develop, operate, and debug services across the stack, working with technologies such as Linux, Docker, Java web services, and Terraform to build reliable, scalable distributed infrastructure.
  
  
You should take initiative, identify opportunities for improvement, and deliver results wherever needed. You should value simplicity and scale, work comfortably in a collaborative, agile environment, and be excited to learn. * Experience building multi-tenant or virtualized infrastructure is a strong plus.

title: Senior AI Solutions Architect
description:
**Job Description:**

We are looking for a
**“Senior Solution Architect”**

with strong hands-on coding expertise and experience designing and developing scalable, secure, and high-performance applications using modern technologies.

The ideal candidate should have a solid software engineering background, expertise in cloud-native architectures, and practical experience building and deploying AI agents and LLM-powered applications. This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can drive architecture decisions while actively contributing to development and implementation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance software architectures aligned with business requirements.
* Develop production-grade applications, APIs, microservices, and distributed systems using modern programming languages and frameworks.
* Build and integrate AI agents, agentic workflows, and LLM-powered solutions into enterprise applications.
* Implement AI capabilities such as tool calling, RAG, workflow orchestration, and integration with enterprise systems.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, AI frameworks, and architectural patterns.
* Lead technical design discussions, conduct code reviews, and establish engineering standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with product managers, stakeholders, and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Optimize application performance, scalability, reliability, and security.
* Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, monitoring, and DevOps practices.
* Mentor developers and provide technical guidance throughout the software development lifecycle.

**Required Technical Skills:**

**1. Software Development**

* Strong hands-on coding experience in one or more languages: Python, Java, C#, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Excellent understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and design patterns.
* Experience developing, debugging, and optimizing production-grade applications.

**2. Solution Architecture**

* Expertise in microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and RESTful APIs.
* Experience designing scalable, highly available, and secure enterprise applications.
* Knowledge of domain-driven design, system integration, and architectural documentation.

**3. AI Agents & Generative AI**

* Hands-on experience developing and deploying AI agents for real-world applications.
* Strong understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, tool calling, and agent orchestration.
* Experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise data integration.
* Understanding of AI agent evaluation, guardrails, security, and performance optimization.
* Experience integrating LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Gemini.

**4. Cloud & DevOps**

* Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
* Familiarity with automated testing, logging, monitoring, and deployment practices.

**5. Databases & Integration**

* Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, or Redis.
* Knowledge of third-party API integrations and enterprise system connectivity.
* Familiarity with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging technologies is an advantage.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 10+ years of software development experience, including significant experience in solution architecture or technical leadership.
* Proven track record of delivering production-ready applications using modern technology stacks.
* Experience deploying and maintaining AI agent solutions in production environments.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Requirement: Strong hands-on coding skills and practical experience developing AI agents are essential. Candidates with architecture-only experience and limited coding exposure will not be suitable.**

title: SCT-Tech Enablment-Aera Technology-Senior
description:

**CNS (300)**
**-**
**Senior Consultant - Aera Technology**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As an Aera Techno-Functional Senior, you will support the design, configuration, testing, and deployment of Decision Intelligence solutions. You will work with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate decision requirements into data, logic, user experience, and action-oriented solution components.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Gather and document business processes, decision points, KPIs, pain points, data needs, and expected outcomes.
* Convert functional requirements into solution designs covering data preparation, curated data views, rules, recommendations, workflows, user screens, and actions.
* Use SQL to profile, reconcile, transform, and validate data across source and curated datasets.
* Configure and test Aera solution components under the guidance of solution leads and architects.
* Prepare test scenarios, execute unit and functional testing, support user acceptance testing, and resolve defects.
* Create clear functional and technical documentation, including mappings, logic, assumptions, test evidence, and operating guidance.
* Collaborate with client teams, data engineers, developers, and project managers to manage dependencies and delivery risks.
* Support production deployment, hypercare, issue triage, and continuous improvement of deployed solutions.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute reusable delivery assets and best practices.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business analytics, supply chain, operations, finance, or a related field.
* Master’s degree or MBA from Tier 1 institute will be preferred.
* 5+ years of overall experience in technology consulting, analytics, enterprise applications, data solutions, or business process transformation.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, data quality checks, and performance-aware query design.
* Ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation in a techno-functional role.
* Experience with requirements gathering solution design, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Understanding of data models, integrations, business rules, workflows, and enterprise application delivery.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Prior hands-on Aera experience is a strong plus.
* Experience in Decision Intelligence, supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial, or finance use cases.
* Exposure to cloud data platforms, APIs, ETL/ELT, reporting, Python, or advanced analytics.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models and distributed global teams.

**What We Look For**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery-focused mindset.
* Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

title: Principal Product Manager - Prisma AIRS - Bangalore
description:
**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
****Who We Are****
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
****Job Summary****
**The Team**
Engineering - Our engineering team is at the core of our products and connected directly to the mission of preventing cyberattacks. We are constantly innovating — challenging the way we, and the industry, think about cybersecurity. Our engineers don’t shy away from building products to solve problems no one has pursued before. We define the industry instead of waiting for directions. We need individuals who feel comfortable in ambiguity, excited by the prospect of a challenge, and empowered by the unknown risks facing our everyday lives that are only enabled by a secure digital environment.
  
  
****Job Summary****
As a Principal Product Manager for the AI Security team, you will lead the strategy and development for the innovative PRISMA AIRS product line. You will define and deliver competitive service offerings by deeply understanding customer needs through collaboration with sales, marketing, and engineering. Your role is crucial in creating marketing materials and evangelizing services to enhance the customer product experience. Success in this position hinges on your ability to guide and influence diverse cross-functional teams across the organization.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Understand AI systems, their differentiation from traditional software, and the evolving AI threat landscape.
* Serve as a strategic advisor, providing expert guidance to various cross-functional teams.
* Translate customer insights and competitive intelligence into differentiated product designs for engineering teams.
* Drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating resilience and a high bias for action to meet goals.
* Use data analytics to monitor metrics, identify trends, and influence the AI Security product roadmap.
* Oversee daily product management, including feature sets and overall strategy for the AI Security space.
* Lead feature prioritization and make critical tradeoff decisions to align with strategic goals.
* Support the full New Product Introduction (NPI) lifecycle, including Beta testing and feature ramp-up.
* Conduct market analysis, develop requirements, and create business cases to define product strategy and positioning.
* Maintain a strong customer focus through active engagement and relationship development.

****Qualifications****
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field.
* Minimum of 14 years of product management experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a history of data-driven decision-making.
* Demonstrated experience with enterprise-grade products and platforms.
* Proven ability to own the full product lifecycle, from conception to launch.
* Experience working effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
* Experience thriving in an agile environment with rapid iteration and collaborative work sessions.
* A demonstrable and consistent track record of success in previous roles.

****Preferred Qualifications****

* Advanced degree such as an MBA or equivalent.
* Product management experience for AI/ML or Cybersecurity-driven products.
* Experience with cybersecurity and AI/ML-powered solutions for an enterprise platform.

**Our Commitment**
We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
  
  
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
  
  
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: B2B SaaS Product Manager
description:
We are specifically looking for a Product Manager with
**proven, hands-on experience in owning and building B2B SaaS / technology products.**

The ideal candidate should have experience across
**0-to-1 and 1-to-N product journeys**
—from identifying problems and validating opportunities to defining, building, launching, scaling, and continuously improving products.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in
**startups, product-led companies, or lean product teams**
, with significant end-to-end product ownership. Experience as a
**Founding Product Manager, first/only Product Manager, or a PM working closely with founders/CEO**
will be highly relevant. This role requires someone who can
**build a new product from scratch while also owning and evolving existing products and product lines.**

**About the Company**

Smart Food Safe is a pioneering software company specializing in
**Quality, Food Safety, Regulatory, and Traceability management solutions**
. The company provides a customizable suite of advanced tools designed to streamline processes, ensure compliance, and improve product quality, empowering organizations of all sizes.

With a strong focus on innovation and real-time operational visibility, Smart Food Safe helps businesses address emerging food safety and regulatory challenges. By combining cutting-edge technology with an affordable and customer-centric approach, the company remains a trusted partner in optimizing food safety and quality management across the supply chain.

As a
**Product Manager**

**strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end execution**
of Smart Food Safe’s B2B SaaS products.

**CEO, engineering, design, QA, marketing, sales, and functional teams**

**0-to-1**
, and evolve existing products from
**1-to-N**
.

**product thinking, customer understanding, ownership, and execution ability**

  **customer problems, market opportunities, and product ideas**
  through research, discovery, and customer interactions.
* Own products
  **end-to-end**
  , from discovery and definition through development, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

  **0-to-1**
  and scale/refine existing products from
  **1-to-N**
  .
* Translate customer needs and business requirements into
  **PRDs, BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and feature specifications**
  .
* Manage and prioritize the
  **product backlog**
  and work closely with engineering during sprint planning, development, testing, and releases.
* Collaborate with
  **engineering, design, and QA teams**
  to ensure timely and high-quality product delivery.
* Track
  **product metrics, customer feedback, and usage patterns**
  to identify improvements and measure product performance.
* Work closely with
  **sales, marketing, and functional consulting teams**
  on product positioning, customer requirements, and go-to-market initiatives.
* Engage directly with customers and stakeholders to
  **understand problems, validate solutions, and gather product insights**
  .
* Maintain
  **Jira or other product/project management platforms**
  to support the technology team and ensure execution visibility.

**Required Skillset**

* Proven experience managing and owning
  **B2B SaaS / technology products**
  and complete product lifecycles.
* Strong understanding of
  **0-to-1 product development and 1-to-N product scaling**
  .
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and
  **data-driven product decision-making**
  skills.
* Ability to work effectively in
  **Agile/Scrum**
  development environments.
* Experience with product management tools such as
  **Jira, Notion, Confluence, ClickUp, or similar**
  .
* Basic understanding of
  **software development, APIs, integrations, AI, and modern web applications**
  .
* Familiarity with product design and collaboration tools such as
  **Figma or similar platforms**
  .
* Strong
  **communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration**
  skills.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership, and operate effectively in a
  **fast-paced startup environment**
  .
* Prior experience working on
  **AI-related SaaS products**
  is a good-to-have.

**Education & Experience**

* **4+ years of experience in Product Management**
  , preferably in B2B SaaS, technology, or product-based companies.
* Demonstrated experience of
  **end-to-end product ownership**
  , preferably in a startup or lean product environment.

  **Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field**
  .

title: Senior Product Manager I (Adtech)
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the role
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead products and capabilities that measure national and local television audiences across linear broadcast, cable, and streaming environments. This role sits at the intersection of media measurement, data science, technology, and client needs—turning complex viewing signals into trusted, actionable audience insights for programmers, advertisers, agencies, and other media stakeholders.
  
  
The ideal candidate understands how television is bought, sold, distributed, and measured across fragmented platforms. You will define product strategy, translate industry requirements into an actionable roadmap, and guide cross-functional teams from concept through launch and ongoing improvement.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Own product strategy and roadmap for cross-platform television audience measurement capabilities spanning national and local markets.
* Translate customer, market, and regulatory needs into clear product requirements, success metrics, and prioritized investments.
* Partner with data science, engineering, research, operations, sales, and customer success to deliver scalable, reliable measurement products.
* Drive measurement solutions across linear and streaming environments, including audience estimates, reach and frequency, impressions, demographic reporting, time-shifted viewing, and deduplicated cross-platform audiences.
* Evaluate the integration and use of viewing data from panels, return-path data, set-top boxes, smart TVs, streaming platforms, and other data sources while maintaining methodological rigor.
* Lead discovery with clients and industry stakeholders to identify unmet needs and validate product direction.
* Define operating models and quality standards that support data accuracy, comparability, transparency, and timely delivery across national and local markets.
* Communicate product vision, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
* Mentor product managers and contribute to stronger product practices, decision frameworks, and team development.

**Qualifications**
What you bring
  
  

* 6+ years of experience in product management, media measurement, audience analytics, advertising technology, streaming, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience taking data-intensive products from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of television and video ecosystems, including broadcast, cable, streaming, connected TV, local markets, ad-supported programming, and media buying.
* Familiarity with audience measurement concepts such as ratings, share, reach, frequency, impressions, demographics, viewing duration, co-viewing, time shifting, and cross-platform duplication.
* Experience working with large-scale data sets, data partnerships, APIs, and/or analytical platforms; comfort partnering deeply with technical teams.
* Ability to balance methodological integrity, customer value, operational feasibility, and commercial priorities.
* Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Experience influencing without direct authority in a matrixed, cross-functional environment.

Success in this role
  
  
In the first year, you will establish a clear roadmap for cross-platform television measurement, strengthen alignment between customer needs and delivery teams, and launch improvements that increase trust, usability, and coverage across national and local audiences.
  
  
Why join us
  
  
You will help shape the next generation of television audience measurement as viewing continues to fragment across traditional and streaming platforms. This is an opportunity to influence an industry-critical product area, work with sophisticated data and technology, and make measurement more transparent, comparable, and useful for the marketplace.
  
  
**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Product Manager - MUAS
