title: Senior Category Manager (Global)
description:
**Role Snapshot:**

As the Senior Category Manager, you will own the business P&L and drive its growth by building a relevant product catalog, defining pricing strategies, identifying new business opportunities, and improving app orders and customer conversion.

You will work closely with the puja calendar owner, marketing, creative, product, and retention teams, to translate regional rituals, festivals, and customer insights into commercially successful offerings.

This role offers the opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up, with significant ownership and the ability to shape category strategy.

**What you’ll Champion:**

**1.Growth & App Order Expansion**

* Drive growth in business orders through relevant category initiatives and customer-focused offerings.
* Identify opportunities across app discovery, merchandising, conversion funnels, and customer journeys.
* Partner with product and growth teams to improve category visibility, conversion, and repeat engagement.
* Analyse customer behaviour and business data to identify growth levers and prioritise high-impact initiatives.

**2.Cross-functional Execution**

* Collaborate with marketing,Retention team, creative teams to develop compelling campaigns, product communication, and festival-led initiatives.
* Work with product, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure smooth execution of category launches and business initiatives.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders and ensure timely execution of priorities.
* Take ownership of outcomes while operating with limited hand-holding in a fast-paced environment.

**3.Business & P&L Ownership**

* Own the end-to-end P&L , driving revenue growth, profitability, and sustainable business performance.
* Define business goals, key performance indicators, and category-level growth plans.
* Identify opportunities to improve margins, increase average order value (AOV), and drive repeat purchases.
* Track business performance, identify gaps, and take data-backed decisions to improve outcomes.

**4.Category Strategy & Catalog Development**

* Define product assortment, SKUs, bundles, and offerings for key rituals, festivals, and everyday devotional needs.
* Identify underserved customer segments and new category opportunities.
* Work with relevant teams to evaluate product feasibility, availability, and operational readiness before launching new offerings.
* Continuously refine the catalog based on customer demand, sales performance, and emerging opportunities.

**5.Pricing & Commercial Strategy**

* Define pricing strategies for new and existing offerings, balancing customer value, competitiveness, and profitability.
* Run pricing experiments to understand customer willingness to pay and improve conversion.
* Evaluate product-level economics, margins, discounts, and promotional effectiveness.
* Develop strategies for bundling, upselling, and cross-selling to improve revenue per order.

**6.Festival, Ritual & Consumer Insights**

* Partner closely with the puja calendar owner to understand upcoming festivals, regional rituals, and high-intent purchase occasions.
* Translate festival calendars and ritual insights into relevant products, bundles, campaigns, and launch plans.
* Develop a deep understanding of Indian devotional practices and differences in customer preferences across regions.
* Use customer feedback, market research, and sales trends to continuously improve the category proposition.

**What is needed for this role**

* **Category management experience:**
  Experience managing a category or business with clear ownership of commercial outcomes, revenue, or P&L.
* **Strong commercial acumen:**
  Ability to make sound decisions on pricing, assortment, margins, promotions, and business growth.
* **Entrepreneurial mindset:**
  Comfortable building from the ground up, navigating ambiguity, and taking end-to-end ownership.
* **Analytical thinking:**
  Ability to interpret business metrics, identify opportunities, and convert insights into actionable growth plans.
* **Customer-centricity:**
  Strong understanding of consumer behaviour and the ability to build offerings around customer needs.
* **Execution excellence:**
  Ability to work cross-functionally, manage multiple priorities, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* **Learning agility:**
  Curiosity to understand Indian rituals, regional nuances, and devotional customer needs, even without prior domain expertise.

**You'll thrive if you**

* Experience in quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C, online marketplaces, or other consumer internet businesses.
* Experience managing a category or business with revenue and profitability targets.
* Exposure to assortment planning, pricing experiments, promotions, merchandising, and conversion optimization.
* Familiarity with devotional categories is an advantage, but not mandatory.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Hiring: Project Manager – Aeon Talent Studio**

**Location:**
Kolkata / Bengaluru, India

**Experience:**
5+ years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Work Model:**
Hybrid

**Certifications:**
PMP and CSM/PSM or equivalent Agile certification mandatory

**About MSH**

MSH is a global consulting firm headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, delivering Talent Solutions and Technology Solutions to organisations worldwide. With experience spanning more than 15,000 placements and a customer base that includes 150+ Fortune 500 companies, MSH combines deep talent industry expertise with technology-led solutions.

About Aeon Talent Studio

Aeon Talent Studio is MSH’s cloud-based talent intelligence platform, built on our extensive recruitment expertise and designed to support business users with talent workflows and insights.

We are looking for a Project Manager who can bring structure, prioritisation and accountability to an evolving technology product — someone who can translate business feedback into a clear roadmap and drive delivery from planning through release.

The Opportunity

This is not a conventional project-tracking role. You will take ownership of product delivery, working closely with Product, Engineering, QA, UI/UX, Infrastructure and business stakeholders across India and the US.

You will help establish clear delivery milestones, define Phase 1 closure criteria, structure Phase 2 and ensure that the team focuses on the right priorities at the right time.

Key Responsibilities

* **Own end-to-end product delivery:**
  Establish clear scope, milestones, deliverables, owners and target dates across product development and releases.
* **Drive roadmap execution:**
  Translate business objectives and user feedback into a prioritised, actionable product backlog.
* **Prioritise effectively:**
  Evaluate requests based on business value, user impact, urgency, effort, dependencies and technical feasibility.
* **Establish delivery discipline:**
  Define Phase 1 completion criteria, structure Phase 2 and maintain a practical roadmap for subsequent releases.
* **Partner with Engineering:**
  Work closely with technical leads and developers to understand estimates, dependencies, architectural constraints and delivery risks.
* **Manage Agile delivery:**
  Drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, release planning and delivery tracking.
* **Coordinate cross-functional teams:**
  Align Product, Engineering, QA, UI/UX, Infrastructure and business stakeholders on priorities and commitments.
* **Manage risks and dependencies:**
  Maintain RAID logs, resolve blockers, manage scope changes and communicate delivery risks proactively.
* **Drive quality and release readiness:**
  Coordinate UAT, defect resolution, acceptance criteria, deployment readiness and post-release validation.
* **Leverage AI in delivery:**
  Use tools such as Claude, GitHub Copilot or equivalent to improve analysis, prioritisation, problem-solving and delivery effectiveness — beyond routine documentation.

What We’re Looking For

* 5+ years of experience in IT Project Management, Technical Project Management, Software Delivery or Technology Programme Management.
* Proven experience delivering software products, platforms or enterprise applications through the SDLC.
* Mandatory PMP certification and CSM, PSM or an equivalent recognised Agile/Scrum certification.
* Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum, backlog management, sprint planning, release management and delivery governance.
* Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Project or similar project management tools.
* Strong stakeholder management, risk assessment, dependency management, resource planning and change control skills.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into clear priorities, actionable deliverables and measurable outcomes.
* Confidence in challenging assumptions, managing competing priorities and making evidence-based delivery recommendations.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with distributed teams across time zones.

Good to Have

* Experience in SaaS, HRTech, ATS, CRM, recruitment technology or enterprise product development.
* Exposure to APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, data products or AI-enabled applications.
* Experience working with US-based stakeholders and cross-functional global teams.
* A technical background in software development, systems engineering or solution delivery.

What Success Looks Like

* A clearly defined and executable product roadmap.
* Transparent priorities, accountable owners and realistic delivery commitments.
* A well-defined Phase 1 closure and structured Phase 2 plan.
* Faster feedback-to-delivery cycles and fewer unresolved dependencies.
* Improved collaboration between business stakeholders and Engineering.
* Measurable improvements in product quality, usability and delivery predictability.

title: Solution Architect And Product Owner
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Unified Support Services (USS) Solution Architect & Product Owner, Support Experience Platforms (U642)**
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. As part of Enterprise Technology, you'll be at the forefront of integrating technology into what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices and the chance to make a real impact.
  
  
**The opportunity**
EY's global Enterprise Technology group provides enabling services across enterprise platforms, infrastructure, digital workplace and service operations. The Solution Architect & Product Owner is a pivotal role within Unified Support Services, accountable for the end-to-end solution architecture, integration strategy, product roadmap and delivery of Support Experience platforms.
  
  
The role serves as the architectural authority for the Support Experience technology ecosystem. The individual will design, govern and enable integrated solutions across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, knowledge platforms, automation solutions and other Service Desk technologies. The role requires deep ServiceNow architecture expertise, strong systems integration capability and sufficient product ownership experience to translate business priorities into a coherent architecture and executable roadmap.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring together business, product, architecture, engineering, security, operations and vendor teams to deliver scalable, secure, resilient and user-centered support solutions from concept through implementation and operational adoption.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Act as the lead Solution Architect and design authority for the Unified Support Services Support Experience ecosystem.
* Define current-state, target-state and transition architectures for Support Experience platforms, including the supporting technology roadmap.
* Own end-to-end solution design across user channels, workflows, integrations, data, knowledge, automation, AI capabilities and operational processes.
* Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow ITSM, r, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
* Design scalable ServiceNow solutions, data models, workflows and platform extensions while protecting platform integrity, maintainability and upgradeability.
* Own the end-to-end integration strategy across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Teams, identity services, enterprise knowledge and automation platforms.
* Define API-led, event-driven, workflow-based and middleware integration patterns, including authentication, authorization, error handling, monitoring, data synchronization and recovery.
* Enable continuity of identity, conversation, intent, device context, case context and interaction history across chatbot, live chat, voice, portal, remote support and assisted-service channels.
* Lead the Genesys integration roadmap with ITSM and digital channels to support intelligent routing and escalation between virtual, digital and voice channels without avoidable loss of context.
* Architect secure integration with LogMeIn Rescue, including remote-session launch, user and case context, technician workflow, audit information and case updates.
* Architect the use of Nexthink telemetry and automation capabilities to support proactive issue identification, contextual diagnostics and remediation workflows.
* Integrate Qualtrics experience data with support platforms to enable feedback capture, experience analysis and closed-loop service improvement.
* Define knowledge integration and orchestration across ServiceNow Knowledge, OEM knowledge sources, internal runbooks and enterprise repositories.
* Define architecture patterns and governance controls for virtual agents, Copilot experiences, agent-assist capabilities, enterprise search and AI-enabled support.
* Establish architecture principles, reference architectures, reusable patterns, technical guardrails, interface standards and non-functional requirements.
* Lead solution architecture reviews and ensure alignment with Enterprise Architecture, information security, privacy, data governance, compliance and resilience requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to engineering teams, platform teams, vendors and implementation partners throughout design, build, testing, deployment and transition to operations.
* Review solution designs, integration specifications, data mappings, user stories, test strategies, release plans and production-readiness evidence.
* Own technical risks, dependencies, architecture decisions, exceptions and technical debt, ensuring timely resolution and transparent escalation.
* Define and communicate the product vision, platform strategy, value proposition and roadmap for Support Experience platforms.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, architectural dependencies, operational impact, risk and user experience outcomes.
* Translate business objectives and architecture into epics, capabilities, features, non-functional requirements, acceptance criteria and release plans.
* Partner with stakeholders to gather and refine requirements, evaluate solution options and validate that delivered capabilities meet intended outcomes.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives, while providing architecture direction and timely decisions.
* Define and monitor measures for platform adoption, reliability, integration performance, self-service, automation, experience and value realization.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior leaders and communicate architecture options, trade-offs, recommendations, risks and roadmap implications clearly.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**To qualify for the role you must have**

* 12+ years of experience across enterprise technology, solution architecture, platform engineering, IT service management or digital workplace solutions.
* 7+ years of ServiceNow solution architecture or equivalent senior technical leadership experience.
* Proven experience architecting enterprise-scale employee support, service management or omnichannel service solutions.
* Strong ServiceNow expertise across ITSM, Employee Center, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
* Demonstrated experience designing complex integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise platforms using APIs, events, middleware and orchestration technologies.
* Practical architecture or integration experience involving Genesys Cloud and one or more of LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics and Nexthink.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, event-driven architecture, integration security, identity and access management, data flows, observability and resilient interface design.
* Experience leading architecture governance, technical design reviews and delivery assurance across internal teams and external partners.
* Experience translating architecture and business priorities into product roadmaps, epics, non-functional requirements and executable delivery plans.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, decision-making and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work effectively across a complex, global and matrixed organization.
* Working knowledge of Agile delivery practices and ITIL-aligned service management processes.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator and relevant Certified Implementation Specialist credentials.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer or architect-level ServiceNow credentials; Certified Technical Architect is preferred.
* TOGAF or an equivalent enterprise architecture certification.
* Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI, conversational AI, enterprise search or knowledge graphs.
* Experience delivering Digital Employee Experience, proactive support, intelligent automation or AI-enabled IT support transformation.
* Experience defining AI, knowledge governance and data protection controls for enterprise support solutions.
* Confidence to make timely decisions, articulate trade-offs and challenge proposed options constructively.
* A customer-centric mindset and the ability to connect technical solutions to measurable user and business outcomes.

**What We Look For**

* A technology leader who combines deep ServiceNow architecture expertise with strong product judgment and end-to-end delivery accountability.
* A proven ability to define target architecture, govern complex integrations and lead cross-functional teams from strategy through implementation and operational adoption.
* Strong systems thinking and the ability to balance enterprise standards, user experience, business value, delivery pragmatism and long-term maintainability.
* Overall experience relevant to an Assistant Director-level role in enterprise support technology, solution architecture or service management transformation.
* Willingness to support a global service environment and collaborate across time zones as required.

**What We Offer**
As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, global team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here's a snapshot of what we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You'll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We'll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We'll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You'll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**Job Description**
Strategic Segment Marketing - Go-to-Market Engineer
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a business-savvy, technically curious, and commercially minded engineer who enjoys turning market insights into business growth. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguous environments, enjoys building new programs from the ground up, and wants to influence how onsemi brings system-level solutions to market. You will own the development and execution of go-to-market strategies for system-level solutions, identification of new opportunities, testing innovative approaches, measuring impact, and continuously refining strategy based on market feedback.
  
  
Success in this role requires creativity, technical credibility, business acumen, and execution. The ideal candidate will help shape solution strategy, drive ecosystem engagement, create compelling content, and deliver measurable business impact. In addition to Go to Market strategy, the role includes multiple responsibilities within solutions, including block diagram analysis, performing teardowns, BOM analysis, and understanding and communicating conclusions to segment leads and management.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine their technical background with a strong work ethic, driving continuous learning toward understanding systems, business, market trends, marketing and partnerships. Success in this role includes:
  
  

* Driving awareness, ecosystem engagement and adoption of onsemi’s and our partners’ solutions.
* Identification of market opportunities that others have overlooked.
* Creation of innovative promotion and partnership programs.
* Development of content and campaigns that generate measurable business impact.
* Building relationships across internal and external ecosystems to accelerate solution adoption.
* Bringing new ideas, challenging assumptions, and continuously improving how we engage customers.

**Responsibilities**
This multi-faceted role requires working cross-functionally across the SSM team, in addition to onsemi’s product and corporate marketing teams.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Go-to-Market Execution
  
  

* Strategize, plan and execute Go to Market tactics associated with SSM roadmaps and strategies.
* Create unique and impactful content such as white papers, videos and media interviews.
* Partner with 3 rd parties to create mutually beneficial co-promotional material.
* Collaborate with Corporate Marketing and SSM to define the target audience and appropriate promotion channels.
* Analyze the impact of each promotion and derive key insights to implement in subsequent campaigns.
* Update and involve internal stakeholders on current and future SSM promotions.

Business & Market Analysis
  
  

* Perform market research in support of TAM/SAM analysis, competitive insights and customer requirements.
* Utilize market analysis and customer insights to support Go-to-Market planning and campaign development.

Ecosystem Partnerships, Consortia & Reference Designs
  
  

* Engage with 3 rd parties, such as partners, contractors, and standards groups, in support of onsemi’s solutions strategy.
* Develop deep technical understanding of our partners’ value and business models, in addition to developing strong relationships to create fruitful, mutually beneficial engagements.

Market Insight, Teardowns
  
  

* Conduct periodic market studies to understand market technology and business trends
* Develop market insights to recommend partnerships, highlight competitors and their activity, and recommend appropriate actions
* Investigate and teardown competitive solutions to understand system architecture and recommend future developments.

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, MBA preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in semiconductors, electronics systems, product marketing, product management, applications engineering, design engineering, or related functions, or equivalent experience in system design at an original equipment manufacturer in data center, industrial/medical, automotive or aerospace and defense segments.
* Understanding of analog and power management semiconductors.
* Strong analytical skills with experience performing market analysis using tools such as Excel, Power BI and other data analysis and visualization tools.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and customer-facing skills.
* Ability to operate effectively across global and cross-functional teams.

**Preferred**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Demonstrated ability to independently identify opportunities and drive initiatives with limited direction.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and creating structure.
* Experience influencing stakeholders without direct authority.
* Curiosity about emerging technologies, business models, and market trends.
* Experience writing white papers and/or application notes
* Marketing experience, creating content and/or running campaigns.
* A strong, continuous learning mindset
* Willingness to try new tasks, solicit regular feedback and pivot as needed

Why Join Us
  
  
You will play a critical role in shaping onsemi’s transformation into a customer- and system-aware company. You will work directly with senior business leaders and world-class engineering teams, influence investment and product decisions, and help create solutions that address some of the fastest growing opportunities across automotive, industrial, data center and aerospace & defense markets. This role offers growth opportunities and the ability to influence product strategy, technology direction, and business growth in multiple rapidly expanding markets.
  
  
**About Us**
**onsemi**
(Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world’s most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world.

description:
Sourcing Manager | AltEdge Manufacturing

About AltEdge

AltEdge Manufacturing is a component sourcing and manufacturing company backed by leading venture capital firms in India. We specialize in custom metal manufacturing, including castings, machined parts, fasteners, flanges, pipes, and other industrial metal components.

We work with a network of Indian MSME manufacturing partners to deliver high-quality, customized components to customers across demanding industries, including infrastructure, mining, automotive, defence, and other industrial sectors.

About the Role

AltEdge is looking for a results-driven and commercially strong Sourcing Manager to lead strategic sourcing, vendor development, and procurement of industrial components and metal products. The role involves identifying reliable suppliers, negotiating competitive commercial terms, ensuring quality and timely delivery, and building a robust vendor network to support the company’s growing business requirements.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in industrial sourcing and procurement, a strong understanding of metal components, and excellent negotiation and supplier management skills.

Key Responsibilities

\* Vendor Identification & Development: Identify, evaluate, onboard, and develop reliable suppliers and manufacturing partners for industrial components and metal products.

We are looking for a commercially driven professional who can independently develop international markets, acquire new customers, build long-term business relationships, and take ownership of export sales growth in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

title: Senior Product Manager I (Adtech)
description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

  
  
**Job Description**

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead products and capabilities that measure national and local television audiences across linear broadcast, cable, and streaming environments. This role sits at the intersection of media measurement, data science, technology, and client needs—turning complex viewing signals into trusted, actionable audience insights for programmers, advertisers, agencies, and other media stakeholders.

The ideal candidate understands how television is bought, sold, distributed, and measured across fragmented platforms. You will define product strategy, translate industry requirements into an actionable roadmap, and guide cross-functional teams from concept through launch and ongoing improvement.

What you’ll do

* Own product strategy and roadmap for cross-platform television audience measurement capabilities spanning national and local markets.
* Translate customer, market, and regulatory needs into clear product requirements, success metrics, and prioritized investments.
* Partner with data science, engineering, research, operations, sales, and customer success to deliver scalable, reliable measurement products.
* Drive measurement solutions across linear and streaming environments, including audience estimates, reach and frequency, impressions, demographic reporting, time-shifted viewing, and deduplicated cross-platform audiences.
* Evaluate the integration and use of viewing data from panels, return-path data, set-top boxes, smart TVs, streaming platforms, and other data sources while maintaining methodological rigor.
* Lead discovery with clients and industry stakeholders to identify unmet needs and validate product direction.
* Define operating models and quality standards that support data accuracy, comparability, transparency, and timely delivery across national and local markets.
* Communicate product vision, tradeoffs, progress, and outcomes to executive stakeholders and cross-functional partners.
* Mentor product managers and contribute to stronger product practices, decision frameworks, and team development.

 **Qualifications**

What you bring

* 6+ years of experience in product management, media measurement, audience analytics, advertising technology, streaming, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience taking data-intensive products from strategy and discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Strong understanding of television and video ecosystems, including broadcast, cable, streaming, connected TV, local markets, ad-supported programming, and media buying.
* Familiarity with audience measurement concepts such as ratings, share, reach, frequency, impressions, demographics, viewing duration, co-viewing, time shifting, and cross-platform duplication.
* Experience working with large-scale data sets, data partnerships, APIs, and/or analytical platforms; comfort partnering deeply with technical teams.
* Ability to balance methodological integrity, customer value, operational feasibility, and commercial priorities.
* Excellent written, verbal, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.
* Experience influencing without direct authority in a matrixed, cross-functional environment.

Success in this role

In the first year, you will establish a clear roadmap for cross-platform television measurement, strengthen alignment between customer needs and delivery teams, and launch improvements that increase trust, usability, and coverage across national and local audiences.

Why join us

You will help shape the next generation of television audience measurement as viewing continues to fragment across traditional and streaming platforms. This is an opportunity to influence an industry-critical product area, work with sophisticated data and technology, and make measurement more transparent, comparable, and useful for the marketplace.

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Regulatory and Trade Services (ARTS Tech)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

ARTS Tech is seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer to build services that make the cross-border movement of products, software, and technology secure, lawful, and seamless. You will design and operate scalable systems that support trade classification, import and export controls, product compliance, and global expansion. This role offers the opportunity to solve complex greenfield problems, work with emerging Amazon businesses, and deliver durable solutions used across Amazon's global footprint.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design, implement, test, deploy, and operate scalable distributed services for cross-border trade and regulatory compliance.
* Translate ambiguous business and regulatory requirements into simple, maintainable technical solutions.
* Own the architecture and delivery of major features, including effort estimation and rollout planning.
* Build reliable, secure, and observable systems that meet performance and availability goals.
* Collaborate with product managers, compliance specialists, UX designers, and engineers across Amazon.
* Participate in code reviews, operational support, and continuous improvement.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to hiring and team development.

  
A day in the life  
You will work with product, compliance, and engineering partners to clarify customer needs, review designs, and build services that operate at Amazon scale. A typical day may include writing and reviewing code, resolving production issues, making architecture decisions, and planning delivery with your Scrum team. You will own the systems you build, use operational data to improve them, and help teammates grow through thoughtful design and code reviews.  
  
About the team  
Amazon Regulatory and Trade Services (ARTS) Tech builds systems that enable the secure, lawful, and efficient movement of products, software, and technology across international borders. Our solutions support trade classification, duties and import costs, export and import restrictions, and product compliance. We serve Amazon businesses—including Global Store, Direct Imports, Devices, Robotics, and Physical Stores—as well as sellers, vendors, carriers, customs brokers, and freight forwarders. We value ownership, pragmatic engineering, operational excellence, and collaborative problem solving.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Staff Engineer, Software
description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

Do you have a passion for innovative ideas and groundbreaking discoveries? With over $1 billion invested annually in R&D, at Thermo Fisher Scientific you’ll help solve some of the world’s toughest challenges, from giving cancer patients hope, ensuring safe drinking water and helping law enforcement tackle cases through forensics. We empower our teams to put science into meaningful action and give our R&D colleagues the autonomy, resources and tools they need to take science a step beyond.

**How you will make an impact**

You will be part of an innovative software team that develops instrument software that control an instrument and allows scientists to interact with instrument features intuitively. You will work closely with product managers and engineering teams around the world to develop the instrument. You will work on sophisticated solutions using full stack technology and reusable UI components.

**What you will do**

* Design and implement features based on requirements and specifications.
* Well verse in object-oriented programming and functional code design.
* Develop a novel UX, implementing the design provided by an internal team
* Development and support of GUI, analysis, communications, and instrument control software
* Integration of algorithms & mathematical functions for identification and quantification of data collected by instruments
* Understand the business needs, analyze the workflows, and carry out integrations across different sub-components.

**How you will get here**

**Education:**

Degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience

**Experience, Knowledge, Skills, Abilities**

* 10+ years of software development experience in the software industry, preferably involving hardware and software integrations. Candidates with varying levels of experience are encouraged to apply and may be considered for positions commensurate with their experience.
* 10+ years of knowledge of current software development methodologies, cybersecurity, recent trend in cybersecurity and its remediation methodology.
* 3+ years strong experience in AI tools, techniques, solutions using LLMs, RAG, AI agents

* Previous experience of developing web applications using front-end technologies like Angular, React, VueJS and Electron is a plus.

* Good understanding of data structures, design patterns, object-oriented design, and algorithms used in programming.
* Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills. Ability to manage high priority tasks and adapt to changes in priorities. Effectively communicates and illustrates ideas; contributes critically and positively to a team.

* **Results Orientation :** Translates strategy into measurable outcomes while maintaining focus on quality and continuous improvement.

**About Thermo Fisher Scientific**

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with an annual revenue of approximately $40 billion. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving sophisticated analytical challenges, growing productivity in their laboratories, improving patient health through diagnostics or the development and manufacture of life-changing therapies, we are here to support them. Our distributed team of more than 130,000 colleagues delivers an unrivalled combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and pharmaceutical services through our industry-leading brands, including Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific, Unity Lab Services, Patheon and PPD.

description:

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The SERVICENOW Automation Engineering Product Analyst supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with the Automation Engineering Architect, they help shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Automation Engineering Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the Product. In addition, this role supports the iTSM Service Catalog and will work in partnership with SERVICENOW Automation Engineering Architect for conversational/automation of forms and MSP service catalog factory for basic forms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Automation Engineering Architect to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.
* Document as-is and to-be system processes, identifying opportunities for system, process, and workflow improvement, supported by impact analysis and basic data insights.
* Document functional and non-functional requirements (e.g., security, performance, operability, accessibility), ensuring they are reflected in specifications and delivery plans.
* Document functional and technical specifications needed to deliver changes and support configuration or code delivery by providing clear design inputs; maintain configuration repositories and version updates where applicable.
* Support technical delivery teams by advising Developers and Test Analysts on expected system behaviour and acceptance criteria, informed by clear business and non-functional requirements.
* Perform functional and non-functional testing for delivered solutions and upgrades, ensuring the system fulfils requirements; support the creation of test cases and execution using test management tooling.
* Support configuration release management activities, adhering to release management policy, documenting version history, deployment notes, and release checklists.
* Develop user guides, configuration documentation, runbooks, and training materials; deliver training to key users or support teams to enable Product adoption and support readiness.
* Support the Automation Engineering Architect to identify and document additional security, data privacy, and compliance considerations (e.g., sensitive data handling), liaising with relevant SMEs to embed required controls.
* Support onboarding into GSK systems and adherence to Portfolio and platform control requirements (e.g., compliance artefacts, access controls, operability standards).
* Support the Automation Engineering Architect to identify and implement automation or workflow efficiency opportunities within the Product team, backed by basic usage metrics or adoption insights.
* Act as an escalation point for the Application Support team, advising on complex incidents and ensuring documentation and configuration records remain accurate for effective support and maintenance.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering), or equivalent experience.
* Industry certifications highly desirable (e.g. SAP certification in related area, Agile methodologies)

**Area of Specialisation**

* Strong business knowledge in a relevant functional domain (e.g., IT, Finance, R&D), with the ability to analyse business challenges using structured frameworks, model end-to-end processes (e.g., BPMN), and support delivery through familiarity with Agile practices (e.g., SAFe, Scrum, Kanban).

**Experience Required**

* Overall 10 years and typically 2–4 years’ experience in a business analysis or product-focused role supporting technology delivery.
* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments; building process flows and facilitating stakeholder sessions.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.

**Skills/Background**

* Strong attention to detail, ensuring requirements, specifications, and testing outcomes are accurately documented and traceable throughout delivery.
* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.
* Comfortable working in a structured, process-driven environment, with an appreciation of compliance, data integrity, and controlled change management practices.
* Collaborative and team-oriented, supporting cross-functional work with Product Owners, Developers, Testers, and business users.

**Skills**

Agile Methodology, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Business Requirements Analysis, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Prioritization, Processing, Process Mapping, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), ServiceNow Platform, Software Development, Stakeholder Management, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. title: Staff, AI Product Management (Global Functions)
description:
**About the Role:**

GSK’s Enterprise AI team, a highly skilled applied AI group, translates the promise of AI into measurable impact across every major group at GSK — R&D, Medical, Commercial, Supply Chain, HR, Legal, Finance, and beyond. Bionic pods — AI product managers, forward deployed engineers, full-stack engineers, data engineers, and digital workers — embed directly with scientific and business teams to build AI products that change outcomes.

We are hiring a Staff, AI Product Manager (Director level equivalent role) to own a major slice of our Global Functions portfolio and act as the strategic counterpart to the engineers and digital workers in your pod, setting the forward deployed strategy they execute against. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can identify and shape high-value AI opportunities across the key areas of Global Functions - HR, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, or Finance, build the case to fund and deploy against them, and ensure FDEs are working on what matters most. You will not manage engineers; you will shape what they build in your domain and how we measure whether it worked.

**Why This Role Exists:**

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. Enterprise AI has no separate strategy layer: the AI Product Manager sets the forward deployed strategy, and the pod executes it. This role closes that gap at this level by ensuring the engineers we deploy are working on the right things.

In this role you will be the person who:

* Owns a clear domain or capability area within the Enterprise AI opportunity portfolio.
* Identifies, sizes, and shapes the highest-value AI opportunities in that domain.
* Partners daily with forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads to scope and steer engagements end-to-end.
* Builds the business and executive alignment the pod needs to land and scale.

**How This Differs from Traditional Product Management:**

This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you:

* Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems rather than evolving an established platform.
* Work with probabilistic systems — defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight instead of fixed functional requirements.
* Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to digital workers, and how they hand off.
* Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes, not features shipped or system uptime.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Opportunity Identification & Value Sizing:**

* **Hunt for high-value AI opportunities** within your assigned domain at GSK; develop a structured pipeline of opportunities ranked by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value.
* **Quantify value rigorously.** Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, cost avoided, scientific productivity gained.
* **Develop deep domain pattern recognition** so you can spot AI-shaped problems in workflows the business itself hasn’t yet articulated.

**Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping:**

* **Shape the opportunity portfolio in your domain.** Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized opportunities, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader Enterprise AI portfolio.
* **Make trade-off recommendations.** When two business sponsors both want an FDE pod, defines the success metrics, run the analysis and recommend where engineers go.
* **Protect engineering focus.** Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes.

  

**Engineering Partnership & Enablement**

* **Be the strategic counterpart to forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads in your domain.** Translate ambiguous business problems into crisp problem statements, prototypes, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can build against.
* **Shape engagements end-to-end.** Define scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways before kick-off, then stay close as engineers execute.
* **Surface re-use and platform leverage** when a one-off solution should become a reusable capability.
* **Design the human–digital split.** Decide which tasks the pod’s digital workers own, where engineers and business users stay in the loop, and how evaluation and oversight make that safe.

**Stakeholder Alignment & Communication**

* **Operate fluently with VP-level business and scientific leaders.** Run conversations that turn fuzzy ambitions into concrete, fundable AI engagements.
* **Build sponsor coalitions** that secure data access, change-management commitment, and air cover for your engagements.
* **Communicate impact clearly** in language that connects AI work to patients, science, and enterprise outcomes.

**Measurement, Learning & Iteration**

* **Apply Enterprise AI’s value-realization framework** to every engagement in your domain and improve it with what you learn.
* **Run honest post-mortems** and feed lessons back into how your domain selects opportunities.

**Required Functional Experience:**

* 18+ years of progressive experience spanning some combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML product strategy, and senior product management or strategy roles in technology-led organisations.
* Demonstrated track record of identifying, scoping, prototyping, and shepherding high-value technology or AI initiatives from problem framing through funding into delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain — R&D, clinical, medical, manufacturing, commercial, or an enterprise function — including the data, decisions, and constraints inside it.
* Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML — LLMs, agentic systems, and digital workers, ML lifecycle, data and evaluation patterns — sufficient to leverage evidence from rapid prototyping to challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Experience operating as a senior individual contributor — leading through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking rather than headcount.
* A product management or product-strategy heritage: discovery, opportunity sizing, roadmap shaping, prototyping, and stakeholder alignment — ideally on products whose core behaviour is AI rather than conventional software.

**Skills**

AI Platforms, AI Product Management, Generative AI, Machine Learning (ML), Production Strategy, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Roadmap, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

title: Media Analyst

You will be expected to identify, recommend and execute scalable operational tactics to support the brand, engagement and performance results.

This role will be accountable to participating and enforcing key business enhancements in relation to tagging, trafficking, creative rotation, dynamic capabilities, third-party verification and all other campaigns management related functions. This vital role will continuously evolve our campaign performance and ensure stringent compliance. You will bring a data-driven approach and an eye toward technological advancements that will make Target first-to-market in the digital media space. It’s critical that this role focus on efficiencies through automation, ensuring business and brand goals are consistently achieved. You will have worked in various digital media and social platforms (IG, TikTok, YouTube, DCM, DMPs, Ad Servers) and you are expected to keep pace with the Digital and Social Advertising industries and help translate relevant industry developments into recommendation and new ideas for Target that lead to more simplicity and efficiencies in nurturing Target’s external advertising presence.

* Deep understanding of full-funnel performance marketing and how media impacts awareness, consideration, conversion, retention, and revenue growth.
* Experience with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Amazon Ads, DV360, The Trade Desk, DSPs, ad servers, retail media platforms, and measurement systems.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Implementation Engineering)
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

**Forward Deployed Engineer (Implementation Engineering)**

*Embedded, hands-on engineering with enterprise customers building AI-native software delivery*

Harness builds the AI Software Delivery Platform used by engineering organizations to automate testing, deployments, application security, reliability, and cost optimization across the software delivery lifecycle. The company is led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal, founder of AppDynamics, and is backed by leading investors. Harness customers use the platform to ship software faster while maintaining strong security and governance, and the company's AI Agents are extending that automation across the entire delivery lifecycle.

We are looking for exceptional engineers to join our fast-growing global team and help build the future of AI-native software delivery.

**Position Summary**
====================

Forward Deployed Engineers work embedded inside enterprise engineering teams to design and build AI-native automation on the Harness platform. This is a hands-on, code-first role. You will write production code and scripts, build production pipelines, and connect Harness AI Agents into a customer's existing systems, staying engaged until the capability is live in production. You will work directly alongside customer engineers, turning business objectives into working software rather than documentation or advice.

**What You'll Do**
==================

* Embed inside a customer's engineering organization for the length of a build engagement to design and build agent-driven automation across the software delivery lifecycle.
* Write production code connecting Harness AI Agents to a customer's pipelines, repositories, ITSM tooling, security systems, and infrastructure.
* Partner directly with customer engineering stakeholders and the broader Harness delivery team to translate an approved plan into working software.
* Prototype quickly, ship incrementally, and iterate directly with customer engineers rather than handing off a static design document.
* Turn what you build into reusable patterns and share them with the broader Harness delivery organization.
* Bring direct feedback to Harness product and engineering teams based on what you learn building in real customer environments.
* Support the transition from custom build to steady-state operation so the customer can independently operate and extend what you built.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* A working, production agent integration lives in the customer's environment by the end of the engagement.
* A reusable pattern or template captured in the Solutions Factory as a direct result of the build.
* Customer engineering stakeholders are able to operate and extend the integration without an ongoing Forward Deployed Engineer presence.
* Healthy, ongoing customer adoption of the Harness platform and AI Agents beyond the specific build, achieved by working closely with the customer throughout the engagement rather than handing off at go-live.
  

**About You**
=============

* A platform engineering or software engineering background, with hands-on coding, scripting, and integration ability, not configuration-only experience. You are comfortable working directly in a customer's codebase, infrastructure workflows, and CI/CD frameworks.
* Experience building integrations against APIs, event-driven systems, or LLM and agent orchestration frameworks.
* Prior experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering, architecture, or embedded consulting capacity where success was measured by working software, not documentation or advisory output.
* Strong grounding in CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code, plus depth in at least one adjacent domain, such as security, observability, or cost management, sufficient to reason about where an agent should plug into a customer's software delivery lifecycle.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity: able to work from a business objective and an agent's capability boundary to a working integration without a pre-written specification.
* Excellent stakeholder communication, able to work day to day with customer engineers while keeping internal stakeholders aligned on progress.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites for the duration of an active build.

### **Harness in the news:**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/

**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

**Reports To :** CEO

**Role Purpose**

Own and drive the complete digital brand strategy, offline/store branding, product promotional campaigns, PR, and event coordination for Koovers pan-India. The role spans social media engagement, product category, external PR/article publishing, retail branding replacement, customer/corporate events, agency management, and marketing budget governance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Digital & Social Media Communications**

* **Awareness Campaigns:** Conceptualize and execute digital awareness campaigns to drive brand recall across garages, workshops, and B2B channel partners.
* **Product Launch Promotions:** Design multi-channel launch strategies for dedicated product lines.
* **Social Media Management:** Manage organic and performance communication calendars across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, and X (Twitter).
* **Website Improvement & SEO:** Partner with technical and content teams to optimize website structure, UX content, landing pages, and search rankings to boost organic lead generation.

**Branding & Content Production**

* **Product Video Shoots:** Plan, script, and direct video shoots for product demonstrations, application usage guidelines, and promotional video clips.
* **Store Openings & Replacements:** Lead end-to-end physical branding for new Koovers store/hub openings and execute existing branding replacement audits across active locations.
* **Merchandise & Promos:** Develop branded merchandise (mechanic apparel, corporate kits) and design promotional leaflets, offer schemes, and trade flyers.

**Events & Public Relations (PR)**

* **Customer Meets & Corporate Events:** Plan and execute regional customer/mechanic meets, trade expos, internal town halls, annual leadership meets, and dealer conventions.
* **PR & Article Publishing:** Draft and publish PR stories, leadership viewpoints, tech feature articles, and press releases across trade media and industry portals.

**Agency Coordination & Budgeting**

* **Agency & Vendor Management:** Brief and supervise creative agencies, production houses, print vendors, merchandise suppliers, and freelance content creators.
* **Marketing Budgeting:** Own marketing budget allocation, track campaign ROI, optimize expenditure across digital and print channels, and maintain cost controls.

**Key Deliverables / KRAs**

* Brand awareness reach and digital engagement metrics (social media growth, website traffic).
* Successful execution and rollout of launch campaigns.
* On-time completion of new store branding and retail signage replacement projects.
* Quality execution of customer meets, corporate events, and published PR coverage.
* Strict adherence to marketing budgets, agency SLAs, and vendor turnaround times.

**Team Size & People Management**

Individual contributor initially with functional leadership over external agencies, video production teams, and print vendors. Potential to expand with junior graphic design/content support.

**Qualification**

Graduate degree required (Mass Communication, Journalism, Marketing, Visual Communication, or Business Administration). MBA/PGDM in Marketing preferred.

**Experience**

5–8 years of experience in marketing, brand management, trade marketing, or corporate communications. Proven track record in handling both digital strategy and physical event/store branding.

**Skills / Competencies – Must Have**

* Digital marketing, SEO principles, and social media analytics.
* End-to-end event management and store branding/retail execution.
* Content direction, video shoot coordination, and collateral development.
* Agency briefing, vendor negotiation, and marketing budget tracking.
* Strong written/verbal communication, press release drafting, and storytelling.

**Skills / Competencies – Good to Have**

* Basic proficiency in visual design/editing tools (Canva, Photoshop, Illustrator).
* Experience in B2B e-commerce, automotive aftermarket, logistics, or industrial products.
* PR network and trade publication contacts in auto/retail/tech sectors.

**Industry / Functional Exposure**

Automotive aftermarket, auto distribution, B2B e-commerce, retail, FMCG, logistics, or multi-location operational networks.

**Any Other Role-Specific Requirements**

Willingness to travel across Koovers store locations and event sites as required.

**Additional Inputs**

Indicative annual CTC: ₹10–15 lakh (Bengaluru location), depending on experience, skill depth, and current compensation.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Banashankari, Bengaluru, Karnataka: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* Please share your Current CTC
* Notice Period

Experience:

* Branding and Marketing: 5 years (Preferred)

title: Sr AI Engineer
description:
**About the team**

Rubrik secures and accelerates the world’s AI transformation. As AI agents reshape the enterprise, Rubrik’s Enterprise AI Incubation team proves it on Rubrik itself. We're building a thinking enterprise: applications that don't just record the business but help run it. They learn from our data, act through our own agents, and improve with every decision. Fully backed by executive leadership, this team drives meaningful, large-scale enterprise transformation.

  

**About the role**

We want senior engineers who have already shipped agents that real people rely on, and who are ready to do it again at higher stakes. You will drop into the real work, redesign it around agents that carry it end to end, and ship it as the new way that part of Rubrik operates.You’ll own your agent systems end to end: understanding the workflow, designing the architecture, writing the code, deploying, and running it in production. Rather than simply querying an API, you engineer robust, production-grade infrastructure around model endpoints, integrating custom tooling, context pipelines, automated evaluations, and defensive guardrails to ensure resilience against unstructured real-world data.

You also decide whether a problem needs an agent, a simpler automation, or nothing at all, and you have explicit authority to stop or re-scope work that won’t deliver impact. You thrive in ambiguous environments with a low-ego mindset, leveraging AI coding tools as core collaborative partners in your engineering workflow.

  

**What you’ll do**

* Lead product discovery alongside Product Managers and domain experts to understand real workflows, map them out, and define clear problems, baselines, and success criteria as the foundation for building agentic solutions.
* Design, build, test, and deploy production agents, automations, and internal tools using coding agents, LLM APIs, and agent frameworks, integrated with Rubrik’s internal agent platform and business systems.
* Turn complex processes into multi-agent workflows that carry real work and make decisions: orchestrators that qualify and routes deals, workers that move orders through approval and fulfillment under business rules, agents that monitor signals and recommend actions for customer health, or coordinated agents that handle hire-to-retire steps across HR, IT, and managers with shared state and clear handoffs.
* Engineer agents for autonomy with reliability, including tool and orchestration flows, context management, caching, retries, and failure handling.
* Leverage full-stack engineering across backend services, APIs, data models, interactive screens, approval UIs, and chat interfaces as the complete medium to deliver high-ownership, user-facing agent systems.
* Apply solid software engineering practices to AI systems, treating prompts, skills, configs, and specs as versioned artifacts, with code review, tests, CI or CD, and staged rollouts.
* Implement evaluation, guardrails, and quality control: derive evals from workflow data, establish quality gates and guardrails, integrate human-in-the-loop approvals where needed, and monitor production runs to refine agents over time.
* Use measured results to decide how to evolve or retire agents, and turn successful systems into patterns and libraries that can be reused.

**Experience you’ll need (must haves)**

* Around 7 or more years of professional software engineering experience in production systems, and around 2 or more years of professional, hands-on experience building AI agents and agent powered production applications with measurable outcomes.
* Strong full stack engineering background, with a track record of designing, building, and owning services end to end, including backend APIs and integrations, data models, and user facing interfaces such as approval UIs, dashboards, or chat surfaces.
* A builder mindset: comfortable defining baselines and metrics, reporting results in business terms, working in a fast moving environment, and closing the loop by building, demoing, learning, and building again. If you like seeing improvements in hours saved, errors avoided, and teams unblocked, you will have plenty of chances to measure that here.

**Software engineering skills and best practices**

* System design: break down complex problems, design APIs and data models, reason about latency, throughput, and failure modes, and choose simple, robust architectures.
* Algorithms, data structures, access control permissions, and data provenance.
Spec driven development: turn vague requirements into clear problem statements, write or refine design docs, and use a Spec Plan Task Code* Converge flow so work is traceable from design to code, including when you use AI coding agents.
* Execution discipline: use version control, code review, automated tests, CI or CD, staged rollouts and rollbacks, logging, metrics, and tracing, and improve systems based on issues and signals from production.

**AI engineering skills and best practices**

* Build agents in code using LLM APIs, SDKs, and libraries, not just no code or low code tools, and have shipped agentic systems that real users rely on.
* Design robust agent harnesses and multi agent orchestrations: model tools and resources, manage context and state, and keep runs reliable under real world data and load.
* Establish continuous evaluation and safety mechanisms: turn production failures into test cases, gate changes on eval suite results, and enforce guardrails across agent workflows.
* Exercise clear judgment on AI fit: decide when a problem needs an agent versus a simpler automation or no build, and make tradeoffs around model choice, latency and cost, context strategy, and autonomy using data rather than intuition.

**Preferred qualifications (nice to haves)**

* Knowledge/context graphs: entities and relationships, GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval.
* Agent frameworks and runtimes: Google ADK, LangGraph, OpenAI style, cloud or container platforms.
* Backend: Python, FastAPI or similar stacks.
* Tools integration: MCP, Slack or Teams bots, REST APIs, webhooks.
* Data systems: Snowflake, Salesforce, graph stores.
* UX: conversational flows, chat surfaces, guided forms, simple dashboards for agent output.

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK) is the Security and AI Operations Company, delivering one platform built at the intersection of data, identity, and AI. The platform enables agentic cyber resilience and trusted AI operations for enterprises worldwide, built to recover before disruption strikes and stay a step ahead, so security is never the reason ambition stalls.

  

**Inclusion @ Rubrik**
----------------------

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:**

* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**
------------------------------------------------

Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law.
