title: Manager, Enterprise Systems
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.

Labcorp is seeking a remote **Manager, Enterprise Systems** to join our team!

**Work Schedule**: This is a full‑time, exempt (salaried) position assigned to a First Shift schedule, with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 10:00 a.m. to 7.00 p.m.in your local time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for leveraging enterprise data to drive business outcomes and decision-making.
* Develop insight solutions aligned to strategic initiatives that deliver simple, compelling, and actionable data visualizations.
* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and analytical solutions using Power BI, Tableau, and other visualization platforms.

* Collaborate with business partners, product owners, business analysts, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
* Develop custom reports and data products that transform complex data into meaningful business insights.
* Design and maintain semantic models, curated datasets, business metrics, and governed reporting frameworks to support self-service analytics.
* Work closely with Data Engineering teams to build and optimize data pipelines, data models, and data structures required for reporting and analytics.

* Perform data analysis to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, opportunities, and actionable insights that support business performance improvement.

* 4 or more years of experience in developing and supporting ETL/ELT processes and data integration solutions.
* 2 or more years of experience leveraging AI features within Power BI and other analytics platforms to enhance reporting and analytics capabilities.
* 2 or more years of experience applying AI-assisted development tools and AI-DLC practices to improve delivery productivity and solution quality

**Additional Job Standards**

* Expert knowledge of Power BI including DAX, Power Query, Dataflows, Semantic Models, Workspaces, Deployment Pipelines, and Row-Level Security (RLS).
* Strong experience with Tableau and enterprise reporting platforms.
* Strong understanding of data modeling, dimensional modeling, business metrics, and analytical reporting concepts.

* Experience with CI/CD, source control, and modern software development practices.

* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Strong stakeholder engagement and presentation skills.
* Ability to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and business opportunities through data analysis.
* Experience documenting technical solutions, architecture decisions, and business requirements.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
* Healthcare, Diagnostics, Life Sciences, or Pharma industry experience is a plus.

* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-powered engineering tools to improve delivery quality, accelerate development cycles, and support continuous innovation.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly skilled **Manager, Enterprise Systems** with 10 or more years of experience delivering data-driven business solutions across Analytics, Reporting, BI, and Data Visualization. title: Staff Product Designer, Consumer
description:
**Ready to be a Titan?**

ServiceTitan strives to be the best place our Titans have ever worked, so they can do the best work they’ve ever done. The Experience Design (XD) team solves real world problems in the home services industry. We are passionate about bringing innovative and delightful solutions to traditional problems and workflows.

Homh is ServiceTitan's consumer-facing home services booking platform, connecting homeowners with local plumbing, heating/air, and electrical pros. The Homh design team is central to proving out ServiceTitan's direct-to-consumer strategy - we design the first experience homeowners have with the ServiceTitan ecosystem, well before they ever meet a technician. We solve real-world problems for everyday homeowners who are often stressed, unfamiliar with trade terminology, and comparing us against far simpler consumer apps. Our designers work closely with product managers, engineers, and marketplace operators to make booking a trusted pro feel as easy as ordering a ride or a meal, including surfacing Titan Intelligence-powered price estimates and recommendations. We embrace agile development and design thinking to ship improvements every month, and we measure success by booking conversion, trust, and repeat usage.

We're growing the Homh design team and looking for an AI-first Staff Product Designer who enjoys solving complex consumer problems with data-driven, AI-powered solutions. You'll bring a balanced toolkit of research, interface design, and prototyping, with real fluency designing AI-driven and agentic consumer experiences.

**What you’ll do**

* As a Staff Product Designer, you're capable of running discovery research with homeowners, creating journey maps and task flows, conducting user interviews, whiteboarding task flows, mocking up interface screens, and prototyping solutions for testing - including AI-assisted prototyping tools that speed up how fast ideas go from concept to validation. You set a strong example and provide thoughtful direction within the team, often acting as a mentor and coach. You're known across the company for your creativity, leadership, and innovation.
* This is an opportunity to shape a brand-new consumer entry point into one of the largest platforms disrupting the home services industry, and to help define what AI-first consumer product design looks like at ServiceTitan's growing Bangalore hub.

* Build positive, collaborative relationships across product, engineering, marketplace operations, and research to explore, build, and ship your work
* Develop deep expertise across the consumer booking funnel, with a focus on where Titan Intelligence and AI capabilities can meaningfully improve trust and conversion
* Design human-AI interaction patterns for consumers, including confidence and trust cues on price estimates, human-in-the-loop review steps, and graceful handling of AI uncertainty or error
* Quickly prototype solutions to visual and interaction problems, using AI-assisted design and prototyping tools to accelerate iteration
* Talk to homeowners to understand their problems, current pain points, and comfort level with AI-driven features
* Design experiences that are simple, elegant, and solve real problems for a first-time, often anxious, consumer
* Use remote tools to whiteboard, create wireframes, and design in Figma, iterating toward a shippable solution
* Validate product ideas through experimental design and research approaches, including testing AI feature outputs for usefulness and trust
* Ship valuable, high-quality work without sacrificing speed
* Help more junior designers build empathy for our users and advocate for user needs, especially as AI changes how they work
* Represent our users in product strategy and roadmap discussions
* Review product design work and give constructive feedback
* Actively mentor designers, helping them build context, strong decision-making skills, and empathy for our users

**What you'll bring**

* 8+ years of experience designing consumer (B2C) products, particularly marketplace, booking, or on-demand services apps
* Strong UX reasoning, with a proven ability to solve complex, ambiguous product problems through simple design solutions
* Direct experience designing AI-powered or AI-assisted product features - for example, generative AI, recommendation systems, copilots, or agentic workflows - with a clear point of view on how to make AI experiences trustworthy and useful to a non-technical consumer audience
* An outstanding portfolio showing a range of UX, interaction, and visual design work, plus idea generation or prototyping used to explore and convey design solutions
* Deep experience with UX research and end-to-end ownership, taking a problem from discovery through shipped solution
* Startup or fast-paced environment experience, with the self-starter mindset to match
* High attention to detail in both visual design and copy, especially for a trust-sensitive, first-time-user audience
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain the "why" behind your design rationale to your team and stakeholders
* A thought partner and leader others turn to for design judgment and point of view

‌

**Be Human With Us:**

Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.
  
  
**Use of AI Technology:**

We use technology, including automated and AI-assisted tools, to support certain aspects of our recruitment process. These tools are designed to improve efficiency and enhance the candidate experience. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

This is an opportunity for individuals who want to move beyond traditional sales roles and become part of building and scaling new businesses.

Key Responsibilities1. Fashion Sales & Business Development

* Develop and execute sales strategies for fashion, apparel, accessories, beauty, and lifestyle products.
* Identify and engage retailers, boutiques, fashion stores, distributors, wholesalers, and institutional buyers.
* Build relationships with manufacturers, designers, fashion brands, and suppliers.
* Drive B2B, B2C, and direct-to-consumer sales opportunities.
* Generate leads, negotiate commercial agreements, and close sales.
* Develop regional sales networks and strategic partnerships.

2. E-Commerce & Marketplace Growth

* Drive sales through online marketplaces, brand websites, and digital commerce platforms.
* Support product launches and growth on platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio, and other relevant channels.
* Onboard fashion sellers, brands, manufacturers, and local retailers onto emerging commerce platforms.
* Work with teams on product listings, pricing, promotions, campaigns, and conversion optimisation.
* Develop social commerce and WhatsApp-based selling opportunities.
* Identify opportunities for omnichannel retail and local fashion delivery.

3. Brand & Vendor Partnerships

* Identify emerging and established fashion and lifestyle brands for commercial collaboration.
* Build partnerships with manufacturers and sourcing hubs, including Bengaluru, Tiruppur, and other fashion markets.
* Negotiate supplier pricing, commissions, margins, and partnership terms.
* Develop vendor onboarding pipelines and maintain strong commercial relationships.
* Support private-label and exclusive product opportunities.

4. Sales Campaigns & Customer Acquisition

* Plan and execute digital and offline sales campaigns.
* Collaborate with marketing teams on influencer partnerships, social media campaigns, and customer acquisition.
* Identify opportunities for pop-up stores, exhibitions, fashion events, and promotional sales.
* Drive repeat purchases, customer retention, and loyalty initiatives.
* Monitor customer feedback, buying patterns, and emerging fashion trends.

5. Revenue Ownership & Commercial Performance

* Own agreed sales targets, customer acquisition goals, and revenue milestones.
* Maintain an active sales pipeline and conversion forecasts.
* Track sales, margins, customer acquisition costs, and channel profitability.
* Identify new growth opportunities and recommend commercial improvements.
* Work independently with a strong focus on measurable business outcomes.

Candidate Profile

We welcome applications from fashion sales professionals, e-commerce specialists, retail business developers, brand partnership managers, and entrepreneurial individuals.

**Essential Skills**

* Experience in fashion, apparel, retail, lifestyle, e-commerce, or marketplace sales.
* Strong business development, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities.
* Understanding of fashion retail, pricing, distribution, and customer behaviour.
* Ability to generate leads and convert opportunities into revenue.
* Confidence working with vendors, brands, retailers, and business owners.
* Strong commercial awareness and an entrepreneurial mindset.

**Desirable Skills**

* Experience with Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio, Shopify, or similar platforms.
* Existing network of fashion brands, suppliers, retailers, or distributors.
* Knowledge of D2C brand growth and digital marketing.
* Experience with apparel sourcing, private labels, or fashion merchandising.
* Understanding of CRM tools, sales analytics, and AI-enabled commerce.
* Experience launching new products or developing new markets.

What Makes This Opportunity Different?

This is not simply a conventional sales position.

You will have the opportunity to work across multiple emerging ventures and help build businesses from the ground up.

Successful individuals may progress into:

* Senior Fashion Sales & Growth Lead
* E-Commerce Business Head
* Fashion Marketplace Director
* Brand & Commercial Partnerships Director
* Venture Business Partner / Founding Team Member

We particularly welcome professionals who are interested in long-term entrepreneurial opportunities and performance-linked growth.

Commercial & Partnership Model

We offer flexible engagement structures depending on the candidate's experience, commercial network, and ability to generate revenue.

Options may include:

* Fixed compensation with performance incentives.
* Sales commission and revenue-linked earnings.
* Project-based commercial partnerships.
* Entrepreneurial revenue-sharing arrangements.
* Long-term business leadership opportunities for high performers.

Specific commercial terms and performance milestones will be mutually agreed upon before engagement.

First 90 Days – Expected Outcomes

**Month 1 – Market Development**

* Understand the fashion and e-commerce initiatives.
* Build a target list of brands, retailers, and vendors.
* Establish an active sales and partnership pipeline.
* Identify immediate revenue opportunities.

**Month 2 – Commercial Activation**

* Begin onboarding vendors and commercial partners.
* Execute initial sales campaigns.
* Develop marketplace and distribution opportunities.
* Secure initial commercial transactions.

**Month 3 – Revenue Growth**

* Demonstrate measurable sales traction.
* Build repeatable customer and vendor acquisition processes.
* Expand active partnerships and sales channels.
* Present a practical six-month revenue growth plan.

Who Should Apply?

We are particularly interested in individuals who:

* Have a passion for fashion, lifestyle, and commerce.
* Enjoy selling, networking, and developing business relationships.
* Can work independently and take responsibility for outcomes.
* Want to participate in building new brands and platforms.
* Are motivated by business growth, achievement, and long-term earning potential.

**If you have the network, sales capability, commercial drive, and ambition to help build the next generation of fashion and lifestyle commerce businesses, we would like to hear from you.**

title: AI Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description:**

AI Engineering Manager / Lead – Purple Fabric

**Company:**
Intellect Design Arena Ltd.

**Business Unit:**
Purple Fabric (Enterprise AI Platform)

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Experience:**
12–15 years (indicative; can be calibrated based on role seniority)

**Role Type:**
Full-time

**Mode of Work:**
Work From Office (WFO) – 5 days a week.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly experienced
**AI Engineering Manager / Lead**
to drive the architecture, development, and delivery of enterprise-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for Purple Fabric, Intellect Design Arena’s enterprise AI platform.

The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on technical expertise in AI engineering with strong engineering leadership, capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, reliable, and production-ready AI solutions. The role will involve building AI-powered applications, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and enterprise integrations while driving engineering excellence, innovation, and delivery outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Engineering & Solution Development**

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI applications leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI architectures.
* Architect and implement multi-agent systems, intelligent workflows, tool calling, and autonomous task execution with appropriate human oversight.
* Build scalable RAG pipelines integrating enterprise data sources, knowledge repositories, vector databases, and semantic search capabilities.
* Develop reusable AI components, frameworks, APIs, and services to accelerate product engineering and solution delivery.
* Drive end-to-end AI application development, from proof of concept and experimentation to production deployment and continuous improvement.

**2. AI Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Define and implement scalable AI application architectures aligned with enterprise requirements for performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Evaluate and integrate LLMs, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, vector databases, and other AI technologies based on business and technical requirements.
* Design robust prompt engineering, context management, agent orchestration, memory, and model interaction strategies.
* Establish engineering standards and best practices for AI application development, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
* Drive architectural decisions related to model selection, latency, token consumption, inference costs, and scalability.

**3. Enterprise Integration & Platform Engineering**

* Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, knowledge systems, and existing technology ecosystems.
* Build secure, reusable microservices and APIs to support enterprise AI workflows.
* Collaborate with platform, cloud, DevOps, and security teams to establish reliable deployment and operational practices.
* Enable interoperability across AI models, tools, enterprise systems, and data sources.
* Contribute to reusable platform capabilities supporting Purple Fabric’s enterprise AI and decisioning use cases.

**4. AI Quality, Governance & Responsible AI**

* Establish evaluation frameworks to assess AI output quality, factual accuracy, groundedness, relevance, and reliability.
* Implement guardrails to address hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe outputs, data leakage, and unauthorised tool execution.
* Drive observability and monitoring for AI applications, including tracing, latency, token usage, cost, and failure analysis.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, privacy, access control, auditability, and responsible AI practices.
* Implement continuous evaluation and regression testing to maintain AI solution quality as models, prompts, and data evolve.

**5. Engineering Management & Delivery**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of AI engineers, software engineers, and other technical specialists.
* Own technical delivery, engineering quality, resource planning, prioritisation, and execution against agreed timelines.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving sessions.
* Establish engineering KPIs covering delivery predictability, code quality, production stability, performance, and productivity.
* Work closely with Product Management, Solution Architects, Presales, and business stakeholders to translate product requirements into engineering deliverables.
* Foster a culture of technical ownership, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* **AI / GenAI:**
  Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI, LLM-based application development, and production AI systems.
* **Agentic AI:**
  Experience designing agent-based applications, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, and workflow automation.
* **RAG:**
  Strong understanding of document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval optimisation, reranking, and grounded response generation.
* **Programming:**
  Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade applications, services, and APIs.
* **LLM Frameworks:**
  Practical experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies.
* **Model Ecosystem:**
  Experience working with commercial or open-source LLMs, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Llama-based models.
* **Data & Integration:**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with enterprise knowledge management, identity and access management, data governance, and audit requirements.
* Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model lifecycle management, and AI application observability.

title: Tech Team Lead
description:
**Tech Team Lead**

**Founding Engineering Hire • Build from the Ground Up**

**Company:**
Allsec AI

**Location:**
Chennai (Hybrid)

**Website:**
www.allsec.ai

**Engagement Type:**
Full-Time | Early-Stage Start-up

**About Allsec AI**

Allsec AI is an AI-native, digital-first, omni-channel CX managed services company. We help enterprises unlock scalable, efficient, and real-time customer experience operations through agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and automation. We are redefining outsourcing by delivering packaged, outcome-led services that eliminate traditional contact Centre inefficiencies.

**About This Role**

This is a founding engineering hire. You will be joining a pre-revenue, product-stage company with no existing engineering team in place,
*which means you will be responsible for taking our base demo product and building it into a production-grade platform.*

You will work in close collaboration with a US-based Technical Consultant who will provide architectural direction and high-level technical guidance. For day-to-day operations, delivery execution, and team coordination, you will report to the India Operational Head.

As the company scales, you will build and lead a cross-functional team of engineers and own the India engineering operations end to end. If you are looking for a role where every decision you make has direct, visible impact.

**Reporting Structure**

* **Technical guidance, architecture direction, and product vision:**
  US-based Technical Consultant
* **Operational reporting, delivery accountability, and day-to-day coordination:**
  India Operational Head

**Key Responsibilities**

***Foundation & Architecture***

* Inherit, extend, and scale the existing technology stack (backend, frontend, DevOps, data pipelines, and ML/AI systems) building on a working demo product toward a production-ready platform.
* Establish production-grade engineering standards, tooling, and development processes, taking the codebase from demo quality to enterprise-ready.
* Define and own a scalable architecture for real-time, high-volume CX operations.

***Product & Infrastructure***

* Own and evolve the existing multi-cloud infrastructure (Digital Ocean, Azure, GCP) improving reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Extend and optimise existing integrations across multiple LLM providers, STT/TTS systems, AI agents, NLP pipelines, and vector databases.
* Ensure system observability, security, redundancy, and performance from day one.

***Team Building***

* As the first engineering hire, identify and help recruit subsequent technical team members.
* Mentor and develop engineers as the team scales; enforce best practices and foster technical excellence.
* Contribute actively to hiring decisions and help shape the engineering culture of the organisation.

***Collaboration & Stakeholder Management***

* Translate technical direction from the US-based Technical Consultant into executable roadmaps.
* Collaborate with CX implementation and QA functions to align technology with delivery operations.
* Actively participate in architectural decisions and long-term technical planning.

**Requirements**

* 6–10 years of total experience, with at least 1 year in a tech or team lead capacity.
* Deep experience with one or more full-stack frameworks (e.g., Node.js + React, Django + Vue, or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of AI/ML model development and deployment – LLMs, transformers, RAG pipelines.
* Proven experience with cloud platforms (Digital Ocean, Azure, and/or GCP) and infrastructure as code (Terraform/CDK).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, LangChain, vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS), and LLM APIs.
* Hands-on experience integrating and managing multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) alongside STT and TTS systems in production or near-production environments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes), and scalable microservices.
* Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy and build things without an established team or process around you.
* Good communication skills — you will primarily interface with a global stakeholder in the US and an operations-focused leader in India.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with contact centre platforms, chatbots, or voice AI systems.
* Exposure to MLOps, streaming data platforms, and real-time analytics dashboards.
* Prior start-up or early-stage product experience — particularly experience being the first or only engineer.
* Comfort working across time zones and with distributed teams.

**Why Join Allsec AI**

* You will be the architect of the technology foundation, i.e., you will take a working demo and turn it into the infrastructure that powers enterprise CX at scale; every architectural decision from here is yours.
* Work on cutting-edge AI/CX technology with global exposure and direct collaboration with the US technical leadership.
* Clear path to leading the India engineering organisation as the company scales.
* Competitive compensation and equity options available for the right candidate.

**Contact**

If you think this role excites you, please send your resumes to
**careers@allsec.ai**
&
**hr@allsec.ai**

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Lead end-to-end CCaaS and Customer Service AI transformation programs that align with client vision and business objectives—enhancing contact center capabilities with cloud-native platforms (Amazon Connect, Genesys, NICE, Five9), conversational AI, CX insights, and operating model redesign. Serve as both growth driver and delivery anchor, working with C‑suite stakeholders, platform partners, and internal teams to deliver measurable impact.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Advise C-suite stakeholders on customer service transformation strategies, including AI adoption, digital channels, and experience-led service design.
* Define target operating models, business cases, and transformation roadmaps aligned to enterprise priorities.
* Identify value levers across cost reduction, experience improvement, and automation.
* Lead pursuits: RFP responses, solution proposals, pricing, and executive stakeholder engagements.
* Build practice offerings in collaboration with CCaaS and AI platform partners to differentiate service capabilities.

**Market & Technology Insight**

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong stakeholder management across client and vendor teams.
* Conversational AI experience (bots, IVA, NLP) and platform migration expertise.
* Data compliance knowledge (PCI/PII, GDPR) tied to CCaaS and compliance platforms.
* Win and deliver multiple CCaaS transformation programs, meeting scope, budget, and timeline goals.
* Demonstrate measurable improvements in customer service KPIs: AHT, FCR, CSAT/NPS.

* Experience in proposal writing, executive presentations, and business development within service operations or contact center technology.

title: Product Owner
description:
**An Amazing Career Opportunity for Product Owner**
**Location: Chennai, India (Hybrid)**
**Job ID: 51321**
**Profile Summary:**
We are seeking an experienced Product Owner to join our product organization in Chennai. This role will work closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, UX, Quality, Security, and other Product Owners to translate product strategy and customer needs into clear, actionable priorities for engineering teams.
  
  
The Product Owner will be responsible for defining and prioritizing the team backlog, providing clarity on customer and business outcomes, supporting product discovery, and enabling the delivery of secure, scalable, and high-quality solutions.
  
  
We are looking for a Product Owner who goes beyond backlog management and understands the customer problem, business value, product context, and technical considerations required to make effective product decisions.
  
  
**About HID Global**
HID Global powers the trusted identities of the world’s people, places and things. We make it possible for people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. Our trusted identity solutions give people secure and convenient access to physical and digital places and connect things that can be accurately identified, verified and tracked digitally. Millions of people around the world use HID products and services to navigate their everyday lives, and over 2 billion things are connected through HID. We work with governments, educational institutions, hospitals, financial institutions, industrial businesses, and some of the most innovative companies on the planet. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, HID Global has over 4500 employees worldwide and operates international offices that support more than 100 countries. HID Global® is an ASSA ABLOY Group brand. HID Global has is the trusted source for secure identity solutions for millions of customers and users around the world. In India, we have two Engineering Centre (Bangalore and Chennai). Global Engineering Team is based in Chennai and one of the Business Unit Engineering team is based in Bangalore. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo
  
  
LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/
  
  
**Physical Access Control Solutions (PACS):**
HID Physical Access Control Solutions (PACS) is at the forefront of securing spaces with advanced, reliable access control solutions. From cutting-edge readers, credentials and controllers to mobile and biometric technologies, HID PACS empowers organizations worldwide to protect their people, property and assets with scalable, high-quality solutions. This is more than just a job – it’s your chance to join an industry leader to drive innovation in access control and make a real impact on global security solutions. Are you ready to make a difference? Join us and help shape the future of security.
  
  
**Are You Ready to Join the Team?**
Our company is committed to finding the best and the brightest talent to help us reach the top. If you are a dynamic, highly skilled, experienced Cloud engineer and technology enthusiast, and you enjoy working in a rapid pace within a rapidly growing business environment, then you will want to consider this position. If you excel at communication, collaboration, and unrelenting innovation, we want to talk to you. And if you bring dedication, positive energy and integrity to the table, you just might be the right fit for our team.
  
  
**Qualifications**
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities (Other Duties May Be Assigned)**
Product Ownership and Delivery
  
  

* Translate product strategy, customer needs, and business priorities into well-defined features, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Own, prioritize, and continuously refine the team backlog in alignment with Product Management priorities.
* Ensure the engineering team understands the customer problem, expected outcome, and value behind the work.
* Make timely product decisions and provide clarification throughout the development lifecycle.
* Review delivered capabilities against agreed requirements, acceptance criteria, and intended customer outcomes.
* Balance new capabilities with technical enablers, quality improvements, security requirements, and technical debt.

**Product Discovery and Collaboration**

* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, UX, and other stakeholders to understand and validate customer problems.
* Support product discovery through customer feedback, technical investigations, prototypes, and incremental validation.
* Collaborate with other Product Owners to manage dependencies and ensure alignment across teams.
* Understand technical constraints and trade-offs sufficiently to support effective prioritization and product decisions.
* Identify dependencies, risks, edge cases, and operational considerations early in the development process.

**Agile Planning and Execution**

* Participate in roadmap refinement, PI Planning, iteration planning, backlog refinement, demos, retrospectives, and Inspect & Adapt activities where applicable.
* Ensure features and stories are sufficiently prepared ahead of planning and development.
* Coordinate priorities and dependencies across teams.
* Track progress toward product outcomes and adjust priorities based on customer feedback, business needs, and delivery learnings.

**Technical Requirements:**
The Product Owner is not expected to define engineering implementation but should have sufficient technical understanding to engage effectively with engineers and architects.
  
  
Experience or working knowledge in several of the following areas is preferred:
  
  

* Cloud-based and SaaS platforms
* Mobile applications and ecosystems
* REST APIs and system integrations
* Authentication, identity, and authorization
* Security and cybersecurity principles
* Distributed systems and cloud architecture
* Hardware, software, and firmware integration
* IoT and connected-device ecosystems

**Experience and/or Education Qualification:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years of overall industry experience in technology and software product development.
* 3–5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, Product Manager, or equivalent product-focused role.
* Experience working with complex enterprise software products or platforms.
* Strong understanding of Agile software development practices and the software development lifecycle.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex customer and business needs into actionable engineering requirements.
* Strong analytical, prioritization, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Experience working with global and distributed engineering and product teams is preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SAFe or another scaled Agile framework.
* SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) certification or equivalent training.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, Miro, or similar tools.
* Previous software engineering or hands-on technical experience is an advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**
The successful Product Owner will ensure that engineering teams understand what they are building, why it matters, and the outcomes expected. They will maintain a healthy and prioritized backlog, enable timely product decisions, identify dependencies and risks early, and establish strong alignment between Product Management and Engineering.
  
  
Most importantly, they will take ownership of customer and business value rather than focusing solely on feature or story delivery.
  
  
**Added Advantage – Not Mandatory**
Experience in the following areas would be beneficial but is not required:
  
  

* Physical Access Control Systems (PACS)
* Digital or mobile credentials and mobile wallets
* Access control, identity, authentication, or credential management solutions
* Products integrating cloud, mobile, software, and physical devices
* Strong Product Ownership and technical product experience from other technology domains will also be considered.

****Why apply?****

* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part-time job seekers.

title: Lead System Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
Systems Engineering ist eine funktionsübergreifende technische Disziplin, die sich auf einen Ansatz, eine Denkweise und einen Prozess konzentriert. Alle Tätigkeiten, die sowohl die geschäftlichen als auch die technischen Anforderungen der Kunden berücksichtigen, mit dem Ziel, ein Qualitätsprodukt bereitzustellen, das die Anforderungen der Benutzer erfüllt. Die Disziplin zur Umsetzung eines soliden Prozesses zum Entwerfen, Erstellen und Optimieren von Systemen, der aus der Identifizierung und Quantifizierung von Systemanforderungen, der Erstellung alternativer Systementwurfskonzepte, der Durchführung von Design-Trade-off-Studien, der Auswahl und Implementierung der besten Entwürfe und der Überprüfung der Tatsache besteht, dass das Design ordnungsgemäß integriert ist und ausgeführt wird. Prozess, der vom Konzept über die Produktion bis zum Betrieb verläuft.
  
  
Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung.Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und -verfahren abgedeckt wird.Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**

* Führt Komponenten- und Produktintegration durch. Alle Aktivitäten, die mehrere Komponenten und Produkte umfassen und sich mit der Integration für maximale Leistung und Bedienbarkeit befassen. Verwaltet Produkt- und Systemanforderungen, Spezifikationen und den Datenfluss. Führt Validierungs- und Verifizierungsaktivitäten für das gesamte Produkt/System durch, einschließlich Tests auf Systemebene. Verantwortlich für die Definition der Produktanforderungen für das Modul/die Komponente/Subunternehmer und Partnerteams. Verwaltet die Schnittstelle zwischen Komponenten und Ausführungsorganisationen. Verantwortlich für das Vorantreiben von CTQ/Risk-Trades innerhalb der Teams, die die Komponenten entwerfen. Verwaltet die Gesamtproduktkonfiguration und das Konfigurationssteuerungssystem.
* Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen.
* Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.

title: Lead Consultant - S/4HANA Indirect Procurement IT Business Analyst
description:
**Role Title:**
Lead Consultant - S/4HANA Indirect Procurement IT Business Analyst
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
We are one purpose-led global organisation. The enablers and innovators, ensuring that we can fulfil our mission to push the boundaries of science and discover and develop life-changing medicines. We take pride in working close to the cause, opening the locks to save lives, ultimately making a massive difference to the outside world.
  
  
AstraZeneca (AZ) is in a period of strong growth and our employees have a united purpose to make a difference to patients around the world who need both our medicines and the ongoing developments from our science. In this journey AZ must continue to work across borders and with partners and new colleagues in a fast and seamless way. The ambition, size and complexity of the organisation, coupled with the opportunities afforded by new technology, has led the Board to approve a large-scale transformation programme – Axial.
  
  
The Axial Programme will be powered by S/4HANA a new ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system which will be implemented right across the organisation and will provide our business with standardised processes, improved financial management, common data and real time reporting, transforming the way we work through our entire supply chain - from bench to patient.
  
  
The new system will be used by more than 20,000 employees daily, is foundational to all AZ entities and is central to most core business processes. This is a once in a generation programme for AstraZeneca and will shape our ways of working globally for many years to come.
  
  
The Axial programme needs the best talent to work in it. Whether it’s the technical skills, business understanding or change leadership, we want to ensure we have the strongest team deployed throughout. We are striving to deliver a world class change programme that leaves all employees with a fuller understanding of their role in the end-to-end nature of our global company. This programme will provide AZ with a competitive edge, to the benefit of our employees, customers and patients.
  
  
The S/4HANA & Indirect Procurement IT Business Analyst plays a meaningful role in supporting the delivery and continuous improvement of AstraZeneca's global procurement platforms and processes. Working within the Procurement and Enterprise Technology organisation, the role supports the analysis, documentation, testing, deployment and optimization of solutions across SAP S/4HANA and associated non-SAP procurement applications.
  
  
The Business Analyst will partner with Product Managers, Product Experts, Enterprise Business Partners and business partners to understand business requirements, document functional needs, support process harmonisation and ensure solutions are aligned with AstraZeneca's global standards and fit-to-standard principles.
  
  
The role supports activities across the end-to-end Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration landscape, including SAP S/4HANA Procurement and Accounts Payable processes as well as key procurement applications such as Coupa, One Network, CyberGrants, IQVIA, Taulia, Workday and Concur.
  
  
The individual will contribute to solution testing, data migration activities, release management, deployment preparation and hypercare support while ensuring compliance with AstraZeneca quality and governance standards.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Gather, analyse and document business and functional requirements for procurement and supplier management capabilities.
* Support the design and continuous improvement of global Purchase-to-Pay processes.
* Collaborate with Product Experts and technical teams to translate business requirements into solution specifications.
* Support SAP S/4HANA Procurement and Accounts Payable process activities including requisitions, purchase orders, supplier collaboration, invoicing and payment processes.
* Support requirements and process analysis for non-SAP procurement systems including Coupa, CyberGrants, One Network, IQVIA and Taulia.
* Assist with data migration, master data creation and validation activities.
* Support system integration, user acceptance testing, regression testing and defect management activities.
* Participate in release planning, deployment activities and hypercare support.
* Work closely with business partners to find opportunities for process simplification, automation and standardisation.
* Support issue investigation and resolution across the procurement application landscape.
* Ensure solutions and documentation meet AstraZeneca compliance, validation and governance standards.
* Report progress, risks, issues and dependencies to project and product leadership teams.

**Essential For The Role**

* Experience as a Business Analyst supporting procurement, finance or supply chain processes
* Experience working with SAP Procurement, S/4HANA or ERP solutions
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements
* Understanding of Source-to-Pay and supplier management processes
* Experience supporting testing and deployment activities
* Strong partner management and communication skills
* Experience working within Agile delivery teams
* Knowledge of Source-to-Pay indirect procurement processes.
* Understanding of SAP S/4HANA Procurement and Accounts Payable concepts.
* Experience creating business & technical requirements and process documentation.
* Knowledge of testing methodologies and defect management.
* Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow or similar tools.
* Ability to analyse business data and process performance metrics.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Self-motivated and capable of handling multiple priorities.
* Effective communicator with both business and technical partners.
* Comfortable working in evolving and ambiguous environments.
* Good attention to detail and documentation quality.

**Desirable for the role**

* Knowledge of procurement integrations and supplier collaboration platforms.
* Understanding of API and middleware concepts.
* Exposure to SAP Business Network and SAP Fiori applications.
* Pharmaceutical industry experience
* SAP S/4HANA Procurement certification
* Experience supporting global transformation programmes
* Experience with MDG
* Experience with Non SAP systems
* Knowledge of Workday and Concur
* Experience in global, matrix organisations

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  
**Why AstraZeneca?**
At Astrazeneca we’re dedicated to being a Great Place to Work. Where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. **Global Business Services**

Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.

Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.

In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.

  
  

**Process Overview:**

Global Banking & Markets division serves mid- to large-sized corporations and institutional clients worldwide. It is comprised of Business Banking, Global Commercial Banking, Global Corporate & Investment Banking, Global Markets and Wholesale Credit. Aligned with these client-facing groups are Global Capital Markets and Global Research. Global Banking and Markets Technology provides end-to-end technology solutions for Global Markets and banking businesses including Equities, Prime Brokerage, Interest Rates, Currencies, Commodities, Derivatives, Structured Products, Commercial Card, Cash Management, Payments, Sales, Servicing and Fulfillment. Across all these products, solutions include architecture, design, development, change management, implementation and support using various enterprise technologies.

**Job Description:**

Product owner contributes to the development of the US Wires high-value payment system. Responsible for maximizing the value delivered by the Wires Modernization product and ensuring alignment with business objectives. Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Wires Modernization initiative. Work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs, challenges, and priorities, translating them into actionable product requirements. Collaborate with the Product Manager within a scaled Agile framework to ensure alignment with broader program and organizational goals. Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring the highest-value work is delivered first. Partner with the development team to clarify requirements, remove ambiguities, and ensure stories are ready for implementation. Work closely with the functional and automation testing teams to ensure all requirements are thoroughly tested and the delivered functionality works as expected. Review and accept completed stories, making timely decisions on scope, requirements, and priorities. Communicate product goals, roadmap updates, and delivery progress to stakeholders and project teams. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive successful execution and delivery of modernization objectives. aLeverage technology solutions and business knowledge to maximize product value and achieve project outcomes.

**Responsibilities**

* Review requirements and acceptance criteria; design and execute positive, negative, integration, and end-to-end test scenarios; maintain requirements-to-test traceability; log defects and validate fixes to confirm functionality works as expected.
* Identify suitable scenarios for automation; develop and maintain automated functional, API, and regression tests; execute automated suites and analyze failures; update scripts as requirements evolve and report coverage and results.
* Coordinate with the different workstreams Product Owner and development team to clarify requirements, prepare test data and environments, confirm coverage across functional and automated tests, and communicate test results, outstanding defects, and risks to support release-readiness decisions.
  

  

**Requirements**

* **Education:** B.E./ B. Tech/M.E./M. Tech/BSC/MSC/BCA/MCA (prefer IT/CS specialization)
* **Certifications If Any:** NA
* **Experience Range:** 12-16 yrs
  

  

**Mandatory skills:**

* US wire payment knowledge
* Experience in modernization from legacy platforms
* Strong payments knowledge.
* SWIFT and ISO20022 experience

  

**Desired skills**

* Good testing exposure and exposure in working with global teams

  

**Work Timings General Shift** - 11:30 AM to 8:30 PM

  
  

**Job Location** – Chennai

title: Senior Product Engineering Lead (Client Journey & Solutioning)
description:
**Senior Product Engineering Lead (Java, Fintech)**

Location: Hyderabad, India

**About Olea:**

Olea is a digital infrastructure platform that connects global liquidity with trade and supply chain opportunities, fueling growth and unlocking potential worldwide. Olea has diverse liquidity pools with varying appetite and focuses. Olea’s vision is to connect capital to opportunity. It has a strong conviction in the role of trade to support sustainable economic development across countries, particularly emerging markets, particularly Asia where many smaller suppliers are based. Olea supports suppliers and buyers in over 70 corridors.

**Role summary:**

We are looking for a Senior Product Engineering Lead for our Client Journey & Solutioning engineering team, based in our Hyderabad office, to bridge the gap between complex business product lines and highly scalable technology. In this role, you will lead and guide a high-performing engineering team focused on crafting seamless, friction-free client onboarding and transaction workflows for trade finance products, including invoice financing, factoring, and supply chain finance. You will be a hands-on Java technical lead with a product manager’s mindset, closely collaborating with Business teams and the SDET Architect to champion agile methodologies. You will also promote the adoption of AI-assisted engineering workflows, while ensuring that all code, whether human-written or AI-generated, adheres to strict structural guardrails and automated testing standards.

**Responsibilities:**

· Team Leadership & Product Collaboration: Partner closely with Business Product teams to translate complex invoice financing, factoring, and supply chain finance requirements into intuitive, reliable client journeys and technical solutions.

· Technical Leadership: Act as the technical lead for the team: set architecture and design direction, own design and code reviews, and stay hands-on in the Java codebase to unblock engineers and raise the engineering bar.

· End-to-End Delivery Management: Manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) for both existing client-facing and product applications, balancing the ongoing enhancement and stability of the existing production platform with the delivery of new greenfield capabilities. Own backend scalability, automated testing,

and production stability, and provide technical direction for the client-facing frontend experience.

· AI-Native Engineering Leadership: Establish and scale AI-native engineering workflows, leveraging AI coding assistants, automated testing, and structured development guardrails to accelerate delivery velocity while enforcing rigorous engineering discipline, and encourage the team to adopt them.

· Guardrails & Code Integration: Establish and oversee robust code merge gates; ensure that whether code is generated by AI and reviewed by a developer, or written directly by a developer, it strictly passes the automated test suite, security linting, and compliance checks before being merged into the main codebase.

· Technical Mentorship & Culture: Guide, mentor, and pair-program with engineers to uplift the team’s technical capabilities, foster an agile DevOps culture, and continuously optimize CI/CD pipelines.

· Proactive Problem Solving: Take ownership of resolving systemic technical debts, operational bottlenecks, or misalignments between business requirements and technical execution.

· Product & Business Ownership: Draw on your product management experience to guide engineering decisions: understand the business model, client needs and commercial outcomes of each product line, contribute to roadmap and prioritisation, and make trade-offs between scope, value and technical risk.

**Role specific technical competencies:**

· Product & Solution Architecture: Ability to translate complex business processes into scalable technical architectures, customer journeys, APIs, and platform capabilities.

· Core Tech Stack (Java): Strong, hands-on background in the Java stack, including Java 11/17+, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA, microservices, REST APIs, event-driven messaging (e.g. Kafka) and relational databases. NodeJS / TypeScript experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

· Backend & Platform Leadership: Proven experience designing and delivering secure, high-throughput, and scalable backend architectures, with the ability to guide the team on client-facing user interfaces and their integration with backend APIs.

· Fintech & Trade Finance Domain Expertise: Mandatory domain experience in Fintech (e.g. payments, lending, transaction banking or trade finance). Hands-on domain knowledge and engineering experience within supply chain finance frameworks, notably Invoice Financing, Factoring, and Supply Chain Finance workflows, is strongly preferred.

· Client Journey Solutioning: Demonstrated ability to map out complex financial workflows into highly performant, intuitive, and secure client solutions and API integrations.

· Product Management & Business Acumen: Product manager or product owner experience, or equivalent hands-on ownership of a product, with a clear understanding of product strategy, requirements definition, prioritisation and how technology decisions drive business outcomes.

· AI-Native Engineering Proficiency: Solid hands-on experience using AI coding platforms or enterprise AI assistants in day-to-day engineering, and the ability to use them effectively to boost team velocity without compromising architectural integrity, code security, or regulatory compliance.

· Core Software Engineering: Strong systems design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and advanced test automation practices.

**Qualifications (training, licenses, memberships and certifications):**

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar quantitative/engineering discipline.

· 6+ years of Java software engineering experience, within Fintech, transactional banking, or Trade Finance platforms.

· 3-5+ years leading engineering teams, with a proven track record of managing technical teams in these domains.

· Strong background in Java-based product engineering, with the ability to lead technically while remaining hands-on.

· Mandatory domain experience in Fintech.

· Product manager or product owner experience (or equivalent hands-on product ownership), with a clear understanding of product and business.

· Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants in software delivery.

**Note:**

Olea is committed to diversity and inclusion. By providing equal opportunities we foster a work environment which embraces diversity and gets the best out of the broadest spectrum of people to sustain business performance and competitive advantage. We build an inclusive culture by demonstrating respect for each other’s unique strengths and perspectives to enable every employee to develop a sense of belonging and have the opportunity to maximise their potential.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Forward Deployed Engineer**

You'll build on top of Saras IQ Product to own the solution and the build for a client requirement - from the first requirements conversation and live customer demos to validated data, one trusted set of metrics, live dashboards, and clean data every morning - as the accountable owner of what gets built as a repeatable product capability.

**About Saras Analytics**

Saras Analytics is an AI and data analytics firm built for ecommerce and omnichannel brands. We help fast growing SMBs and mid-market brands turn disconnected, messy data into decisions — covering ingestion, transformation, and consumption, backed by our own products (Daton and Saras IQ) as the data infrastructure in every engagement.

**Why Now**

Saras is profitable and bootstrapped. We run flat: talent and good ideas move fast here regardless of tenure or title. AI-assisted tooling now lets one engineer take a client from the first requirements conversation to a live, trusted dashboard without waiting on a queue of hand-offs. The Forward Deployed Engineer role is built around that: one owner, end to end, with the tooling to make it fast. Because you build on top of our products rather than around them, what you create for one client requirement becomes capability that every client can use. An FDE joining now helps define what that role looks like at its best.

**The Role**

You'll own the solution and the build for one client account, reporting to an FDE Lead. You build on top of our product, Saras IQ, extending it with software you design and code. You are responsible for interacting directly with the customer — running discovery, demoing what you build, and presenting it to client stakeholders — as well as with the product teams, and you contribute to the product roadmap. Whatever you build, you then become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product: you create repeatable solutions that expand what the product can do and maximize revenue impact. On that account you work alongside a Strategic Account Manager, who owns the client relationship and the commercial outcomes, and a Product Manager, who owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it. You own what gets built and whether it is right — requirements, software, data, metrics, dashboards, and data quality — with our AI-assisted tooling and our SME leads behind you for the hardest problems.

**The Bar**

Speed & Delivery quality are the top priorities for this role: what you ship is correct, validated against the source of truth before the client sees it, and there on the date you committed to. Speed matters because clients feel it — the shortest path from signed-off requirements to a live, trusted dashboard — but never at the cost of numbers the client can rely on. You build to product standard: what you write is well designed, tested, version-controlled, and reusable, because it is part of the product. You surface risks before they block delivery, and you close every issue with a root cause and a fix, you internally escalate the dependencies on time. The lanes are explicit: you own the solution and the build; the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial outcomes; the Product Manager owns product onboarding, enablement, and roadmap, with you as a direct contributor to it.

**What You'll Own**

**1. Own discovery and requirements.**
Join the sales handover to close open questions and call out risks early. Run discovery sessions directly with client stakeholders on the client's core use cases — sales and marketing, contribution margin, customer cohorts, product and inventory — co-design the solution with them, and write the business requirements and metric definitions using Saras' standard templates, reviewing them internally before client sign-off. Build the mock-ups that let clients react before anything is built, demo working builds live to the client at every milestone and take their feedback directly, write the test cases every requirement will be validated against, and track change requests so scope stays visible to you and the Account Manager.

**2. Own the data build.**
Set up integrations and access with our data-ingestion team, translate requirements into technical specifications, and build the staging, master, and presentation datasets with Saras' AI-assisted data-engineering tools, following our data-model conventions (dbt, BigQuery, Git). Apply PII masking, and keep the data dictionary and lineage documentation current. When a problem goes beyond your account — a complex architecture choice or a platform limit — take it to the senior data-engineering lead with a proposed workaround, and keep ownership of the outcome.

**3. Build on top of the product, end to end.**
You are not only modelling data: you build complete solutions on top of Saras IQ, and that takes software & data engineering & Analytics skills. Design and code the services, APIs, integrations, automation, and application logic around the data layer, and apply sound engineering practice — modular design, code review, automated tests, version control, and CI/CD. Write code that others can maintain and extend, because it may become part of the product.

**4. Turn what you build into product.**
Whatever you build, you become the advisor or implementer of that same capability in the product. Package it as a repeatable, configurable solution rather than a one-off, document it, and help other FDEs and accounts adopt it, so each engagement expands what the product can do and maximizes its revenue impact.

**5. Own the client's metric definitions.**
Configure one certified set of metrics and dimensions for each client in Saras IQ's semantic layer, so that every dashboard, self-serve question, and AI answer draws on the same definitions.

**6. Own validation before anything reaches the client**
. Reconcile every dataset against its source of truth, certify it, and run the internal sign-off against agreed criteria for sending work back. Set up the data quality and completeness checks, validate against the requirement test cases and against a benchmark set of business questions the AI analyst must answer correctly, then walk the Account Manager through the build in a final review before it goes to the client.

**7. Own the consumption layer.**
Build dashboards natively in Saras IQ (and in Tableau, Luzmo, or Power BI where the contract specifies), drawing their metrics from the client's certified definitions. Build and maintain the business context that powers Saras IQ Analyst, our AI analyst; set it up and provision it for client users in Slack and their AI tools; and keep refining that context from what users ask it. The Account Manager leads the launch and adoption, and the Product Manager leads enablement.

**8. Own data quality every day.**
Run the daily data-quality cycle: confirm the overnight pipelines and checks have completed, resolve what they flag, escalate anything still open — or late upstream data — to the senior data-engineering lead, re-run and re-test what you fixed, and send the client a routine data-quality status (with any help you need from them), copying the Account Manager. Configure latency and dashboard alerts, and close every bug and change request with a root cause and a fix. When an issue breaches its SLA or stays open past a day, the Account Manager takes the client escalation and you drive the fix.

**9. Run your delivery hygiene.**
Keep your onboarding and project documentation, task tracker, and timesheets current, so anyone can see where your account stands.

**10. Partner across the lanes.**
Be the direct technical voice to customers and to the product teams, and contribute to the product roadmap. Support your Account Manager with the technical answers behind success criteria, client acceptance testing, and adoption, and demo what you built and walk client users through its logic yourself, while the Account Manager owns the relationship and the commercial conversations; work with the Product Manager and the product teams to turn what you hear from customers and learn from your builds into roadmap priorities; and work with our data-ingestion and data-engineering teams to unblock ingestion, data quality, and architecture issues.

**What Winning Looks Like**

**First 90 days:**

you know your account's data and metric definitions in depth, you run the daily data-quality cycle reliably, and you've taken at least one deliverable from signed-off requirements to a validated, live dashboard on your own, demoing it to the client yourself.

**Steady state:**

you deliver datasets and dashboards independently and on the committed date, your validation catches issues before clients ever do, your client's mornings start with clean data, your FDE Lead trusts what you ship without re-checking every number, your teammates enjoy working with you, what you've built is reusable and part of the product, you contribute to the roadmap, and you're ready to own a new account launch end to end.

**Who Thrives Here**

Any of these backgrounds can get you in the room. Across all of them, you bring 3+ years (typically 3–6) of hands-on data and software work — some of it building in SQL and code, and some of it facing clients, including demos.

• You've been a business or data analyst who wrote requirements and specifications, worked hands-on in SQL, and are ready to own the build as well as the brief.

• You've been an analytics or data engineer who built layered data models — raw, staging, masters, presentation — and are ready to own the client conversation as well as the pipeline.

• You've delivered data or BI projects in an analytics consulting or services firm, end to end, directly with clients.

• You've been a software engineer who built backend or full-stack applications and data-heavy products, and are ready to take on analytics, data modelling, and the client conversation.

**Whichever route you come from, you have:**

• A degree from a reputed engineering college.

• Strong SQL and data-modelling fundamentals across the raw → staging → master → presentation layers.

• Software engineering fundamentals: proficiency in Python (or a comparable language such as Java, TypeScript, or Go), data structures, and the ability to write clean, modular, tested, maintainable code.

• Software design skills: you can design the architecture of an end-to-end solution — services, APIs, data flows, and integrations — weigh the trade-offs, and build it to be reusable and extensible.

• Engineering practice: code review, unit and integration testing, CI/CD, and debugging in production. • Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool — Tableau, Power BI, or similar.

• A foundational understanding of statistics — enough to know when a number is meaningful and when it isn't.

• Working knowledge of dbt and BigQuery (or the ability to ramp up quickly), and everyday use of Git.

• Comfort with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, or GitHub Copilot — we'll train you on Saras' own tooling.

• The ability to turn an ambiguous client ask into clear, testable requirements and a technical specification.

• Clear, confident client communication — you can own a delivery conversation without a go-between, run live product demos, and present to client and product stakeholders.

• The ability to work with product teams and contribute to a roadmap: you can turn customer needs and what you've built into reusable product capabilities.

**It's an even stronger fit if you also bring:**

• An engineering degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Analytics, or Data Science.

• Ecommerce data fluency: you know how contribution margin, customer cohorts, attribution, and inventory are really calculated — and where the source data misleads.

• Experience with a semantic or metrics layer, or with data-quality and observability frameworks.

• Dashboards you've built that clients actually use, and the instinct for what makes one trustworthy.

• Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow.

• Experience building APIs, integrations, or full-stack applications, and with cloud services (GCP preferred) and containerization.

• You've presented analysis directly to a client or senior stakeholder, not just to your own team.

**Location**

Hyderabad. Standard working hours are noon to 9 PM IST.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses, comprehensive health insurance, relocation support, and ongoing professional development. Saras Analytics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive workplace for all. If you want to own what gets built, end to end, on top of our product, and see it land with the client, then make it part of the product, we want to talk to you.

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
  
  
Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few.
  
  
Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site (experian.com/careers) to understand why.
  
  
**Job Description**
This role will support the experience of our flagship fraud platform – Ascend Fraud – supporting hundreds of clients, including the largest financial institutions in the world.
  
  
This is an ideal opportunity for a Product Manager with expertise in identity verification, analytics, fraud detection, and / or AI-driven decisioning. The successful candidate will be an AI-native product manager and own product responsibility for the Ascend Fraud platform user experience— from strategy and discovery through roadmap execution, delivery, and market adoption — while unlocking market opportunities, platform synergies, and a clear path for migration to new services.
  
  
**Product Strategy & Globalization**

* Work alongside regional stakeholders to drive roadmap and ensure Ascend Fraud (CrossCore) experience and platform priorities support regional goals
* Drive future-state requirements, feature parity, and long-term migration plans in line with the long term Ascend Fraud and Ascend platform strategy

**Product Discovery & Customer Insights**

* Work with customers and regional stakeholders to understand and address fraud and identity challenges across use cases
* Translate insights and usage data into product features that address clients' jobs-to-be-done

**Roadmap Execution**

* Own and deliver a roadmap for Ascend Fraud solutions across regions, with
* "full-stack" accountability from requirements through release for the client-facing user experience, including UI
* Using AI-DLC processes and tools, create standardized features, capabilities and reusable components

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Collaborate with globally distributed teams across Product, Engineering, Architecture, and Delivery
* Work closely with global and regional teams to ensure alignment with strategic priorities
* You will be reporting to the VP of Product Managemnt

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Product Manager and/or Product Owner experience in complex, matrixed organizations,
* Prior ownership of B2B user experience, including UI in SaaS environment
* Domain expertise in Identity Verification, Fraud Detection, or Risk platforms
* Experience contributing to globally distributed products and platforms
* Drive product work in a geographically distributed environment
* Experience in AI-DLC environments and use of AI tools to drive feature collaboration and accelerated product and value delivery

**Additional Information**
Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. We take our people agenda very seriously and focus on what matters; DEI, work/life balance, development, authenticity, collaboration, wellness, reward & recognition, volunteering... the list goes on. Experian's people first approach is award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2024 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 24 countries, and Glassdoor Best Places to Work 2024 to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or our Careers Site and Glassdoor to understand why.
  
  
Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
  
  
Recruitment Fraud Awareness - Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
  
  
**Benefits**
Experian care for employee's work life balance, health, safety and wellbeing. In support of this endeavor, we offer best-in-class family well-being benefits, enhanced medical benefits and paid time off.
