title: Sr Specialist, Product Management & Development
description:
**About the Role:**
===================

**Grade Level (for internal use):**

11  

S&P Global Market Intelligence provides data, technology, and workflow solutions for global financial markets.

  

**The Role:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to deliver workflow, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions for global capital markets.

The role combines strategy and execution, partnering with clients and cross-functional teams to turn product vision into roadmaps, launches, and measurable outcomes.

  
  

**The Team:**

  

S&P’s Public Markets team delivers workflow, data, and technology solutions for capital markets participants globally. You will join an agile team enhancing electronic order management, bookbuilding, issuance, compliance, market intelligence, and automation solutions.

  
  

**The Impact:**

  

The Product manager will have an opportunity to join a high performing team responsible for building next-generation electronic order management, new issue analytics, data feed, and compliance tools for institutional investors. You will influence strategy, align stakeholders, and deliver capabilities that increase efficiency, adoption, satisfaction, and business value.

  
  

**What's In It For You**

  

* Own strategic product initiatives for capital markets workflows.
* Work with leading banks, issuers, and investors.
* Shape roadmap decisions across workflow, analytics, and AI-enabled products.
* Collaborate globally across Product, Engineering, UX, Data, Operations, and Commercial teams.
  

  

**Responsibilities**

  

* Understand customer workflows, market structure, trends, and competitors.
* Define product vision, strategy, roadmaps, and growth opportunities.
* Identify automation and AI-driven innovation opportunities.
* Translate objectives into requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and metrics.
* Prioritize backlog with Engineering and UX through agile delivery.
* Drive launches, adoption analysis, and product improvement.
* Use AI-enabled tools to improve productivity and outcomes.
* Build relationships with customers, Commercial, Operations, Engineering, and executives.
* Align groups with competing priorities.
* Influence decisions through data, insight, and business cases.
* Engage clients to understand business challenges.
* Turn feedback into product enhancements.
* Track market, technology, and competitive trends.
  

  

**What We're Looking For:**

  

* Experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or related role.
* Experience with SaaS, workflow, platform, data, or API-driven products with good understanding of XML, JSON and REST.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and agile delivery skills.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in financial markets, investment banking, fixed income, or fintech.
* Experience with APIs, integration platforms, automation, or AI-enabled solutions.
* Knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Figma, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.

title: Growth & Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**Growth & Performance Marketing Manager**

*Own paid acquisition, SEO and retention — and be able to explain why a number moved, not just report it.*

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Cosmic Biotech is hiring a Growth & Performance Marketing Manager to own measurable customer acquisition and digital growth. You will run paid media end-to-end, own analytics and attribution, and set the initial SEO and retention strategy, working closely with the creative team to turn performance data into better campaigns.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own paid acquisition across Meta, Google and other relevant platforms — planning, execution and optimisation.
* Develop media plans, audience strategies and campaign structures aligned to business targets.
* Run structured audience, messaging and creative testing; identify which creative directions perform commercially, with the creative team.
* Own tracking, attribution and analytics across all acquisition channels.
* Monitor CAC, ROAS/MER, conversion rates and other core growth metrics; report with clear commentary, not just dashboards.
* Analyse funnels end-to-end and identify conversion-rate optimisation opportunities.
* Develop and manage retargeting and remarketing strategies.
* Own initial CRM and retention strategy for existing customers.
* Own overall SEO strategy — keyword opportunities, organic growth targets, and technical SEO coordination with the website team.
* Monitor GA4, Search Console and other performance tools.
* Guide the content team on search-led content opportunities.
* Present performance insights that inform product, communication and brand decisions.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* Hands-on experience managing real advertising budgets on Meta and Google Ads, with demonstrable results.
* Strong grasp of campaign structuring, audience segmentation, bidding strategies and creative testing frameworks.
* Working knowledge of GA4, Search Console and attribution/analytics tooling.
* Practical understanding of SEO fundamentals — on-page, technical and content-led growth.
* Analytical mindset — able to challenge assumptions and explain why a campaign is or isn't working.
* Experience with CRM/retention tools and remarketing workflows is a strong plus.
* Prior experience in D2C, e-commerce, pharma or nutraceutical categories is an advantage.
* Ability to interpret commercial performance beyond platform metrics, including CAC, conversion, AOV and customer acquisition quality.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

This role needs depth, not breadth. Candidates should be ready to walk through past campaigns in detail — budgets managed, decisions made, results achieved — during the interview process.

Full-time

Critical — immediate hiring need

description:
**Role Summary**

The platform offers 100+ ready-made, approved algorithmic strategies across equities, indices, F&O, and commodities, letting users pick and deploy structured strategies instead of having to build and monitor trades themselves.

We are looking for a curious, proactive and ownership-driven
**Product Intern**
to join the Stratzy Product team. This is an opportunity to work on real product challenges, contribute ideas, collaborate directly with the leadership team and help build features that solve actual user problems. You will gain hands-on experience in product management, user research, data analysis and product development.

This is a
**3 to 6 month internship**
, with a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) opportunity for high performers, based on performance and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of product features, improvements and experiments, from ideation to launch.
* Understand user needs and pain points, identify opportunities and suggest solutions to improve the product experience.
* Work closely with the leadership team to understand business priorities, share ideas and contribute to product decisions.
* Translate ideas and business problems into clear product requirements, user journeys and actionable tasks.
* Collaborate with design, engineering, marketing and customer support teams to bring product ideas to life.
* Analyse user behaviour, product data and customer feedback to identify opportunities and measure the impact of product improvements.
* Research competitors, market trends and emerging developments in fintech, investing and algorithmic trading.
* Interact with users, understand their experiences and bring actionable insights to the product roadmap.
* Track feature performance after launch and recommend improvements based on user feedback and data.

**Requirements**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in any discipline. Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics or related backgrounds are welcome, but not mandatory.
* Strong curiosity about digital products, technology, user behaviour and how businesses solve customer problems.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think logically and break down complex problems into simpler solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to share ideas and collaborate with different teams.
* A proactive mindset, willingness to learn and ability to take ownership in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable with numbers, analysing information and using data to support decisions.
* An interest in finance, stock markets, investing, trading or fintech is an advantage; prior knowledge of algorithmic trading is not mandatory.
* Prior internships, college projects, personal projects, product case studies or startup experience are welcome, but not essential.

We are a start-up organization focused on fast growth with quality products; hence, the ability to

work in a fast-paced environment goes without saying!

**If you are curious, enjoy solving problems and want hands-on experience building real products, we would love to hear from you!**

**Our People & Culture:**

People and culture are the most important aspects of our business.

We are looking for team members just like us, in simple words - good people to work with and

demonstrate following personality traits:

•
**Be super obsessed about ensuring customer satisfaction.**

(We are here because of our customers, and will be here only if we serve our customers)

•
**We have a single opportunity to serve.**

(Our customers will give us one opportunity to serve - we can’t let them down. Be it product,

uptimes, customer service or any interaction we have to deliver a wow experience.)

•
**Respect your work, your team, your co-workers and our customers.**

(The only way to get respect is to give it first)

•
**Speed is all that matters. Ship right and ship faster.**

(You either help the team move ahead fast, or you slow it down. We prefer the first.)

•
**Humility & politeness over arrogance & over-confidence.**

(If you are the smartest one in the room, bring up others to speed. We are here to serve our

customers, not to prove a point.)

•
**Quality over quantity.**

(It is fine if you pick up a few things to do, but do them exceedingly well.)

•
**Make your hands dirty irrespective of who you are.**

(Our CEO responds to customers every day. Our CTO codes every day. This is us.)

•
**Talent and Competency over Credentials.**

•
**Entrepreneurial, ownership driven and disciplined.**

(We trust you to help us gain and retain the trust of our customers and our stakeholders)

•
**Less words, more action.**

(Believe in something? show it by doing things. Not just by talking about it)

•
**Flat hierarchy with open culture & conversations.**

(You are among all of us, and we all are with you)

•
**Passionate about the business you are a part of.**

(Do it because you are passionate about it, not because it’s your job.)

**Why Join Raise?**

We’ve been recognised as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, reflecting the culture we’ve built and the way we work together. At Raise, you’ll experience a flat hierarchy, open conversations, high ownership and a strong bias for action. We value people who bring passion, humility and curiosity to their work, and who care deeply about building great products and creating meaningful customer impact.

We believe in growth with ownership, speed with thoughtfulness and ambition with humility. We

celebrate wins, learn from challenges and give people the ownership and responsibility to build and make an impact. If you enjoy building from the ground up, working with passionate people, and being part of a high-growth fintech ecosystem, Raise offers an environment where you can do meaningful work and grow with the business.

Raise Financial Services is building technology-led financial products and infrastructure for India’s financially aware and digitally savvy consumers. Our ecosystem spans multiple aspects of financial services, with Dhan as our flagship investment and trading platform.

Alongside Dhan, we are building and scaling businesses across the financial ecosystem, including Stratzy, Millions, Upsurge, Filter Coffee, Pluto Insurance, Fuzz and several other emerging products and platforms.

Our ambition is to build a trusted ecosystem of financial products and experiences that make

investing, trading, wealth creation and other financial services simpler, smarter and more accessible. Our philosophy is simple:

* Build great products.
* Deliver awesome experiences.
* Provide exceptional customer service.

title: Senior Analyst, AI Implementation
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  

* Role Summary

Third Bridge produces primary research for private equity, credit, and corporate clients globally. The Private Markets Strategy function owns how that content is built, deployed, and scaled. We are integrating AI across the content lifecycle — from expert identification and vetting through transcript generation, Company Briefs, and demand-signal detection. The AI Implementation team turns those initiatives into working systems.
  
  
**You Will Work Across Three Broad Surfaces**

* Internal content and operations systems — tooling and data workflows that make our content cleaner, faster to produce, and easier to discover across the business.
* Client-facing AI products — the next generation of AI-powered research experiences delivered to institutional clients.
* Demand and coverage intelligence — systems that detect where content is thin, where client demand is concentrating, and which companies, sectors, or themes to prioritise next.
* What You Will Do
* Own one or more workstreams end-to-end: scope the problem, design the approach, build it in Python, and carry it through to a stable, monitored production system.
* Design and productionise prompt-based workflows, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation harnesses, with an eye on quality, cost, and reliability at scale.
* Partner directly with Technology, Product, Compliance, and Data teams to integrate builds into the wider stack and clear the path to deployment.
* Set engineering standards for the team — code review, testing, documentation — and coach Analysts through their work.
* Diagnose and resolve data-quality and performance issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs when internal systems impose constraints.
* Contribute to the team's roadmap by surfacing high-value opportunities and flagging risk early.
* What This Role Is Not
* Not a pure research role. The emphasis is on shipping and integrating reliable systems, not novel model development.
* Not an end-to-end infrastructure ownership role. You build in close partnership with the teams that own the underlying platforms rather than owning that infrastructure yourself.
* Not a people-management role at this level, though you will mentor Analysts and are expected to lead by technical example.
* What You Bring
* 2–5 years of experience building and shipping software or data/ML systems in a production environment. Consulting (MBB or Big 4) or high-growth startup experience alongside solid technical delivery is a plus.
* Strong Python and a track record of taking work from prototype to production, including testing, monitoring, and iteration.
* Practical experience with LLM workflows — prompting, retrieval, and evaluation — and good judgement about where they do and do not fit.
* Ability to work independently within a workstream, make defensible trade-offs, and communicate them clearly to technical and non-technical partners.
* Comfort operating across functions and translating fuzzy business problems into concrete, shippable systems.
* Early signs of leadership — mentoring juniors, raising the bar on quality, and owning outcomes rather than tasks.
* How You Will Be Measured
* The reliability, quality, and business impact of the systems you own end-to-end.
* Autonomy — how much can be handed to you with confidence, and how well you manage ambiguity.
* Effectiveness of your cross-functional partnerships and the strength of the Analysts you coach.
* Career Path

The natural progression is toward the AI Implementation Lead (AVP) track, subject to performance, sustained ownership of production systems, growing cross-functional influence, and demonstrated coaching of Analysts.
  
  
Additional information
  
  
**Why work for us?**

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive salary reflective of your skills and experience.
* Time Off: Benefit from 18 days of paid time off (PTO), 8 fixed holidays, 1 floating holiday, and 8 casual leaves. PTO increases with tenure.
* Learning & Development: Receive a personal development reimbursement yearly for customised learning programs. Additionally, a dedicated budget supports studies and job-related qualifications.
* Health & Well-being: Access private medical insurance, maternity benefits, and engage in various events promoting mental health.
* Life Cover: Automatically enrolled in Life Insurance cover from your date of hire, providing coverage 4x the annual CTC.
* Flexibility: Flexible work options, such as Work from Anywhere program, hybrid work options, and flex days, offered at the company’s discretion and subject to annual review.
* Snacks & Refreshments: Stay energised with daily snacks, tea, and coffee provided.
* CSR Days: Contribute to social responsibility with 2 CSR days annually – take time off to volunteer.
* Equal Opportunity Employer: Third Bridge is proud to foster diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected under local laws.

The successful candidate must, by the start of the employment, have permission to work in the country they are applying.

• Develop the Product Strategy – work with the product management team to develop a comprehensive strategy for all cash management products by clearly defining the market landscape and drivers, core product proposition, target market and client segments, addressable market size, projected share of wallet and associated volumes/revenues, competitor capability assessment, product development roadmap, and commercialization strategy
  
• Drive Product Innovation – establish processes and checkpoints to ensure your team identifies opportunities to develop new products and enhance existing products based on market/sales feedback, client needs and/or regulatory changes. Prioritize the development pipeline based on a sound commercial assessment of each opportunity and review the quality of investment plans before the team seeks formal approvals. Constantly review the Minimum Value Proposition (MVP) for the product set against each target segment as well as defining the future roadmap for an Enhanced Value Proposition (EVP) to stay ahead of the market and position Mashreq as the leading innovator in the region
  
• Commercialize Product Offerings – ensure the team develop and execute a comprehensive commercialization plan for each key cash management product including revenue/volume targets, client target market and prospect lists, core marketing/sales materials, product training for Sales and Coverage, and client education events. Track and monitor execution of these plans through regular reviews and identify any issues where help is required to remove roadblocks. Ensure the Product Management team are working on the right deals with Sales to maximize revenues
  
• Build Product Governance & Compliance Culture – ensure that the team complete all Product Program Guidelines (PPGs) and/or Country Addenda for cash management products on a regular basis, that these documents reflect a true assessment of the inherent risks associated with these products, and that products are aligned to the legal, regulatory, compliance, tax, credit risk and other relevant frameworks and internal policies within the Bank. Review changes in the market landscape to understand the impact on the product bench, including changes in the regulatory horizon, and ensure the team pro-actively implement changes to mitigate risks and stay within the risk appetite of the Bank. Set up programs to promote awareness of risk and compliance issues associated with cash management products within GTB and with Sales and Coverage partners
  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience
  
• Minimum 10-12 years cash management product experience including at least 5 years senior management experience covering India market with full P&L accountability
  
• Strong understanding of all cash management products ideally in India/ global or large regional bank
  
• Track record developing and successfully commercialising multiple new products
  
• Experience in agile product and technology development approaches
  
• Strong people management skills
  
• Strong analytical and data rationale mindset
  
• Strong communication ability and executive impact

title: Assistant Manager - Product Delivery
description:
Assistant Manager – Product Delivery
  
  
Location: Mumbai
  
  
At IDfy, a great product only creates value when it actually lands - deployed, adopted, and working in the real world. As our Assistant Manager – Product Delivery, you'll be the person who makes that happen: turning client requirements into working solutions, translating messy real-world problems into clean product outcomes, and owning delivery end-to-end from the first conversation to go-live. If you love figuring out "what the client actually needs, how to solve it, and how to ship it" - this role is built for you.
  
  
**We're The Perfect Match If You**

* Have 1–3 years of experience in a client-facing implementation, SaaS delivery, solutioning, or technical project role.
* Have worked directly with enterprise clients and juggled multiple stakeholders and workstreams without dropping the ball.
* Are AI-first and hands-on - you reach for AI tools instinctively to move faster and solve smarter.
* Bring a can-do attitude - when someone says "this is tricky," your first instinct is "let's figure it out."
* Communicate with clarity and influence - equally comfortable aligning a client's HR team and rallying internal Product & Engineering.
* Thrive on ownership and ambiguity - you'd rather run a thread yourself than wait for a map.

**Here's What Your Day Would Look Like**

* Own end-to-end delivery of IDfy's products for clients - from requirement understanding through solutioning, UAT, and go-live - within agreed timelines.
* Get deep into the client's employee onboarding journey and HRTech ecosystem to spot process and product gaps before they become delivery issues.
* Translate client requirements into clear, actionable asks for internal teams - and translate the most appropriate solution back out to the client.
* Partner across teams to balance what the client wants against what's buildable, scalable, and on-time.
* Act as the key point of contact across the delivery lifecycle, keeping clients and internal Product / Engineering / Sales / CX aligned.
* Run multiple client implementations at once - tracking dependencies, risks, blockers, and timelines, and prioritizing by client impact and business criticality.
* Spot recurring patterns and push to standardize and improve how delivery gets done.

Why IDfy
  
  
At IDfy, we don't just build products - we build trust infrastructure for the digital economy. In this role, you'll sit at the frontline of how that trust actually reaches clients: owning delivery, shaping solutions, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with Product and Engineering.
  
  
If you've ever wanted to turn delivery puzzles into product wins - this is your playground.

title: Senior Consultant – Digital Strategy
description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Consultant – Digital Strategy**
WSP is seeking a
**Senior Consultant – Digital Strategy**
to join our growing Smart & Digital team in India. The role sits at the intersection of strategy, technology, data, AI and the built environment, helping clients define and deliver practical digital solutions that create measurable business and operational value.
  
  
As a Senior Consultant, you will work across major infrastructure, buildings, cities and real estate projects, supporting clients from strategy development and business case creation through solution definition, implementation planning and adoption. The successful candidate will combine strong consulting and analytical skills with a broad understanding of digital technologies and transformation approaches.
  
  
You will be expected to independently lead project workstreams, engage with senior client stakeholders, develop high-quality deliverables, and contribute to the growth of WSP's Smart & Digital offering.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Tech Strategy Advisory

+ Develop digital strategies and frameworks, smart city and smart asset strategies, digital roadmaps, operating models, business cases, and implementation plans.
+ Work directly with clients to understand business, operational, and asset-related challenges and translate them into practical digital solutions and transformation initiatives.
+ Assess opportunities across areas such as AI, data & analytics, digital twins, IoT, connected assets, automation, intelligent buildings, and digital platforms.
+ Conduct current-state assessments, stakeholder consultations, benchmarking studies, capability assessments, and technology evaluations.
+ Translate complex technology concepts into clear business propositions, executive recommendations and actionable implementation plans.
+ Conduct primary and secondary research, synthesize findings, and develop data-driven insights and perspectives for clients.

* Project Delivery

+ Lead and manage Smart & Digital consulting workstreams, from problem definition through recommendations and implementation planning.
+ Develop business requirements, use cases, and high-level solution concepts in collaboration with WSP technical specialists and delivery teams.
+ Prepare high-quality executive presentations, reports, business cases, and proposals.
+ Ensure deliverables are produced to a high standard of quality, accuracy and client relevance.

* Client and Stakeholder Management

+ Lead client workshops, interviews, and working sessions with senior stakeholders, project teams and multidisciplinary groups.
+ Build strong relationships with clients and act as a trusted advisor throughout project delivery.
+ Manage stakeholder expectations and facilitate alignment across diverse project teams and client organizations.

* Business Development

+ Support business development activities, proposal preparation, and client pursuits across Smart & Digital opportunities.
+ Contribute to thought leadership, market research, and the development of new Smart & Digital service offerings.
+ Identify opportunities to expand client relationships and support account growth.
+ Stay current with developments in AI, digital twins, smart cities, data platforms, automation and related technologies, assessing their practical applicability and business value across sectors.

**Qualifications**
**Requirements:**

* 4-6 years of experience in management consulting, digital strategy, technology advisory, smart cities, smart buildings, or related fields.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business, or a related discipline. MBA from a reputed institution, and prior consulting experience within a Big4 or leading management consulting firm, are advantageous.
* Demonstrated experience developing digital strategies and frameworks, transformation roadmaps, business cases, operating models or technology-enabled solutions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and structured thinking capabilities.
* Proficiency in secondary research, and experience conducting workshops, stakeholder interviews and executive-level client engagements.
* Proven ability to prepare high-quality presentations, reports, and client deliverables with an eye for design and cohesive storyboarding.
* Ability to independently manage workstreams and deliver projects in a client-facing environment.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across geographies and cultures.

**BGV:**

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**

* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.

***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
  
  
**Our Hybrid Working Module**
With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
  
  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
* Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.

**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.
  
  
**Inclusivity and Diversity**
WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.
  
  
**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
Join our close-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.
  
  
**With us, you can.
  
  
Apply today.**

Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. title: Device Manager
description:
At Adalvo, we're not just a company - we're a team of passionate people driven by our mission to consistently deliver high-quality products and services to our partners. We are positive, fast and always on target, we are Adalvo! 🎯 🚀

We are looking for an enthusiastic
**Device Manager**
to join our dynamic Strategic Scientific Affairs team. If you're someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves tackling new challenges, then this is the perfect opportunity for you.

**SUMMARY OF POSITION**

The Device Manager will be responsible for the technical, development, regulatory, and lifecycle management activities related to Adalvo's Drug-Device Combination Products (DDCPs) and Medical Devices. This role will act as the subject matter expert for device technologies, supporting product selection, development, licensing evaluations, regulatory submissions, technology transfers, and commercial launches.

Working closely with R&D, Portfolio, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Intellectual Property, Business Development, Supply Chain, and external device partners, the Device Manager will ensure that all device-related activities are executed in compliance with global regulatory requirements while supporting Adalvo's strategic growth objectives.

**ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE**

The position will report directly to the Senior Director / Head of R&D.

Key cross-functional interfaces include:

· Formulation Development

· Regulatory Affairs

· Quality Assurance

· Portfolio Management

· Business Development

· Intellectual Property

· Supply Chain

· Project Management

· External Device Manufacturers and Technology Partners

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Primary responsibilities of this role include the following:

**Device Strategy & Technical Leadership**

· Serve as Adalvo's technical lead for medical devices and drug-device combination products.

· Support product selection, due diligence activities, and technical evaluations of potential licensing opportunities.

· Define device development strategies aligned with regulatory, commercial, and patient requirements.

· Provide expert guidance on device selection, usability, human factors, and risk management activities.

**Device Development & Lifecycle Management**

· Lead development activities for autoinjectors, pen injectors, prefilled syringes, inhalation devices, nasal delivery systems, and other combination products.

· Prepare and review device development plans, specifications, technical documentation, and design verification reports.

· Oversee Design History Files (DHF), risk assessments, device change controls, and lifecycle management activities.

· Support troubleshooting and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the product lifecycle.

**Regulatory & Compliance**

· Ensure compliance with applicable global regulations and standards including MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, ISO 11608, ISO 11040, FDA 21 CFR, and other relevant medical device requirements.

· Support regulatory submissions, deficiency responses, variations, and lifecycle maintenance activities.

· Review technical files, design documentation, risk management files, and usability engineering documentation.

· Stay informed of emerging global device regulations and industry expectations.

**External Partner & Vendor Management**

· Identify, evaluate, qualify, and manage device manufacturers and development partners.

· Participate in technical due diligence of suppliers, development organizations, and manufacturing sites.

· Support quality audits and supplier qualification activities together with Quality teams.

· Drive collaboration and alignment across internal stakeholders and external partners.

**Technology Transfer & Commercial Launch**

· Support scale-up and technology transfer projects from development through commercialization.

· Ensure readiness of device components, assembly processes, testing methods, and packaging systems.

· Support manufacturing site implementation, validation activities, FAT/SAT reviews, and launch activities.

· Collaborate with Project Management to ensure timely execution of milestones and deliverables.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

· Work closely with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Portfolio, Business Development, and Commercial teams to deliver successful projects.

· Provide device expertise during partner meetings, customer discussions, and licensing evaluations.

· Support training and knowledge transfer related to device technologies across Adalvo.

**QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Packaging Technology, or a related scientific discipline.

• Minimum 8 years of pharmaceutical and/or medical device industry experience.

• Demonstrated experience with Drug-Device Combination Products and Medical Devices.

• Strong knowledge of device development principles, risk management, human factors engineering, and usability studies.

• Experience with prefilled syringes, pen injectors, autoinjectors, inhalation systems, or related delivery devices.

• Knowledge of MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, ISO 11608, ISO 11040 and FDA requirements.

• Experience supporting regulatory submissions and technical documentation.

• Strong project management and stakeholder management capabilities.

• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Preferred

• Experience working with global CDMOs, device manufacturers, and technology partners.

• Experience supporting ANDA, 505(b)(2), hybrid, or complex generic product development.

• Understanding of intellectual property considerations related to device development.

• Experience with design controls, DHF preparation, usability studies, and risk assessments.

• Exposure to global markets including EU, US, LATAM, and emerging markets.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

• Business Focus

• Strategic Thinking

• Results & Operational Excellence

• Collaboration

• Quality

• Innovation & Continuous Improvement

• Change Agility

**Why join us?**

🎯
**Exciting Challenges:**
Every day brings new opportunities to learn and grow.

🎯
**Supportive Environment:**
We foster a culture of collaboration, where your ideas are valued, and your voice is heard.

🎯
**Career Development:**
We're committed to helping you reach your full potential through ongoing training and development opportunities.

🎯
**Recognizing Excellence:**
We recognize and appreciate hard work and dedication by offering competitive compensation packages and employee rewards programs that acknowledge contributions and achievements.

🎯
**Fun and Inclusive Culture:**
We believe in celebrating our successes and building strong connections within our team.

**Ready to Ignite Your Passion?**

If you're ready to take the next step in your career and join a business committed to consistently deliver high-quality products and services, then we want to hear from you! Send us your resume today!

title: Analyst, Mobility Products
description:
**This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office. Based in our Mumbai office.**
**Analyst, Mobility Products**
We’re a data-driven organization, which makes our Analytics and Data Science teams the brains of our operation. On the cutting edge of customer and business analytics, they make sure all our decisions and innovations are based on the latest insights.
  
  
**Why Is This Job a Big Deal**
As part of the Mobility Analytics team, you will use data to generate the insights necessary to drive Priceline’s growth across North America. You will collaborate directly with multiple teams across the organization to identify methods to unlock incremental revenue.
  
  
**In This Role You Will Get To**

* Analyze Priceline’s business performance, identifying trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reports that deliver clear, actionable insights on partner and business performance.
* Lead deep-dive and exploratory analyses on strategic topics, answering complex business questions with data.
* Collaborate with stakeholders across business, marketing, finance, customer operations, and technology to influence decisions and improve outcomes.
* Partner with data engineers to support scalable, modern data solutions and seamless end-to-end processes.

**Who You Are**

* 3+ years of analytics or consulting experience; travel, ecommerce, or retail experience preferred
* Advanced skills in SQL, Python, and BI tools such as Tableau
* Strong analytical, data-driven problem-solving skills
* Ability to translate insights into clear, compelling presentations and have strong communication skills.
* Curious, quick to learn, and able to work independently and able to work independently
* Ability to work under pressure and multi-task in a fast-paced/rapidly changing environment.
* Strong ownership mindset with initiative and accountability

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
  
  
**Flexible work at Priceline**
Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
  
  
**Perks & Benefits At Priceline**
Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
  
  
**Health & wellness coverage**
including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
  
  
**Generous time off**
including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days
  
  
**Work/life support**
including the ability to work up to 4 weeks per year from anywhere, parental leave, dependent care and family support resources, Summer Fridays, and office perks like stocked kitchens and catered meals (varies by location)
  
  
**Financial security programs**
such as retirement plans with company contributions, life and disability coverage, and tax-advantaged accounts
  
  
**Signature travel perks**
including employee-only discounts on hotels and flights, VIP deals, and Big Deal Bucks credits
  
  
**Additional perks & discounts**
like travel and partner discounts, tuition support, legal support, and pet benefits
  
  
**A people-first culture**
with Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), social events, recognition programs, and service awards that help you connect, grow, and celebrate together
  
  
*Specific benefits and programs vary by location.*
**Inclusion is a Big Deal!**
To be the best travel dealmakers in the world, we believe our team should reflect the broad range of customers and communities we serve. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all employees have the freedom to bring their individual perspectives, life experiences, and passion to work.
  
  
Priceline is a proud equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate the unique lenses through which our employees see the world. We’d love for you to join us and help shape what makes our team extraordinary.
  
  
**Applying for this position**
We're excited that you are interested in a career with us. For all
**current employees**
, please use the internal portal to find jobs and apply.
  
  
External candidates are required to have an account before applying. When you click Apply, returning candidates can log in, or new candidates can quickly create an account to save/view applications.

title: Principal Functional Consultant
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**
We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
  
  
**About The Team**
Workday’s Consulting teams are driven by a passion for our products and the success of our customers in implementing our best-in-class cloud solutions. We’re a diverse group of people, with an invaluable mix of experience and backgrounds, located across multiple locations within the region. We are often remote from one another but that doesn’t stop our sense of collaboration, supportiveness, and fun!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a hardworking, innovative, and collaborative HCM Functional Consultant to join our team. In this role you will ensure the successful implementation of the Workday HCM solution with customers through product and implementation expertise. The ideal candidate for this position should have extensive experience implementing or supporting HCM systems, requirements capturing, configuration, data conversion and testing. You should be detail oriented, self-motivated, proactive, results oriented and able to successfully partner with customers and your project team. Be ready to be challenged and have fun!
  
  
**About You**
**Basic Qualifications**

* Minimum 10+ years of functional experience in any of HCM, Benefits, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Performance Management, Time & Absence software solutions or systems
* Should have worked as Solution Architect in an end-to-end implementation.
* Previous consulting experience preferred either as an internal consultant or with a consulting / software organization in another ERP application (e.g. Workday, SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft, Ultimate Software, ADP, Ceridian or similar application).
* Should have experience in at-least 4 full cycle client implementations
* Proven track record of successfully implementing and supporting HCM solutions

**Other Qualifications**

* Passion for customer service
* Validated project management experience
* Functional experience
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Business analysis and requirements gathering abilities.
* Ability to learn technology quickly through instruction and self-training.
* Experience deploying multiple projects simultaneously a plus
* Bachelor’s degree or relevant experience required
* Ability to work across different SKU’s simultaneously
* Work with the customer to help convert legacy data into Workday.
* Assist the Integration Consulting team in helping to configure and test integrations between Workday and third-party/custom solutions.
* Creation and execution of lifecycle test scenarios for all testing cycles in scope through partnership with the Test Lead
* Ensure optimal test coverage and test execution, enabling a smooth and timely transition to production.
* Mentor and share product knowledge with other consultants.
* Help deliver successful project outcomes and lasting customer relationships.
* Great team player

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**
With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply
**spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field**
with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.
  
  
Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.
  
  
Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.
  
  
If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com, as far in advance as possible.
  
  
**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**
At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.
  
  
Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.
  
  
In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

+ Ensure quality and timely delivery of project workstreams.

+ Stay updated on emerging trends in AI-enabled service transformation, including conversational AI and intelligent service management.

+ Support proposal development, RFP responses, and creation of client presentations.
+ Contribute to development of reusable assets, accelerators, and thought leadership for service transformation and AI offerings
+ Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
+ Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

* Have experience delivering AI-led service transformation initiatives, including chatbots, automation, knowledge management, and case management transformation.
* Have exposure to leading service platforms, including CRM/service cloud solutions and ITSM tools.
* Demonstrate an understanding of customer experience metrics (CSAT, NPS) and service KPIs, and their role in improving service operations and customer outcomes.

**What We Look For**

* 5+ years of experience in service transformation, customer operations, process improvement, or consulting.
* Consulting experience is preferred
* Experience in analysing service processes and supporting implementation of service or CRM platforms.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.

title: Smart Home Project Manager [AI & Automation]
description:
Location: Remote, India (flexible hours with U.S. team overlap)
  
  
Engagement type: Full-time
  
  
Compensation: INR 2,38,250 - INR 2,85,900 per month (based on experience and interview process)
  
  
**About Sanctuary**
Sanctuary builds nature - led, wellness - centered communities that feel alive. Our first 135-acre residential community in the Texas Hill Country is designed with:
  
  
🌱 Non-toxic materials
  
  
💧 Clean water and filtration systems
  
  
⚡ EMF-conscious design
  
  
🌿 135 acres of preserved land and eco - sensitive planning
  
  
We are a global team (spread across 8 countries) of designers, architects, engineers, and dreamers building spaces that restore and inspire. For us, it’s not just where people live - it’s how they live.
  
  
Our vision is to bring Sanctuary to major cities around the world: healthy, sovereign communities that sit on the edges of every modern metropolis.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Smart Home Project Manager to bring technology into our homes in a way that supports how people live. You will manage the implementation of smart home systems across our projects - from planning and vendor selection through installation and handover - and use AI tools to prototype integrations, automate workflows, and build internal systems. Internally, we call this role a "Smart Home VibeKid": someone who can vibe code a working prototype instead of waiting for someone else to build it.
  
  
Smart home at Sanctuary looks a little different. Our homes are designed around wellness, so technology has to serve health and comfort - lighting, air and water quality, energy, security - while staying mindful of EMF exposure. You will help decide what goes into our homes, how it all works together, and how residents experience it.
  
  
This is not a role for someone who needs close oversight or a fixed playbook. We are looking for someone curious and hands-on, who can test ideas quickly, figure out what's missing, and turn a concept into a working system.
  
  
****What you'll do****
*Smart home implementation*

* Plan and manage smart home technology across our projects: lighting, climate, air and water quality monitoring, energy, security, and connectivity
* Evaluate and select smart home platforms, devices, and vendors that fit our wellness and EMF-conscious standards
* Work with architects, MEP consultants, and the construction team to build smart home systems into designs early
* Oversee installation, testing, and handover with vendors and integrators

*AI prototyping and automation*

* Use AI tools to prototype smart home integrations and automations before they go into homes
* Build internal systems and workflows using AI-assisted ("vibe") coding and no-code platforms
* Automate project tracking, vendor coordination, and reporting for smart home work
* Keep up with new smart home and AI technology, and test what could work for us

*Project management and coordination*

* Track timelines, budgets, and deliverables for smart home scope on each project
* Coordinate vendors, integrators, and internal teams across India and the U.S.
* Document systems clearly for residents, facility management, and future projects

****What you bring****

* 3-7 years of experience in smart home, home automation, IoT, ELV, or building management systems (BMS) in real estate projects
* Hands-on knowledge of smart home platforms and protocols (e.g. Home Assistant, Control4, Crestron, KNX, Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter)
* Experience managing installations with vendors and integrators, from planning to handover
* Hands-on experience building prototypes or automations with AI (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Replit) or no-code platforms (e.g. Zapier, Make, Airtable)
* Examples of integrations, tools, or automations you've built - please share them when you apply
* Interest in wellness technology (air and water quality, circadian lighting, low-EMF design) is a strong plus
* Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving, remote, cross-cultural environment
* Clear, proactive communicator in English, both written and spoken

****Hiring process****

* Stage 1: Intro interview - Role alignment, experience overview, a walkthrough of systems or tools you've built, and culture fit
* Stage 2: Test task - A short practical assignment: plan or prototype a smart home solution using AI tools
* Stage 3: Final interview - Deep dive into workflows, expectations, and growth

title: Assistant Manager - Digital Marketing
description:
The Assistant Manager – Digital Marketing will be responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and optimizing digital marketing initiatives across the Skechers India brand website, e-commerce platforms, paid media channels, and other relevant digital touchpoints.  
The role will focus on driving website traffic, improving customer acquisition and conversion, maximizing return on advertising spend (ROAS), and contributing to online sales and revenue growth. The incumbent will work closely with the CRM, Web Development, Content Marketing, E-commerce, and Sales teams, along with external agencies and marketplace partners, to deliver integrated campaigns aligned with brand priorities and commercial objectives.  
The position requires a strong combination of digital marketing expertise, e-commerce platform knowledge, analytical capabilities, and project management skills to deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Designation:** Assistant Manager

**Role:** Digital Marketing

**Department:** Marketing & VM  
**Location:** Mumbai (Andheri East)  
**Reporting To:** Senior Manager

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**A. Digital Marketing Campaign Management**

* Plan, execute, monitor, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, search engines, social media, display advertising, and other relevant digital channels.
* Manage paid search, Performance Max, Product Listing Ads (PLA), and other performance marketing campaigns to drive qualified traffic, conversions, and revenue.
* Develop and continuously optimize ad creatives, copy, audience targeting, bidding strategies, and landing pages to improve campaign effectiveness.
* Monitor campaign performance against defined KPIs, including ROI/ROAS, cost per acquisition (CPA), conversion rates, traffic, and revenue.
* Ensure efficient utilization of advertising budgets and achievement of monthly performance targets.

**B. Website and E-commerce Marketing**

* Manage digital marketing activities for the Skechers India brand website, with a focus on traffic acquisition, conversion optimization, and online revenue growth.
* Collaborate with the Web Development and Content Marketing teams to ensure timely execution of website updates, promotional campaigns, product launches, and seasonal initiatives.
* Monitor website performance, customer journeys, and conversion funnels to identify opportunities for improving the overall customer experience.
* Coordinate the implementation of landing pages, promotional content, product campaigns, and other website marketing requirements.
* Support website merchandising and digital initiatives in alignment with brand guidelines and business priorities.

**C. E-commerce Marketplace Marketing**

* Plan and execute digital marketing activities across e-commerce partner platforms, including Amazon, Flipkart, and other relevant online marketplaces.
* Manage marketplace advertising campaigns, including sponsored ads, product ads, and keyword-based campaigns, to improve product visibility and sales performance.
* Track advertising expenditure, sales contribution, campaign efficiency, and ROAS to achieve monthly marketplace performance targets.
* Monitor seller account health, product listings, catalog performance, inventory availability, and other relevant operational metrics in coordination with internal teams and marketplace partners.
* Identify opportunities to improve product discoverability, marketplace conversion rates, sales performance, and overall account effectiveness.
* Collaborate with e-commerce and sales teams to align promotional activities, advertising investments, and revenue targets.

**D. Analytics, Reporting and Optimization**

* Measure and report the performance of digital marketing campaigns against established objectives, budgets, and KPIs.
* Analyze data from Google Analytics, advertising platforms, CRM tools, and marketplace dashboards to generate actionable insights.
* Prepare regular performance reports covering traffic, conversions, revenue, advertising spend, ROI/ROAS, and other relevant business metrics.
* Evaluate the end-to-end customer journey across multiple digital channels and customer touchpoints.
* Conduct performance analysis, identify trends, and recommend optimization strategies to improve campaign efficiency and business outcomes.
* Use data-driven insights to support budget allocation, campaign planning, and continuous improvement.

**E. SEO and Website Optimization**

* Support on-page and off-page SEO initiatives to improve organic visibility, keyword rankings, and website traffic.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and keyword opportunity assessments.
* Coordinate technical SEO and website optimization requirements with the Web Development team.
* Monitor organic search performance and recommend improvements to website content, metadata, landing pages, and site structure.
* Use tools such as Google Search Console, SEMrush, and Google Analytics to evaluate performance and identify opportunities.

**F. CRM and Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with the CRM team to support customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and repeat-purchase initiatives.
* Collaborate with Content Marketing and Creative teams to develop campaign assets, promotional content, and communication aligned with brand guidelines.
* Coordinate with Sales and E-commerce teams to ensure marketing campaigns support business priorities and revenue goals.
* Manage external agencies, platform representatives, and other partners to ensure timely and effective campaign delivery.
* Coordinate campaign timelines, budgets, deliverables, and dependencies across internal and external stakeholders.

**G. Project and Budget Management**

* Manage multiple campaigns and projects simultaneously while ensuring timely execution and adherence to approved budgets.
* Track advertising expenditure, campaign milestones, and deliverables to ensure accountability and efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, campaign workflows, and cross-functional coordination.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail across campaign execution, reporting, and platform management.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Digital Marketing, or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification or certification in Digital Marketing, Performance Marketing, Analytics, or E-commerce will be an added advantage.

**Work Experience**

* Approximately 3–5 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, performance marketing, e-commerce marketing, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience managing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns, including budget management, targeting, bidding, and performance optimization.
* Experience managing advertising campaigns on Amazon and Flipkart or other e-commerce marketplaces.
* Demonstrated experience in analyzing campaign performance, managing advertising budgets, and delivering measurable business results.
* Experience in retail, fashion, footwear, lifestyle, or consumer brands will be preferred.

**Technical Skills and Competencies**

**Digital Marketing and Advertising**

* Hands-on proficiency in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, paid search, display advertising, and performance marketing.
* Understanding of marketplace advertising, including Amazon Ads and Flipkart Ads.
* Knowledge of campaign optimization, audience targeting, keyword bidding, conversion tracking, and budget management.
* Understanding of SEO fundamentals, SEM, and digital customer acquisition strategies.

**Analytics and Reporting**

* Proficiency in Google Analytics 4 (GA4), advertising platform dashboards, and performance reporting.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis, reporting, and spreadsheet-based performance tracking.
* Ability to interpret campaign data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Understanding of KPIs such as ROAS, ROI, CPA, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, and revenue contribution.

**Technology and Marketing Tools**

* Working knowledge of CRM platforms and marketing automation tools.
* Familiarity with SEMrush, Google Search Console, and WordPress.
* Basic knowledge of HTML and CSS will be an advantage.
* Understanding of website analytics, conversion tracking, landing page optimization, and e-commerce platforms.

**Communication and Project Management**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Effective coordination and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet tight deadlines.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

**Desired Experience and Additional Advantages**

The following capabilities will be considered advantageous:

* Experience in on-page and off-page SEO for static and dynamic websites.
* Strong keyword research, competitor analysis, and organic traffic optimization skills.
* Experience in managing Google Ads campaigns, keyword bids, spending limits, and account performance metrics.
* Hands-on experience with Amazon Ads, including sponsored product campaigns and campaign performance optimization.
* Experience with Flipkart Ads and other marketplace advertising platforms.
* Exposure to marketing automation, customer segmentation, lead nurturing, and CRM-led campaigns.
* Understanding of website content management, basic HTML/CSS, and conversion rate optimization.
* Experience working with external digital marketing agencies and cross-functional teams.

**Personal Attributes**

* Passion for the retail, fashion, footwear, and lifestyle industry.
* Customer-centric mindset with an understanding of digital consumer behavior.
* Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently.
* Strong analytical thinking and a solution-oriented approach.
* Highly organized, with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results within defined timelines.
* Collaborative approach with strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
* Innovative mindset with a focus on continuous improvement, customer engagement, and loyalty.
* Commercial awareness and a results-oriented approach to achieving marketing and business objectives.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance in this role will be evaluated against agreed business objectives and campaign targets, including:

* Achievement of monthly digital advertising ROI/ROAS targets.
* Contribution to website and e-commerce revenue growth.
* Efficiency of advertising expenditure and achievement of budget targets.
* Improvement in website traffic, conversion rates, and customer acquisition efficiency.
* Marketplace advertising performance and sales contribution across Amazon, Flipkart, and other partner platforms.
* Improvement in organic search visibility and website performance.
* Timely and effective execution of marketing campaigns and promotional activities.
* Accuracy and timeliness of campaign reporting and performance analysis.
* Effective coordination with internal teams, external agencies, and marketplace partners.

*Note: Specific targets will be established in line with the annual marketing plan, channel budgets, and business objectives.*

**Expected Contribution to the Business**

The Assistant Manager – Digital Marketing will play a critical role in strengthening Skechers India's digital marketing capabilities and supporting its online business growth. The position will ensure consistent execution of marketing initiatives, improve the efficiency of advertising investments, strengthen e-commerce marketplace performance, and enable data-driven decision-making.

By filling this vacancy, the Digital Marketing team will be better positioned to manage its operational responsibilities, execute strategic initiatives effectively, and achieve its annual marketing and commercial objectives without placing an unsustainable workload on existing team members

**About Skechers**

Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

title: Product Associate
description:
**Job Role - Product Associate**
**Location - Pune**
**What The Work Is Like**
Nobody will hand you a finished spec. You'll get a customer with a problem, a rough idea of what good looks like, and
  
  
people who will help if you ask. You talk to the customer, work out what is actually wrong, decide what to build, get it
  
  
built (with engineers, or with AI tools yourself), and check that it worked. Then you do the next one.
  
  
You'll own one area of the product and the customers who use it. We decide which area together, once you've joined,
  
  
based on what you're good at.
  
  
**You'll do well here if**

* You've started something nobody asked you to: a project, a small business, an event, a fix at work, an app
* When instructions are unclear, you make a sensible assumption, say it out loud, and get moving
* You'd rather ship something that works on Friday than something perfect next month
* You go and ask the person with the problem instead of guessing
* You pick up new things quickly, whether that's a new industry, a codebase or a customer's business

**You probably won't enjoy it if**

* You do your best work when the task is fully defined before you start
* You want a large team and a fixed process around you

**What We Don't Require**
A particular degree or college, a product title, or years of experience. Some of our best people came from customer
  
  
support, operations or a family business.
  
  
**How To Apply**
We don't start with your CV. The application form asks for:
  
  

* A link to something you built, ran or fixed that nobody asked you to. Any form counts: an app, a spreadsheet,

an event, a process, a video.
  
  

* What was broken, what you did, and what happened. At most 100 words, with at least one real name, number

or date.
  
  

* One time nobody told you what to do. What did you do in the first hour? At most 100 words.
* When you can start, and a link to your CV or LinkedIn.

Applications without a link, or with answers over 100 words, are not read. The limits are part of the test.
  
  
Apply here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfKHxjoKx3sOvBijnnloJQqE3ywMJpyP9T0GoR7\_kB\_5FKQfQ/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=104777260577875084657
  
  
What happens next: a 30-minute written exercise, a 20-minute call, a take-home (AI tools allowed) and a conversation about
  
  
it, then a final conversation with our CEO.
  
  
**About CrelioHealth**
CrelioHealth is a fast-growing health-tech product company delivering cloud-based LIMS, RIS, CRM, and Inventory solutions to diagnostics labs and hospitals globally. We are building scalable systems that power modern healthcare operations.
  
  
**Website**
: www.creliohealth.com
