title: Engineering Manager- Hardware
description:
**What You’ll Do**
Lead a multidisciplinary engineering organization responsible for the development, industrialization, launch, and lifecycle management of complex electrical and electromechanical products. The role provides leadership to Electrical, Mechanical, Embedded/Firmware, Systems, and Verification and Validation teams, driving execution from concept and product definition through production and lifecycle support while meeting quality, schedule, cost, regulatory, and customer commitments.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine a strong hardware and electrical product foundation with hands-on product development experience and a proven record in systems engineering, new product introduction (NPI), and manufacturing readiness. Preference will be given to candidates who have worked extensively on electrical products, particularly inverters, distributed energy resources (DER), circuit breakers, power management, or related grid-connected products.
  
  
The preferred candidate will also have substantial experience partnering with Product Management to convert customer, market, regulatory, and competitive insights into product requirements, system architecture, differentiated product concepts, and technology or portfolio roadmaps.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, develop, and retain multidisciplinary engineering teams across Electrical, Mechanical, Embedded/Firmware, Systems, and Verification and Validation disciplines.
* Drive end-to-end product development by applying systems engineering practices throughout the product lifecycle, from stakeholder-needs definition and concept development through architecture, detailed design, verification, validation, launch, and lifecycle management.
* Partner closely with Product Management to translate voice of customer, market trends, regulatory needs, competitive intelligence, and business priorities into product requirements, engineering plans, system architectures, and technology roadmaps.
* Lead or technically guide market studies, competitive product analysis, and benchmarking for electrical products, evaluating architecture, functionality, performance, safety, reliability, connectivity, cost, manufacturability, and product differentiation.
* Provide technical and organizational leadership for electrical products such as inverters, DER solutions, circuit breakers, power management products, connected electrical devices, and related electromechanical systems.
* Oversee system architecture, requirements management, interface definition, design trade-offs, design reviews, system integration, verification, validation, product qualification, and technical risk closure.
* Lead NPI, industrialization, manufacturing transfer, design transfer, production ramp-up, and product launch activities in collaboration with Operations, Sourcing, Quality, Manufacturing, and external partners.
* Ensure effective cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Product Management, Program Management, Operations, Sourcing, Quality, Manufacturing, Sales, and other global stakeholders.
* Provide technical leadership in hardware development, embedded systems, system integration, product safety, reliability, and design for manufacturability and serviceability.
* Manage portfolio and project execution, resource planning, budget, engineering risks, priorities, and stakeholder alignment across global teams.
* Build a culture of ownership, customer focus, innovation, disciplined engineering execution, continuous improvement, and talent development.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Systems Engineering, or a related engineering field.
* 14+ years of engineering experience, including significant leadership of cross-functional product development teams.

**Skills**

* Strong hands-on hardware and electrical product development background, with experience in electrical or electromechanical product design and realization.
* Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams comprising Electrical, Mechanical, Embedded/Firmware, Systems, and Verification and Validation engineers.
* Demonstrated expertise in systems engineering, including stakeholder-needs analysis, requirements development and management, system architecture, interface management, design trade-offs, system integration, verification, validation, and product realization.
* Strong experience in NPI, industrialization, manufacturing readiness, design transfer, production ramp-up, and product launch.
* Working knowledge of embedded software or firmware development, system integration, and validation processes.
* Excellent people leadership, stakeholder management, communication, decision-making, and global collaboration skills.

**Preferred Experience**

* Extensive product development or engineering leadership experience with electrical products, especially inverters, distributed energy resources (DER), circuit breakers, power conversion, power distribution, energy management, or grid-connected products.
* Experience applying systems engineering practices to complex, multidisciplinary electrical or electromechanical products across the full product lifecycle.
* Demonstrated partnership with Product Management in customer and market assessment, product definition, portfolio planning, value proposition development, and product or technology roadmap creation.
* Hands-on experience conducting or technically leading competitive analysis, product teardowns, benchmarking, and market studies in the electrical products domain.
* Ability to connect customer needs, competitive insights, market opportunities, and regulatory trends with system requirements, technology choices, product architecture, and engineering priorities.
* Global engineering team leadership and collaboration across regions, functions, and manufacturing locations.
* Experience with regulatory compliance, product safety, reliability engineering, quality systems, and relevant electrical product standards.
* Experience with connected products, industrial controls, residential energy, energy transition, or power management applications.

**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Project Manager supports S2P delivery by managing the backlog in a blended Kanban/Scrum model—driving refinement, ensuring stories meet requirement standards, and routing enablers to the Program Manager. * Establish and manage the backlog process for all Source to Pay functions using a Kanban or Scrum approach, ensuring transparency, prioritization, and readiness for delivery.

* Stories contain clearly defined requirements (e.g., objective, scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, estimates, priority), meeting definition of ready.
* Enablers are identified with clearly documented objectives, outputs, and prioritized.
* Manage a QC process to ensure Program Managers adhere to documentation guidelines
* Drive the Program Increment (PI) prioritization process, partnering with stakeholders to intake work, align priorities, and sequence items based on value and need.

* Manage projects as needed, including planning, prioritization, scope tracking, status reporting, and risk/issue/dependency (RAID) management.
* Maintain delivery artifacts and reporting (e.g., project minutes and action items, approval, testing and other documentation, decision logs, and schedules).
* Identify and escalate blockers, risks, and cross-team dependencies; propose resolution options and coordinate next steps.
* Promote continuous improvement in intake, prioritization, refinement, and flow efficiency across the S2P delivery process.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience
* 3+ years in Project Management/Agile delivery role utilizing Scrum and/or Kanban
* Scrum Master Certification or Service Delivery Manager
* Experience writing/supporting user stories (scope, acceptance criteria) and tracking dependencies/estimates.
* Experience managing a PI/quarterly prioritization (or similar intake and sequencing) process.
* Enforce documentation standards by managing a quality control process.
* Proficient with Jira/Confluence and MS Office (Excel/PowerPoint/Visio)
* Experience with identifying and developing process metrics

* Familiarity with Source to Pay teams and Coupa preferred.
* Experience summarizing complex projects, risks, or ideas to Senior Leadership in a concise manner.
* Detail-oriented and documentation-focused; produces audit-ready artifacts.
* Comfortable with ambiguity with ability to break work down for sequencing.
* Strong organization, communication and facilitation skills
* Proactive communicator who escalates risks/dependencies early and drives follow-through.
* Continuous improvement and curious mindset with interest in flow/throughput metrics.

title: Sr. Product Manager - Trading
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
The Senior Product Manager-Trading will collaborate with the other Trading Product Managers and Trading Product Leads to help guide the vision for Trading, OMS, and IBOR products. We are building this product suite anew and collaborating with our design team to improve the advisor/trader facing workflows and build engaging experiences that scale. You will execute product vision, implement strategy, and collaborate with a cross-functional team in a manner that improves their efficiency and productivity.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Possess a solid understanding of Trading, Rebalancing, and OMS systems used in the US and European wealth management industry. You understand trading products in terms of their users, business value, technical landscape, data, vendors, and can relate these to other areas of the Addepar ecosystem
* Document and communicate goals for the product and drive an innovative product roadmap that conveys the team vision and goals to our clients
* Build consensus with the team to prioritize and define increments of work based on level of effort, interdependencies, and other relevant criteria
* Assist in adjusting strategy in response to changing company, business, market, and technical needs.
* Identify appropriate users, partners, competitors, and market trends from which to elicit input and draw inspiration

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of relevant work experience and education in product management, software development, user workflows, and efficiently leading teams
* Fundamental knowledge in finance, trading, and investments, specifically with trading for wealth management firms
* Ability to communicate finance domain knowledge, problems and knowledge well both in person and in writing for internal development and sales teams as well for clients and 3rd party data partners
* Ability to partner with engineering to define the functional and technical implementation to tackle a business problem. This includes understanding of high level data development concepts, data modelling and the ability to write and review technical requirements documents
* Practical knowledge of agile thinking and lean practices; project management, and a strong ability to guide teams through project iterations
* A superpower for identifying the appropriate tools, people and techniques to accomplish objectives

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

description:

We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Specialist, Global Product Management (Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Solution)
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
In Mastercard Services division, we go beyond payments. We deliver cutting-edge solutions that help businesses, financial institutions, and governments unlock growth and manage risk. By combining deep industry expertise, advanced technology, and data-driven insights, we enable smarter decisions and better outcomes worldwide.
  
  
We are part of a cross-functional team under Financial Crime Solutions (FCS) overseeing solutions that are dedicated to safeguarding businesses and consumers from various financial crimes. Product management collaborates with SMEs, Product Enablement, Data Science, Operations, and Engineering partners to launch solutions that detect and prevent financial crime, with advanced technologies, data analysis techniques and industry best practices to identify suspicious patterns, behaviours, and transactions on a global scale.
  
  
Our team collaborates with banks and regulators to strengthen compliance and stay ahead of evolving threats. Fighting money laundering requires a united effort. Our mission? Improve detection, enhance compliance, and keep innovating to protect the financial system.
  
  
Join us and be part of a global team shaping the future of commerce.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Solutions Product Management team is looking for a Senior Specialist, Global Product Management to help drive delivery of our product roadmap and strategy by consistently innovating and problem-solving. The ideal candidate is passionate about helping our customers to reduce financial crime, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.
  
  
The AML Solutions portfolio spans a variety of launched and new capabilities, helping Financial Institutions strengthen anti-money laundering controls through advanced analytics, network insights and data driven intelligence. By monitoring activity across the Mastercard network, we provide timely notifications to help institutions take action.
  
  
This role presents a unique opportunity to contribute to the ongoing success of our solutions, by providing valuable product support, and help shape the next phase of development on our AML Solutions roadmap. Through collaboration, strategic analysis and innovative thinking, this role will help strengthen our position in the market and provide unique learnings in an ever-evolving landscape.
  
  
Role
  
  

* Drive product initiatives through the Studio framework, supporting ongoing innovation and enhancement delivery for AML Solutions from concept to commercialization.
* Support Product Owners in the development of AML product strategies and roadmaps for new and enhance products. Strive to take them to new markets and new customer segments and support expansion plans with clear value to address key customers.
* Execute test & learn experimentation to ensure that the end user and customer experience is continuously optimized. Support creation of design specifications for product enhancements to Product development.
* Work closely with Regional, Product Management and Product Enablement teams to account for customer and end users feedback. Understand their wants and needs, analyze trends and translate into the product roadmaps where prioritized.
* Conduct research and data analysis to feed in and support initiatives relating to idea generation, concept validation framing, go-to-market strategies and/or business case development.
* Take accountability for the delivery of key product enhancements and partner with Guild members to deliver (e.g. CX&D, Product Management – Technical).
* Understand the Software Development Lifecycle and surface any barriers or obstacles to deliver capabilities on time and budget. Proactively communicate situation and proposed solutions to senior management.
* Leverage data & dashboards to quickly identify Product performance challenges, making recommendations on proposed action plans.
* Participate with stakeholders in cross-functional teams (e.g. Data Science, Engineering, Product Operations) in the development of business requirements to achieve Product objectives.
* Drive institutionalized knowledge through the use of consistent product documentation (e.g., support documents) across the Studio framework.
* Understand our target markets and the relevant regulatory requirements to build a closer relationship with our customers and partners.

Works with Issuers and Partners to create positive experiences for cardholders.
  
  
**All About You**

* Relentless focus to drive strong customer outcomes by understanding and promoting the suite of AML Solutions.
* Take a data-driven approach to product enhancements, identifying opportunity areas and contributing to the Product roadmap, prioritizing work to deliver against key areas of focus.
* Good understanding of global financial crime challenges and how we can support to tackle them, in AML Compliance is an advantage.
* Enjoy working and building relationships in multicultural matrix organization.
* Demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning by leveraging the learning & development

**Curriculum To Augment Existing Knowledge, Skills And Experiences.**

* Have strong written and verbal communication skills in order to clearly articulate and simplify

complex topics.
  
  

* Understand Mastercard’s business model and take key financial or commercial factors into consideration to positively influence revenue delivery and cost efficiency.

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Product Owner - Career
description:
Whether you started from the product side and developed technical skills or started as a technical resource, you have a knack for the product side of the business. You possess the necessary technical product knowledge to drive strategic conversations about the product and enhance value to Equifax and its customers.
  
  
Equifax is seeking a
**technical product owner**
who is a master at bridging the desires of the customer and the capabilities of the technology, removing barriers to software development. You will be responsible for grooming the product backlog and have insight into technical requirements of individual stories thus creating a more efficient user experience.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Connects with the Customer in partnership with Product Management - Know the customer & stakeholders: Understands the needs of customers and stakeholders in a broader context; Develops partnership relationships with key engineering and QA counterparts and engages with Architecture teams as needed; Understands the Problem(s) to be solved: Participates in interviews with users, customers and stakeholders to understand requirements; Can articulate and decompose the work into discrete increments that align to customer needs; Provides inputs in business/technical requirements definition; Develops whole product solutions: Understands the end product/functionality needed and can articulate a broader need to deliver a more holistic solution; Provides guidance to engineering and QA teams when clarity about business requirements is needed.
* Contributes to the Plan and Roadmap - Solutioning and Estimation: Active participant in solutioning and epic decomposition process to groom the backlog of stories, as well as initial t-shirt sizing sessions; Provides inputs to QE partners to ensure testing approach and high level use cases are considered in the solution and estimation; Helps drive MVP definition with stakeholders when applicable; Dependency management: Drives the process to identify, capture and document dependencies required to deliver the plan in partnership with engineering and architecture teams; Interacts with dependent teams to understand dependencies; Backlog Prioritization and planning: Active participant in the process of initial estimates and value/effort assessment to define scope of quarterly increments; Contributes to the analysis of how work should be sequenced and the implications to the critical path.
* Manages & Prioritizes Team Backlog(s) - User Story creation: Reviews initial drafts of stories developed and/or contributes to refinement for Product Management review; Prioritization and sprint planning: Aligns prioritization with Product Management and Product Owner best practices for defined backlog; Creates sprint, sprint goal, ensures sprint plans are in place for the current sprint and the subsequent two sprints; Drives alignment with upstream dependencies to deliver; Testing and Acceptance Criteria: Drives adherence to story acceptance criteria to ensure development team delivers according to desired outcome and readiness checklist; Partners with QE and Engineering lead to define testing approach, scope and planning; Provides final sign-off/acceptance of stories; Demos: Reviews initial drafts and partners with product managers to prepare sprint/quarterly demos. Is capable of presenting the demo itself.
* Getting and Applying Feedback & Lessons Learned - Captures feedback from Demos: Actively lead documentation and synthesize feedback from demos for tangible future work efforts to be considered in the backlog with Product Management; Delivery Retrospectives: Velocity, quality (incidents/bugs), reasons for delays: Understands drivers of team velocity; Understands testing gaps that drove incidents and bugs; Understands drivers for delays in committed deliverables; Synthetizes learnings and proposes a prioritized set of changes in partnership with technology partners; Monitors adoption KPIs: Understands metrics driving the adoption success of the released value and proposes changes to upcoming deliverables to drive improvements; Adopts feedback in future iterations: Drives the scope and/or changes to new release increments to feedback collected.

**What Experience You Need**

* Bachelor's degree in a related discipline strongly preferred; equivalent experience may be considered
* 5-7 years of product owner experience in a cloud-based and/or SaaS environment
* Working experience using Agile methodologies, facilitating Agile ceremonies and Lean product management required
* Working experience with data structures, data analytics and AI concepts preferred
* Experience working with cross functional teams preferred
* Exposure and experience understanding and tracking capacity against the budget of product initiatives
* Cloud certification strongly preferred

**What Could Set You Apart**

* You have the ability build strong relationships with partners across the business; ensure that you understand their role, the needs of their area, and their requirements throughout the project
* You are a self-starter who is organized, detail oriented, takes initiative with minimal direction, and understands concepts quickly
* You understand the value of product ownership and can effectively communicate the value proposition
* You have experience working with multiple partners in a global setting with varying level of needs
* You bring a consultative, creative and process driven approach to your work
* You have an aptitude for handling multiple concurrent demands and prioritizing responsibilities in a dynamic, high energy environment
* Your problem-solving skills enable you to effectively and creatively find solutions for hard problems while maintaining a high level of professionalism and integrity
* Engage and collaborate with all stakeholders, make people feel heard and understood, are able to say no and stand up for tough calls needed to better serve the business and our clients

title: Platform Manager – Insulation
description:
**Huntsman Corporation**
is now looking for a dynamic individual as a
**Platform Manager – Insulation.**
The job holder will be a key member of the ISC Polyurethane Technology & Innovation (T&I) team, based in Mumbai. As part of the broader Global Technology & Innovation organization, the India T&I team plays a critical role in product development, localization, and innovation efforts that support the growth and competitiveness of the Polyurethanes business in India. The team is focused on expanding the product portfolio and delivering high-impact, customer-centric solutions aligned with evolving market demands.
  
  
This role specifically focuses on managing and developing the product portfolio within the Insulation market segment in Polyurethanes. The Platform Manager will drive innovation through the identification and implementation of differentiated solutions, support technology transfers from global platforms, lead localization efforts, and ensure compliance with all regulatory standards. The role requires close collaboration with global and regional teams to bring innovations to market and sustain a competitive edge.
  
  
This position will be based in Pune, India.
  
  
**Core Functions**
**As a**
**Platform Manager – Insulation you will:**
Ensure full compliance with company safety, health, and environmental (SHE) standards across all areas of responsibility, including labs, production facilities, and customer locations.
  
  
Maintain in-depth technical knowledge of Insulation PU products and processing technologies.
  
  
Monitor global and local product portfolios, including competitor offerings, to identify opportunities and ensure market relevance.
  
  
Lead technology transfer and localization efforts for the Insulation product line in coordination with global teams.
  
  
Continuously benchmark and optimize the product portfolio to ensure cost competitiveness.
  
  
Ensure full adherence to regulatory and quality standards in product development and commercialization.
  
  
Collaborate closely with global Platform Managers to align local activities with overall global strategy.
  
  
**Market & Implementation Focus**
Work closely with local cross-functional teams including R&D, Sales, Marketing, and Supply Chain to implement platform strategies effectively.
  
  
Engage directly with key customers to support the introduction and scaling of new technologies.
  
  
Foster close collaboration with the Technical Service (TS) team to ensure fast, effective deployment of innovations and enhanced customer satisfaction.
  
  
Serve as the subject matter expert for the Insulation platform in the Indian market.
  
  
Analyze market trends, customer requirements, and competitive landscape to inform strategic planning.
  
  
Provide technical and strategic support for business development initiatives.
  
  
Represent the company at relevant industry conferences, customer meetings, and technical events.
  
  
Deliver regular reports and presentations to senior leadership on platform performance, innovation pipeline, and market feedback.
  
  
Travel domestically and internationally as required to support projects and customer engagement.
  
  
**What skills and experiences are we looking for?**
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical field.
  
  
8–10 years of experience in the Polyurethanes industry, preferably with a strong background in PU Insulation.
  
  
Proven track record in product/platform management, innovation, and global technology transfer.
  
  
Experience working in a global matrix organization is highly desirable.
  
  
Ability to collaborate across functions and influence without direct authority.
  
  
Strategic mindset paired with a pragmatic, hands-on approach.
  
  
Fluency in English is required; additional language skills are a plus.
  
  
Deep understanding of polyurethane chemistry, formulation, processing, and application development.
  
  
Knowledge of relevant regulatory and quality assurance standards.
  
  
Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
  
  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  
  
Strong project management and organizational abilities.
  
  
**What can we offer?**
Huntsman offers unsurpassed opportunities to build a successful future. We are a global specialty chemical company with locations in 25 countries around the world, employing over 6,000 associates. Our diverse portfolio creates a range of career fields including manufacturing, research and development, technical services, sales and marketing, customer service – and the list goes on.
  
  
Here, you can make an impact and make a difference. Come join us.
  
  
Huntsman is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all qualified applicants for employment, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, gender identification, sexual orientation and/or expression or any other characteristic protected by law in every location in which we have facilities national or local.

title: Technical Product Manager (Platform)
description:
**Company overview:**
TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi-enterprise processes at global scale.
  
  
Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.
  
  
Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.
  
  
****Position Overview****
The OPUS Platform Knowledge Expert is a platform and subject-matter expert responsible for developing, structuring, and maintaining the messaging, positioning, and core knowledge artifacts that power TraceLink’s OPUS Platform go-to-market execution, field enablement, and AI-driven experiences for both customer personas and TraceLink field teams.
  
  
The OPUS Platform Knowledge Expert serves as the global owner of the OPUS platform capability areas—such as Opus Reports and Dashboards, Opus Solution Environment, Solution Catalog, user administration, metadata management, etc.—and builds the messaging frameworks, insights, and artifacts that support executive-level conversations across all relevant customer segments.
  
  
This is a unique role combining platform expertise, industry context, strategic storytelling, and knowledge artifact creation, and curation for executive buyer experiences.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
****OPUS Platform Domain Expertise****

* Serve as TraceLink’s subject-matter expert for the OPUS Platform, supporting Product Marketing, Demand Generation, Content, Sales Enablement, and Sales teams.
* Build a deep understanding of OPUS Platform architecture and capabilities, and how the platform enables TraceLink solutions and customer business outcomes.
* Translate complex platform concepts into clear business value for executive, technical, and operational personas.
* Participate in select cross-functional initiatives, roadmap discussions, and executive or customer engagements as required.

****Strategic Narratives, Messaging, and Positioning****

* Develop strategic narratives, messaging, and positioning for the OPUS Platform targeting executive and technical decision-makers (e.g., CIO, CDO, CTO, Enterprise Architects).
* Articulate the OPUS Platform value proposition as the foundation for TraceLink solutions, ecosystem participation, and digital network effects.
* Create and maintain competitive differentiation against alternative platforms, point solutions, and legacy integration approaches.
* Continuously validate and refine messaging through regular engagement with field teams, customers, and prospects.

****AI and LLM Buying & Enablement Experiences****

* Build and maintain an LLM-ready OPUS Platform messaging framework with modular, metadata-tagged positioning, capabilities, and value narratives.
* Ensure taxonomy alignment, version control, and canonical terminology so platform messaging is consistent, current, and consumable by AI systems.
* Curate and govern the OPUS Platform knowledge corpus to ensure accurate, secure, and authoritative AI-generated outputs.
* Design executive- and architect-ready LLM experiences using prompt patterns, scenarios, and platform value-story templates for internal enablement and external buyer interactions.

****Deliverables and Key Knowledge Artifacts****
Create and maintain a standard set of OPUS Platform knowledge artifacts that drive executive conversations, field enablement, and LLM-driven experiences, including but not limited to:
  
  

* OPUS Platform Messaging & Positioning Playbook documenting platform vision, value pillars, persona-based messaging, and competitive differentiation.
* LLM-Ready Platform Messaging Framework & Metadata Schema defining modular platform message objects, taxonomies, and canonical terminology for AI ingestion.
* Curated OPUS Platform Knowledge Library, including architecture overviews, capability descriptions, platform services, extensibility patterns, security and compliance models, and glossary of terms.
* Executive Platform Narrative Decks tailored for CIO, CTO, CDO, and VP-level personas, highlighting business value, scalability, interoperability, and long-term platform ROI.
* Competitive Platform Landscape & Differentiation Dossiers comparing OPUS to alternative platforms, middleware, and integration strategies with scenario-based differentiation and objection handling.
* LLM Prompt Patterns, Conversation Flows, and Experience Blueprints enabling consistent, high-credibility AI-driven conversations about the OPUS Platform.
* Field Enablement Knowledge Packs including platform talk tracks, architecture narratives, use-case mappings, objection handling, and LLM-powered microlearning assets.

**Skills And Qualifications**

* 10 + years of experience in product management, product marketing, platform strategy, solution consulting, or analyst roles with exposure to enterprise platforms, data networks, or SaaS ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of platform concepts such as APIs, data models, interoperability, extensibility, security, and scalability.
* Exceptional writing and presentation skills, particularly for senior executive and technical audiences.
* Ability to distill complex, technical platform capabilities into clear, structured business narratives.
* Experience producing strategic content such as platform briefs, architecture narratives, whitepapers, or competitive analyses.
* Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), conversational AI, or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems.
* Experience in structuring, tagging, and governing content for AI/ML consumption is a plus.
* Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Solution Consulting, Value Engineering, and Services teams.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience required.
* Travel: Ability to travel up to 25% as required by business needs.

*Please see the Tracelink Privacy Policy for more information on how Tracelink processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise your privacy rights. If you have questions about this privacy notice or need to contact us in connection with your personal data, including any requests to exercise your legal rights referred to at the end of this notice, please contact Candidate-Privacy@tracelink.com.*

title: GM - Business Transformation Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a Business Transformation Lead to drive strategic transformation initiatives across Business service domains, translating enterprise transformation strategy into executable product and service roadmaps. Reporting to the Head of Transformation – Business, this role partners with business leaders, technology teams, markets, Finance, GTM teams and strategic partners to deliver measurable business outcomes, operational efficiency, service excellence and sustainable value realisation. The role combines transformation leadership, business architecture, programme delivery, AI-enabled innovation and stakeholder management to help VOIS achieve its long-term growth and performance ambitions.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the development and execution of transformation roadmaps aligned to business strategy and customer priorities
* Own end-to-end transformation planning, design and delivery across assigned products, services and business domains
* Translate complex and ambiguous business challenges into clear opportunities, hypotheses and actionable transformation plans
* Drive revenue growth, operational efficiency, service performance improvements and value realisation through transformation initiatives
* Manage programme governance, risks, dependencies, milestones and cross-functional delivery across multiple portfolios
* Design target-state business architectures aligned with strategic objectives, operating models, processes, data and technology capabilities
* Ensure alignment between business and technology architecture, identifying gaps and enabling scalable, sustainable solutions
* Partner with business leaders, local markets, Finance, GTM teams, Accenture and technology stakeholders to support adoption and business case delivery
* Utilise AI and GenAI tools to improve analysis, documentation, automation, decision-making and delivery effectiveness
* Establish measurement frameworks and governance mechanisms to track benefits realisation and transformation outcomes
* Influence senior stakeholders through insight-led communication, structured problem solving and strategic recommendations
* Support enterprise-wide transformation programmes while ensuring customer, employee and partner experience objectives are achieved

**Who You Are**

* Strong expertise in business transformation, programme leadership and operational improvement within complex environments
* Deep understanding of business service domains, operating models and the impact of transformational change on service performance
* Proven ability to build and execute strategic roadmaps while managing dependencies across multiple teams and functions
* Skilled in business architecture, future-state design, value realisation and performance measurement
* Strong stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to influence senior leaders using structured, data-driven narratives
* Experience applying Agile, Lean and systems-thinking methodologies to transformation programmes
* Commercially aware with the ability to balance customer outcomes, operational effectiveness and business value
* Experience working with AI-enabled tools and supporting AI-led transformation initiatives
* Telecoms and/or cross-sector experience highly desirable

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to lead large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives with significant business impact
* Exposure to senior leaders across global markets, business functions and technology organisations
* Ability to shape future operating models, services and business architecture across a leading international organisation
* Opportunity to influence AI-enabled transformation strategies and emerging technology adoption
* Collaboration with diverse global teams and strategic partners on high-profile transformation programmes

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced enterprise transformation and strategic planning capabilities
* AI and GenAI application within business transformation and operational environments
* End-to-end business architecture and target operating model design
* Value realisation frameworks and benefits tracking methodologies
* Global stakeholder leadership, executive influencing and large-scale programme governance
* Data-driven decision-making and transformation performance measurement

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, data quality checks, and performance-aware query design.
* Ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation in a techno-functional role.
* Experience with requirements gathering solution design, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Exposure to cloud data platforms, APIs, ETL/ELT, reporting, Python, or advanced analytics.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models and distributed global teams.

* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery-focused mindset.
* Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision.

title: Senior AI Enablement Manager
description:
**Shape the Future of AI-Driven Performance in Tissue**
At Valmet Tissue, we believe Artificial Intelligence will become a key enabler of growth, productivity, customer value, and operational excellence. We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented AI Enablement Lead to accelerate the adoption of AI across our organization.
  
  
This role will initially focus on Commercial Excellence, Sales, Service, and Business Analytics, where immediate opportunities exist to improve productivity, forecasting, customer engagement, opportunity management, and decision-making. Over time, the role will expand to support AI-driven transformation across Engineering, Supply Chain, Project Management, Manufacturing, and Business Support functions.
  
  
This is not solely a technical development role. Instead, we are seeking a business leader who can identify opportunities, drive adoption, lead change, and ensure that AI creates measurable value across the organization. This aligns with Valmet's business-led AI strategy, emphasizing value realization, adoption, capability building, and scalable implementation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Drive AI-enabled business transformation
  
  

* Develop and execute the Tissue AI enablement roadmap.
* Identify high-value opportunities where AI can improve business performance.
* Build business cases and track realized value from AI initiatives.
* Prioritize and coordinate AI projects across functions.
* Promote scalable and reusable AI solutions across the organization.

Optimize commercial performance
  
  

* Improve sales productivity through AI-enabled tools and processes.
* Support opportunity management, forecasting, account planning, pricing, and proposal generation.
* Reduce manual administrative work and increase customer-facing time.
* Enhance installed-base monetization and customer insights.
* Drive data-driven decision-making across commercial teams.

Lead AI adoption & change
  
  

* Build and lead a network of AI Champions across Tissue.
* Deliver training, awareness programs, and practical AI workshops.
* Support leaders in redesigning processes and ways of working.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure successful adoption of AI capabilities throughout the organization.

Expand AI across functions
  
  
**As Adoption Matures, Support AI Initiatives In**

* Engineering and design productivity
* Supply chain planning and optimization
* Project execution
* Customer support and service operations
* Knowledge management
* Business support functions
* Performance management and analytics

Partner across the organization
  
  

* Act as the key interface between Tissue business teams and enterprise AI initiatives.
* Collaborate with IT, Digital, Data & Analytics, and process owners.
* Ensure AI solutions support business priorities and strategic objectives.
* Promote responsible and compliant use of AI technologies.

What success looks like
  
  

* Increased sales productivity and reduced administrative workload.
* Higher adoption of AI tools and capabilities.
* Improved forecast accuracy and commercial effectiveness.
* Measurable business value delivered through AI initiatives.
* Increased organizational AI capability and literacy.
* AI-enabled process improvements deployed across multiple functions.
* A growing portfolio of scalable use cases delivering sustainable business impact.

**Your profile**
You combine business acumen, transformation leadership, and a passion for technology-enabled improvement.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Commercial Excellence, Sales Operations, Business Transformation, Continuous Improvement, Digital Transformation, or related fields.
* Experience leading cross-functional change initiatives.
* Strong understanding of commercial processes and business performance drivers.
* Exposure to AI, analytics, automation, or digital technologies.
* Experience working in a global industrial or manufacturing environment is considered an advantage.

Personal characteristics
  
  

* Strategic and business-oriented mindset.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Curious and passionate about emerging technologies.
* Excellent communication and facilitation abilities.
* Ability to translate complex concepts into practical business solutions.
* Results-oriented with a strong focus on value realization.

**Why join Valmet Tissue?**
This is a unique opportunity to help define how AI will transform the future of Tissue. You will play a central role in building new capabilities, improving performance, and enabling our teams to work smarter and more effectively. Your work will influence how we serve customers, develop our people, and strengthen our competitiveness globally. Join us in shaping the next generation of AI-enabled business performance at Valmet Tissue.
  
  
**Additional Information**
Last day to apply is November 3, 2026. However, we work with ongoing selection, so don't wait with sending us your application.
  
  
***When everything works together***
***Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers; we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.***

title: Business Analyst - Data Platform & Analytics
description:
Founded and headquartered in Switzerland, Avaloq is continuously expanding its global footprint with around 2,500 colleagues in 10 countries, and more than 160 clients in 35 countries. We are an industry-leading provider of wealth management technology and services for financial institutions around the world, including private banks and wealth managers, investment managers, as well as retail and neo banks. Our research led approach and continual innovation is powered by the passion and creativity of our colleagues.
  
  
We are always looking for talented people to join us on our mission to orchestrate the financial ecosystem and democratize access to wealth management. Avaloq offers the opportunity to work closely with some of the world’s leading financial institutions as we jointly develop and shape careers. Championing a collaborative, supportive and flexible work environment empowers our colleagues to reach their full potential.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
We are looking for a committed and competent Business Analyst to join our international team. You will act as a key interface between business stakeholders and technical teams, ensuring that business needs are clearly understood, analyzed, and translated into well-defined technical requirements.
  
  
You will work closely with business stakeholders, software engineers, technology vendors, and other technical teams to support the design and delivery of effective solutions.
  
  
**Key tasks**

* Gather, analyze, and understand business requirements from internal and external stakeholders.
* Translate business needs into clear and structured functional and technical requirements that can be implemented by development teams.
* Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and software engineers, ensuring a common understanding of requirements and expected outcomes.
* Analyze existing business processes, applications, interfaces, and data flows to identify appropriate solutions.
* Understand the Avaloq Core Banking Platform and the corresponding banking business processes and functional areas.
* Prepare and maintain requirements, functional specifications, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, and supporting documentation.
* Support developers during solution design and implementation by clarifying business and functional requirements.
* Support testing and validation activities to ensure that delivered solutions meet the agreed business requirements.
* Assist in root cause analysis and the resolution of functional and production issues.
* Ensure all documentation aligns with internal standards and best practices. Regularly review and update existing documentation to reflect any changes in processes or systems.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, Finance, or an equivalent field.
* 3+ years of relevant experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, or in a similar role within banking or financial services.
* 2+ years with Avaloq Core Platform or similar banking technology
* Experience with documenting business requirements and functional specifications
* Familiarity with developing user stories and use cases
* Strong knowledge of SQL and PL/SQL
* Experience with SQL, Oracle/Snowflake databases data analysis, APIs, interfaces, or system integrations is considered an advantage.
* Experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), including understanding data integration processes, mappings, interfaces, and ETL/data flows is considered an advantage.
* Excellent analytical skills and a structured approach to problem solving.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Quality-conscious, self-motivated, and goal-oriented.
* Open-minded team player with strong communication skills and proficiency in written and spoken English.
* Willingness to develop strong knowledge of the Avaloq platform and complete relevant Avaloq training and certification.

**Additional Information**
We realize that managing work life balance is a challenge we all face in our daily lives and in order to support with this we are pleased to offer hybrid and flexible working for most of our Avaloqers to maintain work life balance and still continue our fantastic Avaloq culture in our global offices.
  
  
In Avaloq we are proud to embrace diversity and understand the success of our business is built on the power of different opinions, we are whole heartedly committed to fostering an equal opportunity environment and inclusive culture where you can be your true authentic self.
  
  
We hire, compensate and promote regardless of origin, age, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other fantastic traits that make us all unique, we have done our best to write this advert in an inclusive and neutral way.
  
  
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations.

Drive partnerships, sourcing and manufacturing solutions and decisions including Make & Buy analysis for common features

Drive system level testing and validation readiness and chair cross-component issue resolution
  
  
Drive profitability and competitiveness through reuse and optimized content for common features

Partner with OEMs, Sales, and GTM teams to define bundled solution scope, differentiation, value narrative and trade-offs
  
  
Translate OEM visual experience requirements into solution architectures and promote cross-product selling
  
  
Define bundled pricing strategies, feature monetization, and business models
  
  
**Stakeholder Alignment & Management**
Act as the central point of alignment across other Product managers, Engineering/delivery teams, Supply Chain, Manufacturing and GTM teams for common UIUX features
  
  
Own solution-level demos and reference platforms aligned with roadmap vision
  
  
Develop customer-facing narratives highlighting differentiation, scalability, and value.
  
  
Resolve trade-offs to optimize portfolio-level outcomes
  
  
Manage strategic partners supporting the solutions for these common UIUX features

* MBA or equivalent business experience is a plus

* Experience in product or solution management within automotive, cockpit systems, or display technologies
* Strong understanding of Software, Hardware & HMI system integration requirements
* Strong ability to connect OEM needs, UX, and business value into scalable solutions
* Proven experience in cross-functional leadership and system-level thinking
* Strong commercial acumen (costing, pricing, business cases)

Be willing to travel domestic and international Be willing to work from office as required Successfully completing a
**background investigation**
and drug screen as a condition of employment

Experience with premium automotive cockpit / luxury OEM display programs Product management experience specifically with displays Supplier management exposure Strong familiarity with automotive or consumer display market.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Powering the world’s payments ecosystem
  
ACI powers the payments ecosystem – globally, and you power ACI. You’ll innovate, collaborate, and grow – in an energetic technology culture with decades of proven success. ACIers – in all roles and levels – are truly your colleagues and many are your friends. Our size and reach allow you to see the global impact of your work. You are visible, your talents are valued, and you are empowered to shape the future of payments.
  
As a Technical Program Manager in Pune, you will join a diverse, passionate team, dedicated to powering the world’s payments ecosystem!
  
  
Job Purpose
  
The Technical Program Manager is an individual contributor responsible for implementing portfolio management processes, configuring work management systems, and delivering data analytics that support portfolio visibility, execution, and decision-making.
  
This role translates strategic portfolio objectives into operational execution through hands-on process design, workflow engineering, Agile planning, reporting, and metrics development. The role partners closely with Engineering, Product, Agile, and leadership teams to improve delivery predictability, governance, and business outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Portfolio & Process Management
  
- Design and implement standardized intake workflows, prioritization frameworks, governance processes, and portfolio operating models.
  
- Establish quarterly planning practices, including PI Planning, capacity planning, retrospectives, and continuous improvement routines.
  
- Create and maintain documentation such as RACI matrices, SOPs, workflow diagrams, process guides, and training materials.
  
- Drive process adoption through change management, stakeholder engagement, training, and self-service knowledge resources.
  
- Conduct process reviews, identify improvement areas, and implement corrective actions.
  
- Partner with Agile coaches and delivery teams to align portfolio processes with team-level ceremonies.
  
  
Workflow Tool Engineering
  
- Configure and optimize work management tools including Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, and Power BI.
  
- Build boards, queries, dashboards, work item hierarchies, automation rules, and reporting structures.
  
- Create stakeholder-specific dashboards and reports to support delivery visibility and portfolio governance.
  
- Provide advanced user support for complex tool, workflow, reporting, and configuration issues.
  
- Develop user guides, FAQs, training materials, and platform enablement resources.
  
  
Data Analytics & Business Intelligence
  
- Design and deliver dashboards for executives, program managers, and delivery teams.
  
- Track portfolio health, milestones, risks, dependencies, budget, and delivery performance.
  
- Implement and report on DORA Metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, and change failure rate.
  
- Establish Flow Metrics including cycle time, lead time, throughput, WIP, and flow efficiency.
  
- Create executive-level reporting that converts complex data into clear insights and recommendations.
  
- Support forecasting, variance analysis, burn-rate tracking, and data quality improvements.
  
  
Portfolio Coordination & Delivery Support
  
- Coordinate quarterly planning events, governance meetings, and cross-functional working sessions.
  
- Track actions, decisions, risks, dependencies, and schedule conflicts.
  
- Support software initiatives from concept through delivery, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and business outcomes.
  
- Oversee SDLC execution across requirements, development, testing, release, and post-launch activities.
  
- Lead continuous improvement initiatives for the Biller Portfolio.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
Education
  
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  
- Equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  
Experience
  
- 2 to 5 years of experience in program management, portfolio operations, PMO, Agile delivery, or related functions.
  
- Hands-on experience administering Azure DevOps, Jira, Smartsheet, or similar work management tools.
  
- Experience configuring workflows, dashboards, reports, and process templates.
  
- Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
  
- Experience supporting Agile teams using Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, or similar methodologies.
  
- Experience implementing or improving portfolio management processes.
  
  
Technical Skills
  
- Strong proficiency in Azure DevOps including boards, queries, dashboards, and process templates.
  
- Strong proficiency in Jira/Jira Cloud including JQL, workflows, automation, and portfolio views.
  
- Working knowledge of Smartsheet, APIs, webhooks, or workflow integrations.
  
- Proficiency in Power BI, data modeling, DAX, and visualization.
  
- Strong Excel skills including pivot tables, lookups, Power Query, and reporting.
  
- SQL knowledge for querying and analyzing data.
  
- Understanding of data quality, validation, and reporting governance.
  
- Ability to use AI tools for analytics, documentation, analysis, and content preparation.
  
  
Methodology & Metrics Knowledge
  
- Portfolio management, prioritization, governance, and capacity management.
  
- Agile methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, and SAFe.
  
- DevOps practices and engineering productivity measurement.
  
- ITIL/ITSM and PMI/PMBOK principles preferred.
  
- Flow Metrics including cycle time, lead time, throughput, and WIP.
  
- DORA Metrics including deployment frequency, lead time, MTTR, and change failure rate.
  
- Financial and portfolio metrics including burn rate, variance analysis, ROI, and resource loading.
  
  
Professional Skills
  
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
- Excellent written and verbal communication.
  
- Ability to adapt communication style for technical, business, and executive audiences.
  
- Strong facilitation skills for planning sessions and working groups.
  
- High attention to detail in tool configuration, documentation, and reporting.
  
- Customer-service mindset with the ability to support and enable users.
  
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  
- Strong collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement mindset.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
- PMP, CAPM, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe, or similar Agile/program management certification.
  
- Atlassian, Microsoft, Power BI, ITIL, or Lean Six Sigma certification.
  
- Experience in payments, financial services, SaaS, or regulated industries.
  
- Experience implementing DORA or Flow Metrics programs.
  
- Experience with enterprise portfolio management tools such as Planview or ServiceNow PPM.
  
- Scripting or automation exposure using Python, PowerShell, Groovy, or similar technologies.
  
- Intermediate SQL skills.
  
  
Work Environment
  
- Standard office environment with frequent computer-based work.
  
- Hybrid work model with regular in-office presence as required.
  
- Collaboration with global teams across Engineering, Product, Agile, and business functions.
  
- Minimal travel may be required for planning sessions, workshops, or business meetings.
  
  
In return for your expertise, we offer opportunities for growth, career development, and a competitive compensation and benefits package—all within an innovative and collaborative work environment.
  
  
Are you ready to help us transform the payments ecosystem? To learn more about ACI Worldwide, visit our web site at www.aciworldwide.com

title: Strategic Customer Account Governance & PMO Specialist - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced PMO and account governance professional to lead the governance, planning and performance management framework for strategic customer accounts within VOIS Go-to-Market. This role enables senior customer account stakeholders to manage priorities, risks, decisions and delivery outcomes across complex cross-functional teams. The successful candidate will drive governance excellence, executive reporting, account planning support, commercial visibility, forecasting inputs and stakeholder alignment while operating in a fast-paced, customer-facing environment
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Lead the operating rhythm for strategic customer account teams, including governance forums, executive reviews, monthly and quarterly business review packs, agendas, decision logs, action tracking and escalation management
  
  
Drive account planning and performance management by consolidating commercial, delivery, finance and operational inputs into clear priorities, risks, dependencies and leadership recommendations.
  
  
Maintain a consolidated view of commercial activity, including pipeline, approved change requests and finance opportunities, ensuring visibility across multiple data sources to support billing and revenue forecasting.
  
  
Coordinate customer-facing materials across service areas, maintaining a repository of presentations, customer success stories, testimonials and case study content
  
  
Partner closely with Customer Account Leads to identify gaps, blockers and decision points while maintaining momentum across complex workstreams
  
  
Influence cross-functional stakeholders to deliver actions, manage dependencies and maintain accountability without direct line management responsibility.
  
  
Continuously improve governance, reporting, lessons learned processes, win/loss analysis, automation opportunities and ways of working to deliver measurable business value.
  
  
**Who You Are**
You have significant experience in PMO, business management, account governance or programme coordination within complex commercial, customer-facing or matrix organisations
  
  
You bring strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and align diverse teams around shared objectives.
  
  
You have experience managing multiple strategic initiatives, competing priorities and senior-level reporting requirements from initiation to completion
  
  
You demonstrate strong commercial awareness and analytical judgement, transforming operational and commercial data into actionable insights and recommendations
  
  
You have excellent governance, organisational and reporting capabilities, including the creation of executive-ready presentations and business review materials.
  
  
You are proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and SharePoint and are comfortable exploring automation, AI-enabled productivity and digital collaboration tools.
  
  
You hold a project, programme or portfolio management qualification, or equivalent practical experience in governance and delivery management

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
Opportunity to work directly with strategic customer accounts and senior leadership stakeholders across commercial, delivery, finance and operations functions
  
  
Exposure to executive governance, account planning, forecasting, commercial visibility and customer engagement activities
  
  
Ability to influence strategic account outcomes and improve governance, transparency and operational effectiveness across multiple markets and workstreams
  
  
Opportunity to contribute to automation, AI-enabled productivity initiatives and continuous improvement programmes
  
  
Broad cross-functional collaboration with customer account, delivery, finance and operational teams.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**
Strategic account governance and executive stakeholder management
  
  
Leadership-level reporting, governance pack creation and performance management.
  
  
Commercial visibility management, forecasting support and revenue-related reporting processes.
  
  
Advanced cross-functional coordination and influencing without direct authority.
  
  
Governance improvement, automation adoption and AI-enabled productivity practices.
  
  
**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
