title: Technical Marketing Engineering Technical Leader (8+ Years)
description:
Meet the Team
  
  
The Cisco Cloud Control team is building the foundational platform that brings Cisco’s cloud-managed and controller-based products together into a unified customer experience. Cisco Cloud Control is redefining how customers operate, monitor, and defend critical IT infrastructure across networking, security, compute, observability, and collaboration. The team is focused on simplifying customer operations, reducing onboarding friction, and creating a consistent platform experience across the Cisco portfolio. As part of this charter, the team is also advancing AgenticOps capabilities that use AI, automation, MCP-based integrations, and agentic workflows to make IT operations more proactive, intelligent, and efficient.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a Senior Technical Marketing Engineer, you will work closely with strategic customers, product management, engineering, customer success, sales, and field teams to shape how Cisco Cloud Control is positioned, adopted, and scaled with customers. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, technical execution, customer engagement, and next-generation AI-enabled operations.
  
  
You will help define and drive the technical marketing strategy for Cisco Cloud Control, with a strong focus on customer onboarding, product integrations, field readiness, and customer adoption.
  
  
**You Will**

* Drive strategic customer engagement with lighthouse accounts, executive stakeholders, and design partners to validate Cisco Cloud Control use cases and influence platform direction.
* Build trusted technical relationships with customers and convert customer insights into roadmap influence, reference architectures, launch proof points, and executive-ready narratives.
* Translate customer operational challenges into product requirements, technical content, field guidance, and repeatable Cloud Control use cases.
* Partner with product and engineering teams to improve onboarding workflows, integration experiences, and cross-product consistency.
* Support early customer engagements, design partners, beta programs, and GA readiness activities.
* Work across Cisco product teams, including cloud-managed, SaaS, and on-premises platforms, to ensure a seamless Cisco Cloud Control experience.
* Identify adoption blockers, integration gaps, and customer experience issues, then drive them to closure with the right stakeholders.
* Enable sales, SEs, customer success, and partner teams with clear messaging, repeatable workflows, and hands-on technical knowledge.
* Represent the voice of the customer and the field in roadmap discussions, launch planning, and prioritization decisions.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in technical marketing, product management, solutions engineering or a related technical customer-facing role.
* Strong understanding of cloud platforms, SaaS products, APIs, identity, authentication, and enterprise IT operations.
* Proven track record leading senior-level customer engagements, including executive briefings, strategic workshops, architecture discussions, and customer-driven product feedback loops.
* Ability to quickly learn complex technical products and explain them clearly to both technical and business audiences.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams across product management, engineering, sales, support, and customer success.
* Ability to create compelling technical content for both executive and deeply technical audiences.
* Strong communication skills, including presentations, demos, writing, and cross-functional influence.
* Strong knowledge of Cloud Operations, Enterprise Networking, Security, Observability, or Data Center infrastructure.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with one or more of Cisco platforms such as Meraki, Catalyst Center, Catalyst SD-WAN, Nexus Dashboard, Intersight, ThousandEyes, Splunk, Secure Access, Collaboration Control Hub.
* Hands-on experience with MCP-based integrations, AI agents, agentic workflows, or AI-assisted operations.
* Familiarity with customer onboarding workflows, tenant/org management, admin roles, API integrations, and enterprise identity models.
* Experience working with enterprise customers and field teams to diagnose adoption barriers and drive platform improvements.
* Strong sense of ownership, urgency, and customer empathy, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
**Disclaimer**
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. * Promote continuous improvement in intake, prioritization, refinement, and flow efficiency across the S2P delivery process.

title: CEO’s Office – Strategy & Business Operations
description:
Job Description: CEO’s Office – Strategy & Business Operations

Company: Pocketful

Location: Delhi NCR

Reporting to: CEO

Experience: min 5 years

About Pocketful

Pocketful is a technology-driven fintech and stockbroking platform building an integrated financial services ecosystem across broking, wealth management, investment products, and AI-powered trading solutions.

We are looking for a high-calibre professional to join the CEO’s Office and work directly with the CEO on business strategy, growth initiatives, performance management, and execution of key organisational priorities.

Role Overview

The CEO’s Office plays a central role in shaping business priorities and ensuring their execution across the organisation. This role offers exposure to strategic decision-making, business performance, new initiatives, and cross-functional leadership.

The ideal candidate will combine analytical thinking with strong execution capabilities, be comfortable working with senior stakeholders, and take end-to-end ownership of important business initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Corporate Strategy & Business Planning

\* Work with the CEO on business strategy, annual operating plans, growth priorities, and long-term business objectives.

\* Conduct market research, competitive benchmarking, and industry analysis to identify growth opportunities.

\* Evaluate new business lines, products, partnerships, and distribution opportunities.

\* Prepare business cases, financial analyses, strategic recommendations, and management presentations.

\* Translate strategic objectives into actionable plans, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

2. Strategic Initiatives & Special Projects

\* Own and drive high-priority projects identified by the CEO, from problem definition through execution.

\* Coordinate the launch of new products, business verticals, and strategic initiatives.

\* Identify operational bottlenecks and develop solutions to improve efficiency, growth, and profitability.

\* Work across functions to resolve dependencies and ensure timely delivery of critical initiatives.

\* Independently research and solve ambiguous business problems, presenting clear recommendations to the CEO.

3. Business Performance & Analytics

\* Monitor business KPIs across revenue, customer acquisition, onboarding, engagement, product adoption, and profitability.

\* Develop management dashboards, business review reports, and performance trackers.

\* Analyse business trends, identify performance gaps, and recommend corrective actions.

\* Support periodic business reviews with functional heads and track progress against targets.

\* Evaluate unit economics, channel performance, cost structures, and growth opportunities.

4. Cross-Functional Execution

\* Work closely with Product, Technology, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and HR teams.

\* Ensure alignment between departmental priorities and the company’s strategic objectives.

\* Track commitments, milestones, and deliverables across teams and drive accountability.

\* Facilitate leadership reviews, document key decisions, and monitor closure of action items.

\* Act as an execution partner to the CEO on initiatives requiring coordination across multiple functions.

5. CEO’s Office & Management Support

\* Prepare decision memos, presentations, research notes, and briefing documents for the CEO.

\* Structure complex business information into concise insights and recommendations.

\* Help prioritise strategic initiatives and ensure management attention is directed towards the most important business outcomes.

\* Support board-level presentations, investor materials, and strategic planning exercises as required.

\* Maintain discretion while handling confidential business information.

6. Process Improvement & AI Enablement

\* Identify opportunities to automate reporting, streamline workflows, and improve organisational productivity.

\* Leverage AI tools and data analysis to accelerate research, decision-making, and execution.

\* Develop repeatable processes and management systems to support Pocketful’s growth and scale.

Candidate Profile

\* 2–5 years of relevant experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, a startup CEO’s office, or a similar role.

\* Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities.

\* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

\* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides.

\* Ability to interpret business data, understand financial metrics, and develop actionable recommendations.

\* Strong project management, stakeholder coordination, and execution skills.

\* High ownership, attention to detail, initiative, and comfort with ambiguity.

\* Ability to work in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred: Experience in fintech, financial services, stockbroking, wealth management, or technology-led businesses. Familiarity with SQL, BI tools, and AI-based productivity tools is an advantage.

Key Success Metrics

\* Timely execution of CEO-led strategic initiatives.

\* Improved visibility into business performance through effective KPI reporting.

\* Better accountability and coordination across functions.

\* Quality and speed of strategic analysis and decision support.

\* Measurable improvements in business efficiency, growth, and profitability.

\* Successful execution of new business initiatives and process improvements.

What We Offer

\* Direct exposure to the CEO and senior leadership.

\* Ownership of high-impact strategic projects.

\* Broad exposure to strategy, finance, technology, product, and business operations.

\* An opportunity to influence the growth trajectory of a fast-evolving fintech company.

\* A strong career path towards leadership roles in strategy, business operations, or general management.

The ideal candidate is someone who can think strategically, analyse rigorously, communicate clearly, and drive execution relentlessly.

title: Director Program Management, 2 Hour Learning (Remote) - $200,000/year USD
description:
You've built dashboards. Tracked milestones. Chased vendors. Flagged risks. But your reports hit a ceiling. You weren't the one making the calls.
  
  
2 Hour Learning is building an AI-powered education model designed to help students achieve a full day of academic progress in just two hours. Making that model work at scale requires dozens of initiatives, technology partners, contracts, and investment decisions to move in sync. Your job as Director of Program Management is to make the execution layer trustworthy enough for executives to act on it.
  
  
You will own the operating outputs behind those decisions: portfolio dashboards that expose slippage before it becomes a surprise, vendor scorecards tied to real contractual commitments, competitive bid packages that make trade-offs clear, and contract controls that prevent unsupported spend. AI will be part of your daily workflow, helping you standardize updates, detect anomalies, compare bids, analyze vendor performance, and validate invoices.
  
  
This is not a PMO role built around meetings, process compliance, or polished status decks. It is for an operator who wants their work to have consequences. When a vendor underperforms, your evidence should make that obvious. When spend drifts from the contract, your controls should catch it. When executives need to make a $5M decision, your outputs should give them the confidence to make it fast. If that sounds like the level of ownership you have been looking for, apply.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Own portfolio-level dashboards across 10+ concurrent initiatives, using AI to standardize updates, detect slippage, expose blockers, and maintain a trusted executive view of delivery, budget, and risk
* Run recurring vendor performance reviews and maintain rubric-based scorecards that combine delivery, quality, cost, contractual commitments, and qualitative performance signals
* Lead competitive technology-vendor procurement, including structured bid packages, normalized comparisons, scoring rubrics, SOW development, and evidence-backed recommendations
* Govern contracts and invoices by tracking fee caps, milestones, acceptance criteria, and amendments, then validating invoices against signed terms before spend is approved
* Use AI daily to analyze portfolio data, detect anomalies, surface underperformance, draft decision-ready outputs, and reduce manual PMO administration

**What You Won’t Be Doing**

* Producing status reports that executives read but never use to make decisions
* Running a meeting-heavy PMO where coordination matters more than measurable execution
* Treating vendor management as relationship maintenance while missed commitments go unchallenged
* Passing contracts, SOWs, invoices, or procurement decisions to someone else because they look too commercial or technical
* Using AI as an occasional productivity trick instead of a core part of how you operate

**Director Program Management Key Responsibilities**
Produce reliable, AI-powered dashboards, scorecards, procurement packages, and contract controls that give executives the clarity and leverage to hold vendors accountable, control costs, and accelerate delivery across a $50M EdTech portfolio.
  
  
**Basic Requirements**

* Directly owned a portfolio of 10+ concurrent initiatives with at least $5M in budget responsibility, including authority over budget allocation, vendor selection, or initiative prioritization
* Managed 5+ external technology vendors at the same time, such as SaaS providers, AI/ML platforms, marketing agencies, or engineering firms
* Built and maintained portfolio-level dashboards covering metrics such as delivery health, budget burn versus forecast, milestone completion, and major risks or blockers
* Can point to a case where C-suite leaders used your portfolio data to make a go/no-go decision on a vendor renewal, budget reallocation, or initiative deprioritization
* Directly led competitive technology procurement, including structured bid evaluation, vendor scoring, negotiation, and selection
* Authored or co-authored SOWs with measurable deliverables, milestone payments, SLAs, acceptance criteria, or other performance-based terms
* Negotiated commercial terms such as pricing, penalties, fee caps, or exit clauses and enforced those terms through invoice validation or corrective action
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex financial and operational data into concise recommendations executives can act on
* Able to analyze financial and vendor-performance data quickly enough to recommend optimization, reallocation, or vendor elimination
* Able to work US business hours

**Nice-to-have Requirements**

* Experience using AI-enabled dashboards, anomaly detection, predictive alerts, or natural-language analysis in portfolio management
* Experience in EdTech, technology, consulting, or another environment managing complex portfolios of external technology partners
* Fluency with portfolio and delivery tools such as Linear, Jira, or similar systems

**About 2 Hour Learning**
Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one-size-fits-all model and replacing it with AI-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.
  
  
**With students consistently ranking in the top 1-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.**
They offer a dynamic, on-campus and remote-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.
  
  
**2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.**
**Here’s How They’re Fixing It.**
There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!

The compensation level for this role is $100 USD/hour, which equates to $200,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. title: Smart Home Project Manager [AI & Automation]
description:
Location: Remote, India (flexible hours with U.S. team overlap)
  
  
Engagement type: Full-time
  
  
Compensation: INR 2,38,250 - INR 2,85,900 per month (based on experience and interview process)
  
  
**About Sanctuary**
Sanctuary builds nature - led, wellness - centered communities that feel alive. Our first 135-acre residential community in the Texas Hill Country is designed with:
  
  
🌱 Non-toxic materials
  
  
💧 Clean water and filtration systems
  
  
⚡ EMF-conscious design
  
  
🌿 135 acres of preserved land and eco - sensitive planning
  
  
We are a global team (spread across 8 countries) of designers, architects, engineers, and dreamers building spaces that restore and inspire. For us, it’s not just where people live - it’s how they live.
  
  
Our vision is to bring Sanctuary to major cities around the world: healthy, sovereign communities that sit on the edges of every modern metropolis.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Smart Home Project Manager to bring technology into our homes in a way that supports how people live. You will manage the implementation of smart home systems across our projects - from planning and vendor selection through installation and handover - and use AI tools to prototype integrations, automate workflows, and build internal systems. Internally, we call this role a "Smart Home VibeKid": someone who can vibe code a working prototype instead of waiting for someone else to build it.
  
  
Smart home at Sanctuary looks a little different. Our homes are designed around wellness, so technology has to serve health and comfort - lighting, air and water quality, energy, security - while staying mindful of EMF exposure. You will help decide what goes into our homes, how it all works together, and how residents experience it.
  
  
This is not a role for someone who needs close oversight or a fixed playbook. We are looking for someone curious and hands-on, who can test ideas quickly, figure out what's missing, and turn a concept into a working system.
  
  
****What you'll do****
*Smart home implementation*

* Plan and manage smart home technology across our projects: lighting, climate, air and water quality monitoring, energy, security, and connectivity
* Evaluate and select smart home platforms, devices, and vendors that fit our wellness and EMF-conscious standards
* Work with architects, MEP consultants, and the construction team to build smart home systems into designs early
* Oversee installation, testing, and handover with vendors and integrators

*AI prototyping and automation*

* Use AI tools to prototype smart home integrations and automations before they go into homes
* Build internal systems and workflows using AI-assisted ("vibe") coding and no-code platforms
* Automate project tracking, vendor coordination, and reporting for smart home work
* Keep up with new smart home and AI technology, and test what could work for us

*Project management and coordination*

* Track timelines, budgets, and deliverables for smart home scope on each project
* Coordinate vendors, integrators, and internal teams across India and the U.S.
* Document systems clearly for residents, facility management, and future projects

****What you bring****

* 3-7 years of experience in smart home, home automation, IoT, ELV, or building management systems (BMS) in real estate projects
* Hands-on knowledge of smart home platforms and protocols (e.g. Home Assistant, Control4, Crestron, KNX, Zigbee, Z-Wave, Matter)
* Experience managing installations with vendors and integrators, from planning to handover
* Hands-on experience building prototypes or automations with AI (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Replit) or no-code platforms (e.g. Zapier, Make, Airtable)
* Examples of integrations, tools, or automations you've built - please share them when you apply
* Interest in wellness technology (air and water quality, circadian lighting, low-EMF design) is a strong plus
* Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving, remote, cross-cultural environment
* Clear, proactive communicator in English, both written and spoken

****Hiring process****

* Stage 1: Intro interview - Role alignment, experience overview, a walkthrough of systems or tools you've built, and culture fit
* Stage 2: Test task - A short practical assignment: plan or prototype a smart home solution using AI tools
* Stage 3: Final interview - Deep dive into workflows, expectations, and growth

title: Product Manager – SaaS / EdTech
description:
Product Manager – AssessPrepAbout AssessPrep

At AssessPrep, we're not just building software – we're building the future of learning. Our mission is to empower K-12 schools worldwide with cutting-edge technology to make assessments more meaningful and improve learning outcomes.

AssessPrep is an all-in-one assessment platform that enables schools to create, deliver, and grade assessments digitally, saving teachers valuable time and allowing them to focus on what matters most: their students.

**AssessPrep in Numbers:**

* Trusted by 600+ international schools in 75+ countries
* Empowering 20,000+ teachers and 200,000+ students
* Facilitating over 1M student submissions annually
* 70%+ annual growth rate
* Annual churn <3%
* 50,000+ trees saved

About the Role

We are looking for a
**proactive, hands-on, and customer-focused Product Manager**
who can take complete ownership of product initiatives, drive execution, and ensure we continuously deliver value to our customers.

At AssessPrep, product management goes beyond creating roadmaps and managing feature releases. We believe great Product Managers understand their customers, solve real problems, and are willing to step in wherever needed to ensure an exceptional customer experience.

You'll work closely with engineering, design, sales, and customer-facing teams to build impactful products.
**You'll also be expected to directly handle customer queries, troubleshoot product issues, and support customers when required**
, particularly during escalations, critical situations, or periods of high support demand.

We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with strong execution skills and believes that no customer problem is too small to understand and solve.

What You'll Do1. Product Strategy & Ownership

* Own and drive the product roadmap, aligning priorities with business objectives and customer needs.
* Manage the complete product lifecycle, from identifying problems and defining requirements to development, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Translate customer feedback and business requirements into clear product specifications, user stories, and actionable tasks.
* Prioritize features, enhancements, and bug fixes based on customer impact, business value, and technical feasibility.
* Take accountability for product quality, usability, delivery timelines, and overall outcomes.

2. Product Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Collaborate closely with engineering and design teams to ensure timely, high-quality product delivery.
* Manage sprint planning, backlog prioritization, feature acceptance, and release readiness.
* Identify bottlenecks, resolve dependencies, and proactively follow up on pending deliverables.
* Coordinate with sales, marketing, and customer-facing teams to ensure smooth product launches.
* Take ownership of problems from identification through resolution rather than simply passing them to another team.

3. Customer Support & Issue Resolution

* **Step in to handle customer support queries whenever required**
  , alongside regular product management responsibilities.
* Communicate directly with teachers, school administrators, and other customers to understand their challenges and provide practical solutions.
* Troubleshoot platform-related issues, investigate reported bugs, and coordinate with engineering for timely resolution.
* Handle customer escalations professionally, ensuring clear communication, appropriate prioritization, and follow-through.
* Support customers during critical assessment periods, product rollouts, or situations requiring immediate attention.
* Assist with product demonstrations, onboarding, and feature walkthroughs whenever needed.
* Ensure customer issues are properly documented, tracked, and resolved, keeping stakeholders informed of progress.
* Identify recurring support issues and convert customer feedback into product improvements, better workflows, or self-service resources.

**Customer support is not the primary function of this role, but being willing and capable of handling it when required is an essential expectation.**

4. Customer Insights & Product Improvement

* Engage regularly with educators, administrators, and internal teams to understand user pain points.
* Analyze customer feedback, support tickets, feature requests, and product usage patterns.
* Identify opportunities to improve usability, reduce customer friction, and increase adoption.
* Work toward eliminating recurring issues through better product design and functionality.
* Monitor product performance and use data to make informed decisions.

5. Communication & Accountability

* Maintain clear and proactive communication with internal teams and customers.
* Provide regular updates on product progress, development priorities, and outstanding issues.
* Demonstrate a strong sense of ownership, ensuring commitments are met and problems are followed through to resolution.
* Be adaptable and comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

A Typical Week at AssessPrep

Your week may include:

* Reviewing product priorities and collaborating with developers on upcoming releases.
* Conducting customer interviews to understand feature requests and usability challenges.
* Investigating a customer-reported issue and working with engineering to resolve it.
* Stepping in to assist the customer support team with urgent queries or escalations.
* Analyzing product usage and support trends to identify improvement opportunities.
* Testing newly developed features before release.
* Conducting a product walkthrough for a school administrator or teacher.
* Sharing roadmap progress, customer insights, and product performance updates with leadership.

No two weeks will be exactly the same. We value people who can adapt, take initiative, and get things done.

What We're Looking For

**Experience & Skills**

* 5+ years of experience in Product Management, preferably in SaaS, B2B software, or EdTech.
* Proven experience managing products from ideation through execution and launch.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, sprint planning, backlog management, and product development processes.
* Ability to understand technical issues and collaborate effectively with developers to resolve them.
* Experience working directly with customers, managing escalations, or troubleshooting software-related issues.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven decisions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently while maintaining attention to detail.

**Personal Attributes**

* **Ownership mindset:**
  You take responsibility for outcomes rather than just completing assigned tasks.
* **Customer-first approach:**
  You genuinely care about solving customer problems and improving their experience.
* **Hands-on attitude:**
  You're comfortable getting involved in execution, testing, troubleshooting, and customer support.
* **Proactive problem-solving:**
  You identify issues early, take initiative, and follow through until they are resolved.
* **Adaptability:**
  You can balance strategic product responsibilities with urgent operational needs.
* **Collaborative mindset:**
  You work effectively across teams and communicate clearly.
* **Passion for education:**
  You're motivated by the opportunity to improve teaching and learning through technology.

What Success Looks Like

You'll be successful in this role when:

* Product initiatives are delivered on time with clear ownership and accountability.
* Customer feedback consistently informs product improvements.
* Critical issues and escalations receive timely attention and effective resolution.
* Recurring customer problems are reduced through product enhancements.
* Feature adoption, usability, and customer satisfaction continue to improve.
* Engineering, design, and customer-facing teams stay aligned on priorities.
* You demonstrate the flexibility to support customers without losing focus on long-term product goals.

Grow With Us

At AssessPrep, we invest in people who take initiative, embrace challenges, and want to make an impact.

As our Product Manager, you'll have opportunities to:

* **Own Meaningful Products:**
  Shape solutions used by thousands of educators and students globally.
* **Develop Leadership Skills:**
  Grow into a senior product management or product leadership role.
* **Gain International Exposure:**
  Work with schools and educators across 75+ countries.
* **Build EdTech Expertise:**
  Develop deep insights into digital assessments, learning technologies, and customer experience.

Benefits

* **Flexible working hours:**
  Enjoy flexibility while taking ownership of your responsibilities.
* **No micromanagement:**
  We trust our team members to deliver results.

title: AI Manager
description:
**AI Manager**

**Location**

Gurugram (Udyog Vihar Phase III), on-site; occasional travel to project sites

**Reports To -**
Head of IT

**Experience -**
7 to 10 years

**Employment Type -**
Full-time, permanent

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Most companies are still debating AI. We have decided to build it into how we engineer, bid, deliver and operate. WOG is looking for its first AI Manager to lead AI transformation and implementation across the company - deciding where AI goes to work, building it, and making sure it is adopted safely.

You will not be one voice in a large digital team. You will own the AI agenda end to end, with direct access to the CEO and leadership, and real engineering problems to solve - in water, wastewater and green energy.

**ABOUT WOG**

WOG Technologies is an IP-led engineering and technology company in water, wastewater and green energy, with 190+ projects delivered across 20+ countries and 350+ engineers. The group includes Bell Cooling Towers and the WOG Green Energy businesses - Green Coal, Carbon Loops, BESS, CBG and Carbon Credits. We are building a patent portfolio and a technology-first culture, and AI is central to that.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Set the AI agenda**

* Map how work flows across the business - proposals and bids, design and engineering, procurement, project delivery, plant operations and support functions - and find where AI saves the most time and money.
* Build and own a 12-month AI roadmap with a business case for every use case, and report the value delivered.

**Get the data ready**

* Organise the data AI depends on - document repositories, master data, and HR, finance and project records - so that AI answers are accurate and traceable.
* Set data ownership and quality standards with each function, starting with the data behind the first use cases.

**Build and ship AI solutions**

* Deploy enterprise AI tools - LLM assistants, document intelligence and workflow automation - and integrate them with our HRMS, ERP, Microsoft 365 and document systems.
* Design and deploy agentic AI: agents that carry out multi-step work across our systems, such as preparing tender responses, reconciling vendor quotes or compiling management reports, with people approving the key decisions.
* Automate high-effort work such as tender review, BOQ and estimation support, document control and management reporting.
* Explore AI for plant performance: predictive maintenance, process optimisation and remote monitoring.

**Make AI safe to use**

* Move WOG from restricted AI use to governed adoption: approved enterprise tools, a clear AI usage policy, and no company data in unapproved platforms.
* Configure data loss prevention (Microsoft Purview DLP) and sensitivity labels so AI tools see only what they should.
* Control what AI agents can access and do: least-privilege permissions, human approval for consequential actions, and full logging.
* Assess AI vendors for security, privacy and contractual risk; keep AI use compliant with the DPDP Act 2023 and IT Act 2000.

**Bring people along**

* Train employees and leaders to use AI well, and build a library of approved prompts, templates and agents.
* Work hand in hand with the IT team, which runs infrastructure and cyber security.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer applications or a related discipline.
* 7 to 10 years in technology, digital transformation or engineering roles, including hands-on generative AI work since late 2022.
* AI work you can show us: at least two AI solutions taken to production in an organisation, with measurable results.
* Working knowledge of Python, APIs and low-code automation, and of data protection in Microsoft 365 (DLP, sensitivity labels, access controls).
* An AI certification or programme from a reputed institute (IIT, IISc, IIM, ISB or a global equivalent) or a recognised vendor (Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS).
* Interest in engineering businesses, with understanding of the water and wastewater industry or a willingness to learn it quickly.

**Good to have**

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Engineering or Computer Science.
* A cyber security certification - CISSP, CISM, CEH, CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft SC-401 / SC-300.
* Hands-on experience building agentic AI workflows (multi-step agents with tool access) in production.
* Postgraduate degree in AI, Machine Learning or Data Science.
* Experience in engineering, infrastructure, utilities, energy or manufacturing companies.

If you meet most of the must-haves and have shipped real AI work, apply. We hire for proven ability, not a perfect checklist.

**WHY WOG**

* Build it, don't maintain it: you are the first person in this role and shape how a whole company works.
* Direct line to leadership: your roadmap goes to the CEO, not through layers.
* Real-world impact and a broad canvas: water, wastewater and five green energy businesses.

title: Product Manager
description:
We’re hiring a
**Digital Lending Product Manager**
to lead the vision and delivery of our lending platform, covering both LMS and LOS. You’ll shape loan products and partner integrations, turn requirements into clear specifications, and work closely with engineering through delivery and UAT.
  
  
We’re looking for someone with hands-on Indian digital lending experience and a track record of building or implementing a digital lending platform. The goal: launch by March 2027 with our first partner portfolio live, regulatory requirements covered, and a platform that makes it faster to onboard future partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Product vision and roadmap for the lending platform (LMS and LOS).
* Agile Way of Working.
* The backlog, spec-first: every feature specified with acceptance criteria before build.
* Loan product design: interest, fees, penal charges, repayment schedules, DPD, the KFS and APR journey.
* The multi-partner construct: partner APIs, onboarding, deduplication, webhooks, tenant isolation.
* Integration requirements: All compliances including RBI, credit bureaux, KYC and CKYC, e-NACH and UPI mandates, bank payment rails, e-sign.
* Delivery: sprint priorities with engineering, UAT design and sign-off.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 5+ years of experience, of which 2+ years in Indian digital lending product roles.
* At least one digital LMS or LOS build or implementation carried end to end.
* 2+ years in one stint at an NBFC or a lending-platform company. Bank-only careers do not qualify.
* The mix: roughly 50 % lending & credit domain 30% technical, 20% business background.
* Working command of the RBI digital lending framework: KFS, APR, FLDG, penal charges.
* Strong specification writing, and daily fluency with AI tools.
* Graduate, engineering preferred.

**Success In This Role Means**

* Platform live by March 2027, with our first partner portfolio running on it.
* Covering actual regulatory requirements at go-live.
* Straight-through journeys, with manual exceptions shrinking month on month.
* Second partner onboarded in weeks, not months.

**We Offer**

* A Truly Global Workplace – collaborate with 40+ nationalities across 25+ countries, embracing diversity, inclusion, and cross-cultural innovation
* Hybrid & Flexible Work – balance your life and career with remote-friendly policies and modern offices across Europe
* A Culture of Growth – accelerate your development with access to LinkedIn Learning, structured mentorship, and internal leadership programmes (HiPo & People Leader tracks)
* Workation Programme – work remotely from abroad for up to 2 months per year and experience new cultures while staying connected and productive
* Financial Growth Opportunities – invest in your future with our share purchase matching programme, doubling your contributions and fostering long-term rewards.
* Medical Coverage – group medical insurance covering hospitalisation and essential care.
* Accident Protection – personal accident insurance for peace of mind.

title: Lead Product Manager
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead Product Manager
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard's Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products, and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As part of this effort, the team is developing innovative products that deliver data through APIs and conversational experiences, creating alternatives to traditional reporting solutions.
  
  
**Role**

* Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities, define product vision, business requirements, and strategic priorities, translating them into actionable project and delivery plans.
* Drive product and business strategy by evaluating customer needs, operational challenges, market trends, and business objectives to recommend new capabilities, processes, and solutions.
* Ensure methodology compliance and manage resolutions, reporting to management when necessary.
* Ensure timely and accurate communication with project staff and stakeholders throughout the lifecycle of initiatives. Monitor and manage project budgets, timelines, dependencies, and resource requirements.
* Must be familiar with business objectives, product goals, project scope, and team responsibilities in order to effectively coordinate activities across cross-functional teams.
* Identify and monitor project, product, and business risks, proactively developing mitigation plans to ensure successful outcomes.
* Regularly communicate strategic recommendations, product updates, business impacts, and project status to senior management and key stakeholders.
* Provide measurable input into new products, processes, standards, operating models, and strategic plans in support of business growth and organizational objectives.
* Effectively lead cross-functional teams to align with business objectives, product strategy, project schedules, and budget expectations.
* Effectively deal with difficult situations, navigate ambiguity, and help develop solutions to complex business and operational challenges.

**All About You**

* Advanced knowledge and demonstrated expertise in the areas of strategy, product management, business planning, and project management processes and techniques.
* Experience developing business cases, product roadmaps, requirements, and executive-level presentations.
* Knowledge of structured project management methodologies, planning tools, and product management frameworks.
* Excellent listening, oral, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong organizational, planning, prioritization, and multi-tasking skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to evaluate complex business challenges and recommend actionable solutions.
* Strong leadership, interpersonal, relationship-building, and negotiation skills with a solid track record of influencing cross-functional teams and building internal and external relationships.
* Demonstrate strategic thinking, business acumen, ethics, and values that foster credibility, trust, and collaboration across teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to balance long-term strategic objectives with day-to-day execution and delivery responsibilities.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Global BI&A Product Director - Commercial
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
BCG's Global Business Intelligence & Analytics team builds the analytics products BCG's own
  
  
leadership uses to run the firm — monitoring performance, shaping commercial strategy,
  
  
allocating investment, and steering leadership initiatives. Your customers are internal: regional
  
  
and global function leaders, up to and including BCG's most senior executives.
  
  
As a Product and Delivery Owner, you will own a portfolio of Commercial performancemanagement products end to end — from raw data through to the reporting interface — and
  
  
lead the cross-functional squad that builds them. You will set priorities with your BI&A Business
  
  
Partners, manage a demanding senior stakeholder pipeline, and make trade-offs between
  
  
customer value, cost, and speed of delivery clear and transparent for our stakeholders
  
  

* Own end-to-end product delivery for BI&A’s Commercial Product Portfolio — Starting

from non-conformed source data through ETL layer to the reporting UI — holding the
  
  
bar high on architecture quality, data quality, performance, and user experience
  
  

* Set and manage the roadmap with your BI&A Business Partners, maintaining a

transparent, prioritized backlog where trade-offs are explicit and understood by
  
  
stakeholders
  
  

* Partner with executive stakeholders across regions and global functions to define a

coherent suite of Commercial management products — eliciting requirements,
  
  
facilitating design trade-offs, and setting clear delivery timelines and acceptance criteria
  
  

* Lead your squad through the full Agile cadence — sprint planning and reviews,

quarterly and annual business reviews — translating Tribe objectives into concrete
  
  
sprint goals and KPIs, and unblocking the team as an escalation point
  
  

* Manage resourcing and budget — directly line-managing your Functional Product

Analysts, working with Chapter Leads on technical resourcing, and running your Product
  
  
portfolio's budget in collaboration with the Tribe Leadership
  
  

* Raise your squad's AI fluency and output — set and maintain AI fluency standards

for the team. Build agents and tools that make both your squad and your internal
  
  
customers more effective and efficient
  
  

* Drive adoption. You will champion stakeholder adoption across BCG and foster a

culture of data-driven decision making and continuous business improvement
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* 10+ years in Product Owner, Product Manager, Delivery Lead, or a comparable

leadership role, including clear experience delivering enterprise BI products at scale
  
  

* A track record of leading Agile teams, with deep command of Agile principles and

practice
  
  

* Proven ability to lead a technology-enabled and enterprise-level Business, Digital or

Organizational transformation
  
  

* Hands-on depth in front-end reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or SAP

BusinessObjects
  
  

* Familiarity with data warehousing tools and concepts, including transformation logic

and end-to-end data flows
  
  

* High AI fluency, both as a practitioner and as a leader introducing new ways of

working
  
  
Who You'll Work With
  
  

* Your Squad — as their leader and coach, you will create the conditions for the team

to do its best work
  
  

* BI&A Business Partners — who manage BI&A's key internal relationships and

surface strategic business needs
  
  

* Internal customers — Translating BCG executives and global function leader’s

voice and needs into actionable deliverables for our squad
  
  

* Tribe Leaders — who will set the vision, roadmap, budget, and priorities & OKRs for

the tribes and subsequently, for the squads
  
  

* Scrum Masters — who will help clear obstacles and support you with the Agile

artifacts and ceremonies
  
  

* Fellow Product and Delivery Owners — to share best practices, contribute to a

cohesive culture and ensure alignment between squads
  
  

* Agile Coaches — who, like you, are passionate about Agile ways of working and

with whom you will promote business agility, both within your teams and across the
  
  
organization
  
  
Additional info
  
  
"At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork."

title: Category Manager - Motorola India
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
  
  
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
  
  
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
As Category Manager, Motorola India, you will own the end-to-end success of the smartphone portfolio across strategy, PL, product lifecycle and market execution. Reporting to the Managing Director, Motorola India, you will serve as the single point of accountability for franchise growth, acting as the bridge between Global Product Portfolio, Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Finance, Supply Chain and channel partners to maximize revenue, profitability and market share.
  
  
**Strategy PL Ownership**

* Own franchise-level PL, revenue, margin, market share and business performance.
* Define category strategy, growth priorities and investment choices aligned to Motorola India's long-term ambitions.
* Define the right product at the right price point for India – work closely with the Global Product team to define the same and ensure the same is coming to India at the right time to market
* Drive short-term and long-term business planning to deliver volume, profitability and premiumization goals.
* Build and lead a high-performing category organization with clear franchise ownership and accountability.

**Portfolio Product Lifecycle Management**

* Own the complete product lifecycle from portfolio planning and launch to in-market management, transition and end-of-life.
* Partner with Global Product Portfolio teams to shape India product strategy, close portfolio gaps and localize market requirements.
* Drive portfolio optimization, lifecycle decisions and transition planning to maximize sell-through and profitability.
* Maintain holistic visibility of portfolio health, inventory, pricing, competitive positioning and business performance.

**Demand Planning Launch Excellence**

* Lead demand planning and forecast alignment with Sales, Partners, Supply Chain, Sales Operations Planning, Finance and Global teams.
* Own commercial readiness for all launches, including pricing, channel strategy, inventory, affordability programs and go-to-market execution.
* Drive launch governance, post-launch reviews and rapid course correction to ensure business targets are achieved.
* Ensure disciplined investment deployment while maximizing sell-in, sell-out and return on investment.

**Consumer Market Leadership**

* Own category insights across consumers, competitors, channels and market trends.
* Translate market intelligence into portfolio, pricing, positioning and go-to-market decisions.
* Anticipate competitive moves and lead response strategies to protect and grow market share.
* Partner with Marketing to deliver differentiated consumer propositions and consistent brand experience across channels.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Act as the business owner and decision integrator across Product, Marketing, Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Service and external partners.
* Drive alignment and execution across stakeholders, balancing growth, profitability, inventory and customer experience.
* Influence regional and global stakeholders to secure resources, products and strategic support for India.
* Build strong partner relationships to enhance category performance, distribution effectiveness and launch quality.

**Performance Management**

* Define and track key business metrics including revenue, market share, margin, inventory health, sell-in, sell-out and launch success.
* Lead regular business reviews and drive corrective actions against performance gaps.
* Leverage analytics and scenario planning to improve forecast accuracy, portfolio productivity and investment effectiveness.
* Foster a culture of ownership, speed, accountability and excellence in execution.

#MBG #Motorola

title: AI Product Builder
description:
**The Short Version**

**Who we’re looking for:**
An AI Product Builder who thinks in terms of problems, systems, and leverage — and is excited to use AI to turn ideas into working solutions. You’re someone who likes getting your hands dirty, experimenting with new tools, and building and testing solutions quickly, with a strong bias toward action and real-world validation.

**What the role is about:**
At Kraftshala, you’ll work on problems across student experience, revenue (admissions, sales, marketing), and internal operations. You’ll identify opportunities, figure out what to build, and use AI, automation, and modern tools to turn ideas into working products, workflows, and systems. You’ll work closely with product and engineering teams to take validated solutions from prototype to production.

**What makes this role meaningful:**
Rather than spending most of your time writing requirements or waiting for development cycles, you’ll be expected to experiment, prototype, ship, and learn quickly.

**Why you should apply:**

* ***Build things that actually get used —***
  products, tools, workflows, and automations that solve real problems for students and teams at Kraftshala.
* ***Go from idea to working solution fast —***
  use AI and modern development tools to prototype, test, and ship instead of waiting around for long development cycles.
* ***Own problems, not just tasks —***
  take an idea from identifying the problem to building the solution and seeing what impact it creates.
* ***Work on problems that matter —***
  across student experience, revenue, and internal operations, alongside product, engineering, and business teams.
* ***Get to build across the stack —***
  from understanding users and business problems to prototyping, testing, and shipping solutions with AI and modern technology.

If you’re someone who sees a problem and immediately wants to figure out how to build a better way, this role is for you.

**About us:**
Kraftshala is India’s largest higher-education institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.

We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.

**The Detailed Version**

As an AI Product Builder at Kraftshala, you’ll be at the intersection of product, technology, and business. You’ll work closely with teams across the organisation to understand how they work, spot opportunities for improvement, and build solutions that make a meaningful difference.

You’ll be expected to move quickly from understanding to experimentation — using AI and modern tools to explore different approaches, build prototypes, and learn what works. As solutions take shape, you’ll work with the right teams to refine, scale, and improve them.

A core expectation in this role is the ability to build quickly and learn through experimentation — using AI-assisted development, LLMs, APIs, integrations, automation, and modular systems to turn ideas into usable solutions, validate them in real contexts, and iterate based on what you learn.

**What you’ll own:**

* Find & Understand Problems: Work with users and teams to identify meaningful problems, understand what’s causing them, and figure out what is worth solving.
* Build & Prototype: Turn ideas into working prototypes, tools, workflows, and automations using AI and modern development tools.
  **Metrics to measure:**
  Time from idea to prototype, number of experiments shipped
* Test & Iterate: Put what you build in front of real users, learn from feedback and data, and improve the solution based on what you learn.
  **Metrics to measure:**
  Adoption, iteration velocity, solution effectiveness
* Ship & Improve: Work with product and engineering teams to take validated solutions into production and continuously improve them based on usage and impact.
  **Metrics to measure:**
  Delivery speed, adoption, business impact

**How you’ll operate:**

* You move fluidly between understanding the problem and building the solution
* You use AI as a force multiplier across research, prototyping, development, and execution
* You default to building and testing, rather than spending too long planning
* You’re comfortable trying things that may not work and iterating quickly
* You prioritize speed to insight and usable output over perfect upfront planning
* You think in systems, not just features
* You care about what happens after something is built — adoption, impact, and outcomes

**Monthly Outcomes**

**Month 1:**

* Build a strong understanding of Kraftshala’s users, systems, and business priorities
* Identify and validate meaningful problems worth solving
* Build and ship at least one small prototype, automation, or workflow improvement

**Month 2:**

* Own a problem from understanding to solution
* Build, test, and iterate on prototypes using AI and modern tools
* Ship at least one meaningful product, workflow, or automation improvement

**Month 3+:**

* Take on increasingly complex problems and build solutions with greater autonomy
* Run faster build-test-learn cycles and improve what you ship based on real-world feedback
* Deliver solutions that create measurable improvements in user experience, revenue, or operational efficiency

**Must Haves:**

* 1–2 years of experience in Product, a builder, technical, or closely related role — startup experience is a plus. (We’re not fussed about the exact years of experience, as that’s just a proxy for your skill level.)
* Have built and shipped something — a digital product, tool, prototype, workflow, automation, or similar.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development, APIs, automation, no-code/low-code, or modern development tools.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a bias for action.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-moving contexts.
* Strong user empathy, product intuition, and communication skills.

**Selection Process:**

As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30-60 minutes.

**Setting Expectations:**
This will be a call to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process.

**Technical Exercise:**
This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role

**Conversation 1:**
This will be a detailed assessment review conversation to go over your submission for the technical exercise along with other competencies required for the role.

**Conversation 2:**
A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode.

**Extending an offer:**
If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.

**Location:**

Delhi

Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture and investors here.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As an Aera Techno-Functional Manager, you will lead the design and delivery of Decision Intelligence solutions, own stakeholder alignment, and guide cross-functional teams from business problem definition through deployment and value realization. The role requires strong solution leadership, data fluency, and hands-on understanding of Aera delivery.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead discovery workshops to define business objectives, decision triggers, personas, KPIs, constraints, actions, and measurable outcomes.
* Own end-to-end solution design across data, recommendation logic, workflow, user experience, action enablement, security considerations, testing, deployment, and support.

* Drive user acceptance, adoption planning, operating model readiness, deployment, hypercare, and outcome tracking.
* Identify reusable assets, accelerators, and delivery standards to improve quality and productivity.
* Partner with sales and account teams on solution shaping, estimates, staffing, and proposal support where required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, business analytics, supply chain, operations, finance, or a related field; a master's degree is advantageous.
* MBA from Tier 1 institute will be preferred.
* More than 10 years of overall experience in consulting, enterprise technology, analytics, data solutions, or digital transformation.
* Demonstrated experience leading techno-functional solution delivery and multi-disciplinary teams.
* Strong SQL and data analysis capability sufficient to review solution logic, validate data, and guide technical teams.
* Proven stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, solution governance, risk management, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to connect solution design to business value, adoption, actionability, and measurable outcomes.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Prior Aera implementation and leadership experience is a strong plus.
* Experience designing Decision Intelligence solutions or equivalent recommendation and action-oriented enterprise solutions.
* Domain experience in supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial, or finance transformations.
* Experience with cloud data ecosystems, integration patterns, analytics, AI/ML, or process orchestration.

**What We Look For**

* Who can create clarity across business, functional, data, and technology workstreams.
* Coach teams toward high-quality, reusable, and supportable delivery.
* Escalate risks early and maintain transparent governance with account and client leadership.
* Own the connection between delivery outputs and client business outcomes.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

* Assess and shape opportunities for delivery through Low-Code/No-Code (LCNC) technologies, workflow automation, self-service and AI-assisted solutions, considering business value, feasibility, complexity and user needs.
* Ensure processes are streamlined before automation solutions are designed or implemented.
* Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, process rules, use cases and acceptance criteria.
* Own and drive assigned LCNC initiatives through the project lifecycle, from discovery and solution shaping through planning, development, testing, implementation, adoption and change management.
* Develop business case and cost-benefit analysis, covering expected outcomes, risks, dependencies and benefits.
* Liaise between process owners, project teams, Tech, Data and other delivery partners throughout project lifecycle.
* Maintain accurate process maps, requirements, decision logs and supporting project documentation.

**Essential**
Experience, Skills and Educational Qualifications
  
  

* Proven experience across Business Analysis, Product Management and/or Project Delivery, with responsibility for taking business problems from discovery through solution design and implementation.
* Strong capability in end-to-end process analysis and redesign, including current-state and future-state mapping, standardisation, simplification and optimisation.

* Experience facilitating workshops and effectively managing stakeholders across business, technology and senior leadership teams.
* Strong product management and user-centred design mindset, with experience defining user journeys, prioritising requirements and shaping solutions around user needs and business outcomes.

title: Digital Strategist
description:
**Who We Are**
WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
  
  
The opportunity
  
  
As a Digital Strategist, you will sit across from Fortune 500 clients, understand their business problem, recommend the right use cases to make best use of the client’s investments in Adobe Experience Cloud solution, and own the delivery outcome. This is a consulting and advisory seat distinct from a pure implementation role.
  
  
What you’ll be doing
  
  
**Adobe Experience Cloud & Digital Ecosystem**

* Advise clients on the right Adobe Experience Cloud solution mix — Analytics, Target, Campaign, AEP, CJA, AJO, AEM — against their business objectives.
* Own delivery outcomes on Adobe tools: configure, design, and lead the strategy layer, not just execute downstream tasks.
* Contextualise Adobe data and outputs within a broader full-funnel digital strategy spanning paid, owned, and earned channels.

**Client Advisory & Consulting**

* Lead discovery sessions and requirement-gathering conversations with client stakeholders, including CXO-level audiences.
* Translate complex business problems into clear, recommendation-led digital strategy and Adobe DX roadmaps.
* Own the client outcome — from requirements to recommendation to delivery — with accountability for measurable business results.
* Manage senior client relationships and present strategy confidently to Fortune 500 leadership.

**AI-Native Consulting & Innovation**

* Drive adoption of AI-enabled consulting methodologies — personalization, segmentation, journey orchestration, content optimization, and operational efficiency.
* Identify where AI can improve client outcomes, including emerging practices such as GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization).
* Build or contribute to reusable AI-enabled consulting assets — frameworks, accelerators, and playbooks — applied across engagements.

**Industry & Strategic Depth**

* Bring demonstrable depth in at least one priority vertical — retail / e-commerce, BFSI, travel & hospitality, or media & entertainment.
* Use industry-specific KPIs and dynamics to ground recommendations in real business context.
* Develop comprehensive, multi-channel digital marketing strategies that go beyond single-tool specialism.

What we want from you
  
  

* Experience: Min8+ years of total work experience, with at least 50% in digital strategy, digital marketing management, or Adobe DX advisory. Recent relevant experience (last 3 years) is weighted heavily.
* Adobe / DX fluency: Hands-on ownership of at least one Adobe Experience Cloud tool with named outcomes
* Client advisory: Proven ability to advise clients, gather requirements, recommend solutions, and own delivery outcomes — not just implement or report.
* Digital marketing breadth: Working command across multiple disciplines — SEO, SEM, paid social, email/lifecycle, marketing automation, analytics — enough to give holistic cross-channel recommendations.
* Industry depth: Sustained engagement in at least one priority vertical where the industry’s specific dynamics genuinely informed the work.
* AI engagement: Demonstrated application of AI-enabled tools or methodologies to client or marketing problems, beyond personal productivity use.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree required. Full-time MBA strongly preferred as a proxy for structured thinking, communication, and stakeholder navigation.
* Enterprise exposure: Experience operating at, or delivering to, enterprise-scale environments comparable to Fortune 500 client engagements.

If you know some of this even better
  
  

* Adobe Experience Cloud certifications (AEP, Analytics, Target, CJA, AJO).
* Prior employment at Adobe, or within the Adobe partner ecosystem, materially reducing ramp time.
* Depth across two or more priority verticals.
* Named AI consulting deliverables — a GenAI personalization framework, agentic workflow, or GEO/AEO strategy with measurable outcomes.

What we can offer you
  
  
Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.
  
  
Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.
  
  
We lead with
**Heart**
, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
  
  
We empower your
**Brains**
for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
  
  
And we champion
**Courage**
, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.
  
  
**About WPP**
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
  
  
WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

title: SAP MM Lead Product Analyst
description:
**Company Description**
**About Sopra Steria**
Sopra Steria, a major Tech player in Europe with 51,000 employees in nearly 30 countries, is recognised for its consulting, digital services and solutions. It helps its clients drive their digital transformation and obtain tangible and sustainable benefits. The Group provides end-to-end solutions to make large companies and organisations more competitive by combining in-depth knowledge of a wide range of business sectors and innovative technologies with a collaborative approach.
