In 2025, the Group generated revenues of €5.6 billion.
  
  
**Job Description**
**The world is how we shape it.**
We are seeking a highly skilled
**SAP MM Consultant with 8–10 years of experience**
, with good knowledge of
**SAP SD**
, to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for implementing, configuring, and supporting
**SAP Materials Management (MM) solutions in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud**
, while also supporting integration with SAP SD and other SAP modules. You will work closely with clients to understand business requirements, optimize procurement and inventory processes, and deliver solutions aligned with SAP best practices.
  
  
**Must have experience at least 1 E2E implementation in Public Cloud and Strong AMS experience.**
**Job Responsibilities**

* Implementation & Configuration: Lead the design, configuration, and deployment of SAP MM solutions in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, covering procurement, inventory management, and related processes.
* Client Consultation: Work closely with clients to gather requirements, understand business processes, and provide SAP MM solutions aligned with standard SAP best practices.
* Business Process Analysis: Analyze and optimize procure-to-pay (P2P), purchasing, inventory management, goods receipt, invoice verification, and material master processes.
* SAP SD Knowledge & Integration: Provide functional support for SAP SD processes and ensure effective integration between MM and SD, particularly across sales, stock availability, material movements, delivery, and billing-related processes.
* Configuration & Process Optimization: Configure and support purchase requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, scheduling agreements, goods movements, inventory management, and physical inventory processes.
* Cloud Integration: Ensure effective integration of SAP MM with SAP SD, FICO, PP, and other SAP Cloud modules and third-party applications.
* Testing & Quality Assurance: Support configuration testing, integration testing, UAT, defect resolution, and troubleshooting to ensure successful implementation.
* Training & Support: Provide end-user training and post-implementation support, including issue resolution, process guidance, and continuous improvement.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to optimize procurement and inventory processes using SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud capabilities and standard SAP best practices.
* Documentation & Knowledge Transfer: Prepare and maintain configuration documents, process flows, functional specifications, test scripts, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Collaboration: Work closely with SAP functional consultants, technical teams, business stakeholders, and project teams to deliver integrated solutions within agreed timelines.
* Project Management Support: Assist project managers with scope, timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and risks related to SAP MM implementations in a cloud environment.

**Required Skills**

* 8–10 years of SAP MM experience, preferably with SAP S/4HANA.
* Strong hands-on experience in SAP MM covering Procurement and Inventory Management.
* Good working knowledge of SAP SD and MM-SD integration.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of P2P, purchasing, inventory management, goods movements, invoice verification, and material master.
* Good understanding of integration with SAP SD, FICO, and PP.
* Experience in requirements gathering, configuration, testing, UAT, documentation, and production support.
* Strong client-facing, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Total Experience Expected: 08-10 years
  
  
**Qualifications**
Engineer
  
  
**Additional Information**
At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.
  
  
All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
description:
**About The Company**
Netspend Corporation is a global, vertically-integrated financial services and technology company dedicated to the delivery of innovative financial empowerment solutions to consumers worldwide. Netspend's financial products and services span prepaid, debit, cross-border payments, and loyalty solutions for consumers and enterprise partners.
  
  
Netspend provides prepaid and debit account solutions that connect customers with secure, convenient access to global payment networks so they can manage their money and make everyday purchases. With a nationwide U.S. retail network, customers can purchase and reload Netspend products at 130,000 reload points and over 100,000 distributing locations.
  
  
Since our founding in 1999 by industry pioneers, Netspend products have processed billions of dollars in transaction volume and served millions of customers worldwide. The company is headquartered in Austin, Texas with employees worldwide.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager with 10+ years of experience to lead complex, cross-team engineering programs built on Java. You will be an enabler for the engineering teams who own delivery — bringing structure, visibility and alignment from scoping through launch — while engaging deeply with engineers on architecture, dependencies and technical trade-offs.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of engineering and execution. You will be the person who turns ambiguous goals into a clear plan, keeps multiple teams moving in step, and gives leadership an honest, early view of risk.
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ years
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program enablement**

* Enable large, multi-quarter programs spanning several engineering teams, partnering with the engineering managers who own delivery from charter through launch and post-launch review.
* Build integrated program plans with milestones, critical path, dependencies and resourcing; keep them current as reality changes.
* Facilitate the program operating rhythm: planning, standups or syncs, status reporting, release readiness and retrospectives.
* Coach teams on Agile (Scrum/Kanban) practices and help adapt the delivery model to fit team size, risk and deadlines.

**Technical partnership**

* Engage with engineers on system design, Java/JVM service architecture, APIs and integration points well enough to challenge estimates and spot hidden dependencies.
* Partner with architects and tech leads on technical debt, scalability, performance and migration plans, and make the trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* Review design documents and help translate technical constraints into scope, timeline and risk decisions.
* Work with DevOps and QA on CI/CD, release management, environments and quality gates.

**Risk, governance and communication**

* Identify risks and blockers early, maintain a RAID log, and help owners drive mitigation, escalating when needed.
* Communicate program status, decisions and trade-offs clearly to engineering leaders, product, and senior executives.
* Define and track delivery metrics such as predictability, velocity, defect trends and milestone health.
* Facilitate scope-change decisions, track budgets, and keep cross-functional partners (Product, Security, Compliance, Operations) aligned.

**Process and people**

* Improve engineering and program management practices across the organization.
* Mentor junior TPMs
* Coordinate with vendors where programs depend on them.

**Experience**
**Required qualifications**

* 10+ years in software delivery, with at least 5 years as a Technical Program Manager, Technical Project Manager or equivalent.
* A track record of enabling large programs involving 3+ engineering teams and multiple stakeholder groups.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Technical depth (Java)**

* Strong working knowledge of Java-based systems — core Java concepts, Spring / Spring Boot and the JVM — enough to engage credibly with engineers; hands-on coding is not required.
* Solid understanding of microservices, REST APIs, relational and NoSQL databases, and messaging systems such as Kafka.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS), containers (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitLab CI).
* Able to review design documents, follow technical debates, and ask the questions that surface real risk.

**Project and program management**

* Deep command of the full project lifecycle: initiation, planning, estimation, scheduling, execution, monitoring and closure.
* Strong practice in Agile and hybrid delivery, including sprint planning, release planning and dependency management at scale.
* Proficiency with tools such as Jira, Confluence, diagramming tool such as Lucid Chart
* Proven skill in risk management, scope control, budget tracking and stakeholder management.

**Leadership and communication**

* Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive-level status reporting.
* Able to influence without authority and resolve conflicts across teams.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to bring structure to it quickly.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a results-oriented mindset and a commitment to delivering value to customers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe or Certified Scrum Master certification.
* Experience leading platform migrations, monolith-to-microservices transitions or cloud modernization programs.
* Domain experience in fintech, e-commerce, SaaS or another regulated, high-scale environment.
* Exposure to observability tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, Datadog, Grafana)
* Experience managing distributed teams across time zones.
* A Master's degree or MBA.

**What Success Looks Like In Year One**

* You have enabled 1–2 critical programs to hit key milestones on or near plan.
* Leadership has a single, trusted view of program health, risks and dependencies.
* Engineering teams see you as a technical peer who removes blockers rather than adds process.

title: Product Manager

title: Assistant Manager - MIS
description:
Job Description – Assistant Manager – MIS

Luxury Furniture Manufacturing | Nivasa

**1. Position Details**

Designation: Assistant Manager – MIS (Management Information Systems)

Department: MIS / Business Operations

Reporting To: Head of Operations / Management

Industry: Luxury Furniture Manufacturing, Retail and Interior Solutions

Location: Gurgaon and as per company requirement

**2. Job Purpose**

To develop, maintain and streamline management information systems and reporting processes across the organization, ensuring accurate, timely and actionable business data. The role will support management decision-making through comprehensive MIS reports covering sales, production, inventory, procurement, project execution, delivery, finance coordination and business performance.

The Assistant Manager – MIS will be responsible for data accuracy, dashboard development, report automation, interdepartmental coordination and identification of business trends, operational gaps and performance improvement opportunities.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A.** MIS Reporting and Management Dashboards

* Prepare and circulate daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports for management.
* Develop dashboards to track business performance, departmental productivity, targets and actual achievements.
* Consolidate data from sales, studios, design, production, procurement, stores, logistics and project teams.
* Present key business indicators, performance trends, variances and exception reports to management.
* Ensure reports are accurate, standardized and submitted within defined timelines.

**B. Sales and Business Development MIS**

* Track sales performance across studios, regions, sales teams and business channels.
* Monitor sales targets, actual sales, order bookings, conversion ratios, average order value and pending quotations.
* Maintain reports on architect and interior designer relationships, client meetings, lead generation and follow-up status.
* Track customer orders, order value, advance payments in coordination with Finance, cancellations and pending customer commitments.
* Analyze sales trends, product categories, regional performance and opportunities for revenue growth.

**C. Production and Order Tracking**

* Maintain a centralized MIS for customer orders and production progress.
* Track order status from confirmation and design approval through production, quality inspection, dispatch and delivery.
* Monitor production plans against actual output, pending orders, bottlenecks and delays.
* Coordinate with Design, Engineering Coordination (EC), Production and Quality teams to ensure timely and accurate updates.
* Highlight delays, rework, quality issues and deviations from committed delivery timelines.

**D. Inventory and Store MIS**

* Maintain inventory reports for raw materials, hardware, fabrics, finishes, work-in-progress and finished furniture.
* Track stock receipts, issues, transfers, consumption, closing stock and ageing inventory.
* Coordinate with Store and Procurement teams for stock reconciliation and material availability.
* Monitor slow-moving, non-moving, excess and shortage inventory.
* Support periodic physical stock verification and investigate discrepancies between physical stock and system records.
* Ensure inventory records are updated in the designated ERP or inventory software.

**E. Procurement and Vendor Performance MIS**

* Track purchase requisitions, purchase orders, pending approvals and material delivery schedules.
* Prepare reports on vendor performance, lead times, delayed supplies and outstanding purchase orders.
* Monitor material costs and purchase price variations in coordination with Procurement and Finance.
* Highlight material shortages that may impact production or customer delivery commitments.

**F. Delivery, Installation and Project MIS**

* Track dispatch schedules, delivery commitments, installation status and pending customer handovers.
* Prepare reports on delayed deliveries, installation issues, pending site work and customer escalations.
* Coordinate with Logistics, Installation, Project Management and Customer Service teams.
* Maintain visibility of project timelines, milestones, outstanding activities and completion status.

**G. Data Analysis and Process Automation**

* Automate repetitive reports using advanced Excel, Power Query, Power BI or other approved reporting tools.
* Develop standardized MIS formats, data templates and dashboards.
* Identify data gaps, reporting inefficiencies and process deviations.
* Establish common data definitions, reporting frequencies and validation checks across departments.
* Recommend improvements in data collection, reporting accuracy and system utilization.

**H. Data Governance and Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Ensure data accuracy, consistency, completeness and confidentiality.
* Coordinate with departmental representatives to obtain and validate data within agreed timelines.
* Maintain master data for products, customers, vendors, locations and other business categories, as assigned.
* Ensure proper documentation, version control and secure access to reports.
* Follow up on discrepancies and ensure corrective actions are completed by the respective departments.

4. Key Result Areas (KRAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

KRA: Target

MIS Reporting

Submission of scheduled reports within timelines

100% on time

Data Accuracy

Accuracy of validated MIS data

Minimum 98%

Dashboard Management

Development and maintenance of approved dashboards

As per agreed reporting plan

Sales MIS

Timely consolidation of sales, leads, orders and target achievement

100% as per schedule

Production Tracking

Accuracy and completeness of order status updates

Minimum 98%

Inventory MIS

Timely inventory reconciliation and discrepancy reporting

100% as per schedule

Procurement MIS

Tracking of pending POs, vendor delays and material shortages

100% visibility of open items

Delivery MIS

Reporting of delayed orders and pending installations

100% of identified exceptions reported

Automation

Reduction in manual reporting effort

Quarterly improvement target

Data Governance

Compliance with approved formats and validation procedures

100% compliance

Cross-Functional Coordination

Closure of reporting discrepancies within agreed timelines

Minimum 95% within SLA

Targets should be finalized with management based on current systems, data availability and reporting frequency.

5. Educational Qualifications and Experience

* Graduate in Commerce, Business Administration, Statistics, Information Systems or a related discipline.
* MBA, PGDM or relevant certification in Business Analytics/MIS will be an advantage.
* Approximately 5–8 years of relevant experience, preferably with experience in MIS, reporting, business analytics or operations reporting.
* Prior experience in furniture manufacturing, luxury retail, interior design, project-based businesses or manufacturing organizations will be preferred.

6. Technical Skills Required

* MS Excel: Advanced formulas, PivotTables, lookups, data validation, charts and reporting automation.
* Power BI: Dashboard creation, data modelling and performance analysis.
* ERP / Business Software: Experience with ERP, inventory or order management systems; Busy or similar software exposure is an advantage.
* Data Analysis: Ability to identify trends, variances, exceptions and performance gaps.
* Reporting Tools: Strong PowerPoint and presentation skills for management reviews.
* Data Management: Strong understanding of data reconciliation, master data and reporting controls.

7. Competencies and Behavioural Skills

* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Excellent coordination and follow-up skills across departments.
* Ability to work with tight reporting deadlines.
* Structured thinking and problem-solving ability.
* Professional communication and management presentation skills.
* Integrity and confidentiality in handling business information.
* Proactive approach to identifying gaps and recommending improvements.

8. Expected Deliverables

The Assistant Manager – MIS is expected to establish and maintain:

* Daily sales, order booking and business performance reports.
* Centralized order lifecycle tracking from confirmation to delivery.
* Production planning and order ageing dashboards.
* Inventory, stock movement and reconciliation reports.
* Procurement and vendor performance trackers.
* Delivery, installation and pending project status reports.
* Monthly management MIS with key business insights and exception analysis.
* Automated dashboards and standardized reporting templates across departments.

9. Overall Performance Expectations

The role is expected to provide management with reliable, timely and actionable business information, improve visibility across the complete order-to-delivery cycle, strengthen coordination between departments and reduce manual reporting effort through automation.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹46,000.00 per month

* Flexible schedule

title: Banking Fraud & Scams Insight Analyst
description:
Date live: 10/27/2026

Business Area: In Business BSS

Area of Expertise: Product Development & Management

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000120396

  

Join us as a "Banking Fraud & Scams Insight Analyst" at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionise our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.
  
  
You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as experience with SQL, SAS, Python as well as job-specific skillsets.

To be successful as a "Banking Fraud & Scams Insight Analyst", you should have experience with:

**Basic/ Essential Qualifications:**

* Strong understanding of end-to-end Fraud and scam journeys across Banking products.

* Experience in customer journey mapping, process design, and service blueprinting using relevant journey mapping tools for example Figma, Visio etc.

* Proven experience working in Agile delivery environments with hands-on use of Jira for backlog management, prioritization, and sprint execution.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience working on large and complex datasets.

* Experience translating customer, business, and operational requirements into product solutions and enhancements.

* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders across Business, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Control functions.

* Expertise in SAS, SQL, Hadoop, Python and Advanced Microsoft Excel

* Strong SQL capability.

* Produce and maintain scheduled MI reporting.

* Deliver insight and analysis to support impact assessments and complex data requirements.

* Provide guidance and technical support to colleagues developing their own SQL capabilities.

* Ability to work with MI reporting and analytical outputs.

* Strong analytical mindset.

* Communication and stakeholder management skills.

* Ability to support AVP, VP and the wider Banking & Fraud Strategy team.
  

  

**Desirable skillsets/ good to have:**

* Fraud and scam knowledge, particularly focused on Non-Plastic transaction types, such as, cash , cheque, International Payments, Faster Payments, Faster Payments.
* Experience working within a financial institution.

* Broader fraud domain expertise.

This role will be based out of Gurgaon.

**Purpose of the role**

Product Managers are responsible for the leading the strategic focus of the product(s), defining the product vision, market strategy, and competitive analysis. They think about the product's future and how it will evolve over time. They work with various teams, including marketing, engineering, operations, and sales, to ensure everyone is aligned on the product strategy. They use data and market research to inform their decisions and prioritize product features.

**Accountabilities**

* Define Product Strategy: Accountable for defining a product strategy that aligns with business vision, managing capabilities, balancing short-term with long-term goals, ensuring that products meet market demands and drive growth.
* Cross functional alignment: Leadership of cross functional relationships, working with various cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of product strategy and goals.
* Risk and Control: Accountable for overseeing product risk management, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to mitigate those risks, and maintenance of alignment between the product management and control functions.
* Product Development Lifecycle: Own product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, ensuring efficient processes, on-time delivery, and alignment with E2E customer expectations and experience. – working with product owners to drive change objectives.
* Deliver Product Goals and Performance: Deliver clear objectives and key outcomes to steer the product vision and ensure alignment with company’s business goals, financial targets, and strategic vision, driving long-term business success.
* Data driven decisions: Monitor product performance through data-driven analysis and insights, regularly assessing progress against objectives and adjusting the strategies as needed to optimise outcomes and maximise value for both business and customer.
* Customer-Centric Focus: Drive a customer -first approach across the product vision, ensuring customer insights, feedback, behaviours, and pain points are at the core of the product strategy and decision-making process.
* Business and financial acumen: Understanding pricing models, costs structures, and ROI to make financially grounded decisions regarding product development.

**Analyst Expectations**

* To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
* Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
* Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
* They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
* Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
* Partner with other functions and business areas.
* Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
* Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
* Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
* Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
* Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
* Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
* Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
* Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
* Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

**Wealth and Personal Banking** is our new global business combining Retail Banking and Wealth Management; and Global Private Banking. Across Asia, where wealth pools are growing faster than in any other region. Our dedicated colleagues serve millions of customers worldwide across the entire spectrum of private wealth, ranging from personal banking individuals and families, through to business owners, investors and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. We provide products and services such as bank accounts, credit cards, personal loans and mortgages, as well as asset management, insurance, wealth management and private banking that best suit our customers’ needs.

**Role Purpose**

The bank primarily depends on the asset products (Mortgage, PIL, LAS, LAM, etc) to build its assets business. The assets business is extremely technical and with each region of India operating under different local regulations. Accordingly, The Branch assets specialist is a subject matter expert is needed for the fulfillment of asset product applications sourced by RMs building a support system to ensure seamless processing of these applications within the system.It involves interaction with various stakeholders both within HSBC and outside of HSBC ( Risk Team, Builders, Societies etc)

**Principal Accountabilities**

**Impact on the Business / Function**

* Responsible for Asset product disbursals of the MSF Channel
* Back-end support to Branch RMs in the e-2-e process of sourcing to disbursal of any asset product applications.
* Effective co-ordination with internal & external stakeholders eg, CRU, CCR, INM, legal, etc…
* Regular monitoring of status of logged in applications.

**Leadership** **& Teamwork**

* Developmental & coaching intervention for the Channel Partner
* Effective co-ordination with all stakeholders
* Identify cross-sell opportunities for other product lines and sell / refer these to the RMs

**Operational Effectiveness & Control**

* Discrepancy rates in applications
* Fraud control
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD & EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM RBWM example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM WPB customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML & Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps need to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile, else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Role Dimensions**

  

* Primary responsibility for them is to help Relationship Manager achieve KPI targets by ensuring seamless asset product disbursals
* The incumbent would effectively carry the direct accountability for achieving assets disbursals of the Branch reporting directly into the BM.

**Qualifications - External**

  

* Graduate/Post Graduate (Masters)/ MBA with two to five years’ work experience

**Pro-tip :** Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable*.*

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

*Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India*

title: Branding & Marketing Manager
description:
**Company Name:** Unicare Fire Safety (India) Pvt. Ltd. (UFS)  
**Job Location:** Sahibabad, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh  
**Department:** Marketing & Business Development  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years (Preferred)  
**Qualification:** MBA in Marketing / Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.

Job Summary

We are looking for a creative, strategic, and result-oriented Branding & Marketing Manager to develop and execute branding and marketing strategies that strengthen the company's market presence, enhance brand visibility, generate business leads, and support overall business growth in the fire safety and manufacturing industry.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Brand Management**

* Develop and implement branding strategies to strengthen the company's identity and market positioning.
* Maintain brand consistency across company profiles, brochures, catalogues, presentations, and promotional materials.
* Manage corporate branding, product branding, and brand communication.
* Build brand awareness among customers, distributors, dealers, and business partners.

**2. Marketing Strategy & Planning**

* Develop annual marketing plans, campaigns, and promotional strategies.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer surveys.
* Identify new market opportunities and recommend strategies to improve market share.
* Plan and execute B2B marketing campaigns targeting industrial and corporate customers.

**3. Digital Marketing**

* Manage the company's website, SEO, social media platforms, and digital campaigns.
* Develop marketing content for LinkedIn, email campaigns, product promotions, and online advertisements.
* Coordinate with digital marketing agencies, designers, and content creators.
* Track campaign performance, website traffic, engagement, and lead generation.

**4. Product Marketing & Promotion**

* Develop product catalogues, brochures, technical presentations, and promotional materials.
* Coordinate with the sales and technical teams to communicate product features and benefits.
* Promote fire safety products and solutions through exhibitions, trade fairs, industry events, and customer engagement activities.
* Support new product launches and marketing campaigns.

**5. Lead Generation & Business Support**

* Plan marketing initiatives to generate qualified business leads.
* Work closely with the sales and business development teams to support revenue growth.
* Develop customer communication strategies and promotional campaigns.
* Monitor lead conversion, campaign effectiveness, and marketing ROI.

**6. Team & Agency Management**

* Manage marketing executives, designers, advertising agencies, and external vendors.
* Prepare marketing budgets and monitor expenditure.
* Analyse marketing performance and prepare periodic reports for management.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of branding, marketing strategy, and brand positioning.
* Experience in B2B marketing, preferably in manufacturing, industrial products, or fire safety.
* Knowledge of digital marketing, SEO, social media, and lead generation.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and content development skills.
* Strong analytical, planning, negotiation, and team management abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Office and marketing analytics tools.

Pay: ₹37,000.00 - ₹56,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (US Market)
description:
***Key responsibilities***

**Campaign strategy and budgets**

* Plan and run full-funnel paid campaigns on Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, Video, Performance Max), Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, Bing, Taboola and Quora.
* Own monthly paid media budgets of ₹50 lakh or more across several client accounts, and pace spend against targets every week.
* Set clear targets for each account (CPL, CPA, ROAS, MQL volume) and agree them with the account manager before launch.

**B2B lead generation**

* Build lead generation programmes for B2B clients, using LinkedIn, Google and Meta to reach decision-makers.
* Work with sales and CRM teams so every lead is tracked from first click to closed deal, and judge success on lead quality, not just volume.

**E-commerce performance**

* Manage Google Merchant Center, Shopping feeds and Meta catalogue campaigns for e-commerce clients.
* Improve product feeds, bidding and audiences to grow ROAS.

**Tracking and analytics**

* Set up and audit GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, LinkedIn Insight Tag and e-commerce tracking.
* Fix broken or duplicate conversions so reported numbers match the CRM.

**Optimisation and testing**

* Run A/B and multivariate tests on ads, audiences, bids and landing pages, with a written test plan and result for each.
* Use heatmaps and session recordings (Microsoft Clarity, Hotjar) to find where users drop off, then brief design and content on fixes.
* Spot SEO issues on landing pages (speed, structure, keywords) that hurt Quality Score and organic reach, and raise them with the SEO team.

**Reporting and leadership**

* Send weekly and monthly reports that show spend, results, what changed and what happens next.
* Lead and coach a team of up to 5 marketers, review their accounts and set quality standards.
* Join client calls, explain results in plain language, and handle questions on performance.

**Qualifications and experience**

* **6 to 10 years** in digital marketing, with at least 4 years focused on paid media.
* A track record of managing monthly budgets of ₹50 lakh (or about $60,000) or more.
* Proven results in B2B lead generation, shown as MQL growth or CPL reduction you can explain with numbers.
* Experience leading or mentoring a small team of marketers.
* Agency experience across several clients and industries is a strong plus.
* A bachelor's degree in engineering, marketing, business or a related field.
* Google Ads and Google Analytics certifications preferred; HubSpot or similar certifications are a bonus.

**Salary Package**: Depends upon the interview

**Working Days**: Monday to Friday

title: Senior Product Manager - IT Operations
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**About the role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead critical areas of IT Operations and Incident Management. You will identify the customer and business problems that make incidents difficult to detect, resolve, and learn from—and turn those insights into focused product strategy and execution.
  
  
This role will serve customers across both IT and Developer teams. You will work across the incident management journey, using a thoughtful combination of AI-powered and non-AI capabilities to improve customer outcomes, user experience, adoption, and business growth.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define and execute product strategy for high-impact areas within Incident Management, impacting both IT and Developer personas
* Identify customer pain points and business opportunities across Enterprise and SMB segments through customer research, product data, support insights, and market signals.
* Prioritize opportunities that improve incident outcomes while creating meaningful value for customers and the business
* Balance AI investments with reliable non-AI capabilities, including workflow improvements, automation, integrations, collaboration tools, reporting, and operational controls.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Research, Marketing, Sales, Support, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality experiences end to end.
* Engage directly with Enterprise and SMB customers to validate problems, test concepts, understand adoption barriers, and measure impact.
* Help JSM and Service Collection grow by increasing customer value, adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion within IT Operations.

**Impact you’ll have**

* Better incident outcomes: Help customers reduce time to detect and resolve incidents.
* Stronger cross-functional collaboration: Enable IT and Developer teams to work together effectively during high-pressure events.
* Smarter operations: Apply AI where it meaningfully reduces effort and improves decisions, while preserving transparency, control, and trust.
* Business growth: Create product experiences that strengthen JSM and Service Collection’s position as a strategic platform for service and operations management.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 10+ years of experience building and launching successful B2B or SaaS products as a Product Manager or equivalent.
* Strong customer empathy, for Enterprise and SMB, and a track record of turning complex customer problems into focused product strategies.
* Comfort operating in technically complex spaces and partnering closely with Engineering and Data Science.
* Practical understanding of AI-enabled product development, including when AI is appropriate and when deterministic experiences are better.
* Strong analytical skills and a focus on measurable outcomes, experimentation, adoption, and business impact.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence across teams and at senior levels.
* A bias toward action, strong product judgment, and the ability to make progress through ambiguity.

**Success in this role**
Success will mean building a clear, evidence-based strategy for specific areas within Incident Management; delivering experiences that customers trust during critical incidents; improving outcomes for both IT and Developer teams; and contributing to sustainable growth for the Service Collection.
  
  
**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

title: AVP, Project Management (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Project Management (L11)**
**Company Overview:**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Project Manager supports S2P delivery by managing the backlog in a blended Kanban/Scrum model—driving refinement, ensuring stories meet requirement standards, and routing enablers to the Program Manager. The role supports PI prioritization, manages QC to ensure documentation compliance, and maintains delivery artifacts and reporting. This position also coordinates mini-project scheduling and may lead small projects, proactively managing timelines, “RAID” items, dependencies, and continuous process improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and manage the backlog process for all Source to Pay functions using a Kanban or Scrum approach, ensuring transparency, prioritization, and readiness for delivery.
* Drive backlog refinement activities to ensure:
* Stories contain clearly defined requirements (e.g., objective, scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, estimates, priority), meeting definition of ready.
* Enablers are identified with clearly documented objectives, outputs, and prioritized.
* Manage a QC process to ensure Program Managers adhere to documentation guidelines
* Drive the Program Increment (PI) prioritization process, partnering with stakeholders to intake work, align priorities, and sequence items based on value and need.
* Manage small project scheduling and coordination, including creating the structure, processes, and templates to develop timeline tracking, task sequencing, meeting coordination, and follow-up on action items.
* Manage projects as needed, including planning, prioritization, scope tracking, status reporting, and risk/issue/dependency (RAID) management.
* Maintain delivery artifacts and reporting (e.g., project minutes and action items, approval, testing and other documentation, decision logs, and schedules).
* Identify and escalate blockers, risks, and cross-team dependencies; propose resolution options and coordinate next steps.
* Promote continuous improvement in intake, prioritization, refinement, and flow efficiency across the S2P delivery process.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience
* 3+ years in Project Management/Agile delivery role utilizing Scrum and/or Kanban
* Scrum Master Certification or Service Delivery Manager
* Experience writing/supporting user stories (scope, acceptance criteria) and tracking dependencies/estimates.
* Experience managing a PI/quarterly prioritization (or similar intake and sequencing) process.
* Enforce documentation standards by managing a quality control process.
* Proficient with Jira/Confluence and MS Office (Excel/PowerPoint/Visio)
* Experience with identifying and developing process metrics

**Desired Characteristics**

* Familiarity with Source to Pay teams and Coupa preferred.
* Experience summarizing complex projects, risks, or ideas to Senior Leadership in a concise manner.
* Detail-oriented and documentation-focused; produces audit-ready artifacts.
* Comfortable with ambiguity with ability to break work down for sequencing.
* Strong organization, communication and facilitation skills
* Proactive communicator who escalates risks/dependencies early and drives follow-through.
* Continuous improvement and curious mindset with interest in flow/throughput metrics.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience

**Work Timings: 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM EST**
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager or HRM before applying for the role on Workday
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP)
* L9+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L09+ Employees can apply.

title: Solution Builder (Technical Builder)
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Salesforce is hiring Forward Deployed Engineers — experienced Technical Builders who design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions directly inside enterprise customer environments. You’ll work as part of a delivery team, partnering closely with a Deployment Strategist (Strategic Builder - a customer-facing advisor who shapes AI strategy and drives adoption) to co-build solutions that go live in production environments from day one. Engagements range from a single large strategic customer to multiple accounts simultaneously. The common thread is real code, real environments, and measurable business impact. This work spans configuration, customisation, and full-stack deployment — shipping solutions customers depend on.
  
  
**Production Experience Required. Builder Mindset Non-negotiable.**
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Develop AI agents and experiences that take real actions for real organisations. Our solutions are in production at some of the largest enterprises on the planet. The work matters because the customers depend on it.
* Design agent intelligence: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and integration with customer systems, leveraging our Agentic AI platform and current LLM techniques.
* Own technical components end-to-end: from architecture choice to deployed, validated, and observable in production.
* Build and integrate data pipelines on Salesforce Data 360, Snowflake, Databricks, and customer data platforms. Model the data, ship the pipeline, validate the output
* Build and maintain agent performance dashboards and customer KPI reporting to track deployment health and business outcomes.
* Contribute to proofs-of-concept and MVPs that move from sketch to deployable in days, not months.
* Co-build alongside customers and partners, sharing best practices and enablement as you go. Leaving teams more capable after each engagement than before.
* Surface platform gaps, edge cases, and field insights to senior Engineers and the product team. Your real-world experience is the product feedback loop.
* Partner with the Deployment Strategist in your pod to translate customer business challenges into agentic solutions that actually ship.

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Total experience of 8-12years and with latest 5+ years of software engineering or technical delivery experience, with at least one production system you’d be proud to walk us through - ideally in an AI tech stack, full-stack development, or working with frontier models
* You have a degree in Computer Science or a related field
* You have prior customer-facing technical delivery experience (consulting, professional services, or forward deployed engineering) — this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* You’re fluent in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Apex — and willing to add to that list as the work demands.
* You’ve been hands-on with LLMs and prompt engineering. You can explain why a prompt failed and what you’d change.
* You understand data modeling, APIs, and integration patterns deeply enough to design them, not just consume them.
* You can hold your own in a room with sales teams and customer architects.
* You ship quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor.
* You actively tinker with the evolving AI/data landscape — piloting new tools, experimenting with new models, and staying genuinely curious about what’s coming next.
* You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it.
* You’re excited to travel ~25% of the time, working directly alongside customers.

Even Better If...
  
  

* Salesforce platform experience or certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I, Agentforce Specialist)
* Familiarity with agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex) and orchestration patterns
* Hands-on with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery)
* Experience across specialist AI delivery areas: data engineering, platform architecture, or headless deployments

title: Tech Lead
description:
**Tech Lead**

**Department**: Information Technology**, Location**: Head office, Kolkata**, Reports to**: CEO**, Team**: IT Network / Hardware & Access Manager (IT Central Support under him) · Product Engineer ×4**, Dotted line**: Site IT Support at the sites — functional, through the IT Network / Hardware & Access Manager.

*Every process in the Company Master is to run on a system by 31 March 2027, mostly on Crystal’s own tools. The Tech Lead will own the IT function and every in-house tool: The tools stay up and correct, every release is safe, and the knowledge to run them sits in documentation, not in one developer’s head.*

**Responsibilities:**

*Run the function*

* The request queue is prioritised weekly with each tool owner; every feature, change and bug sits in a release — nothing reaches a developer directly,
* P1 and P2 turnaround times are published and met; every bug and integration failure is closed with its cause,
* Every integration is listed with an owner and a developer,
* No release reaches production without the tool owner’s sign-off, updated documentation and a rollback plan; only the Tech Lead deploys,
* Every in-house tool outage is owned until restored, root cause logged within 3 days; any cyber incident reaches the CEO the same day.

*The 31 March build*

* Every process on the Implementation List runs on a system by 31 March 2027; build vs plan reaches the Program Lead and CEO weekly,
* Sprints run every two weeks on developer estimates, process engine first, each piloted at one large and one small site,
* The process engine has an owner and backup developer, a configuration backlog and a published turnaround once a process is signed,
* Every build runs from the Master’s spec — governance tracker entry, second-developer code review, owner test sign-off, signed handover,
* No control — checker, approval, gate — is released without a test that tries to bypass it; every merge touching a control is reviewed,
* Every need is assessed build vs buy — process engine, then a tool, then buy — with at least two options compared for the CEO.

*Service to sites and functions*

* Legacy data is cleaned, loaded and checked by the tool owner at each go-live; developers give first-line app support through each support window,
* Each tool is IT-ready before go-live — users trained by the Training & Content Specialist, access loaded by the IT Network Manager,
* Usage per tool per site is reported monthly from system logs, with workarounds seen; gaps reach the owning function head,
* IT sets the standard, tools and calendar for Site IT Support at every site and co-rates them with the Site Lead.

*Security, data and audit*

* The security standard — patching, firewall, incident response — is set and reviewed yearly; the IT Network Manager runs it,
* Cloud admin accounts are named with 2FA; no configuration change takes effect without a ticket and a backup before and after,
* The backup and restore standard is set; the half-yearly restore drill result reaches the CEO with gaps and dates,
* The held processes start once the seat is filled: external IT and cyber audit reporting to the CEO, data retention, personal-data protection with Legal.

*Money, vendors and assets*

* The IT budget — devices, links, cloud, licences, AMCs, contract developers — is built with the IT Network Manager and spend explained monthly,
* Contract developers work to the code policy — company GitHub only, no keys in code, coding tools on company accounts,
* All code, documentation and cloud accounts sit on company accounts, never personal ones.

*Knowledge and review*

* Every tool has an owner and backup developer and passes the quarterly pick-up test from its pack alone; gaps close within two weeks,
* The one-page IT pack goes out in the first week of each month for the CEO’s IT review; actions are logged with owners and dates,
* One measurable IT improvement is delivered each quarter, chosen from the IT review.

*Leading the team*

* Every team member knows their role card, monthly targets and priorities; the weekly team review is held as set in the Meetings Master,
* Each direct report has a monthly one-on-one — progress, honest feedback, help where stuck,
* Performance is reviewed on the PMS calendar, on evidence; weak performance gets an improvement plan early, not at appraisal,
* Every direct report has a development plan that is worked on — coaching on the job, training, stretch work,
* Strong performers are recognised and kept; every critical seat, including this one, has a ready backup,
* Open seats are filled with HR and new joiners inducted well; attendance, conduct and discipline are handled fairly and on time.

Pay: Up to ₹2,400,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

* Take one tool you built for operations. How did you gather the requirements, what architecture did you choose — front end, database, integrations, user access — and why?

title: Manager - Technical Bid & Solution
description:
**Role**
This is not a traditional Project Manager position. We are not looking for someone whose primary strength is maintaining Jira boards, scheduling meetings or updating project plans. We need someone who can read a 150-page government RFP and determine what Dash would actually have to build, migrate, integrate, test, deploy, support and manage if we win. The ideal person can move comfortably between technical and business conversations, challenge unrealistic assumptions, coordinate architects and engineers, build a credible delivery plan and make sure the proposal never promises something the delivery team cannot execute.
  
  
Technical RFP Analysis
  
  

* Analyze technical RFP requirements and decompose them into capabilities, workstreams, deliverables and dependencies.
* Identify mandatory technical requirements, integrations, security requirements, environments, data considerations, service levels and implementation constraints.
* Develop technical questions and clarification requests where requirements are ambiguous.

Solution Shaping
  
  

* Facilitate solution workshops with architects, developers, cloud/data specialists, project managers and other SMEs.
* Develop credible solution approaches for custom application development, modernization, cloud, data, AI, integration and managed-service engagements.
* Define scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and exclusions.
* Ensure proposed solutions are practical, supportable and aligned with Dash delivery capabilities.

Estimation & Delivery Planning
  
  

* Develop or coordinate work breakdown structures, staffing models, schedules, milestones and effort estimates.
* Validate whether the proposed team can realistically deliver within the requested schedule.
* Identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies and support pricing teams with clear resource, effort and timeline assumptions.

Technical Proposal Development
  
  

* Own or co-author technical approaches, implementation plans, transition plans, architecture narratives, project-management approaches and related proposal sections.
* Provide technical input to graphics, diagrams and solution architecture.
* Review technical proposal sections for accuracy, consistency and credibility.
* Participate in technical Red Team reviews.

Presentations & Pursuit-to-Delivery Continuity
  
  

* Support oral presentations, technical demonstrations, solution-defense sessions and clarification responses.
* Lead structured technical handoff after award so delivery receives proposal assumptions, commitments, staffing models, milestones and risks.
* Track lessons learned from actual project delivery and feed them back into future estimates and proposal approaches.

Reusable Solution Assets
  
  

* Develop reusable reference approaches for recurring SLED opportunities.
* Maintain solution patterns, estimation assumptions, team models and implementation approaches that can accelerate future pursuits.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 7-10+ years of experience across IT delivery, architecture, technical presales, solution consulting, bid management or technical project leadership.
* At least 3 years of meaningful involvement in RFP/RFI responses, presales or solutioning.
* Strong understanding of modern application development, cloud, integration, data and enterprise technology delivery.
* Ability to estimate teams, effort, timelines and implementation dependencies.
* Strong understanding of project risks, assumptions and delivery governance.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong professional writing and presentation skills and willingness to challenge unrealistic assumptions.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* U.S. public-sector or government-bid experience.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* PMP, Scrum, SAFe, cloud or architecture certifications.
* Experience with AI/ML, data platforms, application modernization or systems integration.
* Experience supporting fixed-price or deliverables-based IT services proposals.

The Personality We Are Looking For
  
  

* Wants to understand how things actually work rather than repeating buzzwords.
* Challenges an estimate that does not make sense.
* Is comfortable saying, "We should not promise this unless we can prove how we will deliver it."
* Connects commercial promises to delivery reality.
* Takes ownership from RFP analysis through award handoff.
* Can work effectively with strong technical personalities.
* Is practical, curious, organized and decisive.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within the first 90 days, major solution-based pursuits should have clearer scope, assumptions, estimates, staffing models, timelines and technical narratives, with stronger continuity between what Dash sells and what Dash ultimately delivers.

title: Premier Service Manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

**Business Descriptor:**

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

**Job Introduction**

The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer-facing, primarily servicing walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* **Strong Interpersonal Skills:** Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* **Highly Organized:** Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* **Proactive and Efficient:** Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications:**

FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.

**Additional Notes :**

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

* Governance, Quality & Assurance

+ Support definition of data quality standards, operational assumptions, and validation checkpoints for upstream operations datasets and model outputs.
+ Ensure solutions align with established practices and contribute to documentation, playbooks, and governance artifacts for deployed use cases.
+ Drive UAT planning and execution from a functional lens; confirm outputs are credible and usable for operations decision-making.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 8–10 years of upstream Oil & Gas experience with strong upstream operations / field operations depth.
* Practical experience articulating upstream operations workflows in practice, including operational constraints and data quality considerations.
* Strong communication and structured documentation skills; ability to translate operations concepts clearly to non-engineers and technical teams.
* Demonstrated cross-functional delivery experience spanning operations / engineering / digital teams in Agile delivery environments.
* Fluency in English (mandatory).
* Engineering Degree in Chemical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Petroleum disciplines
* MBA
* Experience from/with IOC environments and particularly Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP-type operating models.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, digital transformation, optimization, or surveillance initiatives in upstream contexts.
* Familiarity with upstream operations / production data sources and reporting environments used for operational performance tracking.
* Arabic language capability (optional).

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

* Identify overdue accounts and follow up promptly to minimise collection delays.
* Maintain updated records of customer payments, outstanding balances, and follow-up activities.
* Report collection performance, overdue accounts, and repayment concerns to the reporting manager.
* Support the branch in maintaining a healthy loan portfolio.

**E. Reporting and Compliance**

* Maintain accurate customer records and collection documentation.
* Follow the bank's policies, applicable regulatory requirements, and approved recovery procedures.
* Ensure transparent handling and timely reporting of all collections.
* Maintain customer confidentiality and professional conduct during field activities.

* Willingness to travel within the assigned territory for field visits.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with branch teams.

* Group Loan Collection

* Customer Relationship Management
* Loan Portfolio Monitoring
* Target Achievement
* Reporting and Documentation
* Communication and Negotiation Skills

title: Techno Project Manager
description:
We are hiring a Techno Project Manager with 8-10years years of experience to lead an engineering team, run Scrum, and own on-time delivery. The role sits between engineering and the business, you understand the technology well enough to break down work, challenge estimates and unblock developers, and you report status clearly to leadership.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Team management

• Lead a cross-functional team of developers, QA and designers day to day.

• Assign work based on skills and capacity, and balance load across the team.

• Run 1:1s, give regular feedback, and support hiring, onboarding and performance reviews.

• Resolve conflicts and remove blockers quickly so the team stays productive.

2.Scrum and agile delivery

• Act as Scrum Master: run sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews and retrospectives.

• Work with the Product Owner to groom the backlog.

• Track velocity, burndown and sprint commitments, and keep improving the team's process.

• Manage scope changes and dependencies across teams without derailing the sprint.

3.Status reporting and stakeholder management

• Share weekly status reports covering progress, risks, blockers and next steps.

• Maintain project plans, release timelines and RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies).

• Present delivery updates to leadership and business stakeholders in plain, non-technical language.

• Escalate early when timelines, budget or quality are at risk, with options to recover.

4.Technical ownership

• Understand the system architecture well enough to break features into tasks and review estimates.

• Join design and code-review discussions, and ask the right questions on trade-offs and tech debt.

• Work with engineers on release planning, CI/CD, environments and production issues.

• Ensure quality through clear definitions of done, test coverage and post-release monitoring.

**Required skills and qualifications**

• 7–8 years in software, with 3+ years as a Project Manager, Technical Project Manager or Scrum Master.

• Hands-on background as a developer or technical lead (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js or similar), enough to discuss design and code with engineers.

• Good grasp of web and mobile apps, REST APIs, databases, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and microservices.

• Strong working knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, and tools such as Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.

• Proven record of delivering projects on time with teams of 6–15 people.

• Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to senior leadership.

• Strong problem-solving, prioritisation and risk-management skills.

• B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or a related field (MCA or equivalent also considered).

Good to have

• Certifications such as CSM, PSM, PMP or SAFe.

• Experience in consumer tech, IoT, subscription or D2C businesses.

• Exposure to DevOps practices, monitoring and incident management.

• Experience working with vendors or distributed teams.

title: Project Manager – Project Delivery (Intra-Logistics Warehousing Solutions)
description:
**Toyota Automated Logistics**
is a part of the Toyota Industries Group and specializes in warehouse automation and material handling solutions. We work on innovative technologies and solutions such as automated storage and retrieval systems, conveyors, sortation systems, robotics, and other warehouse automation solutions that help businesses improve operational efficiency and productivity.
  
  

* Methodology: Waterfall (Phased Execution: Initiation, Design, Manufacturing, Installation, Commissioning, Closeout)
* Travel Requirements: Up to 30–50% (depending on phase of site commissioning)

**Key Responsibilities**

* Waterfall Phase Gate Management: Lead large-scale warehouse automation projects through structured Waterfall milestones (Engineering Sign-off, Factory Acceptance Testing, Mechanical/Electrical Installation, Commissioning, and Handover).
* Scope & Change Control: Manage highly detailed technical scopes. Prevent scope creep by strict documentation and pricing of Change Orders for any equipment or software modifications.
* Project Schedule & Milestone Tracking: Maintain the Master Project Schedule (e.g., Gantt charts). Forecast long-lead procurement items (conveyors, AS/RS cranes, racking) to avoid site delays.
* Budget Tracking: Manage multi-million dollar equipment and labor budgets, tracking progress payments and billing milestones tied to delivery phases.
* Monitor & Control Supplier deliverables : Coordinate with suppliers for complete deliverables from date of P.O issue till P.O completion, including warranty period. Ensure timely receipt of dispatch documents from suppliers and handover to Finance team for accounting. Coordinate with Finance team for timely supplier payment releases as per agreed terms.
* Reporting: Prepare & update project progress to customers and internal stakeholders on Weekly & Monthly basis
* Payment Reconciliation : Ensure payment collection from customers as per the deliverables and payment terms agreed with customers
* On-Site Vendor & Subcontractor Coordination: Supervise mechanical and electrical installation contractors on-site to ensure work adheres to engineering drawings and safety protocols.

**Technical & Professional Requirements**

* Industry Experience: 2–6 years of project management or coordination in intra-logistics, warehouse automation, material handling, conveyor systems, or industrial construction.
* Methodology: Proven experience executing capital expenditure (Capex) hardware/software integration projects using Waterfall methodologies.
* Technical Skills: Ability to read and interpret mechanical layout drawings, electrical schematics, and system sequence of operations.
* Software Proficiency: Strong skills in project scheduling tools like Microsoft Project. Should have hands on experience working in Microsoft Planner.
* Preferred / Nice-to-Have: Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering; PMP certification or equivalent field experience in material handling.
