title: Program Project Manager - Vice President
description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
Take a lead role in acquiring, managing and retaining meaningful relationships that deliver outstanding experience to our customers. In this role, you will balance your focus on business results by offering options and finding solutions to help our customers with issues.
  
  
As a Vice President, Strategic Change Manager within Client Account Services, you will help shape and deliver the next generation of CAS.
  
  
****Job Responsibilities:****

* Shape strategic change. Take complex or ambiguous business problems and turn them into clear strategies, priorities and executable plans. Challenge existing processes and identify opportunities to simplify, digitise and reimagine how CAS operates.
* Lead transformation end to end. Own major initiatives from initial problem definition and business case through design, delivery, implementation, adoption and benefit realisation. Connect individual projects into the broader CAS strategy rather than managing them in isolation.
* Reimagine client and operational journeys. Help create simpler, faster and more transparent onboarding and servicing experiences, using strategic platforms, data, workflow, automation and AI where they can materially improve outcomes.
* Turn strategy into executive decisions. Distil complicated issues into clear choices, recommendations and actions. Produce high-quality written and visual materials that allow senior leaders to understand the issue quickly and make informed decisions.
* Create alignment across organisational boundaries. Work across Operations, Product, Technology, Data, Controls and business teams globally. Establish clear outcomes, ownership, dependencies and delivery expectations, and constructively challenge when these are at risk.
* Drive execution with pace and accountability. Identify blockers early, resolve issues wherever possible and escalate clearly when necessary. Maintain focus on the business outcome rather than allowing delivery to become an exercise in milestones and reporting.
* Use data to drive decisions. Define meaningful measures of success across client experience, controls, cycle time, automation, scalability and productivity, and use them to identify where intervention is required.
* Embed change, not just deliver it. Ensure new capabilities are adopted into the operating model with appropriate controls, ownership and measurable benefits. The wider CAS programme explicitly focuses on adoption, readiness and benefit capture as well as technology delivery.
* Act as a trusted strategic partner. Build credibility from working-level delivery teams through to executive management. Communicate candidly, adapt the level of detail to the audience and create confidence in both the direction and the execution.

****Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities:****

* Strategic thinker and strong executor — you move between big picture and detail to turn strategy into practical action.
* Frames unfamiliar problems — you develop a clear point of view and an actionable plan.
* Genuine self-starter — you operate effectively without a tightly defined brief or constant direction.
* Proactively drives progress — you identify gaps, convene the right people, and move work forward.
* Exercises sound escalation judgement — you know when to progress independently vs. when senior engagement is needed.
* Executive impact — you influence senior stakeholders without relying on hierarchy.
* Constructively challenges and clarifies — you question assumptions, align differing objectives, and make clear recommendations.
* Exceptional communicator — you explain complex topics simply and precisely in writing and verbally.
* Bridges working-level to exec-level — you run detailed sessions and translate outcomes into concise executive messaging.
* Commercial and outcome focused — you measure transformation by business outcomes (controls, client experience, cycle time, automation, scalable growth), not activity.
* Strong problem solver with risk judgement — you apply analytical rigor with imperfect information, identify risks/dependencies/control implications early, and balance speed with well-controlled delivery.

title: Project Manager
description:
Department: Projects

Designation: Manager - Projects

Reporting To: Regional Lead - Projects

Location: Bengaluru

**Role Summary:**

The Senior Manager/Manager - Projects will take complete ownership of project delivery across the assigned region within Simpliwork’s managed workspace portfolio. This leadership role requires strong technical expertise, multi-stakeholder coordination, strategic planning, and the ability to manage multiple high-volume fit-out projects simultaneously.

The role ensures seamless delivery from due diligence to handover, maintaining brand standards, operational readiness, and client experience excellence. Strong knowledge of C&I / MEP, commercial fit-outs, compliance, and vendor governance is essential.

**Role & Responsibilities:**

**1. Regional Project Ownership & Leadership**

• Lead end-to-end delivery for all regional projects ensuring timelines, cost control, and quality benchmarks.

• Act as the regional escalation point for design conflicts, vendor issues, risk mitigation, and decision-making.

• Ensure adherence to Simpliwork’s brand standards, specifications, and project delivery frameworks.

• Mentor and guide Assistant Managers, Site Managers, and project teams for consistent performance.

**2. Pre-Construction & Technical Due Diligence**

• Conduct comprehensive technical due diligence of buildings and floors assessing services, risks, infra gaps, and suitability for proposed layouts.

• Support Leasing & BD teams during client pitches by validating feasibility, providing technical inputs, and risk assessments.

• Present due diligence findings to management with clear recommendations and mitigation plans.

• Review landlord-provided infrastructure for HVAC, electrical, fire systems, plumbing, IT/ELV, etc.

**3. Design Coordination & Strategic Planning**

• Review, validate, and approve all project drawings, BOQs, specifications with full ownership.

• Drive design freeze by coordinating with internal design, consultants, architects, and stakeholders.

• Review and finalize project milestones, procurement plans, phasing strategies, and execution methodologies.

• Ensure designs comply with statutory norms and Simpliwork’s operational requirements.

**4. Procurement, Commercial Governance & Vendor Management**

• Support procurement with technical inputs, material validations, and vendor onboarding.

• Align procurement timelines with construction schedules, ensuring zero delays.

• Review SOWs, SLAs, deliverables, and commercial structures to ensure vendor accountability.

• Monitor vendor performance and identify gaps early for corrective actions.

**5. Project Execution & Monitoring**

• Oversee daily execution through regional teams, ensuring quality, safety, and sequencing efficiency.

• Resolve on-ground challenges with quick, logical decision-making and escalation management.

• Implement value engineering solutions without compromising quality or timelines.

• Maintain strict QC/QA controls; ensure approved makes/models are used without deviation.

**6. Client, Consultant & Internal Stakeholder Engagement**

• Act as the primary senior interface for clients during execution and handover.

• Conduct weekly/monthly reviews with clients, consultants, and internal leadership.

• Ensure clear communication on risks, progress, dependencies, and actionable updates.

• Manage walkthroughs, variations, and align solutions to client needs while protecting commercial interests.

**7. Compliance, Documentation & Reporting**

• Ensure all statutory approvals - fire, electrical, occupancy readiness—are planned and closed on time.

• Maintain robust documentation including MOMs, trackers, approvals, deviation logs, commissioning reports, and DLP records.

• Present region-wise dashboards, progress reports, and risk registers to Regional Lead/VP.

**8. Handover & Transition to Operations**

• Ensure all projects are delivered defect-free, fully commissioned, compliance-ready, and operational.

• Oversee final QA/QC checks, testing & commissioning, as-built documentation, and DLP setup.

• Ensure a structured transition to Operations with complete readiness of all services.

**Skill Set Required**

• Strong knowledge of commercial workspace projects with deep understanding of managed office operations.

• Proven leadership experience in managing large teams and multi-city project portfolios.

• Strong MEP, technical audit, and design interpretation capabilities.

• Excellent client-handling, negotiation, and communication skills.

• Strong analytical, planning, research, and documentation capabilities.

• Proficiency in MS Project, AutoCAD, and construction/project management software.

**Experience (Years) required:**

• Minimum 8+ years of project management experience in workspace/commercial interior fit-out industry.

• Experience with managed office operators, commercial developers, IPCs, or reputed D&B firms preferred.

**Qualification:**

• B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering; MEP specialization preferred.

title: Technical Project Manager - Java
description:
About the Company

We are a specialized software house designing and delivering mission-critical communication solutions (Voice, Video, and Data) for Rail/Metro networks and Public Safety operations. With an established footprint across the Asia-Pacific region—including Singapore, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and Taiwan—as well as major deployments across Metros, Airports, and Refineries in India, we build resilient, high-availability software platforms that power vital public infrastructure.

Role Summary

The Technical Project Manager (TPM – Grade II) serves as the crucial bridge between engineering execution and business delivery. In this role, your time will be split between:

40% Technical Governance: Architectural alignment, code quality reviews, engineering mentoring, and technical risk mitigation.

60% Delivery & Project Management: Sprint execution, client & stakeholder management, resource allocation, and milestone tracking.

Key Responsibilities & Deliverables

1. Technical Governance & Engineering Oversight (40%)

Architectural Oversight: Partner closely with architects to design and validate scalable, high-availability Java solutions for critical communications (voice, video, and data communications, live location tracking, network monitoring, and third-party integrations via standard industry protocols).

Code Quality & Technical Mentorship: Conduct high-level code reviews, establish engineering best practices, unblock developers on complex technical hurdles, and chart out technical training programs for team upskilling.

Tech Debt & Vulnerability Management: Strategically balance new feature delivery with proactive refactoring, technical debt resolution, and security patching.

AI-Assisted Engineering: Advocate and operationalize modern AI developer tools across the SDLC for code review, test case and edge case generation, refactoring, debugging, and documentation—ensuring appropriate quality and governance guardrails.

2. Project & Delivery Management (60%)

End-to-End Ownership: Direct full-lifecycle project delivery using Agile methodology for new solutions, add-on feature deliveries, and timely software issue resolution during warranty and maintenance phases.

Estimation & Planning: Leverage deep hands-on software development experience to deliver accurate effort estimations, milestone definitions, and predictable delivery schedules.

Stakeholder Communication: Act as the primary technical liaison for clients and business stakeholders, clearly communicating delivery status, scope adjustments, and technical trade-offs.

Process, Quality & Security Compliance: Follow company Quality Management (QMS) and Information Security Management (ISMS) frameworks, keeping records up to date and partnering with the Quality Manager to clear audits on time.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Must-Have Technical Expertise:

Java Ecosystem: Deep hands-on proficiency in Core Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, etc.

System Design & Integration: Demonstrated experience designing distributed systems, RESTful APIs, and event-driven architectures (e.g., JMS).

Database Management: Solid understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL stores (MongoDB, Redis).

Engineering Foundation: Proven track record with at least 4 years of hands-on Java project development.

Project Delivery & Process Skills:

Agile Leadership: Expert-level mastery of Scrum and Kanban methodologies, along with experience using Git repositories for tracking.

Data-Driven Delivery: Ability to monitor, analyze, and report on engineering health metrics.

Standards & Compliance: Working knowledge of ISO 9001 (QMS) and ISO/IEC 27001 (ISMS) or similar frameworks, with experience working on projects audited against them.

Good-to-Have / Preferred Qualifications:

Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab).

AI Tooling: Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) for code review, test generation, and debugging, with a clear understanding of their limits.

Certifications: PMP certification (valued, but not prioritized over raw technical capability).

description:

For more information, visit www.synchrony.com
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Project Manager supports S2P delivery by managing the backlog in a blended Kanban/Scrum model—driving refinement, ensuring stories meet requirement standards, and routing enablers to the Program Manager. The role supports PI prioritization, manages QC to ensure documentation compliance, and maintains delivery artifacts and reporting. This position also coordinates mini-project scheduling and may lead small projects, proactively managing timelines, “RAID” items, dependencies, and continuous process improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and manage the backlog process for all Source to Pay functions using a Kanban or Scrum approach, ensuring transparency, prioritization, and readiness for delivery.
* Drive backlog refinement activities to ensure:
* Stories contain clearly defined requirements (e.g., objective, scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, estimates, priority), meeting definition of ready.
* Enablers are identified with clearly documented objectives, outputs, and prioritized.
* Manage a QC process to ensure Program Managers adhere to documentation guidelines
* Drive the Program Increment (PI) prioritization process, partnering with stakeholders to intake work, align priorities, and sequence items based on value and need.
* Manage small project scheduling and coordination, including creating the structure, processes, and templates to develop timeline tracking, task sequencing, meeting coordination, and follow-up on action items.
* Manage projects as needed, including planning, prioritization, scope tracking, status reporting, and risk/issue/dependency (RAID) management.
* Maintain delivery artifacts and reporting (e.g., project minutes and action items, approval, testing and other documentation, decision logs, and schedules).
* Identify and escalate blockers, risks, and cross-team dependencies; propose resolution options and coordinate next steps.
* Promote continuous improvement in intake, prioritization, refinement, and flow efficiency across the S2P delivery process.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience
* 3+ years in Project Management/Agile delivery role utilizing Scrum and/or Kanban
* Scrum Master Certification or Service Delivery Manager
* Experience writing/supporting user stories (scope, acceptance criteria) and tracking dependencies/estimates.
* Experience managing a PI/quarterly prioritization (or similar intake and sequencing) process.
* Enforce documentation standards by managing a quality control process.
* Proficient with Jira/Confluence and MS Office (Excel/PowerPoint/Visio)
* Experience with identifying and developing process metrics

title: Deployment Lead – Process Industries
description:
**About Unified AI**

Every plant already has the data. It sits in a historian nobody queries, in batch records nobody reads back, and in the heads of three people on the shift. So when a batch runs long or a yield slips, finding out why is an afternoon of pulling trends and asking around, and by then the next batch is already running.

We build AI agents that close that gap for Indian specialty chemical, pharma, and API plants. Process data and process knowledge sit in one system, so DCS and historian streams are read against the plant's own SOPs, batch recipes, and operational history. The agents investigate and act. They aren't another dashboard waiting for someone to ask the right question.

They run on the instrumentation the plant already owns. No new sensors, no rip-and-replace, no capex case anyone has to defend upstairs. That is why we deploy in weeks rather than quarters. Deviation investigations that used to take hours now take about ten minutes, and the cycle time we give back comes out of equipment already sitting on the floor.

Our founders came out of enterprise automation software, and each of us comes from a manufacturing family. The team is early, and the customers are live, which means you work with the founders directly and see what you build reach a plant floor in weeks.

**Role Overview**

* Own customer pilots end to end, from the first technical conversation to a plant that uses the product every day and a customer ready to roll it out further.
* Find out what each plant runs and what data it can give us, get that data flowing with one of our engineers, analyse it as a chemical engineer, and run the pilot so it succeeds.
* Work as a pair with a platform engineer. You own the customer, the process, and the analysis; they own the integration build.
* Serve as the main point of contact for the customer, from plant floor to plant head. The founder will step in to unblock you when needed.
* Be the voice of the customer to the rest of the company, helping shape platform improvements and iteration.

**What You'll Own — Systems and Data Discovery**

* Map each plant's systems with production, process, instrumentation, and IT/OT teams, including DCS, historians, digital batch records, LIMS, QC sheets, downtime logs, and SOPs.
* Define the data each use case needs, such as tags, batch records, quality results, recipes, and specifications.
* Assess how readily each source is available, including access, format, history depth, export path, and owner.
* Complete a data readiness assessment for every account before kickoff, with gaps and plant-side owners named.
* Judge, with the founders, which plants and use cases have the data to succeed.

**What You'll Own — Data Access and Integration**

* Agree the extraction approach with the customer's IT and OT teams, covering historian access, exports, network and VPN, and security approvals.
* Work alongside our platform engineer to set up data retrieval on the customer side. You run the customer conversation; they build the connection.
* Map tags to activities using P&IDs, PFDs, and instrument indexes.
* Capture recipes, including setpoints, ramp rates, hold times, acceptance criteria, and tolerance bands.
* Monitor feed health, including dead tags, stopped exports, stale servers, and cleared DCS buffers, and catch issues before the customer does.

**What You'll Own — Process Data Analysis**

* Validate data against process reality, such as stuck transmitters, mislabelled tags, resetting totalizers, impossible cycle times, and yields that break a mass balance.
* Analyse batch and process data to find the first wins, including cycle time losses, deviation patterns, idle time, and yield variation.
* Turn findings into a clear story for plant heads and management: what we found, what it is worth, and what to do next.
* Build the evidence that the pilot worked, in numbers the plant's own team agrees with.

**What You'll Own — Pilot Operations and Customer Success**

* Run each pilot end to end, including kickoff, milestone plan, weekly cadence, escalation, and closeout.
* Run weekly customer reviews, including the agenda, minutes, and a numbered action list with owners and dates.
* Maintain one open-item list per account, with an owner and an age against every row.
* Drive adoption with plant users through training and check-ins, making sure the agents get used day to day.
* Prepare progress and management reviews. Tooling drafts them; you verify every number.
* Build the case for moving from pilot to rollout, together with the founders.

**What You'll Own — Product Feedback**

* Translate plant reality into problem statements engineers can build against.
* Judge what is worth automating.
* Write a deployment playbook so every pilot makes the next one faster.

**Qualifications**

* BTech or BE in Chemical Engineering.
* 4–7 years of experience, with at least 2 years hands-on in an operating specialty chemical, pharma, or API plant across production, process, technical services, or operational excellence. Design office and EPC experience does not substitute.
* Experience working with plant data: you have pulled data from a DCS, historian, or LIMS, or been part of a digitalisation, MES, or historian project.
* Strong data analysis skills: advanced Excel at minimum, and comfortable working through large time-series and batch datasets.
* Ability to read P&IDs and PFDs independently.
* Strong process literacy: you can spot impossible numbers on a sheet, whether it's negative pressure, a 40-hour cycle on a 22-hour batch, or a yield that breaks a mass balance.
* Customer-facing polish: you have presented findings to plant heads or senior management, run meetings with external stakeholders, and write clearly.
* Cross-department follow-through, with a specific example you can talk through.
* Fluent in Hindi and English.
* Based in Bengaluru and genuinely willing to travel up to 2 weeks per month to customer plants in Gujarat and Maharashtra. Travel is fully covered.

**Strong Pluses**

* SQL or Python for data analysis.
* Hands-on experience with DCS, SCADA, or historians, such as Yokogawa, Siemens, Honeywell, Emerson, or AVEVA PI, and familiarity with OPC.
* Experience with industrial analytics tools such as Seeq, TrendMiner, or PI Vision.
* Experience working at, or serving as the plant-side contact for, an industrial software or technology vendor.
* Consulting, technical services, or operational excellence project experience.
* Experience working with AI or AI agents.
* Gujarati or Marathi language skills.
* Experience with multi-product batch operations rather than single-product continuous operations.
* Six Sigma or operational excellence training.

**What Success Looks Like at Six Months**

* Every new pilot starts with a data readiness assessment, and no pilot waits more than a week on data access.
* Every live account has a process model its own team recognises as accurate.
* Every pilot has at least one finding the plant head agrees is worth acting on, backed by numbers they trust.
* At least one pilot has moved to a paid rollout with you as the lead.
* our assigned customers call you first.
* You have created a repeatable deployment playbook.

**Incentive Compensation**

title: GN-I&E- S&P DC Construction Manager
description:
**Data Center Construction Manager**
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Data Center Construction Manager to oversee the end-to-end delivery of mission-critical data center projects. You will manage general contractors, MEP subcontractors, and commissioning agents to ensure facilities are delivered on schedule, within budget, and to specification. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in critical facility systems with strong project leadership skills, enabling seamless handoff to operations teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead day-to-day construction management of new data center builds and retrofits, including ground-up campuses, shell-and-core fit-outs, and critical infrastructure upgrades.
* Manage RFP/RFQ processes, bid leveling, and contract award for general contractors and specialty subcontractors (structural, civil, electrical, mechanical, fire suppression, and low-voltage).
* Coordinate with design teams (architects, structural/MEP engineers) to resolve field conflicts, issue RFIs, and manage design submittals and shop drawings.
* Develop and maintain master project schedules (P6 or MS Project), tracking milestones for sitework, steel erection, MEP rough-in, commissioning, and IT readiness.
* Oversee commissioning and integrated systems testing (IST) for power systems (UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs), cooling infrastructure (CRAC/CRAH, chillers, cooling towers, liquid cooling), and life-safety systems.
* Manage project budgets from $50M to $500M+, including monthly cost reporting, change order evaluation, and forecasting CapEx/OpEx through project closeout.
* Enforce EHS compliance on site, conducting daily safety walks, toolbox talks, and incident investigations in alignment with OSHA standards and corporate safety programs.
* Coordinate vendor qualification and equipment procurement for critical path items (transformers, generators, UPS systems, cooling equipment) to mitigate supply chain risks.
* Serve as primary liaison between ownership, design consultants, contractors, and local authorities having jurisdiction (AHJ) for permitting, inspections, and Certificate of Occupancy.
* Mentor and supervise construction coordinators, site engineers, and owner's representative staff embedded on project sites.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with hyperscale or colocation data center campuses exceeding 50MW critical IT load.
* Knowledge of sustainable construction practices including LEED certification, water usage effectiveness (WUE), and energy modeling for PUE optimization.
* Background in modular or prefabricated data center construction (e.g., skid-mounted power, containerized cooling).
* Familiarity with liquid cooling infrastructure: direct liquid cooling (DLC), rear-door heat exchangers, and immersion cooling systems.
* Experience with BIM coordination (Revit, Navisworks) for clash detection and construction sequencing.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
**About The Team**
Zillow's People Technology organization builds and operates the platforms that power how Zillow employees work: Workday, ServiceNow, and the agentic AI layer connecting these systems to the surfaces employees use every day - Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, and AI tools. The India engineering team owns this platform stack end to end: production access, change ownership, on-call rotation, and direct relationships with the business teams we support.
  
  
Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.**
Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
  
  
**About The Role**
As Sr. Technical Program Manager, you are the connective tissue of the PeopleTech delivery model. You own the sprint cadence, the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering, and the cross-team coordination that keeps India-based engineering and US-based product and business partners in sync. You are a single, senior individual contributor - not a team of TPMs - which means you need to be decisive, organized, and confident operating across time zones without a lot of structural backup.
  
  
You will work directly with the Product Managers (US-based) and the India Engineering team, and will be a key voice in how the model matures over time. This is a high-visibility role in a new operating model that is still being built; you will help define how it works, not just execute inside it.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own sprint execution end to end: create and close sprints in Jira, run grooming and planning, lead standup, track capacity and velocity, and ensure all stories are estimated and complete before each sprint closes.
* Serve as the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering: review stories for build readiness before sprint commitment, flag ambiguity or missing technical context, and resolve open requirements questions in partnership with PM and Engineering before work begins.
* Own the US-India coordination bridge: run a daily touchpoint with the PM to carry blocker and handoff status, facilitate the overlap-window ceremonies (grooming, sprint planning, sprint demo) where PM and Engineering both need to be present, and maintain async-first practices that keep live meeting load low.
* Manage cross-team dependencies and risks: identify sequencing issues and resource constraints early, route blockers to the right owner (Engineering or PM), and escalate to leadership when something threatens delivery.
* Coordinate Unit Test logistics: manage test resources, defect tracking, and the communication between Engineering and the PM during unit testing cycles.
* Document the team's operational model: post-launch on-call and support structure, escalation paths, and the handoff from project delivery into business-as-usual operations.
* Drive continuous improvement: use retrospective findings to sharpen handoff processes, story quality, and sprint predictability over time; build and share repeatable practices that improve how the team works.
* Apply AI tools to program work: status synthesis, risk and dependency tracking, meeting notes and follow-ups, draft communications - and help the broader team build that fluency.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
  
  
Who you are
  
  

* 5-8 years of technical program or project/scrum team management experience delivering complex, cross-functional programs in enterprise SaaS or platform environments.
* Demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple teams end to end, including programs where you defined scope and goals yourself in ambiguous conditions.
* Strong technical fluency: you can understand and explain how Workday, ServiceNow, or comparable enterprise platforms fit together, reason about integration dependencies, and assess whether a user story is ready to build - without needing to write the code yourself.
* Demonstrated working knowledge of Workday HCM or ServiceNow (module configuration, integrations, annual HR cycles, security model basics).
* Experience operating in a distributed or offshore/nearshore engineering model, with US-based product and business partners - you understand how to design for async-first collaboration and how to use overlap hours well.
* Best-in-class Jira and sprint management skills: you run ceremonies cleanly, keep the board accurate, and produce sprint summaries that give leadership a clear picture without requiring a meeting.
* Strong communication across technical and non-technical audiences, including senior executives - you know what altitude is right for each conversation.
* Track record of influencing without authority, resolving blockers, and driving cross-org alignment on decisions.
* Fluent with AI tools for program management and able to help others build that fluency.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Get to know us
  
  
At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
  
  
Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
  
  
No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
  
  
*Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.*
*If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.*
*Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.*

As a Staff Technical Program Manager – Infrastructure Leasing & Capitalization, you will execute within the established strategy and operating model for Asset Lease Management, overseeing the lease lifecycle from contract and negotiation through renewal, buyout, and asset retirement. This role partners closely with Treasury, Finance, Sourcing, Legal, vendors, and technology stakeholders to structure and manage lease agreements that optimize financial, operational, and business outcomes while ensuring compliance with accounting and governance requirements.
  
  
You will support the financial and operational management of the infrastructure lease portfolio, including forecasting, budgeting, payment administration, asset capitalization (as needed), and lease performance reporting. As the Staff Technical Program Manager of lease and asset data integrity, you will ensure accurate contract, financial, and asset records within enterprise systems of record. This role provides expertise in finance and operating lease evaluations, supports vendor negotiations and buyout strategies, and delivers insights that maximize asset value, control costs, and support long-term technology investment decisions across GE HealthCare.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Executes projects within the established Asset and Lease Management strategy and operating model, managing the roadmap, and governance framework to support long-term technology lifecycle and financial management objectives.
* Accountable to deliver the long-term Asset and Lease framework, including new leases, lease buyout, optimization opportunities, TSA strategy, and billing and data integrity
* Partner with Treasury, Finance, Sourcing, Legal, vendors, and technology teams to support the negotiation of lease agreements, financial terms, and buyout strategies that align with business and accounting requirements.
* Collaborate with business partners and technology leadership to support the execution infrastructure needs including tracking the progress, key milestones, asset health, and interdependencies.
* Support the vendor strategy and contract agreements in partnership with sourcing and VMO teams to complete project activities
* Track the budget, including forecasting, actuals updates, and variance reviews on a monthly basis
* Participates in Operating Mechanisms with partners to receive consolidated updates and discuss risks and strategies to ensure outcomes are delivered
* Prepare stakeholder communication and progress reporting at various levels of the organization including leadership and executives
* Ensure quality of deliverables is verified and matching stakeholder expectations
* Track outcomes realization and customer satisfaction levels through established metrics against service level. Ensure lessons learned are collected
* Perform financial reviews and approval processes for new leases, amendments, buyouts, capitalization events, and asset transitions.
* Maintain the enterprise system of record for leased assets, ensuring accuracy of contract details, asset records, serializations, financial attributes, ownership information, and lifecycle events.
* Ensure data integrity, audit readiness, compliance, and accurate financial reporting across all leased assets and agreements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems, Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, or Engineering or 4 years of IT technical experience
* Minimum 8 years of IT professional experience
* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Asset and Lease Management including project and financial management leading cross functional initiatives and/or large global projects

**Desired Characteristics**

* Proven expertise in enterprise Asset and Lease Management, including lease structuring, contract administration, buyouts, asset lifecycle management, and financial governance specific to Infrastructure Hosting and Network portfolio.
* Strong understanding of finance lease and operating lease models, capitalization policies, depreciation methodologies, and accounting implications.
* Experience partnering with Treasury, Finance, Sourcing, Legal, and vendors to support complex lease agreements and financial commitments.
* Demonstrated success managing large infrastructure asset portfolios, including hosting, network, data center, and end-user technology assets.
* Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, payment management, and lease portfolio optimization.
* Expertise in maintaining accurate asset and lease records, ensuring data integrity across systems of record, financial platforms, and reporting tools.
* Knowledge of global financial, tax, regulatory, and compliance considerations related to leased technology assets.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess financial impacts, identify optimization opportunities, and drive informed business decisions.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders and lead cross-functional initiatives across Finance, Treasury, Sourcing, Vendor Management, and Technology organizations.
* Excellent communication and executive presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex financial and contractual concepts into actionable business insights.
* Experience supporting vendor negotiations, lease renewals, restructures, buyouts, and asset disposition strategies to optimize financial and operational outcomes.
* Experience working within global organizations and coordinating activities across multiple regions, business units, and stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a track record of driving process standardization, automation, governance maturity, and operational excellence.

title: Lead Customer Program Manager
description:
**About MISUMI Americas**
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
  
  

* Work Hours: 7:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST, Monday through Friday (aligned with US Eastern business hours)\*\*

**Impact in this Role**
At Fictiv/MISUMI Americas, we are building the operating system for custom mechanical parts and assembly - enabling Fortune 500 companies to scale production across India, Mexico, China, and the US. We deliver highly complex, high-quality hardware for autonomous vehicles, surgical systems, industrial robots, and beyond.
  
  
The Lead Customer Program Manager is a people leader role within the Customer Program Management team. You will build, manage, and grow a team of CPMs who are responsible for owning customer programs and projects end-to-end - from initial scoping and kickoff through delivery, escalation management, and long-term account health.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of three disciplines: customer success, project management, and manufacturing expertise. Your team’s job is to be the trusted partner for our customers - understanding their manufacturing needs deeply, keeping programs on track, and ensuring every commitment we make is one we keep. Your job as Lead CPM is to make sure your team does that exceptionally well, consistently.
  
  
You will coach and develop your team, set standards for how programs are run and how customers are managed, resolve escalations, and partner cross-functionally to remove blockers. You bring both the credibility of deep program management and manufacturing experience and the leadership maturity to develop others and elevate the team around you.
  
  
You will report to the Manager of Customer Program Management. This role has a hybrid model (Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday in office, Thursday and Friday remote).
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Team Leadership & People Management
* Directly manage a team of Customer Program Managers (Junior to Mid Level), owning their performance, development, and day-to-day effectiveness
* Set clear goals and performance expectations for each direct report; conduct regular 1:1s and formal reviews
* Build structured development plans for each team member, identifying skill gaps, creating growth opportunities, and actively coaching toward them with the goal of accelerating each individual's potential, not just managing their current performance
* Serve as the first line of escalation for your team: step in on complex programs, difficult customer situations, or cross-functional blockers as needed
* Create and maintain onboarding frameworks, training materials, and capability-building resources for new and growing CPMs
* Actively participate in recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding new team members as the team scales
* Foster a high-accountability, high-support team environment rooted in the MISUMI Americas values: Not Afraid to Fail, Empowerment, Open to Change, Speed / Bias Toward Action, and Grit
* Customer Program & Project Oversight
* Maintain visibility across your team’s full portfolio of customer programs and projects - monitoring health, tracking risks, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks
* Set and uphold team standards for how programs are planned, communicated, and executed: scope management, change control, risk identification, and status reporting
* Step in directly on strategic, high-complexity, or at-risk customer accounts to guide recovery, lead customer conversations, or provide senior presence
* Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure smooth program onboarding, renewals, and escalation resolution
* Champion a consistent customer experience across the team - ensuring customers always have a responsive, knowledgeable, proactive point of contact
* Customer Success & Relationship Management
* Model and coach a customer success mindset within the team: proactive communication, anticipating needs, building trust, and driving long-term account health
* Ensure the team is measuring the right things - on-time delivery, customer satisfaction, escalation rate, response time - and improving over time
* Guide your team in navigating difficult customer conversations: how to deliver bad news, manage expectations, and turn friction into stronger relationships
* Build relationships with senior customer stakeholders on key accounts; represent the CPM team in strategic customer interactions as needed
* Supply Chain & Customer Operations
* Maintain a working understanding of supply chain operations - supplier management, lead times, procurement constraints, and fulfillment workflows - to help your team navigate program risks and set accurate customer expectations
* Oversee customer operations health across the portfolio: order management, delivery performance, issue resolution timelines, and escalation response
* Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and Quality teams to resolve cross-functional blockers affecting customer programs and ensure your team has the right internal connections to act effectively
* Coach your team to think beyond program execution - understanding how supply chain and operational decisions upstream directly impact customer experience downstream
* Identify systemic supply chain or operations issues that recur across programs and work with leadership to address root causes, not just individual incidents
* Team Effectiveness & Execution Consistency
* Stay close to how standards and tooling are evolving across the CPM team, and make sure your team is aligned, trained, and applying them consistently
* Own adoption. When new processes or tools are introduced, drive uptake within your team - close gaps, address resistance, and follow through until it becomes standard practice
* Coach individuals toward stronger execution habits. Where gaps are recurring, treat them as a development opportunity before escalating
* Keep a pulse on execution quality across your team's programs and bring that ground-level visibility into broader team conversations about what is working and what needs attention

**Experience**
**Required**

* 7–13 years of total work experience, with a minimum of 5 years managing customer-facing programs or projects in a fast-paced hardware product development or contract manufacturing environment
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or Manufacturing Engineering required
* Minimum 2 years in a team lead, senior lead, or people management role with direct reports - owning performance reviews, development plans, and day-to-day team management
* Proven track record of running complex, multi-stakeholder customer programs end-to-end, with full accountability for scope, cost, timeline, and customer satisfaction
* Direct experience working with US-based or European-based customers from India on a US business hours schedule

**Preferred**

* Experience at a contract manufacturer, digital manufacturing platform, or hardware supply chain company
* Exposure to low-volume / prototype builds and high-mix, high-velocity manufacturing environments
* Familiarity with the hardware product development lifecycle: EVT, DVT, PVT, MP
* Experience with CRM/ERP tools (Salesforce, Odoo), project management tools (Jira, Asana), and data platforms like Sigma

**Core Skills & Competencies**

* People Leadership: Demonstrated ability to build, manage, and grow a team; sets clear expectations, holds accountability, invests in development, and creates a culture of performance and support
* Customer Success Mindset: Deep instinct for what makes customers stay, grow, and refer; coaches the team to be proactive, solutions-oriented, and relationship-driven
* Project & Program Management: Strong command of program fundamentals - scope, risk, timeline, change management - and the ability to set and enforce standards across a team
* Manufacturing Expertise: Enough technical depth to guide the team through complex manufacturing decisions, support difficult customer conversations, and build credibility with engineering and operations
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English; able to communicate at the right level for the audience - from a customer VP to a junior CPM to an internal engineering team
* Judgment & Escalation: Knows when to delegate, when to coach, and when to step in directly; trusted by the team and by leadership to make the right call
* Agility, Adaptability & Grit: Thrives in fast-paced, ambiguous environments; sets the tone for the team when things get hard
* Data-Driven: Use metrics to evaluate team performance, catch risks early, and drive continuous improvement
* Individual Coaching & Development: Goes beyond performance management: actively invests in helping each team member realize their potential faster; identifies what holds people back, creates the right conditions, and adjusts coaching style per individual
* Agility / Succeeding in the Fictiv Environment: Fictiv moves fast, changes direction often, and rewards people who figure things out without waiting to be told; the right candidate has thrived in environments like this, they do not need certainty to act, do not wait for a perfect process to exist, and are energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity and pace
* People Skills in a Non-Hierarchical Culture: Fictiv's culture is direct, candid, and non-hierarchical; traditional command-and-control or deferential work styles do not fit
* The Lead CPM must be comfortable giving and receiving direct feedback, speaking up in cross-functional settings, pushing back with data, and empowering their team to do the same, regardless of seniority or title in the room
* Urgency & Firefighting Under Pressure: Able to stay effective and keep the team grounded when multiple things are on fire simultaneously; knows how to triage, reprioritize quickly, and help the team navigate constant urgency without burning out or dropping the ball
* Converts chaos into clarity for the people around them

**Interested in learning more? We look forward to hearing from you soon.**
We’re actively seeking teammates who:
  
  

* Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
* Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
* Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
* Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
* Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

title: Delivery Head - Data Science
description:

Tredence is a global data science solutions provider focused on solving the last mile problem in AI. The ‘last mile’ is the gap between insight creation and value realization. Headquartered in San Jose, the company embraces a vertical-first approach and an outcome-driven mindset to help clients win and accelerate value realization from their analytics investments. **Job Summary**

We are seeking a seasoned Data Science Delivery Leader to lead the end-to-end delivery of large, complex Data Science, Advanced Analytics, AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI–driven programs across multiple business verticals. This role is part of Data Science Practice and works horizontally with vertical and functional teams to ensure consistent, high-quality delivery outcomes.

The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI systems, strong program and project management skills, and proven experience managing large delivery teams and enterprise-scale programs. This is a pure delivery leadership role with no P&L, capability building, or practice management responsibilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Delivery & Technical Oversight

• Own and drive end-to-end delivery of large-scale, multi-year Data Science, AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI programs, ensuring adherence to scope, timelines, quality, and cost.

• Provide strong technical oversight across solution design, ML/AI model development, GenAI solution architecture (LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning), agent workflows, validation, deployment, and productionization.

3. Team Leadership (Delivery-Focused)

• Lead and manage delivery teams of data scientists, ML engineers, GenAI engineers, data engineers, and analysts to ensure execution excellence.

• Set clear delivery goals, roles, and accountability for large, distributed program teams.

• Drive performance management, resource planning, and delivery productivity across traditional AI and GenAI/Agentic AI workloads.

4. Stakeholder Management

• Partner closely with business and vertical leaders to translate business requirements into scalable AI, GenAI, and agent-based delivery plans.

• Communicate program progress, risks, and outcomes clearly to senior leadership and client stakeholders, including AI-specific metrics and value realization.

• Drive continuous improvement in delivery processes to enhance efficiency, reliability, and reusability of AI and GenAI solutions.

• Support presales and transition activities through delivery planning, solution estimates, execution readiness, and risk assessments (as required).

• Strong hands-on technical foundation in Machine Learning, AI, Generative AI (LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning), and Agentic AI concepts, with the ability to guide teams in depth.

• Experience with tools and technologies such as Python, R, ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn) and exposure to LLM ecosystems.

Preferred Skills

• Exposure to LLM platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and AI pipelines.

• Exposure to big data ecosystems (Spark, Hadoop, Hive).

title: Marketing Project Manager
description:
**Overview**
**ENERPAC – Who we are?**
Enerpac Tool Group is a premier industrial tools and services company serving a broad and diverse set of customers in more than 25 countries. The Company’s businesses are global leaders in high pressure hydraulic tools, controlled force products and solutions for precise positioning of heavy loads that help customers safely and reliably tackle some of the most challenging jobs around the world. The Company was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Menomonee Falls, Wisconsin. Enerpac Tool Group trades on the NYSE under the symbol “EPAC”.
  
  
Our vision is to be our customer’s preferred partner through relentless innovation of industrial tools and services that help them safely and reliably tackle their toughest jobs around the world.
  
  
For further information on Enerpac Tool Group and its businesses, visit the Company's website at
**https://www.enerpactoolgroup.com/**
.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Marketing Project Manager coordinates the day-to-day workflow of the Global Marketing COE creative project team. The role is the communication bridge between the onshore global marketing team and COE resources: receiving briefed work, scheduling it across the team, tracking progress, and keeping both sides informed. The role ensures work moves smoothly, deadlines are visible, and output reaches onshore review on time. The role supports the Design Manager, who leads the creative team and owns prioritisation and quality; the Marketing Project Manager ensures the Design Manager’s plan runs smoothly and both sides stay informed.
  
  
**Coordination**
**Job Duties and Responsibilities**

* Receive briefed work from the onshore global marketing team and log it into the project management system.
* Schedule tasks across the creative team (design, motion/3D, web, analytics) in line with the Design Manager’s assignments and priorities.
* Track progress of all live projects, keeping timelines, statuses and workloads up to date as the single source of truth.
* Coordinate handoffs between team members where projects span multiple skills.

**Communication**

* Run the daily rhythm with the onshore team across time zones, so overnight progress is visible each UK morning.
* Keep onshore stakeholders informed on status, timelines and any changes, proactively and without being chased.
* Route completed work to onshore creative review and track revisions through to sign-off.
* Flag delays, blockers and resource clashes to the Design Manager and onshore team early.
* Support the Design Manager with capacity visibility, timeline tracking and status reporting for planning decisions.
* Represent the India team's capacity in onshore planning conversations, advising the Design Manager and global marketing team on what the schedule can absorb.
* Hold onshore stakeholders to agreed brief standards, review turnaround and approval dates.

**Reporting**

* Maintain simple, regular reporting on delivery: what shipped, what is in progress, and what is at risk.
* Keep project documentation, templates and shared files organised and current.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong coordination and organisational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable working daily with UK and US stakeholders across time zones.
* Proficiency with project management tooling (Trello or similar) and Microsoft Office.
* Ability to track many concurrent projects and keep information current, accurate and visible.
* Understanding of creative production workflows (design, video, web) preferred.
* Ability to work independently and exercise judgement on sequencing and trade offs, escalating with a recommendation rather than a question.

**Education And Experience**

* 4-5 years of experience in a project coordination, traffic or studio operations role.
* Experience in a creative agency, studio or shared-services environment preferred.
* Experience supporting distributed or onshore/offshore teams preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related field preferred but not required.

**Enerpac Tool Group Values**
Be an ambassador for the businesses and ensure that Enerpac Tool Group Values always come first:
  
  

* SAFETY - Safety is our highest priority and is at the heart of everything we do.
* INTEGRITY - We will act with honesty and transparency and always do the right thing.
* OWNERSHIP - We will own our commitments, act with a sense of urgency, and deliver what is expected of us on time, or ask for help early enough.
* TEAMWORK - We will act as one Enerpac team, operate with an enterprise-wide mindset, and support each other to deliver for our stakeholders.
* AGILITY - We will act with purpose and speed, and we will adapt quickly to changing Circumstances

**What We Offer**
Our employee benefits including flexible workplace policies, employee resource groups, learning and development resources, career progression pathways, and community engagement initiatives are some of the reasons why we have had great success in bringing in new talent. In addition, our global employee wellness programs are crafted to support the physical, emotional, and financial well-being of our employees.
  
  

* Benefits & Perks vary by Country. If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please reach out to us at: recruiter@enerpac.com

If you’re looking for a unique, exciting career with variety and potential for growth, Enerpac Tool Group offers challenges & extraordinary rewards for people on a global scale.
  
  
Never Compromise – choose ETG!

title: Marketing Excellence Manager
description:

Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Lead the deployment, adoption and scaling of high-impact Marketing Excellence programs across APMEA countries and divisions. Working across divisional marketing, country marketing, commercial teams and Centers of Excellence, scale priority programs such as KOL / Customer Advocacy, NPI launch excellence, lifecycle marketing and campaign excellence, ensuring successful approaches are standardized, adopted, measured and continuously improved.

* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate Marketing Excellence processes.
* Capture lessons learned from deployments and continuously improve frameworks, playbooks and adoption approaches.

* Ability to translate strategic frameworks into practical operating models, playbooks and scalable programs.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Program Project Manager - Vice President
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Take a lead role in acquiring, managing and retaining meaningful relationships that deliver outstanding experience to our customers. In this role, you will balance your focus on business results by offering options and finding solutions to help our customers with issues.

As a Vice President, Strategic Change Manager within Client Account Services, you will help shape and deliver the next generation of CAS.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Shape strategic change.** Take complex or ambiguous business problems and turn them into clear strategies, priorities and executable plans. Challenge existing processes and identify opportunities to simplify, digitise and reimagine how CAS operates.
* **Lead transformation end to end.** Own major initiatives from initial problem definition and business case through design, delivery, implementation, adoption and benefit realisation. Connect individual projects into the broader CAS strategy rather than managing them in isolation.
* **Reimagine client and operational journeys.** Help create simpler, faster and more transparent onboarding and servicing experiences, using strategic platforms, data, workflow, automation and AI where they can materially improve outcomes.
* **Turn strategy into executive decisions.** Distil complicated issues into clear choices, recommendations and actions. Produce high-quality written and visual materials that allow senior leaders to understand the issue quickly and make informed decisions.
* **Create alignment across organisational boundaries.** Work across Operations, Product, Technology, Data, Controls and business teams globally. Establish clear outcomes, ownership, dependencies and delivery expectations, and constructively challenge when these are at risk.
* **Drive execution with pace and accountability.** Identify blockers early, resolve issues wherever possible and escalate clearly when necessary. Maintain focus on the business outcome rather than allowing delivery to become an exercise in milestones and reporting.
* **Use data to drive decisions.** Define meaningful measures of success across client experience, controls, cycle time, automation, scalability and productivity, and use them to identify where intervention is required.
* **Embed change, not just deliver it.** Ensure new capabilities are adopted into the operating model with appropriate controls, ownership and measurable benefits. The wider CAS programme explicitly focuses on adoption, readiness and benefit capture as well as technology delivery.
* **Act as a trusted strategic partner.** Build credibility from working-level delivery teams through to executive management. Communicate candidly, adapt the level of detail to the audience and create confidence in both the direction and the execution.

**Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**

* **Strategic thinker and strong executor** — you move between big picture and detail to turn strategy into practical action.
* **Frames unfamiliar problems** — you develop a clear point of view and an actionable plan.
* **Genuine self-starter** — you operate effectively without a tightly defined brief or constant direction.
* **Proactively drives progress** — you identify gaps, convene the right people, and move work forward.
* **Exercises sound escalation judgement** — you know when to progress independently vs. when senior engagement is needed.
* **Executive impact** — you influence senior stakeholders without relying on hierarchy.
* **Constructively challenges and clarifies** — you question assumptions, align differing objectives, and make clear recommendations.
* **Exceptional communicator** — you explain complex topics simply and precisely in writing and verbally.
* **Bridges working-level to exec-level** — you run detailed sessions and translate outcomes into concise executive messaging.
* **Commercial and outcome focused** — you measure transformation by business outcomes (controls, client experience, cycle time, automation, scalable growth), not activity.
* **Strong problem solver with risk judgement** — you apply analytical rigor with imperfect information, identify risks/dependencies/control implications early, and balance speed with well-controlled delivery.

**Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**

* The strongest candidates will not describe themselves simply as project managers.
* They will be curious about how technology, data and AI can change the operating model, but equally focused on the people, process, controls and adoption required to turn new capabilities into real business value.

Morgan and Chase brands. title: Director, Facility Projects
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Job summary
  
JLL is seeking a Facilities Project Lead to support client by serving as the single point of accountability for vendor contract performance and the planning, procurement, and delivery of small facilities projects. This role ensures vendors deliver the full contracted scope at the agreed quality and cost, and that all projects follow one consistent process from request through closeout. In this role, you will help deliver the simplicity, speed, and consistency that define JLL’s integrated approach to real estate and facilities management. You will work across vendor management, project delivery, budgeting, sourcing, and team leadership while supporting JLL’s purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world and our values of Teamwork, Ethics, and Excellence.
  
  
Key responsibilitiesVendor contract management
  
Own the master register of vendor and subcontractor agreements, including scope, term, pricing, and the responsible account team member.
  
Own performance management of fixed-cost contracts and making the final determination on whether work performed meets the contracted scope, frequency, and quality standard, in consultation with technical leads and Sourcing Manager.
  
Participate in vendor performance reviews with Sourcing Manager and drive scope gaps, quality issues, and corrective actions to resolution.
  
Input into vendor contract renewals, rebids, and scope revisions, including benchmarking and recommendations on whether to renew, renegotiate, or replace.
  
Serve as the escalation point for commercial disputes, change orders, and extra-work requests.
  
Small project management
  
Maintain oversight of a single project log covering status, budget, schedule, and owner, and triage incoming project requests.
  
Develop scopes of work, issue bid packages, lead bid leveling, and recommend awards with clear cost and risk rationale.
  
Manage projects from award through closeout, including schedule, cost, change control, quality inspection, punch lists, and documentation.
  
Coordinate with clinical and operational stakeholders on access, shutdowns, and scheduling in a 24/7 Office environment, including infection control, life safety, and interim measures.
  
Ensure vendor compliance with site safety, permitting, and regulatory requirements.
  
Define and enforce a standard project process used by all project owners on the account.
  
Budgeting and financial management
  
Own the project and vendor contract budget, including forecasting, commitments, cost tracking, and monthly variance reporting.
  
Reconcile invoices against work performed and approved scope before payment approval.
  
Partners with finance and capital project management lead so contract and project spend aligns with operating and capital budgets and client reporting.
  
Flag cost risks and recommend corrective action early.
  
Sourcing and procurement partnership
  
Work with JLL sourcing on vendor selection, contract terms, pricing, and renewals.
  
Follow defined approval thresholds and delegation of authority for awards, change orders, and extra work.
  
Support vendor onboarding and compliance requirements.
  
Team leadership
  
Supervise, coach, and develop direct reports, setting priorities, delegating administrative work, and reviewing output for quality.
  
Build direct reports’ technical knowledge through scope-verification checklists, site walks, and progressively larger project ownership.
  
Conduct regular one-on-ones and support performance and development planning.
  
Cross-functional partnership
  
Partner with technical leads and the Account Director on vendor strategy, risk, and client communication.
  
Identify patterns such as repeat failures, vendor underperformance, and recurring project types, and recommend proactive solutions.
  
Report contract status, cost variances, and risks to the Account Director monthly in a form suitable for client leadership.
  
Recommend vendor modifications based on performance management outcomes.
  
Required qualificationsBachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, facilities management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  
8+ years in facilities management, construction, or project management, ideally in technology sector or critical environment.
  
2+ years of supervisory or team development experience.
  
Demonstrated experience writing scopes, managing bids, and administering fixed-price and time-and-materials contracts.
  
Experience managing project or contract budgets and reconciling vendor invoices.
  
Working knowledge of building systems, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and life safety, sufficient to evaluate scope and quality.
  
Strong negotiation, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
  
Proficiency with CMMS or work order systems and Excel.
  
Preferred qualificationsPMP or equivalent project management certification.
  
Experience in a 24/7 Office or other highly regulated operational environment.
  
Experience working within an integrated facilities management model that combines property, workplace, and project management services.
  
Measures of successDocumented scope-versus-delivery verification on all fixed-cost contracts.
  
Projects delivered through the standard process, with on-time, on-budget, and close-out-documentation rates tracked.
  
Reduced unmanaged extra work and unplanned change orders.
  
Budget variance reported monthly, with no unexplained variances.
  
Coordinator developing against documented milestones.
  
Client satisfaction with responsiveness and project communication
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

* Strong understanding of project accounting, cost control, budgeting, forecasting, revenue recognition, financial reporting, and project lifecycle management.

* Knowledge of cash flow management, working capital optimization, taxation, foreign exchange exposure, guarantees, and bonds.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to convert financial insights into actionable business recommendations.

* Proficiency in SAP, advanced MS Excel, and exposure to Power BI or other reporting and analytics tools is preferred.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills with experience working in global and matrix organizations.
Proficiency in spoken and written English.

At Hitachi Energy, we are committed to advancing a sustainable energy future for all. We value innovation, collaboration, integrity, and diversity, creating an environment where talented professionals can make a meaningful impact on the world's energy systems.

By joining our team, you will work alongside passionate experts on challenging and rewarding projects that support the transition toward a more sustainable, flexible, and secure energy landscape. * Develop and maintain project plans, timelines and trackers for assigned Global Legal Function initiatives, in consultation with project owners and stakeholders

* Support resource planning and allocation at the project-team level
* Coordinate onboarding of new business partners and vendors into relevant project or governance workflows

* Strong written and spoken English; additional languages an advantage given the global stakeholder base
* Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* Familiarity with corporate legal operations concepts (contract lifecycle, policy management, compliance workflows) preferred

title: DE - NCLC - M365 Migration And Modernization Manager - GDSN02
description:
