EY GDS Consulting Digital is looking for an experienced Microsoft 365 Consultant Manager with strong subject matter expertise in SharePoint, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations and Nintex modernization. The role will lead teams delivering large Microsoft 365 migration and modernization programs for clients across regions.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a client-focused technology leader who can shape and deliver Microsoft 365 transformation engagements. The role combines solution leadership, delivery management, stakeholder engagement and team development, with a preference for candidates who have led large-scale migration or modernization programs.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Microsoft 365 migration and modernization projects across SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, workflows and forms.
* Provide technical leadership for SharePoint Online, SPFx, Microsoft 365 migrations, Nintex and Power Platform.
* Define the delivery approach, estimates, migration waves, resourcing, governance and quality controls.
* Lead assessments, identify risks and dependencies, and develop practical migration roadmaps.
* Guide migration factory setup, pilots, wave execution, cutover and transition.
* Oversee Nintex workflow and form modernization using Nintex Automation Cloud or Power Platform.
* Review solution designs, migration plans, remediation approaches and deployment documents.
* Lead delivery teams, remove blockers, monitor progress and maintain quality.
* Manage client, security, Microsoft and vendor stakeholders, decisions and dependencies.
* Support proposals, demonstrations, estimates, staffing plans and executive presentations.
* Promote reusable methods, automation and continuous improvement.
* Ensure compliance with security, quality, organizational and commercial requirements.

**Skills And Attributes**

* 9-12 years of relevant technology consulting experience, including substantial experience in Microsoft 365, SharePoint migration or modernization.
* Strong SME-level knowledge of SharePoint Online, SharePoint Server, SPFx, Microsoft Graph, PnP PowerShell and Microsoft 365 architecture.
* Proven experience planning and delivering large Microsoft 365 migration programs involving SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams.
* Experience with migration assessment, remediation, migration factory operations, wave planning, velocity management, cutover and hypercare.
* Hands-on or solution oversight experience with migration tools such as ShareGate, Microsoft Migration Manager, SharePoint Migration Tool or equivalent tools.
* Knowledge of Nintex Workflow, Nintex Forms and Nintex Automation Cloud, with experience in workflow and forms modernization.
* Working knowledge of Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate, and the ability to guide target-platform decisions.
* Experience developing migration and modernization accelerators.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or AI automation.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 governance, permissions, Purview, security and compliance.
* Experience with tenant-to-tenant, acquisition, divestiture or hybrid migrations.
* Knowledge of Azure services, integrations, Azure DevOps and CI/CD.
* Relevant Microsoft, Nintex, project management or agile certifications.

**Soft Skills**

* Ability to lead, motivate and develop high-performing teams across locations.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to balance quality, timelines and cost.
* Sound decision-making and problem-solving in complex situations.
* Ability to manage scope, schedules, risks, quality and competing priorities.
* Collaborative leadership with clear accountability for outcomes.
* Ability to review technical deliverables, challenge assumptions and guide consultants and engineers.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
* A minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, preferably in a professional services or consulting organization.
* Strong Microsoft 365 and SharePoint migration or modernization expertise.
* Proven experience leading teams and delivering complex technology engagements.
* Experience developing estimates, delivery plans, governance and stakeholder communications.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
* Led large-scale Microsoft 365 migration or modernization projects from discovery through transition.
* Managed multidisciplinary teams covering migration, development, workflow modernization, testing and change activities.

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

title: Senior Consultant, Technical Transformation - Aprimo
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Title:**
Aprimo DAM & MRM Lead (Sr. Consultant)
  
  
**Experience Required:**
6–7 Years overall (minimum 4–5 years dedicated Aprimo
**DAM**
**and/or MRM**
experience)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Position Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Aprimo DAM & MRM Lead to own the strategic direction, architecture, and team leadership of our enterprise Aprimo Digital Asset Management
**and Marketing Resource Management**
platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Architecture & Governance**

* Own the long-term architectural roadmap for the Aprimo DAM and MRM platform - taxonomy evolution, metadata schema strategy, integration architecture, and AI capability adoption.
* Define and enforce enterprise-wide DAM and MRM governance standards: naming conventions, field design principles, classification ownership models, and change management processes.
* Review data models, taxonomies, and metadata structures within Aprimo MRM and DAM to ensure accurate reporting, data quality, and future extensibility.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders to translate complex marketing and compliance requirements into detailed Aprimo configuration blueprints and solution documents.
* Define governance guidelines for Aprimo configuration standards, naming conventions, and usage policies so that global teams follow consistent practices.

**🆕**
**MRM - Marketing Planning & Financial Management**

* Configure and manage Aprimo MRM's marketing planning and budgeting modules - including plan hierarchies, activity types, budget structures, and fiscal year setup aligned to enterprise marketing operating models.
* Design and maintain MRM financial workflows including budget request, approval, allocation, accrual, and reconciliation processes - ensuring finance and marketing teams operate from a single source of truth.
* Build and govern MRM project and activity templates that standardise how marketing programmes are initiated, tracked, and closed across global teams.
* Configure MRM work management capabilities - task management, project timelines, resource assignments, and capacity planning - to support marketing operations teams.
* Design MLR (Medical/Legal/Review) and compliance-driven approval workflows within Aprimo MRM for regulated industries, including routing rules, version locking, and audit trail requirements.
* Maintain and evolve MRM field design - custom fields, picklists, calculated fields, and conditional logic - ensuring that data captured at the plan and activity level supports downstream reporting needs.
* Define and enforce MRM data governance standards for plan naming conventions, cost centre mapping, vendor management, and invoice processing workflows.
* Configure and maintain MRM reporting and dashboard frameworks - including standard and custom reports across budget performance, activity status, resource utilisation, and campaign ROI.
* Manage MRM user role and permission architecture - defining role hierarchies, team structures, and access scoping aligned to organisational and regional team models.
* Support MRM integrations with finance and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday) for budget synchronisation, purchase order management, invoice reconciliation, and financial close processes.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor a team of DAM Specialists, Analysts, MRM Administrators, and Integration Developers - setting technical direction and reviewing their configuration and integration work.
* Lead development teams by providing detailed interface specifications, mapping documents, and solution use cases that reduce implementation rework.
* Conduct code and configuration reviews for API integrations, ensuring adherence to security, performance, and maintainability standards.

**DAM Configuration & Taxonomy**

* Configure Aprimo DAM capabilities to streamline asset intake, metadata modeling, and governance processes that improve asset discoverability and reuse.
* Design and maintain a scalable, organisation-wide taxonomy (classification hierarchy) aligned to how marketing teams browse and search for assets.

**Integration Architecture**

* Own the end-to-end integration architecture connecting Aprimo to the broader MarTech and enterprise systems landscape (CMS, PIM, CRM, marketing automation, CDN).
* Design and build API-based integrations using the Aprimo REST API - including asset ingestion pipelines, metadata synchronisation, and event-driven workflows.
* Design and build MRM API integrations - including marketing plan data synchronisation, activity status feeds, budget and spend data pipelines, and bi-directional connectors with finance and ERP platforms.
* Implement OAuth 2.0 authentication flows, manage API client registrations, and maintain secure credential handling for all service accounts.
* Develop and maintain webhook configurations for event-driven integrations with downstream systems (CMS, PIM, email platforms, CDN).
* Build and maintain bulk asset ingestion pipelines handling multi-step processes: record creation, chunked file upload, metadata mapping, commit, and error handling.
* Implement and maintain the Aprimo Content Selector SDK within third-party applications - ensuring scoped authorisation, rendition control, and audit logging.

**Migration**

* Lead asset migration projects from legacy DAM systems or shared drives into Aprimo - including source audit, de-duplication, metadata mapping, and validation.
* Lead MRM data migration projects from legacy marketing planning tools, spreadsheets, or prior MRM platforms into Aprimo - including plan and activity data mapping, historical budget data migration, open workflow migration, and user acceptance validation.

**Aprimo certification is a plus.**
**Experience**

* 6–7 years total professional experience, including a minimum of 4–5 years of dedicated, hands-on Aprimo DAM and/or MRM experience.
* Demonstrated experience as the senior/lead technical resource on at least one full Aprimo implementation or major platform transformation - not merely a contributor.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience configuring Aprimo MRM modules - including marketing planning, budget management, work management, and approval workflow design - at an enterprise scale.
* Proven ownership of enterprise taxonomy and metadata architecture decisions - able to speak to specific trade-offs made and their long-term consequences.
* Deep, verifiable hands-on expertise with the Aprimo REST API - must be able to design integration architecture from scratch, not just describe individual endpoint calls.
* Experience leading or mentoring a team of DAM analysts, specialists, MRM administrators, or developers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a regulated industry (pharmaceutical, financial services, healthcare) with MLR/compliance-driven workflow design - including MRM-side review routing and audit trail configuration.
* Experience owning a DAM or MRM platform migration at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with Aprimo Content Selector SDK, Agentic Orchestration (Copilot Studio, n8n, MCP Server), and emerging AI-driven DAM capabilities.
* Experience with enterprise identity/access architecture - SCIM provisioning, SSO integration, federated permission models.
* Experience integrating Aprimo MRM with ERP or finance platforms (SAP, Oracle, Workday) for budget and spend management.
* Familiarity with Aprimo MRM reporting frameworks and the ability to design custom dashboards for marketing operations and finance stakeholders. #Aprimo Referral Campaign

title: Production Engineer

title: AI Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description:**

AI Engineering Manager / Lead – Purple Fabric

**Company:**
Intellect Design Arena Ltd.

**Business Unit:**
Purple Fabric (Enterprise AI Platform)

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Experience:**
12–15 years (indicative; can be calibrated based on role seniority)

**Role Type:**
Full-time

**Mode of Work:**
Work From Office (WFO) – 5 days a week.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly experienced
**AI Engineering Manager / Lead**
to drive the architecture, development, and delivery of enterprise-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions for Purple Fabric, Intellect Design Arena’s enterprise AI platform.

The ideal candidate will combine deep hands-on technical expertise in AI engineering with strong engineering leadership, capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, secure, reliable, and production-ready AI solutions. The role will involve building AI-powered applications, agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and enterprise integrations while driving engineering excellence, innovation, and delivery outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Engineering & Solution Development**

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise-grade AI applications leveraging Generative AI, LLMs, and Agentic AI architectures.
* Architect and implement multi-agent systems, intelligent workflows, tool calling, and autonomous task execution with appropriate human oversight.
* Build scalable RAG pipelines integrating enterprise data sources, knowledge repositories, vector databases, and semantic search capabilities.
* Develop reusable AI components, frameworks, APIs, and services to accelerate product engineering and solution delivery.
* Drive end-to-end AI application development, from proof of concept and experimentation to production deployment and continuous improvement.

**2. AI Architecture & Technical Leadership**

* Define and implement scalable AI application architectures aligned with enterprise requirements for performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
* Evaluate and integrate LLMs, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, vector databases, and other AI technologies based on business and technical requirements.
* Design robust prompt engineering, context management, agent orchestration, memory, and model interaction strategies.
* Establish engineering standards and best practices for AI application development, testing, deployment, and monitoring.
* Drive architectural decisions related to model selection, latency, token consumption, inference costs, and scalability.

**3. Enterprise Integration & Platform Engineering**

* Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, knowledge systems, and existing technology ecosystems.
* Build secure, reusable microservices and APIs to support enterprise AI workflows.
* Collaborate with platform, cloud, DevOps, and security teams to establish reliable deployment and operational practices.
* Enable interoperability across AI models, tools, enterprise systems, and data sources.
* Contribute to reusable platform capabilities supporting Purple Fabric’s enterprise AI and decisioning use cases.

**4. AI Quality, Governance & Responsible AI**

* Establish evaluation frameworks to assess AI output quality, factual accuracy, groundedness, relevance, and reliability.
* Implement guardrails to address hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe outputs, data leakage, and unauthorised tool execution.
* Drive observability and monitoring for AI applications, including tracing, latency, token usage, cost, and failure analysis.
* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, privacy, access control, auditability, and responsible AI practices.
* Implement continuous evaluation and regression testing to maintain AI solution quality as models, prompts, and data evolve.

**5. Engineering Management & Delivery**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of AI engineers, software engineers, and other technical specialists.
* Own technical delivery, engineering quality, resource planning, prioritisation, and execution against agreed timelines.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving sessions.
* Establish engineering KPIs covering delivery predictability, code quality, production stability, performance, and productivity.
* Work closely with Product Management, Solution Architects, Presales, and business stakeholders to translate product requirements into engineering deliverables.
* Foster a culture of technical ownership, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* **AI / GenAI:**
  Strong hands-on experience in Generative AI, LLM-based application development, and production AI systems.
* **Agentic AI:**
  Experience designing agent-based applications, multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, and workflow automation.
* **RAG:**
  Strong understanding of document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval optimisation, reranking, and grounded response generation.
* **Programming:**
  Strong proficiency in Python and experience building production-grade applications, services, and APIs.
* **LLM Frameworks:**
  Practical experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent technologies.
* **Model Ecosystem:**
  Experience working with commercial or open-source LLMs, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or Llama-based models.
* **Data & Integration:**
  Experience with REST APIs, databases, data pipelines, enterprise integrations, and distributed systems.
* **Cloud & Deployment:**
  Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; containerisation and deployment using Docker and Kubernetes.
* **AI Evaluation & Security:**
  Experience with LLM evaluation, observability, prompt security, guardrails, and production monitoring.
* **Engineering Practices:**
  Strong knowledge of software architecture, CI/CD, automated testing, Git, code reviews, and production support.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building enterprise AI platforms, reusable AI frameworks, or AI products at scale.
* Exposure to financial services, banking, payments, lending, fraud detection, risk, or other regulated enterprise environments.
* Experience with model gateways, model routing, inference optimisation, caching, and cost management.
* Familiarity with enterprise knowledge management, identity and access management, data governance, and audit requirements.
* Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model lifecycle management, and AI application observability.
* Exposure to on-premises or private-cloud AI deployments and enterprise security constraints.
* Experience taking AI products from 0-to-1 development through production rollout and scaling.

**Leadership & Competencies**

* Strong technical ownership and the ability to make sound architecture and engineering decisions.
* Proven ability to lead engineering teams and deliver complex technology initiatives.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to balance experimentation and innovation with production reliability and delivery commitments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex AI concepts to engineering teams, product leaders, and business stakeholders.

**Success Measures**

* Successful delivery of scalable, production-ready enterprise AI capabilities.
* Improved reliability, quality, and performance of AI applications and agentic workflows.
* Reduced inference costs and latency through effective architecture and optimisation.
* Strong engineering quality, predictable delivery, and effective team development.
* Reusable AI components that accelerate product development and enterprise adoption.
* Compliance with enterprise security, governance, and responsible AI standards.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a hands-on AI engineering leader who has
**built and scaled production-grade GenAI or Agentic AI solutions**
, rather than someone whose experience is limited to traditional machine learning, data science, AI research, or integrating basic LLM APIs.

The candidate should demonstrate the ability to architect end-to-end AI systems, lead engineering teams, solve enterprise-scale technical challenges, and translate AI capabilities into secure, reliable, business-ready products.

title: CMS Manager
description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
  
  
We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
  
  
The CMS Manager oversees day-to-day content operations across assigned business areas, ensuring digital content is implemented accurately, efficiently, and in line with business priorities. The role manages operational delivery across cross-functional partners and translates requirements into clear plans that balance deadlines, available capacity, technical requirements, and quality standards. A key part of the role is providing clear ownership and direction for CMS operations, particularly those delivered through WordPress.
  
  
The role combines team leadership with strong working knowledge of content management systems, especially WordPress, alongside operational workflows, quality assurance, and continuous improvement. The CMS Manager is expected to identify risks early, support the resolution of complex implementation issues, develop team capability, and improve the processes and tools used to manage content at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Operational Planning & Delivery****

* Oversee delivery across assigned business areas, including CMS and WordPress activity, aligning execution with business priorities, deadlines, and quality expectations.
* Assess incoming demand against available capacity, prioritize work, and identify risks or dependencies that could affect delivery.
* Coordinate complex updates, launches, migrations, and recurring operational workflows within WordPress and other relevant systems, ensuring work progresses through the appropriate review and approval stages.
* Act as a key point of contact for partners across Editorial, SEO, Business Development, Revenue Operations, Compliance, Product, and Engineering, as relevant to assigned areas.

****CMS/Wordpress Expertise****

* Maintain strong practical knowledge of WordPress and related content management tools, templates, plugins, components, and workflows, providing guidance to the team where required.
* Oversee the effective use of WordPress across assigned business areas, ensuring agreed approaches, standards, and publishing practices are followed consistently.
* Support the team in troubleshooting complex CMS and WordPress implementation issues, identify root causes, and coordinate resolution with relevant technical partners.
* Identify recurring defects, manual tasks, and operational risks within CMS workflows, and recommend scalable improvements to tools, processes, and controls.

****Team Leadership & Development****

* Lead and support team members responsible for CMS operations, providing clear direction, coaching, feedback, and performance guidance.
* Develop team skills in CMS and WordPress usage, quality assurance, troubleshooting, operational judgement, and independent problem solving.
* Conduct regular check-ins and performance discussions, set clear expectations, and support individual development.

****Syndication Management****

* Own the CMS implementation and publishing workflow for syndicated content across external platforms.
* Ensure syndicated content meets platform specific formatting, building, and quality guidelines.
* Coordinate with the Operations team to maintain content continuity and manage daily and weekly content calendars.
* Monitor syndication quality and resolve publishing issues to ensure accurate and timely delivery.

****Quality Assurance & Standards****

* Ensure content and page implementations in WordPress and other relevant systems meet agreed standards for accuracy, structure, configuration, SEO requirements, monetisation elements, and applicable editorial and compliance guidelines.
* Maintain effective quality checks, analyze error patterns, and implement corrective actions to reduce defects and rework.

****Reporting & Continuous Improvement****

* Maintain operational reporting for assigned areas, including throughput, turnaround times, revisions, quality, and capacity.
* Use operational data and stakeholder feedback to identify bottlenecks, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve delivery.
* Share concise updates on progress, risks, and improvement opportunities with relevant leaders.

**Skills & Experience**

* 8 – 10 years of full-time experience
* 2-3 years of experience in leading and managing a team
* Experience managing a team, including workload planning, coaching, performance feedback, and accountability for delivery and quality.
* Experience managing CMS operations, digital content implementation, content production, or digital operations in a high-volume environment, with responsibility for delivery through WordPress or a comparable platform.
* Strong practical knowledge of WordPress, including page components, templates, plugins, workflows, and configuration. Experience with AEM or another comparable content management system is beneficial.
* Ability to plan multiple workstreams, manage dependencies, and adjust priorities as business needs change.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to clarify requirements and constructively address infeasible requests.
* Demonstrated ability to lead the resolution of operational, WordPress, or wider CMS issues and identify practical, repeatable solutions.
* High attention to detail, sound organizational skills, and the ability to balance quality, timeliness, and changing priorities.

**Perks**

* Day off on the 3rd Friday of every month (one long weekend each month)
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement Program to promote health well-being
* Monthly Office Commutation Reimbursement Program
* Paid paternity and maternity leaves

title: Project Planning & Controls Specialist
description:
**In This Role, You Will**

* Instructions and guidelines:

Ensures projects follow sound methodology and execution practices in accordance with internal standard procedures. Ensures that an integrated schedule for the project’s entire scope of work is provided.
  
  

* Planning and scheduling:

Analyses project requirements with project team, checks that all essential work activities have been identified in sufficient detail to serve as a basis for developing realistic project schedules.
  
  
Defines, jointly with the project team, project work aligned to the cost breakdown structure, develops, and maintains properly linked, required role loaded/integrated, baseline and current schedules that provide time phased baseline, actual and forecast data for project.
  
  
Monitors project progress and regularly analyzes project critical paths to ensure all critical path activities and project milestones are progressed to the plan, notifies Project Managers of any deviations or scheduling issues, and provides input for optimizing resources. When required prepares EOT Schedules and Schedule Analysis to support Project Team.
  
  
Works together with Line Management Organization to resolve Resource Demand / Supply Conflicts. Issues progress reports, schedule updates and productivity data on a regular
  
  
basis and as requested by customers and stakeholders.
  
  

* Cost, revenue, and cash flow management:

Supports the establishment of a baseline plan for cost and cash flow performance measurement. Works with project team to define the necessary resources for project completion, evaluating the work breakdown structure and standard productivity.
  
  

* Change management:

Works closely with engineering, construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, client and contractors to identify potential changes in scope and quantifies the impact of each change in a timely fashion.
  
  

* Risk management:

Works with project team to identify and assess the priority of project risks (e.g. schedule, cost and scope risks), and proposes mitigation plans. Analyzes impact of risk on the overall timeline and resources.
  
  

* Procurement:

Integrates material resource requirements with project schedule and defines procurement activities and order lead times. Regularly communicates with SCM team and updates schedules to ensure procurement activities take place in a timely way and lead times are optimized to meet schedule targets.
  
  

* Project reviews:

Participates in project reviews. Composes reports and updates all required project data in Project Controls and reporting systems for Management Information and Project Analysis. Communicates project progress and control issues to project management team and offers solutions.
  
  

* Stakeholder relations:

Effectively communicates appropriate information to the Project Manager and other stakeholders in a timely manner and to achieve desired understanding.

Where required: Support Sales & Operations Planning Process. Work together with Sales team to define Planning Scenarios, and drive workload data collection process from organization. Chair monthly S&OP Review Meeting.

**Required**

* Maintain continuity of daily embossing and card-processing activities.
* Prevent stock shortages that could disrupt card issuance or replacement processes.
* Ensure vendor controls and governance obligations are completed.
* Protect financial accuracy through effective cost and payout tracking.
* Support timely implementation of card-product changes.

title: SAP C-ALM
description:
**Position Executive Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Lead SAP Cloud ALM & Enterprise Toolchain Architect**
to define, govern, and operationalize the complete Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) strategy for our global Greenfield SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
  
  
Acting as the single point of accountability for SAP Cloud ALM adoption across all global regions and workstreams, the ideal candidate will establish cross-functional governance, build end-to-end lifecycle traceability, integrate enterprise toolchains, and drive quality engineering across all phases of the SAP Activate framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Core Governance**
  
  

* Cloud ALM Strategy & Governance
* Strategy Definition: Formulate and execute a comprehensive Cloud ALM strategy aligned with SAP Activate methodology across all global rollout templates.
* Governance Framework: Establish and enforce ALM governance standards across requirements gathering, business process hierarchy modeling, testing execution, defect management, deployment controls, and operations.
* Single Accountability: Serve as the central point of contact and accountability for Cloud ALM adoption across global regions, system integrators, and project workstreams.
* Enterprise Toolchain Integration & Traceability
* Toolchain Management: Architect and manage data flows across the integrated ALM toolchain, connecting SAP Cloud ALM with enterprise architecture, modeling, testing, and operational tools.
* End-to-End Lineage: Maintain complete vertical and horizontal traceability across the lifecycle: Business Scope → Process Design → Requirements/User Stories → Development Units → Test Cases → Defects → Transports/Deployments.
* Integration Engineering: Design and implement robust integration and real-time data synchronization between SAP Cloud ALM and enterprise solutions, including:

+ Process Modeling: Signavio
+ Architecture & Capability Mapping: LeanIX
+ Work Management & ITSM: Jira / ServiceNow
+ Test Management: Tricentis, HP ALM, or equivalent
+ Documentation Systems: Confluence, SharePoint

* Solution Enablement & Fit-to-Standard Execution
* Cloud ALM Configuration: Setup and configure SAP Cloud ALM for:

+ Business process hierarchy structure and solution documentation
+ Requirement, scope, and user story management
+ Test planning, script execution, and defect tracking
+ Task management and deployment tracking

* Fit-to-Standard Governance: Enable and support Fit-to-Standard workshops using standard SAP Best Practices content and Cloud ALM pre-delivered scope elements.
* Program Visibility: Design and maintain project scope baselines, milestone tracking, and real-time status dashboards for executive program leadership.
* Test Quality Management
* Test Strategy Formulation: Design and govern the program-wide testing framework (Unit Testing, System Integration Testing [SIT], User Acceptance Testing [UAT], and Regression Testing) inside SAP Cloud ALM.
* Multi-Regional Execution: Coordinate test execution across multi-regional teams, third-party system integrators, and varying time zones.
* Quality KPIs: Provide executive-level reporting on test coverage, defect burn-down rates, quality KPIs, and release readiness dashboards.
* Release, Deployment & Cutover Management
* Release Orchestration: Oversee release planning, deployment tracking, and release governance using Cloud ALM.
* CI/CD & Transport Integration: Connect Cloud ALM with SAP Transport Management and modern CI/CD delivery pipelines where applicable.
* Cutover Execution: Support cutover sequence planning, dependency mapping, and real-time deployment monitoring.
* Integration & Operations Readiness (Run / Hypercare Phase)
* Monitoring Setup: Configure operational monitoring within Cloud ALM, including:

+ Integration & Exception Monitoring
+ Business Process Monitoring
+ Automated Job Monitoring

* Operational Transition: Lead the transition of ALM artifacts from the project phase to Hypercare and steady-state operations (Run phase).
* Alerting & KPIs: Establish operational KPIs, threshold alerts, and health monitoring for steady-state governance.
* Stakeholder Leadership & Vendor Coaching
* Subject Matter Expert (SME): Act as the lead SME for the Program Management Office (PMO), System Integrator partners, SAP, and regional business leaders.
* Enablement & Upskilling: Coach and upskill project team members, functional leads, and regional business units on Cloud ALM best practices and standardized tool usage.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
SAP ALM & Program Expertise
  
  

* 7–10+ years of hands-on SAP implementation experience within large-scale enterprise environments.
* 3+ years direct experience configuring and leading SAP Cloud ALM (or SAP Solution Manager with a proven track record of Cloud ALM transition).
* Strong, practical knowledge of SAP Activate methodology across all project phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
* Proven experience in Greenfield SAP S/4HANA global implementations.

Functional & Technical Knowledge
  
  

* Solid comprehension of core SAP S/4HANA business processes (e.g., Finance, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Logistics).
* Hands-on familiarity with SAP Best Practices content and enterprise process models.
* Working knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g., Tricentis, CBTA).
* Familiarity with SAP integration technologies (SAP BTP, Cloud Integration / CPI) and SAP transport management concepts.

Leadership & Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven track record in stakeholder management within complex, multi-vendor, global environments.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across global teams, time zones, and diverse organizational cultures.
* Highly organized, structured, quality-focused, and proactive mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications (nice To Have)**

* Official SAP Cloud ALM Certification.
* Prior experience in large-scale rollouts (multi-country, multi-template architectures).
* Exposure to modern DevOps principles and CI/CD pipelines within SAP enterprise landscapes.
* Prior experience in roles such as Enterprise ALM Lead, QA Lead, or Test Manager.

title: Platform & Solution Engineering Lead
description:
**Role Summary**
The Platform and Solution Engineering Lead owns the technical foundation on which the entire Digital Quality (DQ) portfolio is built, delivered and operated. Digital Quality delivers the solutions that transform Quality, Safety and Environmental Operations (QSEO) across Pfizer, and this role is accountable for the platforms, engineering capability and delivery pipelines that allow that portfolio to move at pace while remaining compliant, secure and supportable.
  
  
The incumbent leads a global engineering organisation covering platform engineering, solution architecture and design, integration and data engineering, DevSecOps, environment and release management, and vendor delivery oversight. Accountability spans the full technology mix — Software as a Service (SaaS), commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed solutions — ensuring each is engineered, integrated, validated and operated to a consistent standard rather than as isolated stacks.
  
  
The role is the engineering counterpart to the DQ Solution Leads, who own product strategy and business outcomes, and to the Scaled AI and Solution Architect, who sets cross-portfolio architecture direction and standards; this role is accountable for making those standards real in code, configuration, pipelines and operations. It is also the principal point of alignment between Digital Quality and the wider enterprise technology landscape, including Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organisation, and central platform and infrastructure teams. The role is global in scope, spanning the PGS network, R&D, commercial markets and corporate locations.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
Platform Engineering and Technical Foundation
  
  

* Own the strategy, engineering and lifecycle of the shared technical foundation for Digital Quality, including cloud footprint, runtime platforms, shared services, reusable components, developer tooling and non-production environments.
* Build the foundation as a product used by delivery teams across the portfolio, with defined service levels, roadmaps, adoption measures and a managed path for retiring legacy and duplicated technology.

**Solution Engineering Across SaaS, COTS and Custom Build**

* Provide engineering leadership and design accountability across the full technology mix, establishing how SaaS platforms are configured and extended, how COTS products are deployed and integrated, and how in-house applications are designed, built and maintained.
* Ensure engineering rigour, supportability and consistent quality regardless of delivery model, and prevent unmanaged customisation that undermines upgradability and cost of ownership.

**Integration and Data Engineering**

* Own the integration and data engineering layer connecting Digital Quality solutions to each other and to the wider Pfizer landscape, including manufacturing, laboratory, enterprise resource planning and enterprise data platforms.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, interfaces and data contracts, and ensure integrations are resilient, monitored, documented and compliant with data integrity requirements.

**DevSecOps, Release and Environment Management**

* Define and run the engineering operating model for Digital Quality, covering source control, continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, security scanning, infrastructure as code, and environment and release management.
* Drive automation of validation and compliance evidence so that release frequency, deployment reliability and lead time improve without weakening GxP control.
* Own the release calendar and change governance across the portfolio, including coordination of platform vendor release cycles.

**Vendor and Managed Service Delivery**

* Hold strategic technology vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners to account for engineering quality, delivery commitments, security posture and service performance.
* Shape sourcing strategy and the internal-versus-partner capability mix, define technical standards and acceptance criteria in statements of work, and manage capacity and demand across internal and external engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Alignment**

* Act as the principal interface between Digital Quality and enterprise technology functions, ensuring DQ solutions adopt enterprise platforms, standards and services rather than building parallel capability.
* Influence enterprise roadmaps, standards and investment decisions on behalf of the QSEO domain, and represent Digital Quality in enterprise architecture, cyber security and technology governance forums.

**Organisational Leadership**

* Lead, develop and grow a global engineering team of approximately 8–10 direct reports, spanning platform engineers, solution architects, integration and data engineers, DevSecOps and release specialists, alongside matrixed and contract resources.
* Build engineering capability, talent pipelines and succession plans; set technical performance expectations and career pathways; and foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement across Digital Quality.

**Compliance, Risk and Governance**

* Ensure the technical foundation and all solutions built on it are maintained in a validated and compliant state in accordance with GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) guidelines, computerised system validation expectations, data integrity, data privacy and cyber security requirements.
* Maintain audit and inspection readiness for engineering processes and evidence, support internal audits and regulatory inspections, and balance pace of innovation with regulatory compliance through effective governance and risk management.

**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree required in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in software or platform engineering, technical delivery leadership or engineering management (9+ years with an MS/MBA; 7+ years with a PhD), including accountability for engineering across a portfolio rather than a single application.
* Demonstrated experience leading, hiring and developing engineering teams at scale, including matrix leadership of vendor and contract resources across multiple geographies.
* Deep hands-on grounding in cloud platform engineering, integration architecture and modern software engineering practice, with practical experience of CI/CD, infrastructure as code, automated testing and security-in-the-pipeline.
* Experience delivering and operating across SaaS, COTS and custom-developed solutions, including vendor platform configuration, extension and upgrade management.
* Strong experience with Agile ways of working; SAFe preferred.
* Knowledge of financial management and procurement activities, with the ability to manage complex budgets, vendor contracts and internal-versus-partner capacity decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated manufacturing environment, including GxP computerised system validation, data integrity and inspection readiness
* Experience automating validation and compliance evidence within CI/CD pipelines in a regulated context.
* Working knowledge of quality, or EHS platforms and their integration landscape (for example Veeva, LIMS, Cority, Enablon).
* Experience engineering or operating AI and data capability in production, in partnership with architecture and data functions.
* Demonstrated success leading technology rationalisation, platform consolidation or large-scale migration programmes.
* Recognised cloud or architecture certification.

**Physical/Mental Requirements**
Typical desk job; no specific physical or mental requirements beyond standard office work.
  
  
**Non-standard Work Schedule, Travel Or Environment Requirements**
Occasional travel up to 20%
  
  
Ability to meet with colleagues virtually across different regions and time zones, including occasional out-of-hours working to support deployment go-lives and hypercare.
  
  
**ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**
Reports into Pfizer Digital, PGS, Enabling Functions & Enterprise Platforms - Quality Solutions Lead.
  
  
Key business stakeholders include Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, the enterprise AI and Data organization, central cloud, infrastructure and platform teams, Digital Compliance and Computerized System Validation.
  
  
External: strategic software and cloud vendors, systems integrators and managed service partners.
  
  
**RESOURCES MANAGED
  
  
Financial Accountability**
Annual accountability of approximately $10M across platform, cloud consumption, engineering services and managed service investment, including business case development and investment recommendations for the Digital Quality technical foundation
  
  
**Supervision**
Direct leadership of approximately 8 colleagues, including platform engineers, solution architects,integration and data engineers, and DevSecOps and release specialists. Accountability for external partner and managed service relationships, including contract and systems integrator resources working across the Digital Quality portfolio under the colleague's leadership.
  
  
Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

**Process Overview**
As part of Global Ops Change Group, the incumbent will be an integral part of a multi-disciplinary team whose mandate will be to deliver industry leading Front-to-Back process and technology solutions. Acting as a change agent, he/she will manage a variety of value-driven initiatives at every phase of the project life cycle. Use his/her knowledge of processes and best practices within technology (application integration / application development), Finance/Middle-Office Operations and project management to assist in identification, assessment, and resolution of complex issues/problems.
  
  
**Job Description**
Assist in executing the enterprise-wide direction for GBAM Ops functions. As a member in the group, he/she will support front-to-back integration and change initiatives and be accountable for driving change and executing successful implementations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a member of DROM Transformation and Change Management team within Global Operations responsibilities will include the following:
  
  
Candidate will have to liaise with relevant stakeholders (Business, Legal, Compliance, Operations & Technology etc.) to analyze and decipher key Business requirements and assist in driving the End-to-End Project plan
  
  
Help with defining project scope and perform change assessment
  
  
Will be expected to prepare BRD, Business scenarios, Traceability matrix, Run books and other key project artefacts at various stages of the project life cycle
  
  
He/she should be able to manage or assure any risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies that can impact the Go-live
  
  
Candidate will have the opportunity to plan & manage end to end project/ UAT on behalf of Operations for medium to large sized projects
  
  
Will be expected to create UAT plan, define test approach, co-ordinate environment readiness discussions with technology teams, drive defect management and UAT governance routines

SAP SuccessFactors, Talent Management, HR Technology, HR Systems Delivery, Enterprise HR Landscape, Stakeholder Management, HR Process Transformation, Solution Design, IT&D, and Product/Project Delivery,
  
  
large-scale SuccessFactors landscapes, global HR transformation programs, and strong stakeholder-facing HR

title: Project Manager
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Project Manager**
**Roche India - Roche Services & Solutions**
**Hyderabad**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche
  
  
**Mission**
**Roche Services & Solutions (RSS)**
aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai & Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.
  
  
As
**Project Manager**
you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Engagement Delivery**
In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology.
  
  
Your work will include but will not be limited to:
  
  

* understanding the business goal(s) and value of the project and striving to deliver the defined benefits to the organization
* leading or being part of global project teams ensuring clear roles and responsibilities and resource assignment to the project plan deliverables
* ensuring that the critical success factors of reliability, compliance, efficiency, sustainability, time to value are managed throughout the entire lifecycle of the projects
* effectively managing stakeholders through the establishment of key relationships and developing an understanding of their organizations
* generating, maintaining and tracking an accurate and realistic project plan, project risk and issue log and ensuring the project status is timely and transparent
* preparing and presenting to relevant governance meetings as required by the project methodology and good project management practice
* tracking project financials and seek governance approval when needed
* applying organizational change management practices as needed and ensuring effective project communication
* contributing to business development opportunities where appropriate

**Capability Building**

* Be an active member of the Project Management Chapter by:
* Continuously improving the project management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics
* Supporting the development of training content and toolkits for our team
* Actively managing your project management upskilling
* Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues

**Who You Are**
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes:
  
  

* Appropriate university degree and 5+ years of project management related work experience
* Strong knowledge in project management fundamentals (waterfall, SCRUM and others) and related tools
* Experience in leading global/complex projects, organizing and optimizing resources and establishing clear priorities
* Ability to motivate and lead a project team or team members if required
* Excellent communication skills, with demonstrated proficiency in influencing, negotiating, and effective global collaboration.
* Ability to effectively communicate across various levels of a complex, matrix organization. Ideally exposure to an additional field related to project management, such as project change management, business consulting, methodology coaching
* Experience in project management financials and resource management

In addition, the following skills will make you successful in your position and create the foundation for career growth at Roche:
  
  

* Customer centricity
* Collaborative ways of working
* Presentation and influencing skills
* Business acumen & systems thinking

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

* Drive operational excellence and process standardisation across payroll hubs and regions.

* Strong understanding of payroll operations, governance, controls, compliance, vendor management, and payroll service delivery.
* Proven experience leading or supporting payroll transformation, process improvement, or large-scale change programmes.

* Strong project and programme management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders simultaneously.

Global Payroll, Payroll Transformation, Payroll Vendor Maangement , Payroll Process Improvement; Process management, Process Improvement, Process excellence,Execute plans, Strategic mindset, Digital literacy, HR Data Analysis; Data management; Employee data management, Operational Excellence, Commercial accumen, Solutioning.

description:
**Summary**
The Director, Project Management (ARD India) is responsible for leading end-to-end technical project and portfolio management across ARD India, ensuring seamless execution of analytical development programs aligned with global ARD priorities.
  
  
This role drives technical excellence in project governance, planning, resource optimization, and cross-functional coordination across global and site stakeholders, enabling timely, compliant, and cost-effective delivery of development milestones.
  
  
The position acts as a strategic bridge between global ARD project management, scientific teams, and site operations, strengthening execution discipline, transparency, and decision-making across the portfolio.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Key Accountabilities**

* Portfolio & Project Management Leadership
* Lead the ARD India portfolio of Analytical Project Leads (APLs) analytical development projects across early and late phase programs spanning across the modalities, viz., oral, xRNA, radio-ligand therapy, parenterals.
* Ensure robust project planning, tracking, and delivery in alignment with global timelines and regulatory requirements
* Drive proactive risk identification, mitigation strategies, and escalation mechanisms
* Implement standardized project management methodologies, tools, and best practices
* Governance & Decision Framework
* Establish and lead project governance structures (reviews, portfolio boards, dashboards)
* Provide data-driven insights to support strategic decision-making and prioritization
* Ensure transparency of project status, risks, milestones, and resource utilization
* Align governance processes with global ARD project management standards
* Cross-functional Integration & Stakeholder Management
* Act as key interface between ARD scientific teams, TRD, global project leaders, and cross-functional partners
* Ensure alignment of analytical development activities with overall program and CMC strategies
* Facilitate effective communication across geographies (India, Switzerland, China)
* Strengthen collaboration with functions such as Regulatory, Quality, Supply, and External Partners
* Resource & Capacity Management
* Lead demand and capacity planning across ARD project portfolio
* Optimize resource allocation to ensure efficient utilization and delivery against priorities
* Partner with functional heads to balance portfolio demands and capability development
* Drive workforce planning aligned with future pipeline needs
* Operational Excellence & Digital Enablement
* Drive continuous improvement in project execution through lean principles and digital tools
* Implement data analytics and dashboarding to enhance performance visibility
* Standardize reporting, KPIs, and performance tracking across projects
* Promote automation and digitalization in project management processes
* People & Capability Leadership
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Analytical Project Leads
* Build strong project management capabilities within ARD India
* Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and innovation
* Support talent development, succession planning, and capability building

**Minimum Requirements**

* PhD / Master’s in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or Chemistry
* 15–18+ years in Analytical R&D / Pharmaceutical Development
* Proven experience in project / portfolio management within drug development
* Strong understanding of end-to-end development lifecycle (early to commercialization)
* Experience in global, matrixed organizations with cross-functional leadership

**Why Novartis:**
Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture
  
  
**Benefits and Rewards:**
Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally.
  
  
Read our handbook (PDF 30 MB)

title: Lead Business Execution Consultant[ISO 20022, Business Requirements, JIRA, Payments
description:
**About This Role**
Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Business Execution Consultant to help drive strategic business initiatives, strengthen operational effectiveness, and support the execution of key priorities. In this role, you will partner with business leaders and cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, solve complex business challenges, improve processes, and deliver solutions aligned with organizational goals.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead complex Payments Product initiatives, support functions, and operations across multiple business groups, contributing to large-scale strategic priorities
* Drive operational efficiency, quality, cost effectiveness, and pipeline management across assigned Payments operations
* Research and evaluate complex business, operational, and strategic initiatives using advanced analytical skills, knowledge of organizational strategy, and an understanding of international business and payments operations
* Exercise independent judgment to develop recommendations, resolve complex business challenges, and improve the effectiveness of Payments support functions
* Lead the planning and execution of programs and initiatives focused on risk mitigation, operational efficiency, controls, and customer experience
* Collaborate with business leaders and cross-functional partners to develop and implement project plans, policies, procedures, and performance measures
* Provide leadership in managing stakeholder relationships and implementing complex programs, services, and strategic initiatives
* Influence business decisions by communicating risks, recommendations, and expected outcomes to key stakeholders and senior leaders
* Provide guidance and subject-matter expertise to less experienced team members while promoting consistent execution and knowledge sharing

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* Experience gathering, analyzing, and prioritizing business requirements and translating them into user stories, acceptance criteria, product roadmaps, and prioritized backlogs
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum product delivery, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, testing, release planning, and end-to-end product delivery
* Working knowledge of product development and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Aha!, Balsamiq, or similar product management and wireframing tools
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering across Product, Technology, Testing, Operations, and business teams to deliver complex initiatives and enhance the end-user experience
* 5+ years of Payments processing experience, including SWIFT MT/MX, Fedwire, CHIPS, ACH, RTP, GPPSP, and working knowledge of MX messages (Pacs, Pain, Camt, Admi) and MT N1/N2/N9 series, with a strong understanding of end-to-end payment flows.
* 4+ years of Business Analysis experience and significant experience working in Agile environments, including requirements analysis, backlog management, change delivery, and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technology and/or operations initiatives, driving operational efficiency, business reporting, end-to-end change management, and effective risk and control management throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to guide junior and senior Business Analysts, drive product roadmaps, resolve issues quickly, and reprioritize work based on business, stakeholder, and customer feedback.

Desired Qualifications::
  
  

* SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) certification, SAFe 5 certification, or equivalent Product Owner/Product Management certification
* Relevant leadership, Agile, Scrum, or change management certification
* Experience supporting payments transformation, modernization, or large-scale product implementation initiatives within banking or financial services
* Knowledge of payment operations, risk and controls, and technology-driven process improvement

**Job Expectations**

* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Payments environment, managing multiple priorities and time-sensitive deliverables.
* Ability to collaborate across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, and Agile teams and adapt to changing business requirements.
* Shift timings: Willingness to work in shifts aligned with business and stakeholder requirements, including flexibility to support U.S. business hours, as needed

**Posting End Date**
2 Nov 2026
  
  

* Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

**We Value Equal Opportunity**
Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.
  
  
Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.
  
  
Candidates applying to job openings posted in Canada: Applications for employment are encouraged from all qualified candidates, including women, persons with disabilities, aboriginal peoples and visible minorities. Accommodation for applicants with disabilities is available upon request in connection with the recruitment process.
  
  
**Applicants With Disabilities**
To request a medical accommodation during the application or interview process, visit Disability Inclusion at Wells Fargo.
  
  
**Drug and Alcohol Policy**
Wells Fargo maintains a drug free workplace. Please see our Drug and Alcohol Policy to learn more.
  
  
**Wells Fargo Recruitment And Hiring Requirements**

* Third-Party recordings are prohibited unless authorized by Wells Fargo.
