title: Engineering Manager
description:
**About The Job**
We are looking for an experienced and driven
**Engineering Manager**
to lead our high-performance software development teams. In this role, you are expected to solve client’s business problem by delivering software solution or services.
  
  
As an Engineering Manager, you will not only oversee the technical roadmap but also mentor leads, senior developers, manage client stakeholders, and drive operational excellence. If you have a background in hands-on development and a passion for building scalable teams in a service-oriented environment, we want to hear from you
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Delivery & Project Management
* End-to-End Delivery: Own the delivery of software projects from conception to deployment, ensuring adherence to timelines, scope, and quality standards (SLA/KPIs).
* Agile Leadership: Champion Agile/Scrum methodologies; facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives to ensure team velocity and efficiency.
* Architecture & Quality: Collaborate with Architects to make high-level design choices and technical standards. Oversee code reviews, CI/CD pipeline implementation, and technical debt management.
* Risk Management: Proactively identify technical risks and project bottlenecks, creating mitigation plans to avoid client escalations
* Client & Stakeholder Management
* Client Partnership: Act as the primary technical point of contact for global clients (US). Translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Reporting: Provide crisp status reports, metrics (velocity, defect density, etc.), and financial health updates (billing/utilization) to senior management and clients.
* Growth: Identify opportunities for account mining and technical value additions to expand the scope of work
* People & Team Management
* Talent Development: Manage a team of 10–20 engineers (Developers, QAs, Leads). Conduct performance appraisals, 1:1s, and career pathing.
* Hiring & Retention: Assist in recruitment efforts for the team and implement strategies to retain top talent.
* Mentorship: Foster a culture of continuous learning, guiding the team on new technologies and best practices

**Requirements**
**Requirements**
**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience:

+ 10 to 15 years years of professional experience, with at least 3 years in a dedicated technical project lead / management role for an IT services company.
+ Proven track record of managing and delivering projects for US/North American clients.
+ Experience managing projects that involve AI/ML, Data Engineering, Cloud-native applications, Workflow automation, or Digital Transformation.

* Technical Skills:

+ Any programming and database skills is must. Preferably hands-on
+ Familiarity with modern software development life cycles (SDLC) and DevOps practices.
+ In-depth knowledge of Agile/Scrum and Waterfall methodologies.
+ PMP, PRINCE2, or Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) certification is must.

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice To Have)**

* Experience in a scaling, AI-first or product engineering focused company.
* Advanced certifications (e.g., SAFe Agilist, AWS/Azure/GCP Project Management or Technical certification).
* Experience with advanced tools for project management, collaboration, and reporting (e.g., Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project).

**Benefits**
Why Join Us?
  
  

* Be at the forefront of AI-driven digital engineering and work with cutting-edge technologies.
* Collaborate directly with ambitious, high-growth US tech companies.
* Receive competitive compensation and benefits, with significant opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Be part of a dynamic, high-performance, and technically-focused culture

title: Senior Implementation Specialist
description:
Location - Remote

Reports to - Senior Manager, Implementations, Brightedge

BrightEdge is seeking an experienced
**Site Agent Implementation Specialist (Senior)**
to lead the implementation, optimization, and long-term success of Site Agent, one of BrightEdge's most strategic automation products. This role combines deep technical implementation expertise with customer relationship management and program ownership to deliver exceptional customer outcomes across Enterprise and Mid-Market accounts.

As the primary technical owner for a portfolio of Site Agent customers, you will manage implementations from technical discovery through go-live and ongoing performance optimization. You'll serve as a trusted advisor to customers while partnering closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services to maximize adoption, retention, and business value.

In addition to managing your own portfolio, you will help scale Site Agent across BrightEdge's customer base by leading new deployments, supporting strategic renewals, mentoring teammates, and contributing to product innovation.

**Mandatory Requirement:**
This role requires regular customer-facing coverage during
**U.S. Eastern Standard Time (EST) and Pacific Standard Time (PST) business hours**
. Candidates must be able to consistently support customers across these time zones as part of their regular working schedule.

**What You'll Do**

**Customer Portfolio Ownership**

* Own and manage a portfolio of Site Agent customer accounts across both New Logo and Existing Customer business.
* Take accountability for customer health, adoption, satisfaction, and retention.
* Conduct regular customer touchpoints and quarterly business/performance reviews.
* Identify optimization opportunities and recommend SEO best practices to improve customer outcomes.
* Partner with Customer Success Managers and Strategic Account Managers on renewal and expansion strategies.

**Implementation & Technical Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end Site Agent implementations from kickoff through production deployment.
* Drive implementation workstreams involving:
* Client-side JavaScript integrations
* Server-side SDK implementations
* Sidecar and custom deployment models
* Coordinate technical discovery sessions with customers.
* Manage implementation timelines, milestones, risks, and stakeholder communication.
* Ensure successful production launches and post-launch validation.

**Platform Configuration & Optimization**

Configure and maintain Site Agent including:

* Profiles
* Source and target rules
* Priority ordering
* Anchor text logic
* Regex configuration
* Language settings
* Crawl configuration
* Page and link caps
* Additional domains

Maintain high configuration accuracy, recognizing that every change is reflected on customer-facing websites.

**Technical Troubleshooting**

* Diagnose implementation and production issues using:
* Crawl data
* Site Agent Admin Panel
* Debug tools
* Regex validator
* Resolve implementation issues independently whenever possible.
* Escalate complex engineering issues with detailed technical documentation.
* Coordinate resolution of "AP Down" customer accounts and restore production health.

**Customer Success & Strategic Consulting**

* Conduct Quarterly Site Agent Performance Reviews.
* Review implementation health and KPIs.
* Deliver SEO recommendations based on customer performance.
* Reinforce the value of Site Agent automation, especially during periods of flat or declining performance.
* Support executive customer presentations including QBRs and EBRs.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

Collaborate closely with:

* Customer Success Managers
* Strategic Account Managers
* Sales
* Professional Services
* Product Management
* Engineering

Support:

* Strategic renewals
* Competitive positioning
* Product adoption
* Technical discovery
* Executive customer presentations

**Product Growth & Innovation**

* Support rollout of new Site Agent capabilities including AP Schema and Site Agent for Mobile.
* Deploy Site Agent across new Enterprise and Mid-Market customers.
* Participate in product feedback sessions with Engineering.
* Contribute to implementation playbooks and best practices.
* Share customer insights to influence future product direction.

**Team Leadership**

* Mentor junior Implementation Specialists.
* Provide technical guidance during complex customer engagements.
* Share troubleshooting knowledge and implementation best practices.
* Support onboarding and cross-training initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in Technical Customer Success, Professional Services, Technical Implementation, Solutions Consulting, or SEO technology.
* Experience managing Enterprise customer relationships.
* Strong project and program management experience.
* Excellent executive communication and presentation skills.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent customer implementations.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
* Experience documenting work in Salesforce or similar CRM systems.

**Preferred Technical Experience**

Experience with one or more of the following:

* JavaScript integrations
* Server-side implementations
* SDK integrations
* REST APIs
* Regular Expressions (Regex)
* HTML/CSS fundamentals
* CMS platforms (Sitecore, Shopify, WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager, etc.)
* React and modern web frameworks
* Website architecture
* Rendering concepts (client-side vs server-side)

**SEO Knowledge**

Working knowledge of:

* Internal linking
* Technical SEO
* On-page optimization
* Structured Data / Schema
* Crawl behavior
* Website architecture
* Search engine indexing

**What Makes You Successful**

You are someone who:

* Thrives in customer-facing technical environments.
* Balances technical depth with relationship management.
* Pays exceptional attention to detail.
* Can confidently present to technical and executive stakeholders.
* Communicates clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Takes ownership from implementation through long-term customer success.
* Enjoys solving complex technical problems.
* Can manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously.
* Brings a continuous improvement mindset and enjoys mentoring others.

title: Portfolio Lead
description:
****Company Description****
There's nothing like a career at Entain India. We're the technology powerhouse helping Entain – a world leader in sports and gaming – create products and experiences used by millions of customers across the globe. Whether you're an engineer, product owner or customer care professional, unlock a world of new possibilities – for you and the future of sports and gaming.
  
  
****Job Description****
The Portfolio Lead is accountable for delivery performance across a sub-domain of 4-6 pods (Engineering, Quality, Product). They lead the flow of value from idea to production, ensuring pods deliver with pace, predictability and understanding to outcomes.
  
  
They combine hands-on delivery leadership with AI-augmented ways of working and data-driven decision-making. They do not prescribe a single framework - instead they adapt approaches that best serve each pod's context.
  
  
They partner with Engineering and Product leadership to reduce waste, improve throughput and help pods achieve Autonomy, Accountability and Agreement to value outcomes.
  
  
****What You Will Do****
**Pod Performance & Accountability**
You are responsible for pod delivery performance across the sub-domain.
  
  
You will lead and communicate delivery health, risks and performance to leadership
  
  
Ensure pods operate as, self-organising units delivering value outcomes
  
  
Support pod leads with coaching, facilitation and conflict resolution
  
  
Ensure cross-pod agreement on priorities, dependencies and shared goals
  
  
Facilitate communication and collaboration between pods to promote knowledge sharing
  
  
**Problem Solving**
You will be an expert; deploy root cause analysis, systems thinking and structured techniques to analyse and guide out resolutions.
  
  
Be an escalation point for cross-pod blockers and systemic impediments
  
  
Identify patterns across pods that indicate deeper organisational or process issues
  
  
**AI-Augmented Delivery**
Champion AI agent adoption across pods - including coding agents, test generation, story creation, board health and deployment automation
  
  
Identify opportunities where AI can reduce toil, accelerate delivery or improve decision-making
  
  
Apply AI to improve delivery effectiveness, including workflow insights, risk prediction, and automation of reporting
  
  
Track and demonstrate the impact of AI on delivery performance
  
  
**Flow & Efficiency**
Monitor and improve delivery flow (lead time, cycle time, WIP, throughput) using Kanban and lean principles
  
  
Ensure WIP limits are respected and surface ageing items through Board Walks
  
  
Identify bottlenecks, ageing work and sources of delay across pods.
  
  
Improve through regular assessment and experimentation.
  
  
Support teams in breaking down work into deliverable, value-driven increments
  
  
**Agile Ways of Working**
Support and evolve the agile operating model for a pod-based environment focused on pace, not ceremony.
  
  
Adapt delivery approaches (Kanban, flow-based, lean) appropriate to each pod's needs
  
  
Ensure consistency of practice across pods without being prescriptive
  
  
Promote outcome-driven delivery vs output-driven activity
  
  
Guide teams to operate with autonomy and accountability
  
  
**Metrics & Reporting**
Define and maintain delivery metrics: cycle time, flow efficiency, lead time of initiative, PDLC compression, dependency reduction, rework rate, team satisfaction, and AI effectiveness
  
  
Build dashboards (cumulative flow diagrams, throughput charts, WIP ageing) that provide leadership visibility and lead informed decision-making
  
  
Analyse performance data to identify trends, patterns and areas for improvement
  
  
Use data to facilitate conversations and coach pods — not just track output
  
  
**Stakeholder Management**
Partner with Engineering and Product leadership at sub-domain level
  
  
Represent delivery health and risks in leadership forums
  
  
Build trusted relationships that allow fast decision-making
  
  
Communicate delivery performance to both technical and non-technical audiences
  
  
**Commercial Awareness**
Understand the commercial context of the sub-domain
  
  
Connect delivery decisions to revenue, cost, and customer impact
  
  
Support prioritisation trade-offs with a business lens
  
  
**Capacity Planning**
Forecast capacity across pods based on team composition, skills mix and upcoming demand
  
  
Identify resourcing gaps and support hiring/allocation decisions
  
  
Balance workload across pods to prevent burnout and underutilisation
  
  
Support realistic planning by ensuring pods have clear understanding of available capacity
  
  
**Risk & Dependency Management**
Manage risks through regular assessment and execution of controls
  
  
Ensure cross-pod dependencies are visible, tracked and managed
  
  
Track dependency cost (time blocked, items affected) and lead mitigations such as contract-first development and feature flags
  
  
Support issue escalations, ensuring intervention by the dependency escalation protocol
  
  
**Coach & Capability Development**
Provide hands-on coaching at pod level
  
  
Build capability in workflow management, flow thinking, estimation, planning, and data-led decision-making
  
  
Support teams in understanding and improving their own performance
  
  
Strengthen a culture of continuous improvement and learning
  
  
**Outcome & Value Focus**
Align delivery to always ensure outcomes and value.
  
  
Help teams understand the why behind their work and how their outputs contribute to value
  
  
Challenge work that does not link to outcomes
  
  
Support measurement of delivery against OKRs and value indicators
  
  
**Centre of Excellence (CoE) Contribution**
Be an active contributor to the CoE
  
  
Share best practices, delivery insights and improvement opportunities from pods
  
  
Support adoption of standards, playbooks and tools
  
  
Help evolve delivery practices based on experience
  
  
****Qualifications****
**Specialist Experience**
You will have 7+ years in delivery/agile roles, with at least 3 years operating across multiple teams simultaneously in a technology environment
  
  
Expert in flow-based delivery approaches (Kanban, lean, continuous delivery) — not limited to Scrum
  
  
Experience enabling multiple teams/pods simultaneously at scale
  
  
Strong understanding of AI tooling and its application to software delivery (coding assistants, automation, intelligent analytics)
  
  
Experienced in capacity planning, demand forecasting and resource optimisation across multiple teams
  
  
Use data to solve complex problems; can interpret and communicate complex data sets clearly
  
  
Previous experience of organisational transformation and change management
  
  
Good knowledge of Objectives and Key Results (OKR) strategy
  
  
Experience in a regulated industry (gaming, fintech, or similar) desirable
  
  
**Competencies & Behaviours**
You will embody the Maker Dimensions - selecting for capability, not just competence. We are looking for people who are versatile, curious, and able to operate with autonomy in a high-trust environment.
  
  
**AI Fluency**
uses AI tooling; experiments; iterate with AI as a collaborator
  
  
**Agency & Accountability**
Owns outcomes, not just tasks; directs itself.
  
  
**Systems Thinking**
Sees patterns across pods and addresses causes, not symptoms
  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement**
Builds working relationships across pods and leadership
  
  
**Improve Performance**
Raises the bar through data and experimentation
  
  
**Cross-functional Versatility**
Comfortable operating beyond their primary discipline
  
  
**Product Sense**
Connects their work to customer and outcomes
  
  
**Build Capability**
Invests in developing pods, individuals and self
  
  
****Benefits****
**Additional Information**
At Entain India, We Offer a Package And The Support People Need To Make An Impact. Join Us, And a Great Compensation Package Is Just The Beginning. You Can Expect To Receive Benefits Like:
  
  

* Safe home pickup and home drop.
* A regular bonus and great pension.
* 24 days annual leave.
* Extra paid leave, including wellbeing and development days.
* Life assurance and Income Protection.
* Private healthcare and wellbeing support.
* INR 3,000 per month Communication allowance.
* Up to INR 16,000 per year in Crèche expenses (children under 3).

**Equal Opportunities**
.
  
  
If you need any
**reasonable adjustments**
at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us and we'll support you.
  
  
We're committed to creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to be themselves.
  
  
We're an
**equal opportunities employer**
. We welcome applications from everyone and we do not discriminate based on age, disability, gender or gender reassignment, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marriage/civil partnership, or any other basis.
  
  
We comply with all applicable recruitment regulations and employment laws in the jurisdictions where we operate, ensuring ethical and compliant hiring practices globally.

title: Tech GCC Advisory Manager
description:
**Job Title -**
GCC Technology Advisory Manager
  
  
**Management Level:**
07 – Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata
  
  
**Must have skills:**
GCC (Global Capability Centers) Strategy, Digital & Technology Strategy, Technology Operating Model Design, Sourcing Strategy, Business Case Formulation, IT Processes & Governance
  
  
**Good to have skills:**
Tech M&A Advisory, IT Shared Services, Agile Operating Model, Workforce Transformation, AI in SDLC, Data Visualization Tools, Enterprise Architecture
  
  
**Job Summary:**

* Manage defined workstreams within GCC strategy and digital transformation engagements, taking responsibility for structuring the approach, shaping the analysis, and delivering high-quality outputs within agreed timelines along with budgeting and forecasting activities
* Own and lead projects – guiding team, reviewing outputs, and ensuring coherence across deliverables at the workstream level
* Prepare client presentations, workshop materials, and proposal sections independently, contributing actively to client discussions and working sessions
* Develop business cases, cost analyses, value realization frameworks, and support models for GCC setup and digital strategy assignments
* Apply a technology and business perspective across GCC processes, IT governance design, KPI and maturity frameworks, and emerging areas such as AI-enabled transformation
* Contribute to business development efforts through research, pitch preparation, and proposal development and managing BD cycles
* Excel as a long-term trusted advisor and partner by providing thought leadership and profound knowledge of market trends.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* GCC Strategy and Setup: lead analysis of BOT/ABO setup models, location and sourcing strategy, GCC tooling landscape assessment, capability maturity evaluation, and process taxonomy design for new GCC entities
* Cost Analysis and Value Realization: develop detailed cost models covering setup costs, run-rate costs, and total cost of ownership for GCC and technology transformation scenarios; build value realization frameworks that track benefit delivery against investment over time, incorporating productivity, quality, and strategic value levers
* KPI Design and Performance Frameworks: design KPI frameworks for GCC performance management, covering operational, delivery, financial, and strategic metrics; develop KPI dashboards and reporting cadences aligned to governance structures
* Capability Maturity Assessment: conduct structured maturity assessments across GCC functions, IT processes, and technology capabilities; translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines
* GCC Processes and Tooling: Design GCC-specific operating processes including demand management, project intake, service catalogues, and performance reporting; assess and recommend tooling platforms (ITSM, PPM, reporting) suited to GCC operating contexts
* IT Governance Design: Design IT governance frameworks for GCC and enterprise technology contexts, including governance councils, decision rights, escalation structures, and policy frameworks aligned to organizational objectives
* RACI and Interaction Model Design: Develop RACI matrices and IT interaction models defining roles, responsibilities, and collaboration patterns between the GCC, parent organization, business units, and third-party vendors
* Operating Model Design: Design integrated IT operating models for GCC setups including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition planning considerations
* AI in SDLC: Contribute to assessments and recommendations on AI integration into software development lifecycles within GCC contexts – covering AI-assisted coding, automated testing, and intelligent release management

**Professional & Technical Skills:**

* 7–10 years of total experience in strategy consulting, technology advisory, or in-house corporate strategy; experience at a top-tier or Big 4 firm preferred
* Experience leading workstreams in GCC strategy, digital transformation, or technology operating model engagements
* Working knowledge of at least 2–3 of the following: GCC/Captive Center setup, Digital & Technology Strategy, IT Governance, Operating Model Design, IT Shared Services, Sourcing Strategy, Agile Transformation
* Ability to build and interpret cost models, TCO analyses, and value realization frameworks for technology and GCC transformation contexts
* Experience designing KPI frameworks and performance measurement structures; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
* Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches – capability, process, or technology maturity – and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
* Familiarity with IT governance frameworks (e.g. COBIT, ITIL) and ability to design practical governance structures including RACI models and interaction frameworks
* Understanding of GCC tooling ecosystems – ITSM platforms, project portfolio management tools, reporting and analytics platforms
* Awareness of AI adoption in software delivery including AI-assisted development tools and their implications for GCC workforce and process design
* Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills

**What’s in it for you?**

* Opportunity to work on GCC and digital strategy programs for marquee G2000 clients across industries

+ Exposure to senior stakeholder engagements and client-facing responsibilities as part of high-performing delivery teams

* Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
* Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
* Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
* Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

title: Vendor Manager
description:
**About The Role And Team**
Community Operations at Uber is where real people solve real problems in real time. As a Vendor Operations Manager, you will lead the performance and strategic relationship of our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) network—a global community of thousands of agents who provide world-class support for our riders, drivers, and merchants. The pace is intense, the stakes are high, and the answers aren't always clear.
  
  
You’ll work in a highly-matrixed environment, balancing empathy for our users with a relentless drive for operational excellence. This role is about more than just monitoring metrics; it's about leading through influence, navigating complex cross-functional dynamics, and making fast, thoughtful decisions that improve our global support footprint. title: Natural Gas & NGL Value Chain
description:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Strategic Vision & Initiative Roadmap**

* Define and articulate the strategic vision for value chain optimization aligned to the client's commercial and operational objectives.
* Develop a prioritized initiative roadmap spanning short-, medium-, and long-term horizons, covering upstream supply, midstream processing, and downstream distribution of natural gas and NGLs.
* Identify, scope, and champion quick wins—high-impact, low-effort opportunities that generate immediate value and build stakeholder confidence.
* Facilitate executive workshops and strategic alignment sessions to gain buy-in across operations, finance, IT, and commercial functions.
* Translate strategic ambitions into clear business cases with quantified value potential (cost reduction, margin improvement, throughput optimization).

**2. Value Chain Assessment & Optimization**

* Conduct end-to-end value chain analysis encompassing gas gathering, compression, treating & sweetening, fractionation, storage, transportation, and marketing.
* Assess NGL value chains including ethane, propane, butane, and natural gasoline streams—from separation and stabilization through to product delivery and offtake.
* Identify value leakage points, operational inefficiencies, scheduling bottlenecks, and commercial misalignments across the value chain.
* Benchmark client performance against industry best practices and recommend targeted interventions to close performance gaps.
* Model alternative value chain configurations and commercial structures (e.g., tolling vs. equity, spot vs. term) to maximize netback and margin capture.

**3. Systems & Data Landscape Assessment**

* Perform a structured assessment of the client's current technology landscape—including SCADA, DCS, ERP, scheduling, nomination, and measurement systems.
* Map data flows across the value chain, identifying data silos, manual handoffs, reporting gaps, and integration failures ("digital breaks").
* Evaluate data quality, availability, and timeliness for operational decision-making, commercial settlement, and regulatory compliance.
* Develop a systems capability heat map and gap analysis to frame the digitalization opportunity.
* Review master data management (MDM) practices and data governance maturity in the context of gas measurement, allocation, and balancing.

**4. Digitalization Roadmap & Quick Wins**

* Identify and prioritize digitalization opportunities—from process automation and real-time monitoring to advanced analytics, AI/ML applications, and integrated planning tools.
* Define digital quick wins: automation of manual workflows, dashboard consolidation, IoT-enabled measurement upgrades, or improved scheduling visibility.
* Develop a phased digitalization roadmap with clear milestones, technology recommendations, resource requirements, and expected ROI.
* Advise on fit-for-purpose technology choices (e.g., gas nomination platforms, production allocation software, digital twin capabilities, cloud-based optimization tools).
* Collaborate with IT and OT teams to assess integration architecture and propose practical pathways from current to target-state digital infrastructure.

**5. Stakeholder Engagement & Client Delivery**

* Build trusted advisor relationships with client stakeholders at operational, commercial, and executive levels.
* Lead and contribute to project workstreams, ensuring deliverables are on time, on budget, and meet quality standards.
* Prepare and present high-quality findings, recommendations, and roadmaps through client-ready reports and executive briefings.
* Support change management by coaching client teams through new processes, tools, and operating models.
* Participate in business development activities including proposal development, client scoping discussions, and practice thought leadership.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE :**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree or higher in Chemical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Process Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in the natural gas and/or NGL sector, spanning operations, commercial, or consulting roles.
* Demonstrated expertise across the natural gas value chain: gathering, compression, processing, fractionation, storage, transportation, and marketing.
* Strong working knowledge of NGL products (ethane, propane, butanes, pentanes+), their processing requirements, quality specifications, and market dynamics.
* Proven track record in supply chain and/or value chain analysis, optimization, or transformation projects.
* Experience conducting digital maturity assessments, systems landscape reviews, or operational technology (OT/IT) integration projects.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; proficient in quantitative modeling and data analysis tools.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills; ability to engage effectively at all organizational levels.

**Preferred :**

* MBA or advanced degree in Business, Strategy, or a related field.
* Experience with gas scheduling, nomination, and balancing systems (e.g., Quorum, WinTrak, OpenTicket, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with digital transformation frameworks and methodologies (agile, design thinking, lean).
* Exposure to AI/ML applications in production optimization, demand forecasting, or anomaly detection within upstream/midstream gas operations.
* Prior management consulting experience with a recognized firm (energy, strategy, or operations practice).
* Knowledge of regulatory frameworks governing natural gas pipelines, tariffs, and NGL transportation (FERC, state/provincial regimes).

**WHAT WE OFFER :**

* High-impact engagements with leading energy companies across the natural gas value chain.
* Collaborative, expert team environment with opportunities for mentorship and professional development.
* Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience, including performance-based incentives.
* Exposure to cutting-edge digital tools and methodologies shaping the future of energy operations.
* Flexible working arrangements with a hybrid on-site/remote model (client travel required).

title: Group Senior System Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Senior Systems Analyst leads the implementation, enhancement and support of Oracle Warehouse Management Cloud (OWMS) solutions across assigned regional business units within DP World. The role requires strong functional expertise in Oracle WMS Cloud, coupled with proven capabilities in regional project delivery, stakeholder management, solution design, and cross-functional coordination.
  
  
The position serves as a key point of contact for WMS implementations representing Group Technology team for a given Region, working closely with business stakeholders, regional IT teams, global product teams, implementation partners, and external vendors to ensure successful delivery of warehouse management solutions aligned with business objectives, global solution standards, and regional operational requirements.
  
  
The role manages multiple regional implementations and initiatives, overseeing project execution, risks, dependencies, timelines and quality standards while driving solution standardization. It also provides functional leadership to System Analysts, drives continuous improvement and ensures a smooth transition to business-as-usual support.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead the end-to-end implementation lifecycle of Oracle WMS Cloud solutions across assigned regional business units, from requirements gathering and solution design through configuration, testing, deployment, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Manage multiple concurrent WMS implementation projects and enhancements across the region, ensuring alignment with agreed scope, timelines, budgets, quality standards, and business priorities.
* Ensure effective post-implementation stabilization and transition to support, with clear ownership, documentation, and resolution of outstanding issues.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with regional operations leaders, business sponsors, project managers, and technology stakeholders to understand business priorities and translate them into implementable WMS solutions.
* Facilitate regional workshops, requirements discussions, solution walkthroughs, design reviews, project governance meetings, and implementation progress reviews.
* Manage stakeholder expectations, communicate project progress and delivery risks, and facilitate timely decisions on scope, priorities, solution design, and resource requirements.
* Provide strong functional expertise in Oracle WMS Cloud and its related services, ensuring solutions address complex warehousing and logistics requirements.
* Lead functional solution design across inbound operations, receiving, put-away, replenishment, inventory management, cycle counting, picking, packing, shipping, cross-docking, value-added services, kitting, and shipment manifestation.
* Ensure regional WMS implementations adhere to established project governance frameworks, global product standards, architecture principles, security requirements, and operational controls.
* Provide functional guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing to System Analysts and other project team members supporting regional WMS implementations.
* Ability to liaise with business users and technical consultants.
* Act as an ambassador for DP World at all times when working; promoting and demonstrating positive behaviours in harmony with DP World’s Founder’s Principles, values and culture; ensuring the highest level of safety is applied in all activities; understanding and following DP World’s Code of Conduct and Ethics policies.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Job Context**
Trade is the lifeblood of the global economy, creating opportunities and improving the quality of life for people around the world. DP World exists to make the world’s trade flow better, changing what’s possible for the customers and communities we serve globally.
  
  
With a dedicated, diverse and professional team of more than 119,000 employees from 164 nationalities, spanning 83 countries on six continents and 560+ business units, DP World is pushing trade further and faster towards a seamless supply chain that’s fit for the future.
  
  
We’re rapidly transforming and integrating our businesses -- Ports and Terminals, Marine Services, Logistics and Technology – and uniting our global infrastructure with local expertise to create stronger, more efficient end-to-end supply chain solutions that can change the way the world trades.
  
  
What's more, we're reshaping the future by investing in innovation. From intelligent delivery systems to automated warehouse stacking, we’re at the cutting edge of disruptive technology, pushing the sector towards better ways to trade, minimising disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.
  
  
**Qualifications, Experience And Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computers or a relevant discipline.
* 14+ years of experience with at least 8+ years in implementing Oracle WMS Cloud services.
* Experience in BPM Tools, MS Visio, Mindmap tools
* Ability to understand the business problems in a holistic way to provide robust, scale-able and cost-effective solution.
* Job Specific Skills

+ Certified Oracle Warehouse Management Certified Implementation Specialist
+ Integration to standard warehouse automation tools such as Barcode readers and other warehouse equipment.

* Generic Skills

+ Excellent Communication skills & a team player.
+ Able to work under pressure and handle parallel task without compromising quality.
+ Determination, self-motivation and an eagerness to take on new challenges.
+ Ability to adapt quickly, working in a dynamic business environment.

title: Engineering Team Manager
description:
**Description**
Anaqua is looking for a dynamic Engineering Team Manager to lead our Platform & Microservices team spanning development, QA automation, and DevOps. This is a hands-on leadership role — you write code, review architecture, and make technical decisions while managing people and delivery.
  
  
You will play a dual role: Product Owner for the platform services (owning the backlog, priorities, and roadmap) and technical team lead who drives Agile execution, engineering excellence, and team growth. You lead by example — your team sees you in the code, in the design discussions, and at the whiteboard.
  
  
**You'll Love This Job If You Like To**
**Team & Delivery Leadership**

* Team Management — lead a cross-functional Agile team of developers, QA automation engineers, and DevOps engineers.
* Agile Execution — drive sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, retrospectives, and release coordination.
* Delivery Ownership — own delivery commitments — sprint goals, release timelines, and production readiness.
* People Development — build a high-performing team through hiring, onboarding, mentoring, performance reviews, and career development.
* Stakeholder Management — remove blockers, manage dependencies across teams, and escalate risks proactively.
* Team Culture — foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

**Product Ownership - Platform Services**

* Backlog Management — own the product backlog for platform services — prioritizes features, tech debt, and operational improvements.
* Roadmap & Strategy — collaborate with business, product management, and architecture to define roadmap and quarterly goals.
* Requirements — write clear user stories with acceptance criteria; ensure the team understands the “why” behind every deliverable.
* Prioritization — make trade-off decisions between scope, quality, and timelines with a customer-centric lens.
* Cross-Team Alignment — represent the platform in cross-team planning, dependency discussions, and release coordination.

**Hands-On Technical Leadership**

* Lead by Example — actively participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and design decisions.
* Backend & Cloud — hands-on development experience with Java microservices, APIs (REST, gRPC), and cloud-native patterns on GCP.
* DevOps Fluency — strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* QA Understanding — familiarity with test automation strategy — E2E (Playwright), API testing, contract testing, and quality gates in pipelines.
* Technical Decision-Making — ability to evaluate technical trade-offs, guide technology choices, and drive architectural standards.
* Production Ownership — experience with observability, production debugging, incident management, and post-mortem processes.

**Engineering Practices**

* Establish and enforce coding standards, review processes, and engineering guidelines across development, QA, and DevOps.
* Champion shift-left quality — automated testing, static analysis, security scanning integrated into the development workflow.
* Drive adoption of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to improve team productivity.
* define and track engineering metrics — deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, MTTR.
* Ensure secure coding practices and compliance with organizational security policies.

**Agile & SDLC Mastery**

* deep practical experience running Scrum or Kanban teams in a continuous delivery environment.
* strong command of the Agile work item hierarchy — Epics, Features, User Stories, Tasks, Bugs.
* Jira mastery — board configuration, sprint metrics, velocity tracking, release planning, and reporting.
* full SDLC ownership — from requirements through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.
* clear understanding of environments and promotion workflows — Dev, QA, Staging, Pre-Production, Production.

**Professional Skills & Mindset**

* Proven track record of delivering complex technical projects on time and at quality.
* Dynamic and adaptable — comfortable switching between strategic planning and hands-on problem solving.
* Excellent communicator — translates business needs to technical teams and technical complexity to business stakeholders.
* Customer-centric — every decision is evaluated through the lens of end-user impact.
* Proactive and innovative — brings ideas to improve product, process, tools, and team capabilities.
* Resilient under pressure — maintains clarity and calm during production incidents and tight deadlines.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful**

* 10+ years of relevant industry experience required.
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Certified Product Owner (CSPO).
* Experience managing distributed or remote teams.
* ReactJS frontend knowledge for full-stack architectural context.
* Python for scripting and automation.
* Cloud cost optimization and FinOps awareness.
* Background in brand protection, IP enforcement, or digital investigation domains.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS domains.

Anaqua, Inc. is a premium provider of integrated intellectual property (IP) management technology solutions and services. Anaqua’s AQX platform combines best practice workflows with big data analytics and tech-enabled services to create an intelligent environment designed to inform IP strategy, enable IP decision-making, and streamline IP operations. Today, nearly half of the top 100 U.S. patent filers and global brands, as well as a growing number of law firms worldwide use Anaqua’s solutions. Over one million IP executives, attorneys, paralegals, administrators, and innovators in large and medium-sized companies use the platform for their IP management needs. title: State Program Officer - Bhongir (Bhuvanagiri), Telangana
description:
**Overview**
Jhpiego is an international, non-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high-quality, low-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
  
  
Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on-the-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
  
  
Jhpiego is seeking a highly motivated
**State Program Officer**
based in Telangana for its RISE project. The
**State Program Officer**
will coordinate and support day-to-day state implementation of activities, including workplan tracking, stakeholder follow-up, meeting/field-visit coordination, documentation, data and reporting support, capacity-building logistics, partner coordination and transition records. The role will enable State Leads and Technical Advisors to deliver timely, well-documented technical assistance through government systems rather than parallel implementation structures.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Programme Coordination & Workplan Tracking**

* Maintain detailed state workplans, calendars, action trackers and deliverable status for HIV projects related activities; flag delays, dependencies and required follow-up to the State Lead.
* Coordinate routine communication and scheduling with SACS, district/facility teams, national Advisors, Technical Advisors, MERL/Communications/Operations teams and approved partners.
* Track implementation of technical-assistance priorities, including decentralized/integrated services, digital/data activities, private-sector engagement, combination prevention, capacity strengthening and transition milestones.
* Maintain meeting decisions and action logs and follow up responsible persons through closure, ensuring project records reflect current implementation status.

**Field Visits, Reviews, Workshops & Capacity-Building Support**

* Plan and coordinate logistics and documentation for joint site visits, state/district reviews, technical working groups, consultations, workshops and trainings.
* Prepare agendas, participant lists, materials, approvals, attendance records, minutes and post-event action trackers in coordination with technical leads.
* Support scheduling and follow-up for AAM/PHC/CHC/ART/ICTC and other service-platform assessments or mentoring visits, including private-sector engagement activities as applicable.
* Coordinate logistical and documentation requirements for MAS, Fast Track City, treatment-outcomes workshops, innovation pilots or other approved accelerator activities in the assigned geography.

**Data, Documentation, Reporting & Knowledge Support**

* Compile approved aggregate programme data, action trackers and dashboard inputs for state reviews, district/facility performance discussions and project reporting; coordinate resolution of missing/inconsistent information.
* Support preparation and filing of monthly/quarterly progress updates, presentations, meeting records, technical-assistance logs, learning notes and relevant documentation.
* Assist Technical Advisors/MERL teams with preparation of district profiles, scorecards and SOCH-derived management summaries using only authorised data and access pathways.
* Maintain organised digital and physical project files, version control and evidence folders to support donor/government reporting, audits, transition and close-out readiness.

**Stakeholder, Partner & Referral-System Coordination**

* Maintain updated contact/stakeholder lists and coordinate follow-up with SACS, facilities, private providers, laboratories, pharmacies, professional associations, CBOs and other approved partners.
* Support scheduling, documentation and follow-up for private-provider enrolment/reporting, CME/quality events, referral-network strengthening and approved HIVST/PrEP/PEP activities.
* Support maintenance of approved referral directories/repositories and track operational issues requiring technical escalation or partner action.

**Operations, Compliance, Transition & Close-Out Support**

* Coordinate programme logistics, travel/activity documentation and routine administrative inputs in line with Jhpiego/project procedures, working with Operations/Finance/Procurement colleagues as required.
* Support timely preparation of requests, supporting documents, vendor/venue coordination and activity records for approved meetings, trainings and field activities.
* Track government ownership and handover milestones, including transfer/archiving of tools, materials, files and agreed responsibilities into appropriate local systems.

**Required Qualifications**




+ Graduate degree in Public Health, Social Sciences, Health Management, Life Sciences, Development Studies, Management or a related field.

**Preferred**

* Postgraduate qualification in Public Health, Health Management or a related discipline.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in health or development programme coordination, documentation, stakeholder engagement, reporting support or project operations.
* Experience working with HIV programmes or India's National AIDS Control Programme (NACP) will be preferred.

**Skills And Competencies**
**Technical Knowledge & Skills**

* Knowledge of the local language (Telugu) is essential for effective communication with field-level stakeholders and community members.
* Working understanding of HIV/NACP programme structures, SACS/district/facility coordination and the HIV prevention-care-treatment cascade; willingness to rapidly learn relevant technical terminology and guidelines.
* Strong workplan, calendar, action-tracker, meeting and field-visit coordination skills, with disciplined follow-up on responsibilities and deadlines.
* Ability to compile, clean and present approved programme data/trackers for state reviews and reporting, while maintaining data confidentiality and following project/government data-governance requirements.
* Experience organising workshops, trainings, consultations and stakeholder meetings, including agendas, materials, attendance, minutes, logistics and post-event action follow-up.
* Good documentation and communication skills for progress updates, meeting notes, case/learning documentation, partner correspondence and file management.
* Ability to coordinate across government, technical teams, private-sector/CBO partners, operations, MERL and communications functions

**Core Competencies**
Organisational: Reliability; attention to detail; planning and prioritisation; teamwork; service orientation; integrity; timely follow-up; respect for government systems and project compliance requirements.
  
  
Job Specific: Clear written and verbal communication; strong coordination and documentation; practical problem solving; data/Excel and presentation skills; ability to manage multiple activities and stakeholders; discretion in handling sensitive programme information.
  
  
**Travel Requirements**
The position requires regular travel within the assigned state for meetings, workshops, technical reviews, field visits and coordination with SACS, district health teams, facilities and partner organizations.
  
  
Jhpiego is an equal opportunity employer and offers a highly dynamic and enabling work environment.
  
  

* Jhpiego offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive employee benefits package. Women candidates will be preferred.

Due to high volume of applications, only shortlisted applicants will receive a response from Jhpiego HR.

title: Professional, PDS Projects
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
1. Position Summary
  
The Project Planning & Controls Lead is responsible for providing planning leadership, schedule governance, and delivery assurance for data center construction and infrastructure projects delivered under a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) model.
  
Acting as the client’s planning and controls representative, the role ensures that integrated master schedules, progress reporting, and forecasting frameworks are robust, accurate, and aligned with delivery objectives. The position works closely with Project Managers, Project Directors, contractors, consultants, and client stakeholders to provide clear, data-driven insights that support timely decision-making and delivery certainty across one or multiple mission-critical data center projects.
  
2. Key Responsibilities
  
Planning & Controls Leadership
  
Lead planning and controls activities across the full project lifecycle, including design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.
  
Develop, maintain, and govern integrated master schedules and detailed project programs in alignment with PMC and client standards.
  
Establish planning principles, schedule structures, coding, and reporting frameworks across the project portfolio.
  
Act as the central authority for schedule integrity, logic, and baseline management.
  
Schedule Development & Governance
  
Review, validate, and integrate contractor and consultant schedules into a coordinated master program.
  
Ensure alignment of design, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities across all workstreams.
  
Define and manage key milestones, critical paths, and interface dependencies.
  
Support phasing strategies, fast-track delivery, and concurrent construction models common to data center projects.
  
Progress Monitoring, Analysis & Reporting
  
Implement consistent progress measurement methodologies across all disciplines and contractors.
  
Track progress against baselines, identify variances, and provide forward-looking forecasts.
  
Prepare high-quality schedule reports, dashboards, and executive summaries for client and project leadership.
  
Highlight risks to milestones and critical paths, with clear mitigation and recovery options.
  
Risk, Change & Recovery Planning
  
Support identification of schedule-related risks and development of mitigation strategies.
  
Perform schedule impact assessments for changes, delays, and scope adjustments.
  
Support recovery planning, acceleration strategies, and what-if scenario analysis.
  
Contribute to risk registers and delivery assurance reviews from a planning perspective.
  
Delay Analysis, Claims Review & Forensic Support
  
Perform schedule delay analysis using appropriate methodologies (e.g., impacted as-planned, time impact analysis, as-built vs. as-planned).
  
Review contractor delay notifications, extension of time (EOT) submissions, and time-related claims from a planning and technical perspective.
  
Independently assess the validity of delay causes, critical path impacts, and entitlement implications (schedule-focused, non-commercial).
  
Support the client and Project Director with objective, data-driven advice related to delay responsibility and mitigation options.
  
Maintain robust schedule records and contemporaneous updates to support defensible delay assessments.
  
Contractor & Consultant Coordination
  
Coordinate closely with contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and multidisciplinary consultants.
  
Challenge and validate contractor progress updates, logic, sequencing, and forecasts.
  
Facilitate planning workshops, look-ahead sessions, and interface coordination meetings.
  
Promote consistent planning standards and a collaborative, transparent approach to schedule management.
  
3. Technical Expertise (Data Center Focus)
  
Experience working in mission-critical and data center delivery environments.
  
Strong understanding of data center construction sequencing and phased handover strategies.
  
Knowledge of commissioning, integrated systems testing (IST), and readiness-for-operations sequencing.
  
Familiarity with redundancy-driven sequencing, concurrent builds, and live environment constraints.
  
Ability to interpret technical inputs from electrical, mechanical, ICT, and specialist systems into integrated schedules.
  
4. Tools & Methodologies
  
Advanced proficiency in planning and controls tools such as Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project.
  
Experience with reporting and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI or equivalent).
  
Working knowledge of PMI, PRINCE2, or equivalent project controls methodologies.
  
Understanding of schedule risk analysis, critical path management, and planning best practices.
  
Strong data management and reporting governance capability.
  
5. Qualifications & Experience
  
Education
  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
  
Experience
  
15-20 years of experience in project planning, scheduling, or project controls.
  
Direct experience supporting data center or mission-critical infrastructure projects.
  
Proven experience managing integrated schedules across complex, multi-contractor environments.
  
Professional Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)
  
PMP, PMI-SP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management or planning certification.
  
Primavera P6 professional certification is an advantage.
  
6. Core Competencies
  
Strong coordination and contractor interface management skills.
  
Excellent analytical and problem-solving capability.
  
Clear, concise communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  
Ability to translate complex schedule data into actionable insights.
  
Comfortable operating in fast-paced, high-risk, mission-critical delivery environments.
  
Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused mindset
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

With this comes a high level of accountability and ownership, empowering you to directly influence outcomes and see the tangible impact of your work.

 **Job Description**

We are looking for an experienced **PMO / Project Control Specialist** to support project governance, planning, monitoring, and reporting activities within a complex IT transformation environment. The role focuses on maintaining integrated project plans, tracking risks and dependencies, preparing management reports, and supporting financial oversight to ensure effective project execution. Working closely with Project Managers, workstream leads, and business stakeholders, the specialist ensures transparency, consistency, and alignment with established project management standards and governance frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

* Support day-to-day Project Management Office (PMO) activities, ensuring effective project coordination, governance, and reporting.
* Develop, maintain, and monitor integrated project plans, milestones, deliverables, and project schedules.
* Manage and maintain RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, and Dependencies), ensuring timely updates, escalation, and resolution tracking.
* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, steering committee presentations, and executive management materials.
* Support project financial tracking, including budgets, forecasts, actual expenditures, and cost variance analysis.
* Coordinate cross-functional dependencies, deliverables, and timelines across multiple project workstreams.
* Monitor project progress against agreed KPIs, timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Facilitate project governance meetings, document key decisions, and track follow-up actions and responsibilities.
* Identify opportunities to improve project management processes, reporting efficiency, and overall delivery transparency.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Proven experience in **PMO, Project Control, or Project Coordination** roles within complex IT or business transformation projects.
* Strong understanding of project management methodologies, governance frameworks, and project lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience maintaining integrated project plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers, and project reporting documentation.
* Experience with project financial management, including budget monitoring, forecasting, and cost tracking.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and project management tools such as MS Project, Jira, or similar platforms.
* Experience preparing steering committee materials, management dashboards, and executive-level project reports.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and work effectively across different project workstreams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present complex project information clearly and effectively.

title: Project Manager
description:
Bei Roche kannst du ganz du selbst sein und wirst für deine einzigartigen Qualitäten geschätzt. Unsere Kultur fördert persönlichen Ausdruck, offenen Dialog und echte Verbindungen. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  
Die Position
  
  
Project Manager
  
Roche India - Roche Services& Solutions
  
Hyderabad
  
  
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  
That’s what makes us Roche
  
  
Mission
  
  
Roche Services& Solutions (RSS) aims at "transforming the way Roche operates.'' As a global organization of over 3,500 colleagues, we enable Roche to operate in a competitive and ever-changing business environment. We provide our partners with end-to-end business services and solutions, enabling them to focus on patient-centric activities. Embracing an OneRoche mindset, we leverage our global network located in Budapest (Hungary), Riga (Latvia), Chennai& Hyderabad (India), San José (Costa Rica), Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), and our other sites to remain customer-centric 24/7 and co-create solutions together.
  
  
AsProject Manager you will be part of the RSS Project Management organization and report to the Chapter Lead for Project Management. Are you a project management enthusiast and want to provide best in class project management services to partners across Roche? Then you are the candidate we are looking for.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Engagement Delivery
  
  
In this role you will be responsible for successful Project Delivery using agile or traditional project management methodology.
  
  
**Your work will include but will not be limited to:**  

* understanding the business goal(s) and value of the project and striving to deliver the defined benefits to the organization
* leading or being part of global project teams ensuring clear roles and responsibilities and resource assignment to the project plan deliverables
* ensuring that the critical success factors of reliability, compliance, efficiency, sustainability, time to value are managed throughout the entire lifecycle of the projects
* effectively managing stakeholders through the establishment of key relationships and developing an understanding of their organizations
* generating, maintaining and tracking an accurate and realistic project plan, project risk and issue log and ensuring the project status is timely and transparent
* preparing and presenting to relevant governance meetings as required by the project methodology and good project management practice
* tracking project financials and seek governance approval when needed
* applying organizational change management practices as needed and ensuring effective project communication
* contributing to business development opportunities where appropriate

Capability Building
  
  

* Be an active member of the Project Management Chapter by:
* Continuously improving the project management capabilities, service offerings and community engagement leveraging latest developments and market dynamics
* Supporting the development of training content and toolkits for our team
* Actively managing your project management upskilling
* Applying your learnings during engagements and sharing them with your RSS colleagues

Who you are
  
  
You possess the following qualifications, experience and personal attributes:
  
  

* Appropriate university degree and5+ years of project management related work experience
* Strong knowledge in project management fundamentals (waterfall, SCRUM and others) and related tools
* Experience in leading global/complex projects, organizing and optimizing resources and establishing clear priorities
* Ability to motivate and lead a project team or team members if required
* Excellent communication skills, with demonstrated proficiency in influencing, negotiating, and effective global collaboration.
* Ability to effectively communicate across various levels of a complex, matrix organization. Ideally exposure to an additional field related to project management, such as project change management, business consulting, methodology coaching.
* Experience in project management financials and resource management

In addition, the following skills will make you successful in your position and create the foundation for career growth at Roche:
  
  

* Customer centricity
* Collaborative ways of working
* Presentation and influencing skills
* Business acumen& systems thinking

Wer wir sind
  
  
Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. Durch unser Engagement werden über 26 Millionen Menschen mit unseren Medikamenten behandelt und mehr als 30 Milliarden Tests mit unseren Diagnostik-Produkten durchgeführt. Wir ermutigen uns gegenseitig, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden, Kreativität zu fördern und hohe Ziele zu setzen, um lebensverändernde Gesundheitslösungen zu liefern.
  
  
Gemeinsam können wir eine gesündere Zukunft gestalten.
  
  
Roche ist ein Arbeitgeber, der die Chancengleichheit fördert.

title: Project Manager - Data Center
description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. We boldly go.
  
  
**Where Is The Work**
Field-based: Work is conducted on-site at customer locations.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Project Manager – Data Centre Cooling / HVAC / Chillers**
**Job Summary**
The Project Manager – Data Centre Cooling / HVAC / Chillers is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of mission-critical cooling infrastructure projects for data centres. This role focuses on HVAC plants, chiller systems, precision cooling, chilled water networks, controls integration, and related mechanical infrastructure to ensure high availability, energy efficiency, and compliance with project, safety, and quality requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution of data centre cooling and HVAC chiller projects, from design review through commissioning and handover.
* Manage projects involving chillers, CRAH/CRAC/Fan wall units, Liquid cooling, CDU units chilled water systems, condenser water systems, pumps, cooling towers or dry coolers, piping networks, valves, insulation, and controls.
* Coordinate with design consultants, MEP teams, OEMs, controls teams, contractors, and data centre operations stakeholders.
* Review mechanical and HVAC design drawings, equipment layouts, P&IDs, technical specifications, BOQs, and method statements.
* Oversee installation, testing, balancing, flushing, pressure testing, commissioning, and integrated system validation of cooling systems.
* Ensure proper sequencing and execution in live or partially live mission-critical environments with minimal operational risk.
* Manage interfaces between HVAC/mechanical systems and electrical, BMS, EPMS, fire protection, and building management systems.
* Track project scope, cost, timelines, risks, change orders, and contractor performance.
* Drive vendor and contractor alignment on equipment delivery, installation quality, commissioning readiness, and defect closure.
* Ensure compliance with EHS standards, statutory requirements, site safety rules, and company policies.
* Support energy-efficient design and execution practices, including optimization of plant performance, redundancy, and reliability.
* Prepare and present project reviews, site progress updates, risk registers, and executive status reports.
* Lead project closeout activities, including as-built documentation, O&M manuals, training, snag closure, and final handover.

**Key Deliverables**

* Project execution plan for cooling/HVAC/Chillers scope
* Detailed project schedule and milestone tracker
* Mechanical scope tracker and interface matrix
* Equipment and material delivery tracker
* Installation and commissioning readiness reports
* Risk and mitigation register
* Testing, balancing, and commissioning documentation
* As-built drawings and O&M documentation
* Handover and project closure reports

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline.
* Project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is preferred.
* Additional certifications in HVAC, chiller systems, data centre design, commissioning, or EHS are advantageous.

**Experience**

* Typically 8–15 years of experience in HVAC/mechanical project execution, with strong exposure to mission-critical or data centre environments.
* Proven experience delivering projects involving central chiller plants, precision cooling systems, chilled water distribution, and mechanical infrastructure.
* Experience working with live critical facilities, high-availability environments, or phased retrofit/upgrade projects is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to data centre cooling standards, redundancy concepts, and uptime/reliability expectations is desirable.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Chiller systems and plant design
* Precision air conditioning and data hall cooling
* CRAH/CRAC/Fan wall unit / CDU/ Liquid cooling systems
* Chilled water and condenser water systems
* Pumps, AHUs, piping, valves, and heat exchangers
* Cooling towers, dry coolers, and related auxiliaries
* HVAC controls, BMS, and integrated monitoring
* Data centre Testing and commissioning procedures
* Energy efficiency, load calculations, and plant optimization
* Mechanical system redundancy and resilience in mission-critical environments

**Required Skills**

* Project planning and execution
* Contractor and vendor management
* Technical review of HVAC/mechanical submissions
* Cost and budget control
* Risk identification and mitigation
* Commissioning coordination
* Stakeholder communication
* Problem-solving in critical operating environments
* Schedule tracking and reporting
* Change management and commercial coordination

**Preferred Competencies**

* Strong understanding of mission-critical cooling reliability
* Ability to manage shutdowns, tie-ins, and retrofit works in live sites
* Strong ownership and execution discipline
* Detail-oriented approach to quality and commissioning
* Good cross-functional coordination skills
* Ability to balance technical, operational, and commercial priorities

**Working Relationships**

* Data Centre Operations Team
* Mechanical/HVAC Engineering Team
* Electrical and Controls Teams
* BMS/EPMS Integrators
* OEMs and Equipment Vendors
* MEP Consultants, PMC
* Site Contractors and Commissioning Teams
* Procurement, Finance, EHS, and Quality Teams
* Customers, Developers, and Facility Stakeholders

**Typical KPIs**

* On-time completion of HVAC/cooling/Chiller project milestones
* Budget adherence for mechanical scope
* Safety performance and zero incident execution
* First-time-right installation and commissioning quality
* Cooling system reliability at handover
* Defect and punch-point closure on schedule
* Documentation completeness and handover quality
* Customer satisfaction and operational readiness

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

description:

Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1 billion in committed capital.

Our mission is to bridge the digital divide across Asia Pacific by building the sustainable digital ecosystems of the future. Through building and operating state-of-the-art, energy efficient data centers rich with connectivity options, we bring new colocation and interconnect options to the Asian market, making digital infrastructure deployment in the region easy, efficient, and economical.

Founded in 2020 the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across China, India, Indonesia, Japan, Korea, and the Philippines. This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

**Our values:**

* **Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.**
* **Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.**
* **Strive: We are driven and determined.**
* **Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.**
* **Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.**

**About the role:**

Reporting to the Construction Manager, this role will lead and manage the civil works component related to a largescale Data Center project, involving methodical planning, and staging of execution works and multifaceted management of risk, safety, quality, contract administration and detailed progress reporting.

This role will be project based at Project Site, Thane, Mumbai.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Construction**

* Program: phasing/staging, construction activity sequencing, contractor/subcontractor interface and coordination, detailed programming of all construction activities from commencement to completion, including daily and weekly planning.
* Quality: administering the quality management system and ensuring procedural systems are transcending and adhered to throughout ground level operations to enable uniformity of construction methodology and achievement of leading industry standards on building quality. Making sure that all the Method statements and procedures are followed.
* Safety: Administering and ensuring adherence to the safety management system. Active participation and management in audits, safety meetings, campaigns, and training workshops.
* Trade Workfront Management: On-site operational organization of contractors and subcontractors work front, resource deployment, equipment and machinery provision, short term planning, on and off-site logistics coordination.
* Maintain accurate documentation, reporting site progress and addressing on site challenges.
* Coordinating MEP contractors for civil works.

**Design Coordination and Interface**

* Make sure that all the RCC and finishing works are executed as per the issued drawings.

**Quality, Safety and Environment Management**
