title: Senior Manager – Semiconductor Cleanroom Infrastructure & Operations
description:
**Role Overview**

The Senior Manager, ARL Cleanroom Infrastructure is a hands-on operational role responsible for the physical setup, commissioning, and day-to-day excellence of the ARL cleanroom. Working closely with outside vendors, particularly NICOMAC, this in-house consultant manages the bring-up phase, ensuring equipment installation, safety compliance, and vendor coordination are executed flawlessly.

**Why This Role Matters**

The successful bring-up of the ARL cleanroom is critical to our infrastructure roadmap. The Senior Manager is the on-the-ground driver who turns facility plans into operational reality, ensuring cleanrooms are built to spec, vendors deliver on time, and the facility meets required standards. Without focused execution at this level, the facility setup and integration stalls.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Vendor Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong, on-the-ground relationships with external cleanroom construction vendors, specifically NICOMAC, as well as global equipment vendors.
* Coordinate with vendors for AMC negotiations, spare parts prioritization, and service escalations to ensure the cleanroom remains operational.
* Act as the primary on-site manager for vendor contracts, ensuring all agreements remain cost-effective and meet performance-backed metrics.
* Engage operationally with institutional partners and industry collaborators to sustain facility capabilities during the bring-up phase.
* Help benchmark the ARL facility's operational performance against top-tier institutions and national networks to ensure it meets required standards.

**ARL Cleanroom Bring-Up & Facility Setup**

* Directly manage the day-to-day physical setup, commissioning, and bring-up of the ARL cleanroom in close collaboration with outside vendors like NICOMAC.
* Integrate the new ARL cleanroom capabilities with existing facility assets (such as existing nanofabrication or packaging labs) to create a seamless, multi-purpose environment.
* Execute cleanroom equipment procurement and installation on the floor with precision.
* Strictly manage setup timelines, handle daily vendor coordination, and ensure absolute compliance with EHS (Environmental, Health, and Safety) standards for hazardous materials.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related semiconductor discipline.
* Strong hands-on experience managing semiconductor fabrication facilities, cleanroom setups, or equivalent R&D infrastructure.
* Demonstrated track record in vendor negotiations, AMC management, and EHS compliance for nanofabrication environments.
* Prior experience coordinating with construction vendors (like NICOMAC) and equipment suppliers.
* Proven ability to manage timelines, budgets, and operational setups in a cleanroom context.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
  
  
We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. , you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
  
  

* Lead and guide the Project Controls team for Schedule and Cost function on the Project.
* Work with Project leadership team in alignment and strategic discussions on the project.

* Lead and develop the Progress measurement system for the project based on the contractual reporting requirements and processes.

* Interact with Project and department stakeholders in functional discussions and support required in delivering the Projects assigned.

* Invoicing, preparing Cash flow and presenting in the APEX monthly level meeting.
* Daily/Weekly/Monthly reports.
* Attend Internal and Client review meetings as required to present the Project performance, concerns, and recovery plans etc.

* Tertiary qualifications in Graduate in Engineering/Technology.
* 12+ years of experience in Working for similar type Projects/Industry experience.
* Proven leadership and communication skills
* Extensive experience in Oil & Gas, energy sector & Chemicals.
* Sound knowledge of Planning, Cost control and Monitoring.
* A dedication to client satisfaction
* Excellent relationship building and stakeholder management skills.
* You will be an enthusiastic team player, with excellent stakeholder management skills.
* Proactive thinking and solution-oriented delivery.

**Moving forward together**
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
  
  
We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
  
  
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
  
  
Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

The MSDA plays a critical role in enabling scale across the Managed Services organization by delivering the operational structure, discipline, and insights required for high-quality service delivery.

**Service Delivery Coordination**

* Track milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and action items.
* Facilitate cross-functional communication between Customer Success, Delivery, Operations, and technical teams.
* Support execution of service-management processes and operational standards.
* Maintain visibility into service-delivery progress and operational priorities.

**Onboarding & Operational Readiness**

* Coordinate onboarding activities for new Managed Services customers.
* Track onboarding milestones, dependencies, and readiness requirements.
* Support transition activities between Sales, Professional Services, Delivery, and Managed Services teams.
* Ensure required documentation, access, communications, and operational processes are established before service launch.

* Produce recurring operational reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.
* Prepare materials for governance reviews, service reviews, and leadership reporting.
* Analyze service-delivery trends, KPI performance, utilization, and operational health indicators.

* Support access governance, audit activities, compliance reviews, and operational controls.
* Coordinate documentation updates and process adherence across internal stakeholders.

description:

The company executes large-scale and complex projects across the country, including railway stations, residential buildings, road and foot over bridges, railway yards, car sheds, track laying, earthworks, and railway bridges. GIRIRAJ collaborates with major national organisations such as Indian Railways, multiple zonal railways, the National Highway Authority of India, and key municipal and infrastructure bodies, reflecting its strong industry reputation. The company’s mission is to redefine infrastructure development through advanced technology, innovation, and world-class management practices, with a vision to become a global leader in civil infrastructure. **Industry:**
Railway / Metro Rail / Infrastructure projects

**Department:**
Project Planning & Controls

**Work Location:**
Head Office (Mumbai)

**Reporting To:**
Project Director/MD

**Experience:**
5–10 Years (preferably in railway projects)

**1.    Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced project controls engineer with a strong background in railway and metro rail projects to manage project planning, scheduling, progress monitoring, cost control, and reporting activities from the head office. The candidate will coordinate with project sites, project managers, contractors, consultants, and other departments to ensure timely project execution, effective cost management, and compliance with project milestones.

**2.    Key Responsibilities**

**a.     Project Planning & Scheduling**

**i.**
Develop and maintain detailed project schedules for railway infrastructure projects.

**ii.**
Prepare baseline schedules, milestone charts, work breakdown structures (WBS), and project execution plans using MSP/Primavera P6.

**iii.**
Monitor project progress against client-approved schedules and identify delays and critical activities.

**iv.**
Review and consolidate project schedules received from various project sites for preparing look ahead plans.

**b.    Project Monitoring & Control**

**i.**
Monitor physical and financial progress across multiple projects on a weekly/monthly basis.

**ii.**
Compare actual progress against planned progress and evaluate delay analysis and schedule variances.
**iii.**
Identify critical path activities, slippages, and potential bottlenecks and anticipate the scheduled work accordingly.

**c.   Cost Control & Budget Monitoring**

**i.**
Monitor project budgets, actual expenditure, commitments, and cost forecasts.

**ii.**
Prepare cost variance reports and support project cost optimisation.

**iii.**
Coordinate with finance, procurement, and project teams for budget updates.

**iv**
Track billing progress, work orders, and cost-related project documentation, wherever applicable.

**d.  ERP & Management Reporting**

**i.**
Prepare weekly and monthly project progress reports for Head Office management.

**ii.**
Develop project dashboards, progress charts, and performance reports using MS Excel and ERP.

**iii.**
Present project status, risks, delays, and action plans to senior management.

**e.   Railway Project Coordination**

**i. Coordinate**
with site teams handling civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and other railway infrastructure works, as applicable.

**ii.**
Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and relevant railway authorities through the designated project teams.

**iii.**
Monitor procurement schedules, material availability, approvals, and interface dependencies affecting project execution.

**iv. Track**
project risks, change requests, variations, and extension-of-time issues in coordination with the commercial and contracts teams.

**3.    Educational Qualifications**

**a.**
PG, MBA/Bachelor's degree or diploma in the civil and construction engineering discipline only.

**b.**
Relevant qualifications in project planning, project controls, or project management will be an added advantage.

**4.    Required Experience & Technical Skills**

**a.**
5–10 years of relevant experience in railway, metro rail, railway infrastructure, or related EPC projects.

**b.**
Prior experience in Head Office project monitoring, planning, scheduling is preferred.

**c.**
Proficiency in Primavera P6/MSP and MS Excel is essential.

**d.**
Understanding of railway project execution, contractual milestones, progress measurement, and project reporting.

**5.    Key Competencies.**

**a.**
Strong analytical and project monitoring and coordination skills.

**b.**
Ability to analyse project delays and recommend corrective measures.

**c.**
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**d.**
Ability to manage multiple projects and meet reporting deadlines.

title: Construction Project Manager [AI & Automation]
description:
Location: Remote, India (flexible hours with U.S. team overlap)
  
  
Engagement type: Full-time
  
  
Compensation: INR 2,38,250 - INR 2,85,900 per month (based on experience and interview process)
  
  
**About Sanctuary**
Sanctuary builds nature - led, wellness - centered communities that feel alive. Our first 135-acre residential community in the Texas Hill Country is designed with:
  
  
🌱 Non-toxic materials
  
  
💧 Clean water and filtration systems
  
  
⚡ EMF-conscious design
  
  
🌿 135 acres of preserved land and eco - sensitive planning
  
  
We are a global team (spread across 8 countries) of designers, architects, engineers, and dreamers building spaces that restore and inspire. For us, it’s not just where people live - it’s how they live.
  
  
Our vision is to bring Sanctuary to major cities around the world: healthy, sovereign communities that sit on the edges of every modern metropolis.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring a Construction Project Manager who builds with AI. You understand how construction projects run - schedules, budgets, contractors, and site realities - and you use AI and automation tools to run them faster and smarter. Internally, we call this role a "Construction VibeKid": someone who can vibe code the tools a project needs instead of waiting for someone else to build them.
  
  
You don't need to be a traditional site engineer, and you don't need to be a software developer. You need to sit in the middle: someone who knows construction project management well enough to spot what's slowing a project down, and is hands-on enough with AI tools to build the fix - a scheduling tracker, an automated report, a contractor dashboard, or a workflow that saves the team hours every week.
  
  
This is not a role for someone who needs close oversight or a fixed toolset. We are looking for someone curious, resourceful, and quick to experiment - who can take a messy process, figure out what's missing, and ship a working solution.
  
  
****What you'll do****
*Construction project management*

* Plan and track construction schedules, milestones, and budgets across our projects
* Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, and consultants to keep work on time and on budget
* Track progress, flag risks and delays early, and drive issues to resolution
* Work closely with our architecture, procurement, and construction teams in India and the U.S.

*AI and automation*

* Use AI and automation tools to streamline scheduling, budgeting, reporting, and contractor coordination
* Build internal tools, dashboards, and workflows using AI-assisted ("vibe") coding and no-code platforms
* Automate repetitive tasks such as progress reports, cost tracking, RFIs, and status updates
* Stay on top of new AI tools for construction and test what could work for us

*Reporting and communication*

* Produce clear, regular project reports for leadership - ideally automated
* Keep schedules, budgets, and project data accurate and in one place
* Explain technical tools and project status simply to both construction and non-technical teammates

****What you bring****

* 3-7 years of experience in construction project management, project controls, or planning
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field preferred
* Solid understanding of construction processes, scheduling, budgeting, and contractor coordination
* Hands-on experience building tools or automations with AI (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Replit) or no-code platforms (e.g. Zapier, Make, Airtable)
* Examples of tools, dashboards, or automations you've built - please share them when you apply
* Strong Google Sheets skills; familiarity with project management tools (e.g. ClickUp, Procore, MS Project, Primavera) is a plus
* Experience on U.S. residential construction projects is a must
* Comfortable operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving, remote, cross-cultural environment

****Hiring process****

* Stage 1: Intro interview Role alignment, experience overview, a walkthrough of tools you've built, and culture fit
* Stage 2: Test task A short practical assignment: use AI tools to solve a real construction project problem
* Stage 3: Final interview Deep dive into workflows, expectations, and growth

title: Critical Projects Manager, Critical Projects Implementation
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The Critical Projects Implementation (CPI) team in Amazon Data Services, India is a project management and execution team that manages construction activity within operational data center spaces. The CPI team is tasked with critical infrastructure improvement projects to optimize utilization of space, power, and cooling within live data centers in India. These activities are outside of the scope of standard construction delivery and regular preventative maintenance tasks.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Data Center Project Manager in AWS to serve as a technical resource within Amazon data centers in India. You will be part of a highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating challenges in designing, building, and operating Amazon data facilities in India.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
The Project Manager is ultimately responsible for project oversight and review of all disciplines including electrical, mechanical, controls, and architectural. A fundamental understanding of these systems is required, as the individual will be expected to identify areas for improvement as well as act on data provided from other team and organizations. Ideal candidates will possess the ability to design, develop and deploy innovative solutions to address operational challenges. This role requires both independent contribution as well as the ability to work within multi-disciplinary teams. The scope of projects will include but not limited to the improvement of electrical, mechanical, fire detection and building automation system.
  
  
The Project Manager is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, implementation, execution, control and completion of specific projects ensuring consistency with company strategy, commitments and goals.
  
  
If you are passionate about the Customer Experience; you think big; and you want to contribute to the operational excellence of Amazon data centers then this may be the challenge you’ve been looking for!
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors a Women's Leadership Program that supports the growth and development of female builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* 4+ years of relevant work in a data center or other critical environment experience
* 3+ years of vendor management experience
* Experience with Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of construction or project management experience

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. At IDfy, a great product only creates value when it actually lands - deployed, adopted, and working in the real world. If you've ever wanted to turn delivery puzzles into product wins - this is your playground.

title: Associate - Program Management
description:
**Job Description**
We are modernizing Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting, moving from legacy reporting platforms to a Databricks Lakehouse-based architecture and introducing artificial intelligence-enabled ways of working. We are hiring a hands-on Product Owner / Business Analyst who combines strong regulatory reporting and data analysis experience with a modern technology mindset. You will work across Finance, Technology, and vendor teams to translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions. The ideal candidate can understand the business problem, work through the data, translate requirements into technology delivery, test the outcome, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. To accelerate delivery and improve accuracy, the role leverages agentic artificial intelligence tools while maintaining strong human-in-the-loop controls and review discipline.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As an Associate in Program Management within Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting Modernization, you will own requirements delivery end-to-end—spanning regulatory change, business growth, general ledger optimization, technology modernization, and global alignment in data sourcing and consumption. You will partner closely with Asia Pacific Finance stakeholders (Senior Financial Officers, Legal Entity Controllers), Corporate Technology, and vendor consultants to deliver strategic reporting solutions, operate governance, and ensure high-quality, regulator-ready outputs. You will translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions and drive clear stakeholder communications. You will leverage agentic artificial intelligence tooling to support requirements extraction, impact assessment, test design, validation, and stakeholder-ready narratives, with strong review discipline.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Own product vision and roadmap, intake, prioritization, and change control; maintain the backlog (epics, features, user stories), define minimum viable products, sequence delivery, and drive trade-offs across regulatory change versus modernization.
* Drive delivery governance cadence by preparing committee materials and providing clear, concise stakeholder communications.
* Translate regulatory circulars and business rules into business requirements documentation, impact assessments, functional specifications, and Jira epics and stories.
* Perform impact assessments for upstream system changes and data sourcing changes; define scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with Finance users, Corporate Technology, and vendor teams to align the operating model and delivery approach.
* Define and implement Medallion-layer reporting logic and controls across Bronze (raw and audit-preserving), Silver (standardize, deduplicate, join), and Gold (regulator-ready rules and submission aggregations).
* Own end-to-end lineage from Gold to Silver to Bronze to source using Unity Catalog.
* Implement validation controls and pre-submission quality gates, including anomaly and outlier detection.
* Define the testing approach, scope, and plan; lead user acceptance testing with Finance and Technology.
* Build test cases and expected results; execute end-to-end tests (including automated tools where applicable), identify issues early, propose mitigations, drive timely closure, and continuously improve processes and controls.
* Use agent workflows (for example, GitHub Copilot and Databricks Genie) to accelerate requirements extraction, mapping logic, rule definition, expected-result creation, and validation; perform structured reviews to ensure outputs are accurate, explainable, and governance-ready (impact summaries, control narratives, committee-ready materials).

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Accountancy, Information Systems, or related field.
* 5+ years of overall Product Owner / Business Analyst experience, including 3+ years delivering Asia Pacific local regulatory reporting automation for a foreign bank.
* Proven delivery and project management experience in Finance Regulatory Reporting automation.
* Strong data analysis skills to gather and validate facts, define gaps, perform impact analysis, draft requirements, and translate complex needs into functional specifications.
* Strong communication skills to articulate complex issues clearly to senior stakeholders and produce concise written updates and governance-ready materials.
* Strong planning and time management; ability to handle multiple assignments under deadlines with proactive risk and issue management.
* Collaborative and solution-focused approach; ability to challenge the status quo constructively.
* Practical prompt engineering to drive repeatable outputs (impact assessments, mapping rules, test scenarios, defect triage summaries, stakeholder narratives).
* Ability to review and validate artificial intelligence-generated outputs against source regulatory text, control rules, and expected results (human-in-the-loop).
* Comfort using Visual Studio Code with GitHub Copilot (including Agent Mode) to accelerate requirements and test asset creation while maintaining governance standards.
* Hands-on or working familiarity with Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, Agile backlog tooling (Jira and Confluence), and regulatory reporting vendor platforms (Nasdaq Axiom/Adenza, Wolters Kluwer, Reveleus, Resoft).

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Databricks Certified Data Analyst Associate or Data Engineer Associate (or Generative AI Engineer Associate).
* GitHub certification (for example, GitHub Foundations or GitHub Actions) and/or formal Copilot training or enablement.
* Substitution: 2+ years of production, hands-on experience delivering end-to-end business requirements or testing using Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, and GitHub Copilot Agent Mode in banking.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
  
  
Netflix India's Series team is expanding its scripted slate. As Coordinator, you will support Production Management across multiple series, from development to delivery. You will be the day-to-day link between Netflix teams and our Production House partners, keeping creative intent, budgets, schedules and delivery aligned.
  
  
**THE ROLE**
This is a fast-moving role for someone organized, thorough and quick to exercise judgment. You will run day-to-day production workflows across multiple projects, anticipate risks, and work with senior internal and external stakeholders to find practical solutions. As the main point of contact between Netflix teams and Production Houses, you will keep creative intent, schedules, budgets and delivery aligned.

**Budgets and cost**

* Break down and review series budgets and schedules with EPs, Line Producers and production companies, using market-rate benchmarks to flag savings and risks.
* Track spend against approved budgets with Production Finance. Flag variances early and recommend mitigations.
* Review scripts for feasibility and cost. Recommend production approaches such as location and scheduling strategy, crew structure and block shooting.

**Driving alignment**

* Keep projects moving when scripts, scope or approvals are unsettled. Set out the options and trade-offs, make a recommendation, and help Creative, Finance, Business & Legal Affairs reach a decision.
* Escalate early when creative ambition, budget and schedule conflict. Communicate changes clearly to all stakeholders.

**Slate and delivery**

* Maintain slate timelines and make dependencies visible across Creative, Production Finance, Business & Legal Affairs, Post and Music.

1. Position Details

Department: Operations / Project Execution  |  Reports to: Operations Manager / Head – Operations  |  Location: As assigned

Interfaces: Customer Service, PPC, Procurement, Quality, Finance; manufacturing vendors, fabricators, transporters and installation agencies.

2. Job Summary

Responsible for end-to-end execution of assigned offline branding projects: planning, in-house/outsourced manufacturing coordination, quality, logistics, installation and closure. Ensure delivery to approved specifications, timelines and budgets, coordinating multiple vendors and projects across locations.

3–5. Key Result Areas, Duty Statements and Performance Standards

**1. Project Planning and Scheduling**

**Duties:**
Validate confirmed orders, drawings, quantities, sites and deadlines; prepare milestones, resource plans, risk contingencies and daily execution tracking with PPC and Procurement.

**Standards:**
Execution plans for 100% of projects; ≥95% schedule adherence; immediate escalation of critical delays.

**2. In-house / Outsourced Manufacturing and Vendor Coordination**

**Duties:**
Issue approved job requirements to manufacturing/fabrication vendors; verify materials and production readiness; monitor progress and vendor performance; support Procurement in vendor reviews.

**Standards:**
100% authorized work orders/POs; vendor acknowledgement of specifications and dates; ≥95% vendor on-time delivery; daily monitoring of critical jobs.

**3. Quality Assurance and Technical Compliance**

**Duties:**
Check materials, dimensions, printing, finishing and workmanship against approved specifications; coordinate in-process/pre-dispatch inspections; rectify defects and track CAPA.

**Standards:**
100% compliance at designated critical inspection points; ≥98% first-time quality acceptance; no dispatch with unresolved critical defects.

**4. Logistics, Dispatch and Installation**

**Duties:**
Plan packing, dispatch, transport and site installation; check quantities, labels and site readiness; coordinate safe execution; obtain proof of delivery and completion photographs/reports.

**Standards:**
≥95% on-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery; 100% dispatch documentation; site observations closed within agreed timelines; minimize damages/shortages.

**5. Project Cost Control**

**Duties:**
Monitor production, logistics, installation and incidental expenses against approved budgets; flag overruns; secure prior approvals; reduce rework, waste and emergency costs.

**Standards:**
Projects within approved budgets; zero unauthorized expenditure; final cost closure within 3 working days, subject to vendor invoices/records.

**6. Project MIS and Documentation**

**Duties:**
Maintain project trackers, critical-job progress reports, vendor commitments, dispatch/installation status, action logs and project closure records; attend weekly reviews.

**Standards:**
Current trackers and timely MIS; 100% traceability of POs, dispatch and installation records; assigned actions tracked to closure.

**7. Risk Management and Customer Support**

**Duties:**
Identify vendor, production, transport and site risks; solve issues within authority; coordinate changes and concerns with Customer Service; investigate repeat failures and develop alternatives.

**Standards:**
Escalate critical risks the same working day; maintain risk register for major projects; implement corrective actions by agreed dates.

**8. Productivity, Improvement and Discipline**

**Duties:**
Improve workflows and vendor productivity; standardize records; reduce delays, wastage and rework; comply with SOPs, quality and financial controls.

**Standards:**
Full SOP/approval compliance; at least two improvement initiatives annually; measurable cost/rework reduction where feasible.

6. Job Factors

Technical / functional skills: Advanced project execution, vendor follow-up, POSM/signage/printing knowledge, quality inspection, logistics/installation, problem-solving, Excel/MIS and team coordination; intermediate–advanced outsourced manufacturing management and cost/budget control.

Experience: Operations Executive—2–4 years (preferably 1–2 in relevant industry), assigned jobs under supervision, routine vendor follow-up and cost reporting. Assistant Manager—5–7 years (preferably 3+ in industry), multiple projects independently, vendor issue resolution, budget variance control and possible supervision of coordinators/site teams.

Preferred sectors: Offline branding, POSM, signage, printing, fabrication, visual merchandising, retail branding, logistics or installation.

Education: Diploma/degree in Mechanical, Production or Industrial Engineering, Operations Management or related field; relevant experienced graduates considered. Project, Quality or Supply Chain certification advantageous.

Behavioural competencies: Ownership, accountability, urgency, analytical thinking, cost consciousness, accuracy, discipline, teamwork and resilience under pressure.

title: Continuous Improvement & Transformation Consultant
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Job Overview**
This role would lead strategic and tactical initiatives related to continuous improvement and service excellence for the Global Shared services (GSS) team spread across geographies/locations. This role would own the setup of service excellence metrics, driving CI culture using innovative techniques, deployment of Lean methodologies and build process improvement capabilities within the GSS team by conducting training and facilitation sessions.
  
  
This role would enable leadership to implement site-wide CI initiatives, setting up and rolling out new frameworks, approaches and providing inputs on thought leadership.
  
  
**Job Accountabilities**

* Support GSS extended leadership team in executing the service excellence strategy and framework
* Assist with prioritization of process improvement opportunities and ensuring clear ownership and delivery of improvements
* Collaborate with global stakeholders for implementing initiatives that drive value
* Deep dive into current business practices and processes to identify improvement opportunities
* Lead/drive improvement initiatives such as facilitating/conducting Value Stream Mapping (VSM) sessions, present and future state process design, improvement of key metrices
* Read and interpret SAP Signavio process-mining outputs like process discovery, variant analysis, bottleneck and rework identification, conformance checks, throughput and cycle-time views to baseline current state, validate VSM findings with system evidence, and size opportunities
* Build, structure and maintain end-to-end process models in SAP Signavio Process Manager (BPMN 2.0), including current-state and future-state models, process hierarchy and levelling, naming and modelling conventions, and linkage of models to KPIs, controls and process owners
* Train employees on CI fundamentals & methods to identify and implement process improvement initiatives
* Coach process owners and teams on reading Signavio process models so they are self-dependant on process mapping and insight is interpreted and acted on without dependence on the CI team
* Work collaboratively with global teams to develop and implement ideas that drive business value
* Lead Lean initiatives to eliminate waste, standardize processes/practices, develop action plans to achieve service excellence and customer satisfaction
* Help teams in setting up and standardize operational, service owner and business outcome metrics
* Ensure improved and standardized processes are reflected as governed, published Signavio models that serve as the single source of truth for the process
* Track, validate & report cost savings post implementation of improvement initiatives, implement site-wide CI initiatives, setting up and rolling out new frameworks
* Use Signavio process-mining views to evidence baseline versus post-implementation performance and confirm improvements are sustained

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATION**

* Minimum Degree Requirements: Bachelors
* Minimum years of related experience required: 8
* Minimum relevant SAP Signavio experience required: 2 years, gained alongside a core continuous improvement or process excellence role
* Required Professional Certifications: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt from a reputed institute like ASQ, ISI etc.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Preferred Degree Requirements: Masters
* Preferred Major Area of Study: Shared Service Operations / Quantitative Background
* Preferred Professional Certifications: Lean Practitioner certification, SAP Signavio certification (Process Manager / Process Intelligence)
* Preferred years of related experience: 10

**Specific Skills Needed**
**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio and Minitab
* Experience in SharePoint
* Lean & Continuous improvement methodology & tools
* Project management principles
* SAP Signavio Process Manager (expert): demonstrated hands-on process modelling in BPMN 2.0 — building and governing multi-level end-to-end process models, applying modelling standards and conventions, managing dictionary/glossary objects, versioning, review and publishing workflows, and collaboration with process owners on model sign-off

**Soft Skills**

* Good Verbal & Written Communication
* Analytical thinking
* Interpersonal skills – ability to communicate effectively across all levels & in a multi-culture environment
* Ability to influence
* Problem-solving mindset
* Fast decision making
* Ability to prioritize & manage time

**Additional Requirements**

* Certified on and hands-on with continuous improvement tools, including deploying Lean methodology, conducting VSMs for medium to large projects/initiatives, change management, knowledgeable of best-in-class industry benchmarks for service performance management
* Demonstrated experience in Project Management (Medium and Large projects)
* Able to connect process-mining evidence to Lean problem solving — using data to confirm or challenge what a VSM or Gemba walk suggests
* Individual Contributor role

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Client Servicing Manager
description:
**Interested Candidates - Please send cv on 7249472569 - please read JD before sending! Only Mumbai Candidates, we are looking for candidates from the operations of beauty brands (Nyka etc)**

Role Summary

Serve as the single point of contact for assigned customers, ensuring requirements are understood, documented and coordinated from enquiry and approved quotation through order confirmation, execution, delivery, invoicing support and complaint closure. Build customer confidence through responsiveness, accuracy and reliable service. Account growth, revenue and profitability targets remain with the Key Account Manager (KAM).

Key Result Areas | Duties and Performance Standards

**1. Customer Relationship Management**

**Duties:**
Act as primary day-to-day contact; understand campaign needs; maintain customer communication and meeting records; coordinate complaint resolution and flag additional requirements to KAM.

**Standards:**
Acknowledge enquiries within 4 working hours; monthly key-customer reviews; customer satisfaction target ≥90%; resolve complaints within agreed service levels.

**2. Customer Enquiry, Quotation and Order Management**

**Duties:**
Register enquiries; obtain complete specifications, quantities, artwork, sites and delivery requirements; coordinate costing and feasibility; submit authorized quotations; verify purchase orders and customer approvals.

**Standards:**
100% enquiry registration and documented approvals; standard quotation turnaround 24–48 working hours when inputs are complete; ≥98% order-document accuracy; no unauthorized order release.

**3. Order Handover and Internal Coordination**

**Duties:**
Prepare standard handover to Operations with specifications, timelines and site requirements; obtain acceptance; coordinate with PPC/Procurement; document changes and escalate risks.

**Standards:**
100% checklist-based handovers; daily active-order review; commercially assess changes before implementation; critical deviations escalated the same working day.

**4. Delivery Commitments and Service Performance**

**Duties:**
Track milestones and customer commitments; communicate progress and foreseeable delays; obtain required customer approvals; coordinate closure of shortages, installation issues and complaints.

**Standards:**
Target ≥95% on-time fulfilment; weekly pending-order reviews; documented delivery/installation confirmation; 100% complaint closure within agreed service levels.

**5. Invoicing Support and Commercial Discipline**

**Duties:**
Provide Finance with job completion and billing documents; check PO and billing details; assist invoice processing, billing-dispute resolution and overdue-payment follow-up; refer commercial decisions to KAM/Finance.

**Standards:**
Submit complete billing documents within 2 working days of completion or milestone; accurate billing instructions; weekly outstanding review; zero unauthorized commercial commitments.

**6. MIS, Records and Process Compliance**

**Duties:**
Maintain enquiry, quotation, order, approval, complaint and customer meeting records; report delays, pending approvals and exceptions; participate in weekly project reviews.

**Standards:**
Timely, accurate weekly MIS; 100% traceability of orders and approvals; updated customer records; compliance with SOPs and authorization procedures.

**7. Cross-functional Teamwork and Improvement**

**Duties:**
Coordinate with Operations, PPC, Procurement and Finance; support root-cause analysis, corrective actions, customer feedback sharing and coaching of junior colleagues.

**Standards:**
Attend reviews; close assigned corrective actions on time; reduce recurring service failures; implement at least two service improvements annually.

Job Factors

**Core skills:**
Advanced customer relationship management, communication, negotiation, complaint resolution, project coordination, problem-solving, prioritization, Excel/MIS and cross-functional teamwork; working knowledge of costing, POSM, signage and printing.

**Experience:**
5–8 years in client servicing, account coordination or project coordination; preferably 3+ years in offline branding, POSM, signage, printing, advertising production or visual merchandising. Corporate customer and multi-project experience desirable.

**Education:**
Graduate in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing or related discipline; MBA/PG Diploma preferred. Relevant industry experience may substitute for postgraduate study.

**Behavioural attributes:**
Customer orientation, ownership, integrity, responsiveness, accuracy, teamwork, sound commercial judgment and ability to work under pressure.

* **Role boundary:**
  CSM owns service quality, order accuracy, coordination and documentation. KAM owns account revenue growth, commercial negotiations and profitability; Operations owns physical project execution.

title: Sr. Project Manager, AWS Data Center Capacity Delivery
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The Sr. Construction / Project Manager (CM) for APJC Construction in the Data Center Capacity Delivery (DCCD) organization is responsible for the construction of data center builds. The CM typically works on all phases of a data center construction project, including site development, shell construction, and phase fit-outs. They are responsible for the safety, cost, quality, and delivery performance of their build. They often need to engage with stakeholders to manage changes and react in a timely manner to unexpected situations.
  
  
In this offered role, the Sr. CM works independently to deliver capacity within their cluster with limited guidance and is expected to deliver Data center full builds including multiple full shells, with multiple ROMPs and Sub stations. Works with internal and external stakeholders including Design Engineering, Environmental, Technical Infrastructure Program Management, Power & Cooling, Procurement, Real Estate, Legal, Security, Finance, Commissioning, Controls, Energy, and Infra Operations. Is fully responsible for delivering assigned construction builds within the approved budget, and defines construction Build budgets by gathering requirements and individual site data, and securing the budget approval and funding required to complete the construction builds. Clearly communicates construction constraints to the project team, drives design reviews and changes, and manages construction general contractors to complete all aspects of a DC build per provided designs and specifications, and/or manages individual construction Builds to specifications. Delivers infrastructure build projects to defined cost, time, and quality measures and contributes to the development of these measures. Identifies and mitigates risks and issues on assigned construction Builds. Documents construction issues in standard reporting tools and complies with the project change control process.
  
  
The Data Center Construction Manager (CM) of Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL), the local data center entity in India, is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced construction project schedules achievable. Amazon Construction Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient data centers in the world.
  
  
**About The Team**
As a Data Center Sr. Project Manager / Construction Manager of ADSIPL you will be a part of highly creative, action oriented, efficient team tasked with building Amazon data facilities in India of world class standards. The person will be part of the Construction Management team for AWS Data Centers in India. This team is part of the overall Data Center Capacity Delivery (DCCD) team for APJC (Asia Pacific, Japan, China) region of which India is a part. The team is led by an India Construction Management lead with two construction cluster /zones – Mumbai and Hyderabad. Each region is led by a Regional Construction Manager who has a team of Construction managers who plan and execute the respective Data Center projects. This role will report directly into the BOM (Mumbai) construction cluster manager.
  
  
**About AWS**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil Engineering, or a similar technical discipline
* 10+ years of design, construction or program management in mission critical facilities experience
* Experience reading and interpreting construction drawings and specifications, or experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
* Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
* Experience defining data center system-level architecture, specifying/documenting performance and equipment requirements to vendors and contractors, communicating conceptual designs, and creating/maintaining project documentation before, during and after construction

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in construction management or construction program management of large, complex projects involving large-scale mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) plants
* Experience directly related to the design or construction of large data center facilities, either colocation or client owned/operated
* Experience managing and negotiating contracts and vendor relationships
* Experience leading large, fast-moving projects
* Knowledge of Indian as well as state building codes and regulations including Fire Codes, Building Codes, Energy Efficiency Codes, Sanitary Codes and Safety Codes
* Experience with large scale mechanical and power systems

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Job Description**

**Project Manager – Data Centre Cooling / HVAC / Chillers**

**Job Summary**

The Project Manager – Data Centre Cooling / HVAC / Chillers is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and delivery of mission-critical cooling infrastructure projects for data centres. This role focuses on HVAC plants, chiller systems, precision cooling, chilled water networks, controls integration, and related mechanical infrastructure to ensure high availability, energy efficiency, and compliance with project, safety, and quality requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution of data centre cooling and HVAC chiller projects, from design review through commissioning and handover.
* Manage projects involving chillers, CRAH/CRAC/Fan wall units, Liquid cooling, CDU units chilled water systems, condenser water systems, pumps, cooling towers or dry coolers, piping networks, valves, insulation, and controls.
* Coordinate with design consultants, MEP teams, OEMs, controls teams, contractors, and data centre operations stakeholders.
* Review mechanical and HVAC design drawings, equipment layouts, P&IDs, technical specifications, BOQs, and method statements.
* Oversee installation, testing, balancing, flushing, pressure testing, commissioning, and integrated system validation of cooling systems.
* Ensure proper sequencing and execution in live or partially live mission-critical environments with minimal operational risk.
* Manage interfaces between HVAC/mechanical systems and electrical, BMS, EPMS, fire protection, and building management systems.
* Track project scope, cost, timelines, risks, change orders, and contractor performance.
* Drive vendor and contractor alignment on equipment delivery, installation quality, commissioning readiness, and defect closure.
* Ensure compliance with EHS standards, statutory requirements, site safety rules, and company policies.
* Support energy-efficient design and execution practices, including optimization of plant performance, redundancy, and reliability.
* Prepare and present project reviews, site progress updates, risk registers, and executive status reports.
* Lead project closeout activities, including as-built documentation, O&M manuals, training, snag closure, and final handover.

**Key Deliverables**

* Project execution plan for cooling/HVAC/Chillers scope
* Detailed project schedule and milestone tracker
* Mechanical scope tracker and interface matrix
* Equipment and material delivery tracker
* Installation and commissioning readiness reports
* Risk and mitigation register
* Testing, balancing, and commissioning documentation
* As-built drawings and O&M documentation
* Handover and project closure reports

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline.
* Project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is preferred.
* Additional certifications in HVAC, chiller systems, data centre design, commissioning, or EHS are advantageous.

**Experience**

* Typically 8–15 years of experience in HVAC/mechanical project execution, with strong exposure to mission-critical or data centre environments.
* Proven experience delivering projects involving central chiller plants, precision cooling systems, chilled water distribution, and mechanical infrastructure.
* Experience working with live critical facilities, high-availability environments, or phased retrofit/upgrade projects is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to data centre cooling standards, redundancy concepts, and uptime/reliability expectations is desirable.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Chiller systems and plant design
* Precision air conditioning and data hall cooling
* CRAH/CRAC/Fan wall unit / CDU/ Liquid cooling systems
* Chilled water and condenser water systems
* Pumps, AHUs, piping, valves, and heat exchangers
* Cooling towers, dry coolers, and related auxiliaries
* HVAC controls, BMS, and integrated monitoring
* Data centre Testing and commissioning procedures
* Energy efficiency, load calculations, and plant optimization
* Mechanical system redundancy and resilience in mission-critical environments

**Required Skills**

* Project planning and execution
* Contractor and vendor management
* Technical review of HVAC/mechanical submissions
* Cost and budget control
* Risk identification and mitigation
* Commissioning coordination
* Stakeholder communication
* Problem-solving in critical operating environments
* Schedule tracking and reporting
* Change management and commercial coordination

**Preferred Competencies**

* Strong understanding of mission-critical cooling reliability
* Ability to manage shutdowns, tie-ins, and retrofit works in live sites
* Strong ownership and execution discipline
* Detail-oriented approach to quality and commissioning
* Good cross-functional coordination skills
* Ability to balance technical, operational, and commercial priorities

**Working Relationships**

* Data Centre Operations Team
* Mechanical/HVAC Engineering Team
* Electrical and Controls Teams
* BMS/EPMS Integrators
* OEMs and Equipment Vendors
* MEP Consultants, PMC
* Site Contractors and Commissioning Teams

**Typical KPIs**

* Cooling system reliability at handover

D365 ERP Support, AMS & Operate Governance

Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Management

Risk, Issue, Dependency & Decision Governance

* Govern program-level risks, issues, dependencies, assumptions, and decisions.

title: Construction Manager – Industrial Projects (Civil)
description:
**Looking for challenging role? If you really want to make a difference - make it with us**

At Siemens Energy India Limited, we are more than just an energy technology company. We develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in Siemens Energy’s research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Siemens Energy’s global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

**Your new role – challenging and future-oriented**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced professional as Construction Manager (Civil) at Siemens Energy Real Estate Business in India. The incumbent will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the business as well as you will be instrumental in strategic planning , project schedule and monitoring development. This vital position centers on maintaining tight control over project lifecycles through diligent project tracking, meticulous cash flow management, effective vendor management, and clear, consistent progress reporting. You will play a key role in communicating project status to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and accountability from inception to completion

The role reports directly to the Project Director Real Estate of Siemens Energy India Limited and is based in Navi Mumbai / Project Location.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

**1. Site Management & Supervision:**  

* Overseeing all on-site construction activities, ensuring they align with project plans and specifications.
* Managing site logistics, including material handling, equipment placement, and site access as per Siemens guidelines.
* Conducting regular site inspections to monitor progress and quality.

**2. Schedule Management:**  

* Tracking progress against the schedule and implementing measures to address delays.
* Coordinating activities between different works and contractors to optimize workflow.
* Preparing and presenting regular reports to stakeholders on project status, budget, and schedule

**3. Quality Control & Assurance:**  

* Establishing and enforcing quality standards for all construction work.
* Implementing inspection and testing procedures to ensure materials and workmanship meet specifications
* Addressing and resolving any quality issues that arise.

**4. Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) Management:**  

* Developing and enforcing a robust HSE program to ensure a safe working environment.
* Conducting regular safety meetings, inspections, and training.
* Investigating and reporting any incidents or near misses.
* Proactively identifying internal and external factors that could negatively impact the project (e.g., technical challenges, resource shortages, market changes).

**5. Risk Assessment and Analysis:**  

* Evaluating the likelihood and impact of identified risks.
* Developing Mitigation Strategies:
* Creating plans to prevent, reduce, or respond to identified risks, including contingency plans.

**6. Contractor and Vendor Management:**

* Managing relationships with subcontractors, suppliers, and other vendors.
* Ensuring contracts are adhered to and performance expectations are met.
* Negotiating and resolving disputes if they arise

**7. Stakeholder Management and Communication:**  

* Serving as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders, engineers, contractors, and other key stakeholders.
* Providing regular project updates, progress reports with the project team, and addressing concerns from contractors and key stakeholders

**8. Team Leadership & Motivation:**  

* Leading and motivating the project team, fostering a collaborative and productive work environment.
* Delegating tasks, providing guidance, and conducting performance reviews.

**9. Close-out and post-construction:**  

* Coordinating the final inspection and commissioning of the facility.
* Ensuring all necessary documentation (as-built drawings, manuals, warranties) is provided to the client.
* Finalizing all financial accounts, including payments to contractors and suppliers.
* Reconciling the final budget.
* Conducting a post-project review to identify successes, challenges, and areas for improvement.
* Documenting lessons learned for future projects.

**What you bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Civil engineering.
* Advance Degree in Construction Management or PMP / equivalent project management certification shall be preferred

Minimum of 12-15 years of progressive experience in construction management, with at least 8 years specifically managing MEP works on large-scale industrial projects (e.g., manufacturing plants, data centers, power generation facilities, chemical plants).  

* Working knowledge of design and project management software such as AutoCAD, BIM and MS Project or Primavera.
* Strong understanding of industrial mechanical systems (HVAC, piping, plumbing, fire protection), electrical systems (power distribution, control systems, instrumentation), and building automation systems.
* Proven ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings, specifications, and project schedules
* Strong understanding of the construction processes, PEB and large-scale industrial projects
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficient in both verbal and written communication in English for business purposes.

description:
**Role Title: AVP, Project Management (L11)**
**Company Overview:**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Project Manager supports S2P delivery by managing the backlog in a blended Kanban/Scrum model—driving refinement, ensuring stories meet requirement standards, and routing enablers to the Program Manager. The role supports PI prioritization, manages QC to ensure documentation compliance, and maintains delivery artifacts and reporting. This position also coordinates mini-project scheduling and may lead small projects, proactively managing timelines, “RAID” items, dependencies, and continuous process improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and manage the backlog process for all Source to Pay functions using a Kanban or Scrum approach, ensuring transparency, prioritization, and readiness for delivery.
* Drive backlog refinement activities to ensure:
* Stories contain clearly defined requirements (e.g., objective, scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, estimates, priority), meeting definition of ready.
* Enablers are identified with clearly documented objectives, outputs, and prioritized.
* Manage a QC process to ensure Program Managers adhere to documentation guidelines
* Drive the Program Increment (PI) prioritization process, partnering with stakeholders to intake work, align priorities, and sequence items based on value and need.
* Manage small project scheduling and coordination, including creating the structure, processes, and templates to develop timeline tracking, task sequencing, meeting coordination, and follow-up on action items.
* Manage projects as needed, including planning, prioritization, scope tracking, status reporting, and risk/issue/dependency (RAID) management.
* Maintain delivery artifacts and reporting (e.g., project minutes and action items, approval, testing and other documentation, decision logs, and schedules).
* Identify and escalate blockers, risks, and cross-team dependencies; propose resolution options and coordinate next steps.
* Promote continuous improvement in intake, prioritization, refinement, and flow efficiency across the S2P delivery process.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience
* 3+ years in Project Management/Agile delivery role utilizing Scrum and/or Kanban
* Scrum Master Certification or Service Delivery Manager
* Experience writing/supporting user stories (scope, acceptance criteria) and tracking dependencies/estimates.
* Experience managing a PI/quarterly prioritization (or similar intake and sequencing) process.
* Enforce documentation standards by managing a quality control process.
* Proficient with Jira/Confluence and MS Office (Excel/PowerPoint/Visio)
* Experience with identifying and developing process metrics

**Desired Characteristics**

* Familiarity with Source to Pay teams and Coupa preferred.
* Experience summarizing complex projects, risks, or ideas to Senior Leadership in a concise manner.
* Detail-oriented and documentation-focused; produces audit-ready artifacts.
* Comfortable with ambiguity with ability to break work down for sequencing.
* Strong organization, communication and facilitation skills
* Proactive communicator who escalates risks/dependencies early and drives follow-through.
* Continuous improvement and curious mindset with interest in flow/throughput metrics.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience

**Work Timings: 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM EST**

We are seeking an experienced Aprimo DAM & MRM Lead to own the strategic direction, architecture, and team leadership of our enterprise Aprimo Digital Asset Management
**and Marketing Resource Management**
platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Architecture & Governance**

* Own the long-term architectural roadmap for the Aprimo DAM and MRM platform - taxonomy evolution, metadata schema strategy, integration architecture, and AI capability adoption.
* Define and enforce enterprise-wide DAM and MRM governance standards: naming conventions, field design principles, classification ownership models, and change management processes.
* Review data models, taxonomies, and metadata structures within Aprimo MRM and DAM to ensure accurate reporting, data quality, and future extensibility.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders to translate complex marketing and compliance requirements into detailed Aprimo configuration blueprints and solution documents.
* Define governance guidelines for Aprimo configuration standards, naming conventions, and usage policies so that global teams follow consistent practices.

**🆕**
**MRM - Marketing Planning & Financial Management**

* Configure and manage Aprimo MRM's marketing planning and budgeting modules - including plan hierarchies, activity types, budget structures, and fiscal year setup aligned to enterprise marketing operating models.
* Design and maintain MRM financial workflows including budget request, approval, allocation, accrual, and reconciliation processes - ensuring finance and marketing teams operate from a single source of truth.
* Build and govern MRM project and activity templates that standardise how marketing programmes are initiated, tracked, and closed across global teams.
* Configure MRM work management capabilities - task management, project timelines, resource assignments, and capacity planning - to support marketing operations teams.
* Design MLR (Medical/Legal/Review) and compliance-driven approval workflows within Aprimo MRM for regulated industries, including routing rules, version locking, and audit trail requirements.
* Maintain and evolve MRM field design - custom fields, picklists, calculated fields, and conditional logic - ensuring that data captured at the plan and activity level supports downstream reporting needs.
* Define and enforce MRM data governance standards for plan naming conventions, cost centre mapping, vendor management, and invoice processing workflows.
* Configure and maintain MRM reporting and dashboard frameworks - including standard and custom reports across budget performance, activity status, resource utilisation, and campaign ROI.
* Manage MRM user role and permission architecture - defining role hierarchies, team structures, and access scoping aligned to organisational and regional team models.
* Support MRM integrations with finance and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday) for budget synchronisation, purchase order management, invoice reconciliation, and financial close processes.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor a team of DAM Specialists, Analysts, MRM Administrators, and Integration Developers - setting technical direction and reviewing their configuration and integration work.
* Lead development teams by providing detailed interface specifications, mapping documents, and solution use cases that reduce implementation rework.
* Conduct code and configuration reviews for API integrations, ensuring adherence to security, performance, and maintainability standards.

**DAM Configuration & Taxonomy**

* Configure Aprimo DAM capabilities to streamline asset intake, metadata modeling, and governance processes that improve asset discoverability and reuse.
* Design and maintain a scalable, organisation-wide taxonomy (classification hierarchy) aligned to how marketing teams browse and search for assets.

**Integration Architecture**

* Own the end-to-end integration architecture connecting Aprimo to the broader MarTech and enterprise systems landscape (CMS, PIM, CRM, marketing automation, CDN).
* Design and build API-based integrations using the Aprimo REST API - including asset ingestion pipelines, metadata synchronisation, and event-driven workflows.
* Design and build MRM API integrations - including marketing plan data synchronisation, activity status feeds, budget and spend data pipelines, and bi-directional connectors with finance and ERP platforms.
* Implement OAuth 2.0 authentication flows, manage API client registrations, and maintain secure credential handling for all service accounts.
* Develop and maintain webhook configurations for event-driven integrations with downstream systems (CMS, PIM, email platforms, CDN).
* Build and maintain bulk asset ingestion pipelines handling multi-step processes: record creation, chunked file upload, metadata mapping, commit, and error handling.
* Implement and maintain the Aprimo Content Selector SDK within third-party applications - ensuring scoped authorisation, rendition control, and audit logging.

**Migration**

* Lead asset migration projects from legacy DAM systems or shared drives into Aprimo - including source audit, de-duplication, metadata mapping, and validation.
* Lead MRM data migration projects from legacy marketing planning tools, spreadsheets, or prior MRM platforms into Aprimo - including plan and activity data mapping, historical budget data migration, open workflow migration, and user acceptance validation.

**Aprimo certification is a plus.**
**Experience**

* 6–7 years total professional experience, including a minimum of 4–5 years of dedicated, hands-on Aprimo DAM and/or MRM experience.
* Demonstrated experience as the senior/lead technical resource on at least one full Aprimo implementation or major platform transformation - not merely a contributor.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience configuring Aprimo MRM modules - including marketing planning, budget management, work management, and approval workflow design - at an enterprise scale.
* Proven ownership of enterprise taxonomy and metadata architecture decisions - able to speak to specific trade-offs made and their long-term consequences.
* Deep, verifiable hands-on expertise with the Aprimo REST API - must be able to design integration architecture from scratch, not just describe individual endpoint calls.
* Experience leading or mentoring a team of DAM analysts, specialists, MRM administrators, or developers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a regulated industry (pharmaceutical, financial services, healthcare) with MLR/compliance-driven workflow design - including MRM-side review routing and audit trail configuration.
* Experience owning a DAM or MRM platform migration at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with Aprimo Content Selector SDK, Agentic Orchestration (Copilot Studio, n8n, MCP Server), and emerging AI-driven DAM capabilities.
* Experience with enterprise identity/access architecture - SCIM provisioning, SSO integration, federated permission models.
* Experience integrating Aprimo MRM with ERP or finance platforms (SAP, Oracle, Workday) for budget and spend management.
* Familiarity with Aprimo MRM reporting frameworks and the ability to design custom dashboards for marketing operations and finance stakeholders. #Aprimo Referral Campaign

title: Systems Eng Supervisor
description:

location.
