title: Senior AI Enablement Manager
description:
**Shape the Future of AI-Driven Performance in Tissue**
At Valmet Tissue, we believe Artificial Intelligence will become a key enabler of growth, productivity, customer value, and operational excellence. We are looking for an experienced and business-oriented AI Enablement Lead to accelerate the adoption of AI across our organization.
  
  
This role will initially focus on Commercial Excellence, Sales, Service, and Business Analytics, where immediate opportunities exist to improve productivity, forecasting, customer engagement, opportunity management, and decision-making. Over time, the role will expand to support AI-driven transformation across Engineering, Supply Chain, Project Management, Manufacturing, and Business Support functions.
  
  
This is not solely a technical development role. Instead, we are seeking a business leader who can identify opportunities, drive adoption, lead change, and ensure that AI creates measurable value across the organization. This aligns with Valmet's business-led AI strategy, emphasizing value realization, adoption, capability building, and scalable implementation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Drive AI-enabled business transformation
  
  

* Develop and execute the Tissue AI enablement roadmap.
* Identify high-value opportunities where AI can improve business performance.
* Build business cases and track realized value from AI initiatives.
* Prioritize and coordinate AI projects across functions.
* Promote scalable and reusable AI solutions across the organization.

Optimize commercial performance
  
  

* Improve sales productivity through AI-enabled tools and processes.
* Support opportunity management, forecasting, account planning, pricing, and proposal generation.
* Reduce manual administrative work and increase customer-facing time.
* Enhance installed-base monetization and customer insights.
* Drive data-driven decision-making across commercial teams.

Lead AI adoption & change
  
  

* Build and lead a network of AI Champions across Tissue.
* Deliver training, awareness programs, and practical AI workshops.
* Support leaders in redesigning processes and ways of working.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure successful adoption of AI capabilities throughout the organization.

Expand AI across functions
  
  
**As Adoption Matures, Support AI Initiatives In**

* Engineering and design productivity
* Supply chain planning and optimization
* Project execution
* Customer support and service operations
* Knowledge management
* Business support functions
* Performance management and analytics

Partner across the organization
  
  

* Act as the key interface between Tissue business teams and enterprise AI initiatives.
* Collaborate with IT, Digital, Data & Analytics, and process owners.
* Ensure AI solutions support business priorities and strategic objectives.
* Promote responsible and compliant use of AI technologies.

What success looks like
  
  

* Increased sales productivity and reduced administrative workload.
* Higher adoption of AI tools and capabilities.
* Improved forecast accuracy and commercial effectiveness.
* Measurable business value delivered through AI initiatives.
* Increased organizational AI capability and literacy.
* AI-enabled process improvements deployed across multiple functions.
* A growing portfolio of scalable use cases delivering sustainable business impact.

**Your profile**
You combine business acumen, transformation leadership, and a passion for technology-enabled improvement.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in Commercial Excellence, Sales Operations, Business Transformation, Continuous Improvement, Digital Transformation, or related fields.
* Experience leading cross-functional change initiatives.
* Strong understanding of commercial processes and business performance drivers.
* Exposure to AI, analytics, automation, or digital technologies.
* Experience working in a global industrial or manufacturing environment is considered an advantage.

Personal characteristics
  
  

* Strategic and business-oriented mindset.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Curious and passionate about emerging technologies.
* Excellent communication and facilitation abilities.
* Ability to translate complex concepts into practical business solutions.
* Results-oriented with a strong focus on value realization.

**Why join Valmet Tissue?**
This is a unique opportunity to help define how AI will transform the future of Tissue. You will play a central role in building new capabilities, improving performance, and enabling our teams to work smarter and more effectively. Your work will influence how we serve customers, develop our people, and strengthen our competitiveness globally. Join us in shaping the next generation of AI-enabled business performance at Valmet Tissue.
  
  
**Additional Information**
Last day to apply is November 3, 2026. However, we work with ongoing selection, so don't wait with sending us your application.
  
  
***When everything works together***
***Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers; we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.***

title: Delivery Manager-Test Lead
description:
**Job Purpose**
Looking for a Test Lead / Data QA Engineer to drive and oversee data validation, manual testing, and regression testing activities across capital markets data pipelines spanning both legacy and modern platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and adherence to business rules through source-to-target validation, schema verification, data reconciliation, lineage analysis, and automation-led regression testing.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong data QA and testing expertise, hands-on automation skills, capital markets domain knowledge, and a proactive ownership mindset to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across environments.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead test delivery, manage and coordinate offshore QA resources, and engage closely with business and technology stakeholders to maintain high-quality data across post-trade and enterprise data ecosystems. Key responsibilities include building reusable Python- and SQL-based validation frameworks, supporting batch and cloud-based execution models, identifying data anomalies, validating end-to-end data flows, and embedding robust data quality controls throughout the development lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end test planning, execution, and delivery for data validation and regression testing initiatives, ensuring quality, schedule, and stakeholder expectations are met.
* Manage and mentor offshore/onshore QA teams, including resource planning, task allocation, deliverable reviews, and adherence to testing best practices.
* Drive test governance, including test strategy, defect management, risk tracking, quality metrics, status reporting, and release readiness assessments.
* Collaborate with business, engineering, and product teams to define requirements, resolve issues, ensure test coverage, and embed quality controls across the delivery lifecycle.
* Perform source-to-target data validation across legacy and modern systems, including SQL Server and cloud-based data environments.
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication handling, referential integrity, schema structures, metadata, lineage, and business-rule conformance.
* Build and maintain automation-first regression testing frameworks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable validation utilities.
* Execute field-level, dataset-level, transformation-level, and aggregate-level data checks across source, staging, warehouse, data lake, and downstream systems.
* Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, post-trade data flows, stored procedures, batch jobs, and cloud-based execution workflows.
* Design reusable test cases, validation scenarios, reconciliation checks, automated scripts, and regression packs for repeatable data-quality assurance.
* Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and stored procedures across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms.
* Translate business rules, stored procedure logic, and post-trade process flows into automated validation scripts and assertions.
* Build Python-based utilities, APIs, CLI tools, and reusable frameworks to support data validation, orchestration, API integrations, and reporting workflows.
* Integrate regression tests, data validation checks, SQL deployables, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent tools.
* Automate execution of AutoSys jobs, batch processes, stored procedures, and validation scripts across development, UAT, and production environments.
* Work with engineering teams to embed data quality controls into pipelines, releases, and operational workflows.
* Identify data anomalies, schema mismatches, duplicate records, null-handling issues, transformation failures, reconciliation breaks, and integrity violations.
* Log defects with clear evidence, impact analysis, root-cause observations, and business context.
* Support capital markets and post-trade validation across allocations, clearing, settlement, confirmations, reconciliations, market data, reference data, and downstream reporting.

**Key competencies**

* 8–12 years of hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles and proven experience leading QA teams, test planning, estimation, execution, defect management, and end-to-end test delivery across complex data programs.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate test status, risks, quality metrics, and release readiness to business and technology leadership.
* Experience establishing test strategies, governance frameworks, quality standards, resource planning, and mentoring distributed QA teams.
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional collaboration, manage competing priorities, mitigate delivery risks, and ensure

successful project outcomes in Agile environments.
  
  

* Strong Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification.
* Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets.
* Solid SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis.
* Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms.
* Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities.
* Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance.
* Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
* Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow.
* Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios.
* Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Domain Experience (Must Have)
* Strong experience in Fixed Income Capital Markets domain
* Good understanding of Fixed Income products, reference data, pricing, securities, positions, settlements, and trade lifecycle concepts
* Experience working with market data, reference data, and regulatory reporting-related data sets

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to Azure, AWS, ADF, containers, Kubernetes, or cloud-based data platforms.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar platforms.
* Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, cloud data lakes, and Big Data validation.
* Experience validating batch, streaming, real-time, and Kafka-based ingestion pipelines.
* Capital markets domain exposure, especially post-trade, market data, reference data, trade data, or ION/blotter platform

integrations.
  
  

* Exposure to DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and code quality tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Sonar, Mend, or ZAP.

title: Implementation Consultant
description:
What You'll Do
  
  

* Serve as a senior technical authority and trusted advisor leading end-to-end technical implementations, complex solution architectures, and multi-system integrations for mid-market and enterprise customers adopting Avalara's cloud compliance platform.
* Translate intricate customer business models, global tax compliance requirements, and high-volume transactional workflows into robust, scalable, and resilient technical configurations.
* Champion an AI-first approach to accelerate customer onboarding, reduce project cycle times, and optimize time-to-first-transaction.
* Partner cross-functionally with customer IT, finance leadership, developers, and Avalara internal teams to navigate complex integration landscapes and mitigate cutover risks.
* Elevate organizational delivery excellence by setting technical benchmarks, mentoring team members, and establishing reusable technical assets and automation frameworks.

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**

* Lead advanced solution architecture, custom integration workflows, and tax rule mappings across enterprise applications including ERP, CRM, eCommerce, and Billing systems.
* Evaluate multifaceted business processes, multi-jurisdiction nexus footprints, cross-border taxability rules, and enterprise data schemas to design secure and scalable integrations.
* Design and execute comprehensive end-to-end testing strategies, validate complex API payloads, reconcile high-volume transaction calculations, and resolve nuanced configuration discrepancies prior to production cutover.
* Serve as the technical escalation lead for high-complexity integration challenges, troubleshooting root causes and partnering with Engineering and Product to resolve blockers and influence roadmap improvements.
* Conduct technical discovery sessions, executive-level architecture reviews, and deliver structured administrator and technical training to empower client teams.
* Coach and mentor junior consultants on integration best practices, troubleshooting methodologies, and customer management while conducting peer configuration reviews.
* Pioneer and champion AI-driven tools, reusable integration templates, diagnostic scripts, and automated test workflows to drive operational scale across the global consulting practice.
* Take full ownership of implementation project milestones, ensuring high-quality go-lives with robust test coverage and zero critical post-launch defects.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, BCA, MCA, or related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).
* Experience: 5–8 years of hands-on experience in technical implementation, systems integration, or technical consulting within B2B SaaS or enterprise software environments.
* Enterprise Systems & ERP Expertise: Proven track record of configuring, integrating, and troubleshooting leading enterprise applications (e.g., NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, Salesforce, Sage Intacct, Workday, or major eCommerce platforms).
* Technical & Integration Skills: Strong expertise in APIs, JSON/XML payloads, data transformation tools, middleware/iPaaS platforms, and advanced data analysis (SQL, Excel, or scripting).
* Autonomous Project Leadership: Demonstrated ability to independently manage a portfolio of simultaneous enterprise customer implementations in a fast-paced environment.
* Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills, with proven ability to lead technical workshops and influence customer architects, developers, and executive stakeholders.
* Applied AI Fluency: Practical experience utilizing generative AI tools to accelerate technical discovery, troubleshooting, script generation, and documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Tax & Compliance Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with transaction tax principles (US Sales & Use Tax, VAT/GST, e-Invoicing) or hands-on experience with automated tax engines
* Consulting Background: Prior experience working within technology consulting firms or enterprise Professional Services organizations.
* Architecture & Scripting Tools: Familiarity with cloud architectures, scripting languages (Python, JavaScript/Node.js), and API testing suites (Postman, SoapUI).
* Delivery Methodologies: Experience with Agile/Scrum implementation methodologies, PSA tools, and collaborative project management platforms.

Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

title: Assistant Manager / Senior Production Engineer - Heavy Engineering Fabrication
description:
**About Zeeco**
Zeeco is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced combustion and environmental solutions serving the refining, petrochemical, oil & gas, power, chemical, and pharmaceutical industries. Headquartered in the United States, Zeeco designs and manufactures world-class burners, flares, thermal oxidizers, vapor recovery systems, and fired equipment that help customers improve process efficiency while reducing emissions.
  
  
With manufacturing and engineering facilities across the globe, Zeeco combines innovative technology, engineering excellence, and superior manufacturing capabilities to deliver customized solutions that meet the highest international quality standards.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Zeeco India is seeking an experienced
**Production Engineer**
to lead and coordinate the fabrication and manufacturing of heavy process equipment including
**pressure vessels, process skids, columns, ducting, stacks, structural assemblies, and other static equipment**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess
**10 to 12 years of hands-on shop floor experience**
in heavy engineering fabrication and should have a strong understanding of fabrication methodologies, welding processes, production planning, resource optimization, quality requirements, and statutory fabrication codes. The individual will be responsible for ensuring safe, efficient, and timely execution of manufacturing activities while maintaining the highest standards of quality and productivity.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Production Planning & Manufacturing Execution:****

* Plan, schedule, and monitor fabrication activities to achieve project delivery milestones.
* Prepare daily and weekly production plans based on project priorities and manufacturing capacity.
* Coordinate fabrication activities involving pressure vessels, process skids, structural assemblies, ducting, stacks, and other static equipment.
* Review engineering drawings, fabrication drawings, General Arrangement (GA) drawings, Bill of Materials (BOM), welding maps, and manufacturing specifications before production.
* Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, consumables, and shop floor resources.
* Monitor production progress and proactively resolve manufacturing bottlenecks to achieve committed delivery schedules.
* Coordinate closely with Engineering, Planning, Procurement, QA/QC, and Project Management teams throughout the manufacturing cycle.

****Heavy Fabrication & Shop Floor Management:****
  
  

* Supervise fabrication activities including:

+ Plate cutting
+ Rolling
+ Forming
+ Fit-up
+ Welding
+ Assembly
+ Structural fabrication
+ Equipment integration
+ Final assembly

* Ensure fabrication activities comply with approved fabrication procedures and project requirements.
* Monitor welding activities and ensure compliance with approved WPS, PQR, and welder qualifications.
* Oversee fabrication of Carbon Steel, Stainless Steel, Duplex Stainless Steel, Alloy Steel, and other process equipment materials.
* Ensure dimensional accuracy through regular inspections during fabrication and assembly.
* Coordinate lifting, handling, and movement of heavy fabricated components within the workshop.

****Quality, Codes & Compliance:****
  
  

* Ensure manufacturing activities comply with applicable international standards including:

+ ASME Section VIII Div.1
+ ASME Section IX
+ API Standards
+ ISO Standards
+ Customer Specifications

* Coordinate with QA/QC during:

+ Fit-up inspections
+ Welding inspections
+ Visual inspection
+ NDT activities
+ Hydrostatic testing
+ Pneumatic testing
+ Dimensional inspection
+ Final release inspections

* Maintain complete fabrication documentation, weld traceability, material traceability, and production records.
* Support customer inspections, third-party inspections, and statutory audits.

****People Management & Shop Floor Leadership:****

* Lead welders, fitters, fabricators, riggers, and technicians.
* Allocate work based on manpower capability and production priorities.
* Monitor productivity and implement corrective actions where required.
* Mentor junior engineers and supervisors on fabrication best practices.
* Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, quality, and operational excellence.

****Safety & Continuous Improvement:****

* Ensure strict adherence to company HSE policies and safe fabrication practices.
* Conduct regular shop floor inspections to eliminate unsafe conditions.
* Identify opportunities for improving productivity, reducing fabrication cycle time, and minimizing rework.
* Support implementation of Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Participate in root cause analysis (RCA) for quality issues and implement preventive actions.

**Mandatory Experience**
Candidates
**must have hands-on experience**
in the fabrication and manufacturing of one or more of the following:
  
  

* Pressure Vessels
* Process Skids
* Heat Exchangers
* Columns
* Reactors
* Storage Tanks
* Static Equipment
* Fired Heaters
* Thermal Oxidizers
* Process Equipment
* Heavy Structural Fabrication

**Experience From Industries Such As**

* Oil & Gas
* Petrochemical
* EPC
* Heavy Engineering
* Process Equipment Manufacturing
* Boiler Manufacturing
* Pressure Vessel Manufacturing
* Industrial Equipment Manufacturing

will be highly preferred.
  
  
**Technical Skills**

* Excellent understanding of heavy fabrication processes.
* Strong knowledge of welding processes (SMAW, GTAW, GMAW, SAW, FCAW).
* Knowledge of fabrication sequence planning.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings and fabrication documents.
* Knowledge of welding symbols, GD&T, tolerances, and dimensional control.
* Familiarity with WPS, PQR, WPQ, and welding documentation.
* Working knowledge of NDT methods and inspection requirements.
* Exposure to ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or equivalent.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

**Key Competencies**

* Heavy fabrication planning and execution
* Shop floor production management
* Resource planning and optimization
* Pressure vessel manufacturing
* Welding and fabrication supervision
* Manufacturing quality assurance
* Cross-functional coordination
* Production scheduling
* Problem-solving and decision-making
* Team leadership and people management
* Continuous improvement mindset
* Strong commitment to safety and quality

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Production Engineering.
* 10 to 12 years of relevant manufacturing experience in heavy engineering fabrication is preferred.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
At Regnology our greatest asset is our people. We value diversity and foster an inclusive environment that supports learning, safety, and growth. By investing in our team, listening to customers, and encouraging creativity, we drive continuous innovation and improvement.
  
We offer a flexible, innovative environment where your ideas matter and your career can thrive.
  
Regnology is a global leader in regulatory reporting, helping financial institutions, regulators, and tax authorities improve data quality, efficiency, and cost savings. Our mission: to safeguard financial markets through smarter, future-ready solutions.

**About Regnology**

Regnology is a recognized leader in regulatory, risk, tax, and finance reporting technology— connecting regulators and the regulated across more than 100 countries. Our unique position enables us to span the full spectrum of industry needs, delivering solutions that address both oversight and compliance requirements to a broad range of clients, including global Tier 1 banks, local and regional institutions, corporates, insurers, and authorities.

**What you'll do**

As a Project Coordinator in Regnology, you will be responsible for managing core internal administrative workflows across regional engagements. Your central duties include tracking and approving team timesheets and initiating the billing process for both Time & Material (hourly-billed) and Fixed Price (milestone-billed) projects. Your diligent administrative support serves as the vital operational backbone ensuring hours and invoicing stay accurate.

This position is strictly internal and non-client-facing to begin with, allowing you to build foundational competence without client pressure. Over time, you will learn core project management principles under senior team members’ mentorship and progressively take on simple, structured projects to interact directly with clients.

We are looking for an organized, proactive, and detail-oriented fresh graduate to join our APAC Program Management team as a Project Coordinator in Pune. This entry-level role offers an exceptional springboard to break into project management, starting with hands-on mastery of essential day-to-day project operations.

**Your key accountabilities are:**

**Timesheet Verification & Approvals** : Review, verify, and approve weekly timesheets submitted by delivery team members, ensuring all project hours and work codes are recorded accurately and on schedule.

**Timesheet Discrepancy Resolution** : Track missing submissions, follow up with consultants to resolve time-logging errors, and ensure accurate, audit-ready timekeeping records across all active projects.

**Billing & Invoicing Workflows** : Initiate and coordinate invoicing workflows for both Time & Material (T&M) and Fixed Price engagements, verifying hours against billing caps or milestone completion criteria.

**Operational Administration (Zero-PM Projects)** : Serve as the administrative coordinator for projects operating without dedicated Project Managers, tracking delivery milestones and operational status behind the scenes.

**Project Registers & Tool Maintenance** : Maintain up-to-date project tracking registers, status logs, and internal financial records in collaboration with regional project stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Team Collaboration** : Work closely with APAC program management leaders, delivery teams, and finance operations to eliminate administrative bottlenecks and ensure prompt billing.

**Professional Development & Client Growth** : Proactively learn fundamental project management methodologies and prepare to gradually transition into client-facing project coordination over time.

**Why we should decide on you:**

We are looking for an enthusiastic candidate who brings the following qualifications and mindset:

**Educational Qualifications** : A newly completed Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Commerce, or a related field (this position is specifically designed for fresh graduates).

**Administrative & Organizational Skills** : Strong organizational skills with meticulous attention to detail when working with schedules, task codes, timesheets, and financial data.

**Communication Proficiency** : Excellent written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to interact clearly, confidently, and professionally with internal regional teams.

**Spreadsheet & Computer Fluency** : Comfortable working with spreadsheet tools (such as Microsoft Excel) to organize data, track submissions, and using AI tools (e.g. Gemini) to generate basic operational summaries.

**Dependability & Ownership** : High level of personal responsibility, a reliable work ethic, and the ability to manage routine administrative workflows independently.

**Would be an advantage:**

**Adaptability** : Ability to adjust to evolving business requirements and suggest improvements.

**Prior Internship or Administrative Exposure** : Any prior corporate internship, university student committee leadership, or office administrative experience involving task tracking, timesheet collection, scheduling, or basic invoice coordination.

**Intermediate Spreadsheet Fluency** : Working familiarity with intermediate Microsoft Excel features (such as Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, basic formulas, and data reconciliation) to streamline timesheet validation and billing calculations.

**Exposure to Project Management & Collaboration Software** : Hands-on familiarity with common team collaboration or workflow tools (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Jira).

### **Job Title**

Senior. Engineering Manager - PMO

### **Job Description**

Job Summary

The Senior Engineering Manager – PMO will lead the OHC Project Management Office in Pune, overseeing a diverse portfolio of sustaining programs, product launches, complex product redevelopment initiatives, and multi-year Product Development and Lifecycle Management (PDLM) programs.

The role will translate business, product development, and sustaining requirements into structured programs and projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities, resource availability, financial objectives, and delivery commitments.

As a key participant in the Change Control Board (CCB), the role will establish strong portfolio governance, drive disciplined prioritization and decision-making, and ensure successful execution of the OHC Lifecycle Management (LCM) portfolio across multiple sites and sub-businesses.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive product development experience, strong engineering and program management expertise, financial and portfolio governance capabilities, and proven leadership in managing cross-functional teams and complex, multi-site initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

* **PMO and Portfolio Leadership:** Lead the OHC PMO in Pune and oversee a portfolio of sustaining programs, product launches, complex product redevelopment initiatives, and multi-year PDLM programs.
* **Change Control and Governance:** Chair the Change Control Board and ensure structured intake, assessment, prioritization, approval, and tracking of business and engineering requests.
* **Program and Project Planning:** Translate approved requests into clearly defined programs and projects with established scope, deliverables, ownership, resource plans, budgets, timelines, and success criteria.
* **Portfolio Governance:** Establish and continuously improve PMO processes, governance frameworks, milestone reviews, decision rights, escalation mechanisms, and performance reporting.
* **Budget and Resource Management:** Lead portfolio budgeting, forecasting, capacity planning, and resource allocation, ensuring transparency of costs, commitments, and financial risks.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Collaborate with cross-functional and senior stakeholders to align priorities, negotiate scope and funding, resolve dependencies, and manage delivery expectations.
* **Executive Reporting:** Provide clear, data-driven portfolio updates, identify critical risks and opportunities, and present recommendations to senior leadership to support informed decision-making.
* **Strategic Decision-Making:** Exercise independent judgment to challenge, defer, or decline requests that lack strategic alignment, business value, sufficient clarity, funding, or organizational capacity.
* **Program Performance and Risk Management:** Oversee portfolio execution across scope, schedule, budget, quality, resources, risks, interdependencies, and benefits realization.
* **People Leadership and Development:** Lead, coach, and develop project and program management professionals, building PMO capabilities, strengthening execution excellence, and supporting succession planning.
* **Product Development Excellence:** Apply product development and lifecycle management expertise to guide cross-functional execution, design reviews, lifecycle decisions, and delivery readiness.
* **Digital Transformation and Continuous Improvement:** Drive the practical adoption of Agile methodologies, digital tools, automation, data analytics, and AI to improve execution efficiency, transparency, quality, and decision-making.

Mandatory Qualifications and Experience

* Minimum **18 years of professional experience** in product development or a closely related engineering environment.
* Minimum **10 years of experience** in project, program, or portfolio management.
* **PMP certification is mandatory.**
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional, multi-site product development or lifecycle management programs.
* Mandatory experience in people management, including leading and developing teams.
* Strong understanding of Product Development Lifecycle Management (PDLM), structured development reviews, and cross-functional engineering integration.
* Proven responsibility for project or portfolio budgets, financial forecasting, resource planning, and financial performance.
* Experience managing portfolios that include both short-cycle initiatives and complex, multi-year programs.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing, negotiation, and executive presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing demands, challenge requests, and make difficult portfolio-level decisions.
* Experience establishing, implementing, or improving PMO frameworks, portfolio governance, and project management processes.
* Proven expertise in managing program risks, interdependencies, organizational change, and business benefits.

Key Competencies

* Strategic portfolio and program leadership
* Engineering and product development lifecycle expertise
* Financial planning and resource optimization
* Governance, risk management, and change control
* Executive stakeholder engagement and influencing
* People leadership and talent development
* Data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement
Digital transformation and Agile project management

We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week.
  
Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities.

title: SAP Project Lead
description:
*By creating bearings and solutions for everything from industrial applications to vehicles, SKF plays an essential role in our everyday lives. In Q4 2026, SKF intends to spin off its Automotive business and list it as a separate company under the name of SKF Vertevo. A company created to support the future of the automotive market, and to co-drive the future of mobility faster.*

  

*This role will be a part of that new company.* *Would you like to join us, and move people further?*

  

**SAP Basis Lead-SKF Automotive Business**

**Role Purpose**

The SAP Basis Lead is accountable for the **reliability, availability, security, performance and lifecycle management of the enterprise SAP platform**, across Business-as-Usual (BAU) operations and SAP transformation initiatives.

The role acts as the technical service owner and primary interface between internal IT, SAP application teams, **SAP RISE/ECS**, hyperscalers and AMS/service partners, ensuring a secure, resilient and efficiently operated SAP landscape.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. RISE with SAP & Platform Governance**

* Own technical governance of **RISE with SAP / S/4HANA Private Cloud** and the broader SAP platform landscape.
* Govern the **RISE shared-responsibility model** across SAP ECS, internal IT, hyperscalers and service partners.
* Manage SAP/ECS service delivery, SLAs, planned maintenance, escalations and continual service improvement.
* Govern system provisioning, refreshes, patching, upgrades, capacity and technical lifecycle activities.
* Define and maintain SAP platform standards, architecture principles and technology roadmap.
* Ensure clear ownership and accountability across SAP, AMS and internal teams.

**2. BAU Operations & Service Reliability**

* Ensure stable **24x7 operation of business-critical SAP environments**.
* Govern incident, problem, change and major-incident management, including root-cause analysis and preventive actions.
* Oversee system availability, performance, interfaces, background jobs, databases, capacity and overall platform health.
* Govern kernel/support package upgrades, patching, system refreshes, client copies, housekeeping and transport management.
* Establish and monitor operational **SLAs, KPIs, runbooks and escalation procedures**.
* Drive proactive monitoring and observability across SAP systems, integrations, jobs and critical business processes.
* Drive automation and continual improvement to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents and technical debt.
* Leverage **SAP Cloud ALM, where applicable**, for monitoring, alerting and operational insights.

**3. S/4HANA Transformation, Release & Cutover**

* Act as BASIS technical lead for **S/4HANA implementations, upgrades, migrations and transformation programs**.
* Ensure technical environment readiness across DEV, QA, UAT, Pre-Production and Production.
* Lead technical cutovers, transport/release management, production deployment and hypercare.
* Coordinate technical dependencies across Functional, Development, Integration, Security, Data, Testing and Infrastructure teams.
* Ensure transformation activities are delivered without compromising BAU stability.
* Support landscape simplification and transition from legacy SAP platforms.

**4. Architecture, Integration & Lifecycle Management**

* Provide technical leadership across **S/4HANA, HANA, Fiori/Gateway, Cloud Connector and associated SAP platform technologies**.
* Govern connectivity across SAP cloud, on-premises and third-party platforms.
* Ensure architecture provides appropriate availability, resilience, performance, scalability and capacity.
* Govern authentication, certificates, SSO, connectivity and network dependencies.
* Evaluate new SAP technologies and platform capabilities in alignment with enterprise architecture and business requirements.
* Maintain lifecycle plans for SAP platforms, databases and related technical components.

**5. Security, Risk, Compliance & Resilience**

* Ensure SAP platforms comply with enterprise cybersecurity, **ITGC and audit requirements**.
* Govern vulnerability remediation, secure configurations, certificate management and privileged technical access.
* Maintain SAP platform risks and associated remediation plans.
* Govern backup/recovery, high availability and **Disaster Recovery** capabilities.
* Coordinate DR readiness and testing aligned with agreed **RTO/RPO** requirements.
* Support internal and external audits and ensure appropriate controls and evidence are maintained.

**6. Partner, Vendor & Team Leadership**

* Lead operational governance with **SAP/ECS, AMS providers, hyperscalers and other technology partners**.
* Monitor service delivery against contractual responsibilities, SLAs and KPIs.
* Act as the technical escalation point for critical SAP platform issues.
* Lead service reviews, corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Provide technical direction and mentoring to BASIS/platform specialists.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, SAP Application and business teams.
* Drive **automation, simplification, cost optimization and operational excellence** across the SAP platform.

**Experience & Core Skills**

* About 15 years of experience in **SAP**
* Strong experience leading **SAP BASIS/platform operations within a large enterprise environment**.
* Deep technical knowledge of **SAP S/4HANA and SAP HANA**.
* Strong experience with **RISE with SAP / S/4HANA Private Cloud**.
* Experience working with **SAP ECS and the RISE shared-responsibility model**.
* Strong experience in SAP BAU operations, performance management, upgrades, migrations, technical cutovers, system refreshes and transport management.
* Experience supporting large-scale **S/4HANA transformation and upgrade programs**.
* Strong understanding of **SAP architecture**, **Fiori/Gateway, Cloud Connector, interfaces and enterprise connectivity**.
* Strong understanding of ITSM processes including incident, problem, change and major-incident management.
* Knowledge of security, audit, compliance, HA/DR and business continuity requirements.
* Experience governing SAP, AMS and cloud service providers within an SLA-driven operating model.
* Strong **technical leadership, stakeholder management, vendor management and communication skills**.

**Good to Have**

* Working knowledge of **SAP BTP** and its interaction with the core SAP landscape.
* Experience with **SAP Cloud ALM (CALM)** for monitoring, alerting and operational insights.
* Experience transitioning monitoring/ALM capabilities from **SAP Solution Manager** to newer SAP tooling.
* Exposure to automation and observability solutions supporting SAP operations.
* Experience with global, multi-system and business-critical SAP landscapes.

  

**Role Success Profile**

The successful candidate combines **strong SAP BASIS technical depth with service ownership, governance and transformation leadership**.

The role is not intended to be primarily a hands-on BASIS administrator. The SAP BASIS Lead is accountable for ensuring that internal teams, **SAP/ECS, AMS and other technology partners collectively deliver a stable, secure and future-ready SAP platform**, while enabling S/4HANA transformation and maintaining BAU service continuity.

  

**If you want to go further**

This position will be located in Pune/Bangalore/Gurgaon. You will report to SAP Global Lead, who is located in Gurgaon, India. For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Sonam Dalal, Talent Acquisition Specialist, by email sonam.dalal@skfvertevo.com. Please note that we can't accept applications via email.

Apply with your CV in English throughout the system, no later than 11th November 2026. We will screen candidates continuously, so make sure to submit your application as soon as possible.

If you want to know more about SKF Automotive business, please visit our webpage.

SKF Automotive: Bearings & aftermarket solutions since 1907

  

**Transparency and fairness matter to us**

At SKF, we see diversity in our workforce as an asset that supports better business results. We are committed to having a fair and inclusive recruitment process where all hiring decisions are based on objective, job-related criteria, ensuring equal opportunities for all candidates.

To support a fair and transparent recruitment process, the process may include assessments, and before hiring, we may also carry out background checks and verify application information. Any employment offer will be based on the requirements of the role and an overall assessment of the candidate’s qualifications and potential. Our recruitment process may differ from country to country and will always be in line with applicablecountry-specific laws and regulations.

*Come as you are – just be yourself. #weareSKF*

title: Program Manager, DiscoveryOne, India
description:
**Company Description**
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
  
  
The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.
  
  
In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to ca. 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 950 laboratories in 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
  
  
In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.9 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Program Manager supports the successful execution of integrated drug discovery programs by providing project planning, coordination, governance, and operational leadership. Working closely with Scientific Project Leaders and cross-functional scientific teams, the Program Manager ensures that program activities remain aligned to agreed timelines, budgets, milestones, and client expectations.
  
  
The role is responsible for maintaining integrated project plans, facilitating communication across teams and sites, monitoring risks and dependencies, tracking budgets and deliverables, and supporting effective decision-making through clear reporting and governance. The Program Manager serves as a key operational partner to Scientific Project Leaders, enabling efficient program execution and a high-quality client experience.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain integrated project plans, timelines, milestones, and action trackers.
* Coordinate program activities across multidisciplinary scientific teams.
* Facilitate project meetings and document decisions, actions, risks, and dependencies.
* Monitor program performance against scope, timelines, budget, and deliverables.
* Support financial tracking, forecasting, and change management activities.
* Prepare program reports and dashboards for clients and internal stakeholders.
* Work closely with Scientific Project Leaders to align operational plans with scientific priorities.
* Identify and escalate risks, issues, and schedule impacts.
* Support proposal development, project start-up, and program expansion activities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of program management processes and tools.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related scientific discipline. A Master's degree is preferred.
* Typically 1-3 years of project or program management experience in a CRO, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or related drug discovery environment.
* Experience supporting or managing cross-functional programs involving multiple studies, stakeholders, timelines, budgets, and interdependent deliverables.
* Working knowledge of integrated drug discovery and the relationship between chemistry, biology, ADME/DMPK, pharmacology, safety, and toxicology activities.
* Program management certification or formal project-management training; experience supporting global, multi-site drug discovery programs.
* Strong program planning and execution skills, including work breakdown, critical-path management, milestone tracking, prioritization, and delivery recovery.
* Ability to lead cross-functional, matrixed teams through influence, establish clear accountability, and drive timely decisions.
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including budget management, forecasting, revenue and margin awareness, invoicing visibility, and scope control.
* Working knowledge of risk and issue management, dependency management, change control, governance, and escalation practices.
* Strong client-facing communication, facilitation, negotiation, stakeholder-management, and presentation skills.
* Sound analytical judgment and structured problem-solving, with the ability to challenge assumptions, work through ambiguity, and recommend practical options.
* Ability to communicate complex operational, and financial information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, follow-through, attention to detail, and commitment to quality and on-time delivery.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively across functions, sites, cultures, and time zones.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project-management, collaboration, reporting, and data-visualization tools; experience with Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, SharePoint, CRM, or ERP/AX is desirable.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project/program management certification is desirable.
* Flexible working hours and occasional travel may be required to support global programs, client meetings, and internal collaboration.

title: Senior DPDPA GRC Consultant
description:
**About the Role**

* We are looking for an experienced Senior DPDPA GRC Consultant to support the execution and oversight of a large-scale Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) compliance program.
* The candidate will work closely with the Program Lead, Head of DPDPA, internal business teams, and external consulting partners to ensure successful gap assessment, remediation, and implementation.
* This role requires someone with practical DPDP experience, strong GRC fundamentals, and the ability to independently manage multiple compliance workstreams.
* The person must be able to understand assessment findings, identify missing areas, review implementation progress, guide stakeholders, and ensure deliverables are completed on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee day-to-day activities across multiple DPDPA workstreams.
* Review DPDP gap assessment findings, recommendations, and implementation deliverables prepared by external consulting partners.
* Validate department-wise data inventories, data flows, personal data processing activities, and assessment coverage.
* Identify missed requirements, incomplete assessments, compliance gaps, and implementation risks.
* Review remediation plans and track implementation progress against agreed timelines.
* Coordinate with IT, Legal, HR, Finance, Marketing, Operations, and other business functions.
* Work closely with external consulting partners to ensure delivery aligns with business priorities and DPDP requirements.
* Review activities related to consent management, privacy notices, Data Principal rights, grievance handling, data retention, vendor risk, and breach response.
* Track deliverables, action owners, timelines, dependencies, risks, and closure evidence.
* Validate compliance evidence and follow up on incomplete or ineffective remediation.
* Guide internal teams on required actions and help resolve implementation blockers.
* Prepare management updates, compliance status reports, risk summaries, and escalation notes.
* Escalate critical risks, delays, and dependencies to the Head of DPDPA promptly.
* Support governance reviews, audit readiness, and overall program execution.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Minimum 6 years of professional experience in GRC, information security compliance, risk management, privacy, or IT audit.
* Hands-on DPDP / DPDPA gap assessment, readiness assessment, or implementation experience is mandatory.
* Must have directly participated in at least one DPDP assessment or implementation engagement.
* Strong practical understanding of the DPDP Act, applicable rules, and compliance requirements.
* Experience reviewing data inventories, data flows, consent processes, privacy notices, vendor data handling, and remediation activities.
* Experience coordinating compliance projects involving multiple business departments.
* Ability to review consultant deliverables, identify gaps, and challenge findings where necessary.
* Experience managing compliance trackers, risks, dependencies, deadlines, and evidence collection.
* Strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently with senior management and external partners.
* Must be based in Delhi NCR and available to work from the Delhi office.
* Must be available to join immediately or within 15 days.

**Good to Have**

* ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 27701, or other privacy and information security compliance experience.
* Experience working with Big 4 consulting firms or large enterprise compliance programs.
* Experience in privacy impact assessments, vendor risk management, or IT security control reviews.
* Relevant GRC, privacy, or information security certifications.

**Important: Please Read Before Applying**

This position requires actual DPDP project experience, not just theoretical knowledge or certification.

Candidates with only general ISO 27001, SOC 2, audit documentation, or project coordination experience without practical DPDP exposure will not be considered.

**Please apply only if you meet all three conditions:**

1. Minimum 6 years of relevant GRC experience with hands-on DPDP assessment or implementation exposure.
2. Based in Delhi NCR and comfortable working full-time from the Delhi office.
3. Available to join immediately or within 15 days.

Shortlisted candidates will be expected to explain their actual DPDP project responsibilities, assessment activities, identified gaps, and implementation involvement during the interview.

Advanced qualification in Operations or Manufacturing Management.
  
  
**Detailed Job Description**
**Role Purpose**
The Head – Plant Operations will be responsible for end-to-end plant operations and greenfield manufacturing project execution, including plant setup, commissioning, production readiness, ramp-up, operational stabilization and achievement of manufacturing KPIs.
  
  
The role will lead cross-functional teams and work closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, HR and R&D to establish and operate a high-performance manufacturing facility.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Greenfield Plant Setup & Commissioning**
Lead end-to-end greenfield plant setup and commissioning from project planning through production readiness.
  
  
Drive plant layout, infrastructure, utilities, machinery, production lines and equipment readiness.
  
  
Manage installation, commissioning, trial production and operational handover.
  
  
Establish project milestones, timelines, budgets, governance and risk-mitigation mechanisms.
  
  
Coordinate with engineering teams, contractors, equipment suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  
  
**Plant Operations & Production**
Own end-to-end plant manufacturing and production operations.
  
  
Drive production, capacity utilization, OEE, productivity, throughput and delivery targets.
  
  
Ensure effective manpower planning, line balancing and takt-time adherence.
  
  
Establish standardized operating processes and shop-floor governance.
  
  
Lead production ramp-up from pilot/SOP stage to stable volume production.
  
  
**Manufacturing Excellence**
Drive Lean Manufacturing, TPM, Kaizen, 5S and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
Improve OEE and reduce downtime, rejection, rework and manufacturing losses.
  
  
Establish plant-level operational dashboards and performance reviews.
  
  
Drive automation, digitization and MES-enabled shop-floor operations.
  
  
**Quality & Process Excellence**
Ensure adherence to defined product and process quality standards.
  
  
Drive First-Time-Right, rejection reduction, defect prevention and root-cause analysis.
  
  
Establish robust process controls across manufacturing operations.
  
  
Partner with Quality teams for process validation and continuous improvement.
  
  
Support prototype, pilot and new-product manufacturing activities.
  
  
**New Product Introduction & SOP**
Drive manufacturing readiness for new products and variants.
  
  
Coordinate prototype, pilot and pre-SOP builds.
  
  
Ensure readiness of manpower, machinery, process, material, tooling and quality systems.
  
  
Lead production ramp-up while maintaining quality, cost and delivery targets.
  
  
**Supply Chain & Supplier Readiness**
Work closely with Procurement, SCM and suppliers to ensure uninterrupted material availability. Drive supplier readiness for new product launches and production ramp-up.
  
  
Resolve material, supplier and production bottlenecks.
  
  
Optimize material flow from incoming material through WIP to finished products.
  
  
**CapEx & Cost Management**
Own manufacturing CapEx planning and execution.
  
  
Ensure projects are delivered within approved timelines and budgets.
  
  
Drive manufacturing cost reduction, productivity improvement and manpower optimization.
  
  
Monitor conversion cost and plant operational expenses.
  
  
**EHS & Compliance**
Establish a strong Safety, Health and Environmental culture across the plant.
  
  
Ensure compliance with statutory, environmental and manufacturing requirements.
  
  
Conduct safety audits, risk assessments and corrective-action reviews.
  
  
Drive safe and sustainable manufacturing practices.
  
  
**People Leadership**
Build and lead a high-performing plant organization.
  
  
Develop plant leadership, engineering, production and shop-floor talent.
  
  
Drive manpower planning, capability building and technical training.
  
  
Establish a culture of accountability, safety, quality and operational excellence.
  
  
**Senior Stakeholder Management**
Work closely with senior leadership on plant strategy, capacity, investment and operational performance.
  
  
Partner with Engineering, R&D, Quality, SCM, Procurement, Finance and HR.
  
  
Present plant performance, risks, CapEx, productivity and operational improvement plans to senior management.
  
  
**Other Specific Remarks**
Greenfield plant setup and commissioning experience is mandatory.
  
  
Candidates with only steady-state plant operations experience and no plant setup/project execution exposure should not be considered.
  
  
Strong preference for candidates from Automotive / EV / Commercial Vehicle / Auto Component manufacturing.
  
  
Candidate should have demonstrated experience in production ramp-up and SOP stabilization.
  
  
**Experience Managing Significant CapEx And Manufacturing Investments Is Preferred.**
Strong exposure to Lean, TPM, OEE and manufacturing excellence is expected.
  
  
Role requires regular presence at the manufacturing plant.
  
  
Candidate should be comfortable working in a high-growth manufacturing environment.
  
  
Experience in setting up a new production line/facility and subsequently taking ownership of operations should be clearly demonstrated in the CV.

title: Operations & Brand Partnerships Executive (Health | Wellness | K-Beauty | Retail | E-Commerce)
description:
**Company:**
Ivy & Prime

**Location:**
Civil Lines, Delhi NCR

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | In-Office + Field Operations

**Experience:**
1–3 Years (Entrepreneurial and Startup Experience Preferred)

**Compensation:**
₹20,000–₹40,000 per month + Performance-Linked Incentives

**About Ivy & Prime**

**Ivy & Prime is a next-generation venture studio and global ecosystem built to engineer the future of health and wellness.**
As a hands-on venture studio, we bring together a powerhouse network of global partners, deep operational expertise, and strategic capital to transform early-stage concepts into market-defining health solutions. By pairing visionary founders with unfair advantages in capital, distribution, and clinical insights, we don’t just back the next big health innovation-we build it from the ground up. We actively co-build alongside our portfolio companies, delivering day-one operational support and built-in commercial distribution to accelerate innovations from inception to enterprise scale.

We have an integrated network of:

**Retailers | Clinics | Distributors | Brand Partners | Founders**

We are creating a platform where brands, professionals, operators, and consumers connect to create sustainable commercial opportunities.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive and
**Entrepreneurial Operations & Brand Partnerships Executive**
to work closely with Ivy & Prime's founding team.

This is a hands-on role combining business operations, international brand onboarding, vendor management, strategic partnerships, retail execution, and business development.

The selected candidate will help coordinate and execute Ivy & Prime's expanding business verticals, particularly K-Beauty retail stores, clinical skincare, wellness partnerships, and e-commerce operations.

You will work with Korean and international brands, distributors, sourcing partners, airport stakeholders, clinic operators, doctors, service providers, and internal teams to convert business opportunities into functioning operations.

This is not a conventional sales, marketing, or administrative position. It requires someone who can manage relationships, coordinate stakeholders, organize operational workflows, solve problems, and take ownership of execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Commercial Execution**

* Identify business opportunities across retail, e-commerce, clinics, distribution, and founder networks.
* Generate qualified leads, conduct outreach, arrange meetings, and prepare partnership proposals.
* Support commercial negotiations, partnership structures, onboarding agreements, and revenue opportunities.
* Develop business presentations, partner decks, research summaries, and commercial comparisons.

**2. Operations & Retail Store Management**

* Support the setup, launch, and daily management of K-Beauty, skincare, wellness, and specialty retail stores, including airport retail locations.
* Coordinate store infrastructure, vendors, fixtures, merchandising, inventory, staffing, and operational readiness.
* Coordinate with store managers, beauty advisors, suppliers, and external service providers.
* Monitor stock availability, replenishment, product displays, customer feedback, and store performance.

**3. Brand Onboarding & International Partnerships**

* Identify, approach, and onboard Korean, Asian, and international beauty, skincare, health, and wellness brands.
* Manage brand onboarding requirements, including product catalogs, commercial terms, documentation, product information, pricing, and marketing assets.
* Support discussions regarding product selection, inventory arrangements, distribution opportunities, consignment models, and promotional commitments.

**4. Vendor, Sourcing & Strategic Partnerships**

* Identify and develop relationships with relevant vendors, distributors, logistics providers, retail operators, agencies, and business partners.
* Coordinate vendor quotations, commercial proposals, negotiations, agreements, and execution timelines.
* Support sourcing of products, retail fixtures, displays, testers, promotional materials, and operational services.
* Build partnerships with airport operators, specialty retailers, clinics, salons, spas, wellness centers, and professional networks.

**5. Clinic, Healthcare & Wellness Partnerships**

* Identify and coordinate partnerships with dermatologists, aesthetic doctors, cosmetologists, clinics, pharmacies, salons, spas, and wellness professionals.
* Assist with the development of clinic, beauty, and wellness service concepts and pilot locations.
* Coordinate clinical partners, service providers, brands, and operating teams.

**6. E-Commerce, Community & Marketing Coordination**

* Support product listings, marketplace coordination, online brand activation, and e-commerce operational workflows.
* Assist with product launches, sampling programs, brand showcases, community events, and B2B networking activities.
* Maintain engagement with distributors, creators, buyers, professionals, and business communities.
* Coordinate social media and promotional deliverables without making content creation the primary responsibility of the role.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for an execution-oriented professional who enjoys building new business opportunities and can manage multiple stakeholders in a fast-moving startup environment.

**Experience & Professional Background**

* 1–3 years of relevant experience in operations, brand partnerships, business development, retail, e-commerce, vendor management, or startups.
* Prior experience in a Founder’s Office, entrepreneurial venture, or early-stage business is advantageous.
* Ability to communicate with international partners across different time zones.
* Willingness to attend field meetings, visit retail locations, and coordinate with vendors independently.

**Preferred Educational Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline. Preferred backgrounds include:

* B.Tech / B.E.
* B.Pharm / Pharmacy
* BBA / MBA
* Healthcare, Life Sciences, Beauty, Retail, or related disciplines
* MBBS / BDS candidates interested in business and operations roles may also apply.

Relevant professional experience and demonstrated execution ability will be considered alongside formal qualifications.

**Compensation & Growth Opportunities**

**Fixed Salary:**
₹20,000–₹40,000 per month, depending on experience and capabilities.

**Incentives:**
Performance-linked incentives based on brand onboarding, partnership conversions, revenue contribution, and operational milestones.

**Career Growth:**
Opportunity to progress into Brand Partnerships Manager, Retail Operations Manager, Business Operations Manager, or a broader Founder’s Office leadership role as Ivy & Prime expands.

**We are looking for someone who can connect the right partners, coordinate the right resources, and turn business opportunities into operational results.**

**Location:**
Civil Lines, Delhi

**Job Type:**
Full-Time, In-Office

**Salary:**
₹20,000–₹40,000 per month + Incentives

title: Head - SAP Services -
description:
******JOB PURPOSE******
Head – SAP Services will lead the SAP ecosystem across GMR and its entities. The role covers strategy, architecture, delivery, operations and compliance. It ensures robust ERP performance, a clean-core and scalable S/4HANA landscape, audit readiness, and tight integration with airport operations, commercial and corporate functions. As strategic owner of SAP application services, the role is accountable for governance, innovation (including SAP BTP, analytics and AI), vendor and licence management, and business value from SAP investments.
  
  
****ORGANISATION CHART****
CIO - Enterprise IT --> Head SAP Services
  
  
****Responsibilities****
****KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES****
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
******SAP Strategy, Architecture & Governance******

* Define and own the multi-year SAP roadmap aligned with GAL's digital transformation goals, including the S/4HANA path (version upgrades or RISE with SAP decisions) and a clean-core approach.
* Lead planning and business cases for large SAP transformation programmes.
* Govern SAP architecture, data models, custom code, and dependencies across modules (FI-CO, MM, SD, HCM, PS, PM, RE-FX as applicable) and across airport entities.
* Standardise master data, taxonomy and reporting hierarchies across business units and joint ventures, so regulator (AERA) and concession reporting works across entities.
* Drive adoption of SAP BTP, process automation, workflow digitisation, embedded analytics (SAC/Datasphere) and AI use cases with the Data & AI CoE.
* Run an SAP Architecture/Design Authority and a governance forum with business process owners.
* Adherence to roadmap milestones (on time and on budget)
* Realised ROI and benefits on SAP investments, against the business case
* % reduction in custom code, or clean-core compliance score
* Master data quality
* ROI on SAP investments

******Program & Operations Management******

* Oversee day-to-day operations across SAP modules for uptime, SLA compliance and fast incident resolution.
* Stabilise new SAP projects after go-live (new modules, rollouts to new etntities, integrations).
* Govern the full ticket lifecycle (incidents, service requests, change requests, problems), including root-cause analysis to reduce repeat issues.
* Lead integration across S/4HANA, SuccessFactors and Ariba, and with third-party and systems (billing, e-invoicing/IRP, GST, banking host-to-host, and other systems)
* Coordinate month-end, quarter-end and year-end closing with Finance.
* Make statutory configuration changes on time (GST, TDS, labour codes, Ind AS updates).
* Own SAP disaster recovery, backup and business continuity, including periodic DR drills.
* % SAP availability/uptime
* % tickets resolved within SLA, split by incident, service request and change
* % reduction in repeat P1/P2 incidents
* Number of successful system integrations
* Closing calendar adherence (financial close days)
* DR drill success and RPO/RTO compliance (recovery point and time objectives)

******Enhancements & Change Management******

* Lead identification, prioritization, and execution of system enhancement initiatives across modules.
* Validate business cases for enhancements and ensure ROI justification, budgeting, and vendor coordination.
* Govern the customization lifecycle: review functional specs, interface designs, development timelines, test plans, and UAT outcomes.
* Approve release schedules for new functionalities, patches, upgrades, and version migrations.
* Institutionalize structured change management and communication plans for major releases and system rollouts.
* Number of process enhancements completed annually
* Business satisfaction scores

****Responsibilities****
****KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES - Additional Details****
**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
******Vendor, Licence & Contract Management******

* Drive partner selection, scope, SLAs, commercial negotiations and renewals with Procurement and Legal.
* Manage SAP, AMS and implementation partners on roadmap alignment and delivery milestones (configuration, enhancements, upgrades, patches).
* Track vendor performance against contract KPIs (resolution SLAs, deployment success rate, defect leakage, audit support) and hold quarterly business reviews.
* Run escalation mechanisms for cross-vendor dependencies and delivery risks in multi-partner setups.
* Own SAP licence management: user licence optimisation, annual licence audit (LAW), indirect/digital access compliance, and SAP support contract value (Enterprise Support or RISE).
* % vendor adherence to SLA
* Turnaround time for service requests
* SAP licence cost optimisation (% savings or avoided cost)
* licence audit

******Compliance, Audit & Risk Management******

* Own audit readiness of SAP landscape â ensure compliance with internal controls, access governance, segregation of duties, and audit trails.
* Coordinate with internal and statutory auditors to provide data extracts, system walkthroughs, and evidential logs.
* Collaborate with IT security team for secure integrations, data access protocols, and 3rd party approvals.
* Ensure compliance with the DPDP Act 2023 for personal data in SAP, especially HR and SuccessFactors.
* Run periodic user access reviews and remediate SoD conflicts.
* % critical audit issues closed on time
* Number of repeat audit observations (target: zero)
* % SoD conflicts remediated or mitigated
* % critical SAP security notes applied within SLA
* % of critical audit issues resolved within defined timelines

**Team Development and Management**

* Identify training needs, facilitate skill development programs, and enhance team competencies.
* Implement structured mentorship and leadership development initiatives.
* Address team concerns, provide guidance, and create opportunities for professional growth.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Encourage participation in team-building activities and employee engagement initiatives.
* Attrition rates
* Employee Engagement scores
* % Participation in training and upskilling programs

****EXTERNAL INTERACTIONS****

* SAP SE (account team, Enterprise Support/MaxAttention, RISE)
* SAP implementation and AMS partners
* Third-party software and integration vendors
* Hyperscaler or hosting partner
* Statutory auditors
* Banks and payment partners (host-to-host integration)
* Government portals: GSTN, IRP/e-invoicing, TRACES

****INTERNAL INTERACTIONS****

* Group CIO / Head IT
* Group CFO and Business Finance Heads
* Group CHRO and Business HR Heads
* Head Procurement / Commercial
* Internal Audit and IT Security Team

****FINANCIAL DIMENSIONS****
******OTHER DIMENSIONS******
****EDUCATION QUALIFICATIONS****

* B.E./B.Tech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, or related field
* MBA in relevant field preferred
* SAP Certifications across relevant modules (Finance, MM, HR, SD, ABAP) preferred
