title: Project Head - Carbon Capture, Bio Industrial Solutions and Circular Materials
description:
**Project Head - Carbon Capture, Bio Industrial Solutions and Circular Materials**

CarbonWeave Ventures Private Limited is part of Sindhu Trade Links Limited, the flagship holding company of the diversified Sindhu Group. The company is establishing a new climate-tech and circular-materials business spanning carbon capture, biochar, algae, biotechnology and fly-ash utilisation.

The initiative is currently at the concept stage and has direct Promoter sponsorship. An identified land parcel, project funding and initial resources are available. The Project Head will convert this foundation into an executable, controlled and commercially viable business platform and build the organisation from the ground up.

**Role informationRole : Project Head - Carbon Capture, Bio-Industrial Solutions and Circular Materials**

**Company :**
CarbonWeave Ventures Private Limited

**Group : Sindhu Trade Links Limited and the diversified Sindhu Group**

**Business stage :**
Greenfield concept-to-commercial build

**Employment : Full-time and exclusive**

**Base location :**
Raipur, Chhattisgarh - approximately three weeks per month

**Corporate travel : Gurgaon headquarters -**
approximately one week per month, plus project-related travel

**Reporting :**
Directly to the Promoter

**Role Overview**

CarbonWeave is seeking a senior techno-commercial Project Head to build and lead an integrated carbon capture and circular-materials platform. The role covers CCUS, biochar, algae-based CO2 capture, biotechnology and bio-industrial solutions, and value-added fly-ash utilisation.

This is not a narrow plant-management, research or sustainability-reporting role. It requires a business builder who can combine technology evaluation, industrial project execution, commercialisation, carbon integrity, regulatory discipline, safety and P&L thinking. The successful candidate is not expected to be the deepest specialist in every technical stream; they must bring credible depth in relevant areas and be able to assemble and lead specialist teams across the wider platform.

**Strategic Mandate**

· Create a commercially viable independent business vertical with its own revenue and P&L roadmap.

· Support the Sindhu Group's decarbonisation objectives, develop credible carbon assets and create new products and business opportunities.

· Build a portfolio of projects across CCUS, biochar, algae, biotechnology and fly-ash utilisation. Multiple initiatives are expected to progress concurrently, supported by specialist teams.

· Translate the current concept into board-ready business plans, detailed project reports, pilot programmes, operating systems and commercial-scale execution.

· Establish disciplined governance so that technology, capex, safety, regulatory and carbon-related decisions are supported by evidence and clear accountability.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy and Business Model**

· Prepare and execute a three-year and five-year roadmap for the carbon and circular bio-industrial platform.

· Evaluate opportunities based on carbon impact, technical feasibility, regulatory risk, capex, margins, scalability and offtake certainty.

· Develop detailed project reports, capex and opex estimates, unit-economics models, risk notes, pilot budgets and implementation plans for approval.

· Recommend the appropriate operating model for each opportunity, including an internal division, project-specific partnership, SPV, JV, technology-licensing or other structure.

**Project Development and Technology**

· Identify and assess CO2 sources, biomass and other feedstocks, algae cultivation routes, fly-ash supply chains, industrial partners and customer markets.

· Lead technology scouting, technical due diligence, vendor evaluation, process selection and techno-commercial comparisons across the project portfolio.

· Direct site planning, pilot design, equipment selection, utilities, procurement, commissioning, trial operations and scale-up to commercial implementation.

· Establish project controls covering budget, schedule, quality, contractor performance, procurement, commissioning and handover.

· Ensure pilot programmes generate reliable and scalable operating data rather than remaining demonstration-only initiatives.

**Operating Model and Team Build**

· Build the core multidisciplinary team from the ground up, including process engineering, plant operations, biotechnology and R&D, materials, MRV, EHS, quality, project management and commercial capabilities.

· Create SOPs, production controls, quality systems, maintenance practices, data dashboards and escalation mechanisms for laboratory, pilot and commercial operations.

· Set performance measures for project delivery, operating reliability, yield, energy use, product quality, carbon impact, safety, compliance and commercial outcomes.

· Develop a practical culture of ownership, evidence-based decision-making and cross-functional collaboration among scientists, engineers, operators, contractors and commercial teams.

**Carbon Integrity Compliance and Safety**

· Build robust Measurement, Reporting and Verification systems for carbon reduction, utilisation and removal claims, including baselines, monitoring plans, sampling, chain of custody and audit-ready evidence.

· Ensure that environmental and carbon claims are supported by reliable data, third-party testing and appropriate validation and verification.

· Coordinate environmental permits, regulatory requirements and product approvals with internal and external specialists and government agencies.

· Establish rigorous EHS controls for CO2, pressure systems, high-temperature processes, dust and ash handling, chemicals, wastewater and biological contamination risks.

**Commercialisation and Partnerships**

· Develop commercially viable products and solutions across biochar, algae biomass and derivatives, biotechnology products, fly-ash-based materials and CO2-utilisation applications.

· Build partnerships with industrial emitters, power and cement companies, technology providers, EPC partners, laboratories, research institutions, universities, carbon registries and other ecosystem participants.

· Develop customer trials, specifications, pricing logic, commercial proposals and offtake arrangements before committing to scale-up.

· Create revenue opportunities through product sales, industrial projects, carbon assets, technology licensing, partnerships and other viable downstream opportunities.

**Leadership and Governance**

· Work closely and directly with the Promoter to shape the strategy and establish the business and governance structure.

· Coordinate with finance, legal, HR, EHS, commercial and other Group functions, as well as consultants, vendors, auditors and external partners.

· Present clear progress, budget, risk, compliance and commercial updates to the Promoter and senior management, together with decisions and support required.

· Operate with appropriate commercial discipline and protect the company from uncontrolled capex, weak technical assumptions, regulatory breaches, safety incidents and unsupported sustainability claims.

**Candidate Profile**

**Experience**

· Approximately 5-25 years of relevant experience across industrial projects, process engineering, environmental engineering, carbon projects, biotechnology or bioprocess scale-up, plant operations, circular materials or related sectors.

· At least five years of leadership responsibility covering teams, vendors, budgets, schedules and project execution.

· Demonstrated success in building a new plant, pilot, laboratory, technology platform, project portfolio or business vertical from the ground up.

· Experience taking technologies or industrial projects from concept and feasibility through pilot, commissioning, operation and commercial scale-up.

· Strong exposure to commercial evaluation, unit economics, capex and opex, contracts, customer development, partnerships and offtake.

**Education**

A B.Tech, M.Tech or equivalent qualification in Chemical, Environmental, Biotechnology, Bioprocess, Materials, Mechanical, Civil or Industrial Engineering, or a closely related applied science discipline. An MBA or PGDM, PhD, or relevant certification in carbon accounting, EHS, project management or quality systems would be advantageous when supported by strong industrial execution experience.

**Relevant Technical Exposure**

Candidates should bring meaningful depth in one or more of the following areas and the ability to integrate specialist teams across the broader platform:

· Carbon Capture Utilisation and Storage, CO2 capture or CO2 utilisation

· Biochar, biomass conversion, pyrolysis or gasification

· Algae cultivation, photobioreactors or biological CO2 capture

· Biotechnology, fermentation or bioprocess scale-up

· Carbon mineralisation, fly-ash utilisation, geopolymers, cementitious materials or concrete additives

· Environmental and industrial process systems

· Carbon accounting, MRV, carbon-credit methodologies or verified carbon projects

**Leadership Attributes**

· Broad-based techno-commercial and entrepreneurial orientation

· Hands-on, site-focused leadership style with strong execution discipline

· Ability to make pragmatic decisions under uncertainty and build capability around technical gaps

· High standards of safety, compliance, data integrity and documentation

· Commercial pragmatism and willingness to challenge weak business cases or unsupported claims

· Credibility with technical specialists, industrial partners, regulators, customers, financiers and senior leadership

**Why Consider This Opportunity**

* This is a greenfield leadership opportunity to create a new climate-tech and circular-materials platform within an established diversified Group. The Project Head will have direct access to the Promoter, substantial influence over the business and technical roadmap, and the opportunity to build the team, operating model, partnerships and commercial portfolio from inception.

* Expert in CLM configuration with template rationalization and harmonization, guide or playbook creation and the design of the contracting processes and related functionality

We are focusing our collective efforts to advance sustainability, equity, and trust that come to life through our core commitments. Learn more about Deloitte’s purpose, commitments, and impact.

A Senior Audit Project Lead, leads and manages multiple complex audit projects, overseeing the entire audit process from planning to reporting and ensuring the quality and timely completion of the project in conformance with Internal Audit policies and procedures. The Senior Audit Project Lead may be supervising or consulting on some of these projects while performing planning, fieldwork or reporting on others.
  
  
This senior-level role requires strong leadership, technical expertise, and a deep understanding of audit methodologies, risk management, and relevant frameworks like COSO, SOX/ ICFR and other IT or cybersecurity frameworks. Key responsibilities include developing audit plans, leading and mentoring audit teams, managing project risks, and ensuring objectives are met while maintaining professional judgment and delivering high-quality results.
  
  
The Senior Audit Project Lead is also expected to anticipate and smoothly handle unusual situations and challenges with minimal guidance and support from VGO Internal Audit management. This role will also be responsible for ensuring appropriate and timely follow-up on management action plans from published audit reports. The Senior Audit Project lead will directly oversee the audit projects, the Senior/ Staff Auditor(s) and/or Intern(s) assigned to the project, and the client relationship. This position will also help assist junior team members in carrying out their daily responsibilities. The Senior Audit Project Lead reports to the Senior Manager, Internal Audit.
  
  
**How You Make An Impact (Job Accountabilities)**
Primary responsibilities are related to the full scope of audit project execution and a high level of proficiency, efficiency, and effectiveness, and include the following:
  
  
**Audit Project Management**

* Provides significant project leadership for the Internal Audit process and oversees the associated testing of controls
* Serves as the primary interface with process owners, external audit management and Corporate
* Accounting personnel to communicate design assessment conclusions and testing results
* Develops subject matter expertise within select audit and business process areas (and / or
* technologies), and frequently advises VGO management on risk and control issues, follow-up audits, and management requests in those areas
* Participates in annual risk assessment interviews with VGO management, and provides Internal
* Audit management feedback on design of annual Audit Plan
* Acquires and demonstrates an understanding of the business process / legal entity under review and identify potential risks
* Prepares the Engagement Program, Audit Objectives Memo, Draft Audit Report and various other audit and project management related documents (as prescribed by VGO Internal Audit’s policies and procedures) by coordinating input / feedback from the audit team and client
* Designs and executes an effective strategic testing approach
* Reviews workpapers to evaluate fieldwork and testing results to verify that appropriate conclusions are reached about the adequacy of controls and the efficiency and effectiveness of business processes
* Provides constructive and timely workpaper review notes and guidance to audit team members
* Applies VGO Internal Audit processes and project management procedures in completing all aspects of the audit / assignment
* Anticipates project management roadblocks and implements measures to mitigate such circumstances
* Presents audit results to VGO management both verbally and through the audit reporting process, and obtains appropriate, timely management action plans and target dates

**Client Relationship Management**

* Manages VGO Internal Audit and client expectations regarding deliverables, timing, and how the audit process works
* Delivers audit services in a timely manner with minimal disruptions to client workflow
* Leads the Internal Planning, Senior Management Opening, Management Risk Assessment, Status Update and Client Closing meetings
* Maintains an open dialogue with client management about the project, and is responsive and professional when potential conflict situations arise
* Works with client management to develop practical action plans that are appropriately designed to be successful, cost-effective solutions to mitigate the underlying risks

**People Management**

* Assists in staff recruiting and hiring as requested
* Assists in the preparation and delivery of internal training for select new or revised audit processes and at select internal training sessions and VGO Internal Audit Department Training Summits
* Serves as an audit subject matter expert (SME) and sounding board for less experienced auditors
* Assists in the oversight of the VGO Internal Audit intern program, and serves as a mentor to interns and staff auditors as requested
* Delegates appropriate work to Senior and staff auditors and oversees timely, accurate completion of work
* Provides ad-hoc guidance as needed to assist audit staff in the completion of their assigned work
* Coaches team members on learning and applying technical and soft skills that contribute to the individual’s professional development and to successful project completion
* Provides frequent ad hoc guidance and feedback regarding audit staff performance, and completes their final Internal Audit Project Evaluation form and discusses with the audit staff to help improve their performance on future engagements and further their professional development

**Quality Assurance and Improvement Program (QAIP) Support**

* Provides thought leadership and design / implementation support on designated audit process improvement initiatives
* Provides quality assurance support and review of audit process compliance for select audit engagements
* Leads Internal Audit focus groups in soliciting input and feedback for internal audit process changes and continuous improvement initiatives

**What You Bring to the Role (Job Qualifications / Education / Skills / Requirements / Capabilities)**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Information Technology or comparable major required.

+ Master of Business Administration in Finance or Chartered Accountant or Certified Public Accountant is required
+ Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) certification is required
+ Additional qualification of CIA, CISSP, CISM or CFE is preferred
+ Minimum 8 years of post-qualification experience in Internal Auditing across Financial, Operational and Information Technology domains

**Competencies Desired**
Senior Audit Project Lead's are expected to possess and further develop the following skills and personal characteristics:

* Proficient in Understanding and Analyzing the Interrelationship between Risk and Control
* Project Management

+ Scheduling Planning
+ Budgeting / Tracking
+ Prioritization of Audit Work
+ Use and Alignment of Resources

* Presentation

+ Demeanor
+ Professionalism
+ Customer Focus-Driven
+ Comfort around Senior Management
+ Business Acumen

* Conflict Management

+ Negotiating
+ Listening
+ Overcoming Obstacles and Building Consensus

* Leadership

+ Delegating and Coaching
+ Managing and Measuring Work
+ Evaluating Skills and Behaviors

* Communication

+ Ability to Persuade with Verbal and Written Communications
+ Focused, Relevant, and Impactful Report Writing

* “Big Picture” Thinking

+ Risk Assessment and Solution Design
+ Synthesizing Issues
+ Understanding the Downstream Implications of Process Steps / Issues

title: Manager, Process Solutions
description:

Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.
  
  
At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.
  
  
Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Partner across People Team functions to understand business needs, clarify problems, and support practical process solutions that work across functional boundaries.
* Analyze current-state processes, data, controls, and stakeholder experiences to identify gaps, risks, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
* Gather, document, analyze, and validate business, process, functional, application, data, and reporting requirements. Translate stakeholder needs into clear, actionable, and testable requirements, and trace those requirements through process steps, system behavior, data requirements, reporting, and downstream impacts. Identify unclear, incomplete, or conflicting requirements and escalate decisions to the appropriate stakeholders rather than relying on unsupported assumptions
* Evaluate current capabilities against stakeholder needs and document gaps, dependencies, and potential solution options for optimization. Support the design and implementation of future-state processes, including planning, testing, readiness, communications, training, and transition activities.
* Coordinate work across business partners, People Team teams, Technology, vendors, and other stakeholders to help move priorities from concept through delivery.
* Monitor process performance and issues using available data, feedback, and operational insights; recommend actions that improve effectiveness, quality, and employee experience.
* Identify opportunities to simplify work, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls, standardize practices, and enable appropriate automation or self-service.
* Help manage project plans, dependencies, risks, decisions, action items, and status updates for assigned initiatives.
* Provide responsive consulting and problem-solving support across multiple People Team domains rather than a single Center of Excellence.
* Maintain clear, current, and audit-ready process documentation and contribute to shared standards, tools, and knowledge across the Process Consulting team.

**What You Can Expect**

* A collaborative, cross-functional role with exposure to a broad range of People Team processes, programs, systems, and stakeholders.
* Opportunities to work on complex problems, build consulting and delivery capabilities, and contribute to enterprise priorities.
* A team environment that values curiosity, sound judgment, candor, accountability, continuous improvement, and practical solutions.
* A mix of analytical work, stakeholder partnership, project coordination, and hands-on implementation support.

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience in human resources, business, operations, process improvement, technology, analytics, or a related field.
* Experience supporting business processes, projects, operations, consulting, or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to organize information, identify patterns, and translate findings into clear recommendations.
* Ability to gather and document requirements, map processes, coordinate testing, and support implementation activities.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to tailor information for business, operational, and technical audiences.
* Strong collaboration, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across teams.
* Attention to detail and a commitment to data quality, process discipline, appropriate controls, and a positive stakeholder experience.
* Comfort working in an evolving environment, learning new domains quickly, and contributing both independently and as part of a team.

**What Will Set You Apart**

* Experience with process mapping, Lean, Six Sigma, design thinking, business analysis, project delivery, or change management methods.
* Experience supporting HR or People Team processes, shared services, enterprise systems, or global operating models.
* Familiarity with Workday, ServiceNow, Microsoft 365, reporting tools, workflow solutions, or automation technologies.
* Ability to connect details across processes and systems while keeping the employee and stakeholder experience in view.
* A practical, improvement-oriented mindset and the confidence to ask thoughtful questions, challenge complexity, and help teams reach clear decisions.

title: Manager, Energy - Global Capability Center

title: Scrum Master
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
  
  
Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25-year-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
  
  
While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
  
  
**Position Overview**
The key purpose of the SCRUM Master is to reinforce and refine agile/scrum ways of working and business processes throughout project life cycles within the Data, Analytics, and Automation team. This role is responsible for ensuring each delivery team runs efficient sprint planning meetings, facilitates sprint retrospectives, and works closely with the Director of Enterprise Digital Transformation & Value Realization. This role operates at the heart of the DAA team, maximizing the project prioritization efficiency and ensuring timely development and management of data-related solutions to deliver value in line with the business’s strategy. This role involves a combination of Scrum management experience, business acumen, technical knowledge, and leadership skills
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Agile Delivery & Execution**

* Facilitate effective Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, backlog refinement and other Agile ceremonies.
* Partner with Product Owners to ensure backlogs are appropriately prioritized, refined, and ready for execution.
* Establish and maintain delivery rhythms that enable teams to meet Sprint and release commitments.
* Monitor progress, identify delivery risks and proactively address issues before they impact business outcomes
* Ensure teams maintain appropriate Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, and quality standards.
* Track delivery against milestones, commitments, capacity, and dependencies.
* Help teams translate strategic priorities into actionable increments of work.
* Protect the team from unnecessary disruption while maintaining transparency with stakeholders.

**Team Coaching & Agile Ways of Working**

* Serve as a servant leader and Agile coach, helping teams become increasingly self-organizing, accountable, and high performing.
* Coach team members, Product Owners and stakeholders on Agile principles, Scrum practices and effective collaboration.
* Identify behaviors, processes or organizational conditions that inhibit team performance and work with leaders to address them.
* Foster an environment of psychological safety, transparency, accountability, and constructive challenge.
* Facilitate healthy conflict resolution and improve team communication and collaboration.
* Adapt Agile practices to the needs and maturity of the team while maintaining the principles of Agile.
* Mentor less-experienced team members and contribute to the broader Agile community of practice

**Stakeholder & Dependency Management**

* Establish strong relationships with Product Owners, business leaders, technology teams and other key stakeholders.
* Identify and actively manage cross-team, functional and organizational dependencies.
* Surface impediments that require leadership intervention and drive them toward resolution.
* Provide clear, concise visibility into delivery status, risks, issues, dependencies and decisions.
* Facilitate alignment between business priorities and team execution.
* Coordinate with other Scrum Masters, Program Managers and Product Managers where work spans multiple Agile teams.
* Help stakeholders understand Agile delivery models, expectations, trade-offs and appropriate engagement points

**Continuous Improvement & Performance Management**

* Use retrospectives, delivery metrics and team feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Establish meaningful Agile metrics such as velocity trends, cycle time, throughput, predictability, Sprint completion and impediment aging.
* Analyze delivery data to identify patterns and recommend actionable improvements.
* Lead teams in developing and executing measurable improvement actions.
* Continuously assess team maturity and adapt coaching approaches accordingly.
* Promote experimentation and learning rather than rigid adherence to process.
* Identify systemic issues that extend beyond the team and escalate them appropriately

**Agile Governance, Planning & Organizational Enablement**

* Support quarterly and release planning activities and provide delivery insights to program and portfolio leadership.
* Contribute to Agile governance and enterprise delivery standards.
* Ensure appropriate visibility and documentation of commitments, risks, dependencies and outcomes.
* Partner with leadership to improve organizational Agile maturity and remove systemic barriers to effective delivery.
* Participate in Agile transformation initiatives, communities of practice and methodology improvements.
* Help establish scalable Agile practices across multiple delivery teams and programs.
* Ensure Agile execution remains connected to measurable business value rather than process compliance alone

**Secondary Responsibilities**
Ability to identify opportunities for continuous improvement, develop CI project goals, and drive team efficiency by applying the discipline of planning, organizing, and managing resources to bring about successful project completion
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Level of Education and Discipline- Bachelors in business, project management, Data Analytics, Data Science, Business Information Technology or related field
  
  
Experience - functional/industry/commercial knowledge, business acumen
  
  

* 6–8 years of experience in Agile delivery, Scrum Master, Program Management, Product Management, Technology or Digital Transformation roles.
* Demonstrated experience serving as a Scrum Master for complex, cross-functional Agile teams.
* Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban and broader Agile principles.
* Experience working with Product Owners, technology teams, business stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Proven ability to remove organizational impediments and manage complex dependencies
* Strong facilitation, coaching, conflict-resolution and stakeholder-management skills.
* Experience using Agile delivery metrics and tools, specifically Azure DevOps or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, global enterprise environment.
* Strong written, verbal and executive communication skills. Demonstrated ability to proactively solve problems and multi-task.
* Learn and execute continuous improvement initiatives to improve systems and ways of working.

Interpersonal Skills - leadership, interactions, communication, influence
  
  

* Work closely with functional leadership teams.
* Ability to manage up and mentor peers
* Maintain a sense of urgency to meet scheduling plans and customer requirements.
* Ability to use a systemic approach and tools to identify and drive business value.

**Other Skills And HPO Competencies**

* Business acumen.
* Strong business perspective; able to merge business questions/needs with available data to provide data-driven insights

**Preferred Qualifications**
Certification and/or Licenses- Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master or equivalent.
  
  
Experience - functional/industry/commercial knowledge, business acumen-
  
  

* Experience with Agile at Scale, SAFe or other enterprise Agile frameworks.
* Experience supporting digital transformation, data/analytics, technology or product development.
* Experience managing multiple interconnected Agile teams or complex programs.
* Experience coaching organizations transitioning from traditional project delivery to Agile product-oriented delivery.

**Dimension**
Facilitate agile ways of working for a global team of ~50 operating across India, EMEA, and the US
  
  
At McCormick, we have over a 100-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

title: Project Manager - Kolkata
description:

**Job Category:** Project Management; Engineering

**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana, India

Join a company that is passionately committed to the pursuit of a better world through positive change. With more than 70 years of business and technical expertise in mining, energy, and infrastructure, our 10,000 colleagues in 150 countries tirelessly work toward bettering the industries in which we operate. With practical solutions that are safe, innovative and sustainable, we think globally while acting locally.

Our Project Delivery Group (PDG) is a dynamic team of professionals passionately committed to world-class project delivery across the globe. With expertise in sustainable studies, asset building and operations, and industry-leading efficiencies, our best-in-class team leverages methodologies, governance and systems that are unparalleled in the engineering space. Are you looking for an opportunity to join a diverse group of professionals who are committed to remaining exceptional? We look forward to hearing from you.

  

Looking to take the next step in your career? Hatch is currently seeking a highly motivated **Project Manager** to join our Project Delivery Group (PDG) in **Kolkata, India.**

PDG helps clients reach their business goals through a range of strong technical capabilities. We ensure world-class project delivery through the skills of our people, methodologies, governance, and systems. Our engineering and project management and construction disciplines ensure safe, efficient, and sustainable delivery of projects globally across the metals and mining, infrastructure, and energy sectors.

We manage our clients’ entire project lifecycle from studies to building assets, operating the assets, and developing efficiencies. Join our team and become part of a community that strives for positive change–providing the best solutions for our clients’ toughest challenges!

**Summary**

The Engagement Manager is responsible for the successful delivery of the engagement’s objectives which includes engagement team leadership and quality completion of the client’s requirements and deliverables in accordance with the approved plans in alignment with the client agreement.

**As the successful candidate, you will:**

* The Engagement Manager is responsible for delivery of the engagement post-award, which
* includes the day-to-day management of the plans, processes, tools, and responsibilities
* associated with delivering the engagement to the client’s and Hatch’s defined expectations. This is achieved by:
* Being involved in the pursuit phase as early as practical.
* Establishing appropriate and approved management plans.
* Managing the engagement delivery in accordance with the approved management plans.
* Leading the delivery team and providing support, guidance and coaching as required.
* Ensuring the completion of engagement reviews and monthly reporting in support of the
* successful delivery of the engagement for the client and Hatch.

This position description should be read in conjunction with the Project Management Discipline Guide , which provides the overall context for the Engagement Manager’s accountabilities and responsibilities.

Pursuit Stage

* During each phase of the Engagement Lifecycle from the time the Engagement Manager is appointed, the responsibilities of the role include:
* Winning Work Phase
* Support the winning work efforts or proposal process as required.
* Participate in Prime Contract discussions and negotiations as required.
* Initiation and Transition Phase
* Assist the Delivery Sponsor in completing the engagement transition from the Pursuit Team to the Delivery Team.
* Open the engagement in iPas PM with the Business Sponsor’s agreement.
* Establish appropriate systems including appropriate people, processes and tools are in place to manage the engagement.
* Establish original baselines and delivery, functional and performance requirements,
* including identifying risks, performance metrics and KPIs to achieve the client and Hatch standards.

Delivery Stage

* Planning and Set-Up Phase
* Establish and set-up engagement management plans including review and approval from the Delivery Sponsor of the control baselines that include sufficient provision for risk in accordance with Hatch standards.
* Incorporate quality management requirements into the management plans consistent with the Hatch Integrated Management Systems (HIMS).
* Prepare an engagement staffing plan and ensure regional discipline leadership are aware of the requirements.
* Establish regular communications the Client representative.
* Conduct the Delivery Team and Client Kick-off Meetings.
* Provide the Client with the engagement work plans as appropriate and ensure there is common understanding.
* Create the initial Project Contract Change Request (PCCR) which may include a Variation
* Order (VO) or Project Change Notice or Request (PCN, PCR). Include a Gap Analysis and receive client approval to capture changes from agreed baseline.
* Obtain approval of changes to determine the Current Baseline and Work Plans (Establish Current Baselines if there are changes from Original Baselines).
* Schedule and participate in the set-up review with the Delivery Sponsor. Include an
* Independent Reviewer if necessary, based on scope and governance level

Execution and Control Phase

* Manage the engagement in accordance with the approved management plans.

**Job Description**

The Lead, Strategic Programs & Transformation is a senior leadership role responsible for shaping and executing the future sales operating model by translating business priorities into scalable capabilities, measurable outcomes, and sustained performance improvement.

The role partners closely with sales and business leaders to redesign how sales teams operate, prioritize opportunities, leverage insights, access knowledge, adopt AI-enabled capabilities, and execute against growth objectives. The position serves as a strategic transformation partner to leadership, driving enterprise-wide initiatives that improve commercial effectiveness, productivity, decision-making, and organizational agility.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, sales operations, enablement, transformation, data, and AI, helping build the next generation of capabilities that support profitable growth and long-term competitive advantage.

The successful candidate will lead high-impact strategic programs, operating-model improvements, digital transformation initiatives, and sales enablement efforts while ensuring measurable business value through disciplined execution, governance, adoption, and value realization.

Why This Role Matters

Sales organizations are under increasing pressure to accelerate growth, improve productivity, enhance customer engagement, and scale effectively in a rapidly evolving business environment. Achieving these outcomes requires more than process improvement or technology adoption. It demands modern operating models, disciplined execution, AI-enabled innovation, and a relentless focus on value realization.

This role plays a critical part in shaping that transformation. It offers the opportunity to work directly with senior sales and business leaders, influence enterprise priorities, and lead initiatives that redefine how sales teams operate, execute, collaborate, and create commercial impact.

The successful candidate will help build the frameworks, governance mechanisms, operating rhythms, capabilities, and transformation roadmaps that position the sales organization for sustainable growth and long-term success.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Program Leadership

* Lead a portfolio of high-priority strategic programs aligned to sales and business objectives.
* Translate strategic priorities into structured initiatives, workstreams, milestones, governance frameworks, and measurable outcomes.
* Drive end-to-end program execution from problem definition and solution design through implementation and benefits realization.
* Establish executive governance forums, operating cadences, reporting mechanisms, and decision-making structures.
* Manage dependencies, risks, resource requirements, and stakeholder alignment across complex initiatives.
* Provide strategic recommendations and actionable insights to support executive decision-making.
* Promote consistent program-management and governance standards across transformation initiatives.
* Partner with senior leadership to identify strategic opportunities that drive commercial growth, organizational effectiveness, and operational excellence.

2. Sales Performance & Execution Transformation

* Lead initiatives that improve the effectiveness, scalability, consistency, and predictability of sales execution.
* Simplify, standardize, and optimize sales processes, operating practices, and governance models.
* Improve visibility into critical business metrics, including pipeline health, bookings, forecast performance, deal progression, sales productivity, and execution performance.
* Partner with sales leadership and finance teams to strengthen performance management and actual-versus-forecast insights.
* Develop mechanisms that enhance execution discipline, accountability, operational rigor, and performance transparency across teams and geographies.
* Identify opportunities to remove process friction, improve organizational productivity, and increase seller effectiveness.
* Implement scalable operating mechanisms that strengthen commercial execution while supporting business growth objectives.

3. Sales Transformation, Enablement & Operating Model Innovation

* Define and execute transformation roadmaps spanning sales processes, capabilities, operating models, governance, and ways of working.
* Define and help evolve the future-state sales operating model, including sales planning, performance management, seller productivity, knowledge enablement, governance, and execution effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to redesign how sales teams access information, collaborate, prioritize activities, and engage customers throughout the sales lifecycle.
* Lead initiatives that improve organizational scalability, simplify seller experiences, and reduce non-selling effort.
* Develop scalable frameworks, methodologies, playbooks, and operating models that improve sales effectiveness.
* Build and institutionalize reusable sales-enablement assets, including points of view, capability narratives, executive presentations, case studies, commercial frameworks, pursuit support materials, and playbooks.
* Establish repeatable frameworks that improve the consistency of commercial execution while enabling flexibility across geographies, markets, and account teams.
* Improve the speed, quality, and consistency of sales pursuits through standardized approaches and best practices.
* Drive adoption of new capabilities, processes, operating models, and sales-enablement solutions across the organization.
* Support the creation of differentiated commercial propositions and strategic sales assets that enhance customer engagement and business development efforts.

4. Digital, AI & Process Innovation

* Establish the strategic roadmap for AI-enabled sales transformation and identify opportunities to embed GenAI, agentic AI, analytics, workflow automation, and digital capabilities across the sales lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to improve planning, prospecting, forecasting, account intelligence, knowledge management, seller productivity, decision support, and sales execution through AI-enabled solutions.
* Shape business cases, transformation roadmaps, and adoption strategies for technology-enabled initiatives.
* Partner with business leaders to fundamentally improve how sales teams work rather than simply digitizing existing processes.
* Collaborate with technology, data, and business stakeholders to assess feasibility, prioritize opportunities, and implement scalable solutions.
* Drive adoption and business value realization through governance, change management, measurement frameworks, and user engagement strategies.
* Ensure digital transformation initiatives remain focused on business outcomes, user adoption, and measurable value creation.
* Foster a culture of innovation and continuous improvement across sales operations and enablement functions.

5. Governance, Executive Reporting & Value Realization

* Define key performance indicators, success measures, and value-tracking frameworks for strategic initiatives.
* Establish benefits-realization methodologies covering revenue impact, productivity gains, efficiency improvements, cycle-time reduction, quality improvements, and other relevant business outcomes.
* Monitor progress against transformation objectives, business cases, and expected benefits.
* Develop executive-level reporting, dashboards, performance reviews, and strategic recommendations.
* Provide transparency into program health, risks, dependencies, and outcomes.
* Ensure strategic initiatives maintain a clear focus on business impact and value creation.
* Enable informed executive decision-making through fact-based reporting, insights, and performance analytics.

6. Cross-Functional Leadership & Stakeholder Management

* Build strong relationships across sales, finance, marketing, operations, HR, technology, and other corporate functions.
* Serve as a trusted adviser to business leaders on transformation priorities, execution risks, operating-model evolution, and strategic opportunities.
* Influence and align stakeholders across functions, geographies, and organizational boundaries.
* Act as an effective bridge between business stakeholders and technology or delivery organizations.
* Drive collaboration across global and distributed teams to achieve shared objectives.
* Foster a culture of accountability, partnership, innovation, and execution excellence.
* Build alignment around strategic priorities, transformation roadmaps, investment decisions, and business outcomes.

Business Outcomes & Success Measures

* Deliver strategic programs and transformation initiatives that achieve defined business objectives.
* Improve sales effectiveness, execution quality, operational efficiency, and organizational scalability.
* Strengthen governance, performance transparency, and executive visibility across key initiatives.
* Increase adoption of new processes, capabilities, operating models, and transformation programs.
* Deliver measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency, commercial performance, and business outcomes.
* Improve seller productivity by reducing process complexity and increasing time spent on customer-facing and revenue-generating activities.

description:
**Role Title: AVP, Project Management (L11)**
**Company Overview:**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Project Manager supports S2P delivery by managing the backlog in a blended Kanban/Scrum model—driving refinement, ensuring stories meet requirement standards, and routing enablers to the Program Manager. The role supports PI prioritization, manages QC to ensure documentation compliance, and maintains delivery artifacts and reporting. This position also coordinates mini-project scheduling and may lead small projects, proactively managing timelines, “RAID” items, dependencies, and continuous process improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and manage the backlog process for all Source to Pay functions using a Kanban or Scrum approach, ensuring transparency, prioritization, and readiness for delivery.
* Drive backlog refinement activities to ensure:
* Stories contain clearly defined requirements (e.g., objective, scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, estimates, priority), meeting definition of ready.
* Enablers are identified with clearly documented objectives, outputs, and prioritized.
* Manage a QC process to ensure Program Managers adhere to documentation guidelines
* Drive the Program Increment (PI) prioritization process, partnering with stakeholders to intake work, align priorities, and sequence items based on value and need.
* Manage small project scheduling and coordination, including creating the structure, processes, and templates to develop timeline tracking, task sequencing, meeting coordination, and follow-up on action items.
* Manage projects as needed, including planning, prioritization, scope tracking, status reporting, and risk/issue/dependency (RAID) management.
* Maintain delivery artifacts and reporting (e.g., project minutes and action items, approval, testing and other documentation, decision logs, and schedules).
* Identify and escalate blockers, risks, and cross-team dependencies; propose resolution options and coordinate next steps.
* Promote continuous improvement in intake, prioritization, refinement, and flow efficiency across the S2P delivery process.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience
* 3+ years in Project Management/Agile delivery role utilizing Scrum and/or Kanban
* Scrum Master Certification or Service Delivery Manager
* Experience writing/supporting user stories (scope, acceptance criteria) and tracking dependencies/estimates.
* Experience managing a PI/quarterly prioritization (or similar intake and sequencing) process.
* Enforce documentation standards by managing a quality control process.
* Proficient with Jira/Confluence and MS Office (Excel/PowerPoint/Visio)
* Experience with identifying and developing process metrics

**Desired Characteristics**

* Familiarity with Source to Pay teams and Coupa preferred.
* Experience summarizing complex projects, risks, or ideas to Senior Leadership in a concise manner.
* Detail-oriented and documentation-focused; produces audit-ready artifacts.
* Comfortable with ambiguity with ability to break work down for sequencing.
* Strong organization, communication and facilitation skills
* Proactive communicator who escalates risks/dependencies early and drives follow-through.
* Continuous improvement and curious mindset with interest in flow/throughput metrics.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience

title: SAP CCM - Condition Contract Management
description:
Job Description: SAP CCM
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**SAP CCM**
with
**8 to 10 years**
of hands-on expertise across Application Maintenance (AM) support and Application Development (AD)/enhancements. The ideal candidate will possess deep specialization in
**SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebate processing, accruals, and settlement logic—backed by robust knowledge of
**SAP SD and Pricing**
.
  
  
In this role, you will lead complex enhancements, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support in an S/4HANA enterprise environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enhancements & Application Development (AD)**

* Process Enhancement & Delivery: Lead the design and delivery of CCM enhancements, including new condition contract types, specialized settlement logic, and custom rebate models tailored to evolving business requirements.
* Functional Specifications: Gather business requirements and translate them into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for custom RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement parameters, and cross-module integration points.
* Development & Testing: Partner closely with technical (ABAP) teams through development, unit testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure defect-free production releases.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process optimization and automation initiatives within CCM and pricing operational workflows.

**Application Maintenance & Production Support (AM)**

* L2/L3 Incident Management: Deliver high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM operations, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs and minimal business disruption.
* Troubleshooting & Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing discrepancies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring defects and implement permanent preventive fixes.
* ITSM Governance: Efficiently manage incidents, problem records, and service requests within ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and support period-end settlement runs and corresponding financial postings.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance**

* Integration Alignment: Collaborate with SD and FI teams to resolve complex, cross-module integration issues and ensure seamless Order-to-Cash (O2C) processing.
* Change Management: Adhere strictly to change management, transport release, and governance protocols for all system enhancements.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain detailed functional documentation, conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions, and promote standard SAP best practices.

**Required Candidate Profile**

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP hands-on experience covering both Application Support (AMS) and Enhancements/Implementations in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Core Functional Expertise: Deep domain expertise in SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)—rebates, accruals, settlements, and contract maintenance.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid expertise in SAP SD (Order-to-Cash) and advanced SAP Pricing Procedure configurations.
* Technical Interface Skills: Proven track record of designing functional specs for custom RICEF objects and working with ABAP teams.
* Support Proficiency: Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and standard ITIL support processes.

title: Head of Operations
description:
**Role purpose**

The Head of Operations runs the organisation day to day so the CEO can focus on strategy, partnerships and growth.

This person owns organisational effectiveness. They make sure teams deliver programmes and tasks on time, decisions get made and followed through, and performance is tracked against clear targets. They set up the structures, systems and dashboards that let a multi-state, multi-programme organisation run smoothly.

We are looking for a strong executor: someone who manages projects closely, keeps data current, coordinates teams and supports senior leadership with clear information and follow-up.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Programme delivery across the organisation**

* Track delivery of every programme against its annual and half-yearly (H1/H2) plan, budget and donor commitments.
* Run weekly and monthly delivery reviews with each vertical and program lead; flag delays early and agree corrective actions.
* Make sure donor reports, utilisation certificates and compliance deadlines are met on time, working with programme and finance teams.
* Coordinate shared resources (field staff, events) across verticals and states.

**2. Team performance**

* Set up and run the performance system: KRAs, weekly and monthly reviews and bi annual appraisals for all teams.
* Help vertical leads write clear KRAs and track them through the year.
* Support onboarding of senior hires with expectation notes, JDs and KRA trackers.
* Identify capacity gaps and work with HR on hiring, training and team structure.

**3. Systems, structures and decision-making**

* Define who decides what: approval limits, escalation paths and meeting rhythms (weekly leadership meeting, monthly reviews, quarterly planning).
* Write and maintain SOPs for core processes: procurement, travel, field operations, partner onboarding and document management.
* Make sure decisions from leadership meetings are recorded, assigned and closed.
* Work with Finance, HR and Admin to keep policies current and followed.

**4. Dashboards and reporting**

* Build and maintain an organisation-wide dashboard covering programme progress (activities and outputs), budgets, team KRAs, support team progress and key risks.
* Prepare monthly updates for the ON Sr Leadership and quarterly updates for the Board.

**5. Support to senior leadership**

* Act as the CEO's operational counterpart: prepare briefs, follow up on actions and keep priorities moving.
* Coordinate cross-team projects that need more than one vertical, such as new programme launches and multi-partner proposals.
* Represent the CEO in internal reviews and selected external meetings

**6. External relationships**

* Manage day-to-day operational relationships with donors, CSR partners, government departments and implementation partners.
* Make sure partner agreements, MOUs and reporting timelines are tracked and met.

**Who we are looking for**

**Experience**

* At least 15 years of work experience, with a significant part in operations leadership.
* Has led multiple teams at the same time, ideally across locations or states.
* Has run operations in a MNC/ development-sector organisation, social enterprise, CSR programme or a similar multi-programme or project setup.
* Has worked with donor-funded or CSR-funded programmes and their reporting and compliance requirements.

**Skills**

* Project management: plans work, tracks timelines, and closes loops without being chased.
* Dashboards and data: comfortable building and maintaining trackers in Excel or Google Sheets; familiarity with tools like Power BI, Notion or Asana is a plus.
* Performance systems: has designed or run KRA, OKR or appraisal processes.
* Process design: writes clear, simple SOPs that field teams actually use.
* Communication: writes crisp updates for leadership and Boards; comfortable in English and Hindi; Bengali is a plus.

**Attributes**

* A strong executor who takes ownership and follows through.
* Calm under pressure and able to juggle many priorities.
* Builds trust with team leads while holding them to commitments.
* Comfortable with travel to field locations.
* Willing to work in a start-up like, unstructured environment

**Education**

* Graduate degree required; a postgraduate degree in management, rural management or development is preferred.

**Compensation**

The CTC for this role is ₹18–24 lakh per annum, based on experience.

**Why join us?**

* Run operations for green livelihoods programmes across India.
* Work directly with the CEO and leadership team, and shape how the organisation runs and grows.
* Build the systems, dashboards and performance processes that every team will use.
* Work with national and international donors, CSR partners and government on programmes with real field impact.
* Join a Great Place to Work® certified organisation.

**About SwitchON Foundation**

Established in 2008, SwitchON Foundation is a pioneering non-profit organization committed to driving sustainable development through innovative solutions in climate-resilient agriculture, clean energy, green livelihoods, and industry decarbonization. With a passionate team of over 175+ professionals, we operate across 10 states in India, empowering communities with climate-smart technologies and practices.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work, SwitchON Foundation takes pride in its inclusive and diverse workplace, with strong representation of women in leadership roles. Our impact is amplified through a combination of innovative programs, social enterprises, and strategic policy advocacy aimed at creating lasting change.

To learn more about our work, please visit:
www.switchon.org.in

title: SAP C-ALM
description:
**Position Executive Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Lead SAP Cloud ALM & Enterprise Toolchain Architect**
to define, govern, and operationalize the complete Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) strategy for our global Greenfield SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
  
  
Acting as the single point of accountability for SAP Cloud ALM adoption across all global regions and workstreams, the ideal candidate will establish cross-functional governance, build end-to-end lifecycle traceability, integrate enterprise toolchains, and drive quality engineering across all phases of the SAP Activate framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Core Governance**
  
  

* Cloud ALM Strategy & Governance
* Strategy Definition: Formulate and execute a comprehensive Cloud ALM strategy aligned with SAP Activate methodology across all global rollout templates.
* Governance Framework: Establish and enforce ALM governance standards across requirements gathering, business process hierarchy modeling, testing execution, defect management, deployment controls, and operations.
* Single Accountability: Serve as the central point of contact and accountability for Cloud ALM adoption across global regions, system integrators, and project workstreams.
* Enterprise Toolchain Integration & Traceability
* Toolchain Management: Architect and manage data flows across the integrated ALM toolchain, connecting SAP Cloud ALM with enterprise architecture, modeling, testing, and operational tools.
* End-to-End Lineage: Maintain complete vertical and horizontal traceability across the lifecycle: Business Scope → Process Design → Requirements/User Stories → Development Units → Test Cases → Defects → Transports/Deployments.
* Integration Engineering: Design and implement robust integration and real-time data synchronization between SAP Cloud ALM and enterprise solutions, including:

+ Process Modeling: Signavio
+ Architecture & Capability Mapping: LeanIX
+ Work Management & ITSM: Jira / ServiceNow
+ Test Management: Tricentis, HP ALM, or equivalent
+ Documentation Systems: Confluence, SharePoint

* Solution Enablement & Fit-to-Standard Execution
* Cloud ALM Configuration: Setup and configure SAP Cloud ALM for:

+ Business process hierarchy structure and solution documentation
+ Requirement, scope, and user story management
+ Test planning, script execution, and defect tracking
+ Task management and deployment tracking

* Fit-to-Standard Governance: Enable and support Fit-to-Standard workshops using standard SAP Best Practices content and Cloud ALM pre-delivered scope elements.
* Program Visibility: Design and maintain project scope baselines, milestone tracking, and real-time status dashboards for executive program leadership.
* Test Quality Management
* Test Strategy Formulation: Design and govern the program-wide testing framework (Unit Testing, System Integration Testing [SIT], User Acceptance Testing [UAT], and Regression Testing) inside SAP Cloud ALM.
* Multi-Regional Execution: Coordinate test execution across multi-regional teams, third-party system integrators, and varying time zones.
* Quality KPIs: Provide executive-level reporting on test coverage, defect burn-down rates, quality KPIs, and release readiness dashboards.
* Release, Deployment & Cutover Management
* Release Orchestration: Oversee release planning, deployment tracking, and release governance using Cloud ALM.
* CI/CD & Transport Integration: Connect Cloud ALM with SAP Transport Management and modern CI/CD delivery pipelines where applicable.
* Cutover Execution: Support cutover sequence planning, dependency mapping, and real-time deployment monitoring.
* Integration & Operations Readiness (Run / Hypercare Phase)
* Monitoring Setup: Configure operational monitoring within Cloud ALM, including:

+ Integration & Exception Monitoring
+ Business Process Monitoring
+ Automated Job Monitoring

* Operational Transition: Lead the transition of ALM artifacts from the project phase to Hypercare and steady-state operations (Run phase).
* Alerting & KPIs: Establish operational KPIs, threshold alerts, and health monitoring for steady-state governance.
* Stakeholder Leadership & Vendor Coaching
* Subject Matter Expert (SME): Act as the lead SME for the Program Management Office (PMO), System Integrator partners, SAP, and regional business leaders.
* Enablement & Upskilling: Coach and upskill project team members, functional leads, and regional business units on Cloud ALM best practices and standardized tool usage.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
SAP ALM & Program Expertise
  
  

* 7–10+ years of hands-on SAP implementation experience within large-scale enterprise environments.
* 3+ years direct experience configuring and leading SAP Cloud ALM (or SAP Solution Manager with a proven track record of Cloud ALM transition).
* Strong, practical knowledge of SAP Activate methodology across all project phases (Discover, Prepare, Explore, Realize, Deploy, Run).
* Proven experience in Greenfield SAP S/4HANA global implementations.

Functional & Technical Knowledge
  
  

* Solid comprehension of core SAP S/4HANA business processes (e.g., Finance, Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Logistics).
* Hands-on familiarity with SAP Best Practices content and enterprise process models.
* Working knowledge of test automation frameworks (e.g., Tricentis, CBTA).
* Familiarity with SAP integration technologies (SAP BTP, Cloud Integration / CPI) and SAP transport management concepts.

Leadership & Soft Skills
  
  

* Proven track record in stakeholder management within complex, multi-vendor, global environments.
* Excellent written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate across global teams, time zones, and diverse organizational cultures.
* Highly organized, structured, quality-focused, and proactive mindset.

**Preferred Qualifications (nice To Have)**

* Official SAP Cloud ALM Certification.
* Prior experience in large-scale rollouts (multi-country, multi-template architectures).
* Exposure to modern DevOps principles and CI/CD pipelines within SAP enterprise landscapes.
* Prior experience in roles such as Enterprise ALM Lead, QA Lead, or Test Manager.

We are looking for a Billing & Documentation Engineer to support our ICT and infrastructure projects in Kolkata. The candidate should also have a basic technical understanding of ICT, structured cabling, networking equipment, IT hardware, and active and passive networking systems.

* Maintain records of purchase orders, work orders, delivery challans and invoices.
* Follow up with clients, consultants and internal teams for approvals of MIRs, WIRs, bills and other submissions.

REQUIRED SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE:

* Experience in project billing and documentation.
* Knowledge of MIR, WIR, RA Bills and measurement sheets.
* Basic knowledge of Networking Equipment and IT Hardware, including Active and Passive Networking Equipment.

* Ability to understand BOQs and project quantities.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, data entry, formatting and preparation of trackers.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Word and general documentation.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

Candidates with a technical background and a good understanding of networking equipment, IT hardware, and active and passive networking infrastructure will be preferred.
