description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Head of Projects & Operations / VP – Manufacturing Operations**

**Company: Satvik Enterprises Limited**  
**Industry: Iron & Steel / Ferro Alloys Manufacturing**  
**Location: Kolkata Head Office, with frequent travel to manufacturing plants and project sites**  
**Department: Projects, Manufacturing Operations & Business Support Functions**  
**Reporting To: Managing Director / Director**  
**Position Level: Senior Leadership / Executive Management**

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**A. Project Planning and Execution**

* Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and commissioning of new manufacturing projects and plant expansion initiatives.
* Develop detailed project plans, schedules, budgets, resource plans, and milestone-based execution strategies.
* Coordinate civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, utilities, and infrastructure activities.
* Monitor project progress against approved timelines, budgets, technical specifications, and quality standards.
* Manage contractors, consultants, EPC partners, vendors, and project management teams.
* Identify project risks, resolve execution bottlenecks, and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure timely procurement, delivery, installation, testing, and commissioning of plant machinery and equipment.
* Review engineering drawings, technical specifications, BOQs, and project documentation in coordination with relevant teams.
* Ensure proper project documentation, handover, and transition from project execution to commercial operations.

**B. Manufacturing and Plant Operations**

* Lead overall manufacturing operations to achieve production, productivity, quality, cost, and delivery targets.
* Oversee ferro alloy manufacturing activities.
* Establish production planning systems, standard operating procedures, performance standards, and operational control mechanisms.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of raw materials, power, manpower, equipment, and other production resources.
* Monitor production efficiency, yield, recovery, rejection rates, downtime, and overall equipment effectiveness.
* Develop and implement preventive and predictive maintenance systems to improve equipment reliability and plant availability.
* Coordinate with Production, Maintenance, Quality, Logistics, Procurement, Safety, HR, and Administration teams.
* Establish daily, weekly, and monthly operational reviews to monitor performance against agreed targets.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, reduce wastage, and improve operational profitability.

**C. Operational Excellence and Cost Optimisation**

* Identify opportunities to reduce manufacturing costs, project expenditure, energy consumption, logistics costs, and operational losses.
* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for projects, production, maintenance, procurement, HR, quality, and operational efficiency.
* Implement lean manufacturing principles, process standardisation, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving techniques.
* Monitor manufacturing conversion costs, power consumption per tonne, raw material consumption, production yield, and procurement variances.
* Improve plant capacity utilisation and equipment performance through systematic operational reviews.
* Develop dashboards and management reports highlighting operational performance, cost variances, risks, and corrective actions.
* Drive cross-functional coordination to improve working capital utilisation, inventory management, and overall business efficiency.

**D. Technical and Engineering Management**

* Review technical feasibility, plant layout, equipment selection, engineering design, and process requirements.
* Ensure coordination between engineering, production, maintenance, electrical, instrumentation, and utility functions.
* Oversee installation and commissioning of furnaces, material handling systems, pollution control equipment, electrical systems, and associated plant infrastructure.
* Ensure equipment specifications and operating parameters meet approved technical and production requirements.
* Support troubleshooting of critical technical issues and implement sustainable corrective measures.
* Coordinate with technical consultants, equipment suppliers, and engineering partners to ensure reliable plant performance.

**E. Procurement and Strategic Sourcing**

* Develop and implement procurement strategies for raw materials, plant machinery, equipment, spares, consumables, services, and project materials.
* Lead strategic sourcing initiatives to ensure competitive pricing, quality, timely delivery, and reliable supply.
* Establish and maintain an effective vendor development, evaluation, empanelment, and performance monitoring system.
* Review technical and commercial proposals and recommend vendors based on quality, cost, delivery, service, and commercial terms.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, credit periods, delivery schedules, and contractual conditions in accordance with company policies.
* Coordinate with Production, Projects, Finance, Stores, and Logistics to ensure uninterrupted availability of critical materials.
* Monitor purchase orders, supplier commitments, delivery schedules, inventory levels, and procurement budgets.
* Develop procurement controls to minimise emergency purchases, excess inventory, material shortages, and avoidable costs.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, purchase approvals, contract management, and compliance with internal procurement procedures.
* Coordinate with Finance for vendor payments, advances, outstanding balances, and reconciliation of commercial transactions.

**F. HR Operations and Administration**

* Oversee HR operations in coordination with the HR Head and the Administration function, ensuring alignment with the company's business and manpower requirements.
* Drive manpower planning, workforce budgeting, recruitment priorities, and deployment of personnel across the Head Office, manufacturing plants, and project sites.
* Monitor compliance with applicable labour laws, factory-related employment requirements, minimum wages, contract labour regulations, and other statutory obligations.
* Oversee industrial relations, contractor workforce management, grievance handling, disciplinary processes, and employee engagement in coordination with HR.
* Review workforce productivity, absenteeism, attrition, overtime, manpower costs, and staffing efficiency.
* Ensure implementation of HR policies, code of conduct, performance management, training, and employee development initiatives**.**

**G. Quality, Safety and Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to product quality standards, process specifications, and customer requirements.
* Establish and monitor quality control systems and corrective and preventive action plans.
* Promote a strong safety culture across projects, plant operations, and contractor activities.

**H. Logistics, Supply Chain and Inventory Management**

* Oversee coordination of inbound and outbound logistics for raw materials, machinery, spares, and finished products.
* Monitor inventory levels, stock ageing, material availability, and working capital tied up in inventory.
* Coordinate with Sales, Procurement, Production, Finance, and Logistics teams to meet customer delivery commitments.
* Monitor logistics KPIs, freight expenditure, transit losses, delivery performance, and supply chain risks.
* Develop international sourcing strategies and identify suitable overseas suppliers, trading partners, and logistics service providers.
* Monitor shipment schedules, lead times, documentation accuracy, and delivery commitments to minimise delays and additional costs.
* Evaluate international supplier performance, commercial risks, foreign exchange exposure, and supply chain disruptions.
* Maintain proper import/export records and coordinate with Finance for reconciliation, duty benefits, export incentives, and applicable regulatory reporting.
* Ensure that import and export transactions are executed within approved commercial, financial, and compliance frameworks.

**I. Leadership and Stakeholder Management**

* Lead and mentor project managers, plant heads, engineering teams, production teams, procurement personnel, HR teams, and other functional leaders.
* Establish accountability, performance standards, reporting mechanisms, and review systems across departments.
* Coordinate with senior management on strategic planning, capital expenditure, project priorities, procurement strategies, international trade, manpower planning, and operational challenges.
* Prepare and present periodic reports on project status, production performance, procurement costs, import/export transactions, workforce performance, budget utilisation, and business outcomes.
* Build a performance-driven culture focused on safety, quality, cost efficiency, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure effective communication and coordination between the Head Office, project sites, manufacturing plants, suppliers, customers, and external stakeholders.
* Support business expansion initiatives, capacity enhancement, operational restructuring, and long-term organisational development.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Performance will be assessed against the following parameters:**

* **Timely completion of projects and achievement of commissioning milestones.**
* **Adherence to approved project budgets and control of cost overruns.**
* **Achievement of production targets, plant capacity utilisation, and equipment availability.**
* **Improvement in production yield, recovery, product quality, and manufacturing efficiency.**
* **Reduction in power consumption, manufacturing cost, wastage, downtime, and operational losses.**
* **Procurement cost savings, supplier performance, material availability, and purchase cycle time.**
* **Timely execution of import and export shipments, customs clearance, and trade documentation.**
* **Control of international freight, demurrage, detention, and other avoidable trade-related costs.**
* **Compliance with import/export regulations and timely realisation or settlement of trade transactions, as applicable.**
* **Manpower productivity, recruitment turnaround time, attendance management, and workforce cost optimisation.**
* **Compliance with HR policies, labour laws, contractor requirements, and statutory obligations.**
* **Improvement in inventory turnover, logistics efficiency, and working capital utilisation.**
* **Compliance with safety, environmental, quality, and other statutory requirements.**
* **Timely resolution of project, manufacturing, procurement, HR, and supply chain bottlenecks.**
* **Achievement of profitability, productivity, and overall operational excellence objectives.**

**Educational Qualifications**

* **Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.**
* **Master's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Project Management, Supply Chain Management, or Business Administration will be an added advantage.**
* **Additional qualifications or professional certifications in project management, international trade, supply chain management, procurement, lean manufacturing, or operations excellence will be preferred.**

**Experience and Industry Exposure**

* **Typically 15–20+ years of relevant professional experience in industrial project execution, plant commissioning, manufacturing operations, procurement, supply chain management, and cross-functional leadership.**
* **Experience in senior leadership roles managing multiple functions, operational budgets, project teams, and plant performance will be strongly preferred.**
* **Practical exposure to import/export operations, international procurement, customs clearance, trade documentation, shipping, and commercial banking processes will be advantageous.**
* **Experience in HR operations, workforce planning, industrial relations, contractor management, and labour compliance in manufacturing environments will be preferred.**
* **Experience in iron and steel, ferro alloys, metals, heavy engineering, or other process manufacturing industries will be strongly preferred.**
* **Experience in greenfield projects, brownfield expansion, furnace-based manufacturing, and plant commissioning will be particularly valuable.**

Pay: From ₹30,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Job Title: Technical Lead – AI & Data Engineering Location: Hybrid – Ahmedabad Office / Remote Department: Data Engineering & AI Experience Level: 7+ Years (with at least 2+ years leading/managing technical teams)

About the Role We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Technical Lead – AI & Data Engineering to spearhead our data and AI initiatives from initial requirement gathering through to production deployment and monitoring. In this role, you will lead a cross functional team of data engineers and AI/ML developers, serving as the technical anchor for end-to-end delivery. You will drive architectural decisions across robust ETL/ELT pipelines, relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server), and Power BI semantic models (DAX), while designing enterprise-grade AI and Generative AI systems (RAG workflows, vector search, Azure OpenAI). The ideal candidate pairs deep technical mastery with proven team-handling experience, translating business challenges into production-ready software with strict performance, cost, and reliability benchmarks.

**Responsibilities**

* Key Responsibilities
* 1. End-to-End Solution Architecture & SDLC Ownership
* Own the entire engineering lifecycle: lead requirement discovery, translate business requirements into technical roadmaps, design high- and low-level architectures, and oversee deployment to production.
* Interface directly with product owners, stakeholders, and business analysts to clarify functional expectations, identify edge cases, and define acceptance criteria.
* Establish engineering standards, production deployment strategies (blue/green, canary), rollback procedures, and post-launch maintenance workflows.
* 2. Technical Leadership & Team Management
* Lead, mentor, and coach a team of junior-to-mid-level AI and data engineers, conducting 1-on-1s, technical goal setting, and skills development.
* Own resource planning, sprint estimation, sprint planning, task delegation, and delivery tracking in an Agile framework.
* Enforce rigorous code quality, schema management, and architectural integrity through strict PR reviews, testing standards, and Git workflows.
* 3. Data Engineering & Pipeline Governance
* Architect, automate, and govern resilient ETL/ELT data pipelines using Python and Azure cloud services.
* Direct data cleansing, validation, normalization, and semantic data layer development to provide clean data for downstream analytics and AI.
* Guide database modelling, stored procedure optimization, indexing strategies, and execution plan analysis across PostgreSQL and SQL Server (SSMS).
* Oversee programmatic extraction and tabular aggregation directly from Power BI reports and semantic models using DAX.
* 4. AI, GenAI & Model Performance Engineering
* Lead the design and integration of AI/GenAI architectures (RAG systems, prompt orchestration, vector search integrations with Azure OpenAI).
* Drive inference optimization strategies to maintain low latency and compute expenses: token usage control, caching, smart chunking, ONNX runtime conversion, quantization, batching, and hardware profiling (CPU/GPU).
* Implement enterprise MLOps/LLMOps monitoring for staging and production, tracking model throughput, latency, accuracy, regression, and data drift.
* 5. CI/CD, DevOps & Operational Excellence
* Own production deployment automation via robust CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).
* Define logging, telemetry, anomaly detection, and alerting standards to minimize production downtime and pipeline breakages.



**Qualifications**

* Required Qualifications & Technical Skills
* Experience: 7+ years of hands-on technical experience across data engineering, analytics engineering, or applied AI/ML systems, including 2+ years of formal leadership or team management experience.
* Full Lifecycle Delivery: Proven track record of owning projects from initial requirement discovery and architecture design through deployment, production rollout, and operational monitoring.



**Required Skills**

* Databases & Querying:
* Advanced proficiency in PostgreSQL and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), including database design, query optimization, indexing, and deep execution plan profiling.
* Strong working proficiency in writing and optimizing DAX queries against Power BI datasets and tabular models.
* Programming & Pipeline Engineering:
* Expert-level Python skills (Pandas, Pytorch,NumPy, SQLAlchemy, PySpark/data manipulation frameworks).
* Production experience building automated, scheduled data pipelines (Azure Data Factory, orchestrators).
* AI, GenAI & Performance Optimization:
* Hands-on experience architecting GenAI workflows (RAG, embeddings, vector databases, Azure OpenAI).
* Proven experience with model runtime acceleration, caching, quantization, and profiling techniques (e.g., ONNX Runtime, GPU/CPU profiling).
* Statistical Rigor & Data Quality:

**Department:**
Purchase / Procurement

Assistant General Manager (AGM) / Deputy General Manager (DGM) – Purchase

**Industry:**
Pharmaceutical Manufacturing

**Plant Exposure:**
Formulation, API, and Injectables

Job Purpose

To lead and drive strategic procurement activities for Capital Expenditure (Capex) and Operational Expenditure (Opex) across Formulation, API, and Injectables manufacturing plants. The role will focus on strategic sourcing, vendor development, commercial negotiations, cost optimization, budget control, and timely procurement of equipment, engineering materials, spares, utilities, and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Capex Procurement

* Lead end-to-end procurement of capital equipment, plant machinery, engineering systems, utilities, and infrastructure for Formulation, API, and Injectables facilities.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Projects, Production, QA, QC, and Finance teams to finalize technical specifications and procurement requirements.
* Evaluate technical and commercial offers, conduct techno-commercial comparisons, and negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and contractual conditions.
* Manage procurement for new projects, plant expansions, capacity enhancements, and facility modernization.
* Ensure timely procurement within approved budgets and project timelines.

2. Opex Procurement

* Manage procurement of maintenance spares, engineering materials, consumables, utility-related items, services, and other plant operational requirements.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of critical materials to support plant operations and maintenance.
* Monitor Opex expenditure against approved budgets and implement cost-reduction initiatives.
* Optimize inventory levels, procurement lead times, and purchasing costs.
* Establish annual rate contracts and long-term supplier agreements wherever appropriate.

3. Strategic Sourcing & Cost Optimization

* Develop and implement procurement strategies aligned with business objectives and annual Capex/Opex budgets.
* Identify alternate suppliers, indigenous sourcing opportunities, and value-engineering initiatives.
* Drive cost savings through competitive bidding, negotiations, supplier consolidation, and long-term contracts.
* Monitor market trends, pricing benchmarks, and procurement performance indicators.
* Prepare periodic cost-saving reports and procurement performance dashboards.

4. Vendor Development & Management

* Identify, evaluate, develop, and manage suppliers for pharmaceutical equipment, engineering materials, utilities, spares, and technical services.
* Conduct supplier evaluations in coordination with Engineering, QA, and other relevant departments.
* Establish strong vendor relationships and resolve issues related to cost, quality, delivery, and contractual commitments.
* Ensure compliance with vendor qualification and documentation requirements.

5. Compliance & Procurement Governance

* Ensure adherence to procurement policies, approval matrices, financial controls, and ethical purchasing practices.
* Maintain proper documentation of quotations, comparative statements, purchase orders, contracts, and supplier evaluations.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to meet applicable pharmaceutical quality, EHS, and regulatory requirements.
* Ensure transparency, accountability, and audit readiness across procurement activities.

6. Leadership & Stakeholder Management

* Lead and mentor the purchase team, establish performance objectives, and drive continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Projects, Plant Operations, Finance, QA, QC, Stores, and Supply Chain teams.
* Review procurement budgets, expenditure trends, supplier performance, and cost-saving opportunities.
* Present procurement strategies, project updates, and performance reports to senior management.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Relevant experience in pharmaceutical purchase and procurement, with substantial exposure to both Capex and Opex.
* Experience working with Formulation, API, and Injectables manufacturing plants.
* Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical machinery, engineering equipment, plant utilities, MRO spares, consumables, and technical services procurement.
* Proven expertise in strategic sourcing, techno-commercial evaluation, vendor development, contract negotiation, and cost optimization.
* Working knowledge of ERP/SAP procurement processes and purchasing documentation.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Ideal Candidate Profile

An experienced pharmaceutical procurement professional capable of independently managing strategic Capex and Opex purchasing across Formulation, API, and Injectables facilities, driving cost savings, developing a robust supplier base, and ensuring timely procurement in line with business and operational requirements.

Application – AGM / DGM Purchase (Capex & Opex Management)

title: Manager - Technical Bid & Solution
description:
**Role**
This is not a traditional Project Manager position. We are not looking for someone whose primary strength is maintaining Jira boards, scheduling meetings or updating project plans. We need someone who can read a 150-page government RFP and determine what Dash would actually have to build, migrate, integrate, test, deploy, support and manage if we win. The ideal person can move comfortably between technical and business conversations, challenge unrealistic assumptions, coordinate architects and engineers, build a credible delivery plan and make sure the proposal never promises something the delivery team cannot execute.
  
  
Technical RFP Analysis
  
  

* Analyze technical RFP requirements and decompose them into capabilities, workstreams, deliverables and dependencies.
* Identify mandatory technical requirements, integrations, security requirements, environments, data considerations, service levels and implementation constraints.
* Develop technical questions and clarification requests where requirements are ambiguous.

Solution Shaping
  
  

* Facilitate solution workshops with architects, developers, cloud/data specialists, project managers and other SMEs.
* Develop credible solution approaches for custom application development, modernization, cloud, data, AI, integration and managed-service engagements.
* Define scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and exclusions.
* Ensure proposed solutions are practical, supportable and aligned with Dash delivery capabilities.

Estimation & Delivery Planning
  
  

* Develop or coordinate work breakdown structures, staffing models, schedules, milestones and effort estimates.
* Validate whether the proposed team can realistically deliver within the requested schedule.
* Identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies and support pricing teams with clear resource, effort and timeline assumptions.

Technical Proposal Development
  
  

* Own or co-author technical approaches, implementation plans, transition plans, architecture narratives, project-management approaches and related proposal sections.
* Provide technical input to graphics, diagrams and solution architecture.
* Review technical proposal sections for accuracy, consistency and credibility.
* Participate in technical Red Team reviews.

Presentations & Pursuit-to-Delivery Continuity
  
  

* Support oral presentations, technical demonstrations, solution-defense sessions and clarification responses.
* Lead structured technical handoff after award so delivery receives proposal assumptions, commitments, staffing models, milestones and risks.
* Track lessons learned from actual project delivery and feed them back into future estimates and proposal approaches.

Reusable Solution Assets
  
  

* Develop reusable reference approaches for recurring SLED opportunities.
* Maintain solution patterns, estimation assumptions, team models and implementation approaches that can accelerate future pursuits.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 7-10+ years of experience across IT delivery, architecture, technical presales, solution consulting, bid management or technical project leadership.
* At least 3 years of meaningful involvement in RFP/RFI responses, presales or solutioning.
* Strong understanding of modern application development, cloud, integration, data and enterprise technology delivery.
* Ability to estimate teams, effort, timelines and implementation dependencies.
* Strong understanding of project risks, assumptions and delivery governance.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong professional writing and presentation skills and willingness to challenge unrealistic assumptions.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* U.S. public-sector or government-bid experience.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* PMP, Scrum, SAFe, cloud or architecture certifications.
* Experience with AI/ML, data platforms, application modernization or systems integration.
* Experience supporting fixed-price or deliverables-based IT services proposals.

The Personality We Are Looking For
  
  

* Wants to understand how things actually work rather than repeating buzzwords.
* Challenges an estimate that does not make sense.
* Is comfortable saying, "We should not promise this unless we can prove how we will deliver it."
* Connects commercial promises to delivery reality.
* Takes ownership from RFP analysis through award handoff.
* Can work effectively with strong technical personalities.
* Is practical, curious, organized and decisive.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within the first 90 days, major solution-based pursuits should have clearer scope, assumptions, estimates, staffing models, timelines and technical narratives, with stronger continuity between what Dash sells and what Dash ultimately delivers.

With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. title: Assistant Manager - Operations(ASL)
description:
**Job Title**
**Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations**
**Function**
**Hub Operations**
**Reports To**
Head – Hub Operations
  
  
**Location**
**Surface Hub**
**Travel Required**
**25% ☐ 50% ☐ 75% ☐**
**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited**
, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.
  
  
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
  
  
We are proud to be consistently ranked among
**India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**
, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
**Employer of Choice**
is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
  
  
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety,
**Blue Dart is where you belong**
. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end-to-end mid-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity.
  
  
Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed, and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To manage mid-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Hub Operations Management**

* Lead day-to-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement.
* Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.
* Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives.

**Mid Mile Network Operations**

* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.
* Ensure timely movement of priority, premium and time-definite shipments across the network.

**Network Coordination & Exception Management**

* Monitor adherence to network schedules and proactively manage delays, misconnections, misroutes and operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Network Operations and Regional Operations teams to resolve operational issues.
* Ensure timely communication of network disruptions and recovery actions to impacted stakeholders.
* Monitor stock lying at hub (SLAH) and drive timely clearance of pending shipments.
* Ensure accurate status updates and operational visibility across all network systems.

**Workforce & Shift Leadership**

* Lead operational employees, supervisors and outsourced workforce during assigned shifts.
* Plan manpower deployment based on shipment volumes and operational priorities.
* Conduct daily shift briefings and communicate operational updates and safety requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity, attendance and adherence to operational standards.
* Support capability building through coaching, training and performance feedback.

**Fleet, Capacity & Resource Management**

* Ensure availability and optimum utilisation of vehicles, trailers and operational equipment to support scheduled network movements.
* Coordinate with fleet partners and transport vendors to minimise delays and maximise vehicle utilisation.
* Monitor dock utilisation, bay allocation and turnaround times to improve hub efficiency.
* Support capacity planning during peak volumes, network changes and seasonal demand fluctuations.
* Ensure operational readiness of manpower, equipment and infrastructure to meet business requirements.

**Service Quality & Operational Excellence**

* Drive adherence to network timelines and ensure timely connectivity of shipments across the air or surface network.
* Monitor shipment accuracy, scanning compliance, loading quality and dispatch integrity to minimise operational errors.
* Ensure timely closure of operational exceptions, stock lying at hub (SLAH), misroutes and misconnections.
* Review operational performance trends and implement corrective actions to improve service reliability.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance hub productivity, service quality and operational efficiency.

**Safety, Security & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with organisational policies, operational SOPs, aviation or transportation regulations and statutory requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring safe handling of shipments, vehicles and operational equipment.
* Support periodic operational, security and quality audits and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory documentation, shipment security requirements and operational controls applicable to the hub.
* Identify operational risks and implement preventive measures to ensure uninterrupted hub operations.

**Stakeholder Management & Operational Communication**

* Coordinate closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Operations, Customer Service, Security and Regional Operations teams to ensure seamless execution.
* Maintain effective communication with upstream and downstream network locations regarding shipment movements, operational disruptions and recovery plans.
* Ensure timely escalation of operational risks, capacity constraints and service issues to the Head – Hub Operations.
* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and transport partners to improve network performance.
* Support implementation of organisational initiatives, process changes and operational improvement programmes across the hub.

**People Leadership & Capability Development**

* Lead, coach and develop supervisors, operational employees and outsourced workforce to achieve operational objectives.
* Conduct regular shift briefings and ensure effective communication of operational priorities, safety requirements and service expectations.
* Monitor employee productivity, attendance, discipline and overall team performance.
* Support implementation of learning initiatives and on-the-job capability development programmes.
* Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, continuous improvement and customer focus across the hub.

**Qualifications & Experience:**
**Education**
:
  
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* Degree or certification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or Transportation Management will be an added advantage.

**Experience**
:
  
  
  

* Senior Executive – Hub Operations (Grade N): 3–5 years of experience in hub operations, mid-mile logistics, transportation or express distribution.
* Assistant Manager – Hub Operations (Grade M): 4 - 7 years of relevant experience with demonstrated experience in leading medium to large hub operations.
* Experience in managing inbound, outbound and transit operations within an air or surface logistics network.
* Exposure to fleet coordination, shipment movement, operational planning and network performance management.
* Experience in leading frontline operational teams and working in high-volume, time-sensitive logistics environments.

**Skills & Capabilities:**
**Technical Skills:**

* Hub & Mid Mile Operations Management
* Air & Surface Network Operations
* Shipment Processing & Transit Management
* Fleet Coordination & Capacity Utilisation
* Network Planning & Schedule Adherence
* Service Quality & Operational Excellence
* Operational MIS & Performance Analytics
* Safety, Security & Regulatory Compliance
* Process Improvement & Productivity Enhancement
* Microsoft Office & Logistics Management Systems

**Key Competencies:**

* Operational Leadership
* Decision Making Under Pressure
* Planning & Organising
* Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills
* Team Leadership & People Development
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Customer Focus
* Accountability & Ownership
* Adaptability & Resilience
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

**Key Performance Indicators:**
**KRAs**
**KPIs**
Network Performance
  
  
On-time departure & arrival adherence, Network connectivity, Schedule adherence
  
  
Service Quality
  
  
SLAH %, Misroutes, Misconnections, Shipment processing accuracy, Scan compliance
  
  
Hub Productivity
  
  
Hub throughput, Vehicle turnaround time, Dock utilisation, Productivity per FTE
  
  
Fleet & Capacity Utilisation
  
  
Fleet utilisation, Vehicle availability, Capacity utilisation, Dispatch efficiency
  
  
Operational Excellence
  
  
Exception closure within TAT, Operational audit compliance, SOP adherence
  
  
Safety & Compliance
  
  
Safety compliance, Security compliance, Regulatory adherence, Audit scores
  
  
People Management
  
  
Team productivity, Employee engagement, Training completion, Attrition management
  
  
Continuous Improvement
  
  
Process improvement initiatives, Cost optimisation, Productivity enhancement, Operational efficiency gains
  
  
**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.
  
  
Here’s what makes us stand out:
  
  
  

* Great Place to Work® Certified—a testament to our people-first culture, inclusive environment, and commitment to your growth and well-being.
* Competitive pay and performance-linked rewards that truly recognize your impact.
* Structured learning, global exposure, and on-the-job coaching to help you grow faster than ever.
* Best-in-class benefits—from comprehensive medical cover (including optional parental care) to financial wellness and generous time off.
* A culture that celebrates diversity, innovation, and bold thinking—where your voice is heard and your contributions matter.
* Global career paths across the DHL Group, opening doors to opportunities in 220+ countries and territories.
* The pride of working with India’s most awarded logistics brand, trusted by millions and driven by purpose.

This is your chance to do meaningful work, build a career without borders, and thrive in a company that’s not just a logistics leader—but a Great Place to Work.
**Come grow with us.**

title: Senior Capture Specialist
description:
Senior Capture Specialist / Capture Specialist II
  
  
**Role**
We are not looking for someone who simply downloads RFPs from procurement portals and forwards them to the team. We want someone who is naturally curious, persistent and commercially minded - part researcher, part investigator and part operator. When you see an opportunity, your instinct should be to understand who owns the problem, who has the work today, when the contract expires, what the agency is trying to accomplish, who is likely to compete and whether Dash has a real reason to believe it can win. The right person enjoys connecting dots that other people miss.
  
  
Opportunity Identification
  
  

* Continuously monitor U.S. State, Local and Education procurement sources for relevant opportunities.
* Maintain visibility across state procurement portals, agency sites and major bid platforms such as BidNet, DemandStar and Bonfire.
* Monitor SAM.gov and federal sources when relevant to the broader government strategy.
* Identify upcoming renewals, expiring contracts, pre-solicitation activity, RFIs and opportunities before formal RFP release whenever possible.

Opportunity Qualification
  
  

* Build concise opportunity briefs covering agency, problem statement, scope, estimated value, dates, incumbent, procurement method, vehicle, competition, requirements, past-performance fit and key risks.
* Support formal Bid/No-Bid analysis and separate genuinely strategic opportunities from keyword matches.
* Maintain accurate opportunity status and next actions in CRM and pursuit trackers.

Capture Intelligence
  
  

* Research agency budgets, technology priorities, incumbents, prior awards, procurement history and decision-making environment.
* Develop competitor and incumbent intelligence.
* Identify teaming partners, subcontractors, OEMs and contract-vehicle partners that could improve Dash's position.
* Maintain state-by-state procurement intelligence including registrations, vehicles, portals, renewal calendars and important procurement cycles.

Capture Planning & Proposal Transition
  
  

* Develop lightweight capture plans for priority opportunities and track customer, competitor, partner, solution, past-performance and contract-vehicle gaps.
* Coordinate actions required before the RFP is released.
* Conduct structured handoff from capture to proposal so proposal teams receive the intelligence collected during capture rather than starting from zero.
* Support proposal teams with competitor, customer and partner research throughout the pursuit.

Team Contribution
  
  

* Help coach the junior Capture Analyst already on the team.
* Build reusable research methodologies, templates and source lists.
* Proactively identify improvements in how Dash searches, qualifies and prioritizes opportunities.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 3-5 years of experience supporting U.S. government contracting, capture, proposals, market research or opportunity qualification.
* Direct exposure to U.S. State/Local/Education opportunities strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with public-sector procurement portals and RFP/RFQ/RFI documentation.
* Strong research and analytical capability and ability to turn large volumes of information into short decision-oriented summaries.
* Strong written and spoken English, excellent follow-through and attention to deadlines.
* Comfort with CRM, spreadsheets and structured opportunity tracking.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* Experience using GovWin or similar public-sector intelligence tools.
* Experience researching incumbent contracts and government spending.
* Exposure to IT services, staffing, cloud, data, AI or digital-transformation opportunities.
* Experience researching contract vehicles and teaming partners.

The Personality We Are Looking For
  
  

* Does not stop at the first search result.
* Keeps asking questions until the situation makes sense.
* Is comfortable saying, "I do not know yet, but I know how to find out."
* Follows through without needing reminders.
* Notices inconsistencies and investigates them.
* Treats every opportunity as a business decision, not an administrative task.
* Has the confidence to recommend that Dash walk away from a weak opportunity.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within the first 90 days, the capture function should have a reliable opportunity feed, standardized qualification briefs, state/vehicle intelligence, documented incumbent and competitor research, and a clean handoff process into active proposals.

title: Senior Proposal Writer
description:
**Role**
We are looking for someone who can do much more than write grammatically correct paragraphs. A winning proposal writer understands what the evaluator is asking, why they are asking it, what evidence will make the response credible and how to make the answer easy to score. You should be willing to tell an SME, 'This technically answers the question, but it will not win us points - we need to make it stronger.' You should be comfortable starting with a blank page, interviewing busy subject-matter experts, challenging vague statements, finding proof for claims and turning fragmented input into a clear and compelling story. Most importantly, we want someone who treats the final submission as their personal product.
  
  
Proposal Development
  
  

* Analyze RFPs, RFQs and RFIs and translate requirements into compliant response structures.
* Develop proposal outlines, compliance matrices and writing plans.
* Draft and edit executive summaries, technical approaches, management plans, transition plans, implementation approaches, staffing plans, quality-management approaches, past performance, corporate experience and other response sections.
* Adapt content to the agency and requirement rather than relying on generic boilerplate.

SME Collaboration
  
  

* Conduct focused interviews with technical, delivery, recruiting, finance and management SMEs.
* Translate technical concepts into clear evaluator-friendly language.
* Identify unanswered requirements, unsupported claims and weak differentiators.
* Own follow-ups required to complete assigned sections.

Proposal Strategy & Review
  
  

* Apply established win themes, differentiators and customer priorities throughout the response.
* Connect features to customer outcomes and measurable benefits.
* Participate in structured reviews and incorporate feedback quickly.
* Perform compliance, consistency and quality checks, including contradictions between technical, management, staffing, schedule and pricing narratives.

Content Library
  
  

* Develop and continuously improve reusable proposal content.
* Maintain past-performance narratives, case studies, corporate qualifications and recurring technical/management responses.
* Retire outdated or weak content rather than blindly reusing it.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Provide day-to-day writing guidance and coaching to the existing Proposal Writer.
* Establish writing examples and quality standards.
* Help improve the team's ability to write concise, persuasive and evaluator-friendly responses.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 4-7 years of professional proposal-writing experience.
* Direct experience responding to U.S. government RFPs; SLED experience strongly preferred.
* Excellent U.S. business English and professional editing ability.
* Demonstrated experience with compliance-driven proposals, compliance matrices and structured response outlines.
* Ability to understand IT and professional-services concepts sufficiently to write credible technical content.
* Strong research and interviewing skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* APMP certification.
* Experience in IT services, staffing, cloud, data, AI, application modernization, cybersecurity or digital transformation.
* Experience writing both staff-augmentation and deliverables/solution-based proposals.
* Experience supporting oral presentations or interviews.
* Familiarity with responsible use of generative AI for proposal productivity.

The Personality We Are Looking For
  
  

* Takes pride in the final product and notices details other people overlook.
* Does not accept vague SME answers just because the SME is senior.
* Is comfortable rewriting their own work repeatedly.
* Understands that compliant is the minimum bar, not the definition of a winning proposal.
* Works calmly under pressure and takes feedback professionally.
* Helps junior team members become better rather than protecting knowledge.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within the first 90 days, this person should materially improve first-draft quality, evaluator focus, consistency and reusable content, while beginning to coach the existing writer toward a stronger proposal-writing standard.

title: Senior Brokerage Operations Associate (Canada)
description:
**Who We Are:**
**Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure**
for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.
  
  
Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.
  
  
Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.
  
  
**Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.**
**Our Team Members:**
We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!
  
  
We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Your Role:**
We're seeking a Senior Brokerage Operations Associate (Canada). An experienced individual contributor who has lived dealer, clearing, and custody reality and designs every process as if manual work is temporary.
  
  
You turn CIRO-aligned operating requirements into scalable, automated, auditable workflows that Product and Engineering can build against. You partner closely with the ACCC President / UDP, Compliance, Product, Engineering, and global Ops. Someone who influences through expertise, crisp documentation, and decision logs, not through a team.
  
  
Success is measured by launch readiness, STP and control quality, registered-account / tax operability, and systems others can run and not by headcount or heroic spreadsheet ops.
  
  
**What you'll walk into:**
You won't be starting from zero. You'll be owning live problems:
  
  

* Getting ready to open: figure out how we open and maintain accounts, process trades, and hold client cash and securities on day one. Build that for ACCC rather than copying a manual process from another firm.
* Working with partner brokers: define how a partner firm and ACCC split the work on accounts, trades, and holding client assets, so it still works as volume grows.
* After the trade: settlement in Canada (through CDS), trades that fail to settle, and corporate actions such as dividends and splits. Automate the routine cases and keep a clear list of exceptions, instead of running the book in spreadsheets.
* Registered accounts and tax: TFSA, RRSP, RESP, and similar accounts. Cover who can open them, contribution rules, what a security cost, tax withheld on dividends and other income, and the reports clients and partners need.
* The day after launch: written steps for daily work, checks that our records match the custodian and the market, contacts at vendors and custodians, and a plan if a system or vendor fails. Have these ready before real client volume shows up.
* Building Canada: clear handoffs between product, engineering, and operations teams.

**What you’ll own:**

* Account lifecycle & client/introducing-broker servicing (onboarding handoffs, KYC/AML ops interfaces, maintenance, transfers)
* Trade lifecycle (capture, affirmation, clearing, settlement, fails, breaks)
* Custody & asset servicing (segregation, security movements, corporate actions, cash)
* Books & records, reconciliations, exception management, and operational controls
* Registered accounts & tax ops: TFSA, RRSP, RESP and related wrappers; tax lots / cost basis; withholding; local reporting partners need to stay compliant
* Day-2 production ops: runbooks, escalations, vendor/custody interfaces, BCP/DR operational playbooks

**How you’ll work:**

* **Translate Canadian reality into runnable process**
  — CIRO-aligned dealer/clearing/custody expectations, introducing–carrying dynamics, custody controls, and operational risk into SOPs, RACI, controls, and exception paths Product and Engineering can build against
* **Automation-first by default**
  — redesign high-volume / high-risk / high-friction work for straight-through processing, rules, exception queues, and measurable SLAs, instead of spreadsheet heroics
* **AI-first operating lens**
  — Prototype and productize AI-assisted ops (exception triage, recon investigation, SOP Q&A, control-testing support, runbook copilots) with human oversight where risk or regulation requires it
* **Go-live and beyond**
  — Readiness for ACCC launch and early production; continuous improvement after go-live
* **Raise the bar without managing a team**
  — Coach partners through expertise, crisp documentation, and decision logs; leave systems others can run

**How we'll measure success:**

* Launch readiness gates met with documented controls, SOPs, RACI, and runbooks Product / Eng / Ops can execute against
* STP, exception, and reconciliation aging targets defined and trending the right way post go-live
* Registered-account and tax workflows ready when partners launch, rather than added later
* Specs and decision logs that remove re-discovery for Product and Engineering
* Systems and playbooks others can run after you, so knowledge sticks in the org and not only in one person's head

**Who you are (Must-haves):**

* 10+ years deep, hands-on Canadian brokerage operations experience at a CIRO dealer, carrying broker, custodian, clearing firm, or brokerage ops function in Canada
* Fluent in the plumbing: clearing / settlement, custody, CDS / CDSX (or equivalent), fails, corp actions, tax, cash / securities ops, account servicing, introducing / carrying arrangements
* Demonstrated depth in at least two of: clearing / settlement; custody & asset servicing; books & records / reconciliations; registered accounts & tax
* Regulatory-literate (CIRO / provincial securities / CSA context). You design operable controls, and you are not the UDP or compliance sign-off owner
* Builder: you've redesigned and shipped process + tooling changes that stuck, not only run BAU
* Practical with automation and AI (workflow automation, rules engines, RPA, or AI-assisted ops). You know where AI helps and where controls must stay deterministic
* Exceptional written communication: SOPs, RACI, decision logs, and requirements that cross-functional teams can ship against

**Who you might be (Nice-to-haves):**

* Greenfield Canadian dealer / clearing / custody stand-up
* API-first or broker-as-a-service / correspondent platforms
* US and Canada dual-entity operations
* Deep CDS / CDSX or Canadian market-infrastructure experience
* Registered-account or Canadian tax-ops stand-up (TFSA, RRSP, RESP, tax lots, withholding, reporting)
* AI-native ops workflow: recurring use of tools like Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, or custom agents for SOP drafting, exception synthesis, and prototyping

**How We Take Care of You:**

* Competitive Salary & Stock Options
* Health Benefits
* New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
* Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

*Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.*
*Recruitment Privacy Policy*

description:
**Support the end-to-end project financing lifecycle for greenfield, brownfield, acquisition, expansion and refinancing projects across Adani Group businesses. **CA / MBA (Finance) / ICWA / Inter CA / CFA or equivalent in Financial Management.**

**Experience: 12-18 years of project finance experience and at least 3-5 successful financial closures across greenfield or expansion projects.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Evaluation & Financial Analysis**

* Review project business plans, DPRs, capex estimates and funding requirements.
* Analyze project viability, profitability, DSCR, IRR, Project IRR, Equity IRR and key risk indicators.
* Develop and maintain detailed project financial models.
* Conduct sensitivity and scenario analysis for project risks.
* Support project appraisal presentations for management and lenders.
* Evaluate financing alternatives and recommend optimal debt-equity structures.

**2. Debt Raising & Financial Closure**

* Prepare lender presentations, teasers and information memorandums.

* Assist in debt syndication and lender onboarding activities.
* Support negotiations on financing terms and commercial conditions.
* Track sanction approvals and financial closure milestones.

**7. Covenant Monitoring & Compliance**

title: Customer Relationship Management Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Revanza Developers is a real estate development company based in Tamil Nadu, specializing in thoughtfully planned residential communities. The organization focuses on quality construction, transparent processes, and innovative design to deliver homes that meet modern lifestyle needs. Projects are strategically located to offer convenient access, strong infrastructure, and long-term value for residents and investors. With an emphasis on sustainable planning and customer-centric development, Revanza Developers aims to build communities that foster comfort, trust, and growth.

Role Overview

We are looking for a customer-focused CRM Manager to manage the complete post-sales customer journey—from plot booking and payment collection to documentation, registration, and handover. The role requires strong coordination with sales, accounts, legal, and project teams to deliver a smooth customer experience and timely completion of commitments.

Key Responsibilities

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Act as the primary contact for customers after booking and ensure a smooth handover from the sales team.
* Explain payment schedules, documentation requirements, registration procedures, and project updates clearly.
* Handle customer queries, complaints, and escalations with timely follow-up and closure.
* Build customer relationships that support referrals and repeat purchases.

**Booking and Documentation**

* Verify booking forms, customer KYC, plot details, pricing, discounts, and approved payment terms.
* Coordinate allotment letters, sale agreements, payment receipts, and other customer documents.
* Maintain accurate customer files, plot allocation records, and booking status.
* Process cancellation, refund, transfer, and name-change requests according to company policy and approvals.

**Collections and Account Coordination**

* Track payment schedules, send reminders, and follow up on outstanding amounts.
* Work with accounts to reconcile collections, issue receipts, and resolve payment discrepancies.
* Monitor overdue accounts and escalate payment risks promptly.
* Coordinate home or plot loan documentation with customers and financial institutions.

**Registration and Handover**

* Coordinate with legal teams, customers, banks, and registration support teams to arrange sale deed execution.
* Ensure required documents, payment clearances, and internal approvals are ready before registration.
* Coordinate plot identification, boundary verification, possession documentation, and handover with the project team.
* Track pending commitments and follow through until closure.

**Team Management and Reporting**

* Lead CRM executives, allocate responsibilities, and monitor follow-up quality.
* Maintain accurate records in CRM software and establish clear customer communication processes.
* Prepare reports on bookings, collections, outstanding payments, registrations, cancellations, and complaints.
* Keep customer communications aligned with approved project information and company commitments.

Candidate Requirements

* Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; an MBA is an advantage.
* 5–8 years of experience in real estate CRM or post-sales operations, with experience managing a team.
* Preference for candidates with residential plotted development experience.
* Working knowledge of booking documentation, payment reconciliation, sale agreements, and registration coordination.
* Strong communication, negotiation, problem-solving, and customer-handling skills.
* Proficiency in CRM software, MS Excel, and MIS reporting.
* Fluency in Tamil and English.
* Willingness to travel to project sites and registration offices as required.

Key Performance Indicators

* Collections against agreed payment schedules.
* Reduction in overdue receivables.
* Accuracy and timely completion of customer documentation.
* Registration and handover completion against schedules.
* Customer query resolution time and satisfaction.
* CRM data accuracy and timely reporting.

title: Risk Consulting - Actuarial - P and C -AU - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Name And Description**
**Senior, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. If you have a passion for enabling world class actuarial services globally to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic GDS team!
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.
  
  
Within our talented and dynamic Actuarial team, the members work on multiple client engagement teams that perform actuarial model building and validations, reserving (actuarial liability estimation), due diligence, premium calculation, valuation analysis for IFRS, GAAP, and Statutory calculations and review, capital/risk modeling and other related actuarial projects for General and Health insurance businesses. The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. The position is designed to enable the member to pursue actuarial exams while developing the basic skills needed to be a successful actuarial consultant, combining both excellent learning and career opportunities.
  
  
Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.
  
  
**On engagements, you will:**

* Be responsible for providing high quality results and generating effective solutions working along with Senior Consultants, Managers or Senior Managers in delivering the project
* Provide focused solutions and training to Staff members
* Be responsible for ensuring all engagement are delivered within time
* Deliver engagements in line with our values and commitment to quality and ensuring that work is of high standards
* Establish/manage priorities, communicate the status of activities, and accumulate/report all chargeable hours
* Actively look for automation and AI enhancement opportunities

**Within the actuarial practice you will:**

* Actuarial liability estimation for general insurance lines of business which involves data preparation, data loading to tools, analysis of liabilities and presenting results
* Analyze the historical claims data and identify potential issues and trends and report the findings
* Perform valuation of reserves through IBNR models using the data supplied for estimation
* Working knowledge of different loss projection methods and their applications along with the familiarity of different property and casualty lines of business
* Review data, methodologies, assumptions, results and benchmark against the market
* Be able to build models from scratch
* Assessment of technical provisions and standard formula/ other capital calculations
* Large loss analysis, rating factor analysis and CAT benchmarking
* Perform ad-hoc research and development requests as required
* Preparations of report/memo sent to stakeholders showing results of the analysis
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise
* Knowledge of ARIUS, ResQ or similar reserving software is desirable, but not mandatory
* Exposure to data analytics tools such as SQL and Alteryx is an added advantage
* Familiarity with IFRS 17 or Solvency II frameworks is preferred
* Stay informed of current business/economic developments relevant to the industry/ geography
* Maintain strong focus in finishing Actuarial exams along with developing a strong subject matter expertise

We are looking for individuals who have a proactive attitude and are seeking the opportunity for personal and professional growth, leveraging and supporting our global network.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Skills and attributes for a successful career at EY require a learning mindset and passion to add value to GDS, member firms and client organizations. Bright and enthusiastic individuals who give their all to each assignment they work on will find themselves at home within our energetic GDS actuarial team.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3+ years’ experience in the General Insurance industry, either within a consulting firm or an Insurer or an organisation providing Insurance services (such as reserving, capital modelling, pricing, rate filling, CAT modelling, IFRS17, technical provision, solvency II and risk management)
* Ability to multi-task and flexible work attitude packed with good analytical skills
* Experience of handling a small team will be an advantage
* Proficiency in MS-Office Suite, VBA, SAS, R Programming, Python, SQL, Alteryx, etc., will be a plus
* AI proficiency, automation mindset
* Good exam progress

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Strong academic background with a bachelor’s degree with an emphasis in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or finance related supplemented ideally with a professional qualification
* Strong written and verbal communication skills for report writing, industry studies and stakeholder presentations
* Overseas exposure (US, UK, AU market experience)
* AI Literacy – Good knowledge on GenAI, Agentic AI would be an added advantage

**What We Look For**
Deep knowledge and experience of the insurance industry and/or consulting. Relevant recent big 4 experience in leading actuarial engagement with recognized insurers will be an advantage. This ideally should be complemented by employment experience within the Insurance sector either at an insurer, intermediary or regulator
  
  
Up to date knowledge of the regulatory environment impacting insurers and other financial service organizations
  
  
Experience of supporting teams to high quality timely delivery, actively building relationships and promoting a collaborative culture when working with colleagues
  
  
**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

title: Vice President Operations
description:
**About Us**

Elance is a fast-growing commerce education company delivering professional

programs across ACCA, CA, CMA (USA) through offline centres, online

platforms, and hybrid learning models. Headquartered in Kerala, we are on a

mission to create career-ready professionals through strong academics,

industry relevance, and technology-driven systems.

**Role Overview**

The Vice President – Operations will be a core leadership role responsible for driving operational excellence across the entire student lifecycle while owning P&L performance, scalability, and service quality.

This role requires a rare combination of strategic thinking, hands-on execution, strong people leadership, and data-driven decision-making. The VP – Operations will work closely with the Founder, leadership team, and cross-functional heads to build systems and teams capable of supporting rapid, sustainable growth.

⸻

**Key Responsibilities**

**End-to-End Operations Leadership**

• Lead and scale operations across:

• Admissions & enrollments

• Student onboarding

• Program delivery & academic operations

• Student success & retention

• Career services & placements

• Student support & experience

• Ensure a seamless, high-quality student lifecycle from enrollment to completion and placement.

**P&L Ownership & Financial Performance**

• Own the operations P&L, including budgeting, forecasting, cost optimization, and margin improvement.

• Drive unit economics across centers, programs, and delivery models.

• Partner with Finance to ensure strong financial discipline and scalability.

**Strategy, Metrics & Execution**

• Develop and execute operational strategies aligned with Elance’s growth and expansion plans.

• Drive and monitor key metrics including:

• Enrollments & admissions efficiency

• Retention and completion rates

• Student satisfaction (NPS)

• Placement outcomes

• Operational cost ratios and productivity

• Build dashboards and MIS frameworks for real-time visibility and decision-making.

**Process, Systems & Automation**

• Establish and continuously refine SOPs, governance frameworks, and quality standards across functions.

• Lead process improvements and automation across CRM, LMS, ERP, and internal workflows.

• Ensure systems are scalable for multi-center, hybrid, and international expansion.

**People & Leadership**

• Build, mentor, and manage senior leaders and large cross-functional teams across locations.

• Drive performance culture, accountability, and leadership development.

• Partner with HR on org design, capability building, and succession planning.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

• Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Academics, Product, Finance, HR, and IT teams to align execution with business goals.

• Act as the single point of accountability for operational execution across departments.

**Governance, Compliance & Risk**

• Ensure compliance with internal policies, academic quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

• Identify operational risks and proactively design mitigation and contingency plans.

• Maintain high standards of ethics, transparency, and student trust.

⸻

**Qualifications & Experience**

• Minimum 12 years of experience in Operations, General Management, or Business Leadership roles.

• Proven experience in end-to-end high-volume sales and operations management.

• Prior experience in EdTech, education, or high-growth startups strongly preferred.
