title: Key Account Manager
description:
**The Bridge Business Solutions, Kochi, Kerala is hiring a Key Accounts Manager: someone who can keep many clients happy, many teams in sync and many deadlines friendly. Remote role, with the occasional client-and-internal**


**meetings.**

Role: Key Accounts Manager

Agency: The Bridge Business Solutions, Kochi | Bengaluru

Work mode: Remote (based out of Kochi. Expect travel for client meetings, to metro cities when needed)

Experience: Not a beginner role: minimum 3+ years of experience handling client accounts, ideally in an agency or similar setting

Languages: Fluent communication in English, Malayalam and Hindi (all three are a must)

Apply: postbox@thebridgesolutions.in

**About the agency**

We are an intentionally-small, full-service creative agency. Offering stories that help brands to grow, with end-to-end Branding to all sorts of Marketing Strategies and Solutions. Our clients come from diverse industries, viz,. Sports, Hospitality, Healthcare, E-commerce and Real Estate, among other industries, so no two days (or briefs) look alike. Strategists, writers, designers and developers sit on one team, and brands trust us with their stories and goals. We like ideas that work, people who own their work, and meetings that end on time. 

**About the role**

Think of yourself as the bridge (yes, we know) between our clients and our creative teams. You are the one who knows what each client needs, what each team is doing, and what happens next. You keep the work moving, the clients smiling and the teams clear on what is expected. If you enjoy being the calm centre of a busy, creative storm, read on.

**What you will do**

**Own the client relationships**

* Manage multiple agency client accounts end to end, as the first and trusted point of contact.
* Track client activity, plans and deliverables, and keep everyone on schedule.
* Run regular client meetings and catch-ups, and follow through on every action point.
* Handle liaisoning with clients and partners so nothing slips through the cracks.

**Keep the teams in sync**

* Coordinate activities between strategy, content, design, social and development teams.
* Coordinate internal tasks for every client account: briefs, timelines, reviews and approvals.
* Make sure deliverables go out on time and on brief.
* Join internal meetings and keep discussions moving towards decisions.

**Create and publish content**

* Write relevant, on-brand content for client social media deliverables/ other tasks.
* Coordinate the content calendar and manage or oversee publishing across platforms.

**Bring ideas and drive results**

* Come up with fresh thoughts for client accounts, and rally the teams around goal-oriented tasks.
* Spot opportunities to grow an account and take them forward.
* Travel for client meetings when the situation calls for it.

**What you bring**

* Minimum 3+ years of proven experience handling multiple client accounts, ideally in an agency or creative setup.
* Fluent communication in English, Malayalam and Hindi.
* Good writing skills in English, with a feel for social media content.
* Strong coordination, follow-up and time management habits.
* A self-driven, passionate and committed attitude, and a real team-player streak.
* A curious mind that offers ideas without waiting to be asked.
* Comfort working remotely, and flexibility to travel or join meetings when required.

**How we work**

* Remote day to day, with internal meetings in Kochi/ Bengaluru.
* Small team, direct access to decision makers and plenty of room to shape how accounts are run.
* Clear goals, honest conversations, and a good sense of humour.

**How to apply**

Email your resume and a few lines on an account you are proud of to
**postbox@thebridgesolutions.in**

. Tell us what you handled, what you changed and what the client said afterwards.

title: Resources Manager
description:
**About the Role :**
The RMG Lead is a critical enabler of delivery excellence. You will own the resource management function end-to-end — ensuring seamless fulfilment of project demands, optimising workforce utilisation, and partnering with leadership to future-proof the organisation's talent supply.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1/ Demand & Supply Management**

a/ Drive real-time visibility into open demands and available talent supply across all practices.

b/ Own the fulfilment lifecycle — from demand intake to deployment — including staffing, backfill, and internal mobility.

c/ Lead weekly and monthly resource review cadences with delivery managers and practice heads.

d/ Work closely with Talent Acquisition to bridge gaps that cannot be covered internally, and ensure SLA adherence on time-to-fill

**2/ Utilisation & Bench Management**

a/ Own billable utilisation targets at the practice and BU level.

b/ Proactively identify bench risks, track ageing, and build action plans to redeploy or upskill idle resources.

c/ Partner with Learning & Development and Practice to align skilling programs to the forward demand pipeline.

d/ Ensure bench employees are engaged, career-pathed, and deployment-ready.

**3/ Workforce Planning & Analytics**

a/ Translate headcount, skills, and project pipeline data into actionable hiring and workforce plans.

b/ Build and maintain dashboards and MIS reports covering utilisation, bench status, demand coverage, attrition, and headcount trends.

c/ Present insights and recommendations to senior leadership on a regular cadence.

**4/ Stakeholder Management**

a/ Serve as the primary point of contact for delivery managers, BU heads, project leads, and HR/TA for all resource-related matters.

b/ Balance competing priorities across stakeholders, negotiate trade-offs transparently, and manage expectations proactively.

c/ Build trust with bench employees by understanding their aspirations and advocating for their growth and transitions.

**5/ Governance, Process & Tools**

a/ Design and continuously refine RMG operating models, workflows, and SLAs.

b/ Ensure data accuracy and hygiene across resource management systems.

c/Champion internal mobility programs and cross-skilling initiatives as strategic levers for demand fulfilment.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 8–12 years of overall experience with at least 8 years in a Resource Management or Workforce Management role within an
  **500+ employee sized**
  IT services, consulting, or technology organisation.
* Deep familiarity with IT delivery models (Time & Material, Fixed Price, Managed Services) and their direct impact on resourcing strategy.
* Strong technical acumen and JD-reading and role-matching ability.
* Strong command of resource management and HRMS tools; advanced Excel skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to synthesise large workforce datasets into clear, actionable insights.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills — comfortable engaging VP/Director-level stakeholders.
* Track record of designing and executing internal mobility and bench utilisation programs.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate degree preferred; Bachelor's degree in any discipline is required

**Benefits:**

1/ High-visibility, high-impact position that sits at the crossroads of people strategy and business delivery.

2/ Direct line of sight to senior leadership, influence over how the organisation deploys its most important asset — its people

3/Fast growth trajectory for strong performers.

4/ Exposure to diverse technology domains and global clients.

5/ Competitive CTC, performance bonus, and health benefits.

* Exposure and experience in analytical thinking with tools like power bi, tableu.
* Required knowledge for Python libraries: netaddr, ipaddress, qualysapi, lxml, pandas, numpy

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

title: Oracle Integration Cloud Lead
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) Lead – Enterprise Integrations & Digital Transformation**
**Experience:**
7–10 Years
  
  
**Location:**
Kochi / Bangalore / Hyderabad (Hybrid)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Reports To:**
Service Delivery Manager – Enterprise Applications / Integration Services
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and technically strong
**Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) Lead**
to lead enterprise integration initiatives across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid application landscapes.
  
  
This role is responsible for defining integration strategy, designing scalable integration architectures, establishing governance standards, and leading teams responsible for implementing secure and high-performing integrations using
**Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)**
and related enterprise integration technologies.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Oracle Integration Cloud, API-led integration, enterprise application connectivity, process automation, and integration architecture. You will work closely with Architects, Business Analysts, Salesforce Teams, ERP Teams, HR Technology Teams, and Business Stakeholders to deliver seamless connectivity between Oracle Cloud Applications, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Microsoft platforms, and other enterprise systems.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for professionals who enjoy solving complex integration challenges while supporting large-scale enterprise modernization and digital transformation programs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Integration Leadership & Architecture**

* Lead enterprise integration initiatives using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
* Define integration architecture, governance frameworks, standards, and best practices.
* Design scalable, secure, and resilient integration solutions supporting cloud-to-cloud, cloud-to-on-premises, and hybrid ecosystems.
* Partner with enterprise architects to align integration strategies with organizational technology roadmaps.
* Conduct architecture reviews, design workshops, and technical assessments.
* Define integration roadmaps supporting business transformation and modernization initiatives.
* Establish API governance, security policies, monitoring standards, and operational frameworks.

**Oracle Integration Cloud Solution Delivery**

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of integration solutions using:

+ Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
+ Application Integrations
+ Process Automation
+ Visual Builder Integrations
+ File-Based Integrations
+ Event-Driven Integrations
+ REST and SOAP Services

* Develop reusable integration frameworks and enterprise integration patterns.
* Configure and manage Oracle and third-party adapters and connectors.
* Ensure delivery of scalable, maintainable, and reusable integration solutions.

**Enterprise Application Integrations**

* Lead integrations involving:

+ Oracle ERP Cloud
+ Oracle HCM Cloud
+ Oracle EPM
+ Salesforce
+ ServiceNow
+ Workday
+ SAP
+ Microsoft Platforms
+ Third-Party SaaS Applications

* Ensure seamless data synchronization, workflow orchestration, and process automation across enterprise systems.
* Support enterprise-wide business processes spanning finance, HR, service management, customer operations, and shared services.

**API Management & Security**

* Design and manage APIs using Oracle Integration Cloud capabilities.
* Implement API governance, lifecycle management, and security standards.
* Support authentication and security frameworks including:

+ OAuth 2.0
+ JWT
+ SSL/TLS
+ API Security Policies
+ Identity and Access Management Controls

* Ensure compliance with enterprise security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

**Operational Excellence & Delivery Governance**

* Monitor and optimize integration performance, scalability, and reliability.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex integration issues.
* Establish proactive monitoring, alerting, and support mechanisms.
* Support release management, production deployments, upgrades, and platform maintenance activities.
* Manage integration risks, dependencies, and operational challenges.
* Ensure timely and high-quality delivery across integration workstreams.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Lead and mentor Integration Developers and technical teams.
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance assessments.
* Support technical capability development, certification initiatives, and knowledge sharing.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, automation, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the primary escalation point for integration-related technical issues.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 7–10 years of overall IT experience.
* Minimum 5+ years of enterprise integration experience.
* Minimum 3+ years of hands-on Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) experience.
* Experience leading enterprise integration projects and technical teams.
* Proven track record delivering large-scale integration solutions in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, leadership, and communication skills.
* Experience working in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps delivery environments.

**Oracle Technologies**

* Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
* Oracle ERP Cloud Integrations
* Oracle HCM Cloud Integrations
* Oracle Fusion Applications
* Oracle SOA Concepts
* Oracle Visual Builder

**Integration Technologies**

* REST APIs
* SOAP Services
* Web Services
* XML
* JSON
* XSLT
* API Design & Development
* Event-Driven Architecture
* File-Based Integrations
* Enterprise Messaging Patterns

**Enterprise Integration Expertise**

* Integration Architecture
* Middleware Platforms
* API Management
* Microservices Architecture
* Data Mapping & Transformation
* ESB Concepts
* Workflow Automation
* Enterprise Connectivity Patterns

**Security Expertise**

* OAuth 2.0
* JWT
* SSL/TLS
* API Security
* Identity and Access Management
* Authentication & Authorization Frameworks

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience integrating Oracle Cloud Applications with Salesforce platforms.
* Experience supporting Salesforce Service Cloud, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), or ITSM implementations.
* Experience working with:

+ Oracle Process Automation
+ Oracle Visual Builder Cloud Service
+ Oracle API Gateway
+ Azure Integration Services
+ MuleSoft
+ Boomi

* Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and integration testing frameworks.
* Experience supporting enterprise digital transformation programs.

**Certifications**

* Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) Certification
* Oracle Cloud Platform Application Integration Professional
* Oracle Integration Professional Certification
* Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Certification
* Salesforce Certification (Preferred)
* MuleSoft Certification (Preferred)

**Added Advantage**

* Experience integrating Oracle applications with Salesforce-powered Enterprise Service Management solutions.
* Exposure to Agentforce, Conversational AI, and Intelligent Automation platforms.
* Experience supporting AI-enabled business workflows and enterprise orchestration solutions.
* Knowledge of ITIL, Service Management, and Enterprise Operations processes.
* Experience supporting cloud modernization and digital transformation initiatives.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are seeking professionals who:
  
  

* Think strategically while remaining hands-on technical leaders.
* Enjoy solving complex enterprise integration challenges.
* Can mentor teams while driving delivery excellence.
* Have strong stakeholder management and consulting capabilities.
* Are passionate about enterprise integration, cloud technologies, APIs, and automation.
* Thrive in fast-paced environments focused on innovation and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and a customer-first mindset.

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead strategic enterprise integration initiatives supporting large-scale transformation programs.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies including Oracle Integration Cloud, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, and modern API platforms.
* Influence integration architecture, standards, governance, and engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with experienced architects, product teams, business leaders, and technology stakeholders.
* Mentor and develop high-performing integration teams.
* Accelerate your career toward Integration Architect, Enterprise Architect, or Practice Leadership pathways.
* Join a rapidly growing organization where innovation, technical excellence, and customer success are core to our culture.
* Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model across Kochi, Bangalore, and Hyderabad.

**Join Us**
If you are an experienced
**Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) Lead**
who is passionate about enterprise integration, API-led connectivity, cloud technologies, and technical leadership, we would love to hear from you. Join us in delivering the next generation of connected enterprise solutions, enabling seamless business processes, intelligent automation, and digital transformation across the organization.
  
  
**Compensation**
Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

At Milestone we strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and work with, where we all feel empowered to bring our full, authentic selves to work. We know creating a diverse and inclusive culture that champions equity and belonging is not only the right thing to do for our employees but is also critical to our continued success.

We welcome the unique background, culture, experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression and perspectives you can bring to our global community. Our recruitment team is looking forward to meeting you.

title: Payroll Operations Services Manager
description:
**Join us on a journey of endless possibilities**
At
**Strada**
, possibility isn’t just a promise – it’s the foundation of everything we do. We believe in unlocking potential for every colleague, creating a journey of growth, discovery, and impact.
  
  
With the support, resources, and opportunities we provide, you’ll build a fulfilling future – working on meaningful projects that span industries and regions, contributing to outcomes that matter.
  
  
Strada is a people, payroll, and technology leader simplifying international workforce management. Operating in 180+ countries, we design and deliver
**people-first**
solutions powered by cloud-based technology – helping organizations grow and enabling workforces to perform at their best.
  
  
**Learn more at**
www.stradaglobal.com
  
  
The Payroll Operations Services Manager (OSM) provides end-to-end oversight of payroll operations for assigned clients and serves as the primary operational escalation point. The OSM coordinates delivery teams, third-party providers, Client Service Leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to meet contractual obligations and service commitments. The OSM leads operational health, service-level performance, payroll change execution, audit readiness, financial and resource management, service recovery, and continuous improvement. The OSM is also a people leader who develops aligned payroll colleagues to deliver consistent, compliant, and client-focused outcomes.
  
  
Core Accountabilities
  
  

* Payroll Service Delivery Oversight
* Provide oversight for day-to-day payroll delivery across service locations, platforms, internal teams, and third-party providers.
* Monitor payroll workload, critical processing activities, capacity, dependencies, risks, and open items to ensure business-as-usual work and projects meet required deadlines and quality standards.
* Lead payroll status calls and key client-event planning, including annual and recurring payroll activities including Union agreement changes, bonus cycles, year-end operations, legislative changes, mergers and acquisitions, and changes in scope.
* Ensure consistent execution of operating procedures, controls, contractual requirements, and approved service delivery practices.
* Evaluate orphaned or unclear work to define the process, establish ownership, or eliminate unnecessary activity.
* Lead operational readiness and stabilization activities for new services, transitions, vendor changes, and material payroll initiatives.
* Client Delivery and Service Partnership
* Partner with the CSL to ensure governance actions, service priorities, and client commitments are completed accurately and on time.
* Build trusted relationships with key client contacts and serve as the secondary operational contact for payroll delivery matters.
* Participate in and, as appropriate, lead client governance meetings, operational reviews, and status calls, presenting payroll performance, risks, actions, and recommendations.
* Provide payroll operational consultation, recommendations, and best-practice guidance to support changes, releases, and legislative or tax updates.
* Coordinate timely client communications regarding payroll operations, delivery risks, service improvements, resource changes, and other business initiatives impacting payroll delivery.
* Governance, Metrics, and Operational Health
* Monitor payroll operational health and performance across aligned clients and teams, driving achievement of established service and operational targets.
* Analyze dashboards, productivity data, operational metrics, open-item reporting, and service results to identify trends, emerging risks, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities.
* Prepare payroll governance materials, service metrics, and operational scorecards, ensuring assigned content is accurate, complete, and ready for stakeholder review.
* Develop and coordinate mitigation and recovery plans for missed targets, operational risks, escalating concerns as appropriate.
* Escalation Management, Service Recovery and E&O
* Serve as the primary escalation point for payroll service delivery issues and high-impact or highly visible service failures.
* Coordinate issue investigation to determine root cause, impacted population, operational and client impact, risk exposure, and required corrective actions.
* Develop and coordinate service recovery and mitigation plans, ensuring actions are tracked through completion and appropriate stakeholders are engaged.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis documentation and coordinate required internal review, approval, and client delivery.
* Initiate and support Errors and Omissions processes, ensuring required documentation is completed and coordinating with the CSL and applicable stakeholders to mitigate financial and client impacts.
* Review and track service recoveries, corrective actions, and recurring issues to identify trends and drive process improvement and risk-reduction opportunities.

title: Senior Associate - Resource Management
description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
  
  
The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling & Staffing Support**

* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.

**Capacity, Utilization & Workforce Analytics**

* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.
* Monitor schedule changes and ensure updates are reflected in timely reporting systems.
* Identify trends in staffing, utilization, and resource availability and communicate insights to support decision-making.
* Support data validation efforts to improve reporting accuracy, workforce visibility, and data integrity.
* Assist in workforce planning activities by monitoring forecasted workload, resource demand, and skill requirements.
* Provide scheduling, utilization, and capacity-related information as requested by management.

**Coordination & Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as a resource for routine scheduling inquiries from team members, managers, and engagement teams.
* Coordinate with U.S. and India Tax teams to gather staffing information, scheduling updates, and resource needs.
* Build effective working relationships with U.S. and India leadership teams to support resource deployment decisions.
* Facilitate communication regarding staffing conflicts, priorities, workload balancing, and schedule changes.
* Escalate staffing concerns, scheduling issues, or capacity risks to the Manager, Talent Optimization when appropriate.

**Process & Administrative Support**

* Follow established scheduling procedures, guidelines, and best practices.
* Assist with maintaining scheduling documentation, process materials, and training resources.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance scheduling efficiency, reporting quality, and data accuracy.
* Participate in team meetings, scheduling calls, capacity review exercises, and workforce planning discussions.
* Assist with onboarding and training activities related to scheduling tools, reporting processes, and resource management procedures.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, or related fields.
* 2-4 years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, professional services operations, project coordination, or related discipline.
* Experience in a CPA firm, tax practice, public accounting, or professional services environment preferred.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills, including pivot tables, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and shift business needs in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, summarize findings, and support practical solutions.

**Core Competencies**
Resource Coordination
  
  
Relationship Management
  
  
Schedule Management
  
  
Problem Solving
  
  
Capacity Planning & Tracking
  
  
Business Acumen
  
  
Workforce Analytics
  
  
Time Management
  
  
Operational Support
  
  
Attention to Detail
  
  
Data Accuracy & Reporting
  
  
Adaptability
  
  
**Success Measures**

* Accuracy and integrity of staffing, scheduling, and workforce planning data.
* Timely and effective processing of staffing requests and schedule updates.
* Quality, reliability, and usefulness of capacity, utilization, and availability reporting.
* Proactive identification and communication of capacity constraints, staffing risks, and workload imbalances.
* Responsiveness to scheduling inquiries and ability to support timely decision-making.
* Effective support of workload balancing, resource deployment, and staffing processes across U.S. and India teams.
* Positive stakeholder feedback from leadership, managers, and engagement teams.
* Contribution to improved scheduling efficiency, utilization of visibility, and resource management processes.

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Clients & Industries: Global C&I Strategic Operations Specialist**
**About EY**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
The Global Operations Specialist plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.
  
  
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
  
  
This position sits within the Business Enablement – Business Management Office and supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
  
  
Success in this model depends on agility—the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
  
  
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the Domain Leader and the rest of the Domain team.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Operations
  
  

* Partner with leadership to help translate strategic objectives into actionable operational plans within the aligned domain.
* Support the design and implementation of short- and long-term initiatives/projects that deliver on strategic priorities, monitoring progress against milestones.
* Oversee domain-specific processes, driving clarity, consistency, and timely execution across stakeholders.
* Prepare strategic inputs for leadership (e.g., decks), synthesizing content into clear narratives and recommendations to support decision-making.
* Collaborate with the Strategic Operations Team Lead and counterparts, plus other Domain teams, to coordinate cross-domain priorities, ensuring operational delivery supports strategic impact.
* Support performance monitoring and governance alongside Core Services.
* Leverage Performance & Data Insights for analytics and intelligence to guide decisions and monitor impact.

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Identify and drive efficiencies in relevant areas through automation, standardization, and best practices.
* Assess emerging technologies and tools to enhance operational agility and responsiveness.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the Strategic Operations team.
* Support governance forums and prepare executive-ready updates leveraging data analytics and reporting tools (e.g., Essentials, Dynamics, etc.) in coordination with Performance & Data Insights.
* Drive quality and alignment with Core Services and Performance & Data Insights across domain processes, ensuring clarity in roles, handoffs, and workflows.
* Assist with additional reporting and analysis requests, help manage stakeholder expectations, and reinforce self-service options.

Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Build strong relationships across domains, functions, and pods to foster collaboration and alignment.
* Act as a trusted advisor to leadership, providing recommendations based on operational insights.
* Facilitate communication and coordination across domains, functions, and pods for smooth execution of initiatives.

Skills & Attributes for Success
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience in operational process creation, improvement, and handoff.
* Proficiency in reporting tools, data visualization, and storyboarding to create impactful prompts for decision-making.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities, delivering high-quality outputs under tight timelines.
* A client-focused mindset, with the ability to manage expectations and redirect activity as required.
* Credible, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills at Global/Area leadership level.
* Resilient, embraces ambiguity, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.

What we offer you
  
  
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**SAP SAC Planning – Implementation & Delivery**

* A minimum of 1-3 years of experience in SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solutions.
* Lead end-to-end implementation of SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solutions, including requirement gathering, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and support.
* Design and build SAC Planning Models and Dimensions, including public and private dimensions with attributes and hierarchies.
* Develop Data Actions, Multi-Actions, and Allocation processes to support driver-based planning and automation.
* Configure planning workflows, version management, and data locking to enable governed planning cycles.
* Design and develop SAC Stories, Unified Stories, and Digital Boardrooms for executive and operational reporting.
* Build Optimized stories with advanced scripting to support complex planning and analysis use cases.
* Expertise in SAC security configuration.

**SAP Datasphere/HANA Modelling**

* Leverage 2–3 years of hands-on SAP HANA Modelling experience or Datasphere and SAP BW experience in implementation.
* Design and develop SAP HANA Calculation Views to support SAC Planning and Reporting use cases.
* Perform data modelling, transformations, and performance optimization in SAP Datasphere.
* Collaborate with SAC planning teams to ensure optimal data structures and model performance.

**Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey ideas in both technical and business‑friendly language
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills
* Highly process‑oriented with a structured approach to solution design
* Ability to work independently and lead complex engagements
* Strong documentation and knowledge‑sharing mindset

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Experience in BW
* Good understanding on SAP BDC, Datasphere Seamless planning and SAP Joule and AI.

**What We Look For**

* Experience working on large‑scale finance transformation or planning initiatives
* Exposure to competitor EPM tools is a plus
* Ability to mentor junior consultants and contribute to capability building
* Expertise in delivering the process definition document post workshops. Preparing the system design document by mapping client requirements. Capable to work with the team on sprint planning for the delivery.

High

The GDS Alliances Investments Senior Analyst will be part of the Alliances Partner Operations CoE and will support the execution, governance, reporting, and operational management of the SAP PartnerEdge and SAP CCFlex programs within the broader Global Alliances ecosystem. The role is responsible for managing alliance investment and referral-related processes, validating and reconciling program data, tracking pipeline, referral, and commission metrics, and ensuring timely and accurate reporting to alliance leadership and key stakeholders.

* Manage current operational activities supporting SAP PartnerEdge and SAP CCFlex programs, ensuring timely execution and alignment with applicable alliance requirements.
* Perform data reconciliation and validation across systems to ensure the accuracy and completeness of alliance investment, referral, commission, and pipeline data.
* Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, Excel-based reports, and tracking tools for leadership and stakeholder reporting.
* Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports, executive summaries, and governance metrics covering referrals, pipeline progression, commissions, and alliance investments.
* Track deal status, commission, pipeline progress to ensure visibility and accountability.
* Support compliance and governance requirements through accurate documentation, robust tracking, and adherence to defined processes.
* Involve in reporting automation, process improvement, and operational efficiency through practical, data-driven solutions.
* Manage stakeholder communications, status tracking, issue escalation, and timely follow-through on program activities.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Hands-on experience with Power BI for dashboard development, reporting and visualization.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including the ability to work with large, complex spreadsheets and datasets.
* Strong experience in data reconciliation, validation, and data-quality management, with consistently high accuracy and attention to detail.
* Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify trends, risks, root causes, and improvement opportunities.
* Good email communication, action tracking, preparing reports, and stakeholder follow-up.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, including the ability to develop clear business content with limited initial guidance.

**Additional Skills**

* Experience working virtually across multiple geographies, with cultural sensitivity and a global mindset.
* Ability to identify and mitigate risks and collaborate across cross-functional teams to reach appropriate solutions.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and demanding deadlines.
* Ability to work effectively with global stakeholders and build trusted working relationships.
* Exposure to reporting automation, process improvement, governance, or alliance operations is desirable.

**Experience**

* 6+ years of relevant experience in Finance, Operations, Reporting, Data Analytics, Business Operations, Alliance Operations, or a related field.
* Experience supporting reporting, governance, referral programs, operational processes, or performance tracking is preferred.
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross-functional teams is highly desirable.

Academic Requirements
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in finance, Business Administration, Commerce, Accounting, or related discipline.
* Professional certifications in Analytics, Power BI, or Data Management are an added advantage.

Role Exposure and Opportunity
  
  

* Opportunity to work with global SAP Alliance stakeholders across regions and functions.
* Exposure to SAP PartnerEdge, SAP CCFlex, alliance referral programs, pipeline and commission tracking, reporting, analytics, and governance.

**Senior, P&C Actuarial, EY GDS Consulting**
Global Delivery Services is one of EY's greatest global assets – a network of service delivery centers that provide high-quality services at a competitive cost for all EY’s client serving and enablement teams. Every day, we combine our subject matter expertise with our technology and automation skills to develop new solutions that deliver greater value for EY. **The opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior Consultant to join our General Insurance Actuarial Practice delivering solutions to the leading clients in Insurance Sector, working closely with other Staff/Assistants, Consultants/Seniors, Managers, Senior Managers or Client partners in EY’s global network of insurance sector and consulting professionals.

The team members also receive on-the-job training to acquire practical experience in addressing business/technical issues and in applying industry knowledge and EY policies/procedures on client engagements. Our growing team of professionals come from a diverse background, all committed to being long term trusted advisors to our clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant within the Actuarial team your role involves developing and implementing solutions both within the Insurance service line and in collaboration with other services lines.

title: Operations Manager  (Ship Building)
description:
The Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing and managing the day-to-day operations of the yard, including Production, Logistics, Maintenance, Safety, Resource Management, and overall project execution. The role ensures that operational activities are carried out safely, efficiently, within budget, and in accordance with required quality standards and project timelines.

The Operations Manager will work closely with Engineering, Procurement, Production/Construction, Quality Control, and other departments to ensure smooth workflow and effective utilization of manpower, materials, equipment, and other resources. The role also focuses on continuous improvement, cost optimization, operational performance, and timely delivery of projects.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Yard Operations: Oversee and manage the day-to-day activities of the yard, including production, logistics, maintenance, material movement, and other operational activities.
* Safety Management: Implement and enforce safety procedures, policies, and applicable regulations across yard operations. Conduct or coordinate risk assessments and promote a strong safety-conscious work culture.
* Resource Management: Plan and manage manpower, materials, machinery, tools, and equipment to ensure optimum utilization and availability for project requirements.
* Interdepartmental Coordination: Coordinate closely with Engineering, Procurement, Production/Construction, Quality Control, and other departments to ensure smooth workflow and efficient project execution.
* Budget & Cost Management: Develop and manage operational budgets, monitor expenditure, control operational costs, and identify opportunities for cost optimization without compromising safety or quality.
* Performance Monitoring: Define and track operational KPIs, analyze performance and productivity data, identify operational gaps, and implement corrective and improvement measures.
* Project Management: Oversee operational aspects of projects and ensure completion within agreed timelines, budgets, technical requirements, and quality standards.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, procedures, layouts, resource utilization, and workflows. Implement initiatives to enhance productivity and operational efficiency.
* Quality Control & Assurance: Coordinate with the Quality team to implement and monitor quality control procedures and ensure that vessels meet required specifications, standards, and customer requirements.
* Stakeholder Management: Liaise and maintain effective working relationships with suppliers, subcontractors, service providers, regulatory agencies, and other external stakeholders as required.
* Staffing & Training: Participate in manpower planning, recruitment, onboarding, training, performance monitoring, and development of operational and project personnel.
* Strategic Planning: Develop and support long-term operational strategies and plans aligned with organizational objectives, production requirements, and future projects.
* Inventory & Material Management: Oversee the availability and utilization of materials, consumables, tools, and equipment. Coordinate with relevant departments to maintain adequate stock levels and minimize shortages and operational delays.
* Maintenance Management: Ensure preventive and corrective maintenance of yard machinery, equipment, tools, utilities, and infrastructure to minimize downtime and ensure operational readiness.
* Customer Coordination: Maintain professional relationships with clients, support project-related customer interactions, and coordinate the timely resolution of operational or service-related concerns.
* Compliance & Documentation: Ensure operational activities comply with applicable statutory, regulatory, safety, environmental, and organizational requirements. Maintain appropriate operational records, reports, and documentation.
* Reporting: Prepare and present periodic reports on production progress, operational performance, resource utilization, project status, costs, safety, quality, and other key operational indicators to management.

**Job Requirements**

* Education :Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering

**Experience**

* Relevant managerial experience in Operations, Production, Yard Management, Project Management, or a similar function.
* Experience in shipbuilding, boat manufacturing, marine, heavy engineering, fabrication, manufacturing, or a related industry is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in managing multidisciplinary teams and coordinating multiple projects/activities simultaneously.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of production and yard operations.
* Strong project planning and execution skills.
* Knowledge of safety practices, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
* Effective manpower and resource planning skills.
* Budgeting, cost control, and cost optimization capabilities.
* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent interdepartmental coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Knowledge of quality management and continuous improvement practices.
* Ability to monitor KPIs and prepare management reports.
* Strong inventory, logistics, and material management skills.
* Good communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities and project deadlines.
* Proficiency in MS Office and relevant ERP/project management systems.

**Benefits:**

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

title: Project Manager
description:
The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing villa construction projects from initiation to final handover. The role involves managing site activities, subcontractors, consultants, materials, budgets, quality standards, and project schedules to ensure the villa project is completed safely, within budget, on time, and according to approved drawings and specifications.

Key Responsibilities1. Project Planning and Execution

* Develop detailed project schedules, construction plans, and execution strategies.
* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly construction progress.
* Ensure work is carried out according to approved architectural, structural, and MEP drawings.
* Coordinate all construction activities from foundation to finishing and handover.
* Identify project risks and implement corrective actions to avoid delays.

2. Site and Team Management

* Supervise site engineers, supervisors, foremen, subcontractors, and other project staff.
* Coordinate civil, structural, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, landscaping, and interior finishing works.
* Conduct regular site inspections and progress meetings.
* Ensure effective communication between clients, consultants, contractors, and suppliers.

3. Budget and Cost Control

* Prepare and monitor project budgets and cost forecasts.
* Control construction expenses and minimize material wastage.
* Review bills, subcontractor invoices, and variations.
* Monitor quantities, material consumption, and resource utilization.
* Report cost overruns and recommend cost-saving measures without compromising quality.

4. Quality Control

* Ensure construction work complies with approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
* Inspect concrete, masonry, waterproofing, tiling, painting, joinery, and other finishing works.
* Coordinate inspections and resolve technical issues.
* Ensure all defects and non-conformities are corrected promptly.

5. Procurement and Material Management

* Coordinate with the procurement team to ensure timely delivery of materials.
* Review material requirements and construction specifications.
* Monitor material availability, storage, and usage at the site.
* Coordinate with suppliers and subcontractors to prevent work interruptions.

6. Health, Safety, and Compliance

* Ensure compliance with site safety procedures and applicable construction regulations.
* Conduct safety inspections and ensure workers use appropriate personal protective equipment.
* Maintain proper site housekeeping and safe working conditions.
* Ensure necessary permits, inspections, and approvals are obtained.

7. Client and Consultant Coordination

* Attend client meetings and provide regular project progress updates.
* Coordinate with architects, structural consultants, MEP consultants, and other stakeholders.
* Manage client requirements, approved changes, and variation orders.
* Resolve site issues and ensure client expectations are met.

8. Project Completion and Handover

* Prepare and monitor the snagging and de-snagging process.
* Ensure testing and commissioning of all building services.
* Coordinate final inspections and completion documentation.
* Arrange preparation of as-built drawings, warranties, and operation and maintenance manuals.
* Ensure timely handover of completed villas to the client.

Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–10 years of experience in construction project management, preferably in residential villas or luxury residential projects.
* Strong knowledge of civil construction, MEP coordination, and finishing works.
* Experience in project scheduling, budgeting, procurement, and subcontractor management.
* Proficiency in MS Project, Primavera P6, AutoCAD, and MS Excel is an advantage.
* Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.

description:
**Role Title: AVP, Project Management (L11)**
**Company Overview:**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Project Manager supports S2P delivery by managing the backlog in a blended Kanban/Scrum model—driving refinement, ensuring stories meet requirement standards, and routing enablers to the Program Manager. The role supports PI prioritization, manages QC to ensure documentation compliance, and maintains delivery artifacts and reporting. This position also coordinates mini-project scheduling and may lead small projects, proactively managing timelines, “RAID” items, dependencies, and continuous process improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and manage the backlog process for all Source to Pay functions using a Kanban or Scrum approach, ensuring transparency, prioritization, and readiness for delivery.
* Drive backlog refinement activities to ensure:
* Stories contain clearly defined requirements (e.g., objective, scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, estimates, priority), meeting definition of ready.
* Enablers are identified with clearly documented objectives, outputs, and prioritized.
* Manage a QC process to ensure Program Managers adhere to documentation guidelines
* Drive the Program Increment (PI) prioritization process, partnering with stakeholders to intake work, align priorities, and sequence items based on value and need.
* Manage small project scheduling and coordination, including creating the structure, processes, and templates to develop timeline tracking, task sequencing, meeting coordination, and follow-up on action items.
* Manage projects as needed, including planning, prioritization, scope tracking, status reporting, and risk/issue/dependency (RAID) management.
* Maintain delivery artifacts and reporting (e.g., project minutes and action items, approval, testing and other documentation, decision logs, and schedules).
* Identify and escalate blockers, risks, and cross-team dependencies; propose resolution options and coordinate next steps.
* Promote continuous improvement in intake, prioritization, refinement, and flow efficiency across the S2P delivery process.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience
* 3+ years in Project Management/Agile delivery role utilizing Scrum and/or Kanban
* Scrum Master Certification or Service Delivery Manager
* Experience writing/supporting user stories (scope, acceptance criteria) and tracking dependencies/estimates.
* Experience managing a PI/quarterly prioritization (or similar intake and sequencing) process.
* Enforce documentation standards by managing a quality control process.
* Proficient with Jira/Confluence and MS Office (Excel/PowerPoint/Visio)
* Experience with identifying and developing process metrics

**Desired Characteristics**

* Familiarity with Source to Pay teams and Coupa preferred.
* Experience summarizing complex projects, risks, or ideas to Senior Leadership in a concise manner.
* Detail-oriented and documentation-focused; produces audit-ready artifacts.
* Comfortable with ambiguity with ability to break work down for sequencing.
* Strong organization, communication and facilitation skills
* Proactive communicator who escalates risks/dependencies early and drives follow-through.
* Continuous improvement and curious mindset with interest in flow/throughput metrics.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience

**Work Timings: 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM EST**

* Inform your manager or HRM before applying for the role on Workday
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP)

title: Product Analyst
description:
**Description**
Req ID: 27-0493
  
  
Come join our passionate team! Barracuda is a leading global cybersecurity company delivering complete resilience made easy to buy, deploy and use through a partner-first model. Our intelligent BarracudaONE™ platform provides cyber resilience across email, data, applications, networks, and managed XDR within an open ecosystem. Trusted by hundreds of thousands of organizations and partners worldwide, Barracuda delivers industry-leading solutions and support, powered by people and enhanced by AI, for all size business.
  
  
We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an employer that complies with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability.
  
  
**Envision Yourself At Barracuda**
Help turn customer needs into useful email-security capabilities. As a Product Analyst, you will own a clearly bounded feature or administrator workflow, working directly with engineering and a senior product manager from discovery through delivery and measurement. The role combines hands-on product decisions, customer exposure and structured mentorship, with opportunities to develop toward broader product responsibility.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Working On**
Investigate customer and administrator needs through interviews, support feedback, usage data and market or competitor research. Translate findings into a clear problem statement and practical options for an assigned feature. Explore how phishing, malware and everyday email-management challenges affect the people using the product.
  
  
Define user stories and testable acceptance criteria with senior PM guidance. Partner with engineering and design to evaluate feasibility, refine the backlog and recommend priorities within the agreed scope. Own requirements clarity and follow-through, resolve straightforward product questions collaboratively, and escalate security-sensitive or higher-complexity decisions.
  
  
Track feature milestones, dependencies and delivery risks against the agreed roadmap. Support validation and release readiness, prepare internal product briefings or training, and gather customer feedback after launch. Agree relevant indicators with your mentor, analyse adoption and workflow outcomes, and propose evidence-based improvements.
  
  
You are accountable for the quality and outcomes of your assigned feature or workflow, not only meeting coordination. A senior product manager retains portfolio strategy, overall roadmap ownership and major prioritisation decisions. You will contribute research and recommendations to those decisions and may support a broader strategic initiative under their direction.
  
  
**What You Bring To The Role**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience; and 2–5 years of experience in product management, project management, software engineering or a comparable role.
* Adjacent experience is welcome when it demonstrates customer problem-solving and delivery of software outcomes.
* Working knowledge of agile delivery and cybersecurity fundamentals, together with the ability to interpret customer feedback and product data.
* You can communicate requirements clearly, discuss trade-offs with technical colleagues, collaborate across functions and adapt as evidence or priorities change.
* Preferred, not required: familiarity with email administration, Microsoft 365, phishing and malware protection, and basic email authentication concepts such as SPF, DKIM and DMARC. Product-management certification, including CPM, is also welcome.
* Deep email-security expertise is not expected at entry to this role.

**How You Will Grow And Succeed**
Regular senior PM coaching, engineering partnership and customer conversations will help you strengthen discovery, prioritisation and analytical judgement. You will collaborate with colleagues across locations on shared product goals. Success means well-defined requirements, transparent delivery risks, useful customer insights and measurable improvement in your assigned area, with progressively greater independence as your skills develop.
  
  
**What You’ll Get From Us**
A team where you can voice your opinion, make an impact, and where you and your experience are valued. Internal mobility – there are opportunities for cross training and the ability to attain your next career step within Barracuda. In addition, you will receive equity, in the form of non-qualifying options.

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
**Job Description Summary**
We are seeking a Scrum Master who combines Agile expertise with a rigorous mindset for regulatory compliance. You will serve as the operational backbone of the EDS team.
  
  
The Scrum Master is the operational anchor responsible for team velocity, predictability, and capacity planning. You orchestrate the team’s delivery rhythm, ensuring that sprint commitments are based on realistic forecasting rather than optimistic guessing. You proactively manage team capacity, remove impediments, and shield the engineering teams from distractions to maintain a high-performance environment where delivery is consistent and reliable.
  
  
**About EDS**
EDS is the unified digital platform that powers GE HealthCare’s global software portfolio. It serves as a comprehensive library of reusable UI components, design patterns, and accessibility standards that bridge the critical gap between User Experience (UX) and Engineering. By fostering a philosophy of "reduce, reuse, and recycle," EDS enables hundreds of product teams to eliminate redundant coding and design work. We provide the foundational building blocks that ensure our clinical and operational applications are intuitive, consistent, and accessible, allowing teams to focus on patient safety.
  
  
EDS is the critical path for GE HealthCare’s software portfolio. Our downstream products cannot ship without our components. This requires a Scrum Master who can shield the team from distractions while strictly enforcing the quality gates required for patient safety.
  
  
The Mission: Velocity & Safety:
  
  
Your mission is Team Effectiveness. You are responsible for removing impediments that slow engineers down, while simultaneously ensuring that every line of code we ship meets our rigorous Quality Management System (QMS) standards. You prove that compliance and agility can coexist.
  
  
GE Healthcare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Agile Facilitation and Team Effectiveness
* Ceremony Facilitation: Facilitate all Scrum ceremonies (Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives) to ensure they are efficient, focused, and actionable.
* Cross-Team Coordination: Since EDS is a platform, our delivery affects hundreds of downstream products. You represent the team in Scrum of Scrums (SoS) to manage cross-team dependencies and flag risks to the Release Train, ensuring we never block a customer's launch.
* Shielding the Team: You are the team's protector. You shield the engineering team from outside distractions, scope creep, and organizational noise, allowing them to focus on delivery.
* Impediment Removal: Proactively identify and remove blockers. Whether it's a missing license, a cross-team dependency, or a conflict, you own the resolution so the team doesn't have to.
* Team Onboarding and Alignment: Support the coordination of team activities and facilitate the smooth onboarding of new team members, ensuring they integrate quickly into our culture and processes.
* Process Discipline and Rally Management
* Capacity Planning: You own the team's forward-looking capacity planner. You proactively account for holidays, time off, and meeting overhead to ensure the team neither overcommits nor under commits during Sprint Planning. You base commitments on actual availability, not just historical velocity.
* Rally Hygiene: Enforce disciplined tracking of work items in Rally. You ensure that all User Stories, Defects, and Tasks contain complete details, accurate estimates, and timely status updates.
* Metrics and Predictability: Track and report on team metrics (Velocity, Say/Do Ratio, Cycle Time). You use data to coach the team toward higher predictability and continuous improvement.
* Definition of Ready/Done: Strictly enforce the Definition of Ready (DoR) before items enter a sprint and the Definition of Done (DoD) before they leave. You ensure quality gates are never bypassed for the sake of speed.

**Education Qualification**
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with a minimum of 10+ years of experience in Agile delivery, with at least 7 years as a dedicated Scrum Master.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**

* Mandatory: Experience managing Enterprise Platform software products within large, global, matrixed organizations.
* Mandatory: Experience working in regulated industries (Healthcare, Finance, Aerospace) where strict documentation and QMS compliance are required.
* Tool Proficiency: Expert-level proficiency in Rally (preferred) or Jira. You must understand how to configure boards, run reports, and manage complex hierarchies.
* Certifications: Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) certification is required.

**Key Competencies**

* Servant Leadership: You lead by influence, not authority. You focus on empowering the team rather than commanding them.
* Regulatory Rigor: You do not view documentation as "overhead." You understand that in MedTech, documentation is a safety feature.
* Conflict Resolution: Proven ability to work closely with leadership to resolve conflicts and maintain team alignment.
* Process Coach: You are comfortable coaching Product Owners and Managers on Agile anti-patterns.

Work Schedule
  
  
This role reports to leadership in the United States (Central Time). You must be willing to work flexible hours to ensure significant overlap with US leadership and stakeholders for strategic planning and reviews.
  
  
**Inclusion and Diversity**
GE Healthcare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.
  
  
We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.
  
  
Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.
  
  
******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
No

description:
Location : Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
  
Fixed-term employment contract: 1 year
  
  
**About The/Nudge**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
**Founded**
with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About The Insight Program**
**Who are we solving for?**
We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.
  
  
For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.
  
  
Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.
  
  
With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.
  
  
Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.
  
  
Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.
  
  
Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Define and drive product strategy by translating program needs into a clear roadmap with measurable milestones.
* Lead user research to deeply understand field staff, beneficiaries, and government users, ensuring an intuitive and scalable product experience
* Drive adoption within operations teams by designing onboarding, training, and change management plans, and monitoring adoption metrics
* Configure new modules and set up new programs on the tech platform
* Work with team members to manage the DevOps and build pipelines of the tech product, including the monitoring of application services, Kafka, etc.
* Set up and work with virtual machines in cloud environments like Azure & AWS
* Write scripts to automate tasks specifically with respect to data extraction and manipulation (e.g. using Python)
* Data engineering for production-ready ETL for large datasets using software such as Apache Spark
* Administer and manage third-party tools used. Eg: Survey software such as SurveyCTO, Kobo Toolbox
* Work with the product team to develop automations for operations teams

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Have a strong motivation to contribute to poverty alleviation efforts in India
* Are willing to make periodic field visits to understand the program and the users for whom the tech product is being built
* Work with a high level of rigour - especially in implementing development and DevOps best practices
* Have 5+ years of work experience in development, and/ or DevOps:

+ Experience with developing ETL pipelines
+ Experience in scripting / automations
+ Development experience in any programming language
+ Working with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure

* Have the ability to work independently in an AI-first, fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment (bias for action and curiosity to learn)

**What’s in it for you?**

* Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
* Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
* Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
* Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*
