Job Details
  
  
**Description**
**About Archer**
A new regulatory change lands somewhere in the world every six minutes, and agentic AI is outpacing most teams' ability to govern it. At Archer, we help the enterprises powering the global economy turn that pressure into an advantage.
  
  
Mandates like the EU AI Act and the SEC cybersecurity disclosure rules are driving the most significant GRC buying cycle we have seen in years. That demand is why we are growing this team.
  
  
This is hard work that matters. Our customers span energy, utilities, financial services, pharmaceuticals, and the public institutions communities depend on. People choose Archer because they get to partner with the most trusted brands in the world, on work that protects the customers and communities those brands serve.
  
  
If that sounds like your kind of work, let's chat.
  
  
**The Role**
Quality is not something we inspect at the end of a release; it's something we build into every stage of engineering. As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will be responsible for elevating product quality through intelligent test strategies, automation, continuous validation, performance engineering, and close partnership with engineering and product teams. You'll help teams identify risks early, find defects quickly, and ensure every release meets high standards for functionality, performance, security, and reliability. This is an exciting opportunity to shape the future of quality engineering by leveraging modern CI/CD practices, AI-powered engineering tools, and data-driven decision making while collaborating with globally distributed teams
  
  

* Name the team, key stakeholders this person will work with, who they report to and the one or two main areas of ownership.

**What You’ll Do**
**Quality Strategy & Risk-Based Testing**

* Lead quality planning and risk assessment activities across product initiatives and releases.
* Analyze code changes, feature implementations, and architectural impacts to determine optimal test coverage and identify high-risk areas before defects reach customers.
* Drive a shift-left quality culture by partnering with engineering teams to prevent defects early in the software development lifecycle.

**Test Automation Excellence**

* Build and evolve scalable automation frameworks that improve test coverage, execution speed, and maintainability.
* Drive automation across UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing layers.
* Continuously optimize automated validation to reduce manual effort and accelerate release confidence.
* Expert knowledge in Playwright tool

**CI/CD & Continuous Quality Engineering**

* Own quality gates within CI/CD pipelines to provide fast, actionable feedback on every change.
* Partner with engineering and DevOps teams to integrate automated testing, code quality checks, and release validation into deployment workflows.
* Drive improvements that reduce production defects, improve deployment confidence, and shorten feedback cycles.

**Performance Engineering & Reliability**

* Lead performance testing initiatives to validate scalability, reliability, and responsiveness of applications under varying workloads.
* Build performance benchmarks and proactively identify bottlenecks before they impact customers.
* Partner with engineering teams to improve application resilience, capacity planning, and operational readiness.
* Knowledge in performance testing tools such as K6, JMeter or similar platforms.

**Security & Secure Development Reviews**

* Drive quality reviews focused on security, vulnerability prevention, and secure coding practices.
* Partner with development teams to identify potential security gaps through code reviews, automated scanning, and risk assessments.
* Ensure security validation becomes an integral part of the software delivery lifecycle rather than a release-stage activity.

**AI-Driven Quality Innovation**

* Evaluate and adopt AI-powered solutions that improve test creation, defect detection, root cause analysis, and engineering productivity.
* Experiment with emerging AI technologies to modernize quality engineering practices.
* Champion innovative approaches that improve quality outcomes while reducing engineering effort.

**Cross-Functional Leadership & Execution**

* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and global stakeholders to deliver high-quality customer outcomes.
* Drive resolution of complex quality challenges with a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability.
* Influence technical decisions through collaboration, data-driven insights, and a continuous improvement mindset.

**What You Bring**

* Extensive experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or Software Quality Assurance within modern Agile development environments.
* Proven ability to quickly identify product risks, uncover defects, perform root cause analysis, and drive issues to resolution.
* Strong hands-on experience with automation frameworks and programming/scripting languages used for test automation.
* Experience integrating automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze source code changes, pull requests, and feature implementations to determine effective test coverage and risk areas.
* Strong understanding of performance testing concepts and tools used to validate scalability and reliability.
* Experience collaborating effectively with cross-functional and globally distributed teams.
* A proactive, execution-oriented mindset with strong ownership, urgency, and a passion for continuously improving quality

**Even Better If You Have**

* Experience applying AI/GenAI technologies to software testing, quality engineering, or developer productivity.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud-native application architectures.
* Experience with security testing, vulnerability management, and secure software development practices.
* Experience leading quality transformation initiatives, mentoring engineers, or driving enterprise-scale quality programs.
* Experience with modern observability, monitoring, and reliability engineering platforms such as Coralogix, Grafana, Datadog or similar tools

title: Lead Engineer - IAM Lifecycle Management
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The Lead Engineer, IAM Lifecycle Management will manage Azure DevOps pipeline engineering and release automation for secure IAM solutions, with primary responsibility for reusable YAML pipelines, artifact management, CI/CD, automated quality and security gates, deployment approvals, release traceability and rollback controls. The role will also deliver scalable lifecycle controls, microfrontend experiences and APIs using Next.js, Express.js, NestJS, GraphQL and .NET across cloud and on-premises environments.
  
  
You will establish and continuously improve Azure DevOps delivery capabilities for IAM applications, including pipeline architecture, reusable YAML templates, build and release automation, artifact management, automated testing, quality and security gates, environment promotion, deployment approvals, release evidence, operational traceability and rollback readiness. In partnership with product teams, application owners, HR, security, architecture, operations and audit stakeholders, you will then apply these capabilities to engineer and release secure IAM lifecycle solutions while improving automation, governance and identity-data quality.
  
  
**About the team**
:
  
  
IAM Lifecycle Management owns the identity and account lifecycle end to end. The team ensures that people and non-human identities receive appropriate access when created, joining, moving, changing status or returning, and that access is suspended or removed promptly when no longer required across on-premises, cloud and SaaS systems.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**
This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
  
  

* Implement and enhance Azure DevOps pipeline engineering for IAM solutions, including reusable YAML templates, build and release automation, artifact management, automated testing, code-quality and security gates, secrets handling, environment promotion, deployment approvals, release evidence, end-to-end traceability and tested rollback controls.
* Deliver assigned lifecycle engineering work to agreed scope, quality, security and timelines, identifying delivery risks and dependencies early.
* Collaborate with product owners, architects and engineering stakeholders to translate business, security, regulatory and architectural requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable technical solutions.
* Engineer end-to-end identity and account lifecycle capabilities, including creation, provisioning, modification, suspension, recertification and deprovisioning across on-premises, cloud and SaaS systems.
* Implement and enhance joiner, mover, leaver, rehire, contractor and non-human identity workflows, including trigger events, approval paths, account states, exception handling and recovery controls.
* Integrate authoritative HR and identity sources with directories, governance platforms and target applications using connectors, APIs and event-driven services, while improving source-data quality and reconciliation.
* Create functional and technical test scenarios, maintain requirements traceability and implementation evidence, and support remediation of defects, audit findings and control gaps.
* Develop, enhance and support secure IAM applications using Next.js microfrontends, Express.js and NestJS services, GraphQL APIs and .NET components, applying reusable architecture patterns across the full solution stack.
* Design and deliver accessible, responsive Next.js user interfaces and secure Express.js, NestJS or ASP.NET APIs for IAM lifecycle applications, with reusable components, API versioning, validation, authentication, authorisation, error handling, observability and performance optimisation.
* Support colleagues through technical guidance, peer review, troubleshooting, reusable documentation and knowledge sharing.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong hands-on experience designing and operating Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, including reusable YAML templates, pipeline-as-code practices, artifact and package management, automated unit and integration tests, code-quality and security gates, secrets handling, deployment approvals, environment promotion, release traceability and rollback controls.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in identity and access management, including implementation and support of identity and account lifecycle capabilities.
* Strong understanding of joiner, mover, leaver, rehire, employee, contractor and non-human identity lifecycle patterns and their associated governance controls.
* Experience designing and configuring provisioning and deprovisioning workflows, approval processes, birthright and role-based access, account-state transitions and exception handling.
* Experience integrating IAM platforms with HR systems, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP, databases, SaaS applications and custom applications.
* Knowledge of identity data models, account correlation, reconciliation, access reviews, certification, policy enforcement, orphan-account prevention and auditability.
* Strong hands-on development experience with Next.js, Express.js and NestJS, including microfrontend architecture, TypeScript, reusable user-interface components, secure backend services, authentication and authorisation integration, automated testing and performance optimisation.
* Experience delivering end-to-end UI and API solutions across Next.js microfrontends and Express.js, NestJS, GraphQL or .NET services, including responsive design, secure API development, input validation, automated testing, documentation and production troubleshooting.
* Hands-on engineering experience with .NET and ASP.NET Web APIs, including secure service design, authentication and authorisation, integration with IAM platforms, automated testing, performance optimisation and production support.
* Understanding of least privilege, segregation of duties, account ownership, privileged-access dependencies and application-security practices.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver work independently to a high standard, with strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation and stakeholder-communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Advanced experience architecting enterprise-scale Azure DevOps delivery platforms for Next.js, Express.js, NestJS, GraphQL and .NET solutions, including governed reusable YAML templates, artifact lifecycle management, multi-stage CI/CD, automated quality and security controls, deployment approvals, release traceability, resilience and rollback strategies.
* Advanced hands-on experience with SailPoint, Saviynt or a comparable IGA platform, including workflow, connector and policy configuration.
* Experience modernising or migrating identity lifecycle processes from legacy or bespoke solutions to a SaaS IGA platform.
* Integration experience with LDAP, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID and custom applications using REST, SOAP, Microsoft Graph, GraphQL, TypeScript, .NET or equivalent technologies.
* Experience applying microfrontend design patterns, modular Next.js architecture, API-first development across Express.js, NestJS, GraphQL and .NET, automated testing, secure coding and Azure DevOps-based delivery in enterprise applications.
* Experience designing serverless integration services or event-driven components in Microsoft Azure.
* Experience with audit and control frameworks, including SOX and GxP, and producing evidence suitable for regulated environments.
* Experience implementing AI-enabled identity lifecycle management processes
* Knowledge of AI identity governance, including identity and access controls for AI agents and non-human identities
* Relevant certification such as CISSP, SailPoint, Saviynt, CIMP, Microsoft Azure or another IAM, cloud or security certification.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Typical tools and technologies: Azure DevOps Pipelines and Artifacts; YAML, Git, CI/CD automation, quality and security gates, deployment approvals, release traceability and rollback controls; Next.js, React, TypeScript, microfrontend frameworks and UI component libraries; Express.js; .NET and ASP.NET Web APIs; REST and SOAP APIs, Microsoft Graph, JSON and SQL; SailPoint, Saviynt, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP and Azure integration services.

We are looking for an experienced professional to lead a full-stack engineering team comprising backend and mobile engineers. As a hands-on Manager for one of our core services teams, you will have the unique opportunity to contribute to the design and development of some of our early-stage, innovative products. You will work with your cross-functional partners and team to shape the direction of these products and help make them significant drivers for the company. This position is a hybrid role based in our
**Bengaluru office,**
with 2 days a week in the office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn provides excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet/cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View HQ. You know when to roll up your sleeves and when to empower others—and you're equally excited to do both.

* You have led a team that consistently delivered high-quality output on critical infrastructure projects.
* You are a creative, tenacious problem solver with a get-it-done attitude
* You tend to be the standard bearer who takes a great deal of pride in your work and can inspire others to rise to the occasion
* You can create and maintain a positive, healthy team environment in which everyone is supported, encouraged, and meaningfully challenged to do great work
* Preferred tech skills: C#, .NET/.NET Core, Kotlin, Python, SQL, Databricks, AWS,  REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, Kafka, CI/CD, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native development.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar tools) as part of your software development workflow
* Experience in fintech is a plus.

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. title: Senior Product Owner - Veeva Vault
description:
**About the Team:**
Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.
  
  
Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organisation. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
This role is positioned within the Enterprise Veeva Quality Suite - Product Team, responsible for contributing to the technical solution design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Veeva Quality Suite across Content Management, Quality, Audit & Risk business processes. The Product Owner in Veeva Quality Vault is responsible for requirements, managing advanced configuration change requests on lifecycles, workflows, atomic security settings, objects, reports, etc. and for testing and validation documentation in line with GSK’s Internal framework. The Product Owner is senior to the Product Analyst role and leads large scale configuration projects across Veeva Quality Vault. The Senior Product Owner is responsible for maximizing the value of a specific product by translating business needs into a prioritized backlog and leading delivery across the product lifecycle, within strategic and financial guardrails set by the Product Manager and Associated Director, Product Owner. The role works closely with business stakeholders to define outcomes and ensure delivered functionality is usable, secure, compliant, supportable and aligned to product strategy. The Senior Product Owner guides Product Owner and works with Technical SMEs, Architects, Service teams and external partners to ensure requirements are clear, value-driven and data-informed. The job holder makes day-to-day backlog and acceptance decisions, oversees iterative delivery and uses product performance information to improve adoption, stability, user experience and operational readiness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide product expertise in the Veeva Quality Suite as a certified Vault platform administrator and Veeva configuration specialist, leading large-scale configuration projects.
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand functional needs, refine requirements and define product outcomes within guardrails set by the Product Managers.
* Act as the product knowledge expert across multiple objects, coaching product owners and managing configuration changes for the Veeva Quality Suite in line with agreed priority backlog items.
* Lead impact assessment activities, reviewing proposed changes and ensuring impact understood across the entire Quality Suite.
* Deliver product enhancements through agreed backlog process to ensure Veeva Quality Suite evolves to meet business needs.
* Ensure Quality Vault remains compliant as a Validated Solution through supporting testing and re- validation efforts and that configuration releases from validation to production are compliant.
* Collaborate with Veeva Enterprise Managed Services on product features and with business resources across Global Supply Chain, Research and Development, Vaccines and GSK support functions, managing and maintaining metadata in Quality Vault (including picklists and organisational data).
* Make backlog prioritization decisions based on value, cost, risk, business continuity and resource capacity, escalating strategic trade-offs in line with the agreed RACI.
* Lead refinement, demonstrations, acceptance and release decisions, maintaining clear traceability from business outcome through requirement, test and delivered change, and ensure product changes follow required security, data, quality, validation, change and regulatory controls with specialist approvals obtained where required.
* Support architects in assessing design options, managing cross-product dependencies, interface impacts and release sequencing, and act as an escalation point for the product team and business users on functional product issues, guiding resolution within agreed guardrails.
* Coordinate supplier delivery and hold external partners accountable for quality, documentation, knowledge transfer and product outcomes, promoting agile, iterative, value-driven and data-led delivery and using feedback and performance insights to continuously improve the product.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Experience in product ownership, agile delivery, business analysis, change, process improvement or service management certifications.
* Minimum five years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, digital solutions, technology delivery or process-led technology roles.
* Experience in defining and prioritising epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria and managing a product backlog.
* Experience in working directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into feasible, value-led technology changes.
* Experience in prioritising changes based on value, process impact, risk, cost, capacity and technology dependencies.
* Experience in guiding product analysts, engineers, architects and testers through refinement, design, testing, release and adoption.
* Experience in applying security, data protection, quality, validation, change and service-readiness controls.
* Experience in defining product performance measures and using user, process, stability and service insights to improve outcomes.
* Experience working in agile or iterative delivery environments and coordinating suppliers or external delivery partners.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Communicates product decisions and technology constraints in written and verbal form to non-technical stakeholders.
* Facilitates discovery, backlog refinement, prioritisation, demonstrations and acceptance discussions.
* Applies analytical judgement to balance value, risk, cost, complexity, urgency and operational impact.
* Interprets process information, user feedback and product data to identify and specify improvements.
* Maintains working knowledge of architecture, integration, data, security, validation, service and operational readiness.
* Maintains organisation, traceability and documentation in line with governance requirements.
* Works collaboratively across global, cross-functional and supplier teams.
* Defines solutions that are user-centred, capability-led and technology-agnostic.

**#AGTech**
**#GSK-LI**
**Skills**
Agile Methodology, Backlogs, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Design Thinking, DevOps, Process Diagrams, Product Strategies, Project Management, Requirements Gathering, Services Management, Software Development, User Experience (UX), User Research, User Story
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**
If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Your potential, unleashed.**

India’s impact on the global economy has increased at an exponential rate and Deloitte presents an opportunity to unleash and realize your potential amongst cutting edge leaders, and organisations shaping the future of the region, and indeed, the world beyond.

At Deloitte, your whole self to work, every day. Combine that with our drive to propel with purpose and you have the perfect playground to collaborate, innovate, grow, and make an impact that matters.

The Digital Excellence Centre is responsible for building products and platforms for Deloitte India that focuses on providing extraordinary customer experience by putting design thinking with trailblazing technology in the center of what they do. * Act as the primary functional point of contact for clients during product implementation, requirement clarification, solution discussions, change requests, demonstrations, and production rollouts.

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies with experience using tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira for backlog management, documentation, and sprint execution.

Excellent analytical, communication, stakeholder management, documentation, presentation, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and drive discussions across business and technical teams.

Know more about everyday steps that you can take to be more inclusive. At Deloitte, we believe in the unique skills, attitude and potential each and every one of us brings to the table to make an impact that matters.

title: Business Analyst (12 Months FTC)
description:
To translate business needs into clear, well-evidenced requirements that enable AI workflow solutions to be built and deployed with consistency, quality and measurable impact. Acts as the bridge between stakeholders and the workflow team, defining problems, mapping current and future-state process, shaping requirements, and validating that what gets delivered solves the right problem. Supports the delivery of AI-powered workflows, experiences and solutions (e.g. chatbots, co-pilots) that are scalable, measurable and aligned to strategic objectives.

**This is a 12 months fixed term contract role, only interested candidates apply.**

**What You Will Do:**

**Operating within the Services function, as part of a new Workflow Development team, the Business Analyst's most important duties and responsibilities include:**

* Through discovery, analysing relevant business processes to determine the intended outcomes, how the process currently runs, and future automation and AI opportunities.
* Identifying problems and friction points in the current process, and quantifying their impact.
* Designing potential solutions to the problems identified during discovery, working in partnership with SMEs to propose the new process and any supporting actions.
* Preparing and delivering a report of findings to leadership, with a comprehensive risk and impact assessment, aligned to new process approval.
* Developing comprehensive end-to-end (E2E) test cases at both application and multi-application level.
* Working with the process lead to support implementation of approved process improvements.
* Running training sessions and workshops to guide relevant teams through our methodology and process.
* Carrying out periodic quality checks on current processes.

**Essential Skills:**

* A minimum of
  **5 years**
  experience in a Business Analyst role, including leading discovery independently.
* Demonstrable track record of process analysis and improvement, from discovery through to implemented change.
* Strong process mapping capability (current state and future state) and fluency with a recognised notation such as BPMN.
* Experience quantifying process problems — building the numbers behind the case for change, not just describing the issue.
* Experience writing and executing end-to-end test cases, including across integrated applications.
* Confident presenting findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders, including where the recommendation is unwelcome.
* Experience facilitating workshops and training sessions with mixed technical and non-technical audiences.
* Excellent written communication — able to produce reports that stand up to leadership scrutiny.

**Desirable:**

* Experience analysing processes with automation or AI in mind — identifying where the technology genuinely fits and where it does not.
* Exposure to
  **conversational AI, virtual agents or co-pilot deployments**
  .
* Working
  **knowledge of ServiceNow or a comparable enterprise workflow platform.**
* Experience in a
  **service operations, ITSM or shared services environment.**
* Relevant certification (BCS International Diploma in Business Analysis, IIBA CBAP/CCBA, or similar).
* Familiarity with process or task mining tooling.

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Proud to be recognised in the Financial Times’ Best Employers 2026 list for the second-year running , an independent and data led ranking based on employee feedback. Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Coverage
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.
  
  
Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.
  
  
Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.
  
  
With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.
  
  
At Harness, we're excited to welcome a Senior Engineer to the Coverage team, where you’ll play a central role in evolving the developer experience around code coverage and code quality. This is an opportunity to work on a high-impact product used by hundreds to thousands of engineering teams to ship higher-quality code, faster.
  
  
As a Senior Engineer On The Coverage Team, You'll Take Ownership Of Critical Areas Of The Harness Code Coverage Product Suite, Including
  
  

* New and growing Coverage platform, which helps teams identify and prioritize coverage needs
* Report ingestion and processing which powers code coverage and quality insights
* Interactive dashboards that brings insights to life

You’ll collaborate across product, design, and engineering teams to build seamless, performant, and intuitive user experiences. Whether you’re designing a new coverage feature or improving scalability and resilience in processing, you’ll be empowered to own the full stack and shape the future of how teams test and ship code.
  
  
**In this role you will**

* Lead development across both frontend and backend systems of the Coverage product
* Own the architecture and implementation of key features in our coverage platform
* Improve developer workflows through integrations into other SCMs and CIs
* Author software functional specifications and design documents
* Champion performance, scalability, and reliability across the stack
* Partner closely with design, product, and other engineering teams to turn ideas into working software
* Embrace the challenge of a fast-paced and ever-evolving tech landscape, where your adaptability and problem-solving skills will be your greatest assets.

**Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience required.
* Previous contributions as part of a high-performing software engineering organization.
* Experience designing, extending, and maintaining high volume mission critical systems used by hundreds of thousands of end users.
* Experience with Go and PostgreSQL is preferred, but not required.
* Experience with React or similar is nice to have, but also not required.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Harness In The News**

* Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
* Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5.5 billion valuation
* How Harness runs 16 “startups within a startup” at scale | Jyoti Bansal
* Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
* Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin.
  
  
At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https://harness-privacy.relyance.ai/
  
  
**Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers**
We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers.
  
  
Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness.io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations.
  
  
If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness.io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission’s website (https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Beckman Coulter Diagnostics can provide.
  
  
Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Jira Workflows and Automation
description:
****Role Overview****
As a Senior Software Engineer, you will work closely with the Technical Lead to develop and support engineering workflow solutions built on the Atlassian platform. You will chip in to JIRA workflow automation, dashboard development, data analytics, and engineering process improvements that enable efficient execution across semiconductor development teams.
  
  
This role provides an opportunity to gain experience working with multi-functional engineering organizations while building software solutions that improve engineering productivity and execution visibility.
  
  
****Responsibilities:****
****JIRA Configuration & Automation****
Support the implementation of JIRA workflows, issue types, screens, automation rules, and project configurations. Assist in maintaining engineering processes, defect tracking, and workflow standardization under the guidance of the Technical Lead.
  
  
****Software Development****
Develop scripts, utilities, and automation using Python and SQL to extract, validate, and process engineering data from Atlassian databases and REST APIs. Chip in to custom integrations with engineering tools and reporting systems.
  
  
****Dashboard & UI Development****
Develop and maintain web-based dashboards and user interfaces that visualize project health, engineering metrics, defect trends, and execution status. Work with modern web technologies to enhance usability and user experience.
  
  
****Data Analytics****
Assist in building reporting pipelines, generating engineering metrics, validating data quality, and creating dashboards that provide actionable insights for engineering and program teams.
  
  
****Collaboration****
Work with Design, Verification, Implementation, Validation, Power, Performance, Software, and Program Management teams to understand workflow requirements, support issue resolution, and continuously improve engineering processes.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
**About Revun**
Revun is building a next-generation software platform designed to modernize how property owners, property managers, brokerages, maintenance providers, service professionals, and real estate organizations operate.
  
  
The platform combines CRM, leasing, maintenance, accounting, payments, communications, workflow automation, compliance, reporting, AI, integrations, and stakeholder portals into a single operating platform.
  
  
Our goal is not to build another collection of disconnected software tools. We are building an operational platform that simplifies complex business processes, reduces manual work, improves visibility, and helps organizations operate more efficiently.
  
  
The product is already underway, and we are now looking for a strong product designer who can help turn a complex platform into an intuitive, professional, scalable, and commercially ready user experience.
  
  
**About The Role**
Revun is hiring a
**Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)**
to lead the design of our web and mobile product experience.
  
  
This is not a graphic design role, and it is not a role focused only on creating attractive screens.
  
  
We are looking for someone who understands how to design real software products, including complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, dashboards, workflows, portals, mobile apps, and multi-user systems.
  
  
You will work closely with leadership, engineering, and product stakeholders to simplify complex workflows, improve usability, create scalable design systems, and help prepare the platform for commercial launch.
  
  
The successful candidate must be able to think through product flows, user journeys, permissions, edge cases, responsive layouts, information hierarchy, and design handoff — not just visual styling.
  
  
You should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve your design process, speed up research and ideation, organize complex requirements, generate UX copy, explore layout options, create user flows, and improve documentation while still applying your own product judgment.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Please submit your
**resume and portfolio**
for consideration.
  
  
Your portfolio should include examples of real product-design work, such as user flows, dashboards, complex interfaces, mobile screens, design systems, marketplace workflows, SaaS platforms, or similar product examples.
  
  
Candidates with only branding, landing pages, social media graphics, or marketing websites will not be the strongest fit for this role.
  
  
Qualified candidates will be invited to complete a pre-recorded video interview 24-48 hours after applying as the next step in the hiring process.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design user-friendly web and mobile experiences for a complex SaaS and marketplace-style platform
* Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and developer-ready UI specifications
* Design workflows for multiple user types, including internal users, property owners, tenants, vendors, service providers, partners, and administrators
* Translate complex business processes into simple, intuitive product experiences
* Work closely with leadership and engineering to turn product vision into clear, usable, buildable designs
* Improve the overall information architecture, navigation, dashboard structure, forms, portals, workflows, and mobile experience
* Design and maintain scalable design systems, reusable components, UI patterns, and style standards
* Create clean, professional, modern, and consistent product interfaces
* Identify gaps, edge cases, confusing user flows, and areas where the product experience can be simplified
* Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented accurately
* Review builds and provide design QA feedback before release
* Use AI tools responsibly to speed up research, ideation, UX writing, documentation, design exploration, and workflow development
* Validate AI-assisted design outputs through human judgment, user needs, business requirements, and product logic
* Support commercial launch readiness by ensuring the platform is easy to understand, easy to use, and visually consistent

**Required Experience**

* 6+ years of UX/UI, Product Design, or related digital product design experience
* Experience designing complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, CRM systems, workflow platforms, fintech products, operational dashboards, or other multi-role software products
* Strong experience designing both web and mobile product experiences
* Strong Figma skills, including components, Auto Layout, variants, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff
* Experience designing dashboards, forms, tables, workflows, portals, user profiles, settings, notifications, and role-based user experiences
* Experience working directly with engineers and product stakeholders
* Strong understanding of user flows, information architecture, interaction design, usability, visual hierarchy, responsive design, and design systems
* Experience using AI tools to support design work, UX writing, research synthesis, user-flow creation, wireframing, prototyping, or product documentation
* Ability to explain design decisions clearly and connect them to user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility
* Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, developer-ready designs
* Strong written and spoken English
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

**Strongly Preferred Experience**

* Experience designing marketplace platforms or multi-sided products
* Experience with property technology, real estate platforms, maintenance platforms, field-service software, booking platforms, fintech, CRM systems, or enterprise workflow software
* Experience designing products with multiple user types and role-based permissions
* Experience designing payment, transaction, vendor, booking, service-request, or dashboard workflows
* Experience designing AI-powered product features or AI-assisted workflows
* Experience improving an existing product rather than only designing from scratch
* Experience working in startups or fast-moving product environments
* Experience with usability testing, product analytics, user research, or customer feedback loops
* Experience creating design systems from the ground up

AI Expectations
  
  
We are looking for a designer who uses AI as a productivity tool, not as a substitute for product judgment.
  
  
**You Should Be Comfortable Using AI To Help With**

* UX research organization
* User-flow exploration
* Wireframe ideation
* Interface-copy options
* Product requirement organization
* Edge-case discovery
* Design-system documentation
* Competitive research summaries
* Prototype concepts
* Usability-test summaries
* Design iteration

However, you must still review, validate, and improve all AI-assisted work yourself. Final design decisions must be based on user needs, product logic, business goals, usability, accessibility, and technical feasibility.
  
  
The Person We Are Looking For
  
  
You are a true product thinker.
  
  
You do not just make screens look good — you understand how people actually use software.
  
  
You can take a complicated workflow and make it feel clear, simple, and logical.
  
  
You are comfortable designing for different types of users who each need different information, permissions, dashboards, and actions.
  
  
You think through edge cases, empty states, errors, mobile responsiveness, role-based access, data-heavy screens, and developer handoff.
  
  
You are confident working with engineers and leadership, and you can explain why a design decision matters.
  
  
You are also comfortable using AI to work faster, explore more options, and improve your process, while still owning the quality of the final product.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  

* The platform becomes easier to understand and easier to use
* Core workflows are redesigned with clearer user journeys
* Web and mobile experiences become more consistent and polished
* Developers receive clear, complete, buildable design specifications
* The design system becomes scalable and reusable
* Product screens feel modern, professional, and commercially ready
* Users can complete important tasks with less confusion and fewer unnecessary steps
* AI is used responsibly to improve speed, quality, and documentation
* Design work directly supports product launch and long-term platform growth

**Compensation**
The monthly compensation range for this role is:
  
  
CAD $24,000–$36,000 annually
  
  
Final compensation will depend on experience, product-design depth, SaaS and marketplace experience, AI-assisted workflow capability, communication skills, and ability to work independently.

title: Vice President - Software Engineering
description:

The Vice President - Software Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, delivery, and continuous evolution of the MADTECH.AI platform. This role provides strategic and technical leadership to multiple engineering teams responsible for building scalable, secure, cloud-native B2B SaaS products.

The ideal candidate is an accomplished engineering leader with deep expertise in software architecture, cloud platforms, AI-enabled applications, data engineering, DevOps, and modern engineering practices. This individual will build high-performing engineering teams, establish engineering excellence, drive innovation, and ensure timely delivery of high-quality products while working closely with Product Management, AI/ML, Data Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and Business leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Engineering Strategy & Technology Leadership**

* Define and execute the engineering strategy aligned with the organization's business and product objectives.
* Establish engineering standards, architectural principles, coding best practices, and software development governance.
* Drive technology modernization and adoption of emerging technologies including AI, Generative AI, cloud-native platforms, and automation.
* Develop long-term technology roadmaps to ensure scalability, maintainability, and security.

* Lead multiple engineering teams responsible for backend, frontend, platform engineering, integrations, and DevOps.
* Ensure successful delivery of high-quality software products within timelines and budget.
* Oversee software architecture, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Drive engineering productivity through Agile delivery methodologies and engineering metrics.

**Architecture & Platform Engineering**

* Provide technical leadership for scalable microservices architecture and distributed systems.
* Guide architectural decisions across cloud infrastructure, APIs, data platforms, AI services, and integrations.
* Ensure platform scalability, performance, availability, reliability, and security.
* Lead architecture reviews and technology evaluations.

**Engineering Operations & Delivery Excellence**

* Improve engineering processes, SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, release management, and deployment automation.
* Implement DevSecOps best practices.
* Monitor engineering KPIs including
* Velocity
* Quality
* Reliability
* Deployment frequency
* MTTR
* Engineering efficiency
* Ensure operational excellence through observability, monitoring, incident management, and root cause analysis.

**AI & Data Engineering Enablement**

* Collaborate with AI/ML teams to integrate intelligent capabilities into the platform.
* Enable scalable data pipelines, APIs, AI agents, RAG architectures, and GenAI applications.
* Promote engineering practices that support analytics, automation, and customer intelligence.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Product Management to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Collaborate with QA, Security, DevOps, Customer Success, Sales Engineering, and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Support customer escalations requiring engineering leadership.

**People Leadership**

* Recruit, mentor, coach, and retain world-class engineering talent.
* Build a culture of ownership, innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Develop engineering managers and technical leads.
* Drive performance management, succession planning, and career development.

**Technical Expertise**

* Deep understanding of software architecture, including microservices, distributed systems, event-driven architecture, API-first design, and multi-tenant platforms.
* Proficiency in cloud platforms, with hands-on experience in AWS (mandatory); exposure to Azure and GCP is preferred. Strong knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon EKS, and modern CI/CD pipelines.
* Extensive experience with modern software development technologies and frameworks such as Java, Python, Node.js, React, Angular, TypeScript, and related technologies.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI technologies, including AI Agents, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG architectures, MCP (Model Context Protocol), TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and LLM integrations.
* Experience with data engineering, including SQL, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, reverse ETL, data modeling, data lakes, and large-scale data processing frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, event-driven architectures, Kafka, webhooks, third-party integrations, and modern integration frameworks.
* Experience implementing DevSecOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation), automated testing, release management, monitoring, logging, observability, and production support.
* Expertise in Agile software development methodologies, including Scrum, Kanban, Jira, engineering planning, sprint execution, and continuous delivery.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale B2B SaaS products.
* Strong hands-on background in software architecture, cloud platforms, distributed systems, APIs, and modern application development.
* Experience leading engineering organizations of 30+ engineers across multiple functional teams.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML technologies, cloud-native applications, and modern software engineering practices.
* Experience working with global customers across the US, UK, Australia, and MENA markets.
* Demonstrated success in building high-performing engineering organizations.
* Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and decision-making skills.

If you're passionate about building scalable SaaS products, mentoring exceptional engineering talent, and making a meaningful impact in a fast-growing AI company, MADTECH.AI offers the opportunity to innovate, lead, and grow with us.

company: Telstra Business Technology Centre Perth South
description:
**Employment Type**
-------------------

Permanent

**Closing Date**
----------------

29 Oct 2026 11:59pm

**Job Title**
-------------

Senior Network Software Engineering Specialist

**Job Summary**

Provide and lead specialist analysis, design, development and deployment in network specific technology domains, including developing platform specific technology roadmaps and making technology investment recommendations to deliver products and infrastructure to defined service level standards

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Who We Are**

Telstra is Australia’s leading telecommunications and technology company spanning over a century with a footprint in over 20+ countries. In India, we’re building a platform for innovative delivery and engagement that will strengthen our position as an industry leader. We’ve grown quickly since our inception in 2019, now with offices in Pune and Bangalore  

  

Focus of the role:

  

The Senior Solution Designer / Lead Software Engineer will provide architecture, technical design, and hands-on engineering leadership for the TNI mission. The role requires deep telecommunications OSS and physical network inventory expertise, strong knowledge of the Inventory Platform, and proven capability in designing scalable, resilient, graph-based enterprise solutions. The successful candidate will translate complex business requirements into pragmatic technical designs, implementation roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes while building effective relationships with stakeholders at all organisational levels.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Lead end-to-end solution architecture and technical design for TNI capabilities, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance, security, resilience, and delivery standards.
* Design high-performance Neo4j graph solutions covering graph data models, schemas, relationships, indexing, query optimisation, versioning, migration, and operational performance.
* Translate complex business and platform requirements into scalable solution designs, implementation roadmaps, integration patterns, and delivery plans.
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, and modern enterprise application frameworks.
* Design and deliver enterprise APIs and integrations using OData, REST, and GraphQL.
* Apply deep Inventory Platform knowledge to solution decisions involving business processes, architecture, APIs, and the underlying data model.
* Drive application modernisation, platform resilience, automation, and adoption of AI-enabled and emerging technology solutions.
* Perform business analysis and gap assessments, recommending system and process improvements that increase efficiency and deliver business benefits.
* Collaborate with business, architecture, engineering, data, operations, and delivery stakeholders to manage dependencies, risks, and design decisions.
Provide technical governance, design assurance, documentation, and mentoring throughout the solution lifecycle.  

  

**Mandatory Requirements**
==========================

* Significant experience in software design and delivery, including demonstrated experience in solution architecture, technical design, and enterprise application development.
* Strong practical experience with Neo4j graph database technologies, including graph data modelling, performance optimisation, and enterprise-scale implementation.
* Extensive capability in Neo4j solution design and graph data architecture, including graph modelling, schema design, query optimisation, indexing strategies, relationship modelling, versioning approaches, data migration, and high-performance graph solution implementation.
* Strong knowledge of telecommunications inventory platforms or comparable network inventory environments, including business processes, architecture, APIs, and underlying data models.
* Demonstrated experience designing and delivering API and integration solutions using OData, REST, and GraphQL.
* Hands-on software development experience with Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Python, and modern enterprise application frameworks.
* Experience delivering AI-enabled solutions, driving automation initiatives, and adopting emerging technologies in enterprise environments.
Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions, architecture designs, and implementation roadmaps.  

  

**Qualifications and Experience**
=================================

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in software engineering, solution architecture, and telecommunications OSS or network inventory environments. They will be skilled in requirements analysis, gap assessment, enterprise application design, legacy modernisation, and platform resilience. The role also requires strong stakeholder engagement, sound technical judgement, and the ability to influence architecture and delivery outcomes across multidisciplinary teams.

  
  

**Core Skills and Tools**
=========================

* Telecommunications OSS and physical network inventory
* Master data management
* Solution architecture
* Enterprise architecture and governance
* Enterprise application integration
* Business analysis and business process management
* Order and alarm management
* SOA, SCA, ESB, and microservices architecture
* Agile Scrum delivery

* Microsoft technologies, open-source technologies, and low-code/no-code platforms
* Oracle, including PL/SQL and Pro\*C; Neo4j
* Microsoft Azure cloud solutions
* Confluence and Jira

=========================================

* A relevant tertiary qualification in computer science, software engineering, information technology, telecommunications, or a related discipline is desirable.
* Industry-recognised architecture certification, such as TOGAF, is desirable.
* Training or certification in telecommunications frameworks, enterprise architecture, design thinking, cloud platforms, data engineering, or business analysis will be advantageous.

==============================

* Experience designing or delivering telecommunications OSS solutions across order fulfilment, assurance, service activation, and physical or logical network inventory domains.
* Experience with enterprise-scale inventory transformation, data migration, or platform modernisation initiatives.
* Strong understanding of network and service inventory data, relationships, lifecycle management, and integration with upstream and downstream systems.

* Practical experience with relational and graph data technologies, including Oracle and Neo4j.

title: Senior Principal - SN Automation Engineering Architect
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The SERVICENOW Automation Engineering Product Analyst supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with the Automation Engineering Architect, they help shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. The Automation Engineering Product Analyst documents processes, designs technology-enabled use cases, and supports solution testing, adoption, and operational readiness. They contribute to continuous improvement and automation opportunities that enhance user experience, reduce effort, and enable measurable value for the Product. In addition, this role supports the iTSM Service Catalog and will work in partnership with SERVICENOW Automation Engineering Architect for conversational/automation of forms and MSP service catalog factory for basic forms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Automation Engineering Architect to realise the Product strategy by eliciting and managing detailed business requirements (e.g., features, user stories) and designing technology-enabled use cases.

* Experience eliciting and managing detailed business requirements in operational or complex business environments; building process flows and facilitating stakeholder sessions.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse business problems and develop technology-enabled use cases using structured methods.
* Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
* Familiarity with software engineering concepts, security considerations, and technology solutioning is beneficial.
* Experience in Pharmaceuticals or other regulated industries is desirable to support compliance, data integrity, and controlled business processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.

* Ability to translate complex business rules into clear system behaviour, configurations, and test scenarios.
* Proactive and curious mindset, able to investigate system issues, validate behaviour, and identify improvement opportunities.
* Effective communication skills, capable of explaining system constraints and technology implications in a way business stakeholders can understand.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Project Role :** Scrum Master  
**Project Role Description :** Acts as an enabler for the effective functioning of a software development team using Agile methodologies. Coaches and mentors the Scrum Team(s), removing barriers to successful implementation and enabling a continued focus on the task at hand. Facilitates scrum and agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Identifies and reports progress via appropriate metrics.
  
**Must have skills :** ServiceNow  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **7.5** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
As a ServiceNow Scrum Master, a typical day involves enabling the smooth operation of a software development team by fostering an environment that supports Agile practices. The role includes guiding the team through various Agile ceremonies, ensuring that obstacles are addressed promptly, and maintaining a steady focus on project goals. The Scrum Master actively facilitates communication and collaboration among team members and stakeholders, monitors progress through relevant metrics, and supports continuous improvement within the team to enhance productivity and delivery outcomes.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging feedback and adapting processes accordingly.
* Support the professional growth of team members by fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment.
* Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure alignment of project objectives and timely delivery.
* Facilitate conflict resolution within the team to maintain a positive and productive work atmosphere.

  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in ServiceNow, ServiceNow Scrum Master, ServiceNow project implementation experiences, Project Management, Team Management, ServiceNow Functional Knowledge.
* Strong knowledge of Agile frameworks and methodologies including Scrum and Kanban.
* Experience in facilitating Agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
* Ability to use Agile project management tools and track progress through metrics and reporting.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Capability to identify and remove impediments that hinder team progress.

  
Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in ServiceNow.
* This position is based at our Bengaluru /Pune/ Chennai office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Tech Team Lead
description:
**Tech Team Lead**

**Founding Engineering Hire • Build from the Ground Up**

**Company:**
Allsec AI

**Location:**
Chennai (Hybrid)

**Website:**
www.allsec.ai

**Engagement Type:**
Full-Time | Early-Stage Start-up

**About Allsec AI**

Allsec AI is an AI-native, digital-first, omni-channel CX managed services company. We help enterprises unlock scalable, efficient, and real-time customer experience operations through agentic AI, intelligent workflows, and automation. We are redefining outsourcing by delivering packaged, outcome-led services that eliminate traditional contact Centre inefficiencies.

**About This Role**

This is a founding engineering hire. You will be joining a pre-revenue, product-stage company with no existing engineering team in place,
*which means you will be responsible for taking our base demo product and building it into a production-grade platform.*

You will work in close collaboration with a US-based Technical Consultant who will provide architectural direction and high-level technical guidance. For day-to-day operations, delivery execution, and team coordination, you will report to the India Operational Head.

As the company scales, you will build and lead a cross-functional team of engineers and own the India engineering operations end to end. If you are looking for a role where every decision you make has direct, visible impact.

**Reporting Structure**

* **Technical guidance, architecture direction, and product vision:**
  US-based Technical Consultant
* **Operational reporting, delivery accountability, and day-to-day coordination:**
  India Operational Head

**Key Responsibilities**

***Foundation & Architecture***

* Inherit, extend, and scale the existing technology stack (backend, frontend, DevOps, data pipelines, and ML/AI systems) building on a working demo product toward a production-ready platform.
* Establish production-grade engineering standards, tooling, and development processes, taking the codebase from demo quality to enterprise-ready.
* Define and own a scalable architecture for real-time, high-volume CX operations.

***Product & Infrastructure***

* Own and evolve the existing multi-cloud infrastructure (Digital Ocean, Azure, GCP) improving reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Extend and optimise existing integrations across multiple LLM providers, STT/TTS systems, AI agents, NLP pipelines, and vector databases.
* Ensure system observability, security, redundancy, and performance from day one.

***Team Building***

* As the first engineering hire, identify and help recruit subsequent technical team members.
* Mentor and develop engineers as the team scales; enforce best practices and foster technical excellence.
* Contribute actively to hiring decisions and help shape the engineering culture of the organisation.

***Collaboration & Stakeholder Management***

* Translate technical direction from the US-based Technical Consultant into executable roadmaps.
* Collaborate with CX implementation and QA functions to align technology with delivery operations.
* Actively participate in architectural decisions and long-term technical planning.

**Requirements**

* 6–10 years of total experience, with at least 1 year in a tech or team lead capacity.
* Deep experience with one or more full-stack frameworks (e.g., Node.js + React, Django + Vue, or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of AI/ML model development and deployment – LLMs, transformers, RAG pipelines.
* Proven experience with cloud platforms (Digital Ocean, Azure, and/or GCP) and infrastructure as code (Terraform/CDK).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, LangChain, vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS), and LLM APIs.
* Hands-on experience integrating and managing multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) alongside STT and TTS systems in production or near-production environments.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes), and scalable microservices.
* Demonstrated ability to operate with autonomy and build things without an established team or process around you.
* Good communication skills — you will primarily interface with a global stakeholder in the US and an operations-focused leader in India.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with contact centre platforms, chatbots, or voice AI systems.
* Exposure to MLOps, streaming data platforms, and real-time analytics dashboards.
* Prior start-up or early-stage product experience — particularly experience being the first or only engineer.
* Comfort working across time zones and with distributed teams.

**Why Join Allsec AI**

* You will be the architect of the technology foundation, i.e., you will take a working demo and turn it into the infrastructure that powers enterprise CX at scale; every architectural decision from here is yours.
* Work on cutting-edge AI/CX technology with global exposure and direct collaboration with the US technical leadership.
* Clear path to leading the India engineering organisation as the company scales.
* Competitive compensation and equity options available for the right candidate.

**Contact**

If you think this role excites you, please send your resumes to
**careers@allsec.ai**
&
**hr@allsec.ai**

title: Senior Engineer I - QA
description:
**What is Contentstack?**
Contentstack is redefining how modern digital experiences are built and managed. As the pioneer of the Agentic Experience Platform (AXP), Contentstack brings together structured content and brand governance (Content Cloud), real-time customer data, omnichannel personalization (Data Cloud) and autonomous AI orchestration (Agent OS) into one unified system.
  
  
While many organizations adopted headless CMS or standalone AI tools expecting transformation, they often found themselves managing disconnected systems and manual workflows. Contentstack helps enterprises move beyond that complexity by connecting content, data and AI in a way that makes digital experiences faster to launch, easier to manage and more adaptive in real time.
  
  
Leading brands including Steve Madden, LG Electronics, Subaru of America, Dolce & Gabbana, ASICS, Decathlon, and Caesars Entertainment rely on Contentstack to reduce operational friction and deliver personalized, scalable digital experiences with confidence. The company is known for its customer-first culture and commitment to the communities it serves through the Contentstack Cares program.
  
  
Learn more at www.contentstack.com.
  
  
**Who Are We?**
At Contentstack we are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. Our vision is to pursue equity among our communities, employees, partners, and customers. We are global-diverse yet close; distributed yet connected. We are dreamers and dreammakers who challenge the status quo. We do the right thing, even when no one is watching. We are curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. Our mission is to make Contentstack indispensable for organizations to tell their stories and to connect with the people they care about through inspiring, modern experiences. We care deeply about our customers and the communities we serve. #OneTeamOneDream. Chalo, let's go!
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Own the test strategy for Platform (Web and API): decide what runs on every PR, nightly and at release
* Perform frontend and backend testing (Platform - Web, REST APIs, analytics and data pipelines)
* Perform regression and sanity testing across environments and cloud regions (AWS, GCP, Azure) and give a clear go/no-go for releases
* Design, build and maintain the UI and API automation frameworks (Playwright/Selenium), including shared page objects, fixtures, test data and stable selectors
* Add automated quality gates to CI/CD pipelines, and track and fix flaky tests
* Plan and run performance and load tests for APIs and data pipelines
* Validate data correctness for analytics and metering pipelines (completeness, duplicates, reconciliation)
* Build internal scripts and tools to automate QA processes and test data creation Generate testing reports, status reports and QA metrics (pass rate, defect escape rate) Create and maintain the test case repository
* Provide feedback to the developers, review test code and pull requests
* Mentor junior QA engineers and help developers write better tests
* Complete tasks in a timely manner
* Update internal product documentation

**Mandatory Skills**

* 3 to 5 years of QA experience, with at least 2 years in test automation
* Strong experience with JavaScript/TypeScript based E2E frameworks like Playwright or Cypress.io Experience designing an automation framework from scratch (page objects, fixtures, reporting)
* Strong knowledge of JSON and REST, and API test automation (Postman/Newman, REST Assured, Playwright API or similar)
* Experience in Load Testing with tools like JMeter, k6 or Locust
* Knowledge of Continuous Integration and hands-on experience with Jenkins, GoCD or GitHub Actions
* Experience in using Github and Git, including code reviews
* Experience in any bug reporting and test management tool such as JIRA
* Strong knowledge of the system development life cycle and the testing life cycle
* Experience in Agile/Scrum
* Good SQL and data validation skills; experience testing data or analytics pipelines is preferred
* Experience with logs and monitoring tools (Observe, Datadog or similar) for root cause analysis is preferred
* Basic knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and cloud (AWS, GCP or Azure) is preferred Self-Directed - Ability to detect and solve problems

**What Do We Offer?**
**Interesting Work |**
We hire curious trendspotters and brave trendsetters. This is NOT your boring, routine, cushy, rest-and-vest corporate job. This is the "challenge yourself" role where you learn something new every day, never stop growing, and have fun while you're doing it.
  
  
**Tribe Vibe**
| We are more than colleagues, we are a tribe. We have a strict "no a\*\*hole policy" and enforce it diligently. This means we spend time together - with spontaneous office happy hours, organized outings, and community volunteer opportunities. We are a diverse and distributed team, but we like to stay connected.
  
  
**Bragging Rights**
| We are dreamers and dream makers. Our efforts pay off and we work with the most prestigious brands, from big-name retailers to airlines, to professional sports teams. Your contribution will make an impact with many of the most recognizable names in almost every industry including AirFrance KLM, ASICS, Burberry, Mattel, Mitsubishi, Walmart, and many more!
  
  
**One Team One Dream**
| This is one of our values, and it shows. We don't believe in artificial hierarchies. If you're part of the tribe, you have an opportunity to contribute. Your voice will be heard and you will also receive regular updates about the business and its performance. Which, btw, is through the roof, so it's a great time to be joining…
