title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We're hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer who can take a messy problem, break it down, and design a system that holds up at scale. You'll build backend services in Java and Node.js and the web interfaces that sit on them, for products used by millions of learners and thousands of enterprise customers.

This is a hands-on role with real architectural ownership. You'll write production code every week, and you'll also shape how our services are designed, split, and evolved.

**What you'll do**

• Design, build, and own end-to-end features across Java (Spring Boot) and Node.js services and React front ends.

• Turn ambiguous product and business problems into clear technical designs, with written trade-offs, before writing code.

• Contribute to architecture decisions: service boundaries, API contracts, data models, caching, and event-driven flows.

• Build scalable, secure REST and event-based APIs, and integrate with third-party platforms (payments, CRM, LMS, communication).

• Improve performance, reliability, and observability of production systems; find and fix bottlenecks in code, queries, and infrastructure.

• Write clean, tested, maintainable code and raise the bar through design reviews and code reviews.

• Debug complex production issues across services, and drive root-cause fixes rather than patches.

• Mentor engineers on problem solving, design thinking, and engineering practices.

• Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and DevOps to ship reliably and iterate quickly.

**Must-have skills**

**Problem solving and architecture**

• Strong data structures, algorithms, and analytical problem solving; you can reason about complexity and edge cases out loud.

• Proven experience designing distributed systems: microservices vs. modular monolith, sync vs. async, consistency, idempotency, and failure handling.

• Solid grasp of design patterns, SOLID, domain-driven design basics, and clean API design.

• Ability to write and defend a design doc or ADR with clear trade-offs.

**AI-native engineering**

• Hands-on, daily use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor across the development lifecycle: design, coding, refactoring, testing, debugging, and code review.

• Able to break work into well-scoped tasks for AI agents, write effective prompts and context files, and review generated code critically for correctness, security, and maintainability.

• Track record of using AI tools to measurably speed up delivery, and of sharing those practices with the team.

**Backend**

• 4+ years building production backends in Java (11+/17, Spring Boot) and Node.js with TypeScript (Express or NestJS): REST APIs, Spring Data/JPA, security, async patterns and the event loop, and testing.

• Relational databases (MySQL or PostgreSQL): schema design, indexing, query tuning.

• NoSQL (MongoDB) and caching (Redis).

• Messaging or streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS).

**Frontend**

• Working proficiency in React, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Understanding of web performance, state management, and SSR basics (Next.js a plus).

**Engineering practice**

• Cloud experience, preferably AWS (EC2/ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront).

• Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Git-based workflows.

• Unit, integration, and contract testing; comfort with monitoring and logging tools.

• Clear written and verbal communication.

**Good to have**

• Experience in EdTech, e-commerce, or other high-traffic consumer or B2B SaaS platforms.

• Multi-tenant SaaS architecture and enterprise integrations (SSO/SAML/OIDC, LTI).

• Infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation) and Kubernetes.

• GraphQL, gRPC, or WebSockets.

• Experience building product features on LLM APIs (RAG, agents, evaluations).

• Open-source contributions, tech blogs, or talks.

**Experience**

* Demonstrate expertise in the following Microsoft technologies

* Fluent in written and spoken English
* Outstanding communication and presentation abilities
* Self-directed with strong organisational skills
* Pragmatic and open-minded
* Passionate about technologies
* Strong decision-making and judgment skills (ability to make logical, pragmatic and structured decisions)
* Strong experience working within matrix organisations and leading multi-disciplinary project teams

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 2–3 years in a Technical Lead or equivalent role with demonstrated responsibility for engineering team outcomes

title: UX Designer
description:
**Job Description**
**UX Designer**
Summary/objective
  
  
isolved builds Human Capital Management software that millions of people use to get paid, manage time off, enroll in benefits, and run HR for their companies. The work touches essential parts of people's lives, so the experience needs to be clear, efficient, and trustworthy. You'll drive evidence-based product decisions for the isolved platform, working alongside engineers and product managers as the designer for the experiences you're assigned. You plan the research, shape the direction, and carry the work from problem framing through to what ships, using design thinking methods to ground decisions in how people actually behave rather than how we assume they do.The isolved platform is broad and interconnected. The designers who do well here can design a feature and also see how it ripples through the rest of the product: what it touches, what it changes, and what has to stay consistent.
  
  
Core Job Duties
  
  

* End-to-end experience design: discovery, flows, wireframes, high-fidelity screens, prototypes, and handoff
* Choose the right research method for the question at hand, run it, and turn raw findings into insights the team can act on. Synthesis and storytelling matter as much as the research itself
* Bring product and engineering into the research as it happens so decisions are shared, not pitched after the fact
* Design with the isolved design system and build on it, contributing new components and patterns when your work exposes a gap
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders, with clear goals and tangible outcomes
* Present work to the design team and stakeholders, give and take critique well, and iterate quickly
* Use AI tools as part of your everyday workflow: research planning, synthesis, competitive analysis, exploration, and documentation
* Design for accessibility and for the range of devices and contexts our users work in

Job Complexity
  
  
Having wide-ranging experience, uses professional concepts and company objectives to resolve complex data platform issues creatively and effectively. Serves as the hands-on, go-to expert for isolved's data platform infrastructure, administration, and pipeline operations. Some barriers to entry exist at this level (e.g., peer or architecture review).
  
  
Interaction
  
  
Works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors. Exercises judgment in selecting methods, techniques, and evaluation criteria for obtaining results. Networks with key contacts outside their own area of expertise.
  
  
**Supervision**
Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel.
  
  
**Experience**
Typically requires a minimum of 6 years of related experience with a bachelor's degree; 6 years and a master's degree; or equivalent experience.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Two to five years designing software products, ideally complex, data-heavy business applications
* A portfolio that shows how you think, not just what you shipped: the problem, the constraints, what you tried, and why the final answer won
* A clear research-to-design methodology. You can explain why you picked qualitative over quantitative (or the reverse) on a real project, and how research showed up across the whole process, not only in discovery
* Experience working within an established design system and contributing back to it, and the judgment to know when to extend it versus follow it
* A habit of looking for the root problem. The request you receive is often a symptom
* Comfort with the full UX toolkit: research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping
* Fluency with AI as a working tool. You already use it across your design process: planning and synthesizing research, exploring directions, prototyping, writing, and pressure-testing your own thinking. You can explain where it made your work better and where you overrode it
* Direct, concise communication with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders

**Nice To Have**

* Experience using AI to build or maintain design system assets, or designing AI-driven product experiences
* Enough working knowledge of front-end concepts to have a good conversation with an engineer about how something gets built
* Experience in HCM, payroll, benefits, or another regulated, workflow-heavy domain
* Experience modernizing a legacy product while it stays in production

**Physical Demands**
Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer. Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds.
  
  
**Travel Required**
Yes, up to 15% domestic travel may be required.
  
  
**FLSA Classification**
Exempt
  
  
**Location**
Office/Hybrid/Remote
  
  
**Internal Job Title**
UX Designer
  
  
**About Isolved**
isolved is an employee experience leader, providing intuitive, people-first HCM (Human Capital Management) technology. Our solutions are delivered directly or through our partner network to more than five million employees and 145,000 employers - who use them every day to boost performance, increase productivity, and accelerate results while reducing risk. Our HCM platform, isolved People Cloud, seamlessly connects and manages the employee journey across talent management, HR & payroll, workforce management and engagement management functions. No matter the industry, we help high-growth organizations employ, enable and empower their workforce by transforming employee experience for a better today and a better tomorrow. For more information, visit www.isolvedhcm.com.
  
  
isolved is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. isolved is a progressive and openminded meritocracy. If you are smart and good at what you do, come as you are. Visit www.isolvedhcm.com/careers for more information regarding our incredible culture and focus on our employee experience. Visit www.isolvedeebenefits.com for a comprehensive list of our employee total rewards offerings.

title: Sr. BA II
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Job Description**
Invesco understands data and the products created from data are the lifeblood of our business. Data-first functions work together seamlessly to enable Invesco to achieve the true value of data and data products. Invesco leverages data as a strategic asset by making quality, trusted data and content available to the right people, at the right time, in the right format, in the most efficient way possible to enable both large transformations and day-to-day operations.
  
  
This Senior Business Analyst role sits within the Product Engagement part of our Digital, Distribution and Enterprise Engineering (D2E2) organization. They maintain good relationships with internal partners and collaborate with their peers across the Distribution business domain. They develop a strong understanding of the investments and distribution data and business processes, including both how it is produced and consumed across all Distribution channels and how to apply Invesco’s Data strategy and practices to drive Distribution’s data capabilities forward.
  
  
The focus of this position is to work closely with the business units to gain in-depth understanding of customer's business strategy, processes, services, roadmap and the context in which the business operates. This role will be key to understanding and documenting capabilities needed to address business challenges. Under the general supervision, gather business and data requirements, convert the business and data requirements into technical requirements for solution development. The senior business analyst supports the product owner(s) in managing the scope of the assigned project(s), resolves any impediments from requirements perspective for development team, supports the system testing and user acceptance testing. The business analyst also performs validation of deliverables against requirements ensuring that solution is meeting the objectives.
  
  
You will be responsible for:
  

* The Senior Business Analyst is responsible for reviewing assigned business processes from end-to-end to identify and address operational, financial and technological risks.
* Analyzing and understanding the end-to-end Distribution processes and the data associated with multiple business processes having cross domain.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
* Responsibilities will include a full range of activities from leading small to mid-size projects to assisting product owners on larger more complex projects.
* Under the guidance of the product owners, the senior business analyst should be able to work with business stakeholders to document the functional and non-functional requirements.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is understandable to developers/project team.
* Demonstrate strong Problem-solving skills.
* Attending regular team and other required meetings daily/weekly.
* Ensuring clear and accurate communication and responding to data, business, and technology partners and peers in a timely manner.
* Provides updates to senior management, project stakeholders on the progress of the project and or assigned tasks.
* Reports weekly status to senior management and project team as applicable
* Conduct UAT testing when rolling out new regulatory filings or added data sources
* Identify, research, document and / or remediate exceptions
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.

This individual:
  

* Must be comfortable working in a scaled agile development environment
* Have an ability to handle multiple requests from varied stakeholders, in a way that maintains clear priority, and ability to adjust when needed
* Be an effective “translator” of business needs into technical requirements
* Demonstrate an ability to build relationships, collaborate, and influence internal and external teams
* Be able to work under guidance of senior team member, take initiative, and get projects completed with great attention to detail and on time.

The experience you bring:
  

* A bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, Information Technology.
* Minimum 5-6 years of business and data analysis experience

title: Product Intern - Stratzy (Raise)
description:
**Role Summary**

Raise is built on this core philosophy, we will bring exceptionally great products, awesome user

experience and best-in-class customer service to our users. We started with our first consumer product, Dhan, an investment and trading platform launched in November 2021.

Today,
**Dhan ranks #8 amongst stock brokers in India**
and continues to be one of the fastest-growing platforms in the investment and trading ecosystem.

In September 2026,
**Dhan was also recognised as Fintech Startup of the Year at the Global Fintech Festival,**
reflecting the innovation, product excellence and customer focus that continue to shape the platform. Backed by a passionate team of builders, believers, designers and problem-solvers, we are building a trusted ecosystem of financial products that empowers millions of users to make smarter financial decisions.

**Stratzy**
is an algorithmic investing and trading platform that makes rule-based, system-driven trading accessible to everyday investors. The platform offers 100+ ready-made, approved algorithmic strategies across equities, indices, F&O, and commodities, letting users pick and deploy structured strategies instead of having to build and monitor trades themselves.

We are looking for a curious, proactive and ownership-driven
**Product Intern**
to join the Stratzy Product team. This is an opportunity to work on real product challenges, contribute ideas, collaborate directly with the leadership team and help build features that solve actual user problems. You will gain hands-on experience in product management, user research, data analysis and product development.

This is a
**3 to 6 month internship**
, with a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) opportunity for high performers, based on performance and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of product features, improvements and experiments, from ideation to launch.
* Understand user needs and pain points, identify opportunities and suggest solutions to improve the product experience.
* Work closely with the leadership team to understand business priorities, share ideas and contribute to product decisions.
* Translate ideas and business problems into clear product requirements, user journeys and actionable tasks.
* Collaborate with design, engineering, marketing and customer support teams to bring product ideas to life.
* Analyse user behaviour, product data and customer feedback to identify opportunities and measure the impact of product improvements.
* Research competitors, market trends and emerging developments in fintech, investing and algorithmic trading.
* Interact with users, understand their experiences and bring actionable insights to the product roadmap.
* Track feature performance after launch and recommend improvements based on user feedback and data.

**Requirements**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in any discipline. Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics or related backgrounds are welcome, but not mandatory.
* Strong curiosity about digital products, technology, user behaviour and how businesses solve customer problems.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think logically and break down complex problems into simpler solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to share ideas and collaborate with different teams.
* A proactive mindset, willingness to learn and ability to take ownership in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable with numbers, analysing information and using data to support decisions.
* An interest in finance, stock markets, investing, trading or fintech is an advantage; prior knowledge of algorithmic trading is not mandatory.
* Prior internships, college projects, personal projects, product case studies or startup experience are welcome, but not essential.

We are a start-up organization focused on fast growth with quality products; hence, the ability to

work in a fast-paced environment goes without saying!

**If you are curious, enjoy solving problems and want hands-on experience building real products, we would love to hear from you!**

**Our People & Culture:**

People and culture are the most important aspects of our business.

We are looking for team members just like us, in simple words - good people to work with and

demonstrate following personality traits:

•
**Be super obsessed about ensuring customer satisfaction.**

(We are here because of our customers, and will be here only if we serve our customers)

•
**We have a single opportunity to serve.**

(Our customers will give us one opportunity to serve - we can’t let them down. Be it product,

uptimes, customer service or any interaction we have to deliver a wow experience.)

•
**Respect your work, your team, your co-workers and our customers.**

(The only way to get respect is to give it first)

•
**Speed is all that matters. Ship right and ship faster.**

(You either help the team move ahead fast, or you slow it down. We prefer the first.)

•
**Humility & politeness over arrogance & over-confidence.**

(If you are the smartest one in the room, bring up others to speed. We are here to serve our

customers, not to prove a point.)

•
**Quality over quantity.**

(It is fine if you pick up a few things to do, but do them exceedingly well.)

•
**Make your hands dirty irrespective of who you are.**

(Our CEO responds to customers every day. Our CTO codes every day. This is us.)

•
**Talent and Competency over Credentials.**

•
**Entrepreneurial, ownership driven and disciplined.**

(We trust you to help us gain and retain the trust of our customers and our stakeholders)

•
**Less words, more action.**

(Believe in something? show it by doing things. Not just by talking about it)

•
**Flat hierarchy with open culture & conversations.**

(You are among all of us, and we all are with you)

•
**Passionate about the business you are a part of.**

(Do it because you are passionate about it, not because it’s your job.)

**Why Join Raise?**

We’ve been recognised as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, reflecting the culture we’ve built and the way we work together. At Raise, you’ll experience a flat hierarchy, open conversations, high ownership and a strong bias for action. We value people who bring passion, humility and curiosity to their work, and who care deeply about building great products and creating meaningful customer impact.

We believe in growth with ownership, speed with thoughtfulness and ambition with humility. We

celebrate wins, learn from challenges and give people the ownership and responsibility to build and make an impact. If you enjoy building from the ground up, working with passionate people, and being part of a high-growth fintech ecosystem, Raise offers an environment where you can do meaningful work and grow with the business.

**About Raise Financial Services**

Raise Financial Services is building technology-led financial products and infrastructure for India’s financially aware and digitally savvy consumers. Our ecosystem spans multiple aspects of financial services, with Dhan as our flagship investment and trading platform.

Alongside Dhan, we are building and scaling businesses across the financial ecosystem, including Stratzy, Millions, Upsurge, Filter Coffee, Pluto Insurance, Fuzz and several other emerging products and platforms.

Our ambition is to build a trusted ecosystem of financial products and experiences that make

investing, trading, wealth creation and other financial services simpler, smarter and more accessible. Our philosophy is simple:

* Build great products.
* Deliver awesome experiences.
* Provide exceptional customer service.

Location: Goregaon West, Mumbai

happenings.

**careers@dhan.co**

We are looking for a

You will work across the entire product lifecycle, from requirement analysis and architecture to development, testing, deployment, and production support. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience owning a live, multi-tenant B2B SaaS application and can balance rapid feature delivery with technical quality, security, and maintainability.

* Develop, maintain, and enhance frontend and backend applications using React, TypeScript, Node.js, Drizzle ORM, and PostgreSQL.
* Own PostgreSQL database design and production readiness, including schema changes, migrations, indexing, transactions, performance optimization, and row-level security (RLS).
* Build secure REST APIs, backend services, validation mechanisms, authorization workflows, and multi-tenant functionality.
* Develop enterprise integrations, including inbound webhooks, identity integrations, bulk employee and organization imports, background jobs, file storage, and notification services.
* Maintain and enhance product experiences for employees, managers, HR teams, and executives.
* Develop features across competency management, assessments, development plans, evidence tracking, coaching, reassessment, and workforce intelligence.
* Manage day-to-day application CI/CD operations, deployment workflows, and release readiness.
* Implement observability, health checks, structured logging, error handling, and production diagnostics.
* Ensure complete English and Arabic language support, including right-to-left (RTL) layouts wherever applicable.
* Implement AI-powered features with structured outputs, usage controls, validation, auditability, and safe failure handling.
* Review and validate AI-generated code before merging or deploying it to production.
* Write and maintain automated tests covering business logic, authorization, database operations, tenant isolation, and critical user journeys.
* Troubleshoot production issues, investigate regressions and performance bottlenecks, and perform root-cause analysis.
* Collaborate with the Integration Lead to develop reusable integration capabilities and implement client-specific product enhancements.
* Maintain clean architecture, promote code reusability, and prevent unnecessary technical debt or duplication of models and workflows.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5–9 years of experience in full-stack software development.

* Strong hands-on experience with React and TypeScript.
* Proficiency in Node.js backend development and API design.
* Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL and SQL, including database design, schema migrations, indexing, transactions, and performance troubleshooting.
* Practical experience implementing authorization, tenant isolation, and database-level or policy-based access controls.
* Experience building REST APIs, webhooks, scheduled tasks, background jobs, and third-party integrations.

title: Associate - Program Management
description:
**Job Description**
We are modernizing Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting, moving from legacy reporting platforms to a Databricks Lakehouse-based architecture and introducing artificial intelligence-enabled ways of working. We are hiring a hands-on Product Owner / Business Analyst who combines strong regulatory reporting and data analysis experience with a modern technology mindset. You will work across Finance, Technology, and vendor teams to translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions. The ideal candidate can understand the business problem, work through the data, translate requirements into technology delivery, test the outcome, and communicate clearly with stakeholders. To accelerate delivery and improve accuracy, the role leverages agentic artificial intelligence tools while maintaining strong human-in-the-loop controls and review discipline.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As an Associate in Program Management within Asia Pacific Local Regulatory Reporting Modernization, you will own requirements delivery end-to-end—spanning regulatory change, business growth, general ledger optimization, technology modernization, and global alignment in data sourcing and consumption. You will partner closely with Asia Pacific Finance stakeholders (Senior Financial Officers, Legal Entity Controllers), Corporate Technology, and vendor consultants to deliver strategic reporting solutions, operate governance, and ensure high-quality, regulator-ready outputs. You will translate regulatory and business requirements into scalable, well-controlled reporting solutions and drive clear stakeholder communications. You will leverage agentic artificial intelligence tooling to support requirements extraction, impact assessment, test design, validation, and stakeholder-ready narratives, with strong review discipline.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Own product vision and roadmap, intake, prioritization, and change control; maintain the backlog (epics, features, user stories), define minimum viable products, sequence delivery, and drive trade-offs across regulatory change versus modernization.
* Drive delivery governance cadence by preparing committee materials and providing clear, concise stakeholder communications.
* Translate regulatory circulars and business rules into business requirements documentation, impact assessments, functional specifications, and Jira epics and stories.
* Perform impact assessments for upstream system changes and data sourcing changes; define scope, milestones, and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with Finance users, Corporate Technology, and vendor teams to align the operating model and delivery approach.
* Define and implement Medallion-layer reporting logic and controls across Bronze (raw and audit-preserving), Silver (standardize, deduplicate, join), and Gold (regulator-ready rules and submission aggregations).
* Own end-to-end lineage from Gold to Silver to Bronze to source using Unity Catalog.
* Implement validation controls and pre-submission quality gates, including anomaly and outlier detection.
* Define the testing approach, scope, and plan; lead user acceptance testing with Finance and Technology.
* Build test cases and expected results; execute end-to-end tests (including automated tools where applicable), identify issues early, propose mitigations, drive timely closure, and continuously improve processes and controls.
* Use agent workflows (for example, GitHub Copilot and Databricks Genie) to accelerate requirements extraction, mapping logic, rule definition, expected-result creation, and validation; perform structured reviews to ensure outputs are accurate, explainable, and governance-ready (impact summaries, control narratives, committee-ready materials).

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Data Analytics, Accountancy, Information Systems, or related field.
* 5+ years of overall Product Owner / Business Analyst experience, including 3+ years delivering Asia Pacific local regulatory reporting automation for a foreign bank.
* Proven delivery and project management experience in Finance Regulatory Reporting automation.
* Strong data analysis skills to gather and validate facts, define gaps, perform impact analysis, draft requirements, and translate complex needs into functional specifications.
* Strong communication skills to articulate complex issues clearly to senior stakeholders and produce concise written updates and governance-ready materials.
* Strong planning and time management; ability to handle multiple assignments under deadlines with proactive risk and issue management.
* Collaborative and solution-focused approach; ability to challenge the status quo constructively.
* Practical prompt engineering to drive repeatable outputs (impact assessments, mapping rules, test scenarios, defect triage summaries, stakeholder narratives).
* Ability to review and validate artificial intelligence-generated outputs against source regulatory text, control rules, and expected results (human-in-the-loop).
* Comfort using Visual Studio Code with GitHub Copilot (including Agent Mode) to accelerate requirements and test asset creation while maintaining governance standards.
* Hands-on or working familiarity with Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, Databricks Genie, Agile backlog tooling (Jira and Confluence), and regulatory reporting vendor platforms (Nasdaq Axiom/Adenza, Wolters Kluwer, Reveleus, Resoft).

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Manage projects as needed, including planning, prioritization, scope tracking, status reporting, and risk/issue/dependency (RAID) management.
* Maintain delivery artifacts and reporting (e.g., project minutes and action items, approval, testing and other documentation, decision logs, and schedules).
* Identify and escalate blockers, risks, and cross-team dependencies; propose resolution options and coordinate next steps.
* Promote continuous improvement in intake, prioritization, refinement, and flow efficiency across the S2P delivery process.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience

* Experience writing/supporting user stories (scope, acceptance criteria) and tracking dependencies/estimates.
* Experience managing a PI/quarterly prioritization (or similar intake and sequencing) process.
* Enforce documentation standards by managing a quality control process.
* Proficient with Jira/Confluence and MS Office (Excel/PowerPoint/Visio)
* Experience with identifying and developing process metrics

* Familiarity with Source to Pay teams and Coupa preferred.
* Experience summarizing complex projects, risks, or ideas to Senior Leadership in a concise manner.
* Detail-oriented and documentation-focused; produces audit-ready artifacts.
* Comfortable with ambiguity with ability to break work down for sequencing.
* Strong organization, communication and facilitation skills
* Proactive communicator who escalates risks/dependencies early and drives follow-through.
* Continuous improvement and curious mindset with interest in flow/throughput metrics.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience

title: CSV & Software Validation Lead / Specialist
description:
**Designation: CSV & Software Validation Lead / Specialist**

**Preferred Experience: 3+ Years**

**Job Summary**

Aventior is seeking a CSV & Software Validation Specialist with experience in the biopharmaceutical, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of regulatory compliance, quality management, computerized system validation (CSV), and software testing within regulated environments.

The role involves ensuring that software applications and computerized systems meet applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, and business specifications. The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing test cases, validating system functionality, documenting test results, managing defects, and supporting compliance activities in accordance with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and other relevant regulatory frameworks.

The candidate will collaborate with Quality Assurance, Software Development, Clinical Operations, IT, and Regulatory Affairs teams to ensure software quality, data integrity, and regulatory compliance throughout the software development and validation lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Ensure adherence to applicable GxP requirements, including GMP, GCP, and GLP, based on project and system requirements.
* Support compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU and UK regulations for electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, and access controls.
* Apply GAMP 5 principles and risk-based approaches to computerized system validation and software testing.
* Review and maintain SOPs, work instructions, validation documents, and quality records.
* Support compliance assessments, internal and external audits, client audits, and regulatory inspection readiness.
* Assist with deviation management, CAPA, change control, risk assessments, and compliance remediation activities.
* Support data integrity, security, traceability, and documentation requirements for regulated systems.

**2. Software Testing & Quality Engineering**

* Review business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documentation to identify test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Prepare and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test scenarios for software applications used in biopharma and life sciences.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT), as applicable.
* Validate application workflows, data processing, user permissions, audit trails, electronic signatures, and system interfaces.
* Identify, document, track, and retest software defects in collaboration with development and QA teams.
* Maintain requirements traceability matrices (RTMs) to establish traceability between requirements, risks, test cases, and test results.
* Ensure testing activities are documented, reproducible, and aligned with approved procedures and validation protocols.
* Support test execution, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution verification.
* Participate in release testing, regression testing, and post-implementation verification.

**3. Computerized System Validation (CSV)**

* Support validation activities for GxP-regulated software applications and computerized systems.
* Prepare and maintain validation lifecycle documentation, including User Requirements Specifications (URS), risk assessments, validation plans, and test protocols.
* Execute or support Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ), where applicable.
* Assist with validation of new systems, system upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, and software releases.
* Ensure validation evidence is complete, accurate, approved, and audit-ready.
* Support periodic reviews, change impact assessments, and revalidation activities based on risk and regulatory requirements.
* Apply risk-based validation principles in accordance with GAMP 5 and organizational quality procedures.

**4. Biopharma & Life Sciences Application Testing**

* Test and validate applications supporting clinical trials, clinical data management, pharmaceutical quality processes, laboratory operations, and regulatory workflows.
* Understand regulated-system requirements relating to patient data, clinical trial records, laboratory data, and electronic documentation.
* Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, access controls, audit trails, and system-generated records.
* Support testing of integrations between clinical, laboratory, quality management, and other enterprise applications.
* Help ensure that software changes do not compromise patient safety, product quality, data integrity, or regulatory compliance.
* Support HIPAA-related privacy and security requirements when applications handle protected health information (PHI).

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Computer Science, Information Technology, Quality Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in compliance, software testing, quality assurance, or computerized system validation within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research, or life sciences environments.
* Strong understanding of GxP regulations, including GMP, GCP, and GLP.
* Working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, EU and UK regulations, and electronic records and electronic signature requirements.
* Hands-on experience in manual software testing, test case preparation, test execution, defect tracking, and regression testing.
* Hands on experience with QMS platforms like ServiceNow, Veeva, Master Control a huge plus.
* Experience preparing or executing validation protocols and maintaining validation documentation, including URS, IQ, OQ, PQ, and RTMs, as applicable.
* Knowledge of SDLC, STLC, requirements traceability, risk-based testing, and change management.
* Experience with CAPA, deviation management, change control, and audit documentation.
* Understanding of data integrity, audit trails, access controls, and security requirements in regulated systems.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple testing and compliance activities.

**Company Overview:**

**Aventior**

is a leading provider of innovative, end-to-end technology solutions, empowering businesses across diverse industries to solve complex challenges and accelerate growth. We harness the power of cutting-edge technologies such as
**artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), MLOps, and DevOps**

to build scalable, future-ready solutions that drive measurable business outcomes for the life science industry.

Our expertise extends across the entire data lifecycle. We offer comprehensive data development and management services, including
**cloud data architecture, universal data models, Data Transformation & ETL, data lakes, user management, Analytics & visualization,**

and
**automated data capture**

for unstructured and semi-structured sources such as scanned documents. These capabilities enable organizations to unlock the full value of their data and make faster, more informed decisions.

At Aventior, our strength lies in combining
**deep industry expertise**

with
**advanced technical capabilities**

. Our teams work closely with clients to design and deliver tailored solutions that align with their unique business needs—whether it’s optimizing operations, enhancing customer experiences, or driving strategic decision-making.

We bring a
**holistic, cross-industry perspective**

to every engagement, supported by a strong foundation in
**design, implementation, innovation, migration, and ongoing support**

. With a
**global delivery model**

, a
**multi-country presence**

, and a team of highly skilled professionals, Aventior is well-positioned to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes at scale.

title: Delivery Manager-Test Lead
description:
**Job Purpose**
Looking for a Test Lead / Data QA Engineer to drive and oversee data validation, manual testing, and regression testing activities across capital markets data pipelines spanning both legacy and modern platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and adherence to business rules through source-to-target validation, schema verification, data reconciliation, lineage analysis, and automation-led regression testing.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong data QA and testing expertise, hands-on automation skills, capital markets domain knowledge, and a proactive ownership mindset to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across environments.
  
  
The successful candidate will lead test delivery, manage and coordinate offshore QA resources, and engage closely with business and technology stakeholders to maintain high-quality data across post-trade and enterprise data ecosystems. Key responsibilities include building reusable Python- and SQL-based validation frameworks, supporting batch and cloud-based execution models, identifying data anomalies, validating end-to-end data flows, and embedding robust data quality controls throughout the development lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end test planning, execution, and delivery for data validation and regression testing initiatives, ensuring quality, schedule, and stakeholder expectations are met.
* Manage and mentor offshore/onshore QA teams, including resource planning, task allocation, deliverable reviews, and adherence to testing best practices.
* Drive test governance, including test strategy, defect management, risk tracking, quality metrics, status reporting, and release readiness assessments.
* Collaborate with business, engineering, and product teams to define requirements, resolve issues, ensure test coverage, and embed quality controls across the delivery lifecycle.
* Perform source-to-target data validation across legacy and modern systems, including SQL Server and cloud-based data environments.
* Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, duplication handling, referential integrity, schema structures, metadata, lineage, and business-rule conformance.
* Build and maintain automation-first regression testing frameworks using Python, PySpark, SQL, and reusable validation utilities.
* Execute field-level, dataset-level, transformation-level, and aggregate-level data checks across source, staging, warehouse, data lake, and downstream systems.
* Validate ETL/ELT pipelines, post-trade data flows, stored procedures, batch jobs, and cloud-based execution workflows.
* Design reusable test cases, validation scenarios, reconciliation checks, automated scripts, and regression packs for repeatable data-quality assurance.
* Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries and stored procedures across SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or similar platforms.
* Translate business rules, stored procedure logic, and post-trade process flows into automated validation scripts and assertions.
* Build Python-based utilities, APIs, CLI tools, and reusable frameworks to support data validation, orchestration, API integrations, and reporting workflows.
* Integrate regression tests, data validation checks, SQL deployables, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitLab, or equivalent tools.
* Automate execution of AutoSys jobs, batch processes, stored procedures, and validation scripts across development, UAT, and production environments.
* Work with engineering teams to embed data quality controls into pipelines, releases, and operational workflows.
* Identify data anomalies, schema mismatches, duplicate records, null-handling issues, transformation failures, reconciliation breaks, and integrity violations.
* Log defects with clear evidence, impact analysis, root-cause observations, and business context.
* Support capital markets and post-trade validation across allocations, clearing, settlement, confirmations, reconciliations, market data, reference data, and downstream reporting.

**Key competencies**

* 8–12 years of hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles and proven experience leading QA teams, test planning, estimation, execution, defect management, and end-to-end test delivery across complex data programs.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate test status, risks, quality metrics, and release readiness to business and technology leadership.
* Experience establishing test strategies, governance frameworks, quality standards, resource planning, and mentoring distributed QA teams.
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional collaboration, manage competing priorities, mitigate delivery risks, and ensure

successful project outcomes in Agile environments.
  
  

* Strong Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification.
* Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets.
* Solid SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis.
* Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms.
* Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities.
* Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance.
* Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines.
* Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow.
* Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios.
* Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance.
* Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Domain Experience (Must Have)
* Strong experience in Fixed Income Capital Markets domain
* Good understanding of Fixed Income products, reference data, pricing, securities, positions, settlements, and trade lifecycle concepts
* Experience working with market data, reference data, and regulatory reporting-related data sets

**Nice to Have**

* Exposure to Azure, AWS, ADF, containers, Kubernetes, or cloud-based data platforms.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar platforms.
* Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, cloud data lakes, and Big Data validation.
* Experience validating batch, streaming, real-time, and Kafka-based ingestion pipelines.
* Capital markets domain exposure, especially post-trade, market data, reference data, trade data, or ION/blotter platform

integrations.
  
  

* Exposure to DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and code quality tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Sonar, Mend, or ZAP.

title: Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)
description:
**About Revun**
Revun is building a next-generation software platform designed to modernize how property owners, property managers, brokerages, maintenance providers, service professionals, and real estate organizations operate.
  
  
The platform combines CRM, leasing, maintenance, accounting, payments, communications, workflow automation, compliance, reporting, AI, integrations, and stakeholder portals into a single operating platform.
  
  
Our goal is not to build another collection of disconnected software tools. We are building an operational platform that simplifies complex business processes, reduces manual work, improves visibility, and helps organizations operate more efficiently.
  
  
The product is already underway, and we are now looking for a strong product designer who can help turn a complex platform into an intuitive, professional, scalable, and commercially ready user experience.
  
  
**About The Role**
Revun is hiring a
**Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)**
to lead the design of our web and mobile product experience.
  
  
This is not a graphic design role, and it is not a role focused only on creating attractive screens.
  
  
We are looking for someone who understands how to design real software products, including complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, dashboards, workflows, portals, mobile apps, and multi-user systems.
  
  
You will work closely with leadership, engineering, and product stakeholders to simplify complex workflows, improve usability, create scalable design systems, and help prepare the platform for commercial launch.
  
  
The successful candidate must be able to think through product flows, user journeys, permissions, edge cases, responsive layouts, information hierarchy, and design handoff — not just visual styling.
  
  
You should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve your design process, speed up research and ideation, organize complex requirements, generate UX copy, explore layout options, create user flows, and improve documentation while still applying your own product judgment.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Please submit your
**resume and portfolio**
for consideration.
  
  
Your portfolio should include examples of real product-design work, such as user flows, dashboards, complex interfaces, mobile screens, design systems, marketplace workflows, SaaS platforms, or similar product examples.
  
  
Candidates with only branding, landing pages, social media graphics, or marketing websites will not be the strongest fit for this role.
  
  
Qualified candidates will be invited to complete a pre-recorded video interview 24-48 hours after applying as the next step in the hiring process.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design user-friendly web and mobile experiences for a complex SaaS and marketplace-style platform
* Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and developer-ready UI specifications
* Design workflows for multiple user types, including internal users, property owners, tenants, vendors, service providers, partners, and administrators
* Translate complex business processes into simple, intuitive product experiences
* Work closely with leadership and engineering to turn product vision into clear, usable, buildable designs
* Improve the overall information architecture, navigation, dashboard structure, forms, portals, workflows, and mobile experience
* Design and maintain scalable design systems, reusable components, UI patterns, and style standards
* Create clean, professional, modern, and consistent product interfaces
* Identify gaps, edge cases, confusing user flows, and areas where the product experience can be simplified
* Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented accurately
* Review builds and provide design QA feedback before release
* Use AI tools responsibly to speed up research, ideation, UX writing, documentation, design exploration, and workflow development
* Validate AI-assisted design outputs through human judgment, user needs, business requirements, and product logic
* Support commercial launch readiness by ensuring the platform is easy to understand, easy to use, and visually consistent

**Required Experience**

* 6+ years of UX/UI, Product Design, or related digital product design experience
* Experience designing complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, CRM systems, workflow platforms, fintech products, operational dashboards, or other multi-role software products
* Strong experience designing both web and mobile product experiences
* Strong Figma skills, including components, Auto Layout, variants, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff
* Experience designing dashboards, forms, tables, workflows, portals, user profiles, settings, notifications, and role-based user experiences
* Experience working directly with engineers and product stakeholders
* Strong understanding of user flows, information architecture, interaction design, usability, visual hierarchy, responsive design, and design systems
* Experience using AI tools to support design work, UX writing, research synthesis, user-flow creation, wireframing, prototyping, or product documentation
* Ability to explain design decisions clearly and connect them to user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility
* Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, developer-ready designs
* Strong written and spoken English
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

**Strongly Preferred Experience**

* Experience designing marketplace platforms or multi-sided products
* Experience with property technology, real estate platforms, maintenance platforms, field-service software, booking platforms, fintech, CRM systems, or enterprise workflow software
* Experience designing products with multiple user types and role-based permissions
* Experience designing payment, transaction, vendor, booking, service-request, or dashboard workflows
* Experience designing AI-powered product features or AI-assisted workflows
* Experience improving an existing product rather than only designing from scratch
* Experience working in startups or fast-moving product environments
* Experience with usability testing, product analytics, user research, or customer feedback loops
* Experience creating design systems from the ground up

AI Expectations
  
  
We are looking for a designer who uses AI as a productivity tool, not as a substitute for product judgment.
  
  
**You Should Be Comfortable Using AI To Help With**

* UX research organization
* User-flow exploration
* Wireframe ideation
* Interface-copy options
* Product requirement organization
* Edge-case discovery
* Design-system documentation
* Competitive research summaries
* Prototype concepts
* Usability-test summaries
* Design iteration

However, you must still review, validate, and improve all AI-assisted work yourself. Final design decisions must be based on user needs, product logic, business goals, usability, accessibility, and technical feasibility.
  
  
The Person We Are Looking For
  
  
You are a true product thinker.
  
  
You do not just make screens look good — you understand how people actually use software.
  
  
You can take a complicated workflow and make it feel clear, simple, and logical.
  
  
You are comfortable designing for different types of users who each need different information, permissions, dashboards, and actions.
  
  
You think through edge cases, empty states, errors, mobile responsiveness, role-based access, data-heavy screens, and developer handoff.
  
  
You are confident working with engineers and leadership, and you can explain why a design decision matters.
  
  
You are also comfortable using AI to work faster, explore more options, and improve your process, while still owning the quality of the final product.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  

* The platform becomes easier to understand and easier to use
* Core workflows are redesigned with clearer user journeys
* Web and mobile experiences become more consistent and polished
* Developers receive clear, complete, buildable design specifications
* The design system becomes scalable and reusable
* Product screens feel modern, professional, and commercially ready
* Users can complete important tasks with less confusion and fewer unnecessary steps
* AI is used responsibly to improve speed, quality, and documentation
* Design work directly supports product launch and long-term platform growth

**Compensation**
The monthly compensation range for this role is:
  
  
CAD $24,000–$36,000 annually
  
  
Final compensation will depend on experience, product-design depth, SaaS and marketplace experience, AI-assisted workflow capability, communication skills, and ability to work independently.

title: Lead Firmware Engineer
description:
**POSITION**

**Lead Firmware Developer - Device Driver**

  

**Experience**

**Minimum 9 years of Experience in Embedded Development**

**Minimum 7 years of Experience in Device Driver Development and BSP development**

**At least 2 years of Experience with C++ & RTOS environment**

  

**Education**

**Masters/Bachelor of Engineering with Electronics or Computer Engineering**

  

**LOCATION**

**Pune**

  

**SUMMARY OF ROLE**

Emerson develops and sustains Flow Computers and Remote Terminal Units (RTUs) used for critical measurement, monitoring, automation, and control applications in the Oil & Gas and industrial automation markets.

The Device Driver Lead Developer will provide hands-on technical leadership for the architecture, design, development, work product reviews, and sustainment of low-level embedded software. The role contributes to device drivers, Board Support Packages (BSPs), boot software, board bring-up, and hardware-software integration for existing and next-generation products.

The successful candidate will work as a senior individual contributor within a global Agile/Scrum team, collaborating with hardware, systems, application software, verification, cybersecurity, functional safety, manufacturing, and product teams. The role requires strong ownership, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to convert product and system requirements into reliable, reusable, and maintainable embedded solutions.

  

**SPECIFIC JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Responsibilities of the job will include:**

* **Technical leadership:** Design and delivery of assigned device drivers, BSPs, bootloaders, hardware abstraction layers, and low-level platform services.
* **Architecture and design:** Define scalable, reusable, and maintainable solutions across product families. Create and review requirements, interface specifications, and design documents.

  **• Driver development:** Develop and sustain drivers for interfaces and peripherals such as UART, SPI, I²C, GPIO, timers, watchdogs, RTC, ADC/DAC, DMA, Ethernet, USB, CAN, flash memory, and other processor-specific peripherals.

  **• Board bring-up:** Perform board bring-up and hardware-software integration. Collaborate with hardware engineers on schematic reviews, component selection, FPGA interfaces, memory configuration, timing, and prototype validation.

  **• Real-time performance:** Analyze and optimize interrupt latency, task scheduling, memory usage, throughput, boot time, CPU utilization, DMA operation, determinism, and system reliability.

  **• Product development lifecycle:** Contribute to requirements analysis, estimation, architecture, detailed design, coding, peer reviews, unit testing, integration testing, system validation, release, and sustaining activities.

  **• Troubleshooting and root-cause analysis:** Diagnose complex hardware-software problems using JTAG, trace tools, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, memory dumps, and system logs. Drive corrective and preventive actions for product, manufacturing, and field issues.

  **• Safety and cybersecurity:** Incorporate secure coding, defensive design, least-privilege access, secure update, fault detection, diagnostics, and applicable functional-safety and product-security requirements.

  **• Collaboration:** Work effectively with global cross-functional teams and participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, technical reviews, and release-readiness activities.

  **• Innovation and continuous improvement:** Evaluate new processors, RTOS capabilities, tools, and development methods. Build proofs of concept and improve software reuse.

  **• Team capability:** Coach team members and provide technical guidance to support team growth and project success. Participate in organizational goals to build a better & strong team .

  **• Compliance:** Adhere to Emerson engineering processes, quality systems, product lifecycle practices, and applicable local and international standards and procedures.

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from a recognized institution.
* Expert-level proficiency in C, C++; practical understanding of assembly language, linker scripts, startup code, and object-oriented analysis and design.

  • Extensive hands-on experience developing production-quality device drivers, BSPs, bootloaders, and hardware abstraction layers in an RTOS-based embedded environment.

  • Strong knowledge of ARM Cortex-M and/or Cortex-A architectures, exception models, interrupt controllers, caches, MMU/MPU, multicore considerations, memory maps, and low-level processor initialization.

  • Hands-on experience with RTOS concepts including scheduling, synchronization, interrupt service routines, inter-process/inter-task communication, timing, resource management, and concurrency defect analysis.

  • Experience interfacing and debugging flash memory, SDRAM/DDR, ADC/DAC, Ethernet controllers, FPGA interfaces, and common serial peripherals; proven use of DMA for performance optimization.

  • Strong understanding of board bring-up, schematic interpretation, datasheets, timing diagrams, signal integrity considerations, and hardware-software interface debugging.

  • Expertise with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, JTAG/SWD debuggers, GDB or equivalent debuggers, trace tools, and performance profiling tools.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

• Experience with one or more platforms such as VxWorks, ThreadX, QNX, or Embedded Linux.

• Knowledge of industrial protocols and systems such as Modbus, DNP3, HART, OPC UA, I/O systems, PLCs, RTUs, transmitters, and sensors.

• Experience with Flow Computers, RTUs, edge controllers, industrial automation, process control, Oil & Gas measurement, or other high-reliability embedded products.

• Working knowledge of secure boot, signed firmware, secure firmware update, cryptographic services, key storage, vulnerability remediation, and embedded product security.

• Awareness of IEC 62443, secure development lifecycle practices, and functional-safety concepts applicable to industrial computing products.

  

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

**The successful candidate will:**

**• Systems thinking:** Understands interactions among processors, hardware, FPGA, RTOS, drivers, applications, and product requirements.

**• Customer focus:** Connects design choices to product reliability, maintainability, field performance, and customer outcomes.

**• Problem solving:** Uses structured analysis, evidence, and rigorous logic to identify root causes, evaluate trade-offs, and implement effective solutions.

**• Ownership and accountability:** Takes end-to-end responsibility for commitments, risks, technical quality, and timely delivery.

**• Quality mindset:** Produces robust, testable, maintainable software and does not compromise engineering discipline for short-term progress.

**• Communication and influence:** Communicates complex technical topics clearly, documents decisions, listens to alternatives, and influences across functions and locations.

**• Coaching and collaboration:** Coach team members, gives constructive feedback, shares knowledge, and creates an inclusive environment for technical discussion.

**• Learning agility and innovation:** Quickly learns new processors, tools, standards, and domains; converts learning into practical improvements and reusable solutions.

**• Execution:** Prioritizes effectively, anticipates dependencies, removes impediments, and consistently delivers high-quality outcomes.

Ensures that all projects are delivered within the defined scope, quality, time and cost requirements. Partners with multi-departmental leadership and other stakeholders to locate opportunities and develop and prioritize projects according to relevant measurement criteria.

We are looking for a techno-functional Business Analyst to take end-to-end IT ownership of our websites, along with the analytics and marketing-automation stack. In this role you will need to translate business needs into technical requirements, drive delivery through vendor and system-integrator partners, and be the single point of ownership for the health, performance, and security of our websites and digital platforms
  
  
**Your Responsibilities Will Include**




+ Take end-to-end IT ownership of the D2C eCommerce platform and CMS-based brand website covering IT operations, enhancements, performance, uptime, and quality.
+ Gather requirements from business stakeholders and translate them into clear technical specifications and user stories.

+ Drive continuous improvement in website performance and page speed.

+ Maintain a high-level understanding of WhatsApp bots and conversational commerce, and coordinate related enhancements with vendor partners.
+ Own the relationship with the analytics / BI platform and its supporting vendor team.
+ Ensure dashboards and reports meet business needs; coordinate enhancements, data checks, and troubleshooting.
+ Bring a solid understanding of how analytics and BI solutions work end to end
+ Own and manage the marketing automation / customer-engagement platform.
+ Partner with business teams to build customer journeys, segments, and campaigns, and manage the supporting vendor.
+ Understand what is required to keep the web platforms secure.
+ Coordinate with the security team to identify, prioritise, and remediate vulnerabilities.
+ Coordinate across cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and run solution ideation with vendor partners.
+ Bring a strong understanding of D2C business processes and act as the bridge between business, operations, and technology.
+ Present to senior leadership (including the CIO) and run regular status-update / governance meetings.
+ Own vendor relationships, SLAs, and escalations across all platforms.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 5-7 years in a techno-functional / Business Analyst / IT delivery role, ideally in D2C, eCommerce, or retail.

* Understanding of CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress or similar).
* Solid understanding of D2C / online retail processes — catalog, cart, checkout, promotions, and order management.

**Preferred Skills And Experiences**

* Education: Post Graduate/B. Tech / BE / MCA
* Background: Business Analyst/Product Owner/Product Manager

title: Scrum Master
description:

Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.

title: Global C and I Strategic Operations Support
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Clients & Industries: Global C&I Strategic Operations Support**
**About EY**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. Join EY and help build a better working world. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Global Operations Support plays a key role in supporting operational excellence across the Clients & Industries (C&I) organization. This role focuses on enabling strategic priorities, optimizing processes, and facilitating collaboration across domains, functions, and pods to deliver agility and impact.
  
  
The C&I organization has six Domains, each with individual needs and differing maturity: Insights, Industry, Demand Generation, Client Excellence, Sales & Commercial Excellence, and Enablement & Technology.
  
  
This position sits within the Business Enablement – Business Management Office which supports the C&I organization through three key functions: Strategic Operations, Core Services, and Performance & Data Insights. Strategic Operations works through pods aligned to each of the six domains, working alongside Core Services and Performance & Data Insights to deliver seamless operational support and strategic execution.
  
  
Success in this model depends on agility — the ability to learn quickly, adapt as priorities change, and drive execution while staying responsive to evolving demands.
  
  
The primary stakeholder is the Domain Strategy Execution Leader, although this role will work with the rest of the Domain team. This position works directly with the Operations Senior Specialist or Operations Specialist.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Operations**

* Manage and execute domain initiatives and projects by working closely with senior stakeholders, applying strong project management discipline.
* Maintain project plans, timelines, documentation, and next steps, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.
* Drive project meetings, coordinate actions across contributors, advance activity as appropriate and track progress against milestones.
* Support preparation of leadership‑ready materials (presentations, updates, trackers), ensuring they meet EY standards and are ready for circulation.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, and opportunities to improve processes, escalating issues as appropriate.
* Act as a single point of coordination with relevant C&I domains and CBS Functions (e.g., BMC, Finance, Technology, AWS) to support delivery of project outcomes.

**Operational Excellence**

* Support consistent execution of operational processes by maintaining clear documentation, governance artifacts, and reporting.
* Proactively identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and enhance ways of working within the domain.
* Maintain and manage knowledge repositories, databases, SharePoint sites, and content libraries, including regular review and validation of materials.
* Share knowledge, insights, and updates with stakeholders using agreed communication channels.
* Support preparation of status reporting and dashboards, ensuring clarity in coordination with Performance & Data Insights where applicable.
* Assist the triage of requests for ad‑hoc analysis, reporting, and information, helping to embed new ways of working and reinforcing self‑service where possible.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Develop strong working relationships across domains, functions, and pods, anticipating needs and supporting broader team objectives.
* Manage stakeholder communications and expectations, providing clear, timely updates on progress, risks, and next steps.
* Act as a trusted delivery partner to leadership by ensuring follow‑through on actions and high‑quality execution.
* Participate actively in regular update calls and forums, contributing insights and supporting other team members as needed.
* Facilitate coordination across geographically dispersed teams to enable smooth execution and alignment.

**Skills & Attributes For Success**

* Good analytical and problem‑solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Experience supporting operational process design, improvement, and handoff.
* Competence in reporting, data visualization, and storyboarding, with the ability to translate data into clear insights.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders, delivering high‑quality outputs under tight timelines.
* A client‑focused mindset, with the ability to respond to changing needs and redirect effort as required.
* Clear, confident communicator with the ability to engage senior stakeholders effectively.
* Resilient, adaptable, and comfortable working in a global, matrixed environment with evolving priorities.
* Familiarity with AI/other automation to enhance processes, project outcomes and personal deliverables

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Testing Specialist
description:
Job Description

**Our Story**

At Alight, we believe a company’s success starts with its people. Alight embraces values that come directly from our people – purposeful, human, united and growth-minded – reflecting our inclusive culture and promise that our clients expect. We are passionate about connecting purpose with impact.
