With a comprehensive total rewards package, Alight offers programs and plans that support your mind, body, wallet, and life. Benefits include health, starting Day One. Additionally, Alight colleagues enjoy wellbeing programs, retirement plans, and career growth opportunities – all within a thriving global organization.

**Great Place to Work**

Thanks to the work of every colleague, Alight has received multiple awards of recognition including “Great Place to Work” for the past 7 years and Fortune’s “Best Companies to Work For.” To learn more about our company culture and awards
**Click Here.**

We invite you to join our team! Learn more at careers.alight.com.

**(THE ROLE)**

The Senior Testing Specialist is accountable to test and sign off on the quality of CBA solutions, ensuring that delivery meets client requirements and acceptance criteria. The role leverages deep domain expertise, test design discipline, realistic test data setup, defect analysis, and stakeholder communication to identify quality risks and support production-ready releases. This updated role also requires responsible use of AI as a productivity accelerator for data quality analysis, test design, SQL validation, issue summarization, and documentation.

**AI capability requirement**

Candidates must demonstrate practical, responsible use of generative AI to accelerate data profiling, data quality rule design, test case creation, SQL analysis, and issue summarization. AI-generated checks, summaries, or SQL must be validated, corrected, and explained before use.

**(RESPONSIBILITIES)**

Primary Responsibilities

· Participate in requirements meetings to understand client impact, acceptance criteria, testing coverage, environment needs, non-functional requirements, and testing effort.

· Participate in sprint planning by reviewing user stories, identifying testing tasks, providing estimates, and confirming readiness of test data and environments.

· Create, document, execute, track, and report manual and automated test cases for assigned projects, enhancements, and defects.

· Create realistic participant, provision, configuration, and environment data needed for development, functional testing, regression testing, and UAT preparation.

· Capture, analyze, log, and retest defects; identify quality risks; and partner with developers, product owners, and solution leaders to resolve issues or prioritize backlog items.

· Execute functional and non-functional testing, including regression, data validation, configuration validation, and release-readiness testing.

· Support UAT by preparing environments and test participants, validating test scenarios, and documenting results, risks, and required follow-up.

· Use AI-assisted QA and data analysis tools to accelerate test design, data quality checks, SQL validation, issue summaries, and documentation while independently validating outputs.

Required Skills and Experience

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, Math, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

· 4-6 years of software quality assurance, data testing, or related experience.

· Experience with SQL-based testing and data validation.

· Experience creating and executing manual tests, with exposure to test automation or automated data-validation approaches; familiarity with Agile testing methodologies, test planning, test case creation, defect management, and release validation.

· Experience with QA automation frameworks, test-management tools, or automated SQL/data-quality validation is a plus.

· Strong knowledge of CBA domain, product behavior, environment setup, test data preparation, client impact, and quality risk analysis.

· Ability to analyze requirements, identify edge cases, distinguish true defects from expected business variance, and communicate findings clearly.

· SQL and data quality fundamentals, including joins, aggregations, exception queries, duplicate detection, null analysis, referential integrity checks, record-count validation, and trend analysis.

· Strong secure data handling discipline, including preventing confidential, proprietary, client, colleague, production, PII, or PHI data from being entered into public AI tools.

AI Required and Preferred Skills.

**(REQUIREMENTS)**

**Skill Area**

**Requirement / Posting Language**

**AI-assisted data analysis**

Experience using generative AI tools to accelerate data profiling, SQL analysis, data quality rule design, query explanation, documentation, and issue summarization.

**Prompt engineering**

Ability to write clear prompts for data validation scenarios, anomaly detection logic, SQL troubleshooting, reconciliation checks, and data quality reporting.

**AI output validation**

Ability to critically review AI-generated SQL, data quality rules, test cases, and summaries for accuracy, completeness, privacy, and business relevance.

**Data analysis and RCA**

Ability to profile datasets, identify patterns, isolate root causes, document evidence, and recommend corrective actions.

**Preferred AI usage**

Experience with ETL validation, source-to-target reconciliation, data lineage, data observability, BI/report validation, data governance, and automated data quality checks.

**Application and Interview**

By applying for a position with Alight, you understand that, should you be made an offer, it will be contingent on your undergoing and successfully completing a background check consistent with Alight’s employment policies. Background checks may include some or all the following based on the nature of the position: Government ID validation, education verification, employment verification, and criminal check, search against global sanctions and government watch lists, credit check, and/or drug test. You will be notified during the hiring process which checks are required by the position.

Alight requires all virtual interviews to be conducted on video. Please be aware that Alight is a camera-on culture and may require occasional travel to one of our physical office locations.

**Our commitment to Inclusion**

We celebrate differences and believe in fostering an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. We know that diverse teams are stronger, more innovative, and more successful.

At Alight, we welcome and embrace all individuals, regardless of their background, and are dedicated to creating a culture that enables every employee to thrive. Join us in building a brighter, more inclusive future.

As part of this commitment, Alight will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation for the hiring process. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact alightcareers@alight.com.

Alight is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against anyone based on sex, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital or domestic partner status, citizenship, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics or conduct covered by federal, state, or local law. In addition, we take affirmative action to employ disabled persons, disabled veterans, and other covered veterans.

Alight provides reasonable accommodation to the known limitations of otherwise qualified employees and applicants for employment with disabilities and sincerely held religious beliefs, practices and observances, unless doing so would result in undue hardship. Applicants for employment may request reasonable accommodations/modifications by contacting their recruiter.

**Authorization to work in the Employing Country**

Applicants for employment in the country in which they are applying (Employing Country) must have work authorization that does not, now or in the future, require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the Employing Country and with Alight.

Note, this job description does not restrict management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities of this job to other entities; including but not limited to subsidiaries, partners, or purchasers of Alight business units.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Scrum Master**
----------------

PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.

Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.

**A PURPOSE DRIVEN COMPANY – 150 YEARS**

While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.

At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.

Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.

**What you will do:**
---------------------

Do you enjoy helping teams turn Agile principles into disciplined, outcome-focused delivery? As a Scrum Master, you will lead and coach Agile teams to deliver high-value outcomes through servant leadership, strong collaboration, and continuous improvement. You will create focus, facilitate effective ceremonies, surface delivery risks, and help teams strengthen self-organization and predictability.

**What you can expect:**
------------------------

* Coach teams and Product Owners on Agile principles, practices, backlog refinement, and continuous improvement.
* Plan and facilitate sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, demonstrations, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
* Identify, track, and help resolve risks, impediments, and dependencies, escalating when appropriate and protecting team focus.
* Coordinate across teams through Scrum-of-Scrum forums, Release Train Engineers, other Scrum Masters, and communities of practice.
* Champion Agile ways of working and, where applicable, partner with Financial Management and stakeholders to maintain accurate Journey and Team reporting.

**What you will bring:**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Five or more years of experience as a Scrum Master or in a comparable Agile delivery role.
* Demonstrated experience with Scrum, Kanban, story writing, estimation, backlog refinement, and related Agile techniques.
* Strong servant-leadership, coaching, facilitation, mentoring, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Excellent communication, analysis, organization, problem-solving, adaptability, and stakeholder-partnership skills.

**What will set you apart?**
----------------------------

* Scrum Master certification.
* Experience with Jira, Miro, or comparable Agile collaboration and delivery tools.
* Experience with Power BI or comparable reporting and analytics tools.
* Experience supporting scaled Agile delivery or Program Increment planning.
* **PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.**

title: QA Automation Lead
description:
Role Summary

Lead the Quality Assurance and Testing function for large-scale Government and PSU digital transformation programs. Responsible for defining testing strategy, managing functional and non-functional testing, ensuring product quality, managing test teams, and supporting successful production deployments.

Primary Objective

Ensure delivery of defect-free, secure, scalable, and business-compliant applications by implementing robust testing processes, governance controls, and quality assurance frameworks across the software development lifecycle.

Testing Leadership Responsibilities

Define enterprise testing strategy, test governance framework, quality standards, testing methodologies, test metrics, release readiness criteria, and quality assurance processes.

Test Planning & Management

Prepare Master Test Plans, Test Strategies, Test Schedules, Resource Plans, Estimation Models, Defect Management Plans, and Release Readiness Reports.

Quality Assurance Governance

Define quality gates across requirement, design, development, testing, deployment, and production support phases.

Testing Lifecycle Management

Lead complete testing lifecycle including Test Planning, Test Design, Test Execution, Defect Management, Re-testing, Regression Testing, UAT Support, Production Validation, and Hypercare Support.

Functional Testing

Validate business processes, workflows, integrations, reporting, user journeys, and application functionality against approved requirements.

Automation Testing

Define and implement automation testing frameworks and maximize automation coverage across web applications, APIs, and enterprise platforms.

API Testing

Manage testing of REST APIs, SOAP Services, middleware interfaces, integration services, and third-party integrations.

Performance Testing

Lead performance, load, scalability, endurance, stress, volume, and benchmark testing for large-scale applications.

Security Testing Coordination

Coordinate Vulnerability Assessment, Penetration Testing (VAPT), Secure Configuration Reviews, and OWASP compliance validation.

Integration Testing

Manage SIT across multiple applications, middleware platforms, databases, APIs, and external government systems.

User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

Facilitate UAT planning, execution support, defect management, stakeholder coordination, and sign-off processes.

Production Readiness Assessment

Conduct release readiness reviews, deployment quality validation, defect closure verification, smoke testing, and go-live certification.

Defect Management

Define defect lifecycle, severity classification, root cause analysis, defect leakage monitoring, and quality improvement initiatives.

Non-Functional Testing

Manage performance testing, security testing, usability testing, compatibility testing, failover testing, resiliency testing, and DR testing.

Government Application Testing Experience

Experience testing Citizen Service Portals, Workflow Systems, Grievance Platforms, Regulatory Systems, Utility Platforms, Education Systems, Healthcare Systems, Land Record Systems, Public Finance Systems, and e-Governance applications.

Government Ecosystem Validation

Experience validating integrations with Aadhaar, DigiLocker, eKYC, Payment Gateways, GIS Systems, SMS Gateways, Email Services, SSO Solutions, ERP, HRMS, and DMS platforms.

Mandatory Government / PSU Experience

Minimum 8+ years of experience testing Government, PSU, Public Sector, Smart Governance, Digital India, or e-Governance applications.

Mandatory Transformation Program Experience

Must have successfully served as Test Lead, QA Lead, Test Manager, or Quality Assurance Manager in at least 3–4 large-scale Government or PSU Digital Transformation Programs.

Mandatory End-to-End Delivery Experience

Must have managed testing activities across requirements validation, test planning, SIT, UAT, performance testing, deployment validation, production rollout, and hypercare phases.

Mandatory Go-Live Experience

Must have provided release readiness certification, production deployment support, go-live validation, smoke testing, stabilization support, and production sign-off for enterprise-scale Government applications.

Project Scale Requirements

Experience testing large-scale applications involving multi-department workflows, state-wide or national deployments, citizen-facing systems serving 1 Million+ users, or programs exceeding ₹50 Crore TCV.

Test Management Tools

JIRA, Azure DevOps, HP ALM/Quality Center, TestRail, Zephyr, qTest, Xray, Confluence.

Automation Tools

Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, ReadyAPI, Rest Assured, Robot Framework.

API Testing Tools

Postman, SOAP UI, ReadyAPI, Swagger, REST Assured.

Performance Testing Tools

JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad, BlazeMeter, Gatling.

Database Testing Skills

Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB; ability to validate database transactions, stored procedures, and data reconciliation.

Security Testing Knowledge

OWASP Top 10, Vulnerability Assessment, Penetration Testing coordination, Application Security Validation, API Security Testing.

Cloud & Modern Application Testing

Experience testing cloud-native applications, microservices, container-based applications, Kubernetes deployments, and API-led architectures.

Development Methodologies

Agile, Scrum, DevSecOps, Waterfall, Hybrid Delivery Models.

Fixed Price Project Experience

Proven experience managing testing activities in Fixed Price Project (FPP) environments, ensuring quality deliverables within committed timelines and contractual milestones.

Team Management Experience

Experience leading Test Managers, Test Engineers, Automation Engineers, Performance Testers, UAT Coordinators, and Vendor Testing Teams.

Reporting & Governance

Expertise in Quality Dashboards, Defect Analytics, Test Coverage Reporting, Release Reports, KPI Monitoring, and Executive Status Reporting.

Leadership Skills

Quality Leadership, Stakeholder Management, Analytical Thinking, Risk Management, Team Development, Communication, Escalation Management, Decision Making.

Educational Qualifications

B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Tech or equivalent qualification from a recognized institution.

Preferred Certifications

ISTQB Advanced Test Manager, ISTQB Test Manager, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Agilist, PMP, Agile Testing Certification.

Desired Competencies

Attention to Detail, Quality Mindset, Process Orientation, Problem Solving, Customer Focus, Collaboration, Planning & Execution, Governance Excellence.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Defect Leakage Rate, Test Coverage %, Automation Coverage %, UAT Acceptance Rate, Production Defect Density, Release Success Rate, Test Execution Adherence, Customer Satisfaction, Quality Compliance Score.

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹3,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Project Manager supports S2P delivery by managing the backlog in a blended Kanban/Scrum model—driving refinement, ensuring stories meet requirement standards, and routing enablers to the Program Manager. The role supports PI prioritization, manages QC to ensure documentation compliance, and maintains delivery artifacts and reporting. This position also coordinates mini-project scheduling and may lead small projects, proactively managing timelines, “RAID” items, dependencies, and continuous process improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and manage the backlog process for all Source to Pay functions using a Kanban or Scrum approach, ensuring transparency, prioritization, and readiness for delivery.

* Stories contain clearly defined requirements (e.g., objective, scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, estimates, priority), meeting definition of ready.
* Enablers are identified with clearly documented objectives, outputs, and prioritized.
* Manage a QC process to ensure Program Managers adhere to documentation guidelines
* Drive the Program Increment (PI) prioritization process, partnering with stakeholders to intake work, align priorities, and sequence items based on value and need.
* Manage small project scheduling and coordination, including creating the structure, processes, and templates to develop timeline tracking, task sequencing, meeting coordination, and follow-up on action items.
* Manage projects as needed, including planning, prioritization, scope tracking, status reporting, and risk/issue/dependency (RAID) management.
* Maintain delivery artifacts and reporting (e.g., project minutes and action items, approval, testing and other documentation, decision logs, and schedules).
* Identify and escalate blockers, risks, and cross-team dependencies; propose resolution options and coordinate next steps.
* Promote continuous improvement in intake, prioritization, refinement, and flow efficiency across the S2P delivery process.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience
* 3+ years in Project Management/Agile delivery role utilizing Scrum and/or Kanban
* Scrum Master Certification or Service Delivery Manager
* Experience writing/supporting user stories (scope, acceptance criteria) and tracking dependencies/estimates.
* Experience managing a PI/quarterly prioritization (or similar intake and sequencing) process.
* Enforce documentation standards by managing a quality control process.
* Proficient with Jira/Confluence and MS Office (Excel/PowerPoint/Visio)
* Experience with identifying and developing process metrics

**Desired Characteristics**

* Familiarity with Source to Pay teams and Coupa preferred.
* Experience summarizing complex projects, risks, or ideas to Senior Leadership in a concise manner.
* Detail-oriented and documentation-focused; produces audit-ready artifacts.
* Comfortable with ambiguity with ability to break work down for sequencing.
* Strong organization, communication and facilitation skills
* Proactive communicator who escalates risks/dependencies early and drives follow-through.
* Continuous improvement and curious mindset with interest in flow/throughput metrics.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience

title: Project Manager-eClinical Solutions
description:
Position: Project Manager – eClinical Solutions

Location: Ahmedabad

Job Summary:

As a Project Manager, you will play a pivotal role in spearheading the successful implementation of eClinical Solutions for clinical research organizations. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Clinical Operations, IT, and Quality Assurance, you will drive process reengineering initiatives to optimize clinical operations workflows and enhance data management efficiency. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in managing changes related to technology implementation, ensuring seamless adoption and alignment with organizational objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Lead and manage end-to-end implementation projects of eClinical Solutions for research organizations, from planning and execution to monitoring and delivery, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.

2. Collaborate with external stakeholders, including Clinical Operations and/or Clinical Data Management, to gather requirements and define project scopes for technology implementation and business process reengineering initiatives.

3. Develop comprehensive project plans, including resource allocation, risk assessment, and mitigation strategies, to drive successful execution.

4. Coordinate with internal stakeholders and partners to facilitate the implementation of eClinical Solutions and ensure a smooth implementation process.

5. Identify opportunities for process optimization and reengineering to enhance clinical operations, data collection, and analysis efficiency.

6. Champion change management efforts, including communication, training, and support, to drive user adoption and maximize the benefits of implemented solutions.

7. Establish and maintain effective communication channels with project team members, stakeholders, and senior management to provide regular updates and manage expectations.

8. Monitor project progress, identify deviations from the plan, and proactively resolve issues to keep projects on track.

9. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and best practices in all project activities, with a strong focus on Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines.

10. Continuously evaluate the performance and impact of implemented eClinical Solutions, seeking feedback from end-users, and implementing iterative improvements as needed.

Qualifications and Skills:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in a relevant scientific or technical field.

2. Proven experience (3+ years) as a Project Manager in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or clinical research industry, with a strong background in Clinical Operations.

3. Demonstrated expertise in managing technology implementation projects, particularly eClinical Solutions such as Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems, Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS), and related tools.

4. Comprehensive understanding of clinical research processes and regulatory guidelines (e.g., ICH-GCP) governing clinical trials.

5. Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and lead cross-functional teams effectively.

6. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a keen eye for identifying opportunities for process optimization and reengineering.

7. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is a plus.

8. Familiarity with software development life cycle (SDLC) and Agile methodologies is an advantage.

* we offer a collaborative and dynamic work environment that fosters innovation and professional growth. If you are passionate about transforming clinical research through eClinical Solutions and process reengineering, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

* Understanding of Agile and Waterfall project management methodologies.
* Familiarity with project resource planning, risk management, change management, and project reporting

title: Technical Lead – AI & Data Engineering
description:
Job Title: Technical Lead – AI & Data Engineering Location: Hybrid – Ahmedabad Office / Remote Department: Data Engineering & AI Experience Level: 7+ Years (with at least 2+ years leading/managing technical teams)

About the Role We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Technical Lead – AI & Data Engineering to spearhead our data and AI initiatives from initial requirement gathering through to production deployment and monitoring. In this role, you will lead a cross functional team of data engineers and AI/ML developers, serving as the technical anchor for end-to-end delivery. You will drive architectural decisions across robust ETL/ELT pipelines, relational databases (PostgreSQL, SQL Server), and Power BI semantic models (DAX), while designing enterprise-grade AI and Generative AI systems (RAG workflows, vector search, Azure OpenAI). The ideal candidate pairs deep technical mastery with proven team-handling experience, translating business challenges into production-ready software with strict performance, cost, and reliability benchmarks.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the entire engineering lifecycle: lead requirement discovery, translate business requirements into technical roadmaps, design high- and low-level architectures, and oversee deployment to production.
* Interface directly with product owners, stakeholders, and business analysts to clarify functional expectations, identify edge cases, and define acceptance criteria.
* Establish engineering standards, production deployment strategies (blue/green, canary), rollback procedures, and post-launch maintenance workflows.
* 2. Technical Leadership & Team Management
* Lead, mentor, and coach a team of junior-to-mid-level AI and data engineers, conducting 1-on-1s, technical goal setting, and skills development.
* Own resource planning, sprint estimation, sprint planning, task delegation, and delivery tracking in an Agile framework.
* Enforce rigorous code quality, schema management, and architectural integrity through strict PR reviews, testing standards, and Git workflows.

* Architect, automate, and govern resilient ETL/ELT data pipelines using Python and Azure cloud services.
* Direct data cleansing, validation, normalization, and semantic data layer development to provide clean data for downstream analytics and AI.
* Guide database modelling, stored procedure optimization, indexing strategies, and execution plan analysis across PostgreSQL and SQL Server (SSMS).
* Oversee programmatic extraction and tabular aggregation directly from Power BI reports and semantic models using DAX.
* 4. AI, GenAI & Model Performance Engineering
* Lead the design and integration of AI/GenAI architectures (RAG systems, prompt orchestration, vector search integrations with Azure OpenAI).
* Drive inference optimization strategies to maintain low latency and compute expenses: token usage control, caching, smart chunking, ONNX runtime conversion, quantization, batching, and hardware profiling (CPU/GPU).
* Implement enterprise MLOps/LLMOps monitoring for staging and production, tracking model throughput, latency, accuracy, regression, and data drift.
* 5. CI/CD, DevOps & Operational Excellence
* Own production deployment automation via robust CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).
* Define logging, telemetry, anomaly detection, and alerting standards to minimize production downtime and pipeline breakages.



**Qualifications**

* Required Qualifications & Technical Skills
* Experience: 7+ years of hands-on technical experience across data engineering, analytics engineering, or applied AI/ML systems, including 2+ years of formal leadership or team management experience.
* Full Lifecycle Delivery: Proven track record of owning projects from initial requirement discovery and architecture design through deployment, production rollout, and operational monitoring.



**Required Skills**

* Databases & Querying:
* Advanced proficiency in PostgreSQL and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), including database design, query optimization, indexing, and deep execution plan profiling.
* Strong working proficiency in writing and optimizing DAX queries against Power BI datasets and tabular models.
* Programming & Pipeline Engineering:
* Expert-level Python skills (Pandas, Pytorch,NumPy, SQLAlchemy, PySpark/data manipulation frameworks).
* Production experience building automated, scheduled data pipelines (Azure Data Factory, orchestrators).
* AI, GenAI & Performance Optimization:
* Hands-on experience architecting GenAI workflows (RAG, embeddings, vector databases, Azure OpenAI).
* Proven experience with model runtime acceleration, caching, quantization, and profiling techniques (e.g., ONNX Runtime, GPU/CPU profiling).
* Statistical Rigor & Data Quality:
* Strong grasp of applied statistics, sampling, hypothesis testing, anomaly detection, and ML evaluation metrics (precision, recall, MSE, perplexity).
* Cloud & DevOps:
* Hands-on expertise with the Azure ecosystem (Azure Data Factory, Blob Storage / ADLS, Azure OpenAI, Azure Keyault).
* Advanced Git/GitHub management, branching strategy enforcement, and automated CI/CD pipeline management (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions).



**Preferred Skills**

* Advanced hands-on experience in Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures, including multi-agent orchestration, tool calling, and autonomous workflow design.
* Experience with LLM frameworks and vector search systems such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Azure AI Search.

title: User Interface Designer
description:
**Company Description**
MiniMines is a clean-tech company focused on sustainable and efficient Li-Ion battery recycling within the electric vehicle ecosystem. The organization is dedicated to building a circular economy for energy storage devices through responsible sourcing, collection of spent batteries, and recovery of battery-grade materials. Its operations are driven by advanced research and environmentally sustainable processes that support long-term resource efficiency. Using a proprietary HYBRID-HYDROMERALLURGY™ process, MiniMines extracts high-value compounds such as Nickel, Cobalt, Lithium, and Manganese, along with pure copper, alumina, and spherical graphite from mineral-rich “BlackMass.” These recovered materials can be directly used in the manufacturing of new Li-Ion cells, helping reduce waste and dependence on virgin resources.

**Role Description**
The User Interface Designer role at MiniMines is a full-time, on-site position based in Bengaluru. In this role, the designer will create intuitive and visually engaging interfaces for web and internal tools that support clean-tech and battery recycling operations. Day-to-day responsibilities include designing layouts, components, and interactive elements, preparing high-fidelity mockups, and collaborating closely with UX designers, product managers, and engineering teams. The User Interface Designer will translate complex technical concepts into clear, user-friendly designs and ensure consistency across all digital touchpoints. The role also involves iterating based on user feedback, supporting front-end implementation, and maintaining design systems that align with MiniMines’ brand and sustainability-focused mission.

**Qualifications**

* Strong skills in User Interface Design and Visual Design, with the ability to create clean, consistent, and accessible interfaces.
* Experience producing detailed Mockups and interface specifications to guide development teams.
* Understanding of User Experience (UX) principles and usability best practices, including collaboration with UX research or product teams.
* Basic to intermediate Front-End Development skills (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript) to support design handoff and implementation.
* Proficiency with modern design and prototyping tools (such as Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar).
* Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and communicate design decisions clearly.
* Attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and an interest in sustainability, clean-tech, or the electric vehicle ecosystem.
* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Visual Communication, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Senior Graphic Designer -Matrimony
description:
**About Lokal**
In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren't really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they'd come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalizing.
  
  
Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
  
  
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they've always deserved. We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:
  
  

* Edutainment & Skill Learning - practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
* Matrimonial Matchmaking - hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
* Agri Consulting - farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
* Local Jobs - blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
* Social & Community - Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
* Emotional Well-being & Peer Support - safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
* Astrology & Guidance - instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
* Advisory Services - early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we've built, they don't wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.This is the story new teammates walk into:
  
  
a company that started as a WhatsApp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the center — access changes lives. We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat. We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.
  
  
**About Lokal Matrimony**
Lokal Matrimony is a hyperlocal matrimony platform focused on helping people discover compatible life partners based on their preferences, community, and regional connections. Our mission is to make partner search more relevant, convenient, and accessible through a compatibility-first approach that helps users find meaningful relationships.

**Senior Graphic Designer**
to bring the Lokal Matrimony experience to life through compelling visual designs. The role involves creating engaging social media creatives, promotional banners, campaign visuals, and performance marketing ads that connect with audiences, communicate the platform's value, build trust, and drive user engagement and app installs.

The role involves designing engaging creatives for social media, digital advertising campaigns, app promotions, and brand communication, with a strong focus on attracting users, driving engagement, and supporting app installs.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have a strong design portfolio, a good understanding of digital advertising, and the ability to translate marketing objectives into compelling visual creatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design engaging visual creatives for Facebook, Instagram, and other digital platforms
* Create high-performing ad creatives, promotional banners, festival creatives, and campaign visuals for Lokal Matrimony
* Develop creative assets for Meta Ads, influencer campaigns, and user acquisition initiatives

**Requirements**

title: Senior Product Designer II
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
You'll be designing with more human behavior data than almost anywhere else on the planet.
  
  
At Nielsen, we measure how billions of people watch, listen, and buy across the globe. As a Senior Product Designer II, you'll help build the design vision for major product lines and platforms, turning this huge, complex dataset into products that media professionals, advertisers, and agencies rely on for critical business decisions.
  
  
You'll work on problems where neither the question nor the answer is defined yet. What should cross-media measurement look like three years from now? How do we bring a fragmented product suite into one coherent experience? Which initiatives move the business, and which ones should we stop?
  
  
If you love shaping product direction, solving the hardest design problems, and raising the bar for the people around you, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Build the design vision for major product lines**
Set the direction for entire products or platforms, not just features. Your work connects user needs to business outcomes and shapes design standards across Nielsen.
  
  
**Solve The Problems Others Struggle With**
Lead core architectural changes, redesigns of critical flows, and high-priority initiatives where craft has to hold up under pressure. Work at the tactical and strategic level at the same time, across several projects.
  
  
**Set research strategy for ambiguous problems**
Decide which questions need answering and which methods fit, then guide the team through the work. Use behavioral data and research to shape product direction and fill gaps in what partners know.
  
  
**Influence the roadmap**
Negotiate trade-offs between Product, Engineering, and Design. Build data-backed cases for design-led initiatives that change priorities at the leadership level, and say so clearly when a project is high-effort but low-outcome.
  
  
**Evolve our design system**
Bring new patterns and help make governance decisions for the design system used across Nielsen's global products. Know when to go beyond the system, and be able to explain why.
  
  
**Grow the team around you**
Mentor designers, run workshops and design jams, and advocate for your teammates' growth. Improve how design works with other functions, from handoffs to sprint planning.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**What You Bring**
**You think in systems and business outcomes**
You understand the P&L and the competitive landscape, and you can explain how a design decision affects retention, LTV, conversion, or differentiation. You look for root causes: when the same mistakes keep happening, you fix the process that's causing them.
  
  
**You thrive in strategic ambiguity**
You're comfortable when both the problem and the solution are undefined. You run discovery that defines new product directions, and you create frameworks that help others work through uncertainty. You can make high-stakes calls with incomplete information.
  
  
**Your craft is a reference point**
Your work is detailed, handles edge cases thoroughly, and is used as an example for the team. You use high-quality prototypes and clear storytelling to get executives and partners behind an idea.
  
  
**You lead without a title**
You act as a design leader with or without formal authority. You build alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities and take ownership of outcomes beyond your own team.
  
  
**You've designed for complexity at scale**
Your portfolio shows dashboards, enterprise tools, or analytics platforms where you owned the direction, not just the screens. You can talk about sampling, statistical significance, and data pipelines with data scientists and engineers.
  
  
**You Keep Learning And Help Others Learn**
You follow emerging technologies like AI and what they mean for design, you're open to contrarian views, and you encourage experimentation and learning from failure.
  
  
**7+ years of experience**
Including significant time leading design for complex products. Experience with data-heavy or enterprise products is a strong plus. Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or equivalent professional experience (formal education not required).
  
  
**Strong portfolio**
Show us how you shaped direction on ambiguous problems, the trade-offs you negotiated, and the measurable business impact of your work.
  
  
**Proficiency in design tools**
Expert in Figma and prototyping tools. You build advanced prototypes that feel like the real product.
  
  
**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Multimedia Designer
description:
**THREE CRAFTS, ONE JOB — READ THIS LINE BEFORE ANY OTHER:**

This role is graphic and brand design, AND video editing, AND product interface design. Not one of them. Not two. Your portfolio must show all three, and the very first application question asks you to confirm it — answer No and the application ends there.

If you specialise in one craft and want to keep specialising, this is a good job for someone else. We would rather you knew that in the first ten seconds than in week three.

**READ THIS SECOND — THE DATES THAT CANNOT MOVE:**

* **In-person interview:**
  20–30 November 2026, at our Bengaluru office. It cannot be done online.
* **Applications close:**
  15 November 2026. We interview on a rolling basis and may close early once filled.
* **All online rounds complete by:**
  19 November 2026.
* **Joining date:**
  1 December 2026. Non-negotiable.

You must be free of notice period obligations by 1 December. If you are serving a 60 or 90-day notice, the timing will not work and we cannot make an exception.

Please read this all the way to the end before applying. It is long on purpose — it tells you exactly what the job is, what it is not, and what we will not budge on. Applications from people who clearly have not read it are easy to spot, and we do not take them forward.

**WHO WE ARE:**

Jane Aerospace is a Bengaluru-based aerospace and drone supply chain company. We source aircraft parts, drone components and industrial materials for operators, MROs and manufacturers, and we are building Supply Chain as a Service — a subscription model that takes over procurement for our clients entirely.

We run three companies — in India, Hong Kong and the UAE — and you would work across all three. We are bootstrapped, we are small, and people here own real things early.

**THE ROLE:**

You would be the only designer in the company, serving both marketing and the engineering side.

ONE THING WE WANT TO BE HONEST ABOUT. Nobody at one to three years is world-class at all three of these, and we are not pretending otherwise. We want someone genuinely strong in at least one, competent in the other two, and hungry to get better at all of them.

WHERE THE HOURS ACTUALLY GO. About 60% of your week is marketing craft — graphic and video. About 40% is product interface work. Interface design is the smaller share and the hardest of the three to replace, so we test it carefully. But if graphic and video are not real strengths of yours, you will be underwater from week one.

The second honest thing: this is a lot of work for one person, and we know it. The video volume is capped in writing below rather than left open, and if the work justifies it we expect to add a second designer around March or April. We would rather tell you now than have you discover the load in month two.

WHO HOLDS YOUR QUEUE. The Marketing Specialist holds it, so two teams cannot pull you in opposite directions at once. That protection is deliberate: this role fails when nobody owns the queue, because then everything is urgent, interface work always slips — it has no weekly deadline — and a year later the company has a lot of social posts and no design system.

**WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO:**

**Brand and graphic — the guidelines exist, the system does not -**

* Own and extend the Jane brand system. We have a brand guidelines document. What we do not have is the working apparatus built from it: templates, deck and document masters, social formats, and a version that holds across three companies with three audiences. That is yours to build.
* Produce social and campaign creative against the marketing calendar, for three companies that each keep their own identity.
* Create recruitment and careers creative. We are hiring seven people right now and will hire more.

**Video — capped, and the cap is real -**

Our content model is one substantial long-form piece per brand, cut down into everything else.

* **Long-form edits:**
  about 6 a month. Founder explainers, field reports, podcast and interview appearances.
* **Short-form derivatives:**
  cut from those 6. Clips and stills for Instagram and LinkedIn, across three brands.
* **Everything beyond that:**
  agreed case by case. Not an open queue.

We wrote the cap down because an uncapped video queue is the most reliable way to destroy a role like this. The derivatives are the part that expands without anyone noticing.

**Product interface — about 40% of your time -**

* Design the interfaces for our internal tools and customer-facing products: the hiring and assessment platform, the BD dashboards, and the SCaaS front end.
* Work directly with our engineering team to get your designs built properly rather than approximately.
* Take design off the engineers. They currently design their own screens because there is nobody else to do it, and that stops being their job when you join.

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT:**

* It is not a pure product design job. If interface work is all you want to do, you will be frustrated here 60% of the time.
* It is not a video production house. You edit; we are not building a studio.
* It is not an agency brief-taking role. You make the work.
* It is not marketing strategy. The Marketing Specialist owns the calendar and the angle; you own how it looks.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* 1 to 3 years in design. This is not a fresher role.
* **MANDATORY — a portfolio containing ALL THREE:**
  a body of marketing and brand creative, edited video you cut yourself, and at least one real product or app interface. A portfolio that is all posters, or all app screens, does not qualify. An application without a portfolio link will not be reviewed.
* Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve for editing, and After Effects or equivalent for basic motion.
* Figma to a professional standard — components and systems, not just static frames.
* A real grasp of hierarchy, legibility and accessibility, not just what looks good.
* You can explain WHY you made a design decision, not just show the result. We will ask, in person, and we will keep asking.
* You can work from a written brief without being walked through it.
* Nice to have, not required: a design system built from scratch; data visualisation and dashboard design; deeper motion graphics, sound design or subtitling.

**PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:**

We mean this sincerely — it saves everyone time.

* Your portfolio does not show all three crafts.
* You cannot attend an in-person interview in Bengaluru between 20 and 30 November 2026.
* You cannot join on 1 December 2026, for any reason, including notice period.
* You are not in Bengaluru and are not willing to relocate here at your own arrangement before joining.
* You are looking for a work-from-home or hybrid role. This is fully work from office.
* Your portfolio is entirely template-based work with no original system design.
* Your video reel is entirely stock footage.
* You want to specialise narrowly in one craft right now.

**WHAT YOU GET PAID:**

₹40,000 to ₹45,000 per month CTC (₹4.8–5.4 lakh per annum), depending on experience and on the strength of your portfolio. CTC means cost to company; your in-hand figure will be lower after statutory deductions, and we will show you the exact breakdown at offer stage.

* Compensation reviewed formally at six months and at twelve months, against evidence.
* A proper machine and the software you need, including AI tooling. We do not expect you to pay for your own licences.
* PF and ESI as per statute.

The real compensation here is the ownership. You would take a brand from a guidelines document to the thing three companies actually run on, and design the products as well as the marketing. Most designers wait years to own that much surface.

**OUR HIRING PROCESS:**

Four rounds. We have deliberately kept the unpaid work small.

1. **Application —**
   short questions and your portfolio link. The portfolio is mandatory and must show all three disciplines.
2. **Craft test —**
   timed, online, around 45 minutes. A critique of an existing interface, and your written reasoning against a short design brief.
3. **Video interview —**
   recorded, online. You explain the thinking behind your own craft test answers.
4. **In-person with the Managing Director —**
   Bengaluru, 20–30 November. Includes a full portfolio walkthrough: bring the work and expect to be asked why, repeatedly.

The walkthrough sits in the in-person round on purpose. It is only worth anything if the person listening can ask the next question, and the one after that. We are not willing to automate that.

ON AI: use it. We do, and we expect you to. But you will be asked to account for your own decisions in rounds three and four, and work you cannot explain is worth nothing to us.

**HOW TO APPLY:**

One last time: if you skipped to this section, go back and read the rest. The answers to most of what you are about to be asked are above.

Apply through the link on this posting and answer the application questions in full. Attach your CV, your portfolio link, and a short covering note in your own words. We read the notes, and the ones with a real voice get read twice.

Jane Aerospace Pvt Ltd · Bengaluru, India

We hire on evidence and demonstrated work, and we welcome applications from every background.

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Specialist
description:
Key Responsibilities:

● Analyze the end-to-end e-commerce funnel to identify where Canadian shoppers abandon or

experience friction in the customer journey.

● Compare customer behavior and conversion performance across the Canadian and U.S. Shopify

storefronts to identify meaningful performance gaps.

● Review, validate, and correct analytics, campaign tracking, pixels, and conversion-tracking

configurations.

● Diagnose and resolve site, Shopify theme, browser, device, and performance-related issues that

affect conversion.

● Develop and manage a structured conversion rate optimization and A/B testing roadmap.

● Formulate hypotheses, define success metrics, prioritize tests, and evaluate experiment results.

● Improve the usability and customer experience of product, collection, cart, and checkout pages.

● Use quantitative analytics and customer-behavior insights to recommend conversion

improvements.

● Monitor and report the impact of implemented changes on conversion rate, revenue per visitor,

and related e-commerce performance indicators.

● Partner with marketing, design, e-commerce, and other stakeholders to prioritize and implement

improvements.

● Translate analytical findings into clear, commercially focused recommendations and measurable

actions.

Mandatory Skills Required

● 5+ years of direct-to-consumer e-commerce experience.

● Demonstrated success in improving e-commerce conversion performance.

● Strong experience with: E-commerce funnel analysis, Conversion rate optimization, A/B and

multivariate testing, Analytics and conversion-tracking implementation, Customer-behavior

analysis and Campaign tracking using UTMs

● Hands-on experience improving UX/UI across: Product detail pages, Collection or category pages,

Cart experiences, Checkout journeys and Strong working knowledge of Shopify.

● Ability to diagnose Shopify theme and site-performance issues across browsers and devices.

● Experience with Liquid themes and Shopify Markets.

● Proficiency with Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager.

● Experience with Microsoft Clarity or Hotjar.

● Working knowledge of Meta Pixel and Conversions API.

● Experience using an experimentation platform such as VWO, Convert, or Optimizely.

● Ability to measure and communicate the commercial impact of changes using conversion rate,

revenue per visitor, and related performance metrics.

● Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with marketing,

design, and e-commerce stakeholders.

Core Technologies

● Shopify; Shopify Plus experience is preferred.

● Liquid themes and Shopify Markets

● Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

● Google Tag Manager

● Microsoft Clarity or Hotjar

● Meta Pixel and Conversions API

● Campaign tracking using UTMs

● VWO, Convert, or Optimizely

● Figma

Nice to Have Skills:

● Shopify Plus experience.

● Experience in beauty, skincare, or wellness e-commerce.

● Working knowledge of Figma.

● Google Analytics certification.

● CXL Conversion Optimization certification or training.

● Nielsen Norman Group UX certification or training.

● Shopify Partner credentials.

title: Marketing Executive (Design)
description:
***While applying for this role, please attach your portfolio including examples of video and written content and assets / collateral***

***you've created. We cannot accept applications that do not have a link included.***

**Marketing Executive**

**MishiPay - Global POS / Checkout / Retail Technology**

**Competitive Basic Salary and Bonus**

**Bangalore (office based plus 36 WFH days a year)**

**Unlimited Holidays**

**About MishiPay**

**MishiPay**
is an international, leading checkout technology company that empowers shoppers to checkout in-store using either self-checkout via their own smartphones, or using MishiPay's industry leading, minimalist, low cap-ex kiosks. We are creating an enjoyable and convenient in-store shopping experience for leading retailers globally.

MishiPay now also runs Mobile POS, Click and Collect and Cash registers, so that merchants, who initially start with our self-checkout, can eventually run their whole store checkout process on MishiPay. With our technology, retailers have proven reductions in cost, due to requiring fewer cashiers, a marked increase in sales due to improved basket sizes, higher frequency of shopper visits and reduction in abandoned baskets, and in addition, all our retailers can access rich and priceless data about their customers. This enables a much better understanding of the customer journey in their bricks and mortar stores.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a highly creative, intuitive B2B SaaS/Retail Technology Marketing Executive to join our growing marketing team and support the execution of MishiPay’s global marketing activities. This is a multi-faceted design-led Marketing role, covering content and collateral design, video and creative production, events, digital marketing, social media, marketing operations and sales enablement.

You MUST have 2-3 years of highly creative B2B Marketing experience gained within a fast-paced business, ideally technology/SaaS. It’s essential that you have Canva/Adobe/Capcut and can create and edit B2B videos from scratch. You'll have also created content and collateral for social media (Linkedin etc) posts, case studies, sales and events such as trade shows. As such, you’ll have demonstrative creative skills and experience across graphic design, visual storytelling, digital content, social media assets, presentations, campaign materials and brand communications, ensuring everything you produce is visually engaging, polished and consistent with our brand identity. We'd love to see this in your portfolio, so please ensure a link is added to your application.

You’ll also be highly organised, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple projects and stakeholders at the same time. You will work closely with the Marketing Manager and internal teams to ensure marketing activities are delivered on time and to a high standard, while also creating engaging visual, written, and video content that supports MishiPay’s brand and commercial objectives.

This role offers the opportunity to work across global campaigns, retail events, customer-facing content, digital channels, and creative projects in a fast-growing international technology company.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and develop marketing collateral and creative assets, including brochures, presentations, one-pagers, product guides, case studies, event materials, social media creatives, and digital/print assets.
* Create and edit marketing videos from scratch, including product, customer, event, social media, and promotional content, based on briefs and direction from the Marketing Manager.
* Support content creation and manage the day-to-day production of marketing assets across campaigns, events, website, social media, and sales materials.
* Maintain marketing calendars, task trackers, project timelines, and action lists, ensuring activities stay on track and deadlines are met.
* Support the planning and execution of trade shows, events, customer meetings, and other marketing activities, including logistics and marketing materials.
* Coordinate with internal teams, agencies, vendors, suppliers, and partners to manage deliverables and follow-ups.
* Support social media and website activities, including content scheduling, website updates, landing pages, and other digital marketing requirements.
* Assist with customer case studies, market and competitor research, and other content or marketing initiatives.
* Organise and maintain marketing files, creative assets, databases, and content libraries, and support the preparation of reports, presentations, and internal communications.
* Assist the Marketing Manager with ad hoc marketing projects, meetings, action points, and other day-to-day marketing requirements.
* Design and develop marketing collateral and creative assets, including brochures, presentations, one-pagers, product guides, case studies, event materials, social media creatives, and other digital/print assets.
* Create and edit marketing videos, including product, customer, event, social media, and promotional content, based on briefs and direction from the Marketing Manager

**About You**

* 2–3 years of experience in B2B marketing, marketing operations, or an in-house creative/marketing role within a SaaS, retail technology, or technology company.
* Strong hands-on skills in
  **Figma, Canva, or Adobe Creative Suite**
  (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop).
* Experience with video editing tools such as
  **Premiere Pro, After Effects, or CapCut**
  .
* Working knowledge of
  **HubSpot**
  , a CMS such as
  **WordPress**
  , and project/task management tools.
* Strong organisational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* A hands-on, execution-focused approach, with the ability to work independently while coordinating with multiple stakeholders.

**Why MishiPay?**

You’ll work with an inspirational multi-cultural team, based in our Dubai HQ, the US, London, Bangalore, who are redefining the retail industry globally. We offer a tight-knit, collaborative and exciting work environment, coupled with the opportunity to see the apps we develop live in action within some of the world’s largest retailers, impacting the lives of millions of shoppers.

**We also offer:**

* Bonuses
* Unlimited holidays
* Hybrid Working (36 days WFH a year)
* Monthly Employee Awards
* A small monthly training budget
* Company events
* Free lunch in Bangalore
* MacBook
* Career progression and a chance to work with some of the brightest minds in tech.

title: Lead UX Research

**About Revun**
Revun is building a next-generation software platform designed to modernize how property owners, property managers, brokerages, maintenance providers, service professionals, and real estate organizations operate.
  
  
The platform combines CRM, leasing, maintenance, accounting, payments, communications, workflow automation, compliance, reporting, AI, integrations, and stakeholder portals into a single operating platform.
  
  
Our goal is not to build another collection of disconnected software tools. We are building an operational platform that simplifies complex business processes, reduces manual work, improves visibility, and helps organizations operate more efficiently.
  
  
The product is already underway, and we are now looking for a strong product designer who can help turn a complex platform into an intuitive, professional, scalable, and commercially ready user experience.
  
  
**About The Role**
Revun is hiring a
**Senior Product Designer (UX/UI)**
to lead the design of our web and mobile product experience.
  
  
This is not a graphic design role, and it is not a role focused only on creating attractive screens.
  
  
We are looking for someone who understands how to design real software products, including complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, dashboards, workflows, portals, mobile apps, and multi-user systems.
  
  
You will work closely with leadership, engineering, and product stakeholders to simplify complex workflows, improve usability, create scalable design systems, and help prepare the platform for commercial launch.
  
  
The successful candidate must be able to think through product flows, user journeys, permissions, edge cases, responsive layouts, information hierarchy, and design handoff — not just visual styling.
  
  
You should also be comfortable using AI tools to improve your design process, speed up research and ideation, organize complex requirements, generate UX copy, explore layout options, create user flows, and improve documentation while still applying your own product judgment.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Please submit your
**resume and portfolio**
for consideration.
  
  
Your portfolio should include examples of real product-design work, such as user flows, dashboards, complex interfaces, mobile screens, design systems, marketplace workflows, SaaS platforms, or similar product examples.
  
  
Candidates with only branding, landing pages, social media graphics, or marketing websites will not be the strongest fit for this role.
  
  
Qualified candidates will be invited to complete a pre-recorded video interview 24-48 hours after applying as the next step in the hiring process.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Design user-friendly web and mobile experiences for a complex SaaS and marketplace-style platform
* Create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and developer-ready UI specifications
* Design workflows for multiple user types, including internal users, property owners, tenants, vendors, service providers, partners, and administrators
* Translate complex business processes into simple, intuitive product experiences
* Work closely with leadership and engineering to turn product vision into clear, usable, buildable designs
* Improve the overall information architecture, navigation, dashboard structure, forms, portals, workflows, and mobile experience
* Design and maintain scalable design systems, reusable components, UI patterns, and style standards
* Create clean, professional, modern, and consistent product interfaces
* Identify gaps, edge cases, confusing user flows, and areas where the product experience can be simplified
* Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented accurately
* Review builds and provide design QA feedback before release
* Use AI tools responsibly to speed up research, ideation, UX writing, documentation, design exploration, and workflow development
* Validate AI-assisted design outputs through human judgment, user needs, business requirements, and product logic
* Support commercial launch readiness by ensuring the platform is easy to understand, easy to use, and visually consistent

**Required Experience**

* 6+ years of UX/UI, Product Design, or related digital product design experience
* Experience designing complex SaaS platforms, marketplace applications, CRM systems, workflow platforms, fintech products, operational dashboards, or other multi-role software products
* Strong experience designing both web and mobile product experiences
* Strong Figma skills, including components, Auto Layout, variants, design systems, prototyping, and developer handoff
* Experience designing dashboards, forms, tables, workflows, portals, user profiles, settings, notifications, and role-based user experiences
* Experience working directly with engineers and product stakeholders
* Strong understanding of user flows, information architecture, interaction design, usability, visual hierarchy, responsive design, and design systems
* Experience using AI tools to support design work, UX writing, research synthesis, user-flow creation, wireframing, prototyping, or product documentation
* Ability to explain design decisions clearly and connect them to user needs, business goals, and technical feasibility
* Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, developer-ready designs
* Strong written and spoken English
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment

**Strongly Preferred Experience**

* Experience designing marketplace platforms or multi-sided products
* Experience with property technology, real estate platforms, maintenance platforms, field-service software, booking platforms, fintech, CRM systems, or enterprise workflow software
* Experience designing products with multiple user types and role-based permissions
* Experience designing payment, transaction, vendor, booking, service-request, or dashboard workflows
* Experience designing AI-powered product features or AI-assisted workflows
* Experience improving an existing product rather than only designing from scratch
* Experience working in startups or fast-moving product environments
* Experience with usability testing, product analytics, user research, or customer feedback loops
* Experience creating design systems from the ground up

AI Expectations
  
  
We are looking for a designer who uses AI as a productivity tool, not as a substitute for product judgment.
  
  
**You Should Be Comfortable Using AI To Help With**

* UX research organization
* User-flow exploration
* Wireframe ideation
* Interface-copy options
* Product requirement organization
* Edge-case discovery
* Design-system documentation
* Competitive research summaries
* Prototype concepts
* Usability-test summaries
* Design iteration

However, you must still review, validate, and improve all AI-assisted work yourself. Final design decisions must be based on user needs, product logic, business goals, usability, accessibility, and technical feasibility.
  
  
The Person We Are Looking For
  
  
You are a true product thinker.
  
  
You do not just make screens look good — you understand how people actually use software.
  
  
You can take a complicated workflow and make it feel clear, simple, and logical.
  
  
You are comfortable designing for different types of users who each need different information, permissions, dashboards, and actions.

What Success Looks Like

* Troubleshoot front-end issues, improve existing applications, and implement enhancements based on business needs.
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT), technical documentation, deployment, and ongoing application improvements.

* Experience designing user-friendly interfaces, navigation structures, and interactive components within SAC.

We are looking for a skilled n8n Automation Specialist & Web Designer who can build professional websites, create end-to-end automations, integrate third-party applications, and use AI tools to deliver projects efficiently.

The primary focus is n8n, Zapier, no-code website development, end-to-end integrations, and AI-assisted coding. The ideal candidate should be able to manage projects from website creation and automation setup to integration, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

Key Responsibilities

* Build, design, and maintain responsive websites using WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Framer, and Webflow.
* Create professional business websites, landing pages, forms, and e-commerce experiences with strong UI/UX.
* Use AI tools to build, customize, and improve websites efficiently.

n8n Automation Specialist & Web Designer
