title: Graphic and Motion Designer
description:
If you notice the typography on every ad you scroll past, your Pinterest boards are full of layouts you want to recreate, and you have already imagined how each one would move, this role is for you. Want your static and motion work to go live for real brands, fast? Come to a small agency where it ships quickly.

EXPERIENCE: 1 to 3 years (Agency experience is a must)

TYPE: Full-time (6 days working: Mon, Wed & Fri will WFO, rest WFH)

REPORTS TO: Creative Strategist

LOCATION: Andheri (W), Mumbai (onsite)

Application will be
**AUTO REJECTED**
if: You are not an immediate joiner, or you are a fresher, or your current in-hand salary is above Rs 50,000/-

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a Graphic & Motion Designer with strong fundamentals and a sharp visual eye, who leads with great static design, understands motion, and is curious about AI workflows. As a startup, our roles keep evolving, so you will wear many hats.

**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

• Design high-quality static visuals across Instagram, LinkedIn and ad campaigns for brands (posts, carousels, stories, infographics and thumbnails), adapted to every platform's formats and sizes

• Create motion graphics and animations for reels, ads and social content, from animated posts to short promo videos

• Build layouts, brand assets and creative concepts with a strong aesthetic point of view, keeping each brand's visual identity cohesive

• Turn briefs and ideas from the creative strategist and creative operations team into clear, on-brand visuals, and apply feedback quickly

• Use AI tools for ideation, concept generation, image and video creation, and faster workflows

• Support strategy and pitch decks when required

• Keep up with design trends, internet culture and emerging AI and motion tools

• Handle several client projects at once, keep files organised and deliver on deadline

**QUALIFICATIONS**

• 1–3 years in graphic and motion design (agency), backed by a strong portfolio showing both static and motion work (AI-assisted work is a big plus)

• A strong sense of typography, colour, layout and composition, with a good understanding of social media design and current design trends

• Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects and Premiere Pro, plus Figma and Canva

• Working knowledge of AI creative tools such as Higgsfield, Midjourney, Nano Banana, ChatGPT or Adobe Firefly, and keen to keep up with new ones

• Creative, collaborative and practical, with the ability to think conceptually, not just execute

• Strong attention to detail and consistency, comfortable taking feedback through multiple iterations, and able to deliver multiple projects within timelines

• Adaptable and happy to take ownership across functions in a small team

**BONUS POINTS**

• Experience designing static and motion ad creatives for D2C or performance campaigns

• Knowledge of InDesign

**ABOUT 9AV CREATIVE**

9AV Creative is an early-stage, Mumbai-based digital creative agency that's been building brands for 3 years+. We drive content-led growth across storytelling content & performance content, executing with live-action and AI production, or via creators. Our clients include brands like Polycab, Sting, Pluckk, Ugaoo, Gladful etc.

Website: www.9av.in

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/9av\_creative/

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/9avcreative/

Email: hiring@9av.in

**WHY JOIN 9AV?**

You will not be a tiny cog in a massive corporate machine. As a foundational team member at 9AV Creative, your work will have an immediate, visible impact on the agency's early success. You will get hands-on experience in every facet of creative production, performance marketing, and startup building, creating a formidable portfolio from day one.

• Real client brands from day one, not internal practice projects

• Ownership across the full arc of an idea from concept to camera to final cut

• A small team (3–4 people) where your ideas visibly move the needle

title: Product Intern - Stratzy (Raise)
description:
**Role Summary**

Raise is built on this core philosophy, we will bring exceptionally great products, awesome user

experience and best-in-class customer service to our users. We started with our first consumer product, Dhan, an investment and trading platform launched in November 2021.

Today,
**Dhan ranks #8 amongst stock brokers in India**
and continues to be one of the fastest-growing platforms in the investment and trading ecosystem.

In September 2026,
**Dhan was also recognised as Fintech Startup of the Year at the Global Fintech Festival,**
reflecting the innovation, product excellence and customer focus that continue to shape the platform. Backed by a passionate team of builders, believers, designers and problem-solvers, we are building a trusted ecosystem of financial products that empowers millions of users to make smarter financial decisions.

**Stratzy**
is an algorithmic investing and trading platform that makes rule-based, system-driven trading accessible to everyday investors. The platform offers 100+ ready-made, approved algorithmic strategies across equities, indices, F&O, and commodities, letting users pick and deploy structured strategies instead of having to build and monitor trades themselves.

We are looking for a curious, proactive and ownership-driven
**Product Intern**
to join the Stratzy Product team. This is an opportunity to work on real product challenges, contribute ideas, collaborate directly with the leadership team and help build features that solve actual user problems. You will gain hands-on experience in product management, user research, data analysis and product development.

This is a
**3 to 6 month internship**
, with a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) opportunity for high performers, based on performance and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of product features, improvements and experiments, from ideation to launch.
* Understand user needs and pain points, identify opportunities and suggest solutions to improve the product experience.
* Work closely with the leadership team to understand business priorities, share ideas and contribute to product decisions.
* Translate ideas and business problems into clear product requirements, user journeys and actionable tasks.
* Collaborate with design, engineering, marketing and customer support teams to bring product ideas to life.
* Analyse user behaviour, product data and customer feedback to identify opportunities and measure the impact of product improvements.
* Research competitors, market trends and emerging developments in fintech, investing and algorithmic trading.
* Interact with users, understand their experiences and bring actionable insights to the product roadmap.
* Track feature performance after launch and recommend improvements based on user feedback and data.

**Requirements**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in any discipline. Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics or related backgrounds are welcome, but not mandatory.
* Strong curiosity about digital products, technology, user behaviour and how businesses solve customer problems.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think logically and break down complex problems into simpler solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to share ideas and collaborate with different teams.
* A proactive mindset, willingness to learn and ability to take ownership in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable with numbers, analysing information and using data to support decisions.
* An interest in finance, stock markets, investing, trading or fintech is an advantage; prior knowledge of algorithmic trading is not mandatory.
* Prior internships, college projects, personal projects, product case studies or startup experience are welcome, but not essential.

We are a start-up organization focused on fast growth with quality products; hence, the ability to

work in a fast-paced environment goes without saying!

**If you are curious, enjoy solving problems and want hands-on experience building real products, we would love to hear from you!**

**Our People & Culture:**

People and culture are the most important aspects of our business.

We are looking for team members just like us, in simple words - good people to work with and

demonstrate following personality traits:

•
**Be super obsessed about ensuring customer satisfaction.**

(We are here because of our customers, and will be here only if we serve our customers)

•
**We have a single opportunity to serve.**

(Our customers will give us one opportunity to serve - we can’t let them down. Be it product,

uptimes, customer service or any interaction we have to deliver a wow experience.)

•
**Respect your work, your team, your co-workers and our customers.**

(The only way to get respect is to give it first)

•
**Speed is all that matters. Ship right and ship faster.**

(You either help the team move ahead fast, or you slow it down. We prefer the first.)

•
**Humility & politeness over arrogance & over-confidence.**

(If you are the smartest one in the room, bring up others to speed. We are here to serve our

customers, not to prove a point.)

•
**Quality over quantity.**

(It is fine if you pick up a few things to do, but do them exceedingly well.)

•
**Make your hands dirty irrespective of who you are.**

(Our CEO responds to customers every day. Our CTO codes every day. This is us.)

•
**Talent and Competency over Credentials.**

•
**Entrepreneurial, ownership driven and disciplined.**

(We trust you to help us gain and retain the trust of our customers and our stakeholders)

•
**Less words, more action.**

(Believe in something? show it by doing things. Not just by talking about it)

•
**Flat hierarchy with open culture & conversations.**

(You are among all of us, and we all are with you)

•
**Passionate about the business you are a part of.**

(Do it because you are passionate about it, not because it’s your job.)

**Why Join Raise?**

We’ve been recognised as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, reflecting the culture we’ve built and the way we work together. At Raise, you’ll experience a flat hierarchy, open conversations, high ownership and a strong bias for action. We value people who bring passion, humility and curiosity to their work, and who care deeply about building great products and creating meaningful customer impact.

We believe in growth with ownership, speed with thoughtfulness and ambition with humility. We

celebrate wins, learn from challenges and give people the ownership and responsibility to build and make an impact. If you enjoy building from the ground up, working with passionate people, and being part of a high-growth fintech ecosystem, Raise offers an environment where you can do meaningful work and grow with the business.

**About Raise Financial Services**

Raise Financial Services is building technology-led financial products and infrastructure for India’s financially aware and digitally savvy consumers. Our ecosystem spans multiple aspects of financial services, with Dhan as our flagship investment and trading platform.

Alongside Dhan, we are building and scaling businesses across the financial ecosystem, including Stratzy, Millions, Upsurge, Filter Coffee, Pluto Insurance, Fuzz and several other emerging products and platforms.

Our ambition is to build a trusted ecosystem of financial products and experiences that make

investing, trading, wealth creation and other financial services simpler, smarter and more accessible. Our philosophy is simple:

* Build great products.
* Deliver awesome experiences.
* Provide exceptional customer service.

Location: Goregaon West, Mumbai

Explore More:

* Connect with us: www.raiseholding.co
* Learn more about our Algo Trading platform - https://stratzy.in/
* Learn more about our Investing & Trading Platform – www.dhan.co

Follow our Instagram page
**#LifeatRaise**
for a glimpse into our people and latest culture

happenings.

**Apply for the Role:**

If you are excited about building and scaling one of India's most ambitious consumer fintech

ecosystems, we would love to hear from you. Send your resume to:
**careers@dhan.co**

Raise is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an

inclusive workplace.

title: Growth Brand Designer
description:
**About the role**

DoubleTick.io
, an award-winning conversational CX stack, is looking for a
**Growth Brand Designer**

who combines strong visual design and brand storytelling with a performance-driven mindset. The ideal candidate will create compelling marketing creatives that strengthen DoubleTick’s brand while driving engagement, clicks, and conversions across digital channels.

This role goes beyond design execution. You will work closely with the Growth and Marketing teams to develop campaign concepts, experiment with creative approaches, and translate performance insights into impactful designs. You should be comfortable balancing creative excellence with marketing objectives while maintaining brand consistency across all touchpoints.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Experience in Graphic Design, Brand Design, Growth Design, or Performance Marketing Design.
* Strong portfolio showcasing performance marketing creatives, brand campaigns, digital advertising, and campaign design systems.
* Proven experience working closely with performance marketing or growth teams in a technology, SaaS, or digital-first company.
* Strong understanding of visual design principles, typography, colour theory, composition, and brand identity.
* Hands-on experience designing creatives for
  **Meta Ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads,**

  and other
  **digital marketing channels.**
* Ability to conceptualise original campaign ideas and translate marketing objectives into effective visual communication.
* Understanding of performance metrics such as CTR, engagement, and conversion rates, with the ability to use insights to improve creative output.
* Proficiency in
  **Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator**

  , and other relevant design tools.
* Experience creating design variations, testing creative hypotheses, and iterating based on campaign results.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple deliverables, and maintain quality while working at speed.
* Strong communication, collaboration, creative thinking, and problem-solving skills.

**Ideal candidate**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree/diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, or a related field.
* Experience in
  **B2B SaaS, CRM, MarTech, CPaaS, enterprise technology, or AI-driven products.**
* Knowledge of motion graphics, animated advertisements, and short-form video using After Effects or Premiere Pro.
* Experience with landing page design, lifecycle email campaigns, and product marketing assets.
* Familiarity with AI-powered design and image-generation tools to scale creative production.
* Copywriting skills and the ability to refine headlines, messaging, and creative concepts.
* Experience developing brand guidelines, reusable templates, and scalable creative systems.

**About DoubleTick**

DoubleTick.io
headquartered in Mumbai, is a Meta award-winning AI conversational CX stack, designed to unlock
**conversation-led sales, marketing, and customer engagement use-cases at scale for enterprises**

. Backed by Info Edge Ventures and BeeNext, the platform serves
**10,000+ businesses**

across
**India and UAE**

and serves large clients across various industries like BFSI, Real Estate, Travel, EdTech, Healthcare, Auto, Retail and FMCG. Leading brands such as MakeMyTrip, Piramal Finance, CoinDCX, AU Bank, Lodha Developers among many others trust DoubleTick to power their
**customer conversations**

.

The UX friendly enterprise communication suite features a full-stack conversational platform featuring conversational centralization, automation and analytics across channels like WhatsApp chat, WhatsApp Voice, WhatsApp Groups, PSTN Calls among 10+ other channels. With its AI Agent Builder and Bot Studio enterprises can create and deploy complex AI Agents and Bots across chat and voice in minutes.

**Why work with us?**

* Fast-tracked career success into senior leadership positions
* Opportunity to own high value work and create impact at scale
* Opportunity to work closely with the founders and learn what it takes to grow a company in each stage of growth.
* Opportunity to work in a cultural environment where you can challenge founders/leadership and reason with them on any issue.
* Direct exposure to working with some of the largest enterprises in the world.

title: Creative Specialist - Design (Mumbai)
description:
**Description**
Creative Specialist – Design
  
  
**Mumbai, India**
Make global beauty brands resonate locally.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on, multidisciplinary creative who combines original thinking with exceptional design craft to create work that connects with local consumers.
  
  
Reporting to the Creative Manager, you will translate brand direction into compelling concepts and visual storytelling across campaigns, social, digital, packaging and retail—personally designing, editing and animating the work.

title: Design Lead
company: Bennett Coleman & Co. Ltd. (The Times of India)
description:
**Job Title:**
Design Lead

**Job Details**

* Location: Fort, Mumbai
* Work Mode: Onsite Role
* Employment Type: Full-time / FTE
* Experience: 8 to 12 years

**About BCCL**

Bennett, Coleman & Co. Ltd. (BCCL) is one of India's largest media conglomerates, with a legacy dating back to 1838 and a portfolio that includes The Times of India, The Economic Times, Mumbai Mirror, Navbharat Times, Maharashtra Times, and Vijay Karnataka. Across print, digital, branded content, out-of-home, and experiential platforms, BCCL combines trusted journalism, audience insight, and innovation to shape conversations at scale.

**About 1838**

1838 is a cultural platform and community for creative entrepreneurs and cultural tastemakers. Its space, magazine, events and media bring people and ideas together, extending the creative life of the community beyond the physical space.

**The Opportunity:**

The Design Lead will shape and evolve the visual identity of 1838, a cultural platform and community for creative entrepreneurs and cultural tastemakers. Across its heritage space, magazine, curated events and digital media, the role will translate 1838’s cultural vision into distinctive visual experiences that connect people, ideas and creative disciplines.

Reporting to the Creative Head – 1838, the role will lead the development of visual identities, editorial design, digital creatives, event communication, motion-led assets and other design outputs across the platform. It will combine strong design sensibility and cultural understanding with AI-enabled creative capabilities to develop original concepts, accelerate execution and scale content across formats without compromising creative quality.

The role will also establish AI-assisted design workflows, reusable visual systems and creative standards that strengthen 1838’s identity, enable experimentation and ensure a cohesive visual language across its magazine, programming, community and digital touchpoints.

**What You Will Do:**

**1. Visual Identity & Creative Development**

* Lead the creation of distinctive visual assets across the magazine, digital platforms, cultural programming, events, community initiatives and partnerships.
* Translate creative briefs into compelling visual concepts by combining design aesthetics, cultural insight, storytelling and AI-enabled creative techniques.
* Build and evolve 1838’s visual language, ensuring originality, consistency and a premium, culturally curious identity across touchpoints.
* Explore innovative visual treatments, typography, illustration, imagery and motion-led design to bring 1838’s stories and ideas to life.

**2. AI-Enabled Design Workflows & Creative Systems**

* Integrate AI-powered tools across image generation, visual enhancement, layout exploration, creative adaptation and asset production.
* Develop reusable design systems, templates, prompt libraries and visual asset repositories to improve creative efficiency and consistency.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive design tasks, accelerate iterations and scale content production while retaining human creative judgement.
* Experiment with emerging AI design tools and workflows to expand creative possibilities and improve production quality and turnaround.

**3. Editorial, Digital & Multi-Platform Design**

* Lead visual design for the magazine, digital content, newsletters, social media, presentations, event communication and other relevant formats.
* Adapt creative assets across platforms, formats and audience contexts while maintaining a coherent visual identity.
* Develop modular design approaches for content extensions, event promotions, community stories and partnership communication.
* Work closely with editorial and programming teams to ensure design strengthens the narrative, context and audience experience.

**4. Creative Collaboration & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Partner with the Creative Head, editorial, events and community teams to translate 1838’s editorial vision and programming calendar into compelling visual communication.
* Collaborate with contributors, photographers, videographers and external creative partners to deliver integrated visual experiences.
* Support partnership-led initiatives through design solutions that meet agreed briefs while preserving 1838’s creative and editorial standards.

**5. Creative Governance & Quality Standards**

* Establish design standards and review processes to maintain quality, originality, typography, layout hierarchy and visual consistency.
* Evaluate AI-generated outputs for relevance, accuracy, artefacts and creative integrity, refining them to meet 1838’s standards.
* Ensure responsible use of AI-generated and third-party assets, including appropriate attention to copyright, permissions and authenticity.

**6. Innovation & Capability Building**

* Track emerging AI design tools, generative visual technologies and creative trends relevant to 1838’s cultural and digital ecosystem.
* Drive experimentation with new visual formats and AI-enabled workflows that improve creative impact and production efficiency.
* Share tools, techniques and learnings with the wider creative team to strengthen AI adoption and continuously improve design practices.

**What You Bring:**

* 7 to10 years of experience in graphic design, visual communication, editorial design, digital creative or integrated design environments, supported by a strong portfolio.
* Proven ability to conceptualise and deliver high-quality visual identities and design solutions across editorial, digital, cultural, event or brand-led formats.
* Hands-on experience with AI-powered design tools, including generative imagery, prompt-led visual creation, image enhancement and creative adaptation.
* Strong understanding of design systems, typography, layout, visual storytelling and multi-platform asset development.
* Demonstrated ability to combine creative judgement with AI-enabled workflows to improve quality, speed and scalability.
* Exposure to art, design, culture, architecture, fashion, film, publishing or creative communities is an advantage.

**Education:**

A bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Digital Media or a related discipline is desirable. Practical design capability, AI proficiency, creative thinking and portfolio quality will carry significant weight.

**Equal Opportunity:**

BCCL is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and consider applicants without discrimination based on gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, disability, age, religion, caste, ethnicity, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Candidates who need reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process may inform the recruiter.

**Note:**
The advertised role title is indicative. The final designation will be as per company norms.

title: Senior Digital and Campaign Designer
description:
**Senior Digital and Campaign Designer**

**About Us**

We are a leading ERP software and solutions provider to dealers and rental companies of heavy equipment. We specialize in working with the construction, mining, forestry, material handling, and agriculture industries. We aim to be the ERP thought leader in our space and a trusted IT advisor to all dealers and rental companies. Today, we have over 700 employee associates, offices on four continents, and customers in over 20 countries. We are privately held, and our headquarters are in beautiful Cary, NC. We seek talented individuals to join our team and help us aggressively grow our North American footprint for our on-premises and 100% cloud-based ERP solutions.

**Why work for VitalEdge?**

We don’t just sell technology, we enable transformation that results in broader societal benefits like building homes and critical infrastructure, growing food and delivering all sorts of products we all rely on for daily life. We exist to ultimately equip the world to keep running. We have more than 60 years of combined experience and two industry-leading software suites and associated apps, with which we will drive the market forward. It’s an exciting time to work for VitalEdge – join us!

**Position Overview**

VitalEdge Technologies is looking for a Senior Digital & Campaign Designer to join our marketing team and create high-quality visual work across integrated campaigns, digital, print, video, PowerPoint, events, and brand initiatives.

This is a hands-on role for a designer who enjoys variety and can move quickly from concept to execution. You’ll work closely with our US-based Marketing team and teams across VitalEdge to bring campaigns and programs to market while helping maintain a strong, consistent brand across every channel.

We’re looking for someone with strong creative judgment who understands marketing and can turn a campaign brief or rough idea into polished work ready to perform in market.

**Responsibilities**

*Campaign and digital creative*

· Design creative for integrated marketing campaigns across paid media, email, social, web, demand generation, product marketing, customer marketing, and sales enablement.

· Develop campaign concepts and visual systems that scale across channels, audiences, products, and asset types.

· Create digital advertising including static, animated, GIF, HTML5, display, and retargeting assets.

· Design social graphics, email creative, landing page assets, campaign templates, and other digital content.

· Work directly with Marketing stakeholders to understand campaign goals and translate messaging into strong visual creative.

· Adapt and version creative for different audiences, markets, products, and channels while maintaining quality and brand consistency.

· Create reusable campaign kits that allow Marketing teams to extend approved creative across channels without starting from scratch.

*Print and marketing collateral*

· Design brochures, one-pagers, customer stories, reports, advertisements, direct mail, flyers, product materials, sales collateral, and other marketing assets.

· Turn complex product and industry information into clear, easy-to-understand visual content.

· Prepare production-ready files for professional print, including sizing, bleeds, color, resolution, and vendor specifications.

· Support ongoing campaign and field marketing needs with polished, on-brand materials.

· Coordinate with print and production vendors as needed to ensure quality and accurate execution.

*PowerPoint and presentations*

· Design high-quality PowerPoint presentations for sales, customers, partners, webinars, product launches, campaigns, training, and events.

· Turn written content, product messaging, data, and business concepts into clear visual stories.

· Build and maintain branded PowerPoint templates, slide libraries, diagrams, charts, and reusable components.

· Use animation, transitions, video, and other visual elements appropriately.

· Help teams improve presentation quality while maintaining consistent brand standards.

· Maintain self-service PowerPoint resources so teams can create routine materials without requiring custom design support.

*Video and motion*

· Edit and produce video for campaigns, social media, customer stories, product marketing, webinars, events, and other marketing programs.

· Create motion graphics, animated digital assets, titles, transitions, and other visual elements.

· Edit raw footage and prepare finished content for different platforms, formats, and aspect ratios.

· Repurpose existing campaigns and content into video and motion formats.

· Maintain reusable video elements, intros, outros, lower thirds, title treatments, and other branded components.

· Work with external video and production partners when needed.

*Events and field marketing*

· Create visual assets for tradeshows, customer events, conferences, sponsorships, and field marketing programs.

· Design booth graphics, signage, digital displays, handouts, invitations, presentations, promotional materials, and supporting campaign creative.

· Carry a consistent campaign and brand experience across pre-event promotion, onsite execution, and post-event follow-up.

· Develop reusable event templates and assets for recurring marketing programs.

· Partner closely with the Events team to manage multiple creative deliverables and deadlines.

*Brand stewardship and governance*

· Serve as a steward of the VitalEdge visual brand across marketing channels and materials.

· Maintain brand standards across logos, typography, color, imagery, layouts, templates, photography, video, presentations, and digital assets.

· Review marketing materials and provide clear guidance when creative does not meet established brand standards.

· Help maintain and evolve brand guidelines, templates, campaign systems, and creative resources.

· Conduct final creative quality checks before high-visibility materials are published or produced.

· Help educate internal teams on correct brand usage and make approved resources easy to find and use.

*Canva and marketing self-service*

· Build and maintain a structured library of branded Canva templates that allow marketing and other approved teams to create routine assets independently.

· Develop templates for social media, events, campaigns, presentations, customer communications, digital graphics, and other recurring needs.

· Establish appropriate template controls so teams can customize content without compromising brand standards.

· Keep templates current as messaging, products, campaigns, and brand standards change.

· Identify repeat design requests that can be converted into self-service templates or reusable systems.

· Provide basic guidance and training so team members can use approved templates effectively.

*Image, video and asset library management*

· Maintain an organized, searchable library of approved photography, illustrations, icons, video, logos, campaign creative, and other visual assets.

· Establish and maintain consistent file naming, folder structure, tagging, version control, and archival standards.

· Manage approved stock imagery and licensed creative assets, including usage rights and expiration dates where applicable.

· Maintain clear separation between working files, approved assets, and retired creative.

· Make it easy for Marketing and approved internal teams to find current, on-brand assets without relying on the designer for every request.

· Identify gaps in photography and visual assets and recommend new content needs.

*AI and modern creative tools*

· Use AI-assisted creative tools as part of the day-to-day design process for ideation, concept development, image creation, campaign variations, presentation design, video, and content adaptation.

· Identify practical ways AI can reduce repetitive production work and improve creative iteration.

· Stay current with new design, video, presentation, and AI tools relevant to marketing.

· Apply appropriate quality, copyright, privacy, and brand standards to AI-assisted creative.

· Help establish consistent practices for how AI-generated and AI-assisted creative is used across Marketing.

*Creative process and collaboration*

· Participate in campaign planning and creative brainstorming, contributing ideas early in the process rather than only receiving finished design requests.

· Translate briefs into clear creative concepts and ask the right questions when requirements are incomplete.

· Manage multiple projects and priorities while meeting agreed timelines.

· Maintain organized working files so another team member can easily locate and continue work if needed.

· Partner with agencies, freelancers, printers, video producers, and other outside creative resources when additional support is required.

· Incorporate feedback quickly while also providing informed creative recommendations when a different approach may work better.

**Required Skills & Education**

· 5+ years of professional experience in digital design, graphic design, marketing design, or integrated campaign creative.

· A strong portfolio showing work across digital campaigns, print, PowerPoint, events, video, and motion.

· Advanced proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Acrobat.

· Strong PowerPoint skills, including visual storytelling, animation, template creation, charts, diagrams, and presentation design.

· Canva experience, including creating scalable branded templates for non-designers.

· Hands-on experience using AI-assisted creative tools within a professional design workflow.

· Experience designing paid media, email creative, social content, landing page assets, and integrated campaign materials.

· Strong video editing and motion graphics skills.

· Experience preparing files for professional print production.

· Strong understanding of typography, layout, color, hierarchy, brand systems, and visual storytelling.

· Experience maintaining brand standards and governing visual consistency across a growing organization.

· Experience organizing and maintaining digital asset or image libraries.

· Understanding of image licensing, usage rights, and responsible sourcing of visual assets.

· Working knowledge of Figma and digital design workflows.

· Basic knowledge of responsive design, HTML, CSS, and web accessibility is helpful.

· Strong attention to detail and excellent organization.

· Ability to manage multiple campaigns, projects, and deadlines at the same time.

· Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues in India and the US.

· Comfort working regular India evening hours to maintain meaningful overlap with the US Eastern Time team.

A bachelor’s degree in graphic design, visual communications, digital design, or a related field is preferred, or equivalent professional experience.

VitalEdge is an Equal Opportunity Employer

description:

The Knowledge Services at Marsh in Mumbai combines the design, analytics, and research centers of excellence in India and has been established to service key businesses within the MMC group.
  
  
The Creative Services CoE is an internal design services team supporting Marsh businesses globally.

* A purpose driven environment - the team’s purpose is to develop a highly positive brand image of the Marsh BCS business with audiences, through exceptional design support.

* Translate complex business concepts into compelling information graphics and video content that clarify messaging and amplify stakeholder impact.

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.

Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

title: Senior UX Researcher
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly empathetic and analytical Senior UX Researcher to join our growing design team. In this pivotal role, you will champion the voice of the user, uncover deep insights into their behaviors, needs, and motivations, and translate these findings into actionable recommendations that shape the future of our product experience. You will drive research initiatives that inform strategic product decisions, validate design hypotheses, and ensure we are building solutions that truly resonate with our global user base.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Design & Execute Research:**
  Plan, design, and conduct a wide range of user research activities including usability testing, interviews, surveys, field studies, card sorting, and competitive analysis
* **Generate Insights:**
  Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data from various sources to identify key user pain points, unmet needs, behavioral patterns, and mental models
* **Inform Product Strategy:**
  Translate complex research findings into clear, compelling, and actionable insights and recommendations for product managers, designers, and engineers
* **Collaborate & Influence:**
  Partner closely with product management, UX/UI designers, content strategists, and engineering teams to integrate research throughout the product lifecycle
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Present research findings, methodologies, and strategic implications to stakeholders and leadership, effectively communicating the 'why' behind user behaviors
* **Build Research Practice:**
  Contribute to the development and standardization of research processes, tools, and best practices within the design team
* **Drive User Empathy:**
  Act as an advocate for the user, fostering a user-centered culture across the organization
* **Mentorship:**
  Potentially mentor junior researchers or designers on research methodologies

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  5-8 years of professional experience specifically in UX Research roles, preferably in a fast-paced product-led environment
* **Portfolio:**
  A strong portfolio demonstrating a range of research methodologies, clear articulation of insights, and demonstrable impact on product design
* **Methodological Expertise:**
  Deep understanding and hands-on experience with both qualitative and quantitative research methods, and the ability to choose appropriate methods for different research questions
* **Analytical Skills:**
  Proven ability to analyze complex data sets, identify patterns, and draw insightful conclusions
* **Communication:**
  Excellent verbal, written, and visual communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex information into engaging narratives for diverse audiences
* **Tools:**
  Proficiency with research tools (e.g., user testing platforms, survey tools, analytics dashboards) and presentation software
* **Collaboration:**
  Demonstrated ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams
* Candidates based out of Pune

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with SaaS/Enterprise software products, especially in customer support or conversational AI
* Familiarity with design thinking principles and agile development methodologies
* Experience integrating research insights into a broader Design System context
* Degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Psychology, Cognitive Science, Sociology, Anthropology, Information Science, or a related field

**Leadership & People Management Skills**

* Ability to mentor junior team members and foster a collaborative and continuous learning environment
* Lead and manage multiple research initiatives simultaneously, ensuring quality and timely delivery
* Work collaboratively with other design disciplines (UX/UI Designers, Content Strategists) to ensure research insights are effectively integrated and contribute to a holistic user experience
* Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure the quality and impact of research deliverables

**Interpersonal Skills**

* Positive attitude, proactive, and intrinsically curious
* Strong team player with excellent interpersonal skills
* Ability to motivate others and build strong relationships across teams
* A natural problem-solver and skilled negotiator, focused on finding solutions and driving consensus
* Exceptional listening and communication skills to truly understand user needs and team objectives
* Solid organizational skills

**Benefits**

* Hybrid setup
* Worker's insurance
* Paid Time Offs
* Other employee benefits to be discussed by our Talent Acquisition team in India.

title: Product Designer (UI/UX
description:
**Company Description**
Klypup is a digitally native cloud services advisory company that helps organizations accelerate growth and build resilience using AI and AWS expertise. The company focuses on meeting clients where they are on their cloud journey and guiding them toward high-impact solutions. Its services are shaped by customer value, core capabilities, and AWS foundational frameworks. Team members collaborate with innovative businesses and work on modern cloud, AI, and digital transformation projects. To learn more about Klypup’s expertise and offerings, candidates can visit the company website.

**Klypup · Noida (onsite) · Full-time · 1 to 3 years of experience**

**About the role**

At Klypup, our engineers design the screens as they build them. The products work, but

they look like engineers made them.

We're hiring a product designer to change that. You'll own how everything looks and feels,

and you'll work directly with our Founder and CTO.

**What you'll do**

Design features end to end, from rough sketch to final screens

Map user flows and build clickable prototypes, then test them with users

Build our design system from scratch: type, color, spacing, components and motion

Design the empty, loading and error states along with the main flow

Review builds before release and push for fixes when they don't match the design

Suggest features and flow changes to the founders, and make the case for them

**What we're looking for**

1 to 3 years designing web products, ideally B2B software, dashboards or SaaS

A portfolio with case studies that walk through your process, including directions you

tried and dropped

Strong visual design: typography, layout, spacing and hierarchy

Hands-on UX work: user flows, information architecture and usability testing

Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library

Able to work from our Noida office

**Nice to have**

You prototype in Framer, or know enough HTML and CSS to build a rough prototype

yourself

You've shipped work on an AI product, such as a chat interface, an agent dashboard or

a data-heavy tool

You use AI design tools like v0, Google Stitch, Lovable or FramerAI

You've done motion or micro-interaction design

You have side projects you designed on your own

**How we work**

We take ideas to production in days. In a single week you might sketch a feature,

prototype it, sit with engineers during the build, and fix what users struggle with after it

ships.

We use Figma, Framer, v0, Google Stitch, Lovable, Cursor and Claude heavily. They save

time, but you'll be expected to spot bad output.

What you get

You'll own design and the design system for the whole company, with direct mentorship

from the Founder and CTO. Your input shapes the roadmap. There's a path to Design Lead

as the team grows. Pay is competitive.

**How to apply**

Your work matters more to us than your resume. Send us:

1. A link to your portfolio, or a PDF

2. The project you're proudest of, with a few lines on the hardest decision you made in it

3. For team projects, a note on which parts were yours

* If you match most of this listing but not all of it, apply anyway

title: Director, UX Design
description:
**About This Role**
As Director of UX, you will lead and develop a team of UX professionals while remaining actively engaged in the work. This is a player-coach role that combines people leadership, UX strategy, hands-on design contribution, mentorship, and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
You will help shape UX strategy and execution across Gartner’s products and digital platforms, working directly with Product, Engineering, Business and Technology Insights, Brand, and business stakeholders to solve complex customer problems. You will contribute to discovery, research, journey mapping, ideation, prototyping, design reviews, and validation while setting a high standard for the team’s work.
  
  
You will also help advance Gartner’s AI capabilities by building an AI-focused UX culture, encouraging responsible experimentation, creating AI prototypes, and training the team to use emerging AI tools and methods effectively. Success in this role requires the ability to move fluidly between strategic leadership, hands-on design work, coaching, and delivery.
  
  
**What You will do:**

* Define and execute the UX strategy across Gartner’s products, digital platforms, and key initiatives, from discovery through delivery and optimization.
* Lead, coach, and develop a growing team of UX professionals supporting multiple products and customer experiences.
* Serve as a player-coach, providing hands-on leadership across research, discovery, ideation, prototyping, design, testing, and design reviews.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Business and Technology Insights, Brand, Marketing, and business stakeholders to translate customer needs into clear, useful, and feasible experiences.
* Set expectations for UX quality, process, accessibility, collaboration, and customer-centered decision-making.
* Advance an AI-focused, human-centered UX culture by guiding AI-enabled experiences, rapid prototypes, proofs of concept, and design experiments.
* Promote responsible AI design principles, including transparency, trust, accessibility, privacy, human oversight, and inclusion.
* Build team capability and foster continuous learning through coaching, mentorship, design critiques, training, Design Thinking, user research, and experimentation.

**What you’ll need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Design, UX/UI Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in UX, product design, interaction design, design research, information architecture, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience managing and developing UX or Product Design professionals, ideally in a player-coach leadership role.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX leadership and delivery, including discovery, research, interaction design, prototyping, testing, and implementation.
* Experience defining UX strategy and leading execution across multiple products or initiatives, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, business objectives, and strategic priorities.
* Experience using AI tools or AI-enabled workflows for UX research, ideation, prototyping, experimentation, or product development.
* Experience designing accessible and inclusive experiences and leading cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong communication, storytelling, collaboration, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills, along with a growth mindset and enthusiasm for learning, teaching, and applying emerging technologies responsibly.

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

title: AI Product Builder
description:
**The Short Version**

**Who we’re looking for:**
An AI Product Builder who thinks in terms of problems, systems, and leverage — and is excited to use AI to turn ideas into working solutions. You’re someone who likes getting your hands dirty, experimenting with new tools, and building and testing solutions quickly, with a strong bias toward action and real-world validation.

**What the role is about:**
At Kraftshala, you’ll work on problems across student experience, revenue (admissions, sales, marketing), and internal operations. You’ll identify opportunities, figure out what to build, and use AI, automation, and modern tools to turn ideas into working products, workflows, and systems. You’ll work closely with product and engineering teams to take validated solutions from prototype to production.

**What makes this role meaningful:**
Rather than spending most of your time writing requirements or waiting for development cycles, you’ll be expected to experiment, prototype, ship, and learn quickly.

**Why you should apply:**

* ***Build things that actually get used —***
  products, tools, workflows, and automations that solve real problems for students and teams at Kraftshala.
* ***Go from idea to working solution fast —***
  use AI and modern development tools to prototype, test, and ship instead of waiting around for long development cycles.
* ***Own problems, not just tasks —***
  take an idea from identifying the problem to building the solution and seeing what impact it creates.
* ***Work on problems that matter —***
  across student experience, revenue, and internal operations, alongside product, engineering, and business teams.
* ***Get to build across the stack —***
  from understanding users and business problems to prototyping, testing, and shipping solutions with AI and modern technology.

If you’re someone who sees a problem and immediately wants to figure out how to build a better way, this role is for you.

**About us:**
Kraftshala is India’s largest higher-education institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.

We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.

**The Detailed Version**

As an AI Product Builder at Kraftshala, you’ll be at the intersection of product, technology, and business. You’ll work closely with teams across the organisation to understand how they work, spot opportunities for improvement, and build solutions that make a meaningful difference.

You’ll be expected to move quickly from understanding to experimentation — using AI and modern tools to explore different approaches, build prototypes, and learn what works. As solutions take shape, you’ll work with the right teams to refine, scale, and improve them.

A core expectation in this role is the ability to build quickly and learn through experimentation — using AI-assisted development, LLMs, APIs, integrations, automation, and modular systems to turn ideas into usable solutions, validate them in real contexts, and iterate based on what you learn.

**What you’ll own:**

* Find & Understand Problems: Work with users and teams to identify meaningful problems, understand what’s causing them, and figure out what is worth solving.
* Build & Prototype: Turn ideas into working prototypes, tools, workflows, and automations using AI and modern development tools.
  **Metrics to measure:**
  Time from idea to prototype, number of experiments shipped
* Test & Iterate: Put what you build in front of real users, learn from feedback and data, and improve the solution based on what you learn.
  **Metrics to measure:**
  Adoption, iteration velocity, solution effectiveness
* Ship & Improve: Work with product and engineering teams to take validated solutions into production and continuously improve them based on usage and impact.
  **Metrics to measure:**
  Delivery speed, adoption, business impact

**How you’ll operate:**

* You move fluidly between understanding the problem and building the solution
* You use AI as a force multiplier across research, prototyping, development, and execution
* You default to building and testing, rather than spending too long planning
* You’re comfortable trying things that may not work and iterating quickly
* You prioritize speed to insight and usable output over perfect upfront planning
* You think in systems, not just features
* You care about what happens after something is built — adoption, impact, and outcomes

**Monthly Outcomes**

**Month 1:**

* Build a strong understanding of Kraftshala’s users, systems, and business priorities
* Identify and validate meaningful problems worth solving
* Build and ship at least one small prototype, automation, or workflow improvement

**Month 2:**

* Own a problem from understanding to solution
* Build, test, and iterate on prototypes using AI and modern tools
* Ship at least one meaningful product, workflow, or automation improvement

**Month 3+:**

* Take on increasingly complex problems and build solutions with greater autonomy
* Run faster build-test-learn cycles and improve what you ship based on real-world feedback
* Deliver solutions that create measurable improvements in user experience, revenue, or operational efficiency

**Must Haves:**

* 1–2 years of experience in Product, a builder, technical, or closely related role — startup experience is a plus. (We’re not fussed about the exact years of experience, as that’s just a proxy for your skill level.)
* Have built and shipped something — a digital product, tool, prototype, workflow, automation, or similar.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development, APIs, automation, no-code/low-code, or modern development tools.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a bias for action.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and fast-moving contexts.
* Strong user empathy, product intuition, and communication skills.

**Selection Process:**

As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30-60 minutes.

**Setting Expectations:**
This will be a call to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process.

**Technical Exercise:**
This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role

**Conversation 1:**
This will be a detailed assessment review conversation to go over your submission for the technical exercise along with other competencies required for the role.

**Conversation 2:**
A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode.

**Extending an offer:**
If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.

**Location:**

Delhi

Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture and investors here.

title: Product Analyst
description:
**Description**
Req ID: 27-0493
  
  
Come join our passionate team! Barracuda is a leading global cybersecurity company delivering complete resilience made easy to buy, deploy and use through a partner-first model. Our intelligent BarracudaONE™ platform provides cyber resilience across email, data, applications, networks, and managed XDR within an open ecosystem. Trusted by hundreds of thousands of organizations and partners worldwide, Barracuda delivers industry-leading solutions and support, powered by people and enhanced by AI, for all size business.
  
  
We know a diverse workforce adds to our collective value and strength as an organization. Barracuda Networks is proud to be an employer that complies with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity regardless of race, gender, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, or disability.
  
  
**Envision Yourself At Barracuda**
Help turn customer needs into useful email-security capabilities. As a Product Analyst, you will own a clearly bounded feature or administrator workflow, working directly with engineering and a senior product manager from discovery through delivery and measurement. The role combines hands-on product decisions, customer exposure and structured mentorship, with opportunities to develop toward broader product responsibility.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Working On**
Investigate customer and administrator needs through interviews, support feedback, usage data and market or competitor research. Translate findings into a clear problem statement and practical options for an assigned feature. Explore how phishing, malware and everyday email-management challenges affect the people using the product.
  
  
Define user stories and testable acceptance criteria with senior PM guidance. Partner with engineering and design to evaluate feasibility, refine the backlog and recommend priorities within the agreed scope. Own requirements clarity and follow-through, resolve straightforward product questions collaboratively, and escalate security-sensitive or higher-complexity decisions.
  
  
Track feature milestones, dependencies and delivery risks against the agreed roadmap. Support validation and release readiness, prepare internal product briefings or training, and gather customer feedback after launch. Agree relevant indicators with your mentor, analyse adoption and workflow outcomes, and propose evidence-based improvements.
  
  
You are accountable for the quality and outcomes of your assigned feature or workflow, not only meeting coordination. A senior product manager retains portfolio strategy, overall roadmap ownership and major prioritisation decisions. You will contribute research and recommendations to those decisions and may support a broader strategic initiative under their direction.
  
  
**What You Bring To The Role**

* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, business or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience; and 2–5 years of experience in product management, project management, software engineering or a comparable role.
* Adjacent experience is welcome when it demonstrates customer problem-solving and delivery of software outcomes.
* Working knowledge of agile delivery and cybersecurity fundamentals, together with the ability to interpret customer feedback and product data.
* You can communicate requirements clearly, discuss trade-offs with technical colleagues, collaborate across functions and adapt as evidence or priorities change.
* Preferred, not required: familiarity with email administration, Microsoft 365, phishing and malware protection, and basic email authentication concepts such as SPF, DKIM and DMARC. Product-management certification, including CPM, is also welcome.
* Deep email-security expertise is not expected at entry to this role.

**How You Will Grow And Succeed**
Regular senior PM coaching, engineering partnership and customer conversations will help you strengthen discovery, prioritisation and analytical judgement. You will collaborate with colleagues across locations on shared product goals. Success means well-defined requirements, transparent delivery risks, useful customer insights and measurable improvement in your assigned area, with progressively greater independence as your skills develop.
  
  
**What You’ll Get From Us**
A team where you can voice your opinion, make an impact, and where you and your experience are valued. Internal mobility – there are opportunities for cross training and the ability to attain your next career step within Barracuda. In addition, you will receive equity, in the form of non-qualifying options.

title: Growth Intern - Gold
description:

Jar is India’s leading Daily Saving app that helps people build strong saving habits—one small step at a time. Our goal is to make saving simple, rewarding, and truly life-changing. Founded in 2021 by Misbah Ashraf and Nishchay AG, Jar is a Bengaluru-based startup with one simple belief: saving a little every day in 24K Digital Gold can truly transform your future.
  
  
Today, 20 million+ Indians trust Jar as their saving partner. With flexible saving options—Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Instant Saving—we have made it easy for everyone to save in their own way and withdraw anytime. Backed by Tiger Global Management, Arkam Ventures, and WEH Ventures, among others, we have raised $50 million+ in funding. In January 2025, we hit a huge milestone of becoming profitable. Now, we’re charging ahead, focused on sustainable growth and scaling impact.
  
  
And this is just the beginning!
  
  
**What’s the role?**
This role offers a great opportunity for someone eager to apply analytical thinking to real-world user behaviour and learn how data powers product-led growth. You'll work closely with product and growth teams to support initiatives that drive in-app actions and improve retention. It's a great opportunity to see how user engagement strategies are built, tested, and scaled.
  
  
**What will be your responsibilities?**

* Analyze A/B experiments and product features, translating data into actionable insights for the product and business teams
* Ensure data accuracy through event testing, manual validation, and collaboration with tech teams to resolve data issues
* Maintain trackers, perform quantitative analysis, and assist in data-driven decision-making
* Support Product Managers and business teams by identifying new opportunities and driving innovation through insights
* Have a basic understanding of user communication channels such as Push Notifications etc, or demonstrate a strong willingness to learn and build expertise in this area

**What’s required from you?**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related field; or an MBA from a reputed institute
* Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in Excel and basic knowledge of Python (mandatory)
* Passion for learning and exploring product analytics tools
* A creative mindset for developing engagement strategies and user communications
* Ability to adapt quickly in a fast-paced startup environment

We’re not just building a product- we’re shaping the future of savings in India. We seek people who bring passion, energy, and fresh ideas to help us make that happen. Experience matters, but we are a potential first organisation. We move fast, learn from our mistakes, and take bold risks to solve problems that haven’t been attempted before. If you’re excited about working in an environment where people inspire and truly support each other, you’ve found the right fit.
  
  
**What do we stand for?**
The five values that we live by :
  
  
**Passion:**
At Jar, we strive to create an environment where people love what they do, are motivated and equipped to do their best work.
  
  
**Equality:**
We bring diverse skills, ideas, and experiences to the table, supporting and challenging each other across teams to create something bigger than ourselves.
  
  
**Growth:**
When our people grow, Jar grows. We create opportunities for learning, development, and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Accountability:**
The core of our work ethic is taking ownership of our work, showing initiative, and having the freedom to ask questions.
  
  
**Consistency:**
We believe in doing the right things consistently. Big change doesn’t happen overnight, it’s built one step at a time.
  
  
Join us and let’s build something amazing together!

title: Solutions Design Analyst, Specialty Solutions
description:
At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific. Join us in making clinical trials easier, faster, more engaging, and accessible to all. We are transforming the future of clinical trials. Our Specialty Solutions & Clinical Adjudication team supports some of the world’s most complex and meaningful studies, helping sponsors bring life‑changing therapies to patients faster.

We're looking for passionate Solutions Design Analysts to join our growing team in India. This role is ideal for professionals with a Business Analyst mindset who enjoy analyzing complex clinical trial requirements, engaging with stakeholders, and translating business needs into effective technology solutions.

If you have a background in Life Sciences, Clinical Research, Healthcare Technology, or Business Analysis, along with experience in eCOA, ePRO, IRT/RTSM, eConsent, or other clinical technologies, you'll play a critical role in bridging the gap between clinical study requirements and system design. Your work will directly contribute to improving patient, site, and sponsor experiences while helping bring innovative therapies to market faster.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation and incentives
* Comprehensive benefits supporting security, flexibility, wellbeing, and work–life balance
* Engaging employee programs and learning opportunities
* Hybrid working technology and excellent onsite facilities

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Act as the primary liaison between sponsors, project teams, and technical stakeholders to analyze, document, and translate clinical trial requirements into scalable technology solutions.
* Lead requirements gathering workshops and discovery sessions to understand protocol objectives, study workflows, and operational needs.
* Manage and coordinate the end-to-end Solutions Design process, ensuring clinical protocols are accurately translated into system specifications and configurations.
* Produce clear business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, and design documentation to support study implementations.
* Provide business analysis expertise during client-facing meetings, helping stakeholders understand solution capabilities, constraints, and recommendations.
* Create and maintain study-specific configuration and design specifications for Clario products and services.
* Analyze system, workflow, and data requirements to ensure consistency between clinical data capture, reporting, delivery, and database structures.
* Partner with Clinical Systems Translation & Licensing to ensure appropriate questionnaire versions and content are implemented.
* Support validation and quality review activities by investigating and resolving design-related issues and defects.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze study issues, identify root causes, and recommend process or system improvements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to optimize business processes, documentation standards, and solution delivery practices.
* Work closely with Clinical Project Managers to ensure sponsor requirements and business objectives are effectively translated into system solutions.
* Lead or participate in internal and external design reviews, solution workshops, and milestone meetings.
* Represent Solutions Design during client audits by explaining solution methodologies, business processes, standards, and best practices.
* Support Business Development and Project Management teams by reviewing study protocols, assessing feasibility, and providing solution recommendations for new opportunities.
* Configure clinical technology platforms in alignment with approved business requirements and configuration specifications.

**What We Look For**

* BSc, MSc, or PhD in Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Healthcare, Clinical Research, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience as a Business Analyst, Clinical Business Analyst, Clinical Research Associate (CRA), Clinical Research Manager, Project Coordinator, Project Manager, Solutions Analyst, or similar role.
* Demonstrated experience gathering, documenting, and managing business and system requirements across multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of clinical research processes, clinical trial operations, and eClinical technologies.
* Experience with eCOA/ePRO, IRT/RTSM, eConsent, Clinical Adjudication, or other healthcare technology platforms is highly desirable.
* Proven ability to analyze complex workflows and translate business requirements into functional system solutions.
* Experience facilitating stakeholder discussions, requirement workshops, and client-facing meetings.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, process-mapping, and documentation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Experience working in global, cross-functional environments with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Passion for leveraging technology to improve clinical trial execution, patient engagement, and healthcare outcomes.

At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

title: Product & Strategy Associate
description:
**About**
:
  
  
The CEO's Office is a small, cross-functional team that incubates new products, drives the engagements that matter most to the company, and builds the systems that set and raise the bar for how teams across Sarvam work and collaborate. Problems arrive from research, product, and business, and they vary widely in shape and scope. As an Associate, you are a force multiplier for the CEO: you take an ambiguous problem, give it structure, and carry it to a result.
  
  
The work needs both breadth and depth. Breadth gives you context across the company and a clear sense of where the most important problems lie. Depth is how you deliver: you go deep on the ones that matter most and own their outcomes, working with the right people inside and outside Sarvam.
  
  
****What you'll do****

* Drive 0-to-1 product and strategic bets from idea to a clear outcome, whether that ends in a working business line or a well-understood failure. The goal is to build an engine that comes up with ideas, researches and assesses them, builds and iterates on them, and takes the ones that work to steady state, often by handing them to a dedicated team.
* Own key customer and partner engagements that are top of mind for the executive team.
* Find new ways to use AI to set and raise the bar for how teams across Sarvam work and collaborate, and build the systems that make it happen.
* Create the decks, memos, and prototypes that carry Sarvam's narrative to customers, partners, and government, and that represent the company.

****What we look for****

* High agency: Ownership comes naturally to you. You drive work end to end, especially when the brief is ambiguous and the path is undefined.
* Excessive curiosity: You are curious about AI and frontier technology well beyond what any job requires, and you follow new launches and research closely. You are eager to learn, and you are drawn to hard problems that new technology makes solvable.
* Exceptional people skills: You write and speak clearly, collaborate well across teams, and build trust quickly, and you handle sensitive information with discretion. When a bet needs a team, you can lead it.
* User obsession and agility: You start with the user’s pain points and reason from first principles about what would actually solve it. You use AI to build agents and products, and iterate quickly, and you keep going until you deliver real value and user delight.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2+ Years of work experience & a degree in engineering is preferred.
* Excellent communicator: confident on demos, clear in writing, equally effective with a business stakeholder and an engineer.

title: Associate Manager, Product - Tech, Insight
description:
Location : Bengaluru, Karnataka
  
  
Fixed-term employment contract: 1 year
  
  
**About The/Nudge**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
**Founded**
with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About The Insight Program**
**Who are we solving for?**
We are solving for millions of adults in India, especially in rural communities, living with uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting 1 in 3 people over 30. Without timely access to simple solutions like reading glasses, they face barriers to work and income, despite evidence showing such interventions can boost productivity by 34% and income by 20%.
  
  
**What are we solving for?**
Millions in India experience uncorrected presbyopia, a near-vision impairment affecting one in three people over 30, with cases now appearing as early as 35. Globally, presbyopia is the most common cause of vision impairment, impacting over 800 million people. In India alone, 300 million people live with this condition, contributing to $14 billion in lost productivity each year.
  
  
For many, especially in rural communities, clear near vision is essential for work and daily activities. Without access to timely solutions, individuals may face challenges in earning a livelihood. However, studies from Assam and Bangladesh show that a simple intervention - reading glasses - can increase productivity by 34% and boost income by 20%.
  
  
Despite the clear benefits, several factors have made it difficult for people to access reading glasses at scale.
  
  
With only one trained optometrist per 180,000 people, access to professional eye care remains a challenge in many areas.
  
  
Many individuals aren’t aware that their near-vision difficulties can be easily corrected, and some hesitate to wear glasses due to social and cultural perceptions.
  
  
Bringing reading glasses to remote and rural areas requires innovative and community-driven approaches to ensure affordability and reach.
  
  
Through the InSight Program, The/Nudge Institute is collaborating with central and state governments to make India presbyopia-free using a community-led model.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Define and drive product strategy by translating program needs into a clear roadmap with measurable milestones.
* Lead user research to deeply understand field staff, beneficiaries, and government users, ensuring an intuitive and scalable product experience
* Drive adoption within operations teams by designing onboarding, training, and change management plans, and monitoring adoption metrics
* Configure new modules and set up new programs on the tech platform
* Work with team members to manage the DevOps and build pipelines of the tech product, including the monitoring of application services, Kafka, etc.
* Set up and work with virtual machines in cloud environments like Azure & AWS
* Write scripts to automate tasks specifically with respect to data extraction and manipulation (e.g. using Python)
* Data engineering for production-ready ETL for large datasets using software such as Apache Spark
* Administer and manage third-party tools used. Eg: Survey software such as SurveyCTO, Kobo Toolbox
* Work with the product team to develop automations for operations teams

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* Have a strong motivation to contribute to poverty alleviation efforts in India
* Are willing to make periodic field visits to understand the program and the users for whom the tech product is being built
* Work with a high level of rigour - especially in implementing development and DevOps best practices
* Have 5+ years of work experience in development, and/ or DevOps:

+ Experience with developing ETL pipelines
+ Experience in scripting / automations
+ Development experience in any programming language
+ Working with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure

* Have the ability to work independently in an AI-first, fast-paced, ambiguous startup environment (bias for action and curiosity to learn)

**What’s in it for you?**

* Own your growth: An impact-led learning environment encourages Nudgesters to invest in their learning and capacity building needs through initiatives and policies, including L&D wallet, individual development plan and internal role change opportunities.
* Find your tribe: Our hiring philosophy emphasises intent, attitude, smarts and skills, in that order, to build a cohesive environment for Nudgesters. The organisation is committed to curating people-centric policies, enhancing how employees experience life at The/Nudge.
* Take big bets: Organisational initiatives are intended to facilitate Nudgesters with a view to the big picture, illustrated by our impact across 50000+ households, 15+ governments, 200+ social enterprises and Charcha: India’s largest social sector convening forum.
* Make it happen: A product-based approach in an action-biased environment empowers Nudgesters to implement audacious plans. Driven to fail fast, we endeavour to optimise resources in favour of programs that align with our scale ambition.

*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organization and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*
