title: Product Marketing & Content Manager
description:
**About ZOCA**
We are at $2.5Mn+ ARR, 1000+ beauty and wellness businesses on the platform, and a $6M Series A behind us. We are not starting out. But we are also nowhere close to where we want to be.
  
  
Zoca is building the growth infrastructure that small beauty and wellness businesses have never had access to. Online visibility, bookings, payments, customer retention, voice AI.
  
  
We want people who will think, challenge, ship, and own outcomes.
  
  
**Why this role exists**
There are roughly 8.5 million local service businesses in the United States. Almost every tool ever built for them helps run the business. Almost none of them brings anyone through the door.
  
  
Zoca is a growth system for those businesses, starting with beauty and wellness. More than 1,000 businesses use it today. We are backed by Accel, Elevation Capital, Better Capital, and GTM Fund. Our AI agents get a business found, answer its calls, book its clients, recover its drop-offs, and bring people back, all reading from one shared memory of that business.
  
  
Our customers are salon and med spa owners. They are busy, they have been sold to badly before, and they judge us on exactly one thing. Did more people walk in.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* The path from signup to first visible win, measured in days rather than impressions.
* Progression from the ramp plan to the full plan, and every lever that moves it.
* The monthly value report. Every account should receive an honest account of what we did for them, including how many of the clients we brought were genuinely new rather than people who were coming anyway. Being straight about that distinction is a competitive advantage in this category, not a risk.
* Product communication. Changelogs, in-app messaging, and release notes written for a salon owner rather than for an engineer.
* The knowledge base and the help content that both our AI front desk and our own team rely on.
* Positioning and enablement on the way in. Battlecards against the booking platforms, pricing communication, and launch messaging for new agents. This is a full product marketing seat, not only a retention one.

**Your first 90 days**
The order here matters more than usual, and we will hold you to it.
  
  

* Write the definition of a result, and get it instrumented

Our pricing depends on a number, and a customer has to be able to read how we calculate it and agree. Until that is true, nothing else you build can be trusted, and any communication on top of it makes disputes louder rather than quieter. Nothing else starts until this is done.
  
  

* Backtest the progression gate against real history

Run our criteria against accounts we already have and tell us honestly what it predicts. We would rather find out now that our own gate is wrong.
  
  

* Ship the first monthly value report to every account

Not a dashboard nobody opens. Something an owner reads in ninety seconds and believes.
  
  

* Rebuild the first 14 days after signup

So that a new customer has one measurable win inside two weeks, and knows it happened.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**

* 4 - 6 years in product marketing, lifecycle, or customer marketing at a SaaS company. Small business customers strongly preferred, because enterprise instincts genuinely do not transfer to a salon owner with three staff.
* You have owned a retention or activation number rather than contributed to one.
* You can write clearly for a non-technical reader, with no marketing language anywhere near it.
* You are comfortable inside data. You should be able to pull a cohort yourself and tell us what it says without waiting on anyone.
* You will tell us when a number is not real. In this seat that matters more than being right.

**What This Is Not**
Not a campaign calendar role. Not a role where product tells you what to write and you write it. If the product experience is the reason customers are not getting value, we expect you to say so plainly and to push on it until it changes. You will have the access to do that.
  
  
*Zoca is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation is total CTC and includes a variable component tied to activation and retention outcomes. If you are excited by the role but unsure you meet every line, apply anyway and let the exercise speak.*
Skills: content marketing,customer marketing,product marketing,lifecycle marketing

title: Research Associate - Medical Devices & Imaging
description:
**About The Team / Practice Area**
The Medical Devices & Imaging cluster within TechVision tracks emerging and disruptive technologies transforming diagnosis, intervention, monitoring, rehabilitation, and care delivery. The team connects scientific and engineering advances with clinical needs, regulatory pathways, adoption dynamics, commercial potential, and growth opportunities across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our analysts engage with medical-device and imaging companies, healthcare providers, clinicians, researchers, universities, startups, investors, regulators, standards bodies, technology developers, and manufacturing partners. This ecosystem perspective helps the team evaluate technology maturity, clinical utility, competitive differentiation, implementation barriers, and routes to commercialization.
  
  
The cluster delivers syndicated research, technology scouting, opportunity assessments, benchmarking and prioritization studies, innovator and partner landscapes, growth opportunity analysis, executive briefings, workshops, and customized consulting engagements for medtech, diagnostics, imaging, digital health, life-science, and healthcare organizations.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Research Associate is a full-time entry-level position, ideal for a recent graduate or a candidate with 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in medical devices, biomedical engineering, medical imaging, diagnostics, digital health, healthcare research, life sciences, market intelligence, or a related field.
  
  
The associate will support the Medical Devices & Imaging cluster by conducting primary and secondary research, tracking technology and innovation signals, evaluating companies and ecosystems, and developing high-quality client deliverables. The role requires the ability to understand both the technical and business dimensions of healthcare innovation and translate complex evidence into clear implications, growth opportunities, and actionable recommendations.
  
  
Core Areas of Focus
  
  

* Advanced diagnostics and point-of-care testing
* Medical imaging, including X-ray, ultrasound, MRI, CT, optical and hybrid imaging
* AI-enabled diagnostics, image analysis, clinical decision support and workflow automation
* Connected medical devices, remote patient monitoring, wearables and digital biomarkers
* Surgical robotics, image-guided interventions, navigation and visualization technologies
* Minimally invasive devices, endoscopy and interventional technologies
* Implantable, bioelectronic, neuromodulation and drug-delivery devices
* Personalized, home-based, virtual and decentralized care technologies
* Rehabilitation, assistive, ophthalmic, hearing and vision-care technologies
* Smart materials, sensors, microfluidics, electronics and manufacturing enablers for medical devices

**Responsibilities**
Research and Analysis
  
  

* Monitor and analyze emerging technologies, clinical innovations, product developments, regulatory milestones, patents, scientific publications, funding activity, partnerships, acquisitions, and commercialization signals across medical devices and imaging.
* Conduct structured secondary research using peer-reviewed literature, clinical-trial registries, patent databases, company disclosures, regulatory databases, government and health-agency publications, conference materials, and credible industry sources.
* Support primary research through interviews with clinicians, researchers, device manufacturers, technology developers, startups, investors, healthcare providers, and other subject matter experts.
* Assess technology readiness, clinical utility, unmet need, differentiation, adoption potential, regulatory considerations, reimbursement context, scalability, and commercial relevance.
* Develop technology landscapes, value-chain maps, ecosystem assessments, company profiles, innovation benchmarks, and opportunity-prioritization frameworks.
* Identify emerging signals and technology convergence across medical devices, imaging, AI, sensors, microelectronics, materials, advanced manufacturing, and digital health.
* Evaluate innovations across the care continuum, including pre-hospital, hospital, post-acute, remote, and home-based care settings.
* Analyze the implications of emerging technologies for R&D strategy, product portfolios, partnerships, market entry, care pathways, and future growth.
* Maintain research trackers and evidence repositories with strong source traceability, data accuracy, and consistent taxonomy.

Content Development
  
  

* Produce high-quality research reports, technology assessments, executive summaries, presentations, dashboards, and client-ready deliverables.
* Translate scientific, engineering, clinical, regulatory, and commercial evidence into clear narratives, visuals, frameworks, and recommendations.
* Contribute to syndicated research and customized consulting projects covering technology scouting, benchmarking, prioritization, partner identification, innovation strategy, and growth opportunity analysis.
* Support cluster intelligence by converting research into client propositions, executive briefings, strategic workshops, and opportunity themes.
* Identify potential innovators, startups, research institutions, suppliers, technology partners, and best-practice companies relevant to client priorities.
* Contribute to thought leadership, webinars, client presentations, conference materials, and other external-facing content.

Stakeholder Engagement and Delivery
  
  

* Work closely with global research teams, sector specialists, account teams, and cross-cluster experts to build integrated perspectives.
* Manage key stakeholders by sector and practice area to ensure expectations are met or exceeded and timelines are followed.
* Support expert interviews, client discussions, research validation, workshops, and presentation of findings.
* Take ownership of assigned deliverables and maintain high standards of technical accuracy, analytical rigor, consistency, and presentation quality.
* Work effectively with a global team to create a strong customer experience and contribute to the broader growth strategy of the business.

**Preferred Research And Technology Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; working knowledge of Power BI or other visualization tools is desirable.
* Familiarity with scientific-literature, patent, clinical-trial, regulatory, company, funding, and market-intelligence databases.
* Ability to interpret medical-device and imaging technology concepts, clinical workflows, technical specifications, performance evidence, and product-development pathways.
* Understanding of technology readiness levels, innovation scouting, technology benchmarking, opportunity prioritization, competitor analysis, and ecosystem mapping.
* Awareness of medical-device quality and regulatory concepts, including risk classification, clinical evidence, validation, and post-market considerations, is desirable.
* Ability to analyze quantitative and qualitative evidence and communicate findings through clear frameworks, scorecards, charts, and visual storytelling.
* Ability to use AI-powered research and productivity tools responsibly to improve research efficiency, synthesis, and quality.

Required Competencies
  
  
Education
  
  
UG: B.E./B.Tech in Biomedical, Biotechnology, Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Computer Science, Medical Electronics, or a related engineering discipline; or B.Sc./B.Pharm in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Medical Technology, Radiologic/Imaging Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related field.
  
  
PG preferred: M.E./M.Tech, M.Sc., M.Pharm, MBA, MPH, or an equivalent qualification in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Imaging, Medical Technology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Healthcare Management, or a related discipline.
  
  
Professional and Personal Skills
  
  

* Excellent analytical, research, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to synthesize technical, clinical, regulatory, and commercial information from diverse sources and identify meaningful patterns.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop concise, evidence-based, and compelling business content.
* Curiosity about medical technology, clinical innovation, patient needs, healthcare delivery, and emerging business models.
* Ability to work with ambiguity and structure complex research questions into practical workplans and outputs.
* Self-motivated, independent, detail-oriented, responsible, and collaborative.
* Well organized, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable working to tight deadlines with remote supervision.
* Disciplined and committed to high-quality standards, source traceability, and data accuracy.
* Strategic thinker who understands how research and operational activities support client value and business growth.
* Adaptable and able to learn new technologies, clinical areas, research tools, and analytical approaches quickly.

What Will Make You Succeed at Frost & Sullivan?
  
  
**You Will Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have a genuine interest in medical devices, diagnostics, imaging, digital health, and healthcare innovation.
* Can connect technical advances with clinical needs, adoption realities, and commercial opportunities.
* Enjoy investigating emerging technologies and identifying innovators before opportunities become obvious.
* Balance scientific and analytical rigor with practical business thinking.
* Communicate complex healthcare and technology insights clearly, visually, and persuasively.
* Demonstrate intellectual curiosity, accountability, collaboration, and a growth mindset.
* Take ownership and consistently deliver accurate, polished, client-ready work.

**Benefits**

* Competitive base salary plus bonus opportunity.
* Attractive Medical and Accident insurance.
* Regional travel opportunities.
* A friendly open environment with a diverse and international operational focus.
* A definite career path with numerous growth opportunities.
* You will be part of a winning, global team that fosters teamwork and an Olympic spirit while enhancing your communication and people skills.
* Encouragement to develop your intellectual curiosity and will be provided the ability to collaborate across all levels of the company across the globe.
* Global awards & recognition opportunities & awards - President Club & Chairman Club Awards
* “Best in class" global team that strives for excellence.
* Matrix structure with high visibility to top leadership

title: Product Intern - Stratzy (Raise)
description:
**Role Summary**

Raise is built on this core philosophy, we will bring exceptionally great products, awesome user

experience and best-in-class customer service to our users. We started with our first consumer product, Dhan, an investment and trading platform launched in November 2021.

Today,
**Dhan ranks #8 amongst stock brokers in India**
and continues to be one of the fastest-growing platforms in the investment and trading ecosystem.

In September 2026,
**Dhan was also recognised as Fintech Startup of the Year at the Global Fintech Festival,**
reflecting the innovation, product excellence and customer focus that continue to shape the platform. Backed by a passionate team of builders, believers, designers and problem-solvers, we are building a trusted ecosystem of financial products that empowers millions of users to make smarter financial decisions.

**Stratzy**
is an algorithmic investing and trading platform that makes rule-based, system-driven trading accessible to everyday investors. The platform offers 100+ ready-made, approved algorithmic strategies across equities, indices, F&O, and commodities, letting users pick and deploy structured strategies instead of having to build and monitor trades themselves.

We are looking for a curious, proactive and ownership-driven
**Product Intern**
to join the Stratzy Product team. This is an opportunity to work on real product challenges, contribute ideas, collaborate directly with the leadership team and help build features that solve actual user problems. You will gain hands-on experience in product management, user research, data analysis and product development.

This is a
**3 to 6 month internship**
, with a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) opportunity for high performers, based on performance and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of product features, improvements and experiments, from ideation to launch.
* Understand user needs and pain points, identify opportunities and suggest solutions to improve the product experience.
* Work closely with the leadership team to understand business priorities, share ideas and contribute to product decisions.
* Translate ideas and business problems into clear product requirements, user journeys and actionable tasks.
* Collaborate with design, engineering, marketing and customer support teams to bring product ideas to life.
* Analyse user behaviour, product data and customer feedback to identify opportunities and measure the impact of product improvements.
* Research competitors, market trends and emerging developments in fintech, investing and algorithmic trading.
* Interact with users, understand their experiences and bring actionable insights to the product roadmap.
* Track feature performance after launch and recommend improvements based on user feedback and data.

**Requirements**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in any discipline. Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics or related backgrounds are welcome, but not mandatory.
* Strong curiosity about digital products, technology, user behaviour and how businesses solve customer problems.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think logically and break down complex problems into simpler solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to share ideas and collaborate with different teams.
* A proactive mindset, willingness to learn and ability to take ownership in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable with numbers, analysing information and using data to support decisions.
* An interest in finance, stock markets, investing, trading or fintech is an advantage; prior knowledge of algorithmic trading is not mandatory.
* Prior internships, college projects, personal projects, product case studies or startup experience are welcome, but not essential.

We are a start-up organization focused on fast growth with quality products; hence, the ability to

work in a fast-paced environment goes without saying!

**If you are curious, enjoy solving problems and want hands-on experience building real products, we would love to hear from you!**

**Our People & Culture:**

People and culture are the most important aspects of our business.

We are looking for team members just like us, in simple words - good people to work with and

demonstrate following personality traits:

•
**Be super obsessed about ensuring customer satisfaction.**

(We are here because of our customers, and will be here only if we serve our customers)

•
**We have a single opportunity to serve.**

(Our customers will give us one opportunity to serve - we can’t let them down. Be it product,

uptimes, customer service or any interaction we have to deliver a wow experience.)

•
**Respect your work, your team, your co-workers and our customers.**

(The only way to get respect is to give it first)

•
**Speed is all that matters. Ship right and ship faster.**

(You either help the team move ahead fast, or you slow it down. We prefer the first.)

•
**Humility & politeness over arrogance & over-confidence.**

(If you are the smartest one in the room, bring up others to speed. We are here to serve our

customers, not to prove a point.)

•
**Quality over quantity.**

(It is fine if you pick up a few things to do, but do them exceedingly well.)

•
**Make your hands dirty irrespective of who you are.**

(Our CEO responds to customers every day. Our CTO codes every day. This is us.)

•
**Talent and Competency over Credentials.**

•
**Entrepreneurial, ownership driven and disciplined.**

(We trust you to help us gain and retain the trust of our customers and our stakeholders)

•
**Less words, more action.**

(Believe in something? show it by doing things. Not just by talking about it)

•
**Flat hierarchy with open culture & conversations.**

(You are among all of us, and we all are with you)

•
**Passionate about the business you are a part of.**

(Do it because you are passionate about it, not because it’s your job.)

**Why Join Raise?**

We’ve been recognised as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, reflecting the culture we’ve built and the way we work together. At Raise, you’ll experience a flat hierarchy, open conversations, high ownership and a strong bias for action. We value people who bring passion, humility and curiosity to their work, and who care deeply about building great products and creating meaningful customer impact.

We believe in growth with ownership, speed with thoughtfulness and ambition with humility. We

celebrate wins, learn from challenges and give people the ownership and responsibility to build and make an impact. If you enjoy building from the ground up, working with passionate people, and being part of a high-growth fintech ecosystem, Raise offers an environment where you can do meaningful work and grow with the business.

**About Raise Financial Services**

Raise Financial Services is building technology-led financial products and infrastructure for India’s financially aware and digitally savvy consumers. Our ecosystem spans multiple aspects of financial services, with Dhan as our flagship investment and trading platform.

Alongside Dhan, we are building and scaling businesses across the financial ecosystem, including Stratzy, Millions, Upsurge, Filter Coffee, Pluto Insurance, Fuzz and several other emerging products and platforms.

Our ambition is to build a trusted ecosystem of financial products and experiences that make

investing, trading, wealth creation and other financial services simpler, smarter and more accessible. Our philosophy is simple:

* Build great products.
* Deliver awesome experiences.
* Provide exceptional customer service.

Location: Goregaon West, Mumbai

Explore More:

happenings.

If you are excited about building and scaling one of India's most ambitious consumer fintech

**careers@dhan.co**

title: Product Associate
description:
**Job Role - Product Associate**
**Location - Pune**
**What The Work Is Like**
Nobody will hand you a finished spec. You'll get a customer with a problem, a rough idea of what good looks like, and
  
  
people who will help if you ask. You talk to the customer, work out what is actually wrong, decide what to build, get it
  
  
built (with engineers, or with AI tools yourself), and check that it worked. Then you do the next one.
  
  
You'll own one area of the product and the customers who use it. We decide which area together, once you've joined,
  
  
based on what you're good at.
  
  
**You'll do well here if**

* You've started something nobody asked you to: a project, a small business, an event, a fix at work, an app
* When instructions are unclear, you make a sensible assumption, say it out loud, and get moving
* You'd rather ship something that works on Friday than something perfect next month
* You go and ask the person with the problem instead of guessing
* You pick up new things quickly, whether that's a new industry, a codebase or a customer's business

**You probably won't enjoy it if**

* You do your best work when the task is fully defined before you start
* You want a large team and a fixed process around you

**What We Don't Require**
A particular degree or college, a product title, or years of experience. Some of our best people came from customer
  
  
support, operations or a family business.
  
  
**How To Apply**
We don't start with your CV. The application form asks for:
  
  

* A link to something you built, ran or fixed that nobody asked you to. Any form counts: an app, a spreadsheet,

an event, a process, a video.
  
  

* What was broken, what you did, and what happened. At most 100 words, with at least one real name, number

or date.
  
  

* One time nobody told you what to do. What did you do in the first hour? At most 100 words.
* When you can start, and a link to your CV or LinkedIn.

Applications without a link, or with answers over 100 words, are not read. The limits are part of the test.
  
  
Apply here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfKHxjoKx3sOvBijnnloJQqE3ywMJpyP9T0GoR7\_kB\_5FKQfQ/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=104777260577875084657
  
  
What happens next: a 30-minute written exercise, a 20-minute call, a take-home (AI tools allowed) and a conversation about
  
  
it, then a final conversation with our CEO.
  
  
**About CrelioHealth**
CrelioHealth is a fast-growing health-tech product company delivering cloud-based LIMS, RIS, CRM, and Inventory solutions to diagnostics labs and hospitals globally. We are building scalable systems that power modern healthcare operations.
  
  
**Website**
: www.creliohealth.com

title: Breakthrough NextGen Internship
description:
**Title: Breakthrough NextGen Internship**

**Type: Paid**

**No of Interns: 8**

**Location: Delhi**

**Internship Duration- 11 weeks**

**Work Mode: Hybrid,**

Breakthrough’s work on gender justice extends beyond programme implementation to shaping narratives, influencing institutions, and building long-term alliances across sectors.

Many individuals who will influence institutions in the future; across universities, corporates, consulting firms, media organisations, and public policy spaces; are currently students or early professionals. Engaging with them early in their careers provides an opportunity to deepen their understanding of gender justice and build relationships that extend beyond the organisation itself.

Breakthrough currently engages young people through internships and volunteer programmes. While valuable, these engagements are often informal and task-oriented. A structured internship programme provides an opportunity to create a more intentional platform for talent engagement, learning, and strategic contribution. The proposed internship is therefore designed not primarily as a recruitment pipeline, but as a way to build an extended network of individuals who remain connected to Breakthrough and act as champions of its mission across institutions and sectors.

The internship is designed around
**defined project assignments**
that interns work on during the core phase of the programme. These projects will be drawn from areas that are strategically useful to Breakthrough but may not always receive dedicated internal capacity.The aim is to ensure that interns contribute meaningfully to the organisation while also gaining exposure to different aspects of social change work.

These projects can broadly fall across the following seven categories/ departments:

**1. Corporate and Institutional Engagement(Dept. - Resource Mobilisation)**

Interns can support Breakthrough’s engagement with corporates, philanthropic actors, and institutions by conducting strategic analysis and developing engagement materials.

Illustrative projects may include:

* **Corporate engagement strategy development**
* Mapping companies aligned with Breakthrough’s mission and identifying collaboration opportunities.
* **CSR landscape analysis**
* Analysing corporate CSR priorities related to gender justice, youth engagement, or social norms change.
* **Corporate partnership pitch documents**
* Developing pitch decks and partnership proposals for engaging potential corporate partners.
* **Employee engagement models**
* Designing frameworks for corporate employee engagement initiatives, including volunteering, pro-bono work, or digital campaigns.
* **Institutional partnership mapping**
* Identifying potential collaborations with universities, foundations, think tanks, and networks.

These projects help expand Breakthrough’s ecosystem of institutional partners.

**2. Narrative, Media, and Campaign Strategy (Dept.-Media & Communications)**

Narrative change is a central pillar of Breakthrough’s work. Interns with storytelling, communication, or creative backgrounds can contribute to this area.

Illustrative projects include:

* **Narrative analysis & research**

Analysing how gender-related issues are represented across digital media and public discourse, alongside conducting research-driven tasks to develop first drafts of documents on assigned gender topics.

* **Campaign strategy & media engagement**

Supporting the development of campaign narratives and audience strategies, while mapping and engaging with journalists, media platforms, and digital communities aligned with gender justice conversations.

* **Content creation & storytelling**

Conceptualising and producing content—particularly short-form social media content—through ideation, planning, and execution of shoots (in-office or field-based), in-app editing, and platform management. This also includes exploring diverse storytelling formats such as multimedia narratives, podcasts, and short-form videos.

* **Design support**

Assisting with design tasks as assigned by the graphic design team, in accordance with provided technical requirements.

These projects help strengthen Breakthrough’s influence in shaping public narratives.

**3. Research and Evaluation Support (Dept.-Research & Evaluation)**

Some interns may contribute to research and evaluation initiatives, supporting different stages of the research lifecycle.

Possible projects include:

* **Literature Review**

Undertaking literature review for select research or evaluation studies, entailing deep-diving into secondary sources, contributing towards developing conceptual frameworks and approaches, and mapping socio-demographic and psychographic contexts for key population groups and sub-groups of interest

* **Data Collection and Analysis**

Supporting the Research and Evaluation teams in planning and executing the data collection process, and undertaking quantitative and/or qualitative data analysis

* **Dissemination of Findings**

Supporting the Research and Evaluation teams disseminating the findings of select studies. This would include drafting high-level summaries for key stakeholders and assisting in the design of communication materials articulating key findings for a diverse set of audiences.

These outputs help strengthen research quality, enable knowledge sharing, and support the effective design and replication of studies and evaluation processes across programmes.

**4. Tools, Frameworks, and Methodology Development (Dept.- Deep Transformation & Community Engagement)**

Some interns may focus on developing tools or frameworks.

Illustrative work may include:

* **Programme methodology documentation**
* Documenting frameworks used in Breakthrough programmes.
* **Reporting & decks**

Preparing reports, presentations, and strategic decks for internal and external stakeholders.

* **Toolkit development**
* Creating toolkits that can be used by partners, educators, or community organisations.
* **Programme case studies**
* Documenting impactful initiatives and lessons learned.
* **Workshop or training modules**
* Designing structured modules for youth engagement or awareness building.

These outputs help codify organisational knowledge and improve programme replication.

**5. Thought Leadership and Knowledge Products(Dept.-Positioning)**

Breakthrough produces valuable insights/positioning papers which showcases BT evidence as well as contributes to the sectoral work. Interns can support the initial phase of development of structured knowledge products.

Examples include:

* **Research briefs/Scoping Papers**
* Producing short analytical papers on emerging gender issues.
* **Thought leadership pieces**
* Writing articles or reports that contribute to sector conversations.
* **Global comparisons**
* Analysing how gender justice campaigns operate in different countries.

These outputs help strengthen Breakthrough’s voice as a thought leader in the field.

**6. Organisational Strategy and Consulting Assignment (Dept.-Thematic)**

Some interns may work on projects that resemble short consulting assignments, supporting strategic planning and organisational decision-making.

Possible projects include:

* **Strategic landscape analysis**
* Identifying and mapping relevant policies, reforms, and programs, while building a database of organizations and government stakeholders in gender-transformative education, and identifying collaboration opportunities across aligned initiatives.
* **Programme expansion strategy**
* Analysing opportunities for expanding Breakthrough’s work into new areas or geographies.
* **Stakeholder mapping**
* Identifying networks, institutions, and influencers relevant to Breakthrough’s mission.
* **Strategic briefing documents**
* Preparing background notes and analyses to support leadership discussions, along with strategy updates informed by global trends and relevant international practices.

These assignments can provide valuable strategic inputs to the organisation.

**7. Gender Transformative Education System (Dept.-Strategic Partnerships and Scale Up)**

* **Develop a virtual platform for Learning**
* Documenting lessons learnt and creating a virtual platform for stakeholders to engage, discuss and take learnings
* **Thought leadership pieces**
* Writing articles or reports that contribute to sector conversations.
* **Drafting pitch documents / power point presentation**

Developing pitch deck (brief visual proposition of an idea/s)

* **Developing a compendium of short stories of change**

Professionally documenting short impactful “stories of change” within teachers, Govt. officials, SMC members, parents etc to develop a compendium/ book

* **Developing concept note bank**

Identify and draft different ideas from within the program which has the potential for expansion and develop concept notes (4-6)

These projects can strengthen the organisation’s ability to use data for learning and decision-making.

***Skills, Competencies & Experience Required:***

* Final Year Graduate and Post Graduate students can apply
* Good communication and presentation skills
* Domain knowledge for the department intern is applying for and relevant skills
* Confidence, positive 'can do’ attitude

*About Breakthrough:*

Breakthrough works on culture change by shifting social norms that limit women and girls from reaching their full potential. We work with adolescents and young people aged 11-25 years aiming for an entire generation to shift and push for change. Over time, we have worked with more

than 5.4 million adolescents and young people, aged 11 to 25, to encourage aspiration, agency, leadership and negotiation through our work in schools and communities. We also support them with media tools that shape public narratives.

This has resulted in a generation of young people shifting to think and act in confident, intentional ways. Girls are negotiating to stay in school, delaying marriage, exercising choices around life goals, stepping into non-traditional career paths. Boys are stepping up to contribute, support and uphold equal rights for all.

This gives hope that a more equal world is possible for future generations.

*Breakthrough’s Culture:*

Employees at Breakthrough are expected to work in line with organisational values of Dignity, Integrity and Equity.

Breakthrough is an equal opportunity employer. We consider applicants for all positions without regard to race, colour, caste, religion, creed, gender, age, disability, economic status, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status. We prefer people from marginalised communities, women and other genders. Our policies and procedures reflect our commitment towards child safeguarding. Breakthrough is committed to the well-being of its employees and understands an individual’s mental health can impact their ability to work. Breakthrough recognizes taking steps to improve mental health and wellbeing of the employees is essential. We are committed to fostering an environment that promotes employee wellbeing. We recognize that well-being is not just the absence of illness, but the presence of factors that support a fulfilling life.

**To know more about Breakthrough, please visit – www.inbreakthrough.org**

**Last date of submission is 8th November 2026.**

title: Director, UX Design
description:
**About This Role**
As Director of UX, you will lead and develop a team of UX professionals while remaining actively engaged in the work. This is a player-coach role that combines people leadership, UX strategy, hands-on design contribution, mentorship, and cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
You will help shape UX strategy and execution across Gartner’s products and digital platforms, working directly with Product, Engineering, Business and Technology Insights, Brand, and business stakeholders to solve complex customer problems. You will contribute to discovery, research, journey mapping, ideation, prototyping, design reviews, and validation while setting a high standard for the team’s work.
  
  
You will also help advance Gartner’s AI capabilities by building an AI-focused UX culture, encouraging responsible experimentation, creating AI prototypes, and training the team to use emerging AI tools and methods effectively. Success in this role requires the ability to move fluidly between strategic leadership, hands-on design work, coaching, and delivery.
  
  
**What You will do:**

* Define and execute the UX strategy across Gartner’s products, digital platforms, and key initiatives, from discovery through delivery and optimization.
* Lead, coach, and develop a growing team of UX professionals supporting multiple products and customer experiences.
* Serve as a player-coach, providing hands-on leadership across research, discovery, ideation, prototyping, design, testing, and design reviews.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Business and Technology Insights, Brand, Marketing, and business stakeholders to translate customer needs into clear, useful, and feasible experiences.
* Set expectations for UX quality, process, accessibility, collaboration, and customer-centered decision-making.
* Advance an AI-focused, human-centered UX culture by guiding AI-enabled experiences, rapid prototypes, proofs of concept, and design experiments.
* Promote responsible AI design principles, including transparency, trust, accessibility, privacy, human oversight, and inclusion.
* Build team capability and foster continuous learning through coaching, mentorship, design critiques, training, Design Thinking, user research, and experimentation.

**What you’ll need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Design, UX/UI Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in UX, product design, interaction design, design research, information architecture, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience managing and developing UX or Product Design professionals, ideally in a player-coach leadership role.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX leadership and delivery, including discovery, research, interaction design, prototyping, testing, and implementation.
* Experience defining UX strategy and leading execution across multiple products or initiatives, balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, business objectives, and strategic priorities.
* Experience using AI tools or AI-enabled workflows for UX research, ideation, prototyping, experimentation, or product development.
* Experience designing accessible and inclusive experiences and leading cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong communication, storytelling, collaboration, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills, along with a growth mindset and enthusiasm for learning, teaching, and applying emerging technologies responsibly.

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

title: Solutions Design Analyst, Specialty Solutions
description:
At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific. Join us in making clinical trials easier, faster, more engaging, and accessible to all. We are transforming the future of clinical trials. Our Specialty Solutions & Clinical Adjudication team supports some of the world’s most complex and meaningful studies, helping sponsors bring life‑changing therapies to patients faster.

We're looking for passionate Solutions Design Analysts to join our growing team in India. This role is ideal for professionals with a Business Analyst mindset who enjoy analyzing complex clinical trial requirements, engaging with stakeholders, and translating business needs into effective technology solutions.

If you have a background in Life Sciences, Clinical Research, Healthcare Technology, or Business Analysis, along with experience in eCOA, ePRO, IRT/RTSM, eConsent, or other clinical technologies, you'll play a critical role in bridging the gap between clinical study requirements and system design. Your work will directly contribute to improving patient, site, and sponsor experiences while helping bring innovative therapies to market faster.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation and incentives
* Comprehensive benefits supporting security, flexibility, wellbeing, and work–life balance
* Engaging employee programs and learning opportunities
* Hybrid working technology and excellent onsite facilities

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Act as the primary liaison between sponsors, project teams, and technical stakeholders to analyze, document, and translate clinical trial requirements into scalable technology solutions.
* Lead requirements gathering workshops and discovery sessions to understand protocol objectives, study workflows, and operational needs.
* Manage and coordinate the end-to-end Solutions Design process, ensuring clinical protocols are accurately translated into system specifications and configurations.
* Produce clear business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, and design documentation to support study implementations.
* Provide business analysis expertise during client-facing meetings, helping stakeholders understand solution capabilities, constraints, and recommendations.
* Create and maintain study-specific configuration and design specifications for Clario products and services.
* Analyze system, workflow, and data requirements to ensure consistency between clinical data capture, reporting, delivery, and database structures.
* Partner with Clinical Systems Translation & Licensing to ensure appropriate questionnaire versions and content are implemented.
* Support validation and quality review activities by investigating and resolving design-related issues and defects.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze study issues, identify root causes, and recommend process or system improvements.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to optimize business processes, documentation standards, and solution delivery practices.
* Work closely with Clinical Project Managers to ensure sponsor requirements and business objectives are effectively translated into system solutions.
* Lead or participate in internal and external design reviews, solution workshops, and milestone meetings.
* Represent Solutions Design during client audits by explaining solution methodologies, business processes, standards, and best practices.
* Support Business Development and Project Management teams by reviewing study protocols, assessing feasibility, and providing solution recommendations for new opportunities.
* Configure clinical technology platforms in alignment with approved business requirements and configuration specifications.

**What We Look For**

* BSc, MSc, or PhD in Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Healthcare, Clinical Research, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Experience as a Business Analyst, Clinical Business Analyst, Clinical Research Associate (CRA), Clinical Research Manager, Project Coordinator, Project Manager, Solutions Analyst, or similar role.
* Demonstrated experience gathering, documenting, and managing business and system requirements across multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of clinical research processes, clinical trial operations, and eClinical technologies.
* Experience with eCOA/ePRO, IRT/RTSM, eConsent, Clinical Adjudication, or other healthcare technology platforms is highly desirable.
* Proven ability to analyze complex workflows and translate business requirements into functional system solutions.
* Experience facilitating stakeholder discussions, requirement workshops, and client-facing meetings.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, process-mapping, and documentation skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Experience working in global, cross-functional environments with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Passion for leveraging technology to improve clinical trial execution, patient engagement, and healthcare outcomes.

At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

title: Apprenticeship
description:
**Overview**
This role is for an Apprenticeship – Ecology (Desk-Based, Global Technology Centre – India)
  
  
**Your role**

* Project Support: Work as part of the AtkinsRéalis Environment team from GTC India, supporting a range of UK ecology and environmental planning projects across various sectors. Collaborate closely with UK colleagues to integrate ecological expertise into multidisciplinary project deliverables.
* Ecological Desk Studies & Data Analysis: Conduct desk-based ecological assessments by analysing site survey data for habitats and species. Support ecological desk studies, helping establish baseline ecological conditions and inform project planning and design.
* Environmental Planning & EIA Support: Contribute to Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) and planning consent processes by preparing ecological input sections, baseline descriptions, and technical reports. Assist in evaluating project impacts on biodiversity, and incorporate biodiversity and nature recovery considerations into planning documents and ecological impact assessments.
* GIS Mapping & Spatial Analysis: Use Geographical Information Systems (GIS) (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS) to perform spatial analysis and create high-quality maps of ecological features such as habitats, protected species locations, and designated sites. Provide clear visualisations to support environmental reports and decision-making.
* Data Management & Quality Assurance: Manage and interpret ecological data sets with attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and right-first-time delivery. Adhere to high quality standards in data handling, documentation, and reporting.
* Team Collaboration: Work in a virtual team environment, engaging in technical discussions and knowledge-sharing sessions. Take ownership of your work and proactively communicate progress and findings. Contribute positively to team meetings and coordinate effectively with UK-based ecologists, planners, and other specialists.

**About You**

* Education & Skills: Completed Master's degree (M.Sc) in a relevant field with hands-on knowledge of ecological data analysis and technical report writing.
* Adaptability: Willingness to learn and adapt to UK-specific ecology standards, tools, and data sources, with training and mentoring provided as needed.
* Understanding: Clear and demonstrable understanding of ecological and biodiversity principles, and how they relate to environmental planning and impact assessment processes.
* Communication: Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, along with good written and spoken English for effective communication and report writing.
* Enthusiasm: A genuine passion for ecology and environment, and a proactive approach to continuous learning and professional development.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Education: Master's degree (M.Sc) in a relevant life science or environmental discipline from a recognised university, such as Zoology, Botany, Wildlife Biology, Ecology & Biodiversity, Environmental Science (ecology-focused), Forestry, or a related field.
* Graduation Year: Recent postgraduates who completed their M.Sc in 2025 or 2026 (fresh graduates or those with limited experience are welcome to apply).
* GIS Proficiency: Strong interest and hands-on experience with GIS tools (e.g., ArcGIS, QGIS, or similar) applied to ecological or environmental data sets (through academic projects or coursework).
* Language: Good technical report writing skills and fluency in English.

**Desired Qualifications**

* UK Ecology Awareness: Awareness of or eagerness to learn about UK ecology and environmental regulations (e.g., protected species, Biodiversity Net Gain principles, habitat classifications, nature recovery initiatives) and relevant industry guidance (CIEEM, etc.).
* Data & Analysis: Experience with ecological data analysis methods or software (e.g., basic statistics in R/Python, species distribution or biodiversity data tools) is an advantage.
* Innovation & Tools: Interest in digital innovation and automation in ecological work (e.g., using scripting for data processing, advanced GIS analysis, or visualization techniques) to add value in project delivery.
* Professional Development: Enthusiasm for pursuing further certifications or training in ecology, environmental management, or related technical skills, demonstrating commitment to continuous improvement.

**Rewards & benefit**
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career. Enjoy competitive salaries, employee rewards and a brilliant range of benefits you can tailor to suit your own health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle choices. Make the most of a myriad of opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise. And combine our hybrid working culture and flexible holiday allowances to balance a great job and fulfilling personal life.
  
  
**About AtkinsRéalis**
We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.
  
  
Find out more.

title: Application Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
As Application Engineer, you'll work alongside the Regional Sales/Applications Engineer to further the technical relationship with the customer once a utility-scale PV project reaches the advanced sales stage (roughly 90% probability of closing) and carry it through commissioning and operation. You'll be the person the customer reaches out to with technical questions, the one who makes sure their inverter parameter settings are right before energization, and the bridge between our customers and our internal engineering, service, and modeling teams.
  
  
This is a great role for an engineer who enjoys working directly with customers, wants to build deep product expertise in utility-scale inverters, and takes pride in getting the details right.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Support customers from late-stage sales through commissioning
  
  

* Act as the primary technical contact for project-specific questions once the opportunity reaches the advanced stage, taking a structured handover from the Application Engineer
* Respond to customer requests for technical clarifications, documentation, and project-specific information
* Field questions on inverter configuration, operation, and site-specific requirements

**Own inverter parameter settings**

* Work with customers to finalize project-specific parameter settings, and build a working understanding of how each parameter affects inverter behavior and performance
* Maintain and update parameter-setting documents, and create the parameter files used to configure inverters in the field
* Verify that customer-approved settings are correctly documented and signed off before commissioning
* Support parameter-related discussions during project execution and commissioning

**Deliver accurate project documentation**

* Prepare project-specific technical documentation based on the finalized inverter option codes
* Review documents for accuracy and completeness before they go to customers or internal teams
* Keep clean records of configurations, parameter settings, option codes, and customer approvals

**Coordinate across teams**

* Partner with Project Managers to provide timely technical input throughout the project lifecycle
* Work with our Service and Modeling teams in India to deepen your knowledge of inverter operation, commissioning requirements, and parameter behavior
* Pull in product and engineering subject-matter experts when issues go beyond project scope, and escalate early when needed

**Build and share knowledge**

* Develop strong product expertise in SMA's utility-scale inverters, communication systems, option codes, and parameter settings
* Capture lessons learned from project issues and feed them back into templates, documents, and processes
* Help standardize parameter-setting documents and project support workflows so every project gets easier than the last

**What Success Looks Like**

* Customers get consistent, responsive technical support from late-stage sales through commissioning — no dropped handoffs
* Parameter settings and configurations are reviewed, approved, and documented correctly the first time
* Project documentation goes out accurate and on schedule
* Application Engineers are freed up to focus on new projects, new customers, and new business

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or power systems.
* Experience with utility-scale PV, power conversion systems, or inverter-based resources preferred — but we'll consider strong candidates earlier in their careers who show the right technical foundation
* Working knowledge of PV inverter operation, controls, communication systems, and parameter settings
* Comfort reading technical specifications, electrical drawings, and project documentation
* Clear written and verbal communication — you can explain technical details to customers without jargon and without losing precision
* Strong organizational skills; you'll juggle multiple projects with different timelines and keep commitments on all of them
* Ability to collaborate effectively with international, cross-functional teams across time zones
* Genuine curiosity about how inverters behave and a willingness to keep learning

AI-GENERATED APPLICATION MATERIALS
  
  
We review all resumes and application materials for AI-generated content. Submissions that show evidence of AI manipulation, including AI-written resumes, cover letters, or responses, will be disqualified from consideration without further review. We want to hear your authentic voice and see your genuine experience.

description:
**Analyst - Document Control and Information Management**

* Great opportunity to build expertise in Document Control and Information Management
* Manage the registration, classification, version control and distribution of project documentation

**About The Role**
We are looking for a meticulous and organised
**Analyst - Document Control and Information Management**
to support the accurate and controlled management of project documentation.
  
  
The selected individual will work alongside Information Controllers and the broader Information Management team to maintain document integrity, support project teams and ensure compliance with company policies, quality requirements and applicable regulatory standards throughout the document lifecycle.
  
  
What the role entails
  
  
This role is a strong opportunity for a document control professional with experience managing controlled documentation within engineering, construction, oil and gas, or other asset-intensive environments.
  
  
Success in this role will require strong attention to detail, sound organisational skills and a clear understanding of document registration, classification, metadata, version control and approval workflows.
  
  
The successful candidate will help ensure that project documents are correctly registered, stored, accessed, maintained and distributed through the applicable Electronic Document Management System or Information Management System.
  
  
The role will also support audits, compliance activities, workflow improvements and broader Information Management initiatives.
  
  
**Reporting line**
Information Management Lead
  
  
**Function**
Document Control and Information Management
  
  
Scope
  
  
Your scope will include, but is not limited to, the following
  
  
Document registration and control
  
  

* Receive, review, classify and register incoming and outgoing project documents in accordance with defined naming conventions, taxonomy and metadata standards.
* Maintain an organised and systematic filing structure within the EDMS or IMS to enable accurate and timely document retrieval.
* Track document revisions and ensure that only the latest approved versions are circulated across the project and organisation.
* Update and maintain document control logs, registers and metadata to ensure records remain current, accurate and auditable.
* Control access to documentation and safeguard confidential or sensitive information in accordance with company policies.

Quality and compliance
  
  

* Review documents for adherence to internal quality and compliance standards before distribution or filing.
* Support internal and external audits by retrieving documentation and verifying compliance with relevant regulatory and industry requirements.
* Support the implementation and maintenance of document control procedures, standards and work instructions.
* Identify and escalate document non-conformances, version-control issues and quality risks to the Information Management Lead.
* Maintain accurate audit trails and records in support of applicable compliance requirements

Document distribution and stakeholder support
  
  

* Distribute documents to relevant stakeholders in a timely, accurate and controlled manner.
* Coordinate with engineers, project managers and other departments to facilitate document approvals and ensure that approval workflows are completed correctly.
* Act as the first point of contact for document-related queries from authors, project teams and business users.
* Guide business users on document submission, retrieval and compliance requirements.
* Provide responsive support while maintaining a strong customer-service mindset.

Continuous improvement
  
  

* Identify opportunities to improve document control processes, filing structures and workflow efficiency within the Information Management System.
* Contribute to the development and delivery of document-control training and awareness sessions for project team members.
* Support the Information Management team with broader workflow improvements and compliance initiatives.
* Support digitalisation and automation initiatives associated with Information Management governance.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of standards-related knowledge bases, workflows and AI-enabled support tools.

* An associate’s or bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Engineering, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

* Experience within engineering, construction, oil and gas, or another asset-intensive industry would be advantageous.
* Practical experience with document management platforms and EDMS solutions such as ALIM, SharePoint, Documentum, OpenText or an equivalent system.
* A strong understanding of document registration, classification, version control, naming conventions and metadata management.
* An understanding of the complete document lifecycle, including creation, review, approval, distribution, maintenance and archival.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio and Outlook.
* The ability to maintain document logs, registers, metadata and audit trails accurately.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational capability and time-management skills.
* The ability to manage competing priorities and large volumes of controlled documentation.

title: HIL Systems Design & Integration Engineer
description:
**Department:**
Engineering – Test Systems & Automation

**Experience:**
3–6 years (preferred)

**Qualification:**
B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Automobile Engineering or related disciplines

**Role Overview**

NURBS LABS is looking for a technically competent and hands-on HIL Systems Design & Integration Engineer to undertake the design, development, integration, and validation of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) test systems for automotive and embedded electronic applications.

The candidate will be responsible for translating customer requirements into HIL hardware architectures, selecting and configuring suitable hardware modules, developing electrical interfaces and wiring designs, and executing end-to-end HIL system integration, primarily using Vector HIL hardware, I/O cards, and associated technologies.

The role requires a combination of system design expertise, practical electrical/electronic engineering skills, and strong troubleshooting capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. HIL System Design & Architecture**

* Understand customer requirements, ECU interfaces, test specifications, and HIL system requirements.
* Develop HIL hardware architectures, system block diagrams, electrical schematics, interface definitions, and wiring layouts.
* Identify and select suitable Vector hardware modules, I/O cards, signal conditioning units, communication interfaces, and power distribution components.
* Prepare technical BOMs, interface specifications, wiring schedules, connector pinouts, and integration documentation.
* Coordinate with Vector and other technology partners for hardware selection, configuration, and technical integration.

**2. Electrical Design & Hardware Integration**

* Design ECU interface circuits, power distribution systems, signal routing, protection circuits, and interface panels.
* Develop electrical wiring diagrams, cable harness designs, connector layouts, and rack-level integration drawings.
* Undertake hands-on HIL rack assembly, module installation, electrical wiring, harness preparation, and termination.

**3. HIL Configuration & System Development**

* Configure and integrate Vector HIL hardware and associated interfaces based on project requirements.
* Support CAN, CAN FD, LIN, Automotive Ethernet, and other relevant automotive communication interfaces.
* Perform signal mapping, I/O configuration, interface verification, and system-level hardware integration.
* Support integration with Vector CANoe, VT System, vTESTstudio, and related tools, as applicable.
* Coordinate with simulation and test automation teams for integration of HIL hardware with real-time simulation and automated testing environments.

**4. Testing, Commissioning & Troubleshooting**

* Perform continuity, insulation, grounding, power distribution, and electrical safety checks.
* Conduct hardware bring-up, communication verification, I/O testing, and functional validation.
* Diagnose wiring faults, signal integrity issues, communication failures, hardware configuration problems, and interface mismatches.
* Support system commissioning, Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), and customer acceptance activities.
* Prepare test procedures, validation reports, as-built documentation, and technical handover records.

**5. Project Execution & Technical Coordination**

* Coordinate with mechanical design, procurement, manufacturing, software, and customer engineering teams.
* Support component sourcing, BOM optimization, vendor technical discussions, and engineering change management.
* Ensure adherence to project quality, delivery schedules, safety requirements, and documentation standards.
* Contribute to standardization and continuous improvement of HIL integration processes.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Practical experience in automotive HIL systems, test benches, ECU testing, or embedded hardware validation.
* Working knowledge of Vector VT System hardware, I/O modules, interface cards, and HIL integration architecture.
* Ability to interpret and develop electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, cable schedules, and connector pinouts.
* Hands-on experience in electrical panel/rack wiring, cable harnessing, crimping, soldering, and connector termination.
* Understanding of analog/digital I/O, PWM, sensor simulation interfaces, power supplies, relays, and signal conditioning.
* Familiarity with CAN, CAN FD, LIN, and automotive ECU communication fundamentals.
* Proficiency with electrical measurement and diagnostic equipment  & Strong analytical skills in hardware debugging, integration, and system troubleshooting.

**Preferred Additional Skills (Good to Have)**

* Experience with Vector CANoe, vTESTstudio, VT System Configuration, and related engineering tools.
* Familiarity with ECU test automation, fault injection, and restbus simulation.
* Experience with electrical CAD tools such as EPLAN, AutoCAD Electrical, or equivalent.
* Knowledge of Python, CAPL, or scripting for HIL configuration and test automation.
* Experience in automotive OEM/Tier-1 HIL development or validation projects.
* Understanding of automotive electrical safety, EMC, grounding, and signal integrity considerations.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a
**practical, solution-oriented engineer**
who can take ownership of HIL hardware design and integration activities, from requirement interpretation and hardware selection through physical assembly, testing, and commissioning.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working on engineering design tools as well as directly on the shop floor or test bench, troubleshooting hardware, wiring, and interface-related issues.

**Remuneration:**
Competitive and commensurate with the candidate’s qualifications, technical skill set, relevant experience, and demonstrated capabilities, with consideration for long-term career commitment and professional growth within Nurbs Labs.

**How to Apply:**
Interested candidates may send your resume to
**contactus@nurbslabs.com**
, mentioning “HIL Systems Design & Integration Engineer” in the email subject line and shall list your key hands-on skills in the email body.

title: Optical CM Support Engineer - Operations Engineering Team
description:
**Job Description**
Join our Operations Engineering team as an
**Optical CM Support Engineer**
, where you will be responsible for developing, qualifying, and sustaining advanced optical assembly processes used in high-speed optical transceivers, photonic integrated circuit (PIC) modules, optical engines, and communication systems. You will work across the entire product lifecycle, from New Product Introduction (NPI) through high-volume manufacturing, driving process optimization, yield improvement, and root cause analysis.
  
  
In this role, you will support critical optical assembly technologies including fiber preparation, fusion splicing, fiber routing, optical connector and receptacle integration, active optical alignment, optical packaging, and photonic assembly processes. You will leverage optical measurement systems, microscopy, cross-sectional analysis, and reliability testing to ensure robust manufacturing processes and exceptional optical performance. Our collaborative environment encourages innovation, technical leadership, and continuous improvement while solving challenging manufacturing problems.
  
  
**NILightpath**
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Strong background in optical manufacturing processes and fiber optic assembly technologies.
* Hands-on experience with fusion splicing equipment, process development, optimization, and qualification.
* Expertise in fiber preparation (stripping, cleaving, cleaning, recoating) and best practices
* Experience with fiber routing design, management, bend-radius control, and optical packaging integration.
* Familiarity with optical connectors, receptacles, ferrules, adapters, and cable assemblies for high-performance products.
* Knowledge of optical module assembly and alignment processes, including active and passive methodologies.
* Experience with optical measurement and characterization techniques (IL, RL, power, wavelength verification).
* Ability to perform root cause analysis using optical microscopy, connector inspection, and failure analysis.
* Familiarity with manufacturing process control, SPC, DOE, PFMEA, and structured problem-solving.
* Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) and transitioning products to high-volume manufacturing.

title: Customer Solutions Engineer
description:
**About Us**
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
  
  
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
  
  
**Official Title - Center of Excellence Engineer**
**Available Locations: Bengaluru, India**
**About the Role:-**
As a Center of Excellence Engineer (Customer Solutions Engineer), you will provide technical guidance to Cloudflare customers. Working within the GTM organization and reporting to a Center of Excellence Leader, the Center of Excellence Engineer (CEE) helps Cloudflare customers and internal teams through structured onboarding, technical guidance, adoption support, and scalable enablement. You will guide customers as they move from provisioned accounts to a live, value-generating deployment. You are a Cloudflare product expert and will leverage your knowledge to ensure our customers understand and utilize the Cloudflare platform to its fullest extent. This is a customer-facing technical role focused on post-sale onboarding, technical advisory, 1:1 technical engagements and 1:many technical events. You will be collaborating with CEs, AEs, Support and other internal teams to ensure no customer falls through the cracks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Customer Onboarding and Deployment Readiness: Own the end-to-end technical onboarding experience for assigned customers post-provision. Lead structured onboarding calls, guide customers to configure initial Cloudflare settings (e.g., DNS records, SSL/TLS modes, WAF rules, Zero Trust policies), and validate that traffic is behaving as expected before the customer is declared live. Guide customers through onboarding and implementation runbooks and identify when an engagement requires escalation to the appropriate Cloudflare team. Troubleshoot common onboarding issues including DNS resolution failures, SSL/TLS certificate errors, caching misconfigurations, and authentication failures.
* Cloudflare Configuration Guidance: Guide customers through Cloudflare configuration steps for applicable platform capabilities, including DNS, SSL/TLS, CDN, Application Security, Zero Trust/SASE, Network Services, and other Cloudflare products as assigned. Help customers understand configuration options, operational best practices, and standard deployment patterns.
* Customer Technical Guidance and Enablement: Deliver standardized customer guidance sessions, technical walkthroughs, workshops, bootcamps, 1:1 technical engagements and 1:many technical sessions covering Cloudflare product specific best practices, migration procedures, and post-deployment administration. Explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical customer stakeholders.
* Documentation and Engagement Hygiene: Produce and maintain clear technical and operational artifacts, including call summaries, action item trackers, onboarding plans, runbooks, and handoff materials. Keep relevant internal systems updated after customer touchpoints and maintain high-quality documentation for continuity across teams.
* Cross-Functional Coordination and Escalation Management: Coordinate with Cloudflare Customer Engineering, Support, Product, Engineering, Account, and other internal teams to route complex technical issues, document blockers, support escalations, and maintain continuity of customer outcomes.
* Operational Improvement and Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to reusable templates, procedures, technical guides, internal knowledge articles, automation scripts, AI-assisted workflows, and process improvements that improve the quality, consistency, and efficiency of customer onboarding and customer engineering activities.
* Technical Breadth and Continuous Development: Build and maintain working knowledge across Cloudflare product foundations, including Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services, at a depth appropriate to onboarding, adoption, troubleshooting, and technical advisory scenarios. Stay current on Cloudflare product releases, internal process updates, and relevant certifications. Be familiar with and leverage AI technology available to you to create new and innovative tools to support your work.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5-12 years of experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Customer Engineer, Technical Support, Implementation Engineer, Onboarding Engineer, Sales/Systems Engineer, Technical Account Manager, or NOC/SOC analyst or equivalent hands-on technical experience managing customer deployments.
* Cloudflare product foundations: working knowledge of Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services.
* Networking fundamentals: understanding of DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP/HTTPS, CIDR, NAT, and BGP.
* Web security basics: familiarity with OWASP, WAF rules, OAuth, SAML, MFA, and Zero Trust principles.
* Configuration and integration: hands-on experience with the Cloudflare Dashboard, and comfort with Terraform, API-based configurations, or identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, and SAML/OIDC integrations.
* Observability: ability to read and interpret Security Events, Logs, cURL outputs, and HAR files; awareness of common causes of 5xx/4xx errors post-onboarding.
* Scripting and APIs: ability to read and debug REST API calls; basic proficiency with Python and Bash.

**Working Style:**

title: Technical Lead – Mechanical Prototyping

description:
Hiring: Technical Lead – Mechanical Prototyping

**Location:**
IISc Campus, Bangalore, Karnataka, India

**Organization:**
Centre of Excellence in Design (D-CoE), Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bangalore

**Reporting To:**
CEO, D-CoE
