title: Developer Advocate, Developer Solutions and Engineering Team
description:
**Description**
Do you want to help build the world’s greatest Developer Advocacy team? Amazon is seeking a dynamic problem solver, who will be responsible for all aspects of supporting developer accounts for the Amazon Appstore. In this role, you will be a part of a team of exceptionally driven, customer-obsessed specialists who strive to provide best-in-class support to a growing international community of developers. You will work directly with developers resolve queries, recommend best actions, analyze trends and drive solutions that meet and exceed developer needs. As a Developer Advocate, you will interact with both external developers and internal teams via multiple communication channels to drive solutions to meet developer needs.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Work with external developers to understand how they interact with the Amazon Appstore.
* Dig into the details of a system or process to address customer problems
* Provide valuable feedback to business and development teams to help shape tools, processes, and systems related to the developer journey
* Identify patterns and trends within inbound contact activity across developers and conduct deep dive analysis in order to provide concise verbal and written reports to leadership.
* Propose and drive innovative solutions and projects to improve the developer experience and support
* Collaborate with teammates and colleagues to establish yourself as a subject matter expert in developer-related topics
* Contribute to refining nebulous program, service, and/or feature launches into defined and scalable goals
* Summarize technical customer issues into notes that are readable by non-technical stakeholders (you can paraphrase a complex issue while writing for comprehension)

A day in the life
  
  
As a Developer Advocate, you will work directly with developers handling incoming queries and dig into details to analyze and resolve issues. You will be interacting with both external developers and internal teams via a number of communication channels to drive solutions that meet developer needs. You'll toggle between a broad range of technological productivity and work-flow management tools including SharePoint, MS Excel, MS Word and databases.
  
  
If you are someone who is excited to learn new technologies and help customers succeed, have a successful track record of responding to/resolving customer issues through written communication and thrive on working in a fast paced support environment, come join our team.
  
  
**About The Team**

title: Content Writer
description:
Job Description

**About Digit**

At Digit, our mission is to Make Insurance Simple. We use technology to make insurance easier to understand, buy and claim. Our general insurance products cover motor, health, travel, home and business needs. Simplicity, transparency and customer experience guide how we develop our products and communicate with customers.

**About the role**

You will own content strategy and editorial delivery for assigned insurance categories on godigit.com. You will turn customer questions, product expertise and approved data into useful content that helps people understand insurance and make informed decisions. You will set editorial priorities, guide writers and partners, and work with SEO, product and analytics teams to improve discovery, trust and business outcomes. This is a hands-on role requiring strong writing and editing skills alongside strategic judgement.

**Responsibilities**

Content strategy and planning

* Define audiences, customer needs, core messages and content priorities across insurance education, comparison, purchase and servicing journeys. Align the plan with product and marketing goals.

* Own the editorial roadmap and calendar for product pages, supporting articles, guides and tools. Create briefs that specify audience, intent, angle, evidence, format, owners and delivery dates.

* Audit the content inventory with SEO and product teams. Decide what to create, improve, consolidate or retire, resolving gaps, duplication, outdated information and weak relevance.

Research and original insights

* Work with Product, Claims, Data Science and experts to develop original reports, practical examples and thought leadership from approved information. Interview specialists and identify insights that add value beyond generic summaries.

* Research using primary sources, approved policy documents and relevant public data. Validate facts and comparisons, and record sources, dates, definitions, data periods and limitations for review.

Editorial quality and team leadership

* Write and edit priority content, including product pages, comparisons, FAQs, explainers and tool copy. Make complex insurance concepts clear while retaining material conditions, exclusions and qualifications.

* Set and maintain standards for Digit’s voice, terminology, readability, sourcing and authorship. Arrange expert review for financial and health topics, and check that titles, tables and examples accurately reflect the evidence.

* Mentor writers and review freelance or agency output. Give specific feedback on research, argument, structure and factual accuracy, and set realistic schedules and quality expectations.

SEO and AI search visibility

* Partner with SEO on search intent, topic clusters, content gaps and internal linking. Develop clear answers, useful comparisons and original evidence that support both customer understanding and search discovery.

* Use findings from Google AI Overviews, AI Mode and assistant audits to improve content coverage and factual representation. Work with SEO on AEO and GEO experiments and evaluate results against reliable guidance.

Content formats and production

* Repurpose approved research and expert views into video scripts, social posts, email content and PR material with channel owners. Adapt the message and format to each audience and purpose.

* Work with design, UX and CMS teams on page structure, visuals, accessible presentation and useful calls to action. Review authored pages before release for content accuracy and consistency.

Insurance governance and content lifecycle

* Coordinate Product, Legal and Compliance review of product claims, premiums, benefits, eligibility, statistics and disclaimers. Ensure content identifies the correct insurer and reflects approved policy information and current product status.

* Maintain review dates, source records, approvals and updates for launches, policy changes and withdrawn products. Establish AI-assisted research and drafting workflows with human editing, factual checks and appropriate use of company data.

Measurement and optimisation

* Define content measures with SEO and analytics teams. Review relevant traffic, engagement, search and AI visibility, and contribution to quote starts, qualified leads and policy purchases where attributable.

* Use GA4, Search Console, dashboards and customer feedback to assess pages and content clusters. Test topics, formats and content journeys, explain measurement limits and recommend the next priorities.

**Requirements and skills**

* Proven ownership of a content strategy, editorial roadmap and delivery programme for a large website or competitive product category.

* Excellent English writing and editing skills, with a portfolio showing original research, clear explanations and strong editorial judgement.

* Ability to translate complex financial, health or other technical information for a general audience while preserving accuracy and important qualifications.

* Strong research and interviewing skills, including evaluating primary sources, interpreting data and working with subject-matter experts.

* Working knowledge of SEO, search intent, content audits, internal linking and AI search experiences. Ability to translate research and performance insights into actionable content briefs.

* Ability to interpret content performance using GA4, Search Console, spreadsheets and SEO tools such as Semrush or Ahrefs. Experience working with a CMS and publishing workflows.

* Experience guiding writers, editors or agencies, managing reviews and deadlines, and aligning stakeholders on priorities and quality standards.

* Practical use of AI tools for research, ideation, editing or repurposing, with source verification, editorial ownership and appropriate data handling.

**About the job**

Location: Bengaluru | Employment: Full-time, work from office

Experience: 4–6 years in content strategy, editorial or content marketing, with ownership of planning and delivery

Education: Any graduate

**Preferred experience**

* Experience in insurance or financial services, particularly life insurance. Health insurance content experience is also valuable.

* Experience adapting content into video scripts, social, email or PR formats with relevant channel teams.

Share a content strategy or editorial plan, selected published work and at least one case study. Explain the starting problem, your decisions and contribution, the review process and the results achieved.

title: Research Associate - Medical Devices & Imaging
description:
**About The Team / Practice Area**
The Medical Devices & Imaging cluster within TechVision tracks emerging and disruptive technologies transforming diagnosis, intervention, monitoring, rehabilitation, and care delivery. The team connects scientific and engineering advances with clinical needs, regulatory pathways, adoption dynamics, commercial potential, and growth opportunities across the healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
Our analysts engage with medical-device and imaging companies, healthcare providers, clinicians, researchers, universities, startups, investors, regulators, standards bodies, technology developers, and manufacturing partners. This ecosystem perspective helps the team evaluate technology maturity, clinical utility, competitive differentiation, implementation barriers, and routes to commercialization.
  
  
The cluster delivers syndicated research, technology scouting, opportunity assessments, benchmarking and prioritization studies, innovator and partner landscapes, growth opportunity analysis, executive briefings, workshops, and customized consulting engagements for medtech, diagnostics, imaging, digital health, life-science, and healthcare organizations.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Research Associate is a full-time entry-level position, ideal for a recent graduate or a candidate with 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in medical devices, biomedical engineering, medical imaging, diagnostics, digital health, healthcare research, life sciences, market intelligence, or a related field.
  
  
The associate will support the Medical Devices & Imaging cluster by conducting primary and secondary research, tracking technology and innovation signals, evaluating companies and ecosystems, and developing high-quality client deliverables. The role requires the ability to understand both the technical and business dimensions of healthcare innovation and translate complex evidence into clear implications, growth opportunities, and actionable recommendations.
  
  
Core Areas of Focus
  
  

* Advanced diagnostics and point-of-care testing
* Medical imaging, including X-ray, ultrasound, MRI, CT, optical and hybrid imaging
* AI-enabled diagnostics, image analysis, clinical decision support and workflow automation
* Connected medical devices, remote patient monitoring, wearables and digital biomarkers
* Surgical robotics, image-guided interventions, navigation and visualization technologies
* Minimally invasive devices, endoscopy and interventional technologies
* Implantable, bioelectronic, neuromodulation and drug-delivery devices
* Personalized, home-based, virtual and decentralized care technologies
* Rehabilitation, assistive, ophthalmic, hearing and vision-care technologies
* Smart materials, sensors, microfluidics, electronics and manufacturing enablers for medical devices

**Responsibilities**
Research and Analysis
  
  

* Monitor and analyze emerging technologies, clinical innovations, product developments, regulatory milestones, patents, scientific publications, funding activity, partnerships, acquisitions, and commercialization signals across medical devices and imaging.
* Conduct structured secondary research using peer-reviewed literature, clinical-trial registries, patent databases, company disclosures, regulatory databases, government and health-agency publications, conference materials, and credible industry sources.
* Support primary research through interviews with clinicians, researchers, device manufacturers, technology developers, startups, investors, healthcare providers, and other subject matter experts.
* Assess technology readiness, clinical utility, unmet need, differentiation, adoption potential, regulatory considerations, reimbursement context, scalability, and commercial relevance.
* Develop technology landscapes, value-chain maps, ecosystem assessments, company profiles, innovation benchmarks, and opportunity-prioritization frameworks.
* Identify emerging signals and technology convergence across medical devices, imaging, AI, sensors, microelectronics, materials, advanced manufacturing, and digital health.
* Evaluate innovations across the care continuum, including pre-hospital, hospital, post-acute, remote, and home-based care settings.
* Analyze the implications of emerging technologies for R&D strategy, product portfolios, partnerships, market entry, care pathways, and future growth.
* Maintain research trackers and evidence repositories with strong source traceability, data accuracy, and consistent taxonomy.

Content Development
  
  

* Produce high-quality research reports, technology assessments, executive summaries, presentations, dashboards, and client-ready deliverables.
* Translate scientific, engineering, clinical, regulatory, and commercial evidence into clear narratives, visuals, frameworks, and recommendations.
* Contribute to syndicated research and customized consulting projects covering technology scouting, benchmarking, prioritization, partner identification, innovation strategy, and growth opportunity analysis.
* Support cluster intelligence by converting research into client propositions, executive briefings, strategic workshops, and opportunity themes.
* Identify potential innovators, startups, research institutions, suppliers, technology partners, and best-practice companies relevant to client priorities.
* Contribute to thought leadership, webinars, client presentations, conference materials, and other external-facing content.

Stakeholder Engagement and Delivery
  
  

* Work closely with global research teams, sector specialists, account teams, and cross-cluster experts to build integrated perspectives.
* Manage key stakeholders by sector and practice area to ensure expectations are met or exceeded and timelines are followed.
* Support expert interviews, client discussions, research validation, workshops, and presentation of findings.
* Take ownership of assigned deliverables and maintain high standards of technical accuracy, analytical rigor, consistency, and presentation quality.
* Work effectively with a global team to create a strong customer experience and contribute to the broader growth strategy of the business.

**Preferred Research And Technology Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; working knowledge of Power BI or other visualization tools is desirable.
* Familiarity with scientific-literature, patent, clinical-trial, regulatory, company, funding, and market-intelligence databases.
* Ability to interpret medical-device and imaging technology concepts, clinical workflows, technical specifications, performance evidence, and product-development pathways.
* Understanding of technology readiness levels, innovation scouting, technology benchmarking, opportunity prioritization, competitor analysis, and ecosystem mapping.
* Awareness of medical-device quality and regulatory concepts, including risk classification, clinical evidence, validation, and post-market considerations, is desirable.
* Ability to analyze quantitative and qualitative evidence and communicate findings through clear frameworks, scorecards, charts, and visual storytelling.
* Ability to use AI-powered research and productivity tools responsibly to improve research efficiency, synthesis, and quality.

Required Competencies
  
  
Education
  
  
UG: B.E./B.Tech in Biomedical, Biotechnology, Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical, Computer Science, Medical Electronics, or a related engineering discipline; or B.Sc./B.Pharm in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Medical Technology, Radiologic/Imaging Sciences, Pharmacy, or a related field.
  
  
PG preferred: M.E./M.Tech, M.Sc., M.Pharm, MBA, MPH, or an equivalent qualification in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Imaging, Medical Technology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Healthcare Management, or a related discipline.
  
  
Professional and Personal Skills
  
  

* Excellent analytical, research, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to synthesize technical, clinical, regulatory, and commercial information from diverse sources and identify meaningful patterns.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop concise, evidence-based, and compelling business content.
* Curiosity about medical technology, clinical innovation, patient needs, healthcare delivery, and emerging business models.
* Ability to work with ambiguity and structure complex research questions into practical workplans and outputs.
* Self-motivated, independent, detail-oriented, responsible, and collaborative.
* Well organized, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable working to tight deadlines with remote supervision.
* Disciplined and committed to high-quality standards, source traceability, and data accuracy.
* Strategic thinker who understands how research and operational activities support client value and business growth.
* Adaptable and able to learn new technologies, clinical areas, research tools, and analytical approaches quickly.

What Will Make You Succeed at Frost & Sullivan?
  
  
**You Will Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have a genuine interest in medical devices, diagnostics, imaging, digital health, and healthcare innovation.
* Can connect technical advances with clinical needs, adoption realities, and commercial opportunities.
* Enjoy investigating emerging technologies and identifying innovators before opportunities become obvious.
* Balance scientific and analytical rigor with practical business thinking.
* Communicate complex healthcare and technology insights clearly, visually, and persuasively.
* Demonstrate intellectual curiosity, accountability, collaboration, and a growth mindset.
* Take ownership and consistently deliver accurate, polished, client-ready work.

**Benefits**

* Competitive base salary plus bonus opportunity.
* Attractive Medical and Accident insurance.
* Regional travel opportunities.
* A friendly open environment with a diverse and international operational focus.
* A definite career path with numerous growth opportunities.
* You will be part of a winning, global team that fosters teamwork and an Olympic spirit while enhancing your communication and people skills.
* Encouragement to develop your intellectual curiosity and will be provided the ability to collaborate across all levels of the company across the globe.
* Global awards & recognition opportunities & awards - President Club & Chairman Club Awards
* “Best in class" global team that strives for excellence.
* Matrix structure with high visibility to top leadership
* Growth Coaching University Certification.

**About Frost & Sullivan**
Frost & Sullivan, the Transformational Growth Journey Company, has spent more than 65 years partnering with clients to develop transformational growth strategies by focusing on innovation and growth opportunities driven by disruptive technologies, mega trends, emerging markets and new business models. Today, more than ever before, companies must innovate, not only to survive, but thrive in the future. Our Growth Pipeline Management (GPM) system supports clients by identifying and evaluating new growth opportunities and serves as the foundation for continuous growth. This is your opportunity to be part of a revolutionary global team that truly inspires positive global changes by innovating to zero. Learn more about Frost & Sullivan at www.frost.com

title: Bid Manager (AI Solution)
description:
**Job Description:**

Bid Manager – Purple Fabric (Enterprise AI)

**Company:**
Intellect Design Arena Ltd.

**Business Unit:**
Purple Fabric

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Experience:**
8–14 years

**Mode of Work:**
Work From Office (WFO) – 5 days a week

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented
**Bid Manager**
to lead end-to-end bid management and proposal development for Purple Fabric, Intellect Design Arena’s enterprise AI platform. The role will involve managing RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, and customer proposals while ensuring timely, accurate, compliant, and compelling submissions.

The ideal candidate will work closely with Sales, Presales, Solution Architects, Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, and senior leadership to develop differentiated proposals that articulate Purple Fabric’s value proposition, technical capabilities, business benefits, and commercial offerings.

A strong understanding of enterprise technology solutions, cloud platforms, AI/GenAI concepts, and complex B2B sales cycles will be essential to succeed in this role.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Bid Management**

* Own the complete bid lifecycle, from opportunity qualification and RFP/RFI/RFQ receipt through submission, clarification, and final handover.
* Analyse tender documents and customer requirements to identify eligibility criteria, mandatory requirements, submission guidelines, evaluation parameters, and contractual obligations.
* Develop bid plans, timelines, responsibility matrices, and compliance checklists to ensure submissions meet customer deadlines.
* Coordinate internal stakeholders to collect, review, validate, and consolidate technical, commercial, legal, and business inputs.
* Manage multiple bids simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, quality, and consistency.

**2. Proposal Development & Response Management**

* Lead the preparation, review, and submission of high-quality proposals, RFP responses, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, capability statements, and presentations.
* Translate complex technical and business inputs into clear, structured, customer-focused proposal responses.
* Develop executive summaries, solution narratives, value propositions, differentiators, implementation approaches, and customer benefit statements.
* Maintain a central repository of approved responses, case studies, product collateral, standard answers, and reusable proposal content.
* Ensure all submissions are complete, compliant, compelling, and aligned with the customer's requirements.

**3. AI & Purple Fabric Solution Understanding**

* Develop a working understanding of Purple Fabric and its enterprise AI capabilities to accurately position the platform in customer proposals.
* Understand key concepts such as Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI orchestration, enterprise knowledge integration, and AI governance.
* Collaborate with Presales and Solution Architects to develop technically accurate responses to architecture, integration, security, scalability, deployment, and implementation questions.
* Articulate the business value of enterprise AI solutions, including workflow automation, intelligent decision support, operational efficiency, and responsible AI adoption.
* Ensure technical claims, product capabilities, implementation commitments, and solution differentiators are validated by the relevant subject matter experts.

**4. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Act as the central point of coordination for bid-related activities across Sales, Presales, Solution Architecture, Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Delivery, and leadership teams.
* Conduct bid kick-off meetings, progress reviews, solution review sessions, and submission-readiness checks.
* Track pending inputs, resolve dependencies, escalate risks, and ensure timely stakeholder sign-offs.
* Coordinate with subject matter experts to address customer queries, technical clarifications, compliance requirements, and proposal revisions.
* Facilitate smooth handover of awarded opportunities to the relevant delivery and implementation teams.

**5. Commercial, Risk & Compliance Management**

* Coordinate commercial proposal preparation, pricing inputs, cost assumptions, and financial approvals with Finance and Sales teams.
* Review contractual terms, service-level requirements, delivery commitments, payment terms, and risk-related clauses in coordination with Legal and relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain bid compliance matrices and ensure adherence to customer submission requirements and internal approval processes.
* Identify bid risks, gaps, dependencies, and non-compliance issues early, escalating them to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure the integrity of customer and company information throughout the bid process.

**6. Bid Strategy, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Support bid/no-bid assessments based on opportunity fit, eligibility, strategic value, competitive positioning, and resource availability.
* Work with Sales and Presales teams to identify customer priorities, strengthen win themes, and improve proposal differentiation.
* Track bid progress, submission timelines, stakeholder dependencies, outcomes, and lessons learned.
* Analyse bid performance and recommend improvements to response quality, turnaround time, content reuse, and process efficiency.
* Drive standardisation and automation of bid processes, templates, response libraries, and reporting mechanisms.

**Mandatory Skills & Experience**

* 8–14 years of experience in bid management, proposal management, RFP management, tender management, or presales operations within enterprise technology, IT services, SaaS, or software product organisations.
* Proven experience independently managing complex RFP/RFI/RFQ responses and end-to-end proposal submissions.
* Strong experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and managing multiple time-sensitive bids.
* Excellent proposal writing, editing, documentation, presentation, and compliance management skills.
* Ability to understand technical solution inputs and translate them into clear, customer-centric business narratives.
* Working knowledge of enterprise technology solutions, cloud platforms, software products, and enterprise integrations.
* Strong project management skills, including planning, tracking, risk identification, escalation, and deadline management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and collaboration tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at different organisational levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, data platforms, automation, or enterprise digital transformation solutions.
* Experience working with banking, financial services, payments, lending, fraud, risk, or other regulated-industry customers.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS or product-led organisations with complex solution proposals and commercial models.
* Familiarity with proposal automation tools, content repositories, CRM platforms, and bid tracking systems.
* Experience supporting international bids, large enterprise deals, and multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
* Understanding of information security questionnaires, vendor assessments, compliance documentation, and enterprise procurement processes.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong ownership and accountability for bid outcomes.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to submission quality.
* Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and coordination skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
* Structured thinking and strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Commercial awareness and customer-centric proposal development.
* Ability to learn complex technology offerings and communicate their business value effectively.

**Key Success Metrics**

* On-time submission rate for bids and proposals.
* Compliance and completeness of submitted responses.
* Proposal quality and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Bid turnaround time and adherence to internal review milestones.
* Effectiveness of reusable content and proposal standardisation.
* Reduction in errors, omissions, and last-minute escalations.
* Contribution to bid win rates through strong proposal quality and differentiation.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is an experienced bid professional who can independently drive complex enterprise technology proposals from initiation to submission. They should be comfortable coordinating senior stakeholders, working with technical subject matter experts, managing commercial and compliance requirements, and communicating the value of enterprise AI solutions.

Direct AI expertise is beneficial, but the candidate must demonstrate the ability to understand complex technology offerings quickly and convert technical inputs into compelling, accurate, and commercially aligned proposals.

title: Navigation & Control Manager
description:
**About Planys Technologies**

Planys Technologies is a next-gen defence technology startup building intelligent autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) and maritime robotic systems that give naval and security forces a real-time, machine-driven picture of the undersea battlespace. Inspired by the pace, ambition, and product mindset of modern defence innovators, we are designing persistent, ROVs, AUVs, and hybrid surface vessel edge-compute heavy payloads, and advanced undersea sensing that turn oceans into knowledgeable, navigable, and defendable environments.

Engineers and researchers work like full-stack product teams: shaping hydrodynamics and propulsion, architecting navigation and perception stacks, and building autonomy and mission-systems software that must perform in GPS-denied, low-comms, high-risk conditions. You will see your code and hardware leave the lab quickly, iterate through real sea trials, and plug into high-impact naval, coastal security, and strategic deterrence missions in India and beyond. You’ll be part of a small, high-caliber team empowered to move fast, take end-to-end ownership, and push the boundaries of what underwater systems can sense, decide, and achieve in one of the most demanding environments on Earth.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a Manager – Navigation & Control to design, develop, integrate, and validate navigation and control systems for autonomous underwater vehicles.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement navigation algorithms (INS, DVL, USBL aiding, EKF/UKF sensor fusion) for AUV platforms operating in GPS-denied environments.
* Develop and tune guidance and control systems, including autopilots, path-following (LOS, Pure Pursuit), station-keeping, and depth/heading controllers.
* Build high-fidelity simulation environments for algorithm validation, including Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
* Integrate and calibrate navigation sensors, including IMU, DVL, USBL, pressure sensors, and magnetometers, on vehicle hardware.
* Implement real-time GNC software on embedded Linux platforms with deterministic timing requirements.
* Develop harbour-to-harbour navigation, mission planning, and waypoint management modules, and integrate them with the vehicle autonomy stack.
* Analyse and resolve navigation and control anomalies using sea-trial data, and drive post-trial reviews.
* Define and execute verification and validation (V&V) plans for GNC subsystems against system-level requirements.
* Support system-level integration, sea trials, and field deployments, and troubleshoot vehicle behaviour on-site.
* Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and software teams on vehicle-level design trade-offs and interface definitions.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including algorithm design documents, test reports, and calibration procedures.
* Create and track team work plans, mentor junior engineers, and provide technical guidance.

**Required Skills**

* Strong mathematical and analytical background.
* Strong knowledge of navigation, estimation, sensor fusion, and control systems.
* Proficiency in C/C++ and Python.
* Experience with ROS/ROS2, Linux, Git, and simulation tools.
* Knowledge of INS, DVL, USBL, EKF/UKF, PID, LQR/MPC.
* Experience with robotic or autonomous systems.
* Strong problem-solving and teamwork skills.

**Qualification**

* M.Tech / M.S. / Ph.D. in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Ocean Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Robotics, or related fields.
* 4–8 years of relevant experience in navigation, guidance, and control for robotic/autonomous systems.
* Experience in marine or underwater robotics is preferred.
* Research/thesis experience in navigation, control, or state estimation is an added advantage.

title: Field Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

EVtron Tech is a startup focused on designing, manufacturing, and deploying electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions for logistics fleets, factories, and commercial facilities.

Our mission is to accelerate India’s transition to sustainable mobility through reliable EV charging hardware, smart charging software, and turnkey deployment solutions.

We manufacture our own EV chargers and develop an in-house Charging Management System (CMS) that enables operators to monitor and manage charging infrastructure through web and mobile platforms.

**Role Description**

We are looking for an
**EV Charger Installation & Field Service Engineer**
to join our growing team and support the installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance of EV charging infrastructure across customer locations.

This is a hands-on technical role suited for diploma holders and ITI candidates with an interest in electrical systems, troubleshooting, and emerging EV charging technology.

The role involves personally carrying out basic installation and troubleshooting activities, coordinating with electricians and electrical contractors, verifying installation quality, commissioning chargers, and resolving technical issues at customer sites. You will also work with our engineering team to diagnose charger-related issues and perform basic firmware flashing and configuration using a laptop.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in the field, willing to learn how EV charging systems operate, and capable of taking ownership of technical issues until they are resolved.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install and commission EV chargers at customer locations, including logistics fleets, factories, and commercial facilities.
* Coordinate with electricians and contractors to ensure safe, timely, and quality installation.
* Inspect sites for electrical readiness, including wiring, cable routing, earthing, protection devices, and charger mounting.
* Perform basic electrical installation, testing, and troubleshooting wherever required.
* Diagnose charger issues related to power supply, charging interruptions, connectivity, and configuration.
* Understand EV charging fundamentals and identify whether issues originate from the charger, electrical installation, vehicle, or Charging Management System (CMS).
* Use a laptop to perform basic firmware flashing, charger configuration, and software updates using company-provided tools.
* Verify charger connectivity with the CMS and assist with charging session testing and commissioning.
* Coordinate with customers and internal engineering teams to resolve technical issues, including remote troubleshooting with electricians.
* Support preventive maintenance, service visits, warranty assessments, and installation audits.
* Maintain site photographs, installation checklists, commissioning reports, and service records.
* Follow electrical safety procedures and ensure installations comply with company standards and applicable requirements.

**Desired Qualifications**

* Diploma in Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline. ITI Electrician candidates with relevant experience may also apply.
* 0–2 years of experience in electrical installation, maintenance, field service, or commissioning. Freshers with strong practical aptitude are welcome.
* Basic understanding of single-phase and three-phase systems, wiring, earthing, MCBs, distribution boards, and electrical safety.
* Basic laptop and computer skills, with a willingness to learn firmware flashing, device configuration, and diagnostic tools.
* Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues methodically.
* Good communication and coordination skills to work with customers, electricians, contractors, and internal teams.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites and perform hands-on fieldwork as required.
* Experience in EV charging, solar installations, industrial electrical systems, electrical testing tools, or basic network troubleshooting is an added advantage. A valid two-wheeler driving licence is preferred.

**It's a Plus If You Have**

* Experience in EV charger installation, solar installations, industrial electrical systems, or automation projects.
* Experience coordinating electricians, electrical contractors, or installation teams.
* Familiarity with electrical testing tools such as multimeters, clamp meters, and insulation testers.
* Basic troubleshooting experience with electrical equipment.
* Basic knowledge of firmware flashing, device configuration, or diagnostic software.
* A valid two-wheeler driving licence.
* Startup experience or the ability to handle multiple responsibilities independently.
* A genuine interest in electric mobility and sustainable infrastructure.

**Why Join EVtron?**

* Be part of India's growing EV charging infrastructure ecosystem.
* Gain hands-on experience with EV charging hardware manufactured in-house.
* Learn about charger commissioning, troubleshooting, firmware, and charging management software.
* Work closely with the engineering team to solve real-world technical challenges.
* Take ownership of field deployments and grow into technical support, field service, or project execution roles.

**How to Apply?**

Interested candidates can send their resume to careers@evtron.in with the subject line:

📩
**Application for**
**EV Charger Installation & Field Service Engineer**
**– [Your Name]**

Applicants are encouraged to mention their experience in electrical installations, site supervision, industrial maintenance, EV charging, solar installations, commissioning activities, or any other relevant field experience.

title: Research Analyst - Megatrends
description:
**About The Team / Practice Area**
The Megatrends team at Frost & Sullivan identifies, monitors, and analyzes the powerful global forces reshaping industries, economies, societies, and business models over the next decade and beyond. Through continuous tracking of macroeconomic, geopolitical, technological, demographic, environmental, regulatory, and societal shifts, the team develops forward-looking intelligence that helps organizations anticipate disruption and uncover new growth opportunities.
  
  
Our analysts engage with a diverse ecosystem of thought leaders, policymakers, industry executives, innovators, academic researchers, government agencies, international organizations, startups, investors, and strategic foresight communities worldwide. This global network enables the team to identify emerging signals of change, evaluate their implications, and assess their impact across industries and regions.
  
  
Megatrends services help organizations understand the future business landscape, evaluate strategic risks and opportunities, develop long-term growth strategies, and build resilience in an increasingly uncertain world. Our solutions include syndicated research, customized foresight studies, scenario planning, strategic workshops, executive briefings, trend monitoring programs, and future-focused innovation initiatives.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Research Analyst is a full-time entry-level position, ideal for a recent graduate or a candidate with 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in research, strategy, economics, public policy, business analysis, international affairs, sustainability, data analytics, or a related field.
  
  
The analyst will support Frost & Sullivan's Megatrends practice by conducting primary and secondary research, monitoring global developments, analyzing emerging trends, and contributing to thought leadership and strategic foresight deliverables. The role requires the ability to connect developments across sectors and regions and translate them into clear implications, growth opportunities, and actionable recommendations for clients.
  
  
Core Areas of Focus
  
  

* Future of Society and Demographics
* Geopolitics and Global Trade
* Sustainability and Climate Adaptation
* Future of Work
* Urbanization and Smart Cities
* Digital Economies
* Energy Transition
* Supply Chain Transformation
* Health and Wellness Evolution
* Emerging Technologies and Convergence
* Economic Transformation
* Consumer Behavior Shifts

**Responsibilities**
Research and Analysis
  
  

* Monitor and analyze global developments across political, economic, social, technological, legal, and environmental dimensions using PESTLE analysis.
* Conduct horizon scanning to identify emerging trends, weak signals, disruptions, and strategic inflection points that could influence industries, markets, and societies.
* Apply weak signal detection techniques to distinguish early indicators of change from short-term noise and assess their potential scale, velocity, and business relevance.
* Conduct secondary research using government publications, international organizations, academic literature, company reports, industry databases, and credible media sources.
* Support scenario planning by defining critical uncertainties, developing plausible future scenarios, and assessing implications for clients and sectors.
* Contribute to strategic foresight studies, including trend mapping, impact assessment, cross-sector convergence analysis, and identification of future growth opportunities.
* Conduct geopolitical intelligence analysis to assess policy shifts, global trade developments, regional power dynamics, supply-chain risks, and their business implications.
* Track leading indicators and quantitative evidence supporting the development, acceleration, or decline of megatrends.
* Evaluate the impact of trends across sectors, geographies, value chains, and stakeholder groups.

Content Development and Commercialization
  
  

* Produce high-quality research reports, trend insights, executive summaries, presentations, and client-ready deliverables.
* Translate complex future-oriented developments into clear narratives, charts, frameworks, and actionable business implications.
* Support megatrend commercialization by converting research into client propositions, growth opportunity themes, executive briefings, workshops, and customized consulting engagements.
* Identify opportunities to package and position megatrend intelligence for different industries, markets, and leadership audiences.
* Contribute to thought leadership initiatives, webinars, client presentations, and strategic workshops.

Stakeholder Engagement and Delivery
  
  

* Work closely with global research teams, sector specialists, and subject matter experts to develop integrated perspectives.
* Manage key stakeholders by sector and practice area to ensure expectations are met or exceeded and timelines are followed.
* Support expert interviews, client discussions, and research validation activities.
* Take ownership of assigned deliverables and maintain high standards of accuracy, consistency, and quality.
* Work with a global team of experts to create a powerful customer experience.

**Preferred Research And Technology Skills**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word; working knowledge of Power BI or other visualization tools is desirable.
* Familiarity with research databases, market intelligence platforms, statistical analysis, and forecasting techniques.
* Understanding of PESTLE analysis, scenario planning, horizon scanning, weak signal detection, strategic foresight, geopolitical intelligence, and megatrend commercialization.
* Ability to use AI-powered research and productivity tools responsibly to improve research efficiency, synthesis, and quality.
* Ability to present quantitative and qualitative evidence through clear frameworks and visual storytelling.

Required Competencies
  
  
Education
  
  
UG: B.E./B.Tech, BA, BBA, B.Sc., Economics, Political Science, International Relations, Public Policy, Environmental Sciences, Business, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
  
  
PG preferred: MBA, MA Economics, Public Policy, International Relations, Sustainability, Strategic Management, Data Analytics, or an equivalent qualification.
  
  
Professional and Personal Skills
  
  

* Excellent analytical, research, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to synthesize information from diverse sources, identify patterns, and communicate implications clearly.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to develop concise and compelling business content.
* Curiosity about global change, emerging trends, innovation, public policy, and future business models.
* Ability to work with ambiguity and address long-term strategic questions in a structured manner.
* Self-motivated, independent, detail-oriented, responsible, and collaborative.
* Well organized, able to manage multiple priorities, and comfortable working to tight deadlines with remote supervision.
* Disciplined and committed to high-quality standards and data accuracy.
* Strategic thinker who understands how research and operational activities support the broader growth strategy of the business.
* Adaptable and able to learn new concepts, sectors, tools, and analytical approaches quickly.

What Will Make You Succeed at Frost & Sullivan?
  
  
**You Will Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have a passion for tracking and interpreting global change.
* Enjoy connecting developments across industries, technologies, economies, policies, and societies.
* Can recognize early signals and identify future opportunities before they become obvious.
* Think strategically while maintaining analytical rigor and attention to detail.
* Communicate complex insights clearly, visually, and persuasively.
* Demonstrate intellectual curiosity, accountability, collaboration, and a growth mindset.
* Take ownership and consistently deliver high-quality work.

**Benefits**

* Competitive base salary plus bonus opportunity.
* Attractive Medical and Accident insurance.
* Regional travel opportunities.
* A friendly open environment with a diverse and international operational focus.
* A definite career path with numerous growth opportunities.

title: Technical Writer II
description:
**About Us:**
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.

Technical Writer II - Role Overview As a Technical Writer II, you will own end-to-end documentation tasks/projects for Barry-Wehmiller machinery/product lines using structured authoring applications to scale quality, consistency, and speed. You’ll partner closely with global Engineering, Product Line Managers, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality product documentation. Key Responsibilities Technical Content Development:  Create, review, and maintain comprehensive and well-structured documentation for Barry Wehmiller machinery/products, services, and processes.  Translate complex technical information into clear, concise, and user-friendly content, tailored to a wide range of audiences, including customers, internal teams, and for training purposes.  Work with global teams to understand and learn about the products and write procedures in technical documentation.  Own end-to-end documentation tasks using desktop and structured authoring applications to scale quality, consistency, and speed.  Ensure timely execution of documentation tasks in compliance with guidelines, best practices, and deliver defect free output.  Ensure all documentation adheres to applicable technical writing standards and guidelines such as ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English) and company style guides. Content Management System:  Play an active role in the upcoming CCMS implementation program, contributing across all phases of the implementation roadmap from Foundation & Strategy through Optimization & Governance.  Work closely with the CCMS project team to do the pilot projects and develop the documentation workflows.  Support the migration of legacy content into the CCMS, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and proper metadata tagging throughout the transition. Stakeholder Collaboration:  Partner closely with global Engineering, Product Line Managers, and other cross-functional teams to deliver product documentation.  Coordinate with translation and localization teams to prepare documentation for multilingual publication in global markets. Continuous Improvement:  Identify the opportunities for process improvements and workflow innovations and drive the activities to achieve meaningful results. GCC Qualifications & Skills Essential:  Bachelor's degree or higher in Technical Communication, Engineering, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, or a related field.  Minimum 7+ years of active, hands-on technical writing experience with demonstrable content authoring across previous roles — portfolio or writing samples required.  Strong domain knowledge of engineering industrial machinery, including mechanical systems, hydraulics, electronics, or automation equipment.  Proven experience working with Content Management Systems (CCMS/CMS), including hands-on use of tools such as SchemaST4, Paligo, Author-it, IXIASOFT, Adobe Experience Manager, or equivalent platforms.  Proficiency in using desktop publishing tools like Adobe InDesign, Adobe FrameMaker (including XML driven), and Microsoft Office.  Solid understanding of technical documentation standards and frameworks, including DITA, structured authoring principles, ASD-STE100, and relevant IEC/ISO standards.  Experience contributing to new product development (NPD) projects and managing documentation deliverables against engineering development milestones.  Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to produce clear, precise, and audience-appropriate technical content.  Experience collaborating with global, cross-functional stakeholders across multiple time zones and cultures Good to have:  Familiarity with translation management workflows and localization processes for multilingual documentation.  Knowledge of PLM tools like Windchill, Teamcenter, Infor XA, or BlueStar PLM is good to have.  Knowledge of the best practices used in the technical documentation industry would be a plus.  Familiarity with CAD tools is an advantage. Soft Skills  Excellent written and verbal communication skills  Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities  Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and consistency.  Time Management  Adaptability Travel  May be required to travel.

title: Interface Manager
description:
**Job Description – Interface Manager 1. Role Purpose**
The Interface Manager is responsible for planning, managing, and coordinating all interface activities between the Contractor, Subcontractors, Interfacing Contractors, Primary Contractor, Utility Agencies, Statutory Authorities, Consultants, and the Engineer.
  
  
The role ensures timely information exchange, design alignment, construction synchronization, and risk?free integration across all phases—design, construction, testing, commissioning, and handover.
****B. Information Exchange & Documentation Control****
****C. Stakeholder Meetings & Liaison****
****D. Issue Resolution & Governance****
****3. Design Interface Responsibilities****
****4. Construction Interface Responsibilities****
****5. Testing, Commissioning & Handover****
****6. Leadership & Team Management****
****7. Compliance, Contractual & System Requirements****
****8. Qualifications & Experience****
****9. Technical & Behavioral Competencies****
****Technical Skills****

* Key ResponsibilitiesA. Interface Management & Coordination
* Function as single point of contact for all technical and interface?related issues with the Client, Engineer, Primary Contractor, Consultants, Subcontractors, OEM/Supplier, Existing utility agencies, Statutory body and Government Authorities.
* Establish, implement, and maintain:
* Interface Management Plan (IMP)
* Interface Management Program (IMPG)
* Interface Coordination Plan (CIP)
* Interface Coordination Sheets (ICS)
* Interface Specifications (IS)
* Primary Contractor (PC)
* Coordinate all design, technical, planning, and construction interfaces across packages and disciplines.
* Ensure interfaces are identified, documented, tracked, monitored, and closed on time.
* Review project scope, design deliverables, and construction plans to identify interface dependencies.
* Collect, verify, and transmit information between interfacing parties in a timely manner.
* Maintain:
* Interface registers
* Updated CSD, SEM, DRD drawings
* Meeting minutes, correspondence, and action logs
* Monthly Progress Reports (MPR)
* Submission of project progress report to the Engineer, as per contract.
* Conduct and lead internal/external interface meetings with Primary Contractor, Consultants, OEM/supplier, Engineers, and Existing utility agencies.
* Organize video/tele?conferences for multidisciplinary design and interface alignment.
* Prepare and distribute meeting minutes, attendance lists, and action trackers.
* Maintain strong working relationships with Clients, Primary Contractor, Statutory approval organization, Government agencies and project teams.
* Identify interface conflicts early and propose engineering/sequence?based solutions.
* Resolve or escalate disagreements regarding design, responsibilities, or site access requirements.
* Support the Engineer in clarifying contractual interface responsibilities.
* Monitor interface risks, variation, design changes, and potential impacts on schedule or cost.
* Develop design?stage IMP including information cut?off dates.
* Coordinate design data exchange between Primary Contractor, Consultants, OEM/Supplier, and Internal engineering teams.
* Review, integrate, and finalize:
* Combined Services Drawings (CSD)
* Structural & E&M Drawings (SEM)
* Detailed Routing Drawings (DRD)
* Builder’s work requirements
* Preliminary Design, Detail Design & Construction Design Engineering
* As-builts Design
* Submit design packages with joint design?coordination statements ensuring inter?package alignment.
* Coordinate all construction interfaces from mobilization to handover.
* Ensure synchronization for:
* Cableways, duct banks, trenches
* Openings, penetrations, embedded items, plinths, supports.
* MEP works, systems installation, and civil provisions.
* Manage site access, delivery routes, logistics, workspace, scaffolding, lifting equipment, and temporary facilities.
* Resolve construction issues, clashes, missing provisions, and safety related constraints.
* Expedite field interface activities to prevent delays and ensure sequencing alignment with Primary Contractor, Statutory approval organization, Government agencies and existing utility agencies.
* Coordinate with Existing utility service owners.
* Coordinate testing and commissioning activities across interfacing parties.
* Ensure compliance with performance, integrity, and integration test requirements.
* Validate readiness for system?wide commissioning prior to final handover.
* Ensure submission of “As?Constructed” CSD, SEM, and interface drawings.
* Lead a dedicated Interface Coordination Team stationed at the project site.
* Plan, track, and monitor progress of design and site interface activities.
* Ensure timely identification of delays and implement corrective actions.
* Develop team capability to deliver Primary Contractor ?related interface needs.
* Ensure adherence to Employer’s Requirements, contract conditions, and Primary Contractor specifications.
* Manage interface compliance with statutory agencies, utilities, and Government & other approval authorities.
* Maintain documentation systems for interface hazards, RAMS, and safety?critical interfaces.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical and Electrical.
* 12–18 years’ experience in Metro/Rail/ Tunnel Infrastructure projects.
* Minimum 5 years in Interface Management, Systems Coordination, or Multidisciplinary Integration.
* Hands?on experience with CSD/SEM/DRD drawings, BIM, and interface documentation systems.
* Strong knowledge of multidisciplinary engineering processes.
* Expertise in IMP, IMPG, CIP, ICS, CSD, SEM, DRD.
* Familiarity with Primary Contractor systems
* Electrical: HT & LT Power, UPS, DG, CCTV, Tunnel integrated control system, Emergency Call system, Automatic Fare collection, Traffic Management, GPS & GNSS, PAVA, SCADA, ACS, BMS, Multiple Car level parking,
* Mechanical: Tunnel Ventilation, Environmental Control Systems, HVAC, Fire Fighting, Gas Suppression, Plumbing, Drainage, Safety Equipment’s & Signages, other MEP related activities.

+ Review of Technical Submittal and O&M Manual.
+ Knowledge of RAMS, hazard management, testing & commissioning.
+ Excellent coordination, communication, stakeholder management skills.
+ Strong analytical, problem?solving, and negotiation skills.
+ Ability to work under pressure in multi?contract environments.
+ On?time submission and approval of IMP, IMPG, ICS.
+ Zero construction delays due to interface failures.
+ Timely closure of interface issues.
+ High accuracy and completeness of interface documentation.
+ Positive audit outcomes from the Engineer.

**Role Summary**
Join our Global Technology Engineering and Launch-Analytical technology (GTEL-AT) team as an intern focused on advancing digital transformation in Analytical Technology. You will develop computational tools, APP and system-level models to support process characterization and optimization, with an emphasis on hybrid modeling (data-driven + mechanistic), process monitoring/control, and automation projects aligned with the Lab of the Future (LoTF) vision. Your talent will be tapped for digital fluency enhancement of colleagues.

* Development of E&L app: Development of an E&L app which can track internal and external data repositories, BoH sites and guidance documents.
* Digital Fluency Training: Provide training sessions to colleagues to enhance digital fluency and adoption of AI tools and analytics within the department.
* Vendor Collaboration: Engage with external vendors to co-develop AI-based digital application tailored for Analytical Technology workflows.
* Project Support: Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to run automation projects, contributing to the development of the Lab of the Future (LoTF).
* Model Development: Develop and validate a model for TRS100 in partnership with departmental subject matter experts (SMEs) and vendors.

* Chemistry & Analytics: Utilize a strong foundation in basic chemistry and analytical techniques to support project objectives and ensure scientific rigor.
* Results Communication: Present findings and progress to internal teams and, occasionally, at external forums, using data analysis and visualization tools.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Undergraduate or postgraduate student in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Process Control Engineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Analytics, or related discipline.

* Strong background in basic chemistry and analytics.
* Experience with programming (Python, R, MATLAB, C/C++), numerical methods, and high-performance computing (Linux-based environments).
* Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills; able to manage multiple projects and work effectively in cross-functional teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong background in APP development

description:
****Career Area:****
Product Support
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Our condition monitoring teams use their knowledge, skills, and abilities to interpret the 5 elements of condition monitoring (fluid analysis, equipment inspections, electronic data, repair history, and site conditions) and provides meaningful insights as to what is happening on the equipment. In this role, you will be responsible for providing Caterpillar dealers with relevant recommendations to generate high quality sales leads and help customers manage their business more effectively. This will improve customer loyalty, increase enterprise market share, and grow parts and service sales, while reducing the customer's costs through equipment management efficiency.
  
  
****Job Responsibilities And Duties:****

* Aggregate and correlate the five elements of condition monitoring (where all are available) to provide meaningful insights as to what is happening on the equipment.
* Maintain working knowledge for each of the condition monitoring five elements with subject matter expertise in at least 2 elements.
* Participates in ongoing meetings with Caterpillar dealers and subject matter experts to gain knowledge and insights to increase accuracy of the data analysis and quality of recommendations/leads.
* Provide information for equipment management lead tracking and resolution.
* Assists with Preparing reports regularly to be distributed to Caterpillar dealers detailing financial outcomes and key CM KPIs for CMA recommendations.
* Communicate verbal recommendations as required Caterpillar dealers.
* Build collaborative relationships & act as a consultant with equipment management personnel.

****Basic Qualifications:****

* Experience in the product support and/or engineering fields.
* A college or university degree, technical certification, or equivalent experience.
* Demonstrated experience in condition(health) monitoring.
* Experience of using multiple software/business systems to gather data.
* Proficient in MS office with strong emphasis on MS excel or other analytics tools.
* Performed data analysis and correlation on sets of data.
* Able to deduce and draw conclusions from the analysed data.
* Sound technical ability in servicing/repair of construction equipment, diagnostics tools, data analysis to aide fault finding.

**Skill Descriptors**
**Customer Focus:**
Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Communicates the importance of customer needs/expectations and commits to resolving them.

**Data Gathering & Analysis:**
Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Follows proper data gathering and analysis processes and policies.
* Reports problems that arise in the data collection process.

**Decision Making and Critical Thinking:**
Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Explains characteristics and steps in an effective decision-making process.

**Effective Communications:**
Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
* Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.

**Problem Solving:**
Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.

**Relationship Management:**
Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Provides prompt and effective responses to client requests and interactions.
* Monitors client satisfaction levels on a regular basis.

****Additional Info:****
This position will require travelling about 30% of the time.
  
  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Relocation is available for this position.
  
  
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

October 27, 2026 - November 9, 2026

title: Apps Dev Tech Lead Analyst - C13 - CHENNAI
description:
We are seeking a senior, hands-on
**Fenergo Technical Configurator**
at the Vice President level to lead the end-to-end functional platform configuration across our global KYCX (Know Your Customer / Client Experience) estate.
  
  
This is a senior
**Individual Contributor**
role. You will be responsible for the technical configuration design and hands-on implementation of client journeys, policy rule sets, dynamic document models, risk rating logic, and security entitlements within Fenergo CLM. The position requires a deep technical understanding of Fenergo's declarative framework, data model, and workflow engine to translate complex institutional compliance requirements into scalable, maintainable platform configurations without writing custom application code.
  
  
Core Accountabilities
  
  

* Journey & Workflow Engine Configuration
* Own the technical design, configuration, and end-to-end testing of complex client lifecycle journeys across Corporate, Institutional, and Commercial Banking lines of business.
* Build and maintain workflows for Net-New Onboarding, Periodic KYC Refreshes, Event-Driven/Triggered Reviews, Material Change Ingestion, and Offboarding.
* Configure dynamic stage-gates, milestone triggers, complex decision splits, task orchestration, operational handoffs, and parallel processing branches.
* Implement SLA trackers, escalation paths, and automated fallback/exception handling mechanisms across jurisdictional booking locations.
* Policy, Risk & Regulatory Rules Setup
* Configure and maintain the Fenergo Policy Manager, Regulatory Rule Engine, and Entity Requirement Matrices across major regimes (e.g., FinCEN CDD, FATCA/CRS, EU 5MLD/6MLD, MiFID II, Dodd-Frank, MAS, HKMA, FCA).
* Set up dynamic Document Requirement Matrices, conditional document triggers, and Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) calculation rules based on entity types, ownership thresholds, and control structures.
* Configure risk scoring criteria, automated SDD/CDD/EDD triggers, and integration points for screening triggers (Sanctions, PEPs, Adverse Media).
* Entitlements, Security & Data Visibility
* Design and configure granular Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), functional permission sets, user profiles, and multi-tier approval hierarchies.
* Configure strict data segregation and entitlement rules to enforce cross-border data privacy constraints and regional booking center restrictions.
* Implement Maker-Checker (Four-Eyes principle) controls, operational segregation of duties (SoD), and compliance sign-off stage-gates.
* Data Modeling, UI Forms & Business Rules
* Configure entity data models, complex multi-tier parent-subsidiary hierarchies, fund structures, authorized signers, and related parties in Fenergo.
* Build dynamic, conditional UI forms, custom data groups, dropdown hierarchies, and field-level validation rules.
* Configure data validation rules, format masking, and conditional visibility logic across various stages of the client journey.
* Technical Governance, Packaging & Releases
* Manage configuration asset version control, configuration deltas, XML/JSON deployment packages, and migration scripts across Dev, UAT, Staging, and Production environments.
* Perform pre-release impact assessments for Fenergo core upgrades, service packs, and policy changes to ensure backward compatibility and prevent configuration regressions.
* Troubleshoot advanced configuration defects, data structure inconsistencies, and journey bottlenecks in production and pre-production environments.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have Technical Expertise (Mandatory)
  
  

* Banking & Domain Background: 12 to 15 years of solid experience in Corporate/Investment Banking or Wholesale Financial Services, with deep exposure to KYC/AML, Client Onboarding, Due Diligence (CDD/EDD), and regulatory compliance operations.
* Senior Fenergo Hands-On Experience: Demonstrable, in-depth configuration experience on enterprise Fenergo CLM platforms (v8.x, v9.x, and/or SaaS/Cloud editions).
* Fenergo Journey & Workflow Mastery: Extensive track record building and debugging complex, multi-entity journeys, stage-gates, parallel branches, and exception routing rules.
* Policy Engine & Rules Configuration: Proven hands-on capability in configuring Fenergo Policy Manager, Entity Requirements Matrix, Dynamic Document Engine, and UBO threshold rules.
* Entitlement & Access Model Setup: Direct experience configuring complex user roles, permissions, data-level visibility rules, and cross-jurisdictional entitlement frameworks.
* Entity Data Modeling: Deep expertise in configuring Fenergo data dictionaries, custom attributes, entity relationship mapping, and dynamic UI forms.
* Environment & Package Management: Hands-on experience preparing configuration packages, managing environment-specific variables, and executing zero-downtime configuration deployments across multi-tier environments.

**Nice-to-Have Skills (Preferred)**

* Fenergo Certification: Fenergo Certified Product/Configuration Professional.
* API & Interface Payload Understanding: Strong functional familiarity with REST API / JSON / XML payload structures and data mapping dictionaries for integrating Fenergo with external screening engines (e.g., Fircosoft, World-Check), Core Banking, and Document Repositories.
* External Data Provider Integration: Experience configuring data enrichment lookups and connectors (e.g., Dun & Bradstreet, Bureau van Dijk/Orbis, Companies House, Refinitiv, GLEIF).
* Industry Compliance Certifications: ACAMS (CAMS) or ICA Diploma in AML/KYC.
* Agile Delivery: Experience working in JIRA/Confluence within a Scrum/SAFe technical delivery model.

Scope & Non-Requirements
  
  

* Individual Contributor Scope: This is a dedicated technical and functional configuration role with no line management or people management responsibilities. The candidate will own technical deliverables, solution designs, and platform setup directly.
* No Software Coding Required: This role does not require software engineering or programming background (such as Java, C#, C++, Python, or web UI development). The focus is entirely on declarative platform configuration, rules engine authoring, data modeling, and workflow orchestration using Fenergo native configuration tools.

description:
**The Vacancy**

We're looking for an Integration Support Analyst to join our IT team and become the first point of contact for customer integration support queries. This role is responsible for managing and resolving integration-related issues across our warehouse and logistics platforms, ensuring customers receive clear, accurate, and timely updates.

Working closely with internal engineering teams and customers, you'll investigate failed integrations, identify root causes, perform system checks, and provide practical next steps. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with application support, service desk, or integration support experience who enjoys problem-solving, analysing data, and delivering excellent customer service.

* Manage and prioritise the integrations support queue throughout UK business hours.

* Review API responses, file transfers, and system error logs to determine appropriate actions.
* Verify whether shipment orders, advance shipping notices, item records, and other documents have been successfully processed within warehouse systems.
* Communicate findings clearly to customers, providing concise explanations and recommended next steps.
* Maintain accurate ticket records, documenting investigations, checks performed, actions taken, and closure reasons.
* Escalate recurring incidents, defects, and integration issues to the engineering team with supporting evidence.

* Identify trends and recurring issues that could improve overall integration stability and operational performance.

* Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear, professional, customer-focused responses.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a live support environment.
* Comfortable supporting stakeholders and customers during UK business hours from Chennai.

**Desirable:**

* Experience within logistics, warehousing, supply chain, EDI, or transport environments.
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as Halo.
* Experience using Postman or similar tools to perform API investigations and checks.
* Basic SQL knowledge for data validation and record checking.
* Understanding of system integrations, data mapping, and file-based data exchanges.

**What You'll Bring:**

* A proactive and customer-focused approach.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* The ability to remain organised while managing a busy support queue.
* A collaborative mindset and willingness to share knowledge with colleagues.
* Professionalism, reliability, and a commitment to delivering excellent service.

Snowflake and SQL

* Understanding relational data models, data warehousing, ETL/ELT concepts, data quality, and reconciliation.

AI and Emerging Technology
  
  

* Understanding generative AI concepts and practical enterprise use cases.
* Experience or strong exposure to Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Snowflake Cortex, AI Builder, or AI-enabled Power Platform capabilities.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Experience gathering requirements and delivering solutions in collaboration with business and technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Competencies**

Behavioral Competencies
