title: Technical Support Engineer I
description:
**Sectigo**
is the most innovative provider of certificate lifecycle management (CLM), delivering solutions that help the world’s largest brands simplify how digital trust is managed and scaled. Sectigo’s automated, cloud-native CLM platform issues and manages digital certificates across enterprise environments, enabling organizations to reduce complexity, accelerate time to value, and strengthen security across environments. Sectigo is one of the largest, longest-standing, and most reputable CAs with more than 700,000 customers, including 65% of the Fortune 500. Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust.
  
  
  
  
**Simplicity at Scale.**
  
  
  
How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as #OneSectigo by living out our core values - Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you’d like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we’d like to talk to you.

**Job Description**

We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer II to join our growing global team at Sectigo.

The Technical Support Engineer I works closely with Sectigo’s customer base and sales department, handles the day-to-day customer issues reported, all issues escalated, and sees problems and follows through to resolution. This role involves troubleshooting, diagnosing, and resolving complex technical problems, as well as contributing to the development of support processes and documentation.

This is a full-time and in-office position, working 5 days a week from our Chennai office at DLF IT Park, Manapakkam.

Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:

* Handle issues from customer/Resellers/front line support teams, taking ownership and seeing problems through to resolution.
* Research, diagnose, troubleshoot, and identify solutions to resolve advanced technical issues.
* Assist customers through phone, email, or chat, providing high-quality support and ensuring customer satisfaction.
* Provide prompt and accurate feedback to customers and follow up with unresponsive customers.
* Utilize internal databases and external resources to provide accurate technical solutions.
* Escalate unresolved issues to higher-level (engineering) or internal teams as necessary, be the gate way for engineering teams.
* Communicate effectively with end users, colleagues, and management to resolve issues quickly.
* Prioritize and manage multiple open issues simultaneously, ensuring adherence to SLAs.
* Log and report all system-related issues accurately.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of a Knowledge Base of known issues and their fixes.
* Participate in additional responsibilities and special projects as assigned.
* Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.

**Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Bachelors or college degree in business and/or technical related field or equivalent experience is strongly preferred.

**Experience:**

* Minimum of 1+ years of customer support and help desk experience, with at least some experience with providing Technical Support to global customers is required.
* Strong understanding of Active Directory.
* Advanced knowledge of networking concepts and devices.
* Troubleshooting network issues with ifconfig, ping, tracert, nslookup, netstat,etc.
* Understanding of PKI concepts, including key management, certificate lifecycle management, and trust models.
* Deep understanding of TLS/SSL protocols, cipher suites, and best practices for secure configurations.
* Configuring SSL/TLS settings on firewalls and load balancers (e.g., F5, HAProxy).
* Understanding of SSL offloading and re-encryption.
* Proficiency in managing certificates using tools like MMC (Microsoft Management Console)
* Expertise in OpenSSL, Java Keytool, CertUTIL, CertReq commands.
* Experience/Working with servers like Internet Information Services (IIS), Apache, Tomcat, NGINX, etc.
* Working Knowledge of ACME clients like certbot, win-acme, lego, etc.
* Proficiency in using tools like Wireshark or similar network analysers.
* Familiarity with support/service desk tools and browser developer consoles.

**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**

* Strong communication and organization skills, with attention to detail and must be able to multi-task.
* Superior customer service and phone mannerism are required to handle the support of Sectigo’s customer base.
* Experience working with large and enterprise accounts and customers across different geographies.
* Knowledge of corporate environment.
* Knowledge of Sectigo products and services, including policies and procedures.
* Computer literacy skills must include the use of e-mail, databases, and word processing applications.
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Possess qualities such as integrity, fair mindedness, and a persuasive, congenial personality.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Must have the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and global environment while applying existing skill sets and training to increase knowledge base.
* Must be able to work shift work Monday through Friday including holidays based on business needs and possible Weekends and after hours.
* Must be willing to carry the after-hour Support pager.

**Additional Information**

**Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate.

Our “One Sectigo” culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Our Hiring Process at Sectigo:**

To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage.

**Global team. Global reach. Global impact.**
  
  
  
At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. Importantly, we strive to be recognized not only as the CLM leader but also for our intentional efforts to promote employees into the roles that most challenge and excite them, into experiences that allow them to grow their interests as we grow the business. We are committed to bringing a little bit of fun and a whole lot of happiness into everything we do so that our work – and our team members – reflect the positive outcomes we deliver to our customers every day.

title: Senior / Medical Writer
description:
**Who We Are:**

MIMS is Asia-Pacific’s leading multi-channel provider of trusted, quality medical information, medical education, and knowledge services connecting healthcare communities. Our work empowers healthcare professionals to improve patient outcomes by facilitating knowledge exchange and better decision-making.

Today, MIMS has a strong regional presence in 17 countries and regions across Asia-Pacific with approximately two million healthcare professionals subscribed to its drug & resource portal, digital and print publications. We provide solutions to leading pharmaceutical companies and established healthcare institutions across the world.

**Who We Are Looking For:**

Reporting to the editorial lead, the Medical Writer will develop high-quality scientific publications and associated outputs for MIMS MedComms clients. This role is focused on peer-reviewed manuscripts, congress abstracts, posters, oral presentation materials, publication-enhancement content, and related scientific communications. The role is suited to a medical writer with at least 1 year of existing publications writing experience who wants to build deeper expertise in ethical, accurate, and transparent medical publication practice while working with experienced editorial and client teams.

Given the high volume of writers needed, freelancers are also welcome to apply.

**What Impact You Will Make:**

* Develop scientifically accurate, well-structured publication content for peer-reviewed journals and congresses, including manuscripts, abstracts, posters, oral presentation materials, plain language summaries, and publication-related slide content.
* Work from clinical data, literature, author direction, and client briefs to prepare clear publication drafts that communicate evidence accurately and appropriately for specialist medical audiences.
* Support publication development in line with established industry standards, including Good Publication Practice, ICMJE authorship and disclosure expectations, and relevant reporting guidelines such as CONSORT and other EQUATOR Network resources where applicable.
* Conduct targeted literature reviews, reference checks, data extraction, fact checking, and quality control to ensure scientific accuracy, consistency, and appropriate citation of source material.
* Prepare publication outlines, first drafts, revised drafts, response-to-reviewer content, figure and table legends, and associated submission-ready materials under guidance from senior writers and editorial leads.
* Coordinate comments from authors, clients, reviewers, and internal stakeholders, ensuring revisions are addressed clearly, accurately, and within agreed timelines.
* Maintain awareness of journal and congress requirements, including formatting, word count, referencing, disclosure, acknowledgements, and submission requirements.
* Collaborate professionally with authors, key opinion leaders, clients, project managers, medical editors, and account teams to support efficient and ethical publication delivery.
* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing by building therapy area familiarity, applying editorial feedback, and developing stronger publication-writing judgement over time.

**What Skills and Experience You Will Bring:**

* Graduate degree in life sciences, medicine, pharmacy, public health, biomedical sciences, or a related scientific discipline; a higher degree is advantageous but not essential.
* At least 1 year of existing experience writing or substantially contributing to peer-reviewed medical or scientific publications, ideally within a medical communications agency, publisher, CRO, pharmaceutical company, academic, or healthcare research environment.
* Candidates possessing over 4 years of experience will be evaluated for the Senior Medical Writer position.
* Demonstrated ability to write clear, accurate scientific content for publication outputs such as manuscripts, abstracts, posters, congress presentations, literature reviews, or plain language summaries.
* Working knowledge of publication ethics and industry expectations, including transparency, appropriate acknowledgement of medical writing support, authorship principles, disclosure requirements, and accurate reporting of data.
* Ability to interpret clinical and scientific information, identify the key message, and present complex data in a concise and balanced way for healthcare professional audiences.
* Strong attention to detail, including referencing accuracy, consistency checking, data verification, formatting, grammar, and adherence to client, journal, and internal style requirements.
* Good project discipline, with the ability to manage assigned writing tasks, respond constructively to feedback, and meet agreed timelines across multiple publication deliverables.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office; familiarity with reference management tools, publication databases, and journal submission systems would be advantageous.

**Key Behaviours**

* Scientifically curious, with a genuine interest in communicating research clearly and responsibly.
* Ethical and quality-focused, with respect for publication standards, author accountability, data integrity, and transparency.
* Collaborative and responsive, able to work constructively with authors, clients, senior writers, editors, and project teams.
* Organised and accountable, with the ability to manage detail while keeping publication milestones on track.
* Open to feedback and committed to continuous development as a publications medical writer.
* Positive, proactive, and able to contribute to a supportive regional/global MedComms team environment.

title: Principal Expert, US Insurance Industry
description:
**Life at UiPath**
The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.
  
  
To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.
  
  
Could that be you?
  
  
**Your Mission**
UiPath is building a new way to design and deliver enterprise processes. UiPath cartographer draws on a curated library of industry process knowledge, interviews the business, and produces process maps and design documents. AI coding agents then turn those designs into working, orchestrated solutions, in days rather than months.
  
  
In insurance, "almost right" isn't good enough. The best AI companies in regulated industries have learned the same lesson: quality comes from making a senior practitioner part of the team to building the benchmarks, evaluations and feedback loops around their experience and judgment.
  
  
That's this role. As our Principal Expert for insurance, you will own the quality of everything our AI produces for US insurers. You'll set the bar, build the tests that hold the AI to it, and work in the field with customers and partners to make sure what we ship works in a real carrier.
  
  
This role does not carry a sales quota and is not a product management role. Success is measured by the quality of the insurance solutions we deliver and how confidently customers build on them.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Exciting**

* Your work sets the standard. What you define as good will be used by insurance customers, partners and AI agents across the platform.
* You see the impact. Take a process from discovery to a working solution in days, then keep improving it.
* You're building something new. Help decide which lines of business we go after next and how we measure the success of AI-designed processes.

**What You'll Do At UiPath**
**Own insurance AI quality**

* Own the quality of insurance process knowledge, designs and solutions across Property & Casualty and Life & Annuity.
* Decide what needs fixing first, review changes before they go to customers, and sign off when a process is ready.
* Work with industry experts, partners and reviewers to maintain and improve quality.

**Build the insurance benchmark**

* Build a library of real insurance use cases covering claims, FNOL and triage, total loss, endorsements, life claims, medical records, disability claims and new business NIGO.
* Define test cases, scoring criteria and expected answers to evaluate every new AI model and product release before it reaches customers.

**Turn expert judgment into evaluations**

* Evaluate AI outputs at every stage, from process knowledge and process maps to design documents and working solutions.
* Work with applied scientists and engineers to make sure automated AI evaluations match expert judgment, so we can scale quality checks without relying on manual reviews for everything.

**Find failures and make sure they get fixed**

* Review actual outputs, identify common failure types across regulation, coverage, workflows, data and terminology, and prioritise them based on customer impact.
* Turn recurring failures into reusable test cases and make sure fixes work before they go live.
* Share clear updates on quality, key issues and progress with leadership, product teams and customers.

**How You'll Work**
You'll work in a small, senior team of automation consultants, engineers and applied scientists, working directly with customers.
  
  

* Work with insurance carriers, MGAs and consulting partners to understand how their claims and underwriting teams operate, and test our designs against real processes.
* Join consultants and engineers on customer deployments and use what you learn to improve our benchmarks and evaluations.
* Run a regular review cycle, roughly every two weeks, to assess outputs, prioritise fixes and track improvements.
* Join customer and partner meetings.

**What You'll Bring To The Team**

* Extensive experience (typically 12+ years) in US insurance, ideally starting hands-on in claims and moving into claims operations senior or mid level roles.
* Deep P&C or Life & Annuity knowledge across the lifecycle
* Working knowledge of US claims regulation: unfair claims settlement practices, state acknowledgment and payment deadlines, total-loss and salvage rules, and market conduct exams.
* Experience mapping or redesigning claims or policy servicing operations: queues, handoffs, SLAs, exceptions, fraud referral and QA.
* The confidence to review complex documents quickly, spot what's plausible but wrong, and explain exactly why.

**Nice To Have**

* Life & Annuity or disability expertise: contestability, beneficiary determination, unclaimed property, suitability, and underwriting evidence such as medical records.
* Experience evaluating AI or automation output: writing test cases, rubrics or reference answers, or running QA or validation programs.
* Experience with insurance AI, claims automation or document intake programs.
* Comfort with data and light technical work, such as spreadsheets, data analysis or prompting AI tools.
* Experience leading or calibrating a team of reviewers, auditors or claims QA specialists.
* Commercial lines, workers' compensation, employee benefits or broker/MGA experience.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.
  
  
Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.
  
  
We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

title: Associate IS Engineer
description:
**About Amgen**
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today.
  
  
**Role Description**
We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions.
  
  
This is a blended application engineering role combining IT application support, application lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, integration support, and software development. The successful candidate will work across both run/support activities and change/development initiatives, helping ensure applications remain reliable, secure, compliant, and fit for business needs.
  
  
Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams.
  
  
The role will also contribute to full-stack development and application enhancements, including front-end development, API integration, back-end development, testing, and deployment where required.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day technical and operational support for enterprise applications and associated integrations which could be either of these SaaS, COTS and Custom-built application
* Monitor application health, availability, interfaces, scheduled jobs, and other operational components, and proactively identify potential issues.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents, defects, integration failures, data issues, and performance problems.
* Perform technical root-cause analysis and support implementation of corrective and preventive measures for recurring problems.
* Support incident, problem, request, and change-management processes in accordance with established IT service-management practices.
* Work with business users, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, integration teams, and external vendors to resolve technical issues.
* Support application configuration, upgrades, patches, releases, environment changes, and production deployments.
* Support application integrations with enterprise platforms, databases, APIs, identity and access-management solutions, and cloud services.
* Maintain application documentation including architecture and interface details, configuration information, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and support knowledge articles.
* Contribute to application lifecycle activities including technical assessments, upgrades, modernization, remediation, and application retirement where applicable.
* Participate in periodic operational, security, compliance, and application health activities as required.

**Software Development & Enhancement**

* Contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of application enhancements and software solutions.
* Manage the application SDLC and supporting ITIL Lifecyle completely
* Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable and user-friendly application functionality.
* Develop or enhance front-end applications using technologies such as React, Vite, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Build reusable, responsive, accessible user-interface components following enterprise design standards.
* Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, enterprise services, databases, and third-party platforms.
* Contribute to back-end development using Python and FastAPI, or comparable technologies, under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Participate in technical design discussions, peer code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and technical walkthroughs.
* Follow coding standards, secure-development practices, reusable software-design patterns, and established engineering practices.
* Develop and maintain appropriate unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated tests.
* Support CI/CD processes for automated builds, testing, security scanning, and deployment.
* Analyse and remediate application vulnerabilities, software dependency issues, and technical debt in collaboration with senior engineers.

**Testing, Release & Operational Readiness**

* Create and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end tests for application changes and releases.
* Support user acceptance testing and resolution of defects identified during testing.
* Validate APIs and system integrations using tools such as Postman or equivalent.
* Support release planning, deployment validation, and post-production verification.
* Ensure appropriate technical and support documentation is available before solutions transition into production.
* Work with support teams to ensure operational readiness for new applications, enhancements, integrations, and releases.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, application owners, developers, QA professionals, DevOps teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve application reliability, automate repetitive operational activities, and reduce recurring support issues.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and practices across application development, cloud, DevOps, API integration, observability, cybersecurity, automation, and AI.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience**

* Master's / Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience may include a combination of application development, application engineering, production/application support, system integration, testing, or IT operations.

**Must-Have Skills**

title: Copy of Lead, QA
description:
Ayr designs and manufactures critical power grid equipment including power transformers, distribution transformers, special-purpose transformers, high-voltage circuit breakers, and medium-voltage switchgear. They serve markets such as renewables, data centers, utilities, oil & gas, and industrial sectors. They position themselves as partners in power projects, offering lifecycle support and working to deliver faster than average industry timelines.
  
  
Website: https://ayr.energy
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Own in-process quality for medium and power transformers (33–400 kV), ensuring products meet applicable standards, customer specifications, and Ayr Energy's Quality Management System (QMS). Lead stage-wise quality controls across core, coil, tanking, assembly, oil processing, and final tests to achieve first-time-right builds, reduce rework, and elevate
  
  
customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Quality System & Documentation
* Create and maintain Control Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITP), stage checklists, work instructions, and traveler/route cards; enforce hold/witness points.
* Own NCR/CAPA—facilitate structured root cause analysis (5-Why, Fishbone), implement fixes, and verify effectiveness; drive defect prevention.
* Maintain device history records, test certificates, as-built dossiers, and customer documentation packs for shipment and FAT.
* Supplier & Customer Interface
* Qualify and develop suppliers for critical items (CRGO, copper, bushings, OLTC, radiators, tanks); conduct audits and PPAP/FAI where applicable.
* Lead customer stage and final inspections (FAT), coordinate third-party inspections/test labs, and close observations promptly.
* Data, Metrics & Continuous Improvement
* Track FPY, rework/repair hours, supplier PPM, test bay failures, and COPQ; publish weekly/monthly dashboards.
* Apply 7 QC tools, MSA (GR&R), process capability (Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk), and SPC to stabilize and improve processes.
* Run kaizens to reduce defects (e.g., oil leaks, winding shorts, paint defects) and cycle time at critical stages.

Compliance & Standards
  
  

* ISO 9001:2015 QMS; ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 (EHS) – adhere to procedures and participate in audits.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: BE/B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering (Electrical preferred).
* Experience: 8–15 years in transformer manufacturing quality; at least 5 years hands-on in-process/stage inspection and test bay exposure for 66 kV+ class.
* Certifications (preferred): Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, ASQ CQA/CQE, NDT Level II (VT/PT), Lead Auditor (ISO 9001).

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of transformer construction, drawings (GA, core/coil, schematic), tolerances, and insulation systems.
* Proficiency with electrical tests (TTR, WR, IR/PI, tan δ/PF, SFRA, AC withstand) and interpretation of results.
* Hands-on with metrology and torque tools; ability to set up gauges/fixtures and verify special processes.
* QMS documentation, RCA/CAPA, statistical analysis (MSA, Cp/Cpk), and SPC; working knowledge of ERP/MES and Minitab/Excel.
* Clear written/verbal communication; ability to coach operators, manage audits, and interface with customers and TPI bodies.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* First-pass yield at critical stages and final test
* Supplier PPM and on-time NCR closure
* Defect/rework reduction (%), COPQ trend
* Calibration compliance and audit scores
* On-time documentation pack readiness and shipment clearance

**Why Join Ayr Energy**
Be part of a fast-growing grid hardware company building mission-critical products. You will shape world-class manufacturing systems, work with global suppliers and utilities, and grow into leadership roles with clear impact on reliability and safety of power networks.
  
  
**Work Conditions**

* Primarily shop-floor based role with regular presence in test bay and oil processing areas.
* Shift and weekend support during critical builds or customer inspections as needed.
* Travel up to 60% for supplier audits, customer FATs, or type test witnessing.

title: Sr. BA II
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Job Description**
Invesco understands data and the products created from data are the lifeblood of our business. Data-first functions work together seamlessly to enable Invesco to achieve the true value of data and data products. Invesco leverages data as a strategic asset by making quality, trusted data and content available to the right people, at the right time, in the right format, in the most efficient way possible to enable both large transformations and day-to-day operations.
  
  
This Senior Business Analyst role sits within the Product Engagement part of our Digital, Distribution and Enterprise Engineering (D2E2) organization. They maintain good relationships with internal partners and collaborate with their peers across the Distribution business domain. They develop a strong understanding of the investments and distribution data and business processes, including both how it is produced and consumed across all Distribution channels and how to apply Invesco’s Data strategy and practices to drive Distribution’s data capabilities forward.
  
  
The focus of this position is to work closely with the business units to gain in-depth understanding of customer's business strategy, processes, services, roadmap and the context in which the business operates. This role will be key to understanding and documenting capabilities needed to address business challenges. Under the general supervision, gather business and data requirements, convert the business and data requirements into technical requirements for solution development. The senior business analyst supports the product owner(s) in managing the scope of the assigned project(s), resolves any impediments from requirements perspective for development team, supports the system testing and user acceptance testing. The business analyst also performs validation of deliverables against requirements ensuring that solution is meeting the objectives.
  
  
You will be responsible for:
  

* The Senior Business Analyst is responsible for reviewing assigned business processes from end-to-end to identify and address operational, financial and technological risks.
* Analyzing and understanding the end-to-end Distribution processes and the data associated with multiple business processes having cross domain.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
* Responsibilities will include a full range of activities from leading small to mid-size projects to assisting product owners on larger more complex projects.
* Under the guidance of the product owners, the senior business analyst should be able to work with business stakeholders to document the functional and non-functional requirements.
* Conducts interviews to gather customer requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Translates conceptual customer requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is understandable to developers/project team.
* Demonstrate strong Problem-solving skills.
* Attending regular team and other required meetings daily/weekly.
* Ensuring clear and accurate communication and responding to data, business, and technology partners and peers in a timely manner.
* Provides updates to senior management, project stakeholders on the progress of the project and or assigned tasks.
* Reports weekly status to senior management and project team as applicable
* Conduct UAT testing when rolling out new regulatory filings or added data sources
* Identify, research, document and / or remediate exceptions
* Analyzes and verifies requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.

This individual:
  

* Must be comfortable working in a scaled agile development environment
* Have an ability to handle multiple requests from varied stakeholders, in a way that maintains clear priority, and ability to adjust when needed
* Be an effective “translator” of business needs into technical requirements
* Demonstrate an ability to build relationships, collaborate, and influence internal and external teams
* Be able to work under guidance of senior team member, take initiative, and get projects completed with great attention to detail and on time.

The experience you bring:
  

* A bachelor’s degree in finance, Business Administration, Information Technology.
* Minimum 5-6 years of business and data analysis experience
* Minimum 4-7 year of experience in the Investment Management industry/Asset Management/Financial Services industry.
* Strong scripting skills in programming languages like SQL and Python, as you will be responsible for writing queries and other data transformation scripts.
* Solid knowledge of Data Life cycle, data governance, data risk, Master data management concepts, data modeling, Business intelligence and analytics concepts.
* Ability to work in a team/group setting.
* Ability to interpret complex or vague instructions and successfully produce results.
* Proactively identifies, analyzes, and resolves procedural fail points.
* Demonstrates superior judgement, reasoning, and follow-up skills.
* Demonstrates a high level of initiative, assertiveness, and self-confidence.
* Proactively identifies and analyzes procedural improvements. Initiate projects/workflow that would enhance the department's functions.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office products
* Shares information efficiently between team members.
* Promotes Teamwork.
* Effectively manages multiple responsibilities and meets deadlines.
* An understanding of the concepts related to data modelling, coding and process flow design
* Excellent analytical, mathematical, and creative problem-solving skills
* Excellent listening, interpersonal, written and oral communication skills
* Logical and efficient, with attention to detail

**Full Time / Part Time**
Full time
  
  
**Worker Type**
Employee

No
  
  
**Workplace Model**
At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office.
  
  
**Why Invesco**
In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each other’s identities, lives, health, and well-being. **What’s in it for you?**

description:

**CNS (300)**
**-**
**Senior Consultant - Aera Technology**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As an Aera Techno-Functional Senior, you will support the design, configuration, testing, and deployment of Decision Intelligence solutions. You will work with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate decision requirements into data, logic, user experience, and action-oriented solution components.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Gather and document business processes, decision points, KPIs, pain points, data needs, and expected outcomes.
* Convert functional requirements into solution designs covering data preparation, curated data views, rules, recommendations, workflows, user screens, and actions.
* Use SQL to profile, reconcile, transform, and validate data across source and curated datasets.
* Configure and test Aera solution components under the guidance of solution leads and architects.
* Prepare test scenarios, execute unit and functional testing, support user acceptance testing, and resolve defects.
* Create clear functional and technical documentation, including mappings, logic, assumptions, test evidence, and operating guidance.
* Collaborate with client teams, data engineers, developers, and project managers to manage dependencies and delivery risks.
* Support production deployment, hypercare, issue triage, and continuous improvement of deployed solutions.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute reusable delivery assets and best practices.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business analytics, supply chain, operations, finance, or a related field.
* Master’s degree or MBA from Tier 1 institute will be preferred.
* 5+ years of overall experience in technology consulting, analytics, enterprise applications, data solutions, or business process transformation.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, data quality checks, and performance-aware query design.
* Ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation in a techno-functional role.
* Experience with requirements gathering solution design, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Understanding of data models, integrations, business rules, workflows, and enterprise application delivery.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Prior hands-on Aera experience is a strong plus.
* Experience in Decision Intelligence, supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial, or finance use cases.
* Exposure to cloud data platforms, APIs, ETL/ELT, reporting, Python, or advanced analytics.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models and distributed global teams.

**What We Look For**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery-focused mindset.
* Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.

title: Proposal Manager
description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Business Development & Proposal Manager to lead opportunity identification, market intelligence, bid strategy, and end-to-end proposal management for our U.S. civil engineering and infrastructure business. The role will focus on identifying and qualifying U.S. federal, state, county, and municipal government opportunities; analyzing RFPs and RFQs; developing compliant and competitive proposals; coordinating with technical and commercial teams; and maintaining a strong pipeline of upcoming opportunities.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience managing U.S. government bids and proposals, a strong understanding of government procurement processes, excellent proposal-writing and analytical skills, and the ability to translate business opportunities into well-structured, competitive submissions.
**Prior hands-on experience supporting or managing U.S. government contracts at both federal and state/local levels is mandatory.**
Experience in civil engineering, infrastructure, construction inspection, geotechnical engineering, or engineering consulting is highly preferred.
  
  

* Business Development & Opportunity Identification
* Identify, research, and qualify new business opportunities across U.S. federal, state, county, and municipal government agencies.
* Monitor government procurement portals, including SAM.gov and state/local procurement platforms, for relevant solicitations.
* Identify opportunities related to civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction materials testing, construction inspection, infrastructure monitoring, and engineering consulting services.
* Develop and maintain a pipeline of upcoming, active, and potential business opportunities.
* Conduct market research to understand client requirements, upcoming projects, procurement trends, and competitor activity.
* Support management in evaluating new markets, target agencies, strategic accounts, and potential partnerships.
* Maintain opportunity trackers and provide regular pipeline updates to leadership.
* Bid Strategy & Opportunity Qualification
* Review and evaluate RFPs, RFQs, Requests for Information (RFIs), Expressions of Interest (EOIs), and other government solicitations.
* Assess solicitation requirements, eligibility criteria, scope of work, evaluation methodology, submission deadlines, and contractual conditions.
* Coordinate bid/no-bid evaluations with leadership and relevant technical and commercial stakeholders.
* Identify proposal requirements, compliance risks, resource needs, and potential differentiators.
* Develop proposal schedules, compliance matrices, responsibility assignments, and submission plans.
* Track amendments, addenda, clarifications, and changes to solicitation requirements.
* End-to-End Proposal & Bid Management
* Lead the complete proposal lifecycle, from opportunity identification and qualification through submission and post-submission follow-up.
* Manage the preparation of technical proposals, management approaches, project understanding, staffing plans, past-performance references, and supporting documentation.
* Develop proposal outlines, response matrices, submission checklists, and compliance documents.
* Coordinate with engineering, project management, operations, finance, legal, and leadership teams to collect proposal inputs.
* Ensure proposals address all solicitation requirements and evaluation criteria.
* Review submissions for accuracy, consistency, completeness, compliance, and overall presentation.
* Manage proposal deadlines and ensure timely submission through the appropriate procurement portals.
* Coordinate post-submission clarifications, interviews, presentations, and follow-up activities.
* Proposal Writing & Content Development
* Develop clear, persuasive, and technically sound proposal narratives aligned with U.S. government solicitation requirements.
* Prepare and refine executive summaries, technical approaches, staffing methodologies, management plans, and project-specific responses.

Sr. Business Consultant - Quality Management (QM) Job
  
  
Date: Oct 27, 2026
  
  
Job Requisition Id: 66645
  
  
Location:
  
  
Hyderabad, TG, IN Bangalore, KA, IN Indore, MP, IN Pune, MH, IN Pune, IN
  
  
YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.
  
  
At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.
  
  
**We are looking forward to hire Quality Management (QM) Professionals in the following areas :**
**Lead Quality Management Domain Consultant, Healthcare and Life Sciences**
We are seeking a Lead Quality Management Domain Consultant with 10+ years of experience to support quality-process assessment, operational improvement and digital-transformation initiatives for a global Healthcare and Life Sciences organization.
  
  
The candidate must possess strong quality-domain knowledge and practical experience in regulated manufacturing environments. The role requires the ability to visit manufacturing plants and laboratories, understand how quality processes are performed, identify operational and system gaps, and translate business challenges into practical improvement opportunities and structured requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Assess end-to-end quality processes across manufacturing plants, laboratories, warehouses and distribution operations.
* Conduct shopfloor observations, stakeholder interviews and process workshops.
* Assess incoming, in-process and finished-goods quality processes.
* Review nonconformance, deviation, CAPA, complaint, inspection, testing and release processes.
* Document current-state and future-state processes.
* Identify process, control, data, application and integration failure points.
* Assess GxP, data-integrity and computerized-system considerations.
* Define business requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Support risk-based testing, UAT, validation and implementation.
* Recommend practical process, system and organizational improvements.
* Develop quick-win recommendations and Quality Management transformation roadmaps.
* Present findings and recommendations to Quality, Manufacturing and IT leadership.

Mandatory Requirements
  
  

* 10+ years of professional experience.
* Strong Quality Management domain knowledge.
* Healthcare, Medical Device, Pharmaceutical or Life Sciences experience.
* Manufacturing, plant or shopfloor quality-process exposure.
* Experience across Quality Assurance, Quality Control, inspection, nonconformance, deviation or CAPA processes.
* Knowledge of GxP, 21 CFR Part 11 and computerized-system validation principles.
* Prior client-facing experience in an IT services or consulting organization.
* Strong business-process assessment and requirements-analysis experience.
* Experience supporting testing, UAT, validation or implementation.
* Ability to work independently with plant, quality, laboratory and IT stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, workshop-facilitation and communication capabilities.
* Willingness to travel to client manufacturing locations.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Previous industry-side Quality Assurance or Quality Control experience.
* Medical-device manufacturing experience.
* Knowledge of ISO 13485.
* Experience with global or multi-plant quality-transformation programs.
* Exposure to SAP Quality Management.
* Working knowledge of LIMS, eQMS, MES or other quality applications.
* Experience with ERP, LIMS, MES, eQMS and WMS integrations.
* Relevant quality, regulatory, validation or auditing certification.

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.
  
  
**Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles**

* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Manager, Metadata Specialist
description:
**Summary**
The Manager, Metadata Specialist will work within the Marketing Metadata Operations team and will serve as a key operational contributor responsible for ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance of marketing metadata across brands and channels. This role ensures consistent application of metadata standards, supports campaign tagging needs, and maintains established processes aligned with governance expectations and SLAs.
  
  
This person will collaborate with marketing, brand teams, and operations partners to support Metadata workflows, validate tagging structures, and help ensure a smooth transition of metadata operations as responsibilities move into our team. Strong analytical capability, attention to detail, and comfort working in global, multi stakeholder environments are essential.
  
  
This person leads the delivery of multiple projects across a variety of creative and marketing channels, including print and digital media. Develop and coordinate project plans across the design, development and production stages of a project to support the successful delivery within set KPI's. Will work in collaboration with brand teams, technical teams and all functions to maximize value.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collect, validate, and document business and metadata requirements to support campaign onboarding and ongoing updates.
* Apply and maintain standardized taxonomy, naming conventions, and tagging structures across marketing programs.
* Perform quality assurance checks on metadata inputs and tagging deliverables to ensure completeness, accuracy, and adherence to governance standards.
* Ensure all operational tasks meet established SLAs and internal quality expectations.
* Identify metadata inconsistencies or gaps and coordinate with stakeholders to resolve issues.
* Support knowledge transition activities by documenting processes, workflows, and best practices as the metadata function is fully transitioned.
* Coordinate with agency, partner, and vendor teams to ensure alignment to metadata standards and operational guidelines.
* Collaborate with cross‑functional teams (product, brand, analytics, operations) to ensure metadata supports reporting, insights, and downstream system needs.
* Maintain strong communication and relationships with internal teams and agency partners to drive smooth operations and timely deliverables.
* Provide operational oversight to partners, ensuring adherence to metadata quality expectations and process requirements.
* Identify opportunities to streamline metadata workflows, enhance efficiency, and improve quality; propose actionable solutions.
* Support training and onboarding for teams needing guidance on metadata processes and operational standards.
* Demonstrate strong negotiation, problem‑solving, and interpersonal skills while working across regions and time zones.
* Ensures delivery of efficient and high-quality deliverables.
* Hands-on experience with Power BI for dashboard creation, data visualization, and reporting is a good-to-have skill.

**Essential Requirements**

* Minimum 5+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign management, metadata governance, or related fields in Pharma or LifeSciences
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or in Computer engineering or other related field.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and operational skills, with proven attention to detail.
* Experience working with tagging/taxonomy frameworks, structured data, or marketing execution processes.
* Demonstrated ability to work with cross‑functional teams and manage operational workflows in a fast‑paced, multi‑market environment.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Power BI hands-on experience for reporting and visualization is preferred.
* Track record of operational excellence, meeting SLAs, and improving processes.
* Marketing Strategy
* Metadata Operations
* Campaign Management

**Certifications**
Certifications related to marketing operations, digital marketing, metadata management, or campaign governance are an advantage.
  
  
**Languages**

* Fluent English (both written and verbal)

**Why Novartis:**
Helping people with disease and their families takes more than innovative science. It takes a community of smart, passionate people like you. Collaborating, supporting and inspiring each other. Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture

Learn about all the ways we’ll help you thrive personally and professionally.

title: Senior Medical Writer
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical research organization (CRO) committed to advancing clinical research and improving patient outcomes worldwide. We partner with biopharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, and academic institutions to conduct high-quality clinical trials and deliver innovative solutions across all phases of development. Our multidisciplinary team of experts is dedicated to ensuring regulatory compliance, scientific excellence, and operational efficiency in every project we undertake.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Senior Medical Writer with specialized expertise in clinical trial disclosure and transparency to join our growing team. In this strategic role, you will lead the preparation, review, and delivery of clinical trial transparency submissions while providing regulatory guidance and mentoring junior team members. You will work with global clients to navigate complex disclosure requirements and ensure compliance with evolving regulations. This position offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on clinical research transparency and patient access to trial information.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Independently lead the preparation, review, and delivery of clinical trial transparency submissions, including protocol registrations, results postings, plain language summaries (PLS), lay protocol synopses (LPS), redaction/anonymization packages, anonymization reports, and CCI justification tables
* Advanced clinical and regulatory document authoring and review expertise, including Study Protocols, Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), Investigator Brochures (IBs), Informed Consent Forms (ICFs), Clinical Overviews, Clinical Summaries, and Safety Reports
* Provide strategic and regulatory guidance on clinical trial disclosure requirements to clients and internal teams
* Lead client interactions and provide disclosure-related consultation on complex regulatory matters
* Independently manage complex disclosure projects from initiation through delivery
* Provide regulatory interpretation and strategic recommendations to support client decision-making
* Contribute to process improvements and best practice development within the disclosure team
* Mentor and train junior team members on disclosure requirements, document development, and regulatory compliance
* Ensure all submissions meet quality standards and regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience in medical writing field with demonstrated expertise in clinical trial disclosure and transparency
* Thorough understanding of global clinical trial disclosure and transparency regulations, including ClinicalTrials.gov, EudraCT, EU-CTR/CTIS, EMA Policy 0070, and Health Canada requirements
* Extensive experience with protocol registration, results reporting, registry maintenance, and disclosure compliance strategies
* Strong understanding of health literacy principles and demonstrated ability to develop clear, patient-facing disclosure documents
* Thorough knowledge of data protection regulations and their application to anonymization and redaction activities
* Advanced expertise in identifying and justifying PPD (Personally Identifiable Data) and CCI (Confidential Commercial Information) redactions
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to explain complex regulatory concepts clearly
* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, health sciences, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!
  
  
We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

title: State Program Officer - Bhongir (Bhuvanagiri), Telangana
description:
**Overview**
Jhpiego is an international, non-profit health organization and an affiliate of Johns Hopkins University, dedicated to improving the health of women and families in developing countries. For over 50 years, it has focused on providing high-quality, low-cost health care solutions, training health workers, and strengthening health systems.
  
  
Jhpiego has been working in India since the 1980s in close partnership with national and state governments. With deep technical expertise and strong on-the-ground execution, Jhpiego helps design, test, and scale practical solutions and innovations that fit real-world systems across 11 thematic domains (Maternal and Newborn Health, Reproductive Health, Nutrition, Immunization, Comprehensive Primary Health Care, Human Resources for Health, TB and Infectious Diseases, Global Health Security, Women's Cancers, Non-Communicable Diseases, Digital Health).
  
  
Jhpiego is seeking a highly motivated
**State Program Officer**
based in Telangana for its RISE project. The
**State Program Officer**
will coordinate and support day-to-day state implementation of activities, including workplan tracking, stakeholder follow-up, meeting/field-visit coordination, documentation, data and reporting support, capacity-building logistics, partner coordination and transition records. The role will enable State Leads and Technical Advisors to deliver timely, well-documented technical assistance through government systems rather than parallel implementation structures.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Programme Coordination & Workplan Tracking**

* Maintain detailed state workplans, calendars, action trackers and deliverable status for HIV projects related activities; flag delays, dependencies and required follow-up to the State Lead.
* Coordinate routine communication and scheduling with SACS, district/facility teams, national Advisors, Technical Advisors, MERL/Communications/Operations teams and approved partners.
* Track implementation of technical-assistance priorities, including decentralized/integrated services, digital/data activities, private-sector engagement, combination prevention, capacity strengthening and transition milestones.
* Maintain meeting decisions and action logs and follow up responsible persons through closure, ensuring project records reflect current implementation status.

**Field Visits, Reviews, Workshops & Capacity-Building Support**

* Prepare agendas, participant lists, materials, approvals, attendance records, minutes and post-event action trackers in coordination with technical leads.

title: Tech associate USP MS&T CoE
description:
**Position Purpose**
As USP SMEs, responsible for technology transfers, process lifecycle management, manufacturing support, validation support, and technical governance across Sandoz manufacturing sites and external partners.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
  
  
**Technical support**

* To provide support Upstream manufacturing processes across commercial products.
* Serve as SME for fed-batch, intensified fed-batch, and continuous perfusion upstream process control strategies.
* Support resolution of complex technical manufacturing issues and investigations.

**Innovation & Emerging Technologies**

* Evaluate emerging upstream processing technologies, digital solutions, advanced analytics, automation platforms, single-use technologies, and manufacturing innovations for applicability across the biologics network.
* Assess technical feasibility, business value, implementation risks, and potential impact on product quality, process robustness, cost of goods, and supply reliability.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Process Development, Engineering, Digital, and external technology providers to pilot and industrialize innovative solutions.
* Support implementation of approved technologies and ensure effective knowledge transfer across manufacturing sites and CMOs.

**Manufacturing Support**

* Ensure timely scientific support for routine manufacturing operations.
* Provide support investigations related to process deviations, atypical results, and process performance excursions to in-house facilities as well as CMOs as needed.
* Support root cause analysis and implementation of effective CAPAs.

**Process Lifecycle Management**

* Perform continued process verification (CPV) programs across commercial products.
* Support Annual Product Reviews (APR/PQR) and trend evaluations.
* Support technical risk assessments associated with process changes, deviations, investigations, and technology transfers.
* Support change control assessments and implementation of post-approval manufacturing changes.
* Drive robust documentation and knowledge management practices.

**Technology Transfer**

* Support Upstream process scale-up and transfer activities and documentation into and out of the site as well as into and out of the External partners.
* Ensure effective transfer of process knowledge, process characterization data, and control strategies.
* Assess technical risks and author documents associated with process transfers and scale-up activities.

**Validation Activities**

* Support PPQ planning, execution, review and closure.
* Support process characterization and validation strategy development.
* Provide documentation support for validation exceptions and deviations.
* Support ongoing process validation activities throughout the product lifecycle.
* Author validation protocols, reports, and technical documentation.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Support initiatives to improve yield, throughput, process capability, and cost efficiency.
* Identify and implement innovative manufacturing solutions.

**Competencies**

* Upstream domain expertise
* Execution Excellence
* Scientific Problem Solving
* Collaboration
* Continuous Improvement
* Quality Mindset
* Results Orientation

**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**

* MSc in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, or related discipline
* Min 3+ years experience in Biologics MS&T, Process Development, Technical Operations, or Manufacturing
* Experience supporting commercial manufacturing. Experience investigating process deviations and implementing CAPAs
* Good understanding of GMP requirement
* Experience with technology transfer and process validation
* Experience with perfusion or continuous manufacturing operations
* Experience in scale up and scale down of USP, Experience with single use technology operations

**Why Sandoz?**
Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of access to good healthcare.
  
  
With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.
  
  
Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
  
  
  
  
Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
  
  
**Commitment To Diversity & Inclusion**
We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.
