title: Senior ECM Solution Architect [T500-30491]
description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.**

**Who are we:**

Core Insurance Platforms (CIP) is Zurich’s global capability responsible for building, running, and evolving core insurance technology. We set a unified, scalable operating model—covering governance, standards, architecture, service delivery, and reuse—so our business units can deliver at speed and scale.

CIP is the strategic steward of Zurich’s Guidewire ecosystem, aligning platform roadmaps to business strategy while driving stability, modernization, reduced supplier dependency, and long term cost efficiency.

India delivery center is one of our global delivery and capability hub. We bring together experts in AI, engineering, analysis, quality, and architecture to deliver product & process solutions, application run services, change and transformation initiatives, and centralized platform services across both on prem and Guidewire Cloud environments. Our teams operate from multiple global delivery centers, supporting Zurich’s business units worldwide.

**Enterprise Content Management Solution Architect:**

The ECM Solution Architect defines secure, scalable and supportable end-to-end content management solutions aligned with the enterprise ECM strategy. The role covers solution architecture, requirements engineering, integration design, technical governance and delivery assurance across IBM and Box-based ECM platforms.

**Who we are (Zurich Enterprise Content Management – ZECM):**

Zurich is one of the world’s leading insurance groups, and one of the few to operate on a global basis. Our mission is to help our customers understand and protect themselves from risk. With about 55,000 employees serving customers in more than 170 countries, we aspire to become the best global insurer as measured by our shareholders, customers and employees. We help individuals, small and medium sized companies and global corporations around the world understand and protect themselves from risk by offering a wide range of insurance products, solutions and advisory services.

**ZECM provides our Business Partners with a reliable and comprehensive service for capturing, managing, storing, preserving and retrieving business content and documents that are key to their business functions. We offer two solutions:**

* ECMaaS: is a shared content services platform using primarily IBM Cloud Pack for Business Automation (CP4BA) and hosted in Capgemini Azure Cloud.
* ZBOX: is a shared content services platform based on Box SaaS
* We offer from Consulting Services, to Project execution and application maintenance for the above shared ECM platforms.

**Our opportunity:**

Within the Enterprise Content Management we produce value by offering global services to all those interested Business Units. We implement ECM projects usually with the help of some external vendors and our responsibilities cover a wide range of activities depending on the type of project.

As an ECM Solution Architect, you would be reporting to the ECM Lead Solution Architect performing one or more of the following tasks in each project.

* Perform the analysis of business requirements and translating them into solution requirements to ensure their implementation throughout the project life cycle, or review the proposed solution coming from our partners.
* Write or validate detailed design documents against those requirements and create the technical quality checks to ensure functional and non-functional requirements are met during project/s lifecycle.
* Identify deviations from the standards, enforce best practices and submit ideas and thoughts regarding projects or the whole platform.
* Share subject matter expertise to others in the organization or supporting others in their efforts to deliver (ECM Service Managers, ECM Project Managers, etc).
* Ensure compliance of the ECM Solutions with ECM Strategy, Group Operations & Technology Standards, customer project requirements and operational quality levels.
* Understanding and being able to apply different delivery approaches (Waterfall, SCRUM, Zurich Lean) and perform, independently, business analysis processes in accordance with Zurich Project Management Framework and the Zurich Risk Policy.
* Work with the AI teams and experts to align on best practices and quality / governance controls.

**Your role:**

As an ECM Solution Architect the role is focused on requirements & end-to-end ECM architecture solution definition within a project context across the lifecycle to support business process & IT system changes. The Key tasks include:

* Ensure that ECM Solutions are aligned to business needs and communicate the business benefits.
* Participate in the ECM Solution strategy, innovation areas and technology roadmap globally.
* Participate in the Solution Architecture Governance to ensure the assigned projects are compliant with the strategy and the group.
* Understand customer objectives, processes and products to make recommendations and proposals.
* Work with key stakeholders to understand the business requirements, existing systems and applications, and drive the ECM Solution for assigned projects.
* Balance the competing constraints of business need, services, technology and quality to produce the specified product, service or result with minimal change requests required.
* Produce requirement specifications if needed and outline solution design documents throughout the project life cycle.
* Perform quality review checks on project deliverables.
* Participate on solution portfolio rationalization and operational simplification and identify cost and service efficiencies.
* Apply consulting skills to facilitate decision making, resolve conflicts, and gain consensus and customer commitment.
* Ensure methodical delivery and continuous improvements in shared services
* Collaborate with global teams on strategy updates, planning, and investment prioritization.
* Own the end-to-end solution architecture from initial requirements and option assessment through detailed design, implementation assurance, operational readiness and post-implementation validation.
* In addition to architecture and governance responsibilities, the ECM team owns and evolves selected technical products, frameworks, accelerators and integration components. The Solution Architect is expected to contribute hands-on when appropriate by producing prototypes, reference implementations, API contracts, reusable patterns and technical enablers.

**Your Skills and Experience:**

**Required experience & certificates:**

* English fluent written and spoken.
* Experience to work in diverse, multi-cultural environments and to deal with ambiguity and changing/evolving requirements.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills with the ability to communicate with both, business and technical stakeholders at all levels of an organization.

**Other desirable skills:**

* Other languages might be very valuable due to the distributed nature of the service.
* Good understanding of quality management and development methodologies are highly valuated.

**Technical skills:**

* Degree from a technical program, or a business-related degree with IT experience.
* +3 years as SME/Architect/Senior Developer in complex IT projects and landscape
* **Experience in Enterprise Content Management projects is highly valued, especially if the knowledge is tight to the following products:**
* IBM Cloud Pak for Business Automation
* IBM FileNet Content Manager and its evolution towards IBM Content Cortex
* IBM Content Navigator
* Box.com
* Ability to work at multiple levels of abstraction, from enterprise and solution architecture to API definitions, configuration models, proof-of-concept development and review of critical implementation artefacts.
* Sufficient software-engineering knowledge to guide development teams, assess implementation quality, review critical code or configuration where required, and contribute to prototypes or reference implementations without becoming the primary developer for every initiative.
* Experience in Waterfall and Agile development framework, Scrum Master, tools and process is an advantage.
* Appreciated hands-on spirit and willingness to develop small things if required.
* Artificial Intelligence basic knowledge.
* Know how to leverage the usage of Microsoft 365 Copilot to speed up documentation review.
* Use AI tools to reinforce the quality of the deliverables such as Detailed Design documents, test cases, test plans, etc.
* Use the power of AI to cooperate with it and brainstorm on improvements for the platform.
* Claude or other AI technologies is appreciated as some developments might be part of the work.

**Soft Skills:**

* Positive attitude, strong communication (verbal and written) & interpersonal skills.
* Team player and able to create and work in a collaborative environment.
* Ability to influence stakeholders across all levels, including teams outside of shared services and solutions.
* Act as a trusted advisor for the customer by having a holistic view of the different alternatives that would provide a solution to the customer/s.
* Ability to discuss technical topics in business terms, including but not limited to give presentations to an audience with different level of technological maturity.
* Ability to think outside of the box and be innovative by keeping abreast of new trends, identifying opportunities to bring in change for business benefit.

**Additional Information:**

**Our current technology stack includes, but is not limited to:**

* IBM Cloud Pak for Business Automation
* IBM FileNet Content Manager and its evolution towards IBM Content Cortex
* IBM Content Navigator
* Box.com
* Microsoft Azure
* Microsoft Azure Kubernetes Services
* Microsoft Azure Event Hub
* Microsoft Azure Functions
* Bespoken developed and integrated products

title: Technical Content Writer
description:
Job Description: Technical Content Writer

Company: Proxsoft Global

Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra

Experience: 4–5 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time, On-Site

Preference: Mumbai-based candidates

About Proxsoft Global

Proxsoft Global is an ERP and analytics consulting firm helping businesses streamline operations, improve decision-making, and drive growth through technology. We specialize in ERP implementation, business intelligence, data analytics, and technology consulting, particularly for industries such as construction, manufacturing, and professional services.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly intelligent, analytical, and research-oriented Technical Content Writer with prior experience creating technical content for the construction, real estate, infrastructure, or related industries.

The candidate must be capable of developing a complete website page from a single topic or keyword, independently conducting research, understanding technical concepts, and presenting complex information in a clear, structured, and engaging manner.

We need someone who can think critically, understand industry-specific terminology, identify business challenges, and translate technical information into meaningful content for business audiences. The ideal candidate should demonstrate exceptional research skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to work independently with minimal guidance.

Key Responsibilities

* Technical Website Content: Independently research, plan, and write complete website pages, including service pages, industry pages, solution pages, landing pages, and technical articles.
* Industry-Specific Writing: Create well-researched content related to construction, real estate, infrastructure, engineering, and associated business processes.
* Technical Research: Understand complex technical subjects, industry workflows, software solutions, and business requirements before developing content.
* Independent Content Development: Transform a single topic or keyword into a comprehensive page with logical structure, relevant sections, practical examples, and clear messaging.
* Critical Thinking and Analysis: Evaluate information, identify knowledge gaps, connect technical concepts with real-world business challenges, and develop content that adds genuine value.
* Competitor and Market Research: Study industry publications, company websites, technical documentation, and market trends to develop accurate and differentiated content.
* Business-Focused Communication: Explain complex technical concepts in a simple, professional, and convincing manner for decision-makers, business owners, and industry professionals.
* Content Planning: Determine the appropriate page structure, headings, supporting topics, FAQs, and calls to action based on the subject and intended audience.
* Accuracy and Quality Control: Verify technical information, maintain consistency in terminology, ensure originality, and review content for clarity and factual correctness.
* Collaboration: Work with management, subject-matter experts, and internal teams to understand business objectives and translate them into effective content.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* 4–5 years of experience in technical content writing, preferably in construction, real estate, infrastructure, engineering, or B2B technology.
* Proven experience writing technical website pages, industry-specific articles, service descriptions, and solution-focused content.
* Strong understanding of construction and real estate terminology, processes, and business challenges.
* Excellent research, analytical reasoning, and critical-thinking abilities.
* Ability to understand complex technical information and communicate it clearly to different audiences.
* Exceptional written English, grammar, editing, and content structuring skills.
* Ability to independently develop complete website pages from a brief topic or keyword.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make informed content decisions without constant supervision.
* Ability to distinguish reliable technical information from assumptions and generic, AI-generated content.
* Familiarity with technical documentation, industry research, and AI-assisted writing tools is an advantage.
* Must be based in Mumbai and comfortable working full-time from the office.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with an international technology consulting business.
* Exposure to ERP, analytics, and construction technology solutions.
* Collaborative work environment with opportunities to develop technical.
* Opportunity to contribute directly to the company's digital marketing and organic growth strategy.

How to apply: Send your resume to ishika@proxsoft.co.in with the tagline "Content Technical Writer".

title: Product Intern - Stratzy (Raise)
description:
**Role Summary**

Raise is built on this core philosophy, we will bring exceptionally great products, awesome user

experience and best-in-class customer service to our users. We started with our first consumer product, Dhan, an investment and trading platform launched in November 2021.

Today,
**Dhan ranks #8 amongst stock brokers in India**
and continues to be one of the fastest-growing platforms in the investment and trading ecosystem.

In September 2026,
**Dhan was also recognised as Fintech Startup of the Year at the Global Fintech Festival,**
reflecting the innovation, product excellence and customer focus that continue to shape the platform. Backed by a passionate team of builders, believers, designers and problem-solvers, we are building a trusted ecosystem of financial products that empowers millions of users to make smarter financial decisions.

**Stratzy**
is an algorithmic investing and trading platform that makes rule-based, system-driven trading accessible to everyday investors. The platform offers 100+ ready-made, approved algorithmic strategies across equities, indices, F&O, and commodities, letting users pick and deploy structured strategies instead of having to build and monitor trades themselves.

We are looking for a curious, proactive and ownership-driven
**Product Intern**
to join the Stratzy Product team. This is an opportunity to work on real product challenges, contribute ideas, collaborate directly with the leadership team and help build features that solve actual user problems. You will gain hands-on experience in product management, user research, data analysis and product development.

This is a
**3 to 6 month internship**
, with a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) opportunity for high performers, based on performance and business requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of product features, improvements and experiments, from ideation to launch.
* Understand user needs and pain points, identify opportunities and suggest solutions to improve the product experience.
* Work closely with the leadership team to understand business priorities, share ideas and contribute to product decisions.
* Translate ideas and business problems into clear product requirements, user journeys and actionable tasks.
* Collaborate with design, engineering, marketing and customer support teams to bring product ideas to life.
* Analyse user behaviour, product data and customer feedback to identify opportunities and measure the impact of product improvements.
* Research competitors, market trends and emerging developments in fintech, investing and algorithmic trading.
* Interact with users, understand their experiences and bring actionable insights to the product roadmap.
* Track feature performance after launch and recommend improvements based on user feedback and data.

**Requirements**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in any discipline. Engineering, Business, Finance, Economics or related backgrounds are welcome, but not mandatory.
* Strong curiosity about digital products, technology, user behaviour and how businesses solve customer problems.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think logically and break down complex problems into simpler solutions.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to share ideas and collaborate with different teams.
* A proactive mindset, willingness to learn and ability to take ownership in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfortable with numbers, analysing information and using data to support decisions.
* An interest in finance, stock markets, investing, trading or fintech is an advantage; prior knowledge of algorithmic trading is not mandatory.
* Prior internships, college projects, personal projects, product case studies or startup experience are welcome, but not essential.

We are a start-up organization focused on fast growth with quality products; hence, the ability to

work in a fast-paced environment goes without saying!

**If you are curious, enjoy solving problems and want hands-on experience building real products, we would love to hear from you!**

**Our People & Culture:**

People and culture are the most important aspects of our business.

We are looking for team members just like us, in simple words - good people to work with and

demonstrate following personality traits:

•
**Be super obsessed about ensuring customer satisfaction.**

(We are here because of our customers, and will be here only if we serve our customers)

•
**We have a single opportunity to serve.**

(Our customers will give us one opportunity to serve - we can’t let them down. Be it product,

uptimes, customer service or any interaction we have to deliver a wow experience.)

•
**Respect your work, your team, your co-workers and our customers.**

(The only way to get respect is to give it first)

•
**Speed is all that matters. Ship right and ship faster.**

(You either help the team move ahead fast, or you slow it down. We prefer the first.)

•
**Humility & politeness over arrogance & over-confidence.**

(If you are the smartest one in the room, bring up others to speed. We are here to serve our

customers, not to prove a point.)

•
**Quality over quantity.**

(It is fine if you pick up a few things to do, but do them exceedingly well.)

•
**Make your hands dirty irrespective of who you are.**

(Our CEO responds to customers every day. Our CTO codes every day. This is us.)

•
**Talent and Competency over Credentials.**

•
**Entrepreneurial, ownership driven and disciplined.**

(We trust you to help us gain and retain the trust of our customers and our stakeholders)

•
**Less words, more action.**

(Believe in something? show it by doing things. Not just by talking about it)

•
**Flat hierarchy with open culture & conversations.**

(You are among all of us, and we all are with you)

•
**Passionate about the business you are a part of.**

(Do it because you are passionate about it, not because it’s your job.)

**Why Join Raise?**

We’ve been recognised as a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years, reflecting the culture we’ve built and the way we work together. At Raise, you’ll experience a flat hierarchy, open conversations, high ownership and a strong bias for action. We value people who bring passion, humility and curiosity to their work, and who care deeply about building great products and creating meaningful customer impact.

We believe in growth with ownership, speed with thoughtfulness and ambition with humility. We

celebrate wins, learn from challenges and give people the ownership and responsibility to build and make an impact. If you enjoy building from the ground up, working with passionate people, and being part of a high-growth fintech ecosystem, Raise offers an environment where you can do meaningful work and grow with the business.

**About Raise Financial Services**

Raise Financial Services is building technology-led financial products and infrastructure for India’s financially aware and digitally savvy consumers. Our ecosystem spans multiple aspects of financial services, with Dhan as our flagship investment and trading platform.

Alongside Dhan, we are building and scaling businesses across the financial ecosystem, including Stratzy, Millions, Upsurge, Filter Coffee, Pluto Insurance, Fuzz and several other emerging products and platforms.

Our ambition is to build a trusted ecosystem of financial products and experiences that make

investing, trading, wealth creation and other financial services simpler, smarter and more accessible. Our philosophy is simple:

* Build great products.
* Deliver awesome experiences.
* Provide exceptional customer service.

Location: Goregaon West, Mumbai

Explore More:

* Connect with us: www.raiseholding.co
* Learn more about our Algo Trading platform - https://stratzy.in/
* Learn more about our Investing & Trading Platform – www.dhan.co

Follow our Instagram page
**#LifeatRaise**
for a glimpse into our people and latest culture

happenings.

**Apply for the Role:**

If you are excited about building and scaling one of India's most ambitious consumer fintech

ecosystems, we would love to hear from you. Send your resume to:
**careers@dhan.co**

Raise is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an

inclusive workplace.

title: Technical Trainer CPS - IOT
description:
**Company Description**
C4i4 Lab, backed by the Ministry of Heavy Industries, India, is focused on accelerating business transformation through Industry 4.0 and digitally enabled smart manufacturing. The organization supports companies in adopting technologies such as IoT, AI, Big Data Analytics, and Robotics to enhance productivity, agility, and real-time decision-making. Its holistic approach spans people, processes, and technology, helping organizations achieve manufacturing excellence and operational flexibility. C4i4 Lab offers digital maturity assessments, immersive model factory and iFactory network experiences, and technology and skill enablement through its i4Skills platform. It also builds industry ecosystems, interfaces with government stakeholders, and collaborates with academia to deliver comprehensive skilling and immersion programs.

**Role Description**
C4i4 Lab, Pune is looking for a Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) & IoT Trainer / Faculty to prepare students and industry professionals for the future of smart manufacturing and connected industrial systems. This role exists to bring Industry 4.0 technologies into classrooms and training programs through hands-on laboratory training and project-based learning. Working on deputation at academic institutions and industry client sites, you will help learners understand how physical systems, embedded computing and networks come together in real industrial applications. In doing so, you will directly support C4i4 Lab' mission of bridging academia and industry.

**Qualifications :**

**(Must-Haves)**

•
Education: Postgraduate degree (M.E. / M.Tech. / M.Sc. or equivalent) in Electronics, Electrical

Engineering, Instrumentation, Embedded Systems, IoT, Mechatronics, Robotics, Control

Systems or a related discipline.

• Ph.D. (pursuing or completed); exposure to Industry 4.0 applications, smart

manufacturing, industrial IoT, automation or applied research.

• Technical Skills: Strong understanding of Cyber-Physical Systems, IoT, embedded systems,

sensors and actuators, microcontrollers, communication protocols and industrial automation;

hands-on experience with Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, PLCs, MQTT, Modbus, sensor

interfacing and data acquisition.

• Soft Skills: Strong communication, presentation, mentoring and stakeholder-management

skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and run interactive sessions for academic and industry audiences.

(
Nice-to-Haves
) :

•
Experience: Prior teaching, corporate or technical training, research or laboratory instruction

experience is encouraged, along with practical experience in IoT-based monitoring and control

systems.

**Core Responsibilities & Duties**

• Deliver lectures, workshops and hands-on practicals on Cyber-Physical Systems, Industrial IoT,

Embedded Systems, Sensors, Data Acquisition and Industrial Automation for students and

industry professionals.

• Design, demonstrate and facilitate experiments using microcontrollers, sensors, actuators,

communication protocols, IoT platforms and PLCs.

• Guide learners through real-world projects involving sensor integration, device connectivity,

real-time data acquisition, monitoring and control.

• Demonstrate the integration of physical systems with embedded computing, networks, sensing

and control in smart, connected industrial systems.

• Develop curricula, course materials, laboratory manuals and project-based learning modules

aligned with emerging cyber-physical technologies.

• Conduct practical assessments, evaluate learner projects and mentor participants.

• Support the deployment and demonstration of CPS technologies and laboratory infrastructure

at partner institutions and industry sites.

• Collaborate with faculty, industry clients and subject experts to bridge theory and industrial

practice, including customized corporate training.

description:

. title: Branding and Content Intern
description:
Job Title: Branding and Content Intern

Location: Thane (Mumbai)

Role: General Management

Puŕ Ferme Project (pronounced Pure Farm Project) is a functional food consumer brand focused on clean, science-backed products with incubation support from NutriHub IIMR and CFTRI Mysuru, iACE, MANAGE-CIA and one the select few innovative startups under APEDA’s BHARATI program to access export markets. We are focused on building a transparent, farmer-connected food brand to take high-quality, traceable Indian food products to global markets. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

This role is ideal for someone who wants to develop and grow into a full-time
**Founder’s Office role.**

Work directly with the Founder and Operate from the Founder’s Lens to:

·      
Assist in developing and maintaining a consistent brand identity

·      Support storytelling, writing compelling content, and bringing creative ideas to life

·      Plan and execute marketing campaigns and assist in product launches

**About the Role**

Pur’ Ferme Project is looking for a creative, enthusiastic, and proactive individual to join our team as an Intern to support Content, Copywriting, Branding & Event Coordination.

If you enjoy storytelling, writing compelling content, building brands, planning events, and bringing creative ideas to life, this role offers an opportunity to work across multiple aspects of brand building.

You will work closely with the founders and marketing team to develop brand communication, create engaging content, coordinate marketing activities, and support events, product launches, and brand activations.

This is a hands-on role in a growing food-tech startup, offering exposure to content strategy, brand development, digital marketing, partnerships, and event management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Content Creation & Copywriting**

·      Create engaging content for Instagram, LinkedIn, and other digital platforms.

·      Write compelling captions, social media posts, blogs, newsletters, website copy, product descriptions, and marketing communications.

·      Create compelling designs for packaging, website, social media, print collateral, and more and translate brand strategy into visual concepts.

·      Collaborate to create visually stunning graphics and animations using Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Photoshop, and other design software

·      Develop creative concepts, campaign narratives, and storytelling ideas that communicate the brand's vision and values.

·      Assist in developing scripts and concepts for reels, short-form videos, product features, and promotional campaigns.

·      Ensure consistency in brand voice, messaging, tone, and communication across platforms and have basic video shooting and editing skills

·      Contribute to the production of high-quality marketing materials, including brochures, flyers, and social media content, using Adobe Creative Suite.

·      Support the development and execution of a structured content calendar.

·      Eye for aesthetics and visual storytelling and convert complex product information into simple, engaging, and consumer-friendly communication.

**2. Branding & Creative Communication**

·      Assist in developing and maintaining a consistent brand identity across digital and physical touchpoints.

·      Work on creative briefs and campaign concepts for product launches, seasonal promotions, and brand initiatives.

·      Collaborate with the design team to develop social media creatives, presentations, brochures, posters, and other marketing collaterals.

·      Contribute ideas for packaging communication, product storytelling, and brand messaging.

·      Ensure all marketing materials align with the brand's positioning, visual identity, and communication guidelines.

·      Help build brand narratives around functional foods, conscious consumption, product quality, and farmer stories.

·      Support the creation of presentations, partnership proposals, and brand communication materials.

**3. Event Planning & Coordination**

·      Assist in planning and coordinating events, exhibitions, trade shows, product launches, pop-ups, and brand activations.

·      Coordinate with event organisers, vendors, venues, partners, and internal teams to ensure smooth execution.

·      Support event registrations, logistics, promotional materials, product samples, and other operational requirements.

·      Assist in preparing event presentations, invitations, promotional content, and on-ground branding materials.

·      Coordinate with relevant stakeholders before, during, and after events.

·      Capture event highlights and coordinate the creation of post-event content for social media and other platforms.

·      Maintain event calendars, checklists, budgets, and follow-up trackers.

·      Identify relevant industry events, food festivals, networking opportunities, and brand-building platforms.

**4. Marketing Campaigns & Brand Partnerships**

·      Work with the founders and marketing team to plan and execute marketing campaigns.

·      Assist in developing campaign ideas for product launches, festivals, seasonal promotions, and customer engagement initiatives.

·      Support influencer collaborations, brand partnerships, sampling campaigns, and promotional activities.

·      Research potential collaborators, event partners, content creators, and relevant marketing opportunities.

·      Help prepare campaign briefs, communication material, and partnership presentations.

·      Monitor content performance and assist in identifying insights to improve engagement and communication.

·      Contribute creative ideas for customer acquisition, retention, and brand awareness.

**5. Research & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

·      Research successful food, FMCG, wellness, and D2C brands to identify relevant marketing and branding practices.

·      Track emerging content formats, social media trends, consumer behaviour, and competitor communication.

·      Work closely with the founders and marketing team to understand product positioning and business priorities.

·      Coordinate with product, sales, and operations teams to gather information for accurate product communication.

·      Help communicate the stories of farmers, sourcing partners, and the brand's wider impact.

·      Support marketing documentation, campaign reports, and other business communication requirements.

**What We Are Looking For**

·      A graduate or undergraduate student in Design, Marketing or a related field.

·      Strong writing, copywriting, and communication skills.

·      Creativity, curiosity, and a keen interest in branding, storytelling, and marketing.

·      An interest in food, health, wellness, sustainability, and consumer brands.

·      Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

·      Confidence in communicating and coordinating with different stakeholders.

·      Familiarity with Instagram, LinkedIn, and other digital content platforms.

·      Knowledge of Adobe Illustrator, Canva, presentation tools, or content creation software is an advantage.

·      A proactive attitude, attention to detail, and willingness to take ownership of projects.

·      Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a fast-paced startup environment.

Prior experience in content writing, social media management, event coordination, or branding is an advantage but not mandatory.

**What You’ll Gain**

* Basic
  **stipend**
  and letter of recommendation based on performance
* **Potential for full-time employment offer**
  based on long-term performance and alignment
* Hands-on experience in building a consumer brand from the ground up.
* Direct exposure to founders and the decision-making process in a growing startup.
* Practical experience across content strategy, copywriting, branding, marketing campaigns, and event management.
* Opportunities to contribute ideas and take ownership of live projects.
* Exposure to product launches, industry events, brand partnerships, and marketing initiatives.

title: Remote Pod Lead - Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review engineering tasks for technical accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure that tasks reflect authentic mechanical and aerospace engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent task delivery.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of engineering tasks.
* Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, geometry and mesh files, simulation inputs, material properties, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving finite-element analysis (FEA), computational fluid dynamics (CFD), thermodynamics, heat transfer, dynamics, robotics, flight simulation, propulsion, and orbital mechanics.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic mechanical and aerospace engineering workflows and require meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify engineering correctness across units, equilibrium, conservation laws, boundary conditions, mesh convergence, solver tolerances, reference frames, and numerical stability.
* Validate computational environments, simulation tools, solvers, and dependencies to ensure reproducible results.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as stresses, deflections, natural frequencies, aerodynamic coefficients, thermal performance, orbital parameters, and safety margins.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering calculations or simulations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, Fortran, Julia, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: FEA, CFD, dynamics, flight simulation, thermal modeling, astrodynamics, guidance, navigation and control (GNC), or propulsion modeling.
* Strong understanding of engineering simulation, numerical methods, computational modeling, and technical validation.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, engineering simulations, computational models, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate engineering assumptions, numerical accuracy, solver convergence, and the reliability of computational results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with engineering simulation and computational tools such as OpenFOAM, SU2, CalculiX, Code\_Aster, FEniCS, Elmer, Gmsh, FreeCAD, CadQuery, MuJoCo, ROS, XFOIL, AVL, OpenVSP, JSBSim, OpenMDAO, pyCycle, poliastro, Orekit, GMAT, or SPICE.
* Familiarity with commercial engineering software such as ANSYS, Abaqus, COMSOL, or NASTRAN, including reproducing workflows using open-source tools.
* Experience with state estimation, trajectory optimization, topology optimization, aeroelastic analysis, or multidisciplinary design optimization.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
* Industry or agency experience in automotive, energy, manufacturing, robotics, aircraft, launch vehicles, satellites, or UAVs.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: Senior Electrical Solutions Engineer
description:
The Senior Electrical Solutions Engineer is a core Subject Matter Expert (SME) within Global Solutions Engineering, providing advanced electrical engineering expertise and technical leadership to the broader Solutions Engineering organization. Based in India, the role will primarily support India while also providing cross-regional support to EMEA, APAC, the Americas, and other regions as required. The role translates complex hyperscale and neocloud/enterprise customer requirements into practical, scalable, resilient, and commercially viable data center electrical solutions, with particular emphasis on high-density compute environments and increasingly complex power distribution architectures.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Reports to the Director of Central Solutions Engineering for Global Solutions Engineering and serves as a Senior Electrical SME and escalation point for the Global Solutions Engineering organization, with primary support responsibility for India and cross-regional support as required. The role will support Solutions Engineers with technical interpretation, solution development, customer discussions, electrical capacity assessments, and technical risk identification.
* Lead electrical solutioning for hyperscale, AI/HPC, neocloud, and enterprise opportunities, with strong emphasis on high-density deployments, resilient power architectures, customer fit-outs, and integration into both new and existing data center infrastructure.
* Lead the preparation and coordination of electrical technical response packages for customer requests, RFPs, SOQs, technical clarifications, and design-development activities, ensuring proposed solutions are clearly documented and communicated to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Collaborate with Global Product & Sales Strategy and Space / Capacity Management teams to evaluate electrical capacity, space utilization, future expansion capability, stranded capacity, and infrastructure constraints in support of customer opportunities and portfolio planning.
* Support NTT Data GDC Legal and Commercial teams in the technical review of customer contracts, leases, MSAs, SLAs, responsibility matrices, technical exhibits, and related agreements to confirm that electrical obligations, performance commitments, demarcations, and customer requirements are technically achievable and aligned with NTT Data GDC standards.
* Translate customer RFPs, SOQs, CDEs, technical schedules, design criteria, and engineering standards into electrical concepts that align customer requirements with NTT Data GDC standards, available site infrastructure, resiliency objectives, schedule, and commercial requirements.
* Develop electrical design concepts through approximately 30% schematic design, including single-line diagrams, power distribution concepts, equipment layouts, feeder and busway routing concepts, equipment connection points, system zoning, redundancy strategies, design criteria, protection philosophy, and supporting technical markups.
* Prepare sufficiently detailed schematic packages and technical scope information for Construction / Preconstruction teams to establish fit-out pricing, identify Non-Recurring Costs (NRC), evaluate long-lead equipment requirements, and assess schedule impacts and delivery risks.
* Perform or validate engineering calculations and technical analyses including electrical load calculations, power striping calculations, normal and failure-mode load allocation, failover calculations, transformer and UPS loading, generator loading, feeder and busway sizing, voltage drop, available fault current, equipment interrupting ratings, redundancy capacity, and electrical system operating envelopes.
* Develop and evaluate electrical distribution architectures including 2N, N+1, distributed redundant, catcher, block-redundant, and other hyperscale electrical topologies; evaluate the impact of component failures and maintenance scenarios on available IT capacity.
* Perform power striping and failover assessments to confirm that IT load can be appropriately distributed across available power trains under normal, maintenance, and failure conditions, and verify that proposed solutions remain within the capacity limits of generators, UPS systems, transformers, switchgear, PDUs/RPPs, busway, and downstream distribution equipment.
* Develop electrical solutions for high-density and AI/GPU deployments, including evaluation of rack power requirements, diversity, power factor, harmonic loading, transient characteristics, busway and RPP configurations, branch-circuit distribution, and coordination with liquid-cooling and other high-density mechanical systems.
* Define interfaces between customer electrical systems and base-building infrastructure, including utility and medium-voltage systems, generators, UPS systems, transformers, switchgear, PDUs/RPPs, busway, metering, grounding, controls, remote-trip requirements, power-quality requirements, commissioning, and operational responsibilities.
* Evaluate fault-current and protection requirements, including available fault current at customer connection points, equipment short-circuit ratings, selective coordination considerations, breaker configurations, and mitigation strategies where customer equipment limitations or standards drive additional requirements.
* Assess customer electrical requirements related to power quality, grounding, metering, harmonics, voltage and frequency tolerance, power factor, monitoring, protection, and controls, and identify deviations from NTT Data GDC standard designs.
* Work closely with Mechanical, Controls/BMS, IT, Architectural, Structural, Product, Design Management, Construction, Operations, Commissioning, and Commercial teams to deliver fully integrated, constructible, and operationally supportable solutions.
* Participate directly in customer workshops, technical deep-dives, RFP clarifications, site visits, design reviews, and executive / technical presentations; communicate complex electrical engineering concepts clearly to both technical and non-discipline audiences.
* Review vendor proposals, equipment selections, and technical submittals and assist with selection and application of major electrical equipment including transformers, generators, UPS systems, switchgear, switchboards, PDUs, RPPs, busway, breakers, metering systems, and associated controls.
* Develop technical narratives and scope-of-work documentation including intake forms, Basis of Design input, electrical design criteria, assumptions, deviations, exclusions, demarcation points, and other documentation required to transition solutions from Sales / Solutions Engineering into design and construction execution.
* Identify solution risks, constraints, assumptions, and early design trade-offs; clearly communicate impacts to capacity, resiliency, failure domains, maintainability, constructability, cost, schedule, commissioning, and operational performance.
* Support development and continuous improvement of global electrical solution standards, templates, reference architectures, calculation tools, design guidelines, and technical guidance for the Solutions Engineering organization.
* Stay current with hyperscale, neocloud, and AI infrastructure trends.
* Provide technical knowledge transfer, mentoring, and guidance to regional Solutions Engineers and other engineering team members without direct people-management responsibility.
* Support projects and customer opportunities primarily across EMEA, while providing additional support to India, APAC, the Americas, and other regions as required; maintain flexibility to participate in meetings across multiple regional business hours when needed.
* Engage and often lead technical solution discussions with prospects, customers, and partners, either in person or remotely, in coordination with Account Executives and other commercial stakeholders when senior electrical expertise is required.
* Maintain positive customer relationships throughout the Solutions process by providing credible, responsive, and technically sound engineering support that builds confidence in NTT Data GDC's ability to deliver current and future customer requirements.
* Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Operations, Design, Construction, Commissioning, and Delivery teams throughout the opportunity and project lifecycle.
* Host and support technical tours of NTT Data GDC facilities, explaining electrical infrastructure, resiliency philosophy, capacity, operating methodology, and customer deployment options to prospects, customers, and partners.

**Required Skills:**

* Expert-level understanding of data center electrical infrastructure and power distribution systems.
* Deep practical expertise in hyperscale, neocloud, AI/HPC, and high-density electrical architectures, including 2N, N+1, distributed redundant, catcher, block-redundant, and other mission-critical power topologies.
* Strong understanding of electrical load allocation,
  **power striping, failover calculations, failure-domain analysis, and capacity balancing**
  across generators, UPS systems, transformers, switchgear, PDUs/RPPs, busway, and rack-level distribution.
* Strong ability to develop schematic-level electrical engineering documentation and markups in Bluebeam. Knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, ETAP, AmpCalc, or similar tools, including single-line diagrams, electrical risers, equipment layouts, feeder routing concepts, busway layouts, and customer fit-out concepts, is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of applicable industry standards and codes, including NFPA 70 / NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE standards, ANSI requirements, applicable IEC standards, local electrical codes, utility requirements, and customer-specific hyperscale engineering standards.
* Strong understanding of power-quality requirements, including voltage tolerance, frequency tolerance, harmonics, THD, power factor, transient performance, waveform capture, and customer-specific server power-quality criteria.
* Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to think strategically and make data-driven decisions.
* Advanced knowledge and ability to mark-up electrical and mechanical single lines, as well as floor plan layouts of equipment and systems in AutoCAD, Bluebeam or other drafting software.
* A thorough understanding of modern data center and IT client requirements and environments with a primary focus on wholesale customers and their data center requirements.
* Comfortable speaking/presenting to groups of all sizes.
* Demonstrated ability to work in a team/cross-team/multi-site environment.
* Comprehensive ability to work with 3rd party contractors and vendors to aid in the design of large customer infrastructure deployment requirements.

title: Specialist- Supply Chain Management, HSS
description:
PATH current employees - please log in and apply
**Here**
PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges.
  
  
**About PATH’s Health Systems Strengthening Vertical**
PATH strives to build a world where innovation ensures that health is within reach for everyone. We start by thinking about people. What do children, women, and men need to be healthy? Similarly, what do health workers, managers, and decision-makers need to do their jobs well? How can the information, products, or services that are needed for health best be obtained—not just for today, but for the future?
  
  
Innovators are developing new information, products, and services that hold great promise for global health. But this promise can’t be realized if solutions can’t be delivered. Health systems—that is, the organizations and people whose primary intent is to promote, restore, or maintain health1—are weak in many countries and represent a challenge to achieving health equity. There is an urgent need for energy, support, and creativity to ensure that health systems can deliver effective health interventions.
  
  
This focus on systems is a core component of PATH’s overall mission to improve the health of people around the world by advancing technologies, strengthening systems, and encouraging healthy behaviors. Our systems work both informs and is informed by our work with technology and behavior change. PATH strengthens health systems to improve the health of people around the world.

* Primary Health Care
* Pandemic Preparedness and Surveillance
* Devices and Diagnostics
* Supply Chain Management
* Healthcare Economics and Financing
* Technology and Innovations
* Private Sector Engagement
* Anti-Microbial Resistance and Global Health Security

* Provide regular updates and reports on project progress, including achievements, challenges, and lessons learned, contributing to ongoing monitoring and evaluation efforts.

* Available to travel to intervention states up to 30-40% of the time.

* Postgraduate /Professional degree in Pharmacy/Logistics and Supply Chain Management/ MBA-SCM MPH/MHA or any other related field.
* Minimum 4-5 years of experience in supply chain management in reputed public or private organization

**Skills/ Abilities**

* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and policy concepts to diverse audiences.
* Self-directed and creative individual with experience managing relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and project management skills
* Excellent organizational and project management skills
* Ability to multitask and work in a multi-cultural team.
* Ability to handle a variety of assignments under pressure of deadlines
* Ability to travel up to 40-50% of the time.

title: Remote Pod Lead - Chemical Engineering
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced Chemical Engineering expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.

In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review chemical engineering tasks for technical accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic chemical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent task delivery.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of chemical engineering tasks.
* Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic and property data, process flowsheets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving reaction engineering, thermodynamics, phase equilibria, transport phenomena, separation processes, process simulation, process control, optimization, combustion, and electrochemical engineering.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic chemical engineering workflows and require meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify engineering correctness across mass and energy balances, thermodynamic consistency, property data, unit handling, and numerical convergence.
* Validate computational models, stiff ODE/DAE solvers, solver tolerances, initial conditions, and simulation results to ensure reproducibility and technical accuracy.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as conversion, yield, selectivity, purity, energy consumption, and process constraint satisfaction.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering calculations or simulations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Chemical Engineering.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Julia, C/C++, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: process modeling, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic modeling, process simulation, or optimization.
* Strong understanding of chemical engineering fundamentals, numerical methods, computational modeling, and technical validation.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, chemical process simulations, computational models, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate mass and energy balances, thermodynamic assumptions, numerical accuracy, solver convergence, and the reliability of computational results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with chemical engineering simulation and computational tools such as Cantera, CoolProp, Pyomo, IDAES, DWSIM, CasADi, or OpenFOAM.
* Familiarity with commercial process simulation software such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, or gPROMS, including reproducing workflows using open-source tools.
* Experience with process optimization, reactor modeling, separation systems, process control, or electrochemical simulations.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
* Industry experience in petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, energy, specialty chemicals, or chemical process manufacturing.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: Technical Writer (No AI Writing, Human Content Only)
description:
**This is not a typical content role.**

If your instinct is to:

* Use ChatGPT to write content
* Optimize for speed over quality
* Follow templates without thinking

This role is not for you.

**About Perfect Clicks LLC - Based In New Jersey, USA**

Perfect Clicks is a performance-driven SEO and digital marketing company focused on one core mission: creating irreplaceable, human-written content that dominates Google rankings and becomes a source for AI systems. We don’t chase trends or shortcuts. We build long-term digital assets through deep research, structured thinking, and high-quality execution. Our work spans SEO, content strategy, branding, and full-funnel marketing, all tied to measurable results including rankings, traffic, and revenue growth. With over a decade of experience, hundreds of brands served, and thousands of top-ranking keywords, we operate as strategic partners—not vendors—helping businesses scale through content that compounds over time and cannot be replicated by AI.

We work with high-traffic financial platforms, e-commerce brands, media companies, startups, agencies, and enterprise clients. Since SEO content is the foundation of our business's marketing deliverables, you'll be responsible for writing high quality blog posts, articles, and case studies for a wide range of niches, including wealth management, hospitality, music therapy, pain management, finance, construction, food and restaurants, and more.

We do not:

* Produce generic SEO content
* Use AI to write blogs
* Optimize for volume

We do:

* Create specific, technical, value-driven content
* Build real expertise through human-created work
* Develop team members into strategic partners — not just writers

**The Role: Technical Writer**

As a technical writer with a focus in SEO strategy, you will start by writing — but this is not a traditional writing role.

Writing is how you:

* Learn industries deeply
* Understand client businesses
* Develop strategic thinking

This role is designed as a structured path from execution to strategy, where content writing is the foundation, not the end goal. You will begin by writing and contributing directly to client work, learning how to research, think, and produce high-quality content that drives real SEO performance. As you develop, you will move from task-based execution to owning outcomes—understanding client goals, analyzing data, and contributing to strategy. Over time, high performers transition into leadership roles, managing projects, guiding team members, and participating in client decision-making. With a clear progression from training to independent contribution to strategic direction, this role is built to develop long-term thinkers who can grow into executive-level responsibilities within 6 months to 3 years based on performance and ownership.

**LOCATION:**
Virtual

**HOURS:**
8:30 AM EST to 5 PM EST (6 PM to 2:30 AM)

**SALARY:**
6 to 10 LPA

**Career Growth Path (Year 1):**

**Bootcamp Phase (0-1 month)**

Intensive training focused on writing, research, and core frameworks. You will learn how to produce high-quality, manual content, understand industries deeply, and build the foundation for strategic thinking. This phase is about learning how to think, not just execute.

**Core Team (1-6 months)**

Transition into a full contributor role, owning content production and taking responsibility for quality, timelines, and communication. You will begin making independent decisions, improving efficiency, and developing a deeper understanding of client goals and SEO performance.

**Lead Team (6-12+ months)**

Move into strategy and leadership, managing projects, guiding team members, and contributing to client direction. You will take ownership of outcomes, including content performance, growth, and long-term strategy, while mentoring others and helping scale operations.

The goal is to become someone clients trust to make decisions and become a leader on our team, not just write blogs.

**Core Beliefs on AI Content vs. Human Content**

No generative AI tools for writing content.

* No ChatGPT
* No Gemini or Claude
* No AI-generated drafts

*If AI can write your content, you are not adding value.*

AI-generated content leads to generic output, weak differentiation, and poor long-term performance. Our goal is to create content that AI cannot replicate, only reference.

* **AI-generated writing is not allowed -**
  We maintain a zero-tolerance policy for AI-written content. It goes against our standards, our values, and the level of quality we expect.
* **AI content does not create value -**
  AI-generated content is easy to produce, but also easy to replace. It lacks originality, depth, and true expertise—making it ineffective for long-term SEO performance and client growth.
* **Human content is what AI depends on -**
  AI systems do not create knowledge—they aggregate it. The only content that holds value is original, human-created insight that AI can reference and learn from.
* **We aim to be the source, not the output -**
  Our goal is to create content that ranks on Google and is used in AI Overviews, ChatGPT responses, and other AI systems—not content that competes with them.
* **AI usage reduces learning and expertise -**
  Relying on AI shortcuts limits your ability to think, analyze, and develop real skill. Manual work builds knowledge. AI dependence prevents it.

**What You’ll Actually Do**

* Write 1–2 high-quality blog posts daily using Perfect Clicks internal frameworks
* Translate complex information into clear, structured, user-focused content
* Conduct SEO keyword research and analysis for client sites
* Continuously refine content based on feedback and performance
* Communicate proactively with a remote team working US hours
* Contribute to long-term content strategy as you grow

**Brands, Topics, & Industries**

You will work across a wide range of brands and industries, including:

* Medical and healthcare services and procedures
* Pain management, regenerative medicine, minimally invasive surgeries
* Construction and local service industries (projects, pricing, materials)
* E-commerce and consumer products (comparisons, positioning, conversion content)
* Forex broker platforms, proprietary trading firms, and wealth management companies
* Financial markets: bonds, commodities, cryptocurrencies, stock CFDs, ETFs, indices, options
* Trading strategies, platform features, and investment analysis
* B2B SaaS platforms, software tools, and product workflows

**Benefits**

* Paid sick time
* Pain vacation time
* Paid holidays
* Flexible unpaid time off

**We are not looking for:**

* Generic SEO writers
* People who want easy, repetitive work
* Candidates who rely on AI tools

**We are looking for:**

**Quality-First Thinkers -**
You get frustrated by generic content, care about doing things properly, and notice when something is off.

**Methodical Learners**
- You ask questions before starting, want to understand why, and take time to do things right.

**High Ownership Individuals**
- You communicate proactively, do not cut corners, and take responsibility for outcomes.

**Long-Term Builders**
- You want to develop real skills, grow into strategy, and are willing to do hard things now for long-term growth.

**Who Should Not Apply**

* You prefer using AI tools for writing
* You prioritize speed over quality
* You struggle with detailed feedback
* You avoid asking questions
* You want quick, low-effort work

**Why This Role Is Different**

Most companies want more content, faster, and use AI to scale output. We are doing the opposite.

We believe the future belongs to people who think first, not people who prompt first.

**Growth and Opportunity**

* Direct mentorship and structured feedback
* Clear path from execution to strategy
* Opportunity to work closely with leadership
* Long-term role for high performers

**Remote Work**

* Fully remote
* Must be comfortable working US hours (8:30 AM – 5 PM EST / 6 PM – 2:30 AM IST)
* Strong communication is required

**Qualifications**

* Excellent English writing, grammar, and communication skills
* 3+ years of experience in content writing, journalism, or a related field
* Ability to break down complex financial or technical topics
* Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Ability to work independently and collaborate in a remote environment
* Positive, accountable, and growth-oriented mindset

**Hiring Process**

Our hiring process is designed to identify thinking ability, alignment with our philosophy, and communication and ownership.

You will go through:

1. Large Format Group Introduction Call (30 min)
2. Assessment For Values & Vision Alignment (15 min)
3. Technical Round To Evaluate Content Writing (90 min)

We are highly selective. Most candidates do not pass.

**Keywords**

SEO Content Writing, Copywriting, Communications, Digital Marketing, Content Strategist, Content Marketing, B2B SaaS Content, Blog Writing, Keyword Research, Content Strategy, Organic Growth, Technical Writing, Content Optimization, Remote Content Jobs, Content Specialist, Marketing Content Writer, Remote Writing Jobs

**How To Apply**

If you have read this entire post carefully, include the word “SEO FIRST” in your application.

Apply with intention.

* This is not an easy role, but for the right person, it is a career-defining opportunity.

title: Device Manager
description:
At Adalvo, we're not just a company - we're a team of passionate people driven by our mission to consistently deliver high-quality products and services to our partners. We are positive, fast and always on target, we are Adalvo! 🎯 🚀

We are looking for an enthusiastic
**Device Manager**
to join our dynamic Strategic Scientific Affairs team. If you're someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves tackling new challenges, then this is the perfect opportunity for you.

**SUMMARY OF POSITION**

The Device Manager will be responsible for the technical, development, regulatory, and lifecycle management activities related to Adalvo's Drug-Device Combination Products (DDCPs) and Medical Devices. This role will act as the subject matter expert for device technologies, supporting product selection, development, licensing evaluations, regulatory submissions, technology transfers, and commercial launches.

Working closely with R&D, Portfolio, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Intellectual Property, Business Development, Supply Chain, and external device partners, the Device Manager will ensure that all device-related activities are executed in compliance with global regulatory requirements while supporting Adalvo's strategic growth objectives.

**ORGANIZATION STRUCTURE**

The position will report directly to the Senior Director / Head of R&D.

Key cross-functional interfaces include:

· Formulation Development

· Regulatory Affairs

· Quality Assurance

· Portfolio Management

· Business Development

· Intellectual Property

· Supply Chain

· Project Management

· External Device Manufacturers and Technology Partners

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

Primary responsibilities of this role include the following:

**Device Strategy & Technical Leadership**

· Serve as Adalvo's technical lead for medical devices and drug-device combination products.

· Support product selection, due diligence activities, and technical evaluations of potential licensing opportunities.

· Define device development strategies aligned with regulatory, commercial, and patient requirements.

· Provide expert guidance on device selection, usability, human factors, and risk management activities.

**Device Development & Lifecycle Management**

· Lead development activities for autoinjectors, pen injectors, prefilled syringes, inhalation devices, nasal delivery systems, and other combination products.

· Prepare and review device development plans, specifications, technical documentation, and design verification reports.

· Oversee Design History Files (DHF), risk assessments, device change controls, and lifecycle management activities.

· Support troubleshooting and continuous improvement initiatives throughout the product lifecycle.

**Regulatory & Compliance**

· Ensure compliance with applicable global regulations and standards including MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, ISO 11608, ISO 11040, FDA 21 CFR, and other relevant medical device requirements.

· Support regulatory submissions, deficiency responses, variations, and lifecycle maintenance activities.

· Review technical files, design documentation, risk management files, and usability engineering documentation.

· Stay informed of emerging global device regulations and industry expectations.

**External Partner & Vendor Management**

· Identify, evaluate, qualify, and manage device manufacturers and development partners.

· Participate in technical due diligence of suppliers, development organizations, and manufacturing sites.

· Support quality audits and supplier qualification activities together with Quality teams.

· Drive collaboration and alignment across internal stakeholders and external partners.

**Technology Transfer & Commercial Launch**

· Support scale-up and technology transfer projects from development through commercialization.

· Ensure readiness of device components, assembly processes, testing methods, and packaging systems.

· Support manufacturing site implementation, validation activities, FAT/SAT reviews, and launch activities.

· Collaborate with Project Management to ensure timely execution of milestones and deliverables.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

· Work closely with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Portfolio, Business Development, and Commercial teams to deliver successful projects.

· Provide device expertise during partner meetings, customer discussions, and licensing evaluations.

· Support training and knowledge transfer related to device technologies across Adalvo.

**QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Packaging Technology, or a related scientific discipline.

• Minimum 8 years of pharmaceutical and/or medical device industry experience.

• Demonstrated experience with Drug-Device Combination Products and Medical Devices.

• Strong knowledge of device development principles, risk management, human factors engineering, and usability studies.

• Experience with prefilled syringes, pen injectors, autoinjectors, inhalation systems, or related delivery devices.

• Knowledge of MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, ISO 11608, ISO 11040 and FDA requirements.

• Experience supporting regulatory submissions and technical documentation.

• Strong project management and stakeholder management capabilities.

• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

Preferred

• Experience working with global CDMOs, device manufacturers, and technology partners.

• Experience supporting ANDA, 505(b)(2), hybrid, or complex generic product development.

• Understanding of intellectual property considerations related to device development.

• Experience with design controls, DHF preparation, usability studies, and risk assessments.

• Exposure to global markets including EU, US, LATAM, and emerging markets.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

• Business Focus

• Strategic Thinking

• Results & Operational Excellence

• Collaboration

• Quality

• Innovation & Continuous Improvement

• Change Agility

**Why join us?**

🎯
**Exciting Challenges:**
Every day brings new opportunities to learn and grow.

🎯
**Supportive Environment:**
We foster a culture of collaboration, where your ideas are valued, and your voice is heard.

🎯
**Career Development:**
We're committed to helping you reach your full potential through ongoing training and development opportunities.

🎯
**Recognizing Excellence:**
We recognize and appreciate hard work and dedication by offering competitive compensation packages and employee rewards programs that acknowledge contributions and achievements.

🎯
**Fun and Inclusive Culture:**
We believe in celebrating our successes and building strong connections within our team.

**Ready to Ignite Your Passion?**

If you're ready to take the next step in your career and join a business committed to consistently deliver high-quality products and services, then we want to hear from you! Send us your resume today!
