title: Technical Consulting Engineer
description:
This role provides assistance to customers' technical support requests by applying technical expertise to conduct advanced troubleshooting and resolve issues, handling technical problems within specific technologies and architectures such as Security and Networking across a broad range of problem complexity. At senior levels, the position manages increasingly complex and integrated solutions, operating in a highly complex technical environment that often requires deep, cross-product knowledge and systems-level thinking. The role involves collaboration with customers, partners, engineering, and internal stakeholders to drive resolution and continuous improvement, and contributes to product quality by submitting bugs, defects, and quality escalations to Engineering. Additionally, the position utilizes and enhances lab environments and digital intellectual capital to deepen expertise, support troubleshooting, and scale solutions across the team, while leveraging TAC AI capabilities, software, automation, and diagnostic tools to support quality and efficiency, and proactively identify and address issues. The role may also include mentoring peers and team members for individual and team development.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Supports premium offers and solution support
* Is a technical expert in more than one area and has clear understanding of entire solutions
* Operates independently on case resolution focusing on complex and diverse cases requiring in-depth evaluation & analysis and thinking beyond the fix to prevent future problems
* Serves an as early adopter of processes/tools and helps drive TCE specific priorities
* Impacts within workgroup, shift, site, region as well as product
* Applies expert knowledge and experience with global customer issues, trends and patterns, and the customer experience to participate in proactive engagements with Engineering
* Advises other TCEs on customer problems
* Develops and helps team develop productive relationships with customers and takes ownership for customer success
* Submits effective escalations with Engineering teams and advises peers on effective engagement with the Engineering teams
* May act as a global TAC Sponsor to review and approve formal engineering escalations (e.g., BEMS, Jira submissions)
* Proactively identifies and documents pervasive bugs and systemic issues within the technology domain
* Mentors, develops and coaches others on bug quality, submission review, and other regional best practices
* Provides escalation support, and lab setup expertise. Builds shared and reusable lab setups and provides resolutions for errors and gaps
* Interprets technical documentation, functional specs, and RFCs and applies expected product behavior across industry standards
* Leverages advanced knowledge of software skills and tools to configure, deploy and/or troubleshoot Cisco products and solutions
* Adopts and encourages adoption of AI and automation tools to improve resolution speed and accuracy, productivity, and quality
* Develops and disseminates intellectual capital (e.g., advanced diagnostics, automation workflows, and AI-assisted troubleshooting guides) that supports global reuse across internal teams, Global Delivery Partners, and customers
* Actively adopts TAC Tools essential for solving TAC SRs as well as for TAC Efficiencies (e.g. docs, training, processes) and advocates their adoption within their teams
* Frequently liaises between team and Technology Owners, Technology Group Leaders, Senior Technical Talent and TAC Technical Leaders
* Acts as a bridge between support and engineering strategy
* Guides peers in effective cross-functional engagement and actively mentors junior TCEs, contributing to their development and strengthening team performance through knowledge sharing and support

**Minimum Qualifications**
Bachelors + 7 years of related experience, or
  
  
Masters + 4 years of related experience, or
  
  
PhD + 1 year of related experience, or equivalent relevant work experience
  
  
Expert level (e.g., CCIE) or equivalent relevant certification expected
  
  
Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Senior bid Manager - Mumbai
description:

The Bid Manager will be responsible for driving best practice approaches and high quality bids in our 2000-person strong Turner & Townsend India team. Acting at both an advisory and hands-on level, the successful candidate will be an experienced bid professional with strong stakeholder management skills and a track record for delivering complex proposals in a collaborative environment. Key responsibilities include:

* Lead a best practice approach and the execution of proposals, tenders and bid responses focused on key markets in India. This includes:

  + Providing constructive feedback or escalating concerns to senior leadership and partner organisations throughout the bid and interview process

* Supporting the preparation of other deliverables related to conversion and work winning, such as interview presentation coaching and procurement team engagement.
* Reporting on pipeline and bid conversion at office and sector levels, including providing analysis and commentary on trends.
* Contribute to content libraries and best practice approaches by overseeing maintenance of content and bid libraries.
* Working alongside a team of existing bid professionals
* Support Business Development with other activities, as required

**Qualifications**

* Relevant degree in Business, Marketing, English or engineering.
* Association of Proposal Management Professional (APMP) accreditation desired, or willing to be completed
* Minimum 7 years' experience of bid management and writing successful bid submissions

* Strong skills in Microsoft office suite, including Powerpoint and Word

* Organizational skills, with the ability to priorities and meet deadlines while maintaining a high standard of quality

title: Sr. Engineer – Stack Development
description:
The Bloom Energy Mumbai team is seeking a highly motivated Engineer to support its Fuel Cell Materials Engineering development team. The Stack Engineer will be an integral part of an interdisciplinary team to improve the performance and manufacturability of current and future fuel cell stack Technologies.
  
  
Hiring a Stack engineer to support Bloom Energy servers Engineering and field failures analysis, conduct detailed root cause investigation and develop test plans to investigate the root cause.
  
  
**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Support all engineering development Fuel cell systems analysis in identifying various failure modes.
* Support investigation of Fuel cell Systems performance & failure issues during field operating conditions and develop a failure pareto.
* Support Bloom Energy future product engineering/field HB data analysis.
* Interface with testing team to timely execute stack tests and ensure all required documentation are completed.
* Analysis of test data and provide recommendations for mitigating the root causes with the team support.
* Apply statistical techniques to analyze production and/or field data to learn about product performance, reliability.
* Apply techniques like 8Ds, 5whys to investigate the root cause.
* Present clear reports to the team on the deep dive analysis.
* Develop and execute new test protocols to Turn-on/off failure modes and performance issues.
* Perform meticulous and careful post-mortem analysis of test articles to investigate the root cause and apply extensive knowledge of materials characterization techniques to gain insight into various failures modes.
* Support material characterization activities as and when required.
* Must be willing to do Hands-on data analysis and failure analysis activities.

**Key Skills Required:**

* Fundamental Knowledge on fuel cell technology, electrochemistry.
* Demonstrate good failure analysis and Root cause analysis skills.
* Strong drive for results and continuous improvement.
* Good knowledge on materials characterization techniques (SEM, EDS, XRD), and electrochemical diagnostics such as electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) preferred.
* Very strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and effectively within cross-functional teams, in a fluid and fast-paced environment.
* Knowledge of impedance analysis is additionally preferred skill.
* Knowledge on writing SQL,VB scripts and excel based macros is added advantage.
* Knowledge on writing Python scripts is advantage.

****About Swiss Re's Graduate Programme For Early-Career Talent****
We're looking for intellectually curious, motivated graduates who are passionate about engineering, technology, infrastructure and risk. If you have recently completed (in and after 2024), or are about to complete, an engineering degree (Undergrad/PostGrad) and want to build a career that combines technical expertise, analytical thinking and commercial decision-making, join Swiss Re's Graduate Programme which starts Sept 2027.
  
  
You will gain hands-on experience in the dynamic world of reinsurance, work alongside experienced underwriters and risk professionals, and receive structured training designed to accelerate your professional development. This is an opportunity to contribute to projects that help societies and businesses become more resilient while building a rewarding global career.
  
  
****About The Role****
As a Graduate Underwriting Analyst, you will develop a 360° understanding of Engineering and Specialty Reinsurance while supporting underwriting teams across markets. Working closely with underwriters, engineers, client managers, pricing specialists and risk professionals, you will analyze complex risks, support underwriting decisions and contribute to solving real business challenges from day one. The role provides exposure to construction, infrastructure, industrial, manufacturing and energy projects, including emerging sectors such as renewable energy, battery manufacturing, data centres, semiconductor facilities and hydrogen-related technologies.
  
  
Through structured learning, mentoring and practical underwriting experience, you will have developed a broad understanding of underwriting, portfolio management, claims, client engagement, and risk assessment while establishing the foundation for a specialized career within Swiss Re.

* Review and analyse engineering and construction risk submissions from a wide range of industries.
* Assess project information, engineering reports, construction methodologies, project schedules and risk mitigation measures.
* Support underwriting evaluations by analysing technical, commercial and operational risk factors.
* Review claims experience, loss trends, natural catastrophe exposures and market developments.
* Assist in preparing underwriting recommendations, pricing analysis and portfolio reviews.
* Conduct research on emerging technologies, industry trends and evolving engineering risks.
* Collaborate with underwriters, risk engineers to develop a comprehensive view of each risk.
* Participate in client discussions, broker meetings and market-facing activities to develop commercial and relationship management skills.
* Support portfolio monitoring, data analytics, process improvement and underwriting innovation initiatives.
* Explore the use of AI, automation and data-driven tools to enhance underwriting insights and decision-making.

The Business Analyst will translate Financial Crime Compliance and customer onboarding requirements into clear, actionable business and functional requirements for a CDD workflow solution. * Experience defining workflow, case management, data, controls, reporting, and audit requirements for Financial Crime or onboarding platforms.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex compliance requirements clearly to business and technology audiences.

**Job Requisition**
Description Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

The
**Analyst I, Technical Product Ownership**
plays a key role in supporting and enhancing Icertis Contract Intelligence solutions by partnering with business stakeholders to define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, manage delivery backlogs, coordinate releases, and ensure solutions align with business objectives. This role focuses on product ownership responsibilities, stakeholder engagement, requirements management, solution validation, and delivery governance across the Icertis platform and related enterprise applications.

* Execute configuration activities across templates, clauses, business rules, workflows, metadata, and related Icertis components.
* Support configuration updates and technical changes required for enhancements, fixes, deployments, and support activities.

* Support post-implementation activities such as upgrades, enhancements, issue resolution, user support, and training.

* Collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, developers, testing teams, integration teams, and support teams to deliver high-quality solutions.

**Experience**

title: Senior Application Engineer I
description:
**Job Description**
Fire Alarm System / Fire Detection Pre-Sales Technical Support
  
  
Johnson Controls helps customers create safer, smarter, and more sustainable environments through fire protection and life safety solutions. In this role, you will support fire alarm and fire detection opportunities with practical technical guidance that helps customers and sales teams move forward with confidence.
  
  
You will work within established procedures and guidelines to provide technical information, advice, and assistance regarding the organization’s products and services before and during the sales process.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
This is a pre-sales technical support role focused mainly on fire alarm systems and fire detection. You will help translate customer needs into clear technical direction, support sales conversations with accurate product knowledge, and ensure that technical input is timely, consistent, and aligned to the opportunity.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide technical information, advice, and assistance on fire alarm and fire detection products and services before and during the sales process.
* Support sales staff with product clarification, application guidance, and solution positioning for fire detection opportunities.
* Review customer requirements and help identify suitable fire detection system options within established procedures and guidelines.
* Prepare technical input that supports proposals, bids, and customer discussions.
* Assist with questions related to fire detection panels, detectors, modules, networked systems, and related fire alarm applications.
* Coordinate with sales staff only when clarification of issues is needed to keep opportunities moving forward.
* Contribute to accurate, customer-focused communication that supports safe and effective fire protection outcomes.

How You Will Do It
  
  

* Own the quality of your technical input by providing clear, accurate, and practical guidance that supports compliant fire detection solutions.
* Stay close to the work by understanding customer requirements early, identifying gaps quickly, and removing obstacles before they affect the sales process.
* Improve every day by using feedback, asking good questions, and applying structured problem-solving to refine recommendations and support.
* Win as one team by collaborating with sales staff when clarification is needed and working constructively with internal stakeholders.
* Use established procedures and guidelines to keep technical advice consistent, reliable, and easy for customers to act on.

**Qualifications**

* University degree and 1 year suggested minimum experience, or 2 year degree and 6 years suggested minimum experience, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Ability to provide accurate technical information and follow defined procedures and guidelines.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
* Working knowledge of fire alarm or fire detection systems.
* Ability to support sales activities in a professional, customer-focused manner.
* Comfort working with others to clarify issues and support the progress of opportunities.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with EN-listed fire detection systems.
* Knowledge of fire and voice alarm design installation standards such as BS5839.
* Exposure to EN54, NFPA, or UL-related fire detection applications.
* Familiarity with Johnson Controls, Tyco, or Zettler fire detection platforms.
* Knowledge of PAVA systems or BMS integration concepts such as Modbus or BACnet.

Why Join Us
  
  
At Johnson Controls, you will be part of a team that supports life safety solutions with a strong focus on customer outcomes, technical quality, and collaboration. This is a chance to build your expertise in fire detection while contributing to work that matters.
  
  
If you are ready to bring technical clarity and customer focus to fire detection pre-sales support, we would like to hear from you.

title: Senior Content & Copywriter
description:
UNIMIG is a leading brand in welding equipment, machinery, and safety gear.

We pride ourselves on delivering top-tier products backed by deep technical expertise.

We are moving away from surface-level marketing and generic content, focusing instead on real-world product demonstrations, high-converting copy, and original, human-crafted content that genuinely educates and connects with our trade and industrial audience.

Role Overview: We are looking for a highly versatile
**Senior Content & Copywriter**
who can craft compelling narratives across every touchpoint of our brand.

This is not a high-volume "AI-spinning" role where you publish dozens of generic posts a week.

We prioritise
**depth, technical accuracy, commercial value, and authentic voice**
over sheer quantity. You will own the narrative across long-form guides, website conversion copy, social campaigns, email sequences, and video scripts.

You will work side-by-side with our SEO Lead, who handles keyword strategy and data insights, and our Graphic Design/Video teams, to whom you will provide creative briefs for visual assets.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Long-Form & Educational Content

* Research and write
  **deep-dive, high-value blog posts or guides**
  on welding techniques, equipment breakdowns, industry trends, and comparisons.
* Maintain a focus on
  **commercial intent and technical accuracy**
  , ensuring every piece positions UNIMIG as an industry authority.

2. Multi-Channel Copywriting

* **Website & E-Commerce:**
  Write and optimise high-converting product pages, landing pages, category descriptions, and promotional campaign copy.
* **Social & Email:**
  Draft engaging LinkedIn posts, short-form social captions, and targeted email marketing campaigns that drive clicks and sales.
* **Video & Media Scripts:**
  Partner with our video team to develop concepts, briefs, and scripts for product demonstrations, head-to-head comparisons, and real-world field testing videos.

3. Creative Briefing & Visual Strategy

* Instead of creating images yourself, you will
  **author creative briefs**
  identifying exact visual needs, for example photo shoots, technical diagrams, and video snippets, for each piece of content.
* Collaborate with our graphic designers and videographers to move away from generic/illustrated graphics toward authentic, real-life photography and footage.

4. SEO Collaboration

* Work in close partnership with our internal
  **SEO Specialist**
  to execute keyword strategies, competitor gaps, content outlines, and performance tracking.
* Blend strict search engine best practices seamlessly with natural, engaging human storytelling, ensuring optimisation never harms readability or brand tone.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **4-6 years of professional experience**
  as a Content Writer, Copywriter, or Brand Storyteller. Prior experience in B2B, industrial, hardware, automotive, or technical sectors is highly preferred.
* **Flawless English Command:**
  Exceptional vocabulary, grammar, and a natural ability to refine brand language to drive higher conversions.
* **Human-Led Content Strategy:**
  Strong stance on research-driven writing. You know how to leverage AI tools for ideas/outlines, but your final output is 100% original, articulate, and human-written.
* **Conversion & Copywriting Mastery:**
  Deep understanding of copywriting frameworks, including PAS, AIDA, and direct response, to turn readers into customer inquiries.
* **SEO Fluency:**
  Solid understanding of search intent, on-page SEO, internal linking, and content architecture.
* **Visual Mindset:**
  Ability to picture the visual aspect of a story and translate it into clear briefs for design and video teams.
* Knowledge of regional languages (Hindi, Marathi..) is a plus.

What We Offer

* **Quality over Quantity:**
  A work environment that values 4 exceptional pieces of content over 30 superficial ones.
* **Cross-Functional Impact:**
  Work directly with marketing, SEO, product managers, and video production teams.
* **Global Exposure:**
  Contribute to a brand serving industrial and retail markets across multiple regions.

**Application Instructions (Mandatory)**

Along with your resume, please submit a
**link to your portfolio or work samples**
.

Your portfolio must include examples of:

* Long-form written content, including blogs, white-papers, or technical guides.
* Website copy or promotional marketing campaigns.
* Video scripts, creative briefs, or social media content, if available.

***Applications without a portfolio or writing samples will not be considered.***

title: Electronic Systems Controls Technical Specialist
description:
**Job Summary**
This controls focused position tailors electronic control systems for Cummins products. People in these positions will decompose product requirements into functional requirements and design and tune controls that operate on Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications. Additionally, there is responsibility to configure (tune), and complete comprehensive validation testing of the fully integrated hardware and software systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Contributes to the development of electronic controls (open and closed loop)and diagnostics for a variety of applications (internal combustion engine, power systems, powertrain, etc). Owns investigation, problem resolution, and documentation for these systems with guidance from more experienced team members. Uses strong knowledge of application of controls and first principles to guide decision making.
  
  
Works and improves electronic controls development processes and tools. Processes include system specification, modeling and simulation, calibration, Design Verification Plan and Report (DVP&R), and troubleshooting. Application of tools for simulation, calibration, and product life maintenance required.
  
  
Contributes to negotiations, translates and decomposes requirements and voices from customers into functional requirements for controls algorithms, designs algorithms to meet these requirements, tunes these algorithms, and designs tests to validate performance against these requirements.
  
  
Contributes to decisions in the areas of electronic and electrical controls and diagnostic design, requirements, calibration, and test that impact the quality and performance of individual calibrated features and/or components by using systems knowledge and understanding of product (internal combustion engine, power systems, powertrain, etc). Responsible for review of less-experienced controls engineers' work to ensure robust, reusable, and efficient design.
  
  
Contributes independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team.
  
  
Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Responsible for interacting and collaborating with cross functional teams.
  
  
Contributes as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.
  
  
Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site.
  
  
Competencies:Design and Application of Mechatronics Systems - Specifies electronic hardware and interconnections that measure and control systems; applies electronic hardware and interconnections in Cummins' products.
  
  
Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.
  
  
Machine Integration and Optimization - Combines various parts or sub-systems into a whole to achieve the output most desired by the customer; applies Cummins' installation requirements using our standard tools, processes and identified best practices to ensure optimization of performance, reliability, cost and quality; analyzes technical issues using proven problem-solving and troubleshooting techniques for rapid resolution.
  
  
Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.
  
  
Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.
  
  
Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.
  
  
Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
  
  
System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  
  
Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.
  
  
Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
  
  
Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
  
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  
  
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
Manages ambiguity - Operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
Education, Licenses, Certifications:College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is
  
  
required.
  
  
Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
Experience:Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required
  
  
with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making.
  
  
Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred.
  
  
**Cybersecurity**

* Knowledge . cybersecurity regulations and standards applicable to embedded control systems
* Ability to derive, analyse, and manage cybersecurity requirements for controllers, HMIs, communication interfaces, and connected tools.
* Experience conducting threat analysis, risk assessments, cybersecurity gap analysis, and mitigation planning for embedded control systems.
* Skilled in product and process documentation to demonstrate compliance to cybersecurity norms.
* Understanding of cybersecurity concepts for embedded systems products, test plan creation and system level validation.
* Understanding of controller, HMI, engine ECM, telematics, and plant/network communication architectures , boundary diagrams and interfaces from a cybersecurity perspective.
* Ability to define cybersecurity work products, support audits/evaluations, and ensure compliance throughout the product lifecycle.
* Maintain SDLC for product - ensuring compliance to process, validation and release ( CRA, UL). Secure Product Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) and Regulatory Compliance.

**System Engineering Skills**

* Skilled in genset controllers system
* Electronics and Electrical power systems knowledge
* Electronic System - Harness, Sensor, Actuator, Switch gears, breakers, charging alternator
* Electronic Control Architecture - \*\*microprocessor, \*HW, SW, Service tool, HMI
* 3 phase power supply, synchronization, alternator.
* Genset Domain Knowledge - PLC, Paralleling,3rd Party Interfacing
* Feedback Control Loops/Theory (PG Programs)- AVR, Voltage Regulation, Speed Governing
* System engineering process flows and tools
* Requirement gathering
* System design and documentation (specifically in genset controls system)
* DFMEA
* PSHA (Product Safety & Hazard Analysis) and Product risk assessment
* 7 step problem solving tool
* Test plan creation and test execution (On Genset/Matlab based simulation system-HIL/MIL)
* Embedded C code understanding skill
* Hardware schematics readability
* Datalink domain Knowledge ISO 7-layer, \*Modbus, CAN, \*Ethernet, Basic knowledge of Network Topology
* Understanding of Fault Diagnostics
* Product development lifecycle- in general knowledge
* High level idea of Software calibration
* Six Sigma Tools and Methodology - RACI, SOW, PUGH Matrix, DOE

title: Senior Training Lead, Support Enablement
description:
**Organization Overview**
**Company Description**
QAD is building a world-class SaaS company, and we are growing. We are looking for talented individuals who want to join us on our mission to help solve relevant real-world problems in manufacturing and the supply chain.
  
  
***Note: The role is open for candidates based only in Mumbai/Pune and who are open to work from office 3 days a week.***
**Job Description**
**The Senior Training Lead**
plays a key role in strengthening the capabilities of QAD’s global Support organization by delivering structured, impactful training programs. The primary objective of this role is to equip Support team members—both new and experienced—with the product knowledge, tools proficiency, process clarity, and soft skills necessary to provide world-class support to our customers.
  
  
The role encompasses end-to-end responsibility for training across four focus areas: New Hire Onboarding, Continuing Education, New Product & Process Training, and Soft Skills & Tools Enablement. It requires close collaboration with Support leadership, Product Management, and subject matter experts to ensure training is aligned with business priorities and reflects the evolving needs of a dynamic SaaS environment.
  
  
With a global scope, the Senior Training Lead, Support Enablement must tailor training approaches to different audiences while maintaining consistency in content and outcomes. The role also involves evaluating training effectiveness and continuously improving content based on feedback, performance trends, and product updates. This position is pivotal to driving a culture of continuous learning and ensuring our support teams are fully prepared to meet customer expectations as we scale.
  
  
They essentially own training for QAD’s global Support organization. You will find out where our Support teams struggle, using queue feedback, manager input and ticket data, and build the programs, content and self-service resources that close those gaps. You will run new hire onboarding, continuing education, and training on new products and processes, and you will report on training effectiveness to Support leadership. You will work closely with Support managers, Tier 3, R&D and Product Management.
  
  
This is a build-the-function role: over time you will launch a Support Training Website and a Support Certification Program.
  
  

* Training Delivery:
* Conduct engaging and effective training sessions on QAD products, tools, and processes in both virtual and in-person formats.
* Tailor delivery approaches based on audience experience and learning style.
* Content Development:
* Design and develop self-paced, digital learning content using modern instructional design principles.
* Incorporate AI tools and innovative learning methods to enhance engagement and knowledge retention.
* LMS Administration:
* Manage the Learning Management System (LMS): assign courses, monitor completion, conduct knowledge checks, and generate training reports.
* Ensure seamless user experience and data accuracy within the LMS.
* Stakeholder Collaboration:
* Partner with internal teams such as R&D, Tier 3 Support, and Product Management to facilitate knowledge transfer sessions.
* Act as the liaison between subject matter experts and the support team for effective training content.
* Training Governance & Communication:
* Maintain and regularly update the Support Training Portal with the latest learning content, product updates, tools, and process changes.
* Provide feedback and progress reports on new hires; identify and escalate any performance or engagement concerns.
* Industry Awareness & Agility:
* Stay current with trends and developments in the tech and learning industries.
* Embrace new learning technologies and methodologies, including AI-driven tools.
* Project Management (Preferred):
* Lead or participate in training-related projects and initiatives.
* If lacking prior experience, demonstrate willingness to learn and manage projects within the training domain.
* Shift Flexibility and flexibility:
* Support a global audience by delivering training during EMEA and AMS-friendly hours as needed.
* Participate in shift rotations, weekend shifts, and on-call coverage to provide uninterrupted global support.
* Fulfill additional responsibilities as needed to support organizational goals and priorities, ensuring alignment with the overall mission of delivering high-quality support.

**Qualifications**
**Education:**
A Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Equivalent experience will be considered.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**

* 5 years of relevant experience in supporting enterprise products, demonstrating expertise in resolving complex technical issues, and delivering exceptional customer-focused solutions.
* Excellent people skills with the ability to work in a global team environment
* One year of prior working experience with QAD Applications preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in training delivery and instructional design, preferably in a technical support or enterprise software environment.
* Strong familiarity with LMS platforms (e.g., Workday Learning, Moodle, etc.).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to collaborate across functions and levels.
* Proficiency in using content creation tools (Articulate, Camtasia, Canva, etc.) and AI-based training enhancers is a plus.
* Project management experience or certification (e.g., PMP, Agile) is an advantage.

**Preferred Traits**

* Self-motivated and proactive
* Adaptable and open to feedback
* Passionate about continuous learning
* Culturally aware and inclusive in a global work environment
* Strong soft skills, business communication skills, and the ability to coach and develop these skills in others.
* Embraces new learning technologies, tools, and approaches (including AI-driven learning solutions)

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality service.

**Additional Information**

title: Hardware Functional Safety (FuSa) Specialist
description:
**Enabling a software-defined, electrified future.**
Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe. To know more about us click here .
  
  
**Mission of the Role**
**:**
The Functional Safety Specialist is responsible for ensuring that automotive electronic systems comply with ISO 26262 and related safety standards. The role involves safety concept creation, hazard analysis, safety requirements engineering, technical safety architecture, verification planning, and supporting hardware/software teams through the full safety lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Functional Safety Lifecycle Management
* Lead and execute activities across the ISO 26262 V-model safety lifecycle, from concept phase to SOP.
* Develop and maintain the Functional Safety Plan, timelines, and work products.
* Ensure processes are followed and all safety artifacts are created and reviewed.
* Safety Analysis & Concept Development
* Perform Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) and derive ASIL levels.
* Develop Functional Safety Concept (FSC) and Technical Safety Concept (TSC).
* Define safety goals, safety mechanisms, and safety requirements (FSR/TSR).
* Requirements Engineering
* Write, review, and maintain functional and technical safety requirements.
* Ensure bi-directional traceability between requirements, design, implementation, and validation.
* Support system, hardware, and software teams to interpret and implement safety requirements.
* Hardware & Software Safety
* Collaborate with hardware architects to define safety mechanisms for MCU, PMIC, watchdog, self-tests, power domains, fault handling, etc.
* Support software teams in designing safety-compliant drivers, boot, diagnostics, and monitoring logic.
* Review MCU safety manuals, safety architecture, and vendor documentation (e.g., Infineon Traveo II, NXP, Renesas).
* Safety Analysis & Verification
* Conduct and review FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA, Dependent Failure Analysis.
* Calculate FIT rates, single-point fault metrics, and latent fault metrics.
* Create safety validation plans and support unit/integration/system-level testing.
* Audits, Assessments & Compliance
* Prepare safety case documentation for customer and auditor reviews.
* Work with internal/external assessors (TÜV, Exida, OEM auditors).
* Support ASPICE, cybersecurity (ISO 21434), and quality-compliance alignment.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Provide training and guidance to development teams on ISO 26262 processes.
* Work directly with system architects, hardware designers, software teams, testing, quality, cybersecurity, and program management.
* Participate in design reviews and ensure safety considerations are incorporated early.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**
**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of ISO 26262 Part 2–12 and full safety lifecycle.
* Expertise in safety analyses: FMEA, FTA, FMEDA, DFA.
* Understanding of safety architecture for MCUs, SoCs, and automotive ECUs.
* Experience with safety mechanisms: lockstep CPUs, watchdogs, ECC, BIST/MBIST, CRC, voltage monitoring, clock monitoring, safe states, etc.
* Experience with requirements management tools: DOORS, Polarion, Jama, etc.
* Working knowledge of embedded systems, microcontrollers, hardware design, and automotive software development.

**Domain Knowledge**

* Automotive electronics: clusters, body control, powertrain, ADAS, infotainment, or battery systems.
* Exposure to ASPICE, ISO 21434 (Cybersecurity), and OEM-specific safety processes.
* Experience
* 5–15 years of experience in automotive embedded systems.
* Minimum 5+ years in Functional Safety roles.
* Experience delivering at least one safety-critical product to SOP.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Certified Functional Safety Engineer/Professional (TÜV, Exida).
* Experience with safety implementation on MCUs like Infineon Traveo II, NXP S32, Renesas R-Car, TI Hercules.
* Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Embedded Systems, or related engineering field.
* Experience with model-based development (MATLAB/Simulink).

**Visteon Culture:**
If you thrive in a fast-paced, organizational culture that requires agility, adaptability, and a growth mindset from its employees to thrive and stay ahead of the curve Visteon is the place. We value high performance and a drive for results. Innovation, risk-taking, and continuous learning help us keep up with the ever-changing landscape of our industry and be Market leaders. At Visteon you can be more.

title: CSV & Software Validation Lead / Specialist
description:
**Designation: CSV & Software Validation Lead / Specialist**

**Preferred Experience: 3+ Years**

**Job Summary**

Aventior is seeking a CSV & Software Validation Specialist with experience in the biopharmaceutical, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences industry. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of regulatory compliance, quality management, computerized system validation (CSV), and software testing within regulated environments.

The role involves ensuring that software applications and computerized systems meet applicable regulatory requirements, quality standards, and business specifications. The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing test cases, validating system functionality, documenting test results, managing defects, and supporting compliance activities in accordance with GxP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, and other relevant regulatory frameworks.

The candidate will collaborate with Quality Assurance, Software Development, Clinical Operations, IT, and Regulatory Affairs teams to ensure software quality, data integrity, and regulatory compliance throughout the software development and validation lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Ensure adherence to applicable GxP requirements, including GMP, GCP, and GLP, based on project and system requirements.
* Support compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU and UK regulations for electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, and access controls.
* Apply GAMP 5 principles and risk-based approaches to computerized system validation and software testing.
* Review and maintain SOPs, work instructions, validation documents, and quality records.
* Support compliance assessments, internal and external audits, client audits, and regulatory inspection readiness.
* Assist with deviation management, CAPA, change control, risk assessments, and compliance remediation activities.
* Support data integrity, security, traceability, and documentation requirements for regulated systems.

**2. Software Testing & Quality Engineering**

* Review business requirements, functional specifications, and technical documentation to identify test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Prepare and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, and test scenarios for software applications used in biopharma and life sciences.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT), as applicable.
* Validate application workflows, data processing, user permissions, audit trails, electronic signatures, and system interfaces.
* Identify, document, track, and retest software defects in collaboration with development and QA teams.
* Maintain requirements traceability matrices (RTMs) to establish traceability between requirements, risks, test cases, and test results.
* Ensure testing activities are documented, reproducible, and aligned with approved procedures and validation protocols.
* Support test execution, defect triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution verification.
* Participate in release testing, regression testing, and post-implementation verification.

**3. Computerized System Validation (CSV)**

* Support validation activities for GxP-regulated software applications and computerized systems.
* Prepare and maintain validation lifecycle documentation, including User Requirements Specifications (URS), risk assessments, validation plans, and test protocols.
* Execute or support Installation Qualification (IQ), Operational Qualification (OQ), and Performance Qualification (PQ), where applicable.
* Assist with validation of new systems, system upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, and software releases.
* Ensure validation evidence is complete, accurate, approved, and audit-ready.
* Support periodic reviews, change impact assessments, and revalidation activities based on risk and regulatory requirements.
* Apply risk-based validation principles in accordance with GAMP 5 and organizational quality procedures.

**4. Biopharma & Life Sciences Application Testing**

* Test and validate applications supporting clinical trials, clinical data management, pharmaceutical quality processes, laboratory operations, and regulatory workflows.
* Understand regulated-system requirements relating to patient data, clinical trial records, laboratory data, and electronic documentation.
* Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, access controls, audit trails, and system-generated records.
* Support testing of integrations between clinical, laboratory, quality management, and other enterprise applications.
* Help ensure that software changes do not compromise patient safety, product quality, data integrity, or regulatory compliance.
* Support HIPAA-related privacy and security requirements when applications handle protected health information (PHI).

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Computer Science, Information Technology, Quality Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in compliance, software testing, quality assurance, or computerized system validation within pharmaceutical, biotechnology, clinical research, or life sciences environments.
* Strong understanding of GxP regulations, including GMP, GCP, and GLP.
* Working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GAMP 5, EU and UK regulations, and electronic records and electronic signature requirements.
* Hands-on experience in manual software testing, test case preparation, test execution, defect tracking, and regression testing.
* Hands on experience with QMS platforms like ServiceNow, Veeva, Master Control a huge plus.
* Experience preparing or executing validation protocols and maintaining validation documentation, including URS, IQ, OQ, PQ, and RTMs, as applicable.
* Knowledge of SDLC, STLC, requirements traceability, risk-based testing, and change management.
* Experience with CAPA, deviation management, change control, and audit documentation.
* Understanding of data integrity, audit trails, access controls, and security requirements in regulated systems.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple testing and compliance activities.

**Company Overview:**

**Aventior**

is a leading provider of innovative, end-to-end technology solutions, empowering businesses across diverse industries to solve complex challenges and accelerate growth. We harness the power of cutting-edge technologies such as
**artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), MLOps, and DevOps**

to build scalable, future-ready solutions that drive measurable business outcomes for the life science industry.

Our expertise extends across the entire data lifecycle. We offer comprehensive data development and management services, including
**cloud data architecture, universal data models, Data Transformation & ETL, data lakes, user management, Analytics & visualization,**

and
**automated data capture**

for unstructured and semi-structured sources such as scanned documents. These capabilities enable organizations to unlock the full value of their data and make faster, more informed decisions.

At Aventior, our strength lies in combining
**deep industry expertise**

with
**advanced technical capabilities**

. Our teams work closely with clients to design and deliver tailored solutions that align with their unique business needs—whether it’s optimizing operations, enhancing customer experiences, or driving strategic decision-making.

We bring a
**holistic, cross-industry perspective**

to every engagement, supported by a strong foundation in
**design, implementation, innovation, migration, and ongoing support**

. With a
**global delivery model**

, a
**multi-country presence**

, and a team of highly skilled professionals, Aventior is well-positioned to deliver consistent, high-quality outcomes at scale.

title: Sr Associate, Cyb Sec IT RiskM
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
This role provides specialized technology risk advisory support across key IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, including Incident, Change, and Problem Management. The individual acts as a trusted risk partner to ITSM process owners by assessing control design and operating effectiveness, identifying control gaps, and advising on risk treatment strategies aligned to Technology Risk standards.
  
  
The role combines control assessment execution, risk analysis, and stakeholder advisory, with a strong focus on practical risk mitigation, consistency in documentation, and readiness for internal audits, RCSA exercises, and regulatory reviews.
  
  
**Role And Responsibilities**
ITSM Control Assessment Execution
  
  
Plan and execute ITSM control assessments within an assigned scope of Incident, Change, and Problem Management processes. Perform assessments in alignment with established policies, standards, and control testing methodologies, under the guidance of senior leadership.
  
  
Control Design and Operating Effectiveness Evaluation
  
  
Evaluate The Design And Operational Effectiveness Of ITSM Controls To Identify Gaps, Execution Weaknesses, And Process Deviations. Clearly Articulate Root Causes, Control Impacts, And Associated Technology Risk Implications. Validate That Controls Are
  
  
Appropriately defined and documented
  
  
Consistently executed by process owners
  
  
Supported by complete, accurate, and reliable evidence.
  
  
Risk Advisory and Issue Support
  
  
Provide risk-based advisory guidance to control and process owners on identified control weaknesses. Support the documentation, classification, and escalation of issues arising from assessments. Advise on appropriate risk treatment options—including remediation, risk acceptance, or escalation—in accordance with Technology Risk and IT Risk Management standards.
  
  
Assessment Documentation and Tooling
  
  
Ensure assessment results, evidence, and supporting artifacts are accurately documented and maintained in ServiceNow / Integrated Risk Management (IRM) tools. Adhere to documentation standards to support transparency, auditability, and reuse for future assessments.
  
  
Stakeholder Engagement and Communication
  
  
Engage with ITSM process owners, technology teams, and risk stakeholders to explain assessment results, control gaps, and risk impacts in a clear and practical manner. Contribute to working sessions, governance forums, and RCSA readiness discussions by providing timely updates and insights relevant to ITSM risk posture.
  
  
Trend Analysis and Continuous Improvement
  
  
Identify recurring issues, themes, and systemic control weaknesses across assessments. Provide recommendations to enhance control design, process execution, and testing approaches. Contribute to continuous improvement of ITSM control frameworks and readiness for audits and regulatory reviews.
  
  
Standards and Industry Awareness
  
  
Maintaining working knowledge of ITSM, control, and technology risk best practices, including relevant industry standards. Apply this knowledge to assessments and advisory discussions to ensure alignment with evolving expectations.
  
  
**Knowledge And Experience**
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related discipline, with typically 5–7 years of experience in technology risk, controls, ITSM, or security-related roles
  
  
Strong practical knowledge of ITSM processes and control environments, with the ability to assess risk and control effectiveness.
  
  
Demonstrated analytical skills, sound judgment, and the ability to communicate complex risk concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  
  
Experience working collaboratively with IT teams, risk partners, auditors, and vendors.
  
  
Preferred certifications: ITIL Foundation, CISA, CISSP, or CRISC.
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

* Respond to incidents, service requests, and production support tickets within established service level expectations.
* Maintain integration documentation, support procedures, and operational runbooks.

**Integration Development**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and maintain new Workday integrations.
* Develop scalable and secure integration solutions using Workday-native technologies and external APIs.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
* Perform impact assessments and recommend integration architecture improvements.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience.

* Cloud Connect
* Core Connectors
* Workday APIs
* REST and SOAP web services
* Reports-as-a-Service (RaaS)
* Workday reporting and calculated fields

* Collaborate with internal and external partners to troubleshoot data exchange issues.
* Strong understanding of XML, XSLT, JSON, web services, and API integrations.
* Demonstrated experience supporting Workday’s semi-annual release process, including release review, impact assessment, regression testing, and remediation of integration-related issues.
* Hands-on experience using Jira, ServiceNow or similar enterprise platforms.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Workday Certification or Workday Pro Certification.
* Experience developing and deploying Workday Extend applications.
* Experience with Dashboard and Discovery boards.
* Experience with middleware platforms and enterprise integration patterns.
* Familiarity with security frameworks, data governance, and compliance requirements.

**Team Structure**
This role will be part of the Syneos Technology Solutions (STS) team and will work closely with a small group of Workday team, HR stakeholders, application support teams, and external vendors to deliver reliable and innovative integration solutions across the enterprise.
  
  
**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

title: Implementation Specialist - II
description:
Job Summary:

We are looking for an Implementation Specialist - II to join our Professional Services team based in Pune, Maharashtra. You will be part of a team of engineers and implementation specialists who build customized solutions for Helpshift's Enterprise clients, driving strategic revenue enablement by ensuring that our SaaS platform is seamlessly aligned with clients' tech stack, workflows, and core Support and Engagement objectives.

You will be responsible for providing technical guidance, reviewing solution setups, and supporting client implementations. You will own platform setups, workflow automations, and custom software integrations at different stages of onboarding, ensuring projects are delivered smoothly within expected timelines.

Responsibilities:

* **Ownership:**
  Fully own assigned custom development initiatives, ensuring that designs are aligned with Solutions Architects' proposals, that capacity and timeline are aligned with client expectations, and that final solutions are fully documented
* **Enterprise Deal Acceleration:**
  Accelerate enterprise sales cycles through rapid technical prototyping and proof-of-concept solutions that demonstrate platform capabilities for high-value prospects
* **Delivery Certification & Risk Mitigation:**
  Analyze architectures to audit configurations, schemas, and API payloads before go-live, mitigating risks and certifying solutions to meet gold standards
* **Agile Delivery & Jira Operations:**
  Work in Agile/Scrum sprints, tracking time and deliverables in Jira for billable SOW accounting and capacity planning
* **Platform Configuration:**
  Configure Helpshift's native features, including AI capabilities, automation bots, and core messaging flows
* **Own End-to-End Onboarding:**
  Manage simultaneous technical implementation projects from initial kick-off through go-live and handoff to Customer Success
* **SDK & Platform Configuration:**
  Guide client engineering and product teams on integrating the Helpshift SDK (iOS, Android, Unity, Web) into their games, ensuring that all relevant Helpshift features and capabilities are fully utilized
* **Workflow & Automation Setup:**
  Configure intelligent bot automation, issue assignment rules, smart routing, custom forms, and FAQ knowledge bases tailored to client support workflows
* **Integrations & Data Mapping:**
  Assist in setting up integrations with clients' tool stacks and mapping customer data payloads
* **Issue Resolution:**
  Diagnose and troubleshoot complex technical issues during setup, testing, and go-live, coordinating directly with Helpshift Product & Engineering teams when needed
* **R&D Product Feedback Loop:**
  Formalize the R&D product feedback loop by capturing field insights and feature gaps from enterprise implementations to directly inform product roadmap prioritization
* **API Presentations:**
  Showcase Helpshift API capabilities through live demonstrations, recorded videos and presentations
* **Client Collaboration:**
  Working with the wider Helpshift client-facing team to communicate effectively with clients to translate business requirements into viable product solutions, ensuring alignment with customer needs and product capabilities
* **Analytics & Reporting:**
  Create datasets and reports on BI tools including Power BI, tableau, looker and Sigma
* **Mentorship:**
  Mentor & train junior engineers
* **Custom Deployment Support:**
  Support the deployment and maintenance of client-facing custom solution components hosted on modern cloud infrastructure

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  Minimum of 5 years' SaaS implementation specialist experience, building custom solutions for Enterprise clients
* **Technical Leadership:**
  Experience of leading teams through complex project implementations
* **Code Comprehension & Scripting:**
  Strong ability to read, comprehend, and debug code in languages such as Python and JavaScript/Node.js to inspect client implementations and troubleshoot integration logic
* **Architecture & DevOps Concepts:**
  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, SDKs, containerization (e.g., Docker), and basic Infrastructure-as-Code concepts (e.g., Terraform) for supporting custom deployments
* **Automation Tools:**
  Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code automation platforms like n8n, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, or Zapier to build efficient integration workflows
* **Organization:**
  Exceptional organizational skills and efficiency in task management
* **Communication:**
  Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with stakeholders across multiple disciplines

**Benefits**

* Hybrid setup
* Worker's insurance
* Paid Time Offs
* Other employee benefits to be discussed by our Talent Acquisition team in India

Helpshift embraces diversity. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and do not discriminate on the basis of sex, race, color, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, citizenship, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

By providing your information in this application, you understand that we will collect and process your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information, please see our Applicant Privacy Notice at https://www.keywordsstudios.com/en/applicant-privacy-notice.

title: Associate Applications Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Our clients need their systems to be reliable, secure, and available. As an Applications Engineer, you will help ensure that their applications and hosting environments run smoothly.
  
  
You will act as a bridge between our clients, technology, and engineering teams. You will understand client requirements, configure and deploy applications, troubleshoot technical issues, and support production environments.
  
  
This role is not limited to application support. It requires a combination of application support, troubleshooting, deployment, infrastructure knowledge, database skills, and basic coding/scripting knowledge. You will work with different technical teams to identify problems, implement solutions, automate repetitive tasks, and continuously improve application reliability.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Application Setup and Deployment**

* Install, configure, and deploy applications on servers and application services.
* Support application releases, code deployments, and environment setup.
* Handle client requests such as certificate installations, new sites, site updates, overwrites, and vanity URLs.
* Perform functional and integration testing before releases.
* Support application configuration and environment-related changes.

**Troubleshooting and Production Support**

* Investigate and resolve application errors, access issues, and performance problems.
* Analyze application and server logs to identify root causes.
* Monitor applications and servers and respond to production incidents.
* Troubleshoot issues across application, server, database, and network layers.
* Help maintain application availability, performance, and security.
* Follow change management procedures for installations, upgrades, and maintenance activities.

**Client and Team Collaboration**

* Act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal teams regarding hosting and application requests.
* Understand client requirements and communicate technical solutions clearly.
* Manage and prioritize cases in the hosting queue.
* Assign, update, and follow up on cases while keeping clients and hosting partners informed.
* Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) when handling support cases.
* Review case backlogs and ensure timely updates and resolution.
* Manage shared mailboxes and communication with hosting partners.

**Technical Skills, Coding, And Automation**

* Work with APIs, databases, and other systems integrated with application.
* Use basic coding or scripting skills to troubleshoot issues and automate repetitive tasks.
* Write or modify simple scripts using technologies such as PowerShell, SQL, or other scripting languages.
* Develop automation where possible to improve application reliability and reduce manual effort.
* Understand application configuration, web applications, and basic software development concepts.

**Documentation and Continuous Improvement**

* Create and maintain SOPs, process documentation, and technical notes for client environments.
* Identify recurring issues and suggest improvements to processes and applications.
* Learn and support Momentive's association management products.
* Work closely with developers, DevOps, infrastructure, QA, and business teams.
* Participate in the rotational on-call support schedule.

**What You Bring**

* 1+ years of experience in application support, application implementation, or a similar technical role.
* Good understanding of application troubleshooting and production support.
* Working knowledge of Windows Server, IIS, Remote Desktop, and Domain Controllers.
* Experience with monitoring tools such as Nagios, CloudWatch, or Pingdom.
* Basic understanding of backups and recovery processes.
* Basic SQL Server knowledge, including writing and understanding simple SQL queries.
* Basic coding or scripting knowledge and the ability to understand or modify scripts.
* Experience with cloud-hosted applications or cloud environments.
* Experience using ticketing or IT service management systems.
* Knowledge of troubleshooting client environments, applications, servers, and networks.
* Experience supporting clients through phone, email, or ticketing systems.
* Understanding of change management and controlled deployment processes.
* Ability to analyze logs and troubleshoot technical issues systematically.
* Good communication and problem-solving skills.
* Engineering degree, MCA, MCM, or equivalent technical qualification.

**Nice to Have**

* AWS, Azure, or Microsoft certifications.
* PowerShell scripting experience.
* Knowledge of ITIL or Microsoft Operations Framework.
* Experience with change management tools.
* Experience monitoring and maintaining distributed applications or systems.
* Knowledge of security best practices and client data protection.
* Experience setting up websites and web applications.
* Basic understanding of firewalls, networking, DNS, and certificates.
* Experience working with APIs and application integrations.

**How You Work**
You build strong relationships with clients and colleagues and can work effectively both independently and as part of a team. You take ownership of issues, communicate clearly, and focus on delivering reliable solutions.
