title: Senior Instructional Designer
description:
**Our Company:**

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.

**Senior Instructional Designer / eLearning Developer**

Are you passionate about learning and development? Do you want to work in a high impact, collaborative, and innovative role? Teradata Technical Enablement is looking for an experienced Instructional Designer and eLearning Developer who wants to be a part of building exciting new Teradata Vantage technical courses (VILT and WBT) and microlearning videos on our Cloud and Vantage products. This team supports the learning and enablement of Teradata associates, customers, and partners across the enterprise - globally.

As a Senior Instructional Designer and eLearning Developer on our Technical Enablement team you will research, recommend, and produce a variety of complex, media rich, and highly interactive courses to up-level the knowledge and skills for our Go-to-Market teams, customers, and Partners. This key role will focus on leading and assisting the design, development and delivery of learning programs and enablement resources using a variety of formats including eLearning, virtual instructor-led, and blended learning methods. In this role you will collaborate with technical instructors on our team as well as a variety of other teams within Teradata (including Teradata User Experience, Customer Success, Partners, Consulting Services, Product Management, Marketing, Technical Sales, Solution Engineering, and more) to gather requirements and lead projects through the planning, design, implementation and evaluation lifecycle.

Teradata provides the leading cloud data analytics platform that enables companies to unlock continuous unlimited value from their data, and Teradata’s teams, customers and partners need training, and not just a couple of PowerPoint slides and a long lecture. Our Technical Enablement team, which you would be an instrumental member of, is developing highly technical end user and admin virtual instructor-led courses with extensive hands-on labs and interactive games. Our team also produces on-demand e-learning courses and microlearning videos that can be accessed 24x7 and self-paced labs that allow our associates deep into our technologies. You'll get to educate and play at the same time!

The successful candidate is a confident, articulate professional with a healthy technical knowledge of IT domains and the ability to translate technical content into easy-to-understand training. You have proven training, instructional design or technical documentation experience. You are experienced in designing and developing innovative learning solutions utilizing a variety of methods and tools. You use creative, engaging new approaches based on brain science, adult learning theories, and the latest educational technologies and trends. You have experience gathering requirements and assessing design needs to craft effective and efficient plans for performance solutions and services that address business-specific requirements and constraints. Above all, you will have a passion for learning.

**Responsibilities**

* Designs, develops and delivers technical learning using multiple technologies and modalities such as self-paced eLearning courses and microlearning, ILT/VILT classroom sessions, blended learning and performance support materials for customers, partners, and technical and consulting audiences
* Coordinates and manages the full training cycle as needed including requirements gathering, design/development meeting product release deadlines, in-person delivery and web-based learning, evaluation and metrics reporting
* Works with subject matter experts (SMEs) to produce content that is highly engaging and effective at empowering learner to immediately execute and apply knowledge
* Experiments with new approaches to learning which scale and drive engagement
* Creates training outlines, design plans, storyboards, and authors e-learning content and blended solutions
* Transforms ILT and VILT content into interactive WBTs, with engaging activities, microlearning videos, quizzes, animations, games, job aids, lab guides, etc.
* Provides expert consultation on learning techniques, instructional design theory and digital technology solutions for eLearning and classroom/virtual classroom

**Minimum Qualifications**

Candidate must have 5-8+ years of experience as an Instructional Designer / eLearning Developer, preferably for technical or product release enablement. The candidate must have demonstrated experience with multiple types of learning solutions (including, but not limited to e-learning courses, mobile learning, simulations, microlearning, ILT and VILT programs, and blended learning/flipped classroom). The candidate must also have experience creating learning solutions for technical audiences (e.g., data scientists, citizen data scientists, business analysts, data engineers, database administrators, cloud administrators, devops, consulting services, customer success managers, solution engineers, or technical sales).

* Degree in Educational Technology, Instructional Design, or similar field preferred
* In-depth knowledge and proficiency with course authoring tools including Articulate Storyline and Rise, Adobe Captivate, TechSmith Camtasia, and office tools such as PowerPoint, Excel and Word.
* In-depth knowledge and proficiency creating microlearning videos
* Challenge existing models and processes to design innovative learning that can be used just-in-time and provide on-the-job performance support
* Comfortable working in an environment that is constantly evolving
* Team player with superior people skills and a positive attitude
* Proven self-starter with ability to juggle priorities and manage expectations
* Robust communication skills (verbal, written) including ability to present, facilitate, and influence
* Strong critical thinker with ability to ramp-up quickly on new products, applications and systems
* Independent problem solver who will take initiative and execute work
* Must be deadline driven, organized and able to multi-task

These skills are a plus:

* Domain expertise in one or more of the following: Infrastructure, Networking, Database, Systems Administration, Cloud Technology
* Coding in SQL language
* HTML programming and other related programming skills to create learning websites and tools
* Authoring technical documentation
* Creating SharePoint sites
* Designing and/or building microlearning libraries
* Creating learning content in Saba learning management system
* Generating Excel learning metrics reports
* Scheduling of session offerings to global audiences
* Experience with graphic development tools such as Adobe Photoshop
* Experience with Microsoft Teams, Trello, Kanban, Jira, MS project or other project management tools

title: Product Manager - Technical II
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Product Manager - Technical II
  
  
**Overview**
The Mastercard Transaction Stream team is involved in delivering next-generation Core Payment capabilities for Mastercard. These solutions are built using modern digital architecture, cloud-native principles, event-driven technologies, and a Scaled Agile delivery framework.
  
  
As a Product Manager - Technical II within the Transaction Stream team, you will bring strong payments domain and technical expertise to translate business requirements and customer experiences into well-defined product capabilities and measurable outcomes. You will play a key role in ensuring that Transaction Stream capabilities work effectively across integrated payment ecosystems by analysing transaction flows, defining validation approaches, assessing end-to-end behaviour, and supporting product readiness.
  
  
This role requires a strong understanding of cards and payments, transaction switching, integration flows, ISO payment messaging, and distributed systems, with the ability to analyse complex business scenarios across multiple platforms and services.
  
  
The Role
  
  

* Serve as a functional and technical domain expert for Transaction Stream and Mastercard payment processing capabilities.
* Translate business requirements, customer journeys, architecture, and product requirements into end-to-end functional scenarios and expected product behaviours.
* Define and execute integration validation approaches for Transaction Switching capabilities across interconnected systems, applications, and services.
* Analyse complex payment transaction flows across authorization, advice, reversal, clearing and other related payment-processing lifecycle scenarios.
* Assess product behaviour across upstream and downstream systems to ensure capabilities meet intended business and technical outcomes.
* Identify functional gaps, integration issues, dependencies, and potential customer impacts through detailed analysis of transaction flows and system interactions.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Owners, Engineering, Architecture, and other product teams to drive product readiness and successful delivery.
* Apply strong knowledge of ISO payment protocols, transaction messaging, system interfaces, and data flows when evaluating new or changed capabilities.
* Analyse production issues and customer insights to identify functional gaps, improve product capabilities, and strengthen future delivery.
* Contribute to automation and self-service capabilities that improve repeatability, coverage, and efficiency of product validation.
* Participate in solution reviews, requirement walkthroughs, design discussions, and readiness assessments, providing a payments-domain and end-to-end integration perspective.
* Support defect and issue analysis by tracing transactions across system boundaries and helping identify the functional or integration point responsible for unexpected behaviour.
* Communicate effectively and coordinate with globally distributed teams including Business Owners, Product Owners, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and dependent product teams.

**All About You**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience working with complex transactional platforms, payment systems, or other highly integrated enterprise applications.
* Strong knowledge of the cards and payments domain, including payment transaction lifecycle, message flows, processing rules, and system interactions.
* Hands-on understanding of authorization, advice, reversal, clearing, and related payment-processing flows.
* Working knowledge of payment messaging standards such as ISO 8583 and ISO 20022.
* Ability to understand business and technical requirements and translate them into functional scenarios, transaction flows, expected outcomes, and acceptance criteria.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to troubleshoot complex integration scenarios across multiple applications and services.
* Experience with end-to-end functional and integration validation of distributed applications and interconnected systems.
* Familiarity with payment simulation or transaction-generation tools such as T3 or equivalent.
* Ability to analyse transaction messages, application logs, system responses, and data across multiple integration points.
* Understanding of modern application architecture, including cloud platforms, microservices, event-driven architecture, caching, and persistence technologies.
* Familiarity with CI/CD delivery environments and modern software delivery practices.
* Exposure to Java, Spring Boot, or similar technologies is beneficial for understanding application behaviour and supporting technical analysis.
* Experience using automation or tooling to improve the efficiency and repeatability of functional or integration validation is preferred.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to work across Product, Business, Engineering, Architecture, and other technology teams.
* Comfortable working in an Agile delivery environment.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Technical Information Systems Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
The Technical Information Systems Engineer is responsible for supporting engineering information, mechanical design and drafting, technical documentation, product data, and engineering change management processes that enable engineering teams to work efficiently and effectively.
  
  
The role primarily supports mechanical design and drafting activities for engine and genset components, including 3D modeling, 2D drawing development and review, GD&T, CAD data management, and engineering information processes. The position works closely with Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Engineering, and other technical stakeholders to deliver accurate engineering information, resolve technical issues, support product development, and improve engineering processes and systems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Engineering Design & Drafting**

* Create, modify, maintain, and review 3D models and 2D engineering drawings for engine and genset components using Creo Parametric.
* Apply established CAD and drafting practices to develop accurate, consistent, and manufacturable engineering documentation.
* Interpret and validate engineering drawings, specifications, models, and design information.
* Apply Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T) principles to engine and genset applications.
* Participate in drawing quality reviews and identify discrepancies, errors, and opportunities for improvement.
* Review engineering documentation for compliance with applicable company, industry, national, and international standards, including SAE and ASME requirements.
* Apply mechanical design and drafting principles to support engineering requirements and product development activities.

**Engineering Information & Change Management**

* Manage and maintain engineering drawings, models, specifications, product information, and technical data using established processes and systems.
* Support CAD data management through Windchill/PLM and other applicable engineering information systems.
* Support the Engineering Change Management process, including the review, documentation, and implementation of applicable engineering changes.
* Ensure engineering information is accurate, current, traceable, and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
* Fulfill engineering information and technical service requests in accordance with defined policies, procedures, and service expectations.
* Document completed work, technical findings, decisions, and results to support knowledge management and effective information sharing.
* Support Engineering Standard Work (ESW), Value Package Introduction (VPI), product change management, and technical information repositories as applicable.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work with Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Product Engineering, and other technical functions to understand requirements and deliver appropriate engineering information and solutions.
* Obtain, evaluate, and incorporate inputs from technical stakeholders into engineering documentation and processes.
* Collaborate with technical practitioners to resolve drawing, design, product information, and process-related issues.
* Communicate technical information clearly to stakeholders with varying levels of technical expertise.
* Contribute effectively to team activities and shared engineering objectives.

**Problem Solving & Process Improvement**

* Own and resolve moderately complex engineering information, design, drafting, product, or process-related issues.
* Analyze technical problems and determine appropriate corrective actions using structured problem-solving methods.
* Evaluate drawings, models, specifications, and technical information to identify discrepancies and potential risks.
* Identify opportunities to improve engineering processes, drafting practices, information quality, and workflow efficiency.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering information systems, processes, and technical documentation.
* Support the development and standardization of effective engineering work processes and best practices.
* Make timely technical decisions using available information while maintaining quality and engineering standards.

**Manufacturing & Product Knowledge**

* Apply knowledge of engine and genset components when developing and reviewing engineering models and drawings.
* Consider manufacturing requirements and design intent when validating engineering documentation.
* Apply practical understanding of manufacturing processes, particularly castings and sheet metal , when reviewing designs.
* Support effective communication and alignment between design engineering and manufacturing teams.

**Competency**
**Technical Competencies**

* Knowledge Management: Ensures engineering information, technical knowledge, and experience are available at the right time and through appropriate processes and tools.
* Request Fulfillment: Manages engineering service requests efficiently and professionally through their lifecycle.
* Requirements Elicitation: Understands, evaluates, and documents technical requirements to support appropriate engineering solutions.
* Service Level Management: Supports delivery of engineering services in accordance with defined requirements, processes, and expectations.
* Solution Assessment and Validation: Reviews engineering solutions and information against applicable requirements to ensure the desired outcome is achieved.
* Troubleshooting: Diagnoses and resolves engineering information, design, drafting, and process-related issues using established standards and procedures.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Collaboration: Builds effective partnerships and works collaboratively with cross-functional teams to achieve shared objectives.
* Effective Communication: Communicates technical information clearly and effectively to different audiences.
* Decision Quality: Makes sound and timely decisions based on technical information, data, and established processes.
* Drives Results: Consistently delivers quality results while maintaining engineering and customer expectations.
* Optimizes Work Processes: Identifies effective and efficient ways of working and contributes to continuous improvement.
* Self-Development: Actively develops technical knowledge, engineering expertise, and professional capabilities.
* Values Differences: Recognizes and values diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering (B.E./B.Tech.) or another relevant Engineering/STEM discipline.
* A postgraduate/master’s degree in a relevant technical discipline may be preferred or required for select roles.
* The position may require licensing or eligibility in accordance with applicable export control or sanctions regulations.

**Required**
**Skills & Experience**

* 5–6 years of relevant experience in mechanical design and drafting, with strong hands-on experience using Creo Parametric.
* Expert-level proficiency in Creo Parametric 2D and 3D modeling and drafting .
* Strong knowledge of GD&T , particularly for engine and genset applications.
* Strong understanding of mechanical design and engineering drafting principles.
* Practical knowledge of engine and genset components and their applications.
* Experience creating, interpreting, validating, and reviewing engineering drawings.
* Experience participating in drawing quality reviews/audits and resolving drawing-related issues.
* Working knowledge of Windchill/PLM and CAD data management systems.
* Knowledge of engineering change management and product configuration processes.
* Understanding of manufacturing processes, particularly castings and sheet metal .
* Knowledge of applicable SAE, ASME, and other relevant engineering standards .
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to identify and resolve drawing, design, engineering data, and process-related issues.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office tools .

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting engine or genset product development activities.
* Experience working with structured engineering service, technical information, or product development environments.
* Experience with formal drawing quality audits and engineering documentation reviews.
* Experience supporting engineering change processes and product configuration management.
* Exposure to Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and manufacturing considerations.
* Experience collaborating with Design Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Product Engineering teams.

title: Breakthrough NextGen Internship
description:
**Title: Breakthrough NextGen Internship**

**Type: Paid**

**No of Interns: 8**

**Location: Delhi**

**Internship Duration- 11 weeks**

**Work Mode: Hybrid,**

Breakthrough’s work on gender justice extends beyond programme implementation to shaping narratives, influencing institutions, and building long-term alliances across sectors.

Many individuals who will influence institutions in the future; across universities, corporates, consulting firms, media organisations, and public policy spaces; are currently students or early professionals. Engaging with them early in their careers provides an opportunity to deepen their understanding of gender justice and build relationships that extend beyond the organisation itself.

Breakthrough currently engages young people through internships and volunteer programmes. While valuable, these engagements are often informal and task-oriented. A structured internship programme provides an opportunity to create a more intentional platform for talent engagement, learning, and strategic contribution. The proposed internship is therefore designed not primarily as a recruitment pipeline, but as a way to build an extended network of individuals who remain connected to Breakthrough and act as champions of its mission across institutions and sectors.

The internship is designed around
**defined project assignments**
that interns work on during the core phase of the programme. These projects will be drawn from areas that are strategically useful to Breakthrough but may not always receive dedicated internal capacity.The aim is to ensure that interns contribute meaningfully to the organisation while also gaining exposure to different aspects of social change work.

These projects can broadly fall across the following seven categories/ departments:

**1. Corporate and Institutional Engagement(Dept. - Resource Mobilisation)**

Interns can support Breakthrough’s engagement with corporates, philanthropic actors, and institutions by conducting strategic analysis and developing engagement materials.

Illustrative projects may include:

* **Corporate engagement strategy development**
* Mapping companies aligned with Breakthrough’s mission and identifying collaboration opportunities.
* **CSR landscape analysis**
* Analysing corporate CSR priorities related to gender justice, youth engagement, or social norms change.
* **Corporate partnership pitch documents**
* Developing pitch decks and partnership proposals for engaging potential corporate partners.
* **Employee engagement models**
* Designing frameworks for corporate employee engagement initiatives, including volunteering, pro-bono work, or digital campaigns.
* **Institutional partnership mapping**
* Identifying potential collaborations with universities, foundations, think tanks, and networks.

These projects help expand Breakthrough’s ecosystem of institutional partners.

**2. Narrative, Media, and Campaign Strategy (Dept.-Media & Communications)**

Narrative change is a central pillar of Breakthrough’s work. Interns with storytelling, communication, or creative backgrounds can contribute to this area.

Illustrative projects include:

* **Narrative analysis & research**

Analysing how gender-related issues are represented across digital media and public discourse, alongside conducting research-driven tasks to develop first drafts of documents on assigned gender topics.

* **Campaign strategy & media engagement**

Supporting the development of campaign narratives and audience strategies, while mapping and engaging with journalists, media platforms, and digital communities aligned with gender justice conversations.

* **Content creation & storytelling**

Conceptualising and producing content—particularly short-form social media content—through ideation, planning, and execution of shoots (in-office or field-based), in-app editing, and platform management. This also includes exploring diverse storytelling formats such as multimedia narratives, podcasts, and short-form videos.

* **Design support**

Assisting with design tasks as assigned by the graphic design team, in accordance with provided technical requirements.

These projects help strengthen Breakthrough’s influence in shaping public narratives.

**3. Research and Evaluation Support (Dept.-Research & Evaluation)**

Some interns may contribute to research and evaluation initiatives, supporting different stages of the research lifecycle.

Possible projects include:

* **Literature Review**

Undertaking literature review for select research or evaluation studies, entailing deep-diving into secondary sources, contributing towards developing conceptual frameworks and approaches, and mapping socio-demographic and psychographic contexts for key population groups and sub-groups of interest

* **Data Collection and Analysis**

Supporting the Research and Evaluation teams in planning and executing the data collection process, and undertaking quantitative and/or qualitative data analysis

* **Dissemination of Findings**

Supporting the Research and Evaluation teams disseminating the findings of select studies. This would include drafting high-level summaries for key stakeholders and assisting in the design of communication materials articulating key findings for a diverse set of audiences.

These outputs help strengthen research quality, enable knowledge sharing, and support the effective design and replication of studies and evaluation processes across programmes.

**4. Tools, Frameworks, and Methodology Development (Dept.- Deep Transformation & Community Engagement)**

Some interns may focus on developing tools or frameworks.

Illustrative work may include:

* **Programme methodology documentation**
* Documenting frameworks used in Breakthrough programmes.
* **Reporting & decks**

Preparing reports, presentations, and strategic decks for internal and external stakeholders.

* **Toolkit development**
* Creating toolkits that can be used by partners, educators, or community organisations.
* **Programme case studies**
* Documenting impactful initiatives and lessons learned.
* **Workshop or training modules**
* Designing structured modules for youth engagement or awareness building.

These outputs help codify organisational knowledge and improve programme replication.

**5. Thought Leadership and Knowledge Products(Dept.-Positioning)**

Breakthrough produces valuable insights/positioning papers which showcases BT evidence as well as contributes to the sectoral work. Interns can support the initial phase of development of structured knowledge products.

Examples include:

* **Research briefs/Scoping Papers**
* Producing short analytical papers on emerging gender issues.
* **Thought leadership pieces**
* Writing articles or reports that contribute to sector conversations.
* **Global comparisons**
* Analysing how gender justice campaigns operate in different countries.

These outputs help strengthen Breakthrough’s voice as a thought leader in the field.

**6. Organisational Strategy and Consulting Assignment (Dept.-Thematic)**

Some interns may work on projects that resemble short consulting assignments, supporting strategic planning and organisational decision-making.

Possible projects include:

* **Strategic landscape analysis**
* Identifying and mapping relevant policies, reforms, and programs, while building a database of organizations and government stakeholders in gender-transformative education, and identifying collaboration opportunities across aligned initiatives.
* **Programme expansion strategy**
* Analysing opportunities for expanding Breakthrough’s work into new areas or geographies.
* **Stakeholder mapping**
* Identifying networks, institutions, and influencers relevant to Breakthrough’s mission.
* **Strategic briefing documents**
* Preparing background notes and analyses to support leadership discussions, along with strategy updates informed by global trends and relevant international practices.

These assignments can provide valuable strategic inputs to the organisation.

**7. Gender Transformative Education System (Dept.-Strategic Partnerships and Scale Up)**

* **Develop a virtual platform for Learning**
* Documenting lessons learnt and creating a virtual platform for stakeholders to engage, discuss and take learnings
* **Thought leadership pieces**
* Writing articles or reports that contribute to sector conversations.
* **Drafting pitch documents / power point presentation**

Developing pitch deck (brief visual proposition of an idea/s)

* **Developing a compendium of short stories of change**

Professionally documenting short impactful “stories of change” within teachers, Govt. officials, SMC members, parents etc to develop a compendium/ book

* **Developing concept note bank**

Identify and draft different ideas from within the program which has the potential for expansion and develop concept notes (4-6)

These projects can strengthen the organisation’s ability to use data for learning and decision-making.

***Skills, Competencies & Experience Required:***

* Final Year Graduate and Post Graduate students can apply
* Good communication and presentation skills
* Domain knowledge for the department intern is applying for and relevant skills
* Confidence, positive 'can do’ attitude

*About Breakthrough:*

Breakthrough works on culture change by shifting social norms that limit women and girls from reaching their full potential. We work with adolescents and young people aged 11-25 years aiming for an entire generation to shift and push for change. Over time, we have worked with more

than 5.4 million adolescents and young people, aged 11 to 25, to encourage aspiration, agency, leadership and negotiation through our work in schools and communities. We also support them with media tools that shape public narratives.

This has resulted in a generation of young people shifting to think and act in confident, intentional ways. Girls are negotiating to stay in school, delaying marriage, exercising choices around life goals, stepping into non-traditional career paths. Boys are stepping up to contribute, support and uphold equal rights for all.

This gives hope that a more equal world is possible for future generations.

*Breakthrough’s Culture:*

Employees at Breakthrough are expected to work in line with organisational values of Dignity, Integrity and Equity.

Breakthrough is an equal opportunity employer. We consider applicants for all positions without regard to race, colour, caste, religion, creed, gender, age, disability, economic status, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status. We prefer people from marginalised communities, women and other genders. Our policies and procedures reflect our commitment towards child safeguarding. Breakthrough is committed to the well-being of its employees and understands an individual’s mental health can impact their ability to work. Breakthrough recognizes taking steps to improve mental health and wellbeing of the employees is essential. We are committed to fostering an environment that promotes employee wellbeing. We recognize that well-being is not just the absence of illness, but the presence of factors that support a fulfilling life.

**To know more about Breakthrough, please visit – www.inbreakthrough.org**

**Last date of submission is 8th November 2026.**

title: Grant Writer
description:
If you’ve been looking to join a fast-growing startup with a bold vision of
**a world where doing good is built into everything we do**
, then you’ve found the right place.
  
  
Backed by General Catalyst, the same investors behind Stripe and Airbnb, we’re building something truly extraordinary.
  
  
****Our Mission****
Our mission at Goodstack is to
**revolutionize how the world does good 🌎.**
As a fast growth, AI-native social impact startup, we power global change through technology. We enable companies to seamlessly integrate positive impact into what they do through a unified platform while supporting nonprofits in gaining access to cutting-edge technology and finding new funding streams.
  
  
Global brands, including
**Google, OpenAI, TikTok, LinkedIn, HSBC, Atlassian and Twilio**
- as well as thousands of nonprofits, including the Red Cross, Cancer Research, and Oxfam - use Goodstack to make a difference.
  
  
In 2025 alone, we facilitated
**$5 billion in donations**
to good causes. But this is just the beginning. We're building the world’s leading platform that powers donations to nonprofits globally.
  
  
To keep our momentum and deliver consistently high value to our partners, we need incredible people to help us on our journey –
**we need you 🫵**
****Join us as Grant Writer to act as our lead Expert Reviewer!****
We’re looking for an exceptionally thoughtful, detail-driven Grant Writer to lead high-quality grant research, writing and review for our nonprofit partners.
  
  
You’ll help nonprofits access more funding, faster – identifying relevant opportunities, shaping strong applications and making sure every draft is accurate, compelling and genuinely useful.
  
  
If you have a strong grant writing background, enjoy turning complex programme information into clear funding narratives, and want your work to support organisations doing meaningful social impact work, this could be the perfect role for you.
  
  
****As a Grant Writer, your mission will be to:****

* Research funding opportunities: Identify, evaluate and curate relevant grants tailored to each organisation’s mission, programmes, eligibility and funding needs.
* Draft excellent applications: Write compelling LOIs, grant applications and supporting narratives aligned to funder requirements.
* Use AI to increase quality and pace: Confidently prompt, guide and review AI-assisted outputs to accelerate research, drafting and iteration without compromising accuracy, judgement or tone.
* Act as lead expert reviewer: Review drafts so they are accurate, persuasive, funder-ready and easy for nonprofits to use.
* Manage delivery: Balance pace, quality and care across multiple partner relationships, keeping work moving and expectations clear.
* Build deep context: Work closely with around 25–30 nonprofit partners at any given time, understanding their goals, programmes and impact.
* Improve how we work: Help strengthen our grant support process so we can serve more nonprofits well, without compromising quality.

****After 3 months, success will look like:****

* Producing high-quality grant drafts at a consistent pace.
* Nonprofit partners feel supported, understood, and confident in the work they receive.
* Funding opportunities are well-matched, relevant, and clearly explained.
* AI is used thoughtfully to improve speed, consistency, and quality.
* Drafts are accurate, thoughtful, and tailored to each funder.
* Risks, blockers, or deadline concerns are raised early.
* Our grant support process becomes clearer, stronger, and easier to scale.

****This role is a perfect match for you if you have:****

* 5 years’ grant writing experience, ideally for nonprofits, charities or mission-led organisations.
* Understanding of funding landscapes, eligibility criteria, funder priorities and what makes a proposal competitive.
* Ability to turn rough context into specific, persuasive, funder-ready narratives.
* Confidence using AI tools to support research, drafting, editing and quality assurance, and know where human judgement must lead.
* Ability to take responsibility, communicate early, and enjoy building in a fast-moving environment.
* Attention to detail; Deadlines, geographic nuances, funding restrictions and structural requirements do not slip past you.
* Partner-first communication; You combine warmth, clarity, and sound judgement in every interaction.
* Process discipline; Enjoy clear systems, well-managed workflows, and making the slightly messy feel beautifully organised.

****Bonus if you have knowledge or love of:****

* A degree from a recognised university, or equivalent evidence of strong analytical thinking.
* Nonprofit fundraising, philanthropy or corporate social impact.
* Tea drinking 🫖

**About Us**
Since 2017, Goodstack has been at the forefront of creating a future where good will be built into everything we do. From daily commutes to weekend activities or grocery shopping, we envision a world where creating positive change is seamlessly integrated into our everyday lives. In this future, the depth and breadth of impact we can make through everyday actions will expand dramatically – benefiting both businesses and the world.
  
  
Businesses are expected to deliver on both profit and purpose and those that don’t are falling behind. We’re here to make it easy for any company, anywhere in the world, to integrate good into what they do. Doing this empowers everyone – companies, employees, consumers, and communities – to contribute to positive change and take meaningful action.
  
  
**Let's do this! 💜**
****OUR PLEDGE TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION****
We take pride in our diverse and growing team representing 20+ nationalities across 5 continents 🌍! Our continued expansion provides us with opportunities to embrace and celebrate different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, essential to our success. We actively seek and welcome applicants from all walks of life, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**A team that represents the world that we are trying to support is a wiser, more knowledgeable and stronger one. We’re excited for you to bring your experience, yourself and your special**
**lemon twist**
**to Goodstack to propel us forward in striving to create a better world for us all.**
Check out our
**Careers Page**
for more details!

title: Product Development Engineer – SCG India
description:

.

The Product Development Engineer supports the development, testing, and improvement of building materials and construction products to meet customer needs, technical specifications, and applicable industry standards.

The role focuses on evaluating materials, supporting new product trials, improving product specifications, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to develop innovative and commercially viable product solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support new product development initiatives, including product concept evaluation, material selection, and technical feasibility assessments.
* Conduct or coordinate product trials, prototype evaluations, and performance testing to assess product functionality and suitability.
* Develop and improve product specifications, technical documentation, and product performance requirements.

* Collaborate with Production, Quality Assurance, and Engineering teams to support product trials, testing, and new product introduction.
* Analyze product testing results, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend technical adjustments to meet product requirements.
* Support the development and improvement of AAC blocks, wall panels, and other building material solutions, as applicable.
* Coordinate with Sales, Technical Service, and relevant stakeholders to understand customer requirements and translate market needs into product development opportunities.
* Monitor relevant product technologies, construction material innovations, and industry standards to support continuous product improvement.
* Prepare product development reports, trial results, technical evaluations, and project documentation.

* Familiarity with material testing, product specifications, or engineering evaluation methods is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical learning skills.
* Ability to interpret technical information, analyze test results, and prepare engineering documentation.
* Good communication and coordination skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Good command of English, both written and spoken.
* Proactive, detail-oriented, innovative, and eager to learn, with a strong interest in sustainable materials and product development.

**Career Development**

This role provides opportunities to develop expertise in
**product innovation, materials engineering, new product development, technical research, and sustainable construction solutions**
, supporting career growth within SCG's building materials and international business network.

title: PI Engineer
description:
At Alstom, we build what millions depend on daily - rail transportation systems that can't afford to fail. We're more than 85,000 people worldwide creating the industry's most diverse portfolio: high-speed trains, metros, trams, maintenance services and integrated systems.
  
  
Could you be the full-time Product Introduction (PI) Field Engineer in New Delhi we’re looking for?

We are looking for a passionate Pi Engineer to design and develop cutting-edge solutions that power the next generation of rail mobility. You will collaborate with dedicated teams to ensure performance, safety, and reliability across complex systems that move cities and connect people every day.
  
  
**Your Role, Your Impact**

* Develop scalable integration solutions for train control and monitoring systems using advanced simulation tools.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to align design specifications and ensure seamless system interoperability.
* Ensure reliability and compliance of Pi systems through rigorous validation and verification processes.

You'll work with sharp, committed teams solving complex challenges that shape the future of mobility, ensuring seamless integration of business and technology.

* Hands-on experience with MATLAB/Simulink or similar modeling tools for system validation.
* Knowledge of EN50128 or equivalent safety standards for embedded systems.

Here, progress isn't always easy but the impact is real. Because the scale is massive, the tasks are complex when the system runs, the train moves, and the city connects that feeling stays with you. And the legacy lasts.

title: Writer - Digital Long-Form & Analysis
description:
We are seeking a sharp, research-oriented, and intellectually curious journalist to produce high-quality long-form journalism, in-depth news analysis, investigative features, and explainers.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying trends and policy issues. Conducting extensive research and interviews, analysing data and documents, providing context, insight, and a deeper understanding of current affairs will be part of the responsibility.

The ideal candidate should combine strong reporting skills with analytical thinking, editorial judgment, digital storytelling capabilities, and the ability to translate complex subjects into clear, engaging, and evidence-based journalism.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Long-Form Journalism and In-Depth Reporting**

* Develop and produce original long-form stories, investigative features, deep dives, and narrative articles -- analyses of policies impacting the bureaucracy, economy and business.
* Identify underreported issues, emerging trends, systemic challenges, and public-interest subjects.
* Conduct extensive interviews with subject-matter experts, policymakers, stakeholders, affected communities, and other relevant sources.
* Undertake field reporting and background research to establish context and uncover new information.
* Explain the background, causes, implications, and possible consequences of major events and decisions.
* Articles must be written keeping in mind the digital platform and the audience
* Covering ministries/departments

**Research, Verification**

* Conduct desk research using credible primary and secondary sources.
* Review official documents, government reports, court records, research papers, datasets, public filings, and historical archives.
* Verify claims, statistics, quotations, and source material before publication.
* Use spreadsheets, data visualization tools, and basic quantitative research methods where appropriate.
* Collaborate with visual editors, designers, photographers, video producers, and audience teams to develop multimedia storytelling formats.
* Incorporate timelines, charts, maps, infographics, photographs, audio, video, and interactive elements where relevant.
* Manage multiple assignments and long-form projects within agreed timelines.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Applicants should ideally have 3-5 years of experience. Should be willing to
* Bachelor's or master's degree in Journalism, Mass Communication, Economics, Public Policy, Sociology, or a related discipline.
* A strong portfolio of published long-form stories, analytical articles, investigations, or research-driven features.
* Excellent writing, editing, interviewing, and research skills.
* Familiarity with digital publishing systems, web research, SEO fundamentals, and audience analytics.
* Knowledge of data journalism, spreadsheets, visualization tools, or multimedia storytelling is an advantage.
* Proficiency in source evaluation, fact-checking, and document-based research.
* Ability to work independently on complex stories over extended periods.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be assessed through a balanced evaluation of:

* **Editorial quality:**
  Accuracy, depth, originality, clarity, and strength of analysis.
* **Reporting quality:**
  Reliability of sources, quality of evidence, and depth of research.
* **Story development:**
  Relevance and originality of pitches, reporting initiative, and successful completion of projects.
* **Audience performance:**
  Relevant measures such as engaged reading time, completion rate, returning readership, subscriptions, and meaningful audience interaction.

title: Senior Associate - Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation ( EAII Advisors )
description:
**This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.**
**About EAII**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.
  
  
For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
  
  
**About Evidence Action**
At Evidence Action, we deliver data-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
  
  
Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
  
  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
You will be part of our Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation team supporting the successful design and rollout of monitoring initiatives for the India Safe Water programme. The programme is implementing In-Line Chlorination (ILC) technology in partnership with the Government of India's Jal Jeevan Mission, targeting communities served by Single Village Scheme water systems; ILC delivers safe, chlorinated water at the source and has demonstrated strong potential for cost-effectiveness and scale. The programme is currently operational in Andhra Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh, with the goal of reaching 17.5 million people across multiple Indian states with safe drinking water.
  
  
As the programme portfolio expands, you will contribute to exploring and implementing innovative, technology-enabled ways of operating at scale. The MLE team plays a central role in generating evidence, ensuring data quality, and informing programme decisions; this role requires significant experience in evaluation, quantitative research, impact assessment, development programmes, and applied data analytics.
  
  
The Senior Associate - Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation will be based in New Delhi and reports to the Senior Manager - Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Monitoring Framework and Systems
  
  

* Support the MLE team in developing programme Theory of Change, Results Framework, Logframe, indicators and measurement protocols aligned with programme objectives
* Develop and institutionalise monitoring tools, reporting formats, data quality protocols and SOPs
* Establish systems for routine tracking of programme outputs, outcomes and key performance indicators
* Work closely with programme teams to ensure that monitoring systems generate actionable insights rather than only reporting numbers
* Support the design and implementation of the MLE framework for the India Safe Water programme

Evaluation Design and Assessment
  
  

* Work with MLE team to Develop evaluation designs appropriate to programme objectives, including experimental/quasi-experimental approaches where feasible
* Work with the MLE team to develop sampling strategies, sample size calculations, survey designs, questionnaires and data collection protocols
* Define appropriate evaluation indicators and outcome measures related to safe water access, water quality, behaviour change, service delivery and programme performance

Data Management, Analysis and Interpretation
  
  

* Analysis of large and complex programme datasets using appropriate statistical and econometric methods
* Conduct descriptive, inferential and multivariate analysis, as appropriate
* Identify trends, patterns, correlations and anomalies in programme data and translate these into actionable programme insights
* Develop approaches for data triangulation across survey and monitoring datasets
* Establish standards for data cleaning, validation, documentation and reproducible analysis

Data Visualisation and Dashboarding
  
  

* Develop and maintain management dashboards and data visualisation systems to track programme performance
* Translate complex datasets into intuitive visualisations that can be used by field teams for decision-making
* Design dashboards covering key programme indicators, performance, implementation progress, outcome indicators and emerging risks

Data Quality and Field Monitoring
  
  

* Work with the MLE team to Establish and implement a robust Data Quality Assurance (DQA) framework
* Develop protocols for data verification, back-checks, audits and validation of field-collected data
* Conduct periodic reviews of monitoring data to identify inconsistencies, reporting gaps and potential data quality issues
* Work with field and implementation teams to strengthen data collection processes and address data quality gaps
* Ensure that data collection tools and processes are aligned with evaluation and analytical requirements

Programme Learning and Decision Support
  
  

* Develop regular analytical reports and management briefs highlighting programme performance, challenges, emerging trends and recommended actions
* Institutionalise learning loops between monitoring, evaluation and programme implementation

Stakeholder Coordination
  
  

* Work closely with programme, operations, technical and field teams to integrate M&E into programme implementation
* Manage relationships with external agencies, survey firms, evaluators and technology/data partners

**Requirements**

* 3-5 years of relevant experience in MLE, evaluation, quantitative research, impact assessment, development programmes, or applied data analytics
* Master's degree in Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, or a related field
* Experience in WASH, safe water, public health, or rural development is desirable
* Strong understanding of evaluation methodologies and research design
* Demonstrated experience in designing impact and outcome evaluations
* Knowledge of sampling techniques, sample size determination, and survey methodology
* Advanced skills in data analysis and statistical modelling
* Strong hands-on experience in data quality assurance, high-frequency checks, data validation, data cleaning, and data management
* Excellent data visualisation and dashboarding skills
* Proficiency in Stata, SPSS, Power BI, and CAPI scripting. Experience with multiple analytical and data management tools is an advantage
* Ability to independently interpret quantitative findings and effectively communicate insights and implications to non-technical stakeholders
* Strong report writing, documentation, and presentation skills
* Fluency in written and spoken English and Hindi

**Position Location**
: This role will be based in New Delhi, India.
  
  
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.

title: Investigation Evidence and Documentation Officer
description:
To support PETA India’s Cruelty Investigations Department by carefully reviewing investigation notes, evidence, photos, videos, and related documents; identifying potential legal violations; conducting desk research and helping identify legal, practical, documentation, confidentiality, equipment, or other issues investigators should know before embarking on an investigation; drafting clear factual and legally sound reports; writing and updating departmental SOPs for all areas of investigation work and for the duties carried out by this role; helping ensure that investigation materials are organised, secure, accurate, and useful for legal action, complaints to authorities, campaign work, media outreach, and internal decision-making; and maintaining investigation equipment so investigators are properly equipped for fieldwork. The position will primarily support investigations and will also assist departments with the organisation and cataloguing of photo and video materials. The role acts as a liaison between the investigators and other departments, keeping confidentiality paramount.

**Term of Employment:**

Full-time

**Location:**

Delhi

**Reports To:**

Director

Primary Responsibilities and Duties

Investigation Note Review and Evidence Assessment

* Review investigators' notes and logs to ensure accuracy, completeness, clarity, and usefulness.
* Flag missing information, inconsistencies, gaps, or issues requiring clarification.
* Review photos, videos, documents, and other evidence to identify key facts and potential violations.
* Identify possible breaches of animal protection laws, regulations, licences, court orders, or related requirements in consultation with supervisors and legal colleagues.
* Support preparation of documentation suitable for complaints, legal review, campaigns, media work, and organisational action.
* Track follow-up needs, including missing information, evidence, legal concerns, and reporting requirements.

Pre-Investigation Research and Preparation

* Conduct desk research to support investigations before fieldwork.
* Identify relevant legal, regulatory, licensing, documentation, confidentiality, safety, access, and equipment considerations.
* Research laws, guidelines, court orders, industry practices, locations, entities, complaints, and public records as required.
* Prepare briefs, checklists, questions, and issue summaries to guide investigators.
* Help ensure investigators understand relevant legal considerations.
* Update plans, SOPs, templates, and checklists based on recurring issues and lessons learned.

Report Drafting and Case Documentation

* Draft clear, factual investigation reports, summaries, timelines, factsheets, evidence lists, and briefing documents.
* Prepare materials for legal, media, campaign, government, and internal purposes.
* Ensure reports remain evidence-based and free from speculation.
* Obtain missing details required to make reports complete and credible.
* Assist with materials for complaints, legal notices, letters, campaign proposals, media pitches, and related actions.
* Maintain organised records of reports, evidence references, correspondence, and supporting documents.

SOP Development and Process Documentation

* Develop, update, and maintain SOPs covering investigations, desk research, evidence handling, reporting, filing, confidentiality, equipment use, and cross-department coordination.
* Create and maintain checklists, templates, logs, instructions, and guidance documents.
* Work with investigators, legal colleagues, and departments to ensure SOPs reflect current practices and requirements.
* Review SOPs regularly and incorporate lessons learned.
* Ensure access to current SOPs, templates, filing guidance, and procedures.

Investigator and Department Liaison

* Serve as a liaison between investigators and departments regarding information, evidence, documents, photographs, videos, and follow-up requests.
* Help ensure investigation findings are understood and used responsibly.
* Clarify evidence and documentation requirements for legal, campaign, media, and advocacy purposes.
* Limit circulation of sensitive materials to authorised individuals and maintain confidentiality.
* Track and coordinate cross-department requests.

Investigation Equipment and Field Readiness

* Maintain investigation equipment and supplies.
* Manage inventory of cameras, phones, recording equipment, batteries, chargers, storage devices, and related materials.
* Ensure equipment is functional, charged, labelled, accounted for, and field-ready.
* Coordinate repairs, replacements, purchases, returns, storage, and sign-outs.
* Track issued equipment and follow up on missing, damaged, or faulty items.

Evidence and Investigation Material Management

* Organise, label, index, and maintain investigation-related photos, videos, documents, notes, and logs.
* Maintain filing systems, folders, indexes, spreadsheets, and records.
* Review visual materials to identify evidence, locations, dates, species, violations, and source information.
* Preserve original files, supporting notes, copyright information, and context.
* Ensure sensitive materials are securely stored and accessible only to authorised personnel.

Photo and Video Library Support

* Support organisation and filing of photographs, videos, captions, and related materials.
* Assist other departments with photo and video organisation when required.
* Ensure files include source, date, location, ownership, copyright, permissions, and usage restrictions where available.
* Create searchable filing systems by issue, species, location, case type, department, campaign, or source.
* Help colleagues locate suitable materials while complying with approval, copyright, usage, and confidentiality requirements.
* Ensure sensitive, graphic, restricted, or copyrighted materials are handled appropriately.

Legal, Campaign, and Cross-Department Support

* Work with supervisors and legal colleagues to assess potential cruelty, illegal activity, improper practices, or non-compliance.
* Prepare factual summaries, factsheets, and briefings for internal and external use.
* Support complaints, advocacy, corporate outreach, government engagement, media initiatives, and public awareness efforts.
* Maintain strict confidentiality regarding investigations, sources, whistleblowers, evidence, operational plans, unpublished materials, and internal discussions.

General

* Follow all organisational policies, confidentiality requirements, and SOPs.
* Maintain accuracy, professionalism, discretion, and sound judgement.
* Work responsibly with sensitive or graphic materials involving animal cruelty.
* Manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
* Perform other duties assigned in support of investigations, evidence management, SOP development, equipment readiness, desk research, and animal protection work.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in law, criminology, journalism, public policy, social work, animal protection, communications, or a related field preferred.
* Experience in investigations support, research, legal research, case documentation, evidence review, reporting, advocacy, journalism, NGO work, SOP development, equipment coordination, or similar fields preferred.
* Excellent written English with strong report-writing and documentation skills.
* Strong analytical ability to identify facts, gaps, inconsistencies, research needs, and potential legal or cruelty-related issues.
* Knowledge of animal protection laws and enforcement processes in India preferred, or willingness to learn.
* Strong organisational skills with experience managing digital files, SOPs, records, and equipment inventories.
* Good judgement, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information.
* Ability to work with disturbing or graphic materials.
* Strong computer skills, including shared drives, spreadsheets, document-management systems, and photo/video filing systems.
* Ability to work effectively across departments.
* Fluency in English required; Hindi and/or other Indian languages desirable.
* Support for PETA India's philosophy and ability to advocate professionally for its positions.
* Adherence to a healthy vegan lifestyle.
* Commitment to the organisation's objectives.

**How to Apply:**

To apply for a position with People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA) India, please complete this form.

title: Remote Pod Lead - Mechanical & Aerospace Engineering
description:
**About Turing:**

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review engineering tasks for technical accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure that tasks reflect authentic mechanical and aerospace engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent task delivery.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of engineering tasks.
* Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, geometry and mesh files, simulation inputs, material properties, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving finite-element analysis (FEA), computational fluid dynamics (CFD), thermodynamics, heat transfer, dynamics, robotics, flight simulation, propulsion, and orbital mechanics.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic mechanical and aerospace engineering workflows and require meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify engineering correctness across units, equilibrium, conservation laws, boundary conditions, mesh convergence, solver tolerances, reference frames, and numerical stability.
* Validate computational environments, simulation tools, solvers, and dependencies to ensure reproducible results.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as stresses, deflections, natural frequencies, aerodynamic coefficients, thermal performance, orbital parameters, and safety margins.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering calculations or simulations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, Fortran, Julia, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: FEA, CFD, dynamics, flight simulation, thermal modeling, astrodynamics, guidance, navigation and control (GNC), or propulsion modeling.
* Strong understanding of engineering simulation, numerical methods, computational modeling, and technical validation.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, engineering simulations, computational models, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate engineering assumptions, numerical accuracy, solver convergence, and the reliability of computational results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with engineering simulation and computational tools such as OpenFOAM, SU2, CalculiX, Code\_Aster, FEniCS, Elmer, Gmsh, FreeCAD, CadQuery, MuJoCo, ROS, XFOIL, AVL, OpenVSP, JSBSim, OpenMDAO, pyCycle, poliastro, Orekit, GMAT, or SPICE.
* Familiarity with commercial engineering software such as ANSYS, Abaqus, COMSOL, or NASTRAN, including reproducing workflows using open-source tools.
* Experience with state estimation, trajectory optimization, topology optimization, aeroelastic analysis, or multidisciplinary design optimization.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
* Industry or agency experience in automotive, energy, manufacturing, robotics, aircraft, launch vehicles, satellites, or UAVs.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]

description:
Communications Associate - Content and Editing, CPI India
  
  
New Delhi, Delhi
  
  
**About CPI**
CPI is an analysis and advisory organization with deep expertise in finance and policy. Our mission is to help governments, businesses, and financial institutions drive economic growth while addressing climate change. With a team of experts across seven international offices, including a strong presence in emerging markets and developing economies, CPI is a leader in tracking sustainable investment trends, identifying innovative business models, and supporting the solutions that can drive the transition to a low-carbon, climate-resilient, inclusive economy. We are unique in our focus on finance, our ability to get the right people to the table, and our analytical rigor.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a communications associate who will primarily be responsible for supporting content development and editing across our India programs. You will possess the ability to translate economics, finance, and policy analysis into clear, concise, and accessible insights for investors and policymakers. You will align CPI content with the most recent trends in climate finance and policy, in ways that directly speak to our target audiences and ensures that CPI expertise provides actionable guidance to decision makers at the highest levels.
  
  
The ideal communications associate will have a strong interest in sustainable business, investment, finance, and economics, and dedication to CPI’s mission and impact.
  
  
You will report to the India Communications lead, and will closely collaborate with program teams in India, as well as the global communications team. You will also work with external stakeholders including partner NGOs and the media.
  
  
**Primary Duties & Responsibilities**
Includes the following and other duties as assigned:
  
  

* Develop and carry out integrated, external communications plans that are aligned with directly influencing the intended audience and have measurable KPIs
* Guide content development from concept to publication—including storyboards, key messaging, structure, and editing—of CPI research products, presentations, op-eds, social media campaigns, and other written content.
* Ensure adherence to CPI’s in-house style guide, brand, and citation standards.
* Maintain and evolve a repository of talking points that summarizes CPI India’s body of work and addresses current issues in climate finance and policy.
* Support internal communications that builds cohesion and reinforces CPI’s positive and inspiring culture.
* Help with content taxonomy, keywords, and tagging to ensure web content is optimized for search indexing and discovery.
* Occasionally lead or help with media relations, including identifying outlets and placing stories in top-tier business, financial, and energy sector media.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Post Graduate degree in Mass Communications/ Public Relations/ Marketing, and demonstrable (minimum of 4 years) post-qualification experience in the field, or a Graduate degree with minimum 6 years of experience
* Experience with handling content development, written content editing, media outreach and public relations. Financial and business press experience will be beneficial.
* Experience with content editing, copywriting, and ensuring consistency with brand and style guidelines.
* Experience with social media and online content campaign development, execution, and analysis, as well as experience with relevant tools, including Wordpress, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Mailchimp, Hootsuite, or equivalents.
* Editorial calendar and project management, handling input from a variety of internal stakeholders, ensuring all deliverables are executed on time and internal stakeholders are kept up to date on task status.

Competencies & Personal Attributes
  
  

* Ability to turn economic and finance analysis into engaging and accessible insights for investors, policymakers, and other stakeholders.
* Impeccable English writing and editing skills, including a proven ability to turn technical content drafted by researchers and analysts into compelling copy in a variety of formats, from long research reports to short policy briefs, blogs, social media campaigns, and op-eds.
* Expertise in message crafting, content restructuring, and copyediting (fluency in AP Style is not a requirement but will be highly beneficial).
* Proven record of excellent writing and editing demonstrated in a professional portfolio.
* Independent worker and strategic thinker, who learns quickly and can successfully navigate unchartered territory.
* Polished, diplomatic interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships in a cross-cultural, global working environment that inspires, motivates, and influences highly-discerning team members.
* Outstanding organizational, project management, and prioritization skills, capable of managing deliverables and influencing people across locations to overcome barriers, meet deadlines, and achieve project goals.
* Ability to work flexibly and with a solutions-oriented approach, under pressure, and on tight deadlines.
* Highly proficient in Microsoft Office suite (Word, PowerPoint, and Excel are heavily used on a daily basis).

Location and Compensation
  
  
CPI is hiring for one permanent, full-time communications associate position based in Delhi/NCR.
  
  
CPI offers a competitive compensation and benefits package. Compensation will be dependent on experience.
  
  
To Apply
  
  
Visit this link to apply. With your application, attach two documents:
  
  

* CV no longer than 2 pages
* a compelling cover letter no longer than 1 page, setting out how you meet the requirements of the role and your motivations for wanting to work at CPI.

Applications are accepted on a rolling basis and open until filled. Apply early.
  
  
Only short-listed applicants will be contacted.
  
  
CPI Commitment
  
  
CPI’s mission is to create economic opportunity while protecting our environment. This worldview—grounding opportunity in something more fundamental that we all share and must protect—permeates our organization, and forms the foundation of our approach to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).
  
  
CPI’s approach to DEI mirrors our mission: within a culture that values transparency and dialogue, we strive to improve equity within our organization as well as in the communities in which we work. Internally and externally, we seek to remove inequitable barriers regardless of their origin, whether it be class, race, religion, nationality, region, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation, or physical ability. We are proactive in identifying and removing biases in our processes, seeking fairness in hiring, working conditions, and professional development.
  
  
If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of application. We will then work with you to identify the best way to assist you through the recruitment process.
