Branly shows a brand how often it appears in those answers, how it is described and which sources the engines rely on. Then it turns every gap into a specific fix the brand can act on.

Three things shape how we work:

* Grounded in research. AI search changes every week. We study how each engine finds, trusts and cites its sources, and we keep our methods in step with what the engines do today.
* Signal over noise. We start from the real questions buyers ask, in their own words. We run them repeatedly across every major engine and read the answers over time, so what we show is a pattern, not a one-off.
* Customer first. Our customers sit at the centre of everything we build. We learn their category, competitors and goals, then stay alongside them until the work shows up as growth.

**The role**

We are hiring a Content Intern to help run Branly's content: the blog, our research papers and the Branly LinkedIn page.

Our content starts from data. Every day, we track what AI engines say about brands and which websites they trust. Your job is to turn what we find into articles, posts and short reports that people want to read and share.

We are an AI-first team. You will use AI for the first pass on research and drafts, check every fact and number yourself, and spend your own time on the angle, the story and the edit.

Full-time internship, 6 months. On-site, Gurgaon. Stipend: ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 a month. You will report to the founding team.

**What you will do**

* Write. Research and draft blog posts and articles on how AI is changing the way people find brands.
* Turn data into stories. Help turn our research into reports and posts that people want to read.
* Run the LinkedIn page. Draft posts for the Branly page and learn what readers respond to.
* Check the facts. Make sure every number and source holds up before anything goes out.
* Work AI-first. Use AI for research and first drafts, and spend your own time on the angle and the edit.

**Who you are**

* A student or recent graduate who writes well and wants to get better at it, fast.
* You have published something of your own: a blog, articles, a newsletter, LinkedIn posts or a college publication.
* You write plainly. Short sentences, clear points, no filler.
* You care about getting facts right. You check a number before you use it, and you can tell a study from a sales pitch.
* AI-first by habit. You use ChatGPT, Claude or Perplexity every day for real work, and you know when an answer needs checking.
* Comfortable with spreadsheets. You can read a table, spot what is interesting and explain it in one sentence.
* Curious about marketing, search and how AI is changing both.
* You take feedback well, edit quickly and finish what you start.

**Bonus points**

* You have grown a blog, newsletter or LinkedIn following of your own.
* You have written about marketing, technology or startups.
* You know the basics of how pages get found in search: titles, structure and links.
* You can make a simple chart or carousel in Canva, Figma or a similar tool.
* You have published on a website builder such as WordPress, Webflow or Framer.

**What it is like working with us**

* Write about one of marketing's newest questions. More brands want to know what AI says about them. You will help answer that, with real data, in public.
* Your work goes live fast. Most of what you write will be published within days, and you will see how readers respond.
* Learn to work the AI-first way. You will see how a small team uses AI to do the work of a much larger one, and you will leave with habits most teams are still figuring out.
* Learn from founders who have scaled before. You will work closely with a team that has led and grown businesses across industries.
* Grow as fast as you learn. As you show what you can handle, you will take on larger pieces and more responsibility.

title: Senior Product Support Specialist
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
  
  
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
  
  
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox’s Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi-year vision and strategy execution. Creators are the engine of Roblox. When something breaks for them, whether it is a broken publish flow, a payout that didn't land, an asset that won't upload, how quickly and how well we resolve it directly shapes whether they keep building with us.
  
  
You will be reporting to the Trust & Safety India Operations Manager. The team provides support to Roblox’s global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Senior Product Support Specialist on our Safety Ops Team, you’ll own the hardest escalations end to end, drive root cause analysis with engineering and product partners, and then close the loop by turning what you learn into support content that scales for both our human agents and our automated support experiences.
  
  
Additionally, you will serve as a product expert working closely with the Product Support Management team, providing detailed synthesis of new and existing issues our users experience to prioritize and enable engineering teams to improve the platform. You'll operate with a high degree of independence.
  
  
**You Will**
**Support health and proactive gap identification**

* Co-monitor the health of creator support: contact drivers, resolution rates, reopen and escalation rates, deflection performance, CSAT, and where creators are getting stuck.
* Mine ticket, content, and automation data for patterns: recurring issues, missing coverage, misleading documentation, product gaps and surface them proactively with a recommendation attached to the PSM.
* Independently own root cause analysis for complex, high-impact, and ambiguous creator issues including ones that cross product, platform, and policy boundaries..
* Get ahead of launches: review upcoming product and policy changes, pressure test them from a support perspective, and make sure content, tooling, and agent readiness are in place before creators feel the change. Support PSM in preparing RCA or post launch report to surface to all concerned stakeholder (engineering, product, operations etc)
* Report clearly and regularly to support and product leadership on where creator support is strong, where it's degrading, and what you propose to do about it.
* Drive operational excellence in how creator support runs: hold the line on quality standards, tighten workflows and handoffs between support, engineering, and product, eliminate manual toil through better process and tooling, and treat every process change as something to be measured rather than assumed. Where the current way of working is the bottleneck, you name it and fix it.
* Product Feedback Loop: Partner directly with Product Managers (PMs) during alpha/beta testing phases to provide a "Supportability Scorecard" for major upcoming platform features.

**Knowledge & Support Content**

* Author and maintain the authoritative internal knowledge base agents rely on which includes but is not restricted to troubleshooting guides, decision trees, macros, policy interpretations and keep it accurate as the product changes underneath it.
* Own creator support content, which includes (but is not limited to) intent-ready articles, structured resolution paths, and clear, unambiguous source material for support agents to rely on.
* Build automation and self-service experiences, supplying the content and acting as a subject-matter judgment behind them, and flagging where automation is producing wrong or incomplete answers.
* Serve as a senior point of contact during high-severity creator-facing incidents, coordinating across support, engineering, and comms, when needed
* Raise the bar on escalation quality across the team by setting the standard for what a well-formed escalation looks like, and reduce the volume that shouldn't have escalated in the first place

You Have
  
  

* 7+ years in technical support, product support, or a comparable operational role, including significant time at a senior or escalation tier.
* A demonstrated track record of independent root cause analysis on complex technical issues.
* Excellent written communication. You have the ability to explain a nuanced technical failure to an engineer and to a frustrated creator.
* Comfort with ambiguity and genuine self-direction. You choose your own problems, defend your prioritization, and close things out without being managed.
* Strong cross-functional influence without authority, you can get engineering and product to care about a support problem.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience owning support content at scale, with real evidence that your content changed outcomes (deflection, handle time, resolution quality).
* Experience writing or structuring content balancing automation driven human in the loop support, self-service, etc.
* Prior experience supporting a developer, creator, or partner audience rather than a general consumer base.
* Working knowledge of Roblox as a creation platform; Studio, Lua, the developer economy or comparable experience with a UGC platform.
* Data & Diagnostic Proficiency: Comfortable querying datasets (SQL, Tableau, or similar BI tools) and analyzing diagnostic logs to isolate bugs before routing to engineering.

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
  
  
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
  
  
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

title: Manager - Operational Readiness
description:
**About your role**

You will help ensure people, processes, controls, tools and technology are ready to implement change successfully. You will assess operational impacts, coordinate readiness activity and support adoption so that approved changes are embedded and sustained.

* Lead operational enablement for new initiatives, regulatory changes and process improvements, acting as the primary Operations contact from solution design through implementation and post-go-live stabilisation.
* Assess impacts across customers, people, processes, systems, controls, capacity and service delivery, translating these into clear readiness, adoption and implementation plans.
* Partner with Operations, Product, Change, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Propositions to shape practical solutions and ensure operational requirements are reflected in end-to-end design and delivery decisions.
* Own operational readiness assessments and go-live recommendations, confirming that procedures, controls, training, skills, staffing, access, support arrangements and evidence are in place, and escalating material gaps or risks.
* Develop and deliver the operational learning and capability agenda, including new-starter, process, system, change and refresher training, cross-skilling plans and maintenance of skills matrices.
* Own the quality and governance of operational knowledge, ensuring procedures, checklists, process guides, training materials and knowledge libraries are accurate, accessible, version-controlled and aligned to approved processes.
* Define and maintain end-to-end process taxonomy and process flows in enterprise tool or the relevant enterprise tool, covering ownership, activities, systems, controls, hand-offs and exception routes.
* Use operational data, recurring queries, errors, quality trends and stakeholder feedback to identify capability, process and control gaps, implement targeted improvements and evidence whether the changes are delivering the intended outcomes.
* Support analysis of risk events, control assessments, audits and remediation activity by providing process, readiness, training and skills evidence, facilitating walkthroughs and tracking agreed actions to closure.
* Represent Operations in service-exception and client-onboarding forums, providing recommendations or approval based on operational capability, capacity, controls, readiness and associated risks.
* Work with AI and Technology teams to develop reliable self-service tools, AI-enabled support and knowledge solutions that help operational teams resolve common process questions efficiently.
* Provide clear, data-led reporting to operational and change leadership on readiness, adoption, capability, risks, dependencies, decisions and outcomes, and drive lessons learned and continuous improvement of enablement practices.

**About you**

* Significant experience in operational enablement, readiness, service transition, business change or transformation within a large, complex and multi-geography organisation.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end operations, with the ability to assess impacts across customers, people, processes, systems, controls, capacity and service delivery and translate them into structured enablement and readiness plans.
* Proven experience of leading operational implementation, adoption, learning and capability activity, including procedures, training, communications, knowledge materials, cross-skilling and post-go-live support.
* Sound knowledge of operational risk, controls, customer impacts and go-live requirements, with the judgement to identify gaps, challenge constructively, recommend appropriate action and escalate material issues.
* Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills, with the ability to work across Operations, Product, Change, Technology, Risk and Compliance and present clear options and recommendations to senior leaders.
* Excellent planning, organisation and delivery skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies and deadlines while maintaining clear ownership and accountability for outcomes.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative problem-solving skills, using operational data, feedback and evidence to support decisions, measure adoption and drive continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce concise, high-quality governance updates, readiness evidence and decision papers.
* A proactive, tenacious and collaborative leadership style, with the ability to work independently, lead through ambiguity and operate effectively across virtual and cross-functional teams.
* Knowledge of Workplace Investing and PI&A products and UK financial products is desirable.
* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Business Administration or a related field; a relevant qualification in change management, learning, project management, Agile or process excellence is advantageous.

title: Technical Growth Intern (Voice AI)
description:
Location: Gurgaon

Type: Intern

About Voice of India

Voice of India is an evaluation platform that measures how well AI systems work under Indian linguistic, cultural and deployment conditions. It is built by
AI4Bharat at IIT Madras and Josh Talks
, and launched in New Delhi on 4 August 2026. Our mission is to make AI understand India as it actually speaks, and to measure honestly how close it is.

What sets us apart:

• Real speech, real conditions. Results are broken down by geography, audio quality, speaking rate, gender, device and age. District-level error rates in our benchmark range from about 4% to 44%.

• Honest numbers. Our paper finds that no evaluated system consistently reaches a 20% word error rate across all 15 languages, and that public benchmarks can overstate real-world performance.

• Research behind the boards. Methods are published, not just posted.

• Data nobody else has. A private, held-out test set across India's regional clusters.

About the role

Voice of India's boards are only as useful as the people who see them. When a new speech model launches, the right researcher, founder or AI leader should hear what our evals say about it within a day. Today that depends on a few people posting when they can. We want it to be a system.

We're hiring a
**Technical Growth Intern (Voice AI)**
to help own how Voice of India reaches the people who matter: researchers who build speech models for Indian languages, founders and engineers who ship voice products for India, and the AI and data leaders who decide which models their companies buy. You will help scale our presence on X and LinkedIn, and find new ways to put our leaderboards, benchmarks and datasets in front of the right people.

The core question for this role is simple: does everyone who builds, ships or buys voice AI for India know what Voice of India says about the models they care about?

This is a highly autonomous internship. You'll work directly with the founders and the research team, sitting between the product and its audience. Growth here is not about follower counts for their own sake. It is about reaching the right people, and that is how you will be measured.

In this role, you will

The work runs as one loop: know who we need to reach, get our work in front of them, learn what lands, and feed it back into the product.

1. Map the people we need to reach. Build and keep current the lists of who matters: speech and voice researchers at model labs, founders and engineers at voice platforms, and AI and data leaders at enterprises that buy voice AI for Indian languages. Know who they follow, where they spend time and what they share.

2. Scale Voice of India on X. Help run our X presence: leaderboard updates, benchmark launches, threads and charts. Make sure major voice AI model launches are covered on our boards within a day of release, and that the right people see it.

3. Scale Voice of India on LinkedIn. Grow our company page and the founders' presence, and run targeted promotion so our posts reach researchers at labs, teams at voice platforms and AI leaders at large Indian and global enterprises.

4. Run launches. Plan and ship every release, from new leaderboards and benchmarks to datasets and papers: timing, founder posts, threads, visuals, and the follow-up that keeps a launch alive after day one.

5. Build distribution beyond our own accounts. Work with creators, researchers and partners who already have the audience we need, so our results travel through voices people trust.

6. Run product ops. Keep the boards fresh and the site sharp: track new model releases, work with the research team on what gets evaluated next, and turn audience feedback into changes on the platform.

In a typical week, you might:

• Track every voice AI model launch and get our results out the same day

• Plan and schedule a benchmark launch thread with the research team

• Build a target list of voice researchers and AI leaders, and set up a LinkedIn campaign to reach them

• Brief a group of creators on a new leaderboard and coordinate their posts

• Look at who each post reached and who engaged, and change next week's plan

What matters most

Everything in the loop serves two outcomes. They are how this role will be measured.

1. Reaching the right people

Reach only matters if it is the right reach. A post seen by a million people who will never build or buy a speech model is worth less than one seen by the hundred people who do.

• Know the audience by name. Keep clear, current lists of the researchers, builders and buyers we need, and know which of them already follow us.

• Measure who, not just how many. Track reach and engagement among the people we target, not just impressions and follower counts.

• Be first on launches. Be the place people check when a new voice model ships, by getting our results out fast.

• Earn the reshare. Make posts researchers want to share: clear charts, honest numbers, no hype.

2. Scaling X and LinkedIn into systems

Today a few people post when they can. You'll help turn that into a repeatable engine that runs every day, through launches and quiet weeks alike.

• Run a calendar. Keep a weekly calendar of leaderboard posts and releases across Voice of India's accounts and the founders' accounts.

• Build templates. Create reusable formats for leaderboard updates, launch threads and charts, so quality stays high as volume grows.

• Spend on reach with intent. Use targeted LinkedIn and X promotion to reach specific groups, and cut whatever does not reach them.

• Grow a creator network. Build lasting relationships with creators and researchers who regularly cover voice AI.

• Close the loop. Report what worked each week, and feed what the audience wants back into the product and research roadmap.

What we offer

• High ownership. Own a real slice of Voice of India's reach from day one, with direct access to the founders.

• A front-row seat. See every new voice model and every result before it goes public.

• Real impact. Your work decides whether the labs, builders and buyers of voice AI see what our evals say.

• Room to grow. Build the growth function at an early product and shape how it scales.

Minimum qualifications

• A track record of growing an audience on X or LinkedIn, for a company or for yourself

• Strong writing: you can turn a technical result into a clear post, thread or chart caption

• Comfort with data: you track what each post reached and change course based on it

• Genuine interest in AI, and the curiosity to learn how speech models are built and evaluated

• High ownership: you ship without waiting to be told, and you sweat the details

• Comfortable in Hindi and English; knowing another Indian language is a plus

Preferred qualifications

You don't need to match every bullet. Apply even if you meet only some of these.

• Experience running launches for a technical product, developer tool or AI company

• Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Campaign Manager or X ads and audience targeting

• An existing network among AI researchers, builders or creators

• Experience running creator or influencer campaigns

• Basic design skills for charts and visuals (Figma, Canva or similar)

• Comfort with outreach and data tools such as Apollo, spreadsheets or simple scripts, and with AI tools that help you move faster

Why join Voice of India

• Shape how voice AI gets built for India. Labs, voice platforms and enterprises use our boards to decide which models to build, ship and buy.

• See every model first. Work with the newest speech models across Indian languages, often before most of the field has tried them.

• Grow something with substance. You'll be growing a platform built on real research, created by AI4Bharat at IIT Madras and Josh Talks, with a published benchmark the field can check.

• Reach every part of India's speech. Our evals cover 15 Indian languages and 139 regional clusters, so the audience is every builder who wants voice AI to work for India.

• Join early. Join a small, talent-dense team early, and shape the product, the team and how we grow.

title: US DAT- System Transformation Assurance-Senior Associate
description:

**Responsibilities**

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree in one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Finance, Management Information Systems, Management Information Systems & Accounting, Computer and Information Science, Computer and Information Science & Accounting, Information Science, Economics, Economics and Finance, Economics and Finance & Technology, Business Administration/Management, Engineering, Accounting & Technology, Technology Mathematics, Statistics, Mathematical Statistics , Regulatory Compliance, Science and/or other relevant degree or in lieu of degree a Chartered Accountant/CPA or Equivalent or Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)

* Demonstrating, in addition to the minimum years of experience required for the role, experience in SAP/Oracle controls auditing, consulting and/or implementing, data analysis, compliance, internal audit, or risk

title: AI Automation Intern
description:
**AI Automation Intern**

Step into the world of AI, automation, and global business — right after college.

**ABOUTTHE ROLE:**

We are building next-generation AI automation systems — intelligent agents, autonomous workflows, and LLM-powered pipelines that redefine how modern businesses operate at scale. As an AI Automation Intern, you will work hands-on with cutting-edge AI technologies, automation frameworks, cloud infrastructure, and real-world use cases — contributing to the future of AI-native operations alongside an experienced global team.

This role is ideal for someone who is technically curious, self-driven, and eager to work at the bleeding edge of AI automation.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

You will work directly with the product and technology team to design, build, and optimize automation pipelines that power internal operations and client-facing solutions.

* Design and build end-to-end automation workflows using tools such as n8n, Make (Integromat), or Zapier to streamline repetitive business processes.

* Identify manual, time-consuming processes across teams and propose automation-first solutions to eliminate inefficiencies.

We welcome freshers and final-year students who are self-driven, technically curious, and eager to work at the bleeding edge of AI automation.

* Stipend: ₹10,000 per month.

**COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS:**

* **Technical Curiosity:**

* **Problem-Solving:**

* **Attention to Detail:**

* **Communication:**
  Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* **Ownership Mindset:**

* **Adaptability:**
  Comfortable with ambiguity, fast-changing priorities, and a startup-style work culture.
* **Collaboration:**

title: External Reporting Specialist
description:
**Overview**
The Individual Contributor Expert is a senior subject matter expert who delivers complex SEC reporting, technical accounting and financial statement analysis without people management responsibilities. The role brings deep expertise to the most complex disclosure and accounting topics, serves as a key resource for the team and cross-functional partners, and improves the quality, consistency and efficiency of the external reporting process.
  
  
Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.
  
  
Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Financial Reporting**

* Prepare and review the more complex sections of Forms 10-K, 10-Q and 8-K, including footnotes, MD&A and other disclosures
* Draft and maintain disclosure language for areas such as stock compensation, pension, EPS, leases, revenue and business combinations
* Ensure all disclosures are supported by accurate, well-documented tie-outs and source data
* Perform a final quality review of filings before they are shared with senior leadership and the auditors

**Financial Statement Analysis**

* Analyze the consolidated balance sheet, income statement and cash flow statement, including period-over-period fluctuations and key trends
* Prepare clear commentary and analysis on financial results for presentation to management
* Identify unusual movements and emerging risks, and follow up with business and accounting teams to explain the drivers

**Technical Accounting and Research**

* Research complex US GAAP and SEC reporting questions, reach well-supported conclusions and document them in clear position papers and memos
* Assess the impact of new accounting standards and SEC rules (for example ASU 2024-03 on expense disaggregation) and lead readiness for disclosure changes
* Support non-GAAP compliance, including reconciliations, benchmarking and disclosure language under Regulation G and Item 10(e)
* Partner with the US GAAP Policies function on policy interpretation and related adjustments

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Serve as the subject matter contact for reporting and disclosure questions
* Support analyses for senior finance leaders
* Provide technical input to SOX and disclosure controls documentation

**Audit Support**

* Respond to external auditor requests and review comments on complex topics
* Prepare supporting analyses and walk auditors through technical positions

**Process Improvement and Automation**

* Design and build reusable templates, checklists and review tools to improve accuracy and speed
* Lead the use of Vena, DataSnipper, Adobe Pro and AI-based tools for tie-outs, commentary and recurring analyses
* Document processes and best practices so that knowledge is shared across the team rather than dependent on individuals

**Knowledge Sharing and Mentoring**

* Coach and train team members on technical topics and filing mechanics, without formal line management
* Contribute to team learning sessions on new standards and recurring review findings
* Provide backup coverage for critical reporting tasks

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications**

* CA, CPA or equivalent qualification
* 7 to 10 years of experience in accounting and financial reporting, with strong SEC reporting exposure
* Background in Big 4 audit or a multinational public company preferred
* In-depth knowledge of US GAAP and SEC rules, with hands-on experience in 10-K and 10-Q preparation
* Experience in financial statement analysis and preparing commentary for management
* Demonstrated experience writing technical accounting memos and disclosure language
* Proficiency in Excel and reporting or consolidation tools; familiarity with EDGAR and XBRL preferred

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong technical knowledge and sound judgment on ambiguous accounting and disclosure questions
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn financial data into clear insights for management
* Clear and concise writing, with the ability to explain complex topics to non-accounting audiences
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple deliverables against tight filing deadlines
* Ability to influence across teams and time zones without formal authority
* Integrity and discretion in handling material non-public information
* Curiosity and drive to improve processes through automation

**How Success Is Measured**

* Accurate and timely filings, with minimal review comments and no restatement risk
* Quality of technical memos and speed in resolving reporting questions
* Quality and usefulness of financial statement analysis presented to management
* Adoption of automation and process improvements that reduce cycle time
* Feedback from auditors, partners and team members on reliability and expertise

**About MakeOurHome**

MakeOurHome is an early-stage technology company building a mobile platform in the home space. As a small and growing team, we move quickly, work collaboratively, and expect team members to be comfortable wearing multiple hats.

We are looking for a highly organized, tech-savvy and proactive
**Operations & Technology Intern**
to work closely with our Founder & CEO and broader team.

This is a unique hybrid role combining
**executive support, startup operations and hands-on technology/product work**
. It is ideal for an early-career professional with a Computer Science, Information Technology or similar background who is organized, technically capable and interested in gaining exposure to both the business and technology sides of building a startup.

The position will begin as a
**90-day contract-to-hire role**
, with the opportunity to transition into a permanent position based on performance and company needs.

**Responsibilities**

**Product & Technology Support**

* Support the development, testing and maintenance of MakeOurHome's mobile application
* Assist with mobile application features, enhancements and bug fixes
* Participate in application testing, debugging and quality assurance
* Assist with API integrations and backend services
* Work with AWS cloud services and cloud-based development environments
* Use Git and GitHub for version control and team collaboration
* Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
* Document technical work, issues and solutions
* Help coordinate priorities and communication between technical team members, contractors and leadership
* Assist with product releases, feature tracking and technical project management

**Startup Operations**

* Help establish and maintain internal processes as the company grows
* Coordinate across product, technology, operations and outside partners
* Help manage projects and ensure tasks are completed on schedule
* Assist with various company initiatives and operational needs
* Help with light office management for our small Jersey City office
* Coordinate supplies, deliveries, building management and service providers as needed
* Identify problems, research solutions and take initiative to get things done

**Administrative Support**

* Manage the executive team’s calendar, meetings, scheduling and day-to-day priorities
* Handle correspondence, follow-ups and general administrative tasks
* Coordinate with team members, vendors, contractors and outside partners
* Track projects, deadlines, action items and deliverables
* Organize company documents, agreements, files and records
* Prepare documents, spreadsheets, presentations and meeting materials
* Assist with hiring, onboarding and HR-related administrative tasks
* Conduct research on vendors, tools, services and other business needs
* Follow up with internal and external stakeholders to keep projects moving

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in
  **Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a similar field**
* Coursework, projects or experience involving mobile application development
* Familiarity with technologies such as
  **React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, Android or iOS**
* Knowledge of one or more programming languages such as
  **JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Python or C++**
* Familiarity with AWS or other cloud technologies
* Basic understanding of REST APIs, databases and Git/GitHub
* Strong proficiency with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets and Drive
* Excellent organizational and multitasking skills
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through
* Resourceful, proactive and comfortable figuring things out independently
* Comfortable working directly with a Founder/CEO
* Comfortable switching between technical, administrative and operational responsibilities
* Ability to handle confidential information professionally and with discretion
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment

**Ideal Candidate**

You may be a strong fit if you're early in your career and don't want to be limited to one function.

You might spend part of your day helping test a new mobile feature or working with the development team, another part coordinating an important project, and another helping the Founder prepare for a meeting or making sure an operational issue gets resolved.

We are looking for someone who is
**technically capable, extremely organized, curious and willing to take ownership**
.

Because we're a small team, there will be significant exposure to how an early-stage technology company is built—from product development and engineering to hiring, operations and executive decision-making.

As the company grows, this role can evolve based on the individual's strengths, performance and interests.

title: Technical Editor
description:
**Reporting to - Head of Publishing Operations**

**About Packt**

Packt's mission is to help the world put software to work in new ways, through the delivery of effective learning and information services to IT professionals. We are a technical publisher and learning provider with over 400 staff based across the globe, primarily in India and the UK. Our products have global relevance, and our multimedia portfolio includes over 7,000 books, e-books, audiobooks, and video courses.

For more details, visit www.packtpub.com.

**Role Overview**

As a technical editor, you will work in partnership with content creators and editors to create high-quality products on time, according to the publishing plan. You own the product’s technical accuracy, working with the content creator and other internal stakeholders from the delivery of the first draft of the content to publication. The TE is an editorial quality-control role. The goal of editorial is to raise the revenue performance of every product by understanding content creator and user needs and the market we're publishing into.

The role is ideal for methodical thinkers who can carry out efficient and purposeful code testing, using excellent technical skills. You will adopt an advisory role with content creators, using firm and diplomatic communication to help them understand the technical concerns that you have. This will lead to accurate technical content that allows readers to easily learn about new technologies and develop new skills.

The TE will, in addition to the above, work on different product types to ensure they all meet the standards expected by our customers. These product types may be derived products, such as an audiobook or course based on a book. They may be new products created through market and user research.

This demands a strong focus on quality from TEs: you will understand the level of quality our customers expect and own this on your products. To do this you will have to seek customer feedback throughout the editorial process and apply this during your testing. It is vital you keep track of new tech releases and user trends.

**What You Will Do**

**Technical:**

* Ensure technical accuracy of the content: test all code in the product, as well as all code in the code bundle, ensuring they match
* Follow along with all examples and steps in the product
* Address any other technical concerns you find in the book (technical facts, references, screenshots, architecture, approach, and so on)
* Ensure code indentation is accurate and that the code remains consistent throughout the content
* Verify content coverage thoroughly to ensure technical accuracy
* Perform quality checks on code-related Amazon reviews, errata, and GitHub issues
* Manage book repositories on GitHub and resolve any reader queries alongside the customer care team
* Support the team to improve code repositories and code-testing systems
* Research technology innovations to deepen your tech. knowledge in your vertical’s topic area
* Connect to users and research to deepen your knowledge of users in your vertical’s topic area
* Keep up with market changes that could impact the delivery or success of a product, for example, tech. version updates and competing titles

**Editorial:**

* Function as a reader advocate for your book from a technical point of view
* Query the author if any part of the code isn’t clear
* Provide a technical health check for the portfolio director to facilitate accurate planning and time allocation
* Carry out user research and market analysis to elevate your work
* Work with technical reviewers to ensure technical accuracy of the content and code. Use this to build up an understanding of the book and its audience
* Own the technical quality of a product: sign off the technical aspects of a product for production; advise on whether a product is suitable for cancellation
* Navigate the optimum balance of quality and timeliness in dialog with the rest of the product team
* Apply the Packt styles to the content and ensure the formatting follows the Packt style sheet

**Author/Expert management:**

* Provide detailed and constructive feedback to content creators using the appropriate tone to suggest the necessary actions that will ensure that the technical content matches the proposition and meets Packt’s quality standards
* Build positive yet challenging relationships to get the most from content creators

**Who You Are**

You are a logical, efficient technical editor with a strong passion for creating high-quality, technical content. You possess a good understanding of technology and are skilled at code testing. You work collaboratively with authors, editors, and technical reviewers, balancing high standards with commercial and product goals. You thrive in dynamic environments and continuously seek to optimize processes and workflows to deliver exceptional content.

**Must-have skills:**

* Technology testing: good working knowledge of at least one technology to the level that you can test code and examples in that domain area
* Quality assurance: rigorous attention to detail with a proven track record of ensuring content quality, accuracy, and consistency
* Technical content understanding: strong ability to interpret and convey complex technical concepts clearly for diverse audiences
* Research: the ability to get up to speed on an unfamiliar technology so you can test and evaluate technical content in that topic
* Author relationship management: the ability to build relationships with authors, providing constructive feedback and ensuring their vision is realized
* Stakeholder communication: good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders

**Good-to-have skills:**

* Process optimization: ability to identify inefficiencies and suggest improvements in quality-control processes and workflows
* Adaptability: ability to adapt quickly to changing requirements and navigate ambiguity in fast-paced environments

**Why Work at Packt**

We are a global and remote-first business with most of our team based in India and the UK. We recognize how important our people are and acknowledge and support the things that are important to them. Our culture is open and informal and based around learning. We love sharing ideas and we want everyone to feel that they have an input into how the business works. We are a fun place to work but with a focus on performance and personal development providing opportunities for personal growth and career progression. We try to achieve this by:

* Ensuring a positive working environment for all team members, supportive of flexible and remote work.
* Supporting individual development through growth opportunities and internal mobility.
* Encouraging social collaboration within teams and communities and knowledge-sharing.
* Fostering a culture that supports a healthy work-life balance.

We focus on the full employee experience. We seek to achieve this by:

* Providing a broad range of benefits and initiatives.
* Advocating a healthy lifestyle where wellbeing is seen as an essential responsibility.
* Celebrating success stories and encouraging peer-to-peer recognition.
* Fostering a culture of self-development.
* Providing a work environment where the best idea wins, and challenges are encouraged.

**Benefits:**

You will also have access to a range of flexible benefits that are designed to help you make the most of your time with us.

Bonus scheme

5 day working week

25 days annual holiday (plus bank holidays)

Flexible hours: choose how, when, and where you work within India

Training programs and Certification

Group Medical Insurance

Wellness initiatives

**Salary Range - INR 25 - 40K fixed pay per month (skills and/or experience dependent)**

**Disclaimer: Packt does not authorize any third-party consultancies, influencers, or agencies to offer employment opportunities on our behalf. We are not involved in any financial transactions with these parties. Our hiring process is managed internally, and all applications should be made through the official procedures outlined in our job listings.**

title: Implementation Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Base.com is an all-in-one ecommerce management platform designed for brands that are ready to scale efficiently. Trusted by over 30,000 sellers, including global brands such as Samsung, Philips, and Decathlon, Base centralizes operations across product listings, inventory, orders, and fulfillment. With more than 1,500 integrations, including Shopify, Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, and QuickBooks, Base connects the entire commerce stack so teams can work faster and smarter. The platform replaces spreadsheets and disconnected tools with real-time visibility, smart automation, and flexible workflows, supporting businesses of all sizes and channel complexities. By offering a unified system, Base helps ecommerce teams streamline operations and accelerate growth in a rapidly evolving digital marketplace.
  
**Role Description**
The Implementation Specialist is a full-time, hybrid role based in India, with flexibility for some work-from-home arrangements. In this position, the specialist guides new and existing customers through the end-to-end implementation of Base.com’s ecommerce management platform, including requirements gathering, configuration, data migration, and onboarding. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with clients to understand their workflows, setting up integrations with marketplaces and tools, conducting system testing, and delivering training sessions to help teams adopt the platform effectively. The role also involves troubleshooting implementation issues, documenting processes and best practices, and coordinating with product, engineering, and customer success teams to ensure smooth go-live experiences. An Implementation Specialist is expected to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction by providing clear communication, proactive support, and continuous improvement recommendations.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret client requirements, assess data quality, and optimize implementation workflows.
* Candidates should possess Software Implementation experience, including configuring SaaS platforms, managing integrations, and supporting system testing.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction capabilities to build trust, respond to issues promptly, and drive successful onboarding outcomes.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills to explain technical concepts in simple terms, conduct training, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Prior experience in ecommerce, supply chain, or operations management is beneficial.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfort working in a hybrid setup, with strong self-organization and time management skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Product Support Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE PRODUCT SUPPORT SPECIALIST ROLE:
  
  
WIN is looking for
**Product Support Specialists**
to provide exceptional support to users of our cloud-based applications and digital products. You will develop a deep understanding of our products, business processes, and user needs to help users navigate features, troubleshoot issues, configure applications, and get the most value from our technology.
  
  
We are looking for people who are curious, resourceful, and highly user-focused. You should enjoy solving problems, learning how products work, and explaining solutions in a simple and empathetic way. You will also be expected to embrace AI and modern productivity tools to research issues faster, improve documentation, identify patterns, and make support more efficient and scalable.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
  
  

* Develop deep product and business knowledge to become a Subject Matter Expert across WIN's cloud-based applications, websites, and internal platforms.
* Support users by understanding their needs, answering product questions, explaining features, and helping them effectively navigate and utilize applications.
* Troubleshoot product and application issues, identify root causes, and provide timely and practical resolutions.
* Configure cloud-based applications and product settings based on user and business requirements.
* Manage and prioritize requests through the ticketing system, ensuring timely follow-up, accurate resolution, and a positive user experience.
* Use AI and modern productivity tools to accelerate issue research, summarize information, troubleshoot efficiently, and improve the quality and speed of support.
* Identify recurring questions, issues, and user pain points and use these insights to recommend improvements to products, processes, and support resources.
* Create and maintain clear product guides, FAQs, troubleshooting instructions, knowledge-base articles, and issue-resolution documentation.
* Leverage AI to help organize and improve knowledge content, while ensuring information shared with users is accurate, clear, and relevant.
* Support new product features, releases, and enhancements by understanding changes, testing user scenarios, updating documentation, and helping users adopt new functionality.
* Communicate resolutions and product guidance clearly to users and stakeholders, translating technical or product concepts into simple language.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, and other cross-functional teams to escalate issues, share user feedback, and improve the overall product experience.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
  
  

* 2–5 years of experience in Product Support, Application Support, SaaS Support, Technical Support, or a similar role supporting cloud-based business applications.
* Strong ability to understand software products, business workflows, and application functionality and translate that knowledge into effective user support.
* Hands-on experience with ticketing, help desk, CRM, or knowledge management platforms.
* Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or similar tools to research, summarize, document, and manage work more efficiently.
* Strong curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools, technologies, and more efficient ways of working.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate issues systematically.
* Strong user empathy and the ability to understand problems from the user's perspective rather than focusing only on the technical issue.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to explain complex concepts in simple, easy-to-understand terms.
* Ability to create clear and structured product documentation, FAQs, and knowledge-base content.
* Strong attention to detail, responsiveness, and ability to manage multiple user requests and priorities.
* Comfortable working in rotational shifts to support users across different time zones.
* Strong work ethic, high integrity, ownership mindset, and positive attitude.

WHAT WE OFFER:
  
  

* Highly inclusive and collaborative culture
* Opportunity to work closely with India-based and US-based teams
* Strong focus on learning, ownership, and growth
* 100% remote working flexibility

ABOUT WIN AND OUR CULTURE:
  
  
WIN is the #1 ranked inspection services company in the United States. Backed by 35 years of excellence, we are on a mission to build a global brand through cutting-edge technologies, AI-driven innovation, and operational excellence. WIN has the stability of an established leader as well as the energy of a fast-growing organization. We offer like-minded professionals a unique opportunity for meaningful personal and professional growth.

* The opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology in an environment that encourages you to be creative, innovative, and to make an impact.

As a member of the GCS Organization for the MSA (Multiphysics System Analysis), you will partner with world-wide Cadence customers to provide post sales technical consultation for IC level Power System analysis products for implementing cutting-edge designs. This involves working closely with the customers to understand and debug complex issues enabling them to proceed further with design cycle phases, help them leverage the latest tool capabilities, and guide them with implementation of software in their design methodologies. You will have an opportunity to acquire both breadth and depth of technical knowledge, get wide exposure to the latest design practices in industry and demonstrate expertise by authoring high impact knowledge content.
  
  
This role also provides opportunity to participate in the evolution of key technology solutions to the most pressing design problems. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with product teams to identify and prioritize the product improvement initiatives with your timely feedback and observations.
  
  
This an excellent opportunity to work in a supportive, flexible and friendly work environment that GCS offers, where we are vested in each other’s success, and are passionate about technology and innovation.

* Provide technical support for Voltus product from the Multiphysics System Analysis (MSA) toolset of Cadence products with focus on productivity, and customer satisfaction

* Assist in creation of high quality and impactful knowledge content in MSA domain
* Work independently at Cadence or customer facilities to deliver quality results according to schedule requirements
* Work on problems of moderate scope that may require analysis of situations, data or tool problems

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in; Electrical / Electronics / Electronics and Communication / VLSI Engineering with 5-7 years related experience
* OR Masters with 3-4 years of related experience
* OR PhD with 1 years of related experience

**Experience And Technical Skills Required**

* 3-7 years relevant industry experience in EMIR analysis, PDN analysis with digital signoff tools and Digital Physical implementation as designer or methodology/flow expert
* Strong background in Digital logic Design, CMOS logic Design, Power IR drop analysis, Circuit Design and Analysis, Digital and Behavioral simulation fundamentals related to IC and Package Design
* Debugging of Low power and multiple power domain analysis for chip power integrity sign-off.
* Understanding of Digital design toolsets of Cadence (Genus/Innovus/Tempus/Conformal); knowledgeable of at least 50% of a given flow; detailed knowledge in one CDN tool, learning others; ability to analyze customer's environment and evaluate appropriate support solutions; learning competitive tools/technologies
* Must have excellent debugging skills and ability to separate out the critical issues from trivial ones.
* Ability to solve interface level problems emanating from IC Implementation side and System analysis side.
* Ability to debug Timing and thermal issues in relation to IR and EM is a plus
* Good understanding of Hardware description languages like VHDL, Verilog, System Verilog.

**Behavioral Skills Required**

* Ability to establish a close working relationship with both customer peers and management

title: Lead Engineer - Systems Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
  
  
Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**

* Effectue l'intégration des composants et des produits. Toutes les activités qui englobent plusieurs composants et produits et concernées par l'intégration des solutions pour une performance et une opérabilité maximales. Gère les exigences, les spécifications et les flux de produits et de systèmes. Dirige les activités de validation et de vérification pour l'ensemble du produit/système, comprenant les tests au niveau du système. Responsable de la définition des exigences produits pour les équipes module/composant/sous-traitants et partenaires. Gère l'interface entre les composants et les organisations d'exécution. Responsable de la gestion des transactions de CTQ/Risque au sein des équipes chargées de la conception des composants. Gère la configuration globale du produit et le système de contrôle de la configuration.
* Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.
* Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions.
* Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe.

**Qualifications De Base**


* Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).

**Caractéristiques souhaitées**

* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. The candidate will be responsible for implementing effective SEO strategies, optimizing websites for search engines, monitoring performance, and helping clients achieve their organic growth objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Conduct keyword research to identify relevant, high-traffic, and target-oriented keywords for international markets.

- Conduct technical SEO audits to identify and resolve issues related to crawlability, indexing, site structure, page speed, and mobile usability.

- Analyze competitors' SEO strategies and identify opportunities to improve organic rankings.

- Optimize website content based on search intent, keyword relevance, and SEO best practices.

- Implement local SEO strategies, including Google Business Profile optimization and local citation building, wherever applicable.

- Monitor website performance, keyword rankings, organic traffic, and conversions using Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console.

- Identify and resolve website errors affecting SEO performance, coordinating with content writers and developers when required.

- Perform regular website audits and prepare actionable SEO recommendations.

- Track SEO campaign progress and prepare weekly and monthly performance reports.

- Stay updated with Google algorithm updates, SEO trends, and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with content, development, and digital marketing teams to achieve SEO objectives.

- Ensure all SEO activities follow search engine guidelines and ethical, white-hat SEO practices.

+ Familiarity with hardware lifecycle processes including provisioning, refresh, returns, and disposal coordination.
+ Experience providing smart hands support for network, service, or infrastructure related onsite activities.

title: Project Quality Engineer
description:
Hiring: Project Quality Engineer

Location: Sanand, Gujarat, India

Industry: Automotive Manufacturing

Department: Quality / New Product Development

Reporting to: Project Manager(s)

Experience: 3–6 years (automotive manufacturing preferred)

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented Project Quality Engineer to manage quality planning and execution throughout the project lifecycle, from new product development and customer approval to production launch and final handover. The role will work closely with Project Managers and cross-functional teams to ensure product quality, compliance with customer-specific requirements, timely completion of quality deliverables, and readiness for mass production.

Key Responsibilities

1. Project Quality Planning

\* Develop and maintain project-specific quality plans, inspection plans, and quality deliverables in line with customer requirements.

\* Prepare and coordinate APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) activities and maintain project quality milestones.

\* Coordinate the preparation and review of PFMEA, DFMEA inputs, Process Flow Diagrams, Control Plans, and Process Capability studies.

\* Ensure compliance with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, customer-specific requirements, and applicable automotive quality standards.

\* Identify project quality risks and coordinate preventive actions with relevant stakeholders.

2. New Product Development & Launch

\* Coordinate quality activities from prototype and sample development through validation, customer approval, and mass-production launch.

\* Plan and monitor prototype, pre-launch, and production-stage inspections and testing.

\* Coordinate PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) documentation and submission, including dimensional reports, material and performance test reports, MSA, SPC, and other applicable requirements.

\* Ensure timely closure of customer observations and approval-related open points.

\* Verify process readiness and quality documentation before production handover.

3. Cross-Functional Project Coordination

\* Work closely with Project Managers, Production, Process Engineering, Design/R&D, Supplier Quality, Purchase, and Customer Quality teams.

\* Track quality-related project milestones, deliverables, risks, and pending actions.

\* Participate in project review meetings and provide updates on quality status, delays, risks, and corrective actions.

\* Coordinate trial runs, pilot production, engineering changes, and validation activities.

\* Ensure changes to drawings, specifications, materials, processes, and tooling are assessed, approved, and documented before implementation.

4. Problem Solving & Corrective Actions

\* Lead or coordinate root-cause analysis for project-related defects and launch issues using 5 Why, Fishbone, 8D, and other structured problem-solving methods.

\* Monitor containment, corrective, and preventive actions and verify their effectiveness.

\* Coordinate resolution of dimensional, material, functional, and process-related quality issues.

\* Maintain a lessons-learned register and ensure recurring issues are prevented in subsequent projects.

5. Supplier & Customer Quality Coordination

\* Coordinate with Supplier Quality and suppliers on new component development, supplier PPAP, sample approval, and supplier-related project issues.

\* Support customer audits, process audits, product audits, and quality reviews as required.

\* Ensure customer-specific quality documentation and approval requirements are completed on time.

\* Facilitate timely closure of customer complaints or concerns associated with new launches and project changes.

6. Production Readiness & Documentation

\* Verify availability and completeness of inspection standards, Control Plans, work instructions, gauges, measuring equipment, and quality records before launch.

\* Monitor trial production results, first-off inspections, dimensional conformity, and process capability.

\* Ensure measurement systems are validated and inspection equipment is calibrated.

\* Maintain traceability of samples, inspection results, approvals, deviations, and engineering changes.

\* Support safe and controlled transition from project development to regular production.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

\* On-time completion of project quality milestones and deliverables.

\* On-time PPAP submission and customer approval.

\* First-pass yield and right-first-time performance during trials and launch.

\* Number and severity of launch-related defects and customer complaints.

\* Timely closure and effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions.

\* Compliance with APQP, Control Plan, PFMEA, and other required quality documentation.

\* Supplier quality approval and incoming quality performance for new projects.

\* Reduction in repeat defects, rework, and scrap attributable to project or launch issues.

\* Audit findings and timely closure of non-conformities.

\* Production handover completed with all mandatory quality approvals and documentation.

Required Qualifications & Skills

\* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Mechanical, Production, Automobile, or a related engineering discipline.

\* 3–6 years of experience in quality engineering within automotive or precision manufacturing.

\* Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, Control Plans, MSA, SPC, 8D, and root-cause analysis.

\* Familiarity with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, and customer-specific requirements.

\* Experience with dimensional inspection, engineering drawings, GD&T, and measuring instruments.

\* Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage multiple project deliverables.

\* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.

\* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and quality documentation systems.

Preferred Experience

\* Experience in automotive OEM or Tier-1 manufacturing environments.

\* Exposure to new product development, process validation, pilot runs, and mass-production launches.

\* Experience with metal components, formed or fabricated parts, machining, wheel/rim assemblies, or similar automotive products.

\* Knowledge of customer approval systems and automotive core tools.

Interested candidates: Apply through LinkedIn with an updated resume highlighting relevant automotive project quality, APQP/PPAP, and product-launch experience.

title: Senior Proposal Writer
description:
**Role**
We are looking for someone who can do much more than write grammatically correct paragraphs. A winning proposal writer understands what the evaluator is asking, why they are asking it, what evidence will make the response credible and how to make the answer easy to score. You should be willing to tell an SME, 'This technically answers the question, but it will not win us points - we need to make it stronger.' You should be comfortable starting with a blank page, interviewing busy subject-matter experts, challenging vague statements, finding proof for claims and turning fragmented input into a clear and compelling story. Most importantly, we want someone who treats the final submission as their personal product.
  
  
Proposal Development
  
  

* Analyze RFPs, RFQs and RFIs and translate requirements into compliant response structures.
* Develop proposal outlines, compliance matrices and writing plans.
* Draft and edit executive summaries, technical approaches, management plans, transition plans, implementation approaches, staffing plans, quality-management approaches, past performance, corporate experience and other response sections.
* Adapt content to the agency and requirement rather than relying on generic boilerplate.

SME Collaboration
  
  

* Conduct focused interviews with technical, delivery, recruiting, finance and management SMEs.
* Translate technical concepts into clear evaluator-friendly language.
* Identify unanswered requirements, unsupported claims and weak differentiators.
* Own follow-ups required to complete assigned sections.

Proposal Strategy & Review
  
  

* Apply established win themes, differentiators and customer priorities throughout the response.
* Connect features to customer outcomes and measurable benefits.
* Participate in structured reviews and incorporate feedback quickly.
* Perform compliance, consistency and quality checks, including contradictions between technical, management, staffing, schedule and pricing narratives.

Content Library
  
  

* Develop and continuously improve reusable proposal content.
* Maintain past-performance narratives, case studies, corporate qualifications and recurring technical/management responses.
* Retire outdated or weak content rather than blindly reusing it.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Provide day-to-day writing guidance and coaching to the existing Proposal Writer.
* Establish writing examples and quality standards.
* Help improve the team's ability to write concise, persuasive and evaluator-friendly responses.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 4-7 years of professional proposal-writing experience.
* Direct experience responding to U.S. government RFPs; SLED experience strongly preferred.
* Excellent U.S. business English and professional editing ability.
* Demonstrated experience with compliance-driven proposals, compliance matrices and structured response outlines.
* Ability to understand IT and professional-services concepts sufficiently to write credible technical content.
* Strong research and interviewing skills and ability to manage multiple deadlines.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* APMP certification.

title: Manager - Technical Bid & Solution
description:
**Role**
This is not a traditional Project Manager position. We are not looking for someone whose primary strength is maintaining Jira boards, scheduling meetings or updating project plans. We need someone who can read a 150-page government RFP and determine what Dash would actually have to build, migrate, integrate, test, deploy, support and manage if we win. The ideal person can move comfortably between technical and business conversations, challenge unrealistic assumptions, coordinate architects and engineers, build a credible delivery plan and make sure the proposal never promises something the delivery team cannot execute.
  
  
Technical RFP Analysis
  
  

* Analyze technical RFP requirements and decompose them into capabilities, workstreams, deliverables and dependencies.
* Identify mandatory technical requirements, integrations, security requirements, environments, data considerations, service levels and implementation constraints.
* Develop technical questions and clarification requests where requirements are ambiguous.

Solution Shaping
  
  

* Facilitate solution workshops with architects, developers, cloud/data specialists, project managers and other SMEs.
* Develop credible solution approaches for custom application development, modernization, cloud, data, AI, integration and managed-service engagements.
* Define scope boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and exclusions.
* Ensure proposed solutions are practical, supportable and aligned with Dash delivery capabilities.

Estimation & Delivery Planning
  
  

* Develop or coordinate work breakdown structures, staffing models, schedules, milestones and effort estimates.
* Validate whether the proposed team can realistically deliver within the requested schedule.
* Identify delivery risks and mitigation strategies and support pricing teams with clear resource, effort and timeline assumptions.

Technical Proposal Development
  
  

* Own or co-author technical approaches, implementation plans, transition plans, architecture narratives, project-management approaches and related proposal sections.
* Provide technical input to graphics, diagrams and solution architecture.
* Review technical proposal sections for accuracy, consistency and credibility.
* Participate in technical Red Team reviews.

Presentations & Pursuit-to-Delivery Continuity
  
  

* Support oral presentations, technical demonstrations, solution-defense sessions and clarification responses.
* Lead structured technical handoff after award so delivery receives proposal assumptions, commitments, staffing models, milestones and risks.
* Track lessons learned from actual project delivery and feed them back into future estimates and proposal approaches.

Reusable Solution Assets
  
  

* Develop reusable reference approaches for recurring SLED opportunities.
* Maintain solution patterns, estimation assumptions, team models and implementation approaches that can accelerate future pursuits.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 7-10+ years of experience across IT delivery, architecture, technical presales, solution consulting, bid management or technical project leadership.
* At least 3 years of meaningful involvement in RFP/RFI responses, presales or solutioning.
* Strong understanding of modern application development, cloud, integration, data and enterprise technology delivery.
* Ability to estimate teams, effort, timelines and implementation dependencies.
* Strong understanding of project risks, assumptions and delivery governance.
* Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong professional writing and presentation skills and willingness to challenge unrealistic assumptions.

**Preferred Qualifications / Experience**

* U.S. public-sector or government-bid experience.
* Experience with Azure, AWS or Google Cloud.
* PMP, Scrum, SAFe, cloud or architecture certifications.
* Experience with AI/ML, data platforms, application modernization or systems integration.
* Experience supporting fixed-price or deliverables-based IT services proposals.

The Personality We Are Looking For
  
  

* Wants to understand how things actually work rather than repeating buzzwords.
* Challenges an estimate that does not make sense.
* Is comfortable saying, "We should not promise this unless we can prove how we will deliver it."
* Connects commercial promises to delivery reality.
* Takes ownership from RFP analysis through award handoff.
* Can work effectively with strong technical personalities.
* Is practical, curious, organized and decisive.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Within the first 90 days, major solution-based pursuits should have clearer scope, assumptions, estimates, staffing models, timelines and technical narratives, with stronger continuity between what Dash sells and what Dash ultimately delivers.
