title: Tender Executive
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive
**Tender Executive**
to identify relevant government and private-sector tenders, prepare and submit bids, and manage e-procurement portals. The candidate will be responsible for tracking tender opportunities related to e-waste recycling, waste management, scrap disposal, EPR compliance, reverse logistics, and environmental services.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have prior experience in tender management, bid documentation, government procurement portals, and online tender submission processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Tender Identification and Monitoring
* Regularly monitor government and public-sector tender portals, including GeM (Government e-Marketplace), CPPP, state e-procurement portals, and relevant private-sector platforms.
* Identify suitable tender opportunities related to e-waste collection, recycling, disposal, EPR compliance, scrap disposal, reverse logistics, and waste management.
* Evaluate tender eligibility, scope of work, submission deadlines, Earnest Money Deposit (EMD), tender fees, turnover requirements, experience criteria, and technical specifications.
* Maintain a structured tender tracker covering upcoming, active, submitted, and awarded tenders.
* Track tender amendments, corrigenda, pre-bid meetings, and deadline extensions.
* Tender Documentation and Bid Preparation
* Prepare and compile technical bids, financial bids, commercial proposals, and supporting documentation.
* Draft covering letters, declarations, undertakings, compliance statements, and other documents required by tendering authorities.
* Coordinate the collection and verification of company documents, including GST registration, PAN, CIN, audited financial statements, turnover certificates, work orders, experience certificates, and statutory records.
* Review tender conditions and ensure that all eligibility and documentation requirements are fulfilled before submission.
* Identify deviations, risks, missing documents, and compliance gaps, and escalate them to the concerned team before bid submission.
* Coordinate with internal departments to obtain technical, financial, and operational information required for preparing competitive bids.
* E-Procurement Portal Management
* Register and maintain company profiles on GeM, CPPP, state e-procurement portals, and other relevant procurement platforms.
* Manage Digital Signature Certificates (DSCs) and portal credentials securely.
* Upload tender documents, submit online bids, and complete all required e-procurement formalities within prescribed deadlines.
* Monitor portal notifications, technical clarifications, bid opening updates, and submission acknowledgements.
* Maintain organized records of tender documents, submission receipts, bid status, and related correspondence.
* Tender Pipeline and Reporting
* Maintain an updated database of tender opportunities, eligibility status, submission timelines, and outcomes.
* Prepare periodic reports on tenders identified, bids submitted, pending actions, and tenders awarded or rejected.
* Coordinate with management to prioritize suitable opportunities based on eligibility, commercial viability, and business requirements.
* Follow up on tender results, requests for clarification, technical evaluations, and financial bid openings.
* Maintain a systematic digital repository of tender-related documents for future reference.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in tender management, bid coordination, or e-procurement operations.
* Practical knowledge of GeM, CPPP, and/or state government e-procurement portals.
* Experience in preparing technical bids, financial bids, compliance documents, and commercial proposals.
* Understanding of tender eligibility criteria, EMD, tender fees, turnover requirements, and bid submission procedures.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, MS Word, and document management.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation, coordination, and deadline management.
* Good written communication skills and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external authorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience handling tenders related to e-waste recycling, scrap disposal, waste management, environmental services, or reverse logistics.
* Familiarity with EPR compliance, CPCB requirements, and relevant waste management regulations.
* Experience with government departments, PSUs, municipal corporations, industrial organizations, or institutional procurement.
* Knowledge of DSC-based online bid submission and tender portal registrations.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As an Aera Techno-Functional Senior, you will support the design, configuration, testing, and deployment of Decision Intelligence solutions. You will work with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate decision requirements into data, logic, user experience, and action-oriented solution components.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Gather and document business processes, decision points, KPIs, pain points, data needs, and expected outcomes.
* Convert functional requirements into solution designs covering data preparation, curated data views, rules, recommendations, workflows, user screens, and actions.
* Use SQL to profile, reconcile, transform, and validate data across source and curated datasets.
* Configure and test Aera solution components under the guidance of solution leads and architects.
* Prepare test scenarios, execute unit and functional testing, support user acceptance testing, and resolve defects.
* Create clear functional and technical documentation, including mappings, logic, assumptions, test evidence, and operating guidance.
* Collaborate with client teams, data engineers, developers, and project managers to manage dependencies and delivery risks.
* Support production deployment, hypercare, issue triage, and continuous improvement of deployed solutions.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute reusable delivery assets and best practices.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business analytics, supply chain, operations, finance, or a related field.
* Master’s degree or MBA from Tier 1 institute will be preferred.
* 5+ years of overall experience in technology consulting, analytics, enterprise applications, data solutions, or business process transformation.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, data quality checks, and performance-aware query design.
* Ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation in a techno-functional role.
* Experience with requirements gathering solution design, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Understanding of data models, integrations, business rules, workflows, and enterprise application delivery.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Prior hands-on Aera experience is a strong plus.
* Experience in Decision Intelligence, supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial, or finance use cases.
* Exposure to cloud data platforms, APIs, ETL/ELT, reporting, Python, or advanced analytics.
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models and distributed global teams.

**What We Look For**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery-focused mindset.
* Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**

**How to Apply**

Job Overview:
  
  
Bureau Veritas is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Bid Coordinator to support the Building & Infrastructure (B&I) business in the preparation and submission of proposals and tender documents.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for coordinating tender activities, compiling proposal submissions, liaising with internal stakeholders and affiliates, ensuring compliance with client requirements, and supporting the business in securing new opportunities. The ideal candidate will have experience in proposal preparation, tender coordination, bid administration, sales support, or project coordination, preferably within the construction, engineering, consultancy, testing, inspection, or certification industries.

Proposal & Tender Management
  
  

* Review tender invitations, RFPs, RFQs, and client requirements.
* Prepare, compile, and submit tender and proposal documents in accordance with client requirements and submission deadlines.

Stakeholder Coordination

Documentation & Compliance
  
  

* Ensure all tender submissions comply with client requirements and company procedures.
* Maintain proposal databases, tender registers, and documentation records.
* Organize and manage standard company documents, certifications, project references, and supporting materials for proposals.
* Ensure all submissions are complete, accurate, and professionally presented.

Administrative Support
  
  

* Assist in preparing proposal templates, presentations, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate meeting schedules and follow-up actions relating to tender and proposal activities.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance proposal quality and submission efficiency.
* Provide general administrative support relating to tender and proposal management.

Education

**Experience**

* Fresh graduates with strong organizational and communication skills are welcome to apply.
* Experience in the construction, engineering consultancy, testing, inspection, or certification industry will be an advantage.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Familiarity with tendering and proposal submission processes.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Strong document management and administrative capabilities.
* Ability to compile and review large volumes of documentation accurately.

Competencies
  
  

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proactive, resourceful, and able to work independently.
* Team player with a customer-focused mindset.

**Preferred Experience**

title: Assistant Engineer - Sales (Entry Level)

With nearly three decades of experience in motion control, Arkmotion is a trusted designer and manufacturer of precision motion systems and high-performance motion control solutions for OEM applications. Through changing technologies and evolving market demands, we have continuously adapted, innovated and grown our capabilities.

Our portfolio includes Low Voltage Servo Drives (PMSM/BLDC, Stepper & DC), Multi-Axis & Single Axis Servo Drives, high-speed FOC BLDC drives, centrifugal blowers, joint modules, BLDC motors, wheel drive solutions, frameless motors, hub motors and integrated motion solutions.

Our technologies serve diverse industries including medical, robotics, automation, logistics & warehousing (AGV/AMR), textile, aerospace and industrial manufacturing.

**Job Description**
**Supervising Associate – Service Excellence**
**Job Summary**
Talent Services act as operational business partners to regional talent teams and global functions, offering dedicated support to candidates and employees. Team provides expert advise and facilitate scalable, high-quality services at an economical cost model. We are a crucial part of the EY global talent operating model, supporting its ‘All In’ strategy.
  
  
Support the analysis, mapping, and re imagining of Talent processes as part of EY GDS Service Excellence and Enablement transformation initiatives, with strong ownership of process artefacts, governance, and documentation quality across the deployment lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Role And Responsibilities**
The role supports EY GDS Enablement Services by executing high quality process analysis and documentation for Talent transformation programmes. The Supervising Associate will work closely with Config, Product, Business Analysis, Data, and Change & Integration teams to ensure that current state and future state Talent processes are accurately mapped, validated, governed, and ready for deployment, while embedding Service Excellence, continuous improvement, and change readiness principles.
  
  
**Process Analysis, Mapping & Documentation Excellence**

* Document current state (L4) and future state (L5) Talent processes using standard programme templates and EY methodologies.
* Develop and maintain L5 blueprints, user journeys (UJs), swimlane diagrams, and process variants, ensuring traceability to design decisions and business outcomes.
* Perform structured analysis of process variants, edge cases, handoffs, and dependencies across Talent sub processes.
* Update UJs, L4s, and L5s in line with configuration, design, data, and integration decisions.
* Support creation of methods documents and process playbooks where required.

**Delivery Support, Governance & Execution Discipline**

* Participate in design workshops, playback sessions, focus groups, and usability testing; take structured, decision oriented notes and translate them into validated artefacts.
* Maintain the Process & Enablement (P&E) repository, documentation tracker, and version control logs to ensure audit ready governance.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned deliverables with disciplined execution, accuracy, and attention to detail.
* Act as a Business Analyst for Talent technology initiatives where process design is tightly coupled with system implementation.

* Support development of training materials, job aids, and playback decks aligned to future state processes.
* Consolidate and synthesize insights from focus groups and usability tests to improve design and adoption readiness.
* Support broader continuous improvement and transformation initiatives within Talent and Enablement Services.

**Skills & Experience Required**

* Hands on experience supporting process transformation, technology enablement, or large scale deployments.
* Prior exposure to global delivery / shared services / consulting environments preferred.

* Strong attention to detail, logical structuring, and process thinking.
* Proficiency with Visio, Excel, PowerPoint, and structured documentation templates.
* Ability to collaborate with Config, Product, BA, Data, and Change & Integration stakeholders to refine artefacts.
* Strong written and visual communication skills suitable for senior stakeholder playback.
* Foundational understanding of process re engineering, metrics, and quality concepts (Lean / Six Sigma exposure is an advantage).
* Comfort working in fast paced transformation programmes with evolving requirements.

We invite you to take on this crucial role to facilitate transformative change and enhance excellence within our Talent service delivery operations. Your leadership and expertise will be essential in achieving our objectives and upholding EY’s standard of excellence.

* Process Reengineering and Technology mindset

* Change Management, Adaptability and Agility

Focus on finding solutions and is willing to ask questions to develop creative resolutions. Genuine, approachable, and capable of uniting a team to work collaboratively towards a shared vision.

From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

title: Senior Account Executive - Enterprise Sales
description:
About Superleap

Superleap is an enterprise AI CRM built for sales productivity. It's fast, flexible, and intuitive, with AI built into the core rather than added on later.

We started in India's $2B+ CRM market and are now going after the $70B+ global one. The goal is simple: build a CRM good enough, and a service layer good enough, that companies stop dreading their CRM.

Role Summary

The Enterprise Account Executive at Superleap owns full-cycle enterprise sales — from

sourcing and qualification to multi-stakeholder closure. You will sell ₹50L–₹2Cr+ ACV deals into

complex organizations, navigating CXOs, procurement, legal, and IT stakeholders while driving

urgency and structured decision-making.

This is not a brand-led selling role. You will create demand, build credibility from scratch, and

convert qualified pipeline into revenue in a fast-moving, early-stage environment. If you thrive

in high-ownership roles and are comfortable closing without a large brand safety net, this role

is for you.

The Problem We're Solving

Most enterprise teams are held hostage by their own software. Instead of unlocking productivity, legacy CRMs have become a burden — static, unintuitive, and disconnected from real operations.

Superleap is redefining the CRM category by building a fast, flexible, AI-native
**System of Intelligence**
, with AI at its core rather than bolted on as an afterthought. Our mission is to deliver a 10x superior product and service that handles enterprise complexity at scale.

To disrupt this $70B+ global market, we need Enterprise Account Executives who go beyond following a script. We need
**Deal Architects**
who can navigate complexity, create urgency, and drive meaningful change in how enterprises sell.

Ideal Candidate

* High ownership mindset, strong bias for action, and thrives in early-stage startup environments.
* 3–6 years of total experience with a proven sales track record.
* Ideally, 2–3 years at a large SaaS organization (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.), followed by 1–2 years at a high-growth startup.
* Proven ability to create demand from scratch and sell a newer brand without relying on inbound leads.
* Track record of closing ₹50L–₹2Cr+ ACV deals.
* Experience navigating complex enterprise buying cycles and multi-stakeholder negotiations.
* Hands-on sourcing approach with the ability to build pipeline independently.
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS platforms, sales processes, and terminology.

Roles and Responsibilities

**1. End-to-End Enterprise Deal Mastery**

* Own the full sales cycle, from cold outreach to contract closure.
* Deliver compelling demos that translate AI-native capabilities into business value.
* Lead strategic negotiations for high-value deals (₹40L–₹2Cr+ ACV), defending Superleap’s value against legacy competitors.

**2. Non-Brand Demand Creation**

* Build a self-sourced pipeline through proactive outreach, cold calling, and targeted prospecting.
* Establish credibility and generate demand for Superleap among enterprise buyers.
* Drive urgency, manage next steps, and accelerate enterprise sales cycles.

**3. Complex Multi-Stakeholder Navigation**

* Map and engage buying committees, including champions, decision-makers, and economic buyers.
* Lead technical discovery with CTOs, CISOs, and IT stakeholders on APIs, data security, and integrations.
* Navigate enterprise procurement, legal reviews, and information security assessments.

**4. Technical Understanding & Execution Discipline**

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of enterprise CRM workflows, APIs, integrations, and AI capabilities.
* Maintain disciplined forecasting and pipeline hygiene using frameworks such as MEDDIC or BANT.
* Own deal outcomes end-to-end, taking accountability for wins and losses.

Why You Should Join Now?

Superleap grew 10x in 2025 and has kept growing over 25% month-over-month for the last six months. We're early enough that equity still matters at seed-stage multiples, and late enough that the product is proven: some of the biggest brands in their industries have already switched from legacy CRMs to Superleap.

title: Enterprise Account Executive-Insurance, Healthcare & Financial Services
description:
**Role:Account Executive – Insurance, Healthcare & Financial Services**

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India

**Work Model:**
Hybrid

**Experience: 5+years**

If you've been selling into carriers, hospitals, banks or wealth managers and hitting your number for someone else, come own the territory here.

**About Engineersmind**

Engineersmind builds AI-powered products and delivers digital engineering for regulated industries. We are a team of 150+ engineers, product and delivery people across Jersey City, Dublin, Dubai, Noida and Bengaluru. We are profitable and growing without outside capital.

**Our Products**

Our five products are built for the buyers you already know:

* **CXHealth:**
  A remote patient monitoring and care-coordination platform in production with health systems and payers, and our most-referenced deployment.
* **InsuredDesk:**
  AI-powered policyholder engagement and agency automation for US independent insurance agencies, built TCPA-first and integrated with the agency management systems agencies already run.
* **Fylix:**
  An enterprise wealth management and advisory platform for RIAs, broker-dealers and private banks. It includes an advisor workspace, client portal, portfolio and account aggregation with custodian integrations, and embedded analytics, with role-based access for advisors, assistants, clients and leadership.
* **XCSM:**
  A client engagement and governance platform for wealth managers and banks, designed around the AI-governance guidance regulators are now issuing to licensed financial institutions.
* **PollenX:**
  Our private AI layer: models, guardrails and audit trails deployed inside a client's own cloud or data center, for institutions that will not send data to public models.

**Our Engagements**

Around the products, we deliver fixed-scope, fixed-price engagements:

* AI Readiness & Governance Review (3 weeks)
* Six-Week AI Pilot
* Compliance-Readiness Sprint against a named regulation
* Data Foundations Assessment
* Private AI Landing Zone

These are the doors. Multi-year platform work is what is behind them. Our marketing is already producing the signal: senior buyers engaging with our campaigns, attending our webinars and visiting our site. What we need is a closer who turns that signal into meetings, and meetings into contracts.

**The Role**

You'll work a defined book of named Tier 1 and Tier 2 accounts across the target markets.

**Target industries include:**

* Carriers and MGAs
* Health systems and health plans
* Regional and mid-market banks
* RIAs and wealth managers

**What you'll own:**

* A six-month ramp, with a stepped quota and a non-recoverable draw
* An annual quota based on first-year contract value
* Intent data and account engagement signals to identify potential opportunities
* Entry engagements designed to expand into larger platform deals
* Enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders

**What You'll Do**

* Own the full sales cycle. Prospect, run discovery, build the business case, negotiate, close. No handoffs.
* Lead with a packaged offer. Every first conversation opens with one of our fixed-scope engagements, so the buyer gets a short, priced, low-risk yes. You expand from there.
* Get in front of the people who own the problem. Heads of Claims and Underwriting at insurers. CIOs, CMIOs and VPs of Revenue Cycle at health systems. Heads of Digital Transformation at banks. COOs, Chief Compliance Officers and Heads of Advisory at wealth firms.
* Be first on the trigger. New executives, funding rounds, regulatory deadlines, enforcement actions, revealing job posts. Marketing surfaces them; you are in the inbox within 48 hours with something specific to say.
* Multi-thread every account using Sales Navigator, webinars and executive content, so you never depend on a single champion.
* Mine your network. Five named introduction asks a week into customers, partners and former colleagues. Referrals convert at several times the rate of anything cold, and we protect the time for them.
* Run a disciplined pipeline in HubSpot. Every lead accepted or rejected with a reason, every touch logged, every opportunity with a dated next step. If it isn't in the CRM, it didn't happen.
* Partner with Marketing weekly to sharpen campaigns, case studies and targeting based on what you hear in the field.
* Travel as needed to close, including occasional overnight regional trips.

**Who you are**

* 4+ years closing B2B SaaS or technology-services deals.
* 2+ years selling into at least one of our verticals: insurance, healthcare, banking or wealth management. You don't need all four; deep expertise in one is what matters.
* A consistent record of hitting or exceeding quota on high-value deals, and at least one seven-figure deal you can walk us through.
* **Experience working with customers and markets in both India and the Middle East.**
* Comfortable selling AI and data products to compliance-conscious buyers. You can talk human-in-the-loop workflows, audit trails, model inventories and regulatory exposure with confidence, and you know when to bring in the product expert.
* Experienced with account-based selling, Sales Navigator and a modern CRM (HubSpot preferred).
* A strong writer and presenter. Your first email to a new CRO gets read because it is about them, not about us.
* Self-directed and hungry. You would rather be measured on outcomes than watched on activity.

**Why here**

You won't be one of 400 reps dialing the same list. You'll be one of a handful of sellers building the go-to-market for five products that are already generating senior-level demand, with a founder-led company behind you that has been shipping production software to regulated clients for years.

The accounts are identified, the content is running, the intent data is live, and a partnerships lead is opening doors with the carriers' and health plans' own technology vendors.

The gap between our pipeline and our revenue is a closer.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
Who Are We?
  
  
RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
  
  
We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
  
  
RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
India is one of the largest app markets in the world and the largest market in RZR's INSEA territory. We are hiring one of our first dedicated in-market sellers in India to build new business across user acquisition, retargeting and CTV — and to shape how RZR goes to market with Indian advertisers and agencies.
  
  
Reporting to the Head of Sales, INSEA, you will own the full sales cycle with India-based app marketers, consumer brands and media agencies, working closely with our Growth, Analytics, Marketing and Product teams to turn pipeline into revenue. This is a ground-floor role: you define the ICP, the agency strategy and the go-to-market approach for one of the world's largest app markets.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own the full sales cycle — from account identification and outreach to contract, launch and handoff — for new RZR customers in India
* Present RZR's UA, retargeting and CTV solutions to decision makers at app-first companies (fintech, e-commerce & quick commerce, OTT, gaming, consumer apps) and large consumer brands
* Build relationships with media agencies and their performance / programmatic units to win agency-led budgets, including CTV
* Build and maintain a tiered target account list using the INSEA account prioritization framework, and keep pipeline and forecast current in CRM
* Partner with Growth and Analytics to scope test plans, agree KPIs (CPI, CPA, ROAS, retention) and launch new customers successfully
* Leverage RZR marketing resources (case studies, content, events, ABM) to open doors and build brand awareness in India
* Represent RZR at India industry events and conferences
* Meet and exceed quarterly new business targets

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 7+ years of sales experience in programmatic or mobile advertising in India, including 4+ years selling performance solutions (UA, retargeting, DSP, ad networks) to app marketers
* A named list of accounts in India you can bring to RZR, backed by current relationships with growth / UA decision makers and agency performance leads
* Track record of closing new logos and meeting or exceeding quota — with numbers to show it
* Working knowledge of mobile measurement and performance concepts: MMPs and attribution, CPI / CPA / ROAS models, retargeting, Android-first supply
* Consultative seller who maps client KPIs to a solution and a test plan, and can present credibly to CMOs, growth heads and agency leads

**Nice to have:**

* Experience selling CTV or OTT advertising in India
* Relationships across fintech, quick commerce / e-commerce, OTT and gaming
* Has built a book of business from zero in a small or early-stage regional team

The RZR Code
  
  
Our Values
  
  
Our values define the company we want to be. They guide the decisions we make, the environment we create, and how we treat customers and each other.
  
  

* Win with Customers: We don't call it a win unless our clients win too. We earn long-term trust by putting their success at the center.
* One Team: No team wins when the company loses. We optimize for the company, not our function.
* Challenge with Respect: We say what we think and challenge ideas regardless of title. We are direct without being disrespectful.
* Learn Forward: Thoughtful experiments can fail; failing to learn from them cannot. Share what you learn.

Our Competencies
  
  
Our competencies define what we expect from each of us. They describe the behaviors and capabilities we demonstrate in our day-to-day work.
  
  

* Extreme Ownership: Own the outcome end to end, including problems you didn't create.
* Courage: Speak up, make hard calls, and take thoughtful risks.
* Move Fast: Act with urgency and decide with the information available.
* Curiosity: Ask why, look for better ways, and keep learning.
* Drive for Excellence: Set a high bar for quality and keep raising it.
* Deliver Results: Focus on outcomes that move the business forward.
* Proactive Communication: Share information early, before anyone has to ask.
* Manage Ambiguity: Make progress when the path isn't clear.

**RZR is an equal opportunity employer**
RZR is a place where everyone can grow. However you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.
  
  
RZR provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

* Partner closely with Sales Development Representatives, Solutions Architects, Customer Success, system integrators, and strategic channel partners to generate qualified opportunities, co-sell, and execute account strategies that drive new business and expansion

* Tailor your approach to each segment: a compliance- and risk-led value story for BFSI, and a modernisation-, productivity-, and consolidation-led story for enterprises and conglomerates with multiple business units
* Coordinate and facilitate the involvement of cross-functional GitLab team members, including sales leadership, marketing, product, legal, and support, to progress opportunities and deliver an excellent customer experience

**What You'll Bring**

* Deep experience driving complex B2B software sales cycles with large enterprise customers, ideally in DevSecOps, software development tools, or adjacent SaaS and infrastructure solutions that support the software development lifecycle
* A track record selling into BFSI institutions in India, with an understanding of their buying behaviour, long evaluation cycles, vendor risk assessments, and procurement processes (experience across both BFSI and large enterprises or conglomerates is a strong plus)
* Ability to prospect, build pipeline, and close new business while expanding strategic relationships within large accounts across Mumbai
* Strong understanding of modern software delivery, including CI/CD, secure development practices (DevSecOps, supply chain security), and cloud and infrastructure modernisation, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes
* Working familiarity with the regulatory and compliance landscape for Indian financial institutions, including data residency, audit, and security expectations, and comfort discussing on-premises, private cloud, and hybrid deployment models
* Proven ability to navigate and influence complex organisations, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders such as CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, heads of engineering, and technology risk and compliance leaders
* Experience creating and executing account plans for priority accounts, including opportunity mapping, multi-threaded engagement, and disciplined deal and account management
* Experience working with system integrators and channel partners to co-sell and deliver in the Indian market
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, including comfort leading customer presentations, negotiations, and executive-level conversations, and coordinating internal resources to move opportunities forward
* Capacity to work autonomously and asynchronously in a fully remote environment while staying aligned to shared goals, processes, and forecasting expectations across the broader GitLab team, with the flexibility to meet customers in person across Mumbai
* Familiarity with forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and reporting, including sharing learnings from wins and losses to improve repeatable sales motions

**Some examples of our projects**

* Building and growing a territory plan for Mumbai that balances large BFSI institutions (banks, NBFCs, insurers, asset managers, payments and fintech) with high-potential enterprises and conglomerates, from new logo prospecting through long-term expansion on GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform
* Leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and partnering with Solutions Architects, Sales Development, Customer Success, system integrators, and channel partners to position GitLab as a trusted platform for modern software delivery, security, and compliance in regulated and large-scale environments
* Helping BFSI customers consolidate fragmented toolchains and modernise legacy delivery pipelines while meeting regulatory, audit, and data-residency expectations

The Strategic Account Executive will join our enterprise sales team, which focuses on driving GitLab adoption with large customers in the India market. The team is responsible for the full relationship lifecycle with enterprise accounts, from initial engagement through long-term expansion and advocacy, ensuring customers realize value from GitLab’s DevSecOps platform. Team members work in an all-remote, distributed environment and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with sales leadership, solutions architects, customer success, marketing, and channel partners. The team is currently focused on maintaining and growing our existing footprint in the region, executing a consistent global sales motion while adapting to local customer needs and partnering closely with strategic channel organizations to reach and support key accounts.

title: Senior Account Executive
description:
**Who Are We?**
---------------

RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.

We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.

RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

India is one of the largest app markets in the world and the largest market in RZR's INSEA territory. We are hiring one of our first dedicated in-market sellers in India to build new business across user acquisition, retargeting and CTV — and to shape how RZR goes to market with Indian advertisers and agencies.

Reporting to the Head of Sales, INSEA, you will own the full sales cycle with India-based app marketers, consumer brands and media agencies, working closely with our Growth, Analytics, Marketing and Product teams to turn pipeline into revenue. This is a ground-floor role: you define the ICP, the agency strategy and the go-to-market approach for one of the world's largest app markets.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the full sales cycle — from account identification and outreach to contract, launch and handoff — for new RZR customers in India
* Present RZR's UA, retargeting and CTV solutions to decision makers at app-first companies (fintech, e-commerce & quick commerce, OTT, gaming, consumer apps) and large consumer brands
* Build relationships with media agencies and their performance / programmatic units to win agency-led budgets, including CTV
* Build and maintain a tiered target account list using the INSEA account prioritization framework, and keep pipeline and forecast current in CRM
* Partner with Growth and Analytics to scope test plans, agree KPIs (CPI, CPA, ROAS, retention) and launch new customers successfully
* Leverage RZR marketing resources (case studies, content, events, ABM) to open doors and build brand awareness in India
* Represent RZR at India industry events and conferences
* Meet and exceed quarterly new business targets

**Required Skills and Experience**
----------------------------------

* 7+ years of sales experience in programmatic or mobile advertising in India, including 4+ years selling performance solutions (UA, retargeting, DSP, ad networks) to app marketers
* A named list of accounts in India you can bring to RZR, backed by current relationships with growth / UA decision makers and agency performance leads
* Track record of closing new logos and meeting or exceeding quota — with numbers to show it
* Working knowledge of mobile measurement and performance concepts: MMPs and attribution, CPI / CPA / ROAS models, retargeting, Android-first supply
* Consultative seller who maps client KPIs to a solution and a test plan, and can present credibly to CMOs, growth heads and agency leads

**Nice to have:**

* Experience selling CTV or OTT advertising in India
* Relationships across fintech, quick commerce / e-commerce, OTT and gaming
* Has built a book of business from zero in a small or early-stage regional team

**The RZR Code**
----------------

### **Our Values**

Our values define the company we want to be. They guide the decisions we make, the environment we create, and how we treat customers and each other.

* **Win with Customers:** We don't call it a win unless our clients win too. We earn long-term trust by putting their success at the center.
* **One Team:** No team wins when the company loses. We optimize for the company, not our function.
* **Challenge with Respect:** We say what we think and challenge ideas regardless of title. We are direct without being disrespectful.
* **Learn Forward:** Thoughtful experiments can fail; failing to learn from them cannot. Share what you learn.

### **Our Competencies**

Our competencies define what we expect from each of us. They describe the behaviors and capabilities we demonstrate in our day-to-day work.

* **Extreme Ownership:** Own the outcome end to end, including problems you didn't create.
* **Courage:** Speak up, make hard calls, and take thoughtful risks.
* **Move Fast:** Act with urgency and decide with the information available.
* **Curiosity:** Ask why, look for better ways, and keep learning.
* **Drive for Excellence:** Set a high bar for quality and keep raising it.
* **Deliver Results:** Focus on outcomes that move the business forward.
* **Proactive Communication:** Share information early, before anyone has to ask.
* **Manage Ambiguity:** Make progress when the path isn't clear.

**RZR is an equal opportunity employer**

RZR is a place where everyone can grow. However you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.

RZR provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

title: Associate Director - IAM Operations and Governance
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**:

The Associate Director, IAM Operations and Governance will lead the team responsible for IAM audit controls and compliance governance across the identity estate. This hands-on role will set direction, translate strategy into an executable roadmap, assign clear ownership, remove delivery barriers and ensure commitments are completed to the required quality and timelines. The role will design and operate a modern, automated IAM control environment for SOX, GxP and other regulatory obligations, including continuous monitoring, evidence collection, control-to-evidence traceability, findings management and sustainable remediation. It will also lead the adoption of agentic AI and workflow automation to reduce manual effort, improve control effectiveness and provide audit-ready assurance.

**About the team:**

  

IAM Operations and Governance owns the control layer over GSK's identity estate: access certification, segregation of duties, identity risk reporting and the audit evidence that proves access is under control.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key initiatives:

  

* Lead the IAM controls, audit assurance and compliance governance capability, including its people, operating model, roadmap, delivery and outcomes; set clear priorities, delegate effectively and hold the team accountable for execution.
* Own the IAM control framework for SOX, GxP and other applicable regulatory and enterprise requirements, ensuring clear control objectives, ownership, frequency, procedures and accountability.
* Establish continuous controls monitoring across joiner, mover and leaver processes, access approvals, access certification, segregation of duties, privileged access, service accounts, orphaned accounts and excessive or stale access.
* Design and implement an automated control library that maps each control to its policy and regulatory requirement, systems in scope, control owner, required evidence, test procedure, exception criteria and remediation workflow.
* Apply Agentic AI and workflow automation to collect and validate evidence, detect control failures, identify missing or inconsistent artefacts, maintain traceability and initiate risk-based remediation with appropriate human oversight.
* Define safeguards for AI-enabled controls, including data protection, model governance, explainability, access restrictions, validation, audit logging, exception handling and human approval for material decisions.
* Lead internal and external IAM audits from planning through closure, ensuring that evidence is complete, accurate and timely, and serve as the principal liaison for auditors, Quality, Risk, Finance, Legal and control owners.
* Own findings, deficiencies and corrective and preventive actions, including root-cause analysis, risk assessment, accountable owners, target dates, validation of closure and prevention of recurrence.
* Define key control indicators, compliance dashboards and executive reporting covering control effectiveness, evidence completeness, exceptions, ageing, risk exposure and remediation progress.
* Partner with IAM engineering, application owners and business process owners to embed controls by design, simplify evidence production and reduce manual audit effort without weakening assurance; coordinate dependencies, resolve blockers and drive agreed actions through to completion.
* Build and lead a high-performing team through workforce planning, clear objectives, coaching, delegation, quality review and performance accountability, fostering a culture of ownership, compliance discipline, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* undefined

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Degree in information security, technology, risk, audit or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Substantial experience in IAM governance, risk and compliance, with ownership of audit controls in a complex, highly regulated enterprise.
* Strong working knowledge of SOX IT general controls and GxP requirements as they apply to identity lifecycle management, access governance, privileged access and electronic records.
* Proven experience designing control frameworks, risk and control matrices, test procedures, evidence requirements and control-to-regulation traceability.
* Hands-on experience managing access certifications, segregation of duties, privileged access controls, identity risk monitoring, audit requests and remediation of control deficiencies.
* Demonstrated ability to automate control monitoring, evidence collection, testing and issue workflows using IAM, GRC, ITSM, analytics or orchestration platforms.
* Practical understanding of Agentic AI, including multi-step agent workflows, tool integration, retrieval-based evidence analysis, governance guardrails and human-in-the-loop decision controls.
* Proven experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams and major programmes, translating strategy into executable plans, managing priorities and dependencies, and ensuring delivery through influence across Cyber Security, Quality, Finance, Internal Audit, Risk, Legal, Technology and business functions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate control performance and compliance risk into clear executive decisions

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Advanced experience with SailPoint, Saviynt or a comparable identity governance platform, including certification, policy, role and analytics capabilities.
* Knowledge of GxP computerised system controls, data integrity principles, electronic records and signatures, validation expectations, and risk-based assurance.
* Relevant certification such as CISA, CISSP, CRISC, CGEIT, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, SailPoint or Saviynt platform certification.

* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.
* Typical tools and technologies: SailPoint, Saviynt, Archer, ServiceNow, Power BI.

**Skills**

Account Lifecycle Management, AI Governance, Authentication Systems, Automation Technology, Certificate Management, Cloud Based Services, Cloud IAM, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Control Monitoring, Database Management, Design Controls, Directory Services, Identity Access Management (IAM), Identity Lifecycle Management, Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Infrastructure Security, Oracle Identity and Access Management (IAM) Tools Administration, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Security Controls, System Monitors, Troubleshooting

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

With a sole purpose of Making Everyone Who Touches Tally, Happier, we aim to be the technology fabric that drives the economic growth of the world, by 2030.

**Culture & Values**

Over the years, we have nurtured a value-based culture that let individuals follow their lead and support them in their growth journey with us. We value honesty and integrity, prioritize a people-first culture, pursue excellence, and drive impactful innovation with simplicity.
  
Our vision at Tally is to ensure that all employees get access to equal opportunities, with decisions grounded on performance, merit, competence, and potential. We are dedicated to fairness and transparency in our policies. By fostering diversity and equality, we strive to eliminate all forms of discrimination. We are committed to an inclusive leadership where our leaders ensure that our people are empowered to be at their best, professionally, and personally. We take great pride in our work culture which has helped become a proud member of the elite Kincentric Best Employers Club!

**Corporate Finance:**

Corporate Finance is a dynamic team rooted in value, committed to driving financial strategies that catalyse Tally’s growth and competitive edge. We empower informed decision-making and innovative planning, fortify operations, and optimise cash flow, all with a focus on long-term value creation.

### **We believe in**

* **Drive:** Financial strategies that catalyse Tally’s growth and strengthen its competitive edge through value-driven insights.
* **Optimize:** Fortifying operations and optimizing cash flow with a focus on long-term value creation

**What You Will Own**

This role offers end-to-end ownership of the procurement function, including building and leading the team, while providing direct exposure to business-critical technology and vendor decisions. It involves close collaboration with senior leadership across Finance, IT, Legal, and Business, making it a high-visibility position with strong potential for career growth.

**Where Your Expertise Meets Our Future**

* MBA (Operations/Supply Chain preferred).
* 6–9 years in Procurement/Strategic Sourcing, with significant exposure to IT and technology categories.
* Prior experience leading a procurement/sourcing team.
* Proven experience negotiating software, SaaS and cloud contracts.
* Strong category management, contract negotiation and vendor management skills; Advanced Excel and comfort with procurement/ERP tools.

**The Scope of Your Influence**

* **Procurement Strategy & Planning**

* Own procurement strategy across IT hardware, software/SaaS, cloud and professional services.
* Define the annual procurement plan, aligning sourcing with growth, cost optimisation and vendor-risk objectives.
* Build should-cost models and market intelligence to inform sourcing strategy and negotiation levers.
* Partner with Finance and business leaders to align procurement priorities with budget, OPEX and CAPEX targets.

* **Sourcing & Vendor Management**

* Lead end-to-end sourcing for strategic and high-value vendor relationships.
* Source hotel/venue partners for company events and manage insurer/broker sourcing for benefits and liability renewals.
* Build and manage a preferred vendor ecosystem; run structured performance reviews (SLAs, quality, delivery, commercials).
* Identify and mitigate vendor concentration and supply risk.

* **Contract Negotiation & Cost Management**

* Own commercial negotiations for software, SaaS, cloud, hardware and services agreements.
* Negotiate hotel/venue and insurance renewal contracts, securing favourable rates and terms.
* Drive cost savings and avoidance through negotiation, demand management and contract restructuring.
* Partner with Legal on MSAs, SOWs and NDAs; track savings, renewals and contract lifecycle.

* **Category Management**

* Own category strategies: IT hardware, software/SaaS, cloud, telecom, professional/staffing services, events & hospitality, and insurance & employee benefits.
* Track total cost of ownership (TCO) and rationalise overlapping tools and vendors.
* Stay ahead of market trends, pricing benchmarks and licensing models.

* **Process, Systems & Compliance**

* Build and strengthen procurement policies, approval workflows and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes.
* Drive adoption of procurement tools for PR-PO management, vendor onboarding and spend visibility.
* Ensure compliance with statutory, audit, data-security and vendor-risk requirements; maintain a single source of truth for contracts and spend.

* **Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead and build a team of procurement professionals (category owners, executives, analysts), with plans to scale as the function matures.
* Set team structure, goals and KPIs (savings, TAT/SLA, category coverage); own hiring, mentoring and capability-building.
* Partner with IS, Engineering, Finance, Legal and Business leaders; act as trusted advisor on buy-vs-build and vendor decisions.

**About us**

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

**About the Function:** Supply Chain & Manufacturing is where our brands are made, moved and delivered to the world.

With over half of our people working across more than 100 sites, this is a complex, large-scale operation that brings together production, logistics, engineering and supplier partnerships.

It’s fast-paced and hands-on, with teams working together to ensure quality, efficiency and sustainability at every stage. From sourcing ingredients to getting products into customers’ hands, you’ll play a role in delivering the brands people know and love.

**About the role:**

The **Senior Executive - Export [Logistics Planner]** is responsible for planning and executing end-to-end export logistics operations for alcoholic beverages. The role ensures seamless coordination across manufacturing units, transporters, freight forwarders, and Customs House Agents (CHA) while maintaining strict adherence to excise and statutory regulations. The position focuses on timely gate-in, cost optimization, vendor management and productivity improvements aligned with production and shipment plans.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Export Logistics & Execution**

* Manage end-to-end export logistics including factory dispatch, port movement and shipment handover.
* Ensure **timely vehicle placement** in line with production and shipment schedules.
* Monitor **gate-in timelines** at ports/ICDs to adhere vessel cut-offs and avoid detention costs.
* Coordinate production plans in alignment with **vessel availability and export demand**.

**Documentation & Customs Coordination**

* Oversee preparation and accuracy of export documentation including invoices, packing lists, shipping bills, and excise documents.
* Coordinate with **freight forwarders, transporters and CHAs** to ensure smooth customs clearance and shipment execution.
* Ensure compliance with applicable **DGFT regulations, Foreign Trade Policy, Customs requirements** and other relevant export regulatory requirements, including coordination with concerned authorities for approvals, licences, registrations and statutory documentation.
* Ensure compliance with **self-sealing certification** requirements and related documentation.
* Ensure proper tracking of procurement of material under **Advance Authorisation** and subsequently shipping bill filing while maintaining records of invoice numbers wrt products.

**Stakeholder & Multi-Unit Coordination**

* Act as a single point of contact between multiple manufacturing units, export sales, production and external logistics partners.
* Align dispatch plans across units to optimize load consolidation and shipment efficiency.
* Ensure proactive communication to mitigate operational delays.

**Vendor & Cost Management**

* Manage transporter, CHA and freight forwarder performance against service-level agreements (SLAs).
* Ensure timely **vendor invoice verification, processing and payment coordination** with finance teams.
* Drive **productivity improvements and logistics cost savings** through route optimization, rate negotiations and process improvements.

**Planning & Vehicle Management**

* Prepare and execute **advance transport plans** and share vehicle placement forecasts with transporters.
* Ensure availability of vehicles to support production schedules and avoid dispatch bottlenecks.
* Monitor turnaround time (TAT) for vehicles and optimize utilization.

**Statutory & Excise Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to **Excise regulations and export statutory requirements** at plant and shipment levels.
* Coordinate with excise authorities for approvals, documentation and inspections as required.
* Maintain audit-ready records for regulatory and internal compliance reviews.

**Process Improvement & Reporting**

* Track key logistics KPIs such as on-time dispatch, gate-in adherence, cost per case and vendor performance.
* Identify process gaps and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and compliance.
* Support audits, internal reviews and management reporting.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of **export logistics, documentation and excise compliance** in alco-bev industry
* Hands-on experience with **freight forwarders, transporters and CHAs**
* Expertise in **production-linked dispatch planning and vehicle management**
* Cost optimization, negotiation and vendor management skills
* High attention to detail, problem-solving ability and operational ownership
* Strong coordination and stakeholder management capabilities

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in export logistics within **alco-bev, FMCG or regulated manufacturing industries**
* Graduate/Postgraduate in Logistics, Supply Chain, International Trade or related field
* Experience in excise-controlled manufacturing environments preferred

**Working with us**  
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

description:
* Bengaluru, INDIA, India

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

**Primary Function of the Position**

We are seeking a supply chain professional to own end-to-end **demand forecasting, supply planning, inventory control, and logistics execution** for a portfolio of medical devices — **capital equipment, instruments, accessories, and spare parts**.

The role drives a disciplined **S&OP** process across a regulated, lot-traceable, and often import-dependent supply chain — balancing patient-facing service levels, working capital, regulatory compliance, and cost-to-serve.

The incumbent will be the bridge between **Commercial (tender + commercial channel), Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Manufacturing / Imports, Finance, and Service** — ensuring on-shelf availability of life-critical products and uninterrupted service support to the installed base.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Demand Planning & Forecast Management**

* Own **statistical and consensus demand forecasts** at SKU / region / channel level, segmented by capital equipment, instruments, accessories, consumables, and spares, on a **rolling 18-month horizon**.
* Support **New Product Introduction (NPI) launches** — build phase-in plans aligned to regulatory milestones, sales-force readiness, and channel fill.
* Manage **EOL and product-transition planning** with care — clinical preferences and regulatory constraints make abrupt phase-outs risky.
* Run **spare-parts and accessory planning** driven by installed-base data, attach rates, and service-event history.
* Track forecast accuracy — **MAPE, WMAPE, bias, FVA** — at category level; isolate tender forecast error from commercial baseline.

**Supply Planning & Inventory Control**

* Convert the demand plan into a constrained **supply plan** across in-house.
* Work closely with global Supply planner.
* Own **inventory planning and control** — safety stock, cycle stock, and strategic stock — segmented by criticality (lifesaving / Class C-D items held at higher service levels, slow-moving accessories at lower tier).
* Manage **expiry, FEFO discipline, and inventory ageing** to keep write-offs within target.
* Plan around **import lead times, CDSCO license validity, and customs clearance** dependencies for imported SKUs.
* **Coordinate with global stakeholders** — regional supply hubs, principal manufacturers, and global category / planning teams — for **supply allocation, expedites, and execution tracking** across time zones.

**Logistics & Service Levels**

* Oversee **inbound (imports + domestic), inter-DC, and outbound logistics** to distributors, hospitals (direct), and field service engineers.
* Manage 3PL/4PL partners under **ISO 13485-aligned** vendor audits and **Good Distribution Practices (GDP)**.
* Track and improve **OTIF, lane-level cold-chain excursion %, expiry write-off %, freight cost per unit, OTIF-to-hospital direct, and tender-fulfilment %**.

**S&OP & Stakeholder Integration**

* Run a disciplined **monthly S&OP** — Demand Review Supply Review Pre-S&OP Executive S&OP — with a separate **tender pipeline review** layered in.
* Act as the **single integrator** across Commercial, Tender, Service, Regulatory, Quality, Manufacturing, Imports, and Finance; quantify trade-offs (service to a hospital vs. expiry risk vs. cash).
* Drive **scenario plans** for tender wins/losses, NPI go-live shifts, supplier disruptions, and import delays.

**Analytics, Systems & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive deployment and adoption of planning systems — **o9, SAP** — alongside **QMS-integrated traceability** in ERP.
* Build dashboards for **forecast accuracy, inventory ageing / expiry runway, service level by hospital, tender OTIF, and import lead-time variance**.
* Champion **Lean / Six Sigma** initiatives and **GDP-aligned SOPs**; institutionalize a **logistics control tower** for critical SKUs.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Manage cross functional stakeholders across commercial, Service, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Planning , Imports and Finance.
* Build and sustain Strong working relationship with global counterparts ,3PL/4PL Partners.
* Represent the function in senior business reviews and external audits (CDSCO, ISO 13485 surveillance).

### **Qualifications**

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **7–10 years** of professional experience in a similar position, **ideally within a medical device company**.
* Demonstrated ownership of **demand planning, supply planning, and logistics** in a regulated, multi-channel environment.
* **Strong analytical skills** with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Strong **communication skills**, both verbal and written.
* Effective **time management** and ability to drive multiple parallel workstreams.
* Ability to build and sustain **long-term professional relationships** across cross-functional and external stakeholders.

**Required Education and Training**

* **Bachelor's degree** (Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or related discipline).

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* **MBA / PGDM** in Operations or Supply Chain Management.
* Familiarity with an integrated **ERP, preferably SAP** (MM / SD / PP modules).
* Hands-on exposure to advanced planning systems — **o9,SAP**
* Strong knowledge of the **MS Office** product suite, particularly Excel (advanced functions, Power Query).
* Working knowledge of **CDSCO Medical Devices Rules 2017, GDP, and ISO 13485** as applied to distribution and storage.
* **APICS CPIM / CSCP / CLTD** or **Lean Six Sigma** certification.
* Exposure to **Power BI / Tableau** for analytics and dashboard

Monquotidien is a high volume B2B bakery manufacturing company supplying breads, buns, pastries, cakes, croissants, viennoiserie, desserts, cookies, to corporates, hotels, QSR chains, cloud kitchens and airlines across Bangalore and South India. Focus on large scale production, consistency, shelf life and on-time delivery.

Role Purpose:

To lead complete production operations for high volume B2B production - from recipe standardization to mass production, costing, quality control, dispatch and client satisfaction. Responsible for scaling production from kg to tons with same taste and quality.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Large Scale Production Leadership

- Own complete factory production - planning, execution, output for B2B orders

- Handle daily volumes across breads, buns, laminated products, cakes, cookies

- Make production plan based on B2B orders, forecast, ensure OTIF - On Time In Full delivery

- Scale recipes from small batch to industrial batch without quality loss

- Manage shifts, ensure machine uptime and labor productivity

2. B2B Product & R&D

- Develop B2B products as per client requirement - Corporates, QSR bun, hotel breads, cafe desserts, airline products

- Create products with longer shelf life, travel stability, cost efficiency

- Do trials, shelf life testing, packaging compatibility, costing for each B2B client

- Standardize recipe cards, BOM, yield, process sheets for mass production

3. Quality, Food Safety & Compliance

- Implement HACCP, FSSAI, GMP, food safety systems for large scale factory

- Ensure batch to batch consistency, weight, taste, texture - zero client complaints

- Handle client audits, third party audits, internal audits

- Control CCP points, temperature, proofing, baking curves

- Manage quality team, lab testing, incoming RM quality check

4. Cost, Yield & Efficiency

- Own food cost, target B2B margins - control through BOM, yield improvement, wastage reduction

- Reduce wastage below 1.5%, control return, manage by-product use

- Optimize labor, electricity, oven efficiency, reduce production cost per kg

- Daily production cost sheet, variance report

5. Machines & Operations

- Work with engineering team for preventive maintenance of deck ovens, spiral mixers, proofers, laminators, bun divider, packaging machines

- Plan capacity, add new lines as volume grows

- Implement SOPs, automation where possible

6. Team & Systems

- Build and lead team of 50-150 staff - production managers, bakers, commi, quality, storekeepers

- Hire, train, roster, KRAs, performance review

- Implement ERP / production management software, maintain daily reports - production, wastage, dispatch, stock, manpower

- Coordinate with sales, logistics, dispatch team for timely loading, cold chain

Requirements:

- 10 years experience as Executive Chef / Factory Chef / Head of Production in large scale B2B bakery, industrial bakery, QSR commissary, hotel commissary

- Must have handled high volume - minimum 1 ton per day, ideally 3-10 tons

- Strong expertise in breads, buns, croissant, danish, puff, cookies, cakes at industrial scale

- Expert in scaling, food science, shelf life extension, preservatives knowledge, dough improvers

- Knows HACCP, FSSAI, factory compliance, client audits

- Strong in costing, BOM, yield management, P&L understanding for B2B

- Experience with automatic / semi-automatic bakery lines - dough sheeters, dividers, molders

- Leader who can handle large blue collar team, shift operations, pressure of B2B deadlines

- Based in Bangalore, ready for factory role, early morning / night shifts when needed

KPIs:

- OTIF above 98%

- Wastage below 1.5%

- Client complaints below 0.5%

- Food cost as per target

- Audit score above 95%

What We Offer:

- Opportunity to lead and scale a fast growing B2B bakery brand

- Large factory setup, new machines, growth path to VP Operations

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹85,000.00 per month

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

title: Telecaller Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Dreamstone Developers is a growing real estate organization focused on delivering residential and commercial projects that meet the needs of modern buyers and investors. **Company Description**
Aditya Birla Health Insurance Company Limited (ABHICL), incorporated in 2015, is a health insurance provider backed by Aditya Birla Capital Limited and strategic partners. Since commencing operations in 2016, the company has built a portfolio of products that focuses on chronic care and incentivized wellness, going beyond traditional health insurance. ABHICL positions itself as both a payer of healthcare expenses and an enabler of healthier lifestyle choices through product innovation. Its philosophy centers on rewarding healthy behavior, supporting the management of chronic lifestyle conditions, protecting health needs with dignity, and providing easy access to a holistic, digital-first health and wellness ecosystem. The organization continues to shape the health insurance landscape in India by serving diverse customer segments with personalized and efficient solutions.
  
**Role Description**
The Health Insurance Advisor role at Aditya Birla Health Insurance Company Limited is an on-site position based in the Greater Chennai Area. The advisor will guide customers through health insurance products, explain coverage options and benefits, and help individuals and families select plans aligned with their health and financial needs. Daily activities include responding to customer inquiries, conducting plan comparisons, supporting policy issuance, and assisting with policy renewals and endorsements. The role involves promoting wellness and chronic care solutions, educating customers about ABHICL’s health and wellness offerings, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth customer service. Advisors are expected to maintain accurate documentation, comply with regulatory and company policies, and participate in ongoing training to stay updated on product features and industry practices.

* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear verbal and written interaction with diverse customers.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to handle queries, resolve issues, and maintain a positive, respectful customer experience.
* Candidates should possess Training and Health Promotion skills to educate customers on plan benefits, wellness programs, and preventive health practices.
* Candidates should possess Wellness-related skills and knowledge to promote holistic health solutions and chronic care management offerings.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in business, commerce, healthcare, or a related field are beneficial.
* Prior experience in insurance, financial services, or healthcare advisory is an advantage.
* Familiarity with local health insurance regulations, digital tools, and CRM systems is preferred.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, meet targets ethically, and maintain high standards of integrity and confidentiality.

* Review customer billing, job-card closure, discounts, and complimentary services.

* Reconcile physical stock with the inventory management system.
* Conduct periodic stock audits at all service locations.
* Investigate stock shortages, excess stock, damaged parts, and inventory adjustments.
* Monitor slow-moving and non-moving inventory, including EV batteries and high-value components.

* Ensure timely collection of customer dues, OEM receivables, and warranty claims.
* Plan supplier payments and maintain sufficient working capital.

* Ensure timely GST returns, TDS payments, income tax compliance, and applicable filings.
* Monitor input tax credit reconciliation and GST treatment of vehicle and spare-parts transactions.
* Ensure timely PF, ESI, and other applicable statutory payments in coordination with HR.
* Coordinate statutory audits, tax audits, and assessments.
* Track compliance deadlines and resolve discrepancies promptly.
