* Conduct periodic financial audits of dealerships, workshops, and branches.
* Verify purchase orders, supplier invoices, expense vouchers, and payment approvals.
* Identify unauthorized expenses, billing discrepancies, and potential financial irregularities.
* Review discounts, credit notes, warranty claims, and cash transactions.
* Ensure closure of audit observations within the stipulated timeline.

* Reconcile dealer statements and outstanding balances with automobile manufacturers.
* Monitor OEM incentive claims, warranty reimbursements, and service campaign settlements.
* Investigate debit notes, credit notes, short payments, and disputed claims.
* Track pending claims and escalate overdue settlements.
* Maintain accurate documentation for OEM financial reviews and audits.

* Supervise accountants, branch accounts executives, cashiers, and billing personnel.
* Establish reporting deadlines and clear responsibility for each location.
* Review accounting accuracy, productivity, and compliance.
* Train staff in financial procedures, internal controls, and accounting systems.

**ABOUT STAART BUILDTECH**

STAART BUILDTECH PVT. LTD. is a technology-driven company transforming the construction and commercial interiors industry through software solutions and professional Project Management Consultancy (PMC) services.

We combine technology, project management, cost control, procurement transparency, and real-time project monitoring to help businesses manage construction and interior projects more efficiently.

Our solutions enable clients to improve project visibility, streamline workflows, control costs, and make data-driven decisions throughout the project lifecycle.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a driven, result-oriented Sales Executive with 3–4 years of experience in B2B sales, preferably in SaaS, construction technology, ERP solutions, commercial interiors, or Project Management Consultancy.

The candidate will be responsible for generating new business opportunities, building client relationships, conducting product and service presentations, and converting prospects into paying customers for STAART's software solutions and PMC services.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable selling both technology products and professional services, engaging with decision-makers, and managing the complete sales cycle from lead generation to deal closure.

Key Responsibilities

**SAAS SALES & BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT**

* Identify and acquire new customers for STAART's construction and project management software solutions.
* Generate leads through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, and industry events.
* Understand client requirements and demonstrate how STAART's software can improve project execution, procurement, financial control, and operational efficiency.
* Conduct product demonstrations, discovery calls, and commercial negotiations.
* Develop sales pipelines and consistently achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Manage software subscriptions, renewals, upselling, and cross-selling opportunities.

**PMC SALES & CLIENT ACQUISITION**

* Identify businesses requiring Project Management Consultancy for commercial interiors, office fit-outs, and construction projects.
* Build relationships with corporate clients, business owners, architects, interior design firms, contractors, developers, and facility management teams.
* Understand project scope, budgets, timelines, and client expectations to identify suitable PMC opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal technical and project management teams to prepare proposals, presentations, and commercial quotations.
* Follow up with prospective clients and drive negotiations through to contract closure.
* Build a strong pipeline of upcoming commercial interior and construction projects.

**CLIENT RELATIONSHIP MANAGEMENT**

* Build and maintain long-term relationships with clients and key decision-makers.
* Engage with stakeholders such as founders, directors, procurement heads, project managers, finance heads, and operations teams.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospects and existing clients.
* Ensure a smooth handover of closed deals to the implementation or project execution team.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, referrals, and account expansion.

**SALES OPERATIONS & REPORTING**

* Maintain accurate lead, opportunity, and customer records in the CRM.
* Track sales activities, conversion rates, deal values, and pipeline performance.
* Prepare regular sales reports and revenue forecasts.
* Monitor competitor offerings, market developments, and customer feedback.
* Work closely with marketing, product, and project delivery teams to improve sales effectiveness.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
* 3–4 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or enterprise sales.
* Prior experience in SaaS sales, software sales, ERP sales, construction technology, PMC, or commercial interior sales is preferred.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
* Demonstrated ability to generate leads, manage a sales pipeline, and close deals.
* Ability to understand client business requirements and communicate the value of software products and professional services.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, CRM tools, and sales reporting.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings, site visits, and business development activities when required.

**PREFERRED CANDIDATE PROFILE**

* Experience selling SaaS subscriptions or enterprise software to businesses.
* Existing network in the construction, commercial interiors, real estate, or corporate workplace industry.
* Experience dealing with senior management and business decision-makers.
* Ability to manage both short-cycle software sales and longer-cycle PMC project sales.
* Strong ownership, persistence, target orientation, and commercial awareness.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS(KPIs)**

Performance will be measured against clearly defined sales targets, including:

* Monthly and quarterly revenue achievement.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of client meetings and product demonstrations conducted.
* SaaS subscriptions and new accounts acquired.
* PMC opportunities generated and projects secured.
* Lead-to-opportunity and opportunity-to-closure conversion rates.
* Total value of the sales pipeline and accuracy of revenue forecasts.
* Client retention, renewals, referrals, and account expansion.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Opportunity to work at the intersection of construction, technology, and project management.
* Exposure to B2B SaaS sales and high-value PMC engagements.
* Performance-based incentives linked to business development and revenue achievement.
* Opportunities for professional growth and increased responsibility.
* A collaborative, entrepreneurial, and results-driven working environment.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume along with a brief summary of their B2B sales experience, major deals closed, and sales targets achieved.

* Culture of Trust & Ownership: An empowering environment that values collaboration, accountability and individual contribution.

title: Sales Executive, Luxury Handloom and Occasion Wear
description:
**About Second Skin**

Second Skin brings handwoven sarees from across India to Hyderabad, including Patan Patola, Paithani, Kanjeevaram, Banarasi and Chanderi. Alongside them we offer dress materials and a ready-to-wear line of lehengas, anarkalis and indo-western pieces, with in-house tailoring for bridal and occasion wear. Our customers are often shopping for a wedding, a trousseau or a piece they will keep for decades. We need someone who can earn that trust.

**What you will do**

1. Welcome walk-in and appointment customers, understand the occasion, budget and style, and guide them to the right piece.
2. Explain the craft behind each piece, including the weave, region, fabric and care, so customers see why it is worth the price.
3. Handle high-value sales, including trousseau and wedding shopping with families.
4. Suggest complete outfits, from dress materials and blouse pieces to dupattas and tailoring.
5. Run video shopping calls for out-of-town and overseas customers.
6. Reply to WhatsApp enquiries and follow up with regular customers on new arrivals.
7. Keep displays clean, stock organised and accurate in the billing system, and flag slow-moving pieces to management.

**Who we are looking for**

1. 2 years in premium saree, bridal or boutique retail. Freshers with excellent presence and a genuine love of textiles may be considered.
2. Good knowledge of silks and handloom, or a clear willingness to learn them fast.
3. Fluent in Telugu and Hindi, with comfortable English for higher-end and NRI customers.
4. Well-groomed, patient and confident with demanding customers.
5. Comfortable on video calls and WhatsApp, and with basic billing software.
6. Honest, punctual and trustworthy around high-value stock.

**What you will get**

Fixed salary, festival bonus, paid weekly off, and training in handloom textiles.

**How to apply**

* Send your resume to support@secondskinhyd.com or WhatsApp +91 8880 303132.

title: Connect Account Manager
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**
**Job Title:**
CONNECT Account Manager
  
  
**Location:**
India
  
  
**Reports To:**
Director, CONNECT Platform
  
  
**The job**
The CONNECT Platform Specialist is a high-impact, revenue-driving role at the forefront of AVEVA’s most strategic growth initiative: the CONNECT Platform. As an integral part of this CONNECT commercial team, you won’t just sell—you’ll help define how we bring this platform to market. You’ll be responsible for building and executing a winning sales strategy that delivers measurable customer value and drives ARR growth.
  
  
This is a role for a results-oriented enterprise seller who thrives in fast-moving environments. You bring the full spectrum of enterprise sales skills—strategic prospecting, value-based selling, and deal closing—paired with a strong ability to grow accounts through stakeholder enablement and platform adoption. This role goes beyond achieving sales targets; it's about building long-term customer value, expanding product adoption, and accelerating AVEVA’s next wave of growth. Your insights will directly influence our sales motion, customer playbooks, and broader go-to-market strategy.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enterprise Selling & Commercial Execution**

* Own commercial outcomes—including pipeline generation, opportunity progression, and ARR achievement—for a portfolio of target accounts
* Identify and qualify use-case-driven opportunities for CONNECT platform products, using a consultative, MEDDPICC-informed sales process
* Engage technical and business stakeholders (often VP+ and cross-functional) to build strong buying coalitions
* Drive and close new SaaS/Cloud platform deals, with a focus on land-and-expand strategies
* Negotiate commercial terms in alignment with value delivered, usage patterns, and strategic fit

**Platform Adoption & Value Realization**

* Support onboarding and deployment strategies to accelerate time-to-value
* Develop usage and expansion plans in partnership with customers and internal teams
* Monitor usage trends, identify adoption gaps, and proactively address risk
* Influence post-sale expansion by championing new use cases and capabilities
* Serve as a customer advocate internally to shape roadmap, pricing, and support

**Strategic Feedback & GTM Iteration**

* Capture and share customer insights to improve CONNECT product-market fit and GTM messaging
* Inform commercial model, onboarding approaches, and playbooks for future scale
* Collaborate closely with product, marketing, customer success, partnerships, sales enablement, and regional sales teams

**Essential Requirements:**

* Experience in enterprise B2B SaaS or Cloud software roles (e.g., Account Executive, Account Manager, Solution Consultant)
* Proven track record owning and delivering against ARR targets and closing complex deals
* Strong sales acumen, including territory planning, value-based selling, stakeholder mapping, and negotiation
* Experience working with (or selling into) asset-intensive industries like energy, chemicals, or manufacturing is a plus
* Comfort engaging both technical users and business decision-makers
* Experience driving product adoption and account growth post-sale
* Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Command of the Message
* Proficiency with Salesforce and modern sales/customer success tools
* A self-starter who can operate autonomously and influence cross-functional teams

**Commercial at AVEVA**
Our Commercial team, comprised of over 2,000 dedicated colleagues, is the backbone of our customer relationships and business growth. From industry experts and solution architects to sales, support, success managers, and business operations, everyone shares a common goal: to deeply understand our customers' needs and deliver tailored solutions.
  
  
If you're passionate about driving growth, tackling complex business challenges, and fostering strong customer relationships, you'll find success and fulfilment in our Commercial team.
  
  
You’ll also be joining an award-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our
awards and recognition
.
  
  
Find out more:
https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/
  
  
**India Benefits include:**
Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well-being support
  
  
It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/
  
  
**Hybrid working**
We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.
  
  
**Hiring process**
Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process
  
  
**About AVEVA**
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.
  
  
We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/
  
  
Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

title: Business Development Managers
description:
**Company Description**
Student Education Diagnostics India (SED) is built on a neuroscience-based diagnostic framework designed to understand each student’s unique learning patterns. The organization focuses on using these insights to support both academic achievement and personal growth. By combining scientific assessment methods with practical educational tools, SED aims to help learners realize their full potential. The team collaborates with educators, institutions, and families to translate diagnostic findings into actionable strategies. This approach creates a data-informed, student-centric environment for long-term development.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time on-site role, based in the Greater Hyderabad Area, is for Business Development Managers who will drive growth and partnerships for SED. On a daily basis, the role involves identifying and qualifying new business opportunities, building and maintaining relationships with schools, colleges, and educational organizations, and presenting SED’s neuroscience-based diagnostic framework to potential clients. Responsibilities include developing and executing outreach plans, conducting meetings and presentations, negotiating agreements, and ensuring smooth onboarding of new partners. The role also includes tracking market trends, preparing reports and forecasts, collaborating with internal teams to refine offerings, and representing SED at events and meetings to strengthen brand visibility.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong business development and sales skills, including lead generation, client relationship management, and negotiation.
* Experience in the education sector, edtech, or student-focused services, with an understanding of institutional decision-making processes.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts in clear, accessible language.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple opportunities simultaneously, and meet defined targets and timelines.
* Comfort with data-driven decision-making and interest in neuroscience-based or research-driven educational frameworks.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Education, or a related field; advanced qualifications are an advantage.
* Proficiency in basic productivity tools (e.g., email, spreadsheets, presentation software) and CRM systems is beneficial.
* Willingness to travel within the Greater Hyderabad Area and surrounding regions for client meetings and events.

title: Business Development Manager
description:

Many national brands struggle to scale in South India due to gaps in cultural understanding and regional relevance. Hotcult bridges this gap by combining strategy, storytelling, and execution to create campaigns that resonate with local audiences

**Business Development Manager at Hotcult**
, you will be responsible for identifying, developing, and converting business opportunities across brands, categories, and markets. The role requires a combination of strategic thinking, relationship management, commercial acumen, and ownership of the business development lifecycle from prospecting and pitching to negotiation & closure.

* Develop account growth plans to strengthen client relationships and drive recurring business.

* Strategic Partnerships & Market Intelligence

* Build a strong understanding of HotCult’s capabilities and identify relevant opportunities to position its offerings.

* Strong understanding of the brand and marketing ecosystem, including how agencies develop and deliver solutions for clients.
* Proven ability to generate leads, build relationships with senior stakeholders, and convert opportunities into business.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Commercial acumen, with the ability to understand client requirements and identify revenue opportunities.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* A proactive, ownership-driven approach with a strong orientation towards business growth and closure.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**About the Role**

Makerspace Masters is looking for a Business Development Manager to grow institutional business for hands-on STEM/STEAM learning, innovation and tinkering labs, curriculum-linked learning solutions, and education infrastructure. The role will focus on building relationships with schools and education groups, understanding their academic and infrastructure needs, presenting relevant solutions, and managing opportunities from prospecting through closure and handover. We are particularly interested in candidates who have sold tangible education solutions, lab setups, STEM/robotics/coding solutions, or related products and services to K–12 Institutions—not candidates whose experience is limited to selling standalone SaaS platforms or upskilling courses.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Development & Institutional Sales**

• Identify and develop opportunities with K–12 schools, school chains, education groups, and other relevant institutional customers.

• Build a qualified sales pipeline through targeted outreach, referrals, school networks, education events, channel partners, and territory mapping.

• Understand institutional requirements and position suitable solutions such as STEM/STEAM labs, tinkering and innovation labs, robotics and coding kits, curriculum-linked modules, and related education technology or infrastructure.

• Manage the full sales cycle, including lead qualification, needs assessment, presentations, proposals, commercial discussions, negotiation, closure, and internal handover.

• Build relationships with school owners, trustees, principals, directors, academic leaders, procurement teams, and other decision-makers.

• Achieve agreed revenue and business development targets; maintain accurate pipeline, forecasts, and activity reports in the CRM.

**Solution Presentations, Demos & Proposals**

• Conduct customer discovery meetings and site visits to understand curriculum goals, lab requirements, available space, budgets, and implementation timelines.

• Deliver tailored presentations and demonstrations of relevant products, learning modules, lab concepts, and implementation approaches.

• Coordinate with curriculum, product, pre-sales, project, and technical teams to prepare solution proposals, bills of materials, quotations, and implementation plans.

• Support institutional tenders, RFPs, GeM opportunities, and other procurement processes where relevant.

**Market Development & Account Growth**

• Map target accounts, competitors, market trends, and regional opportunities to identify practical routes to growth.

• Develop relationships with education consultants, system integrators, distributors, and other relevant channel partners.

• Maintain post-sale engagement with key accounts, identify opportunities for additional labs, modules, products, or services, and support repeat business.

• Capture customer feedback and share market insights with internal teams to improve solution fit and customer experience.

**Required Qualifications**

• Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; an MBA or relevant business qualification is an advantage.

• Typically 4–8 years of experience in business development or institutional sales, preferably in the K–12 education ecosystem.

• Demonstrated experience selling to schools, school chains, education groups, or similar institutional customers, with evidence of managing and closing sales.

• Relevant exposure to one or more of the following: STEM/STEAM education, robotics or coding kits, tinkering/innovation labs, educational hardware, interactive flat panels, AV/display solutions, IT hardware for education, curriculum-linked learning modules, or school lab/infrastructure projects.

• Ability to understand customer needs and translate them into a practical solution, proposal, and commercial offer.

• Strong presentation, negotiation, relationship-building, communication, and territory-management skills.

• Comfort using CRM tools and maintaining a structured sales pipeline, forecasts, and follow-up records.

• Willingness to travel for school visits, customer meetings, demonstrations, and education events.

**Preferred Qualifications**

• An established network among school owners, principals, trustees, school chains, or education decision-makers.

• Experience managing multi-stakeholder or consultative sales with longer institutional sales cycles.

• Exposure to tenders, RFPs, GeM, government schools, or institutional procurement processes.

• Experience coordinating with curriculum, technical, project delivery, procurement, or implementation teams.

• Understanding of CBSE, ICSE, or state-board school environments and the needs of K–12 institutions.

**Key Skills**

Institutional sales, K–12 education market, consultative selling, territory development, STEM/STEAM and lab solutions, solution presentations, proposal development, negotiation, account management, CRM discipline, forecasting, and cross-functional coordination.

**What Success Looks Like (First 12 Months)**

• Build a qualified pipeline of target schools and education groups in the assigned territory.

• Meet agreed revenue and closure targets for relevant education solutions and institutional projects.

• Develop productive relationships with key school decision-makers and generate repeatable referral and partner-led opportunities.

• Run effective discovery meetings and demonstrations, with clear proposals and disciplined follow-up.

• Ensure smooth handover of closed opportunities to the internal delivery and implementation teams.

**What We Offer**

• Competitive fixed salary plus performance-based incentives.

• Opportunity to work on hands-on learning, innovation labs, and education solutions for schools.

• Cross-functional exposure to sales, curriculum, product, and project implementation teams.

title: Sales Lead Management & Coordination Executive
description:
**1. Role Overview**

Hydromo is looking for a proactive, highly organised and result-oriented Sales Lead Management & Coordination Executive to manage inbound enquiries, qualify prospects, coordinate with the sales team and drive effective lead progression towards business conversion.

The individual will serve as the first point of contact for prospective customers generated through multiple channels, ensuring timely communication, systematic lead qualification, consistent followups and seamless coordination between customers and the sales team.

The role requires excellent communication skills, strong follow-up discipline, data management capabilities and the ability to prioritise opportunities to improve sales productivity and conversion timelines.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Inbound Lead Management & Qualification**

• Handle daily inbound leads generated through digital campaigns, website enquiries, referrals, social media and other sources.

• Make initial calls to prospective customers to understand their requirements, project details, business needs and purchase intent.

• Qualify leads based on defined business criteria, opportunity potential, urgency, location and other relevant parameters.

• Assign qualified leads to the appropriate sales representatives based on predefined allocation criteria.

• Ensure every new enquiry is contacted promptly and accurately recorded in the lead management system.

**B. Lead Follow-ups & Sales Coordination**

• Manage an active pipeline of new, ongoing and carry-forward leads.

• Conduct systematic follow-ups with prospects to collect pending information, understand buying timelines and assess the next steps.

• Coordinate with sales representatives to facilitate customer meetings, technical discussions and site visits.

• Ensure prospects receive timely responses and that no active opportunity is missed due to inadequate follow-up.

• Support the sales team throughout the sales cycle by maintaining communication with prospects and facilitating progression towards conversion.

**D. Customer Communication**

• Handle daily telecalling, email communication and WhatsApp correspondence with prospective customers.

• Share preliminary product information, company details and relevant communication material.

• Coordinate with technical and sales teams to obtain accurate responses to customer queries.

**E. Outbound Calling & Other Assignments**

• Undertake outbound calling activities and targeted prospecting as directed by management.

• Support specific sales campaigns, customer re-engagement initiatives and database activation.

• Take ownership of additional sales coordination and lead management activities as required.

The role will involve managing a combination of fresh enquiries, ongoing prospects and outbound activities.

Indicative daily activity:

• Tele calling in bound queries new prospect calls per day and documenting requirements in CRM

• Follow-ups with existing and carry-forward leads.

• Customer requirement validation and lead qualification.

• Coordination for sales meetings and site visits.

• Database updates, lead prioritisation and reporting.

• Additional outbound calls as assigned by management.

The actual calling volume will vary depending on incoming lead volumes and the active sales pipeline.

**4. Education & Experience**

**Preferred Experience:**

• Experience in the water treatment, wastewater management, industrial utilities or environmental solutions industry will be an advantage.

• Alternatively, candidates with sales coordination, telecalling, inside sales, customer relationship management or business development experience in technical or industrial sectors may apply.

• Fresh graduates or postgraduates with a strong interest in sales, excellent communication skills and a willingness to learn are also welcome.

**Educational Qualification:**

• Any graduate or postgraduate degree.

• Candidates with technical or engineering backgrounds will have an added advantage.

**5. Skills & Competencies**

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Fluency in English, Hindi and Telugu is mandatory.

• Strong telecalling, customer interaction and follow-up capabilities.

• Good organisational skills and attention to detail.

• Ability to manage multiple leads and prioritise tasks independently.

• Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, email and WhatsApp communication.

• Ability to maintain structured databases, trackers and reports.

• Good interpersonal skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with sales and technical teams.

• Proactive, disciplined, persistent and target-oriented approach.

• Strong learning agility and willingness to understand technical products and solutions.

**6. Product & Technical Knowledge**

Hydromo will provide structured training on its products, solutions and services. The candidate will be expected to progressively develop:

• Understanding of Hydromo's water treatment and wastewater management solutions.

• Basic knowledge of product applications, technical terminology and customer requirements.

• Ability to understand preliminary project requirements and capture relevant technical information.

• Confidence in communicating basic product information and coordinating technical discussions with the relevant teams.

Prior technical expertise is not mandatory, but the willingness and ability to learn technical concepts quickly is essential.

**7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated on:

• Timely response and coverage of new inbound enquiries.

• Quality and accuracy of lead qualification.

• Number of leads effectively followed up and progressed.

• Accuracy and completeness of lead database and CRM records.

• Timely allocation of qualified leads to sales representatives.

• Effectiveness in facilitating customer meetings and site visits.

• Follow-up discipline and reduction in missed or dormant opportunities.

• Quality of daily and weekly reporting.

• Contribution to improving sales team productivity and lead-to-conversion timelines.

**8. Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is:

• A confident communicator who can engage professionally with customers.

• Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple conversations and follow-ups.

• Persistent without being pushy.

• Data-oriented, with the ability to identify and prioritise promising opportunities.

• Responsible and accountable for ensuring every lead is tracked and acted upon.

• Enthusiastic about sales, customer engagement and learning technical products.

The objective of this role is simple: Ensure every genuine enquiry is contacted, qualified, tracked, followed up and effectively moved towards a sales opportunity — without allowing potential business to slip through the cracks.

· LATAM pharmaceutical-market knowledge.

· API business development and technical-commercial acumen.

· Customer acquisition and strategic-account management.

· Portfolio prioritization and market entry.

· Pricing, negotiation, contracts and receivables discipline.

· Coordination with R&D, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Manufacturing, SCM and Finance.

title: Sales Lead Management & Coordination Executive
description:
**1. Role Overview**

Hydromo is looking for a proactive, highly organised and result-oriented Sales Lead Management & Coordination Executive to manage inbound enquiries, qualify prospects, coordinate with the sales team and drive effective lead progression towards business conversion.

The individual will serve as the first point of contact for prospective customers generated through multiple channels, ensuring timely communication, systematic lead qualification, consistent followups and seamless coordination between customers and the sales team.

The role requires excellent communication skills, strong follow-up discipline, data management capabilities and the ability to prioritise opportunities to improve sales productivity and conversion timelines.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Inbound Lead Management & Qualification**

* Handle daily inbound leads generated through digital campaigns, website enquiries, referrals, social media and other sources.
* Make initial calls to prospective customers to understand their requirements, project details, business needs and purchase intent.
* Qualify leads based on defined business criteria, opportunity potential, urgency, location and other relevant parameters.
* Assign qualified leads to the appropriate sales representatives based on predefined allocation criteria.
* Ensure every new enquiry is contacted promptly and accurately recorded in the lead management system.

**B. Lead Follow-ups & Sales Coordination**

* Manage an active pipeline of new, ongoing and carry-forward leads.
* Conduct systematic follow-ups with prospects to collect pending information, understand buying timelines and assess the next steps.
* Coordinate with sales representatives to facilitate customer meetings, technical discussions and site visits.
* Ensure prospects receive timely responses and that no active opportunity is missed due to inadequate follow-up.
* Support the sales team throughout the sales cycle by maintaining communication with prospects and facilitating progression towards conversion.
* Escalate high-potential, urgent or delayed opportunities to management.

**C. Lead Data Management & Sales Prioritisation**

* Maintain accurate, updated and well-organised lead databases.
* Track lead status, source, customer requirements, follow-up dates, sales ownership and next actions.
* Develop and maintain structured lead trackers and daily/weekly sales pipeline reports.
* Identify high-priority prospects based on readiness, potential, urgency and engagement.
* Organise customer and site visit schedules geographically, identifying location-wise and route-wise clusters to optimise travel time and sales team productivity.
* Ensure proper documentation and visibility of all lead interactions and follow-up commitments.

**D. Customer Communication**

* Handle daily telecalling, email communication and WhatsApp correspondence with prospective customers.
* Communicate professionally and confidently with customers across different business segments.
* Share preliminary product information, company details and relevant communication material.
* Coordinate with technical and sales teams to obtain accurate responses to customer queries.

**E. Outbound Calling & Other Assignments**

* Undertake outbound calling activities and targeted prospecting as directed by management.
* Support specific sales campaigns, customer re-engagement initiatives and database activation.
* Take ownership of additional sales coordination and lead management activities as required.

**3. Expected Daily Workload**

The role will involve managing a combination of fresh enquiries, ongoing prospects and outbound activities.

Indicative daily activity:

* Tele calling in bound queries new prospect calls per day and documenting requirements in CRM
* Follow-ups with existing and carry-forward leads.
* Customer requirement validation and lead qualification.
* Coordination for sales meetings and site visits.
* Database updates, lead prioritisation and reporting.
* Additional outbound calls as assigned by management.

The actual calling volume will vary depending on incoming lead volumes and the active sales pipeline.

**4. Education & Experience**

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience in the water treatment, wastewater management, industrial utilities or environmental solutions industry will be an advantage.
* Alternatively, candidates with sales coordination, telecalling, inside sales, customer relationship management or business development experience in technical or industrial sectors may apply.
* Fresh graduates or postgraduates with a strong interest in sales, excellent communication skills and a willingness to learn are also welcome.

**Educational Qualification:**

* Any graduate or postgraduate degree.
* Candidates with technical or engineering backgrounds will have an added advantage.

**5. Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Fluency in English, Hindi and Telugu is mandatory.
* Strong telecalling, customer interaction and follow-up capabilities.
* Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple leads and prioritise tasks independently.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, email and WhatsApp communication.
* Ability to maintain structured databases, trackers and reports.
* Good interpersonal skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with sales and technical teams.
* Proactive, disciplined, persistent and target-oriented approach.
* Strong learning agility and willingness to understand technical products and solutions.

**6. Product & Technical Knowledge**

Hydromo will provide structured training on its products, solutions and services. The candidate will be expected to progressively develop:

* Understanding of Hydromo's water treatment and wastewater management solutions.
* Basic knowledge of product applications, technical terminology and customer requirements.
* Ability to understand preliminary project requirements and capture relevant technical information.
* Confidence in communicating basic product information and coordinating technical discussions with the relevant teams.

Prior technical expertise is not mandatory, but the willingness and ability to learn technical concepts quickly is essential.

**7. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated on:

* Timely response and coverage of new inbound enquiries.
* Quality and accuracy of lead qualification.
* Number of leads effectively followed up and progressed.
* Accuracy and completeness of lead database and CRM records.
* Timely allocation of qualified leads to sales representatives.
* Effectiveness in facilitating customer meetings and site visits.
* Follow-up discipline and reduction in missed or dormant opportunities.
* Quality of daily and weekly reporting.
* Contribution to improving sales team productivity and lead-to-conversion timelines.

**8. Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is:

* A confident communicator who can engage professionally with customers.
* Highly organised and comfortable managing multiple conversations and follow-ups.
* Persistent without being pushy.
* Data-oriented, with the ability to identify and prioritise promising opportunities.
* Responsible and accountable for ensuring every lead is tracked and acted upon.
* Enthusiastic about sales, customer engagement and learning technical products.

The objective of this role is simple: Ensure every genuine enquiry is contacted, qualified, tracked, followed up and effectively moved towards a sales opportunity — without allowing potential business to slip through the cracks.

title: Accounts Executive
description:
Job Summary

LEADSPACE is looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Finance & Accounts Executive to handle day-to-day accounting, billing, invoicing, financial documentation, payment processing, and other backend accounting activities at our Madhapur, Hyderabad office.

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime, a good understanding of accounting principles, GST, banking transactions, and financial reporting. The candidate will coordinate with internal departments, vendors, customers, and management to ensure smooth financial operations and accurate maintenance of company accounts.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounting & Bookkeeping**

Handle day-to-day accounting entries and financial transactions using Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime. Maintain sales, purchase, journal, payment, receipt, and contra entries. Maintain general ledgers, cash books, bank books, and other accounting records. Verify and record financial transactions with supporting documents. Ensure accurate bookkeeping and maintain proper filing and documentation of all accounting records.

**Billing & Invoicing**

Prepare and process sales invoices, purchase invoices, debit notes, and credit notes. Verify invoices, quotations, purchase orders, and supporting documents. Maintain billing trackers and ensure timely submission of invoices. Coordinate with internal teams to resolve billing discrepancies and maintain accurate billing records.

**Accounts Payable & Receivable**

Maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable records. Process vendor bills and verify payment details before processing. Monitor customer outstanding balances and payment due dates. Follow up with customers and internal teams for pending payments. Maintain vendor ledgers and customer account statements. Prepare outstanding payment reports and ageing reports.

**GST & Statutory Compliance**

Prepare GST-related invoices and maintain supporting documentation. Assist in GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B data preparation and reconciliation. Verify GST details, GSTINs, tax rates, and input tax credit records. Coordinate with the Finance Head or external accountant for GST returns and statutory compliance. Maintain TDS-related records and assist with TDS calculations, deductions, and documentation wherever applicable.

**Bank Reconciliation & Payments**

Perform bank reconciliation and resolve discrepancies. Verify bank statements, payment receipts, and transaction records. Maintain records of NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, UPI, and cheque transactions. Prepare payment schedules and coordinate for timely vendor payments. Maintain petty cash records and daily cash transactions, wherever applicable.

**Purchase Orders & Vendor Management**

Prepare and maintain Purchase Orders (POs) and vendor-related documentation. Verify vendor quotations, bills, work orders, and supporting documents. Coordinate with vendors for invoices, payment confirmations, and account statements. Maintain vendor master data and ensure accurate financial records.

**Finance & MIS Reporting**

Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly accounting reports. Maintain Excel-based financial trackers and reports. Prepare expense statements, outstanding reports, payment reports, and reconciliation statements. Assist in monthly closing activities and financial data preparation. Support budgeting, expense monitoring, and management reporting.

**General Accounts Backend Activities**

Handle accounting data entry, document verification, and financial record maintenance. Verify employee expense claims, reimbursements, and supporting bills. Maintain records of office expenses, utility bills, rent, and other operational expenses. Assist with payroll-related accounting entries and salary payment documentation. Support internal and external audits by providing the required records. Coordinate with Sales, Operations, HR, Administration, vendors, and management for accounts-related matters. Perform other accounting and finance-related duties assigned by management.

Required Skills & Qualifications

A Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com), Finance, or Accounting is preferred. Candidates should have 1–5 years of experience in Accounts, Finance, Billing, or Bookkeeping. Practical knowledge of Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime is mandatory. A good understanding of accounting principles, bookkeeping, GST invoicing, GST reconciliation, and basic statutory compliance is required. Candidates should have experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliation, and financial documentation. Proficiency in MS Excel, including formulas, data management, and report preparation, is mandatory. Knowledge of TDS, vendor reconciliation, and financial reporting will be an advantage. Strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail, organizational skills, and good communication and coordination abilities are essential.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience in advertising, media, real estate, or service-based industries are preferred. Experience in independently handling complete accounts backend operations will be an advantage. Knowledge of purchase orders, vendor management, billing, payment follow-ups, GST, and TDS documentation will be preferred. Candidates who can join immediately will be given preference.

Job Purpose

To ensure accurate and timely completion of day-to-day accounting, billing, invoicing, GST documentation, vendor payments, customer collections, bank reconciliation, and other finance backend activities while maintaining proper financial records and supporting the smooth functioning of LEADSPACE's accounting operations.

description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in operations or business management, and vendor management.

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience with GCS sales incentive architectures (spend bands, offerings, performance points) and commission-driven sales behaviors.

**About the job**
-----------------

As a Vendor Performance Manager (VPM), you will play a critical role on the frontlines of Google Customer Solutions (GCS) vendor sales management. You will be the principal stakeholder for your vendor management team, influencing and holding them accountable to deliver excellent sales performance and quality while enabling site-program success with targeted support.

You will be responsible for analyzing vendor performance and presenting key insights to Google sales leadership, supporting initiatives to improve GCS vendor operations, and sharing best practices with vendor management and Google teams across global markets and lines of business.  
  
This role is aligned to the AUNZ market and will require working non standard hours.

The Global Business Organization (GBO) is the engine that powers Google’s full ecosystem of products and services to help customers and partners succeed and grow. GBO includes the commercial arms of Ads sellers, business development teams, and customer services and support, as well as overlay programs that enable coordinated engagement with Google's most complex and important customers and partners.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Deliver against ambitious quarterly business and product adoption goals. Own the end-to-end commercial performance of a multi-million-dollar portfolio by diagnosing growth drivers, mitigating churn risks, and designing scalable sales strategies.

Coach on advanced sales techniques, objection handling, pitch structure, and the Google Ads product suite (e.g., Performance Max, YouTube, Smart Bidding) to maximize customer ROI.
* Lead high-stakes weekly/monthly business reviews with executive vendor sales executives. Coach partners to consistently hit quota.
* Collaborate closely with internal Google sales strategy, product specialists, and GCS counterparts to ensure seamless customer outreach and a cohesive One Google customer journey.

title: Strategic Account Executive - India
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

As a Strategic Account Executive for our Mumbai territory, you'll drive GitLab's growth across large Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI) institutions, alongside leading enterprises and conglomerates headquartered in the city. It will be a blended territory of Enterprise and Conglomerates slightly more BFSI heavy. You'll help these organisations adopt, implement, and expand their use of our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, guiding them through modernisation and DevSecOps transformations while building a pipeline that translates into measurable Net ARR and long-term expansion.
  
  
You'll bring an understanding of the software development lifecycle, including continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) automation, secure development practices, and infrastructure modernisation. You'll apply it to the realities of regulated industries, where security, compliance, auditability, and data residency shape every technology decision. You'll connect customer stakeholders with GitLab's field organisation so GitLab is seen as a trusted, long-term partner across the full sales cycle.
  
  
In your first year, you'll be expected to build a strong BFSI and Enterprise portfolio across your territory, create repeatable sales motions aligned to how regulated financial institutions and large enterprises buy and adopt platforms, and consistently forecast and report on deal progress and account health.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and grow GitLab's largest and most strategic BFSI, Enterprise, and Conglomerate prospects and customers in Mumbai, focusing on organisations that run mission-critical software delivery at scale
* Drive the full enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and pipeline generation through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, including the longer procurement, vendor risk, and security review processes typical of regulated financial institutions
* Provide hands-on account leadership throughout the pre- and post-sales process to ensure a smooth customer experience and strong adoption of GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform
* Position GitLab against regulatory and compliance priorities (for example RBI, IRDAI, and SEBI guidelines on IT governance, outsourcing, cyber resilience, and data localisation), working with Solutions Architects and Security specialists on deployment options such as self-managed and GitLab Dedicated
* Partner closely with Sales Development Representatives, Solutions Architects, Customer Success, system integrators, and strategic channel partners to generate qualified opportunities, co-sell, and execute account strategies that drive new business and expansion
* Develop and maintain detailed account plans for priority customers, including opportunity mapping, stakeholder alignment, and multi-threaded engagement across engineering, security, risk and compliance, platform, infrastructure, procurement, and business leaders
* Tailor your approach to each segment: a compliance- and risk-led value story for BFSI, and a modernisation-, productivity-, and consolidation-led story for enterprises and conglomerates with multiple business units
* Coordinate and facilitate the involvement of cross-functional GitLab team members, including sales leadership, marketing, product, legal, and support, to progress opportunities and deliver an excellent customer experience
* Prepare activity and forecast reports, contribute to forecasting and pipeline reviews, and share root cause analysis and lessons learned from wins and losses with account managers, marketing, and technical teams
* Act as the voice of the customer by contributing product ideas to our public issue tracker, and by preparing and delivering customer-facing and internal presentations, quotes, proposals, and formal sales documents that address BFSI and enterprise business challenges and clearly communicate long-term value and outcomes.

**What You'll Bring**

* Deep experience driving complex B2B software sales cycles with large enterprise customers, ideally in DevSecOps, software development tools, or adjacent SaaS and infrastructure solutions that support the software development lifecycle
* A track record selling into BFSI institutions in India, with an understanding of their buying behaviour, long evaluation cycles, vendor risk assessments, and procurement processes (experience across both BFSI and large enterprises or conglomerates is a strong plus)
* Ability to prospect, build pipeline, and close new business while expanding strategic relationships within large accounts across Mumbai
* Strong understanding of modern software delivery, including CI/CD, secure development practices (DevSecOps, supply chain security), and cloud and infrastructure modernisation, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes
* Working familiarity with the regulatory and compliance landscape for Indian financial institutions, including data residency, audit, and security expectations, and comfort discussing on-premises, private cloud, and hybrid deployment models
* Proven ability to navigate and influence complex organisations, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders such as CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, heads of engineering, and technology risk and compliance leaders
* Experience creating and executing account plans for priority accounts, including opportunity mapping, multi-threaded engagement, and disciplined deal and account management
* Experience working with system integrators and channel partners to co-sell and deliver in the Indian market
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, including comfort leading customer presentations, negotiations, and executive-level conversations, and coordinating internal resources to move opportunities forward
* Capacity to work autonomously and asynchronously in a fully remote environment while staying aligned to shared goals, processes, and forecasting expectations across the broader GitLab team, with the flexibility to meet customers in person across Mumbai
* Familiarity with forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and reporting, including sharing learnings from wins and losses to improve repeatable sales motions

**Some examples of our projects**

* Building and growing a territory plan for Mumbai that balances large BFSI institutions (banks, NBFCs, insurers, asset managers, payments and fintech) with high-potential enterprises and conglomerates, from new logo prospecting through long-term expansion on GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform
* Leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and partnering with Solutions Architects, Sales Development, Customer Success, system integrators, and channel partners to position GitLab as a trusted platform for modern software delivery, security, and compliance in regulated and large-scale environments
* Helping BFSI customers consolidate fragmented toolchains and modernise legacy delivery pipelines while meeting regulatory, audit, and data-residency expectations

**About The Team**
The Strategic Account Executive will join our enterprise sales team, which focuses on driving GitLab adoption with large customers in the India market. The team is responsible for the full relationship lifecycle with enterprise accounts, from initial engagement through long-term expansion and advocacy, ensuring customers realize value from GitLab’s DevSecOps platform. Team members work in an all-remote, distributed environment and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with sales leadership, solutions architects, customer success, marketing, and channel partners. The team is currently focused on maintaining and growing our existing footprint in the region, executing a consistent global sales motion while adapting to local customer needs and partnering closely with strategic channel organizations to reach and support key accounts.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off

* Growth and Development Fund

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. title: Business Development Consultant
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for an experienced, driven and commercially sharp
**Business Development & Growth Consultant**
who can take ownership of new business acquisition, strategic partnerships and revenue growth at Social Square Media.

This isn't a traditional lead generation role. We're looking for someone who understands the advertising and marketing industry, knows how to identify the right brands, can get conversations started with decision-makers and, most importantly,
**convert those conversations into long-term business relationships**
.

The ideal person should be comfortable working independently, building sales pipelines, negotiating commercials, developing pitches and using AI-powered tools and automations to make business development more efficient and scalable.

We're looking for someone who can eventually become an integral part of the company's growth and leadership, rather than simply working on a list of leads.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Client Acquisition**

Take end-to-end ownership of business development, from prospecting and outreach to negotiations and closures.

Identify and acquire clients across
**FMCG, F&B, hospitality, sports, healthcare, wellness, fashion, beauty, lifestyle and consumer brands**
.

Develop relationships with founders, CEOs, CMOs, marketing heads and other key decision-makers.

Identify brands actively seeking marketing agencies, creative partners, social media management and digital marketing services.

Build a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects with genuine business potential.

Handle introductory conversations, discovery calls, client meetings and commercial discussions.

Convert qualified opportunities into retainer-based clients, projects and long-term partnerships.

Explore opportunities for larger agency mandates, integrated campaigns and strategic brand partnerships.

**2. AI-Powered Lead Generation & Automation**

Build and manage intelligent lead generation systems using
**AI tools, CRM platforms, automation workflows and prospecting software**
.

Use tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay, ChatGPT, Make, n8n and other relevant platforms.

Set up automated workflows to identify prospective clients, monitor buying signals and track new business opportunities.

Research brands expanding into new markets, launching products, hiring marketing teams or actively looking for agency partners.

Develop personalised outreach campaigns across email, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

Automate lead enrichment, follow-up tracking, CRM updates and reporting wherever appropriate.

Continuously optimise lead quality, outreach effectiveness and conversion rates.

**3. International Business Development**

Identify and approach potential international clients, particularly in markets such as the
**UAE, UK, US and other relevant regions**
.

Research international brands looking to outsource social media, creative, content production and digital marketing services.

Build relationships with international founders, marketing teams and agencies.

Explore white-label partnerships and agency-to-agency collaborations.

Manage international prospecting, outreach, discovery calls and proposal discussions.

Identify new markets and sectors where the agency can build a competitive presence.

**4. Pitching, Proposals & Negotiations**

Work closely with the Founder and creative/strategy teams to develop compelling pitches and proposals.

Understand client briefs, business objectives, marketing challenges and budget expectations.

Contribute commercially and strategically to pitch decks, credentials presentations and service proposals.

Lead client presentations and discussions wherever required.

Negotiate retainers, project fees, deliverables and commercial terms.

Maintain a strong understanding of agency pricing, profitability and scope management.

Follow through on proposals, negotiations and approvals to ensure timely closures.

**5. Revenue Growth & Business Strategy**

Develop and execute a structured business development strategy with clear monthly and quarterly targets.

Identify new revenue streams, service offerings, partnerships and market expansion opportunities.

Build a predictable pipeline of recurring retainer revenue.

Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing client relationships.

Monitor conversion rates, sales cycles, pipeline value and revenue generated.

Work closely with the Founder on long-term growth plans and business expansion.

Contribute to building scalable systems that support the agency's next phase of growth.

**6. Ownership & Leadership**

Operate with a high level of independence and accountability.

Take ownership of the business development function rather than waiting for day-to-day instructions.

Build systems, processes and reporting structures that can scale with the agency.

Coordinate with internal teams to ensure a smooth transition from client acquisition to onboarding.

Help shape the agency's commercial direction, positioning and growth strategy.

Demonstrate the ability to eventually lead the business development vertical and take on broader commercial leadership responsibilities.

**What We're Looking For**

**1-3 years of relevant experience**
in business development, agency sales, growth consulting or strategic partnerships.

Previous experience working with a
**digital marketing, advertising, creative, branding or PR agency**
is strongly preferred.

A solid understanding of how marketing agencies operate, pitch, price and acquire clients.

Proven experience in generating leads and converting them into paying clients.

Existing industry relationships and professional networks would be a significant advantage.

Experience working with brands across FMCG, food, hospitality, sports, healthcare and lifestyle sectors.

Strong understanding of AI-powered prospecting, sales automation and CRM systems.

Ability to independently handle discovery calls, client presentations and commercial negotiations.

Experience with international client acquisition or cross-border business development is an advantage.

Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills and understanding of profitability.

Excellent communication, relationship-building and presentation skills.

Self-motivated, resourceful, organised and comfortable working with clear revenue targets.

**What Success Looks Like**

We're looking for someone who can deliver measurable business outcomes, including:

A consistent pipeline of relevant, qualified leads.

Regular meetings with founders and senior marketing decision-makers.

Strong pitch-to-conversion rates.

New monthly retainer clients and project opportunities.

Growth in recurring agency revenue.

Expansion into new sectors and international markets.

An efficient, AI-enabled business development process.

A scalable acquisition system that does not depend entirely on the Founder.

**The focus is on conversions and revenue, not simply the number of leads generated or emails sent.**

**Growth & Long-Term Opportunity**

We're looking to build a long-term association with someone who sees the potential in growing an agency and wants to be actively involved in making that happen.

For the right individual, this role could evolve beyond consultancy into a
**senior leadership or business growth partnership position**
.

Based on performance, consistent revenue contribution, long-term alignment and demonstrated ownership, we would also be open to exploring
**profit-sharing, performance-linked incentives or potential equity participation in the company**
at a later stage.

Any such arrangement would be subject to mutual agreement, performance evaluation and separately agreed commercial and legal terms.

**The Person We'd Love to Work With**

Someone who doesn't need to be told which brands to approach, how to find the right people or when to follow up.

Someone who understands that business development is not about sending 100 generic emails a day, but about finding the right opportunities, building genuine relationships and knowing how to close them.

We're looking for someone who can walk into a meeting, understand a brand's business challenges, confidently present solutions, negotiate the commercials and bring the business home.

**More than a consultant, we're looking for someone with an entrepreneurial mindset who wants to build, grow and eventually help lead something bigger.**

description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.
* Experience translating customer objectives into integrated cloud solutions across multiple domains.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data management, data analytics, Cloud AI, networking, migrations, security.
* Experience managing the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, or penetration testing).

**About the job**
-----------------

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business issues. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business issues. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.

You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration testing within existing ones as a technical generalist. You will blend sales prowess, market knowledge and direct technical engagement.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting specific sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture to show the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through demos, pilots, and in-depth workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration, or implementation phases.
